data.title: Software Development Manager
data.description:
Overview

At Radancy, we develop products and solutions that transform the way millions of people find work. We are pushing the recruitment industry's technological boundaries and looking for curious minds to join our diverse team. Our expanding engineering hub in Bangalore is a critical part of our global operations, driving innovation and excellence in talent acquisition technologies. We are seeking an experienced Software Development Manager to lead our engineering operations in Bangalore, India, with a focus on hiring, managing, and developing top engineering talent to support our mission. 

Responsibilities: 

- Lead Recruitment and Talent Acquisition: Drive the hiring process for engineering roles in Bangalore, developing strategies to attract and retain exceptional talent in a competitive market. 
 - Manage Engineering Teams: Oversee and mentor engineering teams, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement while ensuring effective team structures. 
 - Hands-on Development: Work as part of Agile team developing and releasing roadmap requirements. You will have hands on experience of developing software using C# / . Net Core. 
 - Software Architectural Patterns: Lead the design and development of robust software solutions, ensuring alignment with architectural best practices and compliance standards. 
 - Oversee Onboarding: Manage the onboarding process for new hires, ensuring seamless integration into the team and alignment with Radancy's values and goals. 
 - Enhance Operational Efficiency: Implement and refine engineering processes and best practices to boost productivity, streamline workflows, and ensure teams have the tools and resources they need. 
 - Collaborate Globally: Work closely with distributed teams, including Product, Engineering, and Operations, to align engineering efforts with company objectives and facilitate cross-team communication. 
 - Report and Communicate: Provide regular updates to senior management on team performance, operational status, and key milestones, while adapting to global time zones as needed. Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience in a technical environment). 
 - Minimum of 5 years of experience in engineering management or operations, ideally within a software development setting. 
 - Proven expertise in C#/. Net Core, MVC, SQL Server, MongoDB. 
 - Proven expertise in software architecture and design patterns
 - Proven track record of hiring and managing engineering teams, with success in building high-performing, collaborative groups. 
 - Strong understanding of software development methodologies (e. g. , Agile) and experience implementing operational best practices. 
 - Exceptional leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate, mentor, retain, and develop team members. 
 - Experience and flexibility to work with distributed teams across diverse cultures and time zones. 
 - Excellent organizational and problem-solving abilities, with a knack for managing multiple priorities under pressure. 
 - Flexibility to adapt to varying work schedules, including potential coordination with global teams in regions like Europe and North America. Join the global leader in talent acquisition technologies that's committed to finding new ways to leverage software, strategy, and creativity to enhance our clients' employer brands-across every connection point. We're looking for unconventional thinkers. Relentless collaborators. And ferocious innovators. If you're an experienced Engineering Operations Manager with a passion for building great teams and driving operational excellence, we want to hear from you. 

Work Location and Interview Process: 

- Hybrid Work Model: This is a hybrid position, requiring you to work in the Bengaluru office 3 times per week. 
 - Interview Process: As part of the interview process, candidates will be required to complete and pass a technical coding assessment to demonstrate proficiency in key development skills. Company Values: At Radancy, we are dedicated to the core values that guide our work and culture: 

- Innovative Spirit Innovation leads the way. We have a rich history of developing and delivering what's new and next while valuing every voice on our team. Together, we're shaping the future and leading the industry forward. 
 - Rewarding Impact Work that matters. We strengthen organizations with transformative software that connects people around the world to meaningful careers. This work makes a difference in people's lives and inspires our team to advance technology with purpose. 
 - Performance Driven Success drives results. We use data and insights to inform strategy and maximize performance for our customers, all backed by our global teams committed to exceeding expectations with unmatched expertise and support. 
 - Supportive Teams Collaboration is our backbone. We foster an environment that inspires our team members to deliver industry-defining technology. We empower our teams to learn from each other, grow their skills and create positive change in their work and communities. Radancy is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We actively work to create an inclusive environment where all of our employees can thrive. If you require any accommodations during the application process, please reach out to us at recruiting@radancy. com , and we will work with you to meet your needs.

data.title: Software Engineer - Backend Focus
data.description:
About the job: 

We're hiring a Software Engineer - Backend to build and ship production backend systems across real client and internal use cases. You'll design APIs and services, build reliable data-backed applications, and own them in production. This is a full-time, work-from-office role in Hyderabad. 

About us: 

We're a new age tech & business services company, HQ'ed in Hyderabad with clients across the world. Find out more at https: //www. linkedin. com/company/gitforce

What You'll Do

TL; DR: Build and run the backend systems behind real products. 

- Design and build backend services and APIs in Python using FastAPI
 - Design data models and work with SQL and PostgreSQL
 - Build async, scalable services, background jobs, and data pipelines
 - Integrate with third-party APIs, databases, and services
 - Write well-tested, maintainable code with clear documentation

Qualifications

TL; DR: Strong backend engineering fundamentals in Python and FastAPI, with production experience. 

You Are: 

- 2 to 5 years into your professional engineering career
 - A strong backend engineer who has built and shipped production services
 - Someone who cares about reliable, well-tested production systems
 - Comfortable picking up new frameworks and tools quickly
 - Someone who enjoys owning a system end to end, not just isolated tickets

Must-haves: 

- Strong Python, with production experience building APIs in FastAPI
 - Solid SQL and PostgreSQL, including schema design, indexing, and query optimization
 - Experience with async programming, Pydantic, and an ORM (SQLAlchemy or similar)
 - Good grasp of API design (REST), authentication, software architecture, Git, testing (pytest), and production engineering fundamentals
 - Strong problem-solving and communication skills

Nice-to-haves: 

- Redis, message queues (Celery, RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS), or distributed systems
 - Docker, CI/CD, and cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
 - Observability, logging, and monitoring tools
 - Experience integrating LLM APIs or building RAG/AI features
 - Some frontend experience (React, Next. js, TypeScript)

data.title: Service Delivery Manager - Performance & Continuous Improvement
data.description:
BUREAU VERITAS | HR SHARED SERVICES HUB, NOIDA

Service Delivery Manager - Performance & Continuous Improvement

Intelligent Command Centre (ICC) & Transformation Lead - all towers

Tower

Cross-tower: Performance, Governance & Continuous Improvement

Location

Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

Reports to

HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

Role type

People manager

Scope

Intelligent Command Centre, SLA and KPI governance, continuous improvement portfolio, transition PMO support and hub quality management

Grade

About The Hub

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards. 

ROLE PURPOSE

You are the hub's performance and improvement engine. You will build the Intelligent Command Centre that gives leaders one real-time view of service health across every tower. You will also run the continuous improvement system that moves the hub from stable operations to best-in-class service. 

Key Responsibilities

- Transition and shared services set-up
 - Design the hub's performance framework: a KPI tree, SLA definitions, data sources and a reporting cadence shared by all towers. 
 - Capture and certify the pre-transition baselines for each country, so the hub can prove its value against the starting point. 
 - Support the transition PMO with readiness scorecards, go/no-go dashboards and hypercare tracking for every wave. 
 - Set up the Intelligent Command Centre, covering architecture, data pipelines, dashboards and alerting. 
 - Process ownership and service delivery
 - Run the ICC day to day, with real-time SLA, volume, backlog and escalation monitoring across R2P, R2H, Q2R and A2W. 
 - Lead the hub's governance rhythm: daily stand-ups, weekly tower reviews, monthly service reviews and quarterly business reviews with stakeholders. 
 - Own the hub-wide customer voice programme, including CSAT and NPS surveys, closing the loop with respondents, and reporting insight. 
 - Run hub-level capacity and productivity analytics to support resourcing decisions. 
 - Governance, risk and controls
 - Own the hub quality management system, covering process documentation standards, internal quality audits and control testing across towers. 
 - Maintain the hub risk register and the tracking of issues and actions. 
 - Build data governance for performance reporting so that there is one version of the truth. 
 - Continuous improvement and digital
 - Build and govern the hub-wide continuous improvement backlog. Prioritise by value and effort, and agree ownership with each GPO. 
 - Lead improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma and process mining. Track benefits through to realised savings. 
 - Run the hub's automation and AI pipeline, from idea intake to business case, delivery and benefits tracking. 
 - Build a continuous improvement culture through training, recognition and a simple way for every employee to raise ideas. 
 - People leadership, performance and culture
 - Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave. 
 - Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state. 
 - Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings. 
 - Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots. 
 - Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day. 
 - Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers. 

What Success Looks Like

- First 90 days: hub KPI framework, baseline method and ICC design signed off. 
 - By go-live: ICC live with real-time dashboards for the first transition wave, and the governance rhythm running. 
 - Within 12-18 months: continuous improvement portfolio delivering measurable, validated benefits, with hub-wide dashboards trusted by global stakeholders. 

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

KPI

Indicative target

Hub-wide SLA adherence

≥ 95% across towers

Validated CI Benefits

Annual savings and hours released against target

Automation hours released

Increased year on year

Reporting timeliness and accuracy

100% on schedule

Hub CSAT / NPS

At or above target

Audit and quality findings

Closed within agreed timelines

CI participation

% of employees who submitted or delivered an improvement

Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines. 

Technical Skills

- Performance management and command-centre design for multi-tower shared services. 
 - Lean Six Sigma methods, including DMAIC, value-stream mapping and root-cause analysis. 
 - Data analytics and visualisation (Power BI or Tableau). SQL or data-modelling skills are an advantage. 
 - Process mining (Celonis, Signavio or similar) and automation pipeline management (RPA, AI). 
 - ITIL service level management and quality management systems. 
 - Benefits realisation and business case development. 

LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES

Customer-centric leadership

- Builds teams from zero
 - Drives change and adoption
 - Sound judgement under pressure
 - Influences without authority across countries
 - Data-led decision making
 - Coaches and develops talent
 - Holds a high bar on control

Essential

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

- 15+ years of experience, including 7+ years in shared services performance, excellence or transformation roles. 
 - Has built and run an ICC, command centre or equivalent governance function. 
 - Has deployed continuous improvement frameworks across multi-tower shared services centres. 
 - Lean Six Sigma Black Belt. 
 - Master's degree in Business, HR, Engineering or a related field. 

Preferred

- Transition PMO experience
 - Process mining certification
 - Change management certification (Prosci or equivalent)

KEY STAKEHOLDERS

Hub Director, all tower GPOs, Global HR leadership, HR technology and data teams, Finance, Internal Audit, transformation partners.

data.title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - Senior Vice President
data.description:
Role Overview: 

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Lead Forward Deployed Engineer in Chennai to act as an evangelist for continuous integration, testing, and safe, automated deployments and to coordinate the activities of the regionally deployed FDE team. This is a practical DevOps and SRE role for a practitioner who leads by example to make change safe and easy for development teams. The position is roughly 70% coding and configuration. 

Key Responsibilities

- Conduct targeted engagements with development teams facing challenges getting to safe and rapid release cadence, or struggling with vulnerability resolution. 
 - Perform hands-on work including, but not limited to: 
 - Wrapping the application in a suite of well-designed tests, most of which can run locally, including smoke tests to be run as part of the deployment process. 
 - Sourcing and integrating appropriate test data, implementing data masking in lower environments 
 - Upgrading to supported runtimes (generally Java or NPM). 
 - Containerizing applications where feasible. 
 - Upgrading open-source libraries to their latest available major versions (e. g. , migrating from Spring 2). Upgrading to the latest version of all dependencies, whether installed software, libraries, internal code, base images or operating system. Implementing processes that allow us seamlessly to stay current 
 - Implementing continuous library updates using Renovate. 
 - Introducing best practice source control and branch management 
 - Improving code review processes 
 - Ensuring best practice security patterns, secrets management, authentication and authorisation 
 - Simplifying and automating application deployment processes, including automated database changes with Liquibase and installed software with Ansible. 
 - Introducing standard observability patterns. 
 - Overhauling exception handling and logging. 
 - Implementing resilient hot-hot cross-datacenter deployment topologies. 

Required Qualifications

- Several years of experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD) using multiple test frameworks. 
 - Really excellent understanding of the different approaches to automation testing and an ability to choose the best approach and drive outcomes with AI support 
 - Proficiency in JVM languages and optionally TypeScript. 
 - Highest quality coding skills 
 - An excellent understanding of safe practices for critical systems, including deployment architecture and observability 
 - At home with multiple continuous integration and deployment systems 
 - Excellent understanding of secure coding practices 
 - Competent with Docker and Openshift 
 - Actively embracing AI coding 
 - Comfortable with build automation tools such as Gradle, Maven, and npm. 
 - Competent with (RedHat) Linux 
 - Spring framework skills are advantageous. 
 - Ansible skills are advantageous

Recommended Qualifications: 

- 12+ years of relevant experience
 - Experience in applications development
 - Experience in management
 - Experience managing global technology teams
 - Working knowledge of industry practices and standards
 - Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication

This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining automated testing solutions while leveraging Generative AI and emerging AI tools to accelerate test design, test creation, execution, and analysis.

This individual will partner closely with Development, DevOps, and QA teams to ensure high-quality software delivery while advancing AI-enabled testing capabilities across the organization. 

As a Quality Assurance Analyst at Infor, you will have a critical role in ensuring the delivery of high-quality enterprise applications that meet the evolving needs of our global customers. You'll collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and customer success teams to validate functionality, performance, and scalability-helping us deliver smarter, faster, and more intuitive software.

data.title: Senior Enterprise Software Engineer
data.description:
Wolters Kluwer is seeking a motivated and talented DevSecOps Senior Engineer to join our dynamic team. This is an exciting opportunity for an individual with hands-on experience in mature software engineering and a DevSecOps environment to further develop their skills and make a meaningful impact within a forward-thinking organization. As a DevSecOps Senior Engineer, you will play a crucial role in supporting our engineering team, contributing to the development, maintenance, and enhancement of our enterprise cloud platform. 

In this role, you will be responsible for working closely with various stakeholders, including our experienced engineering team, Cloud Operations, Security, Compliance, and other key partners. Your primary focus will be on engineering practices to streamline our software development processes, enhance efficiency, and ensure the reliability and scalability of our cloud platform. You will gain hands-on experience with a variety of DevSecOps tools and application and platform technologies, helping to build and maintain our continuous integration and delivery pipelines, infrastructure as code, and automated deployment processes. 

You will be involved in a wide range of tasks, including application and platform automation, infrastructure management, monitoring, and performance optimization. Your foundational understanding of application and platform engineering concepts, practices, and tools will be critical as you contribute to the implementation of best practices and the optimization of our platform workflows. You will have the opportunity to learn from and collaborate with seasoned professionals, gaining valuable insights and experience that will help you grow in your career. 

As a DevSecOps Senior Engineer, you will be expected to actively participate in the design, development, and deployment of our cloud applications. You will work on projects that require keen attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality. Your ability to collaborate effectively with team members and communicate clearly will be essential in ensuring the successful delivery of our application and platform solutions. 

This position offers a fantastic opportunity for growth and career development within a supportive and innovative environment. You will have the chance to work with state-of-the-art technologies, be part of a collaborative and high-performing team and make a significant impact on our organization's success. If you are passionate about engineering and eager to take your career to the next level, we encourage you to apply and join our team at Wolters Kluwer. 

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

- Support architecture for complex applications ensuring they meet business requirements. 
 - Implement best practices in coding with support of AI
 - IaC-first approach to managing cloud infrastructure using Terraform and an opinionated IaC Framework standard. 
 - Transform manual processes using automation. 
 - Perform the deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of platforms. 
 - Conduct work activities using SRE principles, such as resilience, metrics, capacity planning, toil, Incident management and security
 - Manage cloud infrastructure and services in Azure and AWS
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams (developers, operations, QA, etc. ). 
 - Communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Implement and Manage Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines. 
 - Develop scripts and tools to improve operational efficiency. 
 - Build and help transform container and serverless architectures, such as AKS (Azure Kubernetes Service), EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Services), Docker and Azure Functions. 
 - Ensure software and platforms comply with security standards and regulations. 
 - Implement security best practices and conduct regular security assessments. 
 - Adhere to access controls and protect sensitive data. 
 - Document processes, procedures, and infrastructure setups. 
 - Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends. 
 - Continuously improve systems, processes, and methodologies. 
 - Participate in project planning and execution. 
 - Ensure projects are completed on time and within budget. 
 - Understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions. 
 - Engage with stakeholders to gather feedback and refine requirements. 
 - Ensure customer satisfaction through reliable and high-quality deliverables. 
 - Explore generative AI technologies to enhance software capabilities. 
 - Deploy AI models for automated content generation and predictive analytics. 

Other Duties

- Performs other duties as assigned by management
 - On call rotation responsibilities with the Service Delivery and Operations Team

Job Qualifications & Experience

Requirements: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field
 - Minimum 1 year of experience with AI and Generative AI technologies or equivalent
 - Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in the DevSecOps engineering discipline, prefer enterprise engineering experience or equivalent 
 - Experience with Application and Infrastructure Operations
 - Proficiency in scripting languages (e. g. , Bash, Python) for automation tasks and infrastructure management. 
 - In-depth knowledge of programming frameworks (e. g. , . NET, JAVA) and application development. 
 - Extensive experience with Terraform for infrastructure as code (IaC) management, including writing and maintaining modules. 
 - Proficiency with CI/CD tools and practices (e. g. , Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions), including creating and managing pipelines. 
 - Comprehensive experience with cloud platforms (e. g. , Azure, AWS), including designing and implementing cloud services and architecture. Azure is strongly preferred. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment, ensuring platform reliability and scalability. 

Thought Leadership and Soft skills: 

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a willingness to learn and contribute to team success. 

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Razorpay is one of India's leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we've since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India's digital payment revolution. 

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow. 

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that's redefining how money moves across Asia. 

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India's largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently. 

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India's unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region. 

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

Learning is a lifestyle - if you're curious, you'll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. data.title: Software Engineering Manager, Agentic Transformation for Graphics Systems
data.description:
Agents are changing how all software will be built. Agentic systems can perform substantial engineering work. It is still unproven whether they can be a reliable production capability at graphics systems' quality standards. Meanwhile, teams continue shipping new features, sustaining platforms, and meeting product commitments. Graphics drivers are a difficult proving ground. They involve large codebases, complex hardware-OS interactions, strict performance demands, broad application compatibility, and formal safety obligations in automotive. 

NVIDIA seeks an engineering manager in India to develop a new framework for agentic software development. You will test this model against one of our most fast-paced production software stacks. You will lead a graphics systems team through this transition and continue delivering the necessary product roadmap. Afterwards, you will transform effective practices into a reusable engineering product for other teams. You will grow the people, technology, and operating model together, creating an ambitious, highly engaged team that uses agents to surpass typical capacity. Success goes beyond one team's transformation; it establishes a production-proven system for software development in the agentic era at NVIDIA. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Develop and launch an end-to-end production model for agentic software development. Apply it to graphics systems, where agents perform engineering tasks from requirements and diagnosis to implementation, validation, review, and release. 
 - Define the technical strategy and transformation roadmap, turning fast paced agentic capabilities into dependable production execution and steadily growing the work agents complete end to end. 
 - Keep the team delivering its must-do graphics and display roadmap. This includes new features, platform enablement, performance, stability, and release commitments. At the same time, fundamentally evolve how that work gets done.

data.title: Lead Software Engineer, Real Time Index Engineering(Java)
data.description:
FTSE Russell is a leading global provider of financial services, specialising in the creation and management of indexes, data, and analytic solutions. As part of the London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG), we support investors worldwide in making informed decisions across asset classes, investment strategies, and market segments. Our products are trusted by institutional and retail investors, asset managers, and pension funds to benchmark performance, build investment portfolios, and manage risk. 

Job Summary

We're seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the team building the Real Time Framework (RTF), our low-latency, cloud-native platform for calculating, managing and distributing FTSE Russell's real-time indices at global scale, spanning Equity, Fixed Income and Multi-Asset coverage. Reliability, security, and data quality are non-negotiable as we modernise the platform that underpins our entire real-time franchise. 

The ideal candidate is a self-sufficient, technically excellent engineer who can lead through architectural clarity, thorough code review, and hands-on delivery. You combine strong expertise in low-latency, event-driven system design, data modelling, and debugging with genuine passion for how AI tooling is redefining software engineering. This is an individual contributor role where you will lead through the quality of your thinking and your engineering standards. 

AI-First Engineering This team operates with an AI-first approach. We expect hands-on experience with AI development tooling: terminal-based agents, AI-augmented IDEs, and automated workflows. You are ultimately accountable for production quality, security, and correctness. This means owning infrastructure review, security validation, system observability, and operational guardrails. 

What You'll Do

- Build low-latency, event-driven calculation engines that price indices accurately through market events. 
 - Operate a cloud-native, horizontally scalable, always-on platform, built as resilient and managed through infrastructure as code. 
 - Own data foundations for real-time market and reference data, with strong modelling, quality and auditability. 
 - Deliver secure APIs and streaming, event-driven distribution that make real-time index data easy to consume. 
 - Help bring advanced and multi-asset methodologies to market (e. g. volatility-controlled, options/futures-based, long-short). 
 - Modernise the operations experience: replace manual workflows with intuitive tooling and observability. 
 - Lead through architecture, code review and test strategy, partnering across product, operations and client-facing teams. 

Tech Stack

- Development: Java, C#, , Python, SQL, OpenAPI
 - Cloud: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, SQS, SNS, Aurora, and others as required)
 - Databases: Sybase ASE, Sybase IQ, Aurora Postgres
 - IaC and CI/CD: Terraform, AWS CLI, GitLab
 - AI Development: Agentic AI tooling (e. g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code)

Experience We Value

- 9+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Strong expertise in system design, distributed and event-driven systems, and relational data modelling. 
 - Solid experience building and operating cloud-native applications on AWS. 
 - Ability to write and maintain infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent). 
 - Experience designing test strategies at multiple levels of the testing pyramid. 
 - Proficiency with AI development tooling and a clear understanding of how to use AI to accelerate delivery while maintaining quality. 
 - Strong debugging skills across distributed systems. 
 - Basic understanding of financial services or capital markets. 
 - Effective collaboration and the ability to communicate technical decisions to non-technical audiences. 

How We Work

The Real Time team builds and operates the platform that calculates, manages and distributes FTSE Russell's real-time indices to the global financial ecosystem. We foster a culture of engineering excellence, solving real-world problems with purpose and ambition. We're looking for skilled and passionate engineers to drive the future of modern solutions working with leading AI development tools. 

- Build with purpose. Start with why. Define the problem before reaching for a solution. 
 - Customer driven. Work backwards from client needs and build products to address real-world problems.

 - Lead with data. Validate assumptions, stay close to the details, act decisively.

data.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer Manager
data.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a senior, hands-on mechanical engineering leader to manage the engineering team and own final technical quality control across our engineering workstreams. These include CAD and engineering design data, simulation load cases, and reviews of FEA and CFD work used in AI development. 

You will assess whether deliverables are technically sound, supported by evidence, and ready for client delivery. The role combines broad engineering judgment with detailed technical review, guidance for engineers and external partners, and ownership of consistent quality standards as delivery scales. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own final technical review and sign-off across workstreams; identify critical issues, request corrections, and verify their resolution before delivery. 

• Review CAD models, assemblies, drawings, design changes, and engineering rationale for functional validity, consistency, and manufacturability. 

• Evaluate FEA and CFD simulation assumptions, material properties, loads, boundary conditions, mesh quality, results, and relevant modelling choices; assess convergence, physical plausibility, and whether conclusions are supported. 

• Review load-case definitions and engineering workflows for realistic use scenarios, clear documentation, and traceability between requirements, models, and outputs. 

• Define acceptance criteria and review checklists, resolve technical disagreements, and involve specialist reviewers where deeper domain expertise is needed. 

• Manage and mentor engineers, assess vendor and freelancer capability, and improve review processes to increase throughput while maintaining quality. 

• Communicate directly with customers to clarify technical requirements, discuss review findings, and explain risks and limitations; align with project leads on delivery readiness. 

REQUIREMENTS

• Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline, with 6+ years of relevant industry experience and demonstrated technical leadership at lead or head of engineering level. 

• Experience working with international teams and coordinating quality across multiple projects and external partners. 

• Strong foundations in design, engineering and manufacturing, supported by experience solving real industrial engineering problems. 

• Hands-on expertise in CAD and FEA, with sufficient breadth to evaluate CFD work alongside specialists and recognise the limits of an analysis. 

• Experience reviewing and approving other engineers' work, challenging assumptions, and making defensible technical decisions. 

• Proficiency in relevant CAD and simulation tools, such as SolidWorks, Ansys, Abaqus, Fluent, or Simcenter.

data.title: Senior CPU Verification Engineer
data.description:
CPU Random Tools Engineer - Grade 4

Introduction to Arm

You know us. With 125 Arm-powered products shipped every second, we'll be in over a trillion smart devices by 2035. Your smartphone, award-winning VR gaming, the world's fastest supercomputer - our engineers are crafting the sophisticated core processors leading the race towards a connected, autonomous, hyper-performance future. 

ARM designs the technology that is at the heart of sophisticated digital products, from wireless, networking and consumer entertainment solutions to imaging, automotive, security and storage devices. ARM improves people's lives by enabling the intelligence in affordable, easy-to-use electronic products that transform the way we live and work. We work in partnership with a global network of leading technology companies which are using our smart low-power technology. Together we are enabling the future of a better world. 

ARM is well recognized as the market leader in the CPU and System IP industry and this has been achieved by consistently delivering reliable and high quality IP products. The cost of design and manufacturing is high and that warrants "right first time" approach for all IP and System products. Time-to-market is essential for our partners to take care of steadfast competition in the marketplace, being first would enable them to get premium value from the end products. In this context, Design Verification of CPU IPs is an exciting challenge requiring an engineering abilities that is both broad and deep. 

So, we promise you endless exciting opportunities to experiment and go even further in CPU IP design!

Job Description: Role and Responsibilities

As an Engineer responsible for CPU Random Tools for stress verification, you will work on a sophisticated Random Instruction Sequences (RIS) tool. With a combination of techniques, the tool verifies the functionality of our CPU cores, being designed in Austin (US), Cambridge (UK) or Sophia Antipolis (FR). The existing team ensures addition of new architecture features, its customization to specific CPU cores, and provides support. 

You will be based in Arm's Bangalore design centre in India. 

As Senior Verification Engineer, your role will cover the development of the tool from development to deployment, and accountable for: 

- Understanding the intricacies of the CPU micro-architecture and defining how to push the test boundaries; 
 - Architect and develop solutions to improve the generation of stimuli to produce programs to stress our next generation CPUs; 
 - Implementing and supporting the tool, from the early stages of CPU development to product maturity. 

Job Requirements

- Problem Ownership and ability to work from abstract requirements 
 - Good communication and presentation skills 
 - Self-motivated and willing to take up additional responsibilities 
 - Quick learner with a strong desire to learn and develop new skills

Qualification And Experience

- B. Tech/B. S. or MTech/M. S. in Computer/Electronics Engineering or Computer Science from a reputed institute 
 - 5-10 years of stable proven experience with significant project contributions

Crucial Skills

- You hold experience in software design, and should be comfortable working with low-level hardware 
 - You have good solid understanding of programming languages, such as C and Python 
 - You are knowledgeable about CPU architecture and micro-architecture concepts 
 - You are able to understand assembly language (ASM) 
 - You have strong interpersonal skills and ability to work well as part of a team with the willingness to tackle varied technical challenges. 

Desirable Skills

- Fundamentals of Processor Architecture. 
 - Basics of ARM Architecture. 
 - Familiarity with EDA tools and Hardware Design Verification. 

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. 

Equal Opportunities

Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

data.title: Member of Technical Staff
data.description:
About the Company

Grey Machines is a decision intelligence platform: it lets you simulate a strategic decision before you make it. You ask a "what if" question in plain language, and the system builds a working model of that world from scratch, with its actors, feedback loops and delays, grounded in real data and cited evidence. It then plays out thousands of possible futures and shows the range of outcomes, what drives them, and a brief in which every number traces back to its source, in hours rather than the weeks a strategy team would take. It is built for strategy teams, investors and policy makers. 

The Problem

Take a question like "What happens to nickel markets if Indonesia bans ore exports?" or "What does a US-Iran escalation do to oil and LNG?" Answering it well usually takes weeks: a strategy team, a financial model, expert calls and a deck. 

Grey Machines answers it in hours. From one plain-language question, the system builds a model of that world from scratch: the actors, the stocks and flows, the feedback loops and the delays. It grounds the starting values in real data and cited evidence, then runs thousands of Monte Carlo futures, with convergence checks deciding when to stop. What comes back is an interactive causal loop diagram, the range of outcomes, and a written brief in which every number traces back to where it came from. 

It works end to end and is in private beta. Now it has to be correct, fast and reliable at scale. That is the job. 

What You Will Build

You will be the first engineer and the most senior technical person in the room, so the scope is all of engineering. You will make the architecture calls every later engineer builds on, and own the consequences. 

- The simulation core: the ODE solver, the Monte Carlo engine, sensitivity analysis, and the convergence and health checks that decide when a result can be trusted

- The model-building pipeline: frontier LLMs build the model in stages, and deterministic validators and repair loops check every step. The real work is deciding what the LLM can be trusted with, what code has to verify, and how to fail safely. 

- The data and evidence layer: values from sources such as FRED, the academic literature, the web and the documents users bring, with units, ranges and provenance that survive end to end

- The execution layer: long Monte Carlo jobs are checkpointed and resume after a restart, today on one machine. Next they need to be scheduled and run in parallel across many. 

- Production: AWS, deploys, monitoring, tracing and incident response

- The frontend when it needs you: a React 19 app with Canvas 2D and D3 visualisations that make dense quantitative output readable for a strategist, not just a quant

- The engineering bar: testing, review and release discipline, and hiring the team that comes after you

Who You Are

- You have built systems from zero, not just shipped features into existing ones, and lived with your own architecture decisions, including the wrong ones. 

- You are fluent in Bayesian probability and statistics, stochastic processes and numerical methods: ODEs, Monte Carlo and convergence diagnostics. A PhD is not required. Being able to reason about what the numbers mean is. 

- You write production code fast, debug carefully and care when it is wrong. Production experience with Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL and React is required: the codebase is built on them. 

- You have run LLMs in production: structured output, prompt caching, multi-stage pipelines and the failure modes that only show up there. 

- You write clearly. We work remotely and asynchronously, so your design docs and code reviews are how you work. 

Strong Signals

None of these is required. They are backgrounds that tend to fit. 

- A year or two at a quantitative trading firm (Jane Street, Hudson River Trading, Tower Research, Graviton or similar)

- Your own startup, including one that did not work out. We care about what you learned. 

- A maths, CS, physics or statistics degree from a school these firms hire from

- Multi-tenant SaaS or high-throughput compute pipelines

- CTO, Staff or Principal Engineer experience at an early-stage company

What It Is Honestly Like

We are an early-stage startup, and we would rather say so up front. 

- Priorities move. Something you build this month may be thrown away next month because we learned something. 

- There is no team behind you yet. You will check your own blind spots and make calls with incomplete information. 

- Some weeks will feel like a drawdown. We want someone who stays steady through the good weeks and the bad ones, and treats uncertainty as part of the job. 

In return you get real ownership, founder-level say in the product and the company, and a genuinely hard applied-maths problem. Fully remote, flexible hours.

The Core Engineering

Responsibilities

The Core Engineering builds and operates the platforms, applications, data solutions, models, and analytics that power critical processes for The Core divisions of the firm (e. g. , Risk, responsible for the risk profile of firm activities; Controllers, responsible for the financial control and reporting obligations; Compliance, responsible for the firm's compliance, regulatory, and reputational risks; Corporate Treasury, responsible for the firm's liquidity, funding, balance sheet, etc. ; and Human Capital Management, responsible for attracting, developing, and managing a global workforce). A centralized engineering structure in support of The Core enables a common platform model and operating framework that promotes consistent governance and scalable solutions, leveraging cloud, AI, and machine learning for innovation and efficiency. The Core Engineering's 2, 000+ engineers and strats deliver engineering, data, analytics, and quantitative capabilities within six business units: 

- Metrics & Analytics Platforms: responsible for the measurement and management of the firm's risk, capital, and liquidity for The Core functions 
 - The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics 
 - Financials & Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm's financials and a wide range of reporting functions 
 - Non-Financial Risk & Controls: responsible for non-financial risk and control processes 
 - Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement 
 - Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk

YOUR IMPACT

Are you passionate about leveraging cutting-edge AI/ML techniques, including Large Language Models, to solve complex, mission-critical problems in a dynamic environment? Do you want to contribute to safeguarding a leading global financial institution?

OUR IMPACT

We are The Core Engineering, a global team of engineers and scientists dedicated to preventing, detecting, and mitigating regulatory and reputational risks across Goldman Sachs. We build and operate a suite of platforms and applications that protect the firm and its clients. 

We Offer

- Access to petabyte scale of structured and unstructured data to fuel your AI/ML models, including textual data suitable for LLM applications. 
 - The opportunity to work with state-of-the-art LLM models and agentic framework. 
 - A collaborative environment where you can learn from and contribute to a team of experienced engineers and scientists. 
 - The chance to make a tangible impact on the firm's ability to manage risk and maintain its reputation. 

Within Compliance Engineering, we are seeking an experienced AI/ML Engineer to join our Engineering team. This role will focus on solving highly complex business problems using AI/ML techniques, incorporating latest emerging trends om building out vertical AI agents to run on data at massive scale. 

How You Will Fulfill Your Potential

As a member of our team, you will: 

- Design and architect scalable and reliable end-to-end AI/ML solutions specifically tailored for compliance applications, ensuring adherence to relevant regulatory requirements. This encompasses the development and implementation of GenAI-driven solutions, including agentic frameworks for automating compliance processes, RAG pipelines, and the creation and utilization of embeddings for compliance knowledge bases. 
 - Explore diverse AI/ML problems, such as model fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and experimentation with different algorithmic approaches to address novel business challenges. 
 - Develop, test, and maintain high-quality, production-ready code. 
 - Lead technical projects from inception to completion, providing guidance and mentorship to junior engineers. 
 - Collaborate effectively with compliance officers, legal counsel, and other stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. 
 - Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, maintainability, and adherence to coding standards. Promote best practices for AI/ML development, including version control, testing, and documentation. 
 - Stay current with the latest advancements in AI/ML platforms, tools, and techniques to solve business problems. 

Qualifications

A successful candidate will possess the following attributes: 

- A Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, or a similar field of study. 
 - Preferably 7+ years AI/ML industry experience for Bachelor's/Masters, 4+ years for PhD with a focus on Language Models. 
 - Strong foundation in machine learning algorithms, including deep learning architectures (e. g. , transformers, RNNs, CNNs) 
 - Proficiency in Python and relevant libraries/frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, scikit-learn. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in GenAI techniques, including but not limited to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model fine-tuning, prompt engineering, AI agents, and evaluation techniques. 
 - Experience working with embedding models and vector databases. 
 - Experience with MLOps practices, including model deployment, containerization (Docker, kubernetes), CI/CD, and model monitoring. 
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Curiosity, ownership and willingness to work in a collaborative environment. 
 - Proven ability to mentor and guide junior engineers. 

Experience in some of the following is desired and can set you apart from other candidates: 

- Experience with Agentic Frameworks (e. g. , Langchain, AutoGen) and their application to real-world problems. 
 - Understanding of scalability and performance optimization techniques for real-time inference such as quantization, pruning, and knowledge distillation.

As a Principal Software Engineering Manager in Microsoft Defender, you will lead engineers and work across the organization to help build software and improve processes to make our cloud deployments safer, more reliable, and less dependent on manual intervention. 

You will own people development, technical direction, and delivery through your team while contributing hands-on to architecture, code, and production troubleshooting. Working with service teams across Defender, you will advance deployment automation and engineering efficiency by reducing repetitive work and developing reusable solutions to shared operational challenges. 

Responsibilities Include

- Hire, coach, and develop engineers through clear expectations, actionable feedback, performance management, and career growth opportunities. 
 - Set engineering priorities and deliver results through your team, balancing deployment improvements with reliability, security, and ongoing support. 
 - Lead architecture and design for Azure deployment automation and infrastructure tooling, addressing service dependencies, integration boundaries, and failure recovery. 
 - Contribute code, review designs and implementations, and troubleshoot production issues while developing engineers' technical judgment and ownership. 
 - Partner with Defender service teams to automate deployment preparation and validation, reduce manual handoffs, and clarify ownership of tooling and service operation. 
 - Drive engineering efficiency across Defender by identifying recurring deployment and operational work, improving existing workflows, and building reusable automation where it delivers measurable benefit. 
 - Use deployment telemetry and incident learning to measure improvements in reliability and manual effort and guide testing, observability, and safe rollout practices. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field 
 - 10+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience. 
 - Experience managing software engineers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development. 
 - Experience delivering and supporting production software through an engineering team, including prioritization and dependency management. -
 - Ability to explain technical decisions, risks, and alternatives to engineering partners and leaders and resolve competing requirements. 

Other Requirements

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: 

- This position will be required to pass the Microsoft background and Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. 

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

data.title: Head of Solutions & Delivery
data.description:
About the Company

Fineshift is a founder-led technology services company helping enterprise customers solve complex engineering challenges across DevSecOps, Monitoring & Observability, and AI. 

As an independent, bootstrapped company, we prioritise customer outcomes, delivery accountability, and fast decision-making. We are authorised partners of GitLab, IBM, JFrog, Snyk, and AWS, working with large enterprises across banking, financial services, and manufacturing. 

We are at a stage where the leaders we hire will shape our next phase of growth. This is an opportunity to build and scale a technology practice, not simply inherit one. 

About the Role

This is the senior technology leadership position in the company, reporting directly to the CEO. 

You own what we propose to our customers and what we deliver to them. That means owning the technical solution end to end - understanding the requirement, designing the approach, preparing the proposal, defending it in front of the customer, and then standing behind it when it goes into delivery. 

It also means owning the commercial outcome of the technology business and deciding how the technology organisation should be structured as it grows. You will have the mandate to shape the team, the practices, and the technical standards we hold ourselves to. 

We are looking for someone who wants that level of ownership, not someone who wants a defined scope. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own technical solutioning for customer requirements across all three service lines, from discovery and requirement analysis through to the final solution. 
 - Prepare the technical proposal in line with the solution - architecture, approach, effort estimate, assumptions, and risks. 
 - Review and approve any technical proposal prepared by others before it reaches a customer. 
 - Present and defend the solution to the customer - solution walkthroughs, demonstrations, architecture discussions, and workshops. 
 - Act as the senior technical presence in customer conversations, including steering meetings, quarterly reviews, and escalation discussions. 
 - Own customer escalations end to end, including containment, resolution, and written root cause analysis. 
 - Define the right structure for the technology organisation - how solutioning, delivery, and support are organised - and evolve it as the business grows. 
 - Set technical direction for each service line and define the standard engagements are delivered to. 
 - Build and mentor the technical team, including senior technical staff responsible for solution design, estimation, and customer communication. 
 - Grow existing accounts through upsell and cross-sell, and grow the number of engineers deployed at customer sites. 
 - Own the technology P&L - margin per engagement, revenue per deployed engineer, and cost of unassigned capacity. 

Must Have

- 12+ years in technology, including at least 3 years leading a delivery or solutions practice in an IT services or systems-integration company. 
 - Deep expertise in one of DevSecOps, Monitoring & Observability, or AI, with working credibility in the other two. 
 - Strong hands-on solution design and estimation ability - able to architect an engagement and size it accurately before it is sold. 
 - Strong understanding of CI/CD, release management, containers and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure). 
 - Working knowledge of observability tooling - IBM Instana, Prometheus, Grafana, Nagios, or Icinga - along with incident management and root cause analysis. 
 - Familiarity with AI engagement patterns - LLM and agent applications, RAG, on-premise versus cloud trade-offs - enough to scope an engagement without a specialist in the room. 
 - Experience carrying a P&L or a practice margin number, not only a delivery target. 
 - Experience building and leading a technical team across multiple concurrent customer engagements. 
 - Ability to hold a technical discussion with a CIO or customer architect directly, and to handle escalations without escalating them further. 

Good to Have

- Experience in a partner or reseller model, working alongside product vendors. 
 - Enterprise customers in banking, financial services, or manufacturing in India. 
 - Experience growing a technical practice from a small team into a larger one. 
 - Exposure to presales in a services environment - RFP responses, solution defence, and competitive positioning.

About Five9

Five9 is a leading provider of cloud software for the enterprise contact center market, bringing the power of the cloud to thousands of customers and facilitating more than three billion customer interactions annually. Since 2001, Five9 has led the cloud revolution in contact centers, helping organizations transition from legacy premise-based solutions to the cloud. Five9 provides businesses with cloud contact center software that is reliable, secure, compliant and scalable, which is designed to create exceptional customer experiences, increase agent productivity and deliver tangible business results. 

Role Overview

To complement our rapid growth, we are actively sourcing for a Network Engineer to operate in a 24/7 Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment maintaining IP Networking components in a production setting. 

In this role you will: 

- Design, engineer, and oversee highly scalable CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, digital-twin dry-running, and zero-downtime deployment of configurations across massive physical and virtual network fabrics
 - Champion the "Network-as-Code" paradigm, establishing enterprise-wide GitOps workflows and enforcing source control (Git) as the absolute single source of truth for all network state, policy, and infrastructure design
 - Drive the strategic vision for network automation, designing complex, reusable code frameworks and Playbooks to permanently eliminate manual configuration and operational "toil" at a global scale
 - Design and optimize massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and container networking interfaces (CNIs) supporting ultra-high-throughput, multi-region cloud and bare-metal environments
 - Serve as the ultimate technical authority (SME / Tier 4) for complex network, routing, and overlay issues, rapidly deciphering and resolving the most difficult challenges across physical underlays and software-defined layers
 - Design and implement next-generation telemetry, monitoring, and alerting-as-code platforms, leveraging advanced heuristics for proactive auto-remediation of performance, security, and capacity issues

Key Responsibilities

- Partner at a strategic level with Enterprise Designers, SRE leaders, and Platform teams to build and implement highly resilient, secure, and multi-tenant-isolated network infrastructure
 - Establish coding standards and write/review sophisticated Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Ansible, Terraform, Helm, Python, and Bash
 - Lead the engineering, deployment, and optimization of modern overlay and container networking solutions, particularly VXLAN, OVN (Open Virtual Network), and Project Calico
 - Design the automation of complex security and traffic management policies across enterprise-grade firewalls (Palo Alto/Fortinet) and load balancers (F5 BIG-IP/Cloudflare/Octavia)
 - Embed "Security-as-Code" directly into CI/CD pipelines, engineering automated validation gates for security groups, ACLs, and firewall rules prior to production pushes
 - Engineer robust, automated network validation suites to continuously verify network health, state, and complex routing tables (BGP, OSPF) pre- and post-deployment
 - Drive the adoption of code-based infrastructure definitions and dynamic, living technical documentation (e. g. , NetBox, Git Markdown), setting the standard for documentation across the engineering organization

Qualifications & Skills

- 8+ years of progressive experience in Network Engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, with a deeply established focus on large-scale network design, automation, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC)
 - Expert-level proficiency in engineering complex network automation tooling utilizing Ansible, Terraform, and Python (including deep experience with network-specific libraries like Netmiko, Nornir, or NAPALM)
 - Deep design and operational expertise with massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and overlays, specifically VXLAN, OVN, and Project Calico
 - Advanced mastery of Kubernetes networking designs (CNIs, Ingress controllers, Service Mesh, Kube-Proxy behaviors) at an enterprise scale
 - Extensive, expert-level experience engineering and automating enterprise edge, routing, and security fabrics, including Cisco Nexus (9k/7k/5k/2k), Arista, Versa SD-WAN, and firewalls (Palo Alto and Fortinet)
 - Authoritative knowledge of API-driven application delivery and load balancing across monolithic and cloud-native stacks (e. g. , F5 BIG-IP AS3, Cloudflare APIs, Octavia LBaaS)
 - Deep Linux internals and networking expertise, including advanced knowledge of Linux network namespaces, virtual interfaces, eBPF/iptables, and kernel-level routing
 - CCIE-level (or equivalent) mastery of core routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, EVPN) and a comprehensive understanding of how virtual/container overlay networks map to physical underlays
 - Extensive experience designing and scaling CI/CD platforms (e. g. , GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and implementing test-driven development (TDD) for infrastructure changes
 - Unparalleled troubleshooting capabilities utilizing advanced packet analysis (tcpdump/Wireshark), NetFlow, and log aggregation platforms to trace asymmetric routing and microburst traffic across hybrid fabrics
 - Proven track record of technical leadership, including mentoring mid-level engineers, leading design review boards, and driving cross-functional engineering initiatives
 - Deep telecommunications background, specifically VoIP, RTP, SIP peering/trunking, and Session Border Controllers (SBC), is highly advantageous
 - Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to executive stakeholders while fostering a collaborative, DevOps-oriented engineering culture

data.title: Solar Digital Monitoring & IoT Systems - Roofsol Energy
data.description:
Job Description - Solar Digital Monitoring & IoT Systems

Company: Roofsol Energy Pvt. Ltd. 

Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra

Department: Technology / Digital Solutions

Experience: Approximately 10 years

Employment Type: Full-time

About Roofsol Energy

Roofsol Energy Pvt. Ltd. operates in the solar energy sector, developing and managing solar projects across India. The company has invested in multiple solar projects under the OPEX (CAPEX-free / RESCO) business model, where continuous monitoring of generation, plant performance, equipment health, and operational efficiency is essential. 

As part of its technology development strategy, Roofsol Energy intends to establish its own end-to-end solar monitoring ecosystem, including proprietary data loggers, IoT-based data acquisition systems, cloud infrastructure, and a centralized solar generation monitoring platform. The objective is to develop and own the underlying technology and Intellectual Property (IP), while ensuring reliable monitoring and management of a large portfolio of distributed solar projects across India. 

  

Role Overview

Roofsol Energy is looking for an experienced technology professional to lead the conceptualization, design, development, deployment, and maintenance of an in-house solar data logging and generation monitoring system. 

  

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Strategy and Technology Development

·            Define the technology roadmap for Roofsol Energy's proprietary solar monitoring and data acquisition ecosystem. 

·            Lead the end-to-end development of the monitoring platform, from product architecture and prototype development to commercial deployment. 

·            Evaluate appropriate hardware, communication protocols, software frameworks, cloud technologies, and system architectures. 

·            Develop solutions suitable for both small rooftop solar installations and large distributed solar portfolios. 

2. Data Logger and IoT Hardware Development

·            Lead the design, development, prototyping, testing, and deployment of in-house solar data logging equipment. 

·            Develop expertise in integrating inverters, energy meters, weather sensors, and other plant equipment using protocols such as Modbus RTU/TCP, RS485, Ethernet, and MQTT, as applicable. 

·            Ensure reliable data acquisition, local buffering, time synchronization, remote configuration, and recovery during network or power outages. 

·            Establish hardware validation, field testing, quality assurance, and lifecycle management processes. 

3. Cloud Platform and Software Development

·            Lead the architecture and development of a centralized cloud-based solar monitoring platform. 

·            Establish scalable infrastructure for collecting, processing, storing, and analyzing data from hundreds of geographically distributed solar installations. 

·            Oversee the development of dashboards, plant-level monitoring screens, portfolio-level reporting, alerts, notifications, and automated performance reports. 

·            Ensure integration with existing business systems, maintenance workflows, and third-party equipment where required. 

·            Establish high availability, disaster recovery, backup, cybersecurity, and system performance standards. 

  

4. Solar Generation Monitoring and Analytics

·            Develop real-time and historical solar generation monitoring capabilities. 

·            Establish monitoring of energy generation, plant availability, equipment health, communication failures, and performance deviations. 

·            Enable automated alerts for generation losses, inverter faults, abnormal operating conditions, and data gaps. 

·            Support performance analysis through relevant metrics such as specific yield, Performance Ratio (PR), plant availability, and actual-versus-expected generation, where applicable. 

  

5. Intellectual Property and Technology Ownership

·            Build and maintain Roofsol Energy's proprietary technology stack, including hardware designs, firmware, software source code, system architecture, technical documentation, and associated IP. 

·            Establish appropriate IP ownership, confidentiality, source-code control, licensing, and third-party technology compliance practices. 

  

6. Team Leadership and Vendor Management

·            Build and lead a multidisciplinary team covering embedded systems, electronics, firmware, IoT, cloud engineering, software development, and data analytics. 

·            Evaluate and manage technology vendors, hardware manufacturers, system integrators, and development partners. 

  

Candidate Profile

·            Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics & Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, IoT, or a related technical discipline. 

·            Approximately 10 years of relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, industrial data acquisition, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, or related technology domains. 

·            Demonstrated experience in developing and deploying connected hardware and software products, preferably from concept through production and field deployment. 

·            Experience with cloud infrastructure, databases, APIs, cybersecurity, remote device management, and scalable system architecture. 

·            Knowledge of solar PV systems, inverter communications, energy meters, generation monitoring, and renewable energy analytics will be highly advantageous. 

  

  

Why Join Roofsol Energy?

  This is an opportunity to establish a proprietary technology platform from the ground up and take ownership of a strategic digital initiative within the renewable energy sector. The selected professional will have the opportunity to shape the company's technology roadmap, develop in-house IP, and build a scalable monitoring ecosystem supporting a growing portfolio of solar assets across India. 

Interested candidates may share their updated CV highlighting relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, and technology ownership.
