Puma Energy is a leading global energy business that supplies, stores, and distributes petroleum products in 47 countries across six continents. Founded in 1997, Puma Energy has its headquarters in Singapore and Geneva and employs over 8, 000 people globally with regional hubs in South Africa, Puerto Rico, and Estonia and has a Global Delivery Centre in Mumbai (India). 

Puma Energy has a network of 1948 retail sites and a presence at over 103 airports. Our mission is to energize communities to help drive growth and prosperity by sustainably serving our customers' needs in high-potential countries around the world

data.title: Senior GCP & Oracle Cloud DevOps Engineer – Platform & Tools
data.description:
CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER. It's our heritage and it's also our future. Because we don't just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard-when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers. 

We are seeking an experienced Senior GCP & Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) DevOps Engineer to design, implement, and manage secure, scalable, highly available, and resilient cloud infrastructure across Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). 

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in multi-cloud architecture, DevOps practices, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD automation, Kubernetes, cloud networking, observability, and cloud security. You will work closely with development, QA, security, architecture, and operations teams to streamline software delivery, automate infrastructure management, and improve platform reliability across GCP and OCI environments. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available infrastructure across GCP and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). 
 - Design and support multi-cloud architectures, connectivity, and workloads spanning GCP and OCI. 
 - Implement reusable Infrastructure as Code (IaC) modules and automated provisioning using Terraform. 
 - Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Google Cloud Build, OCI DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, and Argo CD. 
 - Deploy and manage containerized applications using Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) and Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE). 
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning, application deployments, configuration management, monitoring, patching, and operational tasks. 
 - Implement and manage cloud networking, including VPC/VCN, subnets, routing, load balancers, DNS, VPNs, firewalls/security lists, NAT gateways, and private connectivity. 
 - Implement IAM, identity federation, service accounts, OCI dynamic groups, policies, and least-privilege access controls. 
 - Configure monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability using Google Cloud Operations Suite, OCI Monitoring, OCI Logging, Prometheus, and Grafana. 
 - Optimize cloud resources across GCP and OCI for performance, scalability, reliability, availability, and cost efficiency. 
 - Design and support backup, disaster recovery, high availability, and business continuity strategies across cloud environments. 
 - Troubleshoot complex infrastructure and production issues and participate in incident management, root cause analysis, and remediation. 
 - Collaborate with development teams to improve application deployment, release management, and platform engineering processes. 
 - Implement and enforce DevSecOps, vulnerability management, secrets management, policy enforcement, and compliance standards. 
 - Support container and artifact security, vulnerability scanning, and secure software supply-chain practices. 
 - Maintain technical documentation, cloud architecture diagrams, deployment procedures, and operational runbooks. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and promote DevOps, automation, security, and cloud engineering best practices across teams.

data.title: Software Engineer - Android
data.description:
More than 3 billion people in over 180 countries use WhatsApp to stay in touch with friends and family, anytime and anywhere. In India, it is also where a great deal of everyday life gets done - people message businesses, coordinate their families, and increasingly send money as easily as they send a message. We are building a new team to take WhatsApp further in that direction. The newly established WhatsApp Services team is focused on making WhatsApp more useful for more of what people already use it for, and on building what comes next. The WhatsApp Services team is treated as a zero-to-one effort so we can move fast, take risks and build as we go - staffed and prioritized, like every other WhatsApp team, from day one. Payments on WhatsApp aren't a bet on paper: live and growing in India, with the existing WhatsApp payments engineering team moving across as the foundation. As an Android engineer at WhatsApp you will use your start-up mindset and your full range of engineering skills to produce elegantly simple products. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible in a mobile app, while sharing our commitment to quality and attention to detail. You will set direction for a team's technical area, lead major initiatives end to end, and be one of the people the pillar relies on to make the right engineering trade-offs under real ambiguity. 

WhatsApp - Software Engineer - Android Responsibilities: 

- Build and ship client features for WhatsApp on Android, with a focus on performance, reliability and memory footprint on the low- and mid-tier devices that dominate the market. 
 - Own Android client architecture for services surfaces - payments, commerce and the everyday money-centric flows people already come to WhatsApp for. 
 - Work across Kotlin and Java with the Android SDK, and partner with server and platform teams on API design. 
 - Set direction and goals for a team, lead major initiatives and drive them to completion across functions. 
 - Architect efficient and scalable systems that drive complex applications, and make the engineering trade-offs a 0-to-1 effort demands. 
 - Identify and resolve performance and scalability issues, and drive large efforts to reduce technical debt. 
 - Establish ownership of significant components, features or systems with expert end-to-end understanding. 
 - Provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers, help onboard new team members and raise the engineering bar in the team. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams in product management, design, data science and operations to build innovative application experiences. 
 - Partner with payments, legal, compliance and local operations partners to ship services that meet the reliability and regulatory bar expected in India. 

Minimum Qualifications: 

- Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects
 - Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience building Android applications in Java or Kotlin using the Android SDK
 - Experience with multithreading programming and mobile memory management
 - Experience optimising for low-end devices, constrained networks and app size
 - Experience building for the Indian market, including familiarity with UPI and India's digital payments ecosystem
 - In-market experience in India, or experience at an India-based consumer technology or fintech company operating at scale
 - Experience building payment systems at scale, including the reliability, correctness and regulatory requirements they carry
 - Background in monetization, payments, commerce or AI/ML products
 - Experience building 0-to-1 products or standing up new product areas
 - Experience with global, multi-market products, particularly in emerging markets
 - Experience working with teams distributed across multiple sites
 - Familiarity with messaging platforms or mobile-first consumer products
 - Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e. g. , efficiency gains, quality improvements)
 - Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e. g. , risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
 - Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e. g. , prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

About Meta: 

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today-beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics. 

Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

data.title: QA Engineer Int - UI, API and Manual testing (BYDS)
data.description:
Scope

- We are seeking a QA Engineer with 3-5 years of professional experience to join our team supporting enterprise supply chain, order management, and warehouse management systems. This role is focused on validating complex, distributed integrations - not just UI or single-service testing. You'll design and execute test strategies for message-driven systems, data replication pipelines, and cross-system data consistency, working closely with developers to catch issues before they reach production. 

What You Will Do

- Design, write, and execute manual and automated test plans for Java-based services and their integration points 
 - Validate message-driven workflows and asynchronous processing pipelines (e. g. , JMS/ActiveMQ), including message ordering, delivery guarantees, error handling, and failure/recovery scenarios 
 - Test data replication and synchronization accuracy across systems, including verifying trail file processing, replication lag, and conflict resolution outcomes 
 - Build and maintain automated regression suites covering API, integration, and data-consistency test cases 
 - Perform root-cause analysis on data discrepancies between source and target systems 
 - Track, document, and prioritize defects, working with engineering to verify fixes 
 - Maintain test environments and test data sets that reflect production-like integration scenarios

What We Are Looking For

- 3-5years of professional QA/test engineering experience, with meaningful time spent testing backend or integration systems (not exclusively UI/manual testing) 
 - Hands-on experience testing message-oriented middleware (verifying queues, topics, consumers, message flow under failure conditions) 
 - Practical experience validating data replication or CDC pipelines (bonus for Oracle GoldenGate) 
 - Working SQL (Oracle preferred) proficiency, including writing queries to verify data consistency across source and target databases 
 - Experience with API testing tools (Postman, REST Assured, or similar) 
 - Solid understanding of version control (Git) and collaborative QA/Dev workflows

Additional Requirements

- Experience testing systems that process events or messages asynchronously, including handling duplicate or out-of-order messages 
 - Experience with TestComplete or similar UI/functional test automation tools 
 - Familiarity with ElectronJS applications

Our Values

If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success - and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

OUR STORY

At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. 

When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50, 000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. 

Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. 

Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. 

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Digital Verification Engineer to take on a Technical Leader role within our Imaging verification team. The candidate will drive verification strategy and closure for complex digital IPs in imaging and automotive subsystems, mentor junior engineers, and act as the technical point of contact for verification across cross-functional teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end verification strategy, planning, and closure for one or more complex IPs/subsystems. 
 - Architect and review UVM-based verification environments, ensuring reusability and scalability across projects. 
 - Drive functional and code coverage closure; define coverage models and identify verification gaps early in the cycle. 
 - Lead protocol-level verification efforts (e. g. , I3C, MIPI, AMBA), including VIP evaluation, integration, and debug. 
 - Apply the use of formal verification techniques (e. g. , JasperGold) to complement simulation-based verification, particularly for FSM and control-logic-heavy blocks. 
 - Review test plans, testbenches, and verification collateral authored by team members; provide technical guidance on methodology and debug approaches. 
 - Interface with design, architecture, DFT, and software teams to clarify specification ambiguities and drive design-for-verification practices. 
 - Identify and resolve spec ambiguities/errata; work with IP/protocol working groups where applicable. 
 - Mentor and technically guide junior verification engineers; support their ramp-up on tools, methodology, and protocols. 
 - Drive process improvements: regression infrastructure, debug efficiency, coverage methodology, and verification reuse. 
 - Communicate verification status, risks, and closure plans to management and stakeholders. 
 - Support root-cause analysis of silicon/post-silicon issues traced back to verification gaps, where relevant. 

Required Skills

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering (VLSI specialization preferred). 
 - 5-7 years of experience in digital design/IP verification, with demonstrated ownership of verification closure for at least one complex IP or subsystem. 
 - Strong expertise in System Verilog and UVM methodology - testbench architecture, sequences, scoreboards, and reference models. 
 - Proven experience with functional coverage, code coverage, and assertion-based verification (SVA); ability to define coverage models from specification. 
 - Hands-on experience with industry-standard simulation tools (VCS, Xcelium, or Questa) and debug tools. 
 - Experience with formal verification tools and methodology (e. g. , JasperGold) for FSM, connectivity, or control-logic verification. 
 - Solid understanding of one or more protocols such as I3C, I2C, SPI, AMBA, MIPI-CSI, or similar interconnect/interface standards, including VIP-based verification. 
 - Strong scripting skills (Python, Perl, or TCL) for automation, flow development, and regression management. 
 - Ability to read and interpret design specifications, RTL, and identify verification risk areas independently. 

Preferred / Good To Have

- Experience mentoring or technically leading a small team of verification engineers. 
 - Exposure to mutation testing or other coverage-quality assessment techniques. 
 - Familiarity with low-power verification (UPF/CPF) and Gate Level simulations. 
 - Experience working with EDA vendors (e. g. , Cadence, Synopsys) for tool/methodology support and issue resolution. 
 - Prior contribution to internal verification methodology documents, guidelines, or reusable verification IP (VIP) development. 
 - Experience working in a globally distributed team environment. 

Soft Skills

- Strong technical leadership and mentoring ability. 
 - Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to work through ambiguous or under-specified requirements. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills - able to present technical status and risk clearly to management. 
 - Ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and drive closure under deadlines. 
 - Collaborative approach to working with design, architecture, and cross-functional teams. 
 - Exposure to AI/ML assisted verification techniques to improve verification productivity and efficiency. 

What We Offer

- A technical leadership track with visibility into IP-level and subsystem-level verification strategy. 
 - Opportunity to shape verification methodology, including formal and protocol verification practices. 
 - Mentorship and people-development opportunities within a growing team. 
 - Exposure to advanced verification domains including formal verification and next-generation Security IP and systems. 
 - Collaborative, cross-functional work environment with global teams. 

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance. 

At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture. 

To discover more, visit st. com/careers.

The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Summary

Responsible for leading advanced applied science initiatives that drive innovation, optimize business outcomes, and expand the capabilities of data-driven products and services. data.description:
Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for experienced and motivated technologists who possess a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills. You will partner some of the worlds largest Automotive and Manufacturing companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges. 

Here Are Some Other Qualities We Are Looking For

Be great fun to work with. 

At AWS, we have a credo of "Work hard. Have fun. Make history". In this role, you will love what you do, and instinctively know how to make work fun. You will be dynamic and creative, and willing to take on any challenge and make a big impact. 

Enjoy working with large, global customers. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud and AI solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers. 

You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS. 

Key job responsibilities

- Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, understanding their business needs and technology challenges to architect customized solutions
 - Lead discussions to shape a customer's long-term technology and AI strategy and guide them on trade-offs between short-term fixes and extensible, scalable solutions
 - Design end-to-end solutions leveraging both technical expertise and business acumen, driving consensus across multiple teams to deliver impactful solutions
 - Proactively identify opportunities to accelerate implementation through reusable components, parallel workstreams, etc. 
 - Share knowledge by developing technical content like sample code, presentations, workshops to exemplify best practices and educate customers
 - Drive product innovation by gathering customer feedback, translating needs into clear requirements, and partnering with product teams through development
 - Resolve complex technical problems through root cause analysis, both for customers and internally

A day in the life

- Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
 - Develop proof-of-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
 - Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
 - Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
 - Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures

About The Team

The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner. 

The Automotive & Manufacturing Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic automotive and manufacturing accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions. 

Basic Qualifications

- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
 - Experience within specific technology domain areas (e. g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics). 
 - Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
 - Experience working with end user or developer communities
 - 2+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML (Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning), GenAI (Generative AI), Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
 - Experience in IoT, Automotive or Manufacturing domain

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. data.title: Staff Software Architect
data.description:
Job Description Summary

As a Staff Reltio Architect, you will serve as the principal technical authority for our enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) ecosystem. You will lead the architectural design, configuration, and integration of the cloud-native Reltio Connected Data Platform. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex business data needs and cutting-edge cloud architecture, ensuring high-performance entity resolution, robust data governance, and seamless real-time data streaming. 

Job Description

You will play a pivotal role in shaping the technical direction and architecture of our cutting-edge enterprise master data and healthcare data platform solutions. You will be responsible for designing and guiding the implementation of complex, cloud-native master data management (MDM) systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance across various platforms. 

Responsibilities: **

- Lead the architectural design and development of enterprise MDM solutions, translating complex healthcare data requirements into robust and scalable technical designs using the Reltio Connected Data Platform. 
 - Define and enforce best practices for API Development, ensuring seamless real-time data integration, streaming, and interoperability across downstream and upstream healthcare systems. 
 - Architect and optimize MDM solutions leveraging Cloud Technology, aligning multi-tenant SaaS capabilities with organizational considerations for cost, security, compliance, and performance. 
 - Provide expert guidance in Computer Programming and Databasing, selecting appropriate graph database concepts, NoSQL stores, and data structures to optimize Reltio L1/L2/L3 configurations. 
 - Drive the adoption of DevOps principles and practices, fostering continuous integration, deployment, and automated configuration management (JSON/UI) across tenant environments. 
 - Design and implement solutions incorporating Edge Computing and Embedded Systems Architecture, ensuring real-time data syndication and golden-record lookup capability for connected medical devices. 
 - Contribute to Full Stack Development efforts, ensuring architectural coherence from data-layer crosswalks and survivorship strategies to backend integrations and customer-facing UI/data steward consoles. 
 - Integrate Machine Learning (ML) capabilities into software products, utilizing advanced probabilistic matching, anomaly detection, and automated entity resolution. 
 - Design and evolve Microservices Architecture, promoting modularity, resilience, and independent deployability of data connectors and event-driven data streaming pipelines. 
 - Ensure adherence to Network Protocols and stringent healthcare security standards (including HIPAA, HITRUST, and data encryption) in all software designs. 
 - Champion Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles, promoting clean, maintainable, and extensible codebases for custom integration wrappers and data handlers. 
 - Oversee Performance Testing strategies and execution, ensuring high-throughput batch loading and low-latency API response times meet stringent performance requirements. 
 - Lead Software Design Architecture reviews, mentoring and guiding data engineering and MDM development teams on match/merge and survivorship logic. 
 - Provide technical leadership and oversight in Software Project Management, ensuring successful delivery of enterprise data-domain and architectural initiatives. 

Qualifications: **

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 10+ years of progressive experience in software development, with at least 3 years in a lead architect role specifically focused on master data management (MDM) platforms. 
 - Proven expertise in API Development and designing robust REST APIs and event-driven architectures (e. g. , Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS). 
 - Extensive experience with Cloud Technology (e. g. , AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud-native architectures; direct experience with the Reltio SaaS environment is highly preferred. 
 - Strong proficiency in various Computer Programming languages and paradigms (e. g. , Java, Python). 
 - Deep understanding of Databasing technologies, including graph databases, document stores, relational systems, and cloud data warehouses like Snowflake or Databricks. 
 - Solid experience implementing DevOps practices, automated tenant deployments, and CI/CD tools. 
 - Familiarity with Edge Computing and Embedded Systems Architecture principles as they relate to real-time distributed data consumption. 
 - Proficiency in Full Stack Development concepts, including data modeling, pipeline architecture, and front-end interface adjustments (JSON configuration). 
 - Experience with Machine Learning (ML) integration, matching algorithms, and automated data curation deployment. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in Microservices Architecture design and enterprise integration patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of Network Protocols, secure data transmission, and distributed systems. 
 - Mastery of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles. 
 - Experience with Performance Testing methodologies, API load testing, and volume data optimization. 
 - Exceptional skills in Software Design Architecture, data modeling, pattern recognition, and entity resolution framework design. 
 - Proven ability in Software Project Management and leading technical initiatives. 
 - Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills to collaborate with data stewards, product managers, and executive stakeholders. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.title: ASIC Digital Design, Sr Manager
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent the better part of your career building and verifying silicon that actually ships, not just passes simulation. You know that verification is where the real complexity lives, where assumptions break, and where a good engineer becomes a great one by catching the corner case no one thought to write down. Leading a team is not about delegation for you, it is about building engineers who think critically, ask the right questions, and take ownership of the hard problems. 

You have been in the room when a design looked perfect on paper but fell apart under real stimulus. That experience taught you to build verification environments that stress the design in ways the architect did not anticipate. Mentorship matters to you because you remember the engineers who shaped how you think, and you want to do that for others. 

Managing multiple projects does not overwhelm you because you have learned to prioritize what matters, push back when timelines do not match reality, and keep your team focused on the work that moves the needle. You are technical enough to review a testbench architecture and organizational enough to keep three projects on track without losing sight of the people doing the work. 

At Synopsys, you will lead verification for complex ASIC designs that power the products our customers build, and you will do it with a team that values depth, rigor, and getting it right. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead a team of design and verification engineers in Noida, managing performance, growth, and day-to-day execution across multiple ASIC projects
 - Own the verification strategy and environment architecture for complex, high-speed protocol designs, defining testplans and coverage models that catch real issues
 - Drive technical decisions around verification flows, including SystemVerilog, UVM, behavioral modeling, and coverage-driven verification
 - Work directly with architects, RTL designers, and VIP teams to align on design intent, resolve ambiguities, and ensure functional correctness before tapeout
 - Identify design gaps and propose corrective actions when documented functionality does not match implementation or customer requirements
 - Reproduce and resolve customer-reported issues through deep technical analysis, working backward from symptoms to root cause
 - Continuously improve verification methodologies, tooling, and execution efficiency across the team

The Impact You Will Have

- Deliver functionally correct, high-performance silicon designs that ship to customers and power next-generation products
 - Build a team culture where engineers grow technically, take ownership, and solve hard problems without waiting for perfect direction
 - Reduce time-to-market by catching design issues early through rigorous verification and well-architected testbenches
 - Strengthen cross-functional collaboration between design, architecture, and verification, ensuring alignment and reducing late-stage surprises
 - Influence verification best practices across Synopsys, shaping how teams approach coverage, automation, and testbench design
 - Resolve customer issues faster and more thoroughly, building trust and long-term partnerships
 - Set the technical bar for what great verification looks like, raising the standard across projects and teams

What You'll Need

- 15+ years of hands-on experience in ASIC design and verification, with deep expertise in high-speed protocols and complex digital systems
 - Strong proficiency in Verilog, VHDL, and SystemVerilog for RTL design and verification
 - Proven experience building UVM-based verification environments, including testbench architecture, coverage analysis, and constraint-driven stimulus
 - Solid scripting skills in BASH, TCSH, PERL, PYTHON, or TCL for automation, flow development, and productivity tooling
 - Track record of managing and mentoring engineering teams, balancing technical leadership with people development
 - Experience working through ambiguous requirements, incomplete specs, or shifting priorities without losing momentum

Who You Are

- You can review a verification plan and immediately spot what is missing, whether it is a corner case, a coverage gap, or an unrealistic timeline
 - You give feedback that makes engineers better, not just feedback that checks a box during a review cycle
 - You are comfortable saying no when a project plan does not match reality, and you can explain why in a way that moves the conversation forward
 - You manage multiple projects without losing track of the details that matter, knowing when to dive deep and when to trust your team
 - You write and communicate clearly in English, whether it is a technical document, a status update, or a difficult conversation with a stakeholder
 - You adapt quickly when priorities shift, helping your team stay focused on what matters most without creating chaos

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: Design Manager – Mechanical (Water & Wastewater Infrastructure)
data.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

As a Design Manager - Mechanical Infrastructure, you will lead the multidisciplinary mechanical design delivery for complex water and wastewater infrastructure projects, including pump stations, water treatment plants (WTPs), wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs), desalination systems, and associated mechanical/process systems. 

You will be responsible for driving design integration, technical excellence, quality assurance, constructability, risk management, and programme certainty across all stages of project delivery-from concept through detailed and construction design. 

Working closely with Project Managers, Discipline Leads, and Sector/Regional Leadership, you will plan, coordinate, and assure the technical execution of mechanical design packages, while mentoring and developing engineers across global teams. 

Key duties include

- Lead and manage mechanical design for water/wastewater pump stations, treatment plants, and associated mechanical/process systems. 
 - Develop project-specific mechanical design strategies ensuring multidisciplinary integration, alignment with project requirements, and risk mitigation. 
 - Oversee preparation and coordination of mechanical deliverables
 - Equipment sizing & selection
 - Mechanical design calculations
 - Pumping system calculations & hydraulic checks
 - P&IDs, equipment layouts, plant general arrangements
 - Mechanical data sheets and specifications
 - Review and validate vendor documents, datasheets, and shop drawings; ensure integration with overall design. 
 - Lead mechanical engineering inputs for Design for Design‐Build (D for DB) and EPC delivery models constructability, staging, installation methodology, O&M requirements. 
 - Support and lead HAZOP/HAZID, value engineering, risk workshops, failure mode assessments, and operability/maintainability reviews. 
 - Manage and own key design management documents
 - Project Responsibility Matrix
 - Basis of Design
 - Overall Design Programme
 - Schedule of Deliverables
 - Design Risk Register
 - Design Change Register
 - Coordinate with process, civil, electrical, ICA, BIM, structural, and architectural teams for holistic design delivery. 
 - Engage with clients through workshops, presentations, design reviews, and technical clarifications. 
 - Ensure design outputs comply with quality standards, codes, project specifications, and HSE requirements. 
 - Support the preparation of technical proposals, LOE estimates, design execution plans, and project scheduling. 
 - Mentor, coach, and provide performance feedback to engineers to strengthen organisational capability. 
 - Collaborate with global delivery centres to ensure consistent design practices and effective resource utilisation. 

We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects. 

Here's what you'll need

Key software tools

- PipeFlo, AFT Fathom/Impulse, WaterGEMS (for hydraulics interface), vendor pump selection software
 - Planning & Coordination Primavera P6, MS Project
 - Collaboration ACC, ProjectWise, SharePoint, MS Teams
 - BIM (exposure advantageous) Revit, Plant 3D, OpenPlant Modeler, Navisworks, Revizto

Key Behaviours

- Builds strong, collaborative relationships across multidisciplinary teams. 
 - Confident, approachable leader with strong client‐facing presence. 
 - Demonstrates leadership through coordination, clarity, and proactive communication. 
 - Encourages teams to develop integrated, constructible, and high‐quality mechanical design solutions. 
 - Organised, disciplined, and able to resolve complex mechanical issues in a timely manner. 
 - Champions a strong culture of safety, quality, and innovation. 
 - Flexible, dependable, and capable of performing in fast‐paced, contractor‐integrated environments. 

Work Experience

- 15+ years of experience in mechanical engineering design and design management within water/wastewater infrastructure projects. 
 - Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams delivering mechanical design for
 - Water/wastewater pump stations
 - WTPs/WWTPs and associated process units
 - Chemical dosing systems
 - Sludge handling systems
 - High‐lift/low‐lift pumping systems
 - Treatment mechanical equipment (screens, clarifiers, blowers, compressors, valves, etc. )
 - Strong understanding of pumping systems NPSH, system curves, pump selection, surge analysis interface, pipework design, and hydraulic analysis. 
 - Demonstrated capability in Design for Design‐Build constructability reviews, contractor interface, installation sequencing, technical risk mitigation. 
 - Experience coordinating mechanical design within a BIM‐enabled environment. 
 - Strong ability to interpret P&IDs, hydraulic profiles, process input documents, engineering drawings, and specifications. 
 - Experience with vendor coordination, MTO/BoQ preparation, equipment procurement support, and technical bid evaluations. 
 - Experience with change management, design risk management, and impacts assessment. 
 - Ability to support bids, proposals, LOE estimates, and multidisciplinary design execution plans. 
 - Experience with alternate delivery models (DB, EPC, CMAR, PPP) is an asset. 
 - Strong interest in digital delivery, automation, and continuous improvement of mechanical workflows. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical (or related discipline)
 - Master's degree in relevant field is advantageous
 - Professional Engineer (PE) / Chartered Mechanical Engineer (CEng) is advantageous

Preferred Attributes

- Experience delivering large, complex water/wastewater facilities and pumping systems. 
 - Exposure to brownfield upgrades, shutdown/staging, and commissioning planning. 
 - Knowledge of sustainability principles and low‐carbon mechanical design approaches. 
 - Experience working with international codes, standards, and global delivery frameworks. 
 - Ability to operate effectively in fast‐paced, contractor‐integrated environments

Hybrid Work Expectation Average office presence of 3 days per week or as per Company Policy, with travel for client/site meetings and occasional team meetings. 

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients' expectations. 

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you. 

At Jacobs it's all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. 

Your application experience is important to us, and we're keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

- Kumaran Systems is looking for an experienced AI Lead (Technical) to lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable, production-ready AI/ML solutions within its Equity Market Technology -Capital Markets domain. 

- The role will drive innovation in Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI workflows, and intelligent automation using the Microsoft Azure cloud platform. 

- The candidate will provide technical leadership to a team of AI engineers, collaborate closely with stakeholders, data scientists, and platform teams, and translate business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable AI solutions. 

- The role requires strong hands-on technical expertise, solution architecture capabilities, and the ability to lead AI initiatives from Concept to Production. 

Details of Employment: 

Location: Chennai, India

Work Location - Guindy Olympia Tech Park OR SIPCOT Siruseri. 

Mode of Employment - 3 days Hybrid in the Office. 

Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent. 

Notice Period - 0 to 15 days from the date of the offer (Critical Requisition; hence the ask)

Key Responsibilities

1. AI Architecture and Solution Design

- Architect and lead the development of enterprise-grade RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, vector databases, embedding models, and retrieval strategies using Azure AI Search, FAISS, and Pinecone. 
 - Design and implement Agentic AI systems incorporating autonomous agents, multi-step planning, tool orchestration, reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Develop AI solutions that integrate with internal systems, including trading platforms, operations workbenches, and risk engines, to automate decision support, exception handling, and reporting. 
 - Establish standards for prompt engineering, AI guardrails, and evaluation frameworks, including offline evaluations, A/B testing, and automated regression testing. 

2. Azure Cloud and AI Platform Engineering

- Lead the design, implementation, and management of AI/ML infrastructure on Microsoft Azure using Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). 
 - Design scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient AI inference pipelines using caching, request batching, and token-budget optimization. 
 - Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML models and AI agents, incorporating model versioning, controlled deployments, A/B testing, rollback mechanisms, and observability. 
 - Ensure compliance with enterprise cloud governance, data residency, and security requirements using Azure Private Endpoints, Managed Identity, Key Vault, and related security controls. 

3. AI Performance Optimization and Troubleshooting

- Diagnose and resolve production AI performance issues, including inference latency, embedding drift, retrieval quality degradation, hallucinations, and context-window limitations. 
 - Monitor and optimize token consumption, API rate limits, throughput, and cost per query across production AI workloads. 
 - Establish AI observability through structured logging, distributed tracing across prompt processing, retrieval, and generation, and dashboards tracking latency (p50/p95/p99), retrieval recall, and answer relevance. 
 - Conduct root-cause analysis of AI system failures, including incorrect tool invocations, RAG retrieval failures, safety-filter false positives, and model regressions following version upgrades. 

4. Technical Leadership and Collaboration

- Lead and mentor a team of 4-6 AI/ML engineers, overseeing code reviews, architecture decisions, sprint planning, engineering standards, and professional development. 
 - Collaborate with business stakeholders, data scientists, quantitative teams, and operations leaders to translate business requirements into scalable, production-ready AI solutions. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI technologies, model releases, fine-tuning techniques, agent frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, and CrewAI, and AI evaluation methodologies. 
 - Represent the AI engineering function in technical design reviews, architecture governance forums, and incident post-mortems. 
 - Drive engineering best practices and continuous improvement across AI solution design, development, deployment, monitoring, security, and operational support. 

Required Skills and Qualifications

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on AI/ML solutions in production environments. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with RAG architectures, including vector databases, embedding pipelines, chunking strategies, hybrid search (keyword + semantic), re-ranking, and retrieval evaluation. 
 - Proven track record of building Agentic AI systems, including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, planning loops, memory management, and fallback strategies. 
 - Strong proficiency in Azure Cloud services, including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search (formerly Cognitive Search), Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, AKS, and App Service. 
 - Experience troubleshooting AI performance issues, including inference latency optimization, token budgeting, embedding drift detection, hallucination mitigation, and cost management at scale. 
 - Proficiency in Python and at least one of the following: C#/. NET or TypeScript/Node. js. 
 - Experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or CrewAI. 
 - Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, including transformers, attention mechanisms, fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), RLHF, and evaluation metrics such as BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore, faithfulness, and relevance. 
 - Experience leading engineering teams of 4+ members in an Agile/Scrum environment. 
 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and prepare clear technical documentation. 

Resumes can be shared with devika. raju@kumaran. com

Job Description Summary

About GE Grid Solutions: At GE Grid Solutions we are electrifying the world with advanced grid technologies. As leaders in the energy space our goal is to accelerate the transition for a more energy efficient grid to full fill the needs of tomorrow. With a focus on growth and sustainability GE Grid Solutions plays a pivotable role in integrating Renewables onto the grid to drive to carbon neutral. In Grid Solutions we help enable the transition for a greener more reliable Grid. GE Grid Solutions has the most advanced and comprehensive product and solutions portfolio within the energy sector. 

Why we come to work: At GE Renewable Energy, our engineers are always up for the challenge - and we're always driven to find the best solution. Our projects are unique and interesting, and you'll need to bring a solution-focused, positive approach to each one to do your best. Surrounded by committed, loyal colleagues, if you can dare to bring your ingenuity and desire to make an impact, you'll be exposed to game-changing, diverse projects that truly allow you to play your part in the energy transition. 

What We Offer: 

- Working in an international team which is part of global Engineering HVDC Centre of Excellence
 - A key role in a dynamic, international working environment with a large degree of flexibility of work agreements
 - Competitive benefits, and great development opportunities

Job Description Summary

Systems engineering is a cross-functional engineering discipline centred on an approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the users needs. The discipline that executes a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of systems, consisting of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. Process that proceeds from concept to production to operation. 

Impacts departmental operations and responsible for planning/execution. The role has some autonomy but is focused on execution of activities within an operating discipline covered by standard functional practices and procedures. 

Some judgment may be required but this is typically with guidance. 

The role will work within defined parameters to make decisions, apply concepts to issues of moderate complexity, and resolve issues through immediate action or short-term planning. 

We are looking for our future electrical technical project Lead Engineer to strengthen our engineering department. If you project yourself into our mission and our values, then here are more details on GE GRID, the missions of the position and who we wish to become

The GE Renewable - Grid Integration product line is globally recognized for the design, manufacture and supply of custom high voltage direct current (HVDC) solutions for utilities worldwide. With over 130 years of pioneering experience, GE offers two HVDC technologies, Line Commutated Converters (LCCs) and Voltage Source Converters (VSCs), to support a wide range of applications in different countries on land or at sea. 

Each HVDC solution is tailored and designed based on a project-by-project assessment of customer needs, whether connecting offshore wind generation, long-distance power transmission or utility trading. energy between independent power grids. 

In our department we design the control / command / protections of the AC part of HVDC substations. We are responsible for secondary and low voltage engineering, automation and protection. The department's teams are located in France, the United Kingdom and India. 

Our Technical project Lead Engineer contributes to our HVDC projects. You will be part of a project team that delivers the "conventional" control and protection system for our HVDC substations and is in charge of the electrical protection systems, interlocks, wiring and oversees the power supply studies for the auxiliary services. 

As a LV Secondary System Engineer, you will report to the Control System Engineering Manager and will be part of a highly motivated and dynamic team of engineers working on the requirement, design, integration, installation, and commissioning of HVDC and AC Control and Protection System. 

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

Overseeing the overall technical solution that meets customer Requirement

This Includes The Following Actives: 

- Requirement Capture, Gap Analysis
 - Define Schematic diagrams requirements of the Control & protection system and produce detailed design documentation, drawings, test specification and test report. 
 - Prepare substation Single line diagrams & Protection Single line diagrams and Protection list & specification. 
 - On the basis of the single line Diagram of the sub station and the architecture of the control system, clarify the specifications and refine the technical solution with the customer. 
 - Prepare Principal diagrams (Interlockings, Protection actions, Polarities, HVDC specific functions)
 - Monitor the manufacture of control and protection cabinets and supervise factory tests. 
 - Follow the departments standard design practices, engineering reviews and guidelines. 
 - Prepare Technical specification for cabling, fibre optic, cable list , Cable Schedule
 - Interface with equipment supplier and reviewing in-house designs and those produced by external contractors and analyse a variety of engineering data, documents, and reports. 
 - Ensure that design projects are undertaken by competent personnel and sub-contractors reviewing designs created by others
 - Participate in the investigation of technical problems and the establishment of procedures and corrective actions to avoid recurrences. 
 - Prepare Bill of Material for LV equipment using available tools. 
 - Prepare replies to customer comments on technical submittals in coordination with project management. 
 - Attend meeting with customers/contractors/ consultants for technical discussions. 
 - Prepare design calculations including load list, power consumption & heat dissipation data calculations. 
 - Define Control Panel requirements and produce detailed design documentation for the control system using standard design blocks. 
 - Panel Electrical Schematics (using Engineering Base tool)
 - Wire/Cable Schedules
 - Routine Test specification
 - General Assembly drawings
 - Bill of Materials
 - undefined
 - Oversee the testing and FAT witnessing of the Control System. 
 - Assist site activities relevant to the installation and commissioning of the control system. 
 - Share engineering information and promote open dialogue. 
 - Assure proper documentation of technical data generated for the assigned projects and/or tasks consistent with engineering policies and procedures. 

Required Qualifications

- Engineering degree in electrical or electronic engineering. 7 years minimum experience in an EPC project environment in the T&D, Power Gen, or Oil & Gas industries, with at least 2 projects as an engineer responsible for the business. Good experience in project management and budget management processes, quality, planning, R&O. Motivated to evolve in an international environment & recognizes himself in our key values. 
 - Good leadership, listening and communication skills. 
 - Experience in functional team management. 
 - Good experience in managing technical interfaces and systems integration. Solid knowledge of conventional substation control system design. Solid experience in the design of control and protection cabinets, preferably in high voltage substation or power plant environments. 
 - Good knowledge of the control and protection functions of high voltage AC substations. Good knowledge of ancillary services engineering in a substation environment and understanding of design/commissioning of secondary systems. Knowledge of networking and telecommunications. 
 - Experience with engineering tools such as AutoCAD, Engineering Base or Microsoft Visio.

Strong oral and written communication skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills.

data.title: Lead System Designer & Product Security Representative
data.description:
Job Description Summary

We are seeking a Lead System Designer / Product Security Representative (LSD/PSR) to lead compliance, quality, and security governance for Ethos Design System (EDS) by ensuring all components meet QMS, regulatory, and secure development requirements throughout their lifecycle. 

This role ensures that components are designed, developed, verified, released, and maintained in accordance with Quality Management System (QMS) requirements, Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) practices, regulatory expectations, and enterprise security standards. You will serve as the primary compliance steward for EDS, partnering with Product Management, UX, Engineering, Architecture, and Product Security teams to maintain audit readiness, security posture, documentation completeness, and release compliance. This includes complete ownership of QMS documentation, review coordination, approvals, and process compliance activities. 

Job Description

About the Ethos Design System (EDS)

EDS is the unified digital platform that powers GE HealthCare's global software portfolio. It serves as a comprehensive library of reusable UI components, design patterns, and accessibility standards that bridge the critical gap between User Experience (UX) and Engineering. By fostering a philosophy of "reduce, reuse, and recycle, " EDS enables hundreds of product teams to eliminate redundant coding and design work. We provide the foundational building blocks that ensure our clinical and operational applications are intuitive, consistent, and accessible, allowing teams to focus on patient safety. 

The Mission: Scale and Empowerment

We are in a phase of hyper-growth, scaling from 25 adopting products to over 100. This requires a leader who thinks like a founder. You must look beyond simple backlog management to think about scale, growth, and empowerment. You will build a self-service ecosystem that allows teams to move fast without breaking the consistent standards required for patient safety and accessibility. 

Core Responsibilities

- Quality & Compliance
 - QMS Ownership: Own QMS-related activities across the EDS component lifecycle. Set and own the program Design History File (DHF) strategy. 
 - Documentation & Traceability: Develop, maintain, and govern required design, development, verification, and release documentation. Ensure traceability between requirements, design artifacts, implementation, verification, and releases. 
 - Audit Readiness: Coordinate reviews, approvals, and signoffs for quality records. Support audits, assessments, and inspection of readiness activities while maintaining compliance with organizational development processes and regulatory requirements. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Drive continuous improvement of quality processes, templates, and workflows. Ensure component Technical Design Reviews (cTDR/dTDR/eTDR) align with program plans and needs. 
 - Product Security & Secure Development
 - Security Governance: Serve as the Product Security Representative for EDS, ensuring adherence to Secure Development Lifecycle requirements. 
 - Risk Management: Coordinate security reviews, threat modeling, and security risk assessments. Track remediation of vulnerabilities, security findings, and compliance gaps. 
 - Release Validation: Ensure security controls, evidence, and documentation are completed before releases. 
 - Engineering Partnership: Partner with engineering teams to implement secure coding and dependency management practices. Coordinate penetration testing, security scans, SBOM generation, and vulnerability management activities. Track security metrics, remediation SLAs, and compliance status across components. 
 - Governance & Program Oversight
 - Release Readiness: Establish release readiness checklists covering quality and security requirements. Maintain audit-ready records and ensure documentation integrity. 
 - Strategic Liaison: Act as the primary liaison between EDS teams, Quality, Regulatory, and Product Security organizations. Collaborate with Product, Architecture, UX, and Engineering to identify compliance risks and mitigation plans. 
 - Automation: Drive automation of QMS and security compliance processes where practical. Monitor compliance with KPIs and provide status reporting to leadership. 

Qualifications

- Experience: 10+ years of experience with Quality Management Systems (QMS) and regulated product development. 
 - Mandatory: Strong understanding of Secure Development Lifecycle practices. 
 - Mandatory: Experience coordinating security reviews, threat modeling, vulnerability management, and compliance activities. 
 - Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with design controls, traceability, audit readiness, and release governance. 
 - Process & Methodology: Experience in Agile Software Development, including associated concepts, tools, and practices. Ability to drive process improvements and compliance automation initiatives. 
 - AI Tooling: Experience using AI tools is a must to enhance workflows, optimize compliance checks, or assist in documentation generation. 
 - Leadership Skills: Strong cross-functional leadership, stakeholder management, and program coordination skills. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 
Inclusion And Diversity

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. 

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviours: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership - always with unyielding integrity. 

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you'd expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you'll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration, and support. 

#Everyroleisvital

You will have the opportunity to shape not only our technology architecture, but also how engineering teams leverage AI to build high-quality software faster and more effectively.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Development Engineer to help develop and maintain Kaseya's endpoint management agents across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms. 

This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on building secure, reliable, and scalable endpoint management capabilities. The ideal candidate is passionate about operating systems, systems programming, device management, endpoint security, and software quality. 

Unlike traditional development environments where quality ownership is separated, our engineers own the full software lifecycle. You will design, develop, test, deploy, and support your solutions while building automated validation alongside the features you create. Successful candidates combine strong software engineering skills with a quality-first mindset and leverage automation to ensure reliability, maintainability, and release confidence at scale. 

What You Will Do

- Design and implement new features for endpoint agents across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms. 
 - Develop software components supporting monitoring, automation, patching, inventory collection, remote actions, scripting, and device management. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code. 
 - Own features throughout the entire lifecycle from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Build automated tests and validation frameworks alongside feature development. 
 - Develop automated coverage for functional, integration, regression, resiliency, and system-level scenarios. 
 - Improve software quality through testability, diagnostics, telemetry, and automation. 
 - Investigate customer-reported issues and production escalations. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis and implement preventative solutions to avoid future recurrence. 
 - Reproduce complex issues across diverse operating system and endpoint environments. 
 - Improve agent stability, performance, scalability, security, and reliability. 
 - Develop integrations with operating system management, security frameworks, and device management APIs. 
 - Build telemetry and diagnostics capabilities that improve product supportability and troubleshooting. 
 - Collaborate with Product, Support, Cloud Platform, Security, and Engineering teams to deliver customer-focused solutions. 
 - Participate in design discussions, code reviews, architecture reviews, and sprint planning activities. 
 - Utilize AI-assisted development and testing tools to accelerate engineering productivity and improve software quality. 

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of software engineering experience developing system software, endpoint software, platform services, or related applications. 
 - Strong proficiency in C# and . NET, including experience building production-grade applications and services. 
 - Experience building automated tests and validation capabilities as part of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Experience developing automated test frameworks and validation tooling using technologies such as xUnit, NUnit, MSTest, Selenium, Playwright or similar testing frameworks 
 - Experience with Windows system programming concepts such as Win32 APIs, Windows Services, WMI, Registry operations, process management, threading, security models, or related operating system capabilities. 
 - Strong knowledge of operating system fundamentals, including: Processes and threads, Filesystems, Networking, Services and daemons, Security models, Privilege management, Performance and resource utilization 
 - Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis skills. 
 - Experience developing software that interacts with operating system services, APIs, or management frameworks. 
 - Understanding of software quality engineering principles, test automation, and CI/CD practices. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as coding assistants, code generation tools, or intelligent debugging solutions. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with RMM, UEM, EDR, XDR, endpoint security, or device management products. 
 - Knowledge of C, C++, Rust, Go 
 - Experience with Microsoft Intune, Apple MDM, Android Enterprise, or Linux management platforms. 
 - Knowledge of PowerShell, Bash, Python, AppleScript, or other scripting technologies. 
 - Experience building test frameworks, automation libraries, or system-level validation tooling. 
 - Experience working with virtualization, containerization, or automated device provisioning environments. 
 - Familiarity with endpoint telemetry, diagnostics, observability, and monitoring systems. 

What Success Looks Like

A successful Senior Endpoint Software Engineer at Kaseya: 

- Builds secure, scalable, and high-quality endpoint software. 
 - Owns features end-to-end from design through production support. 
 - Demonstrates strong ownership of both software development and quality. 
 - Develops automated validation alongside feature implementation. 
 - Solves complex customer, platform, and operating system challenges. 
 - Improves the reliability, performance, security, and maintainability of endpoint agents. 
 - Rapidly diagnoses issues and implements long-term corrective solutions. 
 - Partners effectively across Product, Support, Security, Platform, and Engineering teams. 
 - Leverages AI-native engineering practices to improve productivity and accelerate delivery. 
 - Continuously grows expertise in operating systems, endpoint management, systems programming, and modern software development practices. 

Additional Information

Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

data.title: Software Engineer (Technical Leadership) - Android
data.description:
More than 3 billion people in over 180 countries use WhatsApp to stay in touch with friends and family, anytime and anywhere. In India, it is also where a great deal of everyday life gets done - people message businesses, coordinate their families, and increasingly send money as easily as they send a message. We are building a new team to take WhatsApp further in that direction. The newly established WhatsApp Services team is focused on making WhatsApp more useful for more of what people already use it for, and on building what comes next. The WhatsApp Services team is treated as a zero-to-one effort so we can move fast, take risks and build as we go - staffed and prioritized, like every other WhatsApp team, from day one. Payments on WhatsApp aren't a bet on paper: live and growing in India, with the existing WhatsApp payments engineering team moving across as the foundation. As an Android engineer at WhatsApp you will use your start-up mindset and your full range of engineering skills to produce elegantly simple products. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible in a mobile app, while sharing in our commitment to quality and attention to detail. You will set technical direction across multiple teams, own the architecture for a major area of the product, and shape what WhatsApp Services becomes in India. 

WhatsApp - Software Engineer (Technical Leadership) - Android Responsibilities: 

- Build and ship client features for WhatsApp on Android, with a focus on performance, reliability and memory footprint on the low- and mid-tier devices that dominate the market. 
 - Own Android client architecture for services surfaces - payments, commerce and the everyday money-centric flows people already come to WhatsApp for. 
 - Work across Kotlin and Java with the Android SDK, and partner with server and platform teams on API design. 
 - Identify and solve the hardest technical problems across the pillar, including finding where new technology can address previously intractable problems. 
 - Set technical direction across multiple teams and own the architecture for a major area of the product. 
 - Lead initiatives of org-wide scope, resolving ambiguity in both product definition and technical approach. 
 - Drive engineering standards, quality and craft across the pillar, and make teams and systems work better to increase their impact. 
 - Mentor senior engineers, influence cross-functional partners in product, design and data science, and act as a credible co-owner of product outcomes. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams in product management, design, data science and operations to build innovative application experiences. 
 - Partner with payments, legal, compliance and local operations partners to ship services that meet the reliability and regulatory bar expected in India. 

Minimum Qualifications:

 - Experience communicating and working across functions to drive solutions
 - Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. data.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.
