data.title: Technical Lead & Manager
data.description:
We are WisdomAI. 

We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity. 

WisdomAI builds AI-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn't just surface insights - it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context. 

We're trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik - and we're just getting started. The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you're compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you'll thrive here. 

The Role

We're looking for our first Technical Lead & Manager in India. This role will help shape the next chapter of that organization while remaining deeply involved in the technical work itself. 

How We Work

Hands-On Leadership

We don't see management and engineering as separate tracks. Our Technical lead will participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, hiring decisions, and occasionally jump into code themselves. The ideal balance is roughly 40% leadership and 60% technical contribution. 

Ownership

Both the geographies - India and US - own meaningful parts of the product and platform. Engineers are trusted with end-to-end ownership and leaders are expected to create the environment where that ownership thrives. 

Talent Density

We're intentional about every hire. The team includes engineers from companies such as Google, Meta, Rubrik, Glean, and other world-class organizations. Maintaining and raising that bar is one of the most important responsibilities of this role. 

Product Thinking

The best engineering decisions start with understanding the customer problem. We look for leaders who can connect technical choices to customer outcomes and help teams prioritize accordingly. 

Builders

We value people who can build from first principles. Processes, operating rhythms, performance management, career development, organizational design-none of these are finished products. You'll help create and evolve them as the organization grows. 

What You'd Work On

Scaling a High-Performance Engineering Organization

The India team has grown rapidly and now spans backend systems, platform infrastructure, frontend experiences, and machine learning. 

You'll help build the systems that allow that team to scale without losing speed, quality, or culture. 

Developing Future Technical Leaders

Many of our engineers are capable of becoming future staff engineers, tech leads, and engineering managers. 

A significant part of this role is helping them get there through mentorship, coaching, feedback, and career development. 

Raising the Hiring Bar

We're actively growing. 

You'll partner closely with leadership to identify exceptional talent, evaluate candidates, and ensure every hire improves the organization. 

Driving Technical Excellence

As the organization grows, maintaining a high technical bar becomes harder. 

You'll help guide architecture discussions, participate in design reviews, review code, and ensure engineering quality scales alongside headcount. 

Building the Next Generation of Analytics

From agent orchestration and reasoning systems to distributed data infrastructure and AI-powered user experiences, you'll work alongside the team solving technically ambitious problems at the intersection of AI, data, and enterprise software. 

You may be a good fit if you

- Have spent years building and shipping complex software systems
 - Have managed engineers and genuinely enjoy helping people grow
 - Still love engineering and want to remain technically involved
 - Hold a high bar for technical quality and execution
 - Operate with high ownership and low ego
 - Can balance speed with sound engineering judgment
 - Have strong product instincts and care about customer outcomes
 - Want to help build an organization, not simply inherit one

Strong candidates may also have

- Experience at companies that have built at scale and have strong engineering cultures
 - Startup or founding engineer experience
 - Experience scaling engineering organizations from
 - Experience with distributed systems, infrastructure, AI, data platforms, or developer tools
 - Experience hiring and developing senior engineering talent

Not sure this is the right fit?

- Looking for a pure people-management role with little technical involvement? This probably isn't it. 
 - Looking for a remote role? We work together in-office five days a week. 
 - Looking primarily for title progression? We're more interested in builders than titles. 

Why WisdomAI?

You'll join a company founded by repeat entrepreneurs and early builders from companies including Rubrik and Glean. 

We're tackling one of the largest software categories in the world: business intelligence and analytics. 

We're backed by leading investors including Kleiner Perkins and NVIDIA Ventures. 

Most importantly, you'll inherit a strong team and have the opportunity to shape what engineering leadership looks like in India from the ground up. 

Our CRAFT

CRAFT isn't a list of aspirational values. It's how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves. 

C - Customer trust. Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust - never the other way around. 

R - Relentless on outcomes. We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn't the measure - results are. If something isn't working, we change the approach now. 

A - Authenticity. We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together. 

F - First principles, grounded in reality. We don't accept "that's how it's done. " We strip problems to what's actually true and build up from there - then validate quickly and let real-world results decide. 

T - Transparency. We share the why, not just the what. When something can't be shared, we say so. We're one team - information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we're wrong. 

Equal opportunity employer

WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

data.description:
Company

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

General Summary

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what is possible to enable next-generation intelligent computing, AI, connectivity, and low-power embedded technologies. 

As a Senior Embedded Software Architect Engineer, you will drive the architecture, design, and evolution of embedded software platforms, developer frameworks, and SDKs that enable internal engineering organizations, OEMs, ISVs, and ecosystem partners to build applications and services across heterogeneous computing environments. 

You will serve as a technical architect responsible for defining scalable Embedded SDK and Agentic SDK strategies spanning multiple operating systems, processors, and software subsystems. This role requires deep expertise across the complete software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and architecture through implementation, validation, commercialization, and long-term platform evolution. 

You will collaborate with software, hardware, AI, systems, security, tooling, and product teams to create developer experiences that accelerate adoption of Qualcomm technologies across mobile, IoT, XR, automotive, industrial, and edge-AI platforms. 

Responsibilities

SDK Architecture & Platform Strategy

- Define the architecture, roadmap, and technical direction for Embedded SDK platforms supporting heterogeneous compute environments. 
 - Architect reusable software frameworks, APIs, middleware layers, tooling, and runtime environments that operate across multiple operating systems and processor architectures. 
 - Drive architecture decisions for Agentic SDK platforms enabling autonomous workflows, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, and edge intelligence solutions. 
 - Establish long-term platform strategies balancing developer productivity, portability, performance, power efficiency, security, and scalability. 

Software Architecture

- Design software architectures supporting Qualcomm SoCs comprising CPUs, DSPs, NPUs, MCUs, accelerators, and secure execution environments. 
 - Define software decomposition, interface specifications, service boundaries, and integration requirements across subsystems. 
 - Develop architectural solutions supporting multi-OS deployments including Linux, Android, Zephyr, QuRT, QNX, Windows, and emerging RTOS environments. 
 - Drive architecture reviews and technical governance processes across multiple engineering organizations. 

Software Development Lifecycle Leadership

- Lead software programs through the complete software development lifecycle including: 
 - Requirements analysis
 - Architecture definition
 - Design specification
 - Development
 - Integration
 - Validation
 - Release management
 - Commercialization
 - Sustaining engineering

- Ensure platform designs meet performance, reliability, scalability, maintainability, and security requirements. 
 - Establish architecture documentation, reference implementations, coding standards, and platform adoption guidelines. 

Agentic AI Enablement

- Architect frameworks enabling AI agents to interact with embedded systems, sensors, edge-AI services, and device resources. 
 - Define SDK interfaces for model execution, orchestration engines, memory systems, telemetry, context management, and tool invocation. 
 - Design software abstractions supporting on-device AI workloads across constrained embedded environments. 
 - Collaborate with AI framework teams to enable deployment of agentic and generative AI capabilities on Qualcomm platforms. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner with silicon architects, systems teams, operating system teams, AI researchers, security architects, and developer tooling organizations. 
 - Influence future chipset software roadmaps through architecture proposals and technical leadership. 
 - Mentor software engineers and contribute to technical growth across the organization. 
 - Represent Qualcomm with OEMs, ecosystem partners, standards bodies, and open-source communities when required. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

data.title: Software Engineering Manager
data.description:
As a Software Engineering Manager within MS TECH Order Fulfillment, you will provide strategic product and technical leadership, along with hands-on expertise, to build industry-leading products. You are a systems thinker capable of driving large-scale transformations that maximize value for Ford, our Dealers, and our customers. The role combines high-level strategy, including product vision, AI/ML use-case portfolio, data strategy, and technical roadmaps, with disciplined execution to deliver scalable, resilient, secure, explainable, and highly available solutions in a global environment. 

Technical Leadership & Vision

- Serve as the primary technical authority for the Order Generation product suite, defining the evolution of the technology stack, data architecture, AI/ML capabilities, and architectural patterns. 
 - Lead cross-functional teams through complex integrations, managing dependencies across the broader Order Fulfillment ecosystem to ensure seamless data flow and system interoperability. 
 - Translate high-level business requirements into actionable technical strategies that align with Ford enterprise standards. 

AI/ML Product Strategy & Innovation

- Define and execute an AI/ML and data analytics product strategy that converts priority business requirements into a sequenced portfolio of intelligent capabilities and measurable outcomes. 
 - Identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI/ML opportunities across forecasting, order generation, decision support, anomaly detection, optimization, and workflow automation using value, feasibility, risk, data readiness, and adoption criteria. 
 - Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of AI/ML products from discovery, business-case development, experimentation, and MVP validation through industrialization, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement. 
 - Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, Product, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Legal, Privacy, and business teams to ensure solutions are technically sound, usable, compliant, and aligned with responsible AI principles. 
 - Establish outcome-based product metrics, experimentation methods, model performance targets, and adoption measures; use evidence and customer feedback to guide investment and roadmap decisions. 
 - Monitor emerging technologies, including generative AI, agentic AI, foundation models, advanced analytics, optimization, and intelligent automation, and determine where they can create differentiated business value. 
 - Drive build, buy, or partner assessments and develop scalable patterns for reusable AI/ML services, data products, model APIs, and decision intelligence capabilities. 

Product Strategy & Delivery

- Partner with business stakeholders to define and execute a multi-year product vision and roadmap focused on optimized order forecasting and generation. 
 - Champion an iterative, Agile delivery model, prioritizing the delivery of Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) and maintaining a high-velocity release cadence. 
 - Apply Human-Centered Design (HCD) principles to ensure technical solutions solve real-world problems for Dealers and customers. 
 - Create launch and adoption plans that include operational readiness, user training, change management, benefit tracking, and feedback loops. 

Data, Model & MLOps Excellence

- Ensure AI/ML solutions are supported by trusted, governed, discoverable, and fit-for-purpose data, with clear ownership, lineage, quality controls, and access patterns. 
 - Guide the implementation of robust MLOps and LLMOps practices covering reproducible experimentation, model registry, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, rollback, and auditability. 
 - Define controls for model quality, explainability, bias and fairness evaluation, privacy, security, human oversight, and responsible use throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Balance predictive accuracy with interpretability, latency, cost, reliability, and business usability when selecting models and architectures. 

Engineering & Operational Excellence

- Enforce rigorous engineering standards, including Test-Driven Development (TDD), robust CI/CD pipelines, and DevSecOps practices. 
 - Drive a culture of Full Lifecycle Ownership, where the team is responsible for the design, security, deployment, and operational health of its services. 
 - Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for system health, code quality, delivery velocity, model performance, data quality, adoption, and realized business value. 

Architectural Design

- Architect and oversee the development of cloud-native, microservices-based systems designed for global scale, multi-tenancy, and high-performance transactional processing. 
 - Design interoperable data and AI architectures that support batch and real-time inference, event-driven workflows, APIs, observability, and secure integration with enterprise platforms. 

People Leadership & Talent Development

- Cultivate a high-performing, diverse team of Software Engineers, Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and ML Engineers through active coaching, mentorship, and career pathing. 
 - Foster a culture of psychological safety and continuous learning, utilizing blameless retrospectives and regular feedback loops to drive team growth. 
 - Identify and close skill gaps within the team to keep pace with emerging technologies and industry trends. 

Strategic Collaboration

- Act as a bridge between the product team and domain experts in Cloud Infrastructure, Data & AI, Cybersecurity, Responsible AI, SRE, and DevOps to reduce portfolio complexity. 
 - Influence stakeholders across the organization to adopt modern engineering practices, responsible AI controls, reusable data products, and standardized service contracts. 

Technical Execution (Hands-on)

- Maintain deep technical fluency in the team's primary languages, frameworks, cloud services, data platforms, and AI/ML toolchain, including Java, Spring Boot, GCP/Azure, Vertex AI, and modern MLOps platforms. 
 - Lead from the front by participating in architecture and code reviews, resolving complex technical blockers, reviewing model and data design decisions, and occasionally prototyping high-risk or emerging technology concepts. 
 - Experience: 10+ years of progressive software engineering, digital product, data, or AI/ML solution delivery experience, with a significant portion in engineering and product leadership roles. 
 - AI/ML Product Leadership: Demonstrated experience strategizing, developing, launching, and scaling AI/ML-based products that address business requirements and deliver measurable operational or customer outcomes. 
 - Product Strategy: Experience defining product vision, business cases, roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, MVPs, go-to-market or launch plans, adoption strategies, and value-realization metrics for data and AI products. 
 - Education: Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field. 
 - Certifications: Industry certifications relevant to software engineering, cloud, data, or AI/ML, or a commitment to obtain them within 6 months. GCP Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Machine Learning Engineer, or equivalent certification is a plus. 
 - Cloud Expertise: 4+ years of experience delivering production solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including cloud-native application and data/AI services. 
 - Technical Depth: Expertise in microservices, cloud-native architectures, event-driven architectures, APIs, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), distributed systems, and secure enterprise integration. 
 - AI/ML & Analytics: Strong working knowledge of supervised and unsupervised learning, time-series forecasting, optimization, anomaly detection, feature engineering, model evaluation, experimentation, and production inference patterns. 
 - Data Engineering: Experience with data architectures, data pipelines, data quality, governance, metadata and lineage, feature stores, batch and streaming data, and analytics platforms. 
 - MLOps / LLMOps: Hands-on experience establishing or governing CI/CD/CT for models, experiment tracking, model registry, automated validation, deployment, observability, drift monitoring, retraining, and lifecycle controls. 
 - Responsible AI: Experience applying secure and responsible AI practices, including privacy, transparency, explainability, bias and fairness assessment, human oversight, access controls, risk management, and auditability. 
 - Technology Stack: Hands-on experience with Java, Angular, Python, SQL, Terraform, Postgres, APIGEE, Kubernetes, Docker, serverless technologies, and containerization. Experience with Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, or equivalent cloud services is strongly preferred. 
 - Engineering Excellence: Thorough knowledge of multi-threading, concurrency, parallel processing, DevSecOps, test automation, and monitoring tools such as Dynatrace or Google Cloud Monitoring. 
 - Developer Experience: Experience increasing developer productivity by integrating AI agents, coding assistants, reusable platform capabilities, or AI skills into the development lifecycle. 
 - Leadership Qualities: Proven ability to lead large-scale transformations, apply systems thinking, create psychologically safe teams, influence complex decisions, and earn the respect of strong individual technical talent through competence and mentorship. 
 - Communication & Business Acumen: Ability to communicate complex technical and AI concepts to executives and business partners, align diverse stakeholders, manage trade-offs, and connect product investments to business outcomes. 

Nice to Have

- Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field. 
 - Experience with Vertex AI, BigQuery, Feature Store, Gemini or other foundation-model platforms, vector search, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, and evaluation frameworks. 
 - Experience building reusable enterprise platforms and underlying services for data, analytics, and AI capabilities. 
 - Experience with forecasting, supply chain, order fulfillment, demand planning, optimization, or decision intelligence products. 
 - Ability to translate product roadmaps into manageable features through quarterly scoping sessions and assist product teams directly with technical blockers. 
 - Proven ability to identify and mitigate delivery, data, model, security, adoption, and operational risks while assessing overall product health and prompting timely decisions. 
 - Strong understanding of business priorities and technical feasibility to prioritize platform backlogs and manage dependencies. 
 - Experience with Lean methodology, eXtreme Programming (XP), Agile product management, and Human-Centered Design. 
 - Experience championing modern software, data, AI/ML, product, and responsible AI practices within a large organization.

data.title: Senior Project Engineer
data.description:
ETAP empowers customers to make informed decisions throughout the life cycle of their projects with innovative software solutions for electrical systems. By applying ETAP solutions, customers experience continuous intelligence during design and engineering and into operations and maintenance using a unified electrical digital twin platform. ETAP supports customers in their digital transformation and sustainable energy transitions for a green and smart future, helping them to prioritize safety, maximize reliability, and stay resilient. 

Our employees' passion for excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction is our most-prized resource. If you share that passion - and want to be part of a company that leads the energy transition towards a cleaner and more resilient world for future generations - we invite you to join us!

ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. 

Job Title: Senior Project Engineer

Location: Mumbai

Employment Type: full-time

The job

In this role, you will be responsible for power system modeling, engineering analysis, real-time power system applications, ADMS/OMS, power automation, project engineering, testing, and commissioning. You will develop and validate electrical network models, perform static and dynamic power system studies, configure real-time applications using field data, and support integration with SCADA, DCS, IEDs, gateways, and external systems. 

The role also involves preparing technical and project documentation, coordinating with customers and multidisciplinary teams, leading or supporting FAT and SAT activities, troubleshooting system and communication issues, demonstrating application functionalities, and conducting customer training. 

Key Responsibilities

Develop, validate, maintain, and update electrical network models and digital twins using ETAP or equivalent power system analysis platforms. 

- Perform power system studies including Load Flow, Short-Circuit, Protection/Relay Coordination, Harmonic Analysis, Transient Stability, Motor Acceleration, Voltage Stability, Arc Flash, and related studies. 
 - Review SLDs, equipment data, protection settings, network parameters, and operating philosophies; analyze study results and prepare engineering reports with recommendations. 
 - Configure and commission real-time power system applications using live field measurements, equipment status, and operational data. 
 - Configure and validate State & Load Estimation (SLE), network topology processing, observability, bad-data handling, and online power system analysis. 
 - Map and validate analog, digital, status, command, and calculated signals from SCADA/DCS/IED/gateway systems and troubleshoot model/data mismatches. 
 - Model and analyze distribution networks and configure ADMS functions including distribution load flow, state estimation, FLISR, switching analysis, Voltage/VAR Optimization (VVO), and network reconfiguration. 
 - Support Outage Management System (OMS) configuration, network tracing, outage identification, restoration workflows, and integration with SCADA, GIS, and enterprise systems. 
 - Engineer and configure power automation and SCADA interfaces, including points/tags, alarms, events, trends, measurements, statuses, commands, and HMI functions. 
 - Configure and troubleshoot communication using protocols such as IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3, Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC UA/DA, and ICCP/TASE. 2. 
 - Support integration of IEDs, RTUs, PLCs, gateways, managed switches, and control-center interfaces. 
 - Perform basic IT/OT system and network configuration, including servers/workstations, IP addressing, managed switches, VLANs, remote access, redundancy, and connectivity troubleshooting. 
 - Prepare FAT/SAT procedures and lead or participate in internal testing, FAT, integration testing, site commissioning, SAT, and functional demonstrations. 
 - Investigate technical issues, perform root-cause analysis, close test observations and punch points, and support customer acceptance. 
 - Plan and monitor project engineering activities, schedules, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and technical interfaces. 
 - Prepare and review FDS, architecture documents, signal lists, interface documents, study reports, test procedures, commissioning records, user manuals, and as-built documentation. 
 - Coordinate with project management, engineering teams, software teams, vendors, EPC contractors, consultants, and customers. 
 - Prepare and deliver customer training covering system architecture, power system applications, operational workflows, troubleshooting, and routine system operation. 
 - Support technical knowledge transfer and mentor junior engineers where required. 

Essential Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related discipline. 

- Minimum 5-6 years of relevant experience in power system studies, real-time power system applications, ADMS/SCADA, power automation, or related project engineering. 
 - Hands-on experience in electrical network modeling and power system analysis. 
 - Working knowledge of real-time power system applications, SCADA, communication protocols, and IT/OT environments. 
 - Experience in FAT, SAT, testing, commissioning, technical documentation, and customer interaction. 
 - Industry exposure in Oil & Gas, Industrial, Utilities / Transmission & Distribution, or Power Generation; Renewable/BESS experience is an advantage. 
 - Professional written and spoken English. 
 - Willingness to travel and mobilize to project sites within the GCC, including onshore/offshore locations and extended site stays when required. 

Desired Skills

Power System Modeling & Digital Twin Development

- Load Flow, Short-Circuit & Relay Coordination
 - Harmonic & Transient Stability Analysis
 - Motor Acceleration & Voltage Stability Studies
 - ETAP Power System Analysis
 - Real-Time Power System Analysis & SLE
 - ADMS / OMS / FLISR / VVO
 - SCADA Configuration & Integration
 - IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3, Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC UA/DA & ICCP/TASE. 2
 - Industrial Communication & IT/OT Networking
 - FAT, SAT & Site Commissioning
 - Technical Documentation & Report Preparation
 - Project Engineering & Coordination
 - Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis
 - Customer Training & Technical Demonstration
 - Leadership, Communication & Stakeholder Management
 - Knowledge of PSS®E, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, PSCAD, CYME, ASPEN OneLiner, Hitachi Energy/ABB Network Manager, or equivalent platforms is advantageous. 

ETAP requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria. 

ETAP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. 

Come and join ETAP to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.

Lead Mobile Software Engineer (P4)

Who We Are

Solera is a global leader in data and software services, transforming every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. Our teams work on mission‐critical platforms that demand reliability, scalability, and thoughtful evolution of complex systems.

- We're looking for a hands-on Lead Mobile Software Engineer (P4) who will help design, build, modernize, and deliver enterprise-grade mobile applications across iOS and Android. This role is focused on building reliable, scalable, secure, and high-performing mobile experiences while applying AI-driven development practices to improve engineering velocity, product quality, and team effectiveness.

 - Leads meaningful mobile features and workstreams across discovery, design, implementation, launch, and continuous improvement
 - Designs and builds cross-platform mobile solutions spanning iOS, Android, and shared mobile components
 - Applies AI-driven development practices, AI-assisted engineering tools, and modern mobile workflows to improve delivery speed and product quality
 - Makes sound technical decisions that balance native platform quality, cross-platform reuse, performance, security, maintainability, and delivery needs
 - Partners effectively with product, design, architecture, backend, security, QA, DevOps/SRE, and business stakeholders to deliver mobile outcomes

Build, Ship, and Own Mobile Applications

Software Backend Test Engineer

Our Purpose

TERADYNE - where experience meets innovation and driving excellence in every connection. We foster an inclusive culture that values diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning, enabling us to deliver advanced robotics solutions with real‐world impact. 

Opportunity Overview

In this role, you will contribute directly to the quality and reliability of robot platform and its core components. You would be responsible for testing the core operating system components of the Robot, including networking features, firewall features etc. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure that our solutions meet the highest standards of performance, safety, and usability. 

We are looking for a Backend Test engineer with strong Python automation skills who enjoys working close to the product and the code. You should be comfortable combining hands-on manual testing with Linux Based platforms using Python-based automated testing, while also bringing a strong understanding of ROS. If you are motivated by improving product quality through robust test coverage, fast feedback loops, and close collaboration with developers, this could be the right role for you. 

Responsibilities

- Design, write, and maintain automated tests in Python for new and existing features of the operating system components of the Robot 
 - Develop and maintain unit, integration, and regression tests to ensure stable and reliable releases 
 - Work closely with developers to understand the changes being made in the controller operating system layer or the network layer, investigate failures, and improve testability 
 - Contribute to and improve test frameworks 
 - Help define effective test strategies and quality practices across the development lifecycle in an agile setup 
 - Build tests that have hardware in the loop (not all flakiness comes from software)

Qualification, Experience, Skills And Educational Background

To succeed in this role, we imagine you have a strong background in software test engineering and a practical mindset when it comes to combining automation with hands-on validation. You understand how software is built, how systems fail, and how to create effective tests that increase quality and confidence. 

Skills Required

- 4 to 6 years of experience in software backend testing, software quality engineering of OS level software components, or a similar role 
 - Strong experience writing and maintaining automated tests in Python for backend components using tools like pytest and FastAPI. 
 - Experience with Penetration testing 
 - Experience with API Testing 
 - Familiarity with GoLang and its frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with Containerization technique (Docker, Podman) 
 - Proficient with linux environment and linux commands 
 - Linux networking stack + systemd (services, journald, network namespaces) 
 - Network analysis tooling: Wireshark/tcpdump and nmap and traffic shaping for resilience tests. 
 - Hands-on experience with manual testing of complex systems, ideally involving hardware, robotics, or integrated software-hardware solutions 
 - Experience creating and maintaining unit, integration, and regression tests 
 - Good understanding of test frameworks, debugging, and finding root causes 
 - Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, build servers, or DevOps practices such as Jenkins or similar tools 
 - Ability to understand complex systems, identify risks, and design effective test coverage 
 - Experience working in agile or scrum environments

It Will Be Considered An Advantage If You Have

- Familiarity with ROS2, Industrial Communication Protocols 
 - Familiarity with Firewall (NF Tables/IP Tables) 
 - Experience building or improving test automation frameworks 
 - Hardware-in-the-loop test frameworks such as labgrid, bench hardware, networked power for automated power-cycling, serial console capture, etc. 
 - Automating through the robot's own interfaces (Dashboard Server, RTDE, the primary/secondary/real-time client ports, URScript) 
 - Strong knowledge of DevOps practices, pipelines, and build servers 
 - Knowledge of safety standards and regulations relevant to robotics or industrial systems

Communication Skills

- Strong communication and collaboration skills and fluency in English 
 - Experience working with distributed and international teams 
 - Working across teams and locations 
 - You will be part of a setup where engineers in India and Denmark work closely together. 
 - This requires: 
 - Clear and conscientious communication 
 - Ability to explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 
 - A collaborative mindset and willingness to contribute across team boundaries

We are only considering candidates local to the position location. This position does not offer relocation or visa sponsorship.

data.title: Agentic Full-Stack Engineer
data.description:
Agentic Full-Stack Engineer

About Securin

Securin is an AI-native cybersecurity company. Our Preemptive Exposure Management Platform turns exposure data into clear decisions - giving organizations the confidence to know which risks are exploitable, what to fix first, and how to act before attackers do. 

Our Engineering Values

We build with agents and verify with humans - treating AI as a genuine collaborator, holding agent-generated code to the same review standard as human-authored code, and shipping features only when test coverage and security checks are in place. We take end-to-end ownership, write maintainable code, and bring security awareness into every decision - not as a checkbox, but as a core discipline. 

The Role

A high-agency software engineer who uses coding agents as a force multiplier: generating design specs with AI, curating those outputs with engineering judgment, and shipping high-quality features at pace on the Securin cybersecurity platform. 

Responsibilities

● Feature Development

Design and ship full-stack features for the Securin platform end-to-end - using AI coding agents (Claude) to generate specs and boilerplate, then curating those outputs with engineering rigor, security context, and architectural judgment before finalizing. Work with teams in the US and India to facilitate communication, operations, and design. Required to attend 1-2 US evening meetings a week to sync with India based teams. 

● Agent & Automation Engineering

Build agentic workflows and automation pipelines that streamline engineering - and enforce a human-in-the-loop review process ensuring every AI-produced change is critically evaluated for correctness, security, and fit before it reaches production. 

● Platform & Infrastructure

Architect and maintain cloud-native SaaS services on AWS, contributing to API design, data modeling, and microservices architecture that power real-time threat intelligence ingestion and delivery. 

● Security Mindset

Apply secure-by-design principles throughout development and work alongside Securin's security researchers to translate vulnerability intelligence domain knowledge into robust platform capabilities. 

Requirements

● 3+ years building production SaaS

● Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

● Public cloud experience required (AWS preferred, GCP or Azure acceptable)

● Deep familiarity with: 

○ Containerization

○ Serverless architecture

○ Event-driven architecture

○ RESTful API design

Culture-Forward Building with AI: What We Expect - Role-Specific

○ Hands-on, daily use of AI coding agents is a prerequisite. 

○ Must be able to critically review agent-generated code and specs for: 

● Hallucinations

● Security flaws

● Architectural drift before merging. 

General

Securin is committed to becoming an AI-native organization where GenAI is embedded into how every team works - not just as an occasional assistant, but as a core part of delivery, operations, and how our expertise compounds over time. We expect every employee to actively integrate

GenAI tools into daily workflows - Automating routine tasks, accelerating research and analysis, drafting documents, and building reusable AI-powered processes for their function. You should understand the limitations of GenAI (including inaccuracies and data sensitivity boundaries), follow data classification rules, and continuously improve your AI proficiency. As you grow, we expect you to move beyond using GenAI to building with it - designing agent workflows, contributing reusable skills, and helping Securin compound its Proactive Exposure Management expertise faster than any competitor can replicate. 

● Demonstrated ability to use GenAI tools (e. g. , Claude, ChatGPT, etc. ) for daily work - drafting, research, summarization, data analysis, code generation, or workflow automation as relevant to the role. 

● Working knowledge of GenAI limitations including hallucination risk, context window constraints, and data sensitivity boundaries; ability to validate AI-generated output before acting on it. 

● Familiarity with prompt engineering techniques - structuring multi-step instructions, providing context, and iterating on output quality to achieve production-grade results. 

● Comfort with agentic AI workflows - using, designing, or building multi-step AI agents that execute tasks autonomously with human-in-the-loop validation. 

● Awareness of AI security fundamentals - prompt injection risks, data classification rules, sandboxed execution, and responsible handling of sensitive data in AI workflows. 

● Familiarity with connecting GenAI tools to internal data sources, APIs, and enterprise systems. 

● Ability to contribute reusable AI skills, templates, agent configurations, or automation workflows to a shared repository for team-wide use. 

● Willingness to learn and adopt new AI tools as they evolve; participation in AI adoption sprints, hackathons, and knowledge-sharing within the team. 

Location : Remote (For candidates outside Chennai), Hybrid model (2 days a week to office - for candidates from Chennai)

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Contact Center Systems Engineer / Quality Engineer for a freelance contract engagement supporting a global enterprise contact center platform. 

The candidate will maintain an existing commercial contact center platform while supporting the implementation and migration to a next-generation solution built on open-source telephony components such as FreeSWITCH and Kamailio. 

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in SIP/VoIP troubleshooting, Linux administration, contact center configuration, production incident management, and QA testing. 

Key Responsibilities

- Configure and maintain contact center routing strategies, queues, IVR flows, and agent targeting. 
 - Troubleshoot SIP, RTP, VoIP, call flows, network connectivity, and voice quality issues. 
 - Support contact center platforms such as Genesys, NICE, Five9, Avaya, or Cisco. 
 - Assist with the implementation and migration of open-source telephony platforms. 
 - Analyze existing routing logic and document configurations for the target architecture. 
 - Perform feature-parity testing, integration testing, UAT, and release validation. 
 - Diagnose production incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and maintain incident documentation. 
 - Automate repetitive operational tasks and review test automation with engineering teams. 
 - Collaborate with globally distributed teams and provide structured shift handovers. 
 - Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and configuration records. Required Skills

- Hands-on experience with enterprise contact center platforms. 
 - Strong knowledge of SIP, RTP, VoIP, TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, and QoS. 
 - Experience troubleshooting call flows, routing logic, and voice quality issues. 
 - Proficiency in Linux administration and command-line troubleshooting. 
 - Experience with Python, Bash, JavaScript, or another scripting/programming language. 
 - Familiarity with REST APIs, webhooks, Git, and deployment workflows. 
 - Strong production incident management and troubleshooting skills. Preferred Skills

- Hands-on experience with FreeSWITCH, Kamailio, OpenSIPS, or Asterisk. 
 - Experience with contact center platform migration or replacement projects. 
 - SIP debugging tools: Wireshark, sngrep, sipgrep, or HOMER. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Terraform or Ansible. 
 - Monitoring and observability: Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, or Datadog. 
 - Experience with automated voice testing tools such as Cyara. 
 - Knowledge of SQL, AI-enabled contact centers, and ITIL/ITSM practices. Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a hands-on engineer who can troubleshoot complex telephony issues, support production operations, validate new platform configurations, and contribute to contact center modernization initiatives.

Company Description Ranchi Techno Park Pvt. Ltd. (RTPark) is a fast-growing Managed IT Services firm based in Ranchi, India, with a primary focus on cloud computing and professional services. Since its incorporation in January 2020, RTPark has expanded its capabilities into IT consulting, enterprise software solutions, and comprehensive cloud services to deliver end-to-end managed IT offerings. The company specializes in cloud solutions, network services, security solutions, customized applications, system integration, AI tools, and professional IT services such as project management and IT infrastructure services. RTPark is committed to using advanced technologies, strong management processes, and robust quality control to ensure complex projects are delivered on time and within budget. Team members benefit from a supportive environment that emphasizes dignity, independence, healthy work-life balance, competitive compensation, flexible scheduling, and reimbursement for tuition and training expenses. 
Role Description The Quality Assurance Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Ranchi. This role is responsible for designing and executing QA processes to ensure that IT services, solutions, and internal operations meet defined quality standards and regulatory requirements. Day-to-day activities include developing test plans, performing quality checks, documenting defects, coordinating root-cause analysis, and working closely with technical and project teams to implement corrective and preventive actions. The specialist will conduct internal quality audits, monitor compliance with established procedures, maintain QA documentation, and support continuous improvement initiatives. Additionally, this role involves collaborating with stakeholders to refine quality metrics, providing training on QA best practices, and contributing to the enhancement of RTPark's quality management framework. 
Qualifications

- Candidates should possess strong skills in Quality Assurance and Quality Control to design, implement, and monitor effective QA processes. 
 - Candidates should possess skills in Quality Management to develop, maintain, and improve organizational quality standards and procedures. 
 - Candidates should possess knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) or equivalent industry quality frameworks to ensure compliance and consistency. 
 - Candidates should possess skills in Quality Auditing to conduct systematic reviews, identify gaps, and recommend corrective actions. 
 - Relevant bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, quality management, or a related field. 
 - Experience in IT services, software development, or cloud environments with hands-on QA/testing responsibilities. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and proficiency with QA tools and documentation practices. 
 - Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams in a structured, process-driven environment. 
 - Familiarity with ISO standards, ITIL, or other quality and service management frameworks is an advantage.

data.title: Staff Engineer, Silicon & Data Automation Systems (Design, DFT, Diagnostics, Yield)
data.description:
Company

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Engineering

General Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically strong Staff Engineer, Silicon & Data Automation Systems to help build and expand a growing automation team supporting silicon and system yield engineering, spanning design, DFT, diagnostics, and yield engineering workflows. This role will focus on developing production-grade automation, data pipelines, database-backed applications, and engineering tools that improve the speed, quality, and scalability of complex semiconductor engineering workflows. 

This position is part of a broader effort to increase automation capacity within the silicon engineering organization, beginning with new engineering roles in the Bangalore Design Center (BDC). The engineer will work closely with U. S. -based yield automation leadership and stakeholders, including regular overlap with U. S. Central Time morning hours. 

This is a senior individual contributor role. The successful candidate will build new automation capabilities under architectural guidance, contribute to robust production systems, and use modern AI-assisted engineering practices to increase development velocity and quality. This role requires an AI-first engineering mindset, where LLM-based coding agents and AI-assisted automation tools are used as core productivity multipliers while maintaining strong human ownership of correctness, security, review, and production safety. 

The ideal candidate is a strong Linux, data, database, and automation engineer who can work effectively in complex semiconductor engineering environments. Prior experience with semiconductor engineering domains such as silicon design, DFT, validation, diagnostics, or yield is strongly preferred but not required for candidates with strong automation and data engineering depth. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

Key Responsibilities

Automation Development & Production Engineering

- Design, develop, test, and maintain automation tools that improve silicon and system yield engineering workflows, including data processing, diagnostics, reporting, and operation efficiency. 
 - Build reliable Linux-based automation services, scripts, data loaders, and backend systems used by engineering teams. 
 - Develop production-grade solutions with appropriate logging, monitoring, error handling, alerting, documentation, and operational supportability. 
 - Contribute to systems that are maintainable, fault-tolerant, secure, and suitable for long-running production use. 
 - Debug and resolve automation issues across Linux servers, databases, file systems, scheduled jobs, data feeds, and dependent engineering systems. 
 - Work under architectural guidance to implement new automation capabilities while developing deeper ownership of specific tools, workflows, or data domains over time. 

Data Systems & Database Automation

- Build and maintain data pipelines that collect, transform, validate, and load engineering and manufacturing data across design, DFT, validation, diagnostics, and yield-related systems. 
 - Work with relational databases, SQL, schema design, query optimization, and database-backed automation workflows. 
 - Integrate data from multiple sources, including engineering systems, manufacturing data feeds, logs, reports, and analysis outputs. 
 - Develop tools that make complex data easier to access, validate, monitor, and act upon. 
 - Ensure data quality, traceability, and operational robustness in automation that supports engineering analysis and decision-making. 

AI-Assisted Engineering & Automation Acceleration

- Use LLM-based coding agents and AI-assisted automation tools responsibly as part of day-to-day engineering work. 
 - Apply AI-assisted development practices to improve code quality, accelerate troubleshooting, generate tests, improve documentation, and increase engineering output. 
 - Build or integrate AI-enabled engineering tools where appropriate, including automation agents, internal assistants, MCP servers, and workflow accelerators. 
 - Maintain strong human review and engineering judgment for AI-generated code, SQL, analysis, documentation, and operational recommendations. 
 - Ensure AI-assisted workflows follow appropriate standards for security, correctness, maintainability, and production safety. 
 - Help establish practical patterns for using AI-first development methods in production engineering environments. 

Tooling, Applications & Workflow Integration

- Build backend tools, dashboards, web applications, APIs, command-line utilities, and scheduled automation to support engineering needs. 
 - Use appropriate technologies for the problem, including Python, shell scripting, SQL, Django or similar frameworks, REST APIs, log analytics tools, and enterprise data systems. 
 - Integrate automation into existing engineering workflows without disrupting production operations. 
 - Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to identify manual pain points and convert them into reliable automated solutions. 
 - Create clear documentation, usage guidance, and operational notes so tools can be supported and extended over time. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with engineers across design, DFT, validation, diagnostics, and data domains to understand requirements and deliver practical solutions. 
 - Communicate technical findings, implementation options, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to both software-oriented and semiconductor engineering audiences. 
 - Participate in code reviews, design discussions, troubleshooting sessions, and production readiness reviews. 
 - Collaborate effectively across time zones, including regular overlap with U. S. Central Time morning hours. 
 - Contribute to a growing team culture focused on engineering rigor, accountability, automation leverage, and continuous improvement. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Linux-based development and automation, including shell scripting, server-side troubleshooting, cron or scheduled jobs, file systems, permissions, and operational debugging. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python or a comparable language used for automation, data processing, backend systems, or engineering tools. 
 - Strong experience with SQL, relational databases, data modeling, query development, and database-backed applications. 
 - Experience building automation that processes, validates, transforms, or integrates large technical datasets. 
 - Experience developing production-quality software or automation with testing, logging, error handling, documentation, and maintainability. 
 - Experience using Git or similar version control systems in a collaborative environment. 
 - Practical experience using LLM-based coding agents or AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity. 
 - Ability to review AI-generated work critically and maintain ownership of correctness, security, reliability, and production readiness. 
 - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across software, data, database, and Linux environments. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. 
 - Ability to work effectively with U. S. -based stakeholders with required time overlap. 

Additional Consideration

- Candidates with strong software, data, or automation backgrounds from non-semiconductor domains will be considered if they demonstrate the ability to learn complex engineering workflows quickly. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with semiconductor design, DFT, validation, diagnostics, yield, or product engineering environments. 
 - Experience working with engineering datasets such as test data, DFT outputs, manufacturing data, diagnostic data, or high-volume silicon or system telemetry. 
 - Familiarity with semiconductor data formats such as STDF, KLARF, wafer maps, lot history, test results, binning, dispositions, or assembly data. 
 - Experience building automation for engineering teams in semiconductor, manufacturing, hardware, or similar domains. 
 - Experience with Oracle, PL/SQL, ODBC, database loaders, schema design, or production database integration. 
 - Experience with Django or similar backend frameworks. 
 - Experience with REST APIs, internal tools, dashboards, reporting systems, or workflow applications. 
 - Experience with log analytics, monitoring, Splunk, or observability tools. 
 - Experience with batch compute, distributed jobs, LSF or grid environments, or multi-server automation. 
 - Experience building or integrating AI-assisted tools, internal agents, MCP servers, or RAG workflows. 
 - Familiarity with responsible AI-assisted development practices, including human-in-the-loop review and secure handling of generated outputs. 
 - Experience working across global teams and time zones. 

Desired Technical Profile

The ideal candidate operates across multiple layers of the engineering stack: 

- Linux: Comfortable diagnosing runtime issues, managing scripts, and troubleshooting production systems. 
 - Data: Able to handle complex, messy engineering data and build reliable transformations with traceability. 
 - Databases: Strong SQL skills with practical understanding of schemas, performance, and data integrity. 
 - Automation: Able to convert manual workflows into robust and scalable systems. 
 - Production Mindset: Builds systems that are observable, maintainable, secure, and resilient.

We have a flock of more than 1, 800 employees across the globe and are proud to be a Flexible-First employer. We empower our employees with the choice of working from an office, from home, or on a hybrid schedule. Our flexible-first environment fosters productivity, inclusion, collaboration, and ensures consistent employee experience regardless of location. 

If working in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving company that is transforming one of the world's oldest and largest industries sounds exciting, let us know. We are excited you are considering Duck Creek as a future employer and hope you decide to join "The Flock"!

To learn more about us, visit www. duckcreek. com and follow us on our social channels for the latest information - LinkedIn and Twitter. 

What You'll Do

The Principal Software Architect is a strategic technical leader responsible for driving architectural excellence across multiple domains and teams. This role blends deep technical expertise with leadership in modern technologies including AI/ML, cloud-native platforms, observability, and cloud security. 

Job Functions & Responsibilities

Architectural Leadership

- Acts as a Domain Architect for a major functional area, owning the architectural vision and roadmap. 
 - Defines and evolves cloud-native architectures using microservices, containers (Docker), and orchestration (Kubernetes). 
 - Leads the integration of AI/ML capabilities into products, including:

Cloud & Security Expertise

Monitoring & Observability

 - Grafana for real-time dashboards and visualization

 - OpenTelemetry for distributed tracing 
 - ELK/EFK stacks for log aggregation and analysis

Technical Strategy & Innovation

- Designs, codes, and configures solutions for high-impact stories

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Behaviors

- Expert knowledge of object-oriented design and enterprise application architecture patterns
 - Expert in C# and associated frameworks
 - Deep understanding of distributed software patterns and full-stack technologies
 - Proficient in relational data storage, database design, query optimization, and operational considerations

 - Skilled in XML technologies including schema design, XPath, and XSLT

 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Lead Software Engineer, Foundational APIs

Location: Noida, India

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, and collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn, and pursue meaningful outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values: Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we are saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

SimCorp is establishing a Foundational APIs capability to make core business data and functionality easier to access securely, consistently, and reliably across our products and solutions. 

As a Lead Software Engineer, you will help turn this ambition into working software. You will design and build API capabilities that support product experiences, integrations, workflows, clients, and approved AI solutions without requiring consumers to understand the complexity of SimCorp's underlying systems. 

You will be a senior, hands-on member of a newly established engineering team in India. You will help the team deliver its first production capabilities, establish effective engineering practices, and make sound implementation decisions across API design, distributed systems, security, reliability, testing, and cloud engineering. 

The role requires strong technical depth and practical delivery experience. You will contribute directly to the codebase while guiding other engineers through design discussions, reviews, problem solving, and continuous improvement. 

You will collaborate with architects, Product Management, domain experts, Platform teams, and engineers across SimCorp to build capabilities that are valuable today and sustainable as the wider platform evolves. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate secure and reliable Foundational API services using C#/. NET and Microsoft Azure. 
 - Translate business and consumer requirements into clear API contracts, technical designs, and incremental implementation plans. 
 - Provide hands-on technical leadership through coding, design discussions, code reviews, pairing, testing, and production problem resolution. 
 - Build API capabilities around clear business use cases rather than exposing the complexity of underlying systems and legacy implementations. 
 - Work with domain experts to understand the business meaning of concepts such as portfolios, positions, transactions, cash, instruments, and settlement information. 
 - Address distributed-system concerns including latency, partial failure, retries, idempotency, concurrency, resilience, and source-system availability. 
 - Build scalable and maintainable backend services with appropriate performance, security, and reliability characteristics. 
 - Assess and reuse existing API frameworks, gateways, integration solutions, domain services, and supported interfaces before introducing new abstractions. 
 - Create adapters and service components that separate stable consumer contracts from legacy or changing underlying implementations. 
 - Support the incremental modernization of existing systems without disrupting current consumers and business processes. 
 - Establish and promote effective engineering practices covering clean code, automated testing, contract testing, secure development, observability, CI/CD, and operational readiness. 
 - Build comprehensive automated tests across unit, integration, API, contract, and end-to-end levels where appropriate. 
 - Help define quality controls for API changes, including compatibility, versioning, documentation, security, and production readiness. 
 - Diagnose performance bottlenecks, production issues, integration failures, and complex defects, and implement sustainable solutions. 
 - Break complex engineering problems into focused, testable, and releasable increments. 
 - Collaborate with the Principal Software Engineer and architects on significant technical decisions and convert agreed direction into practical implementation. 
 - Mentor engineers through technical planning, code reviews, pairing, knowledge sharing, and constructive feedback. 
 - Promote shared technical ownership and help the team avoid dependency on individual specialists. 
 - Collaborate with Product Management, Platform, Architecture, Security, Data, and domain engineering teams to deliver integrated capabilities. 
 - Communicate technical decisions, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and limitations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Continuously improve yourself, the team, our engineering practices, and the Foundational APIs capability. 

What We Value

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing to and thriving in this role. We expect you to have strong expertise in several of the areas below, together with the willingness and curiosity to develop in the others. 

- More than five years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Strong programming experience in C# and . NET, with a good understanding of clean, maintainable, and testable code. 
 - Practical experience designing and developing REST APIs, backend services, and system integrations. 
 - Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, cloud infrastructure, and production deployment. 
 - Experience creating and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated quality controls. 
 - Strong understanding of API design principles, including contracts, resource modelling, versioning, backward compatibility, pagination, filtering, and error handling. 
 - Experience designing secure backend systems using authentication, authorization, identity, access control, and secrets management. 
 - Understanding of distributed-system concerns such as latency, resilience, concurrency, partial failure, consistency, idempotency, and safe retries. 
 - Strong automated-testing skills, including unit, integration, API, contract, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Experience with observability practices including structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, health monitoring, and operational diagnostics. 
 - Experience with relational databases and SQL. 
 - Familiarity with messaging, event-driven architecture, service bus patterns, or streaming technologies is valuable. 
 - Experience with Domain-Driven Design or similar approaches to defining business capabilities and service boundaries is valuable. 
 - Experience working with legacy systems, modernization initiatives, adapters, or incremental migration is valuable. 
 - Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to simplify complex technical problems and create maintainable solutions without introducing unnecessary abstraction. 
 - Ability to balance immediate delivery needs with security, reliability, maintainability, and long-term contract stability. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence through practical guidance and collaboration. 
 - A continuous-improvement mindset and experience working in an agile engineering environment. 
 - Experience collaborating in an international product-development organization. 
 - Strong communication skills and fluency in English, both written and spoken. 
 - A degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, or a related field is valuable, but practical engineering experience and demonstrated capability are equally important. 
 - Interest in learning the investment-management domain and understanding the business meaning behind the capabilities being developed. 
 - Readiness to learn relevant SimCorp technologies, frameworks, and legacy environments where required. 

AI-ENABLED DEVELOPMENT

- Use approved AI tools as part of everyday engineering, development, testing, documentation, and technical-discovery workflows. 
 - Critically evaluate AI-generated code, tests, designs, and documentation for correctness, security, maintainability, and architectural fit. 
 - Help engineers understand when AI can accelerate delivery and when deeper engineering judgment and review are required. 
 - Identify opportunities where AI-assisted development can accelerate prototyping, reduce repetitive work, strengthen testing, and improve developer productivity. 
 - Ensure that AI-generated artifacts meet the same engineering, security, testing, and review standards as other contributions. 

FURTHERMORE, WE VALUE THAT YOU

- Take ownership from technical discovery through implementation, deployment, and production operation. 
 - Are curious about complex business and technical problems and seek to understand the context before proposing solutions. 
 - Can work effectively when business knowledge, implementation ownership, and technical dependencies are distributed across different teams. 
 - Are comfortable challenging assumptions constructively and changing direction when evidence supports a better approach. 
 - Lead through practical engineering contribution rather than relying on title or authority. 
 - Create a collaborative environment where engineers can raise concerns, explore alternatives, and learn from successes and failures. 
 - Identify technical debt and architectural risks and help the team address them deliberately. 
 - Focus on delivering the smallest useful capability that can be validated with a real consumer. 
 - Combine strong technical judgment with humility, openness, and respect for the expertise of others. 

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy: We ask you to work two days a week from the office. You may work remotely on the other days, or work from the office if that is your preference. 
 - Culture: An inclusive and diverse company culture where different perspectives and expertise are valued. 
 - Work-life balance: We believe that a sustainable balance between professional and personal responsibilities helps everyone perform at their best. 
 - Empowerment: We believe all voices are valuable and should be heard. You will be involved in shaping our technical direction and ways of working. 
 - Career and growth: SimCorp offers opportunities for professional development and supports individual career paths based on your strengths and aspirations. 
 - Innovation: You will have opportunities to contribute to engineering improvements, modernization, and strategic capabilities with impact across SimCorp. 

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English through our career site as soon as possible. We assess incoming applications continuously, and only applications submitted through our system can be processed. 

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur during recruitment. To support fairness and equal opportunity for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal information such as photographs, age, or other non-professional details from your application. 

If you are interested in joining SimCorp but are unsure whether this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you identify suitable opportunities. 

We continuously seek to improve our talent-acquisition process and make every candidate's experience positive and valuable. During the process, we may ask you to provide feedback, which will be highly appreciated. 

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become a leading provider of integrated investment-management solutions. Our colleagues represent a broad range of nationalities, educational backgrounds, professional experiences, and perspectives. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of Deutsche Börse Group. Following the merger with Axioma, we combine the strengths of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other status protected under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. 

We believe in the continuous growth and development of our employees so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

You will provide technical leadership across distributed file system architecture, storage protocols, metadata services, data protection, and Kubernetes-based infrastructure. You will influence long-term platform direction while remaining close enough to the technology to solve some of the most complex systems challenges in enterprise storage. 

This role is ideal for engineers who thrive at the intersection of distributed systems, performance engineering, cloud-native infrastructure, and large-scale storage platforms. 

This role is not intended for engineers focused primarily on application development, front-end technologies, or isolated feature delivery. 

This role is located at Nasuni's Hyderabad Office - Hybrid 3 Days Onsite per week.

You Will

- Own architectural decisions spanning multiple subsystems

 - Drive platform scalability, resilience, and operational excellence
 - Influence engineering standards across multiple teams
 - Mentor senior engineers and technical leaders
 - Balance long-term architecture investments with near-term delivery goals

Responsibilities

- Define architecture and technical direction for Nasuni's distributed file system platform

 - Reduce operational complexity through automation and platform improvements

Ideal

Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams-and the AI that supports them.
