Job Details

We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and analytical Data Quality Specialist (Level 2) to join our dedicated team. In this critical role, you will focus on ensuring data quality and accuracy, and analysis. Your responsibilities will be vital to supporting our onboarding processes, including auditing and validating customer master fields, creating Master Load Templates (MLTs) based on customer-provided documentation, determining credit parameters for specific thresholds and existing accounts, and finalizing account setups to enable customers to place orders. 

You will collaborate closely with Data Quality Specialists (Level 1) and cross-functional teams to facilitate successful onboarding and account setup for new customers. If you thrive in a detail-driven environment and are passionate about upholding high standards of data integrity, this is the perfect opportunity for you to advance your career. The ideal candidate will possess a keen eye for detail, excellent problem-solving skills, and a solid understanding of customer master data management and onboarding workflows. 

Key Responsibilities

- 
 - Data Auditing & Validation: Audit and validate all SAP customer master fields for onboarding records to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with organizational standards. 

- 
 - Advanced Documentation Analysis: Lead the analysis of customer-submitted documents to extract and interpret essential data elements, determining setup parameters that align with customer needs. 
 - Quality Assurance Champion: Conduct meticulous quality checks to safeguard data integrity, identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving discrepancies or errors to ensure all data is complete and reliable. 

- 
 - Data Integrity Maintenance: Identify and correct discrepancies in customer master data, ensuring high-quality standards for data accuracy and integrity. 
 - Collaboration: Partner closely with cross functional teams, sales and Customer Engagement Managers to clarify data requirements and resolve any issues related to data input. 

-

 - MLT Creation: Create Master Load Templates (MLTs) based on customer input gathered through document collection processes, ensuring alignment with operational and regulatory requirements. 

- 
 - Documentation Management: Review and analyze customer documentation to determine load parameters. 

- 
 - Threshold Credit Setup: Assess and determines credit parameters for new accounts under a specified threshold, ensuring adherence to company policies and procedures.

data.description:
About Zinier

80% of the workers across the globe are Deskless. These are the people who keep our lights on and gas flowing, build roads and bridges, run our manufacturing factories, ensure that we get healthcare service, and provide us with reliable phone and internet connectivity. As entrepreneurs, have we considered solving their problems and making them more productive?

Zinier is a company on a mission to empower frontline workers - and the people supporting them - to achieve greater things for themselves and the world around them. With the majority of workers worldwide being deskless, Zinier recognizes the need for Technology Equity to improve the lives and productivity of these workers who keep the world up and running. 

We have global team headquartered in Silicon Valley, with a hybrid workforce across the United States, Canada, Europe, Latin America, Singapore, and Bangalore, India, with leading investors that include Accel, ICONIQ Capital, Founders Fund, Newfund Capital, NGP Capital, Tiger Global Management, and Qualcomm Ventures LLC. 

What we're looking for

We are looking for a SDE to join our rapidly expanding Engineering team. 

Responsibilities

- Application Development - Design, develop, configure, and enhance business applications using the Zinier Low/No-Code Platform. 
 - Module Development - Build new modules, workflows, business rules, UI components, and application capabilities based on product requirements. 
 - Application Enhancement - Analyze existing modules and continuously improve functionality, usability, reliability, and performance. 
 - Integration Development - Build and maintain integrations with REST APIs, third-party applications, enterprise systems, and other services. 
 - End-to-End Development - Work across frontend, backend, APIs, integrations, and platform components to deliver complete solutions. 
 - Testing & Quality Assurance - Develop unit, integration, and functional tests and ensure high-quality production releases. 
 - Performance & Security - Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and implement secure application development practices, including protection against XSS, CSRF/XSRF, and other common web vulnerabilities. 
 - AI-Native Development - Build and integrate AI/LLM-powered capabilities such as copilots, intelligent automation, recommendations, and AI-assisted workflows. 
 - Production Support - Diagnose and resolve application, integration, and production issues efficiently. 
 - Collaboration - Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Architects, QA, and other engineering teams to deliver robust solutions. 
 - Version Control & Deployment - Follow engineering best practices using Git, CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, and automated testing. 
 - Continuous Improvement - Identify opportunities to improve application architecture, development processes, platform capabilities, and engineering productivity. 

Required Skills

- 6-10 years of software development experience building scalable web applications. 
 - Strong programming fundamentals in JavaScript/TypeScript. 
 - Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React. js or Angular. 
 - Good understanding of asynchronous programming, AJAX/fetch, JSON, REST APIs, and web application architecture. 
 - Experience with API integrations, authentication, authorization, and API security. 
 - Experience with unit testing frameworks such as Jest, Jasmine, or Mocha. 
 - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills. 
 - Experience with Git and CI/CD practices. 
 - Understanding of web performance optimization and cross-browser compatibility. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a low-code/no-code application development environment. 

AI-Native Development - Must Have

- Hands-on experience building or integrating applications powered by LLMs or AI services. 
 - Experience with AI/LLM platforms or APIs such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock, or similar. 
 - Experience designing and iterating on prompt flows and AI workflows. 
 - Understanding of structured outputs, function/tool calling, RAG, or agentic workflows. 
 - Ability to evaluate AI output quality and design mechanisms for monitoring, feedback, and continuous improvement. 
 - Understanding of AI application security, data privacy, hallucination mitigation, and access control. 

Backend Development - Good to Have

- Experience with Java/JEE, Spring Boot, and RESTful services. 
 - Understanding of database design, schemas, and SQL/NoSQL databases. 
 - Exposure to microservices architecture. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 

What would make a candidate successful

- Strong software engineering fundamentals rather than dependence on a particular framework. 
 - Ability to translate business requirements into working applications. 
 - Comfortable working across UI → business logic → APIs → integrations → data. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. 
 - Curiosity and willingness to learn new platform capabilities and AI technologies. 
 - Ability to balance configuration, low-code development, and custom engineering appropriately.

data.title: Lead Security Engineer (Privileged Access Management )
data.description:
Aboud Gartner Information Security: 

Gartner Information Security enables the business to move quickly and confidently by protecting our people, data, and ideas. We are a global team of defenders, investigators, engineers, and lifelong learners who solve complex security challenges together. 

You will join an inclusive, security-first culture where expertise is shared, thoughtful challenge is encouraged, and strong ideas can come from anyone. If you are curious, practical, and motivated to strengthen the security posture of a global organization, you will have the opportunity to make a visible impact here. 

About the role: 

We are seeking an experienced Lead Security Engineer specializing in Privileged Access Management (PAM) to join our Identity Management team. In this mission-critical role, you will provide technical leadership for the design, implementation, and operation of enterprise PAM capabilities that secure privileged access across on-premises infrastructure, SaaS platforms, and multi-cloud environments. 

You will be responsible for defining technical strategy, driving architectural decisions, and leading the delivery of PAM initiatives that reduce organizational risk while enabling business agility. In addition to hands-on engineering responsibilities, you will mentor team members, establish engineering standards, and drive execution of complex security projects from inception through operationalization. 

What you'll do: 

- Provide technical leadership for the IAM PAM engineering function, driving architecture, engineering standards, and operational excellence across privileged access solutions. 
 - Engage with technology leaders, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to drive the delivery of secure, scalable, and resilient solutions, ensuring critical systems are protected and aligned with organizational objectives. 
 - Lead the design, implementation, and operationalization of privileged access management solutions, including enterprise vaults, secrets management, privileged session management, privileged endpoint controls, and Zero Standing Privileges (ZSP) workflows. 
 - Work within an agile environment to define requirements, prioritize work, manage technical dependencies, and ensure successful delivery of PAM capabilities. 
 - Develop and oversee automation, integrations, and self-service capabilities that improve security posture and operational efficiency. 
 - Troubleshoot complex PAM issues and serve as a technical escalation point, providing guidance to engineers, stakeholders, and partner teams. 
 - Analyze enterprise privileged access use cases and develop detailed technical requirements, governance frameworks, and operational support models. 
 - Drive adoption of security-by-design principles across cloud, infrastructure, and application platforms. 
 - Mentor and develop engineers by providing technical coaching, design reviews, knowledge sharing, and guidance on engineering best practices. 
 - Ensure the reliability and availability of mission-critical IAM systems and participate in the IAM On-Call rotation. 
 - Define, track, and communicate PAM metrics and key performance indicators to demonstrate risk reduction, operational maturity, and program effectiveness. 

What you'll need: 

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field. 
 - 6 to 8 years of experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM) and cybersecurity, including six or more years of experience implementing and operating enterprise PAM platforms such as CyberArk or similar solutions. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading the design and delivery of enterprise-scale PAM programs and complex security initiatives. 
 - Experience working with fast-paced operations and development teams; experience with DevOps practices is required. 
 - Knowledge of information security technologies, regulations, controls, and industry standards. 

Must have: 

- Hands-on experience with enterprise PAM platforms, including credential vaulting, privileged session management, secrets management, and privileged access governance. 
 - Experience with Zero Standing Privilege (ZSP), Just-in-Time (JIT), and other modern privileged access management controls. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud IAM and PAM capabilities and familiarity with IaaS and PaaS architectures across AWS, Azure, GCP, and other enterprise cloud platforms. 
 - Experience developing automation and integrations using scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or similar technologies. 
 - Ability to build and deploy automation on cloud platforms, with familiarity in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices. 
 - Working knowledge of IAM services, LDAP, Active Directory, single sign-on (SSO), and federation protocols. 
 - Working knowledge of PKI fundamentals, certificate lifecycle management, and secrets management best practices. 
 - Experience defining technical requirements, engineering standards, governance models, and operational support processes. 
 - Proven ability to lead complex technical projects from solution design through implementation and operationalization. 

Nice to have: 

- Familiarity with AI Agent Identity security concepts, including credential governance, delegated authorization, runtime access controls, and lifecycle management for autonomous and semi-autonomous AI systems. 
 - Experience securing non-human identities, including service accounts, workloads, APIs, automation platforms, and AI agents within enterprise PAM and Identity Security programs. 
 - Knowledge of machine identity authentication frameworks and standards, including SPIFFE/SPIRE and Zero Trust concepts. 
 - Relevant industry certifications such as CyberArk Defender/Sentry, CISSP, CCSP, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, or equivalent credentials. 
 - Experience working in highly regulated environments with stringent compliance, audit, and security requirements. 

Who you are: 

- A lifelong learner with a desire for continuous personal and professional development. 
 - Someone with proven communication, collaboration, and critical thinking skills. 
 - Able to build trusting, meaningful relationships with peers, stakeholders, partners, and suppliers. 
 - Capable of defining and communicating risk in a business-relevant language to both non-technical and technical audiences, including Leadership teams. 
 - Someone who can apply expert knowledge to solve complex business/technical issues. 

Don't meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE: IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world. 

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities. 

Since our founding in 1979, we've grown to 20, 000 associates globally who support over 13, 000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. It's an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that's reshaping the way we operate. data.description:
Project Role : Quality Engineer

Project Role Description : Enables full stack solutions through multi-disciplinary team planning and ecosystem integration to accelerate delivery and drive quality across the application lifecycle. Performs continuous testing for security, API, and regression suite. Creates automation strategy, automated scripts and supports data and environment configuration. Participates in code reviews, monitors, and reports defects to support continuous improvement activities for the end-to-end testing process. 

Must have skills : Java Full Stack Development

Good to have skills : Spring Boot

Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Role Summary

We are seeking a hands-on Engineering Manager who leads from the trenches - writing production-grade code daily while simultaneously driving team delivery and technical strategy. This is not a purely supervisory role. You will be an active contributor to Java Spring Boot backend services, React frontends, and API development, while managing a team of engineers and owning end-to-end delivery. The ideal candidate is a strong individual contributor who has grown into leadership without stepping away from the keyboard. 

Key Responsibilities

Hands-On Technical Contribution

Independently design, develop, and ship full stack features using Java Spring Boot (backend) and React (frontend) with minimal direction. 

Architect and build RESTful APIs and microservices from scratch, owning the full lifecycle from design through deployment. 

Write complex Oracle SQL queries, manage schema design, performance tuning, and indexing strategies directly. 

Personally contribute to CI/CD pipeline setup, containerization, and OpenShift deployment - not just review others' work. 

Debug, optimize, and refactor production code to meet performance and scalability standards. 

Actively use and champion AI development tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot) as a daily part of your own engineering workflow. 

Technical Leadership

Set architectural direction and make independent technical decisions on system design, API contracts, and data modeling. 

Conduct meaningful code reviews rooted in your own current coding experience, not just managerial instinct. 

Define and enforce engineering standards, security practices, and documentation expectations across the team. 

Evaluate and introduce new tools, frameworks, or patterns based on direct hands-on assessment. 

Team Management & Delivery: 

Lead a team of engineers through agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and delivery milestones while remaining a committed coder yourself. 

Mentor and grow junior and mid-level engineers through pair programming, code walkthroughs, and real-time technical coaching. 

Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions - and then build them yourself. 

Manage delivery risk, technical debt, and cross-team dependencies without delegating your own engineering accountability. 

Required Qualifications: 

7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience. 

Currently active and proficient in Java Full Stack Development - you write Spring Boot and React code regularly, not just in the past. 

Deep expertise in RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and enterprise integration patterns. 

Strong Oracle Database and SQL skills - query writing, performance tuning, indexing, and data modeling done independently. 

Direct experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, and containerized deployments. 

Comfortable working independently in ambiguous environments with minimal oversight. 

Bachelor's degree or equivalent (15 years full-time education preferred). 

Preferred Qualifications: 

OpenShift or Kubernetes hands-on deployment experience. 

Experience with API security (OAuth2, JWT) and cloud-native design patterns. 

Prior experience as a senior individual contributor who transitioned into a working management role.

data.title: SDET Lead
data.description:
About Zinier

80% of the workers across the globe are Deskless. These are the people who keep our lights on and gas flowing, build roads and bridges, run our manufacturing factories, ensure that we get healthcare service, and provide us with reliable phone and internet connectivity. As entrepreneurs, have we considered solving their problems and making them more productive?

Zinier is a company on a mission to empower frontline workers - and the people supporting them - to achieve greater things for themselves and the world around them. With the majority of workers worldwide being deskless, Zinier recognizes the need for Technology Equity to improve the lives and productivity of these workers who keep the world up and running. 

We have global team headquartered in Silicon Valley, with a hybrid workforce across the United States, Canada, Europe, Latin America, Singapore, and Bangalore, India, with leading investors that include Accel, ICONIQ Capital, Founders Fund, Newfund Capital, NGP Capital, Tiger Global Management, and Qualcomm Ventures LLC. 

We are looking for

Experienced QA lead to work with the development leads, project managers and support leads on various projects. Responsible for leading a skilled, cross functional team following agile principles for software development in enhancing platform and product features for best in class quality, scalability and high performance deliveries. 

You will also need to be a hands-on team player and perform tasks such as writing test cases, reviewing testing logs, performing manual tests, etc. You will work very closely with other Technical Managers, DevOps, Tech Leads and business partners to ensure the success of a variety of projects and initiatives. You'll also be responsible for hiring and developing talent within our organization. Providing ongoing metrics and reporting on quality metrics will be key as well. 

Job Responsibilities

- Define and drive an overall unifying quality vision for the QA department through consensus building and leading change. 
 - Define, manage and execute a roadmap to maximize test coverage with emphasis on automation and integration with CI/CD initiatives. 
 - Manage and create proactive testing plans to ensure high availability of the Zinier system in alignment with company initiatives and priorities. 
 - Work with project stakeholders to deliver timely reports and define release strategies. 
 - Lead and Support the release team for various major and minor releases engineering is responsible for. 
 - Monitor and manage testing teams to ensure project deliveries are met with high quality and processes set for testing efforts. 
 - Implement processes to identify feature and regression gaps and build a culture on the effective RCAs on escaped defects and production feedback. 
 - Effectively plan, communicate and conduct presentations (project milestones, risk mitigation, road maps, resource needs, technical information, etc. ) for senior management and stakeholders, while conveying and driving actionable items to your team. 
 - Need excellent leadership skills, working with immediate teams as well as cross functional teams spanning the organization
 - Implement new tools to help reduce the manual testing efforts and define better tracking on the test plans and regression suites. 
 - Report deviations of quality per release and define & execute steps to mitigate the deviations. 
 - Review the core strengths of the QA teams and proactively engage and mentor the team members for career growth, define goals for bringing success to individuals and organization. 
 - Build automation test suites implemented in Java, Selenium, Appium, Rest-assured automation framework. Drive automation led quality efforts for the releases. 
 - Define a comprehensive test data strategy that supports various types of testing. 
 - Manage performance testing benchmarks and periodic reporting against those benchmarks. 

Required Skills

- 9+ yrs of experience in a relevant field. 
 - Bachelors / masters degree is a must. 
 - Excellent communication and people skills for building a passionate team is key for this role. 
 - Strong experience in Agile methodology, processes, and best practices. 
 - Should have strong understanding of CI / CD processes such Bitbucket, Git and Jenkins
 - "Self-starter" attitude and ability to make decisions independently. Can-do attitude and a willingness to take ownership of problems and motivate the team to go above and beyond. 
 - Experience in TDD concepts, methodologies, and best practices. BDD experience is a plus. 
 - Experience in modern Database platforms, including such items as data modeling, stored procedures, schema definitions, performance and scaling considerations is a plus. 
 - Should be able to handle multiple teams and projects simultaneously. 
 - Should have working knowledge / strong understanding of the Web technologies, Web Services, Database, specific knowledge on Security, Performance and Load testing approaches. 
 - Experience with technical design and hands-on work within a modern OOP-based language (C#, Java, Python, etc. ) and related stack is a plus.

Merchants should be able to use Amazon's fulfillment capabilities wherever they sell. Making that possible requires software that connects sales channels with fulfillment services, simplifies complex supply chain workflows, and gives merchants visibility into what happens after an order is placed. 

Amazon's Multi-Channel Commerce and Fulfillment team is looking for a Software Development Manager in Hyderabad to lead an engineering team building these capabilities. Our work helps merchants access Amazon's supply chain services beyond the Amazon marketplace and manage their businesses through connected, intuitive experiences. 

In this role, you will own the technical direction and delivery of a

product and services portfolio, from merchant-facing workflows to the distributed systems behind them. You will partner with product managers and engineering teams across Amazon to translate customer problems into a focused roadmap, make architectural decisions, and deliver reliable software. The technical challenges include coordinating workflows across independently owned services, maintaining consistent order and shipment state, and making complex integrations easier for merchants to use. 

We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who can develop engineers, bring clarity to ambiguous problems, and balance delivery speed with long-term system health. You will have end-to-end accountability for your team's software and its customer outcomes, including architecture, execution and production operations. 

Key job responsibilities

Set technical direction: Own your team's architecture and engineering roadmap, making explicit tradeoffs across customer value, reliability, delivery timelines and operational cost. 

Deliver customer outcomes: Partner with product and program leaders to turn merchant needs into well-scoped initiatives with measurable success criteria. 

Build dependable systems: Lead the design and delivery of distributed services and customer experiences that integrate with Amazon's fulfillment and supply chain platforms. 

Develop the team: Hire and coach engineers, provide actionable feedback, and create opportunities for technical growth and increasing ownership. 

Own operational performance: Establish metrics for service health and customer experience, strengthen testing and observability, and address recurring defects at their source. 

Lead across team boundaries: Align partner teams on interfaces and dependencies, resolve technical disagreements, and communicate decisions and risks clearly to leadership.

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 7+ years of engineering experience

About The Role

About the Team Uber's Merchant team helps restaurants build successful businesses on Uber Eats. This mission spans the entire merchant lifecycle, from onboarding to getting and fulfilling orders. 

The Merchant Fulfillment organization is the operational backbone of this mission. We own the critical "Order Lifecycle" technologies that ensure millions of orders are received, processed, and fulfilled reliably every day. We are also the guardians of the merchant's financial health, managing the complex workflows for disputes, cancellations, and operational reliability. 

About the Role As a Senior Engineering Manager for Merchant Fulfillment in India, you will lead a geographically distributed team of 50+ Engineers and Engineering Managers. You will be responsible for delivering business-critical projects and platforms that merchants and restaurants rely on to run their daily operations. 

This is a high-visibility leadership role where your decisions will directly impact merchant experience, sentiment and the operational trust of our merchant partners globally. You will partner with Product, Ops, and Design leaders in India and the US to define the strategy for how Uber Eats fulfills orders at scale. 

What The Candidate Will Need / Bonus Points

- What the Candidate Will Do

Lead at Scale: Manage and mentor a high-performing org of ~50 engineers and managers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, operational rigor, and customer empathy. 

Drive Reliability: Own the "Uber Eats Orders" (UEO) tablet experience and the underlying reliability systems that ensure 99. 99% uptime for order injection and processing. 

Solve Complex Disputes: Build intelligent, automated platforms for Chargebacks, Cancellations, and Disputes, reducing financial losses for merchants and Uber while improving fairness. 

Unlock New Growth: Lead the BYOC (Bring Your Own Courier) charter, building the "To-Go" and courier onboarding tech that allows merchants to fulfill orders with their own fleets. 

Operational Efficiency: own the "Defect Reduction" mandate, using technology to predict and prevent order failures before they happen. 

- Basic Qualifications

Experience: 12+ years of engineering experience with 6+ years in people management, ideally leading managers and larger organizations (50+). 

Technical Depth: Strong background in building high-scale, distributed systems. You can dive deep into architecture discussions on reliability, eventual consistency, and real-time data processing. 

Strategic Vision: Ability to translate complex business goals (e. g. , "Reduce Partner Avoidable Failures") into a concrete technical roadmap. 

Customer Obsession: A passion for solving real-world operational problems. You understand that a "bug" in our system means a lost dinner for a customer and lost revenue for a small business. 

Collaborative Mindset: Experience working in a global setup, influencing stakeholders across time zones and functions to drive consensus. 

- Preferred Qualifications

Frontend Depth: Deep familiarity with modern frontend ecosystems (React, Next. js, Micro-frontends) and mobile platforms (React Native). 

Scale: Experience managing systems with high throughput and strict latency SLAs (e. g. , P99 < 200ms). 

Influence: Ability to drive consensus across multiple product teams. You can convince a vertical team to adopt your platform standard rather than building a custom one-off solution.

data.description:
About the RoleAptagrim designs, engineers, and deploys specialised enterprise AI products and intelligent workflow systems built around real business knowledge, decisions, and operational workflows. Our work spans our bidPlan platform and AI engineering services for enterprise clients. 

We are looking for a hands-on Full-Stack Technical Lead to build and deliver enterprise applications using Python, Django, Django REST Framework, React, and Next. js. 

You will own technical implementation across the frontend, backend, databases, and deployment, while guiding a team of developers. The role requires strong backend engineering depth, practical frontend expertise, and the ability to translate business requirements into reliable, secure, and maintainable software. You should be comfortable writing code, reviewing architecture, resolving production issues, and taking features through to release. 

Key Responsibilities
 - Lead full-stack development: Design, develop, and maintain applications using Python, Django, DRF, Next. js, React, and TypeScript. Take ownership of features from technical design through implementation, testing, and production release. 
 - Own technical design and architecture: Translate product and business requirements into clear technical designs, data models, API contracts, and implementation plans. Choose appropriate monolithic, modular monolithic, or microservices architectures based on application needs. 
 - Build robust backend services: Develop reusable business logic and well-structured APIs with appropriate validation, authentication, authorization, pagination, versioning, and error handling. 
 - Develop responsive frontend applications: Build accessible, reusable interfaces using Next. js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS or equivalent frameworks. Apply App Router, Server and Client Components, SSR, and SSG appropriately. 
 - Manage frontend data and application state: Implement API integration, data fetching, caching, and state management using suitable tools such as Zustand or Redux. Deliver clear loading, error, and empty states across user journeys. 
 - Own database design and performance: Design and maintain PostgreSQL or MySQL schemas. Optimize Django ORM usage, SQL queries, indexes, transactions, and locking to support reliable concurrent reads and writes. 
 - Implement asynchronous and real-time workflows: Use Redis, Celery, and Celery Beat for caching, background processing, and scheduled tasks. Apply event-driven messaging and WebSockets where required, with appropriate retry and failure handling. 
 - Improve application performance and security: Identify bottlenecks across browser rendering, APIs, databases, and background workers. Implement secure access controls, secrets management, and protection against common web application vulnerabilities. 
 - Support deployment and operational reliability: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments on AWS or equivalent cloud platforms. Work with Docker, Nginx, and application servers such as Gunicorn or Uvicorn; support migrations, release checks, and rollback procedures. 
 - Establish engineering quality: Define coding standards, conduct code reviews, and ensure meaningful unit, integration, and end-to-end test coverage. Maintain technical documentation and API specifications using OpenAPI/Swagger. 
 - Lead and mentor developers: Break requirements into actionable tasks, estimate effort, identify dependencies, and guide junior and mid-level engineers. Remain actively involved in implementation and help the team resolve technical blockers. 
 - Collaborate on delivery and production support: Work with product managers, designers, QA, and other engineering teams to deliver agreed scope. Communicate technical risks early, investigate production incidents, and implement improvements that prevent recurrence. 
Required Skills and Experience
 - 5+ years of professional software development experience, including substantial hands-on experience with Python/Django and React/Next. js, and demonstrated technical ownership of production applications. 
 - Experience leading a small engineering team or owning a significant application module, including technical planning, code reviews, mentoring, and release delivery. 
 - Strong backend expertise: Python, Django, Django REST Framework, Django ORM, REST API design, and maintainable application architecture. 
 - Strong frontend capability: React, Next. js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, including responsive design, reusable components, App Router, Server and Client Components, and server-side rendering. 
 - Practical experience with frontend state management, API integration, caching, and performance optimization. Understanding of SEO requirements for public-facing applications. 
 - Database engineering: Strong SQL skills and experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL, including schema design, migrations, indexing, query optimization, transactions, and concurrency control. 
 - Background processing and caching: Hands-on experience with Redis and Celery, including task scheduling, retries, and reliable background execution. 
 - Cloud and DevOps: Experience deploying and supporting applications on AWS or an equivalent cloud platform using Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Nginx, and appropriate application servers. 
 - Security: Practical understanding of authentication and authorization, role-based access control, JWT, OAuth2, and secure session and token handling. 
 - Testing and troubleshooting: Experience with automated backend and frontend testing, production debugging, structured logging, application monitoring, and root cause analysis. 
 - Engineering fundamentals: Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, separation of concerns, and software design principles. 
 - Proficiency with Git, pull request workflows, Agile/Scrum practices, and technical documentation. 
 - Clear communication, sound technical judgment, and the ability to balance delivery timelines with maintainability, performance, and reliability. 

Additional experience that would be valuable: FastAPI, Kafka or similar messaging systems, Django Channels/WebSockets, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and observability tools such as Sentry, Grafana, or the ELK Stack. Experience integrating AI services into enterprise applications is also useful.

- Automation delivery (~50%) : lead a 15-20-member external vendor team that builds and supports our RPA (robotic process automation) bots. 
 - System controls & SaaS security (~50%) : keep our financial systems, including cloud ERPs such as Oracle Fusion, Coupa, etc secure, well-controlled, and SOX-compliant. 

The two halves belong together. Automation is how we turn manual controls into automated, continuous ones. Strong controls are what make our bots safe to run on financial systems.

data.description:

Lead Software Engineer

Overview

The Mobile Payment Gateway (MPG) program is part of Mastercard Markets and Localization team, responsible for driving the identification of new opportunities across different markets and building bespoke solutions and integrating with the wider Mastercard products and services. 

The MPG program aspires to be the platform of choice for economies moving into the Digital first world of payments. We are building a solution and an ecosystem to enable the Mastercard multi-rail capabilities into these markets, building a Digital Payment Hub that integrates with Mastercard and Industry Payment processing and management solutions - both in the online and offline world. 

Our positioning puts us right in the middle of 3 key dimensions -

Integrating with a varied set of global and regional Payments solutions, 

Ensuring Security as we deliver services in both an API-first approach and over mobile platforms, and

Building an unique customer experience coupled with a set of compelling user journeys, meeting the ever growing and varied Digital financial needs of consumers.

We live by the 'Mastercard Way' cultural values every day

Experience in software engineering majorly in application development

Strong analytical and excellent problem-solving skills.

Spreetail propels brands to increase their ecommerce market share across the globe while improving their operational costs. Learn how we are building one of the fastest-growing ecommerce companies in history: www. spreetail. com . 

Spreetail is becoming a third-party logistics provider, taking on warehousing and fulfillment for external merchants and brands. The 3PL Staff Engineer owns the technical foundation of this new product: the multi-tenant systems that manage client onboarding, inventory, warehouse operations, order fulfillment, and billing for outside customers using Spreetail's fulfillment network.

This platform is being built AI-native from the start - with demand forecasting, automated exception handling, and anomaly detection woven into core workflows rather than bolted on afterward. Your work directly determines whether Spreetail can reliably sell 3PL services to external clients - making it a direct driver of new revenue and margin.

data.description:
Job Purpose

To design system solutions, prepare user document and monitor UAT plan execution, aid in prioritization of projects and UATs and monitoring production issue resolution on a daily basis. 

The role is also responsible for designing and documenting the workflow and making appropriate recommendations that will positively impact operational effectiveness. 

Job Context & Major Challenges

Job Context: To design system solutions, prepare user document and monitor UAT plan execution, aid in prioritization of projects and UATs and monitoring production issue resolution on a daily basis. 

The role is also responsible for designing and documenting the workflow and making appropriate recommendations that will positively impact operational effectiveness. 

Job Challenges: 

- Understanding and gathering user requirement and preparing a business requirement document despite inadequate clarity of thought from the users
 - Downloading the business requirement to IT team who lacks the required end to end process expertise. 
 - Downloading the business needs/criticalities to the vendors who lack the required domain expertise to address BSLI system requirements. 
 - Executing multiple projects simultaneously within their defined timelines with various iterations and limited resources. 
 - Aligning the work schedule basis constantly shifting organisational priorities. 
 - Managing user expectations considering the system limitations and process constraints. 

Key Result Areas

KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)

KRA1 Understanding business process management and business requirements of the Operations team and translating them to specific user requirements. 1. Gathering user requirements for all sub verticals within operations related to various core and peripheral systems existing in BSLI. 

- Understand the business needs, and ensure that requirement is accurately documented in requirement template. 
 - Defining the scope basis business needs and system constraints. 
 - Obtaining Sign-off from the stakeholders on the final UR and scheduling the same for development. 

KRA2 Planning and monitoring UAT and ensure that timelines are met with expected quality parameters. 1. Planning and assigning of UAT's received within the team

- Analysing and preparing Modal test points and downloading the testing scope to the team
 - Reviewing the defects raised by the team and raising it with IT and follow up for resolution. 
 - Monitoring the execution of test cases as planned and signing-off the UAT within set timeline and quality parameters. 
 - Preparing System Manuals, Imparting training to the team members & stakeholders
 - Maintaining repository of test packs and requirement documents for all system changes for effective utilisation in future
 - Monitoring Post production movement and ensuring smooth handover of activity to the stakeholders. 

KRA3 Monitoring the production issues and providing timely resolution as per the set quality standard. 1. Monitoring the production issues raised by users and providing timely resolution with set quality standards. 

- Reporting of system bugs to IT identified at the time of production issues analysis and following up with IT team for timely resolution. 
 - Proactively raise change request with IT for strengthening system validations in order to avoid/minimise the recurrence of the errors. 

KRA4 Monitor the readiness of BSLI and vendor systems before product launch 1. Preparing and maintaining phase 1 and phase 2 system features basis the occurrence of the event. 

- Raising the change request at vendors end and at IT for immediate and vital changes within set timelines. 
 - Monitoring and coordinating UAT of new product for all internal and vendor systems and signing-off within set timeline and quality parameters. 
 - Documenting the process changes and imparting training on new product features to the stakeholders. 

KRA5 Monitor the performance of team to ensure the objectives of the department are accomplished. 1. Analyzing the roles and responsibility of various team members and design the Key responsibility Areas for the team based on the expertise and designations. 

- Guiding team to achieve the company and personal goals. 
 - Identify exceptional performance and recommend for further elevations to reporting manager.

About the Role: 

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a highly skilled AI Automation Engineer - Senior to design, build, and optimize enterprise-grade AI automation solutions for global clients. This role emphasizes deep hands-on engineering expertise, focusing on optimizing AI systems, improving model performance, and delivering scalable, production-ready AI-enabled automation. 

You will work under architect guidance while owning key solution components, leading small workstreams, and delivering high-impact AI solutions across consulting engagements. The role requires a strong blend of software engineering, applied AI, optimization techniques, and secure development practices. 

The ideal candidate demonstrates the ability to independently implement and optimize AI-driven systems, contribute to reusable accelerators, and mentor junior engineers while operating in a client-facing consulting environment. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design, develop, and optimize AI-driven automation solutions using LLMs, agent frameworks, and orchestration platforms. 
 - Own and deliver end-to-end implementation of solution components, including integration into enterprise systems and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Optimize AI systems across dimensions such as latency, cost, accuracy, and scalability (e. g. , caching, batching, prompt optimization). 
 - Develop and enhance Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including chunking strategies, retrieval tuning, re-ranking, and embeddings optimization. 
 - Implement and optimize fine-tuning strategies, including dataset preparation, prompt tuning, and model evaluation workflows. 
 - Build and productionize agentic systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalents. 
 - Develop automated evaluation frameworks, benchmarking pipelines, and model performance metrics. 
 - Contribute to AI harness frameworks, reusable accelerators, and enterprise AI development standards. 
 - Lead small workstreams, client discussions, demos, and proof-of-concept (POC) implementations. 
 - Mentor and review work of junior AI Automation Engineers, ensuring engineering quality and best practices. 
 - Collaborate closely with architects to translate high-level designs into scalable implementations. 
 - Ensure adherence to secure coding, DevSecOps, and AI security best practices. 

Cyber Experience (Any One Preferred): 

- Application Security: 
 - Secure coding practices, SAST/DAST, DevSecOps integration, CI/CD pipeline automation
 - API security, OWASP Top 10, software supply chain security, secrets management, secure SDLC
 - Offensive Security: 
 - Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT), red teaming, adversarial testing
 - Exposure to AI/LLM-specific risks such as prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, and model misuse
Technical Skills and Expertise: 

- Programming: Strong proficiency in Python; exposure to JavaScript, TypeScript, or other languages
 - AI/LLM Tools: OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Gemini, and similar developer tools
 - AI Frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalents
 - Cloud Platforms: Azure (preferred), AWS, or GCP

data.description:
Who We Are Looking For

State Street Investment Management's Data, Analytics & AI Services (DAAIS) team is seeking an experienced hands-on architect, engineer for building the multi-cloud open architecture-based data platform that delivers trusted data products to the business functions. This role is an 80% IC role in doing hands-on engineering and developing POCs to support a resilient, scalable, performance optimized, secure multi-cloud data platform, and 20% of the capacity is responsible for managing and mentoring the employees, based out of Bangalore, responsible for the production maintenance & support of the legacy data platform. The successful candidate will bring deep hands-on expertise in large-scale data platform architecture, distributed computing, data pipeline engineering, and modern cloud architecture and operational experience. 

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Investment Management, one of the largest asset managers in the world. We partner with many of the world's largest, most sophisticated investors and financial intermediaries to help them reach their goals through a rigorous, research-driven investment process. With over four decades of experience and trillions of dollars in assets under management, we offer one of the broadest selections of services across asset classes, risk profiles, regions and styles. As pioneers in index, ETF, and ESG investing, we are always inventing new ways to invest. 

Join us if making your mark in the asset management industry from day one is a challenge you are up for. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

As a Data Platform Engineer, Vice President II, you will -

- Validate target data platform architectures and design principles through hands-on engineering, technical spikes, and POCs for a unified, cloud-native Lakehouse. 
 - Partner with architects to translate reference architectures and data strategies into working prototypes, measurable validation criteria, and production-ready implementation patterns. 
 - Optimize scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using Python/Scala, SQL, Spark, and modern orchestration frameworks. 
 - Engineer high-performance Iceberg-based data models and tables, including partitioning, compaction, schema evolution, metadata management, and multi-engine interoperability. 
 - Establish data engineering standards for data quality, lineage, observability, reliability, versioning, and backward-compatible data product contracts. 
 - Optimize platform, pipeline, and query performance through workload testing, partitioning and clustering, caching, concurrency management, and cost-aware lifecycle practices. 
 - Lead capabilities from POC to production by defining non-functional requirements, resolving engineering risks, integrating with platform services, and enabling operational support and SLA readiness. 
 - Engineer AI-ready data products with trusted, well-governed, semantically enriched data, incorporating context engineering, ontologies, embeddings, vector indexing, and RAG patterns. 
 - Build and productionize data services for Agentic and AI workloads, including MCP-enabled access, interoperable APIs, LLM gateways, multi-model routing, caching, observability, security, and cost optimization. 
 - Mentor and provide technical leadership to the L2/L3 support teams for legacy platform to ensure SLA adherence, escalation discipline, and timely closure of production issues impacting business, clients, or regulators. 

Required Qualifications

- Master's degree in computer science or a related technical discipline, with 15+ years of technology experience, preferably in financial services. 
 - Expert-level hands-on programming in Python and SQL, with Java or Scala as a plus, and proven ability to design, debug, test, and optimize distributed data-processing solutions. 
 - Deep hands-on expertise with Apache Spark for batch and streaming workloads, including performance tuning, troubleshooting, reliability engineering, and cost optimization. 
 - Proven experience building and operating enterprise Lakehouse and data platforms using Snowflake and Databricks, supporting high-concurrency analytical, near-real-time, and AI-ready workloads. 
 - Strong cloud engineering experience across AWS, GCP, and Azure, including cloud-native data services, security, networking, infrastructure automation, portability, and cost management. 
 - Working expertise with open data architectures and metadata ecosystems, including Apache Iceberg, schema evolution, table optimization, catalog federation, zero-copy sharing, data virtualization, and multi-engine access. 
 - Extensive experience productionizing data capabilities through DevOps and CI/CD, automated testing, observability, data quality, incident management, and operational support for mission-critical platforms. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with both structured and unstructured data management tools and associated patterns 
 - Familiarity with modern governance frameworks (Unity Catalog, Collibra, Alation). 
 - Expertise in AI-assisted coding using GitHub Copilot or Claude Code Assistant. 

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. 

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you'll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. data.description:

- Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation using GitLab CI (experience with GitHub Actions is also valued).

 - Solid experience with AWS core services: VPC, EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, Route 53, ECS, ECR, ASM, Lamda, CloudWatch, and AWS Load Balancers. 
 - Solid hands-on experience with Terraform, Terragrunt, Opentofu, CloudFormation for IaC. 
 - Hands-on experience with GitLab CI/CD: writing and maintaining GitLab pipelines, runners, environments, and merge request workflows (experience with GitHub Actions is a plus).

 - Evaluate, introduce, and champion new tools and frameworks for infrastructure automation, chaos engineering, and capacity planning. 
 - Partner with Engineering, Product, and Security leadership to align platform capabilities with business objectives. 
 - Solid knowledge of Linux systems administration and networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, TLS). 
 - Strong understanding of IAM roles, TLS Certificates, LGTM Stack. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with GitLab's broader DevSecOps platform: Container Registry, Dependency Scanning, or GitLab Environments.

data.title: SW QA Engineer - Associate , Physics AI
data.description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

Our Shared Engineering Services team is at the forefront of validating and releasing the cutting-edge SimcenterTM portfolio. Our simulation software and test solutions help companies predict product performance across a broad range of engineering domains - from 3D CAE and system simulation to physical testing. 

We are looking for a technically strong Software QA Engineer - Physics AI to help ensure the quality, accuracy, robustness, and reliability of AI-enabled engineering simulation capabilities. 

In this role, you will combine your knowledge of CAE, physics-based simulation, Engineering AI, and software quality to validate AI/ML models and their integration into desktop simulation products. You will work closely with AI/ML engineers, product teams, software developers, and applications engineers to assess whether AI predictions are accurate, robust, physically meaningful, and reliable when compared with traditional simulation or solver results. 

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys complex technical problem-solving, understands engineering simulation workflows, and wants to contribute to the evolution of AI-enabled physics and simulation software. 

Key Responsibilities

- Validate Physics AI capabilities: Work closely with AI/ML engineers to understand the underlying physics models, simulation workflows, and algorithms, and validate the accuracy, robustness, fidelity, and consistency of AI predictions against traditional solver or reference results. 
 - Own end-to-end quality: Drive QA activities across the software development lifecycle, independently planning and executing quality activities to ensure reliable delivery of AI-enabled simulation capabilities. 
 - Design comprehensive testing: Review user stories, requirements, and design documentation for testability and develop functional, stress, performance, and end-to-end test scenarios aligned with engineering use cases. 
 - Develop and maintain test automation: Create, execute, and maintain automated tests using scripting and automation frameworks, while improving existing test suites and porting automation to high-performance systems where appropriate. 
 - Investigate complex technical issues: Go beyond identifying defects by reproducing issues, analyzing logs and system behavior, investigating root causes, and collaborating with Development and AI/ML teams to drive resolution. 
 - Improve quality engineering practices: Identify potential risks proactively, research complex problems, introduce effective solutions, and champion best practices in software quality, automation, and testing of Physics AI capabilities. 
 - Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with Development, AI/ML Engineering, DevOps, Product Management, Applications Engineering, and other teams in a globally distributed environment. 

Qualifications

- 4-6+ years of relevant technical experience in CAE, engineering simulation, design verification, Physics AI, Engineering AI, or a related domain, along with hands-on experience in Software Quality Engineering or software validation. 
 - 1-3+ years of professional experience in Software QA, Quality Engineering, software testing, or test automation, preferably for complex engineering or desktop software products. 
 - Strong understanding of CAE and engineering simulation workflows, with the ability to analyze simulation results and assess their technical and physical reasonableness. 
 - Exposure to AI/ML or Engineering AI, with the ability to understand and validate AI-driven predictions against physics-based, simulation, or solver-generated reference results. 
 - Experience with desktop simulation or engineering software such as Simcenter, CAD/CAE applications, or similar products; experience with HyperView, Simcenter 3D Post, or equivalent post-processing tools is highly valuable. 
 - Proficiency in Python, C, or similar scripting/programming languages, with hands-on experience developing or maintaining automated tests using PyTest, Ranorex, Selenium, or comparable frameworks. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently, investigate complex technical issues, and contribute effectively in cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience testing or validating AI/ML models, Physics AI, surrogate models, or AI-enabled engineering applications. 
 - Experience comparing AI predictions with traditional CAE/CFD/FEA solver results, experimental data, or other engineering reference data. 
 - Familiarity with Windows and UNIX/Linux environments and cross-platform desktop software testing. 
 - Experience with JIRA, Xray, Git, and modern test automation frameworks. 
 - Experience with functional, regression, stress, performance, and system-level testing. 
 - Strong attention to detail, curiosity, self-motivation, and the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar engineering and software technologies. 

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30, 000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Diversity & Inclusion

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

Detection Engineering is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-fidelity detection logic across enterprise security platforms. This role focuses on proactive threat detection, automation-first practices, and continuous improvement of detection coverage and accuracy, supporting the WPP SOC transformation into an Autonomic Security Operations model.

Technical Expertise

 - Familiarity with detection-as-code principles and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Understanding of MITRE ATT&CK framework and threat-informed defense.

data.title: Sr. Design Engineer
data.description:
We Are The People Who Give Possibilities Purpose

BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of healthTM is our Purpose, and it's no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us-from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year-to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities. 

Job Description

Job Description

- Define, plan and lead activities for test method & measurement system development and validation, and testing optimization in support of Design Verification. 
 - Lead creation and execution of verification protocols, summarize results, enable formal design reviews, and own the verification portion of the Design History File. 
 - Demonstrate proficiency in spotting Design Variance through relevant statistical measures. 
 - Follow Design Control & ensure compliance with all local, state, federal, international, and internal safety regulations, policies, and procedures. 
 - Interpret and analyze design verification data with respect to product performance and operational stability in the manufacturing plants. 
 - The associate will work on receipt, preparation, testing, and delivery of test samples and support materials for all V&V lab associate testing including sample inventory management. 
 - Application of engineering first principles and advanced engineering methods to gain deep understanding of the underlying technical issues, and to propose and implement robust solutions. 
 - Collaborate with Design & Development, Systems Engineering and cross-functional teams to ensure product requirements are verifiable and measurable. 
 - Synthesize, develop, update, and optimize designs based on understanding design space. Understand design options and tradeoffs; managing critical parameters; leverage strong engineering fundamentals and tools. Incorporate manufacturing principles early in the development process. 
 - Executes Continuous Improvement projects in the following (but not limited to) areas. 
 - Equipment or method troubleshooting/repairs. 
 - Coordinates with Test Method Development and Verification & validation team for equipment and method validations
 - Method or Equipment Upgrades
 - Fixture maintenance
 - Drawing or Specification modifications
 - Responsible for Complete end to end maintenance of test equipment and management of Test method validation records. 
 - Ensure deliverables are reliable across the design space, is adequately pressure-tested to satisfy user, regulatory and business requirements. Understand system and subsystem design sensitivity and identify and address early any potential design integration and transfer risks. 
 - Implement DFSS rigor throughout the design selection and development process, leveraging and deploying empirical, statistical, and analytical tools to drive informed design decisions and reduce design iteration cycle times. 
 - Ensure the design considerations are embedding all applicable DFX (Design for Excellence) aspects including manufacturability, usability, reliability, and safety. 
 - Create and document novel test methodologies and provide feedback and recommendations for product/design changes. 
 - Actively build on personal skills, expertise, and competencies. Ensure that technical lessons are reviewed, learned, and disseminated. 
 - Coach and mentor junior engineers and technicians to execute project deliverables. 
 - Ensure compliance with BD quality policies, procedures, and practices. 
 - Ensure compliance with all local, state, federal, and BD safety regulations, policies, and procedures. 
 - The incumbent will also be responsible for ensuring QMS conformance and ensure that the quality policy and objectives are met per organizational guidelines. 
 - Coordinate the Material Shipment & Vendor management. 

Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree in mechanical or biomedical Engineering with 5 to 8 years of experience in medical device or other regulated industry OR Master degree in mechanical or biomedical Engineering and 4+ years of experience. 

Knowledge And Skills

- Expertise with test method development, validation strategy, and execution is required. 
 - Expertise in fixture design & development. 
 - Expertise with design verification & validation strategy development and execution is required. 
 - Strong track record of technical problem solving and effective product development through expert application of engineering principles is required. 
 - Design controls expertise and experience with traditional and modern fabrication techniques is required. 
 - Proven experience in leading CAPAs, design-defect analyses, managing non-conformances and remediation is required. 
 - Proficiency in solid mechanics/mechanics of materials and proficiency statistical methods/tools is required. 
 - Experience with design standard methodologies, including advanced tolerance design, and design for reliability. 
 - Experience and Knowledge on Medical regulatory standards
 - Experience in solid modeling (SolidWorks) or electromechanical systems is a plus. 
 - Experience in high-volume manufacturing processes is a plus. 
 - Experience developing and commercializing medical devices is a plus. 
 - Exposure to Chemistry/ Chemical Engineering and/or structural analysis and simulation/mathematical modeling desirable. 
 - DFSS training or certifications are a plus. 

Preferred Skills

- Ability to lead and teach others to assess project/program needs, formulate strategy, build support, and execute initiatives. 
 - Strong interpersonal and decision-making skills and the ability to effectively manage change and uncertainty. 
 - Ability to engage and mentor team members and to maximize diverse perspectives to achieve the best outcomes. 

Why Join Us?

To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD, you'll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive. 

We believe that when people connect in person, we learn faster, collaborate more deeply, and build a stronger culture. Join us and enjoy a culture where face-to-face collaboration supports your learning, your progress, and your success. 

To learn more about BD visit https: //bd. com/careers.

We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, marital or domestic or civil union status, familial status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetics, disability, military eligibility or veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. Key Responsibilities

- Strategic Technical Leadership: Define verification strategy and architecture for complex Edge AI based digital designs, providing expert consultation across multiple projects and teams
 - Execution excellence & Innovation: Pioneer advanced verification methodologies and frameworks that drive organization-wide improvement in verification effectiveness and efficiency. Promote continuous improvement to verification techniques to ensure 'Zero Defect' chips
 - Team management: Lead a verification team and deliver to multiple parallel projects. Plan and scale the verification domain with efficient resource management. 
 - Cross-Organizational Influence: Drive verification decisions across organizational lines, collaborating with design teams, product managers, and executives on verification requirements and sign-off criteria. Work with Product test engineering, Silicon validation, and SW team for first-pass Si success and high-volume production. 
 - Complex Problem Resolution: Lead resolution of the most challenging verification issues requiring specialized knowledge and creative solutions

 - Industry Leadership: Represent ADI at industry forums, contribute to standards development, and collaborate with EDA tool vendors to influence future verification technologies
 - Strategic Quality Assurance: Establish verification metrics and quality standards across product lines that ensure design accuracy and reliability

Must Have Skills

- SystemVerilog and UVM Mastery: Recognized expert-level knowledge of SystemVerilog and Universal Verification Methodology for architecting sophisticated verification environments for Edge AI class of designs
 - Verification Strategy and Architecture: Exceptional ability to develop comprehensive verification strategies that drive coverage-driven methodologies and verification closure across multiple product lines
 - Digital Verification Expertise: Deep understanding of digital SOC design principles (Processor, Interconnect/Fabric, AHB/AXI protocols, Memory, Security, Boot, High and Low speed peripherals understanding) and verification methodologies, with proven ability to implement innovative verification approaches for complex designs
 - Advanced Debugging Mastery: Superior RTL/System level and GLS debugging skills across multiple design abstractions, with demonstrated ability to solve the most complex verification challenges
 - Verification Methodology Innovation: Proven track record of developing and implementing new verification methodologies that advance the state of the art
 - Technical Leadership and Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence verification direction across the organization, mentor engineering teams, and drive methodology adoption through technical expertise
 - Strategic Problem Solving: Advanced analytical capabilities to identify and solve unusually significant verification challenges with high impact across product lines

Preferred Education And Experience

- Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
 - 15+ years of relevant verification experience with complex digital SOC designs
 - Experience leading verification teams and/or major verification initiatives

data.description:
Sr. Staff Data Platform Engineer

Position Summary

As a Sr. Staff Data Platform Engineer, you will be the primary architect and visionary for the core data infrastructure that powers the entire enterprise. This is a "platform-as-a-product" role; your mission is to build the internal foundation-creating the high-performance engines, abstraction layers, and self-service frameworks that enable hundreds of other engineers to move faster. 

You will operate at the intersection of Systems Programming and Data Engineering, solving "hard-tech" problems like automated schema evolution, multi-engine compute optimization, and global data discovery. As a top-level technical individual contributor, you will bridge the gap between long-term business strategy and deep-kernel technical execution, ensuring WEX's data platform remains a competitive advantage. 

Is this role for you?

- YES, if: You are a Backend/Software Engineer who loves solving "Big Data" problems, building APIs for data discovery, and optimizing distributed systems. 
 - NO, if: Your primary expertise is writing SQL queries, building Tableau dashboards, or managing ETL workflows without deep experience in Java or Python system architecture. 

Responsibilities

- Architectural Sovereignty: Define the 3-5 year technical roadmap for the Data Lakehouse. You aren't just using tools; you are deciding how storage, compute, and metadata layers (e. g. , Apache Polaris, Unity Catalog or Datahub Catalog) interact at an elemental level. 
 - Platform-as-a-Product: Build internal SDKs, CLI tools, and automated orchestration frameworks. Your goal is to abstract away cloud complexity via Control Planes and Custom Operators, allowing Data Engineers to focus on business logic rather than infrastructure boilerplate. 
 - Internal R&D: Prototype and benchmark emerging technologies (e. g. , specialized Spark extensions) to keep the platform at the bleeding edge of performance and cost-efficiency. 
 - Global Governance & Security: Architect "compliance-by-design" systems. Automate data lineage, PII masking, and fine-grained access control across petabyte-scale environments without sacrificing developer velocity. 
 - Engineering Excellence & Influence: Set the gold standard for code quality and system design across the company. You will lead Cross-Functional Architecture Reviews and serve as the final escalation point for the most complex system outages or performance bottlenecks. 
 - Organizational Mentorship: Beyond individual mentoring, you will foster an "Engineering Community, " influencing the hiring bar and professional development paths for the entire data engineering organization. 

Qualifications & Experience

- Experience: 15+ years in software engineering and distributed systems, with at least 4 years in a principal or staff-level capacity leading platform-scale initiatives. 

Core Technical Competencies (Software Engineering Focus)

- Strong Software Foundations: Strong fundamentals on software engineering, system architecture, and scalable production applications (Algorithms, Data Structures, and System Design). 
 - Experience in the Java/J2EE ecosystem (Spring Boot, Microservices) and python. We are looking for a developer who writes clean, testable, and high-performance code, not just scripts. 
 - Data as a Product: Experience building the platforms / framework engines and APIs that power data movement, rather than just building the ETL/ELT pipelines themselves. 

Data Lakehouse Mastery

- Deep internal knowledge of Apache Iceberg, Hudi, or Delta Lake (metadata management, manifest files, and compaction strategies). 
 - Experience contributing to or deeply customizing open-source data projects (e. g. , Spark, dbt). 

Cloud & Infrastructure

- Extensive experience with cloud architecture and services, including AWS (S3, EMR, Kubernetes, Lambda) and Azure. 
 - Deep understanding of CI/CD automation, modern development tools, Git Actions, Terraform and frameworks. 

AI-Driven Development & Productivity

- AI Native Development: Experience leveraging AI Code Gen platforms into software development lifecycle (SDLC) to automate code generation, reviews, generate unit tests, and perform root-cause analysis of system failures. 
 - LLM-Ops for Platform: Ability to architect the infrastructure required to support AI Agent development by enabling vector database integration. 

Leadership & Vision

- Proven track record of "leading by influence"-driving adoption of new technologies across multiple autonomous teams. 
 - Ability to communicate complex architectural trade-offs (e. g. , "Latency vs. Consistency" or "Build vs. Buy") to C-suite executives and junior engineers alike. 

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science (Distributed Systems focus) preferred, or equivalent deep industry experience.

Enterprise Advanced is a distributed team across Europe and India that builds the software running MongoDB on any infrastructure, at global scale - from on-prem data centers to private cloud. You'll work primarily on Ops Manager and Automation, the systems that let customers deploy fault-tolerant, globally distributed MongoDB clusters in minutes. Our software manages some of the largest self-managed MongoDB deployments in the world, with production clusters running hundreds of shards and nodes under a single deployment. 

The main focus of this team is to adapt our software to manage MongoDB clusters which are deployed in data centers or private cloud platforms. 

You will work on the core functionality for all of our products, mainly on the Ops Manager, and Automation products. Our team's end users are some of the largest businesses in the world, deploying massive clusters and processing huge amounts of data. 

This role is based in our Gurgaon office, and can work in a hybrid fashion. 

This role will report to the Senior Engineering Manager also based in our Gurgaon office.

- Design, implement, test, and release features for Ops Manager
 - Own end-to-end delivery of complex projects, from design through incremental shipping
 - Troubleshoot and resolve issues surfaced in customer deployments running at scale
 - Apply engineering judgment and MongoDB's core values across planning, design, and code review

A great fit for this role will be

- You enjoy distributed-systems problems; consistency, fault tolerance, and scale are the daily reality, not edge cases
 - People who like ambiguity and are comfortable defining their own approach with guidance, not step-by-step instruction
 - You're flexible! You're willing to take on a wide variety of responsibilities, learning as you go
 - You're a self-starter! You're comfortable organizing your own time, acting on feedback and prioritizing with guidance from senior members of your team

- 4+ years experience with a language such as Java or GO.

What is in it for you
