At New Relic, we provide our customers real-time insights, so they can innovate faster. Our software delivers insightful observability tools across different technologies and distributed systems, enabling software engineering teams to quickly identify, understand and tackle issues, analyze performance and get the most of their software and infrastructure. 

Database Observability is a critical pillar of New Relic's platform strategy. We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager (M3) to lead a senior, high-performing team building next-generation Database Observability products. Your team will own the entire lifecycle of critical telemetry data flows from lightweight database agents and high-throughput ingestion pipelines to intelligent DB recommendation engines and autonomous DB AI Agents. 

You will lead a team that includes senior and Lead-level engineers with deep domain expertise in distributed systems and AI. Your primary value will come from setting strategic technical direction, enabling their best work, and fostering a high-accountability culture while partnering closely with Product and Design to deliver features that directly drive New Relic's Database Observability. 

What You'll Do

- Manage a full-stack engineering team (6-8 engineers) spanning backend systems, database telemetry, agent engineering, and UI workflows. 
 - Own end-to-end delivery sprint planning, roadmap execution, system quality, and operational excellence for critical database ingestion and recommendation pipelines. 
 - Guide the team in harnessing cutting-edge AI technologies including Agentic AI, MCP, and LLMs to evolve database observability from passive monitoring to automated, AI-driven diagnostics and remediation. 
 - Drive architectural discussions around high-throughput, low-latency ingestion, streaming telemetry (Kafka), and database agent development, holding the team to high engineering excellence standards. 
 - Partner closely with Product Management and Design to translate high-level vision into actionable, well-engineered execution plans. . 
 - Hire, mentor, and grow engineers at every level. Set clear expectations, manage performance equitably, and build a visible talent pipeline. 
 - Build a strong DevOps culture where teams own what they ship ensuring robust monitoring, incident response, CI/CD automation, and high reliability. 
 - Champion modern engineering workflows, including AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to accelerate delivery and spec-driven development. 

This role requires

- 10+ years of total software engineering experience with 2+ years directly managing engineering teams. 
 - Proven track record of coaching, guiding, and retaining individual contributors , enabling domain experts rather than directing them. 
 - Deep technical background in backend and distributed systems (Go, Java, Python, or equivalent) with the ability to engage credibly in architecture discussions around high throughput, low latency, and data pipelines. 
 - Foundational understanding of database engines (Relational and NoSQL) and the challenges of safely collecting performance metrics under heavy production loads. 
 - Proven track record of delivering complex, multi-quarter technical initiatives on time with high quality, alongside experience managing team health, technical debt, and performance expectations. 
 - Clear, direct, and transparent communication style effective at aligning senior engineers, cross-functional partners, and executive stakeholders. 
 - Familiarity with modern practices including CI/CD, microservices, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and production observability. 

Bonus points if you have

- Background in Observability, Database Engineering, SRE, or Performance Tuning domains. 
 - Exposure to Agentic AI, LLM application architecture, or Model Context Protocol (MCP). 
 - Experience with real-time streaming architectures (Apache Kafka) and database collector/agent design. 
 - Hands-on experience with OpenTelemetry (OTel) standards. 
 - Active experience guiding teams through AI-assisted development practices (e. g. , spec-driven development using Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor). 
 - Track record of managing teams through rapid scaling or ground-up product launches. 
 - Familiarity with Kafka, GraphQL, or distributed data systems
 - Exposure to AI-assisted development practices (spec-driven dev, Claude Code, Copilot)

Why Join Us

- Be part of a forward-thinking team working with cutting-edge technologies in a collaborative environment. 
 - Access to opportunities for professional growth and development, including mentorship, learning resources, and a culture that encourages continuous improvement. 
 - We believe in maintaining a healthy work-life balance with flexible work hours and remote work opportunities. 

Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. We celebrate our talented Relics' different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us - including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We're looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes. 

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to resume@newrelic. com. 

We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office-based, fully remote, or hybrid. 

Our hiring process

In compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and to complete employment eligibility verification. Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic. 

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records based on individual circumstances and in accordance with applicable law including, but not limited to, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. 

Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. New Relic does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with New Relic. 

New Relic develops and distributes encryption software and technology that complies with U. S. export controls and licensing requirements. Certain New Relic roles require candidates to pass an export compliance assessment as a condition of employment in any global location. If relevant, we will provide more information later in the application process. 

Candidates are evaluated based on qualifications, regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, age, disability, neurodiversity, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other legally protected characteristics. 

Review our Applicant Privacy Notice at https: //newrelic. com/termsandconditions/applicant-privacy-policy

data.description:

We're transforming how enterprises build software, turning enterprise requirements into enterprise grade code with an agentic software development platform that can autonomously execute 80% of the quantum of software development work. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start-ups. 

Our Culture

Who We Are

Led by two pioneering co-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U. S. , creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500. 

How We Work

- We move Blitzy Fast: Time is both our company's and our clients' most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally. 
 - Championship Mindset: We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in-person, and remaining focused on the mission. 
 - Passion for Invention: We're pushing the frontier of what's possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration. 
 - We Work for the Customer: We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships. 

About The Role

We are hiring a Principal Engineer to take full, hands-on ownership of Blitzy's most critical production-grade systems and to deliver high-leverage features that materially improve customer outcomes and engineering velocity. 

This is the most senior individual contributor role at the company today. 

This is not a Senior-plus role, an architecture-only role, or a promotion-track role. We are looking for someone who has already operated at Principal / Staff+ scope in a highly technical environment and expects to spend their time writing, reviewing, and shipping production code. 

This role is 100% hands-on. Leverage comes from system ownership, execution quality, and durable technical decisions - not people management or process. 

Responsibilities

- Own mission-critical production systems end-to-end, ensuring correctness, scalability, performance, reliability, and operational excellence. 
 - Design, build, and ship high-impact backend systems and features that improve product reliability, performance, and customer value. 
 - Architect scalable services and cloud infrastructure using technologies such as Python, REST, gRPC, Kubernetes, and Terraform. 
 - Identify and resolve complex technical bottlenecks that limit engineering quality, system performance, or organizational velocity. 
 - Build and operate LLM-powered systems and validation loops that evaluate correctness, consistency, durability, and production performance. 
 - Design and evolve data architectures incorporating relational, NoSQL, graph, and vector databases to support complex enterprise applications and semantic retrieval. 
 - Modernize and improve complex enterprise systems while balancing reliability, maintainability, scalability, and delivery speed. 
 - Set and uphold engineering quality standards through hands-on technical leadership, sound technical judgment, and ownership of long-term technical decisions. 

Qualifications

- 12+ years of direct experience with Python as a primary programming language, backend frameworks, and microservices architectures. 
 - Expertise in REST and gRPC, with proficiency in Node. js and JavaScript. 
 - Proficiency in AWS, along with experience using at least one additional cloud platform such as GCP or Azure. 
 - Advanced knowledge of Kubernetes and Terraform in production environments. 
 - Experience operating highly available production systems, including monitoring, scalability, reliability, performance optimization, and operational tooling. 
 - Strong knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, or DynamoDB. 
 - Familiarity with graph databases such as Neo4j and vector databases or embedding infrastructure for semantic search and retrieval. 
 - Hands-on experience building and operating LLM-powered systems in production, including evaluation, validation, regression testing, tracing, and failure analysis. 
 - Working knowledge of LangSmith or comparable LLM observability and evaluation tools; familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar model providers is a plus. 
 - Ability to contribute across the full stack, with a strong understanding of frontend architecture and the ability to debug, design, and ship across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and AI systems. 
 - Understanding of large-scale enterprise software systems, including architecture, integration, deployment, modernization, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Proven track record of operating at Staff+, Principal Engineer, or comparable scope, independently driving complex technical initiatives and delivering high-impact outcomes with minimal supervision. 

Blitzy is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe different perspectives make us stronger. Base salary ranges are determined by country, role, level, experience, and skills. The range displayed on each job posting reflects Blitzy's good faith determination of the minimum and maximum targets for new hire salaries across all locations. Individual pay is determined by related factors, including job skills, experience, and relevant education or training, which may impact a final offer. Your Talent Partner can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process

data.title: Quality Insights Lead
data.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 

The Difference You Will Make

The Quality Insights Lead (QIL) supports the daily operations of the Quality program, setting a high standard for quality across the Customer Support (CS) organization. Reporting to the Quality Manager, the QIL drives continuous improvement through Quality initiatives, including analysis, business case development, reporting on Quality monitoring, and applying Problem Solving Methodologies. They ensure all assigned tasks are completed on time, collaborate with other CS teams as the Quality representative, and may oversee Quality Partner sites as needed. The QIL also serves as a brand ambassador, upholding exceptional customer service standards. 

A Typical Day

- Provide daily support for Quality programs. 
 - Design and oversee deep-dive projects for regional QIA teams to drive service improvements, managing through to project completion. 
 - Execute QI and ad-hoc after-action reviews. 
 - Use transaction monitoring insights to develop targeted continuous improvement initiatives for customer service enhancements. 
 - Utilize AI-driven conversation intelligence solutions, such as Observe. AI, to oversee and analyze customer interactions at scale, validating model-driven scores and automated evaluations to pinpoint systemic performance gaps. 
 - Convert machine-generated insights from AI-assisted monitoring into strategic service enhancements and targeted coaching priorities. 
 - Participate in and lead global calibration sessions with internal and partner teams to standardize Quality monitoring and Problem Solving methodologies. 
 - Provide feedback on coaching effectiveness for internal and partner Team Leads, fostering a coaching culture. 
 - Coach CS agents to achieve Quality program standards. 
 - Act as the Quality representative for other CS teams (e. g. , CM, BPI, Training) and contribute to relevant projects. 
 - Collect, analyze, and propose changes derived from Support Ambassador roundtable insights at internal and partner sites. 
 - Travel to partner sites to implement, train, and run key QA initiatives (e. g. , onboarding workshops, certifications). 
 - Master CS policies, procedures, and workflows, ensuring timely knowledge updates for regional QIA teams. 
 - Conduct spot checks on Quality Analysts and report findings to their QA Leads/Managers. 
 - Recommend actions to improve based on QA dashboard outcomes. 
 - Upskill in relevant or new service tiers when needed. 
 - Lead Quality at partner sites if required. 

Your Expertise

- Technical & Analytical Depth; strong analytical, statistical, and automation background - able to design and build AI-enabled tooling that streamlines review processes while maintaining rigor and high-quality analysis. 
 - Pursuing Excellence; setting the highest standards for the quality of work produced while holding yourself and others accountable
 - Collaborative; skilled working with cross-functional peers/teams
 - Presenting and Influencing; ability to develop action plans, business cases and data driven reporting that you would present to all levels of the organization
 - Coaching; You objectively analyze performance and provide regular feedback. You modify your approach to suit your audience. Ability to maintain high levels of confidentiality while providing analysis and coaching. Maintain high levels of confidentiality while performing analysis and coaching
 - Solving Problems; You quickly identify root causes as well as subtle, hidden issues. You use logic to propose effective solutions to a variety of problems. You dig deeper and utilize all available resources to reach the best possible solution. 
 - Managing Time Efficiently; You prioritize correctly, focusing your efforts on the things that are most important. You stay organized to ensure successful multitasking. 

Role Requirements

- 4-6 years of Customer Experience management experience in a rapidly growing partner network
 - Experience working in a QA Specialist or related role
 - Working knowledge of contact center end to end processes
 - Working knowledge of customer service assessment tools, i. e. , Net Promoter System
 - Working knowledge of google suite, including sheets
 - Experience leading, inspiring and motivating others to meet goals and metrics
 - Passionate about setting a high bar of exceptional customer service
 - Highly-developed analytical and critical-thinking skills
 - Ability to spot trends in data and provide recommended actions to drive performance
 - Experience with AI automation workflows within contact center Quality environments; includes validating AI-generated outputs, identifying anomalies, and interpreting model-driven trends to formulate actionable service improvements. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 - Ability to obtain COPC certification
 - Bachelor's degree required
 - Travel to partner sites expected up to 20%
 - Work with Operations teams in the region to address escalated issues, dips in performance and the roll out of new Quality initiatives to drive performance. 

Prefer To Have

- Exceptional coaching abilities
 - Advanced knowledge of Excel or Google Docs
 - Strong knowledge of NPS and Quality tools (e. g. Medallia)
 - Hands-on experience utilizing Observe. AI or equivalent AI-driven conversation intelligence solutions, specifically involving speech analytics, automated scoring, and real-time guidance. 
 - Expertise in market-leading contact center Quality Assurance platforms and global program frameworks. 
 - Proven ability to operate alongside AI automation workflows; includes assessing AI-facilitated customer interactions, pinpointing model anomalies, and converting machine-generated insights into strategic service enhancements. 
 - Quality Assurance certification (e. g. COPC) 
 - Ability to create and deliver presentations to the organization

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. 

How We'll Take Care Of You

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. 

India Annual Pay Range

₹1, 610, 000-₹2, 110, 000 INR

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. 

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb's hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb's Career's Page at careers. airbnb. com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb. com or @ext. airbnb. com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. data.description:
Description

Enphase Energy is a global energy technology company and a leading provider of solar, battery, and electric vehicle charging products. Founded in 2006, our innovative microinverter technology revolutionized solar power, making it a safer, more reliable, and scalable energy source. Today, the Enphase Energy System enables users to make, use, save, and sell their own power. Enphase is also one of the most successful and innovative clean energy companies in the world, with more than 80 million products shipped across 160 countries. 

Join our dynamic teams designing and developing next-gen energy technologies and help drive a sustainable future!

Must be available to work on-site at Salcomp, Chennai, India 5 days per week. 

About The Role

- APQP/PPAP Administration: Manage the submission and review process of Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) and Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) documents. 
 - Systemic Solutions Support: Act as a key contributor and System Administrator for the deployment of new electronic tools for supplier quality management. 
 - Supplier Data compliance: Audit suppliers supporting quality documents to ensure they meet Enphase requirements before final SQE approval. 
 - Ensure that all suppliers have completed the qualification steps before releasing them to production by developing dashboard to help SQEs track suppliers documentation.

 - Incoming Quality Control (IQC): Oversee the inspection of incoming electronic components (PCBA, magnetic materials) and mechanical parts provided by CM sub-suppliers to ensure they meet specifications. 
 - Process Verification: Ensure the Supplier is following the approved Control Plan. 
 - NPI Support: Participate in New Product Introduction (NPI) stages helping SQEs to track the completion of Line Qualification Dashboard, FAI (First Article Inspection) and PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) documentation and assisting in pilot production builds. - Education: College studies in mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience. 
 - Experience: 2+ years of experience, preferably Supplier Quality and Data analytics. 
 - Technical Core: 
 - Basic knowledge in Quality Core Tools: APQP, PPAP, MSA, SPC, QCP and FMEA. 
 - Strong proficiency in Data Analytics and visualization tools. 
 - Mindset: Strong analytical mindset, high attention to detail, and the ability to act as a "superuser" or admin for new software tools. 
 - Standards: Desirable basic knowledge of IPC-A-610 (acceptability of electronic assemblies). 
 - Environment: Frequently involves a mix of professional office settings, cleanrooms/labs, and active construction or fabrication sites. 
 - Physical Demands: May require standing for long periods, few times lifting to 35-60 pounds. 
 - Desired Skills: 
 - Exposure to contract manufacturing partnership. 
 - Working experience in manufacturing industry and data collection. 
 - A clear desire to grow into a Supplier Quality Engineer (SQA) role. 
 - Work location: Salcomp, Chennai, India (Onsite). 
 - Travel: Travels to supplier facilities (up to 10-20%).

 - Analyze Quality Performance: Leverage quality dashboards, calibration results, and customer satisfaction metrics to identify trends, scoring variance, and coaching opportunities. 
 - Generate Actionable Insights: Conduct root cause analysis and recommend targeted interventions to improve quality performance and customer experience. 
 - Improve Cross-BPO Consistency: Compare quality performance across sites, identify gaps, and drive alignment through focused coaching and calibration. 
 - Drive Closed-Loop Improvements: Partner with stakeholders to address recurring knowledge base, policy, tooling, and process gaps, ensuring corrective actions are tracked to resolution. 
 - Maintain Quality Standards: Build and maintain benchmark cases and standardized scoring rationales to reinforce consistent evaluations. 
 - Communicate Quality Impact: Share calibration trends, performance insights, and improvement outcomes with stakeholders to support data-driven decisions.

data.description:
Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based AI software development platform on a mission to revolutionize the software development life cycle by autonomously building custom software to unlock the next industrial revolution. We're transforming how enterprises build software, turning enterprise requirements into enterprise grade code with an agentic software development platform that can autonomously execute 80% of the quantum of software development work. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start-ups. 

Our Culture

Who We Are

Led by two pioneering co-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U. S. , creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500. 

How We Work

- We move Blitzy Fast: Time is both our company's and our clients' most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally. 
 - Championship Mindset: We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in-person, and remaining focused on the mission. 
 - Passion for Invention: We're pushing the frontier of what's possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration. 
 - We Work for the Customer: We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships. 

About The Role

We are hiring a Principal Engineer to take full, hands-on ownership of Blitzy's most critical production-grade systems and to deliver high-leverage features that materially improve customer outcomes and engineering velocity. 

This is the most senior individual contributor role at the company today. 

This is not a Senior-plus role, an architecture-only role, or a promotion-track role. We are looking for someone who has already operated at Principal / Staff+ scope in a highly technical environment and expects to spend their time writing, reviewing, and shipping production code. 

This role is 100% hands-on. Leverage comes from system ownership, execution quality, and durable technical decisions - not people management or process. 

Responsibilities

- Own mission-critical production systems end-to-end, ensuring correctness, scalability, performance, reliability, and operational excellence. 
 - Design, build, and ship high-impact backend systems and features that improve product reliability, performance, and customer value. 
 - Architect scalable services and cloud infrastructure using technologies such as Python, REST, gRPC, Kubernetes, and Terraform. 
 - Identify and resolve complex technical bottlenecks that limit engineering quality, system performance, or organizational velocity. 
 - Build and operate LLM-powered systems and validation loops that evaluate correctness, consistency, durability, and production performance. 
 - Design and evolve data architectures incorporating relational, NoSQL, graph, and vector databases to support complex enterprise applications and semantic retrieval. 
 - Modernize and improve complex enterprise systems while balancing reliability, maintainability, scalability, and delivery speed. 
 - Set and uphold engineering quality standards through hands-on technical leadership, sound technical judgment, and ownership of long-term technical decisions. 

Qualifications

- 12+ years of direct experience with Python as a primary programming language, backend frameworks, and microservices architectures. 
 - Expertise in REST and gRPC, with proficiency in Node. js and JavaScript. 
 - Proficiency in AWS, along with experience using at least one additional cloud platform such as GCP or Azure. 
 - Advanced knowledge of Kubernetes and Terraform in production environments. 
 - Experience operating highly available production systems, including monitoring, scalability, reliability, performance optimization, and operational tooling. 
 - Strong knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, or DynamoDB. 
 - Familiarity with graph databases such as Neo4j and vector databases or embedding infrastructure for semantic search and retrieval. 
 - Hands-on experience building and operating LLM-powered systems in production, including evaluation, validation, regression testing, tracing, and failure analysis. 
 - Working knowledge of LangSmith or comparable LLM observability and evaluation tools; familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar model providers is a plus. 
 - Ability to contribute across the full stack, with a strong understanding of frontend architecture and the ability to debug, design, and ship across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and AI systems. 
 - Understanding of large-scale enterprise software systems, including architecture, integration, deployment, modernization, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Proven track record of operating at Staff+, Principal Engineer, or comparable scope, independently driving complex technical initiatives and delivering high-impact outcomes with minimal supervision. 

Blitzy is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe different perspectives make us stronger. Base salary ranges are determined by country, role, level, experience, and skills. The range displayed on each job posting reflects Blitzy's good faith determination of the minimum and maximum targets for new hire salaries across all locations. Individual pay is determined by related factors, including job skills, experience, and relevant education or training, which may impact a final offer. Your Talent Partner can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process

data.title: Back End Developer
data.description:
About the role

Engineer backend services, data models and integrations with explicit reliability, security and operational controls. 

Develop the services behind business applications and data-driven workflows. Your work will connect application behaviour, transactional data and external systems without losing track of permissions or failure conditions. 

The role covers new functionality and improvements to existing services across AVIHS products and client engagements. It calls for clear service contracts, practical debugging and changes that can be tested and operated reliably. 

Responsibilities

- Design and implement APIs, business rules and integrations with clear request, response and error contracts. 
 - Model relational data and workflow state, including schema changes, transactions and checks that preserve data integrity. 
 - Implement authentication, authorisation and input validation at service boundaries, with appropriate handling of sensitive information. 
 - Develop background processing and external-service integrations with bounded retries, idempotency and useful operational diagnostics. 
 - Investigate slow queries, concurrency issues and production failures; add unit and integration tests for the cases uncovered. 
 - Integrate AI capabilities where the brief requires them, with evaluation criteria, fallback behaviour and explicit human-review points. Essential qualifications

- Professional backend development experience in at least one server-side language and framework. 
 - Working knowledge of SQL, relational modelling, transactions and API design. 
 - Experience with authentication, authorisation, automated testing and production debugging. 
 - Ability to reason about concurrency, duplicate requests, service failures and secure data handling. Preferred experience

- Asynchronous job processing, queues or event-driven integrations with recovery from partial failures. 
 - Query optimisation, service profiling and monitoring that helps diagnose problems in production. 
 - CI/CD, database migration practices and automated contract or integration testing. Skills you can develop in the role

- Project-specific cloud services, queues and infrastructure tooling. 
 - Retrieval systems, model-provider integrations and AI evaluation workflows. How you will work

Agree service boundaries and acceptance criteria with frontend, product and delivery colleagues. Make dependencies, security assumptions and operational risks visible during design and review. 

Take changes from implementation through testing and release preparation. Leave enough diagnostics and documentation for another engineer to investigate failures without relying on undocumented knowledge. 

Compensation

Compensation is assessed individually, based on relevant experience and demonstrated capability. Exceptional candidates are considered without a rigid salary range. 

What to include in your application

Attach your updated CV. An optional project summary can explain an API, integration or data-processing service you built, including your decisions about reliability, testing and access control.

data.description:
Hello, 

FCM part of FCTG is one of the world's largest travel management companies and a trusted partner for nationals and multinational companies. With a 24/7 reach in 97 countries, FCM's flexible technology anticipates and solves client needs, supported by experts who provide in-depth local knowledge and duty of care as part of the ultimate personalised business travel experience. 

As part of the ASX-listed Flight Centre Travel Group, FCM delivers the best market-wide rates, unique added-value benefits, and exclusive solutions. 

Winner of the World's Leading Travel Management Company Award at the WTM for nine consecutive years (2019-2011), FCM is constantly transforming the business of travel through its empowered and accountable people who deliver 24/7 service and are available online and offline. FCM has won the coveted Great Place to Work certification for the fifth time! FCM Travel India is one of India's Top 100 Great Mid-size Workplaces 2024 and the Best in Professional Services. 

A leader in the travel tech space, FCM has proprietary client solutions. FCM provides specialist services via FCM Consulting and FCM Meetings & Events. 

Day in the life: 

- Work in an Agile environment and adhere to all QA best practices. 
 - Create and maintain test plans that will complement the Product Owners' user stories. 
 - Perform Functional, Integration, Regression, Re- testing and contribute to automation. 
 - Analyse product requirements and ensure the testing strategy is aligning a risk-based test approach mitigating risk exposure within all phases of testing. 
 - Write test cases and scenarios from the requirements/designs, manage bug tracking, perform Test Analysis and Reporting. 
 - Active cooperation/collaboration with the teams across geographic locations (Europe, Americas). 
 - Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Identify and communicate cross-functional devel

You'll be perfect for the role if you have: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems or equivalent. 
 - 8+ years of strong experience in QA. 
 - Time zone flexibility to work with colleagues/stakeholders in Europe (primarily) & Americas. 
 - Strong theoretical knowledge of software testing theory and deep understanding of the quality assurance processes. 
 - Hands-on experience in low-level test case creation, test plans, and traceabilitymatrix. 
 - Exposure to travel domain, testing experience of GDS or booking creation systems will be an added advantage. 
 - Azure DevOps Test Plan usage as a test management system is a plus. 
 - Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics is a plus. 
 - Experience in business requirements analysis and review of technical documentation.

Irreverence. Ownership. Egalitarianism

data.title: Quality Analyst
data.description:
Company Overview

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential. 

Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone's best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3, 000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed. 

Job Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Quality Analyst to support the delivery of Salesforce-powered Conversational ITSM and Enterprise Service Management solutions. 

This role is ideal for professionals who enjoy validating business requirements, testing end-to-end solutions, identifying defects, and ensuring applications deliver expected business outcomes. You will work closely with Business Analysts, Developers, Architects, and Product Owners to validate innovative Salesforce, Agentforce, and enterprise service management solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Assurance & Validation

- Review business requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Identify gaps, ambiguities, and inconsistencies before development begins. 
 - Validate delivered functionality against business requirements. 
 - Ensure quality standards are followed throughout the delivery lifecycle. 

Test Planning & Execution

- Create and maintain: 
 - Test Scenarios
 - Test Cases
 - Test Data
 - Defect Reports
 - Traceability Matrices
 - Execute: 
 - Functional Testing
 - Integration Testing
 - Regression Testing
 - End-to-End Testing
 - User Acceptance Testing Support
 - Document testing results and provide quality reports. 
Salesforce & ITSM Testing

- Validate solutions developed on: 
 - Salesforce Service Cloud
 - Experience Cloud
 - Agentforce
 - Enterprise Service Management Platforms
 - Test business processes including: 
 - Incident Management
 - Service Request Management
 - Knowledge Management
 - Change Management
 - CMDB
 - IT Asset Management
 - Employee Services
 - Verify conversational and AI-enabled workflows. 
Integration Testing

- Validate integrations between Salesforce and enterprise applications. 
 - Test APIs, middleware integrations, workflows, and data synchronization processes. 
 - Ensure data consistency and business process continuity across systems. 

UAT & Stakeholder Support

- Support User Acceptance Testing activities. 
 - Assist in defect triage sessions. 
 - Participate in sprint reviews and solution demonstrations. 
 - Work with stakeholders to validate business readiness and acceptance. 

Continuous Improvement

- Identify opportunities to improve testing effectiveness and efficiency. 
 - Support automation initiatives and quality engineering practices. 
 - Contribute to a culture of quality and continuous improvement. 

Required Qualifications

Must Have

- 3-5 years of Quality Assurance and Testing experience. 
 - Experience testing enterprise applications, Salesforce solutions, or ITSM platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of test planning, execution, and defect management. 
 - Experience creating test cases, test scenarios, and validation documentation. 
 - Knowledge of Agile and Scrum delivery methodologies. 
 - Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Exposure to Salesforce Service Cloud or Experience Cloud. 
 - Experience testing Enterprise Service Management or ITSM solutions. 
 - Familiarity with CMDB and IT Asset Management processes. 
 - Knowledge of API and integration testing. 
 - ISTQB or equivalent testing certification. 

Added Advantage

- Exposure to Agentforce or Conversational AI solutions. 
 - Experience validating AI-powered workflows. 
 - Knowledge of test automation tools and frameworks. 
 - ITIL Foundation Certification. 

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for professionals who: 

- Have a strong attention to detail and quality mindset. 
 - Enjoy validating business processes and technology solutions. 
 - Can collaborate effectively with business and technical teams. 
 - Take ownership of testing outcomes and customer satisfaction. 
 - Are passionate about Salesforce, Enterprise Service Management, and AI-driven service experiences. 
 - Thrive in collaborative and fast-paced environments. 

Why Join Us?

- Be part of strategic Salesforce transformation programs focused on Conversational ITSM and Enterprise Service Management. 
 - Gain exposure to Agentforce, AI-powered service experiences, MuleSoft integrations, and Salesforce technologies. 
 - Work alongside experienced Business Analysts, Architects, Developers, and Quality Leaders. 
 - Build expertise in Salesforce testing, ITSM processes, CMDB, and IT Asset Management platforms. 
 - Accelerate your career through continuous learning, innovation, and certification opportunities. 
 - Join a growing organization committed to delivery excellence and customer success. 
 - Enjoy a flexible hybrid work model across Kochi, Bangalore, and Hyderabad. 

Join Us

If you are a passionate Quality Analyst who believes quality is about delivering business value and exceptional customer experiences, we would love to hear from you. Join us and help build the future of AI-powered Enterprise Service Management and Conversational Salesforce platforms, ensuring every solution is reliable, scalable, and aligned with customer expectations. 

Compensation

Estimated Pay Range: 

Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location. 

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success. 

Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees. 

We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you. 

***Notice to Job Seekers Regarding Impersonation and Fraudulent Job Offers***

It has come to our attention that unauthorized individuals and entities are impersonating Milestone Technologies, Inc. on various job boards/portals, specifically Naukri. com and Linkedin. com

Please be advised of the following official Milestone Technologies recruitment policies: 

Official Communication Channels

All legitimate email communications from our recruitment team will originate ONLY from the domains: @milestone. tech. We do not use generic email services (e. g. @gmail. com, @yahoo. com, @outlook. com) or unofficial third party messaging apps to conduct formal business. 

No Recruitment Fees

Milestone Technologies never requests any form of payment, "security deposit", "laptop/equipment fee", or "processing fee" at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any request for money in exchange for an interview or job offer is a scam.

data.title: Manager, Software Development
data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Development and Test Manager with 12+ years of experience leading software development, verification, and quality engineering for connected healthcare and regulated medical software. The manager will provide technical and people leadership across the complete product lifecycle-from requirements, architecture, design, and implementation through functional, automation, performance, reliability, and release-readiness testing. This role owns delivery of cloud-native applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, user interfaces, microservices, medical-device integrations, and EMR/EHR workflows within agreed quality, schedule, and budget commitments. The role combines engineering leadership, development and test governance, technical direction, stakeholder management, design-control compliance, and audit-ready delivery. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and continuously improve the integrated software development and test strategy in alignment with product roadmaps, business priorities, regulatory commitments, architecture direction, and release plans. 
 - Lead software developers, automation engineers, performance engineers, and functional verification engineers; manage capacity, hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, technical development, succession planning, and delivery accountability. 
 - Plan and lead engineering assignments involving the evaluation, selection, and adaptation of software designs, technologies, development methods, test approaches, tools, and engineering practices. 
 - Provide technical direction from product conception through requirements, architecture, detailed design, implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining activities. 
 - Establish software engineering governance covering estimation, design and code reviews, coding standards, branching and configuration management, unit and component testing, static analysis, code coverage, technical debt, defect management, and quality metrics. 
 - Ensure software architecture and implementation meet requirements for maintainability, security, scalability, performance, reliability, interoperability, observability, and supportability. 
 - Own delivery of cloud-native applications, microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, web user interfaces, integration services, and data processing capabilities using appropriate C#/. NET and related technologies. 
 - Establish test governance, risk-based planning, entry and exit criteria, requirements traceability, defect management, quality dashboards, and release-readiness assessments. 
 - Own the roadmap and governance for reusable C#-based REST API and UI automation frameworks, including coding standards, test-data management, parallel execution, logging, reporting, and environment configuration. 
 - Ensure unit, component, integration, smoke, regression, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and release-level testing is incorporated into CI/CD pipelines with appropriate automated quality gates. 
 - Guide design, development, integration, and verification of HL7 ADT, FHIR resources, clinical workflows, EMR/EHR interfaces, connected medical devices, real-time communications, notifications, and downstream clinical systems. 
 - Implement configuration and change management throughout the complete product lifecycle, including design, development, verification, release, and sustaining phases. 
 - Partner with product, clinical, systems, architecture, DevOps, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, and external integration teams to resolve dependencies, technical issues, and product risks. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis by correlating application behavior, source code, automated and performance results, logs, API traces, network data, database records, queues, container metrics, and infrastructure telemetry. 
 - Incorporate field issues, customer feedback, post-market learnings, and production trends into product design improvements, corrective actions, regression coverage, reliability testing, and performance validation. 
 - Ensure compliance with the product development process, design controls, Quality System requirements, software lifecycle procedures, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable regulatory standards. 
 - Maintain audit-ready requirements, architecture and design records, code and review evidence, plans, test cases, objective evidence, reports, approvals, and traceability in approved tools such as Jira, Jama, source-control platforms, and validated test-management systems. 
 - Develop project plans, engineering milestones, resource strategies, budgets, and delivery forecasts; identify and mitigate issues that could affect quality, cost, scope, or schedule. 
 - Manage external development partners, contractors, vendors, and third-party service providers, including technical direction, deliverable acceptance, and performance monitoring. 
 - Communicate development progress, quality status, technical risks, mitigation plans, resource needs, architecture decisions, test findings, and go/no-go recommendations to program and leadership forums. 

What You'll Bring

- 12-18 years of software engineering, software development, testing, verification, quality engineering, or performance engineering experience, including at least 5 years leading multidisciplinary technical teams in a regulated or safety-critical environment. 
 - B. E/B. Tech in Computer Science / Electronics & Communication / Electrical or related field 
 - Demonstrated experience managing the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, code review, unit testing, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on or technical leadership experience with C#/. NET, object-oriented design, design patterns, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, web applications, and distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of functional and automation test strategy for REST APIs, web user interfaces, integration workflows, and end-to-end regression using Playwright, Selenium, NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience with software architecture and engineering practices such as clean architecture, secure coding, static analysis, code quality, code coverage, configuration management, branching strategies, dependency management, and technical-debt reduction. 
 - Experience validating distributed microservices, event-driven systems, JSON/XML, SQL/PostgreSQL, authentication, authorization, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, MQTT, or comparable technologies. 
 - Working knowledge of Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, autoscaling, service discovery, role-based access control, secrets management, service mesh, resilience, and cloud observability. 
 - Experience with CI/CD architecture, Git, build automation, automated quality gates, pipeline troubleshooting, artifact management, deployment practices, test reporting, and engineering dashboards. 
 - Healthcare domain expertise covering HL7 v2, ADT messages and acknowledgements, FHIR REST resources, EMR/EHR workflows, connected medical devices, data integrity, patient safety, privacy, and clinical risk. 
 - Knowledge of regulated healthcare software practices and standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, design controls, cybersecurity expectations, and formal verification evidence. 
 - Ability to manage complex projects and engineering programs within boundaries of quality, time, scope, and budget while balancing development and verification priorities. 
 - Strong people leadership, stakeholder influencing, conflict resolution, planning, prioritization, vendor coordination, risk management, and executive communication skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with SIP, RTP, WebSocket, WebRTC, audio/video communication, Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, or comparable real-time communication technologies. 
 - Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Application Insights, APM platforms, centralized logging, packet analysis, database diagnostics, and automated performance-threshold evaluation. 
 - Knowledge of Azure Key Vault, Azure App Configuration, Redis, Web PubSub, Terraform, KEDA, infrastructure-as-code, service virtualization, and container security. 
 - Experience supporting regulatory audits, formal submissions, post-market investigations, and enterprise-scale healthcare product releases. 
 - Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, cybersecurity expectations, and quality systems for regulated healthcare software. 
 - Experience with Jira, Jama, validated toolchains, Agile/Scrum delivery, and formal release-readiness reviews. 
 - C#, Azure, Kubernetes, performance testing, healthcare interoperability, PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification is advantageous. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information.

Baxter has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Baxter employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

data.description:
About Juniper Square

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We're the Operations Partner trusted by 2, 300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700, 000+ LPs on platform, we've built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we're reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1, 000+ employees strong, we're building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come. 

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you're energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U. S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Senior Technical Lead to architect, design, and oversee the development of scalable web applications and distributed systems. The ideal candidate brings strong backend expertise in Python (FastAPI preferred) or Java, combined with solid frontend development experience using ReactJS and TypeScript. 

This role will lead the design and delivery of end-to-end systems-from user-facing applications to backend services and cloud infrastructure. You will guide engineering teams, drive architectural decisions, and ensure best practices across the full software development lifecycle. 

Experience leveraging AI tools and building AI-driven solutions will be a significant advantage, especially for developing intelligent features, automation, and data-driven capabilities within products. 

What You'll Do

Technical Leadership

- Lead the architecture and design of full-stack applications, including frontend interfaces, backend services, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Provide hands-on technical guidance to engineering teams and mentor developers across frontend and backend domains. 
 - Define coding standards, enforce code quality, and conduct thorough code reviews. 
 - Drive end-to-end delivery, from architecture and development to deployment and maintenance. 

Backend Engineering & API Development

- Architect and build backend services using Python/FastAPI (preferred) or Java (Spring Boot/Quarkus). 
 - Design and implement scalable RESTful and GraphQL APIs with a strong focus on performance, security, and maintainability. 
 - Build asynchronous processing pipelines and microservices using tools like Celery, RabbitMQ, Redis, or similar message brokers. 
 - Design efficient database schemas and queries using PostgreSQL, MySQL, or NoSQL databases. 
 - Implement caching strategies and optimise backend services for high throughput and reliability. 

Frontend Development

- Develop modern web applications using ReactJS and TypeScript. 
 - Design reusable UI components and scalable frontend architecture. 
 - Implement state management, API integrations, and responsive user interfaces. 
 - Collaborate closely with design and product teams to deliver intuitive user experiences. 
 - Ensure frontend applications maintain high standards of performance, accessibility, and maintainability. 

Cloud & DevOps

- Deploy, manage, and optimise applications on AWS (EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, IAM, etc. ). 
 - Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and environment provisioning. 
 - Use Docker and Kubernetes for containerization and microservice orchestration. 
 - Ensure system observability through logging, monitoring, and distributed tracing. 

Architecture & System Design

- Lead discussions on scalability, distributed architecture, caching strategies, and event-driven patterns. 
 - Design full-stack solutions that balance performance, reliability, and user experience. 
 - Drive adoption of cloud-native architectures and modern engineering practices. 
 - Ensure adherence to security best practices and compliance standards. 

AI & Intelligent Systems (Advantage)

- Leverage modern AI tools and frameworks to enhance developer productivity and product capabilities. 
 - Contribute to or lead the development of AI-powered features, such as intelligent search, conversational interfaces, recommendation systems, or automation tools. 
 - Work with technologies such as LLMs, embeddings, semantic search, and RAG pipelines where relevant. 
 - Evaluate opportunities to integrate AI-driven capabilities into existing products and workflows. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 
 - 10-13 years of software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years in a technical leadership role. 
 - Strong expertise in: 
 - Python (FastAPI preferred) OR Java
 - ReactJS and TypeScript
 - REST and GraphQL API development
 - Asynchronous processing (Celery or similar)
 - AWS cloud services
 - Docker, Kubernetes, and containerization
 - Solid understanding of: 
 - Microservices architectures
 - Distributed systems design
 - SQL and NoSQL databases
 - CI/CD pipelines
 - Monitoring and observability frameworks
Nice to Have

- Experience building AI-driven applications or integrating AI capabilities into products. 
 - Experience with event-driven systems such as Kafka, SNS/SQS. 
 - Exposure to Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and clean architecture principles. 
 - Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation). 
 - Experience with performance tuning, load testing, and AWS cost optimization. 

Soft Skills

- Strong leadership, mentoring, and stakeholder management abilities. 
 - Excellent communication and documentation skills. 
 - Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities. 
 - Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, agile environment.

UAT & Stakeholder Support

Continuous Improvement

ARE YOU A PROACTIVE, VISIONARY SR. FULL STACK DEVELOPER WHO LEADS BY EXAMPLE?

At Crebos, we're not just hiring developers - we're seeking a Senior Full Stack Developer with exceptional technical expertise, strong leadership abilities, and a business-oriented mindset. 

You will own the end-to-end development process, build high-performance applications, mentor developers, and help deliver scalable products that create real value for our customers. 

ABOUT US

Crebos is an innovative technology company focused on building high-quality, scalable, and user-driven applications. 

We believe in ownership, accountability, customer value, quality, and continuous improvement. 

WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR A REGULAR DEVELOPER

- We are looking for an elite performer. 
 - A great senior developer isn't measured by how many tickets they close or lines of code they write. We need someone who understands the business problem, customer value, product, quality standards, risks, delivery commitments, and long-term impact of what they build. 
 - Someone who can take a problem, understand the desired outcome, identify what could go wrong, build the right solution, and take responsibility for delivering it successfully. 
 - At Crebos, we call these people our Spartans - elite performers who take ownership, raise standards, and make the entire team stronger. 

THE MINDSET & TRAITS WE EXPECT

- Business Clarity - Understand why something is being built, the business problem behind it, and what measurable value it should create. 
 - Success Definition - Define what "done" and successful actually mean before starting. 
 - Scope Discipline - Understand requirements, dependencies, assumptions, and exclusions while preventing unnecessary complexity and scope creep. 
 - Extreme Ownership - Own outcomes end-to-end. Don't hide behind roles, teams, or tickets. Escalate blockers early and follow problems through to resolution. 
 - Risk Awareness - Identify technical risks, dependencies, edge cases, security concerns, performance issues, and potential blockers before they become problems. 
 - Delivery Predictability - Make realistic commitments, communicate deviations early, and consistently deliver against a clear definition of done. 
 - Systems Thinking - Fix root causes, not symptoms. Build scalable, maintainable, reusable solutions and avoid unnecessary technical debt. 
 - AI Leverage - Use AI effectively across development, debugging, testing, research, documentation, code reviews, automation, and problem-solving to measurably improve speed and quality. 
 - Continuous Improvement - Turn lessons, failures, and feedback into better standards, processes, automation, and reusable solutions. 

CUSTOMER, PRODUCT & QUALITY MINDSET

- Your responsibility doesn't end when the code works. 
 - You should constantly think: 
 - What problem are we solving?
 - What value does this create for the customer and business?
 - What experience will the customer have?
 - What could fail?
 - Are we solving the root problem?
 - Can we achieve the same outcome with less complexity?
 - Is the solution secure, scalable, maintainable, performant, and production-ready?
 - We expect strong standards around architecture, clean code, scalability, performance, security, automated testing, error handling, edge cases, code reviews, documentation, technical debt, and customer experience. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop, test, and maintain scalable applications using MongoDB, Express. js, React. js, Node. js, Next. js, and Laravel.

• Integrate third-party APIs and services. 

• Debug, troubleshoot, and continuously optimize application performance and reliability.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables. 

• Proactively identify and escalate technical and delivery risks. 

• Mentor developers and raise engineering standards across the team. 

• Improve architecture, processes, automation, and reusable engineering solutions.

• 6+ years of full-stack development experience, with strong expertise in React. js, Node. js, Next. js, and MongoDB. 

• 5+ years of Laravel experience. 

• Expertise in JavaScript (ES6+) and modern front-end development. 

• Proficiency in state management tools like Redux or Context API. 

• Strong experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs. 

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure. 

• Strong understanding of architecture, scalability, performance, security, testing, and maintainability. 

• Proven ability to own complex technical problems from definition through delivery. 

• Strong product, customer, and business understanding. 

• Practical experience using AI and modern engineering tools to improve productivity and quality. 

LEADERSHIP QUALITIES

• Proven ability to lead front-end and back-end teams. 

• Strong ownership, accountability, communication, and problem-solving. 

• Ability to anticipate challenges rather than react to them. 

• Ability to mentor developers and raise the performance of the people around you. 

• Ability to challenge weak solutions constructively and create clarity in ambiguous situations. 

• Ability to balance engineering excellence, delivery speed, customer value, and business priorities. 

WHY JOIN CREBOS?

At Crebos, you'll get an environment, platform, responsibility, and level of exposure designed to accelerate your growth beyond what you would typically experience in a conventional development role. 

We believe exceptional people grow fastest when surrounded by other high performers, given meaningful ownership, and challenged with real business problems. 

- High-Performance Environment - Work with ambitious people who value ownership, accountability, speed, customer value, and quality. 
 - Exceptional Growth Platform - Accelerate your technical, leadership, product, business, and professional growth.

IMPORTANT NOTICE

• This role carries significantly higher expectations than a conventional development position. 

• We expect technical excellence, ownership, business thinking, customer orientation, predictable delivery, AI leverage, and continuous improvement.

People who take ownership. Understand the business. Care about the customer. Think before they build. Identify risks early. Deliver what they commit to. Use AI and technology to multiply their impact. And continuously raise the standards of themselves and everyone around them.

data.title: QA Engineer
data.description:
About Chargebee

Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth. 

Chargebee is trusted by businesses of all sizes, including Zapier, LegalZoom, Lambda, Freshworks, DeepL, Condé Nast, and Pret a Manger, and is proud to have been consistently recognized by customers as a Leader in Subscription Management on G2. 

With headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, our team members are based primarily in India, the U. S. , and Europe. 

About the Team

Our AI Products team builds Chargebee Copilot and other product experiences that bring Chargebee's AI Agents platform to real users. We turn the platform's agents, tools, and APIs into products people use every day, from the backend services and APIs that power them to the interfaces on top. We care about good conversational experiences and about giving people the tools to configure and improve how an AI agent behaves. 

About the role (Job Summary)

We're looking for an AI Quality Engineer to own the quality of our AI-powered products and agents throughout their lifecycle. Unlike traditional QA, AI systems aren't deterministic, so they need continuous evaluation before release and ongoing improvement based on real-world usage. You'll make sure our AI delivers accurate, reliable, high-quality experiences by designing effective evaluations, validating new capabilities, analyzing production behavior, and driving improvements across the AI stack. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys understanding why AI systems behave the way they do and is passionate about improving AI products through evidence, experimentation, and engineering collaboration. 

What you'll do

- Design, review, and improve AI evaluation datasets, benchmarks, and regression suites, ensuring coverage reflects real customer scenarios, edge cases, and expected user behavior
 - Validate new AI capabilities before they are released to customers, and continuously improve evaluations and release criteria
 - Monitor AI quality in production using customer feedback, sampled conversations, telemetry, and quality metrics
 - Perform root cause analysis to understand why AI interactions succeed or fail, classifying issues across prompts, retrieval, tool usage, model behavior, workflows, product knowledge, and application logic
 - Identify recurring quality patterns and recommend engineering improvements
 - Convert production learnings into evaluation cases to prevent future regressions
 - Partner with Engineering, Product, and Support to improve prompts, agent workflows, retrieval systems, tools, and evaluation frameworks
 - Define and track AI quality KPIs, and measure the impact of improvements using benchmarks and production metrics

What you'll bring (required skills and experience)

- Strong analytical and investigative mindset with excellent problem-solving skills
 - 2+ years of experience
 - Ability to identify root causes rather than symptoms
 - Excellent written communication and documentation skills
 - Comfort working with APIs, logs, structured data, and technical systems
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams
 - Passion for building high-quality AI products

Nice to have (preferred)

- Experience in QA, SDET, Technical Support Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Product Analysis, or AI/ML applications
 - Familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, MCP, AI agents, or AI evaluation frameworks
 - Experience designing evaluation datasets, benchmarks, or testing strategies
 - Basic programming or scripting skills (Python, SQL, JavaScript, etc. )

Benefits we offer

At Chargebee, we believe that feeling supported is the foundation for doing great work. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your personal, financial, and professional growth and ensure you thrive in every aspect of your life. Our commitment to supporting our employees is universal, while our benefits are thoughtfully designed to meet the unique needs of each region. We offer comprehensive packages that generally include: 

- Health & Wellness: Robust coverage and access to programs to support your physical and mental well-being. 
 - Financial Security: Initiatives to help you build long-term financial stability. 
 - Work-Life Balance: Flexible options and resources to help you thrive both professionally and personally. 

Chargebee is an equal opportunity employer. At Chargebee, we believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences is not a "good-to-have" but a "must-have" as it strengthens us as a company and as individuals. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. 

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, age, national origin, ancestry, caste, citizenship, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

About Rockwell Automation

Rockwell Automation is the world's largest company dedicated to industrial automation and digital transformation. As a Team Lead - Medium Voltage you will be responsible to lead a team of application/electrical engineers engaged in the engineering of Medium Voltage (MV) Motor Control Center (MCCs), Switchgear and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), customizing as per customer requirement utilizing the AutoCAD tools, while providing engineering support to the manufacturing plants of RA. This role reports to the Engineering Manager and is part of Global Engineering & Business Services group in India, catering to regional Rockwell Automation offices across the globe. It's a hybrid work environment working in 12: 00pm to 9: 00 pm shift located in Pune/Noida - India. 

Your Responsibilities

- Lead, mentor and develop a team of MV application/electrical engineers - allocating and prioritizing work, managing workload and ensuring on-time delivery, high quality engineering and customer satisfaction
 - Manage day-to-day execution of CTO/ETO projects within defined timelines, ensuring high quality engineering while leveraging standard and reusable engineering practices

 - Work closely with internal and external customers, and collaborate with global stakeholders across regions and time zones, to review requirements and deliver customized technical solutions that comply with electrical standards and Rockwell Automation's engineering practices
 - Coordinate overall system integration activities, maintaining accurate documentation and fostering effective collaboration across teams and functions
 - Drive capability development, continuous improvement and knowledge-sharing within the team - coaching engineers, building technical depth and supporting other initiatives

 - Ensure strict adherence to international engineering standards (NEC, UL, CSA, IEC) by consistently applying them throughout order execution activities

The Essentials - You Will Have

- Bachelor's in Electrical / Electronics

 - Exposure of working in a global setup - collaborating with global stakeholders, customers and cross-functional teams across regions and time zones

 - Expertise of AutoCAD-Electrical software
 - Thorough knowledge of DOL & S/D Starters, VFDs, Soft-Starters, Intelligent Motor Control, Safety Product's System Designing

 - Good Command on SAP Documentation and Part Management
 - Industry and application Knowledge, training skills, and familiar with Lean Six Sigma and EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) Principles.

 - Experience on Panel Testing, I/O Testing and FAT

What We Offer

 - Time Off & Family Leave: 25 days holiday plus 10 public holidays, paid maternity, paternity and adoption leave, and a day off for your birthday. 

Our approach to Flexible Working

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.

Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.
