data.description:
Senior DevOps Engineer - Platform Deployment & Multi-Cloud Infrastructure

Location: [Remote / Hybrid - specify]

Team: Platform Engineering / Innovation

Employment type: Full-time

About The Role

We are hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer to own and evolve the deployment of our AI-powered application modernization platform (NEXUS) into client production environments. This role is a unique hybrid of Platform Engineering and Technical Advisory. You will not only design the underlying multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) but also partner directly with client IT groups to establish SysOps frameworks. You will leverage our AI-driven automation tools to provision infrastructure, integrate AIOps for anomaly detection and remediation, and ensure clients receive seamless product updates via our Helm-based delivery pipeline. 

This is a senior individual contributor role that requires a "product mindset"-you are designing for scale, security, and long-term operational sustainability in client environments. 

What You Will Do

Client Collaboration & SysOps Partnership

- Serve as the primary technical partner to client IT groups, guiding them on best practices for operating bespoke NEXUS implementations. 
 - Work with client-aligned delivery teams to manage the lifecycle of the platform, ensuring timely and reliable product updates via Helm charts. 
 - Collaborate with client stakeholders to tailor infrastructure and operational workflows, ensuring NEXUS integrates seamlessly with their existing enterprise monitoring and ticketing systems. 

AI-Driven Automation & AIOps Integration

- Build & Leverage AI for Provisioning: Architect and implement AI-assisted workflows to automate the provisioning and configuration of infrastructure across multi-cloud environments. 
 - AIOps Implementation: Integrate and adopt 3Pillar's AIOps platform into client ecosystems to enable proactive, automated anomaly detection and incident remediation. 
 - Knowledge Base Evolution: Maintain and refine the AIOps knowledge base, training agents to perform accurate root-cause analysis (RCA) and automate recurring issue resolution. 1

Platform & Multi-Cloud Development

- Evolve our Helm-based platform layer and Terraform module libraries to support standardized, secure deployment patterns across AWS, Azure, and GCP. 1 2 
 - Design for "Delegation": Move our automation from simple execution to self-adapting workflows that handle ambiguity and get smarter over time. 3 
 - Ensure all infrastructure-as-code and automated remediation scripts meet rigorous enterprise security and compliance standards, including PII access logging and least-privilege IAM. 

Our technology stack

You should be comfortable working with most of the following (or able to ramp quickly): 

Area

Technologies

IaC

Terraform (>= 1. 5), remote state (S3 + DynamoDB), module versioning via Git tags

Cloud

AWS (primary for client deployments): EKS, VPC, NLB, EFS, ECR, Route 53, KMS, IAM/IRSA

- Azure: AKS, Key Vault, ACR, VNet
 - GCP: GKE, Artifact Registry

Kubernetes

Production cluster operations, storage classes, ingress, HPA, troubleshooting CrashLoop / init failures

Packaging

Helm (umbrella charts, atomic releases), feature-flag-driven deployments

Platform services

HashiCorp Vault, Keycloak, OAuth2 Proxy, cert-manager, Zalando Postgres Operator, Neo4j, Redis Operator, Strimzi Kafka, Prometheus/Grafana/Loki, Apache Airflow, MinIO

Application platform

Python/FastAPI backend, React frontend, MCP server, background workers, retrieval/RAG services; container images on a private registry (e. g. GHCR)

CI/CD & GitOps

GitHub Actions, Flux (internal environments), image signing (Cosign)

Observability & ops

kubectl, helm, structured logging (Loki), metrics/alerts, operational runbooks

Security

TLS (Let's Encrypt DNS-01), secrets via Vault/VSO, SSO/OIDC, VPN / CIDR-based ingress controls

Required Experience

- Client-Facing Advisory & Enablement: Proven experience in a technical advisory or client-facing engineering role. You are comfortable partnering with client IT teams, guiding them through technical adoption, and translating complex platform requirements into operational success. 
 - DevOps & Infrastructure Expertise: 5+ years in DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering. You possess production-grade Terraform experience-architecting modular, multi-cloud IaC frameworks that enable consistent, repeatable deployments across different environments. 
 - AIOps & Observability: Hands-on experience integrating or managing AIOps platforms or automated observability stacks. You understand the lifecycle of incident response, anomaly detection, and automated remediation. 
 - AI-Driven Automation: Demonstrated experience building automation workflows. You don't just write scripts; you build systems that reduce manual operational toil and empower users through self-service provisioning and automated configuration. 
 - Platform Engineering at Scale: Deep expertise in Kubernetes and Helm. You have a track record of deploying and operating complex, multi-service platforms and managing their lifecycle (chart development, values layering, atomic releases). 
 - Foundational Cloud Operations: Proven AWS expertise (EKS, networking, IAM/IRSA) with a strong aptitude for multi-cloud environments (Azure/GCP). 
 - Identity & Security: Solid experience with secrets management (HashiCorp Vault or similar) and identity/SSO integration (Keycloak/OIDC). 
 - Communication & Mentorship: Excellent written and verbal communication. You are able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and mentor teams on best practices. 

Strongly Preferred / Nice To Have

- Consultative Experience: Prior work as a Solutions Architect, Technical Account Manager, or Implementation Engineer in a SaaS or Managed Services environment. 
 - AI/LLM Infrastructure: Experience managing infrastructure for AI/ML workloads, including GPU node pools, vector databases (e. g. , Neo4j), or RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines. 
 - GitOps & Lifecycle: Hands-on experience with GitOps methodologies (Flux, Argo CD) for managing continuous deployment at scale. 
 - Enterprise Compliance: Experience operating within regulated or enterprise environments (PII logging, audit trails, network isolation, SOC2/compliance-heavy workflows). 
 - Kafka & Distributed Systems: Experience with event streaming platforms (e. g. , Strimzi/Kafka) or specialized operators for stateful services. 

What success looks like in your first 6-12 months

- Successful enablement of client IT teams to independently manage and operate the NEXUS platform. 
 - Quantifiable reduction in manual operational toil for clients through the successful adoption of AIOps-driven anomaly detection and automated remediation. 
 - Seamless, low-friction delivery of platform updates via automated Helm-based pipelines. 
 - Deployment of robust, AI-provisioned infrastructure stacks that adapt to client-specific demands while maintaining security and compliance.

data.title: Staff/Senior Operations Engineer
data.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

About CloudBees: 

CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer. 

Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust. 

CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow. 

Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. 

Visit us at www. cloudbees. com. 

About the Role: 

To support the delivery of CloudBees products (both internal and external), our Operations team designs, deploys, secures and manages a variety of software systems and the related GCP / AWS infrastructure that underpins these software engineering objectives. Our guiding principle is simple - "Make Engineering Faster". Underpinning this are the challenges of security, process change, technical change that all must be met to varying degrees. Further, we are passionate about reducing the manual work that plagues IT teams - Engineering / Ops / Support / Security - and are empowered to re-engineer processes and technology to achieve those objectives. 

We are looking for someone who: 

- Is able to troubleshoot complex issues calmly. 
 - An open communicator, capable of bringing new ideas to the team
 - Is able to learn from colleagues at all levels
 - Understands, and is motivated by, rapidly changing technologies and has demonstrable competence with modern AI tools. 

You are: 

- self-motivated and enjoy solving problems
 - excited by the opportunity to automate yourself out of recurring workable to self-organize and document your work and decisions effectively
 - You will liaise directly with the software engineers across all teams, ensuring that decisions are agreed internally and externally to Operations and that they meet our technical and non-technical objectives. 

How you'll work: 

- In a geographically distributed team (APAC, US, EMEA) of peers
 - Choose your own work in tandem with the team, team-leader, and manager
 - Flexible working hours - while there will be some core hours required for meeting with Engineering and Operations teams - much latitude is given in getting work done. 
 - Hybrid work based out of our Chennai hub

Requirements

What you'll Do: 

Team-building - inside the team and across teams - you'll be proposing new ideas and helping implement themThinking - coming up with new ways of solving problems - and working with the team to prove them out and then implement them. Keeping up to speed with the latest technology, and proactively making use of tools like coding assistants and AI agents to accelerate your work. Documenting - describing problems, how your proposed solution solves those problems, and how your implemented solutions are operated. Optimizing - working with Engineering teams to optimize their build systems. Managing and developing tools which enable Engineers to ship faster. Defining - writing / modifying Terraform to handle our infrastructure, and helping teams define their infrastructure using our modules. Coding - you'll be writing code in Golang - we occasionally write code in TypeScript, Python, and GroovySecuring

- working with our security team to drive operational change in engineering teams
 - working with our security team to drive organizational security changes (logging, auditing, monitoring, alerting)

Observing - adding the right monitoring so that we are alerted before our customers notice, and not alerted when the system is able to heal itselfAlerting - getting alerts and working with team members to solve the initial problem, documenting the problem and then working out how to stop them happening againDevOps / DevSecOps - We're not "DevOps" engineers, but we do help our teams become more proficient in doing Dev and Ops (and embracing Total Ownership). We build the guard rails to help them do it safely and align tech-stacks across the company. What you will work on -

- IaaS - GCP, AWS

 - 2+ years experience in a high level programming language (Golang / Python / Ruby / Java or similar)

You have experience in:

General Summary

Staff Engineer / Manager

DSP Firmware, Linux/HLOS & Embedded Systems

Location: Bangalore, India

We are looking for a hands-on technical leader to drive architecture, development, and delivery of high-performance DSP firmware, Linux/HLOS integration, and platform software for next-generation SoC platforms. The role requires deep expertise in real-time embedded systems, low-level processor software, system integration, performance optimization, customer engagement, and technical team leadership. 

The successful candidate will own critical firmware and platform components, guide hardware-software interfaces, and drive technical decisions from pre-silicon development and silicon bring-up through product commercialization. 

Responsibilities

DSP Firmware, Linux/HLOS Architecture & Ownership

- Define software architecture for real-time DSP and processor subsystems, including integration with Linux-based high-level operating systems (HLOS). 
 - Own low-level software spanning boot, board support packages, RTOS integration, DSP services, Linux kernel and user-space interfaces, device drivers, middleware, system services, and developer frameworks. 
 - Drive architecture decisions balancing deterministic latency, throughput, power, memory footprint, reliability, security, and scalability. 
 - Influence hardware-software partitioning, DSP workload offload, host-subsystem interfaces, and the long-term platform roadmap. 
 - Define scalable software models for single-core, multi-core, and heterogeneous compute configurations. 

Technical Leadership

- Lead resolution of complex system issues spanning DSP and processor cores, silicon, firmware, RTOS, Linux/HLOS, kernel and user-space drivers, middleware, and host software. 
 - Drive multi-core and heterogeneous compute architecture, DSP workload partitioning, Linux/HLOS offload, and real-time scheduling. 
 - Guide interrupt, exception, timer, clock, reset, watchdog, and power-domain frameworks. 
 - Own memory architecture and optimization across tightly coupled memory, on-chip memory, external memory, caches, memory protection, DMA, shared memory, and coherency. 
 - Drive boot, image loading, secure boot, subsystem startup, restart, fault handling, recovery, and diagnostic dump mechanisms. 
 - Architect inter-processor communication, shared-memory transport, synchronization, remote procedure calls, and Linux/HLOS-to-DSP interfaces. 
 - Guide Linux kernel drivers, user-space services, DSP drivers, peripheral drivers, data movement engines, and platform services. 
 - Drive DSP performance optimization using profiling, instruction-level analysis, vector and parallel processing, fixed-point arithmetic, signal-processing optimization, memory-access optimization, and compiler/toolchain capabilities. 
 - Lead power optimization across dynamic frequency and voltage scaling, clock gating, retention, sleep states, and coordinated HLOS-subsystem power management. 
 - Drive platform security, privilege separation, memory protection, access control, and subsystem isolation. 
 - Lead pre-silicon validation, silicon enablement, board bring-up, platform stabilization, and production readiness. 
 - Drive measurable improvements in performance, power, latency, memory, stability, and reliability. 

Execution, Customer Engagement & Team Development

- Translate product and customer requirements into architecture, milestones, and executable engineering plans. 
 - Partner with hardware, DSP, Linux/HLOS, systems, validation, tools, applications, and customer engineering teams to deliver end-to-end solutions. 
 - Lead technical reviews, root-cause analysis, and risk management for critical deliverables. 
 - Mentor engineers in firmware design, Linux integration, debugging, optimization, and system-level problem solving. 
 - Manage and develop engineers while remaining technically hands-on and accountable for delivery quality. 

Qualifications

Required Experience & Skills

- 11+ years of experience in embedded software, DSP or processor firmware, Linux/HLOS integration, board support packages, device drivers, or platform software development. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in C/C++ with strong understanding of assembly-level debugging and processor architecture. 
 - Strong experience with RTOS environments such as Zephyr or FreeRTOS, along with Embedded Linux or another Linux-based HLOS environment. 
 - Deep understanding of RTOS internals, scheduling, synchronization, interrupts, exceptions, and real-time constraints. 
 - Strong understanding of Linux kernel fundamentals, user-space services, device-driver models, system startup, power management, and debugging across HLOS and DSP boundaries. 
 - Strong knowledge of boot flows, linker scripts, memory maps, executable formats, image loading, and firmware packaging. 
 - Hands-on experience with caches, tightly coupled memory, memory protection, DMA, shared memory, coherency, and memory bandwidth optimization. 
 - Experience with Linux/HLOS-to-DSP communication, multi-core synchronization, subsystem lifecycle management, and fault recovery. 
 - Experience with DSP profiling, compiler optimization, vector processing, fixed-point arithmetic, low-level optimization, and performance-per-watt analysis. 
 - Proven ability to debug hardware-software issues using JTAG, trace, crash dumps, logs, hardware instruments, Linux debugging tools, and profilers. 
 - Proven experience delivering products from pre-silicon development and silicon bring-up through production. 
 - Experience leading engineers while remaining technically hands-on. 
 - Strong customer-facing communication, technical negotiation, and leadership skills. 
 - Proficiency in using AI-assisted development tools to improve design, implementation, debugging, documentation, and engineering efficiency. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience developing DSP firmware and Linux/HLOS integration for compute, audio, sensor, communication, imaging, or machine-learning subsystems.

data.title: Senior Staff Engineer - Infrastructure Software
data.description:
Netradyne harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth. 

Role Summary

The Infra-Dev team builds the software that runs Netradyne's cloud infrastructure. We write the internal platforms, automation and AI agents that DevOps, Database and engineering teams use every day: cloud cost analytics and anomaly detection, self-service service provisioning on AWS, an internal developer platform on Kubernetes, database access and upgrade automation, S3 data lifecycle and retention, and agentic tooling for infrastructure operations and on-call. 

We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to provide technical leadership for Infra-Dev. You will own the team's technical goals and major platforms, decide how new initiatives are approached, and stay hands-on in design and code. You bring wide-ranging experience across cloud infrastructure, software engineering, databases and cost management, and you understand how these disciplines affect one another. 

Role And Responsibilities

- Act as technical owner and architect for Infra-Dev's major platforms: the cloud operations and cost platform, the service provisioning tooling, the internal developer platform and infrastructure AI agents. 
 - Lead the design and delivery of multi-quarter initiatives such as containerising services onto Kubernetes (EKS), GitOps-based internal developer platforms, an infrastructure registry of service and resource dependencies, and infrastructure-as-code standardisation. 
 - Decide the methods, tools and standards for new assignments, including build-vs-buy evaluations, technology selection and migration plans. 
 - Lead cloud cost management (FinOps) engineering: cost allocation and unit economics (for example, cost per device or per feature), forecasting, anomaly detection, Savings Plans and Reserved Instance coverage, and COGS/OpEx reporting for engineering and finance leadership. 
 - Act as a technical point of contact for Finance and cloud vendors (AWS account and TAM teams, tooling vendors) on cost analysis, forecasts, commitments and renewals. 
 - Own the architecture of data lifecycle and storage-cost programs for petabyte-scale S3 data: retention policies, storage-class transitions, data retirement and safe deletion with customer-specific exceptions. 
 - Run the team's recurring cost and operations reviews, turning findings into prioritised engineering work and measurable savings. 
 - Define the architecture for agentic infrastructure operations: triage and on-call agents, MCP gateways and human-in-the-loop approvals, with clear security guardrails. 
 - Set standards for database and access automation across PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, OpenSearch, ClickHouse and DynamoDB, working closely with the Database team. 
 - Provide architecture guidance on shared infrastructure that DevOps and Database teams depend on, including logging pipelines, internal PKI and certificates, Kubernetes secrets management and device-to-cloud ingestion (IoT, Kinesis Video Streams). 
 - Drive security and compliance-by-default in infrastructure tooling: least-privilege IAM, credential lifecycle, secrets management, tagging and audit reporting. 
 - Lead architecture and design reviews, RFCs and technical decisions for Infra-Dev, and review designs from DevOps and Database teams where they intersect. 
 - Identify and address scalability, reliability, cost and security risks across the infrastructure stack before they become incidents. 
 - Lead investigation of complex production issues that cross application, database, network and cloud layers, and drive lasting fixes. 
 - Plan sprints and roadmaps with engineering leadership: break down work, manage dependencies, track delivery and report progress with team metrics. 
 - Make sure critical knowledge is written down: design documents, runbooks and ownership maps for every system the team runs. 
 - Mentor and grow engineers through design guidance, code reviews and career coaching. 
 - Take part in hiring, interviews and onboarding for the Infra teams. 

Essential Skills

- 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including significant experience building infrastructure, platform, DevOps or SRE software at scale. 
 - Expert programming skills in Python and/or Go, with a strong record of production-quality code and code review. 
 - Deep, hands-on AWS expertise across compute, networking, IAM, storage, databases, messaging and billing, including multi-account and multi-cluster environments. 
 - Strong experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and the cloud-native ecosystem: Helm, Argo CD, Crossplane, service networking and autoscaling. 
 - Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/Terragrunt or equivalent) and designing reusable modules and golden paths. 
 - Strong experience designing CI/CD pipelines and safe deployment strategies across multiple environments. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems: reliability, fault tolerance, idempotency, retries and capacity planning. 
 - Strong understanding of database operations and internals for relational and NoSQL data stores. 
 - Experience with cloud cost management, including cost data pipelines, cost allocation and commitment-based discounts. 
 - Proven ability to determine methods and approaches on new, loosely defined assignments and to evaluate trade-offs across many variables. 
 - Proven technical leadership: driving multi-person initiatives and mentoring engineers while staying hands-on. 
 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs, risks and cost impact to engineering and business leaders. 

Good-to-Have Skills

- Experience building LLM agents and AI platforms (AWS Bedrock, Strands or LangGraph, MCP, vector databases, agent observability). 
 - Experience building internal developer platforms or platform-engineering products used by many teams. 
 - Experience with observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, OpenTelemetry or the ELK stack. 
 - Experience with Snowflake, data warehouses and forecasting or anomaly detection techniques (e. g. , Prophet, regression models). 
 - Experience with IoT or device platforms and large-scale data ingestion. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted software development tools such as Claude, Cursor and GitHub Copilot. 

Leadership & Management Expectations

- Act as the senior technical leader and approver for Infra-Dev, and own team goals for its tactical business targets. 
 - Support the decisions and goals of the wider Infrastructure function (DevOps, Database and Infra-Dev); your work is reviewed on completion. 
 - Understand how infrastructure, application engineering, security and finance depend on one another, and design solutions that work across them. 
 - Direct how existing engineering principles are applied in Infra-Dev, and guide the development of new infrastructure policies and standards. 
 - Build a culture of engineering quality, ownership, automation and continuous improvement. 

Qualifications And Education Requirements

- B. Tech/M. Tech in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Typically requires 8+ years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree, 6+ years with a Master's degree, or a PhD with 3+ years of experience. 

We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. Netradyne is an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any legally protected status. 

If there is a match between your experiences/skills and the Company's needs, we will contact you directly. 

Netradyne is an equal-opportunity employer. 

Applicants only - Recruiting agencies do not contact. 

Recruitment Fraud Alert!

There has been an increase in fraud that targets job seekers. Scammers may present themselves to job seekers as Netradyne employees or recruiters. Please be aware that Netradyne does not request sensitive personal data from applicants via text/instant message or any unsecured method; does not promise any advance payment for work equipment set-up and does not use recruitment or job-sourcing agencies that charge candidates an advance fee of any kind. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in '@netradyne. com' or '@us-greenhouse-mail. io'.

Job Description

About the Role

As a Senior QA Tester, you will lead end-to-end quality assurance for a high-quality SaaS solution that exceeds customer and business partner expectations. Additionally, you will take responsibility for managing defects, tracking resolution, and communicating test results to the broader team.

Required Skills

- 7+ years of professional experience in QA for modern, cloud-based SaaS applications, with expertise in both UI and API testing. 
 - Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated E2E test suites (e. g. Playwright, Cypress, or similar). 
 - Experience testing REST APIs (e. g. Postman, REST-assured, or similar) including contract, data, and error-case validation. 
 - Experience testing AI-powered or AI-assisted product features (e. g. validating model outputs, edge cases, and failure modes for AI-driven functionality) as these capabilities are introduced into the product. 
 - Knowledgeable in testing within cloud environments (AWS, Azure) and across CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Expertise in designing and executing test cases / test plans, including for complex, data-intensive, multi-tenant systems. 
 - Experience in using bug tracking and test management tools such as Jira. 
 - Working knowledge of common web application security risks (e. g. OWASP Top 10) and how to test for them. 
 - Ability to mentor more junior members of the team. 

Nice to Have

- Familiarity with accessibility testing tools and practices (e. g. axe, WCAG 2. 2 AA conformance). 
 - Performance and load testing experience for high-volume, multi-tenant systems. 
 - Domain knowledge in finance, ERP, FP&A, or accounting systems. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Demonstrate a strong understanding of the system under test, including how finance teams use the product to build, version, and collaborate on plans and budgets. 
 - Design, execute, and maintain automated end-to-end test suites (e. g. Playwright) covering critical user journeys across the web application. 
 - Plan and execute API-level testing against REST services, validating contracts, data integrity, and error handling across the microservices estate. 
 - Test across browsers, devices, and cloud environments to ensure consistent behaviour and performance at scale. 
 - Validate data integrity and multi-tenant isolation across large, multi-dimensional financial datasets. 
 - Practical experience using AI-assisted testing tools (e. g. AI-powered test case generation, self-healing test automation, AI-assisted test data generation) to improve test coverage and efficiency. 
 - Incorporate security-aware testing practices (e. g. OWASP Top 10 risk areas) into test planning and execution. 
 - Contribute to accessibility testing (WCAG 2. 2 AA) as part of the overall quality bar. 
 - Provide technical guidance to more junior members of the team. 
 - Collaborate with the delivery team to create source documents used for testing artefacts, and create and maintain test artefacts that maximise the efficiency of the test phase, cover all requirements, and allow for timely delivery of products and/or components to our customers.

Who We Are

Axi was founded in Sydney in 2007 as a two-person startup. It has grown into a top global brokerage that's trusted by tens of thousands of clients in 100+ countries. We offer a multi-asset trading service that allows clients of all levels to achieve their goals by trading and investing in global financial markets. 

Our success is built on having top products, cutting-edge trading technology, award-winning service, and by having a great team of people working together all around the world - we hope you'll enjoy getting to know them!

Axi is proud to have an honest and trusted reputation, with the Axi Group of companies operating under full financial regulation in different regions around the world, governed by ASIC, FCA, DFSA, FMA and CySec. 

Let's talk about the cool stuff you do at Axi!

The Performance & Reliability team works cross-functionally with domain PODs, SRE, and Architecture to shape and enforce performance standards, identify bottlenecks, and drive continuous optimization across services, APIs, and clients. You will be the voice for performance, helping teams design faster systems from inception. 

Your EDGE Assignment/You Will

- Plan and conduct performance, load, stress, and soak tests for . NET Core microservices, React and React Native clients, SQL Server/Cosmos DB queries, and messaging systems. 
 - Profile services and applications to identify performance bottlenecks: CPU, memory, I/O, network, and database contention using tools like Perfview, dotTrace, Azure Monitor, and browser dev tools. 
 - Recommend and validate optimizations at code level (async patterns, caching, batching), database level (query tuning, indexing, partitioning), and infrastructure level (resource limits, autoscaling). 
 - Define and monitor performance budgets, SLOs/SLIs, and capacity plans for critical services, alerting teams to regressions or approaching limits. 
 - Work with Kubernetes/AKS teams on resource allocation, autoscaling strategies, and performance implications of deployments. 
 - Build and maintain performance dashboards and monitoring, visualizing metrics from Application Insights, Prometheus, or similar tools. 
 - Document performance best practices, anti-patterns, and decision trees to guide teams. 

Technical Requirements

- Hands-on experience with performance testing frameworks and tools (e. g. , JMeter, k6, Locust, custom harnesses). 
 - Strong understanding of . NET Core runtime behavior: async patterns, TPL, thread pool, GC, memory allocation, and profiling techniques. 
 - Proficiency with . NET profiling tools: Perfview, dotTrace, Application Insights, or equivalent; ability to interpret ETW traces and metrics. 
 - Solid knowledge of SQL Server performance: query plans, indexing strategies, execution time analysis, and workload characterization. 
 - Familiarity with NoSQL performance tuning: Cosmos DB throughput, partitioning, consistency trade-offs, and cost modeling. 
 - Understanding of browser and mobile performance: network waterfall analysis, rendering performance, JavaScript profiling, and memory leaks. 
 - Exposure to Kubernetes resource management: CPU/memory requests and limits, QoS classes, and impact on performance. 
 - Knowledge of observability tools: Application Insights, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar; ability to correlate metrics and traces to identify root causes. 

Experience And Skills

- 4-8 years of experience in performance engineering, preferably for distributed, microservices-based systems. 
 - Strong debugging and troubleshooting mindset with ability to work backwards from customer impact to root cause. 
 - Experience collaborating with multiple teams across geographies to validate findings and drive implementation. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to present findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Industrial Communication Protocols: Deep understanding of Modbus, DeviceNet, and Ethernet/IP protocols. 
 - VFD Drives: Hands-on experience with Drive parameter settings and establishing communication with various PLCs. 
 - Testing & Troubleshooting: Demonstrated experience in validation and fault diagnosis of MCC and control panels.

About Airbound

Our mission is to make a world where everyone has access to delivery. Where goods move as freely as information moves today. 

This is possible. Today the cost of moving on a scooter is ₹2/km. That's the cost of moving a 150kg mass from point A to B. We're bringing that mass down to less than 5kgs, concurrently bringing the cost down to 10 paise/km. This is how we make deliveries a reality. This is how we create a world where we're doing billions of deliveries per day. 

The tech is not there. The current cost of drone delivery is ₹100/km. We need to completely redefine the way things are done here. We're building the world's most efficient aircraft from the ground-up, and scaling that up to beyond anything the aerospace sector has ever seen. This cannot be an iterative process. We have to tear down all conventions and build everything up from scratch. 

To do this, we need nothing less than the best engineers. The ones who care about building something fundamentally different, who are deeply curious about understanding the fundamentals of everything they're working on, who are dreamers that believe in the impossible. 

About Hardware Engineering

Hardware Engineering owns the aircraft's physical development, from a concept sketch to a part that flies. This spans system design, mechanism design, and structural design: working out how something moves, what it's made of, and whether it holds up under real load. Because most of what we design is custom, it also means designing the equipment we use to prove our work - rigs, jigs, and testers built specifically to validate a design before it goes anywhere near a real flight. It's one team across concept, design, initial prototyping, and test: the full arc of getting a product from an idea to something that ships. 

About The Role

In this role, you will be the bridge between mechatronic systems and the software that validates them. You will architect, build, and deploy the test frameworks and automation software that our flight, structures, and systems teams depend on to ensure the aircraft is safe and reliable. You will take high-level test requirements and turn them into automated routines that safely control sensors and actuators, owning the software stack from initial prototype through to field root-cause analysis. This is a role for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of bits and atoms, ensuring our testers provide representative and repeatable data for critical flight qualification. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Framework & Automation

- Design and deploy scalable test frameworks for hardware validation across R&D, production, and pre-flight stages
 - Develop automation code for testers ranging from individual component-level characterization to full-system integration tests

Hardware Integration

- Integrate hardware interfaces including motor controllers, deployment mechanisms, and diverse sensor arrays into automated test setups
 - Design custom PCBAs and circuitry to support test fixture communications and signal conditioning when off-the-shelf solutions aren't enough

Data, Monitoring & Safety

- Implement fault detection, comprehensive data logging, and remote monitoring to enable safe, lights-out testing capabilities
 - Create intuitive dashboards and visualization tools for rapid interpretation of test results by the wider engineering team

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate testers with flight hardware, ensuring high-fidelity environmental simulation

Qualifications

Must-Have

- 2+ years of experience integrating hardware and software systems
 - Production-level Python experience for test automation; working knowledge of embedded C for interfacing with microcontrollers
 - Strong hands-on experience interfacing software with hardware (sensors, instrumentation, actuators) and reading complex datasheets
 - Fluency with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices within a multidisciplinary engineering environment
 - Knowledge of robotics communication protocols
 - Experience building automation for safety-critical systems where software controls significant energy or physical motion
 - Proven track record of writing hardware test plans and utilizing common test instrumentation (oscilloscopes, DAQs, load cells)
 - Basic project management skills - able to scope, plan, and run your own projects with minimal oversight
 - Ability to solve complex, multidisciplinary problems independently or as part of a high-velocity team

Good to Have

- Robotics / UAV systems test automation experience
 - Custom PCBA design and development experience

Work location: Hoskote, Bangalore (Headquarters)

What We Offer

- Comprehensive health insurance to keep you and your loved ones covered
 - Relocation assistance and a daily travel stipend to ease your commute
 - Advanced salary credit to support you when you need it

"A driven, passionate team where you'll have room to grow and thrive - this is more than just a job, it's a rare opportunity to build something meaningful from the ground up"

Work Schedule

- In-office role, working alternate Saturdays. 

Ready to take off?

Scam Notice: Beware of impersonators collecting fees for interviews & jobs at Airbound (Opendrone Private Limited) Please do not make any payments and report any such incidents to us at contact@airbound. com .

data.description:
Job title: Head of SMS Platform - A2P, SMPP, AI SMS Firewall & DLT

Employment type: Full-time (contract-to-hire considered) · Remote or Hybrid

About us

We're building a global A2P SMS platform for enterprises, aggregators, wholesale partners and mobile operators. It includes SMS APIs, SMPP connectivity, wholesale routing, an AI-powered SMS firewall and a DLT-based compliance platform. The platform is in development. We need an experienced leader who has built and run a live SMS platform before, to take ours to production and run it at scale. 

The role

You'll own the SMS platform end to end: design it, build it with our developers, connect it to carriers worldwide, make it secure and compliant, and run it reliably in production. As we grow, you'll hire and lead the team that manages it. 

What you'll do

Build the core SMS platform

- Review what we've built so far, find the gaps, and plan the path to live production
 - Design and build a scalable, high-throughput, highly available A2P SMS platform with failover
 - Build and manage SMPP connections (client and server) and HTTP/REST SMS APIs
 - Build smart routing: least-cost, quality-based and failover routing, plus delivery reports (DLRs)
 - Integrate number lookup (HLR / MNP), Unicode, long-message handling and global number formatsWholesale platform

- Build customer and supplier management, rates, rating, credit limits, billing and invoicing
 - Connect and test SMPP links with operators and aggregators worldwide
 - Monitor route quality, delivery rates, latency and margins in real timeAI-powered SMS firewall

- Design and build an SMS firewall that protects operators and enterprises from fraud and unwanted traffic
 - Detect and block grey routes, SIM box traffic, SMS pumping / AIT, spoofing, spam and phishing
 - Use AI and machine learning to: 
 - Classify message content automatically (OTP, transactional, promotional, fraud, phishing)
 - Spot unusual traffic patterns and new fraud in real time
 - Score senders and routes for risk
 - Detect malicious links and impersonation of brands or banks
 - Learn from new attacks and update rules automatically
 - Build an operator dashboard with live analytics, alerts, rule management and revenue-assurance reports
 - Support operator deployment models, both on-premise and cloudDLT compliance platform (global)

- Design and build a DLT (distributed ledger technology) platform for SMS registration and compliance, usable by regulators, operators and enterprises in any country
 - Core features: 
 - Registration of businesses (entities), sender IDs (headers) and message templates
 - Customer consent registration and management
 - Do-not-disturb / preference registry
 - Real-time scrubbing of every message against registered entity, header, template, consent and preferences
 - Advanced features: 
 - AI template matching that checks messages against approved templates and flags misuse
 - Automated approval workflows with document checks
 - Tamper-proof audit trail of every registration and change
 - Multi-operator sync and APIs so operators, aggregators and enterprises share one source of truth
 - Configurable rules per country, so one platform adapts to each regulator's requirements
 - Analytics and reports for regulators and operatorsCompliance and security across the platform

- Build sender ID registration, consent, opt-out, DND and sending-hours controls that can be configured per country
 - Secure the platform with encryption, access control, audit logs and API securityRun it in production

- Set up monitoring, alerting and 24/7 operations
 - Track throughput (TPS), delivery rate, latency, uptime, fraud blocked and margins
 - Handle incidents and keep the platform stableBuild the team

- Recommend the team we need, such as developers, data/AI engineers, NOC and support engineers, and a routing and rates manager
 - Hire, onboard and lead that team as we scale
 - Work closely with our product, compliance and sales teamsWhat you bring

- Must have: hands-on experience building and running a live A2P SMS platform in production
 - 2+ years in telecom messaging, with deep knowledge of SMPP (3. 4 / 5. 0), SMSC, SMS gateways and HTTP SMS APIs
 - Experience building or deploying an SMS firewall for operators or aggregators
 - Experience with DLT or sender registration and scrubbing platforms, in any country
 - Understanding of AI/ML for fraud detection, anomaly detection or text classification, or experience leading data scientists who do this
 - Strong coding skills in at least one of Java, Go, Python, Node. js or C/C++, plus databases, message queues and cloud or Linux servers
 - Experience with carrier interconnects, routing, rating and billing for wholesale SMS
 - Experience leading or hiring engineers
 - Nice to have: blockchain or distributed ledger development, GSMA fraud and security standards, signalling (SS7 / SIGTRAN), WhatsApp Business API or RCS, experience working with regulators or operatorsWhy join

- Lead the build of a global messaging platform from the ground up
 - Build advanced AI firewall and DLT products for operators and regulators worldwide
 - Shape the technology and the teamTo apply, describe an SMS platform, firewall or DLT system you built or ran: the traffic volume, the countries and carriers involved, and your exact role.

Our cloud-based SaaS platform combines advanced analytics, machine learning, and real-time data integration to give your teams visibility across every node of the supply network. From scenario modeling and risk detection to predictive insights and executive dashboards - we bring the whole picture together, so your people can act on it. 

We integrate seamlessly with the systems you already rely on - ERP, planning, logistics, and data platforms - through robust APIs and a scalable architecture designed for enterprise complexity. data.title: Tech Lead - Commerce Engineering
data.description:
Hiring: Tech Lead - CommerceEdge

Build the Technology. Shape the Business. Share in the Upside. 

CommerceEdge is building a technology services business focused on B2B commerce engineering for distributors, wholesalers, and manufacturers in North America. 

We help businesses modernize their digital commerce operations through commerce platforms, system integrations, custom software, and practical engineering solutions. 

We're looking for a hands-on Tech Lead to help build our engineering capabilities from the ground up. This is an opportunity to take ownership of technical decisions, work directly with business leadership, establish engineering standards, and help build a team that delivers real business outcomes. 

This role is suited to someone who enjoys solving complex problems, writing code, mentoring engineers, and taking responsibility for the bigger picture. 

What You'll Do

Technical Leadership

* Own technical architecture and engineering decisions across client projects. 

* Lead the design and development of scalable B2B commerce solutions. 

* Establish standards for code quality, testing, security, performance, and deployment. 

* Evaluate technology stacks, frameworks, and tools based on business requirements. 

Hands-on Engineering

* Remain actively involved in coding, code reviews, debugging, and technical problem-solving. 

* Build and integrate commerce platforms, APIs, ERP/CRM systems, and other business applications. 

* Help turn complex business requirements into practical, maintainable technical solutions. 

* Guide implementation from initial discovery through development, deployment, and ongoing support. 

Team Building

* Help recruit, mentor, and develop the initial engineering team in Bangalore. 

* Establish effective development workflows, documentation practices, and engineering processes. 

* Build a culture of accountability, continuous learning, collaboration, and high-quality execution. 

Client and Business Collaboration

* Work with business leadership and client stakeholders in North America. 

* Contribute to technical discovery, solution design, effort estimation, and project planning. 

* Explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 

* Help identify opportunities to improve delivery quality, client outcomes, and business growth. 

What We're Looking For

* 3+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful experience leading technical projects or engineers. 

* Strong software design fundamentals and experience building production-grade applications. 

* Experience with APIs, system integrations, databases, cloud infrastructure, and modern development practices. 

* Experience with one or more commerce platforms, such as Adobe Commerce / Magento, Shopify, or other enterprise eCommerce platforms. 

* Familiarity with ERP, CRM, inventory, order management, or other enterprise business systems is a plus. 

* Ability to make sound architectural decisions while remaining pragmatic about budgets, timelines, and maintainability. 

* Strong communication skills and the ability to work with distributed teams and North American clients. 

* A builder's mindset: comfortable working in an early-stage environment where processes and teams are still being established. 

Experience with B2B commerce, distribution, wholesale, or manufacturing systems is particularly valuable. 

Compensation and Incentives

We believe the people building the business should have an opportunity to benefit from its success. 

In addition to a competitive salary, this role will include a profit-sharing incentive tied to the company's performance and agreed-upon eligibility criteria. 

The intention is to reward meaningful contributions to engineering quality, delivery performance, client success, and the long-term growth of CommerceEdge. 

The structure, calculation, and payout terms will be discussed transparently during the hiring process. 

Why Join CommerceEdge?

* Real ownership: Influence technical direction rather than simply execute decisions made elsewhere. 

* Build from the ground up: Help shape the engineering team, processes, and technical culture. 

* Business exposure: Work closely with leadership and understand how technology delivery translates into commercial results. 

* Growth opportunity: Develop into a broader technology and engineering leadership role as the company grows. 

* Meaningful problems: Work on the systems that power real-world distribution and B2B commerce operations. 

Who Will Thrive Here?

Someone who combines strong engineering fundamentals with sound judgment, initiative, and a sense of ownership. 

You don't need to know everything. You do need to be comfortable learning quickly, making decisions, helping others succeed, and taking responsibility for outcomes. 

If you're interested in building something meaningful rather than simply moving into another position, we'd like to hear from you.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
Company Description

NikahForever is India's leading Community Matrimony platform, dedicated to making marriages simple and accessible. We have proudly facilitated 5 million+ members. By leveraging AI-based algorithms, we streamline the process of searching and connecting with compatible profiles. Our platform redefines how people perceive and approach marriage, ensuring an easy and efficient experience. 

Build the Team. Own the Architecture. Ship the Product. Solve the Hardest Problems. 

Experience: Proven engineering leadership experience required

Preferred background: Strong product-based technology companies

Role: Hands-on Engineering Manager / Individual Contributor

Expectation: High ownership, high execution velocity, zero dependency on constant supervision

The Role

We are looking for an engineering leader who can do both: build a high-performing engineering team and personally solve difficult engineering problems. 

You are not someone who stopped coding after becoming a manager. You can review a system architecture, understand an unfamiliar codebase, investigate a production outage, write a critical service, build an AI agent, and still know how to hire, coach, challenge, and manage engineers effectively. 

You can take an ambiguous business objective, translate it into an engineering strategy, break it into executable work, assign ownership, remove bottlenecks, and drive it to production. 

When the team is moving fast, you multiply its output. When a critical technical problem is blocking delivery, you can get into the details and help solve it yourself. 

You are technology-agnostic, obsessed with execution, comfortable with complexity, and actively exploring how AI and autonomous agents can change the way software is built. 

We are not looking for a manager who needs a team to do the engineering for them but for an engineer who has developed the ability to make an entire team more effective without losing the ability to build themselves. 

What You Will Own

1. Engineering execution and delivery

- Take complete ownership of engineering delivery, from understanding business priorities to shipping reliable production systems. 
 - Convert ambiguous business objectives into clear technical plans, milestones, priorities, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Drive execution across multiple projects without allowing dependencies, indecision, or coordination overhead to become excuses for delays. 
 - Identify bottlenecks early, make trade-offs decisively, and unblock the team without waiting for escalations. 
 - Maintain high execution velocity without accumulating reckless technical debt or compromising security and reliability. 
 - Ensure the team ships working software, not just completed tickets, merged pull requests, or impressive-looking roadmaps. 
 - Take direct ownership of critical deliverables when timelines or technical complexity demand hands-on intervention. 2. Hands-on engineering and technical leadership

- Remain technically credible through active coding, code reviews, debugging, system design, and production ownership. 
 - Design and build backend services, APIs, integrations, data pipelines, automations, and AI-powered systems as required. 
 - Navigate unfamiliar repositories and technology stacks without treating unfamiliarity as a blocker. 
 - Make sound architecture decisions based on business needs, scalability, reliability, maintainability, cost, and time to market. 
 - Diagnose complex production failures, performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, and difficult integration issues. 
 - Establish engineering standards for code quality, testing, security, observability, deployment, and operational readiness. 
 - Know when to delegate, when to coach, and when to personally take the keyboard. 3. Team leadership and people management

- Build and manage a team of high-performing engineers with clear expectations, accountability, and ownership. 
 - Hire engineers who demonstrate exceptional problem-solving ability, technical depth, learning speed, and execution. 
 - Set a high engineering bar and address persistent performance issues directly and fairly. 
 - Coach engineers through difficult technical decisions instead of becoming the team's permanent debugging service. 
 - Develop engineers who can independently own systems, make decisions, and deliver outcomes. 
 - Create a culture where engineers challenge assumptions, surface problems early, take responsibility, and continuously improve. 
 - Balance delegation with hands-on involvement without becoming either a micromanager or an absent manager. 
 - Provide clear feedback, manage performance, resolve conflicts, and make difficult people decisions when necessary. 

4. AI-native and agentic engineering

We expect you to be an active practitioner of modern AI-assisted engineering, not someone who merely encourages the team to experiment with ChatGPT. 

- Use AI coding agents to accelerate code exploration, implementation, debugging, testing, and refactoring. 
 - Build or integrate agentic workflows involving planning, tool calling, multi-step execution, external APIs, and verification. 
 - Identify engineering and business processes that can be automated using LLMs, agents, and conventional software. 
 - Establish practical workflows that increase engineering throughput without sacrificing correctness or security. 
 - Evaluate new AI tools based on measurable improvements in delivery speed, quality, and cost. 
 - Teach the team how to use AI effectively, review AI-generated code critically, and validate agent-driven changes. 
 - Personally prototype and ship AI-powered solutions rather than limiting your involvement to strategy and vendor selection. We want a leader who uses AI to increase the output of the entire engineering organization, including their own. 

5. Cross-domain problem solving

You should be comfortable moving between fundamentally different technical challenges. 

Depending on the problem, this may involve: 

- Backend architecture, APIs, databases, caching, and distributed systems. 
 - Mobile, web, and end-to-end product workflows. 
 - Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, performance, and incident management. 
 - Payment gateways, third-party integrations, asynchronous workflows, and data consistency. 
 - AI applications, LLM integrations, agentic systems, and automation. 
 - Security, reliability, cost optimization, and scaling systems under real-world constraints. 

6. Business ownership

- Understand the business metrics behind the engineering roadmap. 
 - Prioritize work based on customer impact, revenue, risk, and engineering effort. 
 - Challenge unnecessary complexity, low-value projects and choices that don't solve a meaningful problem. 
 - Make informed build-versus-buy decisions. 
 - Optimize infrastructure and engineering costs without creating fragile systems. 
 - Communicate technical risks, delivery trade-offs, and progress clearly to business stakeholders. You are expected to understand not just whether something can be built, but whether it should be built, why it matters, and how quickly it needs to deliver value. 

The Non-Negotiable Bar

Technical credibility: You have personally built and shipped production software and can still reason deeply about code and architecture. 

Independent execution: You do not need your manager to tell you what to prioritize, how to solve a problem, or how to unblock your team. 

Leadership without hiding behind delegation: You can manage through others while remaining capable of direct technical contribution. 

Breadth of experience: You have dealt with different classes of engineering problems and can adapt beyond your primary specialization. 

AI-native thinking: You actively use AI and agentic workflows to improve individual and team productivity. 

Accountability: When a project fails, you investigate the causes, own your part, correct the course, and prevent avoidable recurrence. 

People leadership: You can attract, develop, challenge, and retain strong engineers while addressing underperformance directly. 

What We Do Not Want

- A people manager who has lost the ability to understand or contribute to the code. 
 - A project manager whose primary output is meetings, status reports, and Jira updates. 
 - An architect who produces diagrams but cannot validate implementation details. 
 - A hands-off manager who delegates every difficult technical problem. 
 - A micromanager who becomes the approval bottleneck for every decision. 

What Success Looks Like

- The team consistently ships high-quality software with predictable execution. 
 - Engineers operate with greater independence and take meaningful ownership. 
 - Architectural and technical decisions improve the product rather than create unnecessary complexity. 
 - Critical production issues are diagnosed and resolved systematically. 
 - AI and automation measurably improve engineering throughput. 
 - Engineering resources are allocated to the highest-impact problems. 
 - You can step into the hardest technical problems without becoming a permanent bottleneck. 

Interview Process

- Technical deep dive: Walk us through complex systems you have personally designed, built, shipped, or operated. 
 - Live problem solving: Debug an unfamiliar codebase, investigate a failure, or solve a practical engineering problem. 
 - System design: Design a production system and defend your choices around reliability, scale, security, cost, and delivery speed. 
 - AI-agent exercise: Use an AI coding agent to solve a bounded engineering task and demonstrate how you verify its work. 
 - Engineering management scenarios: Handle missed commitments, underperformance, technical disagreements, competing priorities, and team bottlenecks. 
 - Execution review: Explain a difficult project you owned, the decisions you made, what went wrong, and the measurable result. 
 - Ownership verification: Distinguish what you personally contributed from what the team delivered. We will evaluate the reasoning behind your decisions, not just the final answers. 

The expectation is simple: lead the team, own the outcome, understand the technology, and be ready to build when it matters.

Key Responsibilities

 - 9. Partner with India-based Product/Engineering teams on platform capabilities, ensuring clean handoffs across time zones on integration patterns and enhancements needed for scalable client solutions. 
 - 10. Build and maintain solutioning standards, reusable patterns, and technical documentation so the team can deliver consistently as engagement volume grows. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 6-10 years of experience in technical consulting, integration solutioning/development, or similar roles within HRTech/SaaS or enterprise software. 
 - Proven experience managing Technical Consultants or similar delivery teams (3+ years in a people-management role) - including hiring, performance management, quality oversight, and owning delivery outcomes. 
 - Strong hands-on programming ability in Python - comfortable writing, reading, reviewing, and debugging integration code. 
 - Solid expertise in system integrations (REST/SOAP APIs, file-based integrations, middleware) with the ability to design and solution complex integration landscapes. 
 - Demonstrated ability to help teams diagnose and resolve issues on integration interfaces in production environments. 
 - Experience engaging client leadership through demos, technical meetups, and executive-facing solution discussions. 
 - Experience working with US/North American clients, and willingness to work the US shift on a sustained basis. 
 - A quick learner who already uses AI tools for solutioning and writing code (e. g. , LLM-based assistants, coding copilots) and can strengthen this practice across a delivery team. 
 - Excellent client-facing communication and stakeholder management skills - able to explain technical designs clearly and lead solution discussions with both technical and leadership audiences. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with the ability to balance leadership responsibilities and hands-on technical contribution. 

Good to Have

- JavaScript experience - a plus for integration builds, scripting, and related client-side or middleware work. 
 - Prior direct experience with the Darwinbox platform or similar HRMS/HCM products. 
 - Exposure to standard and custom integration patterns (SFTP, REST/SOAP APIs, middleware tools). 
 - Experience scaling AI-assisted solutioning and coding practices across a consulting or engineering team. 

What Success Looks Like

Within the first two quarters, this person will have become the trusted integrations lead for US client leadership, established clear ownership of integration solutioning and development quality across their team, built a strong rhythm of client leadership demos and meetups, helped stabilize and resolve complex integration interface issues, and strengthened the team's existing AI-driven approach to solutioning and coding - leaving behind a high-performing US-shift Technical Consultant team capable of scaling delivery with consistent quality.

Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan / Open to relocation

Experience: Senior technology leadership experience with a strong track record in AI product development and scaling

Role: Full-time, Founding Leadership

About Aasvaa Innovation LabsAt Aasvaa Innovation Labs, we're building Manthaan OS, an AI operating system designed to power intelligent, secure, and scalable AI applications for governments and enterprises. 

Our vision is to build technology that goes beyond AI experimentation and solves real-world problems through intelligent information retrieval, domain-specific AI, automation, and decision support. 

We're developing AI infrastructure and products that can operate in complex enterprise and government environments, where security, reliability, scalability, and deployment flexibility matter. 

As we move into our next phase of growth, we're looking for a technology leader who wants to build, own, and scale this vision with us. 

The OpportunityWe're looking for a Technology Co-Founder & CTO who has built products, led engineering teams, navigated complex technology decisions, and experienced the journey from early-stage product development to scale. 

This is not a conventional CTO position focused only on managing developers or overseeing technical execution. 

We're looking for someone who can combine deep technical expertise with product thinking, architectural vision, and entrepreneurial ownership. 

You will work directly with the Founder & CEO to shape our technology roadmap, strengthen our AI capabilities, build a world-class engineering culture, and take our products from their current stage to the next level. 

What You'll Own1. Technology Vision & Architecture

- Define and execute the long-term technology strategy for Manthaan OS and our AI product ecosystem. 
 - Design scalable, modular, secure, and production-ready AI systems. 
 - Make critical architectural decisions across AI infrastructure, data systems, model orchestration, and application layers. 
 - Build technology that can support enterprise and government deployments, including on-premises environments. 2. AI Engineering & Product Development

- Lead the development of production-grade AI systems involving LLMs, RAG, agentic AI, semantic search, vector databases, and multimodal AI. 
 - Translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, reliable, and commercially viable products. 
 - Improve model performance, inference efficiency, latency, accuracy, and infrastructure costs. 
 - Establish robust practices for evaluation, observability, security, and continuous improvement. 3. Product Lifecycle & Scaling

- Own the complete product lifecycle, from architecture and prototyping to deployment, iteration, and scaling. 
 - Work closely with the business team to translate customer requirements into product capabilities. 
 - Develop reusable technology components that can power multiple products and use cases. 
 - Balance speed of execution with long-term maintainability, reliability, and technical excellence. 4. Engineering Leadership

- Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing engineering team. 
 - Establish engineering standards, development processes, testing practices, and deployment pipelines. 
 - Create a culture of accountability, experimentation, ownership, and rapid execution. 
 - Make the right build-versus-buy and technology prioritisation decisions for a growing startup. 5. Strategic & Business Ownership

- Work directly with the Founder & CEO on company strategy, product direction, and long-term technology differentiation. 
 - Participate in enterprise and government technology discussions, product demonstrations, and solution architecture. 
 - Contribute to technical due diligence, strategic partnerships, and fundraising discussions. 
 - Help build Aasvaa into a technology company with defensible intellectual property and scalable products. Who We're Looking ForWe are particularly interested in individuals who: 

- Have held senior engineering or technology leadership roles in product-focused technology companies. 
 - Have experience taking AI or software products from early development to production and, ideally, through significant scaling. 
 - Understand the complete product lifecycle, including architecture, development, deployment, customer feedback, optimisation, and iteration. 
 - Possess strong hands-on technical depth in AI/ML systems, backend architecture, distributed systems, or AI infrastructure. 
 - Can move comfortably between high-level architectural decisions and detailed technical problem-solving. 
 - Have built and led engineering teams and know how to establish effective technical processes. 
 - Think like product builders and entrepreneurs rather than technology service providers. 
 - Can work across multiple technology domains and make sound decisions in a fast-moving, resource-constrained environment. 
 - Are comfortable operating in an early-stage startup where priorities evolve and ownership extends beyond a narrowly defined job description. Experience in enterprise AI, AI infrastructure, SaaS, developer platforms, search and retrieval systems, or regulated technology environments would be particularly valuable. 

We value demonstrated product-building ability, technical judgement, and ownership over titles or credentials alone. 

What Makes This Opportunity Different?Build, don't just manage. Play a central role in shaping the architecture, products, and engineering culture of an AI company. 

Own the technology vision. Help define how Manthaan OS evolves into a scalable platform serving enterprise and government needs. 

Meaningful equity ownership. We are open to offering equity based on the candidate's experience, contribution, commitment, and role in building the company. 

Direct founder partnership. Work closely with the Founder & CEO on product strategy, technology decisions, and company building. 

Long-term upside. Help create products, intellectual property, and technology infrastructure with the ambition to solve meaningful problems at scale. 

Compensation & EquityAasvaa is an early-stage company, and we are looking for a co-founder who is excited about building long-term value. 

We can offer a modest initial salary, with the possibility of structuring the first six months around deferred compensation. The deferred amount and payment terms would be mutually agreed upon, with regular salary payments targeted to begin once the product reaches the appropriate stage of maturity, business cash flows improve, or funding is secured. 

Equity participation will be discussed individually and will depend on the candidate's profile, experience, commitment, and expected contribution to the company. 

We want to build a mutually aligned, transparent, and long-term partnership. 

Interested?If you've spent years building technology products and are now looking for an opportunity to build something meaningful with founder-level ownership, we'd love to hear from you. 

Send us your LinkedIn profile or CV along with a brief note about: 

- The most significant AI or technology product you have helped build. 
 - Your role in taking it from development to production and scale. 
 - What interests you about joining an early-stage AI company as a technology co-founder. Let's build the next generation of AI infrastructure together. 

📩 Apply via LinkedIn or reach out directly to the Founder
