data.title: Lead Engineer - Data & AI
data.description:
Job Description

A. P. Moller - Maersk is an integrated container logistics company and member of the A. P. Moller Group. Connecting and simplifying trade to help our customers grow and thrive. With a dedicated team of over 80, 000, operating in 130 countries; we go all the way to enable global trade for a growing world. We leverage cutting-edge technology to optimize operations, enhance customer experience, and drive business growth. We are seeking a Lead Engineer - Data & AI to join our team and play a pivotal role. 

About The Role

Maersk moves a significant share of the world's containerized trade and is a major player in the logistics and services space. The data is large, complex and consequential. This role offers real architectural ownership of a platform that matters, with the freedom to build it yourself, within a team that treats AI tooling as a serious part of engineering practice. 

This is a senior individual contributor role for an engineer who designs and builds the most critical parts of our systems. You will partner in setting the architecture for our data and AI platform, decide how the major pieces fit together, and then write and deploy the code that proves the design works. Design documents and diagrams are part of the job, but they are the beginning of the work rather than the output. The engineers who do well in this role are the ones whose designs are trusted because they have shipped the hard parts themselves. 

The scope spans the full stack of a data and AI platform: storage and table formats, pipelines, services, applications, and the agentic systems built on top. You will make the calls on open standards and interoperability, on build against buy, and on how we sequence a migration without disrupting what is already running. You will also set how this organization uses agentic coding, which at this level means building the tooling and the standards that other engineers work within. 

The role carries no direct reports. Influence comes from the quality of your designs, the code you ship, and the engineers who get better by working alongside you. 

Main Responsibilities: 

- Own the architecture for major platform components and data products, from storage layer through to the application and agent layer. 
 - Define target architectures and the migration paths to reach them, with attention to open standards, interoperability and long-term flexibility. 
 - Write and deploy production code. You will personally build the difficult components and the reference implementations others extend. 
 - Make build against buy decisions with clear reasoning on cost, operational load and dependency risk. 
 - Design the platform foundations that other teams rely on: data contracts, lineage, schema evolution, access control and cost management. 
 - Set the agentic engineering practice across the group, including internal tooling, MCP servers, reusable skills, evaluation harnesses and the standards for reviewing generated code. 
 - Take on the technical problems that are genuinely hard or genuinely ambiguous, and bring them to a working resolution. 
 - Raise the engineering bar through design review, code review and mentoring. 
 - Partner with Product, Business stakeholders and Engineering Managers on sequencing, trade-offs and technical risk. 

Core Skills: 

- Programming: Writing code to manipulate, analyze, and visualize data, often using languages like Python, R, and SQL. 
 - AI & Machine Learning: Creating systems that can perform tasks that typically require human intelligence. Using Machine learning (ML), a subset of AI that uses algorithms to learn from and make predictions based on data
 - Data Analysis: Inspecting, cleansing, transforming, and modeling data to discover useful information, draw conclusions, and support decision-making
 - Machine Learning Pipelines: Using automated workflows that manage the end-to-end process of training and deploying machine learning models. 
 - Model Deployment: Making a trained machine learning model available for use in production environments. 

Required skills: 

Architecture and system design

- Has designed and delivered systems that multiple teams build on, and has lived with the consequences of those decisions. 
 - Strong command of distributed systems fundamentals, including partitioning, consistency models, delivery guarantees, backpressure and schema evolution. 
 - Designs for the non-functional requirements from the start: reliability, recovery, latency, cost, security and operability. 
 - Has migrated live systems to a new architecture while keeping them running. 
 - Writes design documents that another engineer can build from without further explanation. 

Data engineering

- Platform-level design of table formats and catalogs, covering Iceberg, Delta Lake or Hudi, along with partitioning, clustering, compaction and file layout strategy. 
 - Both batch and streaming architectures, including change data capture and event-driven ingestion. 
 - Transformation frameworks at scale, such as dbt, together with semantic layer design. 
 - Data modelling depth sufficient to set standards that other teams follow. 
 - Performance and cost tuning at platform level, including query engines, storage layout and compute sizing. 
 - Multi-tenant governance, data quality frameworks and lineage. 

Software engineering

- Deep expertise in at least one language and working fluency in others. 
 - Service and API design, including versioning, backwards compatibility and contract management across teams. 
 - Observability as a design concern: instrumentation, tracing, structured logging and meaningful alerting. 
 - Infrastructure as code using Terraform, Bicep or equivalent, and container orchestration with Kubernetes. 
 - Security practice covering authentication, authorisation, secrets management and data protection. 
 - Front-end capability sufficient to build a usable interface when a product needs one. 

AI and agentic engineering

- Expert-level use of agentic coding tools. You work through agents for a large share of your output and can explain your harness, your context strategy, how you run work in parallel and how you keep quality high. 
 - Has built tooling that extends what agents can do, such as MCP servers, custom skills, spec-driven workflows or evaluation harnesses. 
 - Has taken large language model systems to production, covering retrieval design, structured output, tool calling, evaluation, guardrails, cost and latency management, and human review where it belongs. 
 - Clear judgement on where a model belongs in a system and where deterministic code is the better answer. 
 - Sets the standard for how generated code is reviewed and how agentic work is verified. 

Open source

- Meaningful exposure to open source, whether through contributions to established projects, maintaining a project with real users, or substantial public work of your own. 
 - Familiarity with the open standards in this space and a considered view on interoperability. 
 - Public artefacts such as repositories, technical writing or conference talks are a strong signal. 

We would be interested to understand from you genuine depth in a minimum two or three of above areas and strong working command across the rest. 

What makes you a strong candidate?

Demonstrated work carries the most weight in this role. The strongest candidates can point to systems they designed and built that are running in production, and can explain the decisions behind them, including the ones they would make differently now. 

Additional indicators of a strong fit: 

- A track record as a Staff, Principal or Lead engineer who remained hands-on, or as an architect who still writes and deploys code. 
 - Experience being the technical anchor on a platform or product that other teams depended on. 
 - A public body of work: an active GitHub profile with substantial projects, open source contributions, technical writing or talks. 
 - Has introduced a significant technical change into an organisation and carried it through to adoption. 
 - Comfort moving between architectural thinking and detailed implementation within the same week. 

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done. 

There's another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works. 

Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost-to-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise-grade yet easy-to-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75, 000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations. 

Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us. 

Job Description

At Freshworks, uptime is sacred. As a Lead Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you'll be the engineer behind the curtain-designing for resilience, automating recovery, and ensuring our systems stay fast, stable, and observable at scale. You'll partner closely with engineering, platform, and product teams to shift reliability left and set the standard for performance and availability. 

If you live for clean telemetry, root cause resolution, and engineering chaos into confidence, this is your playground. 

Responsibilities

- Design and implement tools to improve availability, latency, scalability, and system health. 
 - Define SLIs/SLOs, manage error budgets, and drive performance engineering efforts. 
 - Build and maintain automated monitoring, alerting, and remediation pipelines. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams to improve reliability by design. 
 - Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and blameless postmortems. 
 - Champion observability across services-logs, metrics, traces. 
 - Contribute to infrastructure architecture, automation, and reliability roadmaps. 
 - Advocate for SRE best practices across teams and functions. 

Qualifications

Requirements

- 7-12 years of experience in SRE, DevOps, or Production Engineering roles. 
 - Coding Proficiency: Develop clear, efficient, and well-structured code. 
 - Linux Expertise: In-depth knowledge of Linux for system administration and advanced troubleshooting. 
 - Containerization & Orchestration: Practical experience with Docker and Kubernetes for application deployment and management. 
 - CI/CD Management: Design, implement, and maintain Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery pipelines. 
 - Security & Compliance: Understand security best practices and compliance in infrastructure. 
 - High Availability & Scalability: Design and implement highly available, scalable, and resilient distributed systems. 
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Automation: Proficient in IaC tools and automating infrastructure provisioning and management. 
 - Disaster Recovery (DR) & High Availability (HA): Deep knowledge and practical experience with various DR and HA strategies. 
 - Observability: Implement and utilize monitoring, logging, and tracing tools for system health. 
 - System Design (Distributed Systems): Design complex distributed systems with a focus on reliability and operations. 
 - Problem-Solving & Troubleshooting: Excellent analytical and diagnostic skills for resolving complex system issues. Qualifications : 

- Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 
 - Experience building and scaling services in production with high uptime targets (99. 99%+). 
 - Clear track record of reducing incident frequency and improving response metrics (MTTD/MTTR). 
 - Strong communicator who thrives in high-pressure environments. 
 - Passionate about automation, chaos engineering, and making things just work. 

Additional Information

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.

Fractal is a leading AI and analytics company that helps global enterprises turn data into decisions at scale. You will work closely with architects, TPMs, product managers, QA engineers, DevOps engineers, designers, and peer developers to translate solution intent into scalable, maintainable, and production-ready systems.

What Success Looks Like In This Role

data.title: Full Stack Engineer
data.description:
ROLE PURPOSE

RightWalk's tech platform serves citizens at national scale - helping ITI apprentices, students, and applicants access government entitlements and services via WhatsApp and the web. The platform handles thousands of concurrent users across multiple domains (apprenticeships, education, municipal services) and runs on Go backends, Python MCP servers, PostgreSQL databases, AI-powered agents, and modern web front ends. 

As a Full Stack Engineer, you will design, build, and ship features end to end - from responsive user interfaces and admin dashboards to APIs, data models, and cloud deployment. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, you will work closely with the Solution Architect, the Technical Product Manager, and AI specialists to turn product requirements into reliable, secure, and well-documented software. 

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You are expected to write production-quality code across the stack, understand the trade-offs behind technical decisions, and leave every part of the codebase better documented than you found it. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Front-End Development

- Build responsive, accessible web applications and internal dashboards using React / Next. js and TypeScript. 
 - Translate Figma designs and product requirements into clean, reusable UI components with consistent state management. 
 - Integrate front ends with REST/GraphQL APIs, handling authentication, error states, and loading performance. 
 - Optimise page performance, cross-browser compatibility, and mobile responsiveness for users on low-bandwidth networks. 
 - Write unit and end-to-end tests (Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright/Cypress) for critical user flows. 2. Back-End & API Development

- Design and build RESTful/GraphQL APIs and microservices in Go and Python (FastAPI/FastMCP), with Node. js where appropriate. 
 - Model data and write efficient queries in PostgreSQL - schema design, indexing, migrations, and query tuning. 
 - Integrate third-party services: WhatsApp Business API, government portals, payment gateways, and LLM inference providers. 
 - Implement authentication and authorisation (OAuth 2. 0, JWT, role-based access control) and secure API practices. 
 - Build background jobs, caching (Redis), and message-queue consumers to keep the platform fast under load. 3. DevOps, Cloud & Code Quality

- Containerise services with Docker and deploy to AWS (EC2, ECS/Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudFront). 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar), automated testing, and database migration frameworks. 
 - Instrument services with logging, metrics, and alerting; take part in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-mortems. 
 - Participate in code reviews, uphold coding standards, and maintain test coverage for every feature you ship. 4. Security, Compliance & Documentation

- Follow secure coding practices (OWASP Top 10) and help close vulnerabilities identified in security audits and VAPT. 
 - Implement DPDP Act 2023 requirements in product features: consent flows, data minimisation, retention policies, and audit trails. 
 - Document APIs, system flows, data models, and deployment steps in version control so any engineer can pick up your work. 
 - Contribute to onboarding material and knowledge sharing so the platform does not depend on tribal knowledge. 5. AI-Enabled Product Features

- Build user-facing features on top of LLM-based agents, including chat interfaces, RAG workflows, and MCP tool integrations. 
 - Work with AI specialists on prompt engineering, response evaluation, and model-agnostic integration patterns. 
 - Collaborate with the Technical Product Manager on scope, user feedback, and technical feasibility trade-offs. 
 - Stay current on web, cloud, and AI tooling and recommend improvements to the team. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - YEAR 1

- Ship multiple end-to-end features to production - front end, API, data layer, and deployment - with minimal hand-holding. 
 - Own at least one product module (e. g. user dashboard, admin console, or a citizen-facing web flow) as its primary engineer. 
 - Improve front-end performance and reliability measurably: faster load times, fewer production defects, and better test coverage. 
 - Every feature you build is documented, tested, and covered by CI/CD - new engineers can understand and extend it without your help. 
 - Contribute to security hardening and DPDP compliance work, with no critical vulnerabilities open in code you own. CANDIDATE PROFILE

- Experience: 3-6 years building and shipping full-stack web applications in production. 
 - Front-end: Strong in JavaScript/TypeScript, React (Next. js a plus), HTML5, CSS3, and modern styling (Tailwind CSS or similar). Solid grasp of state management (Redux, Zustand, or React Query), responsive design, and web accessibility (WCAG). 
 - Back-end: Proficient in at least one of Go, Python (FastAPI/Django), or Node. js (Express/NestJS). Experience designing RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs and microservices. 
 - Databases: PostgreSQL (schema design, indexing, query optimisation, migrations); familiarity with Redis and NoSQL stores such as MongoDB or DynamoDB. Exposure to pgvector is a plus. 
 - Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on with AWS, Docker, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar), Git workflows, and Linux fundamentals. 
 - Testing & quality: Writes unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; comfortable with code reviews and clean-code principles. 
 - Security: Working knowledge of OWASP Top 10, OAuth 2. 0/JWT authentication, role-based access control, and secure handling of personal data. 
 - AI/LLM literacy: Has integrated, or is keen to integrate, LLM APIs (OpenAI, Bedrock, open-source models) into products; understands RAG and prompt-engineering basics. 
 - Collaboration & communication: Explains technical choices clearly to peers, product managers, and non-technical stakeholders; documents decisions and makes them discoverable. 
 - Ownership mindset: Takes features from idea to production and owns their quality after release. NICE-TO-HAVES

- Government, civic-tech, or social-impact product experience (compliance, data residency, auditability). 
 - WhatsApp Business API or other chat-platform integrations. 
 - Mobile or PWA development (React Native, Flutter, or Progressive Web Apps). 
 - Kubernetes, Terraform, or other infrastructure-as-code tools. 
 - Observability tools: Datadog, CloudWatch, SigNoz, Prometheus, Grafana. 
 - Message queues and event streaming: Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS/SNS. 
 - Multilingual / Indic-language UI and localisation experience. OUR iMHERO VALUES - WHAT WE LOOK FOR

At RightWalk, thriving means living our six iMHERO values every day - as behaviours you can observe, not adjectives you can claim. 

- Integrity - Do right, always. Report accurately even when results are bad, flag problems early, and never hide data issues or inflate impact. 
 - Mission - Rights-holders are why we exist. Every decision traces back to the people the policy was meant for. 
 - Holism - See the whole, work every part. Zoom out to think, zoom in to deliver; connect field reality to policy insight. 
 - Excellence - High bar, every time. Work counts only when it is delivered, communicated and documented. 
 - Resolve - Unafraid, unbreakable. Stay steady under pressure and persist through bureaucracy at every level, from government to the last mile. 
 - Ownership - Your name on it, no excuses. Anticipate problems early; every task has an owner, a deadline and an output. WORK CONDITIONS

- Location: Primarily on-site in New Delhi. 
 - Full-time, permanent role. WHAT WE OFFER / COMPENSATION

We offer a competitive salary package at par with the development sector, and the opportunity to build technology that serves citizens at national scale. 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

RightWalk is an equal opportunity employer with social inclusion as a core value. We do not discriminate on the basis of caste, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disability, region, language, age, marital or parental status, or socio-economic background, and we actively encourage diversity in the workplace.

data.title: Senior Manager
data.description:
About the Role

Kutch Copper Limited is looking for an experienced Senior Manager - WSMD Lab to lead laboratory operations supporting one of India's largest copper smelting complexes. The role will be responsible for managing weighing, sampling, moisture determination, analytical quality control, laboratory compliance, equipment reliability, and digital laboratory systems. 

The position plays a critical role in ensuring accurate and timely analytical support for smelter operations, enabling data-driven process control, production optimization, and quality assurance while maintaining the highest standards of safety, compliance, and operational excellence. 

Key Responsibilities

Laboratory Operations Management

- Lead daily and shift-wise WSMD laboratory operations to support smelter production requirements. 
 - Ensure timely receipt, preparation, testing, and reporting of samples from smelting, converting, refining, slag, dust, by-products, and other process streams. 
 - Coordinate with operations, process, and quality teams to prioritize critical samples and provide timely analytical feedback. 
 - Ensure compliance with sample collection, preparation, preservation, testing, and reporting protocols. 

Quality Assurance & Analytical Excellence

- Drive laboratory quality systems and ensure adherence to approved SOPs and testing methodologies. 
 - Oversee analytical quality control, calibration verification, standardization, and result validation activities. 
 - Review analytical data, identify deviations, and implement corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Ensure accuracy, reliability, and traceability of laboratory results. 

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

- Identify opportunities to improve testing turnaround time, workflow efficiency, and analytical performance. 
 - Support laboratory automation, process improvement, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Drive best practices in sample management, testing methodologies, and laboratory operations. 
 - Analyze operational bottlenecks and lead improvement actions. 

Equipment Reliability & Maintenance

- Ensure readiness and reliability of laboratory instruments and equipment. 
 - Coordinate calibration, preventive maintenance, breakdown resolution, and AMC activities. 
 - Maintain equipment history, calibration records, maintenance schedules, and audit documentation. 
 - Work closely with OEMs, maintenance teams, and service providers to ensure uninterrupted operations. 

Health, Safety & Compliance

- Ensure strict compliance with HSE requirements, laboratory safety standards, and chemical handling procedures. 
 - Promote safe work practices, PPE compliance, and effective waste management. 
 - Participate in audits, risk assessments, safety inspections, and compliance reviews. 
 - Drive closure of safety observations and regulatory requirements. 

Team Leadership & Capability Development

- Lead and mentor laboratory chemists, technicians, samplers, and shift personnel. 
 - Allocate resources effectively to meet testing requirements and turnaround commitments. 
 - Support competency development, multi-skilling, and succession planning initiatives. 
 - Build a high-performance culture focused on safety, quality, and continuous improvement. 

Inventory, Budget & Cost Control

- Monitor consumption of reagents, chemicals, gases, standards, consumables, and laboratory supplies. 
 - Support inventory management, procurement planning, and vendor coordination. 
 - Drive cost optimization initiatives while maintaining testing quality and operational reliability. 
 - Ensure availability of critical laboratory materials and spares. 

Data Analytics & Reporting

- Prepare laboratory MIS, quality summaries, analytical reports, audit data, and performance dashboards. 
 - Monitor KPIs such as turnaround time, equipment uptime, repeat analysis, and testing accuracy. 
 - Analyze trends and provide actionable insights to support operational decisions. 
 - Maintain complete documentation for audits and regulatory compliance. 

Digitalization & Automation

- Drive effective utilization of LIMS, SAP Lab, and other laboratory information systems. 
 - Support implementation of digital tools, dashboards, and automated reporting solutions. 
 - Ensure data integrity, traceability, and compliance with laboratory digital systems. 
 - Promote data-driven decision-making and operational transparency. 

Desired Candidate Profile

- 15+ years of experience in laboratory operations, analytical quality control, or process laboratories. 
 - Strong experience within Copper Smelting, Metals & Mining, Non-Ferrous Metals, Chemical Processing, or Large Process Industries. 
 - Proven expertise in sample preparation, analytical testing, quality assurance, laboratory management, and process support functions. 
 - Strong knowledge of laboratory quality systems, calibration practices, and compliance requirements. 
 - Experience managing teams, laboratory operations, and cross-functional stakeholder interactions. 
 - Exposure to LIMS, SAP Lab, digital reporting systems, and laboratory automation initiatives. 

Preferred Qualifications & Certifications

- Master's Degree in Chemistry / Analytical Chemistry preferred. 
 - Certification in Quality Management or Quality Assurance. 
 - Certifications in Laboratory Management, ISO Systems, or Environmental Compliance will be an added advantage.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer, Frontier Security Team
data.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don't just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. 

We are hiring a Staff Software Engineer for our Frontier Security AI team. Snowflake's Frontier Security AI teams develop production-grade LLM applications, intelligent agents, AI infrastructure, and evaluation systems for enterprise customers - products that must meet a high bar for quality, security, reliability, and efficiency while operating over sensitive data at large scale. In this role, you will lead the design and development of our Agentic Harness and agent evaluation platform, working across product, infrastructure, applied AI, security, and modeling teams to take new capabilities from prototype to dependable customer value. 

AS A STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL: 

- Architect and build the Agentic Harness that executes complex, multi-step AI workflows across models, tools, data, and services. 
 - Design stable interfaces for tool execution, context construction, state management, memory, permissions, retries, fallbacks, and human review. 
 - Own agent quality end to end by building evaluation harnesses, representative datasets, automated graders, experiment pipelines, and release gates. 
 - Convert ambiguous reports such as "the agent feels worse" into measurable failure modes, reproducible tests, and durable fixes. 
 - Analyze production agent trajectories to identify failures in reasoning, retrieval, tool use, context, orchestration, and application code. 
 - Close the loop between production incidents, root-cause analysis, evaluation coverage, and regression prevention. 
 - Develop offline and online measurements for task completion, correctness, groundedness, safety, latency, reliability, and cost. 
 - Build simulation and replay infrastructure for golden-set tests, adversarial scenarios, model comparisons, and large-scale experiments. 
 - Improve agent efficiency through model routing, prompt and semantic caching, context compaction, tool-result management, and token optimization. 
 - Productionize new model capabilities as secure, observable, multi-tenant services with clear operational controls. 
 - Establish standards for evaluation design, including sampling, ground-truth quality, grader calibration, leakage prevention, and statistical significance. 
 - Define technical direction across multiple teams and lead projects whose scope extends beyond a single service. 
 - Mentor engineers, raise the quality of architecture reviews, and remain directly involved in implementation and debugging. 

OUR IDEAL STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE: 

- 9+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership of complex production systems. 
 - Direct experience shipping and operating LLM applications, AI agents, or model-backed workflows in production. 
 - Strong background in distributed systems, service architecture, high-throughput APIs, concurrency, and failure handling. 
 - Experience building an agent runtime, workflow engine, developer platform, evaluation system, or similar infrastructure. 
 - Demonstrated ability to evaluate nondeterministic systems without relying on a single aggregate score. 
 - Fluency in Python and strong proficiency in at least one systems or application language such as Java, Go, Rust, or TypeScript. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of tool calling, structured generation, retrieval, context engineering, prompt management, and model APIs. 
 - Experience with production observability, including structured traces, replay, metrics, logs, and incident diagnosis. 
 - Ability to balance agent quality with latency, reliability, security, and inference cost. 
 - Track record of setting technical direction and delivering results across organizational boundaries. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication with engineering, product, and leadership audiences. 

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING: 

- Building evaluation or observability infrastructure for agentic coding, data engineering, or analytics systems. 
 - Designing human-evaluation programs, scoring rubrics, annotation workflows, or grader-calibration methods. 
 - Working with multi-agent orchestration, long-running agents, asynchronous workflows, or durable execution. 
 - Developing synthetic tasks, simulations, adversarial tests, red-team exercises, or safety guardrails. 
 - Building retrieval systems that use vector search, hybrid search, semantic indexing, ranking, or caching. 
 - Operating multi-tenant systems that process sensitive enterprise data. 
 - Working with model training, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, or feedback-driven optimization. 
 - Evaluating and onboarding frontier models based on measured product outcomes. 
 - Experience with databases, SQL engines, data platforms, Kubernetes, or cloud-native infrastructure. 

YOU MAY BE A PARTICULARLY GOOD FIT IF YOU: 

- Treat evaluation as part of product engineering rather than a final validation step. 
 - Can move between agent behavior, distributed infrastructure, data analysis, and production debugging. 
 - Question metrics that do not reconcile and design tests that can expose misleading results. 
 - Take ownership from early architecture through deployment, operations, and measurable customer outcomes. 
 - Prefer evidence from representative tasks and production behavior over isolated benchmark results. 
 - Work effectively in fast-moving environments where requirements develop through experimentation. 

Snowflake is growing fast, and we're scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. 

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers. snowflake. com

data.title: Senior Cloud Platform Engineer
data.description:
The Senior Cloud Platform Engineer designs, builds, and operates automated, secure, and scalable cloud platforms across AWS and Azure for enterprise clients. This is a hands-on engineering role - owning landing zone architecture, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, container platforms, and observability - with the technical depth to troubleshoot production issues and the maturity to mentor junior engineers and influence platform standards across client engagements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Platform & Landing Zone Engineering
 - Design and build secure, multi-account/multi-subscription landing zones on AWS (Control Tower, Organizations) and Azure (Landing Zones, Management Groups). 
 - Implement network architecture - VPCs/VNets, transit gateways, hybrid connectivity, DNS, and security group / NSG design. 
 - Define and enforce account/subscription governance guardrails, tagging standards, and cost controls. 
 - Infrastructure as Code & Automation
 - Author and maintain infrastructure using Terraform (primary) and/or CloudFormation / ARM / Bicep, structured as reusable modules. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or Jenkins) for both infrastructure and application deployments. 
 - Drive GitOps practices for environment provisioning and change management. 
 - Containers & Orchestration
 - Deploy, operate, and troubleshoot Kubernetes clusters (EKS, AKS) including networking (CNI), ingress, autoscaling, and RBAC. 
 - Support containerization of legacy and modernized workloads in partnership with application and modernization teams. 
 - Implement service mesh, secrets management, and workload identity patterns where applicable. 
 - Observability & Reliability
 - Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting using CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Prometheus/Grafana, or equivalent. 
 - Define and track SLIs/SLOs for platform services; participate in on-call rotation and incident response. 
 - Conduct root-cause analysis for production issues and drive permanent fixes, not just workarounds. 
 - Security & Compliance
 - Implement identity and access management (IAM roles/policies, Azure AD/Entra ID RBAC), least-privilege access, and secrets management (Secrets Manager, Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault). 
 - Embed security controls into pipelines (SAST/DAST, image scanning, policy-as-code with tools such as OPA/Sentinel). 
 - Support compliance requirements relevant to client engagements, including DPDP Act 2023, ISO 27001, and client-specific regulatory frameworks under Minfy's Kavach360 programme. 
 - Cost & Operational Efficiency
 - Monitor and optimize cloud spend using native cost tools (Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management) and rightsizing recommendations. 
 - Identify automation opportunities to reduce manual operational toil across managed environments. 
 - Client & Cross-Functional Engagement
 - Work directly with client engineering and infrastructure teams as a trusted technical resource on managed services and migration engagements. 
 - Partner with the MiMo and Cloud Advisory teams to implement platforms that support migration and modernization roadmaps. 
 - Produce clear runbooks, architecture diagrams, and platform documentation. 
 - Mentorship & Technical Contribution
 - Mentor junior and mid-level platform engineers; review their IaC and pipeline contributions. 
 - Contribute reusable modules, scripts, and accelerators to Minfy's internal platform engineering toolkit. 
 - Participate in architecture reviews and champion platform engineering best practices across the BU. 

Required Qualifications

- Experience
 - 5-8 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering roles. 
 - Demonstrated hands-on experience operating production workloads on both AWS and Azure (multi-cloud experience required). 
 - Core Technical Skills
 - Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform for multi-cloud Infrastructure as Code. 
 - Production experience with Kubernetes (EKS and/or AKS) - deployment, troubleshooting, and day-2 operations. 
 - Strong CI/CD skills - designing and building end-to-end pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or Jenkins) with automated testing, security gates, and deployment strategies (blue-green, canary, rolling). 
 - Strong containerisation skills - Docker image build and optimization, multi-stage builds, container registries (ECR, ACR), and container security scanning. 
 - Scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or Go for automation and tooling. 
 - Solid networking fundamentals - VPC/VNet design, routing, DNS, load balancing, and hybrid connectivity. 
 - Security & Governance
 - Working knowledge of IAM/RBAC design, secrets management, and policy-as-code. 
 - Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks relevant to enterprise cloud environments (Well-Architected Framework, ISO 27001, DPDP Act 2023 or equivalent). 
 - Collaboration & Communication
 - Comfortable working directly with client technical stakeholders and cross-functional Minfy teams (advisory, MiMo, security). 
 - Able to produce clear technical documentation and communicate incident/root-cause findings effectively. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator / DevOps Engineer Expert, or CKA/CKAD. 
 - Experience with GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux). 
 - Exposure to service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd). 
 - Prior experience in a partner/SI or managed services environment (AWS Premier/Advanced Partner or Microsoft Solutions Partner). 
 - Familiarity with FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization. 

KEY COMPETENCIES

- Ownership - treats production platforms as their own; drives issues to permanent resolution. 
 - Automation-first mindset - defaults to codifying repeatable work rather than manual intervention. 
 - Technical depth with pragmatism - balances best practice with delivery timelines and client constraints. 
 - Collaboration - works effectively across client teams, internal BUs, and junior engineers. 
 - Continuous learning - stays current across a fast-moving, multi-cloud technology landscape.

Job description: 

Head of Quality & Product Industrialisation, India & Vietnam - Safety Fabrics

Location: Madurai, India

  

Role purpose:   

The Head of Quality & Product Industrialization - Safety Fabrics is responsible for leading the global quality strategy, product industrialization, certification and technical governance for Coats' Safety Fabrics business. 
This role ensures that new and existing products are robustly industrialized, consistently manufactured and fully compliant with global safety standards. Working closely with Innovation, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Commercial teams, the role provides technical leadership across Coats' Safety Fabrics manufacturing operations in India and Vietnam, including third-party manufacturing partners, to drive product quality, manufacturing excellence, certification readiness and continuous improvement in support of sustainable global business growth.   
An ideal candidate for the role needs to technically strong and execution-oriented leader with proven experience in safety fabrics or technical textiles, responsible for product development, quality, certification and industrialisation within a manufacturing environment. Brings deep understanding of global safety standards, product testing, regulatory compliance and manufacturing processes, with the ability to successfully transition new products from development into stable, scalable production. Experienced in working across cross-functional teams, including manufacturing, quality, supply chain, procurement and commercial, to deliver consistent product performance, customer satisfaction and continuous improvement. Demonstrates strong problem-solving capability, technical credibility and hands-on leadership, with experience supporting manufacturing operations across multiple sites and third-party manufacturing partners. 

What you will do (Key Responsibilities):   

Quality Leadership

- Define and deploy the global quality strategy for Safety Fabrics. 
 - Establish common quality systems, standards and governance across all manufacturing locations. 
 - Drive zero-defect culture and Right First-Time performance. Product Industrialization

- Lead industrialization of new products from development through commercial production. 
 - Ensure manufacturing readiness before product launch. 
 - Standardize manufacturing processes globally. Certification, Compliance & Regulatory Readiness

- Define and maintain the global certification and compliance strategy for the Safety Fabrics portfolio. 
 - Ensure products meet applicable international and customer-specific standards, including EN, ISO, ASTM and NFPA. 
 - Lead product qualification, testing and certification activities with internal laboratories and external certification bodies. 
 - Establish and lead the Safety Fabrics Technical Laboratory at Perundurai, developing world-class testing, certification and product validation capabilities to support innovation, industrialization and customer qualification. 
 - Manage certification planning, technical documentation and ongoing compliance for new and existing products. 
 - Monitor changes in regulatory standards and ensure timely implementation across products and manufacturing operations. 
 - Partner with Manufacturing, Quality and Supply Chain teams to ensure certified products are consistently produced across Coats manufacturing operations in India and Vietnam, including third-party manufacturing partners. 
 - Support customer technical approvals, audits and product validation while driving continuous improvement in testing, certification and quality systems. Manufacturing Excellence & Continuous Improvement

- Drive manufacturing excellence across Coats' Safety Fabrics operations by improving process capability, product consistency and operational efficiency. 
 - Lead industrialisation and standardisation of manufacturing processes to ensure robust, scalable and repeatable production. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives through root cause analysis, CAPA, Lean and Six Sigma methodologies to reduce defects, improve yield and optimise cost. 
 - Establish and monitor key quality and manufacturing KPIs, including Right First Time (RFT), First Pass Yield (FPY), Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ), customer complaints and process capability. 
 - Partner with Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Quality teams to implement best practices and ensure consistent execution across manufacturing sites in India and Vietnam, including third-party manufacturing partners. Product & Supplier Quality

- Establish and maintain robust product and supplier quality systems to ensure consistent product performance and compliance with customer and regulatory requirements. 
 - Lead supplier qualification, raw material approval, supplier audits and ongoing performance monitoring. 
 - Drive root cause analysis, CAPA and continuous improvement to reduce customer complaints, improve product reliability and minimise the Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ). 
 - Partner with Manufacturing, Procurement and Supply Chain to ensure quality standards are consistently achieved across Coats' manufacturing operations and third-party manufacturing partners. People Management

- Build and develop the Quality & Product Industrialization team in line with business needs and future growth. 
 - Lead and influence cross-functional teams across Manufacturing, Quality and Supply Chain. 
 - Manage indirect reporting relationships across Coats' manufacturing operations in India and Vietnam, including third-party manufacturing partners. 
 - Foster a culture of quality, accountability and continuous improvement. Financial Impact

- Support business profitability through improved product quality, manufacturing efficiency, reduced cost of poor quality and successful industrialisation of new products. 
Who you are (Requirements):   

- Degree in Textile Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Science or related discipline. 
 - 10+ years' experience in safety fabrics, technical textiles or engineered materials. 
 - Proven experience in product industrialisation, quality management and manufacturing processes. 
 - Strong working knowledge of EN, ISO, ASTM, NFPA and other relevant safety standards and certification processes. 
 - Experience working with manufacturing operations, preferably across multiple sites and external manufacturing partners. 
 - Demonstrated experience in root cause analysis, CAPA, process improvement and continuous improvement methodologies. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership skills.   

What will set you apart (Nice to Have): 

- Master's degree in Textile Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Science or a related discipline. 
 - Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, Lean Manufacturing or Quality Management certification. 
 - Experience with textile coating, dyeing, finishing or advanced fabric manufacturing processes. 
 - Experience working with international certification bodies (e. g. AITEX, UL, SEI) and global PPE standards. 
 - Experience supporting global customers, product qualification and customer technical audits.

data.title: Principal Engineer
data.description:
The Principal Engineer is the most senior individual contributor in the System Platform Team. This is not an architect-in-an-ivory-tower role - it is a hands-on technical leadership position where roughly 60% of time is spent writing production code and 40% on cross-cutting technical responsibilities: architecture, technology evaluation, design reviews, and mentoring. The expectation is that when the team runs into its hardest technical problem, the Principal is the one who unblocks it - not by delegating, but by pairing or by writing the solution. 

Over the course of the year, the Principal intentionally rotates across different engineering domains - developer experience, release engineering, data and messaging, incident and compliance tooling. This breadth is deliberate: by the end of the year, the Principal has deep firsthand knowledge of the full platform codebase, which is what makes their architecture reviews, technology decisions, and mentorship credible across all areas. 

The Stack You Will Work On

- A Java/Spring Boot microservices platform (GreyMatter) running on GKE, backed by Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis, and MinIO/S3
 - An Erlang/OTP real-time robot-control system (Butler Core) running on GCP VMs, using Mnesia, EMQX (MQTT broker), and Cowboy HTTP
 - A hybrid CI/CD setup spanning GitHub (mono-repo for 19 platform services) and Bitbucket (legacy/firmware repositories), with Jenkins, Spinnaker, ArgoCD, Nexus, Terraform, and Ansible
 - Kafka-based event streaming with Avro schema contracts and Redis for payload management
 - An internal context-retrieval server that surfaces runbooks, tickets, deployment history, and architecture docs as LLM-queryable tools
 - An incident management platform (evaluating commercial tools vs. in-house) with a custom compliance evidence layer for SOC2/ISO audits
 - A home-grown Just-In-Time access portal covering GKE, GCP IAM, Kafka ACLs, SQL, Mnesia, and config management, integrated with Google Workspace SSO. 

Responsibilites

Architecture & Technical Direction

- Lead cross-team architecture reviews - help the team make large technical decisions, document trade-offs, and land on durable solutions
 - Own build-vs-buy decisions: evaluate commercial tools against in-house alternatives with documented analysis, and live with the consequences
 - Define and enforce engineering standards across the whole team: schema conventions, observability patterns, security postures, secrets hygiene, API design
 - Review system designs across every engineering area the team works in - not just the area you are currently contributing to
 - Partner with the Associate Director on technical hiring: contribute to interview design, loop calibration, and leveling decisions

Hands-On Engineering

- Rotate across different engineering domains throughout the year, contributing meaningfully to each - shipping production code, not just reviewing it
 - Write and maintain design documents and architecture decision records (ADRs) - these are required deliverables, not optional write-ups
 - Unblock engineers on hard problems by pairing directly, not by delegating to someone else
 - Build and own cross-cutting libraries, shared tooling, and foundational components that multiple services depend on
 - Mentorship & Culture
 - Technically mentor the Staff Engineers - paired design sessions, deep code review, escalation target for hard problems
 - Raise the bar in code review: model the level of feedback and depth of analysis that sets the team standard
 - Drive a blameless engineering culture - incidents and mistakes are learning opportunities, not blame events
 - Treat documentation as first-class engineering output: design docs and runbooks ship with features, not after them

Requirements

- 14+ years of software engineering with at least 5 years at Staff Engineer level or equivalent senior IC level
 - Has shipped at least one platform, developer-experience, or infrastructure product at scale that other engineering teams measurably adopted - not just delivered, but adopted and continued to use
 - Production experience across at least four of: Kafka, Kubernetes, GitOps and ArgoCD, Grafana/InfluxDB observability stacks, OAuth2/OIDC identity systems, LLM orchestration or RAG systems
 - Demonstrated build-vs-buy judgment: has made significant make-or-buy decisions, documented the trade-offs, and lived with the outcome
 - Deep system design instincts - can hold a 10+ service distributed system in mind and identify coupling problems and failure modes before they become production incidents
 - Excellent written communication - drives technical influence through documents, not just verbal authority in meetings
 - Comfortable operating as the senior-most IC on a small team where pragmatism and real constraints shape decisions

Nice to Have

- Familiarity with Erlang/OTP, Mnesia, or BEAM VM tooling - for context on the Butler Core platformExperience with hybrid deployment environments spanning Kubernetes and traditional VMs in the same production system
 - Has led a technical governance body - architecture review board, RFC process, or equivalent cross-team decision-making forum
 - Background evaluating and procuring engineering tooling at a technical (not just commercial) level
 - Familiarity with VDA5050 or AGV/robotics communication protocols

Founded in 2004, NetBrain is the leader in no-code network automation. Its ground-breaking Next-Gen platform provides IT operations teams with the ability to scale their hybrid multi-cloud connected networks by automating the processes associated with Diagnostic Troubleshooting, Outage Prevention and Protected Change Management. Today, over 2, 500 of the world's largest enterprises and managed services providers leverage NetBrain's platform.

NetBrain is looking for a Network Development Engineer with a focus on Code Quality to join our Platform team. You will directly influence the reliability and maintainability of a platform that automates network operations for the world's largest enterprises. data.title: Field Quality Analyst
data.description:
Job Description

- Perform end-to-end Failure Analysis (FA) on physical hardware samples, including board-level debug and component diagnostics, and document findings in issue-tracking databases. 
 - Conduct on-site technical audits at repair centers and manufacturing partners, including inventory checks, root-cause data collection, and physical hardware verification to validate repair procedures. 
 - Prepare detailed technical reports based on failure-analysis investigations and data analysis, providing clear diagnostic evidence to support engineering decisions. 
 - Execute SQL queries to extract, clean, and analyze field performance metrics, repair data, and telemetry logs; identify and flag data anomalies for quality assessment. 
 - Monitor bug trackers and quality databases to follow investigation progress, identify technical bottlenecks, and escalate issues based on data trends. 
 - Prepare regular standardized field-quality reports using established templates and communicate key findings to relevant cross-functional stakeholders. 

Key Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent technical experience. 
 - 4 years of relevant experience in field quality, hardware failure analysis, repair engineering, manufacturing quality, or related technical areas. 
 - Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction, cleaning, and analysis. 
 - Familiarity with board-level diagnostic tools such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, and failure-analysis software. 
 - Practical experience applying 5-Why analysis, Fishbone diagrams, or similar root-cause identification methods in a hardware environment. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot hardware issues and derive data-backed insights with limited guidance. 
 - Ability to travel approximately 30-50% to service centers and manufacturing sites to conduct independent diagnostic and audit work. 
 - Good written and spoken English. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience in high-volume consumer electronics manufacturing, connected-device repair, service operations, or factory production environments. 
 - Hands-on exposure to repair-center audits, manufacturing-site audits, or field-quality investigations. 
 - Experience working with technical issue-tracking systems, quality databases, or standardized reporting tools. 
 - Professional fluency in spoken and written Hindi and English to support local vendor communication, site activities, and regional cross-functional collaboration.

data.title: QA Automation Engineer (Remote, Full-Time) [HR217]
data.description:
About Smart Working

  

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn't just another remote opportunity - it's about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you're welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being. 

  

Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you're empowered to grow personally and professionally. 

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world. 

  

About the Role

As a QA Automation Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of quality across a large, roughly 10-year, multi-repo digital health platform. You will build the automated test framework hands-on, define expected behaviour, and help improve reliability from an existing baseline where test coverage and pass rates need strengthening. 

You will work with an engineering team of 4, collaborating to understand how the system should work from client, end-user and internal operations perspectives. The role is predominantly hands-on and independent, with shared responsibility for product quality. 

The first phase will involve speaking with stakeholders, clarifying requirements, documenting expected behaviour, and building out automation that enables faster, safer releases. 

Responsibilities

- Own the quality process end to end and build the automated test framework hands-on

- Understand how a large, roughly 10-year, multi-repo system works and how it should work from client, end-user and internal operations perspectives

- Ask the right questions and document expected behaviour where inherited documentation is partly out of date

- Author English-readable scenarios in Cucumber and Gherkin

- Build automation in JavaScript and TypeScript

- Drive the UI through a page object model

- Add data-test-ids to React code where missing

- Validate correct database state using SQL

- Maintain the automated tests as new features arrive

- Feed into requirements upfront as new features are planned

- Flag compliance, regulatory and security implications

- Run exploratory testing to identify where the product behaves incorrectly

- Improve reliability and enable faster, safer releases through automation

- Reproduce multi-step defects precisely and identify edge cases

- Build a repeatable, documented QA process from an unreliable baseline

- Work out how the system should behave across multiple user perspectives and how it might break

Requirements

- 4+ years of experience in QA or test automation, hands-on with TypeScript or JavaScript

- 4+ years of hands-on test automation coding in TypeScript or JavaScript

- 2+ years of BDD test authoring with Cucumber and Gherkin

- 3+ years of web UI test automation using a page object model, preferably with Playwright

- 2+ years of end-to-end QA ownership, including defining, documenting, building and maintaining tests

- 3+ years of requirements analysis and stakeholder communication

- 2+ years of SQL querying to validate database state, using MySQL or PostgreSQL

- 3+ years of exploratory testing and precise multi-step defect reproduction

- Ability to drive automation and own the build with limited direction

- Strong detail orientation, including the ability to spot edge cases and gaps in specifications

- Hands-on JavaScript or TypeScript automation coding is non-negotiable; willingness to learn is not sufficient

Nice to Have

- Mobile app testing and automation experience, especially with Flutter apps

- Experience with Appium or Flutter integration_test

- Experience reading and working with React front-end code

- Experience with Angular, Vue or another modern JavaScript framework

- Security and regulatory awareness, including ISO 27001, GDPR or NHS DTAC

- Experience in another regulated or audited environment

- ISO 13485 medical-device regulated-environment testing

- Experience in an adjacent regulated domain such as medtech, fintech or NHS/DTAC

- Healthtech or digital health domain experience

- Comfort using AI in the engineering workflow

Benefits

- Fixed Shifts: 12: 00 PM - 9: 30 PM IST (Summer) | 1: 00 PM - 10: 30 PM IST (Winter)

- No Weekend Work: Real work-life balance, not just words

- Day 1 Benefits: Laptop and full medical insurance provided

- Support That Matters: Mentorship, community, and forums where ideas are shared

- True Belonging: A long-term career where your contributions are valued

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
data.description:
Who We Are

At Platform Science, we're working to connect everything that moves. Founded in 2015, we are an open IoT platform that partners with innovative fleets, application developers, vehicle manufacturers, and equipment providers in the transportation industry to deliver revolutionary solutions to supply chain professionals across the globe. 

Our employees are an engaging, diverse group of people who believe in the power of great ideas. We hire people with different experiences and perspectives to build a company culture that fuels growth through innovation. We value thoughtful actions and empathy for others. We approach challenges with resiliency and creativity, while encouraging transparency because, no matter our backgrounds or responsibilities, we are one team. 

About The Role

Platform Science is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our Core Product Development team in Chennai. In this role, you will be responsible for defining, developing, and executing robust manual and automated test suites across our web and mobile applications, ensuring our edge-to-cloud IoT solutions meet strict performance, stability, and quality standards. 

You will play an integral role across the complete software development lifecycle-designing automated UI and API tests, driving exploratory test sessions, and identifying system malfunctions early. Additionally, you will coordinate seamlessly across time zones, collaborating closely with our distributed teams and stakeholders in both India and the US. 

Essential Responsibilities (Measures Of Success)

- Full-Lifecycle Quality Assurance: Participate actively across all stages of product development, including new feature releases, platform upgrades, functional enhancements, performance testing, and defect resolution. 
 - Test Automation & Execution: Design, build, and maintain scalable automated UI and API test frameworks for web applications and mobile platforms (iOS and Android). 
 - Exploratory & Manual Testing: Execute rigorous exploratory tests on new features and bug fixes, blending manual validation with automated test suites. 
 - Defect Lifecycle Management: Identify, document, isolate, and track software defects in Jira with thorough root-cause investigations, logs, and clear reproduction steps. 
 - Cross-Timezone Collaboration: Proactively communicate project status, risks, and technical blockers; balance working hours between Indian and US time zones to attend client/sync calls and address critical production issues. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Research, evaluate, and adopt industry best practices in Quality Engineering, test automation, and Continuous Integration (CI). 

Target Capabilities & Skills

- Experience: 3 to 5 years of professional experience as a Software QA Engineer or SDET. 
 - Core Programming: Strong coding proficiency in Java; knowledge or experience with Kotlin or JavaScript is a significant advantage. 
 - Mobile Test Automation: Proven hands-on experience authoring automated test scripts for native and hybrid mobile applications (iOS and Android) using Appium, Selenium, or WebdriverIO. 
 - Compatibility Testing: Deep understanding of backward compatibility testing across varying operating system versions and device configurations. 
 - Test Design Methodologies: Strong applied knowledge of test design techniques, including Equivalence Partitioning, Boundary Value Analysis, Decision Tables, and Use Case testing. 
 - Agile QA Practices: Practical experience working with Behavior-Driven Development (BDD), Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and exploratory testing patterns. 

Other Requirements

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (equivalent practical QA engineering experience will be considered in place of a degree). 
 - Communication: Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills to interact productively with engineering teams, leadership, and global stakeholders. 
 - Analytical Mindset: Strong ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex architectural documents, technical specs, diagrams, and data models. 
 - Mindset & Ownership: Demonstrates intellectual humility (learning actively from mistakes), self-motivation, high ownership, and the ability to operate effectively with minimal supervision. 

Benefits

The company offers various benefits to regular, full-time employees including: 

- Provident fund and gratuity in accordance with applicable laws. 
 - Paid vacation, sick leave and holidays, in accordance with applicable laws. 
 - Twenty-Six weeks of paid maternity leave in accordance with applicable laws. 

(Note: The compensation details listed in India role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits. )

Legal & Privacy Disclaimers

Platform Science collects your personal information to support its business operations, including for human resources, employment, benefits administration, health and safety, and other business-related purposes as well as to be in legal compliance. You can review further details of such collection and use in our Privacy Policy (https: //www. platformscience. com/privacy-notice). 

Please note: This document is a description of a potential position with our company. Nothing within this document may be construed as an offer for employment or a promise of benefit or remuneration. Further, any representation made within this document is subject to the laws and restrictions of the jurisdiction where employment may be deemed to occur. The parameters and availability of this position are subject to change and based solely within the discretion of the company. In addition, the duties, responsibilities, and scope of this position may not be fully represented in this description or may change as required by the Company. 

Platform Science is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

data.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
Company Introduction

Availity is one of the leading health information networks in the United States, processing more than 4 billion transactions annually and connecting more than two million healthcare providers and over two thousand technology partners to health plans nationwide. Our teams of technology, business, and customer service professionals in Bangalore, India, are working together to transform healthcare delivery in the United States through innovation and collaboration. Our technologists help develop cutting-edge revenue cycle solutions that help hospitals, health systems, and physicians maximize payments and optimize their workflows. 

Availity is a diverse group of people whose talents, curiosity and passion steer the company to create innovative solutions for the US Healthcare industry. If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you. 

Job Description

Roles & Responsibilities

At Availity, we're not just another Healthcare Technology company; we're pioneers reshaping the future of healthcare! With our headquarters in vibrant Jacksonville, FL, and an exciting office in Bangalore, India, along with an exceptional remote workforce across the United States, we're a global team united by a powerful mission. 

We're on a mission to bring the focus back to what truly matters - patient care. As the leading healthcare engagement platform, we're the heartbeat of an industry that impacts millions. With over 2 million providers connected to health plans, and processing over 12 billion transactions annually, our influence is continually expanding. 

Join our energetic, dynamic, and forward-thinking team where your ideas are celebrated, innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts. We're transforming the healthcare landscape, solving communication challenges, and creating connections that empower the nation's premier healthcare ecosystem. 

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Quality Assurance Engineer to join our Bengaluru team and help continuously improve the quality of Availity's product portfolio. In this role, you will build and enhance test automation frameworks, create robust automated tests using Selenium, Cucumber BDD, and Java, and support functional, regression, integration, API, and microservices testing. You will collaborate closely with developers, product managers, product owners, and system analysts to improve test coverage, resolve defects, strengthen test stability, and deliver reliable, customer-focused releases. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build new test automation frameworks and enhance existing solutions using Selenium, Cucumber BDD, and Java. 
 - Develop and maintain Gherkin feature files, step definitions, and reliable automated test suites. 
 - Perform functional, regression, integration, API, and microservices testing to ensure comprehensive test coverage. 
 - Collaborate with developers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, troubleshoot automation failures, and deliver stable, high-quality releases. 

Required Qualifications

- 4+ years of experience in software testing, including at least 3 years in test automation. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber BDD, Java, and Gherkin. 
 - Experience with CI/CD environments, Git workflows, REST API testing, and microservices testing. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and leadership skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Docker and cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure. 
 - Experience developing or improving test automation frameworks from scratch. 
 - Familiarity with executing automation in distributed environments. 
 - Ability to contribute to test resilience, acceptance criteria, and continuous quality improvements. 

Why Join Availity India?

- Meaningful impact: Work on solutions that help simplify healthcare administration and support better provider and patient experiences. 
 - Global exposure: Partner with U. S. teams and leaders while contributing from India to global business priorities. 
 - Learning and growth: Be part of a culture that values continuous learning, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and career development. 
 - Flexible work experience: Work in a way that supports productivity, collaboration, and team needs across remote, hybrid, and office-based models. 
 - Holistic rewards: Benefit from competitive compensation, health and insurance benefits, paid time off, company holidays, leave benefits, Employee Assistance Program support, and learning programs. 
 - Inclusive workplace: Join a casual, collaborative, and inclusive environment where associates are encouraged to bring ideas forward. 
 - Office experience: For office-based associates, Availity India provides amenities such as coffee and tea, subsidized meals, recreation areas, and eligible night-shift transportation support. 

What To Expect From The Hiring Process

Our hiring process is designed to be transparent and engaging. Depending on the role, it may include application review, recruiter discussion, technical or functional assessment, hiring manager interviews, team or leadership conversations, offer discussion, background verification, and onboarding support. 

Equal Opportunity Statement

Availity is committed to building an inclusive workplace where all associates feel valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and encourage individuals who are excited by collaboration, innovation, and meaningful impact to apply. 

Eligibility

Video Camera Usage

Availity fosters a collaborative and open culture where communication and engagement are central to our success. As a remote first company, we are also camera-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role. 

Having cameras on helps create a more connected, interactive, and productive environment, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and build stronger working relationships. The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non-participants.

About Smart Working

  

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn't just another remote opportunity - it's about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you're welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being. 

  

Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you're empowered to grow personally and professionally. 

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world. 

  

About the Role

As a QA Automation Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of quality across a large, roughly 10-year, multi-repo digital health platform. You will build the automated test framework hands-on, define expected behaviour, and help improve reliability from an existing baseline where test coverage and pass rates need strengthening. 

You will work with an engineering team of 4, collaborating to understand how the system should work from client, end-user and internal operations perspectives. The role is predominantly hands-on and independent, with shared responsibility for product quality. 

The first phase will involve speaking with stakeholders, clarifying requirements, documenting expected behaviour, and building out automation that enables faster, safer releases. 

Responsibilities

- Own the quality process end to end and build the automated test framework hands-on

- Understand how a large, roughly 10-year, multi-repo system works and how it should work from client, end-user and internal operations perspectives

- Ask the right questions and document expected behaviour where inherited documentation is partly out of date

- Author English-readable scenarios in Cucumber and Gherkin

- Build automation in JavaScript and TypeScript

- Drive the UI through a page object model

- Add data-test-ids to React code where missing

- Validate correct database state using SQL

- Maintain the automated tests as new features arrive

- Feed into requirements upfront as new features are planned

- Flag compliance, regulatory and security implications

- Run exploratory testing to identify where the product behaves incorrectly

- Improve reliability and enable faster, safer releases through automation

- Reproduce multi-step defects precisely and identify edge cases

- Build a repeatable, documented QA process from an unreliable baseline

- Work out how the system should behave across multiple user perspectives and how it might break

Requirements

- 4+ years of experience in QA or test automation, hands-on with TypeScript or JavaScript

- 4+ years of hands-on test automation coding in TypeScript or JavaScript

- 2+ years of BDD test authoring with Cucumber and Gherkin

- 3+ years of web UI test automation using a page object model, preferably with Playwright

- 2+ years of end-to-end QA ownership, including defining, documenting, building and maintaining tests

- 3+ years of requirements analysis and stakeholder communication

- 2+ years of SQL querying to validate database state, using MySQL or PostgreSQL

- 3+ years of exploratory testing and precise multi-step defect reproduction

- Ability to drive automation and own the build with limited direction

- Strong detail orientation, including the ability to spot edge cases and gaps in specifications

- Hands-on JavaScript or TypeScript automation coding is non-negotiable; willingness to learn is not sufficient

Nice to Have

- Mobile app testing and automation experience, especially with Flutter apps

- Experience with Appium or Flutter integration_test

- Experience reading and working with React front-end code

- Experience with Angular, Vue or another modern JavaScript framework

- Security and regulatory awareness, including ISO 27001, GDPR or NHS DTAC

- Experience in another regulated or audited environment

- ISO 13485 medical-device regulated-environment testing

- Experience in an adjacent regulated domain such as medtech, fintech or NHS/DTAC

- Healthtech or digital health domain experience

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Instrumentation & Electronics Engineer to join our team. ·                Lead the design, development, and implementation of advanced control systems including DCS, PLC, and SCADA solutions. 

·                Review and analyze P&ID drawings, control schematics, and instrumentation layouts to ensure system integrity and compliance. 

·                Prepare and approve detailed control panel wiring diagrams, wiring schedules, terminal diagrams, and loop diagrams.

 - Self-motivated and capable of working independently and within a team.
