data.title: Director - Application Development
data.description:
About The Company

Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners. 

Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U. S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130, 000 reload points and over 100, 000 distributing locations. 

Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide. 

I. The Mission

You will lead a world-class engineering organization responsible for our core Fintech and Banking portfolios. You aren't just a leader; you are a technical visionary who ensures our systems are reliable and fast. You will bridge the gap between complex business requirements and elite engineering execution, pioneering an AI-first development culture (AIDLC) to set a new industry standard for productivity. 

As the Director of Application Development, you will function as a high-impact technical executive. This role is designed for a technologist who can manage large-scale portfolios, lead multi-disciplinary teams (Front-end & Back-end), and navigate the complexities of the Fintech and Banking sectors. 

You are expected to be a "technologist first"- a leader who can sit in an architectural review or a deep-dive debugging session and add immediate value, while simultaneously presenting digital transformation roadmaps for your portfolios. 

The Director of Application Development will serve as a pivotal leader within the Netspend Product & Technology organization, reporting directly to the Engineering Leader. This highly visible Senior leadership role requires an accomplished engineering leader with deep expertise in building and scaling consumer products. 

The Director of Application Development will shape the long-term technology vision, drive SaaS-first engineering excellence, and ensure our product's solutions remain the industry benchmark for innovation, reliability, and customer value. This leader will inspire high-performing global teams and foster strong cross-functional partnerships. 

II. The Core Mandate

- Strategic Technical Leadership & Stakeholder Management
 - The Bridge: Act as the primary interface between business units and engineering. You will translate high-level commercial objectives into executable technical strategies. 
 - Portfolio Oversight: Manage a comprehensive portfolio of applications, ensuring that cross-functional teams are aligned, unblocked, and delivering high-value features. 
 - Agile Transformation: Lead the evolution of the engineering org into a high-performing, fast-paced Agile environment, optimizing for both speed-to-market and system stability. 
 - Technical Depth & Innovation (AIDLC)
 - Hands-on Guidance: While not required to write daily production code, you must possess the technical depth of a former Solution Architect or Dev Lead. You will guide teams through complex technical hurdles and ensure code quality standards. 
 - AI-Augmented Engineering: A core focus will be the AIDLC (AI-driven Development Life Cycle). You will be expected to implement AI tools and frameworks to drastically enhance team productivity and developer experience. 
 - Cloud Strategy: Direct the architecture and migration initiatives within the AWS ecosystem, ensuring cost-efficiency, scalability, and security. 
 - Move Fast with Stability: Transition teams into high-performing, autonomous units that ship code daily without compromising the integrity of financial transactions. 
 - Metric-Driven Results: Define and track KPIs that correlate engineering output with actual business revenue and user engagement. 
 - Organizational Mentorship
 - Leader of Leaders: Provide direct mentorship and career development for Senior Managers and Associate Directors. 
 - Culture of Excellence: Foster an environment of continuous learning, psychological safety, and technical curiosity. 
 - Bottom-Up Leadership: Empower Senior Managers and Associate Directors to take extreme ownership. Foster a culture where the best ideas win, regardless of hierarchy. 

III. Educational & Foundation (Mandatory)

- Academic Excellence: B. Tech / B. E. from a reputed, top-tier institute or a Master of Computer Applications (MCA). 

IV. Experience & Skills

- Years of Experience: 12+ years in Software Development with a progressive track record of leadership. 
 - Domain Expertise: Deep experience in Fintech and Banking (High-volume transactions, security protocols, regulatory compliance). 
 - Full-Stack Vision: Proven experience leading both Front-end and Back-end initiatives simultaneously. 
 - Technical Stack: Strong foundational knowledge in modern microservices, distributed systems, and AWS Migration. 
 - Communication: Elite communication skills; able to influence senior business stakeholders and inspire junior engineers. 

High-Weightage Qualifications

- Demonstrated success in using AI to enhance team efficiency (e. g. , LLM-integrated workflows, automated code synthesis, or AI-driven testing). 
 - Experience transitioning legacy banking systems into modern, cloud-native architectures. 
 - A "Consultative Mindset": The ability to analyze problems from a first-principles perspective and drive data-backed decisions. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Operational Efficiency: 30% improvement in development velocity via AIDLC tools. 
 - System Reliability: Maintaining 99. 99% uptime for critical banking portfolios. 
 - Talent Retention: Reducing attrition among high-potential Senior Managers and Directors. 
 - Stakeholder Satisfaction: High NPS from business partners on the "transparency and predictability" of the delivery pipeline. 

V. Why This Role?

This is a rare opportunity to build an engineering org within the high-stakes world of Finance. You will have the budget of a Tier-1 firm and the autonomy to rewrite the rules of how software is built using AI.

The RADAR product line is a rapidly expanding business within TI, investing to address the fast-growing segment in Industrial & automotive markets. This product line will enable a scalable portfolio using DSP and ARM multi-cores to support high-end applications in ADAS, body & Chassis and in Industrial space. Radar systems process digital information from sources like digital cameras, lasers, radar and other sensors to perform tasks such as lane departure warning or parking assistance. What You'll Do

This role is responsible for leading the electrical engineering design, development, and implementation of large-scale, mission-critical data center infrastructure projects. The position combines technical leadership, people leadership, and project delivery responsibilities to ensure innovative, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective data center solutions. The role serves as the technical authority for electrical systems while driving engineering excellence, design quality, innovation, and team development across the data center project lifecycle. 

Engineering Management

- Lead and manage electrical engineers and subject matter experts across projects. 
 - Allocate resources and manage engineering workloads. 
 - Drive engineering execution to meet project schedules, quality targets, and customer requirements. 
 - Build, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams. 
 - Provide technical coaching and professional development support to engineers. 

Project Delivery & Client Engagement

- Manage electrical engineering deliverables throughout project execution. 
 - Act as the primary technical interface for customers, contractors, and internal stakeholders. 
 - Participate in client meetings, technical reviews, and project discussions. 
 - Support successful project delivery through close collaboration with project management, commercial, and technical teams. 
 - Ensure alignment between customer expectations, project requirements, and engineering execution. 

Quality, Standards & Governance

- Establish and maintain electrical engineering standards, procedures, and best practices. 
 - Conduct formal design reviews and peer reviews. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable electrical codes, standards, and industry best practices. 
 - Promote continuous improvement of engineering processes and design methodologies. 

Site Support & Commissioning

- Lead site visits during installation, testing, and commissioning phases. 
 - Monitor electrical installation activities and resolve technical issues. 
 - Support commissioning activities and operational readiness assessments. 
 - Provide technical guidance for field challenges and project execution risks. 

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

- Drive adoption of innovative technologies and engineering solutions. 
 - Evaluate new approaches to improve efficiency, reliability, and cost performance. 
 - Contribute to the advancement of next-generation data center infrastructure. 
 - Support strategic engineering initiatives and long-term technology roadmaps. 

Qualifications

Bachelor's/ Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering with 8 to 12 years of relevant experience in electrical engineering and data center infrastructure design. 

Skills

Proven experience delivering electrical systems for mission-critical facilities. 

The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise in the design and delivery of mission-critical data center electrical infrastructure, including medium- and low-voltage power distribution systems, transformers, UPS systems, standby generation, and critical power architectures. The role requires proficiency in electrical system design, power distribution analysis, design verification, installation and commissioning practices, as well as a thorough understanding of applicable electrical codes, standards, and quality processes. Candidates should be knowledgeable in emerging data center technologies, edge computing, AI-driven infrastructure trends, value engineering, and cost optimization strategies. Additionally, strong capabilities in engineering and project management, including resource planning, schedule management, quality oversight, risk mitigation, and multidisciplinary team coordination, are essential to successfully deliver reliable, scalable, and innovative data center solutions. 

The ideal candidate should demonstrate strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to build, mentor, and inspire high-performing engineering teams while driving technical excellence and innovation. The role requires strategic thinking, including the ability to evaluate emerging technologies, influence long-term technology direction, and maintain a strong customer and business focus. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills are essential, along with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear and actionable recommendations. The successful candidate should possess strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, effectively lead cross-functional teams, and demonstrate a results-oriented mindset, accountability, ownership, continuous improvement focus, customer-centricity, and a commitment to quality and engineering excellence.

data.title: Lead Quality Assurance, Emerging Growth Opportunites
data.description:
The role is based at Mumbai and reporting to the Head Merch. & Sourcing

Business Context and Opportunities

A global conglomerate, the Aditya Birla Group is in the League of Fortune 500. Anchored by an extraordinary force of over 150, 000 employees belonging to 100 nationalities, the Group is built on a strong foundation of stakeholder value creation. Backed by seven decades of responsible business practices, the Group operates leading businesses across metals, chemicals, textiles, cement, financial services, fashion retail, telecom, and renewable energy, with over 50% of revenues generated from international operations. 

The group expanded its Retail Footprint, leveraging the trust and synergy built over the years in luxury retail by launching its Jewellery brand Indriya, in June 2024. 

India's jewellery market is at an exciting inflection point. For decades, jewellery has largely been associated with weddings, family occasions, inheritance and long-term value. A new generation is now expanding what jewellery can mean. For Gen Z and young consumers, jewellery is increasingly about self-expression, identity, mood, styling, gifting and everyday confidence. It is no longer reserved only for milestone moments. It is becoming part of how young people show up each day, at college, at work, at a café, at a concert, on social media and in the moments that define their personal style. 

Project Tiara is our attempt to build a distinctly new-age jewellery brand for this generation. 

The brand is currently in its conceptualisation stage as a separate and independent business under the legal entity Novel Jewels (the creators of Indriya), backed by the trust, ambition and scale of the Aditya Birla Group. 

The Core Idea

Project Tiara is a jewellery brand will speak to young consumers who want jewellery that is stylish, affordable, versatile and relevant to their lives. It will focus on everyday wear, trend-responsive drops and pieces that can be worn, stacked, layered, mixed, matched and made personal. 

Where the Brand Will Play

Project Tiara is being imagined for the fast-growing daily wear and self-purchase jewellery space. This is a large, under-branded opportunity in India, where young consumers are actively looking for jewellery that feels more current, more expressive and more accessible than traditional fine jewellery. 

The brand will likely operate across digital-first channels, selective physical experiences, pop-ups and omni-channel journeys. It will be designed for a consumer who discovers on Instagram, engages through content, browses online, walks into stores and expects a seamless experience across all touchpoints. 

How We Aim To Differentiate

Project Tiara will be different from traditional jewellery brands in both product and personality. 

This brand will not simply sell jewellery. It will create a new buying behaviour, where jewellery becomes part of everyday identity, styling and self-expression. 

Why This Is Exciting

Project Tiara gives us the opportunity to build a brand from the ground up: the consumer lens, product strategy, design system, brand voice, digital ecosystem, supply chain model, retail experience and growth engine. 

It will also serve as an innovation sandbox for Novel Jewels, allowing us to experiment with new designs, faster drops, creator collaborations, digital storytelling, consumer communities and more agile ways of building a jewellery brand. 

The 3 to 5 Year Ambition

Over the next 3 to 5 years, the ambition is to build Project Tiara into a meaningful, scalable, national Gen Z jewellery brand. The plan is to create a strong digital-first foundation, build repeat-led consumer behaviour, expand through selective offline formats and create a brand that young India sees as expressive, aspirational and accessible. 

Project Tiara will also help Novel Jewels engage consumers early in their jewellery journey, creating a long-term relationship that can grow with them as their life stage, income and jewellery needs evolve. 

Why Join Us

This is a rare opportunity to be part of a founding team for a new consumer brand within one of India's most respected business groups. The team will have the chance to shape the brand's identity, product language, consumer experience, content engine, commercial model and growth journey from the very beginning. 

We are looking for people who are entrepreneurial, consumer-obsessed, culturally aware, digitally fluent and excited by the idea of building something that can redefine how young India experiences jewellery. 

Project Tiara is not just a new brand. It is a chance to reimagine jewellery for a new generation.

data.title: Full-Stack Engineer - Node.js / NestJS / React / TypeScript | Multi-Tenant B2B SaaS (3-5 YOE)
data.description:
📍 Hybrid - Ahmedabad, Gujarat

💼 3-5 Years of Experience

ABOUT THE ROLE

Script Assist is hiring a Full-Stack Engineer with strong production experience in Node. js, TypeScript and React to build and evolve a complex multi-tenant B2B SaaS platform used by UK clinics, pharmacies and operational teams. 

We are looking for engineers with approximately 3-5 years of professional experience who have worked inside a real shared SaaS product - not just simple CRUD applications or separate bespoke projects for individual clients. 

This is an AI-first engineering environment. We expect engineers to use modern AI coding agents throughout the development lifecycle - from understanding unfamiliar code and planning changes to implementation, testing, debugging and reviewing results. 

AI should accelerate your work, while you remain responsible for ensuring that the software is correct, safe and maintainable. 

ABOUT SCRIPT ASSIST

Script Assist is a UK healthcare technology company building software and operational infrastructure for complex private clinical and pharmacy services. 

Our platform: 

• Supports tens of thousands of recurring subscriptions each month alongside high-volume clinical and pharmacy workflows. 

• Supports multiple medications, treatment pathways, clinics, pharmacies, prescribers, patients and operational teams within one shared platform. 

• Covers prescribing, patient onboarding, medication workflows, dispensing, inventory, subscriptions, payments, fulfilment, communications, reporting, permissions and external integrations. 

• Supports different organisational configurations and workflows while keeping the underlying product reliable, secure and maintainable. 

This is not a prototype or a simple dashboard product. Features interact with permissions, tenant configuration, existing workflows, integrations and production data. 

Healthcare experience is not required. Experience building genuinely complex software is. 

WHAT YOU WILL BUILD

• Backend services and business logic using Node. js, NestJS and TypeScript. 

• React and TypeScript interfaces used by real operational teams. 

• Multi-tenant features with correct tenant isolation and tenant-specific configuration. 

• Stateful workflows involving multiple stages, roles, permissions and exception paths. 

• REST APIs, third-party integrations, webhooks and asynchronous/background processing. 

• Reliable product behaviour around retries, validation, edge cases and partial failures. 

• Features across subscriptions, payments, pharmacy operations, inventory, fulfilment and clinical workflows. 

• Automated tests and observability that make production changes safer. 

The SaaS experience we require

Multi-tenant SaaS experience is a core requirement for this role. 

We are looking for candidates who have actually developed a production product used by multiple customer organisations. 

You should have experience with: 

• A shared product and codebase used by multiple tenants/customers. 

• Tenant-aware data access or isolation. 

• Different permissions, roles, configurations or feature access between tenants. 

• Customer-specific behaviour without creating a completely separate product for every client. 

• Several interconnected modules, workflows or integrations. 

• Production releases where changes needed to remain compatible with existing customers. 

Important: Working on multiple separate client projects does not automatically mean you have multi-tenant SaaS experience. We will ask you to explain how tenancy worked in the product you built. 

AI-FIRST ENGINEERING

We are looking for engineers whose development workflow has materially changed because of AI. 

AI should be a regular implementation tool, not something used only occasionally to explain an error. 

You will use AI to: 

• Understand - Inspect unfamiliar modules, trace code paths and understand existing patterns. 

• Plan - Break requirements into implementation steps, identify dependencies and consider edge cases. 

• Implement - Generate substantial implementation work rather than manually typing routine code. 

• Test - Create and extend unit, integration and edge-case test coverage. 

• Debug - Analyse errors, logs, failing tests and unfamiliar execution paths. 

• Verify - Review diffs, run tests and validate behaviour yourself. 

AI output is never accepted blindly. You remain accountable for the quality, correctness and maintainability of your work. 

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• 3-5 years of professional software engineering experience. 

• 2+ years of hands-on production Node. js development. 

• 2+ years of production React / React. js development. 

• 2+ years of production TypeScript development. 

• Real experience building a multi-tenant SaaS product. 

• Strong understanding of backend business logic, APIs, databases and production debugging. 

• Experience owning features end-to-end rather than only implementing small isolated tickets. 

• Clear written and spoken English. 

• Strong AI-assisted engineering experience across planning, implementation, testing and debugging. 

NICE TO HAVE

• NestJS, Express or Fastify. 

• PostgreSQL, MongoDB or another production database. 

• Redis, queues, background jobs or event-driven processing. 

• REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks and third-party integrations. 

• Docker, CI/CD and cloud environments. 

• RBAC, permissions, feature flags and tenant configuration. 

• Testing, logging, monitoring and production incident investigation. 

We do not require experience with one particular cloud, database or queue technology. We care more about the quality and complexity of the systems you have actually built. 

WHY JOIN SCRIPT ASSIST?

• Build on a live multi-tenant SaaS platform where your work reaches real customers quickly. 

• Work across backend and frontend rather than being confined to one narrow subsystem. 

• Take meaningful end-to-end ownership of features and workflows. 

• Work in an AI-first engineering environment focused on leverage and delivery quality. 

• Solve complex operational problems involving integrations, state, permissions and customer variation. 

• Join a growing international product team with opportunities to take on greater ownership as the platform scales. 

If you have built and shipped complex, production-grade multi-tenant SaaS products using Node. js, TypeScript and React, we'd love to hear from you.

data.title: AI Architect
data.description:
The AI Architect designs, governs, and delivers production-grade AI capabilities, including LLM integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic workflows, as part of secure, scalable, and maintainable healthcare products. The role is weighted toward AI/GenAI architecture and core system architecture: distributed systems, microservices, APIs, data, cloud infrastructure, security, and operations. The AI Architect translates product goals, customer commitments, and engineering constraints into architecture that works end to end, from user experience and service boundaries through data pipelines, model and retrieval layers, integrations, deployment, and runtime monitoring. 

This is not a prompt-engineering or agent-building role in isolation. Prompts, models, and agents are components of a larger system, and this role is accountable for everything around them: service decomposition, contracts, data flow, state management, latency and cost budgets, failure handling, security and PHI protection, observability, evaluation, and long-term maintainability. The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect who has shipped GenAI to production and can defend the full system design, not only the model layer. 

Key Outcomes

- Production GenAI and agentic AI capabilities delivered as reliable, secure, observable product features rather than isolated prototypes or demos. 
 - A reusable enterprise AI platform (model gateway, retrieval/RAG services, agent orchestration, evaluation, and guardrails) that product teams adopt consistently. 
 - End-to-end architectures in which AI components are properly integrated with microservices, APIs, event flows, data stores, identity, and cloud infrastructure, with clear service boundaries and contracts. 
 - AI systems that meet defined targets for quality, latency, availability, cost, and safety, with governance, PHI protection, and Responsible AI practices built in from the start. 
 - Stronger alignment among product, engineering, QA, DevOps, data, security, and leadership stakeholders around feasible and sustainable AI-enabled solutions. 

Roles and Responsibilities

- Lead the architecture of GenAI, RAG, and agentic AI solutions, including model selection, prompt and context design, retrieval strategy, tool/function calling, multi-agent orchestration, memory and state management, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Design and evolve a shared enterprise AI platform: LLM gateway and model abstraction, prompt and configuration management, embedding and vector search services, agent orchestration (e. g. , LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), guardrails, and evaluation services. 
 - Define RAG and knowledge architectures end to end: ingestion, chunking, embedding, indexing, hybrid search, re-ranking, access control on retrieved content, data freshness, and grounding/citation strategy. 
 - Establish AI evaluation and LLMOps practices, including offline and online evaluation, golden datasets, regression testing of prompts and models, hallucination and quality metrics, A/B testing, and controlled model/version rollout and rollback. 
 - Drive AI governance, safety, and security: prompt-injection and data-exfiltration defenses, PII/PHI redaction, content filtering, auditability, model risk assessment, and alignment with Responsible AI and healthcare regulatory requirements such as HIPAA. 
 - Make and document build-vs-buy and model trade-off decisions (managed services such as AWS Bedrock vs. open-weight or self-hosted models) based on quality, latency, cost, data residency, and vendor risk. 
 - Own end-to-end system design for AI-enabled features: service decomposition, microservice boundaries, API and event contracts, synchronous vs. asynchronous patterns, data ownership, and integration with existing product and legacy systems. 
 - Design for non-functional requirements across the full stack: scalability, availability, resiliency (timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, fallbacks, and graceful degradation when models fail), performance, latency and token-cost budgets, multi-tenancy, and disaster recovery. 
 - Define data architecture for AI workloads, including operational and analytical stores, vector databases, caching, streaming and event pipelines, data lineage, retention, and secure handling of clinical and patient data. 
 - Architect cloud-native deployment on AWS containers and Kubernetes/ECS, serverless, networking, identity and access, secrets management, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD for both application and AI artifacts. 
 - Define observability across AI and non-AI components together: distributed tracing across services and model calls, prompt/response logging with privacy controls, quality and drift monitoring, cost tracking, SLOs, and alerting. 
 - Define architecture standards, reference architectures, design patterns, API guidelines, and service templates that product teams can adopt consistently. 
 - Analyze current-state architecture, technical debt, and integration constraints to identify where AI can be introduced safely and where modernization must come first. 
 - Partner with product management to translate business priorities and customer commitments into technically feasible AI roadmaps, implementation strategies, and incremental releases with measurable outcomes. 
 - Build proofs of concept and reference implementations hands-on to validate feasibility, and define the path from proof of concept to production-hardened service. 
 - Lead architecture reviews and lightweight governance aligned to agile delivery, covering both AI-specific risks and core design quality. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and engineering managers in GenAI engineering, system design, distributed systems, service ownership, and accountable AI practices. 
 - Document architecture decisions (ADRs), system and sequence diagrams, service catalogs, AI model and prompt inventories, technical risks, and roadmaps in formats usable by engineers and product stakeholders. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, and ChatGPT Enterprise to accelerate codebase exploration, design comparison, and documentation while retaining accountability for decisions. 
 - Track the evolving AI landscape (models, agent frameworks, protocols such as MCP, and evaluation methods) and turn relevant advances into pragmatic architecture guidance. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline is required; equivalent deep technical experience may be considered. 
 - Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred. 
 - Certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect, AWS Machine Learning/GenAI, TOGAF, AI Engineer, or CKA/CKAD are preferred when supported by practical implementation experience. 

Experience

- Overall Experience of 14+ years in software development and architecture. 
 - 8+ years of architecture or technical design experience across distributed systems, microservices, APIs, data, and cloud platforms. 
 - 3+ years architecting and delivering AI/GenAI solutions, including at least one LLM, RAG, or agent-based system running in production with real users. 
 - Proven experience designing end-to-end architectures for complex, high-scale applications, from service decomposition and data modeling through deployment, observability, and operations. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating AI components into existing products and legacy systems, including reliability, latency, cost, and security trade-offs. 
 - Experience with AI evaluation, LLMOps/MLOps, and AI governance in a regulated industry; healthcare/EHR experience is preferred. 

Skills

- Expert knowledge of GenAI architecture: LLM integration, prompt and context engineering, RAG, embeddings and vector search, agentic and multi-agent patterns, tool/function calling, and frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or LlamaIndex. 
 - Expert knowledge of system design and distributed systems: microservices, domain-driven design, API design (REST, gRPC, GraphQL), event-driven architecture, messaging and streaming, consistency and state management, caching, and scalability patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of AI quality and safety: evaluation frameworks, hallucination mitigation, guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, AI observability, and Responsible AI principles. 
 - Strong understanding of full-stack product engineering, relational, NoSQL, and vector databases, CI/CD, containers and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, security architecture (identity, encryption, zero trust), and performance engineering. 
 - Ability to reason about and quantify trade-offs across accuracy, latency, cost, reliability, and maintainability, and to explain them clearly. 
 - Ability to create architecture decision records, reference architectures, system and sequence diagrams, service catalogs, and reusable engineering patterns. 
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to align technical and non-technical stakeholders around architecture decisions and trade-offs. 

Abilities

- Thinks in systems: designs the full request path, data flow, and failure modes around AI components, not only the model or prompt. 
 - Influences across engineering, product, QA, DevOps, data, security, and leadership teams without relying only on formal authority. 
 - Balances innovation speed with production readiness, customer commitments, and regulatory obligations. 
 - Converts ambiguity into clear architecture direction, incremental delivery plans, and executable engineering guidance. 
 - Mentors teams toward full-cycle ownership, reusable patterns, and accountable AI engineering practices. 
 - Maintains practical governance that improves quality and speed rather than increasing unnecessary process overhead. 

Tools and Technologies

- GenAI and LLM platforms: AWS Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI models, and open-weight models (e. g. , Llama, Mistral); Model Context Protocol (MCP). 
 - Agent and orchestration frameworks: LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LlamaIndex, and AWS Bedrock Agents. 
 - Vector and knowledge stores: pgvector, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, Pinecone, Weaviate; knowledge graphs and graph databases such as Neo4j or Neptune. 
 - AI evaluation and observability: LangSmith, Langfuse, Ragas, or similar; OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, and APM tools. 
 - Java, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL, REST/gRPC APIs, microservices, Angular/React, Node. js, and legacy technologies relevant to existing products. 
 - AWS services including Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, S3, IAM, Cognito, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, CloudWatch, Aurora, DynamoDB, Glue, and SageMaker. 
 - Kafka/streaming, relational and NoSQL databases, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis, data lakes, and distributed computing tools where applicable. 
 - CI/CD and platform tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Git/GitHub, NuGet, NPM, and feature management tools. 
 - AI-assisted engineering tools: GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise/Team, Claude, and approved AI assistants; architecture and documentation tools for diagrams, ADRs, and service catalogs. 

AI Usage and Accountability Requirements

- AI capabilities must be designed as part of the full system, with defined service boundaries, fallbacks, and ownership; prompts and agents are not shipped as standalone artifacts. 
 - Every production AI feature must have defined evaluation criteria, quality thresholds, monitoring, and a rollback path before release. 
 - PHI/PII handling, access control on retrieved data, audit logging, and human-in-the-loop controls must be designed in from the start, aligned with HIPAA and organizational AI policy. 
 - Architecture decisions must remain traceable to business goals, quality attributes, cost, implementation feasibility, and known trade-offs. 
 - AI-assisted recommendations, including those from coding and architecture assistants, must be validated against product context, engineering constraints, performance needs, maintainability, and operational risk. 
 - Reusable prompts, agent patterns, evaluation datasets, reference architectures, and design-review checklists should be maintained as organizational assets. 

Success Measures / Accountable Outcomes

- Number of GenAI and agentic capabilities moved from proof of concept to production, and time from proof of concept to production. 
 - AI quality and reliability against agreed targets: groundedness/accuracy, hallucination and escalation rates, latency, availability, and cost per transaction. 
 - Adoption of the shared AI platform and reference architectures across product teams, and reduction in duplicated or one-off AI implementations. 
 - Reduction in production incidents, integration defects, and technical debt attributable to architecture, including in AI-enabled services. 
 - No critical AI security or PHI incidents, with audit-ready AI governance documentation. 
 - Improvement in delivery readiness for strategic AI product initiatives and customer-committed capabilities. 

AI Competency Alignment

Authority and Autonomy

Leads AI and system architecture decisions for product areas and complex initiatives. Determines AI platform direction, architecture approaches, standards, service models, and model and vendor choices in partnership with engineering, product, security, and compliance leadership. It would be nice if you also had: 

- Practical understanding of AI/ML concepts applied to automation or data analysis. 
 - Exposure to ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit‐learn.

data.description:
Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it's consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future. 

Job Description

Gracenote is the content business unit of Nielsen that powers the world of media entertainment. Our metadata solutions help media and entertainment companies around the world deliver personalized content search and discovery, connecting audiences with the content they love. We're at the intersection of people and media entertainment. 

With our cutting-edge technology and solutions, we help audiences easily find TV shows, movies, music and sports across multiple platforms. As the world leader in entertainment data and services, we power the world's top streaming platforms, cable and satellite TV providers, media companies, consumer electronics manufacturers, music services and automakers to navigate and succeed in the competitive streaming world. Our metadata entertainment solutions have a global footprint of 80+ countries, 100K+ channels and catalogs, 70+ sports and 100M+ music tracks, all across 35 languages. 

Job Purpose

- Architect & Design our flagship metadata software solutions. 
 - Design applications with a Platform-first mentality where scale, consistency and reliability are at the core of every decision. 
 - Responsible for driving Technology & good practices in Engineering in their respective teams. 
 - Partner with the Product team to translate vague business requirements into concrete, feasible technical roadmaps. 
 - Actively participate in development along with team members for as much as 60% of their time, creating modules & systems that can then be treated as a working reflection of the best practices. 
 - Cross-System Integration ensuring data flow seamlessly & consistently across ingestion, processing and data deliveries to end customers. 
 - Work closely with Data Science, DevOps, and Frontend architects to ensure our backend infrastructure supports emerging needs. 
 - Being responsible for Scaling, Performance & Quality. 
 - Experiment with new & relevant technologies and tools, and drive adoption while measuring yourself on the impact you can create. 
 - Implementation of long-term technology vision for your teams. 
 - Creating architectures & designs for new solutions around existing and new problem spaces. 
 - Responsible for the architecture of your platform; ensuring it is aligned to the long term requirements and the platform vision. 
 - Drive technology & tool choices for your team & be responsible for them. 
 - Drive technology forums & rhythms in the team to drive best practices. Establish organization-wide engineering standards (coding guidelines, API contracts, security protocols, design standards) to ensure consistency across different teams. 
 - Mentor and guide Senior engineers, fostering a culture of learning and collaboration within the team
 - Going beyond your role and contributing to make the organization & business better. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 10+ years of professional experience in software development
 - Experience in designing, developing and scaling enterprise grade applications, including developing solutions from scratch. 
 - In depth knowledge and proficiency of messaging queue concepts 
 - Proficiency in Java/Python frameworks such as Spring, Hibernate, or similar. 
 - Experience with RESTful APIs and microservices architecture. 
 - Familiarity with front-end technologies (e. g. , HTML, CSS, JavaScript) is a plus. 
 - Working knowledge of machine learning and data science concepts 
 - Champion of SDLC practices. Understanding of software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, etc. ). 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as in a team environment. 
 - Strong understanding of application development, infrastructure management, data engineering and platform constructs. 
 - Deep understanding of various datastores: SQL & NoSQL. 
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). Familiarity with containerization technologies (e. g. , Docker, Kubernetes). Knowledge of CI/CD tools and practices. 
 - Experience with test-driven development (TDD) and automated testing frameworks. 

What We Offer

- Competitive salary and benefits package. 
 - Opportunities for professional growth and development. 
 - A collaborative and inclusive work environment. 

Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen. com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen. com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

data.title: Principal SaaS Architect and Engineering Lead
data.description:
Principal SaaS Architect and Engineering Lead

(. NET Core / Azure)

Location: Surat Gujarat

Experience: 15+ years in software engineering, including SaaS architecture and engineering leadership

Working hours: Full shift aligned with U. S. Pacific Time business hours. This is an ongoing, non-negotiable requirement. 

The opportunity

We are seeking a senior, hands-on technology professional with proven experience designing, building, and operating enterprise SaaS products. You will work closely with technology leadership, contribute independent architectural judgment, and strengthen engineering capabilities across the organization. 

The role has two primary responsibilities: working alongside the existing treasury SaaS product leader to support the product's technical management and day-to-day operations, and guiding the architecture and engineering of our future SaaS products. 

Key responsibilities

SaaS architecture and future product engineering

· Translate business requirements into architecture options, technical roadmaps, implementation phases, and engineering estimates for future SaaS products. 

· Design and review tenancy models, tenant isolation, identity and access, onboarding, integrations, data architecture, and product extensibility. 

· Evaluate trade-offs across scalability, availability, disaster recovery, security, maintainability, and Azure operating costs. Document decisions and guide implementation. 

Hands on delivery and production ownership

· Develop enhancements, review code, investigate complex application and SQL issues, and troubleshoot Azure services and integrations. 

· Own assigned production incidents during the agreed shift: assess impact, identify defects or operational issues, communicate progress, and coordinate resolution. 

· Take fixes through internal testing, UAT coordination, approved production release, and post-release verification; improve monitoring, runbooks, and root-cause prevention. 

Engineering leadership and security

· Guide onsite and India-based engineers through sprint planning, technical discussions, estimation, design reviews, and delivery reviews. 

· Mentor engineers and strengthen code quality, testing, secure development, CI/CD, documentation, and troubleshooting practices across teams. 

· Support VAPT assessments and SOC audits by providing technical evidence, addressing findings, and coordinating remediation, validation, and retesting as applicable. 

· Review application and Azure security posture. Identify potential attack paths and weaknesses in access controls, exposed services, and configurations, working with security teams to prioritize and reduce risk. 

· Communicate clearly with client stakeholders and technology leadership about technical options, operational issues, risks, and delivery commitments. 

Essential experience and capabilities

· 15+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including strong recent hands-on development and technical leadership. 

· Demonstrated responsibility for designing and delivering SaaS products, with experience operating and evolving them in production. 

· Strong C#, . NET Core / ASP. NET Core, SQL, and REST API development, debugging, code review, and performance optimization skills. 

· Practical Azure application architecture experience, including App Service, Azure SQL, Functions, Key Vault, Application Insights, and Log Analytics. 

· Sound understanding of SaaS tenancy models, data isolation, authentication, authorization, secure configuration, and integration design. 

· Experience with source control, Azure DevOps or equivalent tooling, CI/CD, testing, controlled releases, and production incident management. 

· Ability to learn an established codebase, explain architectural trade-offs, independently recommend improvements, and mentor distributed teams. 

· Strong client communication and a willingness to combine architecture leadership with hands-on development and ongoing production support. 

Desirable experience

· Blazor WebAssembly or Server; Azure Logic Apps, Data Factory, and Microsoft Fabric. 

· Treasury, banking, fintech, or financial SaaS applications; VAPT remediation and technical support for SOC audits. 

Working expectations

This role includes regular production support alongside architecture, development, and mentoring. The full U. S. Pacific Time shift is essential.

How we work

• AI-first workflow - Cursor + Claude is our daily driver. You'll direct AI, review its output, and handle the parts it can't.

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
About us: upGrad is India's leading lifelong upskilling partner. We work with learners at every stage of their career, from college students and early-career graduates to working professionals, senior leaders and enterprises, helping them stay relevant through online degrees, certifications, bootcamps, executive programmes, study-abroad pathways and workforce upskilling. We partner with leading universities and institutions in India and abroad, including IIIT Bangalore, the IIMs, IIT Delhi and universities across the US, UK, Europe and Australia. 

Our engineering teams build and run the platforms behind this scale: learner-facing web and mobile apps, enterprise learning products, assessment and career services, and the data and AI systems that power personalised learning. 

Roles & Responsibilities

● Own test automation for web, API and mobile applications across one or more product lines, working closely with engineering and product to understand changes and prioritise testing. 

● Design, build and maintain automation frameworks from scratch or restructure existing ones, using AI-assisted development tools to deliver in aggressive timelines without compromising maintainability. 

● Write, enhance and execute automated functional, regression and acceptance suites, integrated into CI/CD pipelines with reliable reporting. 

● Validate end-to-end flows across the front end, backend services and databases, including data setup, teardown and verification through SQL. 

● Shift testing left: review requirements and designs for testability, and contribute to API contracts and test strategies before code lands. 

● Triage, log and track defects by severity and priority, and drive them to closure with engineering, product and operations. 

● Continuously evaluate new tools, including AI agents and MCP-based testing integrations, and bring practical improvements to the team's workflow. 

● Mentor junior QA engineers and contribute to automation standards and best practices across the team. 

Skills Required

Must have

● Minimum 2 years of hands-on test automation experience, with 3-5 years overall in software engineering or QA. 

● Hands-on experience automating Web, API and Mobile applications using Playwright, Selenium, Appium, Cypress, REST Assured or similar frameworks. Strong in at least two of the three layers. 

● Demonstrated use of AI-assisted tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT or similar) to build or restructure automation frameworks, generate and refactor tests, and accelerate delivery. Be ready to walk us through a real example. 

● Hands-on object-oriented programming in Java, or equivalent in TypeScript, Python or C#, with a solid grasp of design patterns used in test frameworks (Page Object, Builder, Factory).

data.title: Engineering Lead-AI Agentic Platform
data.description:
Engineering Lead

AI Agentic Platform Orchestration, Benchmarking & Unification

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to build, architect, and lead the team behind our next-generation AI Agentic Platform. This platform empowers enterprises to measure ROI on industry-specific agent activity, benchmark AI agents against performance standards, orchestrate complex multi-agent workflows, and unify AI agents seamlessly across diverse platforms and ecosystems. 

As the engineering leader for this strategic product, you will combine deep technical expertise with strong people management skills to deliver a unified control plane for the rapidly evolving agentic AI landscape. You will own the technical vision, drive architectural decisions, and grow a high-performing team that ships at the frontier of AI engineering. 

Platform Capabilities You'll Own

- Industry-Specific ROI Measurement: Build instrumentation, analytics, and reporting frameworks that quantify the business impact of AI agents across verticals such as BFSI, healthcare, retail, and telecom. 
 - AI Agent Benchmarking: Develop standardized evaluation harnesses, performance scoring, and quality metrics that allow enterprises to compare agents on accuracy, latency, cost, safety, and task success. 
 - Agent Orchestration: Design multi-agent orchestration engines, workflow planners, routing layers, and coordination frameworks that enable agents to collaborate on complex tasks reliably. 
 - Cross-Platform Agent Unification: Architect a unified abstraction layer, connectors, and protocol adapters (MCP, A2A, OpenAI Assistants, LangGraph, etc. ) so customers can manage agents across vendors and frameworks from a single pane of glass. 

Key Responsibilities

- Hire, build, and lead a high-caliber engineering team across backend, AI/ML, and platform infrastructure
 - Define and own the technical architecture for a multi-tenant, scalable AI agentic platform
 - Drive the technical roadmap for orchestration, benchmarking, observability, and unification capabilities
 - Partner with Product, Design, Data Science, and GTM teams to translate customer needs into shippable engineering outcomes
 - Establish engineering best practices for AI agent development, evaluation, safety, and deployment
 - Lead architectural reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making for complex distributed systems
 - Build robust evaluation frameworks and ROI dashboards that customers and internal teams trust
 - Ensure platform reliability, performance, security, and cost efficiency at scale
 - Mentor engineers, set growth paths, run performance reviews, and foster an inclusive, high-trust team culture
 - Communicate progress, risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership

Required Qualifications

- 8+ years of software engineering experience with at least 3+ years managing engineering teams
 - Proven experience architecting and scaling distributed systems, microservices, and cloud-native platforms
 - Hands-on experience building AI/ML or LLM-powered products in production environments
 - Strong understanding of agentic AI concepts including planning, tool use, memory, and multi-agent coordination
 - Proficiency in modern programming languages such as Python, Go, Java, or TypeScript
 - Experience designing APIs, SDKs, and integration platforms used by enterprise customers
 - Track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining strong engineering talent
 - Strong communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills
 - Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar)
 - Familiarity with emerging agent interoperability standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols
 - Experience designing LLM evaluation and benchmarking systems (offline evals, A/B testing, golden datasets, judge models)
 - Knowledge of observability for AI systems including tracing, telemetry, and cost/quality monitoring
 - Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and prompt engineering at scale
 - Background in building analytics, ROI dashboards, or business intelligence tooling for enterprise customers
 - Domain experience in one or more verticals (BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, customer support, or sales)
 - Familiarity with AI safety, guardrails, and responsible AI frameworks
 - Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related field

Technical Stack & Tooling

- Languages: Python, Go, TypeScript/Node. js, Java
 - AI/ML Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, PyTorch, OpenAI/Anthropic/Google APIs
 - Agent Protocols: MCP, A2A, OpenAI Assistants API, function calling, tool use frameworks
 - Data & Storage: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Pinecone/Weaviate/Qdrant, Snowflake/BigQuery
 - Streaming & Messaging: Kafka, Redis, RabbitMQ, gRPC
 - Cloud & Infra: AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker
 - Observability: Datadog, OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Langfuse, Prometheus, Grafana

What We're Looking For

- A builder-leader who can both architect deeply technical systems and grow a high-performing team
 - Someone genuinely excited about agentic AI and the future of multi-agent enterprise systems
 - A pragmatic decision-maker who can balance innovation, customer value, and engineering excellence
 - A strong communicator who can simplify complex AI concepts for diverse audiences
 - A coach and mentor who invests in people and builds inclusive, psychologically safe teams

Why Join Us

- Lead one of the most strategic AI initiatives at the company at the forefront of agentic AI
 - Build a category-defining platform that unifies, benchmarks, and orchestrates AI agents across the enterprise
 - Shape product and technical strategy alongside senior leadership
 - Work with cutting-edge LLMs, agent frameworks, and evaluation tooling
 - Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits
 - Flexible work culture with strong investment in learning and development

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

data.title: Agentic AI Architect/Sr. Architect
Staff Architect
data.description:
We are looking for a Staff Architect to help drive architecture across two connected pillars at organisation: the internal AI engineering platform that accelerates how teams build, and the client-facing product architecture that our customers depend on every day. This is a hands-on, deeply collaborative technical leadership role for someone who has shipped real systems with LLMs and agents, who is comfortable shaping architecture across services, data, security and developer experience, and who is energized by working through other engineers rather than around them. 

The Role

You will help drive the technical direction of organisation's AI engineering platform and the architecture of our client-facing products. That means partnering with engineering leads, product, security and operations to shape the systems that internal teams build on, the products customers rely on and the AI capabilities that increasingly run through both. You will write code, write design docs, lead reviews, mentor other senior and staff engineers and turn good local decisions into durable enterprise patterns. 

This role is intentionally cross-cutting. You will move between platform problems (how engineers and product managers ship faster and more consistently across the company) and product problems (how our client-facing systems scale, integrate, stay secure and incorporate AI in ways that hold up in a regulated industry). 

Key Responsibilities

Internal AI Engineering Platform

- Help drive the architecture of organisation's internal AI scaffolding platform, including agent orchestration, skill and contract design, multi-IDE adapters (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and successors) and the developer experience that ties them together. 
 - Co-design enterprise-wide standards for building with LLMs and agents: prompt and context patterns, retrieval and grounding, tool integration, evals, guardrails, cost and latency budgets, observability and incident response. 
 - Partner with engineering leads across product teams to evolve their stacks toward shared scaffolding rather than parallel reinvention, and contribute reusable skills, templates and adapters back to the platform. 
 - Help shape the evaluation strategy for AI features: how we measure quality, regressions, safety and business impact, and how evals are wired into CI, staging and production telemetry. 
 - Influence model selection, agent framework choices, vendor versus in-house tradeoffs and where to place the boundaries between platform and product code. Client-Facing Product Architecture

- Partner with product engineering leads to drive the architecture of organisation's client-facing systems across the surfaces customers interact with, including web applications, APIs, integrations and embedded AI features. 
 - Shape the service architecture: domain boundaries, service decomposition, design platform services, AI services and event-driven patterns. 
 - Contribute to the data architecture in close collaboration with the Data Architect: how transactional, analytical and regulatory data flows through products, how contracts are defined between systems, how lineage and quality are preserved. 
 - Help drive the AI in product strategy: where LLMs, RAG, agents and assistive features belong in customer-facing workflows, how they are evaluated, how they fail gracefully and how their behavior is auditable. 
 - Shape choices around scalability, performance, multi-tenancy and resilience for client workloads, including capacity planning, caching, rate limiting, async processing and graceful degradation. 
 - Co-design the security and compliance posture for products in a regulated domain: authentication, authorization, tenancy isolation, encryption, secrets handling, audit logging and data residency. 
 - Influence observability and operability standards: telemetry, logging, tracing, SLOs, on-call ergonomics and incident review. 
 - Guide integration and interoperability decisions across customer integrations, third-party services, data feeds and partner platforms. Technical Leadership Across Both Pillars

- Lead and contribute to design reviews, architecture decision records and technical writing that sets the bar for the broader engineering organization. 
 - Mentor staff and senior engineers across teams. Coach them through hard tradeoffs rather than making the calls for them. 
 - Be the technical voice that helps leadership decide what to build, what to buy and what to retire, and that translates technical reality back to business stakeholders. 
 - Work with security, compliance and risk to make sure AI-driven workflows and product features meet ORAGANISATION's obligations around data handling, auditability, access control and regulatory exposure. 
 - Stay close to the broader industry. Bring back practices that are working elsewhere and adapt them to our context. Essential Criteria

- 11+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a clear track record of technical leadership at staff level or equivalent cross-team scope. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and shipping production systems built on LLMs or autonomous agents. You can speak in detail to systems you architected, the tradeoffs you made and what you would do differently. 
 - Strong distributed systems and software architecture background. You can move fluently between service design, API design, data flow, security and developer experience. 
 - Hands-on experience architecting client-facing SaaS or enterprise products: service boundaries, APIs, integrations, multi-tenancy, performance, resilience and observability. 
 - Working understanding of data architecture: storage choices (relational, document, analytical, vector), data contracts and how product systems and data platforms meet at the boundary. 
 - Hands-on fluency with modern AI engineering practice: prompt and context engineering, retrieval augmented generation, agent orchestration, tool use, evals and guardrails. 
 - Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives through influence in a mid to large engineering organization. You can move a group of senior engineers toward shared decisions without relying on positional authority. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication. You can write a one-page design doc that aligns a room of senior people and a five-line summary that aligns an executive. 
 - A pragmatic, collaborative mindset. You balance rigor with delivery, work inside legacy constraints and still move the architecture forward. Nice to Have

- Experience building developer tooling or internal platforms at enterprise scale, especially scaffolding, code generation, workflow automation or developer productivity systems. 
 - Experience integrating AI assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot or similar) into team workflows as a deliberate engineering practice, not just individual use. 
 - Familiarity with MCP-style tool integration, agent contracts and multi-agent orchestration patterns. 
 - Experience with eval frameworks (LangSmith or commercial/in-house equivalents) and with observability for LLM and agent systems in production. 
 - Experience designing for compliance, audit and regulatory requirements in financial services, healthcare or another regulated, data-sensitive domain. 
 - Familiarity with cloud-native architecture on AWS (or equivalent), containerization, IaC and modern CI/CD. 
 - A track record of writing or speaking publicly about software architecture or AI engineering practice. What We Offer

- A senior technical leadership role with scope across both the AI platform that internal teams build on and the products our customers rely on. 
 - The chance to help define the architectural standards and patterns that hundreds of engineers and product managers will use every day. 
 - A collaborative, forward-thinking team that takes both engineering rigor and emerging AI practice seriously. 
 - The opportunity to work at the intersection of regulated financial data and modern AI tooling, where the technical bar and the business stakes are both high.

data.title: DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Recruiterflow is the AI-native platform powering executive search and recruiting businesses-from sourcing talent to closing deals. Trusted by 2, 100+ agencies and 10, 000+ recruiters across 100+ countries, we're led by second-time founders with 13 years of experience in AI. Profitable and self-funded, we were recently named Bootstrapped Business of the Year. Our customers fund our roadmap because what we build works. 

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer with 4-6 years of experience to own Recruiterflow's infrastructure end to end. You will be the go-to person for how our product is built, shipped, run and secured on AWS. Our core platform is a multi-tenant Python/Flask application running on AWS EC2, backed by MySQL on Amazon RDS, with code hosted on Bitbucket and shipped through Bitbucket Pipelines. You will take this setup and make it faster, cheaper, more reliable and easier for our engineering team to work with. 

Why Join Recruiterflow?

This is a true ownership role, not a ticket queue. You will be the single owner of our infrastructure, with direct access to engineering leadership and the freedom to choose tools, set standards and drive changes that every engineer and every customer feels. As a profitable company, we invest in getting infrastructure right rather than chasing short-term fixes - and you will be the one shaping it. 

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure ownership (AWS)

- Own Recruiterflow's AWS infrastructure end to end: EC2, RDS (MySQL), Elastic Load Balancing, VPC/networking, IAM, S3, EFS, Route 53 and related services. 
 - Design and optimize EC2 fleet sizing, Auto Scaling and Application Load Balancer configuration for availability and cost efficiency. 
 - Tune Amazon RDS for MySQL: instance sizing, parameter groups, read replicas and replica lag, backups, snapshots and point-in-time recovery. 
 - Drive AWS cost optimization through right-sizing, Reserved Instances/Savings Plans, storage lifecycle policies and regular cost reviews. 
 - Codify infrastructure as code so environments are reproducible, reviewable and version-controlled. 

CI/CD and release engineering

- Own and improve our CI/CD pipelines on Bitbucket Pipelines: faster builds, reliable test stages, PR checks and safe, repeatable deployments. 
 - Introduce zero-downtime deployment strategies (rolling, blue/green) and clean rollback paths. 
 - Manage build artifacts, environment configuration and secrets across development, staging and production. 

Developer tooling and secure access

- Build a secure, streamlined way for engineers to connect to EC2 and RDS - e. g. AWS Systems Manager Session Manager, bastion-less access, port forwarding and SSO-based short-lived credentials - replacing shared keys and ad-hoc access. 
 - Implement least-privilege IAM roles and policies, with access that is auditable and easy to grant or revoke. 
 - Provide self-serve tooling and documentation so developers can spin up, debug and access environments without waiting on DevOps. 

Reliability, observability and security

- Set up monitoring, logging and alerting (e. g. CloudWatch and/or Prometheus/Grafana) with clear dashboards for application and database health. 
 - Participate in production incident response, lead root-cause analysis and write runbooks to prevent repeat issues. 
 - Own backup, disaster recovery and data-retention practices for a multi-tenant SaaS platform holding customer data. 
 - Harden infrastructure security: patching, network segmentation, security groups, encryption at rest and in transit, and secret management. 

Collaboration

- Work closely with backend, frontend and QA engineers and the product support team to remove infrastructure bottlenecks. 
 - Document architecture, runbooks and standards, and share DevOps best practices across the team. 

Impact and Opportunities

Your work will directly shape how reliably and quickly Recruiterflow reaches thousands of recruiters every day. Faster pipelines mean features ship sooner; a tuned AWS setup means better performance at lower cost; and frictionless, secure access means engineers spend their time building instead of waiting. You will have the room to define the DevOps function at Recruiterflow and grow it as we scale. 

Required Skills

- 4- 6 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, SRE or cloud infrastructure roles, ideally supporting a production SaaS product. 
 - Strong AWS expertise: EC2, RDS, ELB/ALB, Auto Scaling, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch and Systems Manager. 
 - Database operations: experience running MySQL on Amazon RDS in production - performance tuning, read replicas, backups and recovery. 
 - CI/CD: proven experience building and maintaining pipelines (Bitbucket Pipelines preferred; GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins also fine) and Git-based workflows. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: hands-on with Terraform, CloudFormation or AWS CDK. 
 - Linux administration: strong Ubuntu/Linux skills, including networking, SSH, Nginx/web servers and process management. 
 - Scripting: solid Bash and Python skills for automation and tooling. 
 - Security: practical experience with IAM least-privilege design, secret management and secure access patterns for servers and databases. 
 - Observability: experience setting up monitoring, logging and alerting, and handling on-call incidents. 
 - Strong problem-solving, clear communication and comfort working as the owner of a function. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience running Python/Flask (or Django) applications in production, including WSGI servers such as Gunicorn/uWSGI and background workers. 
 - Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architectures and their isolation, scaling and data-safety concerns. 
 - Familiarity with Docker and container orchestration (ECS, EKS or Kubernetes). 
 - Experience with caching and queueing systems such as Redis, Celery, SQS or RabbitMQ. 
 - Exposure to zero-trust/secure access tools (AWS SSM, Tailscale, Teleport, AWS IAM Identity Center). 
 - Familiarity with supporting AI/LLM workloads on AWS (e. g. Amazon Bedrock). 
 - AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate/Professional, SysOps Administrator or DevOps Engineer Professional). 
 - Experience with SFTP/EFS-based file integrations and data migration infrastructure. 

Join Recruiterflow and own the infrastructure that powers recruitment for thousands of agencies worldwide!

The team builds core cloud platform services that power provisioning, lifecycle management, and runtime operations of Teradata compute infrastructure across public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud). These highly reliable, scalable, and automated infrastructure services are used by multiple engineering teams and enterprise customers.

 - Platform services for orchestration, scaling, and configuration management across public cloud platforms.

 - Secure and reliable connectivity enablement for cloud-deployed compute systems. We are looking for a candidate to join our fast-paced and cutting-edge development organization that is on the forefront of our "Teradata Everywhere" strategy. 

Teradata Labs, the technology research and development (R&D) organization within Teradata Corporation, has been turning innovative decision support technology into business results for over 30 years. Our R&D team of analytic architects, database developers and engineers work to understand and advance emerging technologies to invent the next wave of cutting-edge analytic data solutions.

The position involves leading one or more software engineering teams responsible for the development, integration, functional and performance testing, and fault analysis of our cloud platform services across public cloud environments. The manager will be responsible for:

CTS Group/CTS Asia - Part of CTS Group is hiring Electrical Design Engineer (HV/MV) for its growing Data Center engineering & delivery teams in Oragadam, Chennai.

About CTS Group

CTS Group is a fast-growing international design and build company specialising in data center development across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). We combine engineering excellence, innovation, and digital transformation to deliver high-performance, sustainable, and future-ready data center solutions. 

With over 40 nationalities represented across our teams, CTS fosters a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance culture where innovation and technical precision drive every project. Beyond construction, CTS develops digital systems and standardised modular data center units to meet the evolving needs of hyperscalers, colocation providers, and enterprise clients. 

Our proven track record and strong partnerships have established CTS as a trusted industry leader delivering large-scale, complex data center facilities with speed, efficiency, and excellence. 

Role Overview

The Electrical Engineer (HV/MV) leads the high- and medium-voltage electrical scope for CTS Group's Chennai production campus, where standardised modular data center units are engineered and manufactured. The role owns the design, specification, and integration of HV/MV power distribution systems, from incoming supply through switchgear, transformers, and protection, ensuring every unit is safe, reliable, and compliant before dispatch. 

Working across the engineering, production, and quality teams, the role provides technical direction to a team of electrical engineers and designers, and interfaces with vendors, consultants, and commissioning teams. It combines hands-on design ownership with day-to-day leadership of the electrical function on the campus. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design and specification of HV/MV power distribution systems for modular data center units and campus infrastructure, including switchgear, transformers, ring main units, protection, and earthing. 
 - Prepare and review electrical calculations and studies (load flow, short-circuit, protection coordination, cable sizing, earthing) along with single-line diagrams and layouts. 
 - Define technical requirements and specifications for HV/MV equipment, and review vendor submittals and drawings for compliance. 
 - Coordinate the electrical scope with mechanical, controls, structural, and production teams to ensure designs are buildable within the campus manufacturing process. 
 - Oversee Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) of switchgear and power equipment, and support site acceptance testing and commissioning as required. 
 - Ensure designs comply with applicable standards (IEC, IS, NFPA) and client technical requirements, and maintain accurate design documentation and as-builts. 
 - Manage and mentor a team of electrical engineers and designers, setting technical standards and reviewing deliverables for quality and consistency. 
 - Support root-cause analysis of electrical issues during production and testing, and drive corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Liaise with utilities, consultants, and clients on HV/MV interfaces, approvals, and technical clarifications. 
 - Contribute to standardisation, value engineering, and continuous improvement of the modular electrical design. 

Required Skills and Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering; a Master's degree is an advantage. 
 - 3+ years of electrical engineering experience with a strong focus on HV/MV power systems, including experience in a managerial or team-lead capacity. 
 - Proven expertise in HV/MV distribution design, covering switchgear, transformers, protection and control, earthing, and cabling. 
 - Hands-on experience with power system studies and tools such as ETAP or equivalent for load flow, short-circuit, and protection coordination. 
 - Experience in data center, industrial, manufacturing, or EPC environments; exposure to modular or prefabricated builds is preferred. 
 - Sound knowledge of relevant standards (IEC, IS, NFPA) and safety practices for HV/MV systems. 
 - Experience with FAT/SAT, commissioning support, and vendor and contractor management. 
 - Proficiency in AutoCAD and electrical design documentation; familiarity with Revit is an advantage. 
 - Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to lead a team in a fast-paced production environment.

 - Database modelling, query design, and API integration.

 - Cloud deployment understanding and practical troubleshooting.

data.description:
Company Description We are a pharmaceutical manufacturer specializing in both large-volume parenterals (LVPs) and small-volume parenterals (SVPs), including ophthalmic solutions. Our focus is on producing high-quality sterile injectable products that support patient care across a range of clinical settings. Candidates joining our organization will work in an environment that values regulatory compliance, product integrity, and continuous process improvement. Team members collaborate closely across functions to ensure safe, effective, and reliable products reach healthcare providers and patients. 
Role Description The Quality Assurance Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Ujjain. This position is responsible for overseeing day-to-day quality assurance activities, including reviewing and approving batch records, SOPs, and quality documentation, as well as ensuring adherence to GMP and regulatory requirements for LVPs, SVPs, and ophthalmic solutions. The role includes managing quality audits, deviations, CAPAs, change controls, and risk assessments, while collaborating with production, QC, and regulatory teams to resolve issues and improve processes. The Quality Assurance Manager will lead and mentor QA staff, support training on quality systems and standards, monitor key quality metrics, and drive initiatives that strengthen product quality, compliance, and operational efficiency. 
Qualifications

- Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical quality systems, GMP guidelines, and regulatory requirements for sterile/ parenteral manufacturing. 
 - Experience managing QA operations, including batch record review, deviation handling, CAPA, change control, and internal/external audits. 
 - Ability to lead and develop teams, coordinate cross-functional activities, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Proficiency in documentation practices, quality risk assessment, and use of quality management software or electronic QMS tools. 
 - Bachelor's or master's degree in Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Chemistry, or a related scientific discipline. 
 - Prior experience in sterile injectables, parenterals, or ophthalmic solutions manufacturing is highly desirable. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with attention to detail and a focus on continuous improvement. 
 - Ability to work on-site in Ujjain and collaborate in a structured, regulated manufacturing environment.

Controls Engineer
