About Inova

Inova is a global provider of innovative data center infrastructure solutions, delivering cutting-edge technologies across AI infrastructure, cooling solutions, and next-generation data center environments. We are committed to building reliable, scalable, and sustainable solutions that help customers operate mission-critical infrastructure efficiently. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Controls Engineer with 4-6 years of experience to develop, test, commission, and troubleshoot control systems for data center liquid-cooling equipment. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in PLC programming, HMI development, PID control, instrumentation, and industrial communication protocols, with the ability to translate control requirements into reliable and robust equipment sequences. 

The role will own assigned controls deliverables and work closely with the Lead Controls Engineer, electrical design, and project teams throughout the design, testing, and commissioning lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and troubleshoot PLC applications for liquid-cooling equipment, including operating sequences, pump duty/standby control, automatic changeover, interlocks, and fault handling. 
 - Implement and tune PID control loops for temperature, pressure, and flow regulation. 
 - Develop HMI screens for equipment operation, monitoring, alarms, trends, and diagnostics. 
 - Configure and integrate communication protocols such as Modbus TCP/RTU, Ethernet, and SNMP. 
 - Select and configure field instrumentation, including temperature sensors, pressure transmitters, flow meters, control valves, and variable-frequency drives (VFDs). 
 - Prepare and maintain I/O lists, Functional Design Specifications (FDS), control sequences, alarm lists, communication mappings, and test procedures. 
 - Review electrical schematics, control-panel drawings, bills of materials, and cable schedules in coordination with the electrical design team. 
 - Execute Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and support Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, and troubleshooting activities. 
 - Validate equipment response to sensor faults, communication loss, pump failure, power restoration, and other operating conditions against approved control requirements. 
 - Maintain software backups, revision records, commissioning reports, and as-built documentation. Essential Skills

- 4-6 years of practical experience in PLC programming, HMI development, controls engineering, and commissioning. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with at least one PLC/controller platform, preferably Schneider Electric or Siemens. 
 - Proficiency in Structured Text, with working knowledge of Ladder Logic and/or Function Block Diagram. 
 - Hands-on experience with PID control, pumps, VFDs, instrumentation, and automated equipment sequences. 
 - Good understanding of industrial communication protocols, including Modbus TCP/RTU, Ethernet, and SNMP. 
 - Experience developing and troubleshooting control logic, interlocks, alarms, and equipment fault-handling sequences. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively during testing and commissioning activities. 
 - Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and control-panel drawings. Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Automation, Mechatronics, or a related discipline. 
 - Experience working with liquid-cooling systems, HVAC/chilled-water systems, data center infrastructure, or other industrial cooling equipment is a plus. 
 - Experience participating in FAT, SAT, equipment commissioning, and site troubleshooting is preferred. 
 - Relevant hands-on experience may be considered in lieu of formal qualifications.

data.description:
Are you looking for a unique opportunity to be a part of something great? Want to join a 17, 000-member team that works on the technology that powers the world around us? Microchip's nationally-recognized Leadership Passage Programs support career growth where we proudly enroll over a thousand people annually. We take pride in our commitment to employee development, values-based decision making, and strong sense of community, driven by our Vision, Mission, and 11 Guiding Values; we affectionately refer to it as the Aggregate System and it's won us countless awards for diversity and workplace excellence. 

Our company is built by dedicated team players who love to challenge the status quo; we did not achieve record revenue and over 30 years of quarterly profitability without a great team dedicated to empowering innovation. People like you. 

Visit our careers page to see what exciting opportunities and company perks await!

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Engineer I - Validation for Microchip's MCU division to support validation and characterization of 8, 16 and 32- bit microcontrollers. 

Microchip is a world leader in 8, 16, and 32- bit microcontrollers. The Validation Engineer position is focused on helping with development of our digital and parametric testing infrastructure. Significant time will be spent developing test cases, performing lab bench experiments, and assisting other team members in the validation of 8, 16 and 32- bit microcontrollers at unit and system-level. This position is based in Bangalore or Chennai, India. As a Validation Engineer, you will work with worldwide teams located in France, USA, Philippines, India and other corporate team members. 

- Develop and implement functional, performance and system level/use-case validation of 8, 16 and 32- bit microcontrollers
 - Experience with Microcontrollers, FPGAs, and in general, Embedded Systems. Familiar with embedded ARM Cortex M family, RISC-V, MIPS is preferred
 - Experience with communication buses (SPI/QSPI, I2C, I2S, USB, EBI, Ethernet, GPIB, RS-232, RS-485, etc. ). 
 - Experience with Embedded firmware development and should have strong hands-on knowledge of Embedded C programming language
 - Candidate will have the primary role of creating, auditing, and overseeing test procedures, validation plans, data collection, post-processing of validation data, reports, and documenting results. 
 - Candidate should be familiar with using lab equipment such as Oscilloscopes, Logic Analyzers, Power Supplies, Arbitrary Waveform and Pulse generators, etc. 
 - Proficient in interpreting PCB schematics and PCB layouts. 
 - Develop performance tests for determining circuit margin and datasheet parameters. 
 - Develop automated lab-based testing of microcontroller for both digital and analog modules at the unit level and at the full chip level and should be able to troubleshoot and resolve issues found during validation
 - Design or assist in the development of new testing infrastructure for use within the validation team
 - Drive design recommendations to improve the validation process, such as enhancements to test software and hardware environments, lab equipment usage, and data management. 
 - Work with the validation team on customer support requests for released products. 
 - Work in an international environment (Europe, Asia, USA) with diverse functional groups (Architecture, Analog/Digital Design, Verification, Emulation, Applications, Marketing, Product and Test Engineering). 

Requirements/Qualifications

- Experience with Clock subsystem and Reset subsystems (BOR, POR, Bandgap, WDT etc. ) and exposure to Analog peripherals (ADCs, DACs, Comparators, Op-AMPs, CTMU). 
 - Exposure to bench automation tools (NI Tools - LabView/TestStand) and scripting languages is add-on
 - Experience in application development, system level test development
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving / debug skills. Code and System debugging skills using in-circuit emulators and lab equipment such as oscilloscope/logic analyzer. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Able to work well in a team environment and adapt real-time. 
 - Able to think of test cases and customer usage model that may violate the assumptions of designers and architects. 
 - Able to prioritize tasks and execute to rigorous and dynamic schedules. 
 - Able to understand and generate board schematics, board design - schematic entry, BOM creation, net list generation (logical board design)
 - Comprehensive record keeping and detailed debugging notes. 

Qualification

Bachelor's degree in Electrical / Electronics or Computer Engineering (or equivalent) with at least 5 to 7 years of related work experience. 

Travel Time

No Travel

To all recruitment agencies: Microchip Technology Inc. does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our recruiting team or other Microchip employees. Microchip is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

data.title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Here at OCI we're building the world's largest AI clusters and we're the fastest at bringing them to the market. The AI Infrastructure organization at OCI is leading this effort by creating a GPU focused cloud with the latest hardware providing the best performance, efficiency, reliability, and scalability. This is your chance to be part of the AI revolution by creating systems that allow customers to scale from tens to thousands of GPUs without compromising performance. You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and make a significant impact on our organization's success. 

We are looking for a highly skilled distributed systems engineer to scale and optimize AI infrastructure components like GPU control plane and GPU data plane that provide computing resources to customer AI workloads. You will provide technical leadership to the team and bring clarity to ambiguous problems and come up with innovative solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance our AI infrastructure to deliver exceptional customer experience and peak performance

Responsibilities

- Design and develop solutions to scale and optimize AI compute infrastructure components like GPU control plane and GPU data plane with the goal to optimize customer experience and customer workload performance on our AI infrastructure. 
 - Develop "best-in-class" AI compute infrastructure for our customers by ensuring that the services and the components are well-defined and modularized, secure, reliable, diagnosable, actively monitored, compliant and reusable. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including development, operations, and product management, to understand their requirements and design innovative orchestration solutions. 
 - Mentor junior developers and drive modern software engineering practices like leveraging data/telemetry to make decisions, well-defined interfaces across components, design reviews, coding standards, code reviews, and comprehensive coverage from unit test, integration test and active production monitoring. 
 - Develop benchmark metrics and automation to drive and track performance and reliability across customer workload and lower infrastructure stack. 

Qualifications & Skills

- BS (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 
 - 5+ years of experience in software development with programming languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, Go, Rust. 
 - 3 years of experience designing and developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems, and services. 
 - 1 year of experience providing technical leadership and clarity to cross-functional teams and projects while collaborating across stake holders. 
 - Systematic problem-solving approach, strong communication skills, a sense of ownership, and drive. 
 - Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in managing cloud infrastructure with hundreds of thousands of servers. 
 - Experience in containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience in scheduling high-performance workloads on Kubernetes or Slurm. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

data.title: Sr. Data QA Engineer
data.description:
Sr. QA Data Engineer

Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Location: Remote - Pan India

Shift Timings: 11: 00 AM - 08: 00 PM IST

Reporting To: Sr. Technical Manager / Director of Engineering, as assigned by Management

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Sr. QA Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team and take ownership of the quality, accuracy, consistency, and reliability of data pipelines and data-driven systems. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in Data Testing, ETL/ELT Testing, 

Database Testing, SQL, Python, Apache Spark, and Databricks. The candidate should be comfortable validating complex data transformations, investigating data discrepancies, and testing end-to-end data workflows across multiple sources, processing layers, and downstream systems. 

You will work closely with Data Engineers, Software Engineers, Database Architects, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product teams to ensure data is processed correctly and delivered reliably to downstream consumers. 

This role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to independently understand complex data flows, develop comprehensive test strategies, automate data validation, investigate defects, and drive quality across the data engineering ecosystem. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and execute functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing for data pipelines and data platforms. 
 - Validate ETL/ELT workflows, data transformations, business rules, and source-to-target data accuracy. 
 - Test Apache Spark/PySpark, Databricks, and Delta Lake data processing workflows. 
 - Perform advanced SQL-based data validation, reconciliation, and data-quality testing. 
 - Validate data for accuracy, completeness, consistency, uniqueness, integrity, and schema compliance. 
 - Test APIs and integrations across data sources, databases, pipelines, and downstream systems. 
 - Develop and maintain Python/SQL-based test automation for data validation and regression testing. 
 - Design and execute positive, negative, edge-case, failure, retry, and recovery scenarios across data workflows. 
 - Investigate data discrepancies and work with Data Engineers, Developers, Analysts, and Data Scientists to identify root causes and resolve issues. 
 - Review requirements, technical designs, and data flows to identify QA risks, dependencies, and coverage gaps early in the development lifecycle. 
 - Maintain comprehensive test cases, automation suites, defect documentation, test evidence, and release validation for assigned data products. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of QA processes, data validation frameworks, automation coverage, and overall data quality. 

Required Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. 
 - 5+ years of relevant QA/testing experience, preferably working with Data Engineering, Big Data, or data-intensive applications. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in ETL/ELT testing, database testing, and data validation. 
 - Advanced SQL skills, including: 
 - Complex joins
 - Subqueries
 - CTEs
 - Window functions
 - Aggregations
 - Data reconciliation
 - Practical experience testing Apache Spark/PySpark data processing workflows. 
 - Hands-on experience with Databricks and Delta Lake. 
 - Strong understanding of Big Data concepts, distributed data processing, data pipelines, and data architecture. 
 - Experience validating Parquet, JSON, CSV, and other structured and semi-structured data formats. 
 - Strong Python programming/scripting skills for test automation and data validation. 
 - Experience with API and integration testing. 
 - Working knowledge of Linux/Unix environments and shell scripting. 
 - Understanding of: 
 - Data Lakes
 - Lakehouse Architecture
 - Data Warehousing
 - ETL/ELT Pipelines
 - Experience with Git, defect management tools, and CI/CD-based testing workflows. 
 - Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.

data.title: Lead Quality Analyst - Finance Systems
data.description:
Hello, 

FCM part of FCTG is one of the world's largest travel management companies and a trusted partner for nationals and multinational companies. With a 24/7 reach in 97 countries, FCM's flexible technology anticipates and solves client needs, supported by experts who provide in-depth local knowledge and duty of care as part of the ultimate personalised business travel experience. 

As part of the ASX-listed Flight Centre Travel Group, FCM delivers the best market-wide rates, unique added-value benefits, and exclusive solutions. 

Winner of the World's Leading Travel Management Company Award at the WTM for nine consecutive years (2019-2011), FCM is constantly transforming the business of travel through its empowered and accountable people who deliver 24/7 service and are available online and offline. FCM has won the coveted Great Place to Work certification for the fifth time! FCM Travel India is one of India's Top 100 Great Mid-size Workplaces 2024 and the Best in Professional Services. 

A leader in the travel tech space, FCM has proprietary client solutions. FCM provides specialist services via FCM Consulting and FCM Meetings & Events. 

Day in the life: 

You will be the finance testing expert inside our internal QA team, running point on finance for every migration from here. You won't be expected to know each market on day one. You will need to engage each market, understand their nuances and requirements, then make sure the system delivers them. 

You'll be perfect for the role if you have: 

What You Will Own

- Finance testing scope for each migration market
 - Functional, end-to-end, integration and user acceptance testing across accounts payable, accounts receivable, credit control, general ledger and billing
 - Performance and usability checks on high-volume processes such as billing runs, payment files and month-end
 - Defects from first log to final retest, working with developers, product owners and functional consultants
 - Quality audits of test evidence, including work done by the third-party provider
 - Clear readiness reporting that tells the program whether finance is good to go, and what needs fixing if it isn't
 - Reusable regression packs and test data, so each migration is quicker than the last

Requirement

You will finish each migration with a market that works and a playbook that makes the next one easier. 

- You have led a team or workstream
 - You have led testing on an ERP or finance system migration and seen it through go-live
 - Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Azure DevOps experience will give you a head start
 - You understand how finance processes hang together, or you pick it up fast and ask the right questions
 - Your test documentation is clear enough that someone else can pick it up and run with it
 - You stay calm and precise when a go-live date is close and the defect list is not
 - You are comfortable managing a vendor and pushing back when the work isn't up to standard

Travel industry experience isn't needed. Attention to detail and the drive to get it right are. 

Work Perks! - What's in it for you: 

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It's also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm. 

You will be rewarded with competitive market salary. You will also be equipped with relevant training courses and tools to set you up for success with endless career advancement and job opportunities all over the world. 

Market Aligned remuneration structure and a highly competitive salary

Fun and Energetic culture: At the heart of everything we do at FCM is a desire to have fun and be yourself

Work life Balance: We believe in "No Leave = No Life" So have your own travel adventures with paid annual leave

Great place to work - Recognized as a top workplace for 5 consecutive years, which is a testimonial of our commitment towards our people

Wellbeing Focus - We take care of our employee with comprehensive medical coverage, accidental insurance, and term insurance for the well being of our people. 

Paternity Leave: We ensure that you can spend quality time with your growing family

Travel perks: You'll have access to plenty of industry discounts to ensure you continue to broaden your horizons

A career, not a job: We believe in our people brightness of future. As a high growth company, you will have the opportunity to advance your career in any direction you choose whether that is locally or globally. 

Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!

Love for travel: We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can't miss in our people or service. 

We value you. . . 

Flight Centre Travel Group is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace that supports your unique identity to create better, safer experiences for everyone. We encourage you to come as you are; to foster inclusivity and collaboration. We celebrate you. 

Who We Are. . . 

Since our beginning, our vision has always been to open up the world for those who want to see. 

As a global travel retailer, our people come from all different backgrounds, and our connections spread to the far reaches of the globe - 20+ countries and counting! Together, we are a family (we call ourselves Flighties). 

We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve. We embrace new experiences, we celebrate the wins, seize all opportunities, and empower all of our people to find their Brightness of Future. 

We encourage you to DREAM BIG through collaboration and innovation, and make sure you are supported to make incredible ideas a reality. Together, we deliver quality, innovative solutions that delight our customers and achieve our strategic priorities. 

Irreverence. Ownership. Egalitarianism

data.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead DevOps Engineer based in India. 

As a Lead DevOps Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in building scalable, secure, and reliable infrastructure that supports enterprise applications and accelerates software delivery. You will lead the design and implementation of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and cloud optimization strategies across development, testing, and production environments. Leveraging AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, and Infrastructure as Code technologies, you will streamline deployment processes and strengthen operational resilience. You will collaborate with development, quality assurance, and operations teams to improve system performance, security, and release efficiency. In this leadership role, you will establish DevOps best practices, mentor engineers, and drive continuous improvement across the technology ecosystem. This fully remote opportunity combines technical leadership, cloud innovation, and cross-functional collaboration in a dynamic, globally connected environment. 

Accountabilities

- CI/CD Pipeline Development and Management: Design, implement, maintain, and optimize continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines for enterprise applications. Improve automation, deployment consistency, release speed, and software delivery reliability using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, and Azure DevOps. 
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and management using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, and AWS CloudFormation. Develop reusable infrastructure components that improve scalability, consistency, and operational efficiency. 
 - DevOps Strategy and Leadership: Define and lead DevOps practices across development, quality assurance, and production environments. Establish technical standards, deployment strategies, and operational guidelines aligned with business and engineering objectives. 
 - Cloud Infrastructure Management: Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure and related services, ensuring high availability, scalability, security, and performance across cloud-based environments. 
 - Containerization and Orchestration: Oversee containerized application deployments using Docker and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes or Docker Swarm. Improve application portability, resource utilization, and deployment reliability. 
 - Monitoring and Performance Optimization: Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and observability solutions using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and the ELK Stack. Analyze system performance, identify bottlenecks, troubleshoot incidents, and implement improvements to maintain service availability. 
 - Security and Compliance: Integrate security controls and governance requirements into automated workflows. Apply best practices for networking, firewalls, access management, and security protocols while supporting compliance with relevant organizational standards. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with development, QA, and operations teams to streamline deployment workflows, resolve infrastructure challenges, and improve coordination throughout the software delivery lifecycle. 
 - Incident Management and Troubleshooting: Investigate and resolve deployment failures, infrastructure issues, and production incidents across cloud and on-premises environments. Identify root causes and implement preventive measures to reduce recurring problems. 
 - Continuous Improvement and Cost Optimization: Identify opportunities to improve release management, infrastructure efficiency, automation coverage, and cloud spending. Evaluate emerging technologies and practices to strengthen system reliability and operational performance. 
 - Team Mentorship: Guide and mentor junior engineers, share technical expertise, promote DevOps best practices, and encourage a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning. 

Requirements

- Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience, supported by relevant academic or vocational qualifications. 
 - Professional Experience: At least 8 years of relevant experience in DevOps, systems engineering, infrastructure automation, cloud operations, or related technical disciplines. 
 - AWS Expertise: Strong proficiency in AWS and its associated services, including experience designing, deploying, managing, and optimizing cloud infrastructure for enterprise applications. 
 - CI/CD Engineering: Extensive experience building, managing, and optimizing CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Proven experience implementing infrastructure automation and configuration management using Terraform, Ansible, or comparable tools. 
 - Containerization and Orchestration: Strong hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes, including container lifecycle management, application deployment, and orchestration. 
 - Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar scripting languages to automate operational tasks, infrastructure provisioning, and deployment workflows. 
 - Monitoring and Observability: Experience with monitoring, logging, and performance analysis tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and the ELK Stack, with the ability to diagnose issues and improve system reliability. 
 - Networking and Security: Solid understanding of networking concepts, firewalls, security protocols, and infrastructure security practices, with the ability to integrate security and governance controls into automated environments. 
 - DevOps Strategy: Demonstrated ability to establish and improve DevOps processes, standardize deployment practices, and support reliable software delivery across multiple environments. 
 - Leadership and Mentorship: Experience leading technical initiatives, coordinating cross-functional teams, mentoring junior engineers, and promoting engineering standards and best practices. 
 - Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong troubleshooting, analytical reasoning, and decision-making abilities, particularly when addressing complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges. 
 - Communication and Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with development, QA, security, and operations stakeholders in distributed teams. 
 - Agile and DevSecOps Practices: Familiarity with agile methodologies and DevSecOps principles is an advantage. 
 - Additional Technical Experience: Knowledge of GitOps and ArgoCD, service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd, serverless architectures, and cloud cost optimization is desirable. 
 - Compliance Knowledge: Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001 is beneficial. 
 - Working Hours: Availability to work from 5: 30 p. m. to 2: 30 a. m. India Standard Time (IST) to support the required operational schedule. 

Benefits

- Fully Remote Work: Opportunity to work remotely from India. 
 - Technical Leadership: Lead DevOps initiatives and influence infrastructure architecture, automation strategies, and software delivery practices. 
 - Modern Technology Stack: Work with AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD platforms, and advanced monitoring tools. 
 - Professional Development: Expand your expertise in cloud engineering, infrastructure automation, security, and modern DevOps methodologies. 
 - Leadership Growth: Mentor engineers, shape technical standards, and develop your leadership capabilities. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with diverse technical teams to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable enterprise solutions.

Develop comprehensive test suites covering frontend applications, backend services, APIs, and contract compatibility to ensure reliable platform behavior as products evolve. 
 - AI and LLM Quality Assurance: Create specialized testing strategies for nondeterministic AI systems, including statistical assertions across repeated runs, semantic similarity evaluation, confidence-threshold validation, and techniques for distinguishing model variability from genuine software regressions. 
 - Workflow Reliability and Resilience Testing: Validate long-running, asynchronous, and event-driven workflows through failure injection, retry scenarios, worker termination, provider outages, idempotency checks, and eventual-consistency assertions. Verify durable execution and appropriate compensation mechanisms during failures. 
 - Multi-Tenant Security and Isolation: Develop automated tests to identify cross-tenant data exposure, configuration leakage, and inaccurate cost attribution. Validate execution sandboxing, network restrictions, and access controls to ensure platform security and tenant isolation. 
 - Adversarial and AI Security Testing: Build and maintain adversarial test datasets to identify prompt injection, tool-call manipulation, unauthorized actions, and potential data exfiltration. Align testing practices with recognized AI security frameworks, including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. 
 - Human-in-the-Loop Validation: Verify that confidence thresholds trigger the appropriate escalation procedures and that restricted or irreversible actions cannot proceed without the required human authorization. 
 - Evaluation Infrastructure and Test Data: Collaborate with AI evaluation teams to build golden-dataset-driven validation processes, synthetic-data generation pipelines, and repeatable evaluation infrastructure. Ensure datasets are reliable, measurable, and suitable for ongoing regression testing. 
 - Performance and Non-Functional Testing: Automate verification of latency, invocation overhead, concurrency, queue backpressure, and AI provider failover times. Analyze performance trends across releases and identify opportunities to improve system efficiency and resilience. 
 - Observability and Trace Validation: Use tools such as Langfuse and OpenTelemetry to validate trace completeness, token usage, cost accounting, and anomaly detection. Incorporate observability data into automated testing and troubleshooting workflows. 
 - CI/CD Integration and Release Quality Gates: Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent tools. Establish mandatory release gates, automate regression detection, and flag metric-level quality issues during pull requests and deployments. 
 - Quality Evidence and Stakeholder Collaboration: Produce reproducible, auditable test reports and evidence packages to support client milestone approvals. Communicate testing outcomes, risks, and quality assessments clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Architecture and Testability: Partner with AI and platform engineers from the design stage to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and incorporate observability and quality considerations into system architecture. 
 - Environment Management and Mentorship: Maintain test environments, mocked AI providers, and synthetic data generators to enable efficient and cost-effective testing. Mentor mid-level QA engineers, develop reusable testing frameworks, and contribute to shared quality engineering practices. 

Requirements

- Professional Experience: At least 8 years of experience in test automation, API testing, and developing reusable test frameworks adopted by engineering teams. 
 - Automation Expertise: Strong proficiency in Playwright and TypeScript is mandatory, with demonstrated experience designing comprehensive automated test suites and integrating them into secure, reliable CI/CD pipelines. 
 - AI and LLM Testing: Hands-on experience testing LLM-powered or other nondeterministic systems, including statistical assertions, semantic scoring, prompt sensitivity, model variability, and evaluation of common Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) failure modes. Candidates should be able to demonstrate practical examples of these testing approaches. 
 - Asynchronous Systems: Experience testing event-driven architectures, distributed workflows, and background processing systems. Strong knowledge of failure injection, idempotency, retries, and eventual consistency is required; experience with Temporal or a comparable workflow engine is a significant advantage. 
 - CI/CD and Release Management: Proven ability to integrate automated testing into continuous integration and delivery pipelines, preferably using GitHub Actions or equivalent tools. Experience defining release gates and making informed quality decisions under tight deadlines is essential. 
 - Database and Data Validation: Solid SQL skills, experience validating data integrity, and the ability to develop synthetic test-data pipelines and assess dataset quality. 
 - Security Testing: A security-focused mindset with experience in adversarial testing, application security, or prompt-injection testing. Candidates should be comfortable identifying vulnerabilities and developing effective negative test scenarios. 
 - Analytical and Evaluation Skills: Strong statistical and analytical capabilities, including interpreting evaluation scores, identifying behavioral patterns, and providing actionable feedback to AI engineers for model and prompt improvements. 
 - Quality Judgment and Communication: Demonstrated ability to determine acceptable quality thresholds under delivery pressure, assess technical risks, and defend testing evidence and release recommendations to non-engineering stakeholders. 
 - Performance Testing: Familiarity with performance and load-testing tools such as k6 or Locust is an advantage, particularly for validating concurrency, latency, and high-volume background processing. 
 - AI Observability and Evaluation Tools: Exposure to tools such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Promptfoo, DeepEval, or Arize Phoenix is desirable. 
 - Multi-Tenant SaaS Experience: Previous experience testing tenant isolation, access controls, and data separation in multi-tenant SaaS platforms is beneficial. 
 - Compliance and Accessibility: Experience producing compliance evidence for frameworks or regulations such as SOC 2 and GDPR, or performing accessibility testing against Section 508 or WCAG standards, is an advantage. 
 - Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with commercial real estate workflows, lease accounting, common area maintenance (CAM) reconciliation, document extraction, OCR, or document layout parsing is beneficial. 
 - Advanced Testing Practices: Experience using LLMs to generate test cases, adversarial payloads, or synthetic documents is an advantage. Familiarity with qTest for test management is also desirable. 
 - Collaboration and Mentorship: Strong communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate across engineering disciplines, share expertise, and promote consistent quality practices. 
 - Work Arrangement: Willingness to work remotely from India and collaborate effectively with distributed international teams. 

Benefits

The Role: Backend Java Software Developer

The Team

A full-scale microservices transformation of the S&P Global's Financial Risk Analytics product, pre-AI, was expected to require a large pool of technology roles across architecture, engineering, platform, security, operations, and delivery. 

For the initial FRA prototype transformation, we want to stand up a lean, generative-AI enabled transformation squad with a focused team structure sized to deliver a validated microservices foundation. 

The objective is to establish an agile technology transformation group to design and deliver a commercially aligned, targeted microservices architecture for the FRA platform, prioritizing measurable business outcomes and rapid learnings. 

Responsibilities And Impact

Backend Engineer (Microservices Transformation)

- Play a central role in building the organisation's next-generation digital platform, developing microservices and backend components that power interactive and near-real-time customer experiences. 
 - Design and deliver high-quality domain microservices, REST/ GraphQL APIs, and event-driven integrations that enable scalable, decoupled, and future-ready systems. 
 - Engineer robust asynchronous workflows and event consumers/producers, helping create resilient services that perform reliably in complex distributed environments. 
 - Own the design and optimisation of service-owned data stores, supporting performance, scalability, and the successful migration of data from legacy monolithic platforms. 
 - Drive engineering excellence through unit testing, integration testing, performance tuning, and active code review, ensuring every release meets high standards of quality and maintainability. 
 - Contribute to operational confidence by monitoring live services, resolving incidents, and continuously improving observability to support secure, stable, and high-performing production systems. 

What We're Looking For

Basic Required Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may also be considered.

Key Soft Skills

- Collaborative problem-solving - Success in a microservices environment depends on working effectively across engineering, product, platform, and architecture teams. This role needs someone who can solve issues collectively, contribute constructively in design discussions, and build strong technical partnerships.

Additional key qualifications for the job

- Kubernetes

Engineers need to understand how services, containers, infrastructure, queues, events, and data flows interact so they can anticipate downstream impact, design more resilient solutions, and troubleshoot effectively across the whole system rather than just their own code.

Engineers must communicate clearly with platform teams, other service owners, and product stakeholders to avoid misunderstanding around APIs, event schemas, ownership, deployment changes, and incident response.

The role needs someone who can learn fast, absorb new patterns, and adjust to changing tooling, operating models, and migration realities without losing delivery momentum.

Engineers need to stay calm under pressure, work methodically through ambiguity, and make sound decisions during incidents to protect service reliability and business continuity.

data.title: Lead Quality Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use): 

11

The Role: Lead Quality Engineer

The Team

Enterprise Solutions (ES) Technology brings together data, software, services, and expertise to deliver innovative solutions for global financial markets. The team works closely with customers to help them manage complex business, regulatory, and risk requirements. 

Financial Risk Analytics (FRA), part of Enterprise Solutions, delivers information-centric capital markets and risk solutions for trading desks and their risk-management partners. Its products support counterparty credit risk, xVA, and market risk for both buy-side and sell-side institutions. 

We are seeking a Lead Quality Engineer to join the FRA Technology team. Quality Engineering is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle and spans application, analytics, data, integration, and platform layers. The successful candidate will help evolve QA from a primarily validation-focused function into a proactive, automation-first, engineering-led capability. 

The Impact

As a Lead Quality Engineer, you will own and influence the quality strategy across the software delivery lifecycle-from requirements and solution design through development, release, and production support. You will partner with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Operations, and Customer Support teams to identify risks early, improve test coverage, increase release confidence, and promote shared accountability for quality. 

This role requires strong technical expertise, a solid understanding of financial risk platforms, and the ability to lead quality initiatives across agile delivery teams. 

Responsibilities

- Own and continuously improve the quality strategy across the full software development lifecycle, embedding effective quality gates from requirements and design through release and production support. 
 - Shift quality engineering from defect detection to defect prevention by identifying risks, control gaps, and testability concerns early in the delivery process. 
 - Lead the design, development, and evolution of scalable automated test frameworks covering UI, API, data, integration, regression, and other relevant testing areas. 
 - Develop, execute, and maintain comprehensive test suites based on software requirements, technical specifications, business workflows, and real-world customer usage. 
 - Drive risk-based testing for financial risk platforms, prioritising coverage for regulatory workflows, calculation accuracy, data integrity, security controls, system integration, and customer-critical journeys. 
 - Design and implement test automation using Java, Python, Selenium, Cucumber, Carina, and other appropriate technologies and frameworks. 
 - Establish and monitor quality engineering standards and metrics, including automation coverage, defect leakage, release readiness, test reliability, environment stability, and production incident feedback. 
 - Champion continuous testing within CI/CD pipelines by integrating reliable and efficient automated validation into build, deployment, and release processes. 
 - Improve release confidence and operational resilience by validating deployment readiness, rollback capability, observability, environment consistency, and applicable non-functional requirements. 
 - Lead quality governance for agile teams, ensuring that acceptance criteria, test evidence, sign-offs, and release risks are clearly documented, auditable, and decision-ready. 
 - Manage and support QA and UAT environments, build deployments, test data, test execution, release planning, and testing sign-off activities. 
 - Partner with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Operations, and Customer Support to resolve quality issues and strengthen end-to-end software reliability. 
 - Collaborate with business stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand business impact and translate workflow complexity and customer needs into effective test coverage. 
 - Use AI and modern engineering practices to improve QA productivity through intelligent test generation, defect analysis, regression optimisation, log analysis, and test data creation. 
 - Mentor QA engineers and influence developers to build quality into their work by promoting automation, code quality, testability, maintainability, and shared ownership. 
 - Perform gap analysis across application and platform test coverage and define remediation plans to address identified risks. 
 - Balance manual and automated testing based on delivery needs, while continuously moving toward automation-first and analytics-driven quality engineering. 
 - Act as a technical leader and subject-matter expert, proactively resolving issues, managing risks, and escalating concerns appropriately. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may also be considered. 
 - 10 plus years of work experience across software quality engineering and end-to-end testing activities, including experience in a technical leadership or lead QA capacity. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with automation and white-box testing using Java, Python, or both. 
 - Experience designing and maintaining test automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, Carina, or equivalent web-testing frameworks. 
 - Demonstrated experience with API and web services testing, including the development or use of API automation frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, software testing principles, test design techniques, and quality engineering practices. 
 - Experience with SQL and relational databases; knowledge of PL/SQL, NoSQL databases, and Linux/UNIX environments is desirable. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and working with build and deployment processes. 
 - Understanding of performance, integration, regression, data, security, and non-functional testing practices. 
 - Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex issues across application, data, and platform layers. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present quality risks and recommendations to technical and business stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated ability to work effectively across cross-functional and geographically distributed agile teams. 
 - Ability to operate independently, take ownership, influence engineering decisions, and drive quality improvements across the organisation. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working with capital markets, financial risk analytics, counterparty credit risk, xVA, market risk, or related financial services platforms. 
 - Experience testing calculation-intensive, data-intensive, or regulatory applications. 
 - Knowledge of cloud-deployed applications, containers, microservices, messaging platforms, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience applying AI-enabled tools and modern engineering practices to improve testing efficiency and quality outcomes. 
 - Experience establishing quality metrics, governance processes, and continuous improvement programmes for engineering teams. 

About S&P Global Market Intelligence

At S&P Global Market Intelligence, a division of S&P Global we understand the importance of accurate, deep and insightful information. Our team of experts delivers unrivaled insights and leading data and technology solutions, partnering with customers to expand their perspective, operate with confidence, and make decisions with conviction. 

For more information, visit www. spglobal. com/marketintelligence. 

What's In It For You?

Our Mission

Advancing Essential Intelligence. 

Our People

We're more than 35, 000 strong worldwide-so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all. From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We're committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference. 

Our Values

Integrity, Discovery, Partnership

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals. 

Benefits

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That's why we provide everything you-and your career-need to thrive at S&P Global. 

Our Benefits Include

Job Description: 

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. 

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do - but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here - we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. 

Job Description: 

We are seeking an experienced Engineering Leader to lead the Product Engineering team in India. In this role, you will manage a global team of more than 20 engineers across India and China, with responsibility for delivering new product options (PVR/DTOs), Product change introductions (PCIs), driving continuous product improvement (CPI), and executing material cost reduction initiatives to enhance product competitiveness and business performance. 

The Product Engineering team plays a critical role within the REPS Engineering organization, optimizing global products to meet evolving customer requirements while delivering sustained value to the business. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and develop a global team of more than 20 engineers across India and China, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and technical excellence. 
 - Drive sales growth by enabling timely execution of Product Change Introduction (PCI) initiatives through cross-functional engineering teams. 
 - Lead the development and delivery of Design-to-Order (DTO) solutions for FGW and Caterpillar customers, partnering closely with Product Management and Sales teams to secure and support multi-million-dollar business opportunities. 
 - Deliver continuous product improvements (CPI) that enhance product quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction, with a strong focus on 2MIS and 12MIS performance metrics. 
 - Own and execute the REPS Material Cost Reduction (MCR) strategy, delivering multi-million-dollar annual savings through large-scale, globally coordinated cost optimization projects. 
 - Lead major product updates and lifecycle enhancements for existing products, ensuring technical robustness, compliance, and market competitiveness. 
 - Drive continuous improvement across engineering value streams, improving efficiency, quality, speed of execution, and business outcomes. 
 - Promote effective knowledge sharing, standardization, and best-practice adoption across global engineering teams to maximize organizational capability and scalability. 
 - Build strong partnerships with Product, Sales, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and other key stakeholders to deliver customer-focused solutions and business results. 

What We're Looking For

- Global Leadership: Ability to lead cross-functional teams, build strong partnerships, and influence outcomes across regions. 
 - Effective Communication: Communicate clearly and confidently with stakeholders at all levels. 
 - Problem Solving: Apply structured thinking to solve complex technical and business challenges. 
 - People Development: Build, mentor, and retain a high-performing global engineering team. 
 - Customer Focus: Understand customer needs and business priorities while adapting to changing market demands. 
 - Product Design & Development: Strong knowledge of product design, NPI, and product lifecycle management processes. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Demonstrate a commitment to learning, innovation, and operational excellence. 

Top Candidates Will Have

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical, Electrical, or a related Engineering discipline, with 10+ years of relevant experience. 
 - Proven leadership experience managing teams and delivering complex engineering projects. 
 - Experience in the genset, engine, power generation, or related industries. 
 - Strong knowledge of product development, NPI, and product lifecycle processes. 
 - Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Self-driven, results-oriented, and effective in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Lean and/or Six Sigma experience preferred. 

Additional Information

This mid-level leadership role involves managing product design and development for electric power gensets/energy solutions ranging from 20-2500 kVA under the Caterpillar and FGW brands. You will collaborate with various departments and work closely with our operations facilities in the US, Brazil, China, and India. 

Benefits

 - Relocation Support: Assistance with in-country relocation to Bangalore, India.

 - Work-Life Balance: Flexible work hours and policies to support a healthy work-life balance. 
 - Paid Time Off: Generous vacation, holiday, and sick leave policies. 
 - Employee Assistance Programs: Support for mental health, financial planning, and other personal needs. 
 - Global Exposure: Opportunity to work with a diverse, global team and gain international experience. 
 - Innovative Environment: Be part of a forward-thinking company that values innovation and excellence. 

Company Culture: 

Our company culture is built on a foundation of collaboration, innovation, and excellence. Here are some key aspects: 

- Collaborative Environment: We foster a team-oriented atmosphere where collaboration and open communication are encouraged. Our global teams work together to achieve common goals and drive success. 
 - Innovation-Driven: We value creativity and innovation, constantly seeking new ways to improve our products and processes. Employees are encouraged to think outside the box and contribute their unique ideas. 
 - Commitment to Excellence: We strive for the highest standards in everything we do, from product quality to customer service. Our commitment to excellence drives us to continuously improve and excel in our industry.

 - Professional Growth: We support continuous learning and development, offering opportunities for employees to grow their skills and advance their careers. Mentorship and training programs are available to help employees reach their full potential.

 - Employee Recognition: We recognize and celebrate the achievements and contributions of our employees. Regular feedback and recognition programs ensure that hard work and dedication are acknowledged.

data.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. 

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

The Manager, Data Storage Platforms is responsible for leading a team of platform engineers overseeing the planning, the build, and the operations of data platforms. They will be responsible for architecting, engineering, and optimizing large‐scale, cloud‐native data platforms on AWS and Azure. This role leads development of event‐driven data architectures, CDC frameworks, data lake ingestion pipelines, and scalable ETL/ELT processes. The architect partners closely with cross‐functional teams, leads technical delivery, ensures operational excellence, and provides hands‐on support for global data transformation initiatives. They will be a part of the Data Services Platforms team and provide technological and process expertise and support the global domain data product delivery teams. They will provide leadership by assisting business partners in identifying and responding to opportunities for cost-effective data implementations and solutions by analyzing and making decisions that have cross functional business impact. 

Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of data platform engineers
 - Accountable for strategic planning and technical roadmap development for data platforms. 
 - Oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of data engineering pipelines in a multi-cloud environment, including integrations with a variety of data sources (including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data)
 - Collaborate with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams and other stakeholders in Architecture, Data Integration, DevOps, and Data Governance to deliver data platform initiatives
 - Ensure data engineering standards align with industry best practices for data governance, data quality, and data security. 
 - Monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines, ensuring they meet SLAs for data availability and quality. 
 - Evaluate and recommend new data technologies and tools to improve data engineering processes and outcomes, in collaboration with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams. 
 - Effectively communicate and realize vision and strategy for the organization that aligns with the business and patient needs. 
 - Embrace and embed agile ways of working in support of a fail-fast-learn-fast culture and enabling continual improvement. 
 - Foster a collaborative work environment with strong working relationships within and across businesses and functions, and with strategic external partners. 
 - Manage datasets using Apache Hudi (version 0. 11. x and higher), focusing on supporting near real-time data processing and incremental data loading utilizing cutting-edge features for more efficient data lake management and complex data transformation pipelines
 - Implement the latest versions of Terraform (0. 12. x and higher) to efficiently handle infrastructure changes and versioning with enhanced security and flexibility

Key Experiences & Attributes

- Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or relevant subject area
 - Minimum 5+ years of progressive technical experience in one or more of the cloud-based data warehouse/data lake platforms such as AWS S3, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse. 
 - Significant experience in leading teams in Data & Analytics programs with experience in native digital technologies (cloud, big data and predictive) in organizations driving product development. 
 - Change Agent - Catalyst for the teams and expected to lead the transformation to a fail-fast-learn-fast culture enabling continual improvement. 
 - Servant Leader - Able to gain respect from their team and willing to get their hands dirty to get the job done. 
 - Courageous - Able to effectively challenge and influence peers and teams, leading them through difficult or uncertain situations. 
 - Significant experience working in a global matrix environment. 
 - Must be a strategic, innovative problem solver, and have strong influencing and communication skills. 
 - Strong knowledge of business process flow and/or entity relationship modeling. 
 - Demonstrated outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with other technology teams as well as business partners. Ability to effectively present information, interact with, and respond to questions from managers, employees, customers, and vendors
 - Experience in applying best practices to ELT/ETL data transformation from variety of data sources to AWS and other data warehouse platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse etc. 

Required Technical Skills

- AWS CDK (TypeScript/Python)
 - AWS Glue (ETL, Catalog, Crawlers, Job Bookmarks)
 - AWS Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, EventBridge
 - Amazon Kinesis, Route 53, S3 (events, triggers)
 - Terraform (0. 12+)
 - Apache Hudi (0. 11+) and CDC methodologies
 - AWS DMS
 - Apache Spark (2. 4+) and PySpark
 - Amazon EMR (5. x+)
 - Python (3. 6+) for automation and pipeline development
 - IBM DataStage (for supplemental ETL workflows)
 - Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse

Reasonable Accommodation

Vantive is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. data.title: Manager, Software Development
data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Development and Test Manager with 12+ years of experience leading software development, verification, and quality engineering for connected healthcare and regulated medical software. The manager will provide technical and people leadership across the complete product lifecycle-from requirements, architecture, design, and implementation through functional, automation, performance, reliability, and release-readiness testing. This role owns delivery of cloud-native applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, user interfaces, microservices, medical-device integrations, and EMR/EHR workflows within agreed quality, schedule, and budget commitments. The role combines engineering leadership, development and test governance, technical direction, stakeholder management, design-control compliance, and audit-ready delivery. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and continuously improve the integrated software development and test strategy in alignment with product roadmaps, business priorities, regulatory commitments, architecture direction, and release plans. 
 - Lead software developers, automation engineers, performance engineers, and functional verification engineers; manage capacity, hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, technical development, succession planning, and delivery accountability. 
 - Plan and lead engineering assignments involving the evaluation, selection, and adaptation of software designs, technologies, development methods, test approaches, tools, and engineering practices. 
 - Provide technical direction from product conception through requirements, architecture, detailed design, implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining activities. 
 - Establish software engineering governance covering estimation, design and code reviews, coding standards, branching and configuration management, unit and component testing, static analysis, code coverage, technical debt, defect management, and quality metrics. 
 - Ensure software architecture and implementation meet requirements for maintainability, security, scalability, performance, reliability, interoperability, observability, and supportability. 
 - Own delivery of cloud-native applications, microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, web user interfaces, integration services, and data processing capabilities using appropriate C#/. NET and related technologies. 
 - Establish test governance, risk-based planning, entry and exit criteria, requirements traceability, defect management, quality dashboards, and release-readiness assessments. 
 - Own the roadmap and governance for reusable C#-based REST API and UI automation frameworks, including coding standards, test-data management, parallel execution, logging, reporting, and environment configuration. 
 - Ensure unit, component, integration, smoke, regression, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and release-level testing is incorporated into CI/CD pipelines with appropriate automated quality gates. 
 - Guide design, development, integration, and verification of HL7 ADT, FHIR resources, clinical workflows, EMR/EHR interfaces, connected medical devices, real-time communications, notifications, and downstream clinical systems. 
 - Implement configuration and change management throughout the complete product lifecycle, including design, development, verification, release, and sustaining phases. 
 - Partner with product, clinical, systems, architecture, DevOps, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, and external integration teams to resolve dependencies, technical issues, and product risks. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis by correlating application behavior, source code, automated and performance results, logs, API traces, network data, database records, queues, container metrics, and infrastructure telemetry. 
 - Incorporate field issues, customer feedback, post-market learnings, and production trends into product design improvements, corrective actions, regression coverage, reliability testing, and performance validation. 
 - Ensure compliance with the product development process, design controls, Quality System requirements, software lifecycle procedures, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable regulatory standards. 
 - Maintain audit-ready requirements, architecture and design records, code and review evidence, plans, test cases, objective evidence, reports, approvals, and traceability in approved tools such as Jira, Jama, source-control platforms, and validated test-management systems. 
 - Develop project plans, engineering milestones, resource strategies, budgets, and delivery forecasts; identify and mitigate issues that could affect quality, cost, scope, or schedule. 
 - Manage external development partners, contractors, vendors, and third-party service providers, including technical direction, deliverable acceptance, and performance monitoring. 
 - Communicate development progress, quality status, technical risks, mitigation plans, resource needs, architecture decisions, test findings, and go/no-go recommendations to program and leadership forums. 

What You'll Bring

- 12-18 years of software engineering, software development, testing, verification, quality engineering, or performance engineering experience, including at least 5 years leading multidisciplinary technical teams in a regulated or safety-critical environment. 
 - B. E/B. Tech in Computer Science / Electronics & Communication / Electrical or related field 
 - Demonstrated experience managing the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, code review, unit testing, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on or technical leadership experience with C#/. NET, object-oriented design, design patterns, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, web applications, and distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of functional and automation test strategy for REST APIs, web user interfaces, integration workflows, and end-to-end regression using Playwright, Selenium, NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience with software architecture and engineering practices such as clean architecture, secure coding, static analysis, code quality, code coverage, configuration management, branching strategies, dependency management, and technical-debt reduction. 
 - Experience validating distributed microservices, event-driven systems, JSON/XML, SQL/PostgreSQL, authentication, authorization, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, MQTT, or comparable technologies. 
 - Working knowledge of Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, autoscaling, service discovery, role-based access control, secrets management, service mesh, resilience, and cloud observability. 
 - Experience with CI/CD architecture, Git, build automation, automated quality gates, pipeline troubleshooting, artifact management, deployment practices, test reporting, and engineering dashboards. 
 - Healthcare domain expertise covering HL7 v2, ADT messages and acknowledgements, FHIR REST resources, EMR/EHR workflows, connected medical devices, data integrity, patient safety, privacy, and clinical risk. 
 - Knowledge of regulated healthcare software practices and standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, design controls, cybersecurity expectations, and formal verification evidence. 
 - Ability to manage complex projects and engineering programs within boundaries of quality, time, scope, and budget while balancing development and verification priorities. 
 - Strong people leadership, stakeholder influencing, conflict resolution, planning, prioritization, vendor coordination, risk management, and executive communication skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with SIP, RTP, WebSocket, WebRTC, audio/video communication, Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, or comparable real-time communication technologies. 
 - Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Application Insights, APM platforms, centralized logging, packet analysis, database diagnostics, and automated performance-threshold evaluation. 
 - Knowledge of Azure Key Vault, Azure App Configuration, Redis, Web PubSub, Terraform, KEDA, infrastructure-as-code, service virtualization, and container security. 
 - Experience supporting regulatory audits, formal submissions, post-market investigations, and enterprise-scale healthcare product releases. 
 - Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, cybersecurity expectations, and quality systems for regulated healthcare software. 
 - Experience with Jira, Jama, validated toolchains, Agile/Scrum delivery, and formal release-readiness reviews. 
 - C#, Azure, Kubernetes, performance testing, healthcare interoperability, PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification is advantageous. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic. 

Reasonable Accommodations

Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. 

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Baxter has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Baxter employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

Expertise You'll Bring

 - Strong understanding of functional, integration, regression, system, exploratory, and end-to-end testing methodologies. 
 - Experience building scalable automation frameworks for analytics, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. 
 - Strong telecom domain experience across 2G, 3G, 4G, and 5G technologies. 
 - In-depth understanding of SIP signaling, call flows, telecom protocols, voice services, and service assurance platforms. 
 - Experience validating telecom KPIs, network performance metrics, subscriber analytics, QoS/QoE measurements, alarms, and operational reporting systems. 
 - Strong understanding of machine learning concepts, model validation techniques, and AI-driven application testing. 
 - Experience validating feature engineering pipelines, data transformations, model outputs, and prediction results. 
 - Hands-on expertise with SQL, Pandas, and NumPy for data verification and analytical validation. 
 - Experience validating dashboards, reporting platforms, trend analysis, anomaly detection outputs, and time-series analytics. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python and automation development. 
 - Hands-on experience with PyTest and automated test execution frameworks. 
 - Expertise in REST API testing and validation using Postman and automation frameworks. 
 - Experience creating automated validation suites for APIs, data platforms, analytics services, and ML workflows. 
 - Experience with Git, Docker, Linux, Jira, Kubernetes, and CI/CD environments. 
 - Understanding of MLOps processes and model lifecycle validation. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis skills.

Location Name: Pune Corporate Office - Mantri

Job Purpose

This role exists to design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using Microsoft technologies, enabling the company to deliver reliable and high-performance financial solutions that support business growth and digital transformation. 

Duties And Responsibilities

Major Activities carried out by the role

- Major Activity 1
 - Design, develop, test, and deploy web-based applications using . NET Core, Angular, and WebAPI. 
 - Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code following best practices and design patterns. 
 - Develop data access layers using Entity Framework/ADO. Net/Dapper and optimize queries for performance. 
 - Troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and implement fixes in a timely manner. 
 - Build and maintain microservices, microapps to support scalable and modular application development. 
 - Work with Git and Azure DevOps pipelines for continuous integration, deployment, and release automation. 
 - Major Activity 2
 - Conduct peer code reviews and provide technical guidance to junior developers. 
 - Optimize application performance through caching, async processing, and efficient coding. 
 - Contribute ideas for technical improvements and participate in long-term planning discussions to align with the company's digital transformation goals. 
 - Major Activity 3
 - Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and review meetings in Agile/Scrum environments. 

Key Decisions / Dimensions

- Making decisions on validation logic, input sanitization, and security practices to prevent vulnerabilities. 
 - Suggesting enhancements or product features that improve user experience or align with business goals. 
 - Implementing effective error-handling mechanisms and deciding on logging strategies for easier debugging and monitoring. 
 - Identifying bottlenecks and applying caching, asynchronous processing, or query optimization to enhance performance. 

Major Challenges

The role faces challenges such as delivering high-quality solutions under tight deadlines, adapting to rapidly evolving technologies, and managing complex systems. It requires balancing performance and scalability, ensuring security and compliance, integrating with legacy and third-party systems, and taking end-to-end. Additionally, effective collaboration across cross-functional teams and handling large data volumes are key ongoing challenges. 

Required Qualifications And Experience

- Qualifications
 - Should have strong knowledge and experience in Object Oriented Programming, Analysis and Design Concepts. 
 - Should have extensive experience in product/application development using Microsoft stack. 
 - Should have experience in developing applications using design principle/patterns and architecture design patterns like MVC and MVVM. 
 - Should have knowledge in asynchronous programming practices using . Net Task Parallel concepts. 
 - Should have experience in writing data access code using Microsoft Entity Framework. 
 - Preference Experience in Financial Domain.
