data.title: High Speed IO Validation Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we are tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing - an era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that understand the world. Doing what has never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. 

NVIDIA's Silicon Co-Design Group is the team that gets every GPU, SoC, and CPU silicon program from first power-on to high-volume production. We are hiring an HSIO Validation Engineer to own characterization and qualification of high-speed I/Os - PCIe, NVLink, NVLink-C2C, UCIe, USB, UFS, and Ethernet - on brand-new silicon serving datacenter, AI, and client markets. Your bench is where silicon meets the signal - where every link train, jitter sweep, eye diagram, and protocol corner gets exercised before the part ships. You drive characterization and debug for IO interconnects across silicon, board, firmware, and driver - designing tests that anticipate rack-scale deployment so marginality surfaces at die-and-board scale, never in a rack. Your decisions show up in link margin, BER, power per lane, and the go/no-go calls that gate samples and production. 

What You Will Be Doing

- Own end-to-end characterization and validation of high-speed IO - PCIe, NVLink, NVLink-C2C, UCIe, USB, UFS, Ethernet - from silicon die through package and board, on NVIDIA GPUs, CPUs, and SoCs. 
 - Develop and execute validation test plans for silicon and SoC-level HSIO features - bring-up, corner qualification, stress, productization, and structured DOE across PVT, board, cable/connector, thermal, and firmware variables - left-shifting silicon failures before deployment. 
 - Drive power characterization and optimization across IO interconnects under workload-representative stimuli (MLPerf-class patterns at silicon/board level) - analyze trade-offs across V/F, lane config, and protocol state - and feed back into design, firmware, and binning. 
 - Drive systematic root-cause analysis for complex HSIO bugs - isolating contributions across silicon, package, board, firmware, and driver, with platform/thermal/mechanical partners when system context matters. Convert rack-observed failures into silicon/board reproducers so future spins fix the root cause upstream. 
 - Assess manufacturing and yield implications of HSIO margin distributions - identify gaps in scaling from chip to product, and feed back into binning and design. 
 - Develop and improve validation methodologies, automation frameworks, and margin-tracking infrastructure - increase efficiency and coverage as platform complexity grows. 

What We Need To See

- BS or MS in Electrical or Computer Engineering (or equivalent), with 3+ years in post-silicon HSIO validation, characterization, or a closely related discipline. 
 - Deep understanding of high-speed serial link protocols (PCIe Gen5+, NVLink, NVLink-C2C, UCIe, CXL) and the underlying SERDES architecture - equalization, link training, electrical characterization - with strong signal integrity and jitter knowledge. 
 - Strong SI and PI fundamentals - S-parameters, eye diagrams, channel margin, crosstalk, return loss, PDN noise, jitter decomposition - and validation experience across silicon and platform boundaries (CoWoS/interposer/substrate, board), translating rack-environment effects into silicon/board characterization. 
 - Hands-on with lab instrumentation (DSOs, BERTs, VNAs, protocol/logic analyzers, TDR), DOE/shmoo/margin-trending, and Python-based test automation - with a track record of driving cross-functional debug across chip, package, board, firmware, driver, and system teams. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Hands-on experience with PCIe Gen5/Gen6 or NVLink validation on production silicon - link training, equalization tuning, BER margining, or compliance debug. 
 - Prior SERDES, mixed-signal, or analog circuit design experience - sufficient to independently form hypotheses, design Sim-to-Si correlation experiments, and propose silicon/system-side fixes during debug. 
 - Track record of translating rack-environment conditions (thermal, connector reliability, neighbor noise) into silicon/board characterization - finding marginality at die-and-board scale before it appears in the field. 
 - Comfortable using AI productivity tools (Claude, Copilot, or equivalent) to compress log triage, regression analysis, scripting, and reporting workflows.

Job Title: Senior Software QA Engineer

Location: Remote (India Based Only)

Hiring Manager: Senior QA Engineering Manager

Estimated salary range: INR 3, 100, 000. 00 - INR 4, 000, 000. 00

- The salary offered for this position will be based on a candidate's experience and skill demonstrated during interviews and other evaluations

Position Overview

Ocient is seeking a Senior Software QA Engineer with strong expertise in database system. This hands-on role provides the opportunity to design and lead end-to-end testing initiatives that validate and enhance Ocient's database engine-ensuring stability, performance, scalability as the platform grows. You should be: Passionate about testing complex, large-scale distributed database systems, with a focus on functional correctness, stress/scale and performance. 

Ready to validate new database features end-to-end-from test planning and execution to resource management-and share results that inform product direction. Interested in new workload generation and understanding how they target performance and stress components of the database, developing infrastructure to measure key performance metrics in a database to understand and identify bottlenecks/soft spots. 

Highly collaborative, proactive with strong communication skills and the ability to work independently to deliver well-designed, meaningful test outcomes. 

Responsibilities

- Design and execute comprehensive test plans and automated suites to validate new features/optimizations for or database as a system. 
 - Develop, run, and analyze regression tests targeting the system-level database functionality - ensuring functional stability, scalability, and performance. 
 - Collaborate strongly with Development team to implement tests onto nightly CI/QA infrastructure, improve existing test coverage and analysis tooling. 
 - Own end-to-end evaluation of Ocient's platform components, partnering across teams to identify behavioral/functional issues, correctness gaps, and opportunities for performance optimization. 
 - Provide technical leadership in defining test strategies, frameworks, and best practices for validating complex optimization and execution scenarios. 
 - Work cross-functionally with engineering leadership and internal stakeholders to align on feature design goals, ensure test completeness, and drive timely resolution of issues. 
 - Lead the evolution of database testing infrastructure to support scalability, reliability, and reproducibility across functional and system-level tests. 
 - Act as a subject matter expert for owned components, partnering with customer operations and development teams on escalated issues and validation. 
 - Mentor junior engineers, fostering expertise in database testing methodologies. 

Ideal Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent. 
 - 4-6 years of experience in database development, administration, or QA engineering, ideally focused on testing and validating query processing behavior and database system components. 
 - Deep understanding of relational and distributed database systems, with strong skills in SQL query design, execution, and analysis. 
 - Proven experience in test planning, designing, and executing automated, reliable test frameworks and workloads for databases. 
 - Strong QA and debugging skills with the ability to trace issues across query planning, execution, and component interactions within the database engine. 
 - Solid Linux expertise - comfortable monitoring resource utilization, analyzing logs, and understanding how system-level factors influence database behavior. 
 - Proficiency in Python for test automation, diagnostics, and feature validation. Hands-on experience with JIRA, test case management system and version control tools. 
 - Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS or GCP), including deployment and monitoring. 
 - Experience using AI coding assistants (e. g. Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf) to author and maintain tests, with the judgment to review generated tests for vacuous assertions and hidden flakiness. 
 - Ability to analyze complex test results, interpret query execution behavior, and derive meaningful insights through visualization and test data analysis. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey technical findings clearly to diverse audiences.

Overview

The Mobile Payment Gateway (MPG) program is part of Mastercard Markets and Localization team, responsible for driving the identification of new opportunities across different markets and building bespoke solutions and integrating with the wider Mastercard products and services. 

The MPG program aspires to be the platform of choice for economies moving into the Digital first world of payments. This is a senior position in the team, so you will also play a part in coaching and mentoring your junior counterparts. Design and implement microservices with high quality, secure code that is modular, functional and testable. 

Develop solutions that are resilient, self-healing and Cloud Native.

Experience in software engineering majorly in application development

Strong analytical and excellent problem-solving skills.

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

data.title: Software Engineer (Full Stack
data.description:
Software Engineer (Full Stack)

Maersk is hiring Software Engineers who can work across the stack to join the Visibility Platform team. The platform answers the questions "where is my shipment?" and "when will I get it?" with a high level of accuracy and timeliness. It is powered by tons of data from multiple sources, and this role provides an opportunity to innovate on how the right subset of that data is processed, served and presented to users in the right context. 

About The Role

In this role, you will work on a greenfield project that aims to provide increased quality of visibility into the movements of containerised shipments and associated attributes like delays, extra charges incurred, emissions, etc. 

You will lead and own the features you pick up from first prototype to production, working across the tech stack. You will move comfortably between the front-end and the back-end, using modern coding agents to move fast and teammates for review and guidance. 

Here are some of the things the role involves: 

- Independently lead and own the design, delivery and long-term health of the features and services you build. 
 - Contribute freely to both the web front-end and the back-end services, using coding agents to explore unfamiliar code, produce working changes, and learn conventions as you go. Take responsibility for what you ship, regardless of who or what wrote the first draft. 
 - Work closely with the UX and product team to iterate and provide feedback on mocks and designs and how well they solve user problems. 
 - Build quick prototypes for exploring concepts. Be happy to throw some away and evolve others into solutions that are maintainable for a long time. 
 - Work backwards from the mocks and help design API structures that can power the views in an efficient and performant manner. Where existing APIs can be limiting, help explore alternate options in design that don't degrade the originally intended user experience. 
 - While building views, care deeply about semantic HTML, accessibility and rendering

performance, often with each going hand-in-hand with the other. 

- While building services, build event driven applications and microservice-based APIs with a lot of focus on scalability, reliability and secure practices from the ground up. 
 - Work with Maersk's design system conventions and ensure consistency in design language across multiple micro-applications. Know when the conventions can be limiting and be comfortable stepping out of them. 
 - Ensure hygiene practices like test coverage, performance profiling, security checks etc. are put in place and gated with automated checks. 
 - Ensure applications emit the standard signals needed for effective monitoring and alerting. 
 - Actively participate in code reviews and encourage using them as a tool for team members to learn from each other. Review agent-assisted changes with the same rigour as any other. 
 - Contribute to a culture of continuous delivery where the path from code commit to going live is as automated as it can be. 
 - Work in an inclusive manner with team members across geographies, time zones and cultures. 

About You

Here are some things we expect from you for the role. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Be highly proficient with either the back-end or the front-end, as described below. This is the minimum bar, and you should be able to independently lead and own delivery of major components, pages or services there with very little hand-holding. 
 - Back-end: Java or Kotlin and a framework like Spring Boot, with experience building event driven applications and microservice-based APIs that handle a huge amount of data. 
 - Front-end: Vue, React, Svelte or Angular, TypeScript, semantic HTML, modern CSS and responsive design. We mainly use Vue, so be open to it. 
 - Be able to contribute across the other side with the help of coding agents: enough familiarity to read the code, judge what an agent produces, write and run tests, and know when to ask a teammate for a second pair of eyes. 
 - Be adept at using modern LLM-based coding agents (like Claude Code or GitHub Copilot) to increase quality and speed of work, including giving them good context, verifying their output, and recognising when they are going wrong. 
 - Be highly proficient with a test framework like JUnit or Jest, and be a natural at always

maintaining high test coverage for any code written. 

- Be familiar with analysing the algorithmic complexity of code, common design patterns and when to use them. 
 - Be familiar with at least one relational and one NoSQL database, and with observability concepts: logging, metrics, traces and alerts. 
 - Be familiar with cloud computing concepts and able to put them into practice, with experience in at least one of Azure, Google Cloud or AWS. 
 - Be familiar with a build system like Webpack, and with Node. js and the npm ecosystem. Be aware of common reusable open-source libraries, and mindful of not causing bloated dependencies. 
 - Be open to deep dives into new areas of the tech stack and learn new skills on the go. 
 - Be a stickler for developer productivity, and always be on the lookout to get things done more efficiently. 
 - Be effective at written and spoken communication. Also exhibit the same in writing code that can be well understood by other developers. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Be highly proficient on both sides: the back-end and the front-end described above, rather than one with agent-assisted contribution to the other. 
 - Be familiar with browser-based testing frameworks like Cypress to automate end-to-end user workflow tests, and with Core Web Vitals and how to build pages that render blazing fast, with measurements set up to be monitored continuously. 
 - Have an eye for extracting patterns for reusability that help ensure consistency across multiple applications. 
 - Previous experience working with visual elements like maps and charts that help display a massive amount of data in aggregated form. 
 - Prior experience working with Kafka, or with containerised 12-factor apps and tools like Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Knowledge about the logistics and supply chain domain. 

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements. 

We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk. com.

data.description:
Citi Market Operations Technology is currently at a pivotal point in its evolution and journey to implement a target operating model. We take pride and are passionate about our People and our culture. We are invested in people and their development. We are transforming and simplifying our operating model and creating an exciting environment which encourages diversity of thought and inclusion. 

We are a dynamic, global, and diverse Organization, supporting operations areas that have a presence in over 60 Countries. Our Technology groups develop and implement a wide range of applications that support the Operations groups which are core to the success of the Markets business and has significant impact across the lifecycle of a Trade by providing innovative products and solutions. 

We partner extensively with a range of internal stakeholders including product aligned Middle Office groups, Settlements, Margin, Asset Servicing, Listed Derivative & Commodities Operations. We support an extensive range of Capital Markets products and services including Fixed Income (FX, Rates, Credit, Muni, Cash and Derivatives) where Citi is consistently a dominant top 3 player in the market, Equity (Cash, Derivatives, Prime Brokerage, Futures, Listed Derivatives, FXPB) where Citi has a significant growth program to continue to build out its capabilities and services; and Syndicates where we support both FI and EQ new issues and IPOs. We play a key role in supporting our global clients to ensure they have a first-class experience in service performance and strategic partnership. 

We have re-imagined how to provide technology and service in our domain through the alignment of our team vision, culture, and aggressive retirement plan for legacy applications and adoption of a micro-based containerized cloud environment. We encourage our people to create, explore and be adventurous whilst taking measured risk, adopting safe practices to protect the firm. Data lineage and optimization is core to how we develop our eco system. We are growing our capabilities using artificial intelligence, natural language processing and machine learning. 

Our roles entail ensuring we operate in a robust control environment, whilst in a fast-paced workplace. We comply with global regulations and internal policies and adopt a proactive approach to identifying opportunities to reduce risk through the continuous evaluation of our controls; to protect our clients, the firm, and our reputation. 

We work closely with our external global peers, partners, and regulators, and play an integral part in leading an agenda at the forefront to optimize and streamline processes and drive strategy across our industry. 

Job Purpose: 

We are seeking a high-impact Senior UI Developer for AI-Based Automation Initiatives and our AI enabled Client Inquiry Management Platform to help build next-generation user interfaces that trigger, control, and monitor AI-driven automated workflows. 

In this role, you will bridge frontend enterprise applications with backend AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and automation pipelines. 

Your core focus is to eliminate manual operational friction by delivering seamless, real-time interfaces for intelligent task execution, automated data extraction/entry, and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) review loops. 

Responsibilities: 

- Build AI Automation Interfaces: Design and implement high-performance frontend interfaces that initiate, parameterize, and execute multi-step AI automated actions and workflows. 
 - Integrate AI Agent & Tool APIs: Connect frontend application layers to backend LLM orchestrators, AI agent frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and REST/WebSocket automation endpoints. 
 - Stream Real-Time AI Execution: Implement low-latency streaming states (SSE, WebSocket), live execution logs, and automated progress trackers for long-running AI tasks. 
 - Implement Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Controls: Develop fast, intuitive validation workflows enabling users to review, edit, approve, or override AI-generated actions before execution. 
 - Build Reusable Automation Toolkits: Create modular components, form-autofill handlers, and action dispatchers that other engineering squads can reuse to integrate AI automation quickly. 
 - Automation Telemetry & Monitoring: Implement operational dashboards tracking AI task success rates, execution latency, failure modes, and automated time-savings metrics. 
 - Risk Assessment: Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing, and reporting control issues with transparency. 

Qualifications: 

- 10+ years of relevant experience in Apps Development or systems analysis role
 - Full Stack Senior Hands-on Developer
 - Strong technology background with working knowledge of evolving technologies. 
 - Extensive experience system analysis and in programming of software applications
 - Experience in managing and implementing successful projects
 - Subject Matter Expert (SME) in at least one area of Applications Development
 - Ability to adjust priorities quickly as circumstances dictate
 - Demonstrated leadership and project management skills
 - Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience
 - Master's degree (Added advantage)

Technical Skills: 

- Frontend Engineering: 10+ years of professional development experience in modern web technologies (React, TypeScript, Next. js)
 - Asynchronous & Streaming Protocols: Strong hands-on experience handling Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSocket's, and resilient asynchronous API integration. 
 - AI & Automation Integration: Demonstrated experience integrating with LLM APIs (internal enterprise AI gateways), tool-calling/function-calling interfaces, and AI agent framework. 
 - Backend & API Fundamentals: Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON-RPC, GraphQL, or gRPC endpoints, along with Node. js/Python scripting for automation hooks. 
 - Data Handling & State Persistence: Experience with client-side caching, optimistic updates, and complex multi-step workflow state machines. 

Nice to have: 

- Experience working with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or agent tool-calling ecosystems. 
 - Familiarity with workflow orchestrators and automation systems
 - Background in building internal developer tools, enterprise RPA bridges, or intelligent operations dashboards. 
 - Experience in automated frontend testing (Jest, Playwright/Cypress) and CI/CD automation pipelines.

If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. About Us: 

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400, 000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values diverse backgrounds. We believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful. At Target, inclusion is part of the core value. We aim to create equitable experiences for all, regardless of their dimensions of difference. As an equal opportunity employer, Target provides diverse opportunities for everyone to grow and win

Every time a guest enters a Target store or browses Target. com, they experience the impact of Target's investments in technology and innovation. We're the technologists behind one of the most loved retail brands, delivering joy to millions of our guests, team members, and communities. 

Join our global in-house technology team of more than 4, 000 of engineers, data scientists, architects, coaches and product managers striving to make Target the most convenient, safe and joyful place to shop. We use agile practices and leverage open-source software to adapt and build best-in-class technology for our team members and guests-and we do so with a focus on diversity and inclusion, experimentation and continuous learning. 

Team Overview

At Target, we are gearing up for exponential growth and continuously expanding our product assortment by welcoming new sellers to Target's thriving marketplace. To support this expansion, we are revamping our systems to meet increasing demands and enhance our seller's experience. We are looking for talented individuals to work with cutting-edge technologies and develop an extensible architecture that will transform our seller journey. This includes improving processes from seller acquisition and onboarding to product listing, logistics, insights, and performance management. - Designing scalable architecture with the best choice of tech, responsible for all the services/functionalities that the team develops while ensuring quality of the team's code and/or infrastructure standards.

data.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. 

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day. 

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's growth at scale. 

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to join our Hyderabad team. In this role, you'll lead, build, and grow teams of world-class engineers, taking responsibility for their technical execution and impact through ambiguity as we scale. This role is based in our Hyderabad office with a hybrid setup, typically 3 days in the office. 

Get to know our Engineering team - what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect. 

What You'll Be Doing

In this role, you will lead a multi-disciplinary team of engineers across various platforms. You will report to a Senior Engineering Manager or Engineering Director, helping to shape the future of our three-sided marketplace. 

Here's What Your Day-to-day Might Look Like

- Lead and grow a multi-disciplinary team of Backend, iOS, Android, and Web engineers, fostering a diverse and high-achieving environment. 
 - Drive technical and product strategy by setting clear project goals, guiding implementation choices, and ensuring your team hits group-level metrics. 
 - Champion a learning culture through active mentorship, helping engineers and emerging leaders accelerate their careers. 
 - Scale our engineering practices by implementing processes and values that improve team efficiency and code quality. 
 - Maintain technical engagement by contributing to code reviews and technical design, ensuring the health and observability of your team's systems.

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others: 

- Significant experience in people management, with at least 2 years spent leading engineering teams through performance reviews and goal setting. 
 - A strong technical background as a Software Engineer, with a proven ability to build user-focused products at pace. 
 - Demonstrated success in team building, including hiring, onboarding, and supporting the personal growth of colleagues. 
 - Proven ability to lead through ambiguity, managing both local and remote engineers to deliver high-impact projects. 
 - Experience collaborating across disciplines, working closely with Product, Design, and Operations to influence the broader roadmap. 

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, You'll Do Work That Matters-solving Real-world Problems In a Three-sided Marketplace That's Constantly Evolving. We're Food Lovers, Problem Solvers, Community Builders And More, Brought Together By a Shared Drive To Make Things Better. Working Here You Can Expect To

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day. 

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment. 

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make. 

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog. 

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine-our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide here to help you feel confident at each stage. 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. 

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. 

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience. 

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

data.title: Senior Automation Engineer - ISEC
data.description:
We're reinventing the market research industry. Let's reinvent it together. 

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow's success starts with today's market intelligence. We empower the world's leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it. 

Senior QA Test Engineer - Shop & Scan (Automation & AI-Enabled)

Overview

Role Purpose

Ensure high-quality delivery of the Shop & Scan platform by designing, automating, and executing robust test

scenarios across the full product lifecycle. This role combines functional validation, automation engineering, 

and AI-assisted testing practices to maximise regression coverage, accelerate feedback cycles, and improve

release confidence. 

Project Context

Shop & Scan is a consumer research platform where household members scan purchases through a mobile

application, generating valuable behavioural insights. The QA role is critical to ensuring seamless end-to-end

user journeys, accurate reward processing, and secure, reliable platform behaviour. 

Role Scope

This role acts as the primary QA owner for Shop & Scan, defining and driving the quality approach across

functional, automated, and AI-assisted testing practices. The scope extends beyond execution to include test

strategy, automation framework maturity, regression optimisation, defect prevention, release readiness, and

continuous improvement. In a lean Agile environment, the role requires strong autonomy, sound judgement, 

and close collaboration with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to ensure quality is embedded

early in the delivery lifecycle. 

Testing Process

- Quality Planning & Test Design

The role analyses User Stories and technical requirements, challenges ambiguity early, and ensures clear, 

testable acceptance criteria are in place for each delivery item. 

Comprehensive test scenarios are designed across functional, negative, and edge-case coverage, with

appropriate preconditions, test data, and reusable test assets to support efficient execution. 

The role maintains and evolves the regression test suite in line with product priorities, ensuring traceability

between requirements, coverage, defects, and release outcomes. 

- Automation Strategy & Framework Ownership

The role is responsible for developing and maintaining automated test coverage for regression testing, critical

business flows, and API validations. Automation must remain maintainable, scalable, and aligned with sprint

delivery, with a continuous focus on improving coverage, execution efficiency, and release of confidence. 

- Test Execution, Defect Management & Release Support

The role oversees execution of planned testing across automated, manual, exploratory, sanity, and release

validation activities, ensuring risks, blockers, and quality concerns are surfaced promptly and managed

proactively. Defects are logged with clear and structured evidence, including reproducibility detail, expected versus actual

behaviour, business impact, and severity assessment to support efficient triage and resolution. 

- Clear reproduction steps and supporting evidence
 - Actual versus expected results and impact on users or business flows

The role works closely with developers and stakeholders through defect triage, prioritisation, retesting, and

release readiness assessments to support informed go/no-go decisions. 

- AI-Enabled Testing Practices

The role leverages AI tools to support test case generation from requirements, optimise regression test

selection, identify coverage gaps, and improve exploratory testing efficiency. It also contributes to the

adoption of practical AI-driven QA approaches across the team where they add measurable value. 

- Validation, Quality Sign-off & Continuous Improvement

Following defect resolution or delivery completion, the role validates outcomes across impacted areas and

ensures fixes meet the agreed quality standard before closure. 

The role also identifies process, tooling, and coverage improvements to strengthen QA maturity over time

and improve overall delivery quality. 

QA Responsibilities: 

- Own the end-to-end QA approach for Shop & Scan, ensuring test coverage is aligned to business

priorities, delivery risks, and release objectives. 

- Drive automation adoption and framework improvement to increase regression efficiency, 

repeatability, and release confidence. 

- Collaborate with product owners, developers, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, 

shape quality standards, and embed QA early in the delivery lifecycle. 

- Provide quality visibility through clear reporting on risks, defects, test progress, and release

readiness. 

- Champion best practice in test design, defect management, AI-enabled testing, and continuous

improvement to support a high-quality, scalable product. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Required Qualifications: 

- Typically 4+ years of experience in software QA across functional testing, regression testing, and release validation activities. 
 - Hands-on experience with test automation using at least one modern framework such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress. 
 - Experience working within Agile delivery teams and collaborating effectively with developers, product owners, business analysts, and business stakeholders. 
 - Strong defect management, analytical, communication, and prioritisation skills. Good understanding of API testing, web and mobile application testing, and quality assurance best practices. 

Candidate Profile: 

- The successful candidate will bring a blend of strong QA fundamentals, automation capability, and modern testing awareness, with the confidence to operate independently and influence quality outcomes across the product lifecycle. 
 - Core QA Skills: Strong experience in functional testing and regression testing, test design, defect management, and working within Agile or Scrum delivery environments. 
 - Automation Skills (Mandatory): Hands-on experience with at least one modern automation framework such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress, with the ability to design, maintain, and evolve automated test suites for critical business journeys. 
 - API & Technical Testing: Experience with API validation tools such as Postman or Newman, plus working knowledge of SQL for data validation and debugging tools or logs for issue investigation. 
 - AI & Modern Testing (Preferred): Awareness of AI-assisted QA tooling and a practical interest in using AI for test generation, coverage optimisation, and smarter exploratory testing practices. 
 - Tools & Delivery: Practical experience with Azure DevOps or Jira, and familiarity with integrating test automation into CI/CD-oriented delivery processes.

data.description:
Overview: 

Guidepoint's Market Research Team is seeking a leader for its Survey Programming team, to help centralize, standardize, and grow a function dedicated to programming and coding questionnaires into web-based platforms, and conducting QA on programmed survey work. This position would be expected to work hours aligned with US-based colleagues on the East Coast. 

This can be a hybrid position out of one of our offices in India (Mumbai, Pune, ) or remote. 

What You'll Do: 

- Oversee a team of 6 survey programmers of differing experience levels, setting standards for quality assurance and timely delivery of questionnaires programmed into Qualtrics
 - Coordinate with other quantitative survey operational team leads (fieldwork, data automation) and client service staff/project managers to ensure effective cross-functional collaboration
 - Serve as a strategic lead for survey programming within the market research organization, helping to design processes, systems, and best practice documentation for survey programming at Guidepoint
 - Train and mentor junior staff on best practices for survey programming and coding, including improving efficiency in translating spec documents to final survey designs, effectively testing routing and randomization for accuracy, and using JavaScript and other custom web design languages to create custom layouts and presentations to meet client needs
 - Serve as a senior voice for internal communication, stepping in to resolve project issues between team members and operational staff, provide leadership on kickoffs for complex or sustained engagements, and serve as an advisor on sales or internal kick-off calls where demonstrated programming experience is needed
 - Consult as needed with survey project teams on survey design, making best-practice recommendations on question type or structure that will best work within our systems and reduce respondent burden, and flagging any designs that may be particularly time-consuming or challenging to execute successfully
 - Serve as a direct project manager on large or urgent work as-needed
 - Other duties as required

What You Have: 

- 10+ years experience in programming market research surveys in Qualtrics (strongly preferred) or another online survey platform (Decipher/Forsta, Alchemer, Sawtooth, Versive)
 - 3+ years experience managing teams of programmers or other operations staff in market research to achieve targets on volume, timeliness, and quality
 - Ability to interface with internal leaders, helping to set strategy and training goals for survey programming, identify and resolve problems at a project and strategic level as they arise
 - Experience with JavaScript/jQuery, HTML, and CSS for developing custom question types or presentations, including training and upskilling staff on web design languages and tools
 - Experience QAing surveys and designing survey QA processes and workflows to ensure that work aligns to requested spec/design work
 - Ability to consult and train on best practices for survey design and experience, flagging if survey designs may have issues that make them difficult for end-respondents to answer

What we Offer: 

- Competitive compensation 
 - Employee medical coverage 
 - Central office location 
 - Entrepreneurial environment, autonomy, and fast decisions
 - Casual work environment

About Guidepoint: 

Guidepoint powers end-to-end research workflows for the world's best research teams. 

Backed by a global network of more than 2 million experts and over 1, 600 employees, Guidepoint delivers real-time access to expertise, primary research, and actionable knowledge that help organizations make informed decisions. Through consultations, surveys, events, proprietary content, and AI-enabled tools, we support every stage of the decision-making process-from developing hypotheses and gathering insights to validating assumptions and building conviction for critical decisions. 

At Guidepoint, our success relies on the diversity of our employees, experts, and clients, which enables us to foster meaningful connections and a broad range of perspectives. We are committed to creating an inclusive and welcoming environment where individuals of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences can contribute and succeed.

data.title: Senior Automation QA (JS) Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Ciklum is looking for a Senior Automation QA (JS) Engineer to join our team full-time in India. 

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4, 000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live. 

About The Role

As a Senior Automation QA (JS) Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. 

Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain automated test suites for the platform, Frontend and Backend, including contract tests that protect the agent-developer experience as the SDK evolves
 - Build automated tests for long-running Temporal workflows including failure injection (worker kill, provider outage, retry storms) to verify durable-execution guarantees such as zero lost runs and correct compensation/saga behavior
 - Automate multi-tenant isolation verification cross-tenant data access, configuration bleed, and cost-attribution correctness executed per release as a platform acceptance criterion
 - Verify agent execution sandboxing and egress controls through negative testing of disallowed tool calls and network destinations
 - Design test strategies for LLM-driven behavior: statistical assertions over repeated runs (pass^k consistency), semantic-similarity scoring, confidence-threshold validation, and flakiness quarantine that distinguishes model variance from genuine regression
 - Build and continuously extend adversarial test corpora document-borne prompt injection in lease PDFs, tool-call hijack, and data-exfiltration probes aligned to OWASP LLM Top 10 and recognized red-team taxonomies
 - Verify Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) escalation behavior confidence thresholds fire correctly and no gated/irreversible action completes without authorization
 - Partner with the evaluation function on golden-dataset-driven checks, contributing test infrastructure, synthetic-data (synthetic lease) pipelines, and CI integration that make agent quality measurable and repeatable
 - Automate verification of platform NFRs invocation overhead (p95), concurrency targets, queue backpressure behavior, and LLM provider failover time and surface trends per release
 - Use tracing data (Langfuse / OpenTelemetry spans) as a first-class test asset: assert on trace completeness, token/cost-accounting accuracy, and alerting behavior for anomalous runs
 - Wire test suites into CI/CD as hard release gates with automated, per-metric regression flagging on pull requests
 - Produce auditable, reproducible test-evidence packs that feed directly into client milestone sign-off
 - Embed with AI and platform engineers from the design stage making acceptance criteria, testability, and observability inputs to architecture, not afterthoughts
 - Maintain test environments, mocked LLM/provider layers, and synthetic data generators that keep test runs fast, deterministic where possible, and affordable
 - Mentor mid-level QA engineers, codify AI testing patterns into reusable internal frameworks, and contribute to Ciklum's quality engineering practice and AI Academy

Requirements

- 8+ years of test automation with API testing, and building test frameworks other engineers adopt, not just test cases
 - Hands-on experience testing LLM-powered or other non-deterministic systems statistical assertions, semantic scoring, and managing model variance (this is the differentiator; cite real examples)
 - Experience testing asynchronous, event-driven systems failure injection, idempotency verification, eventual-consistency assertions; Temporal or a similar workflow engine a strong plus
 - Strong CI/CD integration skills (GitHub Actions or equivalent) and the discipline to design release gates
 - Solid SQL and data-validation skills; comfort building synthetic test-data pipelines and measuring dataset quality
 - A security-testing and adversarial mindset; familiarity with prompt-injection techniques or a strong AppSec testing background with willingness to specialize fast
 - Demonstrated judgment on what "tested enough" means under milestone pressure, and the ability to defend quality evidence to non-engineering stakeholders
 - Strong proficiency in Playwright and TypeScript is mandatory for building automated test suites
 - QA Automation Core: Extensive experience in building automated test frameworks (Playwright/Typescript-based) and integrating them into high-security CI/CD pipelines
 - AI/LLM Literacy: Deep understanding of Large Language Model behaviors, prompt sensitivity, and the common failure modes of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems
 - Analytical Mindset: Strong capability in statistical analysis to interpret evaluation scores and provide actionable feedback to AI Engineers for prompt tuning

Desirable

- Performance/load tooling (k6, Locust) for concurrency and latency NFR verification
 - Prior testing of multi-tenant SaaS isolation
 - Exposure to eval/observability stacks (Langfuse, LangSmith, Promptfoo, DeepEval, Arize Phoenix)
 - Compliance evidence experience (SOC 2, GDPR) or accessibility testing (Section 508 / WCAG)
 - Familiarity with Commercial Real Estate workflows (lease accounting, CAM reconciliation) or document-extraction systems (OCR, layout parsing)
 - Experience using LLMs to generate test cases, adversarial payloads, or synthetic documents
 - Performance Testing: Experience testing high-concurrency background processing within agentic systems
 - Experience with qTest for test management

What's in it for you?

- Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
 - Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
 - Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
 - Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
 - Care: We've got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

About Us

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you'll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress. 

India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level. 

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can't wait to see you at Ciklum.

Job Description

Senior. Specialist, Quality Engineering

The Opportunity

- Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare. 
 - Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products. 
 - Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats. 

Our Technology Centres focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company's' IT operating model, Tech Centres are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy. 

A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centres. 

Role Overview

The Senior Specialist, Quality Engineering (Front-End Testing) is responsible for validating the functionality, usability, responsiveness, and visual quality of web and digital applications across our company. This role ensures that customer-facing and internal applications deliver a consistent, reliable, and high-quality user experience across browsers, devices, and platforms. 

Working closely with Product Managers, Developers, Architects, Business Analysts, and Solution Architects, the successful candidate will perform manual testing, support test automation initiatives, and contribute to quality engineering best practices across strategic platforms and digital products.

 - Verify user interfaces against design specifications, UX standards, and responsive design requirements. 
 - Identify, document, and track software defects using approved testing and defect management tools. 
 - Perform cross-browser and cross-device testing across desktop, tablet, and mobile platforms. 
 - Support release readiness activities and production validation testing. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, refinement, and retrospectives. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams to improve product quality and reduce production defects. 
 - Contribute to testing standards, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Support adoption of automation and AI-assisted quality engineering practices.

data.title: Software Engineer III- ServiceNow QA Analyst
data.description:
Job Description

We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level. 

As a Software Engineer III at JPMorgan Chase within the Infrastructure Platforms team, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile delivery team to validate and assure market-leading ServiceNow solutions in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for executing and improving testing practices across ServiceNow applications and workflows, ensuring releases meet functional, integration, performance, and control requirements in support of the firm's business objectives. 

Job Responsibilities

- Execute QA activities including test planning, test case creation, test execution, defect triage, and test reporting for ServiceNow releases (e. g. , ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, SecOps as applicable). 
 - Design and maintain the scalable manual and automated regression and performance test suites for ServiceNow configurations and customizations (workflows/Flow Designer, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, integrations, portals). 
 - Perform functional, regression, smoke, integration, and end-to-end testing across ServiceNow and upstream/downstream systems (APIs, MID Server, SSO, CMDB-related integrations). 
 - Partner with developers, product owners, and platform teams to review requirements and acceptance criteria, identify test scenarios, and ensure appropriate coverage and traceability. 
 - Log, track, and manage defects with clear reproduction steps, severity/priority, and evidence; validate fixes and support release readiness decisions. 
 - Produce and maintain test artifacts (test plans, test cases, test data approach, RTM as needed) and contribute to release documentation and operational readiness. 
 - Analyze testing results and trends to identify recurring defects, root causes, and quality risks, recommending improvements to process, controls, and platform hygiene. 
 - Support CI/CD quality gates by integrating testing into pipelines where applicable and promoting consistent QA standards across environments (DEV/TEST/UAT/PROD). 
 - Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e. g. , code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness. 
 - Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation. 

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience 
 - Hands-on practical experience in QA/testing within the Software Development Life Cycle, including test design, execution, defect management, and release validation. 
 - Experience testing ServiceNow configurations/customizations and understanding of core platform components (tables, forms, lists, ACLs, notifications, workflows/Flow Designer). 
 - Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices and QA in iterative release cycles; familiarity with CI/CD concepts and environment promotion practices. 
 - Experience with test management and defect tracking tools (e. g. , Jira, ServiceNow Agile Development, or similar). 
 - Basic understanding of web technologies and APIs (HTTP, REST, JSON) and ability to validate integrations using logs and test tools (e. g. , Postman or equivalent). 
 - Ability to create clear, actionable documentation and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Understanding of security and controls concepts relevant to testing (e. g. , access controls/roles, data handling, auditability, evidence capture). 
 - Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e. g. , for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security. 
 - Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices. 

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Experience with ServiceNow test automation (e. g. , ATF - Automated Test Framework) and/or automation frameworks/tools used alongside ServiceNow. 
 - Familiarity with CMDB and ITIL-aligned processes (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Asset/Discovery). 
 - Exposure to performance testing concepts and non-functional testing (availability, resiliency, audit/compliance readiness). 
 - Experience validating SSO, LDAP, and multi-system integrations involving MID Server, integration hubs, or enterprise APIs.

We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with deep expertise in PHP 8+ and Laravel. You will be a key architect in our shift toward a robust microservices and event-driven architecture. - 5-8 years of Development experience

 - Desirable (The "Platform-Aware" edge): Infrastructure-as-Code experience (Terraform). 
 - Knowledge of GoLang for high-performance services or Lambdas. 
 - Experience with OpenSearch and Redis. 
 - Familiarity with VueJS to assist in full-stack collaboration. ○ Knowledge of Kubernetes. 

About Arrive

Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20, 000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It's about more than function, it's about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it's how you Arrive.

data.title: Manager, Software Development
data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Development and Test Manager with 12+ years of experience leading software development, verification, and quality engineering for connected healthcare and regulated medical software. The manager will provide technical and people leadership across the complete product lifecycle-from requirements, architecture, design, and implementation through functional, automation, performance, reliability, and release-readiness testing. This role owns delivery of cloud-native applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, user interfaces, microservices, medical-device integrations, and EMR/EHR workflows within agreed quality, schedule, and budget commitments. The role combines engineering leadership, development and test governance, technical direction, stakeholder management, design-control compliance, and audit-ready delivery. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and continuously improve the integrated software development and test strategy in alignment with product roadmaps, business priorities, regulatory commitments, architecture direction, and release plans. 
 - Lead software developers, automation engineers, performance engineers, and functional verification engineers; manage capacity, hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, technical development, succession planning, and delivery accountability. 
 - Plan and lead engineering assignments involving the evaluation, selection, and adaptation of software designs, technologies, development methods, test approaches, tools, and engineering practices. 
 - Provide technical direction from product conception through requirements, architecture, detailed design, implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining activities. 
 - Establish software engineering governance covering estimation, design and code reviews, coding standards, branching and configuration management, unit and component testing, static analysis, code coverage, technical debt, defect management, and quality metrics. 
 - Ensure software architecture and implementation meet requirements for maintainability, security, scalability, performance, reliability, interoperability, observability, and supportability. 
 - Own delivery of cloud-native applications, microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, web user interfaces, integration services, and data processing capabilities using appropriate C#/. NET and related technologies. 
 - Establish test governance, risk-based planning, entry and exit criteria, requirements traceability, defect management, quality dashboards, and release-readiness assessments. 
 - Own the roadmap and governance for reusable C#-based REST API and UI automation frameworks, including coding standards, test-data management, parallel execution, logging, reporting, and environment configuration. 
 - Ensure unit, component, integration, smoke, regression, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and release-level testing is incorporated into CI/CD pipelines with appropriate automated quality gates. 
 - Guide design, development, integration, and verification of HL7 ADT, FHIR resources, clinical workflows, EMR/EHR interfaces, connected medical devices, real-time communications, notifications, and downstream clinical systems. 
 - Implement configuration and change management throughout the complete product lifecycle, including design, development, verification, release, and sustaining phases. 
 - Partner with product, clinical, systems, architecture, DevOps, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, and external integration teams to resolve dependencies, technical issues, and product risks. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis by correlating application behavior, source code, automated and performance results, logs, API traces, network data, database records, queues, container metrics, and infrastructure telemetry. 
 - Incorporate field issues, customer feedback, post-market learnings, and production trends into product design improvements, corrective actions, regression coverage, reliability testing, and performance validation. 
 - Ensure compliance with the product development process, design controls, Quality System requirements, software lifecycle procedures, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable regulatory standards. 
 - Maintain audit-ready requirements, architecture and design records, code and review evidence, plans, test cases, objective evidence, reports, approvals, and traceability in approved tools such as Jira, Jama, source-control platforms, and validated test-management systems. 
 - Develop project plans, engineering milestones, resource strategies, budgets, and delivery forecasts; identify and mitigate issues that could affect quality, cost, scope, or schedule. 
 - Manage external development partners, contractors, vendors, and third-party service providers, including technical direction, deliverable acceptance, and performance monitoring. 
 - Communicate development progress, quality status, technical risks, mitigation plans, resource needs, architecture decisions, test findings, and go/no-go recommendations to program and leadership forums. 

What You'll Bring

- 12-18 years of software engineering, software development, testing, verification, quality engineering, or performance engineering experience, including at least 5 years leading multidisciplinary technical teams in a regulated or safety-critical environment. 
 - B. E/B. Tech in Computer Science / Electronics & Communication / Electrical or related field 
 - Demonstrated experience managing the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, code review, unit testing, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on or technical leadership experience with C#/. NET, object-oriented design, design patterns, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, web applications, and distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of functional and automation test strategy for REST APIs, web user interfaces, integration workflows, and end-to-end regression using Playwright, Selenium, NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience with software architecture and engineering practices such as clean architecture, secure coding, static analysis, code quality, code coverage, configuration management, branching strategies, dependency management, and technical-debt reduction. 
 - Experience validating distributed microservices, event-driven systems, JSON/XML, SQL/PostgreSQL, authentication, authorization, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, MQTT, or comparable technologies. 
 - Working knowledge of Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, autoscaling, service discovery, role-based access control, secrets management, service mesh, resilience, and cloud observability. 
 - Experience with CI/CD architecture, Git, build automation, automated quality gates, pipeline troubleshooting, artifact management, deployment practices, test reporting, and engineering dashboards. 
 - Healthcare domain expertise covering HL7 v2, ADT messages and acknowledgements, FHIR REST resources, EMR/EHR workflows, connected medical devices, data integrity, patient safety, privacy, and clinical risk. 
 - Knowledge of regulated healthcare software practices and standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, design controls, cybersecurity expectations, and formal verification evidence. 
 - Ability to manage complex projects and engineering programs within boundaries of quality, time, scope, and budget while balancing development and verification priorities. 
 - Strong people leadership, stakeholder influencing, conflict resolution, planning, prioritization, vendor coordination, risk management, and executive communication skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with SIP, RTP, WebSocket, WebRTC, audio/video communication, Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, or comparable real-time communication technologies. 
 - Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Application Insights, APM platforms, centralized logging, packet analysis, database diagnostics, and automated performance-threshold evaluation. 
 - Knowledge of Azure Key Vault, Azure App Configuration, Redis, Web PubSub, Terraform, KEDA, infrastructure-as-code, service virtualization, and container security. 
 - Experience supporting regulatory audits, formal submissions, post-market investigations, and enterprise-scale healthcare product releases. 
 - Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, cybersecurity expectations, and quality systems for regulated healthcare software. 
 - Experience with Jira, Jama, validated toolchains, Agile/Scrum delivery, and formal release-readiness reviews. 
 - C#, Azure, Kubernetes, performance testing, healthcare interoperability, PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification is advantageous. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic. 

Reasonable Accommodations

Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. 

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Baxter has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Baxter employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

The successful candidate will be accountable for delivering software that is safe, secure, compliant, maintainable, and aligned with business objectives. The role requires close collaboration with Product Management, Systems Engineering, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, Program Management, and Operations.

The leader will ensure AI is used responsibly, securely, and effectively to improve productivity, quality, decision-making, and delivery performance while maintaining appropriate human oversight, regulatory compliance, and patient safety. 

Designs, programs, documents, tests, and fixes bugs involved in creating and maintaining applications and frameworks involved in a software release lifecycle resulting in a digital product. Impacts approaches, projects and programs in the functional area or affected business organization and ways of working. Impacts quality, efficiency and effectiveness of own team. Required Qualifications

 - Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, including Agile, hybrid, or V-model approaches in regulated environments. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading teams through complex, multi-release products. 
 - Excellent communication and influencing skills across functions and leadership levels. 
 - Demonstrated applied experience using AI in software engineering or product-development workflows and driving responsible adoption within a team.
