data.title: Test Manager
data.description:
Job Summary

Test Manager role for an MNC focusing on complex data automation testing across AS400 and Cobol systems in a hybrid work model with day shifts and no travel. The role designs plans and manages end to end test activities ensuring quality traceability and robust coverage for automotive and other enterprise platforms while collaborating closely with cross functional teams. 

Responsibilities

- Plan coordinate and monitor end to end testing activities for data automation solutions across AS400 and Cobol based applications to ensure consistent delivery of high quality releases that align with stakeholder expectations and organizational standards
 - Design detailed test strategies and test plans that cover functional integration system and regression testing for data intensive workloads with clear entry and exit criteria and measurable quality outcomes
 - Develop review and optimize automated test suites for data validation and process flows within AS400 and Cobol environments to increase test coverage reduce manual effort and accelerate release cycles
 - Define and maintain test data management approaches for complex batch and online processes ensuring availability of accurate masked and reusable data sets that reflect real world usage scenarios
 - Coordinate defect triage by analyzing issues raised during test cycles collaborating with development and business teams to prioritize fixes and driving timely resolutions that protect production stability
 - Track and report test progress using metrics such as coverage defect trends and execution status while communicating risks and mitigation plans clearly to project stakeholders and management teams
 - Collaborate with business analysts and product teams to validate requirements for data automation features ensuring that test conditions and scenarios accurately reflect user journeys and regulatory needs
 - Guide test engineers in implementing best practices for automation frameworks on AS400 Cobol stacks including coding standards reusability guidelines and robust validation checkpoints
 - Ensure alignment of test activities with hybrid working practices by organizing clear documentation structured handovers and effective virtual collaboration routines that support distributed teams
 - Review batch jobs interfaces and downstream reporting impacts in automotive and related domains to verify that data transformations and calculations meet safety compliance and performance expectations
 - Drive continuous improvement of testing processes by analyzing past releases identifying inefficiencies and implementing refined workflows tools and standards that enhance productivity and quality
 - Coordinate environment readiness by validating that AS400 partitions job schedulers interfaces and stubs are correctly configured before test execution to reduce cycle delays and unstable runs
 - Document lessons learned from each major release and translate them into actionable process updates that strengthen organizational knowledge and reduce recurrence of critical defects across programs

Qualifications

- Require professional experience of five to eight years in software testing with a strong focus on test management test planning and execution coordination for medium to large projects
 - Require proven hands on experience in testing AS400 and Cobol based systems including batch and online components with solid understanding of job flows file structures and transaction processing
 - Require strong skills in data automation testing including creating automated scripts for data validation reconciliation and transformation checks using suitable enterprise tools or custom frameworks
 - Require experience in defect management and test management tools along with the ability to interpret metrics prepare test reports and present concise quality status to diverse stakeholders
 - Require solid understanding of software development and testing lifecycles including requirement analysis test design risk based testing regression planning and release support activities
 - Require excellent communication and collaboration abilities to work effectively in hybrid teams coordinate with cross functional stakeholders and ensure shared understanding of quality goals
 - Nice to have exposure to automotive industry processes such as manufacturing supply chain or telematics with appreciation for safety reliability and regulatory considerations in that domain
 - Nice to have experience in performance and batch optimization testing for data heavy workloads on legacy platforms with focus on job throughput resource utilization and stability
 - Nice to have familiarity with modern automation frameworks reporting dashboards and scripting approaches that can interface with AS400 or Cobol components to extend test coverage and transparency

Certifications Required

ISTQB Advanced Level Test Manager or comparable test management certification preferred

data.description:
Job Purpose

Job Purpose Description

Job Context & Major Challenges

The RMC Industry is highly fragmented and very competitive. As a major RMC player we face competition from other organized players and local players which makes superior service delivery along with quality products important for good margins. There is huge growth in infrastructure which opens up opportunities for setting up commercial and dedicated plants. The plant and its resources need to be cost effective with focus on maximizing capacity utilization. This makes it imperative for each plant to be efficient and profitable. The plant employees need to be focused and deliver high performance in each of their KRAs and accountabilities. 

Key Result Areas

KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)

KRA1 Business Development

- (A) Conducting demos for VAC products to clients to help them understand their functionality

KRA2 Customer Feedback

- (R) Resolve day to day customer grievances related to cracks, workability, slump control, pumping issues cube failures etc. and take corrective and preventive actions based on site feedback
 - (R) Visit customer/ site periodically to gather feedback and identify areas of concern

KRA3 Customer Management

- (R) Provide detailed mix design calculation, physical and chemical analysis of raw material to customer as and when required

KRA4 Maintenance Management

- (A) Ensure the upkeep of the quality control labs with proper product display and availability of relevant BIS codes
 - (R, A) Ensure calibration of instruments is done before due date

KRA5 MIS

- (R) Conduct physical stock measurement and reconciliation
 - (R, A) Maintain all the quality records on Labsys and update as per QCI and ISO. Maintain records related to calibration of all testing equipment

KRA6 Planning & Budgeting

- (R) Prepare, consolidate and analyze Plant plan and budget

KRA7 Product Development

- (R) Generate mix and competitor data at plant level for further analysis
 - (R, A) Arrive at the mix design as per customer's requirements

KRA8 Product Testing

- (A) Conduct testing of cubes of concrete to check if they are as per the Quality Standards
 - (R) Conduct statistical analysis of cubes strength results and monitoring performance of the products
 - (R) Conduct trials for VAC Products to check various functional parameters
 - (R, A) Check the quality of the raw material to ensure adherence to desired standards and specifications. Reject the material that does not match the required specifications
 - (R, A) Collaborate with third party testing for the cubes as and when required
 - (R, A) Undertake trials for performance/ dosage of different admixtures, other special materials and routine products to ensure quality parameters are met

KRA9 Production Execution

- (R) Ensure VAC orders to each plant are executed in time and as per required specifications
 - (R) Track the standard deviation of the produced batch to ensure quality of concrete is within permissible limits and take corrective measures
 - (R, A) Ensure workability and cohesiveness of concrete at plant and at pouring site
 - (R, A) Implement moisture corrections during production
 - (R, A) Monitor the right dosage/ admixture at batching plants during production

data.description:
Job Summary

Serve as a lead quality engineer driving end to end test strategy automation and quality governance for complex hybrid delivery projects using Jenkins Playwright TypeScript and RestAssured. Collaborate closely with cross functional teams to assure reliable releases optimize test coverage and enhance customer trust preferably within the utilities domain. 

Responsibilities

- Define and execute a holistic quality engineering strategy that aligns automated and manual testing to project goals using Jenkins Playwright TypeScript and RestAssured to ensure predictable high quality releases. 
 - Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks with Playwright and TypeScript that support functional regression and integration testing across web services and user interfaces. 
 - Develop robust API automation suites using RestAssured that validate contract functional and end to end scenarios while providing fast feedback to developers through continuous integration pipelines. 
 - Configure manage and optimize Jenkins pipelines that orchestrate build validation automated testing and reporting to reduce cycle time and improve delivery confidence. 
 - Collaborate with product owners architects and engineers to refine requirements into clear test conditions and scenarios that accurately reflect business workflows and customer expectations. 
 - Perform detailed root cause analysis of defects and production incidents translating findings into actionable improvements in test coverage coding practices and deployment processes. 
 - Implement and monitor quality metrics such as defect leakage test coverage and pipeline stability to provide transparent insight into product health and drive continuous improvement actions. 
 - Coordinate hybrid work collaboration by facilitating regular quality checkpoints virtual reviews and knowledge sharing that keep distributed team members aligned on quality goals. 
 - Create and maintain test data management strategies that support repeatable reliable execution of automated test suites across multiple environments without sensitive data exposure. 
 - Support non functional quality efforts by defining test approaches for performance reliability and compatibility while partnering with specialized teams when required. 
 - Guide peers and junior engineers through code reviews test design discussions and automation best practices to build a strong culture of quality and craftsmanship. 
 - Engage with stakeholders from the utilities domain when applicable to understand regulatory safety and reliability expectations and reflect them in test strategy and scenarios. 
 - Document clear test plans execution reports and risk assessments in English that enable transparent communication of quality status to technical and non technical partners in a day shift hybrid model. 

Qualifications

- Demonstrate extensive hands on experience of thirteen to fifteen years in quality engineering with a strong emphasis on automation strategies for complex distributed applications. 
 - Exhibit advanced proficiency in designing and implementing automated tests using Playwright and TypeScript including cross browser and end to end validation of web applications. 
 - Show strong expertise in creating and maintaining API test suites with RestAssured including validation of response structures error handling and integration workflows. 
 - Apply deep practical knowledge of Jenkins configuration including pipeline as code job orchestration and integration with version control and test reporting tools. 
 - Communicate effectively in English through clear reading writing and speaking to collaborate with global stakeholders document artifacts and present quality findings. 
 - Utilize experience in the utilities domain as a strong advantage by incorporating regulatory safety and reliability requirements into test design and risk assessments. 
 - Employ sound understanding of software development lifecycles agile methodologies and hybrid work practices to integrate testing activities smoothly into day to day delivery. 
 - Demonstrate capability to mentor quality engineers in modern automation practices clean code principles and defect prevention techniques while maintaining a hands on technical focus.

data.title: Team Lead
data.description:
Department: Sales & Business Development

Reporting To: Management Head

Location: Perinthalmanna/Calicut (As per company requirements)

Job Overview

Winstud Academy is an established education and skill development institution offering career-oriented courses across 12+ high-demand fields. The institution focuses on industry-relevant training, recognised certifications, and academic partnerships. The Sales Team Lead will drive B2B sales, develop institutional partnerships, and expand market reach. The role requires regular travel for institutional visits, client meetings, and deal closures alongside Management, offering opportunities for growth in sales leadership and strategic business development. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities

1. Team Management & Target Achievement

• Supervise Business Development Executives (BDEs) and monitor their daily activities and performance. 

• Set and communicate individual and team targets, conduct regular performance reviews, and address performance gaps. 

• Take direct responsibility for achieving personal and team sales targets. 

2. ERP-Based Lead Management

• Monitor all leads through the designated ERP system, ensuring accurate updates, timely follow-ups, and proper lead allocation. 

• Track lead status, client interactions, conversion stages, and pending actions. 

• Review ERP reports to identify missed follow-ups, inactive leads, and sales pipeline bottlenecks. 

• Ensure all BDEs maintain accurate and up-to-date lead records. 

3. Lead Generation & Field Activities

• Generate leads independently through institutional visits, market research, networking, referrals, and direct outreach. 

• Conduct client meetings and field visits to explore new business opportunities. 

• Identify prospective institutions and markets to expand Winstud Academy's reach. 

4. Sales Conversion & Closing

• Take ownership of qualified leads requiring final discussions, negotiations, and closure. 

• Strong presentation skills are essential, as the candidate will be responsible for presenting Winstud Academy's offerings to institute owners and other key decision-makers. 

• Ensure smooth lead handovers from BDEs by reviewing client requirements and interaction history. 

• Monitor closing-stage leads, expected conversions, and lost opportunities to improve conversion rates. 

• Must be willing to travel with the Management for client meetings, institutional visits, business

development discussions, and deal closures. 

5. Reporting & Performance Reviews

• Ensure timely daily reporting by BDEs and prepare weekly sales performance reports. 

• Present team performance, target achievement, pipeline status, conversions, and action plans during

review meetings. 

6. Coordination & Accountability

• Coordinate with Management, Operations, and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and sales

execution. Escalate client concerns, operational challenges, and process gaps that may affect sales

outcomes. 

• Maintain professional client communication, reporting discipline, and accountability for assigned

responsibilities. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

1. Sales Achievement - Individual and team target attainment. 

2. Lead Conversion - Conversion rate and successful closures. 

3. ERP Compliance - Accuracy and timeliness of lead updates and follow-ups. 

4. Lead Generation - Quality and volume of independently generated leads. 

5. Team Performance - BDE productivity and target achievement. 

6. Reporting & Follow-ups - Timely reports and effective pipeline management. 

Specific targets and performance benchmarks will be assigned by Management. 

Required Skills & Competencies

• Experience in sales, business development, or team management. 

• Strong communication, negotiation, and closing skills. 

• Working knowledge of ERP/CRM systems and sales pipeline tracking. 

• Ability to analyse sales performance and prepare reports. 

• Willingness to undertake field visits and independent lead generation.

data.title: Sr Software Engineer,  Now
data.description:
Description

Amazon is building India's Quick Commerce offering - Amazon Now - delivering everyday essentials to customers in minutes. We build world-class technology that powers store launches at scale, curates hyper-local selection, and drives seamless operations across our network. We are looking for a seasoned Software Development Engineer to serve as the senior technical leader for the team, owning the architecture and engineering direction across all of our charters - with a primary focus on the Selection experience: how we curate, manage, and scale the right assortment for every customer, in every city. This is a high-impact role where your technical decisions directly fuel Amazon Now's expansion across India. You will set the technical bar for the team, drive the hardest design problems end-to-end, and multiply the impact of every engineer around you. 

Key job responsibilities

- Own the technical strategy and architecture for Selection - curating city-specific assortments, managing per-store catalogs, and simplifying the experience of listing and onboarding new items at scale
 - Provide senior technical oversight across all of the team's charters - store launches, catalog and selection, inventory, picking, staging, and store operations - ensuring architectural coherence across them
 - Architect systems that onboard new stores rapidly across cities, and that scale reliably to hundreds of stores while maintaining low operational latencies
 - Lead the hardest design decisions end-to-end: evaluate trade-offs, simplify complexity, and set patterns the rest of the team builds on
 - Mentor and coach engineers, raise the technical bar, and drive adoption of engineering best practices across the team
 - Partner closely with product, operations, and business teams to translate ambiguous, complex business problems into durable technical solutions
 - Champion operational excellence (CI/CD, monitoring, on-call), lead design reviews, and own a high quality bar for all deliverables

A day in the life

You'll review operational metrics to ensure system health across live stores, unblock engineers on their toughest technical challenges, and dive deep into system designs - weighing trade-offs and cutting complexity. You'll lead design reviews across the team's charters, mentor engineers on architecture patterns, and shape deployment plans for features rolling out across multiple cities, ensuring rollback strategies, monitoring, and alarms are in place before launch. As a senior, you'll help set technical direction and priorities, with Selection as your primary canvas. 

About The Team

Amazon Now builds the technology behind India's Quick Commerce experience - from the moment a store goes live, to how selection is curated for each neighborhood, to how every order is picked and staged for delivery in minutes. We work at the intersection of technology and physical retail, solving hard problems in real-time inventory, catalog and selection management, store automation, and partner enablement. Our work reaches millions of customers who count on us for everyday essentials, fast. 

This role is the senior technical anchor of the team, setting architectural direction across every charter we own - with Selection as the primary focus. It's a rare scope: deep ownership of one of our most important problem spaces, combined with technical influence across the whole team. 

We embrace our differences and are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have employee-led affinity groups reaching thousands of employees globally. We are dedicated to supporting new members through mentorship and knowledge sharing, and we strive to assign opportunities that help each team member develop into a well-rounded contributor. 

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
 - 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone-freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow- helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. 

Join us to put AI to work for people. 

Job Description

About the role

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to set technical direction for a team building AI-native products on the ServiceNow platform. You'll shape how we design, build, and operate systems where AI agents, LLM-driven workflows, and traditional platform engineering work together. This is a hands-on role with broad influence: you'll make architectural calls, raise the engineering bar, and help the team move from AI-assisted development to AI-native delivery. 

What You Get To Do In The Role

- Lead the design and delivery of complex, cross-functional features across the platform, from architecture through production operations. 
 - Build AI-native capabilities, including LLM-integrated workflows, agentic patterns, prompt and context design, and evaluation pipelines, with reliability and governance built in. 
 - Define and drive how the team uses AI tools across the development lifecycle: code generation, test automation, review, triage, and documentation. Measure the impact and share what works.

 - Mentor senior and mid-level engineers and set standards for code quality, observability, and safe AI usage. 
 - Partner with product, UX, and other engineering leads to turn ambiguous problems into scoped, shippable plans.

- Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.

 - Strong proficiency in Java, JavaScript, or another language relevant to the platform, plus solid system design skills.

 - Experience designing AI governance, guardrails, or responsible AI controls.

data.title: Sr Manufacturing Engineer
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Engineering associated with the manufacturing process. Impacts approaches, projects and programs in the functional area or affected business organization and ways of working. Impacts quality, efficiency and effectiveness of own team. Has significant input into priorities. Guided by professional practices and policies that are shaped by the role. The role has moderate autonomy, requiring high levels of operational judgment. 

Job Description

Site Overview

Established in 2000, the John F. Welch Technology Center (JFWTC) in Bengaluru is our multidisciplinary research and engineering center. Engineers and scientists at JFWTC have contributed to hundreds of aviation patents, pioneering breakthroughs in engine technologies, advanced materials, and additive manufacturing. 

Role Overview

- Expertise in design for manufacturability and provides guidance and feedback on part designs through design evolution phase. 
 - Leads industrialization of new parts at suppliers, including review of manufacturing plans, PFMEAs, control plans, process flows, and validation/qualification plans (e. g. , FAIs, PPAPs where applicable). 
 - Supports in supplier selection and sourcing strategies based on technical capability, and risk; partners with sourcing owners to ensure supplier choices provide long-term value. 
 - Supports source changes and transitions, including technical due diligence, process transfer, and risk mitigation plans; develops lower-performing suppliers through on-site support, corrective action plans, and capability-building initiatives. 
 - Proactively identifies barriers to quality, and resolves them in collaboration with Fulfilment, Commercial, Quality, and Engineering teams; drives structured problem solving using methodologies such as 5-Why, Fishbone, 8D, or similar tools. 
 - Has manufacturing expertise across multiple related part families and processes, with deep domain expertise in complex component manufacturing (e. g. , rotating hardware, structures, casings, or precision assemblies, as applicable). 
 - Guides and influences suppliers' performance based on manufacturing expertise, focusing on process robustness, yield improvement, cycle time reduction, and defect reduction. 
 - Demonstrates deep understanding of conventional, non-conventional, and special processes, Special processes: heat treatment, coatings, NDT, surface treatments, etc. 
 - Ensures compliance including safety, quality, and special process approvals. 
 - May mentor junior manufacturing engineers or supplier quality/manufacturing resources, sharing best practices and supporting skill development across the team
 - Developing specialized knowledge in their discipline. Serves as best practice/quality resource. Has awareness of latest technical developments in own area. Contributes towards strategy and policy development, and ensure delivery within area of responsibility. 
 - Has in-depth knowledge of best practices and how own area integrates with others; has working knowledge of competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market
 - Uses judgment to make decisions or solve moderately complex tasks or problems in areas of operational/product management, manufacturing, technology or engineering. Takes new perspective on existing solutions. Uses technical experience and expertise for data analysis to support recommendations. Uses multiple internal and limited external sources outside of own function to arrive at decisions. 
 - Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience. May lead small projects with moderate risks and resource requirements. Explains difficult or sensitive information; works to build consensus. Developing persuasion skills required to influence others on topics within field. 

Ideal Candidate

data.title: Generative AI Quality Engineer - Assistant Vice President
data.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced AI Quality Engineer to join our Retail and Wealth Risk Engineering team under the Enterprise Risk Technology platform. This role spans the full spectrum of modern AI quality engineering - from Agentic AI flow testing and RAG pipeline validation to AI safety, test automation, and performance & reliability engineering. 

You will be the quality pillar for complex autonomous AI systems, ensuring they are safe, accurate, explainable, resilient, and production-ready at scale. This is a high-impact, highly technical role that requires both depth in AI/ML and breadth across testing disciplines. 

Responsibilities

Agentic AI Testing

- Design and execute end-to-end test strategies for Agentic AI pipelines, including single-agent and multi-agent workflows. 
 - Validate agent reasoning, planning, and decision-making chains (e. g. , ReAct, Chain-of-Thought, Plan-and-Execute, Reflexion). 
 - Test tool-use correctness - ensuring agents invoke the right tools, with correct parameters, at the right time. 
 - Evaluate agent memory systems (short-term, long-term, episodic) for accuracy and context retention across sessions. 
 - Validate agent handoff and delegation logic in multi-agent orchestration frameworks (e. g. , AutoGen, CrewAI, LangGraph). 
 - Test termination conditions, loop detection, and infinite loop prevention in autonomous agent loops. 

RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Testing

- Design comprehensive test strategies for end-to-end RAG pipelines - covering ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, and generation stages. 
 - Validate retrieval accuracy and relevance - ensuring the correct context chunks are retrieved for a given query. 
 - Test embedding model quality and vector similarity thresholds across different document corpora. 
 - Evaluate faithfulness, groundedness, and answer relevance of generated responses using frameworks like RAGAS, TruLens, DeepEval. 
 - Test chunking strategies (fixed, semantic, hierarchical) for their impact on retrieval quality. 
 - Validate context window management - ensuring retrieved context does not exceed token limits or degrade generation quality. 
 - Conduct end-to-end regression testing when the underlying knowledge base, embedding model, or LLM changes. 
 - Test multi-turn conversational RAG for context coherence and citation accuracy across turns. 

Test Automation

- Build and maintain automated test harnesses for Agentic and RAG systems, including agent trajectory replay, tool mock injection, and prompt simulation. 
 - Develop automated evaluation pipelines integrated into CI/CD workflows for continuous model and agent validation.

 - Automate vector database validation - index integrity, embedding drift, and retrieval consistency checks. 

AI Safety & Security Testing

- Conduct red-teaming and adversarial testing to uncover jailbreaks, prompt injection vulnerabilities, and goal misalignment in LLM-based systems. 
 - Test output guardrails and content filters for unsafe, biased, toxic, or out-of-scope model behavior. 
 - Validate privilege escalation controls - ensuring agents do not exceed permitted actions or access unauthorized resources. 
 - Perform data poisoning and backdoor attack simulations to assess model robustness. 
 - Evaluate models for bias, fairness, and discrimination using frameworks such as AI Fairness 360 and Aequitas. 
 - Test PII leakage and data privacy controls in RAG and agent pipelines in accordance with GDPR, CCPA, and internal data governance policies. 
 - Conduct security testing aligned with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, including: 
 - Prompt Injection (Direct & Indirect)
 - Insecure Output Handling
 - Training Data Poisoning
 - Insecure Plugin / Tool Design
 - Sensitive Information Disclosure
 - Validate constitutional AI constraints, RLHF-aligned behavior boundaries, and system prompt integrity. 
 - Collaborate with cybersecurity teams on AI-specific threat modeling and vulnerability management. 
 - Maintain safety testing playbooks and document red-team findings with severity ratings and remediation recommendations. 
Performance & Reliability Testing

- Define and execute load, stress, soak, and spike testing for AI-powered APIs, inference endpoints, and agent orchestration services. 
 - Measure and optimize end-to-end latency across RAG and agentic pipelines - from query to final response. 
 - Benchmark LLM inference throughput (tokens/second) and identify bottlenecks across model serving infrastructure. 
 - Test auto-scaling behavior of AI services under variable load conditions. 
 - Validate circuit breaker, retry, and fallback mechanisms in agentic and RAG systems for graceful degradation. 
 - Test vector database performance - query latency, index build time, and retrieval accuracy under high concurrency. 
 - Conduct cost efficiency analysis - measuring token consumption, API call costs, and infrastructure spend per agent task. 
 - Establish SLOs (Service Level Objectives) and SLAs for AI system availability, latency percentiles (P50, P95, P99), and error rates. 
 - Collaborate with MLOps teams to set up observability dashboards, monitoring alerts, and automated anomaly detection for production AI systems. 
 - Perform chaos engineering experiments to validate agent and RAG system resilience under infrastructure failures. 

Domain Knowledge

- Deep understanding of RAG architecture patterns - naive RAG, advanced RAG, modular RAG. 
 - Solid grasp of agent design patterns: ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Reflexion, MRKL, Mixture-of-Agents. 
 - Familiarity with AI safety and alignment principles (RLHF, Constitutional AI, guardrail layers). 
 - Knowledge of token economics, context management, and LLM cost optimization. 
 - Proficiency in performance engineering methodologies for distributed AI systems. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agentic communication standards. 
 - Exposure to multi-modal agent testing (agents handling text, images, code, documents). 
 - Experience in regulated industries (banking, finance, healthcare) with strict compliance requirements.

Education

Experience

 - 3+ years of hands-on experience with RAG systems, or Agentic AI. 
 - Proven experience building automated test frameworks for non-deterministic AI systems.

data.title: Senior Manager - WSMD Lab (Copper Concentrate)
data.description:
About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Job Purpose

The QA Lab Head in a copper mining and smelting operation ensures the highest standards of quality across all stages of production by overseeing various lab functions. The role involves managing multiple labs, ensuring compliance with industry regulations, optimizing testing processes, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve quality control and operational efficiency. 

Responsibilities

Lab Operations Planning and Execution: 

- Manage daily and shift-wise laboratory testing activities in line with smelter production priorities. 
 - Ensure timely receipt, preparation, analysis, and reporting of samples from smelting, converting, refining, slag, dust, by-products, and related process streams. 
 - Coordinate with production, process, and quality teams to prioritize urgent samples and ensure quick analytical feedback for operational decisions. 
 - Monitor adherence to sample collection, labelling, preservation, testing, and reporting protocols to maintain reliability of results. 

Process Optimization And Continuous Improvement

- Identify improvement opportunities in sample preparation, testing turnaround time, analytical accuracy, and laboratory workflow efficiency. 
 - Support implementation of standard methods, best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives within WSMD laboratory operations. 
 - Track routine operational bottlenecks and coordinate corrective actions with the Lab Head and concerned departments. 
 - Assist in adoption of improved analytical practices, automation support, and digital tools for better lab productivity and data reliability. 

Quality Assurance And Control

- Ensure execution of quality control checks, calibration verification, standardization, and validation of analytical results as per defined procedures. 
 - Maintain compliance with approved laboratory SOPs, test methods, internal quality standards, and applicable statutory or customer requirements. 
 - Review routine test data for abnormalities, deviations, or inconsistencies and escalate critical issues to the WSMD Lab Head. 
 - Support root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions for testing errors, repeat analysis, delays, and non-conformities. 

Equipment Readiness And Troubleshooting

- Ensure availability, calibration, routine checks, and proper functioning of laboratory instruments and equipment used for WSMD analysis. 
 - Coordinate with maintenance, OEMs, and service providers for troubleshooting, breakdown resolution, AMC support, and instrument reliability. 
 - Maintain equipment logbooks, calibration records, preventive maintenance schedules, and breakdown history for audit readiness. 
 - Support safe and correct operation of instruments by lab chemists, technicians, and shift personnel. 

HSE And Regulatory Compliance

- Ensure strict adherence to HSE requirements, PPE usage, chemical handling procedures, waste disposal norms, and emergency response protocols inside the WSMD Lab. 
 - Conduct routine safety observations, housekeeping checks, and compliance follow-ups in coordination with the Lab Head and Safety team. 
 - Support compliance with environmental and statutory requirements related to laboratory chemicals, residues, samples, and waste streams. 
 - Promote safe work practices among lab team members and ensure timely closure of safety observations and audit points. 

Cost Management And Budgeting

- Monitor consumption of chemicals, reagents, gases, standards, glassware, spares, and other laboratory consumables to support uninterrupted operations. 
 - Assist the Lab Head in inventory planning, PR follow-up, vendor coordination, and cost control initiatives for routine lab requirements. 
 - Identify opportunities to reduce wastage, optimize reagent usage, and improve cost efficiency without compromising testing quality. 
 - Maintain records of consumable usage, stock levels, and critical inventory items for operational planning and audit purposes. 

Shift Team Coordination And Capability Building

- Coordinate daily work allocation for lab chemists, technicians, samplers, and shift personnel as per testing load and operational requirements. 
 - Guide team members on standard test procedures, safe lab practices, instrument handling, documentation, and quality expectations. 
 - Support training, skill development, and multi-skilling of laboratory team members to build operational flexibility. 
 - Ensure continuity of laboratory operations during shifts, peak workload, audits, and absence of senior leadership, while developing readiness to succeed the WSMD Lead role in future. 

Reporting And Data Analytics

- Ensure timely preparation, review, and submission of routine analytical reports, shift reports, quality summaries, deviation reports, and MIS data. 
 - Maintain accurate documentation of sample records, test results, calibration data, corrective actions, and audit-related information. 
 - Analyze lab performance trends such as turnaround time, repeat testing, deviations, equipment uptime, and sample load to support improvement actions. 
 - Escalate critical quality trends, abnormal results, and urgent operational issues to the WSMD Lab Head and concerned stakeholders. 

Digitization And Tech Adoption

- Support use of SAP Lab/LIMS and other digital systems for sample tracking, result entry, report generation, and data traceability. 
 - Ensure timely and accurate digital updating of test results, equipment records, calibration schedules, and lab MIS. 
 - Assist in implementation of automation, dashboards, and data-driven reporting practices to improve laboratory efficiency. 
 - Promote disciplined data entry, record retention, and system compliance among lab team members. 

Qualifications

Education Qualification: 

Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Industrial Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Metallurgy, or a related science/engineering discipline

Master's degree in Chemistry/Analytical Chemistry or relevant postgraduate qualification preferred

Work Experience (Range Of Years)

Over 15 years of experience in Quality Assurance within the Copper Manufacturing industry

Relevant experience in laboratory operations, analytical quality control, or process lab functions, preferably in copper smelting, metals, mining, chemicals, or process industry environment; suitable for Senior Manager level with team coordination, operational ownership, and future leadership readiness

Certifications

Certification in Quality Management or Quality Assurance

Reporting To: Unit Head (Function: Strategy & Planning)

Reported By: Section Head QC (Quality), Section Head QC (material Handling)

Business and Unit Brief

UltraTech Cement Limited is the cement flagship company of Aditya Birla Group. A USD 9. 9 billion company, UltraTech is the world's largest Cement Company by sales volume and capacity, excluding China. 

The Company has a consolidated production capacity of 205. 5 Million Tonnes Per Annum (MTPA) of grey cement. The Company's business operations span UAE, Bahrain, Sri Lanka and India. 

UltraTech's manufacturing footprint comprises of 34 integrated manufacturing units, one Clinkerisation unit, 36 grinding units and 10 bulk packaging terminals. With 465 Ready Mix Concrete (RMC) plants in 167 cities, UltraTech is the largest manufacturer of Ready Mix Concrete in India. It has a slew of speciality concretes that meet specific needs of discerning customers. 

UltraTech has a network of over 1. 45 lakh channel partners across the country and has a market reach of more than 80% across India. In the white cement segment, UltraTech goes to market under the brand name of Birla White. It has two White Cement units and four Wall Care putty units, with a current capacity of 3. 3 MTPA. 

In 2025, UltraTech extended its footprint in the construction value chain, through wires and cables segment with a planned capital expenditure of ~ INR 1, 800 crore over the next 2 years. 

The Company's social initiatives focus on education, healthcare, sustainable livelihoods, community infrastructure and social causes. Through its CSR initiatives, UltraTech reaches out to more than 1. 8 million beneficiaries in over 500 villages across India. 

Global Manufacturing Leadership Program

This role is part of the Global Manufacturing Leadership Program (GMLP). 

The Global Manufacturing Leadership Program (GMLP) is Aditya Birla Group's flagship leadership hiring initiative focused on building the next generation of manufacturing leaders. Designed for high-potential professionals with a proven track record in manufacturing and operations, GMLP offers accelerated career growth through challenging leadership roles across the Group's diverse businesses, including Cement, Metals, Chemicals, Carbon Black, Pulp & Fibre, Mining, and other global manufacturing operations. 

Through GMLP, selected candidates gain exposure to large-scale manufacturing environments, world-class technologies, cross-functional assignments, and mentorship from senior business leaders.  - Execute performance test plans across the full verification stack: cycle-accurate performance models, RTL simulation, emulation platforms, and silicon, identifying bottlenecks and regressions at each stage. 
 - Debug performance failures through waveform analysis, signal-level queries, trace analysis, and system-level profiling to root-cause issues in the memory subsystem, fabric, or individual engines. 
 - Influence architecture and microarchitecture decisions by surfacing performance data and trade-off analysis to the design and architecture teams early in the product development cycle. 
 - Develop and maintain performance workloads, test suites, and infrastructure - including testbench components, performance simulators, analysis scripts, and automated regression flows.

This includes using LLM-based assistants for querying results and specs, AI-driven triage of regressions, and intelligent tooling that improves over time. 
 - Drive methodology improvements to reduce verification turnaround time, improve coverage of representative workloads, and enable earlier performance insight in the product development cycle.

- B. E. /B. Tech or M. S. /M. Tech (or equivalent experience) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 
 - 3+ years of relevant experience in SoC or system-level architecture, performance verification, or hardware validation.

 - Hands-on experience with RTL simulation and debug, including waveform-based debug and signal-level querying to isolate performance failures. 
 - Solid programming skills in Python and C/C++; scripting proficiency in Bash/Python for automation and analysis. Exposure to Verilog/SystemVerilog or SystemC/TLM is a strong plus. 
 - Strong debugging, data analysis, and statistical analysis skills - ability to synthesize large volumes of performance data into actionable insights. 
 - Experience with or exposure to pre-silicon performance analysis methodologies, including performance models, cycle-approximate simulators, or emulation platforms. 
 - Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a large, globally distributed engineering organization. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Deep experience with RTL-level performance debug - particularly the ability to formulate precise signal queries and interpret waveforms to root-cause complex system-level interactions. 
 - Background in system-level performance analysis for GPU, AI accelerators, or high-bandwidth memory subsystems, with knowledge of bottleneck identification across multiple concurrent engines.

data.description:
Description

Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows. This comprehensive approach ensures quality remains at the forefront of our operational excellence. 

Key job responsibilities

- Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows
 - Create prescriptive actions for quality issues
 - Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality
 - Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements
 - Analyze data trends and develop solutions
 - Monitor quality performance and coach operations teams
 - Create and maintain quality metrics reports
 - Handle customer escalations and recommendations
 - Evaluate and suggest improvements for quality tools
 - Support process documentation and implementation

A day in the life

Your day starts by checking quality dashboards for your assigned workflows - reviewing audit scores, appeal rates, SLA status, and any overnight escalations. You will spend approximately 30% of your time on analysis: reviewing data trends, investigating root causes of quality dips, and creating prescriptive actions for operations teams. 

Another 30% goes to stakeholder communication: leading weekly customer meetings, preparing quality reports, and handling escalations. The remaining time is split between process work (updating SOPs, refining audit rubrics, conducting side-by-sides) and calibration activities (aligning audit standards with Senior Quality Auditors and operations teams). 

You are measured on: SLA metrics (appeals and batch completion), customer satisfaction, quality improvement trends for your workflows, and documentation quality. 

About The Team

The Quality Operations team within FAI Data Services ensures that labeled training data meets accuracy and consistency standards before it is used to train Amazon's AI models. Quality Specialists own the quality strategy for assigned workflows, bridging the gap between operations execution and customer expectations.

data.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
data.description:
The Opportunity

ACA believes that we can deliver the world's best GRC software to our blue-chip financial services client base of over 3500 firms. We are seeking top talent to join us in our journey to build and deliver "The Salesforce of Compliance". Compliance Officers in finance have been stuck in the past, with inefficient, manual effort driving their compliance programs. ACA's ComplianceAlpha is deployed at 800+ clients, with more added daily, to help modernize that. We are investing significantly to drive technology adoption among our clients. 

The SDET role is responsible for the development and delivery of an automation-first test suite for our ComplianceAlpha products. Each SDET will be part of a geo-located agile product team, and will provide guidance to the team during planning and refinement as well as execute on the plan during the sprint. 

We are looking for an imaginative self-starter with a passion for great software and a curiosity for developing test automation solutions that drive exceptional quality and productivity. Only motivated problem solvers willing to take the initiative and demonstrate consistent follow-through need apply. Qualified candidates will have hands-on experience building automated tests and a drive to keep growing their skills. 

What To Expect Day To Day

As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) on the Connectors team, you'll help ensure the reliability of data pipelines that ingest and process large volumes of data from platforms such as Microsoft Teams, Slack, Zoom, Bloomberg, and other enterprise systems. 

On a typical day, you will: 

- Work alongside a highly collaborative and talented engineering team. 
 - Design, develop, and execute automated functional tests to ensure the reliability and quality of our data pipelines. 
 - Collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into effective test coverage. 
 - Investigate failures, identify root causes, and help improve the overall quality of our platform. 
 - Explore and adopt new testing techniques, tools, and automation strategies. 
 - Expand your Python expertise while working with modern data engineering technologies. 
 - Participate in manual validation and release testing during production release cycles when needed. 

Required Skills

Skills and attributes for success

- Curious, lifelong learner who is excited to develop new skills and explore new technologies. 
 - Passionate about software quality, automation, and continuous improvement. 
 - At least 2 years of experience developing software in Python. 
 - Experience developing automated test pipelines for Python-based ETL processes. 
 - Experience consuming REST APIs using Python. 
 - Working knowledge of asynchronous Python (asyncio) and strategies for testing asynchronous code. 
 - Experience translating business requirements into automated functional tests. 

Nice to have

- Experience developing automated tests for Apache Airflow pipelines. 
 - Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL. 
 - Experience testing data-intensive or distributed systems. 
 - Familiarity with AWS services commonly used in data pipelines. 

What We Look For

We are interested in innovative technology professionals with strong vision and a desire to stay on top of trends in the industry. If you have a genuine passion for new technologies and transforming an entire industry, this role may be for you. A BE or B-Tech in computer Science, or equivalent is a great preference. 

What Working At ACA Offers

We offer a competitive compensation package where you'll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options as well as a flexible work environment. You'll also be granted time off for designated ACA Paid Holidays, Summer Fridays, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being. 

Plus, we offer: 

- Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. 
 - Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. 
 - Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. 
 - Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. 

Why join our team?

We are the leading governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) advisor in financial services. When you join ACA, you'll become part of a team whose unique combination of talent includes the industry's largest team of former regulators, compliance professionals, legal professionals, and GIPS® standards verifiers in the industry, along with practitioners in cybersecurity, ESG, and regulatory technology. 

Our team enjoys an entrepreneurial work environment by offering innovative and tailored solutions for our clients. We encourage creative thinking and making the most of your experience at ACA by offering multiple career paths. We foster a culture of growth by focusing on continuous learning through inquiry and curiosity, and transparency. If you're ready to be part of an award-winning, global team of thoughtful, talented, and committed professionals, you've come to the right place. 

More About ACA

ACA was founded in 2002 by four former SEC regulators and one former state regulator. The founders saw a need for investment advisers to receive expert guidance on existing and new regulations. 

Over the years, ACA has grown both organically and by acquisition to expand our GRC business and technology solutions. Our services now include GIPS standards verification, cybersecurity and technology risk, regulatory technology, ESG advisory, AML and financial crimes, financial and regulatory reporting, and Mirabella for establishing EU operations. 

What We Commit To

ACA is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We conduct our business without regard to actual or perceived age, race, color, religion, disability, caregiver, marital or partnership status, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), ancestry, national origin and citizenship, sex, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, sexual and reproductive health decisions, military or veteran status, creed, genetic predisposition, carrier status or any other category protected by federal, state and local law. 

ACA is firmly committed to a policy of nondiscrimination, which applies to recruiting, hiring, placement, promotions, training, discipline, terminations, layoffs, recall, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation and all other terms and conditions of employment. 

Here at ACA, we have created a variety of programs to promote ACA's culture of inclusivity and work hard to ensure that all our employees have an equal opportunity to contribute to ACA and feel that ACA is exactly where they belong.

The Data Services team within Global Technology Platform powers mission-critical data infrastructure across the enterprise, enabling SQL, NoSQL, and messaging services for tens of thousands of deployments across Walmart Global Tech. You will help build sophisticated tooling and platforms on top of open-source and commercial database technologies, tailoring them to Walmart's scale, reliability, security, and developer productivity needs.

Lead the design and evolution of highly available, scalable, secure, and operationally efficient NoSQL platforms that support mission-critical workloads at enterprise scale. 

Diagnose and resolve complex production issues across large installations, including performance degradation, query regressions, replication issues, availability incidents, capacity constraints, and operational bottlenecks. 

Build and influence sophisticated tooling, automation, and platform capabilities that improve database reliability, performance, observability, developer productivity, and operational simplicity. 

Partner with application engineering teams to design, review, and optimize database architectures for complex distributed systems and high-throughput workloads.

Mentor principal and senior engineers, raising the technical bar across database engineering, distributed systems, performance engineering, and production operations. 

What You'll Bring12+ years of software engineering, infrastructure engineering, or database engineering experience, with significant depth in database systems. 

Deep hands-on expertise in any database system at scale, preferably NoSQL databases with strong understanding of database internals. 

Proven experience debugging and operating complex database deployments in production, including high-availability, high-throughput, and low-latency environments. 

Experience designing and operating database platforms with strong reliability, availability, backup and restore, disaster recovery, observability, security, and compliance characteristics. 

Strong systems engineering background, with the ability to reason deeply about distributed systems, concurrency, networking, storage, failure modes, and capacity planning. 

Experience building automation, tooling, or platform capabilities around open-source or commercial database systems. 

Proven ability to define technical strategy, drive architecture across teams, and influence large-scale engineering direction without relying solely on formal authority. 

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex database and platform concepts to senior technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Strong track record of mentoring engineers, reviewing architecture, and raising engineering standards across a large organization. 

Strong programming experience in one or more systems or platform languages such as Java, Python, C++, Go.

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. Benefits

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.

Role Summary

This role combines technical leadership, people management, delivery accountability, and product ownership. You will be responsible for ensuring that the team delivers scalable, secure, supportable, and business-relevant AI and ML solutions from discovery through production operation and continuous improvement. 

This is not a lightweight line-management role. The successful candidate must be technically strong enough to guide senior engineers, data scientists, and technical leads, make sound architectural and implementation trade-offs, and raise the engineering bar of the team. You are expected to provide hands-on technical direction across LLM-powered systems, agent orchestration, RAG, ML model development, MLOps, cloud-native application delivery, integrations, observability, and SDLC discipline, while also building a culture of accountability, ownership, experimentation rigor, and engineering excellence. 

You will work closely with Product Managers, Solution Architects, Lead AI Engineers, Lead Data Scientists, Platform teams, DevOps, Security, and business stakeholders to translate business goals into implementable engineering work and durable product outcomes. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of AI Engineers and Data Scientists across varying experience levels, including senior engineers and technical leads, ensuring strong delivery quality, modeling rigor, engineering discipline, and technical growth
 - Own end-to-end delivery of GenAI, agentic AI, and ML-enabled solutions - from discovery, design, and backlog shaping through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement
 - Guide architectural and design decisions across LLM-powered systems, embeddings pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent orchestration, tool-enabled workflows, ML model pipelines, APIs, and cloud-native application services
 - Oversee the design, development, evaluation, and operationalization of machine learning models for predictive, classification, recommendation, anomaly detection, forecasting, optimization, or other business use cases where applicable
 - Ensure strong practices across feature engineering, experimentation, validation, model performance assessment, explainability, drift awareness, and MLOps readiness
 - Translate business and product priorities into executable engineering and data science plans, technical workstreams, model delivery milestones, and sustainable release outcomes
 - Review and challenge implementation choices to ensure systems and models are scalable, secure, observable, cost-aware, and maintainable

Required Qualifications

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We're a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. Our solutions foster the collaboration that's critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future. 

Department Overview

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer to join our core engineering team to design and develop a high-throughput, mission-critical active-active SIP based microservices across multi-site deployments. 

Job Description

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design and architect high-throughput, stateless SIP microservices using Go, achieving strict performance targets such as 5, 000+ TPS and sub-15ms latency budgets. 
 - Implement complex protocol translation layers to convert inbound SIP-over-TCP/TLS traffic from load balancers into high-speed SIP-over-ZeroMQ traffic for internal stateless services. 
 - Engineer advanced concurrency models utilizing ZeroMQ Router/Dealer socket pooling and internal thread-bridging patterns to prevent mutex bottlenecks and ensure thread-safe message passing under heavy load. 
 - Integrate distributed state and security mechanisms, including automated cryptographic key rotation using discovery tools for leader election and secured vaults for private key storage. 
 - Enforce surge protection and reliability by building multi-layered throttling, distributed batch schedulers, and exponential backoff handling
 - Partner with Network and Infrastructure teams to define advanced load balancer routing frameworks, DNS SRV query logic, and implement distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry) for end-to-end observability. 

Basic Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

- Knowledge of SIP/VOIP & related telecom protocols. 
 - Deep hands-on experience in Golang (preferred) and proficiency in c++/c
 - Strong computer science fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms. 
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems, multi-threading, concurrency control, stateless proxies and Finite State Machines (FSM). 
 - Hands-on expertise with networking and messaging protocols including gRPC and RabbitMQ. 
 - Strong background with distributed databases like Apache Ignite and GridGain. 
 - Practical knowledge of persistence and caching solutions such as PostgreSQL, Redis, and ElasticSearch. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and explaining complex ideas. 
 - Industry Experience - 8+ years

Travel Requirements

Under 10%

Relocation Provided

None

Position Type

Experienced

Referral Payment Plan

Yes

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building modern, scalable enterprise applications that work with large-scale industrial and time-series datasets and deliver rich, responsive user experiences. 

The role requires strong full-stack development expertise with a primary focus on frontend engineering using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS/SCSS, along with solid experience in C#/. NET, REST APIs, and backend services. 

You will design and deliver complex product features across the full stack, contribute to frontend architecture and modernization, and work closely with Product Management, UX, QA, Architecture, and other R&D teams. You will also help establish frontend engineering practices that improve performance, maintainability, usability, and developer productivity.

- Design and develop modern, responsive, and maintainable web applications using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS/SCSS. 
 - Lead the design and implementation of complex frontend features, reusable components, services, and common UI patterns.

 - Experience working with modern authentication and authorization patterns such as OIDC and JWT. 
 - Familiarity with cloud-native application development, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, and Azure-based environments. 
 - Understanding of backend and distributed-system concepts including microservices, asynchronous messaging, caching, and resiliency. 
 - Strong production-first mindset with experience troubleshooting UI, API, performance, and integration issues in enterprise applications. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and their responsible use for development, testing, documentation, and engineering productivity. 
 - Experience with industrial analytics, process data, historian platforms, time-series data, or similar data-intensive products is an advantage. 
 - Experience working with geographically distributed Agile/Scrum product development teams. 

R&D at AVEVA

Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.

Ideally, you'll also have

- Experience with React / Angular web applications as supporting frontend technologies.

 - Knowledge of mobile security practices including encrypted storage, SSL pinning, HTTPS-only communication, certificate handling and secure configuration management.

 - Experience with unit testing and automation using Jest, React Native Testing Library, xUnit, NUnit or similar frameworks.

Technology exposure

Backend: C#, . NET Core / ASP. NET Core, REST APIs, Entity Framework Core, SQL Server, Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, Azure Key Vault, Application Insights

Mobile: React Native, JavaScript / TypeScript, React Hooks, Redux Toolkit, React Navigation, Android Studio, Xcode, Gradle, CocoaPods, Firebase / push notifications

Security & Enterprise Integration: MSAL, Microsoft identity platform / Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, JWT, Intune app wrapping / Intune SDK concepts, app protection policies, SSL pinning, secure storage

Engineering Practices: Git, Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Agile delivery, unit testing, code reviews, monitoring, production support and technical documentation
