data.title: Software Engineer II
data.description:
Job Description

The Core Infrastructure Compute team is responsible for managing and maintaining enterprise compute inventory, integrating and consolidating data from multiple sources, and ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and visibility across infrastructure platforms. The team focuses on developing modern web applications, building scalable data integration and reporting solutions, leveraging Generative AI capabilities, and delivering actionable insights through advanced analytics and intelligent automation to drive operational efficiency, informed decision-making, and continuous infrastructure optimization. 

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Power BI, MS SQL Server, React. js, Python, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and data analytics. 

The ideal candidate will possess strong software engineering fundamentals, programming expertise, analytical problem-solving capabilities, and practical experience designing and developing AI-enabled enterprise applications. The role requires the ability to integrate structured and unstructured enterprise data with modern AI technologies while ensuring application scalability, security, reliability, and performance. 

Responsibilities

Software Engineering & Application Development

- Design, develop, enhance, and maintain scalable enterprise applications, analytical platforms, and AI-enabled solutions. 
 - Develop modern, responsive, and interactive web applications using React. js, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. 
 - Build reusable frontend components, dashboards, and application interfaces. 
 - Develop and integrate RESTful APIs, backend services, and enterprise data integrations. 
 - Implement application functionality using Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, or equivalent programming languages. 
 - Apply software engineering best practices, including modular architecture, clean coding, unit testing, code reviews, and performance optimization. 
 - Troubleshoot complex application, integration, performance, and production issues. 
 - Collaborate with product owners, data engineers, AI engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable technical solutions. 

Power BI & Data Analytics

- Design, develop, deploy, and maintain enterprise Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions. 
 - Translate complex business requirements into interactive dashboards, KPIs, scorecards, and actionable insights. 
 - Develop Power BI semantic models, advanced DAX measures, calculated columns, and Power Query transformations. 
 - Integrate Power BI with MS SQL Server, APIs, enterprise applications, and other structured data sources. 
 - Optimize dashboard performance, data refresh processes, query execution, and reporting efficiency. 
 - Implement row-level security, workspace access controls, and data governance best practices. 
 - Analyze large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, operational risks, and opportunities for improvement. 
 - Develop automated reporting and analytical solutions to improve business decision-making. 
 - Explore AI-assisted analytics, natural-language querying, and intelligent insights across enterprise data. 

MS SQL Server & Database Engineering

- Design, develop, maintain, and optimize SQL Server databases and enterprise data solutions. 
 - Develop complex T-SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, views, and database scripts. 
 - Perform query optimization, indexing, execution plan analysis, and database performance tuning. 
 - Develop data extraction, transformation, and integration workflows to support applications, analytics, and AI use cases. 
 - Implement relational data models and ensure data quality, consistency, integrity, and security. 
 - Integrate SQL Server data with Power BI, React applications, Python services, and AI-powered applications. 
 - Support structured data retrieval and integration with Generative AI and RAG solutions. 
 - Troubleshoot database performance, connectivity, and data processing issues. 

Generative AI & LLM Application Development

- Design, develop, and integrate Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) capabilities into enterprise applications. 
 - Build AI-powered applications using Python and frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration frameworks. 
 - Integrate LLM APIs and enterprise AI platforms, including Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Google Vertex AI, or equivalent services. 
 - Develop intelligent applications supporting natural-language search, document summarization, knowledge retrieval, conversational interfaces, and analytical insights. 
 - Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool/function calling, and context management techniques. 
 - Develop reusable AI services and REST APIs for integration with React-based applications and enterprise platforms. 
 - Evaluate LLM responses for accuracy, relevance, latency, cost, and reliability. 
 - Implement guardrails, secure prompt handling, sensitive-data protection, and responsible AI practices. 
 - Troubleshoot AI application issues involving model responses, context limitations, integration failures, and performance. 

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) & Vector Databases

- Design, develop, implement, and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using enterprise structured and unstructured data. 
 - Build document ingestion, preprocessing, chunking, embedding generation, indexing, retrieval, and response generation pipelines. 
 - Work with vector databases such as Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS, or PostgreSQL with pgvector. 
 - Implement semantic search, similarity search, metadata filtering, and hybrid retrieval techniques. 
 - Integrate vector databases with LLMs, Python services, and enterprise knowledge repositories. 
 - Develop enterprise knowledge assistants, document search applications, and AI-powered question-answering solutions. 
 - Implement embedding models, vector indexing strategies, retrieval optimization, and reranking techniques. 
 - Improve RAG response quality through retrieval evaluation, grounding, citation generation, and hallucination reduction. 
 - Integrate SQL Server and other enterprise data sources with RAG workflows where appropriate. 
 - Implement document-level access controls, data isolation, secure retrieval, and appropriate handling of confidential enterprise information. 
 - Monitor and optimize retrieval accuracy, response latency, token usage, and overall AI application performance. 

Programming, Automation & API Integration

- Develop automation solutions using Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, PowerShell, and SQL. 
 - Build backend services and APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Node. js, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Automate data ingestion, validation, transformation, reporting, and operational workflows. 
 - Develop reusable scripts and components for AI applications, analytics platforms, and enterprise integrations. 
 - Integrate REST APIs, LLM APIs, vector databases, SQL Server, and frontend applications. 
 - Implement error handling, logging, exception management, and automated testing. 
 - Support CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools. 
 - Apply version control, secure coding standards, and automated deployment practices. 

Analytical Problem Solving & Intelligent Solutions

- Analyze complex business and technical problems and translate requirements into scalable software and analytical solutions. 
 - Develop data-driven insights using SQL, Power BI, Python, and AI-assisted analytical techniques. 
 - Identify opportunities to apply Generative AI, semantic search, RAG, and intelligent automation to enterprise workflows. 
 - Perform data profiling, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and root cause analysis. 
 - Evaluate AI use cases based on feasibility, business value, security, accuracy, and operational impact. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders to define KPIs, reporting requirements, and intelligent application capabilities. 
 - Communicate technical findings and analytical insights effectively to technical and non-technical audiences. 

Qualifications

Required Experience & Technical Skills

- 3-5 years of overall IT, software engineering, application development, or data analytics experience, with hands-on experience in modern application development and AI technologies. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, semantic modeling, dashboard development, and Power BI Service. 
 - Extensive experience with MS SQL Server and T-SQL, including complex queries, stored procedures, views, database design, and performance optimization. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in React. js, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. 
 - Strong programming experience in Python, including API development, automation, data processing, and integration. 
 - Solid understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and design patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience developing Generative AI and LLM-powered applications. 
 - Practical knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture, implementation, and optimization. 
 - Experience working with vector databases such as Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS, or pgvector. 
 - Understanding of embeddings, semantic search, vector similarity, document chunking, retrieval strategies, and context augmentation. 
 - Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent LLM application frameworks. 
 - Experience integrating LLM APIs, REST services, enterprise databases, and frontend applications. 
 - Strong understanding of data analytics, data modeling, data transformation, and reporting solutions. 
 - Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and Agile software development practices. 
 - Knowledge of secure application development, data privacy, authentication, authorization, and enterprise AI governance. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities. 
 - Ability to independently design, develop, deploy, and support enterprise-grade software and AI-enabled solutions. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Knowledge of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, and enterprise data governance. 
 - Experience building AI-powered dashboards, conversational analytics, or natural-language interfaces for enterprise data. 
 - Experience developing applications in large-scale, highly regulated environments. 

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service. 

As part of Team Amex, you'll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express. 

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies. 

Job Title: AVEVA Process Simulation - Domain QA Engineer

Location: Hyderabad, India

Employment Type: full-time, hybrid work arrangement

The job

AVEVA Process Simulation (APS) is an integrated platform for engineers and operators to innovate across the entire process life cycle-design, simulation, training, and operations. As an APS - Domain QA Engineer, you will use your Chemical Engineering and process simulation expertise to ensure APS capabilities meet expected process behavior, are reliable for customers, and maintain high quality across releases. You will contribute from a domain perspective during feature grooming, testing, validation, and customer issue triage. 

Key Responsibilities

- Ensure quality of delivered features in AVEVA Process Simulation through domain-driven test planning, execution, and validation
 - Contribute to feature grooming from a domain perspective (review requirements, identify risks/edge cases, propose acceptance criteria and test scenarios)
 - Design, execute, and maintain test suites (regression, functional, domain validation) to ensure both new and existing features continue to work as expected
 - Validate simulation results against expected physical behavior, engineering heuristics, and benchmark/reference cases where applicable
 - Collaborate with developers and stakeholders (product, domain experts, and support) to deliver quality software within planned timelines
 - Interact with customers / primary support to address queries and concerns related to APS
 - Continuously improve QA effectiveness by enhancing coverage, identifying gaps in existing suites, and recommending improvements to test strategy and documentation

Location: Hyderabad, India

Essential Requirements

Education (Chemical Engineering required)

- BE/B. Tech (or higher) in Chemical Engineering is required
 - Coursework in Modelling and Simulation is preferred

Experience

- 3+ years of relevant experience in domain QA, process engineering validation, simulation workflows, or testing/validation of engineering software
 - Experience in process design is preferred; Refining / Oil & Gas background is a strong plus

Chemical Engineering & Process Simulation Knowledge

- Strong fundamentals in Chemical Engineering principles
 - Good understanding of process equipment and unit operations (design intent and operating behavior)
 - Working knowledge of simulation tools such as HYSYS, Aspen Plus, PRO/II (APS exposure is a plus)
 - Proficiency in mathematical modelling and interpreting simulation outputs logically

Testing / QA mindset (domain-driven)

Programming & Software Development Skills (Automation)

data.title: Software Engineering Team Leader-Data License Analytics
data.description:
Location

Pune

Business Area

Engineering and CTO

Ref #

10054453

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg delivers billions of data points to hundreds of thousands of customers daily. When markets move, our customers need their data immediately and without fail. That's not a nice-to-have. It's the whole product. 

The Data License Reliability & Analytics group exists to make sure that promise holds - and to make sure we keep it efficiently. Our new Pune-based DL Optimization & Automation team will build the AI tooling and the context layer that lets engineers, SREs, and AI agents across Data License reason about our systems the way our most experienced people do: which pipelines feed which products, where capacity is wasted, which risks are real, and what to fix first. 

Role

In this role, you'll build and lead a team that puts AI to work on one of the most demanding data platforms in financial services. Your team will create intelligent systems that make Data License leaner, safer, and easier to run: 

Smarter use of infrastructure - finding where compute, storage, and other system resources are over-provisioned or idle, and turning that insight into action. 

Sharper data products - analyzing how the datasets in our Data License packages are built, delivered, and used, so we can keep improving what we offer clients. 

Security, risk, and compliance on autopilot - automating the evidence-gathering, tracking, and reporting that keep us ahead of evolving regulatory and security requirements. 

Maintenance that runs itself - finding the routine upkeep that consumes engineering time and handing it to machines. 

Underpinning all of this is an AI context layer you'll help design: a living, machine-readable understanding of our systems, data, and dependencies that lets engineers and AI agents answer hard questions in minutes instead of weeks. 

You will lead a team of four engineers, setting its technical direction and driving projects from idea to delivery. You'll work closely with engineering teams across Data License and Bloomberg infrastructure - as well as our reliability teams in New York and Dublin - turning their hardest operational questions into tools they rely on every day. 

What You'd Actually Be Working On

- Building and leading the team. Build and grow a team of four engineers. Set a high bar for engineering quality and analytical rigor, run the team's planning and delivery, and create an environment where people ship useful things quickly and learn fast. You'll stay hands-on - this is a lead who writes code and reviews designs, not just one who runs meetings. 
 - The AI context layer. Design and evolve the knowledge foundation our AI tools stand on: architecture knowledge bases, semantic models and ontologies of our data and services, and knowledge graphs that connect code, configuration, telemetry, and incident history. You'll own retrieval quality across RAG and GraphRAG pipelines, decide how knowledge is structured, verified, and kept fresh, and make sure an agent's answer can always be traced back to a source. 
 - AI-driven optimization of systems, processes, and architecture. Turn one-off investigations into repeatable tooling. Build analytics that find underused machines and tenancies, unneeded storage and datasets, and architectural bottlenecks - and quantify the impact of acting on them. If we answered a question once by hand, you'll be figuring out how to answer it on demand. 
 - Agents and MCP tooling. Build MCP servers and AI agents that expose Data License systems and knowledge to engineers and to other agents, and use agent-to-agent (A2A) patterns to compose them into multi-step workflows. Work on context retrieval, prompt and tool design, evaluation frameworks, and the feedback loops that make these systems more accurate over time. 
 - Risk and compliance analytics. Own the automated analytics behind regulatory and risk programs such as emerging cyber-resilience regulation and enterprise risk management: scanning codebases and inventories, tracking remediation, and producing evidence that holds up to scrutiny from auditors and leadership. 
 - Tools people actually use. Build the web applications, dashboards, and reports (React, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python) that put these insights in front of engineers, managers, and leadership, and make them self-service. 
 - Shaping the AI Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC). Help define how Data License builds software with AI agents - agentic development workflows, guardrails, and evaluation. Your team will be an early adopter and an example for the rest of the organization. 
 - Partnering across Data License and Bloomberg infrastructure. Work directly with application, platform, and SRE teams to understand their problems, review designs, and bring data to architecture decisions. You'll be the person teams come to when they want to know what a change will really cost, what it will save, and what it might break. 

What You Bring

- 7+ years writing production software, with strong Python and solid JavaScript/TypeScript
 - 2+ years leading engineers - as a team lead, tech lead, or in a role where you owned a team's technical direction and delivery
 - Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent hands-on experience
 - Hands-on experience building with LLMs: RAG pipelines, prompt and tool design, agents, or evaluation of AI output quality
 - Experience building full-stack applications, including React front-ends and Python back-end services and APIs
 - A data-driven mindset: you measure before you optimize, you show your evidence, and you're skeptical of conclusions - including an AI's - that can't be traced to a source
 - Strong communication skills. You'll lead a team in Pune while partnering with teams in New York, Dublin, and elsewhere, so you need to explain trade-offs clearly and build consensus without authority
 - Willingness to pick up new tools fast - this field changes month to month

What Would Set You Apart

- Experience with GraphRAG, knowledge graphs, ontologies, or semantic modeling
 - Building or deploying MCP servers, multi-agent systems, or agent-to-agent (A2A) protocols in production

Job Description

AI Infrastructure Engineer (Mid / Senior)

Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid - 3 days a week in office)

About Us

Sage is a global leader in accounting and business management software, trusted by millions of businesses worldwide. Together with our Bengaluru engineering team, we are building finance, accounting, payroll and expense management solutions that simplifies how businesses track and reconcile spending. 

Thousands of finance teams globally use our product to streamline expense management, integrate seamlessly with leading accounting platforms, and are recognized for its clean design, usability, and speed. 

We're investing heavily in AI - building the platform that lets AI agents and assistants do real engineering work, reliably and at scale. This team designs and runs the infrastructure behind our coding agents, review agents, and internal AI assistants: the orchestration, context and memory systems, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops that make them better over time. 

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone with 3+ years of software engineering experience (mid-level) or 6+ years (senior), with hands-on experience building LLM-powered or agent-based systems in production. 

Technical Skills

- Solid software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, data modelling, and clean, maintainable code. 
 - Experience building and running production systems in the cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including containers, Kubernetes or similar, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Hands-on experience with distributed systems: queues, async workflows, concurrency, reliability, and failure handling. 
 - Practical experience building with LLMs: tool use, agents, prompt and context engineering, RAG, and evaluation. 
 - Familiarity with agent protocols and ecosystems (e. g. , MCP) and with using AI coding tools day to day. 

Leadership & Ownership

- Comfort working independently and handling ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, scope it, and drive it to production. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining trade-offs to both technical and non technical audiences. 
 - At the senior level, we also expect you to lead projects and set technical direction, mentor other engineers, define evaluation and quality standards, and influence architecture across teams. 

Mindset & Collaboration

- Growth mindset - curious, always learning, and open to feedback. 
 - Works closely with the engineers who use these tools every day; you help the whole organization build software better and faster. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with trace analysis or log mining to find and fix agent failure modes. 
 - Experience building internal platforms or SDKs that other teams adopted. 
 - Background in observability, CI/CD, or developer productivity tooling. 
 - Experience with model routing, cost optimization, or prompt caching. 
 - Open-source or public contributions in agent tooling or LLM infrastructure. 

What to Expect

- We value humility and collaboration - we're looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos. 
 - We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code - including tests, documentation, and long-term system quality. 

Key Responsibilities

The Impact You'll Make

- Build and operate agent platforms: orchestration, tool and skill registries, plugin frameworks, and sandboxed execution. 
 - Develop coding agents and review agents that work well on real, large codebases, and integrate them into the existing SDLC (IDE, CI/CD, code review, issue tracking). 
 - Design context and memory management: retrieval (RAG), summarization and compression, session state, long-term memory, and repository-aware context. 
 - Build evaluation frameworks - both offline (benchmarks, regression suites) and online (production quality signals) - so we can measure whether agents are improving. 
 - Create feedback loops: capture and mine traces, find failure patterns, and turn them into better prompts, tools, skills, and evals. 
 - Build developer tooling and internal SDKs that make it easy for other teams to build on and adopt the platform. 
 - Own observability for agent systems: tracing, cost and latency tracking, and quality monitoring. 
 - Work with engineers and stakeholders to identify high-value workflows, ship quickly, and iterate on real usage data.

data.title: High Speed IO Validation Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the world's most desirable employers in the technology field. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. The NVIDIA Silicon Co-Design Group is seeking a versatile engineer to join our High Speed SERDES IO electrical validation team. Your bench is where silicon meets the signal - where every link train, jitter sweep, eye diagram, and protocol corner gets exercised before the part ships. You drive characterization and debug for IO interconnects across silicon, board, firmware, and driver - designing tests that anticipate rack-scale deployment so marginality surfaces at die-and-board scale, never in a rack. Your decisions show up in link margin, BER, power per lane, and the go/no-go calls that gate samples and production. 

This role focuses on industry-leading high-speed interconnects such as PCIe, USB3, Ethernet, and UFS. You will perform bring-up and electrical validation with a strong emphasis on quality, stability, and efficiency. Additionally, you will leverage AI-assisted workflows, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance validation quality, accelerate root cause analysis, and improve engineering efficiency. This position offers the opportunity to make a significant impact in a dynamic, technology-driven environment influencing product lines that span artificial intelligence, consumer graphics, self-driving cars, and more. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Execute electrical validation for PCIe, Ethernet, USB3, and UFS interfaces for NVIDIA GPUs, CPUs, and SOCs, ensuring adherence to signal integrity standards. 
 - Engage with cross-functional engineering teams to facilitate the design and development process, leveraging your knowledge of firmware/driver interactions and circuit design. 
 - Analyze complex HSIO bugs by applying strong debugging techniques and collaborating with various teams for rapid resolution. 
 - Diagnose issues and validate high-speed interfaces using modern lab equipment, including DSOs and BERT, with expert-level proficiency. 
 - Develop and apply test/debug programs using scripting languages (such as Perl and Python) to perform stress and failure analysis on high-speed interfaces. 
 - Innovate methodologies that leverage AI-assisted workflows and data-driven analytics to enhance debugging efficiency and improve validation quality. 

What We Need To See

- BS or MS in Electronics Engineering (or equivalent experience) with at least 3 years of relevant experience. 
 - Deep high-speed/SERDES electrical validation and tuning experience, with strong SI and PI fundamentals - S-parameters, eye diagrams, channel margin, crosstalk, return loss, PDN noise, jitter decomposition - and validation experience across silicon and platform boundaries (CoWoS/interposer/substrate, board), translating rack-environment effects into silicon/board characterization. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in electrical validation of PCIe (or similar) protocols, hands-on with lab equipment (DSOs, BERT, protocol analyzers), and scripting skills (Perl, Python) for developing test/debug programs. 
 - Proven experience in building AI solutions specifically in the context of electrical and silicon validation, including designing and implementing AI-assisted workflows and automation frameworks to enhance engineering productivity and validation quality. 

If you are energized by challenging problems, real ownership, deep work, and AI-enabled engineering at scale, we'd love to talk to you. 

, , JR2025319

data.title: Director Software Engineering  - Backend (Consumer Team),Hyderabad
data.description:
Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery. . . the stuff dreams are made of. 

Who We Are. . . 

When we say, "the stuff dreams are made of, " we're not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD's vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what's next. . . 

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive. 

Director Software Engineering   - Backend (Consumer Team), Hyderabad

About Warner Bros. Discovery:   

Warner Bros. Discovery, a premier global media and entertainment company, offers audiences the world's most differentiated and complete portfolio of content, brands and franchises across television, film,   streaming  and gaming. The new company combines Warner Media's premium entertainment, sports and news assets with Discovery's leading non-fiction and international entertainment and sports businesses.   

For more information, please visit  www. wbd. com.   

Meet Our Team:     

DTC's many software engineering teams build applications for the web, mobile, tablets, connected TVs, consoles, and other streaming devices. Every customer starts their wonderful journey into the world of WBD through DTC's Partner Integrations team. We ensure customers can seamlessly authenticate and authorize across all WBD brands. We are a fast-growing, global engineering group crucial to WBD's future.     

We have setup an India Development Center to better support our global streaming services and  assist  international teams. 

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Partner Integrations Platform organization: the services that connect our streaming and TV Everywhere products to distribution partners worldwide, including pay TV and virtual pay TV operators, telcos, device makers, and retail and bundle partners. 

The platform carries subscriber authentication and authorization, identity federation and account linking, entitlement resolution, partner initiated subscription and plan lifecycle, and the onboarding and certification path that brings new partners live. It sits on the critical path of subscriber sign in and activation, so reliability and operational discipline matter as much as feature delivery. 

This is a senior leadership role for a leader who manages managers and senior technical staff, sets platform direction, and delivers through an organization rather than through personal execution. Deep expertise in one specific technology is not required. Strong grounding in distributed systems, API and integration architecture, identity and access, cloud platforms, and engineering operations is. 

This is a full ownership role. The organization owns its capabilities end to end, including architecture decisions, delivery, operations, and direct relationships with partner facing stakeholders. It is not a delivery arm that executes designs set elsewhere. 

Roles & Responsibilities:   

Engineering Leadership
 - Lead the engineering managers and teams that own partner authentication, identity and entitlement, partner initiated commerce, and partner onboarding services. 
 - Build an engineering culture of ownership, reliability, partner and subscriber focus, high standards, and inclusion. 
 - Coach managers and staff engineers so that technical judgment, design quality, and day to day decisions are owned inside the organization rather than escalated. Develop staff engineers into the first point of technical guidance for their teams and credible counterparts to senior engineers in peer organizations. 
 - Own workforce planning and performance for the organization: hiring plan, role definition and leveling, hiring decisions, performance expectations and reviews, managing performance concerns to resolution with People and Culture, and succession for manager and staff level positions. 
 - Build a leadership bench with a defensible promotion pipeline, and hold managers accountable for team health, delivery predictability, and talent development. 
 - Establish the operating cadence for the organization: planning, delivery and risk review, technical review, operational review, and skip levels. Platform Strategy and Delivery
 - Own the technical roadmap for partner integration capabilities and translate distribution and product strategy into engineering plans with clear milestones and measurable outcomes. 
 - Hold near term partner launch commitments in balance with architecture quality, operational simplicity, and cost, and balance partner driven feature work against the engineering and operational excellence investment the platform needs. 
 - Drive consolidation and modernization of integration patterns so that new partner models, bundle structures, and billing arrangements are handled through configuration rather than bespoke engineering. 
 - Reduce the cost of change in a system with a large external dependency surface. Hold contract and versioning discipline at partner and vendor boundaries, and plan migrations off deprecated third party interfaces without partner or subscriber disruption. 
 - Ensure significant technical decisions are documented, reviewed, and durable through architecture and design decision records produced by the owning teams. 
 - Allocate ownership across teams by capability and development intent rather than historical familiarity, so that partner and platform knowledge is deliberately spread rather than concentrated in a few individuals. 
 - Resolve capability ownership and cross organization dependency questions with peer engineering leaders at director level. Operational Excellence
 - Own operational readiness for services on the critical path of partner sign in, activation, and entitlement, where failures are immediately visible to subscribers and to partners. 
 - Establish and hold operational practice: SLIs and SLOs for each partner facing flow, dashboards, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and follow through on root cause and correction of error actions. 
 - Move operations from escalation driven to signal driven. Detect problems from authentication, activation, and entitlement error trends and partner traffic patterns before partners report them, and improve mean time to resolution and alert quality on measurable terms. 
 - Hold partner launches and migrations to a defined readiness bar: validation in a partner representative environment, monitoring, rollback plan, named ownership, and a communication plan for the partner and internal stakeholders. 
 - Raise release confidence through automated integration testing in CI/CD across partner flows, trunk based deployment, and sustained reduction of environment instability and pre production regressions. 
 - Reduce operational toil through automation and self service, and size the operations model against real ticket, launch, and maintenance load rather than adding headcount by default. 
 - Apply AI assisted engineering and operations where it measurably improves triage speed, root cause analysis, code quality, or launch support, within company policy on security, privacy, and intellectual property. Partner Experience and Self Service
 - Reduce engineering and operations involvement in routine partner work: onboarding, configuration, credential and key management, identity mapping, plan and offer setup, and migration between subscription models. 
 - Deliver tooling and APIs that let partner facing teams and partners themselves emulate, validate, troubleshoot, and certify end to end subscriber journeys without engineering involvement. 
 - Improve partner facing documentation, error semantics, and diagnostics so that integration problems are self diagnosable and support requests fall as a result. 
 - Use partner support and activation data to identify and champion the platform investments that most reduce onboarding time, defect rates, and partner escalations. Cross Functional Collaboration and Influence
 - Act as the engineering counterpart to partner facing, product, program management, operations, security, data, and finance teams, building direct relationships rather than working through intermediaries. 
 - Bring partner and operational reality into roadmap decisions, so that platform investment reflects how partners actually integrate and where subscribers actually drop out. 
 - Represent the organization in architecture reviews, roadmap and launch forums, leadership reviews, and executive updates, communicating technical topics in terms of partner, subscriber, and business impact. 
 - Define success metrics for major initiatives before launch and publish impact for delivered work. 
 - Keep decisions moving. Time box technical debate, take deep discussion into smaller working groups, and communicate proactively on risk, drift, and escalations rather than on request. What to Bring:   

- 15 - 17 years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - 5+ years leading engineering managers and large engineering teams. Experience managing managers is required. 
 - Experience operating large scale distributed systems or platform services with a significant external integration surface. 
 - Strong grounding in API design and versioning, identity and access management, federated authentication and authorization, event driven and asynchronous integration, data reconciliation, observability, and cost management. 
 - Experience owning systems with material third party dependencies, where partner or vendor interface changes drive migration and compatibility work. 
 - Proven ability to lead platform programs spanning multiple teams, time zones, and stakeholder groups. 
 - Strong operational excellence mindset: incident management, monitoring, SLOs, runbooks, root cause and correction of error practice, and automation. 
 - Demonstrated ability to build organizational capability through hiring, coaching managers, developing technical leaders, and creating credible growth paths. 
 - Ability to set direction and ramp up teams with minimal oversight from leadership. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication with executive, technical, and cross functional audiences. 
 - Experience leading globally distributed teams across time zones.   Preferred Qualifications
 - Experience in streaming media, pay TV distribution, subscription commerce, or partner and affiliate ecosystems. 
 - Familiarity with TV Everywhere or operator based authentication and entitlement models. 
 - Experience building self service partner or developer platform capabilities, including sandbox, emulation, and certification tooling. 
 - Experience running or closely partnering with an operations function supporting a large external partner base. 
 - Experience introducing AI assisted engineering practices with measurable quality or productivity outcomes. 

What We Offer:   

- A Great Place to work.   
 - Equal opportunity employer.   
 - Fast-track growth opportunities.   

How We Get Things Done. . . 

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www. wbd. com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview. 

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law. 

If you're a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

data.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer - Confluent Cloud Infrastructure
data.description:
Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world's leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You'll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM's product and technology landscape. Here, you'll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

Confluent Cloud processes millions of events per second across AWS, GCP, and Azure. When incidents happen in a multi-cloud streaming platform, they happen at scale-data in motion, exactly-once semantics, and cascading failure modes that require deep systems thinking. We need an expert-level engineer who can drive proactive reliability improvements that prevent these incidents before they occur. 

This role combines hands-on technical work with strategic program ownership. You'll spend roughly 75% of your time on engineering: building automation, improving tooling, analyzing systemic failure patterns, and designing reliability improvements. The remaining 25% is teaching and coordination: coaching teams through post-mortems, training incident commanders, and evolving our incident response practices. 

You'll be part of a global team with follow-the-sun coverage, with clean handoffs that keep everyone working sustainable hours. Confluent has 800-1000 engineers across highly autonomous teams. This role sits within Cloud Architecture and Reliability - Supportability (CAR-S), a horizontal team that owns reliability standards and tooling across engineering. You're the person who makes us need incident management less. 

What You Will Do

- Proactive Reliability Engineering (~75% of role)
 - Analyze systemic failure patterns and design improvements that prevent incident recurrence
 - Define and maintain SLO/SLA frameworks; use error budgets to guide reliability investments
 - Build tooling and automation to reduce incident response toil and scale team impact
 - Own Rootly configuration, workflows, and integrations with PagerDuty, Jira, Confluence, and Slack
 - Analyze reliability data to identify systemic improvements; build dashboards that drive action
 - Explore AI-assisted approaches to documentation quality and incident analysis
 - Design scalable reliability standards that reduce reactive workload over time. 
 - Incident Management Program (~25% of role)
 - Own standards, practices, and continuous improvement of incident response
 - Serve as an on-call Incident Commander for production incidents, including acting as escalation IC when incidents exceed a team's management chain
 - Develop and deliver training programs for engineering teams at all levels
 - Coach teams through post-mortems and on developing actionable corrective actions
 - Customer Root Cause Analysis (CRCA)
 - Edit and review customer-facing incident documents to ensure quality and clarity
 - Drive turnaround SLAs while maintaining technical accuracy
 - Ensure clear explanation of what happened, why, and how we'll prevent recurrence
 - Cross-Team Leadership
 - Partner with engineering leaders to elevate reliability practices
 - Be the expert who teams proactively engage for guidance

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- 10+ years in SRE, incident management, or reliability engineering
 - Cloud experience with at least one of AWS, GCP, or Azure·
 - Deep expertise with incident management tooling (Rootly, PagerDuty, or similar platforms)
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems and failure modes at scale-Kafka/event streaming expertise preferred, or demonstrated rapid mastery of complex systems
 - Deep experience with observability: metrics, logging, tracing-ability to diagnose complex issues
 - Kubernetes and container orchestration experience
 - Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and release processes
 - Systems thinking: understanding how infrastructure design choices affect failure modes and recovery
 - Familiarity with SLO/SLA frameworks. 
 - Track record as a trusted advisor across engineering organizations
 - Experience driving org-wide process and cultural changes
 - Strong written communication (design docs, one-pagers, runbooks)
 - Post-mortem facilitation experience
 - Experience with async collaboration across time zones
 - Large company experience navigating reliability/incident programs at 500+ engineer organizations·

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- Multi-cloud experience (minimum 2+ of AWS/GCP/Azure). 
 - Modern CI/CD, GitHub, AI-assisted workflows-you'll have the freedom to build what you need.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Software Engineer - Full Stack & Mobile in GDS Digital, you will play a key role in designing and delivering secure, scalable and high-performing enterprise solutions across . NET backend APIs and React Native mobile applications. 

The role requires strong hands-on experience in creating RESTful APIs using C#, . NET Core / ASP. NET Core, integrating APIs with enterprise mobile applications, and delivering React Native solutions for both iOS and Android. 

The ideal candidate should be comfortable owning technical modules end-to-end, contributing to solution design, implementing MSAL / Microsoft identity-based authentication, supporting Intune app wrapping / enterprise app protection requirements and mentoring junior engineers. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop and maintain scalable backend systems, RESTful APIs and reusable services using C#, . NET Core / ASP. NET Core.

 - Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis and drive effective remediation. 
 - Mentor junior engineers, provide technical guidance and support knowledge sharing within the team. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

To qualify for the role, you must have

- 4-6 years of experience in software development with strong hands-on experience in . NET backend engineering and mobile application development. 
 - Strong expertise in C#, . NET Core / ASP. NET Core for building enterprise-grade applications and APIs. 
 - Strong understanding of REST API design, distributed systems, microservices concepts, API security, scalability and performance optimisation. 
 - Hands-on experience with React Native for building and maintaining iOS and Android enterprise applications. 
 - Strong knowledge of JavaScript / TypeScript, React concepts, hooks, component architecture, state management and mobile navigation patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating mobile apps with backend APIs, authentication systems and enterprise platforms. 
 - Practical experience with Microsoft identity platform, MSAL authentication, OAuth 2. 0 / OpenID Connect, JWT tokens, scopes, claims and role-based access. 
 - Exposure to Microsoft Intune app wrapping / Intune SDK concepts, mobile application management and app protection policies. 
 - Good understanding of Android and iOS build ecosystems including Android Studio, Xcode, Gradle, CocoaPods, app signing, certificates and provisioning profiles. 
 - Hands-on experience with SQL Server, Entity Framework Core, database design and query optimisation. 
 - Experience with Azure services such as App Services, Functions, Azure SQL, Storage, Key Vault, API Management and Application Insights. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions, Git-based workflows and release management. 
 - Strong debugging, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder collaboration skills. 

Ideally, you'll also have

- Experience with React / Angular web applications as supporting frontend technologies. 
 - Experience with Redux Toolkit, React Navigation, push notifications, Firebase messaging, secure storage, mobile analytics and crash reporting. 
 - Knowledge of mobile security practices including encrypted storage, SSL pinning, HTTPS-only communication, certificate handling and secure configuration management. 
 - Experience with API versioning, Swagger / OpenAPI, Azure API Management, caching and observability practices. 
 - Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, Azure Kubernetes Service, event-driven architecture, messaging and asynchronous communication patterns. 
 - Experience with unit testing and automation using Jest, React Native Testing Library, xUnit, NUnit or similar frameworks. 
 - Ability to contribute to solution architecture, technical documentation, reusable components, engineering playbooks and mentoring initiatives. 

Technology exposure

Backend: C#, . NET Core / ASP. NET Core, REST APIs, Entity Framework Core, SQL Server, Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, Azure Key Vault, Application Insights

Mobile: React Native, JavaScript / TypeScript, React Hooks, Redux Toolkit, React Navigation, Android Studio, Xcode, Gradle, CocoaPods, Firebase / push notifications

Security & Enterprise Integration: MSAL, Microsoft identity platform / Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, JWT, Intune app wrapping / Intune SDK concepts, app protection policies, SSL pinning, secure storage

Engineering Practices: Git, Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Agile delivery, unit testing, code reviews, monitoring, production support and technical documentation

What We Offer You

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

data.description:
Job Purpose

To define the quality base line of the products and how they should function, conducts quality analysis to verify the functionality of the products for end users and to ensure they are developed to meet requirements planned in the stories. 

Key Result Responsibilities

Employs technical and analytical skills to conduct quality testing and checks on the products design in line with agreed objectives. 

Verifies the products from quality perspective to ensure they are all designed, developed and delivered in accordance to the agreed concepts, design and requirements recommended in the stories. 

Uses available resources and tools to execute gap analysis and identify gaps or deficiencies in the products and provide recommendations on solutions. 

Collaborates with the products team to carry the functional analysis for all the products designed to ensure they are useful and useable by end users. 

Develops a variety of testing scenarios to ensure credibility of testing and analysis conducted and recommends solutions as applicable. 

Concludes the testing results and releases them using the JIRA tool to be accessible by team members as needed. 

Key Result Responsibilities-Continued

Supports the development team in the sprint planning by providing them with results of the testing scenarios to consider in their final artwork or in alternative solutions.

Job Description

This strategy is key to the WSP in India Buildings Mechanical Electrical Public Health (MEP) business as we position ourselves to address the challenges of a changing global economy. The role is the cornerstone of the establishment of a MEP Design Capacity in Noida working and adhering to WSP Global standards and promoting technical excellence, in addition to creating and building a team. This will involve recruiting, leading, developing a team of Engineers over a relatively short period of time. The successful candidate will stimulate and manage significant growth in a technically demanding environment to time, cost and quality targets. Cultural awareness, an open mind and excellent communication skills are essential requirements for the role. 

Responsibilities

A major element of this role is to liaise with the WSP in India design teams to ensure that the following essential elements of the role are satisfactorily completed: -

- Agree and confirm the project brief to anticipate and identify needs and expectations in conjunction with others. 
 - Agree the project deliverables and programme. 
 - Agree the resource in India that will be required to undertake the designs to complete the project brief in time and cost. 
 - Agree the project fees according to brief, resource required and programme. 
 - Be responsible for the quality of detailed design to WSP in India and Global Building Regulations standards ensuring technical reviews and sign off including complex calculations and co-ordination issues. 
 - Ensure design are co-ordinated and due consideration of Health & Safety, Construction Design Management and Quality Assurance standards. 
 - Regularly communicate and update the local Indian and wider Global project teams on programme delivery and quality issues through use of staff utilisation charts and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) reporting etc. 
 - Review outputs of Computer Aided Design analysis, and determine additional levels of checking needed. 
 - Where necessary, development of energy strategies incorporating renewable technologies and low energy designs to satisfy local authority planning requirements and compliance with Building Regulations Part L.

Commercial

Qualifications

data.title: Process Lead - Accounts Payable
data.description:
Job Summary

The Process Lead - Accounts Payable is responsible for the accurate, timely, and compliant execution of end-to-end Requisition-to-Pay (R2P) processes across multiple entities and jurisdictions. The role supports invoice processing, vendor payments, employee expense reimbursements, account reconciliations, and financial controls while ensuring adherence to banking regulations, internal policies, audit requirements and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). The role also supports quality improvement, issue resolution, and acts as a point of guidance for junior analysts. 

The individual will play a critical role in optimizing payment operations, mitigating risk, enhancing controls, supporting transformation initiatives, and ensuring consistent delivery against Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Key Responsibilities

- Manage end-to-end R2P activities including invoice processing, validation, payment runs, reconciliations, Travel & Expense, and MIS professionally & efficiently
 - Ensure daily work allocation (indexing, assessing, processing) is completed consistently and efficiently. 
 - Review incomplete or incorrect invoices before moving them to the rework queue. 
 - Prioritize urgent and critical invoices as per instructions from the Manager or Team Coordinator. 
 - Ensure all assigned volumes are completed as per agreed productivity and quality targets. 
 - Maintain 100% accuracy in invoice processing, journals, and rework movements. 
 - Journals to be processed with 100% accuracy based on inputs received. 
 - Ensure strong financial and operational controls are in place and operating effectively. 
 - Monitoring to ensure that the standards of customer service provided, is consistently meet or exceed the requirements set under the Service Level Agreements agreed with the customers
 - Support audit requirements and ensure compliance with internal policies and quality standards. 
 - Review processes regularly to identify opportunities for efficiency, quality, and automation improvements. 
 - Supervising the team, providing on-the-job and other process trainings
 - Support new process transitions, migrations, and stabilization initiatives. 
 - To be responsive to the needs of the stakeholders at all times, ensuring clear and effective communication. 
 - Coordinate with other R2P team leads and Global Finance teams to ensure smooth operations. 
 - Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes. 
 - Apply accounting knowledge across the end-to-end P2P lifecycle, including upstream and downstream dependencies. 
 - Review and manage the book of work for the assigned process stream. 

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

- Advanced Accounts Payables Knowledge (E2E)
 - Good accounting knowledge
 - Good understanding of Operations Risk & Controls
 - Month end reporting
 - Process Improvement Techniques
 - Good understanding of Taxes

Other Skills

- Reconciliation
 - SAP (VIM / S4 HANA / Ariba)
 - Technical Skills (MS Excel & PPT)

Motivations

- Strategic & Analytical Thinking
 - Problem Solving
 - Attention to Detail
 - Stakeholder Management
 - Time Management
 - Team Collaboration
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
 - Continuous Improvement Mindset

Qualifications

Key Experiences

- 3-5 years of experience in Accounts Payable, Procure-to-Pay (P2P), or Requisition-to Pay (R2P) operations. 
 - Experience within Banking, Financial Services or Shared Services preferred. 
 - Exposure to multinational and high-volume transaction environments is an advantage
 - Proven experience handling complex AP transactions, audits, controls, and stakeholder management. 
 - Proven experience in managing end-to-end operational processes. 
 - Strong understanding of operational risk, controls, and regulatory requirements. 
 - Experience in process improvement, automation, and transformation initiatives. 
 - Demonstrated ability to engage with senior stakeholders and drive business outcomes

Certifications / Qualifications

- Any Degree or master's degree in commerce or business administration

Languages

- English

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us. 

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion. 

Together We

Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do

Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well

Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing. 

Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations. 

Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum. 

Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns. 

Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits

A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning. 

Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

data.title: Lead Salesforce Engineer
data.description:
The IT SaaS Engineering Team plays a critical role in enabling MongoDB's post-sales business processes, including Customer Success, Support, Renewals, Services, and account management workflows. By leveraging Salesforce and related business systems, the team ensures that post-sales teams have the tools, automation, security, and governance needed to effectively manage customer relationships, support customer outcomes, improve operational efficiency, and drive long-term customer growth. 

With deep expertise in Salesforce development, platform governance, automation, integrations, and system operations, the team continuously enhances the CRM platform to support evolving post-sales business needs. The team partners closely with stakeholders across Customer Success, Technical Services, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Billing, Security, Compliance, and Engineering to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable Salesforce solutions. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly experienced Lead Salesforce Engineer to drive the architecture, design, and evolution of critical Salesforce and CRM solutions supporting MongoDB's post-sales business processes. This role combines deep technical leadership, hands-on solution design, cross-functional stakeholder partnership, people management, and a modern engineering mindset that embraces AI-powered development responsibly to improve productivity, quality, and long-term platform health. 

The ideal candidate will have strong experience designing scalable Salesforce solutions for complex customer lifecycle processes, including customer success operations, support workflows, renewals, account management, customer health, and post-sales automation. 

What you'll do

- Lead the architecture, design, and development of scalable Salesforce solutions supporting post-sales teams, including Customer Success, Support, Renewals, Services, and account management workflows
 - Translate business requirements into secure, maintainable, and scalable technical solutions aligned with long-term platform strategy
 - Partner closely with business stakeholders, product teams, and engineering teams to refine requirements and deliver high-quality post-sales solutions
 - Oversee integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise platforms, ensuring reliable data flow and sound system design across the customer lifecycle
 - Drive platform optimization across performance, scalability, usability, maintainability, and governance
 - Establish and enforce engineering standards for coding, testing, documentation, CI/CD, and release management
 - Troubleshoot complex technical and production issues and drive long-term, scalable resolutions
 - Maintain technical documentation, including architecture decisions, design specifications, and implementation details
 - Stay current with Salesforce platform capabilities, releases, and best practices, and proactively recommend improvements
 - Proactively identify process and technical gaps, and help define and drive tech debt reduction initiatives, platform modernization efforts, and engineering efficiency improvements across the Salesforce ecosystem
 - Leverage AI-powered engineering tools such as Apex Guru, GitHub Copilot, Salesforce Agentforce/Vibes, Claude Code, and similar capabilities to improve development productivity, code quality, design effectiveness, troubleshooting, and documentation, while applying strong judgment around security, privacy, accuracy, and responsible AI usage

Responsibilities

- Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and engineering best practices
 - Act as a subject matter expert on Salesforce development, platform capabilities, automation, integrations, and scalable CRM solution design for post-sales business processes
 - Lead technical design sessions and identify gaps between current-state and future-state solutions
 - Design and support scalable solutions for customer success, support operations, renewals, customer health, account management, and related post-sales workflows
 - Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and engineering practices, and drive proof-of-concepts where appropriate
 - Mentor engineers across the team and foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and engineering excellence
 - Support team growth by coaching, developing talent, and helping build a high-performing engineering organization
 - Influence business and technical stakeholders through strong communication, sound judgment, and effective problem-solving
 - Operate effectively in a fast-changing environment by managing priorities, driving accountability, and ensuring high-quality execution

Minimum Requirements

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
 - 12+ years of experience in Salesforce engineering, application development, or technical leadership within global SaaS organizations
 - Strong hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, integrations, and Salesforce platform customization
 - Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, governor limits, design patterns, and scalable solution design
 - Experience designing or supporting Salesforce solutions for post-sales functions such as Customer Success, Support, Renewals, Services, or customer lifecycle management
 - Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, release management, and Agile/Scrum delivery models
 - Salesforce Platform Developer II certification required; Salesforce Certified Application Architect and Salesforce Certified System Architect certifications strongly preferred

Success Measures

In 3 months, you will

Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB's Salesforce ecosystem, post-sales business processes, and technical landscape. Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders across Customer Success, Support, Revenue Operations, and Engineering. 

In 6 months, you will

Lead the technical design and successful delivery of critical Salesforce initiatives supporting post-sales workflows. Establish yourself as a trusted technical leader within the Business Systems team. 

In 12 months, you will

Be the go-to technical leader for Salesforce architecture, complex solution design, and platform strategy for post-sales systems. Elevate team quality through strong technical leadership, mentoring, and scalable engineering practices

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. data.title: Senior Software Developer - Mobile (Kotlin)
data.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

Veryon is a global information services and software company that exists to make flying safer and more reliable. Our products help reduce operating costs, improve aircraft reliability, and support technical knowledge sharing and collaboration within the general, business, and commercial aviation, as well as military/defense and OEM industries. 

Reporting to the Manager of Engineering, the Senior Software Engineer will contribute to the design and development of modern mobile applications using Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP/KMM). We are looking for someone with strong hands-on technical expertise, a passion for clean, scalable code, and solid problem-solving skills. This role will focus on designing, writing, and reviewing shared and platform-specific code, while collaborating closely with product, design, and quality teams to deliver high-quality mobile software that meets business objectives. 

The Day To Day

- Design and develop cross-platform mobile applications using Kotlin Multiplatform, sharing business logic across Android and iOS while leveraging native platform capabilities where appropriate. 
 - Build and maintain shared KMP modules (networking, domain, data, caching) and integrate them with Android (Jetpack/Compose) and iOS (Swift/SwiftUI/UIKit) layers. 
 - Write clean, efficient, testable, and well-documented Kotlin code, ensuring high performance and maintainability. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, designers, QA, and backend engineers to translate business requirements into scalable mobile solutions. 
 - Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives. 
 - Conduct and participate in code reviews, ensuring adherence to mobile and KMP/KMM best practices. 
 - Continuously evaluate new mobile technologies, KMP/KMM libraries, and tooling to improve development efficiency and product quality. 
 - Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior engineers, especially around mobile architecture and shared code strategies. 

Requirements

- 2-5 years of hands-on experience in mobile application development using Kotlin multi platform. 
 - Proven experience with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP), including sharing business logic across Android and iOS. 
 - Strong proficiency in Kotlin, including coroutines, flows, and modern language features
 - Solid understanding of mobile architecture patterns (MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture). 
 - Experience integrating KMP/KMM modules with Android (Compose / XML) and iOS (Swift / SwiftUI / UIKit). 
 - Experience implementing platform-specific functionality using expect/actual patterns or native interop with Swift and Android APIs. 
 - Strong experience in RESTful API integration, including authentication, error handling, and performance optimization. 
 - Demonstrated ability to optimize mobile app performance and handle scalability challenges. 
 - Experience building offline-capable mobile applications, including local persistence, caching strategies, and data synchronization. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git-based version control, and mobile build/distribution workflows. 
 - Experience providing technical guidance or mentoring to peers or junior engineers. 
 - Exposure to cross-platform frameworks such as . NET MAUI, Xamarin, or Flutter is an added advantage. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 

What You'll Accomplish - Your Performance ObjectivesObjective #1 In your first 30 days: 

- Develop a basic understanding of applications by working with the team
 - Familiarize yourself with the technical implementations of mobile apps
 - Approve your first merge request through our peer review process. 

Objective #2 In your first 3 months: 

- Work with the development and QA teams to deliver your first feature to production
 - Work with the dev ops team to support the automation of our build and deployment processes, and to implement feature flagging
 - Ramp up on the existing codebase, tools, and development workflows. 
 - Participate in code reviews and team discussions to share insights and learn best practices. 
 - Contribute to identifying areas of technical improvement and begin proposing solutions or enhancements. Objective #3 In your first 12 months: 
 - Consistently contribute to the on-time delivery of features and bug fixes using Agile methodologies. 
 - Take ownership of key components or modules, ensuring their quality, scalability, and maintainability. 
 - Collaborate across teams to support technology and process improvements within engineering and related functions. 
 - Actively participate in architectural discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Contribute to the knowledge base by documenting best practices and mentoring newer team members. Who We're Looking For - The Personal Competencies That Matter Collaborative: You have empathy for your colleagues and customers. You demonstrate cross-functional collaboration within the engineering teams and seek out opportunities to build relationships with others throughout the company. You understand we are all on the same team working towards the same goals. Intellectually Curious: You have a strong level of curiosity and care about learning. You understand that learning is a continuous part of being an engineering manager and are always looking for ways to sharpen and/or broaden your skillset. Flexibility: You understand that priorities and requirements will evolve, and you may have to be flexible in your approach and in your expectations. You are open-minded and adapt well to changing environments as a company grows and scales. You aren't afraid to step outside your comfort zone and take the initiative to help the team succeed. Technical Skills: You have technical expertise across numerous technologies, and the ability to train and mentor your team on how and when to utilize them. How We Work - The Core Values That We Live By
 - Fueled By Customers: We work hard so our customers can get more uptime. A customer-centered approach is on the forefront of our minds. We're big on transparent communication with our customers, and we celebrate their wins internally because we love the positive impact we're making on their lives. 
 - Win Together: We focus on the "we" and not the "me". Collaboration is key, we value diverse backgrounds and skill sets. Our mission is to win as a team; we think everyone plays an integral part in our success. 
 - Make it Happen: When we make a commitment, we get it done. We take a proactive approach, we commit, we adapt to evolving landscapes and problems, we tackle problems at every difficulty level. 
 - Innovate to Elevate: We set the standard in aviation by embracing and advancing cutting edge technology. We take a fail-forward approach using everything as a learning experience. We encourage creativity and experimentation within our teams. This helps us set the bar high and provide world class expertise in aviation. 

Notice of AI Use in Job Application Review

As part of our commitment in creating a fair, efficient, and consistent hiring process we may use artificial intelligence (AI) to help our recruiting teams organize, summarize, and analyze information provided by candidates, including resumes, application responses, and other materials submitted during the application process. AI may be used to identify patterns, highlight relevant skills, and experience, and assist in comparing a candidate's qualifications with the requirement of a specific role. These tools are to improve efficiency and consistency while supporting more informed hiring decisions, which will ultimately be made by the hiring team.

Job Description

Microchip's Communications Business Unit (CBU) develops high-performance networking, connectivity, and edge compute semiconductor solutions that power communications infrastructure, data centers, automotive systems, aerospace and defense platforms, and industrial applications. Our global team works across the full product lifecycle to deliver innovative products that enable the world's most demanding connected systems. 

The CBU Product Development team is engaged throughout the device R&D cycle, from concept and design through implementation. Once a prototype is available, we support embedded software development and system-validation lab testing through mass-market production release. Our experienced chip-development team uses the latest semiconductor tools and methodologies, together with advanced process technologies, to develop state-of-the-art networking devices. 

As a Principal Engineer on the CBU Product Development team, you will be responsible for verifying digital integrated circuits at the block or device level. You will collaborate with chip architects, subsystem leads, and verification team members to deliver increasingly complex designs in a friendly, professional environment. 

The Role Of The Principal Engineer Includes

- Verification
 - Own the verification of complex digital integrated circuits at the block, subsystem, or device level. 
 - Understand the device requirements and functional description to ensure compliance with specifications and error-free operation. 
 - Plan verification activities, develop testbenches, and execute tests. 
 - Develop verification platforms using the UVM methodology and SystemVerilog. 
 - Technical Leadership
 - Deliver verified designs at the Device, Subsystem or Block level
 - Partner with a dedicated Design Lead to deliver high-confidence designs
 - Verify designs implemented in SystemVerilog RTL using industry-standard methodologies. 
 - Domain Expertise
 - Contribute to the development and enhancement of verification technologies and methodologies. 
 - Cross Functional Responsibility
 - Collaborate with Software and Validation teams to deliver devices that integrate into a wider system. 
 - Participate in Product Validation during the prototype stage of development. 
Requirements/Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering
 - 8+ years related experience
 - Excellent analytical and debugging skills and the ability to proactively solve issues
 - Proven ability to thrive on, learn and adapt to new methodologies and technologies
 - Strong coding skills
 - Experience using one or more of System Verilog/Verilog/VHDL, Tcl/Perl/Python, C/C++
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
 - Experience with verification methodologies, including UVM, formal verification, and constrained-random verification.
