data.title: Staff Engineer
data.description:
Life at Plume

At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces-and human experiences-at massive scale. 

We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. 

With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day. 

This is a work-from-office / In-Office role based in our Hyderabad, India location. 

Plume's Core Engineering team builds the open-standards firmware foundation of our platform across RDK-B, prplOS and OpenWRT and OpenSync. We are looking for a Staff Engineer to own the controller based broadband router firmware stack end to end: architecture, design, implementation, upstreaming

You will be the technical lead for various features like device management, network management, Wi-Fi and multi-AP mesh features such as backhaul management and steering, onboarding and metrics etc. 

What you'll do

- Own architecture and design for various CPE features like EasyMesh, Wi-Fi Optimization, remote and local controller over standard SDK platforms like RDK-B, PrplOS, OpenWRT and OpenSync. This includes deep Wi-Fi sub-system management like backhaul link tracking, standard and hitless (make-before-break) backhaul steering, backhaul STA policies, and AP/STA metrics. 
 - Break large features into sequenced, reviewable work. Write design documents, feature matrices and validation reports that both engineers and program stakeholders can use. 
 - Maintain Plume's RDK-B Yocto layer and patch framework. Lead quarterly rebases onto new RDK-B releases and keep reference builds healthy on gateway and extender targets. 
 - Close gaps in TR-181 data models exposed through USP (obuspa) and UBus, RBus, including Wi-Fi DataElements, DHCP and DNS. 
 - Deliver onboarding flows: WPS, Wi-Fi EasyConnect (DPP) and backhaul onboarding, with WPA3/SAE, 6 GHz and Wi-Fi 7 MLO support. 
 - Triage and fix Alpha, Beta and GA blockers: mesh instability, IPv6 dual-stack and RA behavior, routing, firmware upgrade failures, and CPU and memory regressions. Back each fix with measured before/after data. 
 - Upstream fixes to opensource community like RDK Central, PrplOS, OpenWRT and evaluate competing community contributions against our own implementation. 
 - Contribute to cross-platform work on prplOS/prplMesh and OpenSync, including porting spikes and architecture comparisons. 
 - Review code and mentor engineers. Work closely with QA, program management and architects in other regions. 

What you'll bring

- 10+ years building embedded Linux or networking firmware, with 4+ years on Wi-Fi or broadband CPE software. 
 - Strong C and C++ on Linux user space, plus shell scripting. Comfortable debugging on target with gdb, core dumps, /proc and packet captures. 
 - Hands-on RDK-B (e. g. CCSP components, RBus, OneWifi, WebConfig, and Yocto/BitBake builds) and PrplOS experiences
 - Deep 802. 11 knowledge: hostapd and wpa_supplicant, 802. 11k/v/r and BTM, WPA3/SAE, 6 GHz, MLO. 
 - Working knowledge of EasyMesh and IEEE 1905. 1: topology discovery, TLVs, controller/agent state machines and backhaul. 
 - TR-181 and USP/TR-369. TR-069 experience is a plus. 
 - Solid IP networking: IPv4/IPv6 dual stack, DHCPv4/v6, router advertisements, routing, netfilter/iptables and QoS. 
 - A track record of taking features from spike to GA, with written designs that others build from. 
 - Fluent in Git and GitHub pull-request workflows, quilt-style patch management and Jenkins CI. 

About Plume

As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J: COM. 

Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume's software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture. 

Plume is an equal opportunity workplace that maintains a continuing policy of nondiscrimination in all employment practices and decisions, ensuring equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth or related individual conditions, medical conditions (as defined by state law), military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

data.title: Sr Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
About SailPointSailPoint is the global leader in identity security for the cloud enterprise. We empower the world's most influential organizations to securely unlock the power of their workforce and technology. By harnessing the power of advanced AI, machine learning, and cloud-native architecture, SailPoint provides intelligent, automated identity governance that seamlessly secures access to applications, data, and critical infrastructure. 

Driven by our core values-Innovation, Integrity, Impact, and Individuals-we foster an inclusive, high-trust engineering culture where curiosity and technical excellence thrive. Joining SailPoint means tackling complex distributed systems challenges at global scale while safeguarding millions of user identities worldwide. 

Role OverviewAre you passionate about building mission-critical enterprise systems and eager to drive real architectural impact? At SailPoint, our Engineering team is where world-class software craftsmanship meets direct customer impact. 

We are seeking a seasoned Principal or Backend Software Engineer to design, build, and scale reliable, high-throughput microservices and SaaS infrastructure. Our platform is built on a mature, cloud-native, event-driven microservices architecture hosted in AWS, securing identity governance for the world's leading global enterprises. In this role, you will lead complex technical initiatives, mentor senior peers, collaborate across product and UX teams, and deliver robust software that defines the future of identity security. 

What You'll Do (Responsibilities)
 - Architect & Build Scalable Services: Design and implement robust, high-performance, and resilient microservices in a modern Java ecosystem, exposing performant REST and event-driven APIs. 
 - Full Stack & UI Leadership: Collaborate with product and UX designers to build responsive, modern front-end interfaces (React, TypeScript, or modern ES6+ frameworks) and rapid prototypes to validate design decisions. 
 - System Design & Modeling: Lead domain modeling, object-oriented analysis, and technical design discussions for distributed SaaS applications hosted in AWS. 
 - Raise the Engineering Bar: Drive engineering excellence through rigorous code reviews, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), continuous delivery, and comprehensive code coverage metrics. 
 - Observability & Operational Excellence: Instrument services for performance monitoring, telemetry, tracing, and logging to ensure high availability and proactive issue resolution in production. 
 - Technical Mentorship & Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional peers-product managers, UX architects, and DevOps engineers-to scope initiatives, estimate complexity, and mentor engineering talent. 
What You'll Bring (Requirements)
 - 14+ years of progressive, hands-on professional software development experience building enterprise SaaS or distributed systems. 
 - Deep Core Java Expertise: Advanced mastery of modern Java (Java 11/17+), concurrency, design patterns, and JVM performance tuning. 
 - Distributed Systems & Architecture: Proven track record designing and maintaining event-driven microservices and RESTful API ecosystems. 
 - Full Stack Proficiency: Solid hands-on experience with modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (e. g. , React, Angular) and modern front-end build pipelines (ES6+). 
 - Engineering Rigor: Passion for automated testing (TDD/BDD, JUnit, Mockito, Cypress/Selenium) and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Communication & Leadership: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
Preferred Qualifications
 - Cloud Native Ecosystems: Direct experience architecting and operating production workloads on AWS (e. g. , ECS/EKS, Lambda, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, S3, RDS). 
 - Data & AI/ML Systems: Experience integrating with or designing for Big Data pipelines, streaming architectures (Kafka, Kinesis), or AI/ML-driven product features. 
 - Production Observability: Hands-on experience with metrics and APM tooling (e. g. , Datadog, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, CloudWatch). 
 - Security & Identity Governance: Prior exposure to Identity and Access Management (IAM), OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML, or RBAC/ABAC models. 
30 / 60 / 90-Day Success PlanThis roadmap provides clear expectations and milestones to empower you to ramp up quickly, integrate with the team, and deliver meaningful architectural impact. 

First 30 Days: Onboard, Understand & First Ship
 - Architecture Immersion: Build a deep understanding of SailPoint's domain, platform topology, event-driven microservices, data pipelines, and AWS infrastructure. 
 - Environment & Tooling: Set up local and cloud dev environments, CI/CD pipelines, test automation suites, and observability dashboards. 
 - Team Alignment: Complete 1: 1s with engineering peers, product managers, UX partners, and architects to understand priorities and existing pain points. 
 - First Production Delivery: Implement, test, and deploy an initial bug fix or small enhancement to production to validate the end-to-end deployment workflow. 
Days 31-60: Ownership, Feature Delivery & Design Collaboration
 - Take Ownership: Assume technical ownership of a primary microservice component or full-stack feature stream. 
 - Architectural RFCs: Author and present technical design documents/RFCs for upcoming initiatives, incorporating feedback from security and architecture teams. 
 - Full Stack Delivery: Collaborate closely with UX and product counterparts to design and deliver intuitive interfaces and supporting backend APIs. 
 - Quality & Observability: Enhance automated test coverage and set up proactive alerting/telemetry metrics for services under your care. 
Days 61-90: Leadership, Scale & Strategic Impact
 - Autonomous Execution: Lead end-to-end delivery of high-priority roadmap deliverables, ensuring high throughput, reliability, and zero-downtime releases. 
 - System Optimization: Identify architectural bottlenecks, technical debt, or scale limits in data persistence/streaming layers and execute performance tuning initiatives. 
 - Engineering Mentorship: Actively review peer code, lead architectural discussions, and mentor mid-level and senior engineers on design and coding standards. 
 - Roadmap Contribution: Partner with Product Management to help scope future quarters, translating business vision into scalable engineering milestones. 

SailPoint is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified candidates to apply to join our team.   All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.   

Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. Contact applicationassistance@sailpoint. com or mail to 11120 Four Points Dr, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78726, to discuss reasonable accommodations.   NOTE: Any unsolicited resumes sent by candidates or agencies to this email will not be considered for current openings at SailPoint.

data.title: Compiler Performance Engineer
data.description:
Falcon is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM. 

We are looking for a Compiler Performance Engineer to make Falcon generate even faster code. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: the compiler exists, runs in production at large enterprises, and your job is to find where the generated code is slower than it should be and fix it in the optimizer and code generator. 

You will join a distributed team of compiler experts and work on real workloads with direct, measurable impact on customer performance. 

What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)

- Analyze performance of Java benchmarks and customer workloads, find gaps in generated code and trace them to their root cause in the compiler

- Implement and improve optimizations in Falcon's middle end and back end: inlining, loop optimizations, vectorization, redundancy elimination, speculative optimizations and their interaction with the runtime

- Improve code generation for x86_64 and AArch64

- Write tests and benchmarks that prove the improvement and protect it from regressions

- Contribute changes upstream to LLVM where it makes sense

What You'll Bring (Experience, Skills)

- 2+ years of professional experience in compilers, JIT compilers or low level performance engineering

- Strong C++ design and coding skills

- Solid understanding of compiler optimization theory: SSA, data flow analysis, loop transformations

- Ability to read assembly and reason about why one instruction sequence is faster than another

Very Nice to Have

- Experience with LLVM IR and LLVM optimization passes, or with another optimizing compiler such as HotSpot C2, Graal, GCC or V8

- Experience with profilers such as perf, VTune or async profiler

- Knowledge of x86_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture

- Experience with Java, Scala or Kotlin, or with JVM internals

- MSc or PhD in Computer Science with a compiler or performance focus

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Must have skills : Veeva CRM testing

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Summary: 

As a Veeva CRM Senior Tester, a typical day involves designing and executing testing for implementations, integrations, and releases in a regulated life sciences environment. The role owns test preparation, execution, defect investigation, validation evidence, and delivery of high-quality results. This position focuses on ensuring quality, compliance, traceability, and release readiness across Veeva CRM programs while collaborating with cross-functional teams, supporting testing best practices, and contributing to continuous improvement in testing processes and automation.

- Analyze requirements and prepare test scenarios, cases, data, and traceability.

 - Validate Veeva CRM commercial processes, Salesforce configurations, integrations, and offline scenarios.

- Must Have Skills: Hands-on Veeva CRM testing experience in a life sciences environment.

 - Exposure to Selenium, Cucumber, Tosca, or similar automation tools. 
 - Understanding of Agile delivery, GxP, CSV, ALCOA+, data integrity, and validation controls. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, collaboration, and communication skills. 
 - Strong learning agility, stakeholder collaboration, and effective communication skills. 
 - Experience with Veeva Commercial Cloud, CLM, Approved Email, Align, MyInsights, or iOS offline testing is preferred. 
 - Exposure to API, database, automation, performance, accessibility, and security testing is preferred. 

Additional Information: 

- The candidate should have 4-6 years of software testing or quality engineering experience, including at least 2 years of hands-on Veeva CRM testing.

Nextiva is looking for a Staff AI Engineer to help build an internal AI platform that will shape how we work across engineering and the broader organization. 

This is a Staff-level, hands-on individual contributor role at the intersection of backend/platform engineering, system architecture, AI, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity. You'll design and build production-grade agentic workflows across the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and intelligent automation that improves engineering and business processes across Nextiva. 

Working across Nextiva's technology platform, you'll identify high-value opportunities, architect solutions, and take them from concept through deployment, operationalization, security, observability, and scale. You'll also provide technical leadership and influence across engineering teams. 

We are looking for an engineer who understands that AI is a means to a business outcome-not the outcome itself and can turn promising capabilities into reliable systems that create measurable value. 

Top 3 Outcomes (first 12 months)

- Build and operationalize agentic SDLC capabilities: Architect and deliver production-grade AI workflows that materially improve how Nextiva engineers design, build, test, review, deploy, operate, and maintain software, with measurable improvements in engineering effectiveness. 
 - Establish a scalable internal AI platform: Develop reusable architecture, services, infrastructure, patterns, and guardrails that enable AI-powered workflows to move reliably from experimentation into secure, observable, production-scale operation. 
 - Deliver measurable business impact through AI and automation: Identify and execute high-value automation opportunities across engineering and business processes, establishing clear success metrics and demonstrating tangible improvements in productivity, quality, velocity, cost, or customer outcomes. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect, build, deploy, and operate production-grade AI systems and agentic workflows across the SDLC and broader business processes. 
 - Design scalable internal platform capabilities that enable teams across Nextiva to safely and efficiently adopt AI-powered automation. 
 - Own solutions end-to-end-from problem definition and architecture through implementation, deployment, observability, security, scaling, and ongoing operation. 
 - Build robust integrations between AI models, agents, developer tooling, internal platforms, enterprise systems, APIs, data sources, and engineering workflows. 
 - Apply strong software engineering principles to AI systems, including modular architecture, testing, reliability, performance, maintainability, and fault tolerance. 
 - Design approaches for AI evaluation, observability, quality measurement, failure handling, and continuous improvement in production. 
 - Make pragmatic architectural and technology decisions based on business outcomes, engineering constraints, risk, and total cost of ownership rather than technology trends. 
 - Work deeply within GCP and/or AWS, designing cloud-native architectures and infrastructure capable of supporting secure, reliable, scalable production workloads. 
 - Partner with infrastructure, DevOps, security, architecture, and engineering teams to establish reusable engineering patterns, technical standards, and operational guardrails for AI-powered systems. 
 - Understand complex software systems and large codebases to identify opportunities where AI can improve developer workflows across the end-to-end SDLC. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI models, frameworks, agent architectures, and developer technologies to determine where they can create meaningful value for Nextiva. 
 - Provide Staff-level technical leadership through architecture reviews, design decisions, technical mentorship, and influence across engineering teams. 
 - Translate ambiguous business and engineering problems into clear technical strategies and executable solutions, measuring and optimizing impact based on production data, user feedback, and business results. 

Requirements

Must-have

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating complex production-scale systems. 
 - Demonstrable hands-on experience designing and building AI/ML or generative AI solutions that have reached production and/or delivered measurable business outcomes. 
 - Strong software architecture and system design skills, including experience making consequential technical decisions for distributed or large-scale systems. 
 - Strong programming and software engineering fundamentals in one or more production languages such as Java, Python, Go, or equivalent. 
 - Hands-on experience working with LLMs, generative AI, AI agents, or AI-enabled application architectures, beyond simply consuming AI productivity tools. 
 - Experience taking AI solutions beyond prototypes into deployment, operationalization, monitoring, security, reliability, and scale. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with GCP and/or AWS, including designing and operating cloud-native production systems-not solely familiarity with cloud services or consoles. 
 - Strong understanding of DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, reliability, and production operations. 
 - Strong understanding of application, infrastructure, data, and AI security considerations and the ability to incorporate appropriate controls into system architecture. 
 - Strong understanding of the end-to-end software development lifecycle, developer workflows, and the challenges of working within large software systems and codebases. 
 - Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs and select technologies based on the problem, desired business outcome, operational requirements, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Strong technical judgment and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, cross-functional problem spaces. 
 - Ability to influence technical direction across teams without relying solely on organizational authority. 

Preferred

- Experience designing or implementing agentic AI systems, multi-step AI workflows, tool-using agents, or autonomous/semi-autonomous engineering workflows. 
 - Experience applying AI to developer productivity, software engineering, code generation, testing, code review, incident management, or other stages of the SDLC. 
 - Experience building internal developer platforms, engineering productivity platforms, or enterprise automation capabilities. 
 - Experience with AI evaluation frameworks, model/agent observability, prompt and context management, retrieval architectures, and production AI quality measurement. 
 - Experience spanning traditional software engineering and AI engineering-for example, a strong backend, platform, or distributed-systems engineering foundation combined with substantial hands-on AI engineering experience. 
 - Experience driving technical initiatives that span multiple teams, systems, or organizational domains. 

Tools & Tech Stack

The Exact Stack Will Evolve As We Select Technologies Based On The Problems And Outcomes We Are Solving. Relevant Experience May Include

- Cloud: GCP and/or AWS
 - Languages: Java, Python, Go, and/or equivalent production engineering languages
 - AI: LLMs, generative AI, agentic frameworks and architectures, model APIs, evaluation and observability tooling
 - Platform & Infrastructure: Containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, cloud-native services
 - Engineering: APIs, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, observability and developer tooling
 - Security: Cloud security, identity and access management, secrets management, secure application and AI architecture

Nextiva DNA (Core Competencies)

Nextiva's most successful team members share common traits and behaviors: 

- Drives Results: Action-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and simplicity to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go. 
 - Critical Thinker: Data-driven, forward-thinking individuals who identify key drivers, anticipate risks, and deliver clear recommendations. They confidently leverage AI and automation to reduce friction, improve decision-making, and focus on higher-value work. 
 - Right Attitude: Collaborative, competitive, and resilient team players who jump in to solve tough problems, learn from setbacks, and foster a culture of service, respect, and care for customers and teammates. 

Total Rewards

Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to allow our employees to take care of themselves and their families so they can be their best, in and out of the office. 

Our compensation packages are tailored to each role and candidate's qualifications. We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. We aim to offer competitive salaries or wages that reflect the value you bring to our team. Depending on the position, compensation may include base salary and/or hourly wages, incentives, or bonuses. 

- Medical 🩺 - Medical insurance coverage is available for employees, their spouse, and up to two dependent children with a limit of 500, 000 INR, as well as their parents or in-laws for up to 300, 000 INR. This comprehensive coverage ensures that essential healthcare needs are met for the entire family unit, providing peace of mind and security in times of medical necessity.

 - Experience establishing metrics-based process and platform improvements. 

Our Commitment

We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks. com. 

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

data.title: Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead
data.description:
Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML, LLM application development, Generative AI, platform architecture, solution architecture, or technical product development. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead to drive the development and evolution of the Fluid AIQ Platform and lead AI-powered application development for upcoming client projects. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience building production-ready applications using LLMs, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, and modern AI frameworks. 

This role goes beyond traditional chatbot development, focusing on building intelligent agentic applications capable of reasoning, planning, interacting with enterprise systems, using tools, and operating within defined guardrails. 

The position combines AI architecture, hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and product commercialization. You will help transform platform capabilities into modular commercial offerings that can be deployed independently and expanded based on client requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Agentic AI Architecture & Platform Development

- Design scalable architectures for agentic AI applications, including single-agent and multi-agent systems. 
 - Define agent orchestration, tool usage, memory, state management, and workflow patterns. 
 - Establish reusable reference architectures, implementation guides, client onboarding playbooks, and engineering standards. 
 - Evaluate AI technologies, models, frameworks, and infrastructure based on business and technical requirements. 
 - Contribute to the evolution and architecture of the Fluid AIQ Platform. 

2. AI Application Development

- Build production-ready applications using AI agents, LLMs, RAG, and workflow automation. 
 - Implement tool/function calling, planning and reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop processes. 
 - Develop integrations with enterprise APIs, business applications, and external systems. 
 - Implement MCP Server/Client integrations and autonomous or semi-autonomous workflows. 
 - Build AI-powered decision-support solutions and reusable platform components. 

3. LLM & Generative AI Engineering

- Work with LLM providers and models, including OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, and open-source or local models. 
 - Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management, function calling, and model fallback strategies. 
 - Evaluate and benchmark models based on cost, performance, latency, privacy, and business use cases. 
 - Ensure flexibility in model and framework selection without unnecessary platform dependency on a single provider. 

4. Product Leadership & Commercialization

- Take technical and product ownership of Fluid platform components and client AI programs. 
 - Help package platform capabilities into independent, commercially viable modules. 
 - Support the commercialization of reusable platform capabilities and technical IP. 
 - Develop sales-enablement materials and implementation guidance. 
 - Track and report platform health, adoption, and delivery metrics to leadership. 

5. AI Safety, Reliability & Governance

- Implement guardrails and validation mechanisms to reduce hallucinations, incorrect tool usage, unauthorized actions, and unsafe outputs. 
 - Design human-approval workflows where required. 
 - Build reliable agent workflows with error handling, retries, fallback mechanisms, and observability. 
 - Support release management, environment management, service-level objectives, and production support models. 
 - Address security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI requirements. 

6. Technical Leadership & Collaboration

- Lead and mentor architects and engineers working on agentic AI solutions. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, development, and cross-functional teams. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI technologies and build proof of concepts (POCs). 
 - Ensure solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and delivery timelines. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

Agentic AI & Generative AI

- Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and agentic AI architectures. 
 - Hands-on experience with RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, context management, and AI evaluation. 
 - Experience with agent orchestration, tool/function calling, multi-agent systems, agent memory and state, and human-in-the-loop workflows. 
 - Understanding of agent guardrails, reliability, and observability. 

Programming & Application Development

- Strong programming skills in at least one of the following: Python or Node. js/TypeScript. 
 - Experience with REST APIs, microservices, authentication and authorization, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and database integration. 

AI Frameworks & SDKs

- Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, Claude Agents SDK, or equivalent agent SDKs. 
 - Ability to evaluate and select frameworks based on solution requirements rather than relying on a single technology. 

LLM Integration

- Experience integrating multiple LLM providers, preferably OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Ollama/open-source LLMs. 

Data Engineering & RAG

- Experience with PostgreSQL, vector databases, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or similar technologies. 
 - Knowledge of embedding models, document processing, semantic search, and hybrid search. 
 - Familiarity with knowledge graphs and ontology design, including Neo4j, RDF/OWL, or GraphRAG. 
 - Understanding of multi-tenant data architecture. 

Cloud Platforms

- Strong experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. 

Good-to-Have Skills

- Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. 
 - Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other AI coding tools. 
 - Ollama and open-source LLMs. 
 - Multimodal AI, Voice AI, and AI workflow automation. 
 - AI observability, evaluation platforms, and model evaluation. 
 - Fine-tuning, AI security, prompt-injection protection, and PII/data protection. 
 - Enterprise SaaS, CRM, and ERP integrations. 
 - AI FinOps and FinOps Foundation practices. 
 - Cloud marketplace listings, including Azure Marketplace and AWS Marketplace. 
 - Product management experience and experience commercializing consulting IP as licensed software. 
 - Experience replacing or complementing traditional RPA solutions with AI-agent-based approaches. 

What We're Looking For

- A hands-on technical leader who can translate business requirements into scalable agentic AI solutions. 
 - Someone who can combine architecture, engineering, platform development, and product thinking. 
 - A professional capable of taking AI capabilities from proof of concept to production-ready and commercially deployable solutions. 
 - Strong communication, technical decision-making, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills. 

Interested in building production-grade Agentic AI platforms and bringing AI-powered products to market? Apply now!

data.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. 

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

The Manager, Data Storage Platforms is responsible for leading a team of platform engineers overseeing the planning, the build, and the operations of data platforms. They will be responsible for architecting, engineering, and optimizing large‐scale, cloud‐native data platforms on AWS and Azure. This role leads development of event‐driven data architectures, CDC frameworks, data lake ingestion pipelines, and scalable ETL/ELT processes. The architect partners closely with cross‐functional teams, leads technical delivery, ensures operational excellence, and provides hands‐on support for global data transformation initiatives. They will be a part of the Data Services Platforms team and provide technological and process expertise and support the global domain data product delivery teams. They will provide leadership by assisting business partners in identifying and responding to opportunities for cost-effective data implementations and solutions by analyzing and making decisions that have cross functional business impact. 

Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of data platform engineers
 - Accountable for strategic planning and technical roadmap development for data platforms. 
 - Oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of data engineering pipelines in a multi-cloud environment, including integrations with a variety of data sources (including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data)
 - Collaborate with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams and other stakeholders in Architecture, Data Integration, DevOps, and Data Governance to deliver data platform initiatives
 - Ensure data engineering standards align with industry best practices for data governance, data quality, and data security. 
 - Monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines, ensuring they meet SLAs for data availability and quality. 
 - Evaluate and recommend new data technologies and tools to improve data engineering processes and outcomes, in collaboration with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams. 
 - Effectively communicate and realize vision and strategy for the organization that aligns with the business and patient needs.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
CS DISCO is aimed at redefining the landscape of legal technology. Ultimately, we seek to enable lawyers to achieve more efficient, data-oriented, and fact-based legal outcomes. We started our journey as a company by focusing on the crucial 'discovery' phase of the legal process. One of our offerings, Ediscovery, focuses on enabling legal teams to achieve these outcomes with incredible efficiency. 

The massive data proliferation over the last decades has revealed the limitations of many legal technology products, impacting the efficiency of legal practices. At CS DISCO, we strive to provide solutions to the legal domain that are magical. To do so requires the processing of large volumes of data at petabyte scale, with high availability, while maximizing performance, minimizing operations cost, and also ensuring data security, privacy, and sovereignty. 

Our overarching mission is to create a unified technology platform for the practice of law. We envision a suite of products focused on delivering distinctly better legal outcomes with a minimum of human toil and cost. Our technology addresses the challenges of scale in data and enables legal teams to focus on the critical tasks that necessitate human legal judgment. 

With a trajectory that has already seen substantial disruption in this market, our approach is underscored by a lawyer-inspired interface and a cloud-enabled technology platform, aiming for exemplary performance and cost efficiency. Thoughtful product planning and design are ingrained in our "product first" business ethos and culture, aligning with the broader objective of enhancing the practice of law through technology. 

Your Impact

You will be a key contributor and responsible for both hands-on technical work to improve existing systems as well as guiding long-term evolutions in this space. You'll be successful by ensuring that the product and its backend systems meet current and future functional and scaling demands. Through your contributions towards both implementation and system design, you will play a pivotal role in maintaining and evolving our software systems to meet the growing demands of our business, ensuring high availability and high performance. 

What You'll Do

- Engage actively in coding, code reviews, and technical discussions, ensuring high-quality output. 
 - Lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable, high-performance, easily modifiable distributed systems. 
 - Continuously enhance system performance, focusing on meeting customer needs using the best practices for designing scalable distributed systems. 
 - Share knowledge and mentor junior engineers, promoting a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning. 
 - Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions. 

Who You Are

- 10+ years of relevant experience in backend engineering, with a focus on building large scale, highly responsive, fault tolerant services in SaaS and cloud-based applications. 
 - Strong experience with building highly reliable, highly responsive services backed by relational and non-relational data stores. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in designing, implementing, and maintaining (through operational observability) highly available, high-performance, distributed systems. 
 - Proven ability to deliver well-crafted, tested, and maintainable code solutions to complex technical challenges. 
 - Experience with multiple software stacks, have opinions and preferences, but are not tightly coupled to a specific stack. 
 - You've delivered cloud native software solutions (including designing, implementing, and operational excellence). 
 - Experience in implementing RESTful APIs for outward-facing services and using gRPC for efficient internal service-to-service communication. 

Even Better If You Have. . . 

- Experience with designing, modifying, and operating multi-tenant systems. 
 - Familiarity with designing and developing from a security perspective with security best practices in system design and development. 
 - Demonstrated proficiency in multiple programming languages, including but not limited to Python and Kotlin/Java. 
 - Strategic level interaction with UI Developers. 

Some Of Our Technology Stack

- Cloud Provider: AWS
 - Persistence: Sql Datastore, Elasticsearch, and others
 - Container Orchestration: ECS, Kubernetes
 - Transport: gRPC, GraphQL
 - Persistence: Elasticsearch, DynamoDB, PostgresQL, Redis
 - Event Bus: Kafka
 - Languages / Frameworks: Kotlin / Netflix DGS, Python / Flask, . NET

Perks of DISCO

- Open, inclusive, and fun environment
 - Benefits, including medical and dental insurance
 - Competitive salary plus discretionary bonus
 - Opportunity to be a part of a startup that is revolutionizing the legal industry
 - Growth opportunities throughout the company

About DISCO

DISCO provides a cloud-native, artificial intelligence-powered legal solution that simplifies ediscovery, legal document review and case management for enterprises, law firms, legal services providers and governments. Our scalable, integrated solution enables legal departments to easily collect, process and review enterprise data that is relevant or potentially relevant to legal matters. 

At DISCO, we believe AI is a core enabler of how work gets done. All employees are expected to proactively adopt and responsibly use AI tools to drive efficiency, improve outcomes, and continuously evolve how they operate in their role. 

Are you ready to help us fulfill our mission to use technology to strengthen the rule of law? Join us!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We're committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power. 

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care-about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose. 

Could that be you?

About The Role

Join the Vertical Solutions team and build UiPath's most ambitious product - an AI agentic orchestration platform that's been recognized as our Invention of the Year for two consecutive years. As a Principal Software Engineer, you'll be at the forefront of our Act 2 strategy, building the infrastructure that allows enterprises to seamlessly orchestrate AI agents, robots, and human-in-the-loop workflows to achieve critical business outcomes. 

You'll be working with Lax and the Maestro backend team to build the core orchestration engine that powers enterprise AI automation. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role on UiPath's biggest strategic bet. 

What You'll Do

- Build and Scale: Design, develop, and maintain full stack for Vertical Solutions products leveraging AI Coding Assistants. 
 - Hands-On Development: Write production-quality code daily, leveraging AI tools (Claude, GitHub Copilot, etc. ) to enhance your development workflow
 - Prototype and Ship: Take ideas from Prototype to validate with real customers and turn the ones that prove value into production systems. 
 - Measure what matters: Design evaluations, measure quality against real customer data, and understand when metrics mislead. Our systems are often non-deterministic. Responsible shipping means measuring honestly, not chasing vanity numbers. 
 - Customer-Centric Engineering: Deeply understand who will use the features you build and why they need them, translating customer needs into elegant technical solutions
 - Ensure Reliability: Contribute to building highly scalable, reliable distributed systems that enterprises depend on. 

What We're Looking For

- Builder mindset - you enjoy turning ideas into working systems and taking ownership from Concept through, Customer impact and Production
 - Strong full stack knowledge including frontend systems like React and backend systems -Python and/or C# - most Vertical Solutions product development is Python (agents, APIs, ETL), while core platform work includes C#, frontend in React. Willingness to work across both is important. 
 - Experience building production AI systems - LLMs, tool-calling, multi-agent architectures, orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent), structured outputs, orchestration, and evaluation of model behavior in real-world workflows
 - Distributed systems experience - designing resilient systems with idempotency, replay ability, state management, and long-running jobs
 - Strong analytical thinking - able to reason quantitatively about system quality and make sound decisions using imperfect signals
 - Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid prototyping - able to move from idea to proof-of-concept quickly and iterate based on customer feedback. 
 - Experience with healthcare Tech/ Finance Tech/ Procurement Tech systems experience will be a big plus. 

What You'll Bring To The Team

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent experience. 
 - 13+ years of software engineering experience, with 5+ years focused on distributed systems and backend architecture. 
 - Strong proficiency in one or more system-level languages - Javascript / C# / Java etc
 - Full-stack experience: ability to work across backend services and frontend layers (REST/GraphQL APIs, basic UI integration, component contracts). 
 - Deep understanding of object-oriented programming, architectural design patterns, system design, and data structures & algorithms. 
 - Experience with React, TypeScript, or other modern frontend frameworks for deeper full-stack contribution. 
 - Strong grasp of multithreading, asynchronous programming, synchronization, and cloud-native programming models. 
 - Hands-on experience with cloud ecosystems: Azure, AWS, or GCP. 
 - Proficiency with containerization and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI coding tools and coding agents (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) and a demonstrated ability to integrate these into daily engineering workflows. 
 - Experience driving team adoption of AI-powered productivity tools - setting norms, measuring impact, and iterating on usage patterns. 
 - Familiarity with modern engineering practices: agile development, CI/CD, DevOps, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills; proven success collaborating with globally distributed teams and managing complex, time-bound deliverables. 
 - Ability to understand, communicate, and drive complex technical decisions with stakeholders at all levels. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with healthcare Tech/ Finance Tech/ Procurement Tech systems experience will be a big plus. 
 - Data science and evaluation
 - Experience with applied ML techniques such as classification, anomaly detection, ranking, or predictive modeling
 - Experience evaluating AI systems using experimentation, metrics, and empirical analysis to improve quality and reliability
 - Data and retrieval systems
 - Experience with large-scale data platforms (Snowflake, columnar warehouses, denormalized data models)
 - Familiarity with retrieval-heavy architectures, RAG systems, or citation-grounded AI workflows
 - Engineering for trustworthy AI
 - Experience blending deterministic and probabilistic systems (rules engines + AI)
 - Experience designing eval-driven systems, regression testing for LLM outputs, or human-in-the-loop review workflows
 - Platform and product development
 - Frontend familiarity (React, TypeScript)
 - Workflow orchestration platforms (Temporal, Airflow, Maestro, BPMN, Step Functions)
 - Kubernetes and distributed infrastructure
 - Experience in startups, applied research, or 0→1 product environments
 - Open-source contributions

How We Work

Vertical Solutions operates like an internal startup inside UiPath: small teams, fast iteration, and real customers in the loop. We build quickly, test ideas with users, and turn the best ones into products. Some ideas won't make it - that's expected. You'll work in short cycles, demo frequently, and adapt as we learn. We care more about solving the right problem than protecting a plan that no longer fits. If you enjoy ambiguity, rapid feedback, and building where product boundaries move fast, you'll likely thrive here. 

Why Join Us

- Work on cutting-edge AI technology that's shaping the future of enterprise automation
 - Be part of a team building Times top 100 Invention of the Year (2 years running)
 - Collaborate with talented engineers who value rapid iteration and customer impact
 - Contribute to UiPath's Act 2 strategy - our most important product initiative

Maybe you don't tick all the boxes above-but still think you'd be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes-and passion can't be learned. 

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected. 

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

data.description:
About The Role
About Soar and how we build
Soar is building an AI-native home-financing platform for Saudi Arabia, and the AI-driven engineering system that builds it. Our product spans origination, credit decisioning, loan management, collections and investor products, all under SAMA regulation. 
We build differently. Our engineers don't hand-write code; they specify, direct and review AI agents that do. If that sounds like where engineering is going, you'll fit here. 
How we work : 
Agents write the code. Engineers own the spec, the context, the tests and the review. DevOps doesn't hand-manage servers either. 
Context engineering is the core skill. Agents work from a shared knowledge graph of business rules, architecture principles and money-movement rules that we keep current. 
We build our own agents. Requirements, DevOps, PM and self-testing agents run on our MCP/A2A framework to automate the SDLC end to end. 
Full stack by default. AI closes skill gaps, so engineers work across backend, frontend and infrastructure, with cross-domain reviewers. 
Regulated means rigorous. Money-movement logic gets human review, every time. KSA data residency shapes which models and tools we use and where they run. 
What every role here needs: you already use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar) as your main way of working, not as autocomplete. You can show us real workflows you've built, where they broke, and what you changed. 
Role Summary: We rely heavily on AI throughout engineering and are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who treats AI agents as a core part of how they build software. You will own complex features from design through production, direct agents effectively, and apply strong engineering judgment to everything you ship. You should be equally comfortable accelerating implementation with AI and investigating difficult problems yourself. Key Responsibilities: 

- Design, build, and maintain production features and services, taking ownership of correctness, performance, security, and maintainability. 
 - Use AI agents across planning, coding, refactoring, debugging, test generation, and documentation to accelerate end-to-end delivery. 
 - Provide agents with clear requirements, architecture context, constraints, and acceptance criteria; break complex work into verifiable steps. 
 - Inspect and refine AI-generated code. Detect incorrect assumptions, insecure patterns, unnecessary complexity, and missing edge cases. 
 - Build automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; validate actual user journeys and failure paths before declaring work complete. 
 - Create reusable workflows and tool integrations that help agents access the right context and perform tasks within appropriate permissions. 
 - Own changes through review, deployment, observability, and production troubleshooting; investigate root causes and prevent repeat failures. 
 - Collaborate with Product, QA, and other engineers; mentor teammates and document decisions and validation evidence in pull requests. 
Requirements
Requirements: 

- Typically 5+ years building and shipping production software, or equivalent demonstrated engineering depth and ownership. 
 - Strong proficiency in at least one production programming language and experience with application design, APIs, databases, version control, and automated testing. 
 - Substantial hands-on experience delivering software with AI coding tools or agents, supported by concrete examples of shipped work. 
 - Ability to reason about, debug, and explain code independently, including code generated by AI. 
 - Practical understanding of context management, tool use, agent limitations, and the trade-offs between model capability, speed, and cost. 
 - Strong ownership and collaboration, including careful handling of credentials, sensitive data, and permissions in AI workflows. 
Nice to have: Experience with agent orchestration, MCP or API integrations, retrieval systems, evaluation suites, cloud platforms, or financial systems. What success looks like: You ship reliable features with clear validation evidence, catch defects in generated code, improve delivery speed, and create reusable practices that raise the effectiveness of the wider team.

data.title: AI Execution Analyst and Reporting Lead
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

EY INFORMATION SECURITY

Job posting

AI and Automation Engineering Lead, Associate Director

At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

The exceptional EY experience. It's yours to build. 

EY focuses on high ethical standards and integrity among its employees and expects all candidates to demonstrate these qualities. 

Today's world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 1000 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets. Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust. 

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value. 

The opportunity

As an Associate Director in Information Security, this position leads the application of AI engineering within a global technology program, working closely with program leadership, workstream leads and technologists from across the globe. The position is responsible for the AI agents and automation that produce the program's reporting to senior leadership and to regional teams, and for the technical standards that govern how the program builds with AI. 

This position also serves as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams across the function on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within our services and processes. This includes identifying which assurance, risk and policy activities are suited to AI, advising teams on the approach to take, and establishing the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function. 

This is a hands-on engineering position at a senior technical grade, with authority across the program and no direct reports. The position runs and builds AI agents and automation using Claude alongside Python, Power Automate, and the Microsoft platform, and determines what work is given to an agent, how agent output is verified, and what remains with people. 

Areas of focus

- AI Engineering: Building agentic workflows in Claude that complete an entire piece of work, from reading source data through to producing the finished output. 
 - Functional AI Leadership: Acting as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes. 
 - Automation Delivery: Owning a program's automation estate, including what is automated, how it is built, and how it is supported over time. 
 - Assurance of AI Output: Accountability for reporting that is accurate, reconciled and defensible, with verification of agent output built into the systems that produce it. 
 - AI Standards and Capability: Setting the technical direction and standards for how the program builds with AI, and developing engineering capability across the program. 

Key Responsibilities

Key responsibilities include: 

- Design, build and operate the AI agents and automation that produce the program's recurring reporting, using Claude and Claude Code, integrated with the enterprise systems. 
 - Own the AI and automation roadmap for the program, prioritizing work according to the effort it saves and the risk it reduces. 
 - Guide teams across Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes, including which activities are suited to AI and the approach to take. 
 - Establish the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function, and support teams in applying them. 
 - Establish how AI output is verified, including reconciliation and checks against source data on every run, and define the conditions under which an agent must stop and escalate rather than continue. 
 - Set the standards the program builds to for AI use, covering how work is scoped to an agent, prompt and context engineering, testing for repeatability, documentation and the handling of sensitive data. 
 - Advise program leadership on where AI is appropriate, including where a conventional solution is the better answer, and on the cost, risk and effort involved. 
 - Evaluate developments in AI tooling and models and introduce what is of value to the program. 
 - Build automation that is resilient and supportable, with error handling, secure credential management, logging and alerting, held in version control and documented so that it can be maintained by others. 
 - Work with IT and Information Security to secure approval, connectivity and ongoing support for AI tooling, and build within firm policy on AI use, data classification and client confidentiality. 
 - Represent the program's AI and automation position to senior stakeholders and governance forums. 
 - Develop AI engineering capability across the program through reusable components, documented patterns and practical working sessions. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Proven technical authority in AI engineering, built on agents and automation in production that other people depend on. 
 - Ability to judge where AI is the right tool, where a conventional solution is better, and what should remain manual. 
 - Understanding of the limitations of AI models, and the ability to design verification appropriate to those limitations. 
 - Strong analytical skills, with the ability to validate the accuracy of reporting relied on by senior leadership. 
 - Capable of building relationships with senior stakeholders. 
 - Proficient in explaining technical trade-offs and their business implications to a non-technical audience. 
 - Ability to work independently and set technical priorities in a large program. 
 - Ability to team well with others and raise the AI engineering capability of colleagues. 
 - Strong organizational skills and the ability to deliver against fixed reporting deadlines. 
 - Ability to maintain a high level of integrity, trustworthiness and confidence when handling confidential information. 

To qualify for the role, you must have

- At least 10 years of experience in software, automation or data engineering, including significant time as a senior individual contributor with technical ownership of systems in production. 
 - Demonstrable experience building production solutions with Claude, including Claude Code and the Claude Agent SDK. 
 - Experience designing agentic workflows that complete an end-to-end task. 
 - Practical prompt and context engineering, including testing that model output is reliable and repeatable. 
 - Strong Python, including automation of document and data workflows with libraries such as python-pptx, python-docx, openpyxl and pandas, or the equivalent. 
 - Microsoft platform experience: Power Apps, Power BI, Dataverse, Copilot Studio and Microsoft Graph. 
 - Production experience with a major enterprise workflow automation platform such as Power Automate, including error handling and unattended runs. 
 - A track record of automating a recurring operational or reporting process end to end, with demonstrable outcomes. 
 - Experience building unattended systems that run reliably, including error handling, credential management, logging, alerting and scheduling. 
 - Experience working with large datasets drawn from multiple systems, including reconciling them and assessing whether the data supports the conclusions being drawn from it. 
 - Experience setting technical standards that other people build to, through review, shared components or documented patterns. 
 - A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience. 
 - Strong English language communication skills and the ability to work with diverse, globally distributed teams. 

Ideally, you'll also have

- Experience integrating AI tooling with enterprise systems and data sources. 
 - Experience introducing AI tooling into a governed enterprise environment, including the approval and assurance path. 
 - Experience evaluating models or agent frameworks and making an adoption recommendation. 
 - Experience delivering security, technology risk or audit reporting to a senior audience. 
 - Familiarity with vulnerability management data and tooling. 
 - Experience coaching or building technical capability in colleagues who are not engineers. 
 - Relevant certification in cloud, data or security engineering. 

What We Look For

We are looking for individuals with a passion for applied AI and a demonstrated ability to build with it to a standard that a global professional services firm can rely on. This is a senior hands-on position for someone who wants to build AI into the way a large program works and to set the standard for how it is used. 

What We Offer

As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here's a snapshot of what we offer: 

- Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. 
 - Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way. 
 - Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. 
 - Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The role will also support deployment patterns where AI capabilities may need to run closer to the operational environment, including Edge AI scenarios, hybrid cloud-edge architectures, and efficient inference workflows for mission-critical control room use cases. You will collaborate with cloud partners, product owners, architects, Data & AI engineers, developers, and validation teams across locations to enable fast, reliable, and secure delivery of workflow innovation capabilities. 

- Build and maintain cloud-native DevOps and AI/MLOps infrastructure for the Workflow Innovation product on GCP.

 - Establish observability, monitoring, logging, alerting, reliability, and cost-awareness practices for cloud-native Data & AI product capabilities. 
 - Support secure handling of product data, secrets, access control, compliance needs, and cloud security best practices. 
 - Work closely with Data & AI engineers and product teams to improve developer experience, release readiness, test automation, and operational reliability. 
 - Guide and mentor fellow colleagues in DevOps, cloud, and AI/MLOps practices while contributing to technical discussions and engineering excellence. 

Qualifications and Experience

Education

We are seeking experience with the following technologies/domains: 

B. Tech. /B. E. /M. E. /M. Tech. in Computer Science/AI Engineering

Experience

- 3-6 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, cloud platform engineering, SRE, AI/MLOps, or related product engineering roles. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with GCP is required, including relevant cloud-native compute, storage, networking, IAM, observability, and deployment services. 
 - Experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines for cloud-native applications, backend services, data pipelines, and AI/ML workloads. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI/MLOps practices, including model deployment, model serving, inference workflows, experiment tracking, model versioning, and release automation for AI-enabled product features. 
 - Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with infrastructure-as-code and environment automation using tools such as Terraform, Helm, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Good understanding of cloud security practices, including IAM, secrets management, network security, secure deployment patterns, and least-privilege access. 
 - Experience setting up monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, SLO/SLA-oriented reliability practices, and incident response workflows. 
 - Exposure to data and AI platforms or services such as BigQuery, Vertex AI Vector Search, Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub, vector databases, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Experience supporting RAG-based applications, GenAI-enabled services, model APIs, or AI inference platforms is highly desirable. 
 - Exposure to Edge AI concepts, hybrid cloud-edge deployments, on-device or near-device inference, model optimization, and operational constraints such as latency, reliability, connectivity, and resource usage is desirable. 
 - Good programming and scripting experience using Python, Bash, or similar languages, with ability to build automation and internal tooling.

data.title: Senior Software Development Engineer (Mobile)
data.description:
About Neo

AI is the most significant shift in how work gets done since the advent of the Internet - yet most organizations fail to capture its value. Neo is changing that. 

Founded by Bhavin Turakhia - Co-Founder of Zeta, Radix, and Titan - Neo is building an integrated, AI-first suite of products that capture work, centralize context, and make AI a first-class participant in every workflow: 

Tasket - A radically reimagined, AI-native work management platform that centralizes context and makes AI delegation seamless for all work. 

Friday - AI Assistant, co-worker and agent platform, pre-integrated into Tasket, Studio, Drive and 1000+ SaaS platforms. 

Studio - AI-native suite for co-creating docs, spreadsheets and diagrams collaboratively with humans and agents. 

Scribe - AI assistant for meetings that goes beyond note-taking and actually does your work while on the call

About the role

As a Mobile Engineer you will build and ship features across the Neo suite's React Native and Flutter apps - the surfaces where people carry Tasket, Friday, and Scribe in their pocket. 

We are proponents of leveraging best-in-breed AI tools at every step of the engineering lifecycle - design, development, review, and testing. This requires a different engineering mindset: a lean team of senior, hands-on, AI-adept engineers, resulting in ultra-rapid iteration cycles and fast output. You will work within this approach, from design through to production. 

You'll own well-scoped components end to end - from a feature's UI down to how it behaves on a real device - and grow your judgment on the trade-offs that only show up once something ships. 

Responsibilities

Build

- Build features across Neo's cross-platform apps (React Native / Flutter) - the interfaces where people delegate work to Friday and pick up Tasket, Studio, and Scribe on the go. 
 - Take a spec to a shipped feature by directing agents through implementation, then reviewing the result against device behaviour, not just the simulator. Architecture & systems judgment

- Own components and screens end to end - state management, navigation, and how they hold up under real network and device conditions. 
 - Contribute to design discussions on offline behaviour, sync, and app performance. Agent leverage

- Use agents to move from spec to working UI quickly, then validate the output by hand against the craft and correctness bar. 
 - Structure well-defined tasks - a screen, a component, a bug - so agents can execute them reliably. Quality & ownership

- Own performance and correctness on real devices - startup time, jank, memory, and behaviour across OS versions and screen sizes. 
 - Triage and fix crashes and platform-specific issues; keep release quality high across app store submissions. 

Skills

- AI-native engineering practice - Comfortable directing coding agents against a clear spec and validating their output against device-level reality, not just what compiles. 
 - Cross-platform mobile fundamentals - Solid command of React Native/TypeScript (preferred) or Flutter/Dart, including state management, navigation, and the native bridge/platform-channel layer when you need to drop below the framework. 
 - Native platform awareness - Working knowledge of Android and iOS build, release, and permissioning models - enough to debug a platform-specific issue without waiting on a native specialist. 
 - Performance & reliability - Reasons about startup time, rendering performance, offline/sync behaviour, and memory use on real, low-end devices, not just flagship hardware. 
 - API integration - Comfortable consuming REST/GraphQL APIs, handling auth, and building resilient network and caching layers for a mobile client. 

Experience & Qualifications

- 4+ years building and shipping production mobile apps
 - 1+ years in React Native (preferred) / Flutter, or equivalent cross-platform frameworks. 
 - Have taken at least one app through real app-store release and iteration cycles. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical depth. 

Equal Opportunity

Neo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success.

Ignite Your Future: Technical Leadership

Are you a senior architect who has shaped the technology direction of a large SaaS platform, and who is equally comfortable presenting a three-year technology plan to the CTO and reviewing a low-level design with engineers? Join QAD, where we are redefining the supply chain through a single System of Action that connects people, processes, and data.

You will be the most senior technical voice across product pillars, setting the technical bar for the organization and influencing a large engineering community without needing a large reporting line. This is a deeply technical leadership role, not a people-management role. 

The Mission: Defining the Platform's Future

You Will Set The Technical North Star For The Platform, Translate Company Strategy Into a Multi-year Architecture Roadmap, And Ensure Architectural Alignment Across All Product Pillars.  - Applied AI Experience: Hands-on experience designing production GenAI or agentic systems: LLM orchestration, RAG, vector databases, evaluation pipelines and AI observability. 
 - Hands-on Technical Credibility: Strong foundations in data structures and algorithms, OOP and modern engineering practices, with working fluency in Java, Python, Scala, Go or Node. js and a recent history of hands-on design and code reviews. 
 - System Governance & Security: Proven ability to establish governance for quality, performance, resilience, security and data privacy at enterprise scale. 
 - Measurable Outcomes: A track record of quantified impact: scale, uptime, latency, cost reduction or delivery-speed improvement. 

The Mindset

- Strategic Thinker: Sees the big picture and the implications of technology choices, and can defend a position with data and sound judgment. 
 - Influencer Without Authority: Builds consensus across product and platform teams, mediates conflicts and moves large engineering groups in one direction.

Qualifications

Qualifications

Why QAD?

Ready to step into the future of manufacturing? Apply now and start building a System of Action!
