data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
About The Role
About Soar and how we build : 
Soar is building an AI-native home-financing platform for Saudi Arabia, and the AI-driven engineering system that builds it. Our product spans origination, credit decisioning, loan management, collections and investor products, all under SAMA regulation. 
We build differently. Our engineers don't hand-write code; they specify, direct and review AI agents that do. If that sounds like where engineering is going, you'll fit here. 
How we work : 
Agents write the code. Engineers own the spec, the context, the tests and the review. DevOps doesn't hand-manage servers either. 
Context engineering is the core skill. Agents work from a shared knowledge graph of business rules, architecture principles and money-movement rules that we keep current. 
We build our own agents. Requirements, DevOps, PM and self-testing agents run on our MCP/A2A framework to automate the SDLC end to end. 
Full stack by default. AI closes skill gaps, so engineers work across backend, frontend and infrastructure, with cross-domain reviewers. 
Regulated means rigorous. Money-movement logic gets human review, every time. KSA data residency shapes which models and tools we use and where they run. 
What every role here needs: you already use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar) as your main way of working, not as autocomplete. You can show us real workflows you've built, where they broke, and what you changed. 
Role Summary: We rely heavily on AI to build, test, and improve software. We are looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager who can lead a team of engineers working with AI agents, keep delivery focused, and ensure every release meets a high quality bar. You will combine people leadership with practical technical oversight and help your team become more effective every week. Key Responsibilities: 

- Own the team's delivery from requirements through production, with clear scope, acceptance criteria, priorities, and accountability. 
 - Coach engineers to use AI agents effectively for implementation, debugging, refactoring, testing, and documentation; contribute directly when needed. 
 - Help the team break complex work into reviewable tasks, provide relevant context to agents, and validate results against product requirements. 
 - Review designs and critical code changes, challenge unsupported AI assumptions, and ensure changes remain understandable and maintainable. 
 - Embed automated tests, peer review, CI checks, security checks, and end-to-end validation into delivery; keep human review accountable for release decisions. 
 - Partner with Product, QA, and DevOps to resolve blockers, prepare releases, and address production issues and recurring defects. 
 - Run regular one-to-ones, give actionable feedback, support career growth, and manage workloads sustainably. 
 - Improve team practices using evidence from delivery lead time, escaped defects, reliability, and AI usage costs. 
Requirements
Requirements: 

- Typically 7+ years in software engineering and 2+ years leading engineers or managing a team; equivalent demonstrated impact is welcome. 
 - Strong hands-on experience building production applications, with sound knowledge of APIs, databases, testing, CI/CD, and cloud systems. 
 - Practical experience using AI coding assistants or agents to deliver production software and helping other engineers adopt them effectively. 
 - Ability to review and debug AI-generated code, identify missing edge cases, and select appropriate automated and human validation. 
 - Strong planning, communication, and coaching skills, with a record of creating clarity and delivering through a team. 
Nice to have : 
Experience building reusable agent workflows, integrating engineering tools through APIs or MCP, or delivering software in fintech or another regulated environment. 
What success looks like : 
The team ships tested features predictably, resolves issues quickly, and demonstrates improving quality and productivity. Engineers use AI effectively while understanding and owning the systems they deliver.

data.title: Senior Software Quality Assurance Engineer – Medical Device Integration & Connectivity
data.description:
Role Summary

Arthrex seeks a highly motivated, technically skilled Senior Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join the Software Quality Assurance team in Pune, India. 

This position focuses on testing medical device software, connected devices, healthcare interoperability, and network-based applications. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise in HL7, DICOM, . NET/C#, device networking, IoT technologies, and Modality Worklist (MWL) integration. 

The role requires a proactive, detail-oriented engineer who owns software quality, demonstrates strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, and can work independently while collaborating effectively with global development and SQA teams. 

This is a full-time, on-site position at the Pune office, where hands-on access to medical devices and test equipment is essential. Employment type: Full-Time (1 FTE). 

Role Description

- Develop, execute, and maintain test plans, test cases, and test procedures for medical device software and connected systems. 
 - Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and end-to-end testing across software and hardware environments. 
 - Validate communication between medical devices, hospital systems, and enterprise applications. 
 - Identify, document, investigate, and troubleshoot software defects in collaboration with developers. 
 - Identify quality risks, testing gaps, and opportunities to improve test coverage. 
 - Participate in requirements reviews, technical discussions, and software design reviews. 
 - Test healthcare interoperability protocols, including HL7 and DICOM, and validate DICOM Modality Worklist (MWL) and imaging workflows. 
 - NoSQL distributed database
 - Healthcare IT, medical imaging, and connected-device environments are suitable
 - People overlap with ACT hours, working to 10 am PST. We will try to make all meetings between 8 a. m. and 10 a. m. PST. We will also like this person to come to the office each day to work with the devices. 
 - Validate connectivity with PACS, RIS, HIS/EMR, and other healthcare information systems. 
 - Test IoT-connected devices, cloud-connected applications, and device-to-server communication. 
 - Analyze network traffic, application logs, and protocol messages to diagnose integration issues. 
 - Develop and maintain automated test scripts and utilities using C# and . NET. 
 - Perform API, database, and backend integration testing. 
 - Configure and troubleshoot networks involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS, and related protocols; use Wireshark and other diagnostic tools. 
 - Support physical medical device setup, configuration, firmware/software updates, and network connectivity testing. 
 - Use AI-assisted testing tools where appropriate to improve test design, automation, defect analysis, and testing efficiency while maintaining reliability and traceability
 - Collaborate with developers, systems engineers, product owners, and global SQA teams; communicate progress, defects, and quality risks clearly. 
 - Maintain accurate test documentation, execution evidence, and defect records in line with quality processes for regulated medical device software. 
 - Take ownership of assigned testing activities and drive issues through resolution. 

Skill Requirements

PRIMARY SKILLS (MUST HAVE SKILLS): 

- 5+ years of experience in software QA, software testing, or software development. 
 - Hands-on experience with HL7, DICOM, and DICOM Modality Worklist (MWL). 
 - Proficiency in C# and . NET for software testing, automation, or development. 
 - Strong understanding of computer networking, TCP/IP, and network troubleshooting. 
 - Experience testing network-connected devices, embedded systems, or IoT applications. 
 - Experience with integration and end-to-end testing across multiple software and hardware components. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and technical problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; able to work independently and prioritize effectively. 
 - Ability to work full-time on-site at the Arthrex Pune office. 

Secondary Skills (good To Have)

- Experience in the medical device industry or regulated healthcare software environments. 
 - Familiarity with FDA software quality expectations, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, and software design controls. 
 - Experience with PACS, RIS, HIS, EMR/EHR, and medical imaging workflows. 
 - Experience with HL7 v2 messaging, DICOM networking services, and healthcare integration testing tools. 
 - Knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, XML, SQL, and database validation; Couchbase/NoSQL knowledge. 
 - Experience with test automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, Git, Jira, Xray, or similar tools. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted test automation and AI-powered software development tools. 

Experience with cloud platforms, connected medical devices, or remote device management systems. 

Qualifications And Education Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Biomedical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 5+ years of relevant experience in software QA, testing, or development.

Build a Better World Through Business

At Barry-Wehmiller, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. We are a global provider of manufacturing technologies and services serving customers across packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and industrial automation markets.

The Role

The Delivery Leader is responsible for day-to-day delivery, people leadership, capacity alignment, stakeholder communication, and team performance. This role converts platform demand into executable work, develops engineering capability, and creates an environment where teams can consistently deliver high-quality outcomes. 

This is an ideal opportunity for a leader who enjoys building high-performing teams, strengthening delivery discipline, developing future leaders, and partnering with global stakeholders in a people-first culture.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured through: 

- Consistently high-quality project delivery

Delivery & Business Leadership

Technical Foundation

Global Collaboration

Preferred Experience

Knowledge Areas

data.description:
Opentext - The Information Company

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation. 

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered. 

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do-powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us. 

Your Impact

As a Principal Software Developer, you will define the target web UI architecture to replace the existing WPF thick-client application, owning the strategy for decomposing the monolithic UI into independently deployable, containerized front-end modules

What The Role Offers

- Define target web UI architecture (Angular and/or React) to replace WPF thick client functionality
 - Own the micro-frontend decomposition strategy (e. g. , Module Federation) for breaking apart the monolithic UI
 - Define component library/design system standards, state management approach, and API integration patterns with backend microservices
 - Set standards for containerizing and deploying the web UI (Docker/Nginx, Kubernetes on GCP/GKE) using GitLab CI/CD and Artifactory
 - Produce high-quality architecture and design specifications; deliver POCs and estimates on technology choices
 - Lead architecture/design reviews to ensure quality and adherence to standards
 - Mentor Lead and Senior Engineers on modern front-end architecture and migration patterns
 - Work across teams (including the Backend/Platform team) to ensure interoperability

What You Need To Succeed

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
 - 12+ years of enterprise product development/architecture experience
 - Deep expertise in Angular and/or React, TypeScript, and modern front-end architecture
 - Experience with micro-frontend architecture and decomposing monolithic UIs
 - Understanding of WPF/XAML sufficient to map legacy functionality to web equivalents
 - Experience with Docker/Nginx for static hosting and basic Kubernetes concepts on Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
 - Strong understanding of design systems, accessibility (WCAG), and REST/GraphQL integration
 - Excellent communication and cross-team collaboration skills

Desired/Preferred Skills

- Experience leading WPF-to-web migration initiatives
 - Experience in C#, . NET Framework, and modern . NET (. NET 8+), with hands-on experience modernizing large enterprise applications. 
 - Exposure to AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot
 - Content management & Capture (IDP) domain experience would be a plus

One Last Thing

OpenText is more than just a corporation, it's a global community where trust is foundational, the bar is raised, and outcomes are owned. Join us on our mission to drive positive change through privacy, technology, and collaboration. At OpenText, we don't just have a culture; we have character. Choose us because you want to be part of a company that embraces innovation and empowers its employees to make a difference.

Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws. 

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us at hr@opentext. com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

- Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience.

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way. 

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. 

The AI and Infrastructure team works on the world's toughest problems, redefining what's possible and the possible easy. We empower Google customers by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Googler Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. We're at the center of amazing work at Google by being the "flywheel" that enables our advanced AI models, delivers computing power across global services, and offers platforms that developers use to build services. 

In AI and Infrastructure, we shape the future of hyperscale computing by inventing and creating world-leading future technology, and drive global impact by contributing to Google infrastructure, from software to hardware (including building Vertex AI for Google Cloud). We work on complex technologies at a global scale with key players in the AI and systems space. We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.

As a key technical leader within our Salesforce practice, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping and evolving our Salesforce ecosystem across Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Experience Cloud and enterprise integrations. You'll work alongside talented colleagues across multiple geographies, driving innovation, establishing engineering best practices, and influencing architectural decisions that support Civica's long-term digital strategy. 

This role offers the opportunity to combine technical leadership with hands-on delivery, empowering you to create meaningful solutions that help public sector organisations and communities thrive.

data.title: Principal Software Engineering Manager - Ads
data.description:
Overview

Microsoft Advertising makes billions of decisions every day across search, native, shopping, display, audience, and AI-powered advertising experiences. 

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineering Manager to lead the engineering organization building Ads Quality systems at global scale. 

The team builds the software systems that turn quality signals and models into dependable production decisions across ads, landing pages, advertisers, businesses, accounts, and changing behavioral patterns. 

This is a deeply technical engineering leadership role. You will lead senior engineers and engineering managers while remaining close to architecture, distributed systems, production AI, measurement, and operational quality. 

Responsibilities

- Own the engineering strategy and execution for Ads Quality systems across signal processing, entity systems, model execution, decisioning, feedback, and measurement. 
 - Build scalable real-time, nearline, and offline systems supporting very large volumes and demanding reliability requirements. 
 - Create the production infrastructure that allows new models and signals to move rapidly from experimentation into safe global deployment. 
 - Partner with Applied Science on model integration, evaluation, experimentation, serving trade-offs, and productionization. 
 - Build common engineering foundations for heterogeneous AI workloads including classifiers, multimodal models, LLMs, agents, and deterministic systems. 
 - Develop feedback, observability, experimentation, and diagnostic systems that make quality problems easy to find and fast to fix. 
 - Drive architectural simplification and prevent the quality stack from becoming a collection of bespoke pipelines and one-off services. 
 - Lead and grow senior engineers, engineering managers, and technical leaders capable of independently owning complex areas. 
 - Drive difficult programs across organizational boundaries and maintain a high bar for architecture, engineering quality, and production ownership. 

Qualifications

- 15+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent technical depth. 
 - Significant experience leading senior engineers, engineering managers, or large engineering organizations. 
 - Strong technical depth in distributed systems, AI/ML infrastructure, decision systems, or large-scale data platforms. 
 - Experience building production systems that operationalize machine-learning models at significant scale. 
 - Strong judgment around latency, throughput, reliability, freshness, cost, observability, and operational safety. 
 - Ability to challenge architecture, understand failure modes

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across your team and adjacent teams, solving the highest-scope and most complex problems in your area. This is a technical leadership role that combines deep backend expertise, systems judgment, product judgment, and influence across organizational boundaries. You will work with Product, Frontend, Infrastructure, Security, Data, Engineering Managers, and engineers across product groups, bringing subject matter expertise, and you will do it without relying on formal authority. 

Why you'll love this role

- Leverage: Your work multiplies across teams. The platforms, standards, and architectural decisions you lead determine how quickly everyone else can ship. 
 - Genuinely Hard Problems: You'll lead the modernization of a large monolith toward modular, reusable, appropriately independent systems - at the scale of a platform used by millions of users. 
 - Influence Without Bureaucracy: You'll shape technical direction across teams through clear written proposals and decision records, and partner with Product and Engineering leadership on platform roadmap and investment trade-offs. 
 - Frontier AI Work: You'll lead adoption of AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows and define the review, quality, security, and privacy guardrails that make them safe to rely on. 
 - Autonomy: You'll thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success.

- Lead Cross-Cutting Initiatives: Lead the technical design and delivery of large backend initiatives that span teams, and identify and remove systemic bottlenecks across product and infrastructure groups. 
 - Own Architecture Strategy: Drive modular backend, service, data, and platform architecture. Lead modernization of the monolith and legacy backends toward modular, reusable, and appropriately independently operated systems - while preventing fragmentation and service sprawl. 
 - Set the Standards: Define and improve standards for APIs, contracts, compatibility, schema evolution, testing, security, performance, observability, operability, and maintainability - plus the build, test, deploy, release, rollback, and production-readiness practices needed to operate modular features safely. 
 - Establish Shared Patterns: Create the patterns for dependency management, data ownership, eventing, failure isolation, service maturity, and operational documentation. Establish Go service patterns and Kubernetes operating practices where they matter to our production estate, and guide Rust adoption where it solves a real systems, security, performance, or supply-chain problem. 
 - Own What You Build in Production: Take part in on-call and incident response for the systems your teams own, act as a technical escalation point during complex incidents, and turn what you learn into architectural and operational improvements that prevent recurrence. 
 - Influence and Partner: Shape technical direction across teams without formal authority, and partner with Product and Engineering leadership on platform-level roadmap decisions and investment trade-offs. 
 - Grow Engineers: Mentor Senior and Intermediate engineers, shepherd technical debt reduction and reusable patterns that improve throughput, and raise the technical capability of the wider team. 
 - Lead AI Adoption: Lead team-level adoption of AI-assisted and agentic workflows, including the quality, security, privacy, and operational guardrails, and help engineers direct, validate, reject, and course-correct agent output. 

What You'll Bring

- Cross-Team Technical Leadership: A sustained record of technical leadership across more than one team or a broad product area. 
 - Deep Architecture Experience: Deep backend architecture and production experience in complex applications, services, or platforms, including scaling or governing APIs, service platforms, data systems, modular monoliths, or shared backend components. 
 - Modularization in Production: Experience modernizing a monolith or legacy backend architecture in production, and with modular architecture such as bounded contexts, package encapsulation, ports and adapters, service extraction, event-driven boundaries, or an equivalent approach. 
 - Influence Without Authority: A strong ability to create alignment through clear written proposals and decision records, so decisions are documented, understood, and adopted without constant escalation. 
 - Product Judgment: The ability to balance customer outcomes, delivery speed, technical health, reliability, and long-term platform investment. 
 - Mentorship: Experience mentoring engineers and shaping standards through code review, documentation, and example. 
 - Agentic AI Leadership: Production experience with AI-assisted or agentic engineering workflows, including the ability to evaluate and improve how a team adopts them. 

Helpful Experience

- Go services and APIs at scale. 
 - Kubernetes and cloud-native operations, including deployment, scaling, observability, rollback, and production readiness. 
 - Rust adoption or production ownership for systems, security, performance, or platform components. 
 - Ruby/Rails modularization and large-monolith modernization. 
 - PostgreSQL scaling, data partitioning, queues, messaging, or distributed systems.

Company Description

NikahForever is India's most trusted Muslim Matrimony platform, dedicated to making marriages simple and accessible. With 65, 000+ success stories and over 2 Million+ members, we are committed to fostering strong connections and building a better community. Our AI-based algorithm ensures seamless profile searches and connections, transforming the way people approach marriage. Based in India, NikahForever has created a user-friendly platform where finding your life partner happens in just three steps: Register, Search, and Connect. 

About the Role

We're looking for an engineer who can think independently, solve difficult problems, and turn ideas into reliable production software. 

You won't always get a detailed specification or a step-by-step implementation plan. You'll get a problem, its context, and the freedom to figure out how to solve it. You'll learn unfamiliar systems, make practical engineering decisions, build and test solutions, and take ownership of your work from implementation through deployment. 

We're AI-native. You'll use AI coding agents and modern engineering tools to accelerate development, explore unfamiliar codebases, debug issues, and automate repetitive work. You'll remain accountable for the correctness, security, and reliability of everything you ship. 

We don't hire based on familiarity with a particular programming language, framework, or technology stack. We value strong fundamentals, problem-solving ability, learning speed, engineering judgment, and the ability to deliver working software. 

What You'll Do

- Build and ship software: Turn product requirements and business problems into working, reliable software that delivers measurable value. 
 - Own features end to end: Understand requirements, explore possible solutions, implement features, write tests, deploy changes, and fix issues after release. 
 - Solve engineering problems: Break down ambiguous problems, evaluate trade-offs, reason through edge cases, and develop practical solutions without relying on step-by-step instructions. 
 - Work across domains: Contribute to backend systems, APIs, databases, infrastructure, integrations, data-intensive applications, and AI-powered workflows as the problem requires. 
 - Navigate unfamiliar systems: Understand existing codebases, investigate how components interact, and adapt to new technologies without treating unfamiliarity as a blocker. 
 - Debug and investigate: Reproduce failures, analyze logs and system behavior, identify root causes, and implement fixes that prevent recurring problems. 
 - Make sound technical decisions: Consider correctness, performance, reliability, maintainability, security, cost, and implementation complexity when choosing a solution. 
 - Use AI-native engineering workflows: Leverage AI coding agents for exploration, implementation, debugging, testing, and refactoring. Review their output critically and verify that solutions work as intended. 
 - Automate repetitive work: Identify inefficient manual processes and build tools or automations that improve productivity and reduce operational effort. 
 - Collaborate and take ownership: Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and technical problem-solving. Communicate blockers early and incorporate feedback constructively. 
 - Continuously improve: Learn from production issues, measure the impact of your work, and improve the quality and reliability of the systems you build. 

Examples of Problems You'll Tackle

- Build a new product capability from an ambiguous requirement, making appropriate implementation and design decisions along the way. 
 - Investigate a slow or unreliable service, identify its bottlenecks, and improve its performance and resilience. 
 - Design a reliable workflow for processing tasks asynchronously, handling failures, and preventing data inconsistencies. 
 - Build an AI-powered workflow that uses external tools and APIs to automate a multi-step business process. 
 - Investigate a production failure in an unfamiliar codebase, identify the root cause, and ship a thoroughly tested fix. 
 - Develop an internal tool that removes repetitive manual work and measure the resulting improvement in efficiency. 

What We're Looking For

Must Have

- Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to reason systematically about unfamiliar problems. 
 - A solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, computational complexity, and essential software design principles. 
 - The ability to write clear, maintainable, and testable code, regardless of the programming language or technology used. 
 - A practical understanding of how software components interact, including APIs, databases, networking, and operating systems. 
 - The ability to break down complex tasks into smaller, verifiable steps and make progress without constant supervision. 
 - Comfort navigating unfamiliar codebases, learning new technologies, and adapting to different technical environments. 
 - A disciplined approach to debugging, testing, handling edge cases, and investigating the root causes of failures. 
 - The judgment to make reasonable technical trade-offs and recognize when a solution is unnecessarily complex or unreliable. 
 - Practical familiarity with AI coding tools or a demonstrated willingness to adopt them, along with the ability to validate generated code critically. 
 - Strong ownership, curiosity, attention to detail, and a bias toward finishing and shipping work. 
 - The ability to communicate technical decisions clearly, ask useful questions, and take feedback constructively. 
 - Evidence of practical engineering ability through projects, internships, research, open-source contributions, or other work demonstrating problem-solving and implementation skills. 

Strong Plus

- B. Tech/B. E. in Computer Science (CS), Information Technology (IT), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical Engineering (EE), or a related field, ideally from a strong engineering program. 
 - Experience building and deploying software that solves a real problem for actual users. 
 - Experience diagnosing performance issues, improving reliability, or resolving difficult technical bugs. 
 - Exposure to production systems, cloud environments, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, or incident investigation. 
 - Experience working across multiple technical domains or adapting to unfamiliar technology stacks. 
 - Projects involving AI-powered applications, LLMs, autonomous agents, or workflow automation. 
 - Practical experience using AI coding agents to accelerate development while maintaining strong quality standards. 
 - Contributions to products, tools, research, or open-source projects that demonstrate initiative beyond completing tutorials. 
 - Evidence of independently taking an idea from initial problem discovery to a working, tested solution. 

How You'll Be Evaluated

- Engineering and project review: Walk us through something you've built, the problem it solves, your personal contribution, and the decisions you made. 
 - Practical problem-solving: Work through an engineering problem that assesses reasoning, implementation, edge cases, and correctness rather than familiarity with a particular technology. 
 - Code implementation and debugging: Build or modify a solution in a practical environment, investigate failures, and demonstrate how you test your work. 
 - System design and reasoning: Approach an open-ended problem, explain the major components, evaluate trade-offs, and reason about reliability and future growth. 
 - AI-assisted engineering exercise: Use an AI agent to explore, build, or debug a solution while demonstrating how you guide, inspect, and verify its work. 
 - Ownership and learning discussion: Discuss a difficult problem you've solved, a mistake you've made, how you handled feedback, and how you approach unfamiliar technology. 

Why Join

- Own meaningful engineering problems and contribute directly to product outcomes. 
 - Work across different technical domains rather than being restricted to a single technology stack. 
 - Learn how production systems are designed, built, deployed, monitored, and scaled. 
 - Use AI coding agents and modern engineering workflows to solve real-world problems. 
 - Develop strong engineering judgment through practical challenges, code reviews, and production ownership. 
 - Work in an environment that values initiative, learning speed, technical depth, and measurable impact. 

How to Apply

Send your resume, GitHub or equivalent technical portfolio, and 1-2 examples of systems or projects you've built, shipped, or improved. 

Please briefly describe: 

- A difficult engineering problem you've solved and how you approached it. 
 - Something you've built that demonstrates your ability to turn an idea into a working solution. 
 - An example of how you've learned an unfamiliar technology or used AI tools to improve your engineering workflow. 

We value engineering ability over technology-stack familiarity, demonstrated problem-solving over memorized answers, and the ability to learn and deliver over experience with a specific tool.

data.title: Senior AI Test Engineer
data.description:
Senior AI Test Engineer

Location: Remote

About the Role

Alternative Path is looking for a Senior AI Test Engineer to lead quality assurance on a client engagement with a leading financial data and analytics company that has built AI agent systems (chatbots, RAG-based research/report generation, MCP-based tool-calling agents) on top of its proprietary datasets for its own clients. This is a senior, client-facing role: you'll own the test strategy for these systems end-to-end, working directly with the client's engineering team to validate accuracy, reliability, and safety before these agents reach financial industry end-users - where hallucinations or bad data retrieval carry real business risk. 

This is not conventional QA. You'll be building evaluation frameworks and datasets, running systematic evals, and defining quality bars for non-deterministic, LLM-driven systems operating over complex financial data. 

About Alternative Path

Alternative Path is a strategic operations consulting firm, founded in 2020, that helps growth-stage and enterprise organizations build high-performing, India-based teams across Technology Ops, Data Ops, Business Intelligence, and Finance. Every engagement is senior-led, and the firm has delivered 50+ engagements for clients across the US, Europe, and Australia. 

What You'll Do

- Own the test and evaluation strategy for the client's AI agent systems - chatbots, RAG-based research/report generation, and MCP-based tool-calling agents
 - Design and build eval suites covering accuracy, groundedness/faithfulness to source data, task completion, latency, and safety
 - Build and curate golden datasets reflecting real client use cases and financial-data edge cases (ambiguous queries, stale data, conflicting sources, numerical precision)
 - Use eval/observability tooling such as LangSmith (or equivalents - Ragas, DeepEval, Braintrust, Langfuse, PromptFoo) to trace, score, and monitor agent runs
 - Define and track RAG-specific metrics (retrieval precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation/source accuracy) - critical given the systems sit on top of financial datasets where correctness is non-negotiable
 - Evaluate MCP-based tool-calling behavior - correct tool selection, multi-step task execution, failure handling
 - Design regression testing so prompt, model, or data-pipeline changes don't silently degrade quality
 - Run structured red-teaming for hallucinations, prompt injection, and unsafe/incorrect financial outputs
 - Act as the primary quality point of contact with the client's engineering stakeholders - translating findings into clear, actionable risk assessments
 - Mentor/guide any junior QA resources staffed onto the engagement as it scales
 - Build automation to integrate evals into CI pipelines where feasible

What We're Looking For

Must-haves

- 3+ years in software QA/testing, with hands-on senior-level experience evaluating LLM-based or agentic AI systems (not just traditional QA)
 - Direct experience with eval frameworks/tools - LangSmith strongly preferred; also acceptable: Ragas, DeepEval, PromptFoo, Braintrust, Langfuse
 - Strong understanding of RAG architecture and how to independently evaluate retrieval quality vs. generation quality
 - Practical familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or comparable agent tool-calling frameworks
 - Strong Python skills for building test harnesses, scoring pipelines, and automation
 - Experience designing evaluation approaches for non-deterministic systems (probabilistic scoring, not binary pass/fail)
 - Comfortable working directly with client engineering teams - strong communication, able to explain quality risk to both technical and business stakeholders
 - Prior experience in a client services / consulting QA environment (this is a client-facing engagement, not an internal product team)Nice-to-haves

- Experience testing AI systems in fintech, capital markets, or data/analytics domains
 - Familiarity with financial data accuracy/compliance considerations (numerical precision, source traceability, audit trails)
 - Exposure to LLM red-teaming/safety evaluation practices
 - Experience with browser-automation agent testing (Playwright or similar)

Position Overview

Job Title: Software Development Engineer in Test

Corporate Title: Vice President

Location: Pune, India

Role Description

This role is responsible for owning product quality and defining and implementing AI-first engineering and automated validation solutions for the Account Information Platform. The candidate should demonstrate strong software engineering expertise, excellent problem-solving skills, and an agents-first mindset, with the ability to apply agentic AI approaches to testing while leading quality engineering through hands-on development. The candidate is expected to: 

- Bring an AI-first and agent-first approach to quality engineering by identifying, designing, and implementing agentic AI use cases across test design, automation, execution, analysis, and reporting. 
 - Own quality for the Account Information Platform, including test strategy, risk assessment, regression execution, release-readiness reporting, and quality sign-off for production releases. 
 - Contribute as a hands-on senior engineer involved in analysis, design, and code reviews, coding, automation framework development, and release activities. 
 - Work closely with business stakeholders, the Tribe Lead, Product Owner, architects, developers, SRE, and platform teams to successfully deliver business outcomes. 
 - Acquire strong functional knowledge of account-information capabilities, customer journeys, data flows, and services delivered through the Account Information Platform. 
 - Demonstrate ownership, inspire others, apply innovative thinking and a growth mindset, and collaborate across teams for success. 

What We'll Offer You

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you'll enjoy, 

- Best in class leave policy. 
 - Gender neutral parental leaves
 - 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
 - Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
 - Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
 - Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
 - Accident and Term life Insurance
 - Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your Key Responsibilities

- Lead an AI-first, agents-first approach to testing by identifying and implementing agentic AI patterns for requirements analysis, test design, code generation, test-data preparation, execution orchestration, defect triage, root-cause analysis, and quality reporting. 
 - Define the automation strategy, framework design, engineering standards, and scalable patterns for validating account-information journeys across web interfaces, APIs, services, data flows, and integrations. 
 - Design and develop critical automation components, reusable libraries, utilities, AI-enabled testing tools, and test agents using Java, Selenium, Playwright, and scripting languages; establish high standards through robust code and design reviews. 
 - Partner with developers and architects to embed testability, observability, security, reliability, and automated quality gates throughout design, development, CI/CD, release, and production validation. 
 - Build and maintain reliable risk-based regression capabilities, drive effective execution and result analysis, and use engineering metrics and root-cause analysis to reduce escaped defects, flaky tests, and repetitive manual effort. 
 - Coach engineers in AI-enabled testing, modern development and test practices, foster continuous learning, and build a culture where quality is an engineering responsibility shared across the product team. 
 - Translate quality risks, AI-enabled testing opportunities, regression outcomes, and release-readiness evidence into clear business terms for product, technology, and executive stakeholders. 

Your Skills And Experience

- Proven ability to define and implement agentic AI approaches for software testing, including the use of autonomous or semi-autonomous agents for test design, automation development, execution orchestration, defect triage, analysis, and reporting. 
 - Strong agents-first mindset, with the ability to identify where AI agents can improve coverage, engineering productivity, decision-making, and delivery confidence while retaining appropriate human oversight and control. 
 - Practical experience with generative AI, coding assistants, prompt engineering, agent workflows, tool integration, and evaluation of AI-generated code and test artefacts for correctness, security, maintainability, and responsible use. 
 - Minimum 14 years of IT industry experience, with substantial hands-on experience in software development, test engineering, product-quality ownership, and delivery of complex business-critical systems. 
 - Expert-level programming skills in Java, with the ability to develop clean, maintainable, reusable, and production-quality automation code and engineering frameworks. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Selenium and Playwright for browser and end-to-end automation, including framework design, parallel execution, cross-browser validation, and test reliability. 
 - Strong scripting capability using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Shell scripting for automation, AI-agent tooling, data preparation, and engineering productivity. 
 - Deep experience in API and service-level automation using tools and libraries such as REST Assured, with a sound understanding of REST, JSON, XML, authentication, and integration testing. 
 - Demonstrated experience owning test strategy, risk-based regression scope and execution, defect governance, release-readiness assessment, and quality sign-off for production releases. 
 - Strong knowledge of software design principles, object-oriented programming, debugging, code reviews, and engineering practices that support scalable and maintainable solutions. 
 - Experience integrating automated validation and AI-enabled testing capabilities into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions, with good knowledge of Git and build tools such as Maven or Gradle. 
 - Experience with test environments, test data management, databases and SQL, service virtualisation or mocking, observability tools, and evidence-based quality reporting. 
 - Good understanding of performance, security, accessibility, reliability, contract, and risk-based testing, with the ability to incorporate relevant checks into engineering workflows. 
 - Proven technical leadership, stakeholder management, mentoring, and communication skills, combined with the ability to remain a hands-on individual contributor. 

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs. 

How We'll Support You

- Training and development to help you excel in your career. 
 - Coaching and support from experts in your team. 
 - A culture of continuous learning to aid progression. 
 - A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs. 

About Us And Our Teams

Please visit our company website for further information: 

https: //www. db. com/company/company. html

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Test Automation Engineer Consultant

Are you interested in building capabilities that enable the organization with innovation, speed, agility, scalability and efficiency? The Global Technology team takes great pride in our culture where digital transformation is built into our DNA! When you join our organization at Prudential, you'll unlock an exciting and impactful career - all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world's leading financial services institutions. 

Your Team & Role

As a Test Automation Engineer Consultant on/in Global Technology & Operations IAM Team, you will partner with tech leads, developers and delivery professionals to test IAM services implementations across supporting systems. You will design, create, test, and deploy test-driven solutions across multiple technology domains delivering business capabilities that support Product Delivery. You must demonstrate strong logical and creative problem-solving abilities, good oral and written communication, and excellent analytical skills. 

You will be part of a team who will deliver new IAM services that utilize reusable solutions across many applications. Speed to market and services quality are critical to the future of the IAM Services which can only be achieved by building the right Automation Regression Test beds that span the entire IAM Services Lifecycle and Solution. Reusability of the Automation Regression Test beds will be pivotal to delivering new capabilities to the consumer quickly and efficiently. 

Here is What You Can Expect on a Typical Day

• Designing, writing, reviewing, and executing automated test scripts using Jmeter & Selenium for Test Automation. 

• Maintaining and enhancing existing automated test scripts and frameworks to improve test efficiency and coverage. 

• Designing and executing automated tests that validate identity verification and fraud mitigation workflows across IAM services, ensuring secure, consistent, and compliant onboarding and authentication experiences. 

• Collaborating with developers and security engineers to troubleshoot defects in identity proofing, fraud detection, or risk scoring services, ensuring high quality and resilient IAM capabilities. 

• Well versed with UI & back-end automation testing to ensure there is the right level of testing for the Product changes. 

• Contributing to the Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) processes by integrating automated tests into build pipelines to enable quick responses to compliance, regulatory, and product changes. 

• Developing Quality Management plans and overall Test Strategy for each Iteration and

Program Increment. Reviewing test plans and conducting peer reviews of plans and test cases. • Working with tech leads to ensure business requirements enable test cases meet automation standards and fulfill business expectations for quality software output. 

• Update Quality Tools with requirement traceability, test cases, test sets, and defects according to QA standards and report status on the QA review report. 

• Hands on test creation and execution of user stories (Smoke, Functional Integration, and Regression) and logging defects. 

• Engage Development Team in defect resolution and lead defect review calls. • Assisting testing with other groups for Non-functional QA phases (Data Creation, Performance, Security, Accessibility). 

• Provide guidance around QA Strategies, Proactive Governance, and Risk Management for overall quality delivery of platform applications. Working collaboratively across Scrums Teams, Release Trains, and Journeys to test across our partner BUS to ensure success by applying best practice principals, and techniques. 

• Able to build out IAM Services Test Plans across all systems and with clear environment plans of how new products will be implemented with reusable Test Data for optimal regression testing. 

The Skills & Expertise You Bring

• Bachelor of Computer Science or Engineering or experience in related fields. 

• Experience in the execution and control of all aspects of testing. 

• Expertise in Web based and Mobile testing, knowledge of J2EE applications testing

• Good working knowledge of test automation processes, concepts, and tools such as Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, TestNG, Jmeter, FitNesse, Postman, SoapUl, Protractor, Cucumber, Jira Xray, and Scripting. 

• Experience with multiple development methodologies (e. g. , Agile, NWOW, and Hybrid) & different tools (Jl RA, Confluence, Ml RO). 

• Profound understanding of web-based technologies including multi-tier applications and security standards (HTTP, TLS, REST/SOAP, Cookie Handling, SAML, OAUTH, 01 DC, . . . )

• Experience with ETL (e. g. DataStage, Informatica), Rest API automation, and Unix scripting to enable data sourcing, transformation, and validation. 

• Leading the development and execution of fast test scripts that are easily reusable and maintainable. 

• Familiarity with Jenkins and integrating into CI/CD pipelines. 

• Creating Jira Xray test along with test evidence to ensure test coverage with clearly outline summary, description, relevant tests, and status with screenshots or screen recordings • Jira Xray Test Execution must be created and execution results recorded prior to product owner accepting the story with mapping back to Jira Align and Cloud. 

• Defects should be traceable to the original User Story which identifies the acceptance criteria or has the acceptance criteria identified. 

• Regression Test must be in an organized manner, so they are easy to utilize in the future especially when there is a change to an existing feature. 

You'll Love Working Here Because You Can

Join a team and culture where your voice matters; where every day, your work transforms our experiences to make lives better. As you put your skills to use, we'll help you make an even bigger impact with learning experiences that can grow your technical AND leadership capabilities. You'll be surprised by what this rock-solid organization has in store for you.

data.title: Quality Assurance Engineer - Level 1 (Manual + Automation)
data.description:
Experience: 1-2 years

Reports to: QA Lead / Engineering Manager

Employment Type: Full-time

About Company: 

Ruloans is one of India's leading loan distribution platforms. It connects borrowers with 200+ banks and NBFCs. Through Ruconnect, our B2B partner platform, thousands of Direct Selling Agents (DSAs) submit leads, track applications and manage their commissions. Our tech team builds the borrower journeys, partner tools, CRM, bank recommendation engine and automation that run this ecosystem. 

Role Summary: 

We're hiring a QA Engineer (Level 1) to help us ship reliable releases across the Ruloans web platform, the Ruconnect partner app, our internal CRM and backend APIs. You'll handle structured manual testing and grow into test automation: writing and maintaining UI and API test scripts and plugging them into our release pipeline. 

Key Responsibilities

Testing & Quality

- Create, execute, and maintain test cases and test scenarios based on product requirements (BRDs, PRDs, user stories). 
 - Run functional, regression, smoke and sanity testing on web, mobile and API releases. 
 - Test key lending journeys, such as lead creation, eligibility and CIBIL checks, document upload, application status tracking and DSA commission flows. 
 - Log, track and retest defects with clear steps to reproduce, severity, screenshots and logs. 
 - Take part in sprint ceremonies and give QA sign-off before production releases. 

QA Documentation & Test Management

- Maintain QA documentation, including test plans, test reports, bug reports, and regression suites. 
 - Organize test cases using tags for module, priority, test type, platform, and execution status. Ensure requirement traceability, test coverage, and documentation updates for every release. 

Automation

- Write and maintain automated UI test scripts using Selenium, Playwright or Cypress. 
 - Automate REST API tests using Postman/Newman or RestAssured/PyTest. 
 - Add automated test suites to CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins/GitHub Actions) under the guidance of senior engineers. 
 - Keep test data, test suites and automation reports up to date. 

Data & Backend Checks

- Write basic SQL queries (MySQL) to check that data was saved correctly after a transaction. 
 - Use logging and monitoring tools (e. g. , Kibana) to dig into failures and API errors. 

Required Skills

- At least 1 year of hands-on experience in software testing, including some exposure to test automation. 
 - Solid grasp of SDLC, STLC, defect lifecycle and test design techniques (boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning). 
 - Hands-on with at least one automation tool: Selenium, Playwright or Cypress. 
 - Working knowledge of one programming language: Java, Python or JavaScript. 
 - Experience testing REST APIs with Postman (status codes, request/response validation, auth headers). Basic SQL: SELECT, JOIN, WHERE, GROUP BY. 
 - Familiar with a bug-tracking or project tool such as ClickUp, Jira or similar. 
 - Strong attention to detail and clear written communication. 

Good to Have

- Exposure to mobile app testing (Android/iOS) or Appium. 
 - Basic knowledge of Git and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience with BFSI/fintech/lending products (KYC, loan applications, credit checks). 
 - Awareness of basic security and performance testing (e. g. , JMeter). 
 - ISTQB Foundation certification.

We are an inclusive, forward-thinking organization where diverse perspectives enable innovation, continuous improvement and better outcomes for our customers and teams. The work we do plays an important role in helping Australians work, learn, create and connect. 

About the Technology Function: 

By joining the Technology team in the GCC you will play a direct role in Officeworks' global digital transformation, contributing to world-class capabilities that sit at the heart of how the business operates and grows. The GCC will support Officeworks' purpose of helping to bring big ideas to life at low prices, ensuring technology remains a true enabler of customer value and operational excellence. 

This opportunity to join as a founding member of the new global hub is a chance to be part of the original build-out of our GCC. Early joiners will influence how the hub operates and help shape the future state of some of Officeworks' core technology ecosystem. 

These roles are best suited for people who enjoy: 

- exposure to eCommerce and digital platforms, customer facing services enabled online and in retail stores, and an expanding presence into generative and agentic commerce - covering operations, security, development, automation, and solution architecture
 - supporting global initiatives and modernizing business critical systems
 - being the forefront of global innovation and transformation, helping digitize the Officeworks business
 - joining a place where your skills matter, your growth is intentional, and your work has visible impact on business outcomes. 

Why this role exists: 

The Associate Test Analyst supports the Supply Chain Technology team by driving quality assurance and testing activities across core software applications. Operating within the Technology function, this role ensures software-based solutions, such as Blue Yonder and related enterprise supply chain platforms, are rigorously tested and validated before deployment into production. 

Working closely with project teams, functional analysts, developers, and business stakeholders, the Associate Test Analyst helps prevent defects, verifies functional requirements, and streamlines testing workflows. Through the application of both automated and structured manual testing practices, the role protects system stability and enables seamless technology delivery across Officeworks' supply chain capability. 

Where you will make a difference: 

In this role you will: 

Test Strategy and Execution: 

- Develop, maintain, and execute comprehensive test plans, scenarios, and test scripts based on system functional requirements and business processes. 
 - Perform software-focused functional, integration, regression, and system testing across core supply chain applications such as Blue Yonder. 
 - Prepare accurate, high-quality test data aligned with solution designs and specific test case scenarios. 
 - Support developers and functional analysts during unit testing and early-stage defect identification. 

Test Automation and Continuous Improvement: 

- Design, build, and maintain scalable automated test scripts for software applications to increase test coverage and efficiency. 
 - Evaluate software testing tools to enhance automation frameworks and decrease release cycle times. 
 - Identify continuous improvement opportunities across software QA methodologies and release control processes. 

Defect Management and Reporting: 

- Identify, document, and track software defects through to successful resolution using enterprise defect management tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps. 
 - Work closely with technical, functional, and third-party vendor teams to communicate defect severity and accelerate bug resolution. 
 - Deliver clear testing status reports and progress updates to project teams and IT management. 

User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Business Support: 

- Support business UAT testers during larger project rollouts by facilitating test environment readiness and defect tracking. 
 - Lead and coordinate UAT execution on smaller application releases and targeted functional updates. 
 - Assist in delivering solutions training and guidance to end-users prior to final deployment sign-off. 

Release Control and Deployment Verification: 

- Participate in release control checkpoints when application changes transition from build environments to test cycles. 
 - Execute production verification testing during post-deployment phases and hyper care support periods. 
 - Escalate risks or technical blockers that could impact release schedules, application quality, or project budgets. 

Who you will be working with: 

- Internal IT Delivery Teams: Collaborate with Supply Chain Functional Analysts, Developers, and Test Leads to align software testing cycles with delivery milestones. 
 - Internal Business Partners: Work directly with Supply Chain business operational teams and end-users to guide User Acceptance Testing and validate functional requirements. 
 - Quality Assurance Community: Partner with cross-functional QA peers across Officeworks Technology to share best practices and automation standards. 
 - Third-Party Software Vendors: Liaise with external application support and vendor consulting resources (e. g. , Blue Yonder, SAP) to manage integration defect resolution. 

What success looks like: 

- Software Quality and Reliability: High-quality software deployments delivered with minimal post-production defects across Supply Chain Tech applications. 
 - Automation Efficiency: Incremental growth in automated test coverage for regression suites, reducing manual testing effort and cycle times. 
 - Stakeholder Engagement: Strong collaborative relationships with business stakeholders and IT delivery teams, ensuring smooth UAT execution. 
 - Timely Issue Escalation: Swift identification, logging, and escalation of testing risks and defects to prevent schedule delays. 
 - Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks' values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture. 

How you will lead: 

Individual Contributor: 

- Lives our Officeworks values and behaviors
 - Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behavior
 - Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
 - Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
 - Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

Our Values: 

Our values shape the way we work, our behaviors and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities. 

We begin with customer: 

- We start with our customer' needs in every decision. 
 - We offer simple, helpful and affordable solutions. 
 - We listen, learn and continuously improve. 

We do the right thing: 

- We lead with integrity and care for our team communities and planet. 
 - We work together safely and treat everyone with respect, inclusion, and trust. 
 - We collaborate across teams and think Officeworks-wide. 

We execute with accountability: 

- We are accountable for our decisions, actions, results, and mistakes. 
 - We stay across the details and focus on delivering what matters. 
 - We move with pace and agility to deliver outcomes. 

We lead with ambition: 

- We set bold ambitions that help us to win and transform. 
 - We are courageous with new ideas. 
 - We focus on transformation, not incremental steps. 

Qualifications and work experience: 

Essential: 

- Education: Tertiary degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience: Minimum 5+ years of dedicated software testing experience across manual and automated testing methodologies. 
 - Automation Capabilities: Proven experience creating and executing software automation test frameworks using industry-standard tools (e. g. , Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar). 
 - Supply Chain Software Context: Working knowledge or experience testing Enterprise Supply Chain/WMS/TMS software platforms (e. g. , Blue Yonder / JDA, SAP, or similar). Koerber HighJump, Manhattan WMS, SAP S/4 HANA
 - System SDLC Knowledge: Solid understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) within Agile and Waterfall delivery frameworks. Hands on testing operational experience, with exposure DC/ CFC environment.

 - Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to liaise effectively across technical and business stakeholders. 

Preferred: 

- Industry Experience: Prior testing experience within Retail, Omnichannel, or Supply Chain Logistics environments.

You will partner with process owners, product owners, analysts, architects, and IT teams to translate requirements into secure, reliable solutions; build reusable components and frameworks; and establish best practices that accelerate delivery and reduce operational risk. If you thrive in complex enterprise environments, excel at influencing without authority, and are energized by building governed automation capabilities that deliver measurable business value, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a patient-focused, innovation-driven organization. 

How you will make an impact: 

- Own end-to-end delivery of automation solutions using approved low-code tools (e. g. , Power Automate cloud/desktop, Power Apps, UiPath), from discovery and solution design through release, hypercare, and steady-state operations. 
 - Lead stakeholder workshops to understand current-state processes, define future-state workflows, document user stories/acceptance criteria, and align on measurable outcomes (cycle time, accuracy, compliance, cost). 
 - Design integration patterns leveraging connectors, APIs, and data services (e. g. , Dataverse/SQL) and ensure solutions align to enterprise integration, data-handling, and audit requirements. 
 - Engineer for resiliency by implementing standardized exception handling, structured logging, alerting/notifications, retry strategies, and proactive monitoring. 
 - Define and evolve team standards and reusable assets (templates, child flows, libraries, solution packages, framework components) to improve delivery speed, quality, and maintainability across the automation portfolio. 
 - Establish and enforce quality practices (unit/integration testing, peer reviews, test evidence) and drive defect remediation through UAT to meet release and validation expectations. 
 - Partner with security, infrastructure, and application owners to implement least-privilege access, credential management, and secure connectivity; proactively identify and mitigate control gaps. 
 - Own operational readiness: produce solution designs, runbooks, support models; lead incident triage, root-cause analysis, and preventative actions to improve service stability. 
 - Continuously improve existing automations (performance, resiliency, cost) by analyzing telemetry, reducing technical debt, and recommending platform capabilities and roadmap enhancements. 
 - Provide technical leadership across project teams by guiding design decisions, unblocking delivery, mentoring developers, and ensuring solutions conform to architecture, quality, and security standards. 
 - Drive technical excellence and innovation by evaluating new platform capabilities, establishing patterns for adoption, and sharing recommendations that improve the team's delivery velocity, maintainability, and compliance posture. 
 - Enable the broader automation community through demos, documentation, and reviews; coach citizen developers and project teams to operate within governance, ALM, and security standards. 

What you will need (Required): 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field 
 - 8+ years of experience developing and supporting automation solutions using low-code platforms (e. g. , Microsoft Power Platform-Power Automate/Power Apps/Dataverse-or UiPath), including design, build, test, deployment, and support. 
 - Proven ability to translate business needs into fit-for-purpose solution designs (user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria) and deliver automations in an Agile/Scrum environment while managing dependencies and risk. 
 - Hands-on experience with connectors/integrations (REST APIs, HTTP actions, webhooks) and data sources (Dataverse, SQL, SharePoint, SAP/ServiceNow or similar). 
 - Relevant certifications (strongly preferred but not required), such as Microsoft Power Platform (PL-100/PL-200/PL-400/PL-500) and/or UiPath certifications. 
 - Deep knowledge of platform governance and ALM (environments, solutions, connection references, DLP policies) with demonstrated experience establishing guardrails and delivery patterns; plus, working scripting/coding skills (e. g. , JavaScript, PowerShell, Python, or C#) to extend automations when needed. 
 - Strong interpersonal skills 
 - Excellent documentation and communication skills and interpersonal relationship skills including negotiating and relationship management skills with ability to drive achievement of objectives and communicate to various levels of audience or to explain complex or technical matters in a manner suitable for non-technical audiences. 
 - Strong collaboration skills: ability to partner with business process owners, analysts, and IT teams to deliver automation outcomes and communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences. 
 - Strong SDLC ownership (analysis, development, QA/UAT support, deployment, and post-go-live support) with a focus on reliability, security, maintainability, and operational readiness. 
 - Practical understanding of authentication/authorization concepts (service accounts, OAuth, MFA) and secure handling of sensitive data within automations. 
 - Ability to produce clear technical documentation (solution designs, data mappings, test evidence, runbooks) appropriate for regulated environments. 
 - Knowledge of best practices related to IT governance, operations, and administration. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate with architects, platform administrators, and project/program managers to deliver automation solutions aligned to standards, roadmaps, and timelines. 
 - Demonstrated problem-solving skills, including troubleshooting production issues and identifying continuous improvement opportunities. 
 - Adhere to all company rules and requirements (e. g. , pandemic protocols, Environmental Health & Safety rules) and take adequate control measures in preventing injuries to themselves and others as well as to the protection of environment and prevention of pollution under their span of influence/control. 

What else do we look for (Preferred): 

- Experience establishing and operating DevOps/ALM for low-code at scale (pipelines, solution packaging, automated testing) and applying source control practices (Git) for automation assets. 
 - Experience building enterprise-grade solutions using Power Platform (custom connectors, Power Fx, plugins) and/or UiPath (REFramework, Orchestrator) in a governed environment, including reusable architecture patterns and operational support models. 
 - Exposure to intelligent automation capabilities such as document processing (OCR/IDP), process mining, and/or AI-assisted automation, with an understanding of validation and quality requirements 
 - 4 years of relevant industry experience (e. g. , medical device, pharmaceuticals, etc. ) or in highly regulated environments preferred. 

Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families.

data.description:
Overview

Microsoft Advertising makes billions of decisions every day across search, native, shopping, display, audience, and AI-powered advertising experiences. 

We are looking for a Principal Software Architect to define the technical direction for Ads Quality at global scale. 

Quality decisions can depend on ads, landing pages, advertisers, businesses, account history, behavioral patterns, and signals that may be incomplete, delayed, noisy, or changing. The challenge is to turn this evidence into systems that are accurate, scalable, measurable, and continuously improving. 

This is a hands-on software engineering role spanning distributed systems, production AI, decision systems, entity intelligence, agentic workflows, and measurement. 

Responsibilities

Define the long-term architecture for Ads Quality across signals, entity understanding, model execution, decisioning, feedback, and measurement. 

Establish how quality systems should reason across ads, landing pages, advertisers, businesses, relationships, and behavior over time. 

Design architectures that support heterogeneous AI systems including lightweight models, multimodal models, LLMs, agents, and deterministic systems. 

Define how evidence, model outputs, confidence, calibration, thresholds, and decision policies come together in production. 

Set technical direction across real-time, nearline, and offline systems, balancing quality, latency, freshness, cost, and reliability. 

Drive convergence where common abstractions create leverage and challenge unnecessary duplication or complexity. 

Partner with Applied Science on how new model capabilities should shape system architecture. 

Prototype difficult ideas when that is the fastest way to establish technical feasibility. 

Influence implementation through design reviews, architecture guidance, and hands-on engagement with critical systems. 

Qualifications

15+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent technical depth. 

Deep experience architecting large-scale production systems spanning multiple teams. 

Strong expertise in distributed systems, production AI/ML systems, decision systems, or large-scale data platforms. 

Strong understanding of model serving, experimentation, evaluation, observability, rollout, and feedback loops. 

Ability to reason across software architecture and model behavior without treating ML as a black box. 

Track record of simplifying complex systems and turning ambiguous technical problems into durable architecture. 

Ability to influence senior engineers and technical leaders across organizational boundaries. 

Experience with advertising, quality systems, entity intelligence, multimodal AI, agentic systems, behavioral systems, or large-scale inference is valuable. 

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. 

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances.
