data.description:
Ready to be a Titan?

The Data & Reporting Platform team powers ServiceTitan's growth by delivering high-quality, low-latency, and reliable data and BI products that enable trust, acceleration, and data-driven decision-making for our customers and across ServiceTitan. 

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to own the semantic model architecture at the heart of our data platform. The semantic layer is the single source of truth for business metrics and logic, and it powers critical data products such as Reporting, and Agentic Analytics. This role sits at the intersection of data modeling, platform engineering, and product thinking - you'll define how data is modeled, governed, and consumed at scale across multiple product surfaces. 

This is a T-shaped role: deep expertise in semantic modeling and data architecture, with the breadth to operate across the full data platform stack at the principal level. You'll partner closely with our Data Foundations team (which owns ingestion and storage), our Reporting team (which owns the reporting experience), and teams building agentic AI capabilities; ensuring the semantic layer is the performant, scalable, and extensible foundation they all depend on. 

What You'll Do

Semantic Model Architecture: Design and evolve the semantic modeling layer that serves as the single source of truth for metrics, dimensions, entities, and business logic across all data products. Define the standards for how semantic models are authored, versioned, tested, and governed. Evaluate and drive the semantic layer technology strategy (e. g. , dbt MetricFlow or equivalent). 

Data Product Enablement: Architect how the semantic layer is consumed across distinct product surfaces such as Reporting (high-performance BI platform for customers), and Agentic Analytics (metadata-rich, discoverable interfaces that enable AI agents to reason over and query the semantic layer). Partner with adjacent teams to ensure the semantic layer meets each product's unique requirements. 

Performance & Scale: Own query performance, materialization strategies, pre-aggregation patterns, and cost optimization. Ensure the semantic layer is highly performant and scalable as data volumes and consumer demand grow. 

Platform & Governance: Build the semantic layer as a true platform experience: self-service metric onboarding, developer-friendly abstractions, clear documentation, data validation, and governance guardrails. Make it easy for other teams to extend the semantic layer without compromising consistency or quality. 

Technical Leadership: Operate as a technical leader across the Data & Reporting Platform organization. Participate in and drive design sessions across teams. Mentor engineers, manage stakeholder and leadership alignment. Contribute to architecture decisions that span from data foundations through reporting and analytics. Champion high-quality code with corresponding test coverage. 

AI-Augmented Engineering: Use AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) as a core part of your daily workflow. Drive adoption patterns, build team-specific contexts and workflows, and set the standard for how the team multiplies velocity through AI-assisted development. 

What You'll Bring

- 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering or Data Engineering roles, including experience with large-scale, high-traffic, fault-tolerant systems. 
 - Deep experience with semantic modeling, data engineering, data lakehouse, and data product development. Track record of building platform-level abstractions consumed by multiple product teams. 
 - Strong experience with the DBT ecosystem. Experience with semantic layer technologies (e. g. , dbt MetricFlow or similar) is highly preferred. 
 - Expert-level SQL and Python skills. Experience with query optimization, materialization strategies, and performance tuning at scale. 
 - Experience with modern data platform technologies: Snowflake, ClickHouse, or similar OLAP/columnar engines. Familiarity with Spark and streaming platforms (Kafka, Kinesis). 
 - Experience designing APIs and interfaces for domain specific data products. 
 - Demonstrated proficiency with AI coding tools (eg Claude, Cursor) as part of your regular engineering workflow; not just familiarity, but active daily use. 
 - Experience leading the architecture and design of systems (architecture, design patterns, reliability, and scaling). 
 - Strong communication and technical writing skills. Ability to empathize with users and champion for their experience. 
 - B. S. , M. S. , or PhD in Computer Science or a related field. 

Highly preferred

- Experience building semantic layers that serve both human analysts and programmatic/AI consumers. 
 - Experience with data governance frameworks, metric versioning, or data product catalogs. 
 - Familiarity with LLM-friendly data interfaces; designing schemas and metadata that enable AI agents to discover and query data effectively. 
 - Experience with data validation and quality frameworks (e. g. , Monte Carlo, Great Expectations). 

To effectively support our international teams, this position requires flexibility to overlap with US working hours as needed.

data.title: Senior Cloud Operations Engineer
data.description:
About Us

At Tally, we're driven by one core mission - making business simpler for everyone. As a pioneer in business management software, we've been the trusted partner of choice for ~3 million and 7. 5 million users across 100+ countries - many of them are MSMEs that form the backbone of global economies. 

Our journey is rooted in innovation, guided by deep empathy for customers, and driven by a commitment to excellence. With a legacy of trust and a future fueled by technology, we are shaping the way businesses manage accounting, inventory, compliance, and much more. 

We believe in honouring our people, nurturing potential, creating fearlessly, and mastering our craft - all while staying true to our values. If you are looking to make a real impact, grow with purpose, and be part of something meaningful, you'll find your place at Tally. 

As we continue to grow, we are working towards a larger ambition - to become the technology backbone for global economic progress. 

About Cloud Operations

Cloud Operations mission is to deliver the best-in-class connected services in public clouds for Tally's customers by ensuring unmatched reliability, strong security realized at the most optimal cost. Engineers here get to design, implement, and operationalize solutions leveraging deep cloud native technologies that ultimately deliver a flawless experience for our customers. 

Role: Senior Cloud Operations Engineer/Associate Staff Engineer

Experience: 7 - 12 years

Location: Bangalore

What You Will Own

In this role, you will own the reliability, scalability, and security of Tally's cloud infrastructure end-to-end, driving architectural decisions that shape the evolution of the platform. You will work closely with engineering, security, and product teams to lead major infrastructure initiatives, provide technical direction, and mentor engineers through complex, business-critical deployments. You will also champion an automation-first approach and establish strong observability practices across the platform, proactively identifying systemic risks, preventing incidents, and driving permanent root-cause solutions instead of temporary fixes. 

Where your Expertise Meets Our Future

Deep, hands-on expertise architecting, configuring, and troubleshooting large-scale, production-grade services in OCI / AWS cloud environments, with a track record of resolving complex, ambiguous issues under pressure. 

Proven experience owning the full lifecycle of application deployment and management in OCI / AWS cloud, including capacity planning, performance optimization, cost governance, and driving reliability at scale. 

AWS and OCI cloud operations are central to this role - candidates with strong, demonstrable depth in either platform are encouraged to apply; you'llbe expected to quickly build cross-platform proficiency and bring senior-level judgment to design and operational trade-offs across both environments. 

Strong track record of designing, deploying, and running production Kubernetes clusters at scale using OCI OKE and/or AWS EKS, including cluster architecture decisions, workload management, upgrade strategy, and cluster health monitoring. 

Proven ability to lead rapid, high-pressure troubleshooting of complex, multi-layered infrastructure, OS, and application issues , acting as an escalation point and driving incidents through root cause analysis(RCA) to full service restoration. 

Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical direction, mentor junior engineers, and represent the cloud operations function in cross-functional and leadership discussions. 

Intermediate Skills Required

Advanced expertise in configuring, hardening, and maintaining Linux hosts at scale, with strong shell scripting skills to build reusable operational tooling. 

Deep, hands-on expertise with container technology such as Docker, and strong command of the OCI OKE and AWS EKS ecosystems, including designing for scale and resilience. 

Strong command of network security architecture, including firewall rule management, network segmentation, zero-trust principles, and cloud security groups/NACLs, with the judgment to make and defend design trade-offs. 

Strong grounding in CI/CD pipeline design and DevOps principles, with experience improving pipeline reliability and deployment velocity across teams. 

Solid operational experience with database technologies such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB, including performance tuning and high-availability design. 

Strong Python skills for building automation and tooling, along with solid working knowledge of AWS boto3. 

The Scope of Your Influence

Act as a senior escalation point in the on-call rotation, leading incident response and root cause analysis (RCA) for critical issues and driving thorough post-incident reviews. 

Own the deployment architecture and monitoring strategy for Tally's cloud, making the calls on design trade-offs and setting the standard other engineers follow. 

Lead deployment governance and change management, driving alignment across development, testing, and operations teams on patch and release strategy, ensuring changes roll out consistently and safely across all environments (development, staging, production). 

Proactively identify systemic in efficiencies and lead automation initiatives (scripting, configuration management, orchestration) that reduce manual toil across the team, not just your own workload. 

Own the performance and availability of Tally's cloud-based applications, setting SLOs and driving the team's response when they're at risk. 

Define, track, and improve operational KPIs including service availability, deployment success, incident response, and platform health. 

Success Measures

Effective deployment governance through active participation in change management and release reviews. 

Strong stakeholder engagement and operational communication across teams. 

Continuous improvement through automation, operational excellence, and incident reduction initiatives. 

Data-driven operational management through CloudOps metrics, reporting, and service health reviews. 

Demonstrated leadership in driving cross-functional operational outcomes and technical excellence. 

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further steps in the hiring process.

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer, Cells Infrastructure
data.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 

- Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

An overview of this role

We're looking for an Intermediate Site Reliability Engineer to join the Cells Infrastructure team in GitLab's Scale & Architecture organization. In this role, you'll help build and operate Cells, the architecture that lets GitLab. com scale horizontally. Cells splits GitLab. com into many independent units, each with its own application and data stack, behind a shared routing layer. 

This is a build-it-and-run-it role. You'll provision cells, route traffic to them, deploy them safely, and keep them reliable in production. You'll also help move customer organizations onto Cells, one of GitLab's most important scaling initiatives. 

What you'll do

- Operate Cells in production: join the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, lead post-incident reviews, and drive corrective actions to completion. 
 - Define and monitor service level objectives (SLOs) for routing and cell health, and build the dashboards, alerts, and runbooks behind them. 
 - Provision and operate cell infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Kubernetes, networking, Identity and Access Management (IAM), PostgreSQL, Redis, and object storage. 
 - Develop infrastructure as code with Terraform, Helm, and GitOps tooling such as Argo CD. 
 - Operate and extend the global routing layer, built on Cloudflare Workers, Envoy, and a Go service backed by Cloud Spanner, and expand routing to more protocols and services. 
 - Improve the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines behind ring-based deployments, covering promotion, database migrations, quality assurance validation, and rollback. 
 - Support organization migrations by preparing destination cells and helping with dry runs and production cutovers. 
 - Work with product teams to make their services cell-compatible, and write documentation so others can operate Cells with confidence. 

What you'll bring

- Professional experience running production infrastructure at scale on AWS, GCP, or both, including Kubernetes, along with strong Terraform and Helm skills. 
 - Proficiency in Go, or strong experience in another systems language and willingness to work in Go daily. 
 - Solid grounding in site reliability engineering (SRE) best practices: SLOs and error budgets, blameless post-incident reviews, reducing toil through automation, capacity planning, and designing for graceful degradation. 
 - Experience owning services in production, including on-call, incident response, and monitoring with tools such as Prometheus and Grafana. 
 - Practical knowledge of progressive delivery: how to roll changes safely across a fleet and how to roll them back. 
 - A strong understanding of distributed-systems fundamentals, such as request routing, proxies, consistency, and failure domains. 
 - Experience working effectively in distributed, all-remote teams: you default to asynchronous, written-first communication, document decisions in issues and merge requests, hand off work cleanly across time zones, and stay transparent about progress and blockers. 
 - Experience with Cloudflare, Spanner, Argo CD, TypeScript, or operating GitLab at scale is a plus, not a requirement. 

About The Team

Every team in our organization owns its services end to end, from design through on-call. We own the control plane that tracks cells and decides where each request belongs, and keep the fleet in step with GitLab's release cadence. We work closely with delivery, database, migration, and product teams across GitLab. Feature teams own how their services behave on the platform; we own the underlying infrastructure. We're an all-remote, asynchronous team. We make decisions in GitLab issues, use directly responsible individuals (DRIs) to own technical direction, demo our work weekly, and use AI-assisted workflows every day. 

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

- Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
 - Flexible Paid Time Off 
 - Team Member Resource Groups
 - Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
 - Growth and Development Fund
 - Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application. 

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process. 

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us. 

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab's policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

The ideal candidate is an expert in React, who has been part of migration projects from different eCommerce platforms and from SFCC - SFRA into SFCC - PWA Kit, is an expert in Managed Runtime (MRT) , can establish and follow coding standards, resolve bugs, vulnerabilities created by QA and Code quality platforms tools like SonarQube, and bridge modern frontend frameworks with SFCC's backend power.

data.title: Principal/ Sr Engineer- Harness Engineering
data.description:
FICO (NYSE: FICO) is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity

Come join our Software Engineering team in a hands-on technical role at the heart of a new discipline: Harness Engineering. As AI coding agents take on more of the software lifecycle, the hard part is no longer writing code - agents generate it faster than humans can review it, so the bottleneck shifts to verification and trust. Harness Engineering exists to break that bottleneck: engineering the environment that steers agents toward correct, maintainable, well-architected output so that quality is enforced by the system, not re-audited by a person on every change. We call that environment the harness (Agent = Model + Harness). As a Senior Harness Engineer (Band D2), you'll independently own whole harness subsystems, set the standards other engineers build to, and be involved in the end-to-end lifecycle of turning raw model capability into production-grade engineering. 

What You'll Contribute

- Design, build, deploy, and support core components of the harness - the guides, feedback loops, guardrails, and shared context that turn raw model capability into production-grade engineering. This is a hands-on role focused on systems and leverage, not hand-writing application code. 
 - Own and evolve feedforward guides - agent instruction files, reusable skills, architectural rules, reference docs, and codemods - and drive team-wide standardization so agents get it right the first time. 
 - Build feedback sensors - custom linters, static analysis, structural and architecture-fitness tests, verification loops, and LLM-as-judge reviewers - that catch issues automatically before they reach human reviewers. 
 - Own quality gating and release criteria for agent-produced work, defining authority boundaries for what agents may merge unaided and the escalation rules for what must route to a human. 
 - Establish LLM testing infrastructure and evaluation approaches that ensure AI-generated output meets quality and safety thresholds; apply consumer/contract testing (e. g. Pact) where service integration reliability matters. 
 - Run the steering loop - when an agent repeats a mistake, engineer a control so it can't happen again - deciding where each control runs in the path to production (fast pre-commit checks, heavier post-integration checks, or continuous drift-scanning sensors) to keep quality as far left as is economical, while treating repository knowledge as the system of record and fighting drift with continuous garbage collection. 
 - Improve observability into agent work and track the measures that matter - cost per merged PR, time-to-merge for agent-assisted PRs, review velocity relative to PR size, defect escape rate, and agent-PR survival rate - using them to decide where to invest next. 
 - Partner with product and platform teams to turn specifications and acceptance criteria into enforceable controls. 
 - Serve as a source of technical expertise and mentor engineers across teams in harness practices and the effective, responsible use of AI tools. 

What We're Seeking

- Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience in software architecture, design, development, and testing, with a strong track record in large, complex codebases. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI coding agents (e. g. Claude Code, Codex, or similar), including building your own tooling or harnesses to make AI agents genuinely effective - not just using them as a power user. 
 - Proven ability to build engineering tooling across a modern stack, including linters, static analysis, CI/CD pipelines, containerized build/test environments, and instrumentation/observability. 
 - Experience with spec-driven development, context engineering, agent orchestration, and fitness functions, with a systems mindset that favors fixing the environment over fixing individual outputs. 
 - Judgment in choosing between deterministic controls (type checkers, linters, structural tests) and inferential, LLM-based controls (AI code review, LLM-as-judge), understanding the trade-offs between them. 
 - Experience owning quality-gating processes and defining release criteria to ensure engineering standards are consistently met. 
 - Working knowledge of the security surface unique to autonomous agents - prompt injection, tool/permission scoping, sandboxed execution, and audit trails - and designing least-privilege guardrails around them. 
 - Experience with consumer/contract testing approaches (e. g. Pact) to validate service integrations across distributed systems. 
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions, drive standards across teams, and evangelize best practices while incorporating feedback from internal users. 

Our Offer to You

- An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others. 
 - The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences. 
 - Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so. 
 - An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie. 

Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today - Big Data analytics. You'll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more. 

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide: 

- Credit Scoring - FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders. 
 - Fraud Detection and Security - 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems. 
 - Lending - 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score. 

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO's solutions, placing us among the world's top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world's largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people - just like you - who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that's nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We'll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www. fico. com/Careers

FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we're proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don't meet all stated qualifications. data.title: Senior AI Engineer - Quality Platform
data.description:
About The Company

Founders today are building global companies from day one - but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that!

We're building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building. 

Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Our team brings global experience from leading fintech and technology companies, and many of us are former founders and operators who understand what it takes to build thoughtfully, make trade-offs, and deliver at scale in a global environment. 

Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50, 000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018. Together with partners like J. P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we're building for the next generation of global companies. 

About The Role

Software quality and code volume are increasingly an engineering and AI problem. Leading teams now use agents to generate tests, detect coverage gaps before merge, and enforce quality through infrastructure rather than manual processes. 

At Aspire, we're already building this infrastructure. We have a merge guardrail in production that reads live product specs and blocks PRs when coverage gaps are detected. We are building an LLM pipeline that generates tests directly from specs, and a live traceability matrix that keeps specs, code, and test results in sync, along with AI-assisted code review. 

We are hiring a software engineer who builds AI systems and has a strong understanding of coding, testing and quality. You will design, build, and ship the AI tooling that makes quality automatic across Aspire's engineering organisation. 

What You'll Own

- The AI test generation pipeline. Build the LLM system that assesses product specs for gaps and testability, and converts them into automated tests. You will take it from POC to production, owning context retrieval across specs and codebases, prompt and agent design, evaluation frameworks for generation accuracy, and feedback loops based on live test results. 
 - The merge guardrail. The guardrail is live and blocks merges when coverage is missing or critical bugs are detected. You will improve its precision, scale it across all engineering tribes, and integrate it with the generation pipeline so it creates missing tests rather than only blocking for them. 
 - Reliable automation tooling. Build the intelligence layer behind our automation, including synthetic test data generation, AI agents that explore and verify flows, automated failure classification, and risk-based test selection, so that every alert is accurate and actionable. 
 - Quality platform ownership. Understand the spec, the code, and the failure modes, and build that understanding into systems. Contribute at the design stage, not after release. In a regulated fintech serving 50, 000+ businesses, quality gaps directly impact customers. Work closely with QA engineers to embed AI-assisted practices and use quality data (coverage, escape rates, flakiness) to drive decisions. 
 - Security regression in CI. Design and build automated security regression tests for our highest-risk API endpoints, ensuring every auth boundary is verified at merge. This is a MAS Singapore requirement and will be built from scratch. 

What We're Looking For

- Proven experience shipping AI systems. You have built and deployed an LLM application, agent, developer tool, or automation that replaced real manual work. You understand common failure modes such as hallucinations, context limits, and evaluation gaps, and how to address them. 
 - Strong software engineering with a quality mindset. You write production code, design systems, and build tools used by other engineers. You understand test architecture, coverage, and failure analysis well enough to define what good testing looks like. 
 - High standards. You address root causes rather than symptoms and treat production defects and flaky tests as system-level problems to eliminate. 
 - Ownership and initiative. You identify problems, validate them with data, and propose solutions without waiting to be assigned. 
 - Comfort with ambiguity. You are motivated by an evolving roadmap that starts with quality and extends to wider engineering workflows as we learn what works, and you want to help shape its direction. 

Technical Skills

- Strong software engineering in TypeScript and/or Python, with experience building production services, internal tools, or developer platforms
 - Hands-on experience building LLM applications, including prompt engineering, RAG or context retrieval, agents or tool use, and output evaluation. Side projects, internal tools, or POCs count if they were shipped. 
 - Strong day-to-day use of AI coding tools and agentic workflows. 
 - Solid understanding of test automation and test architecture; Playwright experience is a strong plus
 - CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), including building tooling that integrates at PR and merge stages
 - Ability to read and reason about backend code, API contracts, and service boundaries
 - 5+ years in software engineering with meaningful exposure to development, testing, quality, or developer tooling, preferably including a fintech or regulated-environment project
 - Experience owning a system or product domain end-to-end
 - Familiarity with financial workflows such as payments, KYB/KYC, and transaction processing is a strong plus

What This Role Is NOT

- Building AI prototypes that never reach production. 
 - Waiting at the end of the delivery pipeline for a build. 
 - Maintaining a regression suite without evaluating its value. 
 - Treating quality as another team's responsibility. 

In Your First 90 Days, You'll Probably

- Become the go-to engineer for building quality into development workflows. 
 - Challenge at least one existing practice with data and propose a better approach. 
 - Review the codebase and identify the three biggest quality gaps based on data, propose solutions, and build tooling for at least one. 
 - Deliver a measurable improvement in quality via the test-generation pipeline, the merge guardrail, automation reliability, code review etc. 

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Aspire. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Aspire may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Aspire's Candidate Privacy Notice.

data.title: SASE Firewall QA Automation Engineer
data.description:
Role Overview

NETGEAR is looking for a QA Automation Engineer to help validate our next-generation firewall and cybersecurity platform. In this role, you will build and maintain automated tests that verify firewall behavior across critical security domains including Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW), Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Secure Web Gateways (SWG), Virtual Private Networks (VPN), and Software-Defined Wide Area Networks (SD-WAN). 

Working alongside firewall developers and senior QA engineers, you will automate functional, regression, and performance testing against real and simulated network traffic. You will not be expected to know every area of the stack on day one - we will support you in growing across it. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain automated test suites that validate firewall functionality - policy and rule evaluation, NAT, stateful session handling, and traffic filtering across NGFW, SASE, ZTNA, SWG, VPN, and SD-WAN features. 
 - Build and maintain test topologies and lab environments, including virtual machines, containers, and physical firewall appliances. 
 - Generate and shape realistic network traffic to exercise the firewall data plane, and verify observed behavior against expected policy outcomes. 
 - Run test suites in CI, triage failures, distinguish product defects from environment and test issues, and file clear, reproducible defect reports with supporting packet captures and logs. 
 - Contribute to test plans and test-case design from firewall requirements, and help keep automation coverage mapped to those test cases. 
 - Support performance and scale testing - throughput, connections per second, and concurrent sessions - and help identify regressions. 
 - Work with developers to improve testability, and stay current with automation tooling, including AI-assisted test generation, maintenance, and failure triage. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - 2-4 years of professional experience in QA automation or test engineering, preferably for networking or security products. 
 - Strong automation scripting ability in Python and Bash, comfort working in Ubuntu or other Linux environments from the command line, and day-to-day use of Git. 
 - Working knowledge of networking protocols and traffic flows - TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS/SSL, NAT, and routing fundamentals. 
 - Understanding of firewall fundamentals such as packet filtering, stateful connection tracking, NAT, and rule and policy evaluation. 
 - Hands-on experience with Linux networking and firewall tooling - iptables and nftables rule configuration, conntrack for session inspection, and iproute2 (ip addr, ip route, network namespaces, bridges, VLANs) for building and inspecting test topologies. 
 - Proficient in analyzing logs and network captures using tools such as Wireshark, tshark, and tcpdump. 
 - Experience with a test framework and runner such as pytest or Robot Framework. 
 - Experience with REST API testing using Postman, REST Assured, or scripted HTTP clients, for validating firewall management and policy APIs. 
 - Experience running automated tests in CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI). 
 - Familiarity with defect tracking and test management tools (e. g. , Jira, TestRail, Xray), and good communication skills in an agile, cross-functional team. 

Preferred Qualifications (optional)

- Experience with traffic generation, shaping, and impairment tools such as iperf3, Scapy, hping3, tc/netem, TRex, or commercial testers like Spirent or Ixia. 
 - Contributions to open-source security or networking projects. 
 - Exposure to firewall security testing - IPS/IDS signature validation, TLS/SSL inspection, URL filtering, and threat-feed verification. 
 - Familiarity with virtualization and container tooling for building test labs - Docker and Docker Compose, VMware or KVM, Kubernetes - and with infrastructure-as-code such as Ansible or Terraform. 
 - Exposure to performance and scale testing, and to high-availability and failover validation. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted and agentic testing tools - for example LLM-assisted test generation, self-healing test maintenance, or agent-based exploratory testing - and an interest in applying them to network security test suites. 
 - Experience automating network devices and appliances over SSH and CLI using libraries such as Paramiko or Netmiko. 
 - Familiarity with certificate and PKI tooling such as OpenSSL, for generating test certificates and validating TLS/SSL inspection behavior. 
 - Experience validating firewall logging and telemetry - syslog, NetFlow, or IPFIX export - against expected policy events. 

Company Statement/Values

At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live. 

We're a performance-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the Next Gear by living our values: we Dare to Transform the future, Connect and Delight our customers, Communicate Courageously with each other and collaborate to Win It Together. You'll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture. 

We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity. 

NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Principal Mobile Software Engineer (P5)

Who We Are

Solera is a global leader in data and software services, transforming every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235, 000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our teams work on mission‐critical platforms that demand reliability, scalability, and thoughtful evolution of complex systems. 

Job Summary

- We're looking for a hands-on Principal Mobile Software Engineer (P5) who will lead the architecture, development, modernization, and delivery of enterprise-grade mobile platforms across iOS and Android. This role is focused on building reliable, scalable, secure, and high-performing mobile experiences while using AI-driven development practices to accelerate engineering velocity, improve quality, and unlock intelligent mobile capabilities. 
 - This role is ideal for a senior technologist who: 
 - Leads complete, high-impact mobile initiatives end-to-end across discovery, architecture, implementation, launch, and continuous improvement
 - Designs and builds cross-platform mobile solutions spanning iOS, Android, and shared mobile platform capabilities
 - Applies AI-driven development practices, AI-assisted engineering tools, and intelligent mobile workflows to improve delivery speed and product quality
 - Makes pragmatic architectural decisions that balance native platform excellence, cross-platform reuse, performance, security, maintainability, and time-to-market
 - Partners effectively with product, design, architecture, backend, security, QA, DevOps/SRE, and business stakeholders to turn ambiguous goals into mobile outcomes
 - Mentors mobile engineers and raises the technical standard through platform ownership, code review, architecture guidance, and hands-on implementation
 - You will operate with broad autonomy, lead complete mobile initiatives without requiring constant direction, influence mobile platform direction across teams, and be known as someone who ships, unblocks others, aligns stakeholders, and makes things happen. 

What You'll Do

Build, Ship, and Own Mobile Platforms

- Write production-quality mobile code regularly across iOS, Android, shared platform libraries, and mobile integration layers
 - Own and deliver high-impact mobile features, platform capabilities, and system improvements end-to-end
 - Lead modernization of legacy mobile applications, incrementally migrating toward modular, maintainable, testable, and scalable mobile architectures
 - Design and evolve mobile platform foundations, including app architecture, shared components, design systems, SDKs, offline capabilities, authentication flows, telemetry, and release infrastructure
 - Translate ambiguous business and user requirements into reliable, intuitive, and performant mobile experiences
 - Identify mobile technical risks early, including app performance, crash rates, app store constraints, OS fragmentation, security, privacy, offline behavior, and API reliability

AI-Driven Mobile Development & Intelligent Experiences

- Lead the adoption of AI-driven development practices for mobile engineering, including AI-assisted design, coding, refactoring, test generation, debugging, documentation, and code review workflows

 - Evaluate when intelligence should run on-device, at the edge, or in cloud services based on latency, privacy, cost, reliability, and user experience

 - Implement hallucination mitigation and validation strategies for AI-powered mobile features, including grounding, structured outputs, user confirmation, fallback states, and telemetry-driven evaluation
 - Design monitoring and feedback loops for AI-enabled mobile behavior in production
 - Ensure AI-enabled mobile capabilities meet security, privacy, compliance, accessibility, and user trust requirements

Mobile Technical Leadership & Architecture

- Set and evolve mobile architecture standards through hands-on implementation
 - Guide platform decisions across native iOS, native Android, cross-platform frameworks, shared libraries, backend integration, data synchronization, security, and observability
 - Make principled tradeoffs between native platform depth, cross-platform reuse, delivery speed, scalability, performance, correctness, and long-term maintainability
 - Act as a technical escalation point for challenging mobile problems, including performance, memory, battery usage, offline-first behavior, crash stability, OS compatibility, release quality, and integration reliability
 - Influence technical direction across multiple teams without becoming a bottleneck
 - Provide full technical leadership for projects by coordinating architecture, engineering execution, dependency management, risk mitigation, mobile release planning, and cross-team alignment
 - Communicate clearly with product owners, UX/design, engineering leaders, backend teams, security, DevOps/SRE, QA, support, and business stakeholders to keep delivery aligned with business outcomes

AI-Assisted Mobile Engineering & Developer Productivity

- Leverage AI-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, and mobile-specific automation to accelerate high-quality delivery
 - Establish best practices and guardrails for safe, high-quality AI-assisted mobile coding
 - Use AI tools for mobile solution design, architecture analysis, refactoring, test generation, debugging, system comprehension, documentation, and release readiness
 - Improve developer productivity through reusable mobile components, shared architecture patterns, CI/CD automation, test automation, build optimization, and platform tooling
 - Help teams adopt modern mobile workflows that improve velocity while maintaining engineering rigor, security, accessibility, and release quality

Mentorship & Team Elevation

- Mentor mobile engineers through pairing, code reviews, architecture reviews, and design discussions
 - Help senior mobile engineers grow into broader technical leadership roles
 - Coach engineers on modern mobile architecture, cross-platform development, AI-aware engineering practices, quality engineering, observability, and secure development
 - Foster a culture of continuous learning, ownership, customer empathy, and technical excellence
 - Lead by example with clear communication, humility, accountability, and hands-on technical contribution

Mobile Execution, Quality & Operations

- Build and maintain enterprise mobile applications using modern native and/or cross-platform frameworks
 - Design and implement integrations with RESTful APIs, GraphQL services, event-driven workflows, identity providers, analytics platforms, and mobile backend services
 - Optimize mobile applications for performance, memory usage, battery life, network efficiency, offline behavior, accessibility, localization, and reliability
 - Partner with DevOps/SRE and QA to ensure strong mobile CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, build signing, release automation, observability, crash reporting, and safe deployments
 - Own release quality across TestFlight, Google Play testing tracks, App Store, and Google Play production releases
 - Participate fully in the SDLC: design, coding, testing, deployment, production support, incident response, and continuous improvement

Experience

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 10+ years of professional software development experience, including significant hands-on mobile engineering experience
 - Proven experience owning and delivering large, complex mobile applications or mobile platform capabilities
 - Demonstrated success modernizing legacy mobile applications, mobile architectures, and mobile delivery practices

 - Strong proficiency with Kotlin and Android platform development, including Android architecture, Jetpack, coroutines, networking, persistence, testing, and Google Play release practices

 - Experience integrating mobile apps with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, identity providers, telemetry platforms, crash reporting, analytics, feature flags, and remote configuration

 - Strong experience with mobile testing strategies, including unit testing, UI automation, integration testing, contract testing, snapshot testing, and regression automation
 - Experience with mobile CI/CD, build automation, signing, provisioning, release tracks, app store submission, observability, and production monitoring

 - Proficient with Git and modern development workflows
 - Strong understanding of production-quality code, performance tuning, reliability engineering, accessibility, and user-centered mobile design

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with React Native, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform, . NET MAUI, or other cross-platform mobile frameworks at scale
 - Experience building shared mobile platform libraries, SDKs, design systems, or reusable component frameworks
 - Experience with offline-first mobile applications, synchronization, conflict resolution, and intermittent connectivity scenarios
 - Experience with mobile observability, crash analytics, performance monitoring, synthetic monitoring, and SLO-driven reliability practices

 - Experience with regulated, security-sensitive, or compliance-driven mobile applications
 - Background with event streaming, messaging, or real-time data workflows
 - Strong background in Agile/Scrum environments

EDUCATION

Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience

What Success Looks Like

- You are consistently delivering high-impact mobile features and platform capabilities across iOS and Android
 - Mobile applications are more reliable, performant, secure, observable, accessible, and easier to release

 - AI-assisted engineering practices improve team velocity, code quality, test coverage, and documentation quality

data.title: IT Quality Lead
data.description:
IT Quality Lead, 

Location: India

Company: VB Spine

Looking for a career where your work truly matters? At VB Spine, you'll be part of a mission-focused team that supports surgeons during life-changing spinal procedures. We're looking for driven individuals ready to learn quickly, adapt under pressure, and grow in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. 

As an IT Quality Lead, you will be a trusted partner to IT and business leaders, driving quality, compliance, and validation excellence across technology initiatives. 

You will lead quality assurance and computer system validation activities, establish and maintain quality standards, and ensure technology solutions are delivered reliably, compliantly, and efficiently. Working across global teams, you will oversee validation programs, identify and mitigate risks, drive continuous improvement, and strengthen quality practices throughout the software development lifecycle. 

This role is well suited to a proactive professional who excels in dynamic environments, enjoys building scalable processes, and can effectively balance speed, structure, and business needs in a regulated MedTech organization. 

What You'll Do

- Lead and support Computer System Validation (CSV) activities across the full system lifecycle, including validation planning, risk assessments, testing strategies, execution oversight, and validation deliverables. 
 - Drive validation efforts for GxP-regulated applications, data migration projects, and infrastructure qualification activities to ensure compliance and operational readiness. 
 - Ensure computerized systems remain in a validated state through effective change management, periodic reviews, lifecycle management, and ongoing compliance monitoring. 
 - Partner with IT, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, business stakeholders, and vendors to deliver compliant, efficient, and business-aligned technology solutions. 
 - Apply risk-based validation methodologies and industry best practices to optimize validation activities while maintaining regulatory compliance. 
 - Support governance and compliance for critical GxP systems, including system implementations, enhancements, upgrades, retirements, access reviews, backup verification, and disaster recovery testing. 
 - Review and approve system changes, ensuring appropriate validation impact assessments, testing requirements, and documentation standards are met. 
 - Oversee and collaborate with external service providers and implementation partners to ensure high-quality delivery of validation, testing, and support services. 
 - Develop, maintain, and enhance validation documentation, procedures, SOPs, training materials, dashboards, and compliance metrics to support inspection readiness. 
 - Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen IT Quality processes, increase operational efficiency, improve vendor performance, and support regulatory and business transformation programs. 

What You Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. 
 - 4+ years of experience in IT Quality, Computer System Validation (CSV), IT Compliance, or regulated IT environments within Life Sciences. 
 - Strong knowledge of GxP regulations, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11, GAMP, and risk-based validation practices. 
 - Experience supporting validation activities across the system lifecycle, including implementation, testing, change management, and operations. 
 - Familiarity with validation documentation such as validation plans, risk assessments, traceability matrices, and IQ/OQ/PQ protocols. 
 - Experience with data migration validation, infrastructure qualification, or technology transformation projects is preferred. 
 - Strong stakeholder management, communication, and documentation skills, with the ability to work effectively across global teams. 
 - Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, regulated environment. 
 - Proactive, solution-focused mindset with the ability to work independently and drive continuous improvement. 

Why VB Spine?

We believe in growing talent from within. At VB Spine, you'll get the training, mentorship, and support you need to build a strong foundation in the medical sales field. You'll work alongside a high-performing team, gain valuable operating room experience, and take your first step toward a rewarding and meaningful career. 

Compensation

Compensation for this role is competitive and based on experience, qualifications, skills, and local market conditions. Final compensation will be determined on a case-by-case basis.

data.title: Senior Manager Quality Engineering
data.description:
Overview

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer's and partner's needs and solve their challenges. 

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve. 

You'll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about-locally and globally. 

Come make an impact every day at Zebra. 

What We're Looking For

As a Senior Manager of Quality Assurance for GenAI, you will be a key leader in our engineering organization. You will be responsible for building and leading a world-class QA team, while also defining and executing a strategy to leverage AI to revolutionize our development and testing methodologies. This role requires a deep understanding of not just traditional software QA, but also the emerging challenges of validating intelligent, autonomous systems. You will shape the future of quality for a new class of software. 

Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Vision

Lead, mentor talented QA engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Set a clear vision for how quality is defined and achieved in an AI-driven software development environment. 

AI-Driven Quality Strategy

Develop and implement a comprehensive strategy for developing and testing products built leveraging agentic AI and for using GenAI to enhance testing itself. Pioneer and define a new suite of quality and performance metrics for Generative and Agentic AI models, focusing on areas like accuracy, bias, safety, relevance, and autonomous task completion. Design novel testing methodologies to validate the autonomous behavior of Agentic AI systems within our development process, ensuring their reliability and alignment with intended goals. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with product, engineering, and data science to embed a "quality-first" mindset in every stage of the development lifecycle for our agentic systems. Act as the key subject matter expert on AI quality, effectively communicating risks, strategies, and results to stakeholders at all levels. 

Process & Tooling

Evolve our test automation frameworks to handle the non-deterministic and dynamic nature of AI-driven software. Drive the selection and implementation of new tools and infrastructure required for robustly testing and monitoring AI models and agents in production. 

- Basic Qualifications: 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 10+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, with at least 5 years in a leadership role. 
 - Proven track record of building and leading high-performing QA teams in a fast-paced, agile environment. 
 - Strong foundational knowledge of software development lifecycle and modern testing methodologies. 
Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, AI, or a related field. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in defining and implementing novel quality metrics for AI models, such as fluency, coherence, factuality, hallucination rates, and task success for AI agents.

data.title: Senior AI Evals Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

The Senior AI Evals Test Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for defining, developing, and executing robust evaluation frameworks and test strategies for AI agents built using the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or similar sort of agentic frameworks. This role bridges AI development and reliable deployment - ensuring our agents are safe, ethical, effective, and meet high-quality performance standards. A significant focus of the role is on Responsible AI and Safety Evals, including adversarial testing, red-teaming, bias detection, and toxicity measurement. The engineer will design scalable evaluation pipelines, build synthetic test environments, and work closely with AI/ML Engineers, Researchers, and policy teams to ensure agents are production-ready and compliant with regulatory and ethical standards. The role is 70% Automation and 30% Manual Testing, and sits within the Applied AI: Test Engineering team as a key technical authority. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and build agent evaluation frameworks - create end-to-end infrastructure for evaluating LLM-based agents across correctness, latency, cost, safety, and task completion rate
 - Build synthetic testing environments and simulation strategies to stress-test AI agents under diverse real-world conditions, with specific focus on agents built on Google ADK and related Google AI/ML services (e. g. , Vertex AI, Gemini models)
 - Build golden datasets and test harnesses - curate domain-specific evaluation sets for Rubrik's product verticals (data security, SaaS protection, cyber recovery, compliance)
 - Establish eval-as-a-service - build and enhance centralized evaluation platform that any IT team members can self-serve to test their agents against standardized and custom benchmarks
 - Automate regression and drift detection - implement CI/CD-integrated eval pipelines that catch regressions on every model or prompt change before production deployment
 - Define eval taxonomies and rubrics - establish structured scoring criteria for agentic workflows (tool use accuracy, multi-step reasoning, hallucination rate, policy adherence, error recovery)
 - Instrument production observability - build real-time monitoring for agent quality in production: success rates, user corrections, fallback triggers, escalation patterns
 - Benchmark and select models - run structured model comparisons (cost, quality, latency trade-offs) to inform model selection decisions across agent use cases
 - Analyze and interpret evaluation results, providing clear, actionable quality and safety reports to stakeholders and development teams, with specific focus on risk metrics, trend analysis, and mitigation recommendations
 - Define comprehensive end-to-end QA strategies - functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT) - tailored for conversational and goal-oriented AI agents with tool-use, memory, and multi-turn reasoning capabilities
 - Develop and maintain detailed test artifacts (test plans, test cases, test scenarios, automated test suites) covering agent features, tool invocation, memory persistence, and reasoning accuracy across evolving model versions
 - Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects, performance regressions, and alignment failures using Jira, collaborating closely with Applied AI Engineers to analyze root causes and validate fixes
 - Evaluate new technologies and patterns (e. g. , new tools for Agent Evals), run proofs-of-concept, and influence the platform roadmap
 - Partner with policy and legal teams to ensure agent evaluations systematically cover regulatory compliance, fairness objectives, and emerging AI governance requirements
 - Provide technical leadership to engineers, including solutioning, design reviews, code reviews, pair programming, and mentoring of junior and contract engineers
 - Collaborate cross-functionally - work closely with ML engineers, product teams, platform engineers, and security to embed eval-driven quality gates into the agent development lifecycle

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
 - 8+ years of overall software Test engineering experience, with 5+ years focused on test engineering, QA automation, or developer tooling, and demonstrated ability to build evaluation systems across multiple AI/ML domains, conversational agents, or Large Language Models (LLMs)
 - 2+ years working with ML/AI systems, building, testing, or evaluating models in production environments, including hands-on experience with LLM-based applications, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or agentic workflows
 - 2+ years as a senior/lead, owning evaluation strategy, quality frameworks, and technical decisions for complex AI agent systems in an enterprise product environment
 - 1+ years in designing or operating evaluation frameworks specifically for generative AI / LLM agents, including benchmarking, red-teaming, and production quality monitoring in the AI ADLC model

Technical Skills

- Deep hands-on experience with LLM evaluation - familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as LangSmith, DeepEval, LLM as a Judge, Promptfoo, RAGAS, Hugging Face evaluation tooling, custom eval harnesses
 - Strong understanding of agentic AI patterns - tool use, function calling, multi-step planning, ReAct/CoT reasoning chains, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
 - Production experience with eval pipelines - building automated, CI-integrated evaluation infrastructure (not just notebooks)

 - Collaborate with product, engineering, and leadership to improve quality standards.

 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Jenkins, Github Actions). 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills across multiple technical domains.

 - Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

Job Description

We are Omnissa!

The world is evolving fast, and organizations everywhere-from corporations to schools-are under immense pressure to provide flexible, work-from-anywhere solutions. They need IT infrastructure that empowers employees and customers to access applications from any device, on any cloud, all while maintaining top-tier security. That's where Omnissa comes in. 

The Omnissa Platform is the first AI-driven digital work platform that enables smart, seamless and secure work experiences from anywhere. It uniquely integrates multiple industry-leading solutions including Unified Endpoint Management, Virtual Apps and Desktops, Digital Employee Experience, and Security & Compliance through common data, identity, administration, and automation services. At Omnissa, we're driven by a shared mission to maximize value for our customers. Our five Core Values guide us: Act in Alignment, Build Trust, Foster Inclusiveness, Drive Efficiency, and Maximize Customer Value-all with the aim of achieving shared success for our clients and our team. 

As a global private company with over 4, 000 employees, we're always looking for passionate, talented individuals to join us. If you're ready to make an impact and help shape the future of work, we'd love to hear from you! high ownership, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence

What is the opportunity?

Our software scales to support millions of devices across multiple device platforms. We have a high bar for quality, performance, scale, availability and supportability - our customers are counting on us to keep their business running. We support complex use cases that span across VMware and services/capabilities provided by OS vendors. We integrate with customers enterprise infrastructure to provide a seamless management experience. 

You will be part of a AI Platform team that is solely focused on driving AI features with Omnissa product portfolio. This role will be responsible for building tools and services that enable us to automate the complex use cases that we support. Responsibilities for this role will also include ensuring that the product being built is testable including designing and refactoring core platform components to ensure so. Team member is expected to participate actively in product design discussions and work closely with functional engineering teams to ensure that the product is built in parallel with the integrations, services and tooling required to effectively test it in an automated fashion. 

You will be owning engineering initiatives and champion a culture of high ownership, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence. 

Responsibilities

- Own release readiness and quality sign-off for assigned product areas, defining and enforcing quality gates, applying severity/priority models, and making go/no-go calls on releases. 
 - Build and improve test automation (API, UI, or CLI) in Python and other scripting languages to increase coverage, reduce cycle time, and optimize test processes. 
 - Lead critical customer escalations by partnering with support and customer teams to reproduce, diagnose, and drive resolution of live issues under time pressure, keeping stakeholders updated with clear, actionable status. 
 - Perform deep log analysis and root-cause investigation across client and server logs and network captures to isolate failures in client-server products spanning Windows and Linux. 
 - Define test strategy for various components and features, identifying coverage gaps, risk areas, and the right mix of manual and automated testing. 
 - Design, write, and maintain test cases and regression suites, ensuring new functionality and prior fixes are validated consistently across supported platforms. 
 - Validate networking-centric functionality such as TCP/IP, DNS, TLS/DTLS, proxies, routing, and VPN/ZTNA, including certificate/PKI, firewall, and authentication scenarios where relevant. 
 - Manage test execution and defects end to end using a test-management tool (e. g. , TestRail) and Jira, producing clear bug reports, test summaries, and escalation updates others can act on directly. 

What will you bring to Omnissa?

- 12 to 18 Years in software / test engineering, including senior ownership of a product area or release. 
 - Proven experience in automation design, programming and process optimization. 
 - Experience in programming language Python. 
 - Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, TLS/DTLS, proxies, routing, and VPN / ZTNA concepts. 
 - Hands-on experience testing across platforms (Windows and Linux) and testing client-server products. 
 - Proven skill in log analysis and root-cause investigation; comfortable reading server and client logs and network captures. 
 - Experience owning release readiness / sign-off and working to defined quality gates and severity/priority models. 
 - Experience with a test-management tool (e. g. TestRail) and defect-tracking in Jira. 
 - Excellent written communication - bug reports, test summaries and escalation updates that others can act on directly. 
 - Ability to work with customers and support teams on live escalations under time pressure. 

Preferred / Nice To Have

- Experience with endpoint management, secure access gateways, or SASE. 
 - Certificate / PKI, firewall and authentication troubleshooting experience. 
 - Test automation experience (API, UI or CLI) and scripting (Python, Bash, Go or similar). 
 - Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS) for standing up test infrastructure. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and containerized (Docker) test/release workflows.

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA's product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. data.title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers' implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‐oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools. 

-Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems. 

-Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members. 

-Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Implements performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions. 

-Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures. 

-Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures. 

-Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health. 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

-Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system. 

-Implements tests scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 

-Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation. 

-Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues. 

-Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls. 

-Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security. 

-Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date

Automation & Change Management: 

-Maintains automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure. 

-Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

-Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. 

-Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance

Collaboration & Partnership: 

-Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

-Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices

Continuous Learning: 

-Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. . 

Continuous Improvement: 

-Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

Oversee the BU Product Quality Assurance implementation

Develop & implement BU Testing Quality

Developing supplier capability to meet Sasmos HET's business objectives and defined quality standards

Address customer complaints

 - Support the BU head & BD head in discussions with the customers to resolve disputes with respect to customer rejections

Monitor adherence to Systems and Process

 - Ensure adherence to Quality systems such as AS9100 etc
 - Act as the Management Representative for the Quality Management System, ensuring compliance with AS 9100 certification and aerospace standards. 
 - Oversee quality manuals, procedures, and audit processes, ensuring adherence to customer and certification body requirements.

 - Ensure SAP is updated regularly and accurately by the team. 

Champion quality as a culture

- Review training material periodically to standardize content as required for conducting training programs
 - Train BU production team in quality systems, tools and techniques to ensure that quality becomes the Way of Working

Drive Continuous Improvement & Innovation

- Promote continuous improvement initiatives in quality processes, leveraging industry trends and technological advancements
 - Implement kaizen (projects) to address quality gaps / defects identified and ensure standardization of resolution in processes, as applicable
