data.description:
Location: Bangalore Anchorage, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we're driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust. 

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India's growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry. 

Role Description: 

- Support industrial teams during the industrialization phases by assisting in the validation of supplier PRRs and FAIs, monitoring action plans, and securing product launches. 
 - Communicate and maintain TDMS quality requirements (technological, configuration management, quality system) with suppliers. 
 - Decide on the conformity of purchased items during final inspection at suppliers or incoming inspection at Thales (ability to inspect products, make decisions according to Thales inspection specifications). 
 - Perform acceptances at supplier sites. 
 - Manage Non-Conformities with the supplier within a timeframe acceptable to production needs. 
 - Implement securing actions (traceability, sorting, etc. ). 
 - Lead root cause analyses, drive corrective and preventive action plans, and challenge suppliers' 9S practices. 
 - Verify the effectiveness of action plans deployed by suppliers in the field. 
 - Use performance indicators to identify areas for improvement. 
 - Implement improvement actions with suppliers when necessary to reduce the number of non-conformities and enhance performance (following the DMAIC methodology). 
 - Monitor the effectiveness of actions on-site at suppliers, with regular visits planned. 
 - Participate in follow-up and supplier performance review committees in collaboration with Purchasing and Supplier Performance Management teams. 
 - Participate in optimizing the consistency of incoming and outgoing inspections between suppliers and Thales (ensuring proper application of control specifications, implementing defect tracking systems, quality walls if necessary). 
 - Take part in definition and implementation of new acceptance criteria if needed, and then share them with the suppliers. 
 - Ensure the maintenance of qualification of the Indian production supply chain and prevent, contain, and address deviations. 
 - Anticipate operational risks at suppliers (duty to alert), share identified weaknesses with the Supplier Performance Management (SPM) teams and Auditors to contribute to the suppliers maturity improvement. 
 - Promote quality tools (9S, FMEA, SPC, QRQC, etc. ). 
 - Proactively map Tier 2 and Tier 3 subcontractors to assess risk levels and propose mitigation measures. 
 - Ensure the implementation of quality indicators at Tier 2 and Tier 3 suppliers (both internal and external) and establish quality routines between suppliers. 
 - Act as the interface with Industry teams (Methods, RCFI, RSP), Quality teams in France, and serve as the local liaison for suppliers. 

Qualifications & Experience: 

- Industrial experience related to the supplier environment, ideally in aerospace and defense, mechanical, and electronic sectors. 
 - Quality experience, preferably in supplier quality. 
 - 10 to 15 years of experience. 
 - Engineering degree or equivalent with around 10 to 15 years of experience in the industrial sector (quality, purchasing, production, supply chain, etc. ). 
 - Knowledge of quality processes, particularly in production. 
 - Familiarity with quality management tools and models (DMAIC, 9S, FMEA, QRQC, APQP, etc. ). 
 - Proficiency in supplier improvement techniques (SD projects, DMAIC, problem-solving, root cause analysis, continuous improvement). 
 - Knowledge of aerospace manufacturing technologies. 
 - Ability to work in teams (cooperative attitude, listening skills, behavior) with teams in France and suppliers. 
 - Capability to represent Thales at suppliers, both operationally and at the management level. 
 - Strong communication skills, leadership, and influence. 
 - Capacity to lead improvement projects and deploy best practices. 
 - Understanding of control processes and standards: IPC-A-610 for assembled circuit boards, IPC-A-600 for bare printed circuit boards, IPC-A-620 for cable and rack wiring. 
 - Proficiency in English, French ideally. 

At Thales, we're committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you'll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference - for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

Title: Senior AI Engineer

The GCC will support Officeworks' purpose of helping to bring big ideas to life at low prices, ensuring technology remains a true enabler of customer value and operational excellence. 

This opportunity to join as a founding member of the new global hub is a chance to be part of the original build-out of our GCC. Early joiners will influence how the hub operates and help shape the future state of some of Officeworks' core technology ecosystem. 

These roles are best suited for people who enjoy:

Why this role exists: 

The Senior AI Engineer sits inside a Customer Platforms pod and orchestrates the technical agents that produce code, tests, documentation and design artefacts. The role is a full stack engineering role that takes complete ownership of the quality engineering and testing, holding accountability for everything committed to production. 

The role exists to translate product specifications into functional agent tasks, maintain the human-in-the-loop review gate, and ensure system design integrity, non-functional performance and security standards are met. It plays a critical role in enabling continuous delivery across Customer Platforms while mentoring junior engineers and continuously improving agent workflows across pods. 

Where you will make a difference:

Agent Orchestration and Execution:

 - Sequence workstreams and manage technical dependencies to maintain high pod delivery velocity. 
 - Apply base context, security policies and platform standards to every agent execution cycle. 

Quality Control and Commit Gate: 

- Hold the human-in-the-loop review and commit gate independently on complex and high-risk change.

 - Own defect management for the pod, from identification through root cause and resolution tracking, escalating systemic quality risks.

Knowledge Governance and Workflow Improvement:

 - Feed refined domain context back to central repositories in collaboration with Context Engineers. 
 - Continuously refine and optimize agent workflows and share best practices across engineering pods.

 - Vendor and Platform Partners: Liaise with external AI tooling providers and vendor technical support to resolve complex platform constraints and adopt new capabilities. 

What success looks like: 

- Commit Gate Integrity: Low commit gate escape rate on complex and high-risk production changes. 
 - Innovation and Scaling: Agent workflow improvements developed within the pod are successfully adopted across broader engineering teams. 
 - Operational Resilience: Rapid resolution of production incidents within the pod with minimal downtime or customer impact. 
 - Delivery Velocity: High throughput of automated coding and testing tasks achieved without compromising technical quality or architectural standards. 
 - Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks' values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture. 

How you will lead: 

Individual Contributor:

data.description:
About Bright Money

Bright Money is a consumer fintech built for middle-income consumers. Our platform helps consumers build credit, manage debt, and access suitable loans and credit cards - addressing the key financial needs of people living paycheck to paycheck. 

Bright is a profitable, India-built fintech serving the U. S. market, with a clear trajectory toward $100 million in revenue. Our business model combines subscription revenue with a financial-services marketplace across loans, credit cards, and credit-building solutions. 

We have launched an AI-powered money assistant and agentic AI experiences that simplify access to credit. Our ambition is to build the first AI-driven consumer-fintech platform for middle-income consumers. 

Founded in 2019, Bright's founding team includes leaders from McKinsey's Banking Practice - Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava - and data science leaders from InMobi. Bright is backed by leading global venture capital firms and technology investors across the U. S. , Europe, and Asia. 

With a data-driven, high-ownership, and fast-paced culture, we are building a global consumer-fintech company from India. 

What is the role about?

We are looking for an SDET - II to contribute to quality engineering for Bright's consumer app and platform. You will help build, execute, and maintain the automation frameworks that our mobile, API, and web testing runs on, ensuring quality gates are met in our release pipelines. 

This is a hands-on, independent technical role focused strongly on automation. You will write test code every week, execute test strategies, collaborate closely with developers, and put AI to work in your daily testing workflow to ensure we ship high-quality products to our customers. 

What will you do?

- Automation execution & frameworks: Contribute to the development and maintenance of scalable automation frameworks across mobile, API, and web layers. 
 - Mobile & API coverage: Build and execute end-to-end automated tests for the Bright app (iOS and Android) and backend services, covering functional, integration, and regression suites. 
 - CI/CD & release quality: Monitor and maintain automated tests integrated into CI/CD pipelines. Analyze test execution results, assist in defect triage, and perform root-cause analysis for failures. 
 - Shift-left engagement: Participate in design discussions and test planning to ensure early defect detection and adequate test coverage. 
 - Non-functional testing: Assist in the execution of performance, load, security, and resilience tests alongside the broader engineering team. 
 - Quality metrics: Track automation coverage, report test results, and log escaped defects to maintain visibility on application health. 
 - AI-assisted testing: Use GenAI tools to accelerate script generation, brainstorm edge cases, and improve daily productivity while maintaining a critical eye for validating AI-generated output. 

Ideal candidate profile

Experience & Background: 

- Experience: 2-4 years in software testing and quality engineering, with a strong focus on automation-driven roles. 
 - Automation Skills: Strong hands-on experience in writing automation scripts and working within established frameworks (such as Appium, Espresso, or XCUITest for mobile; REST Assured or pytest for APIs; Selenium or Playwright for web). 
 - Programming: Basic knowledge in programming (Java, Kotlin, or JavaScript/TypeScript) to understand application codebases and write reliable test scripts. 
 - CI/CD & tooling: Familiarity with Git, Jenkins or GitHub Actions, and test reporting tools. Comfortable analyzing logs and debugging pipeline failures. 
 - Backend & data: Basic understanding of SQL and API debugging. 
 - Domain: Experience in fintech, payments, or another regulated, high-reliability environment is a strong plus. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Immediate joiners are a strong plus. 
 - Basic knowledge in Python is highly preferred. 
 - Knowledge of using GenAI (like Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, etc. ) for test case design, script generation, and productivity enhancement. 

Mindset & Operating DNA: 

- Quality focus: Takes end-to-end responsibility for the quality of the features they test, rather than just executing test cases. 
 - Automation bias: Instinctively looks to remove repetitive manual effort and writes automation to solve testing bottlenecks. 
 - Pragmatism: Prioritizes testing based on risk and user impact. 
 - Collaboration: Works smoothly with developers and product managers to resolve defects and improve overall product quality. 

Non-Fit Profiles

- Primarily manual testers, without strong hands-on automation experience. 
 - Candidates depend purely on record-and-playback tools without the ability to write or understand basic code. 
 - Those seeking team lead, architectural, or managerial QA roles. 
 - Profiles limited to a single layer of testing, with no exposure to both mobile and API automation. 

What Bright Offers?

- A profitable sub-unicorn with U. S. market scale - liquidity potential at $1-3B valuations. 
 - Real ownership: You own the quality bar for products used by consumers across the U. S. 
 - Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale. 
 - A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed. 
 - Benefits: Excellent benefits package in line with sector best practice.

Are you passionate about building and operating large-scale distributed systems powering real-time data? Do you enjoy combining platform engineering, automation, and AI-driven operations to deliver highly reliable and scalable systems?

Join Maersk's Technical Services Engineering as a Platform Engineer for the Event Streaming Platform, where you will help evolve a cloud-native, Kafka-based platform that enables real-time integration across global logistics systems. 

This role provides a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of event streaming, cloud platforms, platform engineering, and AI-driven operations, contributing directly to Maersk's ambition of becoming a digital leader in global trade. 

About the Role: 

We are hiring a Platform Engineer to build and operate our enterprise-scale Event Streaming Platform, a Kafka-based backbone powering real-time data across global systems. 

You will work on a modern platform spanning Azure (AKS), AWS (EKS), and on-premises Kafka clusters, combining distributed systems, cloud-native engineering, and AI-driven operations. 

This role is ideal for engineers passionate about Kafka at scale, platform engineering, and operational excellence.

Build & Evolve the Platform

- Implement and enhance a scalable, multi-tenant Kafka platform across cloud and on-prem environments

 - Contribute to a developer-first platform with strong focus on usability and reliability

Operational Excellence

Cost & Efficiency

Collaboration

Good to Have

 - Network (DNS, routing, load balancers)

data.description:
We are seeking an experienced Manager - Embedded Systems Development & Testing to lead a high-performing engineering team responsible for the design, development, integration, verification, and validation of embedded systems for next-generation medical devices. 

The role will provide technical and people leadership across the embedded product lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through software/hardware development, system integration, verification, validation, and product release. 

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in embedded software, real-time systems, hardware/software integration, automated testing, system verification, and regulated product development, combined with the ability to build and lead engineering teams. 

What You will do: 

Key Responsibilities

- Engineering Leadership
 - Lead and manage embedded systems development and testing teams responsible for medical device products. Define engineering strategies, development processes, technical direction, and execution plans. 
 - Provide technical leadership across embedded software, firmware, system integration, and verification. Drive execution of multiple concurrent projects while balancing quality, schedule, cost, and technical risks. 
 - Establish clear ownership, accountability, and engineering metrics across the team. Partner with Product Management, Systems Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Clinical, and other cross-functional teams. 
 - Embedded Systems Development
 - Lead development of embedded software/firmware for medical devices and connected systems. Guide architecture and design decisions involving: Embedded C/C++RTOSMicrocontrollers and SoCsDevice driversCommunication protocolsUSB/BLE/Wi-Fi/EthernetSensor interfacesMotor/control systemsPower managementBootloaders and firmware update mechanisms
 - Ensure robust hardware/software integration and system-level performance. Drive reuse of software platforms, common architectures, libraries, and development frameworks across products. 
 - Verification & Validation
 - Lead development and execution of unit, integration, system, and acceptance testing strategies. Establish robust verification methodologies for embedded software and complete medical-device systems. 
 - Drive automated testing, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), simulation, test automation, and continuous integration where appropriate. Ensure traceability between: User Needs → System Requirements → Software Requirements → Design → Implementation → Verification
 - Review and approve verification strategies, test plans, test cases, and test results. Drive root-cause analysis and resolution of complex technical issues discovered during development and testing. 
 - Quality & Regulatory Compliance
 - Ensure engineering activities comply with applicable medical-device development processes and organizational quality systems. Work closely with Quality and Regulatory teams to ensure compliance with applicable standards and regulations, such as: ISO 13485IEC 62304IEC 60601, where applicableISO 14971IEC 62366, where applicableCybersecurity requirements applicable to medical devicesApplicable FDA and international regulatory requirements
 - Ensure appropriate documentation, design controls, risk management, change control, and verification evidence throughout the product lifecycle. Participate in design reviews, risk reviews, audits, and regulatory submissions as required. 
 - Test Automation & Engineering Excellence
 - Establish a modern automated testing strategy for embedded products. Increase automated test coverage and reduce dependence on manual testing. 
 - Promote: CI/CD for embedded systemsAutomated regression testingHardware-in-the-loop testingStatic and dynamic analysis Code coverage Unit testing Integration testing System-level testing. Establish engineering metrics to monitor product quality, test effectiveness, defect escape rates, and development efficiency. 
 - Technical Problem Solving
 - Act as an escalation point for complex embedded-system issues. Lead cross-functional investigation of difficult hardware/software/system failures. 
 - Drive structured root-cause analysis using methodologies such as 5-Why, Fishbone, FMEA, and fault-tree analysis. Ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented effectively. Provide technical guidance during field issues, customer escalations, and product investigations. 
 - People & Talent Leadership
 - Build, mentor, and retain a strong embedded engineering organization. Define team structure, roles, responsibilities, and technical career paths. Conduct performance management, coaching, and regular career development discussions. 
 - Identify technical skill gaps and establish training and development plans. Recruit high-quality embedded software, firmware, systems, and test engineers. Develop future technical leaders and engineering managers. 
 - Project & Program Execution
 - Work with program/project managers to develop realistic technical schedules and resource plans. Identify technical risks early and establish mitigation plans. 
 - Track milestones, dependencies, defects, technical debt, and engineering deliverables. Communicate project status, risks, and opportunities to senior leadership. Support product launches and sustaining engineering activities. 

What You Need: 

Must Have

- 13-16 years embedded systems experience with 5+ years people-management/technical leadership. 
 - Strong embedded architecture and system-design knowledge across software, hardware, RTOS, drivers, and interfaces. 
 - Proven experience leading teams through end-to-end product development from requirements to release and sustaining. 
 - Strong understanding of verification, testing, quality, risk management, and regulated product development. 
 - Strong people leadership, mentoring, cross-functional influence, and execution skills. 

Good to have

- Medical-device / safety-critical / regulated product development experience. 
 - Experience with manufacturing/NPD, production, and sustaining engineering. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of motor control, electromechanical systems, embedded Linux, connectivity, and cybersecurity. 
 - Experience with automation, HIL, CI/CD, static analysis, and automated testing. 
 - Previous experience as a Senior Staff/Staff Engineer or Embedded Architect before moving into people management. 

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

data.title: Electrical Lead - Validation Lab
data.description:
Role: Electrical Lead - Validation Lab

Department: New Product Development Location: Bengaluru, India Experience: 5-10 Years

Your Team: 

You'll be working with New Product Development - a group that runs on coffee and an infectious passion for building products that have never been built before. Our Flexible Energy Stack consists of the e^pack (battery pack) and e^pump (charging station), which unlock 15-minute rapid charging. 

Our philosophy: 

Break. Believe. Build. 

Break stuff, break assumptions, break the thumb rule. 

Believe in the team, the process, and through failures. 

Build fast, build passionately, build to simplify. 

Own it like you mean it. 

What you'll own: 

The Electrical Lead owns electrical validation of batteries, chargers and vehicle-level electrical systems end to end - and leads the team of hardware test engineers who execute it. You will be technically hands-on, set priorities across parallel programs, and thrive in a fast-moving startup where plans change weekly and the team is expected to adapt quickly. 

What you'll do: 

Technical ownership

- Own DVP&R planning and execution for battery packs, BMS hardware, chargers, wiring harnesses and electrical sub-systems
 - Translate product requirements and standards (AIS-156, AIS-038 Rev 2, AIS-048, IS 17017, IEC 61851, CMVR) into test plans, acceptance criteria and lab capacity
 - Review test data and reports; sign off on test results and drive root-cause analysis (8D, fishbone, 5-Why) with design, firmware and suppliers
 - Support certification and homologation testing with ARAI/ICAT and NABL labs - test witness, documentation and closure of observations
 - Drive supplier qualification testing for all components sourced for e^ products
 - Define lab infrastructure needs - equipment, fixtures, safety systems - and own HV safety practices in the lab

People & execution

- Lead, mentor and grow a team of hardware test engineers and technicians; set goals, run reviews and build skills
 - Run the team in an agile way - weekly sprint planning, daily stand-ups, visible test trackers, quick re-prioritisation
 - Balance capacity across multiple programs; flag risks and trade-offs early to program managers and leadership
 - Build a culture of ownership, safety, clean documentation and fast feedback
 - Participate in hiring and onboarding for the team

What you'll bring: 

- Education qualification
 - B. E. /B. Tech (M. Tech a plus) in Electrical, Electronics or EEE
 - 6-10 years in EV / automotive electrical validation, with deep hands-on experience in batteries/BMS and chargers
 - 2+ years of direct people management - leading engineers, assigning work, conducting performance reviews
 - Strong command of HV safety, battery and charger test methods, CAN diagnostics and lab instrumentation
 - Proven experience delivering DVP&R and supporting homologation in the Indian regulatory context
 - Comfortable with agile / sprint-based ways of working and changing priorities
 - Clear communicator with design, firmware, quality, supplier and leadership teams

Good to Have

- Experience setting up a validation lab or scaling a test team
 - Exposure to DFMEA, functional safety (ISO 26262) concepts, and test automation
 - Experience working in a startup or high-growth environment

What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months)

- All active electrical DVPs have owners, schedules and live trackers
 - Team runs on a predictable sprint rhythm with visible throughput
 - Certification tests for the current program cleared without major repeat runs

What matters to us: 

- Quality of work
 - Structured problem-solving
 - Dissatisfaction with mediocre work
 - Ability to multi-task and handle a dynamic working environment
 - Resilient attitude to bounce back after failing

About Us: 

Exponent is building the energy stack powering commercial EVs in India. Our proprietary battery and charging technology enables safe, reliable 15-minute rapid charging while delivering a 3, 000-cycle battery life warranty using standard lithium-ion cells. Today, our platform powers high-utilisation commercial vehicles - from three-wheelers to intercity buses, making electric mobility rapid, more reliable and more affordable than petroleum. 

Founded by Arun Vinayak (Founding Partner & Former Chief Product Officer, Ather Energy), Exponent is a 250+ member team of passionate builders solving some of the toughest engineering challenges in energy. 

If solving hard engineering problems across mechanics, thermal systems, power electronics, manufacturing, and the charging network, while staying obsessed with customer experience excites you, we'd love to build with you.

As an SDET-3, you will own end-to-end quality for these models, from training data preparation through inference pipelines to performance at production scale. You will validate both functional correctness and scaling behavior, and you will use agentic AI tools to move faster without lowering engineering standards. 

How You'll Make an Impact: 

- Own model quality before production. Build validation frameworks for computer vision models (preferably satellite or geospatial). Catch regressions in accuracy, precision/recall, and IoU before they reach customers. 
 - Build version-aware model regression. Set up pipelines that compare inference outputs across model versions on curated golden datasets. Every release should come with a clear, data-backed go/no-go signal. 
 - Make data quality a first-class gate. Validate training and evaluation datasets for label quality, class balance, geographic and seasonal coverage, leakage, and drift. Ensure models are tested on data that reflects real-world conditions. 
 - Validate inference at scale. Design load and benchmark tests for inference services and batch pipelines. Find the throughput, latency, and cost limits on AWS and Kubernetes before customers do. 
 - Harden the platform end-to-end. Automate API, contract, and data-pipeline tests across distributed services. Use logs, metrics, and traces to speed up root-cause analysis. 
 - Raise the bar for the team. Strengthen the shared automation frameworks and set standards for maintainable, non-flaky tests. Show how tools like Cursor and Claude can speed up test authoring, triage, and reporting while staying under human review. 
 - Influence release decisions. This is a high-visibility role. Your quality signals will directly shape what ships across Aidash's product lines

What we're looking for: 

We are looking for a senior QA engineer with deep backend automation experience who can validate ML models and backend systems end-to-end, and who actively uses agentic AI development tools (e. g. , Cursor, Claude) to accelerate test design, automation, debugging, and reporting - without compromising fundamentals, coverage, or engineering quality. 

- 8-10 years in software testing and test automation, with strong ownership of backend system quality 
 - Hands-on backend automation experience using at least one of: 
 - Java + RestAssured Or Python + pytest 
 - Experience testing ML applications (model/service behavior, data quality, inference pipelines, evaluation/regression of model-backed features) 
 - Broader stack familiarity: observability (logs/metrics/traces), cloud (AWS), contract testing, data-pipeline validation 
 - Experience improving shared automation frameworks and raising team standards for maintainable tests 
 - Solid grasp of testing fundamentals and best practices (test design, risk-based coverage, isolation, maintainability, flaky-test control, clear defect/RCA discipline) 
 - Strong coding ability in Java or Python (proficient in at least one), with willingness to learn the other (or additional languages) as needed 
 - Good understanding of backend system design and how services interact in distributed systems 
 - Practical exposure to databases - SQL and/or NoSQL (at least one is mandatory) 
 - Working knowledge of application deployment and underlying orchestration (e. g. , containers, Kubernetes, service rollout/health concepts) 
 - CI/CD pipelines - must have (Jenkins/GitHub Actions/Bitbucket Pipelines or equivalent): triggering suites, reading failures, improving pipeline reliability 
 - Performance testing - must have (JMeter/k6/Locust or equivalent): load/benchmark basics, interpreting results, flagging SLA/risk 
 - Exposure to agentic development tools such as Cursor and Claude (or similar) for coding, test authoring, log/triage assistance, and documentation - used with human review and quality gates

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing diversity and inclusion in our hiring practices, and we promote a work environment where everyone, from any race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, can do their best work. 

We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all candidates. Please let us know if you require any accommodation during the interview process, and we will make every effort to meet your needs.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
About The Company

Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners. 

Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U. S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130, 000 reload points and over 100, 000 distributing locations. 

Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide. 

About The Role

We are seeking a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to take ownership of our core card authorization platform. This high-throughput, low-latency platform processes real-time debit and prepaid transactions over ISO 8583 for major networks including Visa, Mastercard, Pulse, and Fiserv. Because every request operates under strict latency budgets, high availability, and PCI DSS compliance, every millisecond counts-and every failure carries direct financial impact. 

In this role, you will lead a team of talented engineers, drive the architectural evolution of our network connectivity and authorization services, and continue to write production-grade code. You will serve as the primary technical point of contact for platform upgrades, network certifications, and production incident management. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Team Management

- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 5-8 software engineers. 
 - Set coding standards, conduct architectural design reviews, perform code reviews, and foster technical excellence. 
 - Serve as the technical owner and primary point of contact for production health, network certifications, and platform upgrades. 

Core Architecture & Engineering

- Design, build, and maintain high-throughput, low-latency Java/Spring Boot microservices covering authorizations, financial transactions, advices, reversals, and stand-in processing. 
 - Manage long-lived client/server TCP connections to card networks, ensuring robust handling of sign-on/sign-off, echo tests, request/response matching, and automatic failovers. 
 - Architect distributed transaction boundaries ensuring data consistency across Oracle, Kafka, JMS, and downstream services through idempotency, compensation/saga patterns, and reversal handling. 
 - Implement resilient concurrency models: tune thread pools and executors, control backpressure, execute row-level/distributed locking, and eliminate race conditions on balances and card states. 
 - Build fault-tolerant systems using resilience patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, time limiters, retries, and graceful degradation). 

Platform Modernization & Security

- Drive platform modernization initiatives, including Spring Boot 2. 7 → 3. 5 / Jakarta EE migration, removing legacy RMI/JMX remoting, and containerizing microservices for Kubernetes deployment. 
 - Collaborate with Security and HSM teams to integrate EMV cryptogram processing (ARQC), CVV/dCVV/CVC3 validation, and HSM key management. 
 - Maintain strict PCI DSS compliance across all services (PAN masking, sensitive authentication data protection, secure logging, and secrets management). 

Operations & Stakeholder Engagement

- Define SLIs/SLOs and create comprehensive dashboards and alerts using Dynatrace and Splunk. 
 - Lead incident response efforts, drive root-cause analysis (RCA), and implement permanent remediations. 
 - Partner with Product, Network/Scheme partners, QA, and Operations to navigate card network mandates, network certifications, and release schedules. 

Requirements & Qualifications

Must-Have Skills & Experience

- Experience & Leadership: 10-15 years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years leading engineering teams or driving technical architecture. 
 - Core Java Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in Java (11/17+), deep understanding of java. util. concurrent, JVM internals, garbage collection tuning, and memory analysis. 
 - Spring Framework: Extensively hands-on with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud microservices (Config, OpenFeign, Actuator, Security). 
 - Distributed Transactions & Systems: Proven expertise in transaction management trade-offs (2PC/XA vs. Saga pattern, outbox pattern, idempotent consumers/producers, and delivery semantics). 
 - Database & RDBMS: Deep relational database skills (Oracle preferred), including JDBC transaction isolation, SELECT . . . FOR UPDATE, deadlock analysis, and SQL query tuning. 
 - Messaging & Event Streaming: Real-world experience with event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka (Avro, Schema Registry) and/or JMS (ActiveMQ). 
 - System Resilience: Hands-on experience implementing resilience frameworks (Resilience4j or similar) for high-availability systems running thousands of TPS. 
 - DevOps & Quality: Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/Jenkins), Gradle, static code/security analysis (SonarQube, SAST, Trivy), and test automation frameworks (JUnit 5, Mockito). 
 - Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex technical trade-offs for engineers, product leads, and executive leadership. 

Good-to-Have Skills

- jPOS Framework: Experience with ISOMsg, custom packagers, channels (PostChannel, BaseChannel), ISOMUX/QMUX, ISOServer, and Q2 configuration. 
 - ISO 8583 Specifications: Hands-on experience with Visa Base I, Mastercard MIP/Debit, Pulse, or Fiserv STAR/Accel specifications (messages 0100/0110, 0200/0210, 0400/0420, 0800 network management, DE55 EMV TLV data). 
 - Observability Tools: Advanced usage of Dynatrace (PurePath, Smartscape, DQL) and Splunk (SPL query generation, alerting, dashboards). 
 - Advanced Concurrency: In-depth familiarity with ReentrantLock, StampedLock, distributed locks (ShedLock, Redisson), Java 21 Virtual Threads, and Micrometer metrics integration. 
 - Card Payments Domain: Understanding of EMV chip/contactless flows, stand-in processing, settlement, chargebacks, HSM integration (Atalla, Thales payShield), and key management (KEK, ZPK, key blocks). 
 - Infrastructure & Rules: Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, AWS (MSK, IAM), and business rules engines (Drools, Jess). 

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience). 
 - Direct experience in the Payments, Fintech, or Banking domain is strongly preferred. 
 - 10-15 years of professional experience in designing, coding, developing, and scaling high-throughput, enterprise-grade Java/J2EE applications. 
 - 3+ years of hands-on experience in a technical lead or architectural capacity-driving system design, leading 5-8 engineers, and setting coding/quality standards. 
 - Proven track record of architecting low-latency, mission-critical distributed systems operating under strict SLAs and high concurrency.

data.title: GST Reconciliation Team Lead
data.description:
Company Description

AARC & Co is one of India's prominent Chartered Accountancy firms, with over 33 years of experience delivering financial and advisory services to multinational corporations, venture funds, and major Indian business houses. The firm focuses on applying intelligence and expertise to provide realistic solutions to complex business scenarios. Teams combine strong analytical capabilities, functional specialization, and intensive training to support clients effectively. AARC & Co is result-oriented and success-driven, committed to offering consistent, high-quality services to clients of all sizes and across locations. Professionals joining the firm can expect a rigorous, client-centric environment with opportunities to grow in advisory and compliance domains. 

Role Description

We are looking for a GST Input Reconciliation Lead who will be responsible for managing and

reviewing end-to-end GST input tax credit reconciliation processes for multiple entities of a

clients. The role requires strong understanding of GST, excellent reconciliation skills, and the

ability to independently manage client deliverables and lead a team of 5-6 people. 

Key Responsibilities

* Lead the GSTR-2B vs. books / purchase register reconciliation for multiple entities. 

* Review and analyse unmatched, missing, duplicate and ineligible ITC. 

* Prepare and maintain ITC mismatch trackers with clear action points and ageing. 

* Identify differences arising due to vendor filing, amendments, credit/debit notes, timing

differences and accounting issues. 

* Coordinate with client finance teams and vendors for resolution of reconciliation differences. 

* Review GST input ledgers and ensure appropriate classification and eligibility of ITC. 

* Support the team in determining ITC eligible for claim, to be deferred, or requiring reversal. 

* Ensure reconciliation is completed before finalisation of GST returns / monthly compliance. 

* Review GST workings and reconciliation reports prepared by team members. 

* Monitor monthly closure timelines and ensure timely completion of client deliverables. 

* Develop and improve reconciliation processes using Excel, automation tools and GST

technology platforms. 

* Assist in GST audits, departmental queries, assessments and other indirect tax assignments, 

wherever required. 

* Train and mentor junior team members on GST reconciliation and issue resolution. 

* Maintain proper documentation and audit trail for reconciliation and management review. 

Candidate Profile

* CA / CA Inter / CMA with relevant GST experience. 

* 2-5 years of experience in GST, tax consultancy, accounting or CA firm environment. 

* Strong practical knowledge of GSTR-2B, GSTR-2A, GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and ITC provisions. 

* Strong understanding of purchase accounting and GST treatment. 

* Excellent Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS and data analysis. 

* Experience with GST reconciliation tools / ERP systems will be an advantage. 

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 

* Good communication skills and ability to independently interact with clients. 

* Ability to manage multiple clients and deliverables simultaneously. 

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work like industries and client environments. 

* Exposure to GST advisory, audit and finance processes beyond routine compliance. 

* Opportunity to lead a team and take ownership of client deliverables. 

* Technology-driven and process-oriented working environment. 

* Strong learning and career growth opportunities within the firm.

A detail-oriented hands-on QA professional who understands business problem, gains depth in domain/ functionality, has strong SQL and data validation skills, practical automation experience, understanding of modern cloud data platforms and hands-on with AI tools. data.title: R&D Engineering, Sr Manager
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent the last decade and a half deep in the physics and architecture of embedded memory, and you know that the difference between a compiler that ships and one that stalls is usually buried in how well someone understood variation, power, and area tradeoffs six months before tape-out. You have moved from designing circuits yourself to leading the people who design them, and you still get pulled into the hardest debug sessions because you can see what others miss. 

Leading a team is not about delegation for you, it is about unblocking, teaching, and making sure your engineers have what they need to do their best work. You know when to let someone run with a problem and when to step in with a pointed question that changes the direction. You have managed projects across geographies and you understand that keeping a distributed team aligned takes more than status meetings, it takes clarity, trust, and follow-through. 

You do not wait for perfect information. When a layout is not converging or a characterization flow is producing questionable data, you dig in, ask the right people the right questions, and find a path forward. At Synopsys, you will lead a team building memory IP that powers the most advanced chips in the world, and the work you do will matter. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead a team of engineers developing SRAM, Register File, TCAM, and ROM architectures and circuit implementations across advanced FinFET nodes
 - Oversee the full memory design flow from architecture definition through schematic entry, simulation, layout planning, verification, characterization, and model generation
 - Drive low-power and area-efficient circuit design strategies, balancing performance, variation, and manufacturability constraints
 - Coordinate with CAD teams on layout verification, parasitic extraction, and compiler automation using Perl and Python
 - Manage project timelines, prioritize deliverables, and resolve technical and resourcing issues across multi-site teams
 - Build and maintain relationships with internal stakeholders and external customers, translating technical requirements into executable design plans
 - Mentor engineers on memory compiler development, transistor-level design, and advanced node challenges

The Impact You Will Have

- Deliver embedded memory IP that powers cutting-edge semiconductor products for Synopsys customers across AI, automotive, and high-performance computing
 - Accelerate time-to-market for memory compilers by improving design flows, automation scripts, and characterization methodologies
 - Enable your team to solve complex variation and power challenges in deep submicron and FinFET technologies, raising the technical bar across the organization
 - Strengthen cross-functional collaboration between design, CAD, and verification teams, reducing integration friction and rework
 - Build a high-performing, motivated team that consistently delivers on schedule and grows technically under your leadership
 - Shape the roadmap for next-generation memory IP, influencing architecture decisions that affect product competitiveness
 - Contribute to Synopsys' reputation as a trusted partner by delivering robust, scalable, and customer-focused memory solutions

What You'll Need

- BE/B. Tech/ME/M. Tech/MS in Electrical & Electronics Engineering from a recognized institute or university
 - 15+ years of hands-on experience in embedded memory design, including SRAM, Register File, TCAM, or ROM
 - Deep expertise across the full memory design flow: architecture, circuit design, layout, compiler automation, characterization, timing, and model generation
 - Proven experience leading engineering teams and delivering complex projects on schedule in a multi-site environment
 - Strong proficiency in Perl and Python for design automation and scripting
 - Hands-on experience with deep submicron and FinFET technologies, including variation-aware design techniques
 - Solid understanding of CMOS fundamentals, digital design, RC circuits, transfer function analysis, and CMOS fabrication processes

Who You Are

- You can walk into a layout review, spot the issue that is going to cause a timing violation three steps downstream, and explain the fix in a way that gets the team moving again
 - You manage multiple projects and shifting priorities without losing track of what matters most, and you communicate risks and tradeoffs clearly before they become blockers
 - You build trust across teams by following through, showing up when things get hard, and giving credit where it belongs
 - You know how to have the tough conversation when a design is not going to meet spec, and you do it early enough that the team has options
 - You mentor engineers not by giving answers but by asking the questions that help them think through the problem themselves
 - You stay current on memory design trends, advanced node challenges, and industry best practices, and you bring that knowledge back to your team

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: Lead AI Platform Engineer (Python, Cloud & GenAI)
data.description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Team Overview

Our team is at the forefront of building next-generation AI-powered platforms and cloud-native solutions that enable the organization to accelerate innovation at scale. We develop reusable engineering capabilities, intelligent services, and enterprise-grade platforms that empower product teams, data scientists, and engineers to build, deploy, and operate secure, scalable, and reliable applications. 

We work across the full technology stack, combining modern software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and Generative AI to solve complex business challenges. Our focus areas include Python engineering, cloud-native architectures on Google Cloud Platform, AI/ML platforms, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic AI systems, platform reliability, and developer productivity. 

The team values technical excellence, innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. Engineers are encouraged to experiment with emerging technologies, influence architectural direction, contribute to platform strategy, and collaborate closely with product, security, data science, and business stakeholders. We foster a culture where strong engineering fundamentals, operational excellence, and practical AI innovation come together to deliver meaningful business impact. 

As part of this team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies, solve large-scale engineering problems, and help shape the future of intelligent systems across the enterprise. You'll collaborate with highly skilled engineers, architects, and AI practitioners while helping establish engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices that drive success across multiple teams. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week. 

Role Overview

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Lead Engineer to design, build, and operate production-grade systems that span software engineering, cloud-native infrastructure, and AI-powered applications. The ideal candidate combines deep Python engineering expertise with strong cloud architecture skills on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and proven experience building and deploying Generative AI at enterprise scale. This role will define reusable engineering patterns and platform capabilities that enable multiple product, data science, and engineering teams to safely build, deploy, evaluate, and operate intelligent systems. The Lead Engineer will remain deeply technical while providing architecture leadership, mentoring engineers, and influencing engineering standards across the organization. 

Core Responsibilities

Production Python Engineering: Design and develop high-performance, production-grade Python services and applications following modern software engineering best practices. Establish coding standards, design patterns, and reusable frameworks that enable teams to ship reliable software at velocity. 

API Design & Microservices Architecture: Architect and build scalable microservices and RESTful/GraphQL APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI and Flask. Define service boundaries, communication patterns, and data contracts that support distributed system reliability and independent team ownership. 

System Design & Distributed Systems: Lead the design of distributed, event-driven, and asynchronous systems that handle high throughput and low-latency requirements. Apply principles of concurrency, fault tolerance, and horizontal scaling to deliver resilient production architectures. 

Testing Strategy & Engineering Quality: Define and drive comprehensive testing strategies including unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end testing using pytest and related tooling. Champion code review practices, static analysis, and automated quality gates to maintain high engineering standards. 

Reusable Libraries & SDKs: Identify repeated engineering patterns across teams and convert them into standardized Python libraries, SDKs, templates, and self-service platform capabilities that accelerate development and reduce duplication. 

Cloud-Native Architecture (GCP): Design and implement cloud-native architectures on Google Cloud Platform using services such as GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, and App Engine. Establish patterns for containerization, orchestration, autoscaling, and resilient infrastructure that support production AI and software workloads. 

Data Infrastructure & Pipelines: Architect scalable data infrastructure using BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, and Cloud Composer. Design data pipelines that support both real-time streaming and batch processing for analytics, ML training, and AI application data needs. 

Infrastructure as Code & DevOps: Establish infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform and CI/CD pipelines with Cloud Build or equivalent tooling. Drive automation of build, test, deployment, and rollback workflows to ensure repeatable, auditable, and fast delivery cycles. 

Observability & Site Reliability: Implement end-to-end observability using Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Cloud Trace, and custom metrics. Define SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets for production services and establish incident response practices that minimize mean time to recovery. 

Cloud Security & Cost Optimization: Establish security best practices including IAM policies, VPC design, secrets management, and workload identity federation. Drive cloud cost optimization through resource right-sizing, committed use discounts, and efficient architecture patterns. 

LLM Integration & GenAI Applications: Design and build production applications powered by large language models, integrating commercial and open-source models through well-defined abstraction layers. Establish patterns for prompt engineering, context management, structured outputs, and token optimization. 

RAG & Knowledge Architecture: Design scalable Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, semantic and hybrid retrieval, reranking, and metadata-enriched knowledge stores. Implement GraphRAG and semantic models where appropriate to improve retrieval quality. 

AI Evaluation & Quality: Define engineering standards for evaluating LLM applications and AI agents. Establish golden datasets, automated regression testing, retrieval evaluation, groundedness measurements, task-success metrics, and structured-output validation frameworks. 

Model Serving & Inference: Design model integration and inference architectures on Vertex AI and equivalent platforms supporting commercial, private, and open-source models. Establish patterns for model selection, routing, fallback, versioning, latency optimization, and cost management. 

Agentic AI & Orchestration: Define patterns for production agentic systems including tool calling, workflow orchestration, state and memory management, planning and execution, human-in-the-loop controls, retries, recovery, and long-running workflows. 

Technical Leadership: Lead architecture and design reviews, resolve complex technical problems, establish engineering standards, and make pragmatic trade-offs across quality, speed, scalability, security, operational complexity, and cost. 

Mentoring & Engineering Excellence: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, review technical designs and code, raise engineering quality across the team, and help engineers adopt modern Python, cloud, and AI engineering practices. 

Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with data scientists, platform teams, security, architecture, product management, and business stakeholders to translate enterprise requirements into scalable, production-ready solutions. 

Technical Communication: Communicate technical strategy, architecture decisions, risks, trade-offs, and capabilities to engineering leaders, architects, product teams, and senior stakeholders with clarity and precision. 

Qualifications

Required Knowledge And Experiences

Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Experience: Typically 7+ years of software, platform, cloud, data, or AI engineering experience, including significant hands-on ownership of production systems and technical architecture. Demonstrated experience building production cloud-native applications on GCP and working with Generative AI or ML systems is required. Experience may span traditional software/platform engineering and newer AI engineering; candidates are not expected to have spent an unrealistic number of years specifically working with Generative AI. 

Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to independently design complex systems, lead technical execution across multiple engineers or teams, influence architecture, and convert emerging technologies into reliable enterprise capabilities. 

Technical Skills

Expert-level proficiency in Python and strong production software engineering fundamentals. Experience with FastAPI, Flask, asyncio, pytest, and modern Python tooling. Familiarity with Java, Go, TypeScript, or another production language is advantageous. 

Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, API design, distributed systems, concurrency, asynchronous programming, software architecture, automated testing, debugging, Git, and engineering best practices. 

Deep hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) including GKE, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Vertex AI, Cloud Build, IAM, and Cloud Monitoring. Experience with Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. 

Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture patterns including containerization, serverless, event-driven design, service mesh, autoscaling, and infrastructure as code. Experience designing for high availability, disaster recovery, and cost efficiency. 

Strong working knowledge of deep learning and Transformer architectures, including tokenization, embeddings, attention, inference, and modern foundation-model architectures. 

Experience with PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or comparable modern ML/AI frameworks. 

Deep hands-on experience designing and building production applications using LLMs, Generative AI, RAG pipelines, vector databases, and agentic AI patterns. 

Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Cloud Monitoring, and Cloud Logging for production systems. 

TransUnion Overview

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our Workforce for Good, which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver's seat of their professional development- while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that's why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence. 

Be a part of our Workforce for Good - you'll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology. 

TransUnion Job Title

Sr Developer, Software Development

data.title: Senior Network Automation Engineering
data.description:
Over the last 20 years, Ares' success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values - Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy - and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry. 

Job Description

8+ years of enterprise Network Engineering experience delivering secure, resilient network services across global campus, data center, cloud, and WAN environments. Demonstrable expertise deploying and managing network infrastructure through code using Terraform, Ansible, Python, Git-based workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and vendor APIs. 

Primary Functions & Responsibilities

- Design, implement, and automate enterprise network infrastructure across global offices, data centers, cloud, and WAN environments. 
 - Engineer resilient routing, switching, SD-WAN, wireless, and hybrid cloud connectivity using Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, Meraki, and Microsoft Azure. 
 - Develop reusable Terraform modules, Ansible playbooks, Python tooling, and API integrations for network and security platforms. 
 - Build Git-based CI/CD workflows with code review, automated validation, approvals, deployment controls, and rollback capability. 
 - Design and operate Palo Alto Networks firewalls and secure network architectures incorporating segmentation, micro-segmentation, identity, and network access controls. 
 - Provide L3 engineering support, lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis, and improve performance, resiliency, disaster recovery, and operational efficiency. 
 - Create and maintain reference architectures, HLDs, LLDs, engineering standards, runbooks, and technical documentation. 
 - Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, application teams, and vendors to deliver secure, scalable, and compliant network services. 

Qualifications

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related discipline. 
 - CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent expert-level networking experience preferred. 
 - Microsoft Azure or Palo Alto Networks certification preferred. 

Experience Required

- Enterprise Networking & Wireless: Cisco Nexus, Cisco IOS-XE, Cisco ACI, Meraki Wireless, routing and switching, campus and data center networking. 
 - Network Security & Segmentation: Palo Alto Networks NGFW, Panorama, Prisma Access, SCM, security and NAT policy, network segmentation, micro-segmentation, and Zero Trust architecture. 
 - Cloud Networking: Microsoft Azure networking, Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute, hybrid connectivity, routing, Private Link, DNS, and cloud network security. 
 - Network Automation & Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Ansible, Python, REST APIs, JSON/YAML, reusable modules and playbooks, platform-native automation, and orchestration. 
 - Source Control & Delivery: GitHub or GitLab, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines, automated validation, secrets handling, deployment governance, and rollback. 
 - Network Engineering & Operations: Architecture, design, implementation, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, disaster recovery, high availability, and resiliency. 
 - Technical Leadership & Governance: HLDs, LLDs, design standards, operational procedures, stakeholder management, vendor management, and cross-functional collaboration. 

General Requirements

- Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Excellent technical documentation and architecture design skills. 
 - Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously. 
 - Experience in global enterprise environments, preferably financial services or another regulated industry. 
 - Familiarity with Agile delivery, ITIL processes, and change governance. 
 - Willingness to travel approximately 10-25%. 
 - Work from the Office. 

Reporting Relationships

Global Head of Infrastructure and Platform Engineering

There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer
data.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

Company Profile

Qualys is a leading provider of cloud-based security and compliance solutions, helping organizations identify vulnerabilities, manage cyber risk, and protect their IT infrastructure. 

The Module Loader is a critical component of Qualys Remote Vulnerability Detection and acts as the brain behind vulnerability assessment workflows. It plays a key role in orchestrating and executing the capabilities required to identify vulnerabilities across diverse enterprise environments and technologies. 

Given its central role in vulnerability detection, the Module Loader requires a high degree of accuracy, reliability, scalability, performance, and backward compatibility. The team works on complex engineering challenges involving vulnerability detection, networking, protocols, operating systems, security technologies, and large-scale enterprise environments. 

Be part of the team building and validating one of the foundational components powering Qualys vulnerability detection. 

Core Responsibility

As a Senior Software QA Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, performance, and scalability of the Module Loader and its remote vulnerability detection capabilities. 

This is a hands-on technical QA/SDET role where you will own quality from requirements and design through release and production. You will work closely with developers, security researchers, Product Management, and other engineering teams to understand vulnerability detection requirements and translate them into comprehensive test strategies. 

You will be expected to go beyond functional validation and understand how vulnerability detection works, identify potential gaps and edge cases, create complex test environments, automate validation, analyze failures, and troubleshoot problems across application, operating system, network, and protocol layers. 

You will have end-to-end quality ownership of features, including test design, automation, functional and integration testing, performance and scalability testing, regression qualification, debugging, and production issue analysis. 

Position Requirements

Eligible candidates should meet the following criteria. 

Required

- 4+ years of hands-on experience in Software QA, SDET, or Software Testing for complex enterprise software products. 
 - Strong experience in testing system-level, security, networking, or distributed applications, preferably on Linux/Unix platforms. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with test automation using Python, Shell scripting, C/C++, or equivalent programming/scripting languages. 
 - Ability to independently understand complex feature requirements and technical designs and develop comprehensive test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, and automation. 
 - Strong understanding of Linux/Unix operating systems, processes, services, file systems, permissions, package management, and system-level troubleshooting. 
 - Strong knowledge of networking fundamentals and protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, proxies, and client-server communication. 
 - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate failures across application, operating system, and network layers. 
 - Experience analyzing logs, network traffic, system behavior, application failures, CPU/memory utilization, and other diagnostic information to drive issues toward root cause. 
 - Experience in functional, integration, regression, negative, compatibility, upgrade, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Ability to identify corner cases, failure scenarios, environmental dependencies, and regression risks beyond documented requirements. 
 - Experience validating software across heterogeneous enterprise environments involving different operating systems, services, network configurations, and software versions. 
 - Experience with performance, scalability, reliability, and resiliency testing of enterprise products. 
 - Strong focus on an automation-first approach, with experience building maintainable and reusable automated tests and reducing repetitive manual validation. 
 - Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines and analyzing failures to differentiate product defects, automation failures, and environmental issues. 
 - Strong understanding of SDLC/STLC, defect lifecycle, risk-based testing, release qualification, source control, and software engineering best practices. 
 - Ability to work independently with developers and other engineering teams to reproduce, debug, and drive complex product issues to closure. 
 - Strong analytical mindset with the ability to question assumptions and identify scenarios where expected vulnerability detection behavior may produce incorrect, incomplete, inconsistent, or unexpected results. 
 - Self-driven and quick learner with an interest in understanding new technologies, operating systems, protocols, applications, and security concepts. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to engage with different technical teams, seek clarification, challenge assumptions constructively, and build consensus. 

Desirable Requirements

- Experience in the Cyber Security, Vulnerability Management, Vulnerability Assessment, or Network Security domain. 
 - Understanding of vulnerability detection concepts and security assessment methodologies. 
 - Experience testing network scanners, vulnerability scanners, security products, or other network-intensive system software. 
 - Good knowledge of common enterprise protocols and services. 
 - Knowledge of SSL/TLS, certificates, authentication mechanisms, and cryptography fundamentals. 
 - Experience with packet analysis and network troubleshooting tools such as Wireshark/tcpdump or equivalent tools. 
 - Exposure to C/C++ applications and debugging tools such as GDB. 
 - Experience creating and maintaining complex test environments consisting of multiple operating systems, applications, services, and network configurations. 
 - Exposure to containers, virtualization, and cloud infrastructure.

data.title: Software Engineer 2
data.description:
The role

An SDE 2 at CareFi owns problems, not tickets. You will take a business outcome, work out what needs to be built, design it, ship it, and stay accountable for how it behaves in production. 

This is a backend-leaning role on a small team, which means your work will show up in front of hospital staff, ops teams and borrowers within weeks. You will have real say in architecture, and real responsibility when something breaks at 11pm on a discharge that has to clear tonight. 

What you will own

- Design and deliver backend services end to end: scoping, data modelling, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and the fixes that follow

- Write a lightweight design doc for anything that spans more than one service or one engineer, and get it reviewed before you build

- Model and evolve financial and claims data correctly. Ledgers, disbursements, repayments and reconciliation have to be right the first time, and auditable afterwards

- Build and maintain integrations with hospitals, insurers, payment providers and logistics partners, including the messy ones with no sandbox and a PDF for documentation

- Raise technical risk, feasibility concerns and scope creep before work starts rather than in the retro

- Review code substantively. Explain the reasoning behind a change request, not just the change

- Mentor SDE 1s and interns through pairing, intentional PR reviews, and unblocking them early

- Own incidents in your domain: triage, mitigate, write the post-incident review, close the action items

- Identify tech debt in the areas you touch and propose a concrete fix alongside the flag

- Keep the documentation for your systems current after every release

What we work with

- Backend: NestJS, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL

- Cloud and infra: Azure (AKS), containerised services, GitLab CI/CD

- Adjacent: React Native and Flutter clients, OCR and document extraction pipelines, internal ops tooling

- Ways of working: sprint-based delivery, design docs, PR review culture, blameless post-incident reviews. You do not need prior NestJS experience. Strong Node and TypeScript fundamentals transfer in a week or two. 

What we are looking for

- 5 to 7 years building and running backend systems in production, with at least 3 years in a typed language on a modern service framework (Node/TypeScript, Java, Go, Python)

- Strong relational database skills: schema design, indexing, query performance, transactions and isolation levels. You can explain why a migration is safe under load

- Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of at least one non-trivial system or service, including what it cost you to operate it

- Practical experience with API design, third party integrations, idempotency, retries and failure handling

- Comfort with cloud infrastructure and CI/CD. You can deploy, observe and debug your own service without waiting for someone else

- Testing as a default habit, not a compliance step

- Clear written communication. Design docs, PR descriptions and incident notes are part of the job

- Evidence of lifting other engineers: mentoring, reviews, standards, or documentation people actually use

data.title: Technical Delivery Manager
data.description:
Aptagrim designs, engineers and deploys specialised enterprise AI products and intelligent workflow systems. Our systems are built around how a business actually works: its knowledge, its decisions and its day-to-day operations. 

We are a growing team at an early stage. You will shape how we deliver, not just follow an existing playbook, and the AI systems you ship will run inside real enterprise operations. 

The role

We're hiring a hands-on Technical Delivery Manager with deep Python and Django experience. You will own the delivery of enterprise applications and AI solutions, from discovery to production rollout. 

This is a technical leadership role, not a task-tracking one. Expect to spend about 25-30% of your time hands-on: reviewing code, designing backend systems, unblocking engineers and building critical pieces or proofs of concept yourself. The rest goes to delivery ownership, client relationships, planning and team leadership. 

What you'll do

Delivery ownership

- Own delivery end to end: lead discovery, scoping, estimation, planning, build, testing, client acceptance, deployment and handover to support. 
 - Plan realistically: set milestones, dependencies and acceptance criteria that account for technical uncertainty, data readiness and client inputs. Spot risks early and act on them. 
 - Control scope and economics: assess the effort, schedule and commercial impact of change requests. Track utilisation, budgets and project margins, and correct course when they drift. 
 - Run multiple engagements: balance engineering, QA, DevOps and business analysis capacity across projects, working with the Project Coordinator on tracking and reporting. 

Technical leadership

- Lead backend engineering: guide the design of scalable, secure and maintainable systems in Python, Django and Django REST Framework, including APIs, data models, background processing and enterprise integrations. 
 - Stay hands-on: review code, debug hard production and performance issues, and build critical components or proofs of concept when the team needs it. 
 - Integrate AI into products: work with the Head of AI's team to bring LLM, retrieval and agent capabilities into production applications, with sound data flows, failure handling and monitoring. 
 - Set the quality bar: establish practical standards for testing, code review, documentation, security, observability and release readiness, and own production readiness: deployment, rollback, monitoring and incident response. 

Clients and team

- Own client communication: run delivery reviews, explain technical trade-offs in plain language, set expectations (including around AI accuracy and iteration) and resolve escalations. 
 - Support pre-sales: turn business requirements into solution options, estimates, assumptions and statements of work. 
 - Grow the team: mentor engineers and tech leads, help hire, delegate well, and use retrospectives to make estimates and delivery steadily more predictable. 

What you'll bring

- 7+ years in software engineering, including at least 3 years in technical leadership with ownership of client-facing delivery. 
 - Deep, recent, hands-on Python and Django: Django REST Framework, object-oriented design, application architecture and production troubleshooting. You still write and review code regularly. 
 - Strong backend fundamentals: REST API design, authentication and role-based access, PostgreSQL (schema design, ORM, indexing, query tuning, migrations), and async processing with task queues and caching (for example, Celery and Redis). 
 - Production engineering: testing, Git workflows, CI/CD, Docker, Linux and deployment on a major cloud, plus security, secrets management, logging, monitoring and incident investigation. 
 - A track record of delivering enterprise applications from requirements through deployment and client acceptance. 
 - Delivery and commercial skills: estimation, planning, risk and scope management, effort forecasting, and managing budgets and margins. 
 - Clear communication: you can explain technical problems to non-technical stakeholders and handle difficult client conversations calmly. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile delivery, applied pragmatically rather than by the book. 

Nice to have

- Experience shipping LLM-based features to production, such as RAG pipelines, agent workflows, prompt and output evaluation, or LLM API integration
 - Experience delivering projects where data quality, model accuracy or non-deterministic outputs shaped the plan
 - Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure services beyond basic deployment
