data.title: Head of Software Engineering Edge Platform
data.description:
Head of Software Engineering

Tesco Technology | Bengaluru, India

About the role

Tesco operates a large, geographically distributed retail estate where technology is

fundamental to the day-to-day running of our stores. Critical retail capabilities, including

checkout, payments, stock management and colleague-facing applications, depend on

technology that must operate reliably at the edge, close to where our business operates. 

The Edge Platform provides the underlying computing environment and software capabilities

that enable applications to run across our stores. It encompasses edge computing, server

hardware, Linux operating systems, virtualisation, storage, platform software, infrastructure

automation and centralised management capabilities required to deploy, operate, secure and

maintain technology consistently across a diverse retail estate. 

The Edge Platform is business-critical to Tesco. Store technology must remain dependable

despite connectivity disruptions, constrained local resources and the complexity of managing

software and infrastructure changes across thousands of locations. Failures or poorly executed

changes can directly affect store operations, colleague productivity and customer experience. 

As Head of Software Engineering: Edge Platform, you will lead two major, interconnected

engineering priorities: modernising Tesco's edge virtualisation estate through the migration

from VMware to Proxmox, and building a robust, scalable software-driven Edge Management

Platform to provision, manage, monitor and maintain the retail edge estate throughout its

lifecycle. 

You will define the technology strategy and architecture, lead complex engineering and

migration programmes, and build a high-performing engineering organisation. You will combine

deep software engineering expertise with infrastructure knowledge, strategic thinking and

organisational leadership to simplify complexity, improve resilience, drive automation and

deliver a scalable, secure and cost-efficient platform for the future of Tesco's stores. 

This role requires a leader who can move seamlessly between enterprise-level strategy and

detailed technical decisions, balancing the safe execution of a large-scale infrastructure

transition with the long-term development of a modern software platform. 

Key responsibilities

1. Technology strategy and architecture

• Define and execute the Edge Platform engineering strategy, target architecture and

modernisation roadmap, aligned with Tesco's wider technology objectives. 

• Lead the evolution of the platform across edge computing, server hardware, Linux, 

virtualisation, storage, distributed systems and platform software, balancing reliability, 

scalability, security, cost and maintainability. 

• Establish architectural principles, engineering standards and reusable capabilities that

simplify the technology landscape and enable consistent operation across the retail

estate. 

• Make sound architectural decisions, challenge technical assumptions and balance

immediate delivery commitments with long-term platform sustainability. 

• Partner with enterprise and domain architects to ensure the Edge Platform integrates

effectively with wider infrastructure, cloud, network, security and store technology

capabilities. 

2. Virtualisation modernisation: VMware to Proxmox

• Own the engineering strategy and execution of Tesco's migration from VMware to

Proxmox across the edge estate, delivering a secure, reliable and cost-effective

alternative virtualisation platform. 

• Define the target architecture, migration patterns and repeatable build configurations

for different store environments, accounting for hardware compatibility, workloads, 

networking, storage and operational constraints. 

• Lead the assessment, design, engineering, testing and production validation of platform

variants before progressive rollout across the retail estate. 

• Establish automated approaches for hypervisor provisioning, configuration, workload

migration, upgrade management, validation, rollback and recovery. 

• Manage migration dependencies, technical risks, compatibility challenges and cross

functional delivery, ensuring changes are introduced safely without compromising

critical store operations. 

• Establish clear engineering ownership, documentation, knowledge transfer and

operational handover so the platform can be sustainably supported and evolved by

Tesco teams. 

3. Edge Management Platform engineering

• Lead the design and development of a robust, software-driven Edge Management

Platform that provides centralised management and lifecycle control of Tesco's

distributed edge estate. 

• Define a modular, API-first architecture that enables automated provisioning, 

configuration management, fleet inventory, health monitoring, software distribution, 

patching, upgrades and remote diagnostics. 

• Drive engineering across Java, Micronaut, microservices, REST APIs, Python

automation, Terraform and Infrastructure as Code, applying appropriate technologies

and architectural patterns to build maintainable, scalable platform capabilities. 

• Establish consistent abstractions and automation for managing different hardware

configurations, Linux environments, virtualisation platforms and store deployment

patterns. 

• Design for scale, resilience and intermittent connectivity, including safe handling of

disconnected stores, asynchronous operations, configuration drift, failed deployments

and recovery scenarios. 

• Build in observability, auditability, security controls, role-based access and policy

driven configuration to enable reliable and secure fleet-wide operations. 

• Create reusable platform services and self-service capabilities that reduce manual

effort, simplify store technology operations and enable consuming engineering teams to

deploy and manage workloads consistently. 

• Ensure the management platform evolves independently of individual infrastructure

technologies wherever practical, reducing future migration complexity and supporting

long-term technology flexibility. 

4. Software engineering and automation

• Set high engineering standards across software design, development, testing, 

deployment and production operations. 

• Champion automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure provisioning, configuration

management and observability to improve engineering productivity, release confidence

and operational consistency. 

• Establish repeatable approaches for building, testing, deploying and upgrading platform

software and infrastructure across diverse store environments. 

• Ensure software and infrastructure are designed for maintainability, resilience and

predictable operation, including stores with constrained resources or intermittent

connectivity. 

• Promote continuous improvement in engineering quality, developer productivity, 

deployment safety and operational efficiency. 

5. Engineering and people leadership

• Lead and develop a high-performing engineering organisation through Engineering

Managers, Principal Engineers and senior technical leaders. 

• Build the capabilities required to deliver both the virtualisation migration and the long

term Edge Management Platform roadmap, maintaining clear ownership and delivery

accountability across workstreams. 

• Establish a culture of engineering excellence, technical curiosity, collaboration, 

ownership and continuous improvement. 

• Develop engineering leaders, strengthen succession planning and build sustainable

internal expertise in edge computing, virtualisation, platform software and automation. 

• Empower teams to make decisions and deliver independently while maintaining clear

architectural standards and engineering governance. 

6. Reliability and operational excellence

• Drive platform reliability, security, resilience and operational readiness across the retail

estate. 

• Establish repeatable approaches for hardware and firmware lifecycle management, 

Linux upgrades, virtualisation maintenance, storage management, patching and

recovery. 

• Ensure platform releases and migration waves are thoroughly tested, progressively

deployed and supported by effective rollback and recovery strategies. 

• Establish service-level objectives, fleet health monitoring and operational metrics to

improve availability, incident recovery and service quality. 

• Partner with Infrastructure Operations, Cyber Security and Store Technology teams to

ensure the platform meets business-critical operational and security requirements. 

7. Strategic execution and commercial outcomes

• Translate business priorities into clear engineering roadmaps, investment plans, 

milestones and measurable outcomes. 

• Lead complex, cross-functional programmes, managing dependencies, risks and

competing priorities across engineering, architecture, infrastructure, security, 

operations and store technology. 

• Balance the demands of the immediate VMware exit programme with investment in the

strategic Edge Management Platform, ensuring neither compromises the other. 

• Drive cost optimisation through automation, hardware consolidation, improved

compute and storage utilisation, technology standardisation and reduced operational

complexity. 

• Evaluate technology investments and supplier decisions based on long-term value, 

total cost of ownership, operational risk and strategic fit. 

• Influence senior stakeholders, communicate complex technical trade-offs in business

terms and build alignment around the platform strategy and migration roadmap. 

What you will bring

• 15+ years of experience in software engineering and technology, with a proven track

record of technical leadership, architecture and delivery of complex software platforms. 

• Significant experience leading multiple engineering teams, developing engineering

leaders and delivering large-scale technology transformation. 

• Strong technical foundations and credibility across Java, Micronaut or comparable Java

frameworks, microservices, REST APIs, Python automation and Terraform. 

• Solid experience with Linux operating systems, edge computing, server hardware, 

virtualisation and storage technologies, including the design, integration, deployment or

lifecycle management of infrastructure platforms. 

• Experience designing and evolving distributed systems, infrastructure software, fleet

management solutions or platform management systems operating at scale. 

• Experience leading major infrastructure modernisation or virtualisation migration

programmes, ideally involving VMware and Proxmox or comparable hypervisor

technologies. 

• Demonstrated ability to design and deliver software platforms for automated

provisioning, configuration management, fleet monitoring, lifecycle operations and

remote management. 

• Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automated testing, 

configuration management, observability and production reliability. 

• Experience with hardware and software compatibility, operating system upgrades, 

firmware management, capacity planning and infrastructure lifecycle management. 

• Proven ability to define technical strategy, make architectural decisions and translate

long-term vision into executable roadmaps and measurable outcomes. 

• Strong people leadership skills, including developing Engineering Managers and senior

technical leaders, building effective teams and establishing accountability. 

• Commercial acumen, including investment planning, cost optimisation, supplier

management and total cost of ownership. 

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to

influence senior leaders, navigate competing priorities and make sound decisions in

complex enterprise environments. 

How success will be measured

• Virtualisation migration: Safe and predictable migration from VMware to Proxmox, 

successful validation of required store configurations, reduced legacy dependencies

and effective operational handover. 

• Edge Management Platform: Delivery of a scalable, secure and resilient management

platform with automated provisioning, fleet visibility, configuration management and

lifecycle capabilities. 

• Reliability and resilience: Improved platform availability, reduced incident impact and

stronger recovery capabilities across the retail estate. 

• Engineering effectiveness: Increased automation, improved software quality, faster and

more predictable delivery, and reduced manual intervention. 

• Infrastructure consistency: Improved configuration compliance, reduced drift and

standardised hardware, operating system and virtualisation lifecycle management. 

• Cost efficiency: Lower total cost of ownership, improved compute and storage

utilisation, reduced licensing exposure and lower operational overhead. 

• Security and operational readiness: Effective security controls, timely vulnerability

remediation, validated releases and sustainable operational support. 

• Organisation effectiveness: Strong engineering leadership, clear accountability, 

improved internal technical capability and effective collaboration across Tesco

Technology. 

Success will be measured against agreed baselines and targets, balancing the immediate

delivery of the virtualisation migration with the sustainable development of the strategic Edge

Management Platform. 

About Tesco

At Tesco, our purpose is serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every

day. Our technology teams build and operate the platforms that enable our colleagues to serve

customers effectively and keep our business running. 

We value collaboration, inclusion, continuous improvement and engineering excellence. 

Joining Tesco Technology means solving complex engineering challenges at scale and helping

shape the technology that supports our stores, colleagues and customers every day.

data.title: Principal Engineer

About The Role

The Principal Engineer role is a highly strategic position, operating at the same level as an Engineering Director. In the Developer Platform organization, you will be responsible for defining and executing the technical strategy for multiple key systems/technical areas that are of significant impact to the company's Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), developer experience, and core engineering productivity. 

The scope and impact of your work will span the interactions among multiple complex systems and engineering organizations, focusing on the end-to-end flow of software delivery, scaling Developer Platforms & Infrastructure, and leveraging AI to revolutionize productivity. You will sit at the center of driving these critical improvements, ensuring the platform scales to meet the company's growth. 

Your primary focus will be problem seeking. This involves not only defining plans for ambiguous problems (e. g. , "How do we scale our platform 10x while reducing costs?") but also identifying problems crucial for the future of engineering productivity and proposing plans for their resolution, such as the strategic integration of AI/ML into core developer workflows. 

What You'll Do

Your responsibilities will encompass technical leadership, strategic delivery and people growth with a focus on cross-functional impact across the Developer Platform and the wider Engineering organization:

 - Pioneer the integration of AI/ML not just for engineering tasks but to drive overall company productivity, transforming internal processes and tools. 
 - Identify and translate a future business opportunity or engineering productivity gap into a solvable, multi-quarter technical problem with a clear roadmap.

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. 

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. data.description:
Title: Software Architect

Location: Bangalore

About Company: 

We are redefining the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by significantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems - a critical barrier to scalable adoption. 

Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption significantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency - unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale. 

Our architecture is not just an incremental improvement - it's a foundational shift in how AI hardware is built for the future. 

JOB DESCRIPTION: 

Responsibilities: 

- Architect CMIS 5. x stack (DataPath State Machine, VDM, I2C/MCTP, FW-SW interface)
 - Lead host interop tests for hyperscalers (Meta, AWS, etc. ), build test matrix and regression suite
 - Develop manufacturing test orchestration (ATE integration, yield analytics, on-chip stimulus)
 - Build telemetry pipeline from FW to host/cloud (formats, compression, SDK APIs)
 - Own customer SDK and tools (C/Python, CLI, log analysis), release management
 - Ensure standards compliance (CMIS 5. x, OSFP MSA, SFF-8024, OIF)
 - Travel: Up to 25% (customer engagement, manufacturing, standards)

Skills: 

- Good knowledge of C/C++, Python, systems language (Go/Rust); CI/CD, conformance tests
 - Good knowledge of I2C/MCTP, SFF-8024, vendor extensions
 - Good understanding of standards implementation (OIF, SFF, IEEE mgmt-plane)
 - Good knowledge of architecture documentation (SHALL/MUST, REQ traceability)
 - Self-motivated, with strong sense of ownership and responsibility
 - Good communication and reporting skills

Experience: 

- Principal / Senior Staff (8-10 years post-degree)
 - 8-10 years high-speed interconnect software (module SW, management, test, SDK)
 - CMIS 4. x/5. x implementation and OSFP MSA experience
 - Hyperscaler interop with NIC/switch ASICs (Nvidia, Broadcom)
 - Test software architecture with ATE/yields
 - Manufacturing and field support experience

Education: 

- BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science (MS preferred)

Contact: 

SUMIT S. B. 

Mulya Technologies

sumit@mulyatech. com

Job Title: Automation Lead - Python, BDD & AI/ML

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Automation Lead to lead the development and enhancement of a scalable automation platform for desktop and web applications. The platform supports advanced scientific instruments used in semiconductor, life sciences, and materials research. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise in Python-based test automation, PyTest, Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) frameworks, and automation architecture, along with experience integrating AI/ML and Large Language Model (LLM) services into automation workflows. 

The candidate will technically lead a team of automation engineers, drive framework innovation, improve automation reliability, and integrate AI-powered capabilities to accelerate test authoring, classification, execution, and reporting. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for desktop and web applications using Python, PyTest, PowerShell, and related technologies. 
 - Architect and maintain BDD-based automation frameworks, including reusable step libraries and mapping BDD steps to UI objects and actions. 
 - Develop Python modules for BDD step classification, structured data extraction, and AI-driven automation workflows. 
 - Design and maintain data pipelines to process, classify, and map BDD steps to automation objects using structured formats such as CSV and JSON. 
 - Integrate Azure OpenAI and other LLM services into automation workflows using LangChain or similar orchestration frameworks. 
 - Develop and optimize AI-assisted capabilities for automated test authoring, classification, and execution. 
 - Ensure consistent framework configuration, dependency management, file handling, and execution across developer machines and CI/CD agents. 
 - Integrate automated testing frameworks with CI/CD pipelines and release workflows using tools such as Jenkins. 
 - Collaborate with QA, DevOps, Product, and Engineering teams to improve test coverage, platform stability, and delivery efficiency. 
 - Lead, mentor, and guide a team of Python automation engineers, establishing coding standards, design practices, and quality benchmarks. 
 - Own platform deployment, onboarding, and usability improvements, including environment validation, troubleshooting documentation, and user enablement. 
 - Improve automation reliability, scalability, observability, reporting, and long-running execution stability. 
 - Ensure appropriate auditability, traceability, and security practices in automation development and deployment. 

Required Skills and Qualifications

- 6-10 years of experience in software development, test automation, or automation framework engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on programming experience in Python. 
 - Experience with PyTest and test automation framework development. 
 - Strong understanding of BDD frameworks, reusable step definitions, and mapping BDD steps to UI objects and actions. 
 - Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation utilities. 
 - Experience designing modular, scalable, and maintainable software frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of structured data processing using CSV, JSON, and Python data-handling libraries. 
 - Experience integrating automation frameworks with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins. 
 - Strong understanding of configuration management, dependency handling, debugging, and execution consistency. 
 - Experience in technical leadership, mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, and establishing engineering best practices. 
 - Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and collaboration skills. 

Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills

- Hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI SDKs, or other LLM services in production environments. 
 - Experience with LangChain or similar LLM orchestration frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of AI/ML-enabled automation, prompt engineering, and AI-driven test generation or classification. 
 - Exposure to Agentic AI concepts and AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot. 
 - Experience with Node. js for developing APIs, backend services, and automation integrations. 
 - Knowledge of software design patterns, modular architecture, and enterprise-grade platform design. 
 - Experience implementing automation reporting, observability, and reliability improvements. 
 - Exposure to scientific instruments, semiconductor technology, life sciences, engineering, or regulated environments. 

Educational Qualifications

- B. Tech / B. E. in Computer Science, Electronics, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Equivalent practical experience may also be considered. 

Key Competencies

- Technical leadership and team mentoring
 - Python automation framework architecture
 - BDD framework development
 - AI/LLM integration and prompt engineering
 - CI/CD integration and release automation
 - Framework scalability, stability, and maintainability
 - Cross-functional collaboration and continuous improvement

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical lead with strong Python automation expertise, practical experience building BDD-based frameworks, and the ability to integrate AI-powered capabilities into enterprise automation platforms. Experience leading automation engineers and delivering reliable, scalable solutions is essential. Exposure to Azure OpenAI, LangChain, and AI-assisted development will be an added advantage.

From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. 

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. 

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65, 000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1, 000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200, 000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. 

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6. 95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years. 

Job Description

QA Test Lead

Eurofins IT Solutions, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

With 36 facilities worldwide, Eurofins BioPharma Product Testing (BPT) is the largest network of bio/pharmaceutical GMP product testing laboratories providing comprehensive laboratory services for the world's largest pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, and medical device companies. 

BPT is enabled by global engineering teams working on next-generation applications and Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS). As Senior Automation Engineer, you will be a crucial part of our delivery team, ensuring the product features are completely automated and reducing the idea to live time to Business. As a technology leader, BPT wants to give you the opportunity not just to accept new challenges and opportunities but to impress with your ingenuity, focus, attention to detail and collaboration with a global team of professionals. 

This role reports to a Manager. 

Required Experience and Skills

Experience: 

- Experience between 8 to 10 yrs. Responsibilities

- Develop and implement test strategies, plans, and schedules for both manual and automated testing. 
 - Define and prioritize testing tasks based on project requirements, risks, and timelines. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders to understand requirements and design comprehensive test cases. 
 - Lead and mentor a team of QA engineers, providing guidance and support. 
 - Coordinate and manage the testing team's activities, ensuring productivity and adherence to testing standards. 
 - Conduct regular team meetings, performance reviews, and provide constructive feedback. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts using C# and Selenium , Typescript of Java. 
 - Integrate test automation into CI/CD pipelines for continuous testing and delivery. 
 - Design and implement automated tests for RESTful APIs using tools like RestSharp or similar libraries. 
 - Validate API functionality, performance, and security through thorough testing. 
 - Oversee the execution of manual and automated tests, track results, and report defects. 
 - Generate and present detailed test reports, metrics, and dashboards to stakeholders. 
 - Ensure that defects are tracked and managed effectively throughout the testing lifecycle. 
 - Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure high-quality deliverables. 
 - Participate in requirement reviews, sprint planning, and retrospectives to provide QA input. 
 - Continuously evaluate and improve testing processes, tools, and methodologies. 
 - Stay updated with the latest industry trends and best practices to enhance testing efficiency. 
 - Identify and mitigate risks related to software quality and testing processes. 
 - Ensure compliance with quality standards and project requirementsRequired Skills: 

- Proficiency in C#, Typescript for developing and maintaining automated test scripts and frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented programming concepts, design patterns, and coding best practices. 
 - Expertise in using Selenium WebDriver for automating web application testing. 
 - Knowledge of Selenium Grid for distributed test execution. 
 - Familiarity with Selenium best practices for managing locators and handling dynamic content. 
 - Good knowledge in Database & SQL. Ability to create & mine data using SQL queries. 
 - Experience with RestSharp or similar libraries for creating and executing API test cases. 
 - Understanding of RESTful principles and common HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE). 
 - Ability to validate API responses, handle authentication, and test error handling. 
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks using tools like NUnit or MSTest for C#, WebDriver IO , Selenium
 - Knowledge of integrating test automation with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI/CD
 - Proficiency with version control systems like Git for managing test scripts and collaborating with the development team. 
 - Familiarity with test management tools like JIRA, TestRail, or similar for tracking test cases, execution, and defect management. 
 - Ability to write and execute SQL queries for data validation and verification. 
 - Understanding of performance testing concepts and tools (e. g. , JMeter) for assessing application performance under load. 
 - Experience working in Agile environments, including participation in Scrum ceremonies like stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration and reportingDesirable Experience

- Knowledge of Performance testing. 
 - Knowledge of Security testing. 
 - Knowledge of Mobile Automation Testing. Personal Skills: 

- Excellent analytical and problem solving skills
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills
 - Ability to articulate and present different points-of-views on various topics related to project and otherwise. 
 - Successful teamwork experience and demonstrated leadership abilities are required. 
 - Eager to learn and continuously develop personal and technical capabilities. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- MCA or Bachelors in Engineering, Computer Science or any other equivalent degree. 

Additional Information

Personal Skills: 

- Customer-service oriented with a problem-solving attitude; 
 - Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential; 
 - Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change; 
 - Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing); 
 - Structured and clear writing skills; 
 - Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning; 
 - Demonstrated positive attitude, self-motivated, team player. PERFORMANCE APPRAISAL CRITERIA: Eurofins has a strong focus on Performance Management system. This includes quarterly calibrations, half-yearly reviews and annual reviews. The KPIs shall be set and may vary slightly between projects. These will be clearly communicated, documented during the first 30 days of your joining.

data.title: Manager I - Senior Software Engineer, SAP Quality Management
data.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, "Who are you working for?"-a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. 

At Bristol Myers Squibb, we are inspired by a single vision - transforming patients' lives through science. In oncology, hematology, immunology and cardiovascular disease - and one of the most diverse and promising pipelines in the industry - each of our passionate colleagues contribute to innovations that drive meaningful change. We bring a human touch to every treatment we pioneer. Join us and make a difference. 

Position Summary

At BMS, digital innovation and Information Technology are central to our vision of transforming patients' lives through science. To accelerate our ability to serve patients around the world, we must unleash the power of technology. We are committed to being at the forefront of transforming the way medicine is made and delivered by harnessing the power of computer and data science, artificial intelligence, and other technologies to promote scientific discovery, faster decision making, and enhanced patient care. 

The Senior Software Engineer, SAP Quality Management should have strong experience supporting and delivering SAP QM capabilities in an SAP S/4HANA environment, with working knowledge of manufacturing integration points across PP/PI, MM, IM, WM/EWM, MES, and LIMS. This role focuses on quality inspection processes, quality notifications, batch and material quality controls, master data, regulated validation expectations, and operational support in an FDA and GxP environment. 

If you want an exciting and rewarding career that is meaningful, consider joining our diverse team!

🚀 Shape the Future of Quality Technology | SAP S/4HANA Quality Management Specialist

Are you ready to make an impact where Quality meets Innovation?

We're looking for a talented SAP Quality Management Specialist to join our global team and help drive the next generation of intelligent, compliant, and cloud-enabled quality solutions. If you're passionate about SAP QM, digital quality transformation, AI-enabled innovation, and regulated manufacturing excellence, we'd love to hear from you. 

💡 Delivering Smart Quality Solutions

- Design, implement, and support SAP S/4HANA Quality Management solutions across inspection planning, inspection execution, results recording, usage decisions, quality notifications, batch release, and quality certificate processes. 
 - Own end-to-end delivery across requirements, design, configuration, testing, deployment, validation support, and operational excellence. 
 - Provide scalable and compliant SAP QM solutions aligned with business and regulatory expectations. 

🔗 Connecting the Dots

- Partners with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Warehouse, Laboratory, and Enterprise Platform teams to deliver integrated quality processes. 
 - Support integrations with MES, LIMS, Batch Release Hub, BTP/BIAP, and other enterprise platforms. 
 - Ensure seamless execution of quality processes across manufacturing, inventory, warehouse, and laboratory systems. 

☁️ Driving Cloud & AI Transformation

- Support digital quality transformation initiatives leveraging SAP S/4HANA and cloud technologies. 
 - Apply AI, GenAI, automation, process mining, reporting, and analytics to improve operational efficiency, accelerate documentation, strengthen quality compliance, and reduce manual effort across SAP QM processes. 
 - Identify and support AI-enabled use cases including quality anomaly detection, proactive incident prevention, automated root cause analysis, intelligent incident resolution, quality trend analytics, and process mining insights. 
 - Use AI/GenAI responsibly in regulated environments to support GxP documentation, test script preparation, validation evidence reviews, audit-readiness checks, and knowledge management while aligning with Information Technology Quality System (ITQS), Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) Teams, data integrity, and validation expectations. 
 - Contribute to enterprise modernization initiatives involving SAP RISE, BTP/BIAP, and digital manufacturing capabilities. 

🛡️ Keeping Us Compliant

- Support FDA, GxP, Information Technology Quality System (ITQS), and Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) compliant solution delivery, documentation, and operations. 
 - Produce and maintain GxP documentation including SDLC deliverables, validation plans, requirements traceability, test scripts, testing evidence, deviations, approvals, and audit-ready records in alignment with Information Technology Quality System (ITQS) and Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) expectations. 
 - Ensure quality processes and system changes meet regulatory, validation, inspection readiness, and compliance requirements. 

🤝 Collaborating & Innovating

- Build strong relationships with Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Validation, Enterprise Platform, IT Business Partners, and external partners. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives and promote adoption of emerging technologies. 
 - Lead stakeholder communications and influence cross-functional decision making. 
 - Mentor team members and contribute to organizational capability development. 

What You'll Bring

- ✅ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Life Sciences, Quality, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - ✅ 5-7+ years of SAP QM experience in SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA environments. 
 - ✅ Strong experience in Inspection Management, Quality Notifications, Batch Management, Quality Master Data, and Quality Certificates. 
 - ✅ Experience supporting FDA-regulated and GxP-compliant environments, including Information Technology Quality System (ITQS) / Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) documentation, validation evidence, traceability, change control, and audit readiness. 
 - ✅ Knowledge of SAP QM integration with PP/PI, MM, IM, WM/EWM, MES, and LIMS. 
 - ✅ Experience supporting SDLC, validation, testing, deployment, and operational support activities. 
 - ✅ Ability to apply AI, GenAI, automation, analytics, and process mining to improve SAP QM delivery, documentation quality, incident prevention, testing efficiency, and compliance outcomes. 
 - ✅ Strong stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills. 
 - ✅ Passion for continuous learning, innovation, and adoption of emerging technologies. 

Bonus Points If You Have. . . 

- ⭐ Experience with SAP RISE, SAP BTP/BIAP, cloud transformation initiatives, or enterprise integration platforms. 
 - ⭐ Experience with Batch Release Hub and advanced quality release processes. 
 - ⭐ Hands-on exposure to AI/GenAI, Copilot-style productivity tools, automation, process mining, predictive analytics, anomaly detection, or intelligent operational support in SAP, Quality, Manufacturing, or regulated environments. 
 - ⭐ Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated manufacturing industry experience. 
 - ⭐ Experience supporting global SAP programs and enterprise-scale deployments. 

What Makes You Stand Out

You combine deep SAP Quality Management expertise with a passion for innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. You thrive in complex environments, build trusted partnerships across business and technology teams, and proactively leverage modern technologies such as AI, GenAI, automation, process mining, analytics, and cloud platforms to improve quality processes, reduce manual effort, strengthen compliance, and support better patient outcomes. You bring a growth mindset, strong leadership capabilities, and a commitment to delivering compliant, scalable, and business-focused solutions in a regulated digital environment. 

Why You Should Apply

Around the world, we are passionate about making an impact on the lives of patients with serious diseases. Empowered to apply our individual talents and diverse perspectives in an inclusive culture, our shared values of passion, innovation, urgency, accountability, inclusion and integrity bring out the highest potential of each of our colleagues. 

Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. 

#HYDIT

We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials - if this role excites you, but doesn't perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. 

How We Work

Where you work matters - because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. Learn more at https: //careers. bms. com/ways-of-working. 

Supporting People With Disabilities

BMS is dedicated to ensuring that people with disabilities can excel through a transparent recruitment process, reasonable workplace accommodations/adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Applicants can request a reasonable workplace accommodation/adjustment prior to accepting a job offer. If you require reasonable accommodations/adjustments in completing this application, or in any part of the recruitment process, direct your inquiries to adastaffingsupport@bms. com. Visit careers. bms. com/eeo-accessibility to access our complete Equal Employment Opportunity statement. 

Candidate Rights

BMS will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, pursuant to applicable laws in your area. 

For roles based in Los Angeles County only: If you live in or expect to work from Los Angeles County if hired for this position, please visit this page for important additional information: https: //careers. bms. com/california-residents/

Data Protection

We will never request payments, financial information, or social security numbers during our application or recruitment process. Learn more about protecting yourself at https: //careers. bms. com/fraud-protection. 

Any data processed in connection with role applications will be treated in accordance with applicable data privacy policies and regulations. 

If this posting is missing required information required by local law or incorrect, contact BMS at TAEnablement@bms. com with the Job Title and Requisition number. Do not send application-related inquiries to this email. To check your application status, please login to your Candidate Home Account.

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. data.description:
Senior Software Engineer - Payment Systems

Location: Hyderabad

Experience: 6+ Years

Role: Senior Software Engineer - Payments & Distributed Systems

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years of hands-on experience in software development, payment processing, distributed systems, and modern API-driven architectures. The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of Wire, ACH, and RTP payment systems, along with expertise in REST APIs, microservices, backend processing, and event-driven architectures. 

The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, integrating, and supporting highly scalable and reliable payment applications that process critical financial transactions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain highly scalable payment processing applications supporting Wire, ACH, and RTP transactions. 
 - Develop robust backend services using REST APIs and microservices architecture. 
 - Build distributed systems capable of handling high-volume, concurrent, and mission-critical payment transactions. 
 - Design applications with strong focus on concurrency, thread safety, fault tolerance, scalability, and reliability. 
 - Develop backend processing components for transaction validation, routing, processing, status management, and exception handling. 
 - Implement secure and reliable integrations with internal and external payment systems. 
 - Work with API Connect (APIC) for API management, integration, routing, security, and enterprise connectivity. 
 - Develop and integrate event-driven services using messaging or event-streaming technologies. 
 - Design loosely coupled, asynchronous components to support scalable payment processing workflows.

Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead to drive the development and evolution of the Fluid AIQ Platform and lead AI-powered application development for upcoming client projects. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience building production-ready applications using LLMs, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, and modern AI frameworks. 

This role goes beyond traditional chatbot development, focusing on building intelligent agentic applications capable of reasoning, planning, interacting with enterprise systems, using tools, and operating within defined guardrails. 

The position combines AI architecture, hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and product commercialization. You will help transform platform capabilities into modular commercial offerings that can be deployed independently and expanded based on client requirements.

1. Agentic AI Architecture & Platform Development

data.title: Quality Engineer
data.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a Quality Engineer with experience in pressure vessel and heat exchanger manufacturing. The candidate will be responsible for fabrication inspection, welding quality, material traceability, NDT coordination, and quality documentation in compliance with ASME Section VIII, Division 1 & 2, and applicable customer requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Carry out stage-wise quality inspections during the fabrication of pressure vessels, heat exchangers, and related equipment. 

- Review engineering drawings, material specifications, approved procedures, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), and Quality Assurance Plans (QAPs). 

- Perform incoming material inspection and verify Material Test Certificates (MTCs), material grades, identification, and traceability. 

- Conduct fit-up, dimensional, visual welding, and final inspections as per approved drawings and applicable code requirements. 

- Verify compliance with approved Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS), Procedure Qualification Records (PQR), and welder performance qualification records. 

- Ensure weld identification, material traceability, and inspection records are maintained throughout manufacturing. 

- Coordinate NDT activities, including RT, UT, MT, and PT, as required by the approved inspection plan and applicable code. 

- Monitor hydrostatic testing and other applicable pressure tests, ensuring approved procedures and safety requirements are followed. 

- Coordinate inspections with Authorized Inspection Agency (AIA) representatives, third-party inspectors, and customer inspectors, as applicable. 

- Prepare and maintain inspection reports, non-conformance reports (NCRs), corrective action records, and manufacturing quality documentation. 

- Support preparation and review of the final manufacturing data report and quality dossier, including applicable ASME documentation and the Manufacturer's Data Report (U-1 or applicable form). 

- Ensure inspection hold points and witness points are followed and properly released. 

- Identify quality issues, coordinate root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions to minimize rejection and rework. 

- Support ASME U Stamp-related quality activities in accordance with the company's Quality Control System (QCS) and applicable code requirements. 

- Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Procurement, and Project teams to resolve quality-related issues and ensure timely inspection clearance. 

Required Qualifications and Experience

- Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline. 

- 3-6 years of relevant experience in pressure vessel, heat exchanger, or process equipment manufacturing. 

- Practical experience in fabrication quality control and inspection of welded pressure equipment. 

- Working knowledge of ASME Section VIII, Division 1, and applicable material and welding requirements. 

- Knowledge of welding inspection, WPS/PQR, welder qualifications, NDT, dimensional inspection, and material traceability. 

- Experience in quality documentation, ITP/QAP implementation, NCR handling, and final inspection. 

- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in an ASME U Stamp-certified manufacturing facility. 

- NDT Level II certification in applicable methods. 

- Welding inspection certification such as CSWIP or AWS-CWI. 

- Familiarity with ASME material traceability, pressure testing, and Manufacturer's Data Report documentation. 

- Knowledge of ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems.

data.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Golang (Product Engineering)
data.description:
ABOUT OOLIO: 

Oolio is a leading B2B SaaS platform transforming how hospitality venues operate and grow. Trusted by more than 22, 000 venues, we power mission-critical POS, payments, online ordering, kiosks, loyalty, kitchen management, and real-time insights - all within one connected ecosystem. 

We are building the operating system for modern hospitality - simplifying complex operations, accelerating service, and unlocking smarter, data-driven decisions. Built by hospitality professionals with decades of industry experience, we understand the realities of every shift, every service rush, and every guest interaction. From cafés and quick-service restaurants to pubs, multi-site groups, and stadiums, Oolio enables venues to operate seamlessly at scale. With next-business-day settlements, powerful third-party integrations, and 24/7 real human support, we go beyond software - we become long-term partners in growth. 

As a rapidly scaling product-led organisation, we're shaping the future of hospitality technology. 

We build the technology backbone that powers modern hospitality businesses to perform, compete, and thrive at scale. 

JOB DESCRIPTION: 

At Oolio, Senior Backend Engineers - Golang are hands-on engineers who design, build, and operate scalable, reliable, and high-performance backend systems. You will take ownership across the backend engineering lifecycle - from technical design and development through testing, deployment, observability, and production support. 

The role requires strong expertise in Golang, microservices, distributed systems, APIs, event-driven architectures, cloud-native technologies, and system performance. As AI continues to transform software engineering, you will also be encouraged to leverage AI-powered development tools, automation, and emerging AI capabilities to improve engineering productivity, accelerate delivery, enhance code quality, and solve real-world engineering problems. 

The primary focus of this role is hands-on backend engineering, with opportunities to contribute to technical design, architecture decisions, and engineering best practices. You will work closely with Product, Design, Platform, and Engineering teams to build customer-facing products and backend capabilities that support Oolio's growing global platform. 

RESPONSIBILITIES: 

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain reliable and scalable backend services using Golang. 
 - Contribute to the design and implementation of scalable microservices with strong emphasis on performance, concurrency, maintainability, and reliability. 
 - Contribute to technical design and architecture discussions, including HLD/LLD, service boundaries, data flows, and integration patterns. 
 - Design and implement event-driven systems using asynchronous messaging, queues, pub/sub, and streaming patterns where appropriate. 
 - Build and maintain RESTful and/or gRPC APIs that power web, mobile, and third-party integrations. 
 - Work collaboratively across the stack when required, including integration with React and Node. js services to deliver end-to-end product features. 
 - Develop and operate cloud-native services deployed on AWS, leveraging Kubernetes and Docker for containerized environments. 
 - Identify and resolve performance, scalability, and reliability bottlenecks as product usage and customer scale increase. 
 - Implement effective testing strategies including unit, integration, contract, and performance testing. 
 - Contribute to observability best practices including structured logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing, and alerting. 
 - Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving engineering standards, coding practices, and overall code quality. 
 - Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement sustainable fixes to prevent recurrence. 
 - Collaborate with other engineers to deliver high-quality solutions within agreed timelines. 
 - Mentor and support junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge sharing. 
 - Leverage AI-powered development tools and automation to improve development productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and software delivery. 
 - Explore and adopt relevant AI capabilities and engineering tools that can solve practical software development and operational challenges. 

REQUIREMENTS: 

Role: Senior Backend Engineer (Product Engineering) - final role will depend on candidate experience, credentials, and interview outcomes

Experience: 5 - 9 Years

Education: Preferred - B. Tech/B. E/M. Tech/M. E/MCA/M. S

Technology Stack: 

(A) Core Engineering: 

Golang, Microservices, Distributed Systems, Event-Driven Architecture, REST APIs, gRPC, System Design (HLD/LLD), Performance Optimization, Testing Frameworks, AI-Powered Development Tooling

(B) Good/Nice to Have: 

ReactJS, NodeJS, GraphQL

OTHER REQUIREMENTS: 

- Strong hands-on experience building production-grade backend systems in SaaS or product-based organisations. 
 - Strong expertise in Golang, including concurrency patterns, goroutines, channels, memory management, profiling, and performance optimization. 
 - Proven experience developing and operating scalable microservices and distributed systems. 
 - Strong understanding of API design, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and system reliability principles. 
 - Experience with PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, or similar databases, including schema design, indexing, transactions, and query optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native application development. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern software development and delivery practices. 
 - Good understanding of observability, monitoring, logging, tracing, fault tolerance, and production reliability. 
 - Experience troubleshooting production issues, conducting root cause analysis, and implementing long-term improvements. 
 - Experience working in high-scale or high-transaction environments is highly desirable. 
 - Practical experience leveraging AI-powered development tools to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and delivery outcomes. 
 - Exposure to AI-powered workflows across development, testing, documentation, deployment, or operational processes is a plus. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced product engineering environment. 
 - Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional and engineering teams while taking ownership of assigned services and features. 
 - Strong focus on writing clean, maintainable, well-tested, and production-ready code.

Or for an individual contributor, they lead organisation wide projects and act as deep technical expert and thought leader, identifying new ways of working and collaborating cross functionally.  - Foster and guide compliance, ensure regulations are observed that relevant processes in place to facilitate adherence.

data.title: Electrical Engineering & Computer Science
data.description:
About Turing: 

- Turing is one of the world's fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Role Overview: 

- We are seeking an experienced Electrical Engineering or Computer Science expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based scientific and engineering tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative. 
 - In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5-10 trainers, review technical tasks for accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure tasks reflect authentic computer science, software systems, and electrical engineering workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent delivery of challenging technical tasks. 

What you'll do: 

- Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of scientific and engineering tasks. 
 - Review technical tasks end to end, including problem statements, codebases, circuit netlists, hardware description languages (HDL), datasets, computational environments, reference solutions, and automated tests. 
 - Validate tasks involving high-performance computing (HPC), parallel computing, algorithms, distributed systems, compilers, operating systems, databases, ML systems, GPU computing, circuit design, signal processing, power systems, and embedded systems. 
 - Ensure tasks reflect realistic software engineering, research, and electrical engineering workflows requiring meaningful multi-step technical reasoning. 
 - Verify technical correctness across algorithm complexity, numerical accuracy, memory management, concurrency, circuit laws, power balance, signal processing, timing constraints, and system stability. 
 - Validate compilers, simulation tools, software dependencies, computational environments, and build processes to ensure reproducible results. 
 - Identify unreliable tests caused by nondeterministic behavior, race conditions, hardware-dependent performance thresholds, or simulation convergence issues. 
 - Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful technical outputs such as functional correctness, performance, frequency response, waveforms, timing, efficiency, and system behavior. 
 - Identify technical inaccuracies, flawed assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass computation, simulations, or automated evaluations. 
 - Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval. 
 - Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices. 

What we're looking for: 

- Ph. D. , postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related discipline. 
 - Strong programming skills in C/C++, Rust, Python, Julia, Fortran, MATLAB/Octave, or hardware description languages (HDL), with advanced Linux and terminal proficiency. 
 - Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: parallel computing, systems programming, scientific software development, circuit simulation, signal processing, power systems, or digital hardware design. 
 - Strong understanding of algorithms, computational systems, numerical methods, software testing, or electrical engineering principles. 
 - Experience reviewing complex codebases, technical implementations, engineering simulations, or research outputs. 
 - Ability to evaluate algorithm correctness, computational performance, numerical accuracy, concurrency behavior, and reliability of technical results. 
 - Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, race conditions, and flawed engineering assumptions. 
 - Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams. 
 - Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards. 

Nice to have: 

- Experience with HPC and systems development tools such as MPI, OpenMP, CUDA, LLVM/GCC, CMake, gdb, Valgrind, perf, sanitizers, or Slurm. 
 - Familiarity with electrical engineering and hardware simulation tools such as ngspice, Xyce, Icarus Verilog, Verilator, GHDL, Yosys, pandapower, PyPSA, MATPOWER, openEMS, GNU Radio, or QEMU. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks such as pytest. 
 - Experience developing technical benchmarks, programming challenges, simulation-based evaluations, or automated grading systems. 
 - Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated technical solutions. 
 - Open-source development or maintainer experience, particularly reviewing and validating external contributions. 
 - Industry experience in semiconductors, high-performance computing, power utilities, telecommunications, or embedded systems. 
 - Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs. 

Offer Details: 

- Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST. 
 - Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
 - Duration of contract : 4 week [expected start date is next week]

data.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, "Who are you working for?"-a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. 

Position Summary

We are seeking an AI Engineer to support the AI Enablement Team in developing and deploying enterprise-grade generative AI solutions. This role leverages large language model (LLM) platforms, cloud-based AI services, and modern API integration frameworks to expand the organization's AI capabilities and drive adoption across business functions. 

The ideal candidate will have expertise in generative AI application development, prompt engineering, and AI tool integration within regulated enterprise environments. The position is responsible for delivering secure, scalable, and compliant GenAI-powered solutions that enhance employee productivity, streamline information access, and support intelligent automation - in close partnership with senior engineers, data scientists, and cross-functional business stakeholders. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, and deploy autonomous multi-agent workflows using orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Autogen, or similar, including complex state machines with conditional routing, parallel execution, and error recovery patterns. 
 - Architect graph-based agent workflows with 10+ nodes involving agent collaboration, task decomposition, and sequential/parallel execution across multiple business domains. 
 - Develop and maintain reusable agent node libraries, extensible platform patterns, versioning strategies, and testing frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end) for agent workflows. 
 - Build production-grade FastAPI applications with async I/O patterns, integrating PostgreSQL, Redis, and external enterprise services. 
 - Implement real-time agent streaming using Server-Sent Events (SSE) and WebSocket protocols, alongside RESTful and event-driven API architectures for agent orchestration. 
 - Integrate cloud-based LLM providers (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT-4) and design prompt management systems with versioning, templating, and dynamic compilation. 
 - Implement conversation state persistence using Redis checkpointing and build tool-calling protocols (Model Context Protocol, function calling) for external data sources and APIs. 
 - Develop hybrid intelligence patterns combining LLM reasoning with rule-based logic and statistical analysis, and build response transformation pipelines for structured analytical outputs. 
 - Integrate observability platforms (Langfuse, LangSmith, or similar) to enable end-to-end agent tracing, telemetry, performance monitoring, and cost optimization across production workflows. 
 - Implement evaluation frameworks measuring agent success rates, reasoning quality, and output accuracy, while continuously optimizing token usage and LLM costs. 
 - Ensure enterprise security integration (LDAP, SSO, access control), robust error handling, and compliance with data governance and Responsible AI standards. 
 - Partner with data engineers, business analysts, and UX teams to translate requirements into scalable agent workflows and streaming interfaces. 
 - Mentor junior engineers on async Python patterns, agent design, and LLMOps best practices; participate in architecture reviews and contribute to documentation and knowledge sharing. 

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline. 
 - 9+ years of software engineering experience, with 2+ years building and deploying production LLM-powered applications. 
 - Proven experience with
 - Agentic orchestration frameworks LangGraph (preferred), LangChain, CrewAI, Autogen, or similar. 
 - Cloud LLM providers AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or OpenAI GPT-4. 
 - Production async web frameworks, particularly FastAPI. 
 - Docker containerization, Git version control, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Cloud platforms AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. 
 - Expert-level async Python programming (asyncio, async/await patterns). 
 - Demonstrated experience building autonomous agent systems performing multi-step tasks beyond simple chatbots, including conditional logic, state management, and tool-calling patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of agentic design patterns including ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, and tool-use agents. 
 - Experience implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with LLMOps practices, observability tooling (Langfuse, LangSmith), and prompt engineering at scale (templating, versioning, optimization). 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively in globally distributed teams. 
 - Prior experience in global life sciences, especially in the GPS functional area, is a plus. 
 - Experience managing or collaborating with offshore technical development teams and diverse international stakeholders is a plus. 
We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials - if this role excites you, but doesn't perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer I/II - Backend (Python)
data.description:
About UrbanPiper

Close to 30 million restaurant orders a month run through UrbanPiper. We sit between thousands of restaurant kitchens and everywhere they sell: Swiggy, Zomato, their own storefronts, the POS at the counter. When we get it wrong, a restaurant stops selling. When we get it right, nobody notices. That's the job. 

About The Team

A restaurant's menu is its storefront, and it lives in a dozen places at once. Change one price, one add-on, one opening hour, and it has to land correctly on every aggregator, each with its own schema, its own rate limits and its own ways of failing silently. Now do that for thousands of brands, hundreds of times a day at peak. 

The Menu team owns that pipeline: ingestion, publishing, and knowing exactly what went where when something breaks. The hard parts are : data modelling, idempotent sync, async processing at scale, and partners who change their APIs without telling you. 

How We Work

Small team, large surface area. We use AI as a force multiplier & not just to speed up coding. We expect you to work effectively with AI agents, exercise sound engineering judgment, and take ownership of what ships. Not every problem comes with a clear spec or an obvious solution; we expect you to iterate, challenge your assumptions, and find the best solution to the problem. 

What You'll Do

- Ship to production in your first week. Then keep shipping. 
 - Take a merchant's "my prices are wrong on Zomato" from Support, find the cause in the logs and the data, and make sure it can't happen again. 
 - Design async pipelines that survive retries, partial failures and rate limits (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, Temporal). 
 - Model messy catalogue data so that each new aggregator's quirks stay out of the core. 
 - Build the validation loops that make AI-written code safe to ship: tests, replays against real production payloads, staging checks. 
 - Instrument your services well enough that you find the bug before the merchant does. 
 - Review code, write design docs, and go on call for what you built. 

You'll fit if

- You're AI-native. You run AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar) every day, and not as ask-and-hope. You think before you prompt, give the agent the right context, and close every loop with a check. You have opinions on models, tools, plugins and skills, and you can defend them. 
 - You take responsibility for what ships, regardless of who wrote it. AI makes mistakes; you know where, and you catch them before production does. You own the code whether you typed it or not. 
 - You've built Python backends that run in production at meaningful scale. Django or FastAPI (we run both), REST and GraphQL APIs with versioning, pagination and error contracts. 
 - You know your fundamentals. Data structures, testing, SQL you can index and read a query plan, and the ways async systems fail. 
 - You write clearly. A PR description or incident note from you explains the trade-off. 
 - You've owned something. A service in production, a design across teams, engineers who got better working with you. 

Good to have

- You have built your own AI tooling: agent skills, MCP servers, hooks, eval sets, or automations that run without you. 
 - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Helm, and GitOps with ArgoCD. 
 - Catalogue, e-commerce, or third-party marketplace integrations. 
 - Durable workflow engines such as Temporal. 
 - Experience at a fast-paced startup. 

Your first 6 months

- Week 1: ship your first PR to Prod! You set up your environment and AI tooling yourself, from the code and the docs. 
 - Month 1: you take a real customer escalation, root-cause it from logs and data, and ship the permanent fix. You're on the on-call rotation. 
 - Month 3: a part of the menu pipeline is yours, end to end. Something you shipped is used daily by partners or Support, with alerts and dashboards you built. 
 - Month 6: you own a number, such as publish failure rate or ingestion time, and you've moved it. You've led a design across services, contributed to next quarter's roadmap for your area, and built tooling that makes the rest of the team faster.

data.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
data.description:
We are now looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer!

For more than 25 years, NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing. Our work in accelerated computing and AI brings together outstanding technology and talented people. As an NVIDIAN, you'll join a diverse, encouraging environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. 

NVIDIA is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to build, maintain, and improve the pipelines, automation, and infrastructure that support software delivery. As a dedicated member of the DevOps team, you will contribute to the team's projects and roadmap, improve build and deployment reliability, and collaborate with SRE and development teams globally. This role provides primary DevOps support during India business hours, with clear handoffs to US-based teams. 

What You Will Be Doing

- Participate as a dedicated member of the DevOps team, contributing to scrums, planning sessions, team meetings, and delivery of the team's projects and roadmap. 
 - Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines, build and release automation, and deployment workflows. 
 - Serve as the primary point of contact for DevOps issues during India business hours, triaging and resolving pipeline and workflow failures. 
 - Collaborate with SRE and development teams across time zones, ensuring clear communication and effective handoffs to US-based teams. 
 - Automate manual processes and improve the reliability, speed, and visibility of build and deployment systems. 
 - Develop and maintain documentation, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides for DevOps workflows. 
 - Contribute to tooling, infrastructure as code, and configuration management for DevOps platforms. 
 - Manage and maintain data center infrastructure using tools such as NetBox and Foreman, along with Mellanox switches. 
 - Improve codebase and platform security through software hardening and secure credential management. 

What We Need To See

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. 
 - 8 + years of hands-on experience in DevOps, build and release engineering, or a similar role. 
 - Strong experience with CI/CD systems such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Strong experience working on any of the public clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure) 
 - Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python and Bash. 
 - Experience with source control tools and workflows using Git, GitLab, Perforce, and Gerrit. 
 - Experience with infrastructure as code and configuration management tools such as Ansible, Terraform, and Packer. 
 - Experience with orchestration and automation platforms such as StackStorm, Argo CD, or Flux CD. 
 - Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Strong Linux fundamentals and skills in solving issues. 
 - Strong understanding of production release cycles, pipeline testing, and software quality practices. 
 - Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with distributed teams across time zones. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Experience developing automation and tooling in Go. 
 - Demonstrated success improving CI/CD reliability, reducing build and deployment times, and eliminating manual work. 
 - Hands-on experience with NetBox, Foreman, and Mellanox switches in data center environments. 
 - Experience implementing software hardening and secure credential management. 
 - A track record of creating clear runbooks and improving operational handoffs across global teams. 

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you.
