data.title: System Software Engineer - Infrastructure
data.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It's a unique legacy of innovation that's fueled by great technology-and amazing people. 

Today, we're tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. 

Do you derive more satisfaction from eliminating a manual process than from completing one? Are you the resident tool-builder and creative solution specialist on your team? We're looking for the engineer who invents, crafts and overall automates everything they touch. AI, scripts, workflow redesigns, documentation - it's all at your disposal to empower teams making the world's best firmware for the world's best GPUs. 

Join us, the GPU Firmware Infrastructure team, whose mission is crafting extraordinary automation, tools, and practices that accelerate NVIDIA's GPU innovation. We're responsible for the substrate: dev tools, build compute, test farms, artifact and release pipelines, secure signing services, and the observability that proves it all works. When our platforms are fast and trustworthy, every product ships faster! This is your chance to make waves in the industry while working alongside some of the most top-valued diverse set of minds in the business, building the best AI Supercomputers. If you're up for the task, we'd like to hear from you!

What You'll Be Doing

- Build, supervise, and improve the core infrastructure our firmware teams run on: build systems, regression farms, CI/CD pipelines, developer tooling, and the frameworks and web services that sit on top of them
 - Debug and resolve issues across hardware, software, infrastructure, and team processes - solving not just the present problem, but for that entire class of issue in the future
 - Invent and build AI-powered workflows that scale to multiply your own, your team's, or the whole company's output
 - Learn, document, and automate processes, services, and tooling for teams via many internal-facing and external-facing projects
 - Seek out, identify and eradicate toil company-wide by growing your ideas for improvements from a proof-of-concept to fully shipped and scalable solutions

What We Need To See

- BS or MS degree in EE/CS/CE (or equivalent experience) and 5+ years of software, infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE engineering
 - Hands-on experience with modern CI/CD and test automation: architecting and debugging pipelines, working inside the frameworks that orchestrate the tests (pytest or equivalent)
 - History in, or curiosity about device BIOS, firmware, or other low-level embedded software, and interest in building tooling for the engineers who write it
 - Solid understanding of the services and data behind infrastructure: web services, REST APIs, relational databases and schema design (SQL, PostgreSQL)
 - Scalability thinking
 - Strong Python and comfort working in Linux shell environments
 - Strong communication skills: ability to articulate the sharp questions, write clear requirements, review critically, and explain trade-offs
 - Exceptional interpersonal and empathy skills, and the curiosity to match as you'll work closely with both hardware and software engineers to design, develop, and debug process and tooling enhancements

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Sense of humor heavily encouraged, but not required
 - A side project, open source contribution, or internal tool you built because something annoyed you enough
 - Track record of writing clear technical proposals, design docs, or architecture decisions that others have acted on independently
 - Experience with containers, orchestration, or infrastructure-as-code tooling (K8s)
 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools: knowing what's trustworthy, when to be diligent, and when to throw away the output

Widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www. nvidiabenefits. com/

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - AWS
data.description:
Title: Senior Software Engineer - AWS

Location: Hyderabad, India(Onsite)

Fulltime

Qualifications

Required: 

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 6+ years of relevant software engineering experience building cloud-native applications, APIs, data services, integration services, or enterprise digital platform capabilities. 
 - Strong hands-on experience designing and building AWS serverless solutions using services such as Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, Event Bridge, S3, Glue, DynamoDB, Aurora, RDS, CloudWatch, IAM, and related AWS services. 
 - Experience building AWS ETL services and data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, enrichment, validation, orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, error handling, replay, and production support. 
 - Strong API development experience, including REST APIs, Graph APIs, API lifecycle management, authentication, authorization, throttling, error handling, versioning, and performance optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS database services and data modeling patterns across relational, NoSQL, and graph-oriented workloads. 
 - Experience with Graph API and graph database concepts on AWS, including relationship modeling, graph queries, connected data patterns, and graph-powered customer experience or search use cases. 
 - Experience integrating AWS services with digital experience platforms such as Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Product Information Management (PIM), Coveo Search, eCommerce platforms, content platforms, or customer-facing web applications. 
 - Experience configuring and supporting CDN platforms such as Akamai, Wangsu, or similar services, including origin configuration, cache rules, TTLs, invalidation/purge processes, routing behavior, and caching strategies for customer-facing web applications and APIs. 
 - Experience designing, supporting, or integrating AWS-based product data cache capabilities or product data services that support customer-facing web, search, content, commerce, or digital experience platforms. 
 - Must have strong hands-on programming experience in either Node. js or Python for building APIs, ETL services, automation, backend services, and cloud-native AWS integrations. 
 - Solid understanding of event-driven architecture, microservices, asynchronous processing, message-based integration, serverless design patterns, data quality, and scalable cloud operations. 
 - Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, observability, logging, monitoring, performance tuning, incident response, and production support for cloud services.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer Rust- Assistant Vice President
data.description:
Department Overview

The Equities Technology division is responsible for building and maintaining the high-performance, ultra-low-latency trading infrastructure that powers our global equities business. This includes market data dissemination, order routing, algorithmic execution, smart order routing (SOR), and real-time risk management systems. We operate in a highly competitive environment where microseconds matter, requiring cutting-edge software engineering practices, deep hardware-software co-design, and robust system reliability. 

Role Summary

We are seeking an exceptional Senior Software Engineer with deep expertise in Rust and C++ to join our Equities Low-Latency Trading Technology team. 

In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize our next-generation trading systems. You will lead the strategic transition of legacy high-performance C++ components to modern Rust where safety and concurrency are paramount, while continuing to maintain and optimize critical ultra-low-latency C++ execution paths. This is a highly technical role requiring a strong understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, network protocols, and modern software engineering paradigms. 

Key Responsibilities And Skills

8+ YOE is a must have

- System Design & Development
 - Architect, build, and maintain ultra-low-latency trading systems, including exchange connectivity gateways, market data feeds, and algorithmic execution engines using Rust and C++
 - Design clean, modular, and reusable APIs and libraries that can be leveraged across multiple trading desks. 
 - Lead the strategic migration of critical trading components from C++ to Rust, leveraging Rust's memory safety and concurrency guarantees without sacrificing performance. 
 - Performance Optimization
 - Profile and optimize systems to achieve sub-microsecond latencies and deterministic performance. 
 - Apply low-latency techniques such as CPU pinning, cache-friendly data structures, lock-free programming, memory-mapped files, and custom memory allocators. 
 - Utilize kernel bypass technologies (e. g. , Solarflare OpenOnload, DPDK, EF_VI) to minimize network stack overhead. 
 - Concurrency & Reliability
 - Design and implement highly concurrent, thread-safe, and lock-free algorithms to handle massive throughput with minimal jitter. 
 - Implement rigorous testing methodologies, including unit testing, integration testing, property-based testing (in Rust), and high-fidelity simulation/back testing environments. 
 - Ensure the high availability and operational resilience of trading systems through robust error handling and failover mechanisms. 
 - Collaboration & Support
 - Work closely with quantitative researchers, traders, and product managers to translate complex trading strategies and business requirements into robust, production-ready software. 
 - Build real-time telemetry, monitoring, and alerting tools to ensure operational visibility. 
 - Provide level-3 escalation support for production systems during market hours. 

Required Technical Skills & Qualifications

Programming Languages

- C++: Expert-level proficiency in C++ (C++11/14/17/20), with a deep understanding of template metaprogramming, RAII, move semantics, smart pointers, and the standard library (STL). 
 - Rust: Strong proficiency in Rust, including ownership/borrowing concepts, lifetimes, unsafe Rust boundaries, macro systems, and the Cargo ecosystem. 

Systems Programming & Low-Latency

- Deep understanding of Linux operating system internals (kernel tuning, memory management, virtual memory, page faults, system calls). 
 - Experience with low-latency networking (TCP/IP, UDP, Multicast) and socket programming. 
 - Familiarity with hardware-level concepts: CPU cache hierarchies (L1/L2/L3), TLB, branch prediction, and memory barriers. 

Concurrency

- Proven experience in multi-threaded programming, memory models (sequential consistency, acquire-release), and lock-free data structures. 

Equities Domain Knowledge

- Solid understanding of Equities market structure, order types, exchange protocols (FIX, OUCH, ITCH), and trading lifecycles. 

Tools & Infrastructure

- Experience with profiling and debugging tools (gdb, valgrind, perf, VTune, heaptrack). 
 - Proficiency with build systems (CMake, Cargo) and CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions). 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with FPGA integration or hardware acceleration. 
 - Experience with kernel bypass technologies (Solarflare EF_VI, OpenOnload, DPDK). 
 - Knowledge of market-making, smart order routing (SOR), or statistical arbitrage execution strategies. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related quantitative field. 

Core Competencies

- Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze complex systems and identify performance bottlenecks. 
 - Collaboration: Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional team environment. 
 - Adaptability: Eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving business requirements and market conditions. 
 - Quality Focus: Commitment to writing clean, well-documented, and thoroughly tested code.

data.title: Lead Developer - Java and Microservices
data.description:
We are seeking a highly experienced and technically accomplished Application Dev Lead to join our team, responsible for architecting, developing, and leading our core banking integration strategies and modern microservices ecosystem. The ideal candidate will be a subject matter expert in integration technologies, possess deep, hands-on expertise in Java Microservices and enterprise Database engineering (Oracle/SQL), have extensive knowledge of the financial services domain, and demonstrate a proven track record of leading technical teams to deliver robust, scalable, and secure solutions. 

This role requires a unique blend of hands-on technical excellence, architectural vision, database performance optimization, and strong people management skills to drive the modernization and stability of our mission-critical banking systems. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Leadership & People Management

- Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead, manage, and mentor a high-performing team of developers, backend engineers, and integration specialists, fostering technical capability, career growth, and engineering excellence across Java microservices and middleware platforms. 
 - Project & Delivery Ownership: Take full ownership of technical delivery across complex integration initiatives, including architectural scoping, task breakdown (WBS), accurate sprint estimation, resource planning, and milestone prioritization. 
 - Quality Assurance & Engineering Governance: Enforce best-in-class engineering practices by conducting rigorous code reviews, pull request audits, and comprehensive architectural design reviews (TDRs). 
 - Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate seamlessly across business lines, enterprise architecture, database administrators, infrastructure, Information Security, and third-party vendor teams to align technical delivery with strategic business goals. 
 - SME & Agile Delivery: Act as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for complex escalations, production incident triage (Sev-1/MIM), and root-cause analysis, while driving Agile/Scrum ceremonies to ensure predictable, high-quality, and timely delivery. 

Technical & Domain Responsibilities

- Java Microservices Architecture: Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, containerized Java microservices using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and RESTful/gRPC APIs, implementing distributed resilience patterns (Saga orchestrations, Circuit Breakers, Bulkheads, Outbox pattern). 
 - Database Engineering & Query Performance: Design robust database models and persistence layers (Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, JDBC), execute query tuning, analyze execution plans (EXPLAIN PLAN), optimize indexing strategies (B-Tree, Bitmap, composite), and resolve connection pool (HikariCP) and row-level locking contentions in enterprise Oracle/SQL environments. 
 - High-Availability Integration Design: Design and implement resilient, distributed integration solutions prioritizing active-active high availability (HA), fault tolerance, multi-region disaster recovery (DR), recoverability, and minimal business disruption. 
 - Legacy-to-Cloud Modernization: Lead the architectural evolution and phased decomposition of legacy centralized middleware (TIBCO BusinessWorks, IBM MQ) into distributed, event-driven architectures utilizing Apache Kafka and cloud-native Java microservices. 
 - Banking Domain Systems Integration: Apply deep expertise in banking and financial services to integration architecture, specifically in real-time fraud detection, payment processing rails (ISO 20022, SWIFT, Fedwire, ACH), clearing and settlement, and core enterprise banking ledgers. 
 - Security, Audit & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all integration services strictly comply with enterprise security baselines, audit controls, regulatory mandates (OCC, Fed, PRA, MAS), data protection rules (PII, PCI-DSS), Mutual TLS (mTLS) certificate management, and operational resilience standards. 
 - High-Volume Real-Time Messaging: Oversee the architecture, throughput tuning, and management of real-time transaction flows, high-volume messaging pipelines, dead-letter queue (DLQ) automation, and sub-second SLA routing. 

Recommended Qualifications

Core Technical Skills

- Java & Microservices: 
 - Advanced proficiency in Core Java (Java 11/17/21), Multithreading, Concurrency, and JVM tuning (Memory management, Garbage Collection - G1GC/ZGC). 
 - Hands-on mastery of Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Batch). 
 - Deep experience with Microservices patterns (Saga Orchestration/Choreography, CQRS, Circuit Breaker via Resilience4j, API Gateway routing). 
 - Containerization and orchestration experience using Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift. 
 - Database & Data Persistence: 
 - Advanced expertise in Relational Databases: Oracle (19c+), SQL, PL/SQL, stored procedures, functions, packages, and triggers. 
 - Deep knowledge of Query Performance Tuning, Execution Plan analysis (EXPLAIN PLAN), index design, partitioning, and stats gathering. 
 - Mastery of connection pool management (HikariCP), lock contention mitigation, deadlock resolution, and transaction isolation levels (READ COMMITTED, SERIALIZABLE). 
 - Solid understanding of ORM frameworks (Hibernate, JPA) and mitigation of ORM antipatterns (N+1 queries, dirty checks). 
 - Enterprise Middleware & Messaging: 
 - Subject Matter Expertise in TIBCO technologies: TIBCO BusinessWorks (BW 5. x / 6. x), TIBCO Enterprise Message Service (EMS), TIBCO Administrator/TEA. 
 - In-depth experience with enterprise queuing and streaming: IBM MQ and Apache Kafka (Topic design, Partitioning, Consumer Groups, Schema Registry). 
 - APIs & Protocols: 
 - Contract-first API development: RESTful Web Services, OpenAPI/Swagger, SOAP Web Services, gRPC.

About The Role

We're looking for a hands-on Java Developer with 4-5 years of experience who combines solid engineering fundamentals with sharp problem-solving instincts. You'll design and build scalable backend systems, write clean and maintainable code, and work fluidly with modern AI-assisted development tools to ship quality software fast. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain robust, high-performance backend applications in Java. 
 - Contribute to architecture decisions - service design, data modeling, API contracts, and scalability trade-offs. 
 - Design, build, and operate microservices, including inter-service communication, resilience, and deployment. 
 - Instrument services for observability - logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and alerting - to ensure reliability in production. 
 - Write clean, well-tested, production-grade code and participate in code reviews. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted / "vibe coding" tools (e. g. , Copilot, Claude, Cursor) to prototype and deliver features efficiently, while maintaining full ownership and understanding of the output. 
 - Debug complex issues across the stack and reason through ambiguous problems independently. 
 - Collaborate with product, QA, and DevOps to deliver end-to-end features. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- 4-5 years of professional Java development experience. 
 - Strong grasp of core Java, OOP, collections, concurrency, and the JVM. 
 - Solid experience with Spring / Spring Boot and building RESTful APIs. 
 - Architecture: Proven ability to design scalable, maintainable systems; understanding of microservices, design patterns, and system design principles. 
 - Microservices: Hands-on experience building and running microservices - service decomposition, REST/gRPC communication, API gateways, and resilience patterns (circuit breakers, retries). 
 - Observability: Practical experience with logging, metrics, and distributed tracing using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, or similar. 
 - Coding: Clean-code discipline, strong testing habits (JUnit/Mockito), and Git-based workflows. 
 - Vibe coding: Comfortable and productive with AI-assisted coding tools; able to prompt, review, and refine AI-generated code rather than blindly accept it. 
 - Analytical ability (high IQ): Excellent logical reasoning and problem-solving skills; able to break down complex problems and learn new concepts quickly. 
 - Experience with SQL and at least one relational database. 
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure) and CI/CD pipelines. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and caching (Redis). 
 - Containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Exposure to event-driven or distributed systems at scale. 

What We Offer

- Ownership of meaningful, high-impact work. 
 - A modern, AI-forward engineering culture. 

Benefits

We like to think that talent grows at Ginesys and stays at Ginesys. To ensure this, we provide our employees with the best working environment, the latest technology and continuous support. We go out of our way to retain the small business feeling with which we started and stimulate innovation and collaboration through teamwork and our non-hierarchical approach.  - Excellent rewards and recognition policy

 - Travelling opportunities between our offices across the country.

Ginesys is India's best omniretail suite, the first integrated Retail specific ERP software for online and offline retail and distribution. It is the largest Indian company in the retail tech industry catering to both online and offline needs. 1200 + brands including (Manyavar, V-Mart, Skechers) are accelerating their businesses with Ginesys. With a team of 300+ employees, Ginesys One plans to revolutionize retail by being a single-stop cloud-based retail suite. 

We have a pan India presence with offices in major cities including Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai & Goa and are expanding rapidly. We love the challenges of retail and are busy solving them to create a great retail tech suite.

data.title: Senior Testing Lead - Automation, Performance, Security & Functional QA
data.description:
Position: Senior Testing Lead - Automation, Performance, Security & Functional QA

Location: Hyderabad ( 8 PM to 5 AM IST)

Work Type: Full-Time/Onsite

Experience: 8+ Years

PETADATA is looking for a highly experienced Senior Testing Lead with 8+ years of experience to own the overall quality strategy, build and scale test automation, and lead functional, performance, security, API, and data-validation testing for a data migration platform operating across cloud and on-premise environments. 

Roles & Responsibilities Quality Strategy & Leadership

- Own and define the overall QA and testing strategy across functional, automation, performance, security, and data-integrity testing. 
 - Establish quality gates, release criteria, testing standards, metrics, and reporting. 
 - Identify and prioritize testing efforts based on business and technical risk, especially data-correctness risks. 
 - Build and manage the quality function with minimal supervision. 
 - Mentor developers and QA engineers and promote a quality-first engineering culture. 
 - Partner closely with Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Security, and Implementation teams. 

Test Automation

- Design and build test automation frameworks from scratch. 
 - Develop automated UI, API, integration, and regression testing solutions. 
 - Use tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, and REST/API automation frameworks. 
 - Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Build scalable regression suites that improve release velocity and confidence. 
 - Use programming languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java for automation. 

Functional & Migration Testing

- Own end-to-end functional testing across supported CRM platforms and migration scenarios. 
 - Test standard and custom objects, relationships, transformations, mappings, and edge cases. 
 - Design test scenarios based on real-world customer data migration use cases. 
 - Validate migration correctness from source to destination. 
 - Test multi-tenant behavior, configuration, and tenant data isolation. 
 - Identify defects and ensure issues are properly investigated, resolved, and prevented from recurring. 

Data Validation & Integrity

- Build automated source-to-target data validation frameworks. 
 - Validate: 
 - Record counts 
 - Field-level accuracy 
 - Data mappings 
 - Relationships and associations 
 - Transformations 
 - Deduplication 
 - Overall data integrity 
 - Use SQL and programmatic validation techniques to verify migration results. 
 - Ensure migrated customer data remains complete, accurate, and consistent. Performance Testing

- Design and execute load, stress, scalability, and performance testing. 
 - Test large data volumes and high numbers of concurrent migrations. 
 - Establish performance baselines, benchmarks, and SLAs. 
 - Identify performance bottlenecks and work with Engineering and Architecture teams to resolve them. 
 - Use tools such as k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust. 
 - Integrate appropriate performance testing into the CI/CD pipeline. 

Security Testing

- Perform and coordinate security testing across the application and platform. 
 - Test tenant isolation and ensure no cross-tenant data access is possible. 
 - Validate authentication and authorization controls. 
 - Perform input validation and abuse-case testing. 
 - Integrate SAST, DAST, and vulnerability scanning into CI/CD. 
 - Coordinate penetration testing with internal security teams and external security vendors. 
 - Support security and compliance requirements such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001 through appropriate testing evidence. 

Technical Quality & Delivery

- Ensure software is secure, scalable, reliable, and production-ready. 
 - Establish automated quality checks throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Collaborate with developers to identify defects early. 
 - Review testing approaches and improve overall engineering quality. 
 - Support both cloud and on-premise deployments. 
 - Help establish reliable test environments using cloud, containers, and infrastructure automation. 

Note: Should be highly self-directed, comfortable building the QA function from the ground up, and able to work effectively with distributed engineering teams across required time zones. 

Note: Should be able to work independently and work in USA time zones

Required Skills

- 8+ years of professional QA / Test Engineering experience. 
 - Strong experience leading QA strategy and quality engineering for software products. 
 - Strong hands-on experience building test automation frameworks from scratch. 
 - Proficiency with Playwright, Cypress, and/or Selenium. 
 - Strong API and REST testing experience. 
 - Strong programming experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience with functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Strong experience with performance/load testing using JMeter, k6, Gatling, Locust, or similar tools. 
 - Working knowledge of security testing, including OWASP, authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, SAST, DAST, and vulnerability scanning. 
 - Strong SQL and data-validation experience. 
 - Experience validating source-to-target data integrity across multiple systems. 
 - Strong understanding of data migration, ETL, integration, or data-intensive applications. 
 - Experience testing multi-tenant SaaS applications. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Experience with on-premise/customer-deployed software is preferred. 
 - Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar CRM platforms is a plus. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, containers, and IaC is a plus. 
 - Exposure to chaos/resilience testing or contract testing is a plus. 
 - Experience supporting SOC 2 / ISO 27001 or other compliance audits is preferred. 
 - Strong problem-solving, communication, leadership, ownership, and decision-making skills. 
 - Ability to independently establish testing processes, frameworks, quality standards, and release criteria. 

Education

Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is preferred. 

Candidates must attend phone/video calls and in-person interviews as required. After selection, candidates will undergo background checks on Education and Experience. 

Please email your resume to pavanm@petadata. ai

After carefully reviewing your experience and skills, one of our HR team members will contact you about the next steps.

Job Description / Area of Responsibility

- Enable the plant's growth from approximately €250 million to €600 million by 2030 by achieving customer quality targets, securing timely APQP/PPAP and quality-gate approvals, ensuring launch readiness, and maintaining stable serial-production quality and delivery performance. 
 - Develop and execute a multi-year plant quality strategy aligned with the 2030 growth plan. Translate business objectives into departmental targets, resources, competencies, technology investments, audit plans, and budgets. 
 - Maintain the Quality Management System and required automotive certifications, and report performance and risks to plant and business leadership. 
 - Drive profitability by reducing scrap, rework, process rejection, sorting, premium freight, warranty, and customer-complaint costs. 
 - Establish measurable cost-of-poor-quality targets, robust root-cause analysis, effective corrective and preventive actions, and continuous improvement across the plant. 
 - Lead quality planning and industrialization for new products, customers, production lines, transfers, and technologies. 
 - Ensure robust APQP, design and process risk analysis, control plans, measurement concepts, capability validation, traceability, safe-launch controls, and release criteria for complex safety-critical mechatronic products. 
 - Define, implement, and continuously improve plant-wide quality assurance for incoming material, mechanical manufacturing and assembly, electric-motor processes, electronics/PCBA production, SMT lines, final inspection, and product release. Ensure effective process controls, equipment and measurement-system capability, soldering and assembly quality, traceability, change control, layered process audits, product audits, quality gates, error-proofing, and rapid containment of deviations. Job Description

JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Firmware Developer - Thermal Application

Location - Pune Chakan

Position Summary

The Senior Firmware Developer - Thermal Application engineer will be responsible for leading the design, development, validation, and support of electrical and electronic systems for HVAC equipment, with strong hands‐on experience in screw chiller machines and thermal products. This role involves technical leadership, cross‐functional coordination, and end‐to‐end ownership of electrical, controls, and integration activities throughout the product lifecycle-from concept to commissioning. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design and development of electrical and electronic systems for HVAC machines, including screw chillers and thermal products. 
 - Prepare, review, and approve electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, control panel layouts, interlock logic, and BOMs. 
 - Select and integrate electrical and electronic components such as VFDs, controllers, PLCs, HMIs, sensors, protection devices, and safety components. 
 - Lead and support PLC and HMI programming activities, including control logic review, I/O allocation, tag mapping, alarm handling, and parameter optimization. 
 - Drive BMS integration (BACnet / Modbus or equivalent), including points list definition, signal mapping, validation, and coordination with site/BMS teams. 
 - Support control philosophy development and close integration of electrical systems with controls and embedded software. 
 - Drive design validation testing (DVT), dry testing, performance testing, and troubleshooting in lab and factory environments. 
 - Lead root cause analysis and corrective action implementation for electrical and controls‐related issues identified during testing or field operation. 
 - Support commissioning, field issues, and service escalations related to electrical, controls, and automation systems. 
 - Coordinate with Mechanical, Software, Product Management, QA, Sourcing, and Service teams to ensure successful product execution. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable electrical standards, safety norms, cybersecurity guidelines (where applicable), and regulatory requirements. 
 - Support component localization, alternate sourcing, and cost optimization initiatives without compromising performance or reliability. 
 - Provide technical guidance, reviews, and mentoring to junior engineers and team members. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Instrumentation Engineering (or equivalent). 
 - 4 to 6 years of relevant industry experience, preferably in HVAC, industrial machinery, or automation systems. 
 - Strong machine‐level experience with HVAC systems, particularly screw chiller machines and thermal products. 
 - Deep knowledge of industrial electrical systems, power distribution, control panels, safety circuits, and VFD applications. 
 - Solid working experience with PLC and HMI programming in industrial or HVAC applications. 
 - Proven exposure to BMS integration using standard industrial protocols such as BACnet and Modbus. 
 - Working knowledge of programming languages such as C, C++, Structured Text (ST), and Function Block Diagram (FBD); ability to review logic and coordinate with software teams. 
 - Hands‐on experience in testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting complex HVAC and automation systems. 
 - Proficient in reading and interpreting electrical drawings, control schematics, functional descriptions, and technical specifications. 
 - Strong analytical, problem‐solving, communication, and team‐leadership skills.

Description

Come join our growing Hyperforce Enterprise Security organization. We are chartered with architecting, implementing, and operating security solutions that protect Salesforce's complex, multi-cloud technology landscape at scale. 

As a Principal Member of Technical Staff, you will provide technical leadership in building the next generation of infrastructure security and developer security guardrails. You will work across the software development and deployment lifecycle to identify security risks early, build scalable controls, and enable secure-by-default engineering practices without compromising developer velocity. 

Our team operates at the intersection of cloud security, application security, infrastructure security, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and runtime security. We build and operate security guardrails that identify and prevent high-risk security issues from source code and Infrastructure as Code through CI/CD and into runtime environments. 

You will be expected to operate at both strategic and hands-on technical levels, defining architecture and technical direction while also diving deeply into complex engineering problems, writing production-quality code, and driving solutions from concept through deployment and operation. 

This role is an opportunity to shape security capabilities that operate at significant scale across Salesforce infrastructure and to influence how security is embedded throughout the engineering lifecycle. 

Responsibilities

- Act as a technical leader and subject matter expert for infrastructure security and security guardrails, providing architectural direction across teams. 
 - Design and build scalable shift-left security capabilities that identify security risks in source code, Infrastructure as Code, containerized workloads, and deployment configurations before they reach production. 
 - Architect and build shift-left security controls that identify security risks early while providing developers with actionable findings and straightforward remediation paths. 
 - Design scalable policy-as-code and security enforcement frameworks for consistent security controls across multiple gates and environments. 
 - Drive risk-based security engineering by identifying exploitable, high-impact, and meaningful security risks rather than treating all scanner findings equally. 
 - Design mechanisms for security finding correlation, prioritization, deduplication, and enforcement when signals originate from multiple security systems. 
 - Lead architecture and implementation of Kubernetes admission control and workload security capabilities. 
 - Define technical strategies for reliability, scalability, performance, observability, fault tolerance, and operational readiness of security services. 
 - Establish and evolve SLIs, SLOs, telemetry, rollout strategies, and operational practices for critical security services. 
 - Own technical outcomes across the complete lifecycle - requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, production readiness, rollout, and ongoing operations. 
 - Continuously identify opportunities to improve security coverage, automation, detection quality, enforcement, and developer experience. 
 - Establish engineering standards and best practices for reliability, scalability, observability, testing, and operational readiness of security services. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar across the organization. 
 - Influence technical strategy and roadmap decisions across teams and drive initiatives from concept through production. 
 - Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow by pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high-quality code. 
 - Design and orchestrate complex systems where AI agents integrate seamlessly into human workflows, driving efficiency and innovation at scale.

 - Strong understanding of security engineering concepts including vulnerability management, configuration security, policy enforcement, workload security, identity/access controls, and risk assessment.

 - Preferred Qualifications

data.title: Director of Engineering- Frontend
data.description:
About The Role

ThoughtSpot is looking for a bold, technically fearless Director of Engineering to lead the Connected Insights track - the heart of ThoughtSpot's visualization, navigation, and frontend experience. This track spans three high-impact teams: FE Infra (module federation, client caching, build systems, performance, and developer platform tooling), Charts (the rendering engine for ThoughtSpot's visualization library, from core charting primitives to agent-driven chart configuration via the Answer API), and Liveboard (the primary interactive canvas in ThoughtSpot - architecture, presentation & interactivity, agent integration, and the AI-driven Liveboard experience). 

This is a pivotal moment for the Connected Insights track. The frontend tech stack is deep and modern - React, GraphQL, module federation, complex state management - and the architecture is ready for a thoughtful rethink. We need someone who will question assumptions, challenge the status quo, and bring the curiosity and technical horsepower to redesign for the next era of ThoughtSpot's scale and AI-first product vision. 

Equally important: the bug backlog is real. This leader must approach quality differently - not just as a process checkbox, but as an engineering culture and operational discipline that the team owns and takes pride in. 

What You'll Do

Lead & Scale Three Frontend -Heavy Teams

- Own the engineering roadmap, headcount, and technical vision for FE Infra, Charts, and Liveboard - three teams with deep React and TypeScript DNA. 
 - Be an active presence in architecture forums and design reviews - not just signing off, but shaping technical direction hands-on. 
 - Build and develop engineering managers and senior ICs into the next generation of ThoughtSpot leaders. 
 - Hire relentlessly for intellectual curiosity, ownership mindset, and frontend depth. 

Rethink the Architecture

- Audit the current architecture across module federation, client cache design, state management, rendering performance, and component system - and build a compelling vision for what comes next. 
 - Lead the move to a scalable, maintainable, and AI-ready frontend foundation that can power ThoughtSpot's Spotter, SpotterViz, and next-generation Liveboard experiences. 
 - Drive architectural decisions with first-principles thinking, not convention - question every assumption about how the frontend is structured today. 
 - Define and own the technical north star for frontend infrastructure, charting capabilities, and interactive Liveboard experiences. 

Attack the Bug Backlog & Raise the Quality Bar

- Treat the bug backlog as a cultural and operational challenge, not just a ticket queue - instill a quality-first mindset across all three teams. 
 - Build operational systems (on-call hygiene, bug SLAs, regression prevention, automated testing frameworks) that structurally reduce bug accumulation. 
 - Define quality metrics that the teams live by - not just defect counts, but incident response time, customer-impacting regressions, and release reliability. 
 - Partner with customer success and support to close the loop between customer-facing bugs and engineering accountability. 

Drive Cross-Functional Impact

- Work tightly with Product, Design, and the AI/Spotter teams to ensure the frontend platform keeps pace with an increasingly AI-native product surface. 
 - Represent the Connected Insights track in R&D staff reviews, quarterly planning, and executive discussions with clarity, data, and conviction. 
 - Be the connective tissue between what customers experience in the UI and what engineering builds - customer obsession must be visible in every architectural and process decision. 

What You Have

Non-Negotiables

- 15+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5+ years in senior engineering leadership (Director level or above) managing multiple teams. 
 - Deep hands-on frontend engineering background - production React, GraphQL caching patterns, module federation, and the modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem at scale. 
 - Proven track record of architectural reinvention - you've led a team through a meaningful frontend re-architecture, not just incremental improvement. 
 - Track record of raising quality standards in a team with a meaningful bug backlog - you know how to make this cultural, not just procedural. 
 - Excellent judgment in hiring, developing, and retaining senior IC and EM talent. 
 - Strong communication and cross-functional influence - comfortable presenting to executive leadership and working shoulder-to-shoulder with product and design. 

Strongly Valued

- Experience building or scaling visualization/charting systems - chart rendering performance, SVG/Canvas tradeoffs, animation, responsive design at scale. 
 - Familiarity with AI-integrated product surfaces - building frontend systems that adapt to and expose LLM/NLP capabilities to end users. 
 - Experience in enterprise SaaS environments with multi-tenancy, embedded analytics (SDK, iframe, component embedding), and stringent performance/security requirements. 
 - Prior experience working in geographically distributed teams, particularly with India-based engineering centers. 
 - Exposure to backend services and data pipelines - enough to have informed conversations with backend counterparts and own end-to-end product quality.

You'll work on our AI-powered products and platforms, building everything from interactive user interfaces and dashboards to APIs, backend services, integrations, and AI-powered workflows.

We're looking for someone who can take ownership of a feature end-to-end - understand the requirement, design the solution, build it, test it, and get it into production.

Full Stack Development

- Ensure applications are responsive, accessible, and performant. 

- Work closely with Product and Design teams to turn ideas into intuitive user experiences.

You'll be working in an AI-first engineering environment. 

- Integrate LLM APIs and AI capabilities into production applications. 

- Work with AI-powered workflows and intelligent automation. 

- Build or integrate agent-based systems and tool orchestration. 

- Work with AI APIs, inference workflows, prompt orchestration, and model integrations. 

- Explore new approaches to building AI-powered product experiences. 

- Stay curious about emerging AI technologies and developer tools. 

You don't need to be an AI/ML researcher. We're looking for strong software engineers who are excited about learning and building with AI. 

Quality, Performance & Reliability

- Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code. 

- Write unit and integration tests using tools such as Jest, Mocha, or Chai. 

- Debug issues across frontend, backend, APIs, and databases. 

- Identify performance bottlenecks and improve application scalability. 

- Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices.

Collaboration

- Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, AI Engineers, QA, DevOps, and other developers. 

- Participate in technical discussions and architecture decisions. 

- Break down product requirements into practical technical solutions. 

- Take ownership of features and deliver them from concept → production. 

- Contribute to a collaborative and fast-moving engineering culture. 

What we are looking for

- 2-4 years of professional experience in full-stack software development. 

- Strong experience with JavaScript / TypeScript. 

- Strong backend development experience with Node. js. 

- Good hands-on experience with React and modern frontend development. 

- Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and/or GraphQL APIs. 

- Strong understanding of MongoDB and experience with at least one SQL database such as PostgreSQL or MySQL. 

- Good understanding of asynchronous programming, promises, async/await, and event-driven architecture. 

- Experience with authentication and authorisation mechanisms such as JWT and OAuth. 

- Good understanding of software development best practices, testing, debugging, and version control. 

- Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows. 

- Ability to troubleshoot production issues and work independently. 

- Good understanding of responsive web development. 

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. 

- Good communication skills and ability to work in a cross-functional team. 

Good to Have

- Experience with AI/LLM integrations. 

- Experience working with AI agents or agentic workflows. 

- Experience with real-time systems or event-driven architectures. 

- Exposure to voice technologies, streaming, speech-to-text, or text-to-speech. 

- Experience with Redis or other caching technologies. 

- Experience with microservices architecture. 

- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. 

- Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP. 

- Experience with CI/CD pipelines. 

- Experience working in a SaaS or B2B product company. 

- Exposure to AI coding assistants and AI-powered development workflows. 

What We Value

At Enterprise Bot, we value ownership over titles. 

We're looking for someone who: 

- Doesn't wait for instructions for every step. 

- Can take a problem and figure out how to solve it. 

- Is comfortable working in a fast-changing startup environment. 

- Cares about the quality of what they build. 

- Is curious about AI and new technologies. 

- Enjoys learning and experimenting. 

- Can balance speed with good engineering practices. 

- Is comfortable working across different parts of the technology stack. 

Benefits

Join our team

If you're excited about building full-stack products and want to work where software engineering meets AI, we'd love to hear from you.

data.title: Head – Quality (Food & Nutraceutical Ingredients)
data.company: Spray Drying and Chemicals Pvt Ltd
data.description:
About the role

SDC is hiring a Head - Quality to build the quality and food safety system of a fast-scaling ingredient manufacturer, not to maintain one that already exists. 

Spray Drying and Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. (SDC) manufactures food and nutraceutical ingredients at Saykha Industrial Estate, Bharuch, Gujarat. We are FSSC 22000, Halal and Kosher certified, US FDA registered, and export to the US and EU. The plant runs 24x7, and new production lines are being added. 

Growth has outrun our systems. Documentation, batch records, specifications and audit readiness exist, but they are not yet lived on the shop floor every shift. The gap is cultural as much as technical. This role exists to close it. 

You will report directly to the Directors, own the Quality Assurance and Quality Control functions end to end, and have the mandate to change how the plant works. This is a leadership seat with a board-level voice, not a documentation role. Building systems and building culture are the two things that matter most in this role; everything else follows from them. 

Role at a glance

• Reports to: Directors

• Direct reports: QA and QC teams (team leads, executives, analysts)

• Base: Surat Head Office, with presence at the Saykha (Bharuch) plant at least 3 days a week and whenever the plant needs it

• Key interfaces: Production, Engineering, Projects, Warehouse, R&D, Purchase, Sales, customers, auditors, certification bodies, FSSAI

• Scope: Full accountability for food safety, quality systems, QC laboratory, compliance, customer quality and quality culture across the site

What you will own

You are accountable for outcomes, delivered through your team. Culture and systems are the priority; they are where the role will be judged first. 

1. Quality culture and leadership

• Make food safety and quality a shop-floor habit on every shift, not a QA-department activity. 

• Build a culture where operators stop a line, raise a deviation and record it honestly without fear. 

• Lead, structure and grow the QA and QC teams: roles, KRAs, training plans, succession and performance. 

• Act as the senior voice for quality with Production and Engineering; resolve quality-versus-output conflicts at the leadership level. 

• Run a visible quality rhythm: daily shop-floor rounds, weekly quality reviews, monthly management review with the Directors. 

2. Quality and food safety management systems

• Own the FSMS and QMS end to end: FSSC 22000, ISO 22000, HACCP, GMP, GHP, PRPs and allergen management. 

• Build and maintain the full documentation architecture: manuals, SOPs, work instructions, formats, records and document control. 

• Design and govern Batch Manufacturing Records: issue, in-process checks, label verification, post-production review and release. 

• Run the CAPA, deviation, change-control and non-conformance systems so that root causes are found and closed, not just logged. 

• Own validation, verification, calibration and the internal audit programme. 

3. Quality control and laboratory

• Set specifications and test plans for raw materials, packaging, in-process material and finished goods. 

• Run the QC laboratory: methods, instruments, calibration, reference standards, analyst competence and data integrity. 

• Manage external laboratory testing and the testing schedule required by certifications and customers. 

• Own the release decision for every batch. 

4. Compliance, certifications and audits

• Keep SDC audit-ready at all times for FSSC 22000, Halal, Kosher, organic, US FDA and FSSAI. 

• Lead all certification, regulatory and customer audits; own the response and closure of findings. 

• Track Indian and international regulatory change (FSSAI, US FDA, EU) and translate it into plant practice. 

• Own supplier quality: approval, specifications, audits and performance for imported raw materials and packaging. 

5. Customer quality

• Own customer complaints: investigation, root cause, response and prevention. 

• Deliver customer quality documentation: questionnaires, specifications, certificates, statements and technical files, working with Sales. 

• Support customer audits and technical visits as the quality face of SDC. 

6. Systems for scale

• Design the quality system for the new production lines so new capacity starts compliant on day one. 

• Digitise quality records and dashboards in SDC's internal ERP; replace paper where it slows the plant. 

• Define and report quality KPIs to the Directors: right-first-time, deviations, CAPA closure, complaints, audit findings, training coverage. 

7. New product development and regulatory

• Own the quality and regulatory workstream for every new product: specifications, test methods, shelf-life and stability studies, allergen and contaminant assessment. 

• Prepare and maintain process validation, cleaning validation and method validation documentation for new products and new lines. 

• Build the regulatory file for each new product: FSSAI compliance, export market requirements (US FDA, EU), labelling and claims, certification scope extensions (Halal, Kosher, organic). 

• Work with R&D from concept stage so that products reach the plant with specifications, controls and documentation already in place. 

What success looks like in the first 12 months

By 90 days: a gap assessment of the plant against FSSC 22000, GMP and customer requirements with a prioritised closure plan agreed with the Directors; the QA/QC team mapped with capability gaps and a hiring or training plan; daily quality rounds and a weekly quality review running and attended by Production. 

By 6 months: BMR, deviation and CAPA systems redesigned and in use on every shift; SOP and document-control architecture rebuilt; shop-floor training programme live with coverage tracked by shift and role; quality KPIs reported monthly to the Directors. 

By 12 months: a surveillance or recertification audit passed with no major non-conformance; customer complaints closed with documented root cause within an agreed turnaround; quality system ready for the new production lines before commissioning; quality decisions made at floor and team-lead level without escalation to the Directors. 

Who we are looking for

A quality leader who has already built or rebuilt a system in a growing food plant and wants to do it again with full ownership. 

Experience

• 10-15 years in quality assurance and quality control in food, nutraceutical, dairy, flavour or food-ingredient manufacturing; at least 4 years heading or deputy-heading a plant quality function. 

• Has personally led a site through FSSC 22000 or ISO 22000 certification, or through a major system rebuild; has faced customer and regulatory audits as the accountable person. 

• Experience in an export-oriented B2B ingredient business supplying US or EU customers is a strong advantage. 

• Experience with powder, drying, blending or encapsulation processes is an advantage; a strong learner from an adjacent food sector will also be considered. 

• Has built or led a team of 8 or more across QA and QC. 

Education and certifications

• B. Tech, B. Sc or M. Sc in Food Technology, Dairy Technology, Microbiology, Chemistry or a related discipline. 

• FSSC 22000 or ISO 22000 lead auditor; HACCP certification. PCQI (US FDA FSMA) is an advantage. 

Competencies that matter here

• Changes behaviour on a shop floor, not just documents in an office; comfortable spending most of the day in the plant. 

• Holds the line on quality with Production under output pressure, and does it without creating enemies. 

• Builds systems that survive without them: clear ownership, simple formats, trained people. 

• Finds root causes; is not satisfied by a CAPA that only reassigns blame. 

• Communicates clearly in English and Gujarati or Hindi with operators, Directors, auditors and overseas customers. 

• Thrives in a company where structure is still being built and ambiguity is normal. 

Why join SDC

• Build, not maintain. You will design the quality system of a plant that is adding new production lines, and it will carry your name. 

• Direct access to the Directors. No layers. Decisions on budget, hiring and plant changes happen in the same week they are raised. 

• Global customers. Our products go into food and nutraceutical brands in the US, EU and Asia; your work is tested against international audit standards, not local ones alone. 

• A growing platform. SDC is moving from a single-ingredient specialist to a multi-product ingredient and contract-manufacturing platform, with an in-house R&D and pilot facility. The quality function grows with it. 

• Compensation that reflects a head-of-function role. Competitive fixed salary benchmarked to established food companies, performance-linked variable pay, and relocation support for the Bharuch-Surat region. Specific terms discussed at interview. 

How to apply

Apply through LinkedIn, or email your CV to hr@sdcplindia. com

Travel Required

Experience And Education

To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Dexcom. Only authorized staffing and recruiting agencies may use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes on specific requisitions. data.title: Senior Enterprise Software Engineer (JD Edwards)
data.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a highly accomplished, hands-on Senior Lead Operations Manager to join our enterprise technology leadership team. This pivotal role blends deep technical execution with strategic leadership across four core disciplines: JD Edwards EnterpriseOne (JDE E1), IBM Integration technologies, Cloud Architecture, and emerging Artificial Intelligence practices. 

The ideal candidate is not a bystander manager - they roll up their sleeves, architect solutions, and directly contribute to development, configuration, and administration while simultaneously guiding a team of engineers and analysts. You thrive in fast-paced environments, absorb new technologies at exceptional speed, and champion a culture of continuous innovation. 

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership & Team Management

- Lead, mentor, and manage a cross-functional team of developers, CNC administrators, integration engineers, and cloud architects. 
 - Define operational KPIs, SLAs, and delivery roadmaps for all enterprise platform areas. 
 - Drive Agile/DevOps delivery practices including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives. 
 - Act as escalation point for critical incidents and ensure timely resolution with root-cause analysis. 
 - Partner with business stakeholders, functional analysts, and C-suite to translate business needs into technology solutions. 

JD Edwards EnterpriseOne - Development, Architecture & CNC Administration

- Provide hands-on technical leadership across the complete JDE E1 stack spanning custom development, functional configuration, CNC infrastructure, and Oracle database administration. 
 - Architect and develop JDE customizations using Business Functions (BSFNs), Named Event Rules (NERs), Report Design Aid (RDA), Form Design Aid (FDA), Table Design Aid (TDA), and Data Dictionary extensions. 
 - Design and deploy JDE Orchestrator Framework solutions - building orchestrations, connectors, cross-reference rules, and form requests to automate business workflows and expose JDE services as REST APIs. 
 - Lead User Defined Object (UDO) governance: Composite Pages, Watchlists, Notifications, One View Reports, and EnterpriseOne Pages configuration and lifecycle management. 
 - Architect and implement JDE integrations via Business Function calls, Interoperability (XML/Z-files), RESTful and SOAP web services, and third-party middleware adapters. 
 - Own and lead end-to-end JDE EnterpriseOne upgrade projects - from current-release assessment and gap analysis through to production cutover - including major application releases (e. g. , 9. 0 to 9. 2) and incremental Application Service Packs (ASPs). 
 - Plan and execute JDE Tools Release upgrades (e. g. , TR 9. 2. x. x series): download and stage ESU/ASU bundles from Oracle Update Center, run the Tools Release installer on Enterprise and HTML Web Servers, validate planner and spec merge, and post-upgrade regression test all critical business objects. 
 - Manage the full Application Service Update (ASU) and Electronic Software Update (ESU) lifecycle: evaluate Oracle support patches, assess object conflicts using the Object Management Workbench (OMW) conflict checker, apply updates through Change Management, and produce post-apply validation reports. 
 - Perform and document pre-upgrade checklist activities: hardware and OS prerequisite validation, Oracle Database version compatibility matrix review, JVM and WebLogic/JBoss version alignment, disk capacity planning, and backup verification. 
 - Coordinate co-existence environments during upgrade cycles - maintaining multiple tools release levels across DV, PY, and PD path codes to support parallel development, QA testing, and production stability simultaneously. 
 - Perform deep CNC administration across all JDE server tiers: Enterprise Server (Logic Server), HTML Web Server, Deployment Server, and Batch Processing / UBE Server on both Linux (RHEL / Oracle Linux) and Windows Server platforms. 
 - Provision, configure, and maintain JDE environments from scratch: stand up new logic server instances, configure jde. ini / jdbj. ini / jas. ini, define server maps, configure ports and JMX monitoring, and register environments in the Server Manager Management Console (SMMC). 
 - Administer the Deployment Server: manage path codes (PRISTINE, DEMO, DV733, PY733, PD733, and custom path codes), configure package build INI settings, maintain the Central Objects business data source, and control check-in/check-out workflows in OMW. 
 - Execute full package builds - both Full and Partial packages - including: setting package build definitions, resolving spec merge errors, monitoring Package Assembly and Deploy logs, managing the deployment queue, and validating successful client and server package deployment. 
 - Configure and manage JDE Change Management: define environments and path codes, set up promotion paths (DV -> PY -> PD), govern Object Librarian (OL) projects, manage OMW user roles and activity rules, and enforce promotion approval workflows. 
 - Administer JDE Security: configure Application Security (Action, Row, Column, Tab, Version security), Orchestrator token-based security, Single Sign-On (SSO) via SAML/LDAP integration, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) aligned with SOX and audit requirements. 
 - Manage the JDE Scheduler: configure and monitor UBE job queues, set host and subsystem job priorities, tune concurrent job limits, diagnose stuck/failed jobs, and manage batch version control and interactive server routing. 
 - Monitor and tune JDE system performance: analyze HTML Server heap dumps and GC logs, tune JVM parameters (Xmx/Xms/MaxPermSize), review logic server kernel configuration, diagnose slow UBE execution, and optimize jde. log / jdedebug. log verbosity and rotation policies. 
 - Lead new JDE environment provisioning projects end-to-end: requirements scoping, server sizing, OS-level prerequisite configuration, Oracle DB schema creation, JDE Planner installation, workbench environment setup, and handoff to development or QA teams. 
 - Build and configure additional path codes for specialized purposes (e. g. , RETROFIT, TRAINING, UAT, REPORT-DEV) - including creating new business data sources, system data sources, and object librarian data sources, and configuring server map entries accordingly. 
 - Establish and maintain Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity (BCP) environments: configure replication or restore procedures for Enterprise Server, Deployment Server, and Oracle databases; document and periodically test failover runbooks. 
 - Administer Oracle Database (versions 12c, 19c, and 21c) supporting JDE EnterpriseOne on both Oracle Linux / RHEL and Windows Server platforms - including installation, patching (PSU/CPU/RU), listener configuration, and TNS connectivity. 
 - Manage JDE-specific Oracle DB objects: Central Objects (COCTL), Business Data, Control Tables, and Versions data sources - including tablespace sizing, index management, and regular schema statistics gathering (ANALYZE / DBMS_STATS) to ensure query plan stability. 
 - Perform Oracle DBA tasks in support of JDE operations: export/import using DataPump (expdp/impdp) for environment refreshes, RMAN backup and restore, Flashback operations, AWR and ADDM performance report analysis, and deadlock/latch contention investigation via V$ views. 
 - Tune Oracle SQL performance for JDE: review execution plans using EXPLAIN PLAN and SQL Trace / TKPROF, identify and resolve full table scans on high-volume JDE tables (F0911, F4211, F43121 etc. ), create or rebuild indexes, and gather optimizer statistics on schedule. 
 - Configure and manage Oracle Data Guard or Oracle RAC (Real Application Clusters) to provide high availability for JDE production database tiers on Linux; manage redo log shipping, standby switchover/failover procedures, and TAF (Transparent Application Failover) settings. 
 - Administer Oracle networking on Linux: configure tnsnames. ora, listener. ora, sqlnet. ora; manage Oracle Wallet for encrypted database connections; and control OS-level oracle user permissions, ulimits, and kernel parameter tuning (shmmax, semaphores, open file limits). 
 - Manage Oracle databases on Windows Server: configure Oracle Windows Services, OracleDBConsole, NTFS permission structures for Oracle homes, Windows Scheduler tasks for backup jobs, and Event Log integration for Oracle alert log monitoring. 
 - Perform periodic JDE database health checks: purge JDE log tables (F9861, jdeDebug), archive obsolete versions, compress historic business data, and manage tablespace free-space thresholds with proactive alerting. 

IBM Integration - Integration Developer & MQ/IIB Administration

- Architect, develop, and administer IBM Integration Bus (IIB) / App Connect Enterprise (ACE) message flows, policies, and deployment BAR files. 
 - Design and manage IBM MQ infrastructure including queue managers, channels, topic-based messaging, and high-availability clustering. 
 - Lead integration governance - define patterns, reusable components, and API management policies. 
 - Implement end-to-end monitoring for integration pipelines using MQ Explorer, IBM Operations Console, and third-party observability tools. 
 - Troubleshoot production integration failures, analyze message flows, and lead performance optimization efforts. 
 - Evaluate and plan migration paths from IIB to IBM App Connect Professional/Enterprise or cloud-native alternatives. 

Cloud Solution Architecture & Automation

- Design, implement, and govern multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP) aligned with enterprise security and compliance standards. 
 - Lead cloud-native solution design including microservices, serverless computing, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and API Gateway strategies. 
 - Drive cloud automation initiatives using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools - Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or equivalent. 
 - Develop CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices to accelerate delivery velocity while maintaining quality gates. 
 - Oversee cloud cost optimization, FinOps practices, and capacity planning. 
 - Establish cloud security posture management (CSPM), identity and access policies, and compliance guardrails (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR). 
 - Lead cloud migration strategies for on-premises JDE and IBM workloads into cloud environments. 

AI Strategy & Emerging Technology Adoption

- Champion an AI-first mindset across the operations and engineering team - identifying automation, efficiency, and insight opportunities. 
 - Evaluate, pilot, and operationalize AI/ML tools and platforms (e. g. , AWS , Azure AI Services, OpenAI APIs). 
 - Integrate generative AI and intelligent automation into business workflows, JDE processes, and integration pipelines. 
 - Stay current with the rapidly evolving AI landscape; rapidly acquire new skills and facilitate team enablement workshops. 
 - Partner with data engineering and analytics teams to build AI-ready data pipelines and governance practices. 

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we're getting to know you-not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process. 

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
Sanas is pioneering the future of human communication. Founded by a team of Stanford researchers and entrepreneurs with deep industry experience, Sanas has developed the world's first real-time speech AI platform capable of accent translation, noise cancellation, speech enhancement, cross-language communication, and more. 

Sanas makes conversations clearer, more inclusive, and more effective, removing barriers that prevent people from being understood, regardless of accent, background noise, or native language. 

Sanas is currently one of the fastest growing startups in Silicon Valley, growing from $16M to $50M ARR in 2025. The company's core business is profitable and is on track to end 2026 with >$77M ARR. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering with a design-minded product engineering culture to build and ship cutting-edge AI models and experiences - entirely in-house. 

Sanas is a 130 person team, established in 2020. In this short span, we've successfully secured over $100 million in funding. Our innovation has been supported by the industry's leading investors, including Insight Partners, Google Ventures, Quadrille Capital, General Catalyst, Quiet Capital, and other influential investors. Our reputation is further solidified by collaborations with numerous Fortune 100 companies. With Sanas, you're not just adopting a product; you're investing in the future of communication. 

If you're looking to have a significant role in roadmapping and driving technical directions, if you're looking to deploy challenging and big ideas without much overhead or slowness, if you're looking to leave your mark on an ambitious, generational mission to change how the worlds thinks about speech + AI, then Sanas is a well-suited place for you. 

About The Role

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to set technical direction across multiple teams and raise the bar for how we build real-time voice AI. You'll own our hardest cross-cutting problems: the architecture of a platform that runs in live conversations, reliability and latency at production scale and developer velocity across our Desktop App, SDK, Voice Gateway and Portal. 

As Sanas expands beyond contact centers into telecom, enterprise communication and custom voice products, your architectural decisions will shape how the platform scales. 

This is a senior individual contributor role, not a management track. You'll stay hands-on in the code while multiplying the impact of the engineers around you. 

What You'll Do

- Set technical direction. Define and drive architecture across our client (Desktop App / SDK), gateway and cloud backend systems. Balance near-term customer delivery against long-term scalability as we move from contact centers into telecom and enterprise. 
 - Own real-time performance. Treat end-to-end latency, audio quality, CPU and memory footprint and uptime as first-class requirements. Our products run live on customer calls, where regressions are immediately audible. 
 - Lead cross-team initiatives. Take ambiguous, high-impact problems that span the SDK, backend, ML inference and DevOps teams, turn them into clear plans and see them through to production. 
 - Stay hands-on. Write and review production code, prototype new approaches and dig into the hardest bugs across the client, backend services and deployment layers. 
 - Make decisions visible. Write design docs and architecture decision records that explain the reasoning behind technical choices. 
 - Raise the bar. Establish and model best practices for code quality, testing, observability, security and operational excellence. 
 - Mentor and grow engineers. Coach senior and mid-level engineers and help shape how we interview and level technical talent. 
 - Partner beyond engineering. Work with Product, Research/ML, Customer Success and leadership to shape the roadmap, surface technical risks early and support enterprise customer and technical requirements. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field. 
 - 8-12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant time at a senior or staff level.

 - Deep expertise in one or more of Rust, Python & GoLang with strong command of distributed systems and RESTful API design.

data.description:
Job Description

Job Description - ASIC/SoC Verification Engineer

We are seeking an experienced Principal ASIC/SoC Verification Engineer to join our dynamic and fast‐paced engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the functional correctness, robustness, and overall quality of our cutting‐edge semiconductor and SoC designs. If you thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy solving complex technical challenges, this opportunity is an excellent fit. 

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Verification Planning and Execution
 - Develop and execute comprehensive SoC/IP‐level verification plans aligned with design specifications and project goals. 
 - Drive verification closure through functional, code, and assertion coverage, ensuring high‐quality deliverables. 
 - Apply industry‐standard ASIC/SoC verification techniques including test planning, testbench creation, constrained‐random and directed stimulus, assertions, and coverage‐driven verification. 
 - Perform SoC integration verification, validating interactions across subsystems, interfaces, and power/performance domains. 
 - Testbench & Environment Development
 - Architect, develop, and enhance SystemVerilog UVM/OVM‐based testbenches for IP and SoC‐level verification. 
 - Build and integrate reusable Verification IP (VIP) and scalable verification components. 
 - Collaborate with internal teams and third‐party VIP providers to ensure seamless integration and compliance. 
 - Develop checkers, scoreboards, monitors, and coverage models to support robust verification. 
 - Methodology, Flows & Best Practices
 - Demonstrate strong understanding of ASIC/SoC design and verification methodologies, including constraint‐random verification and object‐oriented programming principles. 
 - Contribute to verification methodology improvements, automation, and flow optimization. 
 - Ensure adherence to best practices in UVM architecture, reuse, and maintainability. 
 - Advanced Verification Skills
 - Perform Gate‐Level Simulation (GLS) including SDF annotation, timing verification, and debug of post‐synthesis/post‐layout issues. 
 - Execute power‐aware verification using UPF/CPF, validating power modes, isolation, retention, and sequencing. 
 - Debug complex SoC‐level issues involving multiple clock domains, resets, and power states. 
 - Apply formal verification techniques where appropriate to complement simulation‐based verification. 
 - Technical Skills
 - Strong proficiency in SystemVerilog (UVM/OVM) and scripting languages such as Python, Perl, Tcl, C/C++, and Verilog PLI. 
 - Familiarity with standard protocols and interfaces (e. g. , I2C, SPI, UART, AXI/AHB/APB). 
 - Experience with simulation, debug, and coverage tools from major EDA vendors (Synopsys, Cadence, Siemens). 
 - Knowledge of CI/regression automation, version control, and workflow tools is a plus. 
 - Collaboration & Communication
 - Work effectively with design, architecture, DV, validation, and firmware teams to drive verification to completion. 
 - Communicate technical concepts clearly through documentation, reviews, and cross‐functional discussions. 
 - Demonstrate initiative, strong analytical problem‐solving skills, and adaptability in a diverse team environment. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field. 
 - 10 Years of experience in SoC/IP verification, . 
 - Strong expertise in SystemVerilog, UVM, and advanced verification methodologies. 
 - Hands-on experience with ARM-based SoC architectures, AMBA protocols (AXI/AHB/APB), and system-level interactions. 
 - Proven ability to build reusable, scalable testbench architectures. 
 - Solid understanding of test planning, coverage-driven verification, and verification metrics. 
 - Experience with GLS, timing verification, and debug. 
 - Knowledge of power-aware verification (UPF/CPF). 
 - Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Perl, Shell, Make, etc. ). 
 - Exposure to AI/ML techniques applied to verification (e. g. , intelligent stimulus generation, failure triage, coverage optimization). 
 - Excellent problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills. 

About Us

onsemi (Nasdaq: ON) is driving disruptive innovations to help build a better future. With a focus on automotive and industrial end-markets, the company is accelerating change in megatrends such as vehicle electrification and safety, sustainable energy grids, industrial automation, and 5G and cloud infrastructure. With a highly differentiated and innovative product portfolio, onsemi creates intelligent power and sensing technologies that solve the world's most complex challenges and leads the way in creating a safer, cleaner, and smarter world.

https: //www. onsemi. com/careers/career-benefits
