data.title: TD And E - TD - Scrum Lead - Manager Consultant
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Title: Manager II, Technical Scrum Lead

EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization. 

Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you'll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY's deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you'll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact. 

EY Technology: 

Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250, 000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization. 

EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units: 

- Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly. 
 - Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) - EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience. 
 - Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems. 

The opportunity

This role leads a team providing agile methodology services to cross-functional technology-related project(s) or product(s) teams, demonstrating technical expertise to improve productivity of teams and quality of work processes and outcomes. Project(s) or product(s) often have enterprise-wide implications. This role also ensures agile best practices are embedded in delivery, manages stakeholder alignment, and drives team performance through metrics and continuous feedback. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures. 
 - Leads, builds, and coaches high performing teams in the delivery of technology-related products or projects, ensuring team actions are aligned with project and business goals. Instruct and coach other professionals. 
 - Leads planning, team learning, and adaptation of processes to ensure the quality of team solutions. 
 - Enables a continuous learning environment, identifying ways to strengthen the team's understanding of Agile/Scrum concepts and principles as they relate to technical capabilities. 
 - Builds and applies methodology that supports the integration of changing customer inputs and business conditions into technology-related product development. 
 - Recommends to the product owner and management in the definition and prioritization of technology-related outcomes. Identifies trade-offs between short and long term benefits to drive shared vision between the team and product owner. 
 - Ensures the application of agile frameworks to the development process to increase effectiveness of technology-related product development or architecture. 
 - Removes roadblocks to technology-related product development or architecture. Applies learnings to other development projects. 
 - Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned. 
 - Manages stakeholder expectations regarding target scope, schedule, and budget. 
 - Helps teams estimate iteration deliverables and increase sprint velocity. 
 - Acts as a Subject Matter Expert for agile methodologies and best practices. 
 - Promotes continuous communication and monitors team dynamics to foster collaboration. 
 - Facilitates scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, demos, and iteration meetings. 
 - Manages development tracking systems (e. g. , product and sprint backlogs). 
 - Motivates and acts as the glue that holds cross-functional teams together. 
 - Monitors sprint progress and identifies impediments that hinder delivery. 
 - Design, implement, and maintain comprehensive monitoring and alerting to proactively identify performance degradation and application disruptions
 - Perform end to end triage and in depth troubleshooting of production incidents by analysing logs, telemetry signals, and related diagnostic data to quickly identify root causes and restore service
 - Design and build ML models that analyse telemetry, logs and metrics to predict and prevent incidents before they impact users. 
 - Implement best in class detection mechanisms to reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and accelerate incident response
 - Develop systems that learn from historical incidents, continuously improving diagnostic accuracy and accelerate incident response time
 - Build innovative, scalable alerting solutions across a heterogeneous technology landscape, including AWS, Unix, and Mainframe platforms. 
 - Develop and maintain synthetic monitoring to simulate real user interactions and ensure early detection of failures. 
 - Perform daily health checks, triage and troubleshoot alerts, and resolve issues to minimize downtime and user impact. 
 - Conduct trend analysis, identify recurring patterns, and partner with application teams to enhance system reliability and availability
 - Lead and participate in standard incident management processes, leveraging incident playbooks, diagnostic tools, and technical expertise to quickly identify impact and restore service
 - Proactively trigger incident management when early signals indicate potential disruption
 - Review and act on maintenance notifications, service advisories, and platform updates to mitigate operational risks. 
 - Maintain a centralized incident response playbook, ensuring steps, processes, and escalation paths are clearly documented. 
 - Document incidents, recovery steps, and learnings, and communicate them to relevant stakeholders to drive continuous improvement
 - Collaborate closely with application (App) development teams to identify, diagnose, and resolve operational problems impacting the platform or applications. 
 - Act as a bridge between platform operations and development teams to ensure timely root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes. 
 - Work collaboratively with developers, DevOps engineers, and IT stakeholders to improve performance, reliability, and operational maturity. 
 - Continuously refine alerting to reduce false positives and false negatives. 
 - Stay current with emerging observability tools, monitoring strategies, and SRE practices. 
 - Promote and support adoption of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles across teams. 
 - Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned
 - Willingness to work in a 24×7 support model, as needed

Skills And Attributes For Success

- A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
 - Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
 - A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders

To qualify for the role, you must have

- Minimum 8 years of experience in Agile software development, with at least two years leading large cross-functional teams on enterprise technology initiativesBachelor's degree (B. E. /B. Tech) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field is required; graduate degree preferred. 
 - AWS Cloud Practitioner Certification (mandatory); AWS Solutions Architect certification preferred. 
 - Minimum of 8 years of hands on experience as an operations engineer, full stack developer, or automation engineer. 
 - Strong expertise in IT project management, Agile methodologies, and SDLC best practices with experience in IT infrastructure, software development, and enterprise IT solutions. 
 - Proficiency in risk management, budgeting, and IT governance. Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and IT compliance standards. 
 - Must have skills: Node. js, TypeScript, ECS, Kubernetes, Kore. AI, Android, iOS development
 - Good to have skills include Agile team leadership, stakeholder management, sprint planning, backlog prioritization, velocity optimization, and use of agile tools like JIRA or Azure DevOps. Strong skills in collaboration, verbal and written communication, team motivation, time management, and critical thinking are essential. 
 - Preferred certifications include Certified Scrum Master (CSM), SAFe Agilist, PMI-ACP, or ICAgile Certified Professional. 
 - Demonstrated ability to build high-performing agile teams, remove delivery blockers, and foster a culture of continuous improvement in fast-paced, enterprise-level environments. 
 - Experience working with Confluence. 
 - Experience monitoring and refining dashboards. 
 - Experience in continuous process improvement for process flows and workflows. 

Required Skills: 

- Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability collaborating with application teams, ability to handle escalations and troubleshoot complex application issues. 
 - Proficiency in reading and interpreting logs to generate operational intelligence and accelerate incident resolution. 
 - Experience with observability, SRE principles, and automation to reduce manual effort and improve system reliability. 
 - Expert level knowledge of AWS services, including EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, and IAM. 
 - Experience with REST APIs, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems
 - Strong tooling and automation skills using Python, Java, Selenium etc. 
 - Prior experience in incident management and stakeholder communication. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively across teams

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Familiarity with Agile development practices and methodologies. 
 - Experience with Application Performance Monitoring (APM) tools such as Honeycomb, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, or other similar tools
 - Background in supporting Java-based applications on AWS, including troubleshooting, performance tuning, and deployment support. 
 - Experience with additional monitoring and visualization tools such as Splunk, Grafana, and ThousandEyes. 
 - Exposure to Unix and Mainframe environments. 
 - Experience in networking and troubleshooting connectivity issues
 - Experience building AI/LLM-powered applications (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini)
 - Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar agent frameworks
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Ideally, you'll also have

- Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills. 
 - Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative. 
 - Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)

What We Look For

- Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values. 

What Working At EY Offers

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer: 

- Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
 - Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
 - The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: System Architecture Designer
data.description:
About College Circle AI

At College Circle AI, we believe that curiosity should never die in a classroom. We are

building an AI-powered learning ecosystem that helps students understand concepts

better, identify their weak areas, and receive personalized academic support beyond

traditional classrooms. 

Built for Students, by Students. We are a team of students, builders, and innovators

who have experienced the challenges of modern education firsthand. Every product, 

feature, and initiative is designed with one goal: helping students learn better, grow

faster, and unlock their full potential. 

Our mission is to empower millions of learners with smarter learning, stronger career

readiness, and equal access to guidance whenever they need it. If you are passionate

about education, technology, and creating real impact, you'll feel right at home here. 

Building the Future of Academic Intelligence

We are looking for a System Architecture Designer who can step back, understand the entire system, identify where the architecture is breaking, and design the architecture required for the next 10, 000+ users and systems. 

This is not simply a debugging role. You will work on how the entire technology system should be structured, connected, monitored, and scaled. 

What You Will Work On
 - Study the current CCAI technology architecture and identify structural problems. 
 - Map the complete system: frontend, backend, APIs, databases, AI services, authentication, integrations, deployment and data flow. 
 - Identify recurring bugs and determine whether they are caused by implementation, dependencies, architecture or system design. 
 - Redesign weak or fragile parts of the architecture. 
 - Create a scalable architecture capable of supporting the next stage of users and product complexity. 
 - Design clear communication between different services, APIs and modules. 
 - Improve reliability, performance, security and maintainability. 
 - Establish systems for error handling, logging, monitoring and debugging. 
 - Identify technical debt and create a structured plan to resolve it. 
 - Work closely with Backend, Full-Stack, AI/Research and Product teams. 
 - Create architecture documentation that developers can actually follow. 
 - Review major technical decisions before implementation. 
 - Think about how today's technical decisions will affect the platform at 10, 000 → 100, 000 → 1M+ users. 
The Core Problem You Will SolveWe don't want: 

"There is a bug, let's fix the bug. "We want: 

"Why did this class of bug become possible in the first place, and how should we design the system so that it does not repeatedly happen?"You will be responsible for finding those patterns. 

What We Are Looking ForYou may come from backgrounds such as: 

- System Architecture
 - Software Architecture
 - Backend Engineering
 - Full-Stack Engineering
 - DevOps / Infrastructure
 - Distributed Systems
 - Platform Engineering
 - Technical Product EngineeringYou do not need to have the exact title "System Architect" on your resume. 

What matters is that you can understand a complex technical system, identify structural problems, and design a better one. 

Strong Candidates Will Have

- Strong understanding of backend and system architecture
 - Experience designing APIs and service communication
 - Understanding of databases and data modelling
 - Experience with scalable applications
 - Knowledge of deployment, CI/CD and infrastructure
 - Understanding of authentication, authorization and security
 - Experience with logging, monitoring and observability
 - Ability to debug problems across multiple systems
 - Ability to identify technical debt and architectural weaknesses
 - Strong documentation and system-design skills
 - Ability to think beyond the current implementation
 - Ownership mindset and willingness to work closely with developers
 - 
Current Technology Environment

Our current environment includes technologies such as: 

Frontend: React / Next. js / JavaScript / TypeScript / Tailwind

Backend: Node. js / Express

Database: PostgreSQL / Supabase

Infrastructure: Cloud deployment, CI/CD and GitHub-based workflows

AI: AI models, APIs and research-driven AI systems

You don't need to know every technology beforehand, but you should be comfortable understanding and designing systems around them. 

Your First Mission

Your first assignment will be to: 

Audit the existing architecture → identify critical architectural problems → trace recurring bugs → propose a redesigned architecture → create a roadmap for implementation. 

We want to understand how you think before asking you to redesign anything. 

Why This Role Is Different

You will not only be given tickets to complete. 

You will have the opportunity to influence: 

How College Circle AI is technically built. 

Your decisions can affect our: 

- Product architecture
 - Engineering workflows
 - Data architecture
 - AI infrastructure
 - Scalability
 - Reliability
 - Security
 - Future technical teamThis is a builder role for someone who enjoys solving system-level problems. 

What You Can Grow Into

Depending on contribution and ownership, this role can evolve toward: 

System Architect → Platform Architect → Chief Technology Architecture / Technology Leadership

For long-term Co-Builders, equity opportunities may also be considered based on contribution, ownership, performance, tenure and formal company agreements. Equity is not automatic. 

Who Should Apply?Apply if you look at a technical problem and naturally ask: 

"Why is the system designed this way?"rather than only: 

"How do I fix this error?"If you want to help design the technical foundation on which the next 10, 000+ users and future systems of College Circle AI can operate, this role is for you.

Location: Erode, Tamil Nadu

Job SummaryThe position is responsible for coordinating hospital quality management, accreditation compliance, patient safety initiatives, and academic administration of DNB/DrNB programmes. The role involves ensuring adherence to applicable NABH and QAI accreditation standards, including Advanced Stroke Centre requirements, while coordinating postgraduate medical training activities in accordance with applicable National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) guidelines. 

The role requires effective coordination with clinical and non-clinical departments, medical faculty, trainees, hospital management, and quality committees to maintain compliance, improve operational efficiency, and ensure accreditation and academic assessment readiness. 

Key Roles and Responsibilities1. Quality Management & Accreditation
 - Implement, monitor, and maintain compliance with applicable NABH and QAI accreditation standards, including Advanced Stroke Centre requirements. 
 - Develop, review, update, and maintain hospital policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), quality manuals, records, and accreditation documentation. 
 - Conduct internal audits, gap assessments, and mock assessments to evaluate compliance and identify areas for improvement. 
 - Monitor audit findings and ensure timely implementation and closure of Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA). 
 - Monitor patient safety practices, incident reporting, risk management, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and clinical and non-clinical quality indicators. 
 - Track patient feedback, complaints, and resolution timelines to support continuous improvement in patient experience. 
 - Coordinate quality committee meetings, management reviews, staff training, and accreditation-related activities. 
 - Maintain document control systems and monitor applicable statutory and regulatory requirements. 
 - Analyse quality performance data and prepare monthly dashboards, reports, and compliance updates for management. 
 - Collaborate with all departments to implement quality improvement initiatives and sustain compliance with hospital quality and patient safety standards. 2. DNB/DrNB Academic Coordination
 - Coordinate and monitor the academic and administrative activities of DNB/DrNB programmes in accordance with applicable NBEMS guidelines and institutional policies. 
 - Coordinate trainee admissions, joining formalities, faculty communication, academic calendars, and clinical postings. 
 - Monitor trainee attendance, logbooks, case presentations, seminars, journal clubs, and periodic academic assessments. 
 - Maintain records of trainee progress, leave, examination schedules, thesis submissions, and research activities. 
 - Coordinate with the Head of Department, teaching faculty, trainees, and hospital management to ensure timely completion of prescribed training requirements. 
 - Maintain mandatory academic records, reports, and documentation required for institutional assessments and NBEMS inspections. 
 - Monitor applicable requirements relating to faculty eligibility, clinical exposure, academic activities, and training documentation. 
 - Identify gaps in academic and administrative compliance and coordinate corrective actions. 
 - Facilitate institutional assessments, inspections, and other academic compliance activities as required by NBEMS. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 - Compliance with applicable NABH and QAI accreditation standards. 
 - Completion of internal audits and closure of audit findings within defined timelines. 
 - Timely closure and effectiveness of CAPA. 
 - Accuracy and completeness of quality and accreditation documentation. 
 - Staff training completion and awareness of quality standards. 
 - Monitoring and reporting of clinical and non-clinical quality indicators. 
 - Patient safety incident monitoring and complaint resolution. 
 - Accreditation and assessment readiness. 
 - Timely completion and maintenance of DNB/DrNB academic records. 
 - Compliance with applicable NBEMS training and documentation requirements. 
 - Coordination and completion of scheduled academic activities and assessments. Benefits
 - Cell phone reimbursement
 - Paid time offPreferred Candidate Profile
 - Strong organisational, documentation, coordination, and communication skills. 
 - Knowledge of hospital quality management systems and accreditation processes. 
 - Familiarity with NABH standards, quality indicators, internal audits, CAPA, and RCA.

data.title: Lead Engineer, Agentic AI Engineering
data.description:
About Trinity & This Role

Trinity Life Sciences is a leading analytics and technology partner to the biotech and pharma industry, helping clients solve their hardest commercialisation challenges across market access, forecasting, field force, customer engagement, and real world evidence. AI Foundations is the internal team making AI adoption fast, safe, and repeatable across Trinity - building the platforms, standards, and reusable components that product teams build on. 

Trinity is seeking a Lead AI Engineer - Agentic Systems to take ownership of technical execution across the AI Foundations engineering team in India. This is a step up from Senior Engineer: you are still deeply hands-on, but you carry additional responsibility for how the team executes - ensuring deliverables land on time and to standard, coaching engineers on agentic and platform development approaches, and acting as the technical authority the team rallies around. The right candidate leads by doing, holds the bar high, and understands that their success is measured as much by the team's output as their own. 

Key Responsibilities

Team Oversight & Project Execution

This is the dimension that distinguishes the Lead role from Senior. You are responsible for how the team delivers, not just what you personally build. 

- Own end-to-end delivery of agentic AI engineering workstreams - planning, prioritisation, dependency management, and ensuring deliverables complete on time and to the quality standard the business expects. 
 - Track progress across parallel workstreams; surface blockers early, escalate when needed, and remove obstacles so engineers can focus on building rather than navigating process. 
 - Maintain visibility into the health of ongoing projects: scope creep, technical debt accumulation, integration risks, and resource constraints - and act before they become problems. 
 - Coordinate with Data Scientists, product managers, and stakeholders to align on requirements, timelines, and definition of done - ensuring engineering and business expectations stay in sync throughout delivery. 
 - Run effective sprint rituals, design reviews, and retrospectives that keep the team sharp and continuously improving without adding unnecessary overhead. 

Architecture Standards & Technical Governance

- Act as the technical authority for agentic systems architecture within the India team - reviewing and approving significant design decisions, ensuring consistency with Trinity's established patterns and guardrails. 
 - Enforce adherence to engineering standards: coding conventions, testing requirements, CI/CD practices, security and RBAC patterns, and agent harness implementation - not as bureaucracy, but as the foundation that makes the team go faster over time. 
 - Own the team's reference architectures and reusable component library; keep them current as the agentic AI landscape evolves and new approaches prove themselves. 
 - Identify and address technical debt proactively - make the call on when to refactor versus when to ship, and be transparent with stakeholders about the trade-offs. 

Hands-On Engineering

The Lead role is not a management role. You remain a significant individual contributor and the technical credibility that comes from that is what makes the rest of the role work. 

- Architect and deliver complex agentic AI solutions end-to-end - multi-agent systems on LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Google ADK, and platforms including AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, Snowflake Cortex, and Databricks Mosaic AI. 
 - Design for MCP/A2A interoperability, agent memory systems, tool registries, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints; implement agent execution harnesses with sandboxed tool execution, policy-as-code guardrails (NeMo Guardrails, Guardrails AI), and full observability via Langfuse or LangSmith. 
 - Build or integrate with full-stack enterprise applications - applying enterprise-grade security (OAuth2, SAML, SSO, RBAC), secrets management, audit logging, and secure API design as first-class engineering concerns. 
 - Make informed, production-tested choices on inference infrastructure (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM), container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes / EKS / AKS), and data tooling (SQL, Snowflake, Databricks). 

Team Growth, Mentorship & Culture

- Coach and mentor engineers across all levels on agentic AI development, platform engineering, and software engineering craft - investing in their growth as seriously as in the team's output. 
 - Run structured technical sessions: design reviews, architecture walkthroughs, code review standards, and knowledge-sharing forums that build collective capability in agentic and platform development. 
 - Identify skill gaps in the team and work with leadership to address them - through hiring, coaching, or deliberate project assignments that stretch engineers in the right directions. 
 - Foster a culture of ownership, high standards, and continuous improvement; be the kind of technical leader people want to work for and learn from. 
 - Contribute actively to hiring - define what good looks like for engineering roles, assess candidates rigorously, and help build a team that makes everyone in it better. 

Stay Current & Drive Adoption of What Works

- Stay ahead of the agentic AI field - evaluate new frameworks, protocols, and techniques with a critical eye and bring well-formed recommendations to the team on what is worth adopting. 
 - Champion the adoption of AI-enabled development practices that improve team productivity: code generation, automated testing, documentation tooling, and developer experience improvements. 

What We Are Looking For

- 8+ years of software engineering in production, with 4+ years in AI/ML or agentic systems - and at least 2 years in a technical lead or principal engineering capacity. 
 - Proven ability to drive delivery across a team: you have owned project timelines, managed dependencies, and ensured engineering work lands on time and to standard. 
 - Deep technical expertise across the agentic AI stack - frameworks, cloud platforms, agent safety, evaluation, inference infrastructure, and full-stack enterprise integration. 
 - Strong Python and SQL proficiency; hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes in production container environments. 
 - Demonstrated ability to set and uphold engineering standards - coding, testing, architecture, and security - and bring a team along with you, not just impose them. 
 - Excellent communication: able to represent technical decisions to senior leadership, align with business stakeholders, and coach engineers at every level. 
 - Passion for the agentic AI field and a genuine habit of staying current - you bring ideas to the team, not just execution. 
 - Background in life sciences, pharma, or regulated environments is a strong differentiator. Degree from IITs, NITs, BITS, or comparable; strong applied track record considered equally. 

The Kind of Achievements We Respect

- "Led a 4-person engineering team to deliver a multi-agent analytics platform on AWS Bedrock in 12 weeks. All milestones hit. Adopted by 3 product teams within a month of launch. "
 - "Introduced architecture review and testing standards across the team. Deployment-related incidents dropped by 70% in the following quarter. "
 - "Coached two engineers from mid-level to senior in 18 months through structured design reviews, paired engineering sessions, and deliberate project ownership. "

Why This Role Matters

Trinity is building something foundational in India - a team that will shape how AI gets built and adopted across the enterprise. The Lead Engineer is the person who makes that team deliver with consistency and craft. If you are energised by the combination of deep technical work, team ownership, and genuine influence over how an AI organisation develops, we would like to meet you.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer - AI Native UX
data.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone-freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow- helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. 

Join us to put AI to work for people. 

Job Description

What you'll do: 

UX Architecture & Strategy - Define and own the long-term architecture for AI-native user experiences across the platform, making critical build-vs-buy decisions (design systems, agent-to-UI interaction patterns, real-time/streaming UX for AI-generated content) to ensure the experience layer stays resilient and coherent as the platform scales. 

AI-Native Intelligent Experiences - Design and build user-facing surfaces where agentic backends - recommendations, autonomous triage, generated fixes/insights, multi-step agent reasoning - are exposed to end users through fast, trustworthy, low-friction interaction patterns. Own the hard UX problems unique to AI-native products: progressive disclosure of agent reasoning, graceful handling of uncertainty/latency, human-in-the-loop review flows, and making autonomous system behavior legible and controllable to end users rather than a black box. 

UXC & Workspace Platform - Deep ownership of the UXC (User Experience/Workspace, UI16) surface - component architecture, design system consistency, and performance - as the primary canvas AI-native features are built on top of. 

Agentic Pipeline Awareness - Partner closely with platform/ML teams building the agent orchestration and tool-calling infrastructure underneath (multi-agent dispatch, MCP-style tool integration, reasoning traceability) - translating what these backends can do into UX patterns that make them usable, safe, and trustworthy for real users. 

Business Alignment - Align UX and technical architecture with business goals, ensuring engineering velocity, experience quality, and adoption of AI-native features directly support customer acquisition, retention, and time-to-market. 

Hands-on Engineering - Write high-performance, clean, production-grade code primarily across the frontend/experience stack (Lit. js, React/TypeScript, design systems, component architecture), with working fluency in backend/platform code (Java, Python, Postgres, K8s) to collaborate effectively with platform teams. 

Cross-functional Execution - Drive business-critical UX and platform outcomes in close collaboration with ML, backend platform, and product teams. 

Engineering Culture - Mentor senior engineers, champion UX and engineering excellence, and foster a culture of rapid, impact-driven innovation in AI-native product development. 

Ownership & Initiative - Proactively identify UX and platform gaps in the AI-native experience, propose solutions, align stakeholders, and drive execution with a high degree of ownership. 

Qualifications

- Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into engineering and platform work-AI-powered tooling, automated operational workflows, agentic systems for fleet visibility and operations, or reasoning about AI's impact on how infrastructure is built and run. 
 - 15+ years of software engineering experience with demonstrated progression into senior technical leadership, and a track record concentrated in user experience and frontend platform engineering. 
 - Deep UXC / AI-native UX expertise - has shipped intelligent, AI-driven user experiences (not just consumed an LLM API), with strong intuition for how agent/model output should surface to real users. 
 - Hands-on experience with agentic/multi-agent systems from the consumer side - understands agent orchestration, tool-calling protocols (MCP or equivalent), and reasoning traceability well enough to design UX around them, even if platform-layer implementation sits with another team. 
 - Strong hands-on coding ability with deep design thinking in the frontend/experience stack (React/TypeScript, component/design systems), working proficiency in backend fundamentals (K8s, Java, Python, Postgres) to bridge into platform architecture conversations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to connect UX and engineering decisions to business outcomes - adoption, retention, time-to-market, not just technical metrics. 
 - Self-driven with strong ownership, able to identify UX and system gaps, propose solutions, align stakeholders, and execute at startup pace. 
 - Experience integrating or critically evaluating AI tools/agentic workflows in product and engineering decision-making, particularly from a user-experience and trust/legibility angle. 

Good to Have

- Prior experience in distributed systems performance/scalability, even if not the primary focus of recent roles. 
 - Open-source contributions to major AI-native UX, design-system, or agent-framework projects. 
 - Prior startup experience working closely with Product and Growth teams in an early-stage environment. 

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. 

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow. com for assistance. 

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U. S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

The ideal candidate should be able to quickly understand the product and platform, onboard effectively, and work both independently and collaboratively across teams.

The candidate will also be expected to contribute to engineering initiatives, proof of concepts, automation ideas, and continuous platform improvements.

- Design, implement, and manage scalable, secure, and reliable infrastructure on AWS

- Strong hands-on experience with AWS cloud services/resources
 - Good working knowledge of AWS CLI
 - Experience with Jenkins and/or TeamCity
 - Strong expertise in CI/CD pipeline design, implementation, and support

 - Strong scripting and automation skills using:

 - Python
 - Experience with ECS Containers

data.title: Principal, Software Engineering
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Principal, Software Engineering

Overview

In the time between when you swipe your Mastercard and you receive the approval, Authorization Decisioning has provided your transaction with more than 20 different market-facing services-including industry leading fraud detection. Everyday Authorization Decisioning provides these same robust computational intelligence services to more than a billion transactions around the planet. 

As a Principal Software Engineer for Authorization Decisioning, you are a technical authority. You are responsible for providing a broad spectrum of technical leadership and decision making across our program and its partners in technology and product. You are a way finder. You are working across organizational lines to partner with architects, product managers, analysts, managers, and engineers to collaboratively and creatively find solutions to evolving our growing platform. You are an enabler. You are hands-on experimenting, building, creating, guiding, and mentoring engineering teams through to seeing the realization of these solutions into production. 

Role

- Between 20-40% individual contributor with technical team leadership. Who is recognized as a team/s technical expert within a discipline and drives innovation and organizational growth through their contributions. 
 - Work on complex enterprise-wide initiatives spanning multiple services/programs and drives resolution by collaborating with business/product owners, engineers, and architects to design and deliver on new services to introduce new products and bundles
 - Has skills to succinctly articulate architecture patterns of complex systems, with business and technical implications, to executive and customer stakeholders
 - Responsible for the analysis, design, development and delivery of software solutions
 - Defines requirements for new applications and customizations, adhering to standards, processes and best practices. 
 - Set priorities, objectives, and drive deliverables within global technology domains and sub-domains and engage with the broader technical community to anticipate developments in innovation and evaluate new solutions for future business platform system requirements. 
 - Leverages input of partners and personal experience to make thoughtful decisions on technical direction and then has the ownership to see those decisions through
 - Practice sustainable incident response and conduct blameless postmortems, taking a holistic approach to problem-solving during production events. 
 - Explain technical issues and solution strategies to stakeholders, ensure timely accomplishment of technical designs and delivery milestones and liaise with stakeholders to understand business needs. 

All About You

- You've made your career in designing and building high performance, high transaction volume, and globally scalable platforms. 
 - As an individual contributor you made your name by solving the hard problems that no one else could and as your career grew so did the complexity. You still love getting your hands dirty, but now look forward to working with your friends to solve the big stuff that no one person can solve on their own. 
 - Designing and crafting the best software this world has ever seen might be your favorite thing, but you know that's not the alpha and omega of your problem set. You relish your time with the SRE, Performance Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to ensure the architectures are correct and tuned and that your teams' code is optimized for each system. 
 - You know you are responsible for software that is critical financial infrastructure for multiple nation states, but you also know that you can't be everyone all the time, so you've extended your ownership to ensure the SDLC and governance processes are both efficient and responsible. 
 - You are intelligent and industrious, but people don't know that because you tell them. Its because they see it in the way you lead. From ideation where you make everyone's ideas feel heard and respected all the way through to production crisis where you stick with the engineers to overcome oversights not found until the last minute. Your personal culture sets the team culture. 

Proficiencies

- Deep experience in financial services - particularly in payments industry and hands on experience designing for standard and regulatory compliance - PCI-DSS, GDPR, etc. 
 - Data-intensive designing and architecture patterns - APIs, event-driven-services, batch-services, messaging systems, and big data. 
 - Data-intensive programming - Java, REST API, Microservices, Kafka, Axon, MQ, and Spring. 
 - Cloud and DevOps Architecture - Kubernetes, Docker, and Pivotal Cloud Foundry
 - Databases - Oracle, SQL server, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, ElasticSearch
 - Tools - Eclipse or IntelliJ, Sonar, GIT, Maven, SQL Developer, Jenkins, CI/CD, Gatling

Education

- Required undergraduate degree in Computer Science or in a STEM-intensive degree program with related experience in software engineering. 
 - Preferred graduate degree in Computer Science or Business with related experience in fintech and payments. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
At Tecsys, the software we deliver keeps hospitals, pharmacies and distributors supplied with what they need, when they need it. Every role here connects to that outcome. 

Why This Role Matters

As a Site Reliability Engineer you will join our Network and Security Operations Center (NSOC), a team at the heart of platform reliability for our mission-critical SaaS environments. You'll respond to incidents, keep day-to-day operations running smoothly, and lead improvements and automation that cut repetitive work and technical debt. By finding the root cause of recurring issues and fixing them for good, you'll make our platform more dependable for the healthcare and distribution customers who rely on it, and leave a lasting impact on the team. 

What You'll Be Part Of

Tecsys is trusted by mission-critical organizations in healthcare and distribution to power resilient, efficient and secure supply chains. We are a global provider of cloud-based, AI-driven software, publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: TCS). 

Three values guide how we work. We earn trust daily by valuing the customer and acting with integrity. We build each other up by recognizing individual strengths and working as one team. And we explore boldly by staying curious and adapting for success. 

You'll join a culture driven by curiosity, continuous learning, and people who challenge what's possible. 

Requirements

What You'll Do

- Respond to and resolve P1-P4 incidents during your day hours, working closely with the NOC team across North America and India 
 - Dig into repeat incidents to find the root cause and put fixes in place so they don't come back 
 - Handle recurring operational work, including onboarding and offboarding requests and monitoring changes 
 - Run regular backup checks and infrastructure reliability checks 
 - Build automation and improvements that reduce manual effort and technical debt for the team 
 - Contribute to projects that leave a lasting impact, such as our backup architecture redesign, which strengthens how we protect backups from a security perspective 
 - Develop tooling and automation on top of AWS and Azure to continuously reduce the need for manual intervention. 

What You Bring

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field 
 - Strong background with at least 3+ years of experience working in a technical SaaS environment 
 - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, AWS and Azure at scale 
 - Hands-on expertise with Infrastructure as Code and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, or similar) 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab preferred, Jenkins acceptable) and monitoring and observability tooling (Datadog or equivalent), including metrics, alerting and dashboards 
 - Experience with monitoring and alert handling 
 - Solid incident management experience, including on-call rotations, escalations, and postmortem

Benefits

- Benefits (Insurance and access to learning platform) and vacation from day one 
 - Flexible work environment
 - Regular Employee Engagement initiatives 
 - Room to learn, stretch and take on new challenges 
 - Collaboration with global teams 
 - We foster an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. 

If this role fits what you are looking for, apply today. If you are not actively searching but want to hear more, we are glad to talk

Apply today and discover what you could build, solve, and achieve with Tecsys!

Degree: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

data.title: Senior Manager- CCR
data.description:
About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Job Purpose

The CCR Area Incharge is responsible for overseeing multiple production sections within the Continuous Cast Rod (CCR) Plant. This includes ensuring the seamless integration of production processes, driving overall operational excellence, and aligning plant activities with organizational goals. The role involves strategic planning, fostering a culture of innovation and sustainability, and ensuring compliance with safety and quality standards. 

Responsibilities

- CCR Production Operations & Target Delivery
 - Lead day-to-day CCR production operations to achieve planned copper rod output, quality and dispatch readiness. 
 - Ensure smooth operation of shaft furnace / holding furnace, casting system, rolling mill, cooling, coiling and handling areas. 
 - Monitor production plan versus actual performance, identify deviations and drive corrective actions with shift teams. 
 - Optimize plant throughput, yield, availability and operating discipline while minimizing process interruptions and rework. 
 - Ensure effective shift handover, daily production review, manpower deployment and shop-floor execution governance. 
 - Safety, Compliance & Shop-Floor Discipline
 - Ensure adherence to safety standards, SOPs, PTW requirements, LOTO, PPE compliance and safe operating practices in CCR operations. 
 - Drive hazard identification, near-miss reporting, unsafe condition closure and safety engagement with operators and contract workforce. 
 - Maintain operational discipline through checklist compliance, logbook accuracy, housekeeping, 5S and process control documentation. 
 - Ensure statutory, environmental and quality system compliance applicable to CCR production operations. 
 - Build a safety-first operating culture across shifts through training, audits and visible shop-floor leadership. 
 - Process Control, Quality & Defect Reduction
 - Maintain critical process parameters for molten copper temperature, oxygen level, casting speed, rolling conditions, cooling and surface finish. 
 - Work with quality, laboratory and process teams to ensure copper rod meets required specifications for diameter, conductivity, elongation, surface quality and coil condition. 
 - Analyze process deviations, rod breaks, surface defects, dimensional variation, cracks, scale formation and other quality issues. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis and corrective / preventive actions for recurring process and quality failures. 
 - Support process trials, standard parameter setting and improvement projects for stable CCR operations. 
 - Equipment Reliability, Maintenance Coordination & Utility Interface
 - Coordinate closely with mechanical, electrical, instrumentation and utility teams for equipment health, breakdown analysis and preventive maintenance planning. 
 - Monitor critical equipment including furnace, casting wheel, rolling stands, shear, coiler, cooling system, pumps, burners and material handling systems. 
 - Support planned shutdown execution, equipment readiness checks, start-up preparedness and post-maintenance trial stabilization. 
 - Identify reliability concerns impacting production, quality, energy consumption and safety performance. 
 - Ensure timely closure of process-related maintenance observations and operational improvement actions. 
 - Continuous Improvement, Cost & Team Development
 - Drive improvement initiatives for productivity, yield, energy efficiency, consumable consumption, downtime reduction and quality cost reduction. 
 - Use production data, process trends, defect analysis and equipment performance inputs to identify improvement opportunities. 
 - Develop SOPs, OPLs, training modules and skill-building plans for operators, technicians and shift personnel. 
 - Support digitalization of production monitoring through dashboards, shift MIS, process analytics and automated reporting. 
 - Build a high-performance production team focused on safety, quality, reliability, accountability and continuous improvement. 

Qualifications

Education Qualification: 

- B. E. /B. Tech in Metallurgy, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Production or Industrial Engineering. 
 - Additional qualification in Operations Management, Process Engineering, Quality Management or Manufacturing Excellence will be preferred. 

Work Experience (Range Of Years)

- 10-15 years of experience in copper rod / CCR operations, non-ferrous metals production, casting and rolling, process control, production planning or plant operations in large manufacturing setups. 
 - Minimum 4-6 years of direct exposure to CCR plant operations, copper rod quality, furnace / casting / rolling process, shift management, troubleshooting and maintenance coordination.

What You'll Be Part Of

Software Engineer for Embedded Security is responsible for the architecture, design, development, integration, and validation of security solutions across Android and Embedded Linux platforms. This role provides technical leadership and strategic direction for platform security, focusing on Software Security, Secure Boot, Trusted Execution Environments (TEE), Secure Storage, Key Management, and compliance with automotive cybersecurity standards. The position collaborates closely with OEMs, SoC vendors, security teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver robust and secure automotive platforms. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Architect, design, develop, and integrate embedded security solutions for Android and Embedded Linux platforms. 
 - Own and maintain security components across Rich OS and Secure World environments. 
 - Implement, optimize, and troubleshoot Android security features including Keystore/Keystore2, SELinux, Android Verified Boot (AVB), and security-related system services. 
 - Develop and harden Embedded Linux security solutions, including Secure Boot, kernel security configurations, and Linux Security Modules (LSMs). 
 - Integrate, validate, and support TrustZone/TEE solutions using GlobalPlatform standards and APIs. 
 - Enable secure storage solutions such as RPMB, Secure File Systems (SFS), and hardware-backed key storage. 
 - Drive key provisioning, cryptographic services, encryption, certificate management, and key lifecycle management. 
 - Support OTP memory access and security-critical OEM-specific configurations such as ECU identifiers. 
 - Lead security testing, vulnerability assessments, production build validation, and system stabilization activities. 
 - Collaborate with SoC vendors, TEE vendors, OEMs, and cross-functional teams to resolve complex security challenges. 
 - Ensure compliance with automotive cybersecurity standards, customer requirements, and internal security specifications. 
 - Define and drive the security architecture, technical roadmap, and strategic direction for Android and Embedded Linux platforms. 
 - Lead technical reviews, architecture discussions, security risk assessments, and design decision governance across programs. 
 - Mentor and guide engineering teams on security best practices, implementation strategies, and advanced troubleshooting techniques. 
 - Act as the primary technical interface for customers, OEMs, suppliers, and cybersecurity stakeholders. 
 - Drive root cause analysis and resolution of complex security issues spanning bootloader, kernel, framework, middleware, and TEE layers.

What Makes You A Strong Fit

- Proven experience in automotive embedded systems and platform security. 
 - Strong understanding of ISO/SAE 21434 and automotive cybersecurity processes.

 - In-depth knowledge of GlobalPlatform specifications and TEE architectures.

 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation for security validation, compliance, and release management.

 - Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams and customer-facing technical engagements. 

Things To Know

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

 - Strong programming skills in C/C++ and scripting languages such as Python or Shell.

 - Hands-on experience with Secure Boot, TEE integration, cryptographic services, key management, and secure storage solutions. 
 - Proficiency with debugging and development tools such as GDB, JTAG, ADB, and Linux tracing utilities. 
 - Experience with Git, Gerrit, and collaborative software development workflows. 
 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced product development environment.

data.description:
About The Opportunity

We are looking for experienced QA Automation Engineers - AI-Forward Testing to support PLM and ERP initiatives in a highly collaborative, AI-driven engineering environment. These engineers will work closely with development, product, and project teams to design and scale automated testing frameworks while using AI tools such as Claude to accelerate test planning, test case generation, framework development, specification clarification, and day-to-day QA activities. 

The role requires strong technical judgment and hands-on ownership of quality. AI will be used as an engineering accelerator, but engineers will remain responsible for critically reviewing generated outputs, identifying gaps, validating requirements, performing mandatory manual testing, and ensuring final release quality. 

Responsibilities

- Automation Framework Design & Development: Design, build, maintain, and expand scalable automated testing frameworks for PLM and ERP applications. 
 - AI-Assisted QA Engineering: Leverage AI tools such as Claude to accelerate test planning, test case generation, automation development, framework implementation, debugging, and specification clarification. 
 - Test Strategy & Coverage: Define automated testing strategies and use existing repository specifications and documentation to generate, improve, and expand test coverage. 
 - Specification Analysis: Use interactive AI sessions and direct collaboration with engineering and product teams to clarify requirements, identify inconsistencies or missing specifications, and resolve questions efficiently. 
 - Quality Gatekeeping: Critically review AI-generated test cases, code, recommendations, and technical outputs to ensure they meet engineering, product, and business requirements. 
 - Manual Validation: Conduct mandatory manual testing, exploratory testing, peer testing, and final validation to ensure quality and reliability before release. 
 - Agile Collaboration: Participate actively in PM, engineering, stand-up, planning, and other project ceremonies to help maintain accurate and current requirements, specifications, and QA documentation. 
 - Cross-Functional Communication: Collaborate proactively with distributed engineering, product, and project teams, including developers based in India. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve QA processes, engineering productivity, automation coverage, and project timelines through effective use of AI and automation. 
 - Technical Ownership: Apply strong engineering judgment when deciding how to use AI, what questions to ask, how to validate generated outputs, and when manual intervention or additional technical review is required. 

SOW Requirement Coverage

- AI-Forward QA Lifecycle: Supports the use of AI throughout test planning, test design, test case generation, automation development, specification clarification, and QA documentation. 
 - Automation Framework Development: Establishes and expands automated testing frameworks for PLM and ERP applications using Playwright, Pytest, JavaScript, Postman, and related technologies. 
 - Specification & Documentation Quality: Uses repository specifications, product documentation, project ceremonies, and interactive AI sessions to identify gaps and maintain accurate testing requirements. 
 - Manual & Automated Validation: Ensures AI-generated and automated outputs are subject to engineering review, peer testing, mandatory manual validation, and final quality approval. 
 - Engineering Productivity: Helps reduce project timelines by improving test coverage, automation efficiency, and development productivity while maintaining strong quality standards. 

Risk Mitigation

- Prevents over-reliance on AI-generated testing artifacts by requiring engineering review, manual validation, and critical evaluation of generated test cases and automation code. 
 - Identifies incomplete, inconsistent, or unclear specifications early in the development lifecycle, reducing downstream defects and rework. 
 - Maintains release quality while accelerating delivery through a balanced approach combining AI-assisted automation, peer review, and mandatory manual testing. 
 - Ensures automation frameworks remain scalable, maintainable, and aligned with engineering and business requirements as PLM and ERP projects evolve. 

Required Qualifications

- QA Automation Expertise: Strong hands-on experience in QA automation, automated test strategy, and test framework design and development. 
 - Automation Stack: Hands-on experience with Playwright, Pytest, JavaScript, and Postman. 
 - Programming Knowledge: Familiarity with Golang. 
 - Testing Fundamentals: Strong understanding of test planning, test case design, test execution, validation, regression testing, and release quality assurance. 
 - Framework Ownership: Experience designing, implementing, maintaining, and expanding automation frameworks. 
 - AI-Assisted Engineering: Ability to use AI tools throughout the QA lifecycle while critically reviewing and validating generated test cases, code, recommendations, and documentation. 
 - AI Judgment: Ability to formulate effective questions and prompts, identify unreliable or incomplete AI outputs, and determine when manual review or engineering intervention is required. 
 - Agile Experience: Experience working closely with Product and Engineering teams in Agile environments. 
 - Communication: Strong communication skills with the ability to actively participate in technical discussions, project ceremonies, stand-ups, and conversations with engineering and product stakeholders. 
 - Proactive Mindset: Highly motivated, collaborative, and comfortable working with evolving or incomplete specifications while proactively identifying gaps and inconsistencies. 
 - Distributed Teams: Comfortable working in a highly interactive environment with geographically distributed engineering teams. 

Nice To Have Skills

- Experience with Oracle. 
 - Experience testing PLM or ERP applications. 
 - Previous experience using Claude, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or other Generative AI tools within software testing or engineering workflows. 
 - Experience building automation frameworks through collaborative and interactive AI-assisted development.

Data Masking & Compliance

- 5 to 8 years of experience; education and experience may be combined to satisfy experience requirements.

data.title: Senior Performance Engineer - DGX Cloud
data.description:
Joining NVIDIA's DGX Cloud AI Efficiency Team means advancing the performance, efficiency, and resiliency of large-scale AI workloads. We help AI researchers and platform teams understand end-to-end behavior across GPUs, networking, storage, and software stacks. We are seeking a Senior Performance Engineer to characterize workloads, establish performance baselines, diagnose bottlenecks, and drive optimizations from investigation through deployment. Your work will shape scalable DGX Cloud systems, turn complex measurements into prioritized engineering decisions, and continuously raise the performance and reliability of AI workloads. Join our technically diverse team of infrastructure experts to unlock more efficient AI at scale. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Analyze end-to-end performance of large-scale AI workloads across compute, network, storage, and software stacks. 
 - Design and execute rigorous performance studies to establish baselines, diagnose regressions, and quantify bottlenecks. 
 - Define performance and efficiency evaluation methodologies, benchmarks, and success metrics for AI workloads. 
 - Use profiling, observability, and data analysis to turn performance measurements into actionable optimization plans. 
 - Partner with deep learning engineers, platform teams, and GPU architects to validate and deliver performance improvements. 
 - Communicate performance findings, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to influence system and software design decisions. 

What We Need To See

- BS or higher degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 
 - 12+ years of experience in strong programming skills in C++ and Python, with the ability to build reliable analysis and automation workflows
 - Solid foundation in operating systems, computer architecture, and distributed systems
 - Experience with performance engineering, benchmarking, profiling, and optimization of complex software or systems
 - Ability to communicate technical findings, prioritize high-impact work, and build alignment across teams

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Experience analyzing large-scale AI clusters or distributed training and inference workloads
 - Experience with CUDA, GPU computing systems, and GPU performance analysis
 - Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX/XLA
 - Deep understanding of system-level performance analysis, workload characterization, and optimization

NVIDIA leads the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions, from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for exceptional people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence.

data.title: Specialist
data.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Test Specialist to own the testing of assigned product areas end-to-end and to bring an AI-first way of working into every part of the QA lifecycle. This is an individual contributor role. 

The successful candidate will run sprint testing for their assigned areas, engage directly with Product Management (PMG) on requirements, and partner with the automation team to define what should and should not go into the automation suite for every meaningful change. 

AI-first thinking is a non-negotiable for this role. We expect the person to actively apply AI across requirement analysis, test case generation, test data creation, defect triage, and reporting - in line with our Innovate for Growth 2027 mandate. 

Key Responsibilities

- Product Area Ownership & Sprint Testing
 - Own end-to-end testing of assigned product areas across the sprint lifecycle - from grooming to sign-off. 
 - Design and execute test cases (with AI assistance wherever it accelerates the work), maintain them in QMetry, and drive defects through to closure in Jira. 
 - Ensure adequate coverage of functional, integration, and regression scenarios within sprint timelines. 
 - Maintain low defect slippage to UAT and production for the areas you own - quality of your area is your accountability, not the team's. 

Requirement Discussions with PMG

- Partner with Product Management (PMG) during grooming and requirement discussions to clarify scope, edge cases, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Convert requirements into testable scenarios using AI-driven tooling as a first pass, then refine with domain judgement. 
 - Raise gaps or ambiguities early - before they become defects in later sprints or production incidents. 

Automation Scope Discussions

- Partner with the automation team to define automation scope for every significant sprint change - what to automate, at what level (API, UI, integration), and when. 
 - Provide well-defined scenarios and expected outcomes so automation engineers can build reliable, low-flake tests. 
 - Review automated coverage for the areas you own and flag missing coverage or over-testing. 
 - AI-First Testing Practices
 - Treat AI as a default tool, not a novelty - apply it to requirement analysis, test case generation, test data creation, defect triage, and reporting. 
 - Contribute AI use cases back to the wider QA team - share what works, what doesn't, and where the efficiency gains come from. 

Required Skills & Experience

Must-Have Technical Skills

- Strong experience in functional and system testing across web-based products. 
 - Hands-on experience with test management tools (QMetry preferred) and defect tracking tools (Jira). 
 - Working knowledge of SQL for backend validation and data reconciliation testing. 
 - Familiarity with API testing tools (Postman, Rest Assured, or equivalent) for backend verification. 
 - Understanding of how automation frameworks fit into the QA lifecycle - enough to have informed discussions with automation engineers about scope, coverage, and trade-offs. 
 - Comfort using AI-assisted testing tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) as part of day-to-day work. 

Must-Have Domain Knowledge

- Solid understanding of the capital markets domain - trade lifecycle, order management, commissions, and/or post-trade workflows. 
 - Prior experience in investment banking or buy-side / sell-side technology. 

Must-Have Soft Skills

- AI-first mindset - defaults to AI as the starting point for any repeatable task, actively looks for efficiency and quality gains, and encourages the rest of the team to do the same. 

Strong ownership of assigned product areas - accountable for quality outcomes, not just execution. 

Confident stakeholder engagement with PMG, Development, and Automation teams; comfortable pushing back on requirements or scope where quality is at risk. 

- Clear communication - can explain testing decisions, defect impact, and coverage trade-offs to both technical and business audiences. 
 - Individual contributor maturity - delivers reliably in an IC role without heavy oversight, and knows when to escalate. 

Nice to Have

- Exposure to BDD / Cucumber for shared understanding with the automation team. 
 - Familiarity with mobile testing workflows. 
 - Prior experience testing commission management, order management, or post-trade platforms. 

Euronext Values

Unity

- We respect and value the people we work with
 - We are unified through a common purpose
 - We embrace diversity and strive for inclusion

Integrity

- We value transparency, communicate honestly and share information openly
 - We act with integrity in everything we do
 - We don't hide our mistakes, and we learn from them

Agility

- We act with a sense of urgency and decisiveness
 - We are adaptable, responsive and embrace change
 - We take smart risks

Energy

- We are positively driven to make a difference and challenge the status quo
 - We focus on and encourage personal leadership
 - We motivate each other with our ambition

Accountability

- We deliver maximum value to our customers and stakeholders
 - We take ownership and are accountable for the outcome
 - We reward and celebrate performance

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, gender, age, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, or any other legally protected factor. We value the unique talents of all our people, who come from diverse backgrounds with different personal experiences and points of view and we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect.

This job description is only describing the main activities within a certain role and is not exhaustive. It does not prevent to add more tasks, projects.

As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

The pricing platform supports millions of users every year in finding suitable travel products using technologies such as Java, Scala, Kotlin, Spring, MSSQL, DynamoDB, Redis, AWS, etc. We encourage experimentation with new technologies while maintaining a healthy balance between short- term and long-term goals. The Digital and Emerging Payments team at Amazon is working to make that happen, building payment experiences that work across geographies, platforms, and customer expectations. From Android and Fire devices to resilient back-end systems that guarantee no order is ever lost, the technical challenges here are real and the customer impact is global. 

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to help lead the technical direction of our payments platform. You will own the design and delivery of systems that process transactions at massive scale, mentor fellow engineers, and shape architectural decisions that determine how millions of customers complete their purchases. If you're passionate about solving complex distributed systems challenges and want to make a direct impact on the customer experience, this could be the role for you. 

Key job responsibilities

- Lead the design and delivery of payment platform features end-to-end, ensuring systems are reliable and performant across multiple geographies and device platforms. 
 - Own your team's architectural direction by evaluating technology choices, defining engineering best practices, and guiding future system design while balancing short-term delivery with long-term maintainability. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, partner engineering teams, and stakeholders across Amazon to define requirements, align on technical approaches, and deliver integrated solutions. 
 - Mentor engineers on your team through code reviews, design discussions, and hands-on guidance, raising the overall quality of the codebase. 
 - Use metrics and operational data to identify improvement opportunities, drive rapid iteration on features, and maintain high availability for payment systems. 

A day in the life

You review a design document for a new payment method integration, providing feedback that helps a teammate strengthen their approach. You dive deep into code, building a service component that must process thousands of transactions per second while staying resilient when downstream dependencies are unavailable. You join a cross-team sync with product managers to discuss upcoming requirements for an emerging market, then pair with a junior engineer on a tricky concurrency issue. Throughout the day, you balance hands-on engineering with the architectural thinking that keeps the platform reliable and ready for what comes next. 

About The Team

The Digital and Emerging Payments team is responsible for how Amazon customers pay across the globe. We build and run the systems that connect customers to the payment methods they trust, whether that is a credit card, a mobile wallet, or a region-specific option unique to their market. Our mission is to make every transaction feel simple and reliable. 

We are an inclusive group that values knowledge sharing and mentorship. Team members at every experience level contribute to technical decisions, and we invest in each person's growth by matching projects to development goals. If you want to shape the future of payments at Amazon's scale, we would love to hear from you. 

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
 - 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
