data.title: Lead Response Technology and Automation Security Engineer
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Lead Response Technology and Automation Security Engineer

Overview

The Corporate Security Threat and Response Management product ownership team is looking for a Lead Level Security Engineer to help drive our Security Operations modernization strategy. The ideal candidate is passionate about the modern security tools, capabilities, and strategies. 

The RESPOND product team executes on the multi-year strategy and roadmap set by the RESPOND product owner to evolve and modernize SecOps incident investigation and response technology, capabilities, tools, and process. 

Response product team members work closely with regional SOC teams to execute the RESPOND product strategy on the ground. This role is the connective tissue between product vision and operational reality: building, tuning, and operationalizing response automation, AI-augmented workflows, and analyst tooling that SOC and DFIR teams rely on every day. The RESPOND product team is hands-on with SOAR development, agentic AI integration, notebook-based investigation tooling, and continuous improvement of analyst workflows. 

Core Responsibilities

- Execute the RESPOND product roadmap in close partnership with SOC and Incident Response teams in the region. 
 - Design, build, test, and maintain SOAR playbooks used for incident triage and response scopes to collect and process digital evidence and artifacts at speed and scale. 
 - Build and operationalize AI-augmented response capabilities, including: 
 - Agentic AI workflows integrated into triage, enrichment, and response. 
 - Prompt books and prompt libraries tuned for SOC and Incident Response use cases. 
 - Prompt-book/code notebook (Jupyter, etc) development for repeatable investigation, hunt, and DFIR workflows. 
 - LLM-driven enrichment and summarization integrated into case management. 
 - Define strategic requirements and oversee management for connectors, apps, and integrations between SOAR, SIEM, EDR, identity, ticketing, threat intelligence, and AI/LLM platforms (including MCP servers where applicable) for build through our dedicated engineering partners. 
 - Build and maintain response tooling: scripts, live-response packages, enrichment services, and automation utilities deployable via EDR and SOAR. 
 - Embed with SOC and DFIR analysts to identify high-toil workflows and convert them into automated, AI-assisted, or fully autonomous playbooks with appropriate guardrails. 
 - Tune and optimize playbooks and AI-assisted workflows against measurable outcomes (MTTR, false-positive rate, analyst touch time, AI-assist accuracy). 
 - Contribute to the centralized response tooling, prompt book, and notebook libraries, ensuring code quality, documentation, version control, and reusability across regions. 
 - Support major incident response activities by deploying and operating response tooling and AI-assisted investigation workflows under pressure. 
 - Provide feedback into the product backlog and partner with the PO on requirements refinement. 
 - Document playbooks, prompt books, notebooks, and technical designs to enterprise standards. 

All About You

- 5+ years in security operations, incident response, detection engineering, or security automation engineering
 - Prior experience as a SOC analyst, Security Engineer, Digital Forensics Examiner, SOAR engineer, and/or threat hunter preferred. 
 - Hands-on SOAR development experience with low-code/no-code or hyper-automation tools and concepts. Must be able to define and build reliable, scalable response capabilities. 
 - Demonstrated enterprise experience executing on AI-augmented SOC concepts, including at least two of: 
 - Building and maintaining AI prompt books for analyst workflows. 
 - Developing Jupyter notebooks for investigation, hunt, or DFIR. 
 - Integrating LLMs or agentic AI into XDR, SOAR, case management, or response tooling. 
 - Leveraging IDEs with AI connectors to process data and execute AI workflows
 - Deploying agent-based AI workflows for triage or enrichment in production. 
 - Strong scripting skills in Python and PowerShell. Comfortable with basic code repo management using Git or equivalent. 
 - Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and authentication patterns (OAuth, API keys, managed identities). 
 - Solid grounding in incident response fundamentals and the IR lifecycle. 
 - Hands-on experience with: EDR platforms (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Defender for Endpoint), SIEM (Splunk ES, Microsoft Sentinel), identity platforms (Entra ID, Okta), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and cloud protection products (CNAPP, CWPP, CSPM). 
 - Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and the ability to map response actions to adversary techniques. 
 - Demonstrated ability to operate inside an agile delivery model with a product backlog. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, cybersecurity, or IT-focused disciplines (or equivalent experience). 
 - At least two Industry certifications: GCFA, GCIH, GNFA, GCFR, GREM, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with SecOps focused MCP server architectures, agentic frameworks, or tools
 - Experience building EDR live-response scripts and tool libraries. 
 - Exposure to detection-as-code and response-as-code practices, including CI/CD for security content. 
 - Background in regulated financial services or Fortune 500 SOC environments. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Staff Devops Engg
data.description:
Staff DevOps EngineerAbout the Role

LeadSquared serves thousands of businesses around the world, each with its own requirements for data residency, latency, and compliance. CloudOps runs the infrastructure behind all of it: the production estate that serves customers today, the shared services every product team depends on, and the modern platform that new products are built on. 

We're hiring a Staff DevOps Engineer to set the technical direction for infrastructure across the whole LeadSquared platform. This is not a ticket queue role. You'll decide how a new environment comes up, how tenants are isolated, how a production change is reviewed and rolled out, how existing workloads move to more modern foundations without disrupting customers, and how we know something is broken before a customer tells us. Then you'll build those systems and make sure they keep working after you move on to the next problem. 

You'll work across CloudOps, every product engineering team, Security, and Engineering leadership. Your influence will reach well beyond the code you write yourself. 

What You'll Own

- Architecture: Set the long-term direction for LeadSquared's cloud infrastructure across all products and environments through design documents and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs). Lead migrations from today's estate to a standardised platform without customer impact. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Bring all infrastructure under reviewed code with safe change practices, including PR-driven plan and apply, policy as code, drift detection, and production guardrails. 
 - Runtime and Delivery: Own the compute, Kubernetes, and CI/CD platforms so that shipping a service or onboarding a tenant becomes self-service. 
 - Reliability: Define SLOs, own observability, lead major incidents and postmortems, and regularly test disaster recovery. 
 - Security and Compliance: Enforce least-privilege access, secrets management, and encryption by default. Support audits through automated evidence collection. 
 - Cost Optimisation: Treat cloud spend as an engineering metric, with visibility into costs per product, tenant, and service. 
 - Leadership: Mentor engineers, represent CloudOps to product teams, and eliminate operational toil through automation. 

What We're Looking ForMinimum Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, infrastructure, or platform engineering, with clear ownership of production systems at meaningful scale. 
 - Deep, hands-on AWS expertise, including multi-account organisations, networking, IAM, compute, containers, managed data services, and edge delivery. 
 - Expert-level Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform or equivalent tools, including designing reusable modules and structuring code across multiple environments. 
 - Expert-level Kubernetes experience in production, including cluster upgrades, autoscaling, networking, RBAC, and debugging under pressure. 
 - Production experience with CI/CD and GitOps practices. 
 - Experience running and migrating a large, existing production estate, not just building greenfield environments. 
 - Strong programming or scripting skills in at least one language, with the ability to build production-grade tooling. 
 - A track record of leading incidents, writing postmortems, and delivering the reliability improvements that follow. 
 - Proven ability to write clear technical documents and influence decisions across teams without formal authority. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience designing or operating highly available, active-active, or disaster recovery (DR) architectures in the cloud. 
 - Experience leading large-scale migrations, such as moving from virtual machines to containers, with zero or near-zero customer impact. 
 - Experience building an observability practice with SLOs and error budgets. 
 - Experience with policy as code and software supply chain security. 
 - Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms, including tenant isolation models, per-tenant routing, and capacity management. 
 - FinOps experience with demonstrable cloud cost reductions. 
 - Contributions to open-source infrastructure tooling or public speaking and writing on platform engineering. 

What Success Looks LikeFirst 90 Days

- Understand LeadSquared's infrastructure end to end across products, accounts, and environments, and join the on-call and incident commander rotation. 
 - Deliver at least one meaningful improvement to change safety or developer experience across teams. 
 - Produce a written assessment of the platform's top reliability, security, and cost risks, along with a proposed roadmap. 

First Year

- New environments can be provisioned from code in days, not weeks. 
 - Most production infrastructure is managed as code and changed only through reviewed pull requests. 
 - SLOs are defined for critical customer journeys, alerting is driven by them, and error budgets inform release decisions. 
 - Disaster recovery has been tested end to end, with documented results. 
 - Cloud spend per unit of load is measurably lower. 
 - At least two engineers on the team are operating at the next level as a result of your mentorship. 

How We Work

- Everything is code, everything is reviewed: Infrastructure changes go through pull requests, plans are visible, and production applies are deliberate. 
 - Standards over snowflakes: One consistent way to build an environment, deploy a service, and manage observability. 
 - Blameless by default: Incidents are opportunities to improve systems, not to blame people. 
 - Writing is how we decide: Design documents and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) come before major changes. 

LeadSquared is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of gender, religion, caste, disability, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

data.title: Sr Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone-freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow- helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. 

Join us to put AI to work for people. 

Job Description

Position Overview

ServiceNow is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Staff Software Engineer for platform engineering across DevOps, Deployment, and Performance Engineering functions within the PAXE DevOps & Performance Engineering organization. This role sits at the intersection of developer productivity, AI-native tooling, and operational excellence, owning the systems and practices that enable teams to ship with speed and confidence. 

As a technical anchor on the team, you will drive the strategy and execution for CI/CD pipeline enablement, the cross team AI development platform, and shift-left performance engineering. You will work closely with partner organizations including framework, UX and other engineering teams to build the infrastructure and tooling that powers how AI is built, tested, and delivered at ServiceNow. Success in this role requires strong cross-functional collaboration aligning on developer experience, end-to-end delivery, and platform teams on observability and release quality. This role offers high executive visibility and the opportunity to shape foundational engineering practices across the organization. 

Key Responsibilities

DevOps & Release Engineering

- Lead design and execution of CI/CD pipeline enablement, working with devProd to improve developer throughput, greenlight processes, and merge guidance. 
 - Own the Application Rating Tool and observability infrastructure, partnering with platform teams to surface actionable engineering metrics via a centralized dashboard. 
 - Drive the all Pods technically, establishing scalable testing patterns across frameworks and applications built on Karuna. 
 - Build and maintain the IT initial triage agent, applying AI to automate first-line engineering support. 

Cross team delivery Platform

- Own the cross team platform roadmap. 
 - Architect and implement batch API strategies to avoid API rate-limit thresholds and improve platform reliability. 
 - Build and iterate on the Pod Coach / Scrum Master agent, applying agentic AI to improve team delivery workflows. 
 - Drive MCP integration and lead weekly communications, demos, and governance meetings to align stakeholders and scale adoption. 
 - Maintain documentation and program-level visibility. 

Performance Engineering

- Lead a shift-left performance strategy, embedding client, API, and page-load performance tooling earlier in the development lifecycle. 
 - Define and drive performance monitoring requirements for Lit based framework and application-level workloads. 
 - Own the Performance Tooling efforts, reporting infrastructure, and test data strategy. 
 - Coordinate with the broader Performance Engineering team on MCP integration and result triage workflows. 

Technical Leadership

- Act as a technical leader and mentor, setting engineering standards, driving code quality, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. 
 - Champion the use of AI to accelerate DevOps and platform engineering including AI-assisted PR reviews, skill/agent development, deployment recommendations, test generation, and predictive monitoring. 
 - Partner with Engineering Managers and cross-functional teams to align on roadmap priorities, delivery milestones, and operational health. 

Qualifications

- Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry. 
 - 12+ years of software engineering experience in a high-traffic, cloud-based environment, with at least 3 years in a senior or staff-level individual contributor role. 
 - Strong proficiency in Java, javascript and/or Python, with solid understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, and scalable service design. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with CI/CD platforms (e. g. , Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and modern DevOps tooling at scale including pipeline design, build optimization, and release automation. 
 - Expert-level knowledge of Kubernetes and container orchestration
 - Strong observability and monitoring background - hands-on with Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, or equivalent stacks; able to design and instrument dashboards, alerts, and SLO/SLI frameworks across distributed services. 
 - Experience operating and debugging services on Kubernetes clusters - log aggregation, tracing, resource profiling, and incident response in containerized environments. 
 - Demonstrated experience building and operating developer productivity or internal platform tooling. 
 - Understanding of performance engineering concepts including load testing, API latency profiling, page-load optimization, and shift-left testing strategies. 
 - Track record of applying AI/ML or agentic AI to engineering workflows; experience with MCP, A2A, or AI-native development platforms is a strong plus. 
 - Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills - able to influence partner orgs (App and platform teams), lead governance forums, and drive alignment without direct authority. 
 - Familiarity with the ServiceNow platform is a plus. 

Additional Information

Work Personas

Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow. com for assistance.

data.description:
Who We Are Looking For

We are seeking a hands-on process and knowledge engineer to join Alpha Intelligence, State Street's AI & Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations. You will help transform complex processes end to end - understanding how work is done today, designing simpler future-state processes, and enabling automation and AI solutions that improve speed, control and client outcomes. 

The ideal candidate is analytical, structured and delivery-focused, comfortable working directly with subject-matter experts, and able to own a workstream of process discovery and documentation end to end with limited supervision. 

Why this role is important to us

Alpha Intelligence goes beyond documenting processes - we redesign how Alpha implementations are delivered. This role connects process discovery, future-state design, automation and AI, implementation and continuous improvement. 

About The Team - Alpha Intelligence

Alpha Intelligence is State Street's AI & Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations - the team rewiring how the industry's first front-to-back platform gets delivered. We turn the deep expertise locked inside our implementation teams into engineered processes, governed knowledge and intelligent agents that cut manual effort, compress client go-live timelines and make every implementation faster and more predictable than the last. 

We operate as one global team across the US, UK, Europe, India and APAC, combining process engineering, automation delivery, AI platform engineering and responsible-AI governance under a single roof. We work on real client implementations, not pilots that sit on a shelf - what we build is adopted, measured and scaled. If you want to shape how AI is applied to one of the most complex delivery landscapes in financial services, this is the team to do it in. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

- Conduct process discovery through interviews, shadowing, walkthroughs and system observation with implementation and operations subject-matter experts. 
 - Own end-to-end process transformation for assigned workstreams, from discovery and future-state design through implementation, adoption and continuous improvement. 
 - Map and assess current-state processes, including handoffs, systems, data, controls and exceptions, to identify root causes, effort, risk and friction. 
 - Design simpler, standardized future-state processes that improve controls and use the right mix of people, process, data, automation and AI. 
 - Structure and tag content for search, RAG and agent use, ensuring knowledge assets are discoverable, accurate and maintainable. 
 - Validate process and knowledge assets with subject-matter experts, manage signoffs and maintain version control. 
 - Prioritize redesign, automation and AI opportunities, and define the expected benefits and success measures. 
 - Turn approved future-state designs into clear requirements and implementation plans, working with automation, AI, technology, operations and change teams. 
 - Support rollout and adoption, track results, and use feedback to improve the process over time. 
 - Maintain accurate status, progress and delivery reporting for your assigned workstream, escalating risks and blockers early. 
 - Coordinate across regional teams and time zones to enable seamless handoffs and effective dependency management. 

What We Value

- Strong structured thinking and attention to detail - precision matters in process and knowledge engineering. 
 - Curiosity and persistence in getting to the real process, not just the documented one. 
 - Self-driven delivery with the ability to produce quality outcomes with minimal follow-up. 
 - Clear, concise written and verbal communication, especially in documentation. 
 - A collaborative mindset and comfort working with senior subject-matter experts and global stakeholders. 

Experience And Capabilities That Will Help You Succeed

- 10 to 15 years of relevant experience in business process analysis, process documentation, operations, transformation or automation delivery within financial services. 
 - Working knowledge of investment management or capital markets operations across front, middle and back office and the trade lifecycle. 
 - Hands-on experience with process mapping and documentation methods and tools, exposure to BPMN, Visio, UiPath Task Capture, ARIS or comparable platforms is beneficial. 
 - Familiarity with automation platforms such as UiPath and an understanding of what makes a process automatable. 
 - Good understanding of AI and GenAI concepts, including how structured knowledge and content quality drive RAG and agent performance. 
 - Strong analytical and documentation skills, with proficiency in relevant collaboration, data and presentation tools such as JIRA, Confluence, SQL, Excel or PowerPoint; equivalent tools and transferable experience are welcome. 
 - Ability to plan, prioritize and deliver milestones in a fast-moving programme environment. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with regional teams, occasional participation outside local working hours may be required for planned handoffs or critical discussions. 

Education & Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Technology, Engineering, Finance, Management or Information Systems, or equivalent relevant professional experience. 
 - Process excellence or automation certifications (e. g. , Lean Six Sigma, BPM, UiPath) are an advantage. 

Interested but do not meet every qualification? If your experience and transferable skills align with the overall role, we encourage you to apply. We value different paths to building relevant expertise and will consider the full picture of what you can bring to the team. 

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. 

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. data.description:
Role Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Privileged Access Management (PAM) Engineering Manager - Vice President to join the Global Cybersecurity organization. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who thrives in complex, highly regulated environments and is passionate about privileged access security, CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault, PIM, AKV, AWS, automation, platform modernization, and operational resilience. 

The role will drive engineering ownership for strategic PAM capabilities across the enterprise, including CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault, privileged account onboarding, secrets management, automation, access modernization, platform reliability, and integration with enterprise IAM, security, and cloud ecosystems. 

- Role Title: PAM Engineering Manager - Vice President
 - Capability: Privileged Access Management / Infrastructure Access Management
 - Function: Global Cybersecurity
 - Primary Focus: CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault, PIM, AKV, AWS, PAM engineering, platform modernization, automation, and risk reduction
 - Location: Bangalore or Hyderabad

Key Responsibilities

PAM Engineering Leadership

- Lead the engineering lifecycle for enterprise PAM platforms, including CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault, CA-PAM migration support, PIM, AKV, AWS, and related privileged access capabilities. 
 - Drive platform architecture, design, implementation, integration, and continuous improvement for privileged access services. 
 - Own engineering delivery for strategic PAM initiatives such as CyberArk platform uplift, HashiCorp adoption, secrets management expansion, CPM/PSM capability development, access modernization, and migration from legacy PAM platforms. 
 - Partner with product, operations, governance, application, infrastructure, and cloud teams to ensure PAM engineering outcomes align with business priorities, risk requirements, and enterprise security standards. 
 - Lead engineering design and implementation across CyberArk components including Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM, PSMP, DR, connectors, integrations, monitoring, and platform automation. 
 - Drive HashiCorp Vault engineering for secrets management use cases including cloud workload identities, Azure service principals, AWS workloads, static secrets, database secrets, certificate/PKI use cases, and application credential modernization. 
 - Ensure PAM platforms are engineered for scalability, resilience, auditability, and secure operations. 
 - Support design patterns for privileged account onboarding across Windows, Unix/Linux, databases, network devices, cloud platforms, service accounts, application accounts, and non-human identities. 
 - Identify and deliver automation opportunities to reduce manual effort, ticket volume, operational risk, and configuration errors. 
 - Drive API, scripting, CI/CD, Terraform, PowerShell, REST API, and workflow-based automation for PAM and secrets management use cases. 
 - Establish reusable engineering patterns, onboarding templates, reference architectures, and technical accelerators. 
 - Promote engineering practices such as test automation, code review, tech debt reduction, platform refactoring, and continuous improvement. 
 - Ensure PAM engineering solutions support least privilege, zero trust, credential vaulting, session monitoring, access control, audit logging, and regulatory expectations. 
 - Partner with governance and audit teams to close control gaps, support evidence generation, remediate findings, and improve control traceability. 
 - Drive remediation of platform-related vulnerabilities, configuration gaps, audit issues, and resiliency risks. 
 - Ensure PAM controls integrate with IAM, SIEM, ServiceNow, SailPoint, monitoring, change management, and incident response processes. 
 - Collaborate with global technology, cybersecurity, infrastructure, application, cloud, risk, audit, and business stakeholders. 
 - Translate business and regulatory requirements into scalable PAM engineering solutions. 
 - Provide senior technical leadership during major incidents, platform escalations, design reviews, audit discussions, and program governance forums. 
 - Work across time zones and global teams to support enterprise delivery. 
 - Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing PAM engineering team. 
 - Provide technical guidance to engineers and support teams across L2/L3/L4 responsibilities. 
 - Build engineering capability across CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault, cloud PAM, automation, secrets management, and non-human identity security. 
 - Foster a culture of accountability, engineering discipline, innovation, documentation, and operational excellence. 
 - Create and maintain architecture diagrams, engineering standards, SOPs, runbooks, implementation patterns, knowledge articles, and support handover documents. 
 - Ensure documentation is audit-ready, operationally usable, and aligned to enterprise standards. 
 - Establish clear ownership models, RACI alignment, support handoffs, escalation paths, and post-implementation validation practices. 

Your Team

You will be part of the Global Cybersecurity Privileged Access Management / Infrastructure Access Management team, responsible for engineering and modernizing enterprise privileged access, secrets management and non-human identity/account capabilities. The team supports business-critical access platforms that enable secure infrastructure access, privileged credential management, session control, secrets management, and privileged access governance across the enterprise. 

This role will work closely with PAM Operations, PAM Governance, Cloud Security, Infrastructure, Application Technology, Risk, Audit, and Product teams to deliver secure, scalable, and resilient privileged access services. 

Required Experience

- 16+ years of technology experience, with significant experience in cybersecurity, IAM, PAM, infrastructure security, or platform engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with one or more leading PAM platforms such as CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault, BeyondTrust, Delinea, or CA-PAM. 
 - Deep understanding of privileged account management, credential vaulting, session monitoring, password rotation, privileged access workflows, and least privilege principles. 
 - Experience leading large-scale PAM engineering or modernization initiatives in complex enterprise environments. 
 - Strong knowledge of CyberArk architecture and components such as Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM, PSMP, DR, connectors, policies, safes, platforms, and onboarding patterns. 
 - Experience with HashiCorp Vault architecture, secrets engines, authentication methods, policies, namespaces, replication, audit logging, and application integration patterns. 
 - Experience integrating PAM solutions with IAM, SIEM, ServiceNow, SailPoint, Active Directory, cloud platforms, and enterprise monitoring tools. 
 - Strong understanding of Windows, Linux/Unix, databases, network devices, cloud platforms, service accounts, and application credential management. 
 - Experience with platform upgrades, patching, DR validation, certificate management, vulnerability remediation, and operational readiness. 
 - Experience with Agile delivery, Jira, change management, incident management, problem management, and production support governance. 

Technical Skills

- CyberArk: Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM, PSMP, PTA, EPM, AIM/Conjur or Secrets Manager capabilities. 
 - HashiCorp Vault: KV, database secrets, AppRole, LDAP/OIDC, Kubernetes auth, PKI, transit, dynamic secrets, replication, audit logging. 
 - Automation: PowerShell, Python, Shell scripting, REST APIs, Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Cloud: Azure, AWS, hybrid cloud identity and access patterns. 
 - Integrations: ServiceNow, SailPoint, Active Directory, LDAP, SIEM, monitoring platforms, application onboarding workflows. 
 - Governance: audit evidence, access reviews, control validation, policy compliance, risk remediation. 

Leadership Skills

- Proven ability to lead technical initiatives and drive results across teams without relying solely on direct authority. 
 - Strong people leadership, mentoring, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills. 
 - Ability to simplify complex technical topics for senior stakeholders, risk partners, and engineering teams. 
 - Strong ownership mindset with focus on stability, security, resilience, and measurable delivery outcomes. 
 - Ability to operate effectively across global teams and time zones. 

Preferred Qualifications

- CyberArk Defender / Sentry / CDE certification. 
 - HashiCorp Vault Associate or Professional certification. 
 - Cloud certifications in Azure or AWS. 
 - Experience with non-human identity governance, secrets discovery, credential rotation automation, and elimination of hardcoded credentials. 
 - Experience with PAM modernization programs, CA-PAM to CyberArk/HashiCorp migration, cloud-native PAM, and ephemeral access models. 
 - Familiarity with regulatory, audit, and risk expectations in financial services. 
 - Experience leading transformation from operational support models into engineering-led platform ownership. 
 - Timely closure of audit findings, control gaps, and vulnerability remediation items. 
 - Successful migration from legacy PAM platforms to strategic PAM capabilities. 
 - Stronger engineering documentation, SOPs, runbooks, and operational handover readiness. 
 - Measurable improvement in onboarding cycle time, incident reduction, and change success rate. 
 - Capability uplift across PAM engineering teams through mentoring, training, and certification.

What We Absolutely Need

 - Strong hands-on experience with Node. js and Express. js

- Develop VFD-based applications and integrate them with PLCs, HMIs, SCADA, and IoT platforms in collaboration with system architects and automation engineers

Why you'll love working here

data.description:
## ROLE SUMMARY

Are you a hands-on engineer who raises the bar for everyone around you?

Join us at FTSE Russell! We're establishing a team of engineers passionate about software craftsmanship, quality, and substantial impact. As a Lead Software Engineer, you'll own the technical direction of the software that powers the indices trusted by financial institutions worldwide. 

We build primarily in Python, so that's our preference - but depth of engineering judgement matters more to us than the language on your CV. If you've led the design and delivery of serious systems in Java, C#, C, C++, Scala, Go, or Rust and you're motivated to lead in Python, we'd like to talk. At this level we expect you to become fluent quickly and to bring the cross-language perspective with you. 

This is a hands-on Lead IC role - not a management role. You'll still be writing and reviewing code every week. What changes at this level is scope: you own architecture and technical direction in a defined area, you mentor and grow the engineers around you, and you raise quality across the team through reuse, good design, and hands-on support. The systems handle serious volumes of financial data, so there's real depth in the data problems - but you're being hired as a software engineer who leads through code. 

If you're excited about building systems that matter and making the engineers around you better, we'd love to meet you. 

## WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

We're building the next-generation index data platform at FTSE Russell - and we want you to shape it with us: 

- Staying hands-on - designing and writing production code, primarily in Python with 10 +yrs of experience , and setting the standard for what good looks like through the code you ship
 - Owning technical direction and architecture for a defined area of the platform, and making the trade-offs explicit so the team can move fast with confidence
 - Leading design of software systems - services, APIs, shared libraries, and the interfaces between them - with resilience, performance, and reusability designed in
 - Driving engineering quality across the team: raising the bar in code review, reducing duplication through well-designed shared components, and championing testing, refactoring, and secure development practices
 - Mentoring and coaching engineers - pairing, reviewing, and growing capability so that good practice outlives any one project
 - Digging into design and risk trade-offs - failure modes, operational readiness, security, and cost - and resolving the blockers that slow the team down
 - Designing data-intensive software across relational databases (Aurora PostgreSQL), object storage, and AWS services, with careful attention to schema design and evolution at scale
 - Building software that processes data at scale on AWS - Lambda, containerised services, and where appropriate Glue, EMR Serverless, and lakehouse table formats such as Apache Iceberg
 - Embedding observability and quality controls so issues are found before customers find them
 - Influencing and collaborating across teams, and translating between technical and non-technical audiences
 - Building deep knowledge of the financial indices domain and using it to guide team-level design

## WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Essential - this is the bar: 

- A substantial track record of building and shipping software. Applications, services, platforms, or libraries you designed, built, ran in production, and evolved over years - not just pipelines and scripts
 - Python is our preference, but not a hard gate at this level either. Either you already lead in production Python, or you have equivalent depth in Java, C#, C, C++, Scala, Go, or Rust and are motivated to make Python your primary language here. Engineers who have worked across several languages often bring the sharpest design judgement, and we value that
 - Depth in software design and architecture - you can decompose a complex problem, choose the right boundaries, and explain why. You know which patterns earn their keep and which are cargo cult
 - You write and review excellent code. In Python: type hints, linters, strong pytest discipline, and an instinct for readable, maintainable code - and the equivalent rigour in any other language you've worked in
 - You are genuinely hands-on and intend to stay that way. Leading through code is the point of this role
 - Proven experience mentoring and levelling up other engineers - through code review, pairing, design guidance, and setting standards
 - Strong ownership of technical outcomes - you take responsibility for what production does, not just what merges
 - Deep experience with relational databases (e. g. Aurora PostgreSQL) - modelling, performance, and evolution under real load
 - Solid AWS experience and strong CI/CD, automation, and testing practice
 - Comfort with data-intensive systems - batch processing, ETL, schema evolution, and reasoning about correctness at volume
 - Excellent communication - you tailor how you explain design decisions to technical and non-technical audiences and create shared understanding
 - You value collaboration over solo heroics and thrive in Agile teams

## NICE TO HAVES

Beneficial, but not what we're screening on: 

- Apache Spark / PySpark and experience optimising large-scale distributed processing
 - Big data experience - designing systems for datasets and workloads well beyond single-machine scale
 - Breadth across languages used in data-intensive and performance-critical systems - Scala, Java, C++, Go, or Rust - and the judgement to know when reaching for one is warranted
 - Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or similar open table formats, and lakehouse architecture
 - Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable data platforms
 - CI/CD tooling such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions
 - Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CDK) and platform/DevOps exposure
 - Data quality frameworks like Great Expectations or Deequ
 - Experience in financial markets, index data, or investment analytics
 - Experience in finance domain (investment banking, asset/portfolio management) or in any product company

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth. 

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

data.title: Director - Data Engineering
data.description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Innovation & Data Office (IDO) team, part of our Marsh Tech business at Marsh. This role will be based in Mumbai/Pune. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office. 

Director - Data Engineering (G)

This is a hands-on leadership role. You lead a squad of data engineers and you also build things yourself. You're the person who can whiteboard a data model in the morning, pair with an engineer on a tricky pipeline in the afternoon and present a delivery plan to a business stakeholder before end of day. You don't just point; you drive. 

You'll own technical delivery for priority initiatives within Marsh's Innovation & Data Office (IDO). Your first assignment will likely be in one of our Mercer businesses (Wealth or Careers), but the expectation is fungibility, not permanent domain alignment. As IDO's priorities evolve, so will yours. The constant is the quality of your engineering leadership, not the label on the work. Your squad will be a mix of employees and contractors, and you'll be responsible for making that team perform as a unit: setting standards, unblocking problems, mentoring engineers, and holding the bar on quality. The work lands in Databricks. The outcomes land in the business. 

The key distinction: This is not a people-management role that happens to involve data. It's a hands-on technical leadership role where managing people is one of the things you do, alongside designing architecture, writing code, reviewing PRs, and solving hard data problems. If your last few years have been spent in meetings about data rather than working with data, this isn't the right fit. 

We will count on you to: 

- Lead a delivery squad. You'll run a pod of 4-8 data engineers (employees and contractors) assembled against a business outcome. You set the technical direction, decompose work, manage sprint-level execution, and are accountable for what the squad ships. When the initiative concludes or transitions to steady state, you and your engineers move to the next priority. 
 - Build with your hands. You write code. You build pipelines. You debug production issues. You're comfortable in SQL, Python, and Spark, and you use them regularly, not as a party trick, but as your primary tools. When something is broken or behind, you can step in and do the work, not just escalate it. 
 - Design before you build. You think in terms of data models, medallion architectures, ingestion contracts, and reusable patterns. You design solutions that are maintainable and that the next engineer can understand without an archaeology expedition. You care about schema evolution, data quality checks, idempotency, and lineage, not because someone told you to, but because you've been burned when those things were missing. 
 - Engage with the business. You're not building pipelines into a void. You'll work directly with Engagement Leads and business stakeholders to understand what they need, why they need it, and what "done" looks like. You translate business problems into data solutions and push back when what's being asked for doesn't make technical sense. You're comfortable in a room with non-technical leaders and can explain complexity without hiding behind jargon. 
 - Drive engineering standards. CI/CD, version control, testing, code review, documentation: these aren't aspirational for you, they're how you've always worked. You'll bring these practices to your squad and raise the bar for everyone around you. You care about developer experience and operational excellence, not just feature delivery. 
 - Operate on a modern stack. The platform is Databricks (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Spark, medallion architecture) running on AWS and Azure. You'll work with infrastructure-as-code, Git-based workflows, and pipeline orchestration tooling. If you've spent the last several years in the Databricks ecosystem, great. If you've built equivalent capabilities on other modern platforms and can ramp quickly, that works too. 

What you need to have: 

- 5+ years of hands-on data engineering experience, with at least some time leading or mentoring other engineers
 - Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Spark, used recently and regularly, not years ago
 - Real experience with cloud data platforms (Databricks strongly preferred; Snowflake, Synapse, or similar accepted) on AWS, Azure, or GCP
 - Demonstrated ability to lead a mixed team of employees and contractors: setting expectations, managing performance, building cohesion across employment types
 - Fluency with modern engineering practices: Git, CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure-as-code, DataOps
 - The instinct to understand why something is being built, not just how. Intellectual curiosity about the business domain you're working in
 - Clear communication skills; you can explain a technical tradeoff to a business leader and a business requirement to an engineer with equal ease

What makes you stand out: 

- Experience with Databricks specifically: Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, medallion architecture, Databricks workflows
 - Experience with dbt or similar transformation frameworks
 - Familiarity with data governance patterns: lineage, access controls, metadata management, data quality frameworks
 - Prior work in financial services, insurance, benefits, or consulting environments
 - Experience with document or unstructured data ingestion pipelines
 - Exposure to LLM-based tooling, AI-assisted development, or analytics engineering

What success looks like: 

- Your squad ships. Pipelines go to production. Data lands in silver and gold. Business users consume it. You're measured by outcomes delivered, not activity performed. 
 - Your engineers grow. People on your team get better, technically and professionally. Contractors ramp fast because you've built clear standards and onboarding patterns. 
 - Each initiative leaves things better than it found them. Reusable assets (curated datasets, documented schemas, tested pipelines) accumulate so the next project starts from a stronger baseline, regardless of domain. 
 - Business stakeholders trust you. They come to you not just for status updates, but for advice on what's possible and what's worth doing. You've earned credibility by delivering, not by presenting. 
 - You raise the engineering bar. Code quality, testing coverage, and operational reliability improve across the squad. Standards you set become the ones others adopt. 

How to Think About This Role: 

If you're looking for: 

- A pure management role where you delegate all technical work
 - A stable, unchanging scope with years of predictable roadmap
 - A role where you wait for requirements to arrive before you act

. . . This probably isn't the right fit. 

If you're energized by: 

- Building things yourself while also leading a team
 - Working on hard data problems in a business that's genuinely complex
 - Setting the technical standard and watching your team rise to meet it
 - Engaging directly with the business to understand what matters and why
 - Joining an organization that's being built, not just maintained

Why join our team: 

- We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders. 
 - We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities. 
 - Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being. 

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95, 000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh. com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X. 

Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. 

NVIDIA is a "learning machine" that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life's work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. As part of this team, you would be working on projects that will help make our next generation visual computing, automotive, GPU, HPC systems better. You will get to work on high performance CPU and Memory sub-systems, Next-Gen GPUs , NOC based Interconnect Fabric etc. Make the choice to join us today. 

We are looking for a motivated engineer to drive the transformation of performance verification workflows through AI and automation. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy solutions that accelerate verification cycles, improve coverage, and reduce manual effort across hardware performance verification project lifecycles. You will be at the forefront of redefining how performance verification is done at scale - replacing repetitive manual analysis with intelligent, self-improving automation that helps engineers focus on what matters most. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Automate verification workflows by building AI/ML-based tools that generate, triage, and analyse performance test cases and results
 - Develop intelligent agents that can identify performance regressions, root-cause failures, and recommend corrective actions
 - Integrate LLM-based assistants into existing verification infrastructure to enable natural-language querying of results, specs, and coverage data
 - Design data pipelines to collect, curate, and label verification data for model training and continuous improvement
 - Collaborate with verification engineers to understand pain points, define automation priorities, and validate AI-driven solutions against real-world workflows
 - Establish metrics and dashboards to measure automation impact (cycle time reduction, coverage improvement, engineer productivity)
 - Stay current with state-of-the-art techniques in generative AI, reinforcement learning, and formal methods as they apply to hardware verification

What We Need To See

- B. Tech/M. Tech/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
 - 3+ years of experience in hardware verification, performance validation, or EDA tool development
 - Strong programming skills in Python; familiarity with C/C++, SystemVerilog/UVM is a plus
 - Hands-on experience with ML/AI frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn) or LLM APIs (OpenAI, NVIDIA NIM/NeMo)
 - Understanding of performance verification methodologies (benchmarking, profiling, regression analysis)
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Experience applying ML to EDA or verification problems (e. g. , coverage closure, bug prediction, test generation)
 - Familiarity with RAG architectures, prompt engineering, and agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, etc. )
 - Knowledge of NVIDIA GPU/SoC architecture or similar complex hardware platforms
 - Published work or patents in AI-for-verification or related domains

data.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer – Firmware, Pre/Post-Silicon Boot & Automation
data.description:
Build the Future of SoC Software Validation!

Do you enjoy solving complex engineering problems? Are you passionate about automation, embedded systems, and understanding how a chip boots from its first instruction?

We are looking for a Senior/Staff Software Engineer to help us build the tools and automation that make firmware development, system boot, and SoC validation faster and more reliable. 

Our team works across the SoC development lifecycle, from early software development to silicon bring-up. We develop and validate firmware across simulation, emulation, FPGA/prototyping environments, and post silicon. 

You'll work with engineers across firmware, silicon, architecture, operating systems, and validation to solve technical challenges, improve test coverage, and create automation that can be reused across different platforms. 

We value engineers who enjoy writing good software, exploring how systems work, and finding practical ways to simplify complex engineering tasks. 

What You'll Do

You'll help us design and build automation that supports firmware development and system validation throughout the SoC lifecycle. 

Your Work Will Include

- Build automation frameworks using Python and other programming languages to support firmware testing, system boot, platform bring-up, and regression testing. 
 - Automate SoC boot workflows, from firmware builds and deployment to platform configuration, boot execution, log collection, failure detection, and reporting. 
 - Develop reusable test solutions that work across simulation, emulation, FPGA/prototyping environments, and post silicon, adapting to platform-specific capabilities. 
 - Validate firmware and boot components, including Boot ROM, security firmware, trusted firmware, bootloaders, UEFI, Linux, and platform initialization. 
 - Investigate complex failures across firmware, operating systems, hardware models, silicon, and automation infrastructure. Build tools that make debugging and failure analysis easier. 
 - Improve continuous testing by integrating automated validation into CI/CD pipelines and developing reliable regression and release-validation workflows. 
 - Collaborate and share knowledge with engineers across teams, review technical designs, and help improve our automation architecture and engineering practices. 

As a Senior/Staff Engineer, you'll also shape technical decisions, guide framework architecture, mentor engineers, and help define how we approach firmware and platform validation across projects. 

What We're Looking For

We are looking for engineers who combine strong software development skills with an interest in firmware, embedded systems, and SoC technology. 

You Should Bring

- 8-15 years of strong Python programming skills, experience developing reusable automation frameworks, and working knowledge of C, C++, or Rust. 
 - Experience in firmware, embedded systems, SoC software, system boot, platform validation, or test automation. 
 - Understanding of SoC boot flows, including Boot ROM, firmware initialization, bootloaders, UEFI, and operating-system boot. 
 - Familiarity with the SoC development lifecycle and validation using simulation, emulation, FPGA/prototyping environments, or post-silicon platforms. 
 - Experience with Linux, shell scripting, debugging tools, source control, and CI/CD systems. 
 - Ability to investigate technical issues, develop maintainable software, and work effectively with engineers from different teams. 

We encourage candidates with experience in one or more platform environments to apply. You don't need to have worked with every stage of the SoC lifecycle. 

A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, will help you succeed in this role. 

Experience That Would Be Helpful

You may also have experience in some of these areas: 

- Arm-based SoCs, Arm Fixed Virtual Platforms (FVPs), RTL simulation, hardware emulation, FPGA platforms, or silicon bring-up. 
 - Firmware technologies such as Boot ROM, Trusted Firmware-A (TF-A), RSE or similar security firmware, U-Boot, EDK II/UEFI, and Linux. 
 - Secure boot, trusted execution, device trees, ACPI, and platform security. 
 - Pytest, Robot Framework, or other automation and validation frameworks. 
 - Hardware debugging and management interfaces such as JTAG, serial consoles, BMCs, Redfish, or IPMI. 
 - Container-based testing, remote lab management, distributed test execution, dashboards, and automated failure analysis. 

In Return

Based in Bangalore India, this is an opportunity to join a dynamic, collaborative, and driven team, and provides a genuine opportunity to craft the best outcomes for Arm. 

Our 10x mindset guides how we engineer, collaborate, and grow. Understand what it means and how to reflect 10x in your work: https: //careers. arm. com/en/10x-mindset

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

data.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www. analog. com and on LinkedIn and X. 

Staff Design Evaluation Engineer - Automotive Networking

Role Overview

Analog Devices International is seeking an experienced Staff Design Evaluation Engineer to join the Automotive Networking team in Hyderabad, India. In this senior technical role, you will lead the definition and execution of evaluation strategies for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs, from initial platform bring-up through system-level validation, characterisation, and release readiness. You will combine hands-on laboratory expertise with strong software development, test automation, data analysis, and technical leadership skills to deliver robust, repeatable, and high-quality evaluation solutions. 

You will work closely with design, verification, applications, systems, software, and product engineering teams to identify technical risks, resolve complex issues, and ensure that silicon and supporting platforms meet product and system requirements. As a Staff Engineer, you will provide technical direction, mentor engineers, and drive improvements in evaluation methodologies, tools, and laboratory practices. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and lead comprehensive evaluation strategies, test plans, coverage goals, methodologies, and release criteria for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs. 
 - Translate product, architecture, and system requirements into measurable laboratory tests, including functional, performance, interoperability, robustness, and corner-case evaluation. 
 - Architect, develop, bring up, and maintain hardware and software evaluation platforms, test fixtures, reference systems, and supporting infrastructure. 
 - Develop modular, maintainable test and automation software in C and Python, including instrument control, data acquisition, regression execution, result processing, and report generation. 
 - Execute and analyse complex silicon and FPGA test cases; debug failures across hardware, firmware, software, interfaces, and system boundaries. 
 - Perform electrical and functional measurements using oscilloscopes, logic analysers, protocol analysers, signal generators, power supplies, and other laboratory equipment. 
 - Lead structured root-cause investigations, clearly document findings, and work with cross-functional teams to drive issues to resolution. 
 - Evaluate Automotive Ethernet T1S and related networking functionality, including link behaviour, data-path performance, timing, error handling, diagnostics, and interoperability. 
 - Develop system-level hardware, embedded software, scripts, user guides, application examples, test procedures, and technical reports that enable internal and external product evaluation. 
 - Review evaluation results, identify coverage gaps and technical risks, and communicate evidence-based recommendations to engineering and programme stakeholders. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in test architecture, automation, data quality, traceability, repeatability, and laboratory efficiency. 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentoring, lead design and code reviews, and contribute to planning, estimation, and prioritisation activities. 

Required Qualifications And Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. 
 - Typically seven or more years of relevant experience in design evaluation, silicon validation, product engineering, systems engineering, or a comparable role. 
 - Demonstrated experience evaluating FPGA prototypes and performing bench validation or characterisation of ASICs. 
 - Strong proficiency in C and Python, with experience developing reliable test, automation, or embedded software. 
 - Strong knowledge of embedded systems, digital hardware, laboratory measurement techniques, and hardware/software integration. 
 - Proven ability to diagnose complex problems using structured debugging, critical thinking, root-cause analysis, and evidence-based decision-making. 
 - Experience capturing, processing, interpreting, and presenting technical data, with a strong focus on accuracy, repeatability, and traceability. 
 - Working knowledge of Ethernet and networking concepts, together with experience using serial interfaces such as SPI, I2C, and UART. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical reports and present complex findings to varied audiences. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership, collaboration, ownership, and the ability to influence outcomes across cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications And Experience

- Experience with automotive Ethernet technologies, including 10BASE-T1S, single-pair Ethernet, MAC-PHY devices, Physical Layer Collision Avoidance, or related in-vehicle networking solutions. 
 - Familiarity with automotive networking architectures, zonal systems, software-defined vehicles, and relevant industry standards. 
 - Experience with Ethernet protocol analysis, network traffic generation, performance measurement, interoperability testing, or fault injection. 
 - Experience developing embedded firmware for microcontrollers and integrating host-side software with evaluation hardware. 
 - Experience with audio and video interfaces or data paths, including PDM and RGB8. 
 - Familiarity with source control, continuous integration, automated regression frameworks, requirements traceability, and issue-tracking systems. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers, leading technical reviews, or coordinating evaluation activities across multiple sites or disciplines.
