data.title: Infrastructure Automation Specialist – Python, Ansible, F5 LTM/GTM & Network APIs
data.description:
Job Summary

Synechron is seeking an Infrastructure Automation Engineer to implement and maintain automation solutions for infrastructure certification, plant management, and infrastructure-on-demand services. The role requires hands-on experience with Python, Ansible, infrastructure APIs, F5 load balancers, networking protocols, Linux-based environments, and lab-based testing. The Infrastructure Automation Engineer will work with internal clients and stakeholders to understand business requirements and design well-architected solutions. The role contributes to business objectives by improving infrastructure provisioning, certification efficiency, operational consistency, test coverage, deployment speed, and service reliability. 

Software Requirements

Required Software Skills

- Python: Hands-on experience automating infrastructure installation, configuration, management, certification, and testing activities. 
 - Ansible: Practical experience developing and maintaining playbooks, roles, automation workflows, and infrastructure configuration processes. 
 - Shell scripting: Experience using shell or other scripting/programming languages to automate repetitive infrastructure tasks. 
 - F5 LTM and GTM: Expertise in configuration, administration, troubleshooting, and API-based integration. 
 - F5 TMSH, iControl, and iRules: Practical experience using these capabilities for configuration, automation, service management, and integration. 
 - Networking technologies: Strong understanding of TCP/IP, BGP, HTTP, SSL, and networking concepts across all relevant layers. 
 - Linux command line: Comfort working in Linux-based environments for configuration, troubleshooting, automation, testing, and operational support. 
 - Infrastructure APIs: Experience extending and integrating APIs to provide infrastructure-on-demand capabilities. 
 - Lab-based testing: Experience performing and automating testing for new hardware and software certification. 
 - Software versions: Experience working with the Python, Ansible, Linux, F5, networking, API, automation, and testing tool versions used by the assigned Synechron project. Ability to assess compatibility and upgrade considerations is required. 

Preferred Software Skills

- Experience with additional programming or scripting languages. 
 - Hands-on experience deploying and configuring network infrastructure, including Cisco, Arista, or comparable platforms. 
 - Experience with the Infoblox suite of DNS and DHCP products. 
 - Knowledge of virtualized and containerized infrastructure. 
 - Understanding of software version control, deployment, build tools, and software development lifecycle practices. 
 - Experience with infrastructure testing, continuous integration, continuous delivery, or automated release tools. 
 - Recognized industry certifications from F5, Cisco, or other relevant technology vendors. 

Equivalent tools and platforms may be considered where they provide comparable capabilities. 

Overall Responsibilities

- Implement automation for certification and plant management using Python and Ansible. 
 - Automate repetitive infrastructure installation, configuration, provisioning, management, and validation tasks. 
 - Extend and integrate APIs to provide infrastructure-on-demand capabilities. 
 - Design, develop, test, document, and maintain automation workflows and reusable components. 
 - Perform and automate lab-based testing as part of new hardware and software certification. 
 - Configure, manage, integrate, and troubleshoot F5 LTM and GTM load balancers. 
 - Use TMSH, iControl, and iRules to support F5 configuration, automation, integration, and operational requirements. 
 - Apply knowledge of TCP/IP, BGP, HTTP, SSL, and other networking concepts when designing and troubleshooting solutions. 
 - Work with distributed web applications and understand the infrastructure required to support their availability, performance, scalability, and connectivity. 
 - Use Linux command-line tools for infrastructure configuration, automation, testing, monitoring, and issue resolution. 
 - Communicate with internal clients and stakeholders to identify new business requirements. 
 - Translate stakeholder requirements into well-architected, secure, scalable, supportable, and maintainable infrastructure solutions. 
 - Collaborate with infrastructure, network, software, testing, security, and operations teams to deliver automation initiatives. 
 - Investigate failures, resolve defects, improve automation reliability, and document technical findings. 
 - Support infrastructure certification outcomes by ensuring that test activities are repeatable, traceable, and aligned with defined requirements. 
 - Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to infrastructure automation, testing, deployment, and service delivery. 
 - Consider sustainability by reducing manual rework, improving resource utilization, reusing automation components, and minimizing unnecessary infrastructure provisioning and test activity. 
 - Deliver automation solutions that meet agreed requirements for functionality, reliability, security, maintainability, and operational support. 

Technical Skills (By Category)

Programming Languages

Essential

- Python for infrastructure automation, API integration, configuration management, testing, and operational tooling. 
 - Shell scripting or another scripting/programming language for infrastructure automation and command-line operations. 
 - Ability to write maintainable, reusable, testable, and well-documented automation code. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot scripts, automation workflows, API interactions, and infrastructure-related failures. 

Preferred

- Experience with additional programming languages used for automation, infrastructure management, testing, or software development. 
 - Familiarity with structured data formats and API data exchange, including JSON or YAML. 
 - Experience developing reusable libraries, modules, or automation frameworks. 

Databases/Data Management

Essential

- Understanding of configuration data, infrastructure inventory, service metadata, test results, and certification records. 
 - Ability to manage, validate, and document data used by automation workflows and infrastructure APIs. 
 - Experience working with structured configuration files and data exchanged through APIs. 

Preferred

- Experience integrating automation with relational or non-relational databases. 
 - Familiarity with configuration databases, infrastructure inventories, DNS data, DHCP data, or asset-management systems. 
 - Experience maintaining data consistency, traceability, and auditability across infrastructure processes. 

Cloud Technologies

Essential

- Understanding of infrastructure-on-demand concepts and automated provisioning. 
 - Ability to apply infrastructure automation principles in distributed or cloud-enabled environments. 
 - Understanding of scalability, availability, networking, configuration, and operational requirements for infrastructure services. 

Preferred

- Knowledge of virtualized and containerized infrastructure. 
 - Experience automating cloud infrastructure or integrating infrastructure APIs with cloud services. 
 - Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code, container orchestration, or cloud-based testing environments. 
 - Awareness of resource-efficient infrastructure design and cloud cost considerations. 

Frameworks and Libraries

Essential

- Experience with Ansible playbooks, roles, modules, variables, templates, inventories, and automation workflows. 
 - Experience with F5 TMSH, iControl, and iRules. 
 - Experience extending and integrating infrastructure APIs. 
 - Ability to build reusable automation components for infrastructure management and certification. 

Preferred

- Familiarity with Python libraries for API integration, networking, testing, logging, or automation. 
 - Experience with infrastructure-as-code frameworks and configuration-management tools. 
 - Exposure to libraries or platforms supporting virtualized, containerized, or cloud-based infrastructure. 

Development Tools and Methodologies

Essential

- Experience automating infrastructure installation, configuration, management, and certification activities. 
 - Understanding of software version control, deployment, build tools, and software development lifecycle practices. 
 - Experience performing and automating lab-based testing for hardware and software certification. 
 - Ability to document automation processes, configuration requirements, test results, dependencies, and operational procedures. 
 - Experience troubleshooting automation failures, infrastructure issues, networking problems, and API errors. 
 - Ability to work with Linux-based command-line tools and operational processes. 

Preferred

- Experience with Git or equivalent version-control systems. 
 - Familiarity with continuous integration, continuous delivery, automated testing, build pipelines, and release-management tools. 
 - Experience with test automation frameworks, infrastructure validation, performance testing, or service monitoring. 
 - Familiarity with Agile or iterative delivery practices. 

Security Protocols

Essential

- Strong understanding of SSL and its role in secure network communication. 
 - Awareness of authentication, authorization, access control, secure API integration, and protection of infrastructure credentials. 
 - Ability to apply secure configuration and operational practices when automating infrastructure. 
 - Understanding of security considerations for distributed web applications, load balancers, APIs, and Linux environments. 

Preferred

- Experience with certificate management, encryption, secrets management, network security controls, or secure automation practices. 
 - Familiarity with security testing, vulnerability remediation, auditability, and infrastructure compliance requirements. 
 - Experience incorporating security validation into hardware, software, or infrastructure certification processes. 

Experience Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in infrastructure automation, network automation, systems engineering, DevOps, infrastructure engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience automating repetitive tasks related to infrastructure installation, configuration, certification, or management using Ansible, Python, shell, or another scripting/programming language. 
 - Expertise with F5 LTM and GTM load-balancer configuration and APIs, including TMSH, iControl, and iRules. 
 - Strong understanding of networking concepts and protocols, including TCP/IP, BGP, HTTP, and SSL. 
 - Experience with distributed web applications and knowledge of their underlying infrastructure. 
 - Practical experience working with Linux-based command-line environments. 
 - Experience extending and integrating APIs to support infrastructure-on-demand services. 
 - Experience performing or automating lab-based testing for new hardware and software certification. 
 - Preferred experience with additional programming languages, network infrastructure, Infoblox DNS and DHCP products, virtualized infrastructure, containerized infrastructure, version control, deployment tools, build tools, and SDLC practices. 
 - Candidates may also qualify through equivalent combinations of network engineering, systems administration, DevOps, platform engineering, test automation, infrastructure development, or technical operations experience that demonstrate the required capabilities and outcomes. 

Day-to-Day Activities

- Develop and maintain Python and Ansible automation for infrastructure certification, plant management, installation, configuration, provisioning, and infrastructure-on-demand services. 
 - Configure and troubleshoot F5 LTM and GTM environments, use TMSH, iControl, and iRules, and collaborate with network, infrastructure, software, testing, and operations teams. 
 - Perform and automate lab-based hardware and software certification tests, review results, investigate failures, and document technical findings and delivery status. 
 - Engage with internal clients and stakeholders to clarify requirements, recommend solution designs, prioritize work, and make technical decisions within the agreed architecture and governance boundaries. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Networking, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered. 
 - Recognized industry certification from F5, Cisco, or another relevant technology vendor is preferred but not mandatory. 
 - Relevant training in Python, Ansible, Linux, networking, F5 technologies, API integration, automation, testing, cloud, virtualization, or containerization is preferred. 
 - Demonstrated experience delivering infrastructure automation, network automation, infrastructure certification, API integration, or lab-based testing solutions is required. 
 - Commitment to continuous professional development through technical training, hands-on learning, certification maintenance, knowledge sharing, and awareness of evolving infrastructure technologies. 

Professional Competencies

- Apply structured problem-solving and technical analysis to diagnose automation failures, network issues, API errors, configuration defects, and certification risks. 
 - Collaborate effectively with infrastructure, network, software, testing, security, operations, and stakeholder teams to deliver shared outcomes. 
 - Communicate requirements, solution designs, technical risks, testing results, dependencies, and delivery updates clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Adapt to new hardware, software, infrastructure platforms, networking technologies, automation tools, APIs, and evolving business requirements. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, infrastructure reliability, testing repeatability, provisioning speed, resource efficiency, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Manage multiple automation, certification, testing, support, and stakeholder priorities while maintaining technical accuracy, documentation quality, and agreed delivery timelines.

Job Description

insightsoftware is looking for a technically sharp, people-first Engineering Lead to lead our Financial Reporting team - a squad at the center of our most complex and high-stakes enterprise workloads. We want a hands-on technical leader who codes when it counts, drives architecture decisions with conviction, and knows how to get the best out of engineers in an AI-accelerated development environment.

If you've led high-performing backend engineering teams, are fluent in modern AI developer tooling, and thrive at the intersection of technical depth and people leadership - this role is built for you. 

The differentiator we're hiring for: This is not a role for someone who has moved away from the database. We need an architect-level Oracle SQL/PL-SQL practitioner who leads by example - writing and reviewing the hardest queries on the team, not just approving other people's designs.

 - Lead code reviews and architecture discussions as a teacher and a critic - raising the technical floor of every engineer on the team

 - Partner with cross-functional teams - Product, QA, DevOps, and Customer Success - to deliver releases that enterprise clients can depend on

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent demonstrated engineering depth
 - 10+ years of hands-on experience in designing and developing enterprise SaaS applications on the backend with deep understanding of Databases
 - 2+ years of engineering team management with a proven record of growing senior engineers and retaining high performers
 - Architect/Principal engineer level deep expertise in relational databases - Oracle PL/SQL - complex query optimization, stored procedures, performance tuning, and large-scale data handling
 - Very strong command of SQL and data modelling
 - Experience in Reporting/BI on Development side (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik etc. )
 - Demonstrated, day-to-day use of AI developer tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) with the ability to coach teams on maximizing their impact

From the moment a consumer is thinking of placing an order, to the time the order arrives at their door and a review is posted to social media, Foodhub has solutions to drive the consumer experience, whilst adding extra value via our ecosystem of partners. The Foodhub Tech Stack is extensive: from Web and Mobile Ordering to 3rd Party Order Aggregation, Dispatch and Self-Delivery, complete Hardware/Software POS systems, extensive array of POS integrations, On-Premise Kiosks, QR Code Ordering and Payment, Table-side Mobile Order/Receipt Printers, plus an extensive product and development team to support all of this. 

About The Role

We are seeking a skilled Mobile Application Developer to design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality cross-platform mobile applications using React Native and TypeScript for iOS and Android. This role involves leveraging modern AI coding assistants to accelerate delivery without compromising quality. 

Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test and deploy high-quality cross-platform mobile applications using React Native and TypeScript for iOS and Android. 
 - Take ownership of feature delivery end-to-end, from technical design through release, monitoring and post-launch iteration. 
 - Translate product requirements into clear technical specifications and design documents. 
 - Contribute to and influence the mobile architecture, including state management, navigation, offline behavior, modularization and native bridges. 
 - Work with the React Native New Architecture (Fabric, TurboModules, JSI) and Hermes to deliver performant, memory-efficient applications. 
 - Build and maintain reusable component libraries and shared modules used across multiple Foodhub brands and applications. 
 - Develop and integrate native modules in Swift and Kotlin where required, and debug native build issues across Xcode and Android Studio. 
 - Optimize application performance, including bundle size, startup time, frame rates, list virtualization, memory usage and crash rates. 
 - Implement and maintain robust automated testing using Jest, React Native Testing Library and end-to-end frameworks such as Detox or Maestro. 
 - Own and improve mobile CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Fast lane, EAS Build, App Center or equivalent. 
 - Lead code reviews with a strong focus on quality, security, accessibility and maintainability. 
 - Establish and maintain project-level AI context configurations and coding standards documentation. 
 - Mentor mid-level and junior engineers on React Native, TypeScript, mobile best practices and the responsible use of AI development tools. 
 - Collaborate closely with Product, Design, Backend, QA and EPOS/POS teams to translate business requirements into well-scoped technical solutions. 
 - Contribute to engineering standards, documentation, technical specifications and the continuous improvement of team processes. 

Preferred Skills

- Familiarity with emerging standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and the integration of AI tooling into developer workflows is desirable. 

Requirements

Qualifications

- Minimum 5+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - At least 5 years of hands-on production experience building React Native applications in TypeScript. 
 - Demonstrable experience shipping and maintaining mobile applications that are live on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 

Required Skills

- Strong, advanced-level TypeScript skills, including strict mode, generics, discriminated unions, utility types and disciplined API typing. 
 - Practical experience with the React Native New Architecture (Fabric, TurboModules, JSI) and the Hermes JavaScript engine. 
 - Deep understanding of React Native internals, including the bridge, lifecycle, rendering pipeline, reconciliation and threading model. 
 - Experience writing or extending native modules in Swift (iOS) and Kotlin (Android). 
 - Proficiency with modern state management approaches such as Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Jotai, MobX or React Query. 
 - Strong working knowledge of React Navigation, including deep linking, universal links, App Links and complex navigation patterns. 
 - Experience with offline-first architectures, secure local storage, push notifications, background tasks and OTA updates. 
 - Hands-on experience with mobile CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Fast lane, EAS Build, Bitrise or App Center. 
 - Strong testing discipline using Jest, React Native Testing Library and at least one end-to-end framework. 
 - Solid understanding of REST and/or GraphQL API integration, authentication flows and secure communication on mobile. 
 - Working knowledge of mobile application security best practices. 
 - Proficiency with Git and modern branching workflows. 
 - Daily, hands-on use of AI coding assistants as a core part of the development workflow. 
 - Demonstrated judgment in applying AI assistance appropriately.

Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care. 

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our team and help build and support applications used across Teladoc Health.

You will work closely with other engineers, product managers, and technical partners to solve problems and deliver reliable software to production. 

We are also adopting AI-assisted development tools as part of our engineering workflow. We value engineers who know how to use tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or similar tools to speed up development, testing, debugging, and documentation while still applying good engineering judgment. 

Healthcare experience is a plus. Experience with FHIR, HL7, Mirth Connect, EHR/EMR integrations, or other healthcare interoperability technologies is helpful, but it is not required. 

What You'll Be Doing

 - Participate in an on-call rotation as needed.

 - Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.

 - Experience with healthcare data privacy and security, including HIPAA. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor.

DFT architect -14-20years

Developing silicon for Edge Computing isn't just about speed; it's about balancing high-performance data processing with extreme power efficiency and reliability in remote environments.

Logic BIST. 

Cross-Functional Synergy: Collaborate with Design, Physical Design, and Yield teams to ensure high test coverage while minimizing area overhead and power impact.

(IEEE 1149. 1/6). 

Advanced Nodes: Proven track record with FinFET nodes (7nm, 5nm, or below).

data.title: Lead Design Evaluation Engineer
data.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www. analog. com and on LinkedIn and X. 

Staff Design Evaluation Engineer - Automotive Networking

Role Overview

Analog Devices International is seeking an experienced Staff Design Evaluation Engineer to join the Automotive Networking team in Hyderabad, India. In this senior technical role, you will lead the definition and execution of evaluation strategies for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs, from initial platform bring-up through system-level validation, characterisation, and release readiness. You will combine hands-on laboratory expertise with strong software development, test automation, data analysis, and technical leadership skills to deliver robust, repeatable, and high-quality evaluation solutions. 

You will work closely with design, verification, applications, systems, software, and product engineering teams to identify technical risks, resolve complex issues, and ensure that silicon and supporting platforms meet product and system requirements. As a Staff Engineer, you will provide technical direction, mentor engineers, and drive improvements in evaluation methodologies, tools, and laboratory practices. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and lead comprehensive evaluation strategies, test plans, coverage goals, methodologies, and release criteria for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs. 
 - Translate product, architecture, and system requirements into measurable laboratory tests, including functional, performance, interoperability, robustness, and corner-case evaluation. 
 - Architect, develop, bring up, and maintain hardware and software evaluation platforms, test fixtures, reference systems, and supporting infrastructure. 
 - Develop modular, maintainable test and automation software in C and Python, including instrument control, data acquisition, regression execution, result processing, and report generation. 
 - Execute and analyse complex silicon and FPGA test cases; debug failures across hardware, firmware, software, interfaces, and system boundaries. 
 - Perform electrical and functional measurements using oscilloscopes, logic analysers, protocol analysers, signal generators, power supplies, and other laboratory equipment. 
 - Lead structured root-cause investigations, clearly document findings, and work with cross-functional teams to drive issues to resolution. 
 - Evaluate Automotive Ethernet T1S and related networking functionality, including link behaviour, data-path performance, timing, error handling, diagnostics, and interoperability. 
 - Develop system-level hardware, embedded software, scripts, user guides, application examples, test procedures, and technical reports that enable internal and external product evaluation. 
 - Review evaluation results, identify coverage gaps and technical risks, and communicate evidence-based recommendations to engineering and programme stakeholders. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in test architecture, automation, data quality, traceability, repeatability, and laboratory efficiency. 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentoring, lead design and code reviews, and contribute to planning, estimation, and prioritisation activities. 

Required Qualifications And Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. 
 - Typically seven or more years of relevant experience in design evaluation, silicon validation, product engineering, systems engineering, or a comparable role. 
 - Demonstrated experience evaluating FPGA prototypes and performing bench validation or characterisation of ASICs. 
 - Strong proficiency in C and Python, with experience developing reliable test, automation, or embedded software. 
 - Strong knowledge of embedded systems, digital hardware, laboratory measurement techniques, and hardware/software integration. 
 - Proven ability to diagnose complex problems using structured debugging, critical thinking, root-cause analysis, and evidence-based decision-making. 
 - Experience capturing, processing, interpreting, and presenting technical data, with a strong focus on accuracy, repeatability, and traceability. 
 - Working knowledge of Ethernet and networking concepts, together with experience using serial interfaces such as SPI, I2C, and UART. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical reports and present complex findings to varied audiences. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership, collaboration, ownership, and the ability to influence outcomes across cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications And Experience

- Experience with automotive Ethernet technologies, including 10BASE-T1S, single-pair Ethernet, MAC-PHY devices, Physical Layer Collision Avoidance, or related in-vehicle networking solutions. 
 - Familiarity with automotive networking architectures, zonal systems, software-defined vehicles, and relevant industry standards. 
 - Experience with Ethernet protocol analysis, network traffic generation, performance measurement, interoperability testing, or fault injection. 
 - Experience developing embedded firmware for microcontrollers and integrating host-side software with evaluation hardware. 
 - Experience with audio and video interfaces or data paths, including PDM and RGB8. 
 - Familiarity with source control, continuous integration, automated regression frameworks, requirements traceability, and issue-tracking systems. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers, leading technical reviews, or coordinating evaluation activities across multiple sites or disciplines.

Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U. S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position - except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U. S. In this Senior technical role, you will lead the definition and execution of evaluation strategies for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs, from initial platform bring-up through system-level validation, characterisation, and release readiness. You will combine hands-on laboratory expertise with strong software development, test automation, data analysis, and technical leadership skills to deliver robust, repeatable, and high-quality evaluation solutions. 

You will work closely with design, verification, applications, systems, software, and product engineering teams to identify technical risks, resolve complex issues, and ensure that silicon and supporting platforms meet product and system requirements. As a Senior Engineer, you will provide technical direction, mentor engineers, and drive improvements in evaluation methodologies, tools, and laboratory practices. 

Key Responsibilities

- Execute comprehensive evaluation strategies, test plans, coverage goals, methodologies, and release criteria for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs. 
 - Translate product, architecture, and system requirements into measurable laboratory tests, including functional, performance, interoperability, robustness, and corner-case evaluation. 
 - Develop modular, maintainable test and automation software in C and Python, including instrument control, data acquisition, regression execution, result processing, and report generation. 
 - Execute and analyse complex silicon and FPGA test cases; debug failures across hardware, firmware, software, interfaces, and system boundaries. 
 - Perform electrical and functional measurements using oscilloscopes, logic analysers, protocol analysers, signal generators, power supplies, and other laboratory equipment. 
 - Lead structured root-cause investigations, clearly document findings, and work with cross-functional teams to drive issues to resolution. 
 - Evaluate automotive Ethernet and related networking functionality, including link behaviour, data-path performance, timing, error handling, diagnostics, and interoperability. 
 - Develop system-level hardware, embedded software, scripts, user guides, application examples, test procedures, and technical reports that enable internal and external product evaluation. 
 - Review evaluation results, identify coverage gaps and technical risks, and communicate evidence-based recommendations to engineering and programme stakeholders. 

Required Qualifications And Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. 
 - Four or more years of relevant experience in design evaluation, silicon validation, product engineering, systems engineering, or a comparable role. 
 - Demonstrated experience evaluating FPGA prototypes and performing bench validation or characterisation of ASICs. 
 - Strong proficiency in C and Python, with experience developing reliable test, automation, or embedded software. 
 - Knowledge of embedded systems, digital hardware, laboratory measurement techniques, and hardware/software integration. 
 - Proven ability to diagnose complex problems using structured debugging, critical thinking, root-cause analysis, and evidence-based decision-making. 
 - Experience capturing, processing, interpreting, and presenting technical data, with a strong focus on accuracy, repeatability, and traceability. 
 - Working knowledge of Ethernet and networking concepts, together with experience using serial interfaces such as SPI, I2C, and UART. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical reports and present complex findings to varied audiences. 
 - Demonstrated collaboration, ownership, and the ability to influence outcomes across cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications And Experience

- Familiarity with automotive networking architectures, zonal systems, software-defined vehicles, and relevant industry standards. 
 - Experience with Ethernet protocol analysis, network traffic generation, performance measurement, interoperability testing, or fault injection. 
 - Experience developing embedded firmware for microcontrollers and integrating host-side software with evaluation hardware. 
 - Experience with audio and video interfaces or data paths, including PDM and RGB8. 
 - Familiarity with source control, continuous integration, automated regression frameworks, requirements traceability, and issue-tracking systems.

As such, applicants for this position - except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U. S. - Drive shift-left quality by influencing requirements, acceptance criteria, solution designs, and testability. 
 - Define the overall test approach, quality gates, automation coverage targets, and release-readiness criteria. 
 - Champion test-driven development, behavior-driven development, API-first testing, and early defect prevention. 
 - Collaborate with product owners and business analysts to create clear, testable acceptance criteria.

- Conduct automation design and code reviews and ensure adherence to programming, security, and maintainability standards. 
 - Establish reusable libraries, coding guidelines, test patterns, branching practices, and Definition of Done. 
 - Ensure automated tests are reliable, independent, maintainable, and resistant to flaky execution. 
 - Implement effective test reporting, failure analysis, defect triage, and root-cause analysis practices. 

CI/CD, Cloud and Non-Functional Quality

- Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to provide fast and actionable feedback. 
 - Enable parallel, cross-browser, environment-based, and scheduled test execution. 
 - Partner with DevOps and platform teams to improve test environment availability, test data provisioning, and pipeline reliability. 
 - Contribute to performance, accessibility, security, compatibility, and resiliency testing strategies. 
 - Implement dashboards and quality metrics that provide visibility into coverage, defects, execution stability, and release risk. 

Stakeholder and Business Outcome Ownership

- Communicate quality status, release risks, dependencies, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Provide objective, data-driven release-readiness assessments rather than limiting accountability to test completion. 
 - Drive measurable improvements in release confidence, escaped defects, automation coverage, cycle time, and customer experience. 

MUST HAVE Skills

- 5- 7 years of experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles, including technical leadership responsibilities. 
 - Deep hands-on experience designing and developing automation frameworks using Playwright. 
 - Strong programming capability in TypeScript or JavaScript; working knowledge of Python or Java is valuable. 
 - Strong experience testing modern web applications across multiple browsers and responsive interfaces. 
 - Expertise in API testing using tools or frameworks such as Karate, REST Assured, Playwright API, Postman, or equivalent. 
 - Experience designing maintainable automation using page/component models, reusable fixtures, data-driven approaches, and appropriate design patterns. 
 - Strong knowledge of test pyramid principles, shift-left testing, risk-based testing, and quality engineering practices. 
 - Experience integrating automation with CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or equivalent. 
 - Proficiency with Git-based version control, pull requests, code reviews, and branching strategies. 
 - Experience with BDD and Gherkin, with sound judgment on where behavior-driven specifications add value. 
 - Strong understanding of test data management, service virtualization, mocking, environment management, and defect lifecycle. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot complex failures across UI, API, integration, data, and application layers. 
 - Strong stakeholder communication, analytical thinking, influencing, and technical decision-making skills. 

SHOULD HAVE Skills

- Experience testing applications hosted on AWS or another public cloud platform. 
 - Experience with containerized test execution using Docker and cloud-based browser execution platforms. 
 - Familiarity with accessibility testing tools and WCAG-aligned validation practices. 
 - Experience with performance testing tools such as k6, JMeter, or Gatling. 
 - Working knowledge of application security testing and secure software development practices. 
 - Knowledge of observability platforms such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry. 
 - Experience testing enterprise applications in the Property & Casualty insurance domain. 
 - Familiarity with policy administration workflows or platforms such as Duck Creek Policy. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted engineering and testing capabilities for test generation, defect analysis, and productivity improvement. 

Education

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered. 

Hartford Success Profile

- Owns product quality and business outcomes-not merely test execution. 
 - Leads through technical credibility, hands-on contribution, and sound engineering judgment. 
 - Builds quality into the delivery lifecycle rather than treating testing as a final-stage activity. 
 - Balances delivery speed with customer experience, security, resilience, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Communicates release risk clearly and provides data-driven recommendations. 
 - Acts as a technical multiplier by improving team capability, engineering practices, and automation effectiveness.

Purpose: Recruit and assess a hands-on Java engineer for the HIG India POD model, with emphasis on Java design patterns, secure API/backend delivery, Python as an adjacent technical skill, cloud readiness, AI developer tools, ownership, and business-aligned execution. 

Design principle: This is one Java JD. Python is included as a supporting technical skill, not as a separate role. The expectation is strong Java engineering fundamentals, AI-assisted delivery habits, mature technical judgment, and ability to operate in an accountable POD with US + India collaboration. 

Location

Hyderabad, India

Employment type

Full-time

Experience Level

2-4 years preferred; strong candidates with lower tenure may be considered if they demonstrate excellent fundamentals, learnability, and analytical problem solving. 

Role family

Software Engineering - Application Development

Operating model

HIG India POD / Agile delivery team with strong collaboration across US and India

Core expectation

Strong Java engineering with Java design patterns, Spring/API delivery, SQL, automated testing, cloud readiness, AI developer tools knowledge, and Python as a supporting automation/scripting skill. 

Position Overview

The Employee Benefits IT team is seeking a Software Engineer with strong Java/API engineering capabilities to support HIG India POD delivery across modernization, cloud readiness, service integration, and enterprise application support. 

The ideal candidate understands Java design patterns and SOLID principles, can develop secure APIs and services, writes automated tests, uses Python as a practical supporting skill, uses logs and data to troubleshoot issues, applies AI developer tools responsibly, and collaborates across product, architecture, QA/SDET, DevOps, and business partners. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own Java service/API design, development, unit/integration testing, implementation, and support for assigned components within enterprise Employee Benefits applications. 
 - Apply Java design patterns and SOLID principles to build maintainable, testable services and APIs without unnecessary complexity. 
 - Use Python as a supporting technical skill for automation, scripting, data/log analysis, test support, and engineering productivity where applicable. 
 - Translate business and technical requirements into secure, maintainable application modules and service contracts. 
 - Use AI developer tools responsibly to accelerate coding, test generation, code analysis, documentation, refactoring, debugging, and learning while validating quality, security, and compliance. 
 - Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, estimation, feature/story refinement, demos, retrospectives, and production readiness discussions. 
 - Collaborate with product owners, scrum masters, architects, QA/SDET, UX, platform, DevOps, and business partners to deliver outcomes, not just code. 
 - Perform peer code reviews and contribute to engineering standards for code quality, testing, security, accessibility, observability, and performance. 
 - Troubleshoot production/non-production issues using logs, monitoring dashboards, traces, database analysis, Python utilities where useful, and structured root-cause thinking. 
 - Document technical decisions, implementation notes, runbooks, operational impacts, and knowledge-transfer artifacts for the POD. 

Technical Knowledge Requirements

Area

Required Capability

What good looks like in the HIG India POD

Java fundamentals

Java 17+ preferred, collections, concurrency basics, streams, exception handling, memory/performance awareness, clean code. 

Writes maintainable Java code and can explain design decisions, performance tradeoffs, and testing strategy. 

Java design patterns

Strong understanding of SOLID and patterns such as Factory, Strategy, Builder, Adapter, Facade, Singleton, Observer, Repository, MVC, and dependency injection. 

Applies patterns pragmatically to simplify change, improve testability, and avoid over-engineering. 

Spring/API engineering

Spring Boot, REST APIs, JSON, service contracts, validation, error handling, security basics, API gateway/APIC awareness. 

Designs APIs with clear contracts, resilient error handling, secure access, and integration readiness. 

Python as technical skill

Working knowledge of Python for scripting, automation, data validation, test support, log/data analysis, small utilities, or productivity tooling. 

Uses Python to accelerate engineering work, automate repeatable tasks, support validation, and improve team throughput without shifting role ownership away from Java. 

Data and persistence

Oracle SQL, JPA/Hibernate concepts, query analysis, transaction boundaries, data troubleshooting, performance awareness. 

Uses logs and data together to diagnose issues and validate business outcomes. 

Cloud and DevOps

AWS fundamentals, ECS/Fargate, Lambda, SQS, CloudWatch, containers, Tomcat, CI/CD, GitHub branch/PR workflow. 

Understands what changes when moving from on-prem to cloud and contributes to migration readiness. 

Testing and quality

JUnit, Mockito, integration tests, contract testing awareness, secure coding, static analysis, code reviews, DevSecOps. 

Builds quality in by learning and contributing to QE practices such as Playwright automation, API automation, regression coverage, test evidence, and CI/CD quality gates rather than relying on downstream validation. 

AI developer tools

GitHub Copilot, Copilot Chat or equivalent AI IDE tools for code analysis, unit test generation, refactoring, documentation, debugging, and learning. 

Uses AI responsibly with human review, tests, security/compliance judgment, and clear explanation of generated code. 

Observability and support

Splunk/Dynatrace/CloudWatch concepts, structured logs, error analysis, performance and reliability patterns. 

Improves diagnostic capability by adding useful logs, metrics, and operational documentation. 

QE / Playwright skills

Ability and willingness to learn quality engineering practices including Playwright UI automation, API automation, regression coverage, test data strategy, shift-left testing, and CI/CD quality gates. 

Developer contributes directly to automation and quality outcomes, improves test coverage, supports evidence for release readiness, and does not treat testing as solely a QE responsibility. 

Leadership Expectations

Area

What Good Looks Like In The HIG India POD

Ownership

Takes accountability for outcomes, not only assigned tasks. 

Raises risks early, follows through on commitments, and drives blockers to closure. 

Technical judgment

Uses design thinking and tradeoff analysis to choose maintainable solutions. 

Can explain options, risks, and recommended approach to tech leads and stakeholders. 

Collaboration

Works across US/India time zones and functions without waiting for perfect instructions; learns adjacent QE practices such as Playwright and contributes where needed. 

Brings questions, proposals, and artifacts that make decisions easier. 

Mentoring

Helps peers with code reviews, debugging, standards, and onboarding. 

Improves POD capability through examples, documentation, and pairing. 

Bias for action

Moves work forward with appropriate urgency while respecting enterprise controls. 

Breaks ambiguous problems into next steps and demonstrates follow-through. 

Business Acumen Expectations

Area

What Good Looks Like In The HIG India POD

Outcome orientation

Understands how technical work supports claimant, employer, operations, and product outcomes. 

Frames decisions around stability, speed, user experience, and business risk. 

Domain awareness

Develops working knowledge of Employee Benefits, claims, intake, leave, payments, profile, and service workflows relevant to the POD. 

Can connect defects/features to user journeys and operational impact. 

Risk and controls

Understands compliance, data protection, security, accessibility, and production-readiness expectations. 

Plans for controls during development rather than treating them as afterthoughts. 

Financial awareness

Understands HIG India is a strategic capacity and vendor-reduction lever. 

Demonstrates productivity, knowledge transfer, and reduced dependency on external SMEs. 

Communication

Communicates clearly with business/technology partners using concise status, risks, decisions, and asks. 

Can explain technical topics in business-friendly language. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 4+ years of software engineering experience with strong Java fundamentals. 
 - Strong knowledge of Java design patterns, SOLID principles, coding standards, and maintainable service design. 
 - Hands-on experience with Spring Boot or equivalent Java service frameworks. 
 - Experience with REST APIs, service integration, JSON contracts, validation, error handling, and secure service design. 
 - Working knowledge of Python for scripting, automation, data/log analysis, test support, small utilities, or productivity tooling. 
 - Oracle SQL experience; ability to troubleshoot application, data, and integration issues. 
 - Git/GitHub experience including branches, pull requests, code reviews, and local setup troubleshooting. 
 - Automated unit testing experience with JUnit/Mockito or equivalent and a DevSecOps mindset. 
 - Agile delivery experience with active participation in refinement, planning, demos, and retrospectives. 
 - Practical knowledge of AI developer tools such as GitHub Copilot/Copilot Chat or equivalent, including responsible review of AI-generated output. 
 - Cloud fundamentals, with AWS exposure strongly preferred. 

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

- Java 17/21, Spring Boot 3, Spring 6, Tomcat, containerization or cloud migration experience. 
 - Hands-on Python automation experience using pytest, pandas, file/API processing, or operational scripting. 
 - AWS ECS/Fargate, Lambda, SQS, CloudWatch, or related observability tooling. 
 - OAuth, API gateways/APIC, MSAL or enterprise authorization patterns. 
 - Splunk/Dynatrace or similar troubleshooting tools. 
 - Angular/TypeScript awareness and ability to collaborate on end-to-end portal/API delivery. 
 - Insurance, benefits, claims, leave, billing, or portal application experience.

In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories. 

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality - bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse - the Group's innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally. 

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and futureproofing. Today, it brings together over 16, 000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. 

Sustainability is at the core of the Group's strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women's Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040. 

What You'll Be Doing

Work fully hands-on on complex functional, automated, integration, regression, and performance testing while providing senior technical guidance to other QA engineers, ensuring committed scope is delivered on time with high and measurable quality. 

- Execute complex functional, integration, end-to-end, automated, and regression testing hands-on for assigned scope. 
 - Build and maintain test automation using frameworks such as Playwright and Tosca and run automated regression suites. 
 - Lead defect triage, root cause support, and release readiness reviews with engineering and product teams to ensure issues are closed in time for launch. 
 - Conduct performance, load, stress testing, and API and integration testing to validate system reliability. 
 - Execute test strategy and design complex test scenarios, managing test data and enforcing quality gates. 
 - Drive defect analysis, root cause support, and defect resolution, ensuring reliable release validation. 
 - Coordinate test data, environment readiness, and UAT support for critical releases to prevent avoidable delays in validation. 
 - Provide senior technical guidance and mentoring to other QA engineers, upholding QA standards and risk-based testing. 
 - Anticipate quality and delivery risks and support Agile delivery through estimation, prioritization, and troubleshooting for on-time, high-quality delivery. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement of testing, 

What You'll Need To Succeed

- 5+ years of hands-on quality engineering experience across complex functional, automated, integration, regression, and performance testing. 
 - Strong test automation skills with frameworks such as Playwright and Tosca, including automated regression and load and stress testing. 
 - Expertise in test strategy execution, complex test scenario design, test data management, and quality gates. 
 - Strong defect analysis, root cause support, release validation, and risk-based testing skills, with a technical mentoring capability. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile delivery and continuous improvement, with familiarity in AI-assisted test analysis. 
 - Experience driving QA across enterprise ecommerce releases, integrations, and production cutovers in an Agile delivery model. 

What We Can Offer You

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
About Lifesight

Lifesight is a privacy-first Unified Marketing Measurement platform that helps marketers measure, plan, and optimize marketing spend for growth. The platform brings together causal MMM, incrementality testing, incrementality-adjusted attribution, decision intelligence, and AI-driven workflows to help marketing and finance teams understand the true incremental value of marketing investments. 

Role Summary

Lifesight is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead engineering teams building our marketing measurement and decision intelligence platform. This role is suited for a hands-on engineering leader who can manage high performing engineers, guide architecture, improve execution discipline, and build scalable SaaS systems for enterprise customers. 

The role will involve leading product engineering across marketing data pipelines, measurement workflows, attribution systems, MMM output consumption, experimentation modules, customer dashboards, reporting layers, AI-assisted insights, platform integrations, and production-grade SaaS infrastructure. 

The ideal candidate should be comfortable operating at the intersection of product engineering, data systems, cloud infrastructure, reliability, security, and marketing technology. 

Key Responsibilities

- The Engineering Manager will lead one or more engineering squads responsible for building scalable and reliable product capabilities for Lifesight's marketing measurement platform. The person will work closely with Product, Data Science, Marketing Science, Solutions, Customer Success, and GTM teams to convert complex customer and measurement requirements into clear engineering roadmaps and production-ready features. 
 - The role will involve owning architecture decisions for backend services, APIs, data workflows, integrations, dashboards, model-output consumption layers, and customer-facing product modules. The person should ensure that engineering solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, observable, and aligned with product requirements. 
 - Champion AI Adoption: Act as the evangelist for AI-augmented development, driving the deep integration of tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Antigarvity 2. 0, and custom internal agents. 
 - The role will also require close partnership with implementation and solutions teams. Since Lifesight works with fragmented customer data across multiple sources, the Engineering Manager should understand data quality issues such as schema mismatches, type errors, data transformation gaps, API failures, and integration inconsistencies. This will help the team build stronger onboarding, data validation, and platform configuration workflows. 

Required Skills and Experience

- The candidate should have 8 - 12 years of engineering experience, including 2 - 4 years of experience managing engineering teams in a product or SaaS environment. 
 - Strong hands-on experience is expected in backend or full-stack product engineering using Java, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript or similar languages. The candidate should have strong working knowledge of modern distributed systems, and modern web application infrastructure. 
 - The role requires experience with cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS
 - The candidate should understand production-readiness practices such as SLOs, incident response, root cause analysis, postmortems, backup and restore testing, capacity planning, performance tuning, and disaster recovery. 
 - Experience with BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform, data transformation workflows, marketing platform integrations, ad-platform APIs, customer data platforms, tag managers, SDKs, pixels, or attribution systems would be valuable. 

Domain Exposure

- Prior exposure to MarTech, AdTech, marketing analytics, attribution, incrementality testing, Marketing Mix Modelling, experimentation platforms, customer data platforms, or marketing measurement products would be a strong advantage. 
 - The candidate does not need to be a data scientist, but should be able to work effectively with data scientists and marketing science teams. The person should understand how statistical or model outputs need to be converted into reliable, explainable, and usable product experiences for business users. 

Leadership Expectations

The Engineering Manager should be able to coach engineers, review architecture, unblock execution, and create clarity in a fast-moving SaaS environment. The person should balance speed with engineering discipline and ensure that the team builds systems that are not only functional, but also reliable, secure, observable, and scalable. 

The role requires someone who can work with ambiguity, ask the right technical and product questions, and convert complex business problems into structured engineering solutions. 

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured through improved engineering delivery predictability, reduction in production issues, stronger release readiness, scalable platform architecture, improved data pipeline reliability, faster customer onboarding support, better observability, reduced operational toil, and successful delivery of product capabilities across marketing measurement, attribution, experimentation, and AI-led decision intelligence.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible

The Senior Automation Engineer encompasses leading the work of Electrical (15%), Instrumentation (20%) and Automation (65%) and is responsible for executing the design, development, implementation, validation, commissioning, and lifecycle management of automation, instrumentation, and electrical solutions for Cytiva. Acting as a technical expert, the role requires a deep understanding of customer requirements, URS, P&IDs, process control philosophies, international standards, and regulatory compliance requirements to deliver robust, compliant, and customer-focused solutions.

What You'll Do

- Act as SME for technical proposal development, project estimation, solution architecture development, detailed engineering, and execution activities for systems such as chromatography, filtration, TFF, Single-Use Mixing platforms etc. Responsibilities include preparation and review of automation architectures, IO Lists, Instrument Indexes, instrument configuration and calibration documentation, loop diagrams, cable schedules, instrument hookup drawings, control panel specifications, component selection, and verification of wiring and GA drawings
 - Showcase expertise in PLC/DCS/SCADA platforms like Siemens, Emerson etc, with working knowledge of TIA Portal, WinCC, PCS7, DeltaV and other Similar systems. Responsibilities also include generation and review of automation documentation, change controls, and validation-related deliverables. 
 - Drive FAT, SAT, startup, troubleshooting, training, and customer acceptance activities related to EIA for projects while ensuring the projects and Products are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. The engineer will proactively identify technical risks, develop mitigation plans, and support product lifecycle management, standardization initiatives, cybersecurity considerations, and obsolescence planning
 - Mentoring junior engineers, conducting technical reviews, supporting continuous improvement initiatives, and collaborating with customers, suppliers, project managers, and global engineering teams to deliver innovative and scalable solutions. 

Who You Are

- BE Instrumentation/Electrical/E& TC/Computer Science or equivalent. A higher degree or secondary degree in a related subject would be an advantage. Experience of project engineering / project management of equipment used in Biopharmaceutical manufacturing with relevant experience and knowledge to perform commissioning support on a filtration, separation, and purification system/equipment in the biopharmaceutical industry. 
 - A minimum of 10+ years post qualification experience in Automation or similar position. Experience within the biopharmaceutical market is added advantage. Factory test work and/or site work experience. 

Travel Requirements

- The position requires willingness to travel up to 40% for project execution, inspections, FAT/SAT, commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer support activities. 

Join our winning team today. Together, we'll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow's science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

data.title: Senior Performance Engineer - DGX Cloud
data.description:
Joining NVIDIA's DGX Cloud AI Efficiency Team means advancing the performance, efficiency, and resiliency of large-scale AI workloads. We help AI researchers and platform teams understand end-to-end behavior across GPUs, networking, storage, and software stacks. We are seeking a Senior Performance Engineer to characterize workloads, establish performance baselines, diagnose bottlenecks, and drive optimizations from investigation through deployment. Your work will shape scalable DGX Cloud systems, turn complex measurements into prioritized engineering decisions, and continuously raise the performance and reliability of AI workloads. Join our technically diverse team of infrastructure experts to unlock more efficient AI at scale. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Analyze end-to-end performance of large-scale AI workloads across compute, network, storage, and software stacks. 
 - Design and execute rigorous performance studies to establish baselines, diagnose regressions, and quantify bottlenecks. 
 - Define performance and efficiency evaluation methodologies, benchmarks, and success metrics for AI workloads. 
 - Use profiling, observability, and data analysis to turn performance measurements into actionable optimization plans. 
 - Partner with deep learning engineers, platform teams, and GPU architects to validate and deliver performance improvements. 
 - Communicate performance findings, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to influence system and software design decisions. 

What We Need To See

- BS or higher degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 
 - 12+ years of experience in strong programming skills in C++ and Python, with the ability to build reliable analysis and automation workflows
 - Solid foundation in operating systems, computer architecture, and distributed systems
 - Experience with performance engineering, benchmarking, profiling, and optimization of complex software or systems
 - Ability to communicate technical findings, prioritize high-impact work, and build alignment across teams

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Experience analyzing large-scale AI clusters or distributed training and inference workloads
 - Experience with CUDA, GPU computing systems, and GPU performance analysis
 - Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX/XLA
 - Deep understanding of system-level performance analysis, workload characterization, and optimization

NVIDIA leads the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions, from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for exceptional people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence.

 - Day-to-day, act as a technical expert, building and deploying production-grade ML and AI systems while championing engineering best practices across the team

What you'll do

We're looking for someone who can work with our Data Scientists to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable machine learning and AI solutions. You'll work closely with data scientists, engineers, architects and business stakeholders to deliver reliable and secure products that support our business strategy and customer outcomes. 

You'll stay curious about emerging technologies and industry developments, helping to identify opportunities to improve our machine learning and AI platforms, tooling and delivery capabilities.

- Designing, building, deploying and maintaining machine learning, Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions in production environments
 - Implementing robust ML engineering and MLOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, model monitoring and observability

You'll ideally hold an undergraduate or master's degree in a quantitative, engineering or computer science discipline, or demonstrate equivalent practical experience. 

You'll also need strong software engineering experience, including cloud-native development, data engineering and machine learning operations. We'll look to you to demonstrate technical leadership, a passion for engineering excellence and the ability to mentor others while continually developing your own skills. Ability to self-manage, take initiative and demonstrate a proactive approach to delivering high-quality engineering outcomes is also required. 

You'll Also Need

 - Expertise in MLOps practices, including model deployment, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, model monitoring and performance optimisation. Knowledge of containerisation and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes

 - Working knowledge of Agile development practices. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 
 - Fluency in English (spoken and written). 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment. 

Assets

 - Experience with BizTalk Server. 
 - Experience with MuleSoft. 
 - Domain experience in large enterprises (finance, manufacturing, engineering).

 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services.

data.description:

What You Will Do

- Lead a team of AML/TMS investigators on the floor, manage daily work allocation, queue prioritization, shift adherence, productivity tracking, and real-time support for operational issues
 - Oversee end-to-end transaction monitoring alert reviews, including customer profile assessment, transactional behavior analysis, red-flag identification, adverse media review, sanctions/PEP checks, and escalation decisioning
 - Support analysts on complex financial crime scenarios such as structuring, layering, rapid fund movement, unusual transaction velocity, high-risk jurisdiction exposure, mule activity, fraud-linked activity, and suspicious source/destination of funds. 
 - Review investigation narratives, evidence packs, and escalation rationale to ensure suspicious activity is documented clearly and supports SAR/STR filing decisions where required. 
 - Perform sample reviews, identify documentation gaps, validate alert disposition decisions, support calibration sessions, and drive corrective coaching based on QA and client feedback. 
 - Prepare and publish daily/weekly MIS covering volumes, productivity, SLA/TAT, quality, aging, escalations, attendance, staffing, and key risk themes for supervisor/client review. 
 - Act as the first point of contact for operational escalations, floor clarifications, process queries, and high-risk cases, ensuring timely updates to Supervisors, QA, Training, and client stakeholders. 
 - Conduct daily huddles, case walkthroughs, feedback discussions, refresher sessions, nesting support, and performance improvement plans to build analyst capability and consistency. 

What You Will Need

- Minimum 8+ years of overall experience in AML, Financial Crime Compliance, Transaction Monitoring, KYC/CDD/EDD, fraud risk, payments, banking operations, fintech, crypto compliance, or BFSI/BPO financial crime operations. 
 - Currently operating in a Team Lead role or equivalent, managing an on-ground team with ownership of daily production, queue management, SLA/TAT adherence, quality performance, attendance, and reporting. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in Transaction Monitoring Systems (TMS), including alert review, investigation documentation, risk assessment, dispositioning, and escalation of potentially suspicious activity. 
 - Experience supporting L2 investigations, SAR/STR escalation preparation, suspicious activity narrative review, and evidence-based case documentation. 
 - Working knowledge of AML/CFT concepts, red-flag typologies, sanctions screening, PEP/high-risk customer review, source of funds/source of wealth considerations, and regulatory expectations. 
 - Experience preparing operational dashboards, daily/weekly MIS, aging reports, productivity and quality reports, and stakeholder updates for leadership or client review. 
 - Exposure to TMS/case management platforms such as Actimize, SAS AML, Verafin, Oracle FCCM, NICE Actimize, or equivalent tools is preferred. 

What Would Be Nice To Have

- Experience in crypto/virtual asset transaction monitoring, including exchange-related activity, wallet behavior review, on-chain/off-chain transaction context, and virtual asset red-flag typologies. 
 - Exposure to blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis, TRM Labs, Elliptic, or similar investigation platforms. 
 - Prior experience supporting client-facing reviews, audits, calibration calls, process transitions, new queue launches, or ramp-up of AML/TMS teams.

data.description:
Overview

Citi Treasury and Trade Solutions (TTS) is seeking a highly experienced and hands-on engineering leader to drive the architecture, development, and delivery of our next-generation Global Instant Payments Platform. 

This role is ideal for an accomplished software engineer who enjoys solving complex distributed systems challenges, remains actively involved in architecture and technical design, and wants to build the future of real-time payment infrastructure at global scale. The successful candidate will combine deep payments expertise, low-latency Java engineering, cloud-native architecture, and strong delivery leadership to build resilient, high-performance payment solutions supporting Citi's global clients. The role requires close collaboration with Product, Operations, Infrastructure, Risk, and Engineering teams globally to deliver innovative, scalable, and secure instant payment capabilities. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of Citi's next-generation Instant Payments platform, providing hands-on technical leadership across the full Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). 
 - Design and develop high-performance payment services using Java, distributed systems principles, and event-driven architectures to support low-latency, real-time transaction processing at global scale. 
 - Drive the modernization of payment platforms on AWS through cloud-native architectures, microservices, APIs, containerization, and automated infrastructure practices. 
 - Build and evolve payment capabilities supporting RTP, FedNow, UPI, SEPA Instant, and emerging real-time payment networks across multiple markets and regulatory jurisdictions. 
 - Architect highly resilient and scalable systems capable of processing millions of transactions daily with demanding requirements for latency, availability, security, and operational resilience. 
 - Lead and mentor a team of engineers while remaining actively engaged in technical design reviews, architecture decisions, code quality, and resolution of complex engineering challenges. 
 - Partner with Product, Operations, Sales, and business stakeholders to translate client and market requirements into innovative payment capabilities and platform enhancements. 
 - Build and enhance core payment platform services including payment orchestration, liquidity management, reconciliation, settlement processing, transaction monitoring, exception management, and recovery capabilities. 
 - Champion engineering excellence through automated testing, CI/CD, observability, performance engineering, secure software development practices, and measurable quality outcomes. 
 - Leverage AI-enabled software engineering tools throughout the SDLC to improve developer productivity, code quality, testing effectiveness, platform reliability, and delivery velocity. 

Required Qualifications

- 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience building large-scale payment processing, transaction processing, or financial technology platforms. 
 - Expert-level Java development experience with deep understanding of concurrency, JVM performance tuning, asynchronous processing, low-latency application design, and distributed systems engineering. 
 - Proven experience designing and delivering high-throughput, mission-critical systems operating at enterprise scale. 
 - 5+ years of hands-on AWS experience building, deploying, and operating cloud-native applications in production environments. 
 - Strong expertise in microservices, event-driven architectures, REST APIs, messaging systems, and streaming technologies such as Kafka. 
 - Deep understanding of instant payments, payment processing, settlement, reconciliation, liquidity management, transaction lifecycle management, and payment operations. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams while maintaining hands-on involvement in architecture, technical design, and solution delivery. 
 - Strong experience with Agile delivery, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and production support. 
 - Experience leveraging AI-powered engineering tools and modern software development practices to accelerate development and improve engineering productivity. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence technical and business decisions across a global organization. 
 - Experience developing or operating platforms supporting RTP, FedNow, UPI, SEPA Instant, Faster Payments, Visa Direct, Mastercard Send, or similar real-time payment networks. 
 - Knowledge of global payment regulations, operational resiliency requirements, and financial services risk controls. 

Why Join Citi

Join a team shaping the future of global money movement and real-time payments. You'll have the opportunity to build cloud-native payment infrastructure at global scale, solve complex low-latency distributed systems challenges, influence the evolution of instant payments worldwide, and leverage AI-powered engineering capabilities to deliver the next generation of payment innovation.

We are seeking an accomplished Java Backend Architect to lead the design, modernization, and delivery of large-scale, cloud-native platforms.
