data.title: Plant In charge Quality
data.description:
Job Purpose

To ensure quality assurance and quality control systems of concrete products. Promotion of VAC and optimization of mixes. 

Job Context & Major Challenges

The RMC Industry is highly fragmented and very competitive. As a major RMC player we face competition from other organized players and local players which makes superior service delivery along with quality products important for good margins. There is huge growth in infrastructure which opens up opportunities for setting up commercial and dedicated plants. The plant and its resources need to be cost effective with focus on maximizing capacity utilization. This makes it imperative for each plant to be efficient and profitable. The plant employees need to be focused and deliver high performance in each of their KRAs and accountabilities. 

Key Result Areas

KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)

KRA1 Business Development

- (A) Conducting demos for VAC products to clients to help them understand their functionality

KRA2 Customer Feedback

- (R) Resolve day to day customer grievances related to cracks, workability, slump control, pumping issues cube failures etc. and take corrective and preventive actions based on site feedback
 - (R) Visit customer/ site periodically to gather feedback and identify areas of concern

KRA3 Customer Management

- (R) Provide detailed mix design calculation, physical and chemical analysis of raw material to customer as and when required

KRA4 Maintenance Management

- (A) Ensure the upkeep of the quality control labs with proper product display and availability of relevant BIS codes
 - (R, A) Ensure calibration of instruments is done before due date

KRA5 MIS

- (R) Conduct physical stock measurement and reconciliation
 - (R, A) Maintain all the quality records on Labsys and update as per QCI and ISO. Maintain records related to calibration of all testing equipment

KRA6 Planning & Budgeting

- (R) Prepare, consolidate and analyze Plant plan and budget

KRA7 Product Development

- (R) Generate mix and competitor data at plant level for further analysis
 - (R, A) Arrive at the mix design as per customer's requirements

KRA8 Product Testing

- (A) Conduct testing of cubes of concrete to check if they are as per the Quality Standards
 - (R) Conduct statistical analysis of cubes strength results and monitoring performance of the products
 - (R) Conduct trials for VAC Products to check various functional parameters
 - (R, A) Check the quality of the raw material to ensure adherence to desired standards and specifications. Reject the material that does not match the required specifications
 - (R, A) Collaborate with third party testing for the cubes as and when required
 - (R, A) Undertake trials for performance/ dosage of different admixtures, other special materials and routine products to ensure quality parameters are met

KRA9 Production Execution

- (R) Ensure VAC orders to each plant are executed in time and as per required specifications
 - (R) Track the standard deviation of the produced batch to ensure quality of concrete is within permissible limits and take corrective measures
 - (R, A) Ensure workability and cohesiveness of concrete at plant and at pouring site
 - (R, A) Implement moisture corrections during production
 - (R, A) Monitor the right dosage/ admixture at batching plants during production

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Processing
data.description:
Aliases: Staff Engineer, Senior Staff Engineer, Lead Engineer, Senior Technical Lead, Senior Architect, Platform Architect, Data Architect, Solutions Architect (Engineering), Principal Engineer at a smaller company

About Truveta

Truveta is the world's first health provider-led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a unique combination of health, software, and big data expertise who share our company values. 

This opportunity

Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the early members, you will help build and scale a high-impact organization while contributing to the products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is an unusual chance to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub. 

The Data Platform group in India owns parts of the pipeline that ingests, processes, stores, and serves healthcare data at a scale very few organizations operate at. Patients, doctors, and medical researchers deserve the same engineering rigor that has transformed other industries, and that is the work: correctness under volume, reliability under failure, and speed without cutting the corners that regulated health data does not allow anyone to cut. 

Who We Need

We are seeking engineers who think in platforms. You will own a processing domain or a multi-team data capability, define its architecture, and make that architecture legible enough that the teams building inside it can move quickly without asking permission. The problems at this level are the recurring ones: the class of data-quality defect that keeps returning, the chronic cost line, the incident that has a different proximate cause every quarter and the same root cause every time. You will remain hands-on, because the credibility of the architecture depends on it. 

What You Will Do

- Own a platform, a processing domain, or a multi-team data capability, including both its architecture and its technical roadmap. 
 - Define the architecture for your domain and write it down clearly enough that teams can build inside it without constant consultation. 
 - Drive modernization, reliability, scalability, and cost programs that cross team boundaries. 
 - Solve the systemic problems that show up as recurring incidents, cost escalations, or repeating data-quality defects. 
 - Influence the technical direction of several teams through design review, written architecture, and working prototypes. 
 - Set engineering standards for the domain and make them hold without relying on a reporting line. 
 - Mentor SDE2 and SDE3 engineers and raise the design bar of the whole group, not only of your own projects. 
 - Stay hands-on through prototypes, critical-path code, and the hardest debugging in the domain. 

Key Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7 to 12 years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Ownership of a platform or domain rather than a single system, with architectural decisions that outlived your involvement. 
 - Deep distributed systems and data-processing expertise at production scale. 
 - Strong hands-on coding ability that is current, not historical. 
 - Demonstrated cross-team influence, meaning architecture that other teams adopted because it was right rather than because it was mandated. 
 - Cloud-native architecture on Azure or equivalent, with real depth on cost, reliability, and security. 
 - Track record of mentoring senior engineers and improving how a group designs. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Healthcare data, clinical informatics, or any other heavily regulated data domains. 
 - Experience standing up or scaling an engineering site, or a new platform area from zero. 
 - Governance, lineage, privacy-preserving processing, or large-scale de-identification. 
 - Public technical writing, conference talks, or sustained open-source contribution.

data.title: Principal AI Engineer
data.description:
About InvoiceCloud: 

InvoiceCloud is a fast-growing fintech leader recognized with 20 major awards in 2025, including USA TODAY and Boston Globe Top Workplaces, multiple SaaS Awards wins for Best Solution for Finance and FinTech, and national customer service honors from Stevie and the Business Intelligence Group. Judges also highlighted our mission to reduce digital exclusion and restore simplicity and dignity to how people pay for essential services, as well as our leadership in AI maturity and responsible innovation. It's an award-winning, purpose-driven environment where top talent thrives. To learn more, visit InvoiceCloud. com. 

About InvoiceCloud

InvoiceCloud is the leading digital payments platform for utilities, insurance carriers, municipalities, and financial institutions. We enable billers to present bills digitally and collect payments across every channel - driving digital adoption, reducing costs, and improving the customer experience. With 3, 000+ billing organizations, 240M+ invoices, and $38B+ in annual payment volume, we're investing heavily in AI to transform from a best-in-class payments processor into a Billing Intelligence Platform. 

About The Role

We're building a shared AI platform that powers the next generation of our product portfolio - multi-agent orchestration, ML scoring infrastructure, and LLM-powered intelligence products. As Principal AI Engineer, you'll architect this platform, set the technical direction, and define the engineering standards that the organization builds against. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role - not a management position. You set architectural direction and write production code every day. You think in ADRs, trade-off matrices, and failure modes. You use Claude Code and AI accelerators to operate at 3-5x speed, and you teach the team to do the same. 

Your work directly shapes a growing AI product portfolio. The platform you architect becomes the shared foundation - every subsequent product launches faster because of the infrastructure decisions you make now. 

You'll be based in India, working hybrid (3 days in-office per week), and will report to the VP of Engineering / CTO. 

What You'll Do

Own AI Platform Architecture : 

- Design the full AI platform - multi-agent orchestration, ML inference infrastructure, LLM gateway, tool registry, and eval/observability stack
 - Write Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) that the organization builds against
 - Make build-vs-buy decisions, evaluate emerging frameworks (A2A, MCP, Visa TAP), and define integration patterns
 - Design system-level concerns: auth gating, policy enforcement (OPA), API gateway patterns (Kong), and multi-tenant isolation
 - Define reference architectures for AI-enabled services across . NET 10 APIs, Python ML workloads, React frontends, AKS deployments, Kong gateway integration, and Azure DevOps delivery pipelines

Drive Product AI Strategy : 

- Partner with Product and CTO office to translate business objectives into AI technical strategy
 - Identify where AI creates differentiated value - predictive models, conversational agents, intelligent automation
 - Evaluate and de-risk emerging technologies. Present to executive leadership on AI capabilities, costs, and competitive positioning
 - Define the AI FinOps strategy: token metering, model routing for cost optimization, quota management, and budget forecasting
 - Establish clear platform decision rules for when AI capabilities should be implemented as . NET services, Python services, Azure ML pipelines, background jobs, or embedded product workflows

AI Safety, Governance And Responsible AI : 

- Define and enforce the Responsible AI framework - content safety guardrails, PII governance, bias testing, and audit trails
 - Ensure all AI systems meet PCI DSS, SOC 2, and emerging AI regulation requirements
 - Establish model validation and governance processes - transparency, explainability, and fairness are non-negotiable
 - Build the trust infrastructure that enables the organization to deploy AI confidently in regulated financial services
 - Champion ethical AI principles; ensure all agents and models comply with global financial regulations and internal compliance standards

Write Code - Everyday : 

- Write production code, review critical PRs, debug complex agent interactions, and prototype new capabilities

 - Collaborate with business analysts configuration teams and operations stakeholders to translate payer and provider business requirements into testable Facets scenarios that reflect real world claim patterns.

 - Validate interoperability between Facets and downstream systems such as financial reporting data warehouses and provider portals to ensure claims and benefit data integrity across the ecosystem. 
 - Apply healthcare payer and provider domain expertise to evaluate the impact of new benefit designs regulatory mandates and product changes on Facets test coverage and regression suites. 
 - Create and maintain reusable test assets including regression packs test data libraries and execution checklists tailored to Facets claims and benefits modules to support continuous delivery. 
 - Coordinate test execution in a hybrid work environment ensuring effective communication of progress risks and dependencies across onsite and remote stakeholders during day shift operations. 
 - Provide mentoring and guidance to peers and junior testers on Facets configuration concepts claims adjudication flows and best practices for healthcare product testing while promoting quality ownership. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by assessing test process performance proposing optimization opportunities and supporting adoption of automation where feasible in Facets testing. 
 - Document clear and concise test results and business impact summaries highlighting improvements in claim accuracy benefit interpretation and provider satisfaction driven by high quality configuration validation. 

Qualifications

- Leverage extensive experience of nine to twelve years in product testing with a strong focus on healthcare payer and provider domains to interpret complex requirements and design robust Facets test approaches. 
 - Apply expert proficiency in Facets claims functionality to validate claim adjudication business rules pricing logic and edits ensuring alignment with contractual and regulatory expectations. 
 - Utilize advanced knowledge of Facets benefit configuration including benefit plans accumulators and eligibility constructs to verify that configured products support diverse member coverage scenarios. 
 - Demonstrate hands on experience across broader Facets platform capabilities such as membership billing and provider data to ensure holistic validation of integrated health plan operations.

ABOUT THE TEAM & ROLE: 

Swiggy Instamart's Supply Chain Fulfilment team builds and operates the systems that power workforce management and pod fulfillment. These systems sit close to day-to-day operations and need to work reliably at scale while evolving quickly with the business. 

We're looking for a strong, hands-on engineer to lead technical execution across a team of 8-10 engineers. This is an individual-contributor role: you'll set technical direction, break down outcomes into clear work, delegate and coordinate execution, coach engineers, and stay close to the code and production systems. You'll partner with the product/business teams to understand the product features and specifications, translate them into high level and low-level design thereby facilitating the team in design and development of mission critical applications. You'll partner with the Engineering Manager to own the team's technology outcomes and act as the technical gatekeeper for new initiatives. 

The role suits someone who can move comfortably between architecture, implementation, reviews, operational problem-solving, and multiple parallel initiatives - and who can build robust systems from the ground up. 

Job Description

Job Profile: Software Development Engineer III (Supply chain)

Base Location: Bangalore

Years Of Experience - 6 To 9 Years

ABOUT THE TEAM & ROLE: 

Swiggy Instamart's Supply Chain Fulfilment team builds and operates the systems that power workforce management and pod fulfillment. These systems sit close to day-to-day operations and need to work reliably at scale while evolving quickly with the business. 

We're looking for a strong, hands-on engineer to lead technical execution across a team of 8-10 engineers. This is an individual-contributor role: you'll set technical direction, break down outcomes into clear work, delegate and coordinate execution, coach engineers, and stay close to the code and production systems. You'll partner with the product/business teams to understand the product features and specifications, translate them into high level and low-level design thereby facilitating the team in design and development of mission critical applications. You'll partner with the Engineering Manager to own the team's technology outcomes and act as the technical gatekeeper for new initiatives. 

The role suits someone who can move comfortably between architecture, implementation, reviews, operational problem-solving, and multiple parallel initiatives - and who can build robust systems from the ground up. 

What qualities are we looking for?

- B. Tech/M. Tech in Computer Science or equivalent experience, with 6-8 years of software development experience in a product engineering environment. 
 - Strong hands-on engineering ability and sound fundamentals in algorithms, data structures, object-oriented design, and design patterns. 
 - Experience designing and operating distributed, scalable services; able to work through both high-level architecture and low-level implementation details. 
 - Proficiency in at least one of Java or Go. 
 - Practical experience with cloud platforms, relational and non-relational databases, and Linux/Unix environments. 
 - A track record of owning systems or product areas end to end- from problem definition and design through launch, operations, and iterative improvement. 
 - Experience providing technical leadership to engineers: decomposing work, delegating effectively, mentoring, reviewing designs and code, and helping a team deliver together. Formal people management is not required for this IC role. 
 - Strong judgment when balancing delivery speed with reliability, maintainability, and operational risk; able to explain trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical partners. 
 - Comfort working across several concurrent workstreams and responding to production needs while maintaining focus on the most important outcomes. 
 - Ability to work effectively with agentic AI development tools and understand how to harness generative AI to improve engineering productivity across exploration, implementation, testing, and documentation - while applying sound judgment on correctness, security, and quality. 
 - Supply chain, workforce management, fulfilment, or operations-tech experience is a plus. 

What will you get to do here?

- Own technical outcomes with the Engineering Manager: Shape the technical roadmap and architecture for Workforce Management and Pod Fulfilment, and take responsibility for delivery, quality, reliability, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Lead as a hands-on IC: Guide technical execution across an 8-10 member team. Break down ambiguous goals, sequence and delegate work, surface dependencies, unblock engineers, and raise the team's design and code quality through coaching and reviews. 
 - Build from zero to production: Turn business and operational problems into clear technical designs, APIs, data models, services, and production-ready systems. Improve existing platforms where that is the better path. 
 - Be the technical gatekeeper for initiatives: Review proposals and designs for sound architecture, scalability, reliability, operability, security, and maintainability. Identify risks and dependencies early, and ensure initiatives have a safe delivery and rollback plan. 
 - Stay close to production: Use metrics, logs, and traces to diagnose issues, lead technical resolution, and drive root-cause fixes-not just short-term mitigations. Improve observability and operational readiness as systems grow. 
 - Context-switch with intent: Balance roadmap delivery, design decisions, code-level problem solving, production issues, and emerging business needs without losing clarity on priorities or ownership. 
 - Partner across functions: Work closely with Product, Operations, Data, and other Engineering teams to understand constraints, align on trade-offs, and deliver outcomes that work in real operating conditions. 
 - Raise the engineering bar: Champion sound engineering practices, thoughtful reviews, clear technical documentation, and pragmatic choices in tools and technology. 

Qualifications

- B. Tech/M. Tech in Computer Science or equivalent experience, with 6-8 years of software development experience in a product engineering environment. 

Additional Information

Visit our tech blogs to learn more about some the challenges we deal with: https: //medium. com/swiggy-bytes

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by the law.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Principal Engineer. Job Overview

We at Arm are crafting the future of Software-Defined Vehicles and Robotics driven by Physical AI by building next-generation reference software platforms for sophisticated compute subsystems. We are looking for a passionate and highly skilled Principal Software Engineer to join our growing team and help drive this exciting transformation

You will lead key technical initiatives in multiple engineering domains. You will collaborate with software leads, architects, and program management teams. Your goal is to deliver robust, scalable, highly optimized system solutions that demonstrate the full potential of Arm platforms. 

This is a great opportunity for engineers who enjoy working across the complete software stack - from low-level system firmware and operating systems to middleware and application development. You will have the chance to tackle intricate technical problems, influence architecture decisions, and contribute to innovative progress in physical systems based on artificial intelligence. 

Beyond technical excellence, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about building high-performing teams, mentoring engineers, and fostering a strong culture of collaboration and innovation. 

If you are excited about groundbreaking technologies, eager to work on industry-defining solutions, and motivated to help build an exceptional engineering team at Arm, we would love to hear from you. 

Roles and Responsibilities

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will play a key role in overseeing the implementation and end-to-end validation of platform firmware and software features for next-generation Physical AI compute platforms. 

You will own the design and implementation of features, scalable test infrastructure, automation frameworks, and modern quality assurance practices to ensure delivery of high-performance, reliable software. 

You will work closely with developers, architects, product owners, and multi-functional teams to breakdown end-to-end system-level firmware and software requirements, and develop comprehensive solutions. 

You will also champion the use of industry-standard open-source frameworks and tools, established internal test environments, and continuously improve software quality, performance, and development efficiency across the group. 

This position offers the opportunity to influence platform-level engineering decisions, tackle sophisticated technical challenges, and contribute to modern innovations in Physical AI systems. 

In addition to technical leadership, you will mentor and guide a distributed software engineering team, fostering a strong culture of collaboration, innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning. 

You should be able to clearly communicate architecture, decisions, risks, alternatives and recommendations to engineers as well as senior technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 16+ years of experience in software development, end to end verification and validation of system firmware across semiconductor development life cycle. 
 - Deep understanding of low-level system BSP firmware like TF-A, TF-M, SCP, OP-TEE, Xen, Zephyr etc. 
 - Good in programming embedded C/C++, Python, Bash/Shell scripting, and familiar with Git, Pytest, ROS2, GitLab/GitHub, and Virtualization software
 - Hands-on experience of defining test strategies, test methods, test metrics, productization of firmware etc. 
 - Leading and driving team to achieve excellent result!
 - Good interpersonal and communication skills, excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to write coherent documentation, influence, and build consensus

Desirable Skills & Qualities

- Strong debugging skills, capable of navigating complex software stacks and delivering effective solutions
 - Experience in qualifying automotive/robotics workloads, use cases, AI / ML software stacks, and tooling
 - Experience with automotive/robotics software safety/security qualification is an added advantage!
 - Good understanding of architecture and microarchitecture concepts, ideally for the Arm architecture. 

If this sounds like you, please don't hesitate to apply. 

In Return

We provide an opportunity to learn about the latest Arm architecture features, working closely with a highly skilled engineering team on ground-breaking technology!

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Job Summary

Serve as a senior test analyst specializing in MES validation and automation for hybrid work model projects ensuring high quality manufacturing execution solutions through rigorous functional integration and AI assisted testing. Apply expertise in Camstar MES platforms and multi layer integration to improve reliability reduce defects and support efficient supply chain operations while collaborating with diverse global teams. 

Responsibilities

- Design and execute comprehensive test strategies for MES validation that align with project scope regulatory expectations and enterprise quality standards ensuring reliable delivery of manufacturing execution capabilities across hybrid work environments. 
 - Develop and maintain detailed automated test suites for MES applications using suitable frameworks focusing on regression coverage repeatability and rapid feedback to project teams to reduce release cycle times and production defects. 
 - Perform thorough manual functional and integration testing for MES features where automation is not yet feasible documenting clear test conditions reproducible steps and evidence to support release readiness decisions. 
 - Validate and test MES L4 L3 and L2 integration flows across enterprise planning systems shop floor control systems and field devices ensuring accurate data exchange timing and transaction integrity for manufacturing and supply chain scenarios. 
 - Configure and validate Camstar MES features workflows and business rules in test environments ensuring that process configurations meet user requirements while upholding data integrity and traceability standards for regulated manufacturing contexts. 
 - Utilize generative AI tools in a compliant manner to accelerate test design test data generation and defect analysis while applying critical judgment to review AI generated outputs for accuracy relevance and risk. 
 - Collaborate closely with business analysts developers MES engineers and operations stakeholders to clarify requirements define acceptance criteria and proactively identify risks or gaps that could impact manufacturing continuity or supply chain visibility. 
 - Analyze test results and production like data patterns to identify systemic defects performance bottlenecks and integration issues then work with technical teams to prioritize and verify fixes that provide measurable operational improvements. 
 - Create and maintain clear test documentation including test plans test cases traceability matrices and execution reports that support audits and provide transparent evidence of validation coverage for all MES components. 
 - Provide mentoring and practical guidance to other test professionals on MES validation techniques automated testing practices and integration testing patterns fostering a culture of quality ownership across the delivery team. 
 - Engage in defect triage sessions and change review activities presenting well reasoned impact analyses and retest strategies that balance quality risk with project timelines for day shift hybrid operations. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance test automation frameworks test data management and environment stability thereby increasing efficiency across recurring MES validation cycles. 
 - Partner with manufacturing and supply chain stakeholders to understand process flows and key performance indicators ensuring that test scenarios reflect real operational conditions and help safeguard product quality and service reliability. 

Qualifications

- Demonstrate extensive hands on experience in MES validation and automated testing with a proven track record of owning test design execution and reporting for complex enterprise scale implementations. 
 - Exhibit strong proficiency in manual MES validation activities including requirement analysis test case creation risk based prioritization and evidence collection suitable for regulated manufacturing environments. 
 - Show advanced skills in testing L4 L3 and L2 integration scenarios across planning manufacturing and shop floor systems with an ability to troubleshoot data flow discrepancies and interface failures effectively. 
 - Apply practical knowledge of generative AI in the context of software quality engineering using it to enhance test asset creation and analysis while maintaining strict review controls and compliance awareness. 
 - Demonstrate deep working knowledge of Camstar MES configuration object modeling and workflow behavior enabling precise validation of manufacturing processes and electronic records under varied operational conditions. 
 - Display solid understanding of manufacturing and supply chain business processes including work order management inventory tracking and quality events so that test coverage aligns with real world operational needs. 
 - Communicate findings and recommendations clearly in written and spoken form to cross functional teams enabling timely decisions on release readiness and risk mitigation in a hybrid day shift setting. 
 - Maintain strong analytical and problem solving capabilities supported by a methodical approach to root cause analysis that helps reduce recurring defects and enhances overall MES ecosystem stability.

data.description:
Job Title: Director - Principal Data Engineering Lead

GCL: F

Location: Chennai

Introduction To Role

Are you ready to turn the latest AI breakthroughs into resilient, production-grade systems that accelerate late-stage scientific discovery and move life-changing medicines closer to patients? Can you picture yourself setting enterprise-wide Data and AI strategy while building reusable autonomous frameworks and GenAI capabilities that scale with confidence?

In this role, you will lead how we embed intelligence into the digital backbone of drug development. You will develop long-term platform funding priorities, capability roadmaps, and technology choices. Then you will translate strategy into solutions that make complex enterprise workflows simpler, safer, and faster for our scientists and product teams. 

Join us at a pivotal point in our transformation into a digital and data-led enterprise. Backed by investment and an ecosystem of partners, you will work across AI science, engineering and business partners to create patterns that become the standard and prove them through high-impact deliveries that stand up in a regulated environment. 

Accountabilities

- Shape and evolve the long-term Data and AI strategy for drug development, including platform investments, capability roadmaps, technology choices and alignment with enterprise architecture. 
 - Partner with AI science teams to design reusable agentic patterns, GenAI components and scalable solutions that streamline sophisticated enterprise workflows and accelerate delivery. 
 - Influence enterprise architecture decisions and lead strategic vendor evaluations, pilots and ecosystem partnerships to bring the best technologies into the enterprise. 
 - Lead multi-functional engineering teams, driving end-to-end delivery from prototype to robust, compliant production systems. 
 - Define, govern and promote engineering standards, guidelines and reusable design patterns; produce and review detailed technical designs across data models, APIs, integrations, security, deployment, error handling, performance, monitoring, testing and support. 
 - Promote strong data integrity and governance, including clear ownership, quality management, metadata, lineage, audit trails, master and reference data, and standardized terminology. 
 - Establish and maintain AI and ML governance controls, covering risk assessment, proper use, human oversight, explainability, model approval, versioning, performance monitoring, change control and retirement. 
 - Implement production-grade controls for GenAI and retrieval-augmented generation solutions to deliver reliable, traceable and secure outputs based on trusted information, including prompt and model management, response quality testing, source referencing, access controls and mitigations for prompt attacks and data leakage. 
 - Define and operate comprehensive evaluation and monitoring frameworks that track accuracy, reliability, security, response quality, business relevance, degradation, latency, cost and operational stability. 
 - Establish API-based and event-driven integration standards, including data formats, contracts, versioning, interoperability and integration with legacy and regulated systems. 
 - Improve value from enterprise data platforms and guide the implementation of DevOps, DataOps and MLOps practices to deliver resilient, automated, auditable pipelines across data, ML and AI. 
 - Ensure data solutions adhere to FAIR principles-findable, accessible, interoperable and reusable-and support end-to-end machine learning and AI workflows. 
 - Foster a culture of continuous improvement, experimentation, collaboration, and innovation across engineering and AI teams, encouraging thoughtful use of AI and digital tools in day-to-day work. 

Essential Skills/Experience

- Track record of leading end-to-end delivery of AI-native products within a controlled or enterprise environment. 
 - Demonstrable ability translating research advances in GenAI or agent-based systems into scalable industrial solutions. 
 - Deep knowledge of modern cloud and data architecture patterns: microservices, serverless, etc. 
 - Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), SQL/NoSQL databases, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code. 
 - Fluency in Python, with a good understanding of secure software engineering practices. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and leading high-performing teams. 
 - Comfortable influencing senior partners and shaping technology strategy across functions. 

Desirable Skills/Experience

- Pharma industry experience, particularly in R&D or Late-Stage Development. 
 - AI or Gen AI technical certifications or equivalent. 
 - AWS Cloud Certification or equivalent. 

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world. 

Why AstraZeneca

Here, your work directly accelerates the development of life-changing medicines by pairing leading science with modern data platforms, analytics and AI. You will join a community that brings unconventional combinations of expertise together to spark bold thinking, supported by real investment and the freedom to experiment-from hackathons to high-impact deliveries in production. We value kindness alongside ambition, recognize meaningful contributions and create space for diverse minds to collaborate, learn fast and shape how an entire enterprise uses data and AI to create patient impact. 

Call To Action

Step into this role to architect the AI foundations of drug development and amplify your impact-share your profile and start shaping what's next. 

Date Posted

13-Oct-2026

Closing Date

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Billing Platform
data.description:
About Freshworks

Freshworks makes it fast and easy for businesses to delight their customers and employees. 

Our products are designed to be simple, intuitive, and powerful, helping organizations create

exceptional customer and employee experiences. 

Job Description

About the Billing Platform

The Billing Platform is a foundational platform that powers how Freshworks manages and

monetizes its products and customer relationships. 

The platform currently owns three critical capabilities: 

● Subscription Management - managing customer subscriptions, plans, products, and

their lifecycle. 

● Entitlements - determining what customers are entitled to access and use based on

their subscriptions and commercial agreements. 

● Metering - capturing and processing product usage to support usage-based billing

and evolving monetization models. 

These capabilities sit at the intersection of technology, product, pricing, finance, and

customer experience and are consumed across multiple Freshworks products. 

As Freshworks continues to expand its product portfolio and evolve its monetization models, 

the Billing Platform will play a critical role in enabling new business models while ensuring

scale, reliability, accuracy, and a great customer experience. 

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the engineering organization

responsible for Subscription Management, Entitlements, and Metering. 

This role goes beyond managing engineering execution. You will shape the technology

strategy, platform architecture, roadmap, engineering organization, and cross-functional

partnerships that enable Freshworks' monetization journey. 

We are looking for a leader who is equally comfortable discussing distributed systems and

architecture with engineers, business models with Product and Finance, and strategic

priorities with senior leadership. 

Most importantly, you should enjoy stepping outside the boundaries of engineering-meeting

stakeholders from Product, Finance, Pricing, Sales, Customer Success, and other business

functions, understanding their problems, and turning those problems into scalable

technology solutions. 

What You'll Do

1. Lead Billing Platform Engineering

● Own the engineering strategy and technical direction for Subscription Management, 

Entitlements, and Metering. 

● Build highly scalable, reliable, secure, and extensible platform capabilities. 

● Drive architecture across distributed systems, APIs, data platforms, event-driven

systems, and integrations. 

● Design platforms that can support multiple products, subscription models, pricing

structures, and evolving monetization strategies. 

● Establish strong engineering practices around reliability, observability, security, 

performance, and operational excellence. 

2. Shape the Platform Strategy & Roadmap

● Partner closely with Product and business stakeholders to shape the Billing Platform

roadmap. 

● Translate business requirements and commercial models into scalable technology

solutions. 

● Identify opportunities to build reusable platform capabilities rather than

product-specific solutions. 

● Balance business priorities with platform modernization, technical debt, scalability, 

reliability, and long-term engineering investments. 

● Anticipate future business and monetization needs and ensure the platform is ready

to support them. 

3. Partner with Business & Non-Engineering Stakeholders

This role requires strong engagement beyond engineering. 

● Build trusted relationships with Product, Finance, Pricing, Sales, Customer Success, 

Operations, and other business teams. 

● Understand the business and commercial models behind subscription and

usage-based offerings. 

● Participate actively in business discussions and explain technical implications in

simple terms. 

● Translate complex business problems into technology strategies and platform

capabilities. 

● Challenge requirements constructively when necessary and help stakeholders arrive

at better solutions. 

● Represent the Billing Platform in cross-functional and strategic initiatives. 

We are looking for a leader who is curious about the business, enjoys meeting people

outside engineering, and wants to understand the problem behind the

requirement-not just implement the requirement. 

4. Drive Execution & Business Outcomes

● Lead end-to-end execution of complex, cross-functional platform initiatives. 

● Establish clear goals, milestones, ownership, and execution mechanisms. 

● Proactively manage risks, dependencies, capacity, and organizational constraints. 

● Drive predictable delivery while maintaining high engineering quality. 

● Measure and improve platform health, engineering effectiveness, reliability, and

business impact. 

5. Build High-Performing Engineering Teams

● Build, lead, and scale high-performing engineering teams. 

● Develop Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, and emerging technical leaders. 

● Create a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous

improvement. 

● Hire and retain strong engineering talent. 

● Coach engineers and leaders to take broader ownership and operate with increasing

autonomy. 

● Build organizational capabilities that scale beyond the immediate team. 

6. Drive Engineering Excellence & AI Adoption

● Raise the bar on engineering productivity, quality, automation, and developer

experience. 

● Encourage modern engineering practices and AI-assisted development. 

● Explore AI and agentic workflows to improve development, testing, deployment, 

operations, and engineering productivity. 

● Establish meaningful engineering metrics around quality, reliability, delivery, and

productivity. 

What We're Looking For

Technical Leadership

● 15+ years of software engineering experience, with significant experience building

and scaling large-scale platforms. 

● 5+ years of engineering management experience. 

● Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, APIs, databases, 

event-driven architectures, and cloud-native systems. 

● Experience building shared platforms or services consumed by multiple products or

teams. 

● Strong understanding of scalability, reliability, security, observability, and operational

excellence. 

● Experience with billing, subscriptions, payments, commerce, entitlements, 

metering, or monetization platforms is helpful. 

Business & Product Orientation

● Ability to connect technology decisions with business and revenue outcomes. 

● Strong product and business mindset with the ability to translate business processes

into scalable technology. 

● Comfortable working closely with Product, Finance, Pricing, Sales, Customer

Success, and other non-engineering stakeholders. 

● Ability to influence business and product decisions through technology expertise. 

● Genuine curiosity about how the business works and how technology can create

leverage. 

People Leadership

● Proven experience building and leading high-performing engineering organizations. 

● Experience managing Engineering Managers and/or senior technical leaders is

helpful. 

● Strong track record of hiring, coaching, developing, and retaining engineering talent. 

● Ability to create clarity and drive execution in ambiguous and complex environments. 

● Passion for building autonomous teams and developing the next generation of

engineering leaders. 

Leadership & Influence

● Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. 

● Ability to influence senior technical and business leaders across organizational

boundaries. 

● Strong judgment in balancing business urgency with engineering quality and

long-term platform investments. 

● Ability to simplify complex technical and business problems for diverse audiences. 

● Collaborative leadership style with the ability to challenge constructively and build

strong relationships. 

The Leadership Profile We're Looking For

You are someone who: 

● Thinks in platforms, not projects. 

● Understands both technology and business. 

● Enjoys solving complex problems with Product and business stakeholders. 

● Can move seamlessly between architecture, strategy, execution, and people

leadership. 

● Creates clarity in ambiguous situations. 

● Challenges assumptions while building strong relationships. 

● Builds teams that can operate autonomously and scale. 

● Balances long-term platform thinking with near-term business outcomes. 

● Has deep technical judgment without needing to be the primary hands-on contributor. 

● Is passionate about building platforms, people, and organizational

Additional Information

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.

data.description:
About Tide

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting. 

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France. 

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love. 

Tide Facts

- Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
 - Over 2 million members across UK and India
 - Over $300 million raised in funding
 - Over 2, 800 Tideans globally
 - Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India's Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
 - We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Role

Here at Tide, we are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Team Leader to oversee our Acquiring Transaction Monitoring team in our first line of defence with experience in transaction monitoring within the card acquiring space or merchant banking, with a deep understanding of fraud detection, compliance, and risk management. This role requires strong leadership skills, along with a deep understanding of fraud prevention, risk management, and compliance within the payments ecosystem. 

Your team will be responsible for the monitoring of the transaction and behaviours across our customer base, ensuring we put our genuine members first, whilst spotting and investigating potentially suspicious activity. This role is a key element of our team, so we're looking for someone who is a passionate investigator, possesses good knowledge on merchant payments, who will help reduce risk to tide, and let our members get back to doing what they love. 

- Lead, manage, and mentor a team of Transaction Monitoring Analysts, ensuring they meet performance metrics, including transaction reviews, case resolution times, and fraud detection accuracy. 
 - Conduct regular performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and develop individual training plans to improve team capabilities. 
 - Manage resources of the team by effective capacity forecasting and monitoring, setting priorities, work allocation and reallocation where necessary. 
 - Supervise the monitoring of acquiring transactions, ensuring suspicious activities are detected in real-time or through post-transaction analysis. 
 - Oversee the monitoring of merchant acquiring activities, including card payment authorizations, settlements, chargebacks, and disputes, ensuring all processes follow best practices. 
 - Ensure all monitored transactions comply with industry regulations and standards, including AML, and card network rules (Visa, MasterCard, etc. ). 
 - Develop strategies to reduce fraudulent activities across merchant card payments and ensure merchants meet compliance requirements. 
 - Use data-driven insights to recommend improvements in transaction monitoring processes and fraud mitigation strategies. 
 - Keep the team updated on emerging fraud trends and adjust detection rules and constantly measure, assess and improve our risk policies, procedures and controls across products
 - Foster a collaborative team environment focused on continuous improvement and high operational efficiency. 
 - Representing your area in front of different stakeholders, including internal and external auditors. 

What We Are Looking For

- You are willing to work in flexible shift patterns. 
 - 3-5 years of experience in merchant banking, card acquiring, merchant acquiring, transaction monitoring, or merchant card payments with automated processes and data driven decisioning tools/culture. 
 - Proven leadership experience, with a track record of managing teams in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. 
 - Deep understanding of card acquiring processes, merchant acquiring systems, payment networks (Visa, MasterCard, etc. ), and fraud detection methodologies. 
 - Analytical mindset with a proven ability to interpret complex transaction data and identify fraud patterns. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience in handling escalations and coordinating cross-functional teams. 
 - Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard. 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone's voice is heard. 

Disclaimer

It Has Come To Our Attention That Individuals Or Agencies Are Falsely Claiming To Represent Tide And Are Reaching Out To Candidates Regarding Job Opportunities. Please Be Aware That

- Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. 
 - All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel. 
 - Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide. co email address. 
 - Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf. 

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide. co

Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. 

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy. 

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

data.title: System Architect
data.description:
EVA Equity Partners acquires enterprise software companies and transforms them into AI-native, profitable, scalable businesses. We don't add AI features. We redesign foundational architecture so autonomous agents can safely build, test, and ship production software at scale. 

The role

We are hiring a Agentic Systems Architect to transform 10+ year legacy codebases into high-velocity, agent-operable architectures. This role sits at the intersection of software architecture, AI-agent orchestration, and engineering governance. You will be embedded into EVA portfolio companies, design system patterns and MCP interfaces, and govern what AI generates. 

What you'll do

Agent-operable system architecture

- Decompose legacy monoliths into agent-readable, modular systems with strict boundaries and single responsibility
 - Lead incremental modernization using the Strangler Pattern, wrapping legacy logic in modern, contract-driven interfaces
 - Enforce SOLID principles, Dependency Injection, and Hexagonal Architecture to ensure deterministic AI execution and low regression riskAgentic framework and MCP leadership

- Architect and maintain the agent context layer: standardized Skills, Rules, and Commands for AI-driven engineering workflows
 - Build and operate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers exposing legacy APIs, services, and databases as typed, secure, AI-consumable tools
 - Own contract-first API design as the primary interface between human intent and autonomous agent executionEngineering governance and AI quality control

- Act as architectural gatekeeper for AI-generated pull requests, ensuring scalability, security, and long-term maintainability
 - Mandate test-driven development (TDD) and characterization testing to preserve legacy behavior during refactoring
 - Monitor and optimize agentic reasoning loops to balance cost, speed, and architectural integrityWhat we're looking for

- 7+ years in software architecture, platform engineering
 - Proven experience modernizing large, undocumented legacy systems
 - Deep hands-on expertise with TypeScript, . NET, and Node. js
 - Strong background in API design, distributed systems, and modular architectures
 - Practical experience with agentic development, MCP, LLM tooling, or AI-assisted engineering
 - Bias toward clean code, deterministic systems, and production-grade AI
 - Comfort operating in high-ambiguity, high-ownership, remote-first environmentsNice to have

- Experience in PE-backed or SaaS transformation environments
 - Background working across multiple companies or codebases as a consultant or fractional leader
 - Familiarity with LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar agentic orchestration frameworksWhy this role matters

You are not adding AI features. You are designing the architectural substrate that allows AI to safely build software at scale. This is a career-defining role for architects shaping how autonomous systems write, change, and govern production code.

As a manager

data.title: Senior Staff AI Application Engineer
data.description:
Job Description Summary

We are looking for a senior full-stack engineer who has shipped production applications, and who has owned software that other engineering teams depended on - a framework, SDK, shared library or internal developer platform - living with an abstraction decision long enough to have had to correct it while consumers depended on it. Establishing engineering standards through automation rather than documentation should be instinctive. 

You will be the senior technical owner of GE HealthCare's internal AI engineering platform: the shared libraries, standardised interfaces, code generation tools and automated verification our data scientists and engineers use to take AI solutions into production. It exists to deliver four outcomes for the company: 

- reduce time from working prototype to production from months to days; 
 - allow data scientists to ship production-grade AI without expertise in cloud infrastructure, deployment, application security or front-end development; 
 - make security, compliance and consistency automatically enforced properties of every solution, rather than outcomes dependent on scarce expert review; 
 - allow underlying technologies to be replaced - model provider, agent framework, user interface approach - without rewriting the solutions built on them. 

Your accountability is the platform's architecture and public interfaces, the automated verification that enforces our engineering standards, and the versioning and migration approach that keeps it dependable as it evolves beneath a growing number of applications. The role also includes building AI applications end to end yourself - front end, back end and agents - where that is the fastest way to prove a platform capability or unblock a priority use case; the emphasis at this level sits firmly on the platform, with application work serving it rather than competing with it. This is a hands-on senior engineering role with substantial architectural responsibility and organisational influence - not a management position, and not a research position. 

Job Description

GE HealthCare's Chief Data and Analytics Office is delivering a portfolio of strategic AI programmes across Commercial, Finance, Supply Chain, Quality, Manufacturing and Operational Excellence. 

The problem this team addresses is structural. Most people creating AI solutions here are data scientists, and it would be neither reasonable nor efficient to require deep infrastructure, security and front-end expertise of them. Every solution must nonetheless reach production as a secure, reliable, observable, supportable enterprise system, and remain so through years of change. That is the central design constraint: the platform and its automated safeguards must substitute for a depth of software engineering review that is not available at the scale and pace we require. 

The failures a strong platform engineer prevents - undetected interface drift, poorly chosen abstractions that become permanent, over-broad access permissions, configuration that cannot be reviewed or reversed - are silent, and present months later as an outage, an audit finding or a security incident rather than as a broken feature. 

Core Responsibilities

Architecture and design

- Define the platform's architecture and public interfaces: what is offered, what is guaranteed, what is private, and what a version number promises to dependent applications. 
 - Design isolation boundaries so each significant third-party technology - agent framework, model provider, message queue, data source, UI rendering approach - is confined to a single replaceable component, with automated checks making that a verified property rather than a documented intention. Validate each in practice, for example by running the same agent unmodified on two frameworks (LangGraph and AWS Bedrock AgentCore, say) with equivalent evaluated behaviour. 
 - Design the interfaces between roles and components as machine-readable specifications with automated verification, so no two teams need to read each other's code to work together reliably. 
 - Hold the boundary between declarative configuration and executable code - configuration states what, code implements how - preventing the familiar progression by which a configuration format acquires conditional logic and becomes an undocumented programming language with no type checking, debugger or tooling. 
 - Record architectural decisions formally (options rejected, trade-offs accepted, revisit conditions), and decline unnecessary abstraction in writing and with reasoning. A significant part of this role's value lies in shared capability deliberately not built. 

Engineering delivery and long-term ownership

- Lead the highest-leverage components hands-on: the agent execution layer, the secure data resolution layer, and the configuration-driven user interface system. This is a building role, not a supervisory one. 
 - Build selected AI applications end to end - front end, back end and agents - where that is the fastest way to prove a platform capability or unblock a priority use case, and judge what should then be harvested into the platform and what should remain specific to that use case. 
 - Establish automated verification before the practice it enforces is adopted - a standard that is not automatically enforced does not, in practice, exist - including automated quality evaluation of AI behaviour in the release path, so degraded output prevents release and a change of model or framework can be shown to have preserved behaviour. 
 - Own backward compatibility and the migration path. The platform will change continuously while dozens of solutions depend on it; making that change inexpensive and safe for consumers is a primary responsibility. 
 - Prevent version divergence across applications and shared components; run deprecation properly - announce, migrate, remove - and maintain visibility of the platform's own engineering health, acting before it is raised. 

Interfaces with adjacent disciplines

- Define and maintain the interfaces between this team and adjacent specialist functions - infrastructure, security, data - as version-controlled specifications with automated validation rather than request queues or standing meetings. These cover what an environment provides, what an infrastructure component accepts, what a service requires to run and is permitted to do, what must pass before release, what artefact is deployed and how it is promoted, and what telemetry and service level commitments apply. 
 - Anticipate and act on the recognised ways such boundaries deteriorate: a request queue re-forming, resources created outside the sanctioned path, release throughput constrained by a single function, divergent standards emerging, or incidents beginning with a dispute about ownership. 
 - Represent the platform's architecture and trade-offs to enterprise architecture, information security, risk and senior leadership, in terms appropriate to each audience. 

Technical leadership

- Mentor engineers and data scientists moving into platform and application engineering, and establish a review culture in which human review addresses design judgement and business fit, because formatting, type correctness, security fundamentals and interface compliance are handled automatically. 
 - Author the guidance, reference implementations and worked examples that let colleagues and AI coding assistants work productively without direct supervision, and set the standard for responsible use of those assistants under named human accountability. 

Experience Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable practical experience. An advanced degree is welcome but not required. 
 - Minimum 8 years of professional software engineering experience, including demonstrable ownership of a shared library, framework, SDK or internal developer platform relied upon by other engineering teams. This is the essential requirement: not a record of delivering many applications, but an engineer whose software other engineers' software depends on, and who can describe concretely what it cost when an abstraction had to change. 

Software engineering

- Expert Python: advanced static and structural typing (mypy or Pyright, strict), interface definition, and judgement about where type-level guarantees earn their cost. Strong TypeScript and modern component-based front-end engineering (React), sufficient to design typed component contracts and a design token system rather than only consume them. 
 - API and interface design and long-term evolution: specification (OpenAPI), generated clients, versioning, compatibility, deprecation. Relational databases and SQL at depth: schema design, migrations, indexing, behaviour under load, injection resistance established structurally rather than by review. 
 - Testing strategy across unit, integration, interface-contract and end-to-end levels; CI/CD design (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) including shared reusable pipeline components, and the discipline of keeping checks fast enough that engineers do not bypass them. 

AI and Generative AI engineering

- Substantial production experience with LLM systems: instruction design, tool and function calling, structured output, retrieval-augmented generation and retrieval quality, cost and latency control, characteristic failure modes. 
 - Hands-on experience with more than one AI agent framework (for example LangGraph, LangChain, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, OpenAI Agents SDK) and demonstrated ability to design a durable abstraction across them - including rigorous reasoning about which capabilities belong in a common, framework-independent agent definition and which do not. 
 - Familiarity with emerging standards for AI tool and context interoperability (for example the Model Context Protocol), with the judgement to design toward such a standard's shape without prematurely building infrastructure for it. 
 - Evaluation-driven development at depth: designing evaluation suites and quality measures for non-deterministic systems and using them as a formal release gate. 

Required

Cloud and delivery engineering Infrastructure and production operations are specialist disciplines owned elsewhere in the organisation; our applications request what they need through version-controlled declarations validated automatically, rather than by authoring infrastructure or access policies directly. You are not expected to author infrastructure modules, access policies or network components, nor to own cloud estate design, release execution or infrastructure on call. Required at this depth: 

- Strong working knowledge of a major public cloud, ideally AWS: serverless compute (Lambda), messaging (SQS), object and vector storage (S3, S3 Vectors), secret management, managed relational databases (Aurora), content delivery, event routing, managed AI model services (Bedrock) - sufficient to design well against them and reason about cost, quota, scaling and failure. 
 - Infrastructure-as-code: fluent reading and review (Terraform) - interpret an execution plan, evaluate whether a component's interface meets a requirement, articulate precisely what is missing and why. Access-management design literacy at boundary level: what a grant permits, what a boundary constrains, why least-privilege access is better generated than hand-written, and how to identify an over-broad request in review. 
 - Observability design (OpenTelemetry): distributed tracing, structured logging, standardised telemetry, service level objectives and error budgets. Supply chain and delivery security: immutable artefact identity, build provenance, secret scanning, dependency vulnerability management, short-lived federated credentials. 
 - Cost engineering at the level of declared resource requirements: compute sizing, execution limits, model consumption, caching and result limits. 

Leadership and communication

- Ability to explain a technical design and its trade-offs to executive leadership, to security and risk, and to a data scientist, adjusting the level without losing the substance - and willingness to state clearly when a programme is blocked and what would unblock it. 
 - Experience leading work where the principal difficulty was organisational rather than technical, with a concrete account of how a cross-team boundary was kept healthy. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

FC Global Services India LLP (First Citizens India), a part of First Citizens BancShares, Inc. , a top 20 U. S. financial institution, is a global capability center (GCC) based in Bengaluru. Our India-based teams benefit from the company's over 125-year legacy of strength and stability. First Citizens India is responsible for delivering value and managing risks for our lines of business. We are seeking talented individuals to join us in our mission of providing solutions fit for our clients' greatest ambitions. 

Job Description

Value Proposition

The Principal Software Engineer in DevSecOps brings a unique blend of security expertise, automation excellence and architecture foresight enabling the organization to build and deliver secure, scalable software at speed

Drive reliability and resilience - Ensure critical applications and platforms are highly available, scalable, resilient and capable of meeting defined SLOs and SLAs. 

Shift reliability and security left - Embed reliability and security practices early in the software development lifecycle, reducing production risks and remediation costs. 

Improve incident responses and recovery: Establish effective monitoring, alerting, incident response and RCA practices. 

Job Details

Position Title: Principal Software Engineer

Career Level: P4

Job Category: Assistant Vice president

Role Type: Hybrid

Job Location: Bangalore

About The Team

Our team is a strategic team that drives in adoption of secure, automated and scalable software delivery practices. We set the standards, frameworks and best practices for integrating security into Devops process. By Embedding automated security controls into CI/CD pipelines promoting secure coding practices and enabling infrastructure as code the team empowers developers to deliver quickly without compromising safety. 

Impact

As a DevSecOps SRE Engineer on our team, you will play a key role in building and operating secure, scalable and highly reliable platforms. You will bridge development, security and operations by embedding reliability and security into software delivery life cycle, driving automation and observability, improving incident response and enabling faster and safer software delivery. The role offers an opportunity to influence engineering practices at scale, solve complex reliability challenges, and build platforms that improve both developer productivity and business resilience

Key Deliverables

- Define and implement SRE practices, standards and reliability engineering principles across applications and platforms
 - Improve system availability, scalability, performance, resilience and fault tolerance
 - Identify reliability risk and implement proactive measures to prevent recuring incidents
 - Participate in on-call rotations, production support, incident response and post -incident reviews
 - Lead root cause analysis for complex production incidents and drive corrective and preventive actions
 - Design, implement and maintain CI/CD templates with integrated security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA, secret scanning etc). 
 - Develop automation for vulnerability scanning, compliance checks and infrastructure hardening across cloud and on prem. 
 - Define and enforce secure IaC practices. 
 - Conduct Code reviews and provide guidance on application and infrastructure security architecture
 - Set up and manage observability tools and implement alerting and logging for early issue detection and ensuring the reliability and performance of DevSecOps applications and services in preproduction and production. 
 - Troubleshoot software infrastructure issues and collaborate with the team to resolve them. 
 - Identify code vulnerability solution and fix. 
 - Mentoring engineers on DevSecOps practices and tools usage through training and documentation

Skills And Qualification

Functional Skills: 

- Strong written and verbal communication skills to explain technical concepts to non-technical teams
 - Define and drive the DevSecOps vision, roadmap and adoption strategy
 - Ability to prioritize tasks in a fast pace dynamic environment. 
 - Bridge gaps between teams to create shared accountability for secure delivery
 - Evaluate security posture and drive risk mitigation strategies. 
 - Proactively stays current with tools, trends and best practices. 
 - Lead DevSecOps transformation initiatives across large, distributed teams. 

Technical Skills

- 6+ years of experience in SRE, Platform Engineering, or a related field
 - Strong understanding of Site Reliability Engineering principles and practices
 - Strong experience with Linux/Unix systems administration and troubleshooting
 - Strong understanding of DevOps methodologies, tools, and practices, with a focus on automation and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD). 
 - Experienced in setting up and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment using DevSecOps tools and platforms, such as Jenkins/GitLab CI/Github actions, Docker, Kubernetes, and security scanning tools. 
 - Security tooling and practices - familiar scans like SAST/DAST and SCA with tools like sonarqube, Checkmarx, snyk, blackduck
 - Experienced in multiple programming and scripting languages and capable of writing secure code. 
 - Proficiency with Ansible and terraform. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes (K8s), Helm or OpenShift for orchestration and scaling and scanning tools like snyk, trivy aqua. 
 - Awareness of monitoring solutions (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana) and log management tools like Splunk. 
 - Familiarity with security scanning and vulnerability management
 - Experience collaborating with teams using tools like Jira/Confluence
 - Expertise in cloud platform like AWS, Azure

Leadership Qualities

- Demonstrate strong technical ownership and accountability for production systems. 
 - Encourage a culture of automation, learning, knowledge sharing and operational excellence
 - Motivates and encourages the team to achieve their best. 

Relationships & Collaboration

Build strong, trust-based relationships with engineering, security, infrastructure and compliance teams to drive secure delivery practices

Collaborates with global and cross functional teams to align DevSecOps initiatives with organizational priorities

Facilitates knowledge sharing by conducting workshops, documentation sessions, and mentoring programs across engineering teams

Influence leadership and stakeholders through clear communication of security risks and mitigation strategies

What Role You Will Play In Our Team
The Wells Quality Engineer - Drilling Services is a broad role definition for individuals, generally with an Operations background, supporting the global Wells business with a focus on Drilling Services, Equipment, and Tools. This role focusses on application of risk mitigations through quality best practices and processes to ensure integrity and compliance of materials, products, and equipment to industry and specified requirements and provides guidance on fit-for-purpose quality implementation. This position is embedded in the technical center (based in Bengaluru) and provides support to business units and the global Wells Quality network. 

This role is also responsible for stewarding monthly Global Wells Quality Network meetings, driving efficiencies in the standardization of processes, sharing quality catches and alerts across business units, and enabling the implementation of best practices through continuous improvement and industry engagement.
