 - Organize, plan, and supervise verification programs via Third Party Inspectors (TPIs) to ensure conformance with the applicable ExxonMobil specifications and industry codes and standards. 
 - Ensure appropriate budget allocation for Third Party inspection agencies in collaboration with Wells Teams. 
 - Maintain sound understanding of API specifications and ExxonMobil Quality procedures. 

About You

- Must have a bachelor's degree from a recognized university in engineering (Mechanical or Manufacturing or Equivalent) as a minimum. 
 - Minimum 8-10 years of relevant experience in oil and gas Drilling Services equipment inspection and testing in the field of Quality.

Abreast of best practices and latest technology in meeting minimum industry standards and specifications (such as API and/or ISO 9000, ASME, DS-1, NACE, etc. ) for inspection, assembly, testing, storage and transportation of drilling services equipment.

data.description:
About the Company

Every minute of every day, Smiths Detection's threat detection and security screening technology helps to protect people and infrastructure, making the world a safer place. Smiths Detection is a global leader in the development, manufacture and management of security and detection solutions designed to make the world a safer place. Our technology provides threat detection and screening solutions for customers in our key markets: aviation, ports and borders, defence, and urban security. Our expertise spans 21 global offices, seven manufacturing sites and five R&D centres, with a global network of 3, 000 dedicated colleagues contributing towards over 40 years at the frontline of advances in safety and security. This results in careers built on variety and the opportunity to work on a range of state-of-the-art solutions, where you can develop your knowledge and experience every day. 

About the Role

Job Purpose: 

The Senior Software Test Engineer role ensures delivery of high‐quality, reliable, and secure software by leading comprehensive testing across distributed, microservices‐based applications. It involves designing and executing test cases, supporting automation frameworks, and integrating testing into CI/CD pipelines to validate functionality, performance, and scalability. By collaborating with cross‐functional teams, identifying and documenting issues, and driving continuous improvement, the role enhances product stability and accelerates delivery cycles. 

Responsibilities

- The Senior Software Test Engineer role ensures delivery of high‐quality, reliable, and secure software by leading comprehensive testing across distributed, microservices‐based applications. 
 - It involves designing and executing test cases, supporting automation frameworks, and integrating testing into CI/CD pipelines to validate functionality, performance, and scalability. 
 - By collaborating with cross‐functional teams, identifying and documenting issues, and driving continuous improvement, the role enhances product stability and accelerates delivery cycles. 
 - As per company policy, this role requires presence in the office 4 days per week. 

Duties: 

- Test Case Development & Execution: Collaborate with senior engineers to develop and execute comprehensive test cases that align with project requirements, ensuring thorough testing of software functionality, performance, and security. 
 - Automation Support: Contribute to the development and maintenance of automated test scripts and frameworks. Assist in enhancing test automation coverage for both system-level and front-end applications. 
 - Issue Identification & Documentation: Identify, track, and document software defects, functionality issues, and performance problems, working closely with developers to reproduce, debug, and resolve issues. 
 - Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product owners, and senior testers, to ensure alignment on testing goals and priorities. Communicate findings and progress effectively. 
 - Test Reporting & Metrics: Contribute to the preparation of test reports and track key testing metrics to assess test coverage, defect resolution, and overall testing progress. 
 - Support in Test Planning: Participate in test planning activities, contributing to discussions about scope, approach, and strategy for different types of testing, such as functional, regression, and integration testing. 
 - Version Control & Configuration Management: Utilize version control systems (e. g. , Git, Subversion) for maintaining test scripts, test cases, and related artifacts. 
 - CI/CD Integration: Assist in integrating test scripts into Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to ensure that automated tests are executed as part of the development process. 
 - Manual Testing: Conduct manual testing where required, especially in areas that are difficult to automate or require more exploratory testing to identify edge cases. 
 - Collaboration on Automation Strategy: Support senior engineers by contributing ideas and improvements to the automation strategy, tools, and frameworks used in the testing process. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Provide feedback on testing processes and practices, suggesting improvements and applying lessons learned from past testing cycles to enhance efficiency and test effectiveness. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. 

Required Skills

- 4-7 years of hands‐on experience testing distributed, microservices‐based applications, including test strategy definition, design, execution, and maintenance. 
 - Strong expertise in automated testing frameworks such as Robot Framework and Python for service‐level and end‐to‐end testing across backend and consumer‐facing applications. 
 - Proficiency in API testing (RESTful services), including contract validation, payload verification, error handling, and service dependency checks. 
 - Hands‐on experience with containerisation technologies (Docker) and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes), including deployment validation and scalability testing. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud platforms and their deployment models. 
 - Experience supporting applications deployed via CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Bitbucket) with understanding of microservices promotion across environments. 
 - Proficiency with Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence), test management tools (TestRail), and version control systems (Git). 
 - Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, microservices concepts, and test methodologies with ability to collaborate across development, DevOps, and testing teams. 
 - Demonstrated ability to write clear test cases, maintain accurate documentation, and track quality metrics in fast‐moving environments. 

Preferred Skills

- Broader exposure to advanced automation strategies or scripting for test environments. 
 - Certifications in testing frameworks, cloud technologies, or DevOps practices. 
 - Experience with performance testing and monitoring tools. 
 - Familiarity with security testing or compliance validation in microservices architectures. 
 - Resourceful with strong analytical and communication skills at all organisational levels. 
 - Self-starter with excellent time management, attention to detail, and initiative. 
 - Proven ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional and cross-cultural teams.

About Submer

Submer enables organizations scaling AI to overcome the limits of traditional datacenters across power, compute density and efficiency. 

We design and deliver scalable, high-density AI datacenter infrastructure built around industry-leading liquid cooling, supporting everything from early AI deployments to full-scale production environments. 

Acting as a full-stack delivery partner, Submer provides advisory, design, build and IT integration through a single point of accountability, working with a deep ecosystem of technology specialists. This end-to-end approach accelerates time-to-AI while reducing operational cost, complexity and environmental impact. 

The result is AI infrastructure that performs today, scales predictably and avoids the redesigns and inefficiencies slowing the market down. 

What Impact You Will Have

The role is responsible for : the design, development and integration of building management systems and the controls that run our modular MEP platforms for data centers. This role is responsible for the full controls stack: architecture, PLC/SCADA programming, data integration, control logic, sequencing and system-level validation. 

You'll work closely with mechanical, electrical, and systems architects to define how each MEP module is monitored, automated and coordinated so the entire facility operates reliably and efficiently. You'll also guide best practices, review vendor implementations and help shape the long-term controls roadmap. 

What You'll Do

- Own the architecture and development of control systems across cooling, power, plumbing and support utilities. 
 - Design and integration of PA, FA, Rodent repellant, WLD, BMS, ASD, Security and access control, CCTV system etc. 
 - Define control strategies, sequences of operation, alarm logic, failover logic and interlocks across mechanical and electrical systems. 
 - Develop PLC, HMI and SCADA code and oversee software integration with building management systems, EPMS and monitoring platforms. 
 - Produce control architecture diagrams, network layouts, data models and interface specifications. 
 - Perform cross-functional design reviews to ensure control systems align with mechanical, electrical and systems architecture requirements. 
 - Review and approve vendor controls submittals, functional specifications, hardware selections and software implementations.

 - Support continuous improvement of the MEP modules by identifying opportunities for automation, optimization and predictive insights. 

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree Controls Engineering, Computer Engineering or related discipline. 
 - 8+ years of experience in IBMS solutions design, controls engineering, automation or industrial software development, ideally with mission-critical facilities or modular equipment. 
 - Hands-on experience with PLC programming (Allen-Bradley, Siemens or equivalent) and HMI/SCADA platforms. 
 - Solid understanding of control theory, sequencing, PID loops, interlocks and safety logic. 
 - Familiarity with building utilities and mechanical and electrical systems found in data centers (cooling systems, switchgear, power distribution, pumps, valves, sensors).

 - Ability to read and produce P&IDs, control narratives, wiring diagrams and network architecture documents. 
 - Experience with commissioning, field testing and troubleshooting automation systems.

data.title: Senior Data Engineer
data.description:
About us

Factori is a rapidly growing location and consumer intelligence company built for an AI-first world. Each day we ingest billions of privacy-compliant signals and maintain the world's most comprehensive consumer, mobility and point-of-Interest database. 

Our AI-driven insights help Fortune 500 brands, global media agencies and technology innovators decide where to invest, build and grow. Headquartered in New York City with hubs across APAC, EMEA and the Americas, we operate with the ownership mindset of a startup and the global footprint of an enterprise data leader. 

About the Role: 

We are hiring a Senior Data Engineer to own and scale a petabyte-scale data platform on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), processing TB scale of data every day with Apache Spark. You will lead a small team of data engineers, drive cloud cost optimisation across our data workloads, and build AI-driven workflows that change how we support and operate the platform. 

This is a product engineering role, not a services or consulting engagement. You will own systems end to end, live with your design decisions in production, and help define data engineering culture in India. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Build and scale the platform

- Design, build and operate highly available, fault-tolerant batch and streaming pipelines on GCP that ingest hundreds of terabytes a day into a petabyte-scale data lake and warehouse. 
 - Write and tune large Spark workloads (PySpark, Spark SQL, Scala/Java) on Dataproc or Spark on Kubernetes (GKE): partitioning, shuffle and join optimization, skew handling, memory and executor sizing. 
 - Build real-time and near-real-time pipelines with Pub/Sub or Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming or Dataflow (Apache Beam), with clear guarantees on latency, ordering and exactly-once or idempotent processing. 
 - Model data in BigQuery and the lakehouse (Parquet, Avro, Delta Lake or Apache Iceberg) into clean, simplified datasets that teams can self-serve. 

Own data quality

- Build data cleaning, validation and reconciliation pipelines that stay correct when source data is late, duplicated, malformed or missing. 
 - Put data contracts, schema evolution rules, quality checks and alerting in place, and own data mapping, business logic and transformations end to end. 

Lead cloud cost optimization

- Own the cost of our GCP data workloads: measure cost per pipeline and per customer, then reduce it through right-sizing, autoscaling, preemptible/Spot VMs, storage tiering, BigQuery slot and query optimization, and job consolidation. 
 - Set up cost visibility (billing export, labels, dashboards) and FinOps practices so cost is tracked and owned, not discovered after the fact. 

Lead and mentor

- Lead and mentor 2-4 junior and mid-level data engineers: plan and break down work, review code and designs, and raise the team's engineering bar. 
 - Lead system design and architecture discussions, write design docs, and make trade-offs on scalability, reliability, latency and cost. 

Innovate with AI

- Design AI-driven workflows for technical support and operations: LLM-assisted triage of pipeline failures and data incidents, automated root-cause analysis, runbook automation, and agents that answer data questions from internal teams. 
 - Turn repeated support work into automated, process-driven workflows, and measure the time and tickets they save

Run it in production

- Own production reliability: on-call, monitoring and observability, incident response, postmortems, and low-level debugging and performance tuning on large clusters. 
 - Orchestrate pipelines with Airflow / Cloud Composer and ship through CI/CD and infrastructure as code (Terraform). 

What we are looking for : 

Experience: 

- 6 plus years in data engineering or backend/software engineering, with at least 4 years building big data pipelines in production. 
 - Minimum 1-2 years as a tech lead or team lead, mentoring junior engineers and owning delivery for a team. Product background: 

- Most of your experience at product or SaaS companies, owning platforms you built and ran in production, rather than consulting or IT services delivery. Apache Spark at scale: 

- Deep hands-on PySpark and Spark SQL; Spark internals (DAG, stages, shuffle, catalyst, AQE), performance tuning, and handling data skew on multi-terabyte jobs. Scala or Java Spark is a strong plus. Google Cloud Platform: 

- Production experience with BigQuery, Dataproc, Cloud Storage (GCS), Pub/Sub, and Cloud Composer or Airflow. Dataflow, GKE and Bigtable are a plus. Batch and stream processing: 

- Designed and run both, with a solid grasp of windowing, watermarks, late data, checkpointing, backfills and idempotency. Kafka or Pub/Sub plus Spark Structured Streaming, Flink or Dataflow. SQL: 

- Expert-level, including window functions, complex joins and query optimization on large analytical warehouses. Programming and OOP: 

- Strong Python and Java with object-oriented design, design patterns and clean, testable, reusable code. Data quality: 

- Built data cleaning, validation, deduplication and reconciliation pipelines, with automated quality checks and alerting. System design: 

- Can design a scalable, fault-tolerant distributed data system and defend the trade-offs in consistency, latency, cost and failure handling. Cloud cost optimization: 

- A track record of measurably reducing cloud or data platform costs (state the numbers on your CV). Databases and storage: 

- Parquet, Avro and ORC; partitioning and clustering; production experience with PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch and Bigtable (or comparable relational, search and NoSQL stores). 

Good to have : 

- Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect certification. 
 - Lakehouse table formats: Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg or Apache Hudi. dbt, Trino/Presto or ClickHouse. 
 - Terraform, Docker and Kubernetes (GKE) for data infrastructure. 
 - Data observability and lineage tools such as Monte Carlo, OpenLineage or DataHub. 
 - Building with LLM APIs, RAG or agent frameworks (Vertex AI, Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, LangChain). 
 - Domain experience in ad tech, martech, marketing attribution or measurement. 

Who thrives here : 

- You own outcomes. When a pipeline breaks at 2 a. m. or a number looks wrong, you treat it as yours until it is fixed and the root cause is gone. 
 - You are accountable. You make commitments you can keep, flag risks early, and close the loop without being chased. 
 - You think like a product engineer. You care about the customer impact of data quality, latency and cost, not just whether the job finished. 
 - You raise the people around you. You give clear reviews, share context, and help junior engineers grow into owners. 
 - You simplify. You prefer fewer, well-understood systems and automate repeated work, increasingly with AI. 

How to apply : 

If this sounds like you, apply now at careers@lifesight. io. We'd love to hear from you! For more information visit - https: //factori. ai/

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Privileged Access Management (PAM / IAM)
data.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description. 

About JumpCloud®
JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times. 

  

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT. 

Position Overview
We are seeking a Senior / Lead Software Engineer to drive the architectural evolution, security posture, and engineering execution of our core platform. In this role, you will lead the design of scalable microservices, integrate enterprise Privileged Access Management (PAM) frameworks, drive automated delivery pipelines, and champion cutting-edge AI-assisted engineering practices. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- 
Architecture & Core Engineering: Design, build, and maintain scalable, highly available microservices using C#, . NET Core, Go, and TypeScript via gRPC and the ABP framework. 

- 
Privileged Access Management (PAM): Design and deploy enterprise-grade Privileged Access Management (PAM)/IDAM solutions (e. g. , CyberArk, BeyondTrust, HashiCorp Vault), enforcing Zero Trust principles, Least Privilege access, and SCIM protocol integrations. 

- 
Delivery & Test Engineering: Own end-to-end continuous delivery using Origin CI, Kargo, and WoK. Ensure platform resilience by implementing unit, functional, and Playwright E2E suites alongside Performance, Scalability, and Reliability (PSR) testing. 

- 
AI Adoption & Technical Leadership: Champion the BMAD framework to establish governance and structure for AI-assisted workflows (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot). Mentor engineers, conduct RFC reviews, and build shared team skill libraries. 

- 
Multi-Platform & Full-Stack Development: Build cross-platform services and native desktop applications (macOS, Windows, Linux) supporting complex enterprise user workflows. 

- 
Observability & Operational Excellence: Implement robust telemetry, logging, and tracing across microservices to monitor system health, reduce latency, and ensure strict SLA/SLO compliance. 

- 
Technical Debt & Governance: Partner with Product, Design, and Infrastructure teams to manage technical debt, refactor legacy components, and establish standardized engineering best practices across Agile sprints. 

- 
Problem solving & Troubleshooting: Active participation in the incident management process and contributing PIRs, taking ownership/accountability for a quick turn-around to resolve the incident.   

Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

- 
Experience: 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with proven leadership as a Lead Architect or Senior Staff Engineer in a modern product environment. 

- 
Backend Stack: Deep expertise in C#, . NET (ASP. NET Core / ABP Framework), Go, gRPC, and RESTful APIs. 

- 
Databases: Advanced proficiency with relational (PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL (DocumentDB) architectures. 

- 
Cloud & DevOps: Strong hands-on experience with AWS, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and custom CI/CD automation pipelines. 

- 
Testing: Proficiency with automated testing frameworks, specifically Playwright for E2E automation and dedicated load/stress testing tools. 

- 
Artificial Intelligence: Direct experience establishing spec-driven AI development workflows in production teams. 

Where you'll be working/Location: 

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description. 

  

You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.   

  

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed. 

  

Language: 

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.   Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description. 

  

Why JumpCloud?   

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You'll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We're out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You'll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.     

  

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to "Build Connections. " To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed. " - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

  

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.   Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.     

  

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. 

  

Scam Notice: 

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment. 

  

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud. com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud. com with the subject line "Scam Notice"  

  

#BI-Remote

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https: //jumpcloud. com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

Tieto CareTech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care. 

We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need. 

Experience Required: 5-8 years of hands-on experience in software development

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead end-to-end feature development, including requirement analysis, design, coding, testing, and deployment. 
 - Logical abilities
 - Independently deliver high-quality software solutions aligned with business and technical objectives. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile/Scrum environment to ensure timely and efficient delivery. 
 - Maintain and enhance existing product releases, ensuring stability and performance. 
 - Drive technical excellence through adherence to coding standards, design principles, and best practices. 
 - Contribute to architectural decisions and framework-level thinking to support scalable and maintainable solutions. 
 - Promote a culture of continuous improvement, automation, and innovation. 
 - Ensure non-functional requirements (NFRs) such as performance, scalability, and security are considered during development. 

Required Technical Skills: 

- Full stack developer
 - Backend Development: Expertise in C#, . NET, . NET Core, and RESTful API development. 
 - Frontend Development: Proficient in Angular v10+, with strong skills in HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript/TypeScript. 
 - Database: Good understanding of any Structured Query Language and relational database concepts. 
 - Software Design: Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), design patterns, knowledge of micro services and software architecture. 
 - Testing: Experience with any unit testing frameworks. 
 - DevOps & Containers: Preferred to have working knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized deployments. 
 - Code Quality: Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code from the outset. 
 - Preferred Attributes: 
 - Exposure to Code generation using AI enabled tools like Github Co-pilot will be added advantage
 - Demonstrated ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables. 
 - Strong technical leadership and mentoring capabilities. 
 - Passion for modern tools, technologies, and engineering excellence. 
 - Familiarity with Agile methodologies and experience working in Scrum teams. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD practices. 
 - Customer-centric mindset with a focus on delivering value and quality. 

- Domain Advantage: 
 - Experience in the Healthcare domain will be considered a strong plus. 
 - Knowledge of OpenEhr, HL7/FHIR
What's in it for you?

In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture. We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working. 

Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you're interested in. 

Could you be our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the Recruiter.

data.description:
Job Description: SAP Test Manager / Test Lead

Position: SAP Test Manager / Lead

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience Level: Senior Level

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced SAP Test Manager / Test Lead to oversee and manage end-to-end testing activities across complex SAP implementation and rollout programs. In this role, you will define comprehensive test strategies, coordinate test planning and execution, and drive quality assurance standards. You will leverage SAP Cloud ALM (CALM) and Jira for complete test lifecycle management, defect tracking, and governance while serving as a primary point of contact for key client stakeholders. 

Key Responsibilities

- Test Strategy & Planning: Design, implement, and maintain overall SAP Test Strategies, Test Plans, and Governance Frameworks tailored to client requirements and project scope. 
 - Test Execution Management: Drive end-to-end test phases including Integration Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Cutover / Go-Live testing. 
 - Tool & Process Management: Utilize SAP Cloud ALM (CALM) and Jira to create test cases, track execution progress, manage defects, build quality dashboards, and deliver regular status reports to senior management. 
 - Stakeholder Management: Manage direct relationships with client leadership, functional leads, business users, and third-party vendor teams to align on test scope, schedules, risks, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Defect & Risk Governance: Facilitate daily defect triage meetings, establish clear SLAs for defect resolution, manage escalation paths, and proactively address quality risks to keep project schedules on track. 

Required Qualifications & Mandatory Skills

- SAP Testing Leadership: 
 - Proven expertise as an SAP Test Manager or Test Lead with a strong track record in Test Strategy, Test Planning, Test Coordination, and Test Execution Management across SAP landscapes. 
 - Tools Expertise (CALM & Jira): 
 - Hands-on proficiency with SAP Cloud ALM (CALM) and Jira for end-to-end test planning, defect management, metrics tracking, and governance reporting. 
 - Client-Facing & Stakeholder Management: 
 - Exceptional customer-facing communication and interpersonal skills, with demonstrated experience interacting with client executives, managing business expectations, and facilitating user training/UAT sessions. 
Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills

- Test Automation: Exposure to or experience with automated testing tools and methodologies within SAP environments (e. g. , TOSCA, Worksoft Certify, Selenium, or native SAP automation capabilities). 

Key Competencies

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Leadership skills with a collaborative approach to leading cross-functional delivery teams. 
 - Capability to thrive in high-pressure project delivery environments. 

Skills: testing, sap, test planning, alm

Isprava is seeking an experienced Process Excellence Manager operational efficiency, process optimization, and project management excellence across its luxury residential real estate business.

data.title: Quality Assurance Manager
data.description:
QA Manager - Job Description

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience Required: 5+ years in QA, including 3+ years managing a QA team

Role Overview

We are hiring a QA Manager to own quality across our e-commerce platform and ensure releases ship on time and to standard. 

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will run the QA team day to day, set priorities, unblock people, and hold yourself accountable for what goes to production. 

We run a lean team, so we need someone who gets the work done with fewer people. You think analytically, adapt quickly when priorities shift, and improvise practical solutions rather than waiting for ideal conditions. 

You will bring AI tools into the team's daily work, from test design to defect analysis, and measurably raise the output and quality the team delivers. 

Who You Are

1. A People Person

You build trust quickly with your team, developers, support teams, and customers. People come to you because you listen, stay calm under pressure, and handle disagreements constructively. 

2. A Motivator

You keep a small team engaged and accountable, give honest feedback, and help people grow. 

3. Sharp and Resourceful

You learn new domains quickly, ask the right questions, and find the simplest way to solve complex problems. 

4. A Builder and Early Adopter

You enjoy building small tools, experimenting with new technologies, and finding ways to make the team's daily work faster and easier. 

5. Results-Driven

You take ownership, follow through without being chased, and measure success by what gets delivered rather than the effort spent. 

6. A Clear Communicator

You explain issues and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, in writing and during calls. 

Mandatory Requirements

Candidates must meet all the following requirements to be considered for this position. 

1. Employment Stability: Minimum 3 continuous years with a single employer in a QA Lead or QA Manager capacity. We are looking for professionals who have managed products and teams through multiple release cycles rather than short-term assignments. 

2. QA Leadership Experience: 5+ years of overall QA experience, including at least 3 years directly managing QA engineers, covering hiring, work allocation, and performance reviews. 

3. Proven Delivery Track Record: Demonstrated ownership of releases or quality improvements from start to finish, supported by measurable results such as fewer escaped defects or shorter testing cycles. 

4. Lean Team Management: Proven ability to manage QA effectively with a small team by prioritizing risks, eliminating low-value activities, and meeting release deadlines. 

5. Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong ability to identify root causes of defects using logs, data, and API transactions, and recognize patterns across recurring issues. 

6. Hands-On AI Tool Experience: Practical experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or GitHub Copilot for test case generation, log analysis, requirement summarization, and defect analysis, with the ability to implement these tools across a QA team. 

7. E-commerce Testing Experience: Extensive experience testing e-commerce applications, including product catalogs, shopping carts, checkout, order processing, shipping, promotions, discounts, returns, and exchanges. 

8. Payment Gateway Testing: Hands-on experience testing payment gateway workflows, including authorizations, captures, refunds, transaction failures, and error handling. 

9. Third-Party Integration Testing: Experience testing ERP, CRM, tax, shipping, inventory, and marketplace integrations. 

10. API Testing and SQL: Strong practical skills in API testing and SQL-based data validation and troubleshooting. 

11. Agile/Scrum Experience: Experience managing QA activities within Agile/Scrum teams, including effort estimation, sprint planning, and release coordination. 

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership and Delivery

- Lead, mentor, and develop the QA team, establish clear goals, and conduct regular one-on-one meetings and performance reviews. 
 - Own QA planning for every sprint and release, including scope, estimates, assignments, and timelines. 
 - Monitor daily progress, remove blockers, and escalate risks before they affect delivery timelines. 
 - Own release sign-off and remain accountable for the quality of production releases. 
 - Report quality status and key metrics, including defect trends, test coverage, and cycle time, to engineering leadership. 
 - Participate in hiring QA engineers as the team expands. Efficiency, AI Adoption, and Process Improvement

- Introduce AI tools into daily QA workflows, including test case design, test data generation, requirement reviews, log analysis, and defect analysis. 
 - Establish clear guidelines and best practices for using AI tools within the QA team. 
 - Measure AI adoption outcomes by tracking time saved, improvements in testing cycle time, and defect trends. 
 - Develop risk-based testing strategies that enable a small team to focus on the highest-impact areas for each release. 
 - Simplify QA processes, templates, and checklists to improve efficiency without compromising quality.

data.description:
Overview

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft's expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft's "Intelligent Cloud" mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission. 

As Microsoft's cloud business continues to accelerate, the ability to deliver new silicon innovations and infrastructure at scale, with quality, speed, and cost efficiency, has never been more critical. Within SCHIE, the Methodology, Infrastructure & Labs Engineering (MILE) organization plays a pivotal role in enabling Microsoft's silicon strategy. MILE is responsible for end-to-end silicon design methodologies, EDA/CAD ecosystems, and the underlying compute infrastructure that powers the development of Microsoft's custom silicon portfolio - the Azure Cobalt and Azure Maia processors. 

We are seeking a Silicon Front-End (FE) CAD Software Engineer to develop, maintain, and support CAD flows and methodologies, as well as dashboards, CAD indicators, and automation used across Microsoft's front-end silicon design ecosystem. The role requires Python software-development skills, hands-on experience building and testing end-to-end, system-level software, and a solid understanding of front-end CAD flows and methodologies.

 - Use Git-based version control and code-review practices to manage CAD flow development and releases.

Qualifications

- Required Qualifications:

 - Experience with FE CAD infrastructure - build/run/release flows, continuous integration (CI/CD), flow orchestration, design data management, and version control; object-oriented programming and software-development practices; exposure to Azure cloud infrastructure and DevOps.

Other Requirements

 - Microsoft Cloud Background Check. This position is required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.

International Traffic in Arms Regulations or Export Administration Regulations, the EU Dual Use Regulation, and/or other export control regulations. As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide either proof of their country of citizenship or proof of their U. S. permanent residency or other protected status (e. g. , under 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3)) for assessment of eligibility to access the export-controlled information. To meet this legal requirement, and as a condition of employment, the successful candidate's citizenship will be verified with a valid passport. Lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees may verify status using other documents, where applicable.

data.description:
About Officeworks: 

Officeworks' purpose is "we bring big ideas to life at low prices". It's how we create shared value for customers, team members, suppliers, communities and shareholders.

Our products and services provide solutions to our diverse range of customers across Australia from households, students, small to large sized businesses, governments and schools. 

Our culture is built on beginning with customer, doing the right thing, executing with accountability, and leading with ambition. We are one team who are proud to "wear the blues" and deliver for our customers. 

We are an inclusive, forward-thinking organisation where diverse perspectives enable innovation, continuous improvement and better outcomes for our customers and teams. The work we do plays an important role in helping Australians work, learn, create and connect. 

The role: 

Title: Senior AI Engineer

Function: Technology

Location: Bengaluru

About the Technology Function: 

By joining the Technology team in the GCC you will play a direct role in Officeworks' global digital transformation, contributing to world-class capabilities that sit at the heart of how the business operates and grows. The GCC will support Officeworks' purpose of helping to bring big ideas to life at low prices, ensuring technology remains a true enabler of customer value and operational excellence. 

This opportunity to join as a founding member of the new global hub is a chance to be part of the original build-out of our GCC. Early joiners will influence how the hub operates and help shape the future state of some of Officeworks' core technology ecosystem. 

These roles are best suited for people who enjoy: 

- Exposure to eCommerce and digital platforms, customer facing services enabled online and in retail stores, and an expanding presence into generative and agentic commerce - covering operations, security, development, automation, and solution architecture
 - Supporting global initiatives and modernising business critical systems
 - being the forefront of global innovation and transformation, helping digitise the Officeworks business
 - Joining a place where your skills matter, your growth is intentional, and your work has visible impact on business outcomes. 

Why this role exists: 

The Senior AI Engineer sits inside a Customer Platforms pod and orchestrates the technical agents that produce code, tests, documentation and design artefacts. The role is a full stack engineering role that takes complete ownership of the quality engineering and testing, holding accountability for everything committed to production. 

The role exists to translate product specifications into functional agent tasks, maintain the human-in-the-loop review gate, and ensure system design integrity, non-functional performance and security standards are met. It plays a critical role in enabling continuous delivery across Customer Platforms while mentoring junior engineers and continuously improving agent workflows across pods. 

Where you will make a difference: 

In this role you will: 

Agent Orchestration and Execution: 

- Decompose Product Orchestrator specifications into functional tasks for technical agents. 
 - Run multiple agents in parallel across coding, test generation, documentation and design workflows. 
 - Sequence workstreams and manage technical dependencies to maintain high pod delivery velocity. 
 - Apply base context, security policies and platform standards to every agent execution cycle. 

Quality Control and Commit Gate: 

- Hold the human-in-the-loop review and commit gate independently on complex and high-risk change. 
 - Perform fast, accurate code and test reviews to ensure correctness, specification alignment and standards conformance. 
 - Owns end-to-end quality assurance accountability by designing agent test coverage and evaluation logic. 
 - Own defect management for the pod, from identification through root cause and resolution tracking, escalating systemic quality risks. 
 - Identify when agent workflows are insufficient and apply direct engineering intervention to resolve technical issues. 

System Design and Non-Functional Excellence: 

- Own architectural fit and system design judgement across the features delivered by the pod. 
 - Ensure non-functional outcomes, including performance, scalability, resilience and security, are met across all releases. 
 - Lead production incident resolution within the pod across touched platform domains. 
 - Contribute to domain design decisions as a consulted partner to the Solution Architects. 

Knowledge Governance and Workflow Improvement: 

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation and knowledge artefacts to serve as context layers for future agent runs. 
 - Feed refined domain context back to central repositories in collaboration with Context Engineers. 
 - Continuously refine and optimize agent workflows and share best practices across engineering pods. 
 - Mentor engineers on test design, defect triage and quality engineering practice across the pod. 

Who you will be working with: 

- Pod Leadership and Delivery Teams: Partner with Product Orchestrators and fellow pod engineers to refine requirements, assess technical feasibility and execute workstreams. 
 - Architecture Teams: Consult with Domain Architects and Solution Architects on domain design, system architecture and escalation pathways. 
 - Capability and Platform Specialists: Collaborate with Context Engineers, Associate AI Agent Evaluation Engineers and Associate Platform Engineers to align on shared context, security standards and tooling. 
 - Vendor and Platform Partners: Liaise with external AI tooling providers and vendor technical support to resolve complex platform constraints and adopt new capabilities. 

What success looks like: 

- Commit Gate Integrity: Low commit gate escape rate on complex and high-risk production changes. 
 - Innovation and Scaling: Agent workflow improvements developed within the pod are successfully adopted across broader engineering teams. 
 - Operational Resilience: Rapid resolution of production incidents within the pod with minimal downtime or customer impact. 
 - Delivery Velocity: High throughput of automated coding and testing tasks achieved without compromising technical quality or architectural standards. 
 - Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks' values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture. 

How you will lead: 

Individual Contributor

- Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
 - Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
 - Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
 - Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
 - Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

Our Values: 

Our values shape the way we work, our behaviours and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities. 

We begin with customer: 

- We start with our customer' needs in every decision. 
 - We offer simple, helpful and affordable solutions. 
 - We listen, learn and continuously improve. 

We do the right thing: 

- We lead with integrity and care for our team communities and planet. 
 - We work together safely and treat everyone with respect, inclusion, and trust. 
 - We collaborate across teams and think Officeworks-wide. 

We execute with accountability: 

- We are accountable for our decisions, actions, results, and mistakes. 
 - We stay across the details and focus on delivering what matters. 
 - We move with pace and agility to deliver outcomes. 

We lead with ambition: 

- We set bold ambitions that help us to win and transform. 
 - We are courageous with new ideas. 
 - We focus on transformation, not incremental steps. 

Qualifications and work experience: 

Essential: 

- Education: Tertiary degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience: 8-10 years of software engineering experience, primarily full stack with microservices architecture exposure, including senior-level ownership of quality engineering and test strategy. 
 - AI-Assisted Delivery: Proven experience or strong proficiency in delivering production software using AI coding, test generation and orchestration tooling. 
 - Quality Ownership: Demonstrated track record of owning end-to-end code quality, test strategy design, defect management and release gates directly, built through hands-on quality engineering experience. 
 - Stack Breadth: Broad technical exposure across front-end, back-end and integration layers. 
 - System Design: Strong system design judgement with the capability to evaluate, challenge and refine agent-generated architectural outputs. 
 - Technical Support: Experience supporting production cloud environments, including logging, alerting, incident response and observability
 - Proficient in Kotlin, with a strong understanding of Jetpack Compose, View-based layouts (XML), , Kotlin Flows, Coroutines and asynchronous programming (async/await, structured concurrency). 
 - Solid grasp of MVVM architecture, Clean Architecture patterns (Use Cases / Repositories), and Navigation Component. 
 - Experienced in unit and UI testing using JUnit, Mock, and Espresso / Compose Test frameworks. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, preferably Bitrise. 
 - Experienced in managing dependencies using Gradle (Kotlin DSL / Version Catalogs). 

Preferred: 

- Retail and Commerce Exposure: Experience in retail, e-commerce, or complex omnichannel platform ecosystems. 
 - Advanced AI Tooling: Familiarity with modern AI agent frameworks, model gateways, and evaluation platforms.

data.title: Supplier Development Professional – Specialist
data.description:
About Milacron

We serve the primary market segment: Milacron Injection, Molding & Extrusion (MIME), which designs, manufactures, and sells injection and extrusion equipment, co-injection systems and related parts and services. 

THE ROLE

The Milacron Supplier Development group, a global and progressive function within Milacron, is currently seeking strong, results-oriented candidates for the positions as a Supplier Quality Professional ranging from Specialist to Engineer. 

Reporting to Global Supplier Development, this position will support, facilitate, and lead Supplier Development actions for multiple regional facilities. The role focuses on supply chain performance with responsibility for supplier quality, assessing supplier capability, verifying the quality of purchased items at the source, providing timely and accurate supplier performance metrics, facilitating continuous improvement and training of the supporting supply base. In this role you will manage the resolution of supplier quality issues at the regional facilities as well as global suppliers for specific categories. 

As part of the Supplier Development organization, you will provide technical guidance in the use of quality management tools incorporating the technical disciplines found in FAI, PPAP, SPC, FMEA, Control Plans and Problem Analysis. Coordinate formal supplier training to drive consistency in process, including supplier continuous improvement and development programs. Work with underperforming suppliers to improve On-time Delivery (OTD) and non-conformance rates using improvement tools like 8Ds, A3's, etc. Review and maintain evaluations of perspective suppliers and existing supplier performance, report status of supplier performance, and proactively act when quality trends indicate such action is warranted. Serve as liaison between engineering, procurement, quality and production to assure quality and reliability from the supply base. In addition, you will help build and sustain a strategic supply base that aligns with the corporate category management team strategy. 

General Characteristics

To perform this job successfully, the candidate will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform the essential duties proficiently. 

- Process and results driven with strong project management skills
 - Have functional working knowledge of Quality Engineering principles
 - Be a self-starter with a proven ability to manage supplier improvement initiatives
 - Strategically lead supplier performance improvement projects to increase the supplier capability of consistently meeting Milacron requirements
 - Must be able to establish cross functional relationships and partnerships through your product and process knowledge
 - Implement and monitor the part qualification and certification process with elected suppliers
 - Champion problem solving and root cause analysis activities with suppliers and customers to eliminate recurrence of non-conformances
 - Function as liaison between procurement, engineering, manufacturing and suppliers to resolve supplier quality issues and to provide technical support
 - Work to resolve supplier technical issues in a timely manner to ensure continuity of supply
 - Support leadership and maintain a high level of performance in carrying out the goals of the department and corporation
 - Review targeted supplier manufacturing processes, evaluate supplier root cause corrective actions relative to those processes and confirm identified failure modes. 
 - Ability to travel (up to 50%) is required

Experience

- 5+ years of experience in Supplier Development, Manufacturing Quality or Supplier Quality Engineering in a manufacturing environment or Comparable Work Experience
 - Understanding of Print Reading and Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerance (GD&T)
 - Experience in Casting, Machining and Machined Components is preferred
 - Experience in facilitating change and working with cross functional teams including engineering and manufacturing
 - Experience in a high mix low volume global business is desired
 - Familiarity in auditing supplier manufacturing processes and quality systems
 - Familiarity with US and International Industry measurement standards and tools
 - Familiarity with quality standards such as ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and compliance auditing experience
 - Experience in using structured problem solving to drive acute and chronic quality issues to closure

Education

- B. E/B. Tech degree from an accredited 4-year college or university in a technical or supply chain related discipline or equivalent combination of education and experience with a minimum of 4 years of experience in Quality, Manufacturing, Shop Operations, Materials or Sourcing
 - Proficient oral and written communication skills
 - Proficient in English language (verbal and written communications). 

Who We Are

Milacron is a global industrial leader in the manufacturing and distribution of highly engineered and customized injection molding and extrusion solutions, and aftermarket parts and service for the plastics processing industry. The company's 1, 900+ associates worldwide collaborate to serve a diverse range of end-markets, such as automotive, construction, medical, telecommunications, material handling, packaging, and much more. With expertise in plastics spanning nearly 60 years, Milacron holds longstanding relationships with more than 27, 000 customers around the world. The original equipment provider of plastics manufacturing solutions is the largest US-owned and globally served of its kind. Headquartered in Batavia, OH, Milacron's global footprint is also serviced through regional facilities in Asia, Europe, and South America.

The policy of Milacron is to extend opportunities to qualified applicants and employees on an equal basis regardless of an individual's age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression or veteran status. We are committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and offer opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. Overview

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft's expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft's "Intelligent Cloud" mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission. 

The Compute Silicon & Manufacturing Engineering (CSME) organization within SCHIE is responsible for design, development, manufacturing and packaging of Microsoft's state-of-the-art computer chips, notably the Azure Cobalt. Our solutions provide sustainable strategic advantages to Microsoft and enable our customers to achieve more. 

As Microsoft's cloud business continues to grow the ability to deploy new offerings and hardware infrastructure on time, in high volume with high quality and lowest cost is of paramount importance. To achieve this goal, the Verification & Validation team is instrumental in defining and delivering operational measures of success for hardware manufacturing, improving the planning process, quality, delivery, scale and sustainability related to Microsoft cloud hardware. We are looking for experienced engineers with a dedicated passion for customer focused solutions, insight and industry knowledge to envision and implement future technical solutions that will manage and optimize the Cloud infrastructure. 

We are looking for a Principal SOC Performance Verification Engineer to join the team.

 - Embody our culture and values.

Preferred Qualifications

These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

International Traffic in Arms Regulations or Export Administration Regulations, the EU Dual Use Regulation, and/or other export control regulations. As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide either proof of their country of citizenship or proof of their US. residency or other protected status (e. g. , under 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3)) for assessment of eligibility to access the export-controlled information. To meet this legal requirement, and as a condition of employment, the successful candidate's citizenship will be verified with a valid passport. Lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees may verify status using other documents, where applicable.

About Globeia: 

Globeia is establishing its base along the French Riviera, and we are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Administrative Associate to be the first face of our service on the ground. 

This is a part-time, hourly role, 10 to 15 hours per week to start, scaling up as our client volume grows. In the early phase, you will be working mobile, meeting clients across Nice and the French Riviera. Once volumes build, we will establish a permanent office space in the region, and you will have the opportunity to grow with us into that. 

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and versatile Senior QA Automation Engineer to lead our testing efforts across our entire application suite. In this role, you will be responsible for full-cycle testing from exploratory manual testing to architecting and building out our automated testing frameworks from scratch. You will also leverage the latest AI-driven QA tools to accelerate test creation and improve coverage. If you have a deep understanding of modern QA methodologies, love breaking software to make it better, and want to own the quality standards for a growing engineering team, this is the perfect opportunity. 

Key Responsibilities

- Test Strategy & Execution: Perform comprehensive all-around testing, including functional, integration, regression, performance, and cross-browser testing for both frontend and backend systems. 
 - Automation Architecture: Design, build, and maintain scalable automated testing frameworks from the ground up for web applications and APIs. 
 - AI-Assisted Testing: Leverage AI-powered testing tools and coding assistants to accelerate test script generation, create intelligent test data, and reduce test maintenance overhead. 
 - CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated test suites into continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to ensure code quality upon every deployment. 
 - API & Backend Testing: Thoroughly test RESTful and GraphQL APIs to ensure data integrity, security, and performance. 
 - Manual & Exploratory Testing: Identify edge cases and complex user flows that require manual validation before translating them into automated scripts where applicable. 
 - Defect Management: Track, document, and triage bugs clearly, working closely with full-stack developers and product managers to resolve issues quickly. 
 - Quality Advocacy: Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) for QA, mentor team members, and foster a culture of quality across the organization. 

What We're Looking For

- Experience: 5+ years of QA experience, with at least 2-3 years focused heavily on building test automation frameworks from scratch. 
 - Core Languages: Strong programming skills in JavaScript or TypeScript for writing maintainable test scripts. 
 - Automation Tools: Hands-on expertise with modern UI automation tools like Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium. 
 - AI Testing Experience: Familiarity with AI-driven testing platforms (e. g. , Mabl, Testim, Percy) or using AI coding assistants (like GitHub Copilot) to optimize testing workflows. 
 - API Testing: Proven experience testing APIs using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or equivalent automated libraries.

 - DevOps Basics: Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD platforms (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Vercel, etc. ). 
 - Problem Solving: A meticulous eye for detail and the ability to anticipate how users might break a system in the real world. 

Why Join Us

- Build and own the QA automation infrastructure from day one. 
 - Work with cutting-edge QA technologies, including AI-driven testing frameworks. 
 - Work closely with a collaborative, modern engineering team. 
 - Clear career progression and the opportunity to build out a QA team in the future. 
 - Competitive salary, benefits, and a flexible work environment. Location: Gurugram

data.title: Senior AI Engineer - Mobile IOS [T500-30145]
data.description:
About Officeworks:

We are Australia's leading omnichannel retailer of complete technology solutions, stationery, furniture, art supplies, and learning resources. We also offer services including Print & Create, and Geeks2U. 

Our products and services provide solutions to our diverse range of customers across Australia from households, students, small to large sized businesses, governments and schools. 

Our culture is built on beginning with customer, doing the right thing, executing with accountability, and leading with ambition. We are one team who are proud to "wear the blues" and deliver for our customers. 

We are an inclusive, forward-thinking organisation where diverse perspectives enable innovation, continuous improvement and better outcomes for our customers and teams. The work we do plays an important role in helping Australians work, learn, create and connect. 

The role: 

Title: Senior AI Engineer

Function: Technology

Location: Bengaluru

On Call: Yes

About the Technology Function: 

By joining the Technology team in the GCC you will play a direct role in Officeworks' global digital transformation, contributing to world-class capabilities that sit at the heart of how the business operates and grows. The GCC will support Officeworks' purpose of helping to bring big ideas to life at low prices, ensuring technology remains a true enabler of customer value and operational excellence. 

This opportunity to join as a founding member of the new global hub is a chance to be part of the original build-out of our GCC. Early joiners will influence how the hub operates and help shape the future state of some of Officeworks' core technology ecosystem. 

These roles are best suited for people who enjoy: 

- exposure to eCommerce and digital platforms, customer facing services enabled online and in retail stores, and an expanding presence into generative and agentic commerce - covering operations, security, development, automation, and solution architecture
 - supporting global initiatives and modernising business critical systems
 - being the forefront of global innovation and transformation, helping digitise the Officeworks business
 - joining a place where your skills matter, your growth is intentional, and your work has visible impact on business outcomes. 

Why this role exists: 

The Senior AI Engineer sits inside a Customer Platforms pod and orchestrates the technical agents that produce code, tests, documentation and design artefacts. The role is a full stack engineering role that takes complete ownership of the quality engineering and testing, holding accountability for everything committed to production. 

The role exists to translate product specifications into functional agent tasks, maintain the human-in-the-loop review gate, and ensure system design integrity, non-functional performance and security standards are met. It plays a critical role in enabling continuous delivery across Customer Platforms while mentoring junior engineers and continuously improving agent workflows across pods. 

Where you will make a difference: 

In this role you will: 

Agent Orchestration and Execution: 

- Decompose Product Orchestrator specifications into functional tasks for technical agents. 
 - Run multiple agents in parallel across coding, test generation, documentation and design workflows. 
 - Sequence workstreams and manage technical dependencies to maintain high pod delivery velocity. 
 - Apply base context, security policies and platform standards to every agent execution cycle. 

Quality Control and Commit Gate: 

- Hold the human-in-the-loop review and commit gate independently on complex and high-risk change. 
 - Perform fast, accurate code and test reviews to ensure correctness, specification alignment and standards conformance. 
 - Owns end-to-end quality assurance accountability by designing agent test coverage and evaluation logic. 
 - Own defect management for the pod, from identification through root cause and resolution tracking, escalating systemic quality risks. 
 - Identify when agent workflows are insufficient and apply direct engineering intervention to resolve technical issues. 

System Design and Non-Functional Excellence: 

- Own architectural fit and system design judgement across the features delivered by the pod. 
 - Ensure non-functional outcomes, including performance, scalability, resilience and security, are met across all releases. 
 - Lead production incident resolution within the pod across touched platform domains. 
 - Contribute to domain design decisions as a consulted partner to the Solution Architects. 

Knowledge Governance and Workflow Improvement: 

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation and knowledge artefacts to serve as context layers for future agent runs. 
 - Feed refined domain context back to central repositories in collaboration with Context Engineers. 
 - Continuously refine and optimise agent workflows and share best practices across engineering pods. 
 - Mentor engineers on test design, defect triage and quality engineering practice across the pod. 

Who you will be working with: 

- Pod Leadership and Delivery Teams: Partner with Product Orchestrators and fellow pod engineers to refine requirements, assess technical feasibility and execute workstreams. 
 - Architecture Teams: Consult with Domain Architects and Solution Architects on domain design, system architecture and escalation pathways. 
 - Capability and Platform Specialists: Collaborate with Context Engineers, Associate AI Agent Evaluation Engineers and Associate Platform Engineers to align on shared context, security standards and tooling. 
 - Vendor and Platform Partners: Liaise with external AI tooling providers and vendor technical support to resolve complex platform constraints and adopt new capabilities. 

What success looks like: 

- Commit Gate Integrity: Low commit gate escape rate on complex and high-risk production changes. 
 - Innovation and Scaling: Agent workflow improvements developed within the pod are successfully adopted across broader engineering teams. 
 - Operational Resilience: Rapid resolution of production incidents within the pod with minimal downtime or customer impact. 
 - Delivery Velocity: High throughput of automated coding and testing tasks achieved without compromising technical quality or architectural standards. 
 - Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks' values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture. 

How you will lead: 

Individual Contributor: 

- Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
 - Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
 - Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
 - Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
 - Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

Our Values: 

Our values shape the way we work, our behaviours and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities. 

We begin with customer: 

- We start with our customer' needs in every decision. 
 - We offer simple, helpful and affordable solutions. 
 - We listen, learn and continuously improve. 

We do the right thing: 

- We lead with integrity and care for our team communities and planet. 
 - We work together safely and treat everyone with respect, inclusion, and trust. 
 - We collaborate across teams and think Officeworks-wide. 

We execute with accountability: 

- We are accountable for our decisions, actions, results, and mistakes. 
 - We stay across the details and focus on delivering what matters. 
 - We move with pace and agility to deliver outcomes. 

We lead with ambition: 

- We set bold ambitions that help us to win and transform. 
 - We are courageous with new ideas. 
 - We focus on transformation, not incremental steps. 

Qualifications and work experience: 

Essential: 

- Education: Tertiary degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience: 8-10 years of software engineering experience, primarily full stack with microservices architecture exposure, including senior-level ownership of quality engineering and test strategy. 
 - AI-Assisted Delivery: Proven experience or strong proficiency in delivering production software using AI coding, test generation and orchestration tooling. 
 - Quality Ownership: Demonstrated track record of owning end-to-end code quality, test strategy design, defect management and release gates directly, built through hands-on quality engineering experience. 
 - Stack Breadth: Broad technical exposure across front-end, back-end and integration layers. 
 - System Design: Strong system design judgement with the capability to evaluate, challenge and refine agent-generated architectural outputs. 
 - Technical Support: Experience supporting production cloud environments, including logging, alerting, incident response and observability. 
 - Proficient in Swift, with a strong understanding of UIKit, SwiftUI, and Combine and in Swift Concurrency features (async/await, structured concurrency). 
 - Solid grasp of MVVM architecture, coordinator pattern, and the Use Case Repository pattern.

Preferred: 

- Retail and Commerce Exposure: Experience in retail, e-commerce, or complex omnichannel platform ecosystems.

Oleovista Solutions Private Limited is a technology-focused company developing solutions across trading, and Energy Trading &  

Risk Management (ETRM). We build scalable platforms supporting trading, analytics, risk management, integrations, and  

transaction processing. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a Lead Python Developer / Senior Backend Technical Lead to lead the backend architecture and development  

of a next-generation ETRM platform. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on Python, Django/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, transaction processing,   

distributed systems, messaging, security, cloud, and system architecture. The candidate will own technical design and  

implementation, guide developers, and ensure the platform is scalable, secure, reliable, and transactionally accurate. 

Experience in banking, fintech, payments, trading, brokerage, treasury, or other financial transaction systems is strongly  

preferred. Direct ETRM/Treasury experience is advantageous but not mandatory. 

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Technical Leadership

• Own backend architecture, system design, technical standards, and implementation strategy; design scalable,   modular, maintainable, and secure services; lead technical planning, code reviews, estimation, mentoring, and  delivery, and collaborate with Product, Business, QA, DevOps, and Frontend teams. 

Python Backend Development

• Develop production-grade backend services using Python, Django and/or FastAPI; build REST APIs, business  workflows, state-based processing, external integrations, and high-volume transaction services; work with  asynchronous/background processing using Celery and messaging technologies. 

Transaction Processing & Data Integrity

• Design reliable financial workflows with strong transaction integrity, consistency, concurrency control, idempotency,   locking, transaction isolation, retry/recovery handling, and rollback mechanisms; implement controlled  workflow/state management, auditability, traceability, and reconciliation between internal and external systems. 

Event-Driven & Distributed Systems

• Design event-driven and distributed architectures using Kafka, RabbitMQ, Celery, or similar technologies;   

implement reliable asynchronous processing, retries, failure handling, recovery, and appropriate patterns for scalability  and resilience. 

Database & Data Architecture

• Design and optimize PostgreSQL schemas, data models, SQL queries, indexes, transactions, and database  

performance; work with Redis for caching/distributed processing and MongoDB/NoSQL where appropriate. 

Security & Financial Controls

• Implement secure backend and API solutions covering authentication, authorization, RBAC, OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, MFA,   access control, least privilege, encryption, TLS, secrets management, audit logging, and secure coding; protect  sensitive financial data and enforce critical transaction authorization and business rules server-side; follow OWASP principles and support appropriate security monitoring and controls. 

Cloud & DevOps

• Deploy and support services on Microsoft Azure using Docker, CI/CD, and Git; establish effective logging, monitoring,   health checks, diagnostics, deployment practices, and production troubleshooting. 

Required Skills

Backend & Architecture: Python, Django/FastAPI, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, SQL, system design, backend architecture,   microservices, distributed systems, transaction processing, concurrency, idempotency, workflow/state management,   reconciliation, asynchronous processing. 

Messaging & Processing: Kafka, RabbitMQ, Celery, event-driven architecture, message-based processing, retry and failurerecovery patterns. 

Security: API security, authentication, authorization, RBAC, OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, MFA, encryption, TLS, secrets management,   access control, audit logging, secure coding, OWASP principles. 

Cloud & Engineering: Microsoft Azure, Docker, CI/CD, Git, application monitoring, logging, performance optimization, and  production support. 

Leadership: Technical leadership, architecture ownership, code reviews, mentoring, technical decision-making, problemsolving, stakeholder collaboration, and end-to-end delivery ownership. 

Preferred Skills & Experience

• Banking, Fintech, Payments, Trading, Brokerage, Treasury, or Financial Technology experience. 

• Experience developing transaction-heavy, financially critical, or regulated applications. 

• Experience with financial reconciliation, settlements, balances, payments, positions, or transaction lifecycles. 

• Experience with ETRM or Treasury Management Systems. 

• Experience with banking APIs, payment systems, financial integrations, trading platforms, or market-data systems. 

• Experience with banking-grade security, compliance, audit, and access-control requirements. 

• Knowledge of PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar security frameworks. 

• Experience with MongoDB, Redis, Kubernetes, and multi-tenant SaaS architecture. 

• Familiarity with React, Angular, TypeScript, or Java. 

• Exposure to Oracle is an advantage but not mandatory. 

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a hands-on Python backend engineer with strong technical leadership and architectural capability, able  to work across application design, development, databases, messaging, security, cloud, and production support. 

- We particularly value candidates who understand that financial systems require correctness, transaction integrity, security,   concurrency, auditability, reconciliation, reliability, and performance. Financial-system roles increasingly emphasize these  areas alongside Python, PostgreSQL, messaging, API security, and cloud engineering. 
 - Direct ETRM/Treasury experience is preferred but not mandatory; relevant banking, fintech, payments, trading, brokerage, or  other transaction-heavy financial experience is strongly preferred
