data.description:
Job Description Summary

Come Join Our Software Integration Team!! Our main activity consists in setting up GE Vernova software in different environments for internal and external customers, supporting project activities and providing expertise in tailoring the components based on requirements. We have a hybrid work environment as we work from home, the office and travel to customer sites as needed. The integration engineer is a key member in all projects, being engaged throughout the full lifecycle (Development, Factory Acceptance Tests, Site Acceptance Tests, Cutover, Support). 

Job Description

GE Vernova allows us to bring a significant contribution to the Worldwide Electrical Energy context. Delivering on life-critical solutions we are deeply immersed into the worlds of Transmission, Distribution, Asset Management and Market Management making sure we shape how the energy landscape looks today and tomorrow. 

Our teams breathe software-life into R&D, Services and Support for GE Vernova Electrification Software's products while liaising with stakeholders and customers all around the globe. 

GE Vernova is a global provider of software, hardware, services, and expertise in automation and embedded computing. We offer a unique foundation of agile and reliable technology providing customers a sustainable competitive advantage in the industries they serve, including energy, water, consumer packaged goods, oil & gas, government & defense, and telecommunications. 

The activity within this office consists of development and implementation of: 

- Energy Management Systems (EMS)
 - Distribution Management Systems (DMS)

Different specialized teams for distinct technical fields contribute to the realization of these systems. (hardware, communications, databases, HMI, applications). 

One of the activities, carried out in the mentioned context, is engineering for specific monitoring and control of power systems applications (power flow, short-circuit calculation state estimator, contingency analysis, optimization in power systems, voltage control, load frequency control, power reserve management, load forecast, stability analysis, transient regimes, modeling of the equipment, of the automation and protection systems in power plants and of the power grids, energy market models). 

Main Job Responsibilities

- Development of the mathematical models of the physical phenomena in the power systems
 - Software development for real-time applications (code, testing)
 - Carrying out the analysis to define the specifications for the real time monitoring and control systems
 - Commissioning of the EMS, DMS systems
 - Engineering and code development for the EMS, DMS systems that meets the high standards. 
 - Parameterization, optimization, testing of EMS, DMS systems
 - Databases management
 - Good technical background is required. The development of professional skills is achieved, in time, by involvement in the team activities and by trainings. 
 - Knowledge of the power systems phenomena and processes and related mathematical models (power flow, state estimator, short-circuit analysis, contingency analyst, voltage control, load-frequency control, power systems optimal regimes, load forecast, stability analysis, transient analysis, modeling of equipment and of automation and protection systems in power plants and power grids, DTS, models for the energy market)
 - C / C ++ programmer skills or similar
 - Exposure in Modelling of SCADA and Power System Analyst Applications
 - Familiarity or development experience on Windows OS or UNIX OS

Qualifications / Requirements

- Master's degree in Power Systems with 2 to 5 years of experience in the PSA Domain
 - Troubleshooting skills
 - Fluent in English
 - Ability and willingness to travel

Desired Characteristics

- Technically good performer who can integrate and test complex software systems to completion with a minimal supervision
 - Excellent communication skills (verbal and written)
 - Rigorous, methodical, well organized and self-disciplined
 - Take initiatives, good trouble-shooter and autonomous
 - Adaptability, reactivity and Availability
 - Ability to analyze complex topics and make a verbal/written synthesis
 - Ability and willingness to travel

Network & Links

- Internal: Operations, Product Development, Tendering, and Maintenance & Support

Performance Measurement

- On Time Delivery

In collaboration with Methods & Tools

In collaboration with Maintenance & Support

data.title: Staff Software Engineer, Privileged Access Management (PAM) / Password Manager (PWM)
data.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description. 

About JumpCloud®
JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times. 

  

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT. 

Position Overview

We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer with 12+ years of experience to serve as a technical anchor, system architect, and engineering catalyst for our core platform. In this high-impact role, you will define macro-architectural strategy, author and pitch technical visions to cross-functional leaders, and anchor engineering teams in executing scalable, highly secure microservices. You will blend deep hands-on expertise in . NET, Go, and PAM solutions with strategic leadership in AI-driven development and modern release engineering. 

Architectural Leadership & Executive Pitching: 

- 
Architectural Ownership: Own the end-to-end technical vision and architectural decisions for high-throughput, highly available microservices and multi-platform solutions. 

- 
Technical Anchoring: Serve as the primary technical anchor across multiple engineering squads-establishing engineering standards, resolving complex system trade-offs, and mentoring senior engineers. 

- 
Technical Pitches & RFCs: Craft and deliver compelling technical pitches, Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), and RFCs to convince executive leadership, Product, and Infrastructure partners on strategic platform investments. 

- 
Cross-Functional Alignment: Translate complex business objectives into clear, scalable technical roadmaps while balancing velocity, technical debt, and system stability. 

Core Systems & Security Engineering

- 
Platform Development: Architect and write high-performance production code using C#, . NET (ASP. NET Core / ABP Framework), Go, TypeScript, and gRPC. 

- 
Privileged Access Management (PAM): Design and deploy enterprise PAM/IDAM architectures (CyberArk, BeyondTrust, HashiCorp Vault) and SCIM protocol integrations enforcing Zero Trust and Least Privilege principles. 

- 
Multi-Platform Strategy: Collaborate with the cross-functional teams (e. g. , data engineering team) to define data architecture strategy across relational (SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (DocumentDB) platforms; across environments and similarly collaborative with the infrastructure teams to have better infrastructure strategy in place that targets towards cost-saving on a long-term basis. 

- 
Problem solving & Troubleshooting: Active participation in the incident management process and contributing PIRs, taking ownership/accountability for a quick turn-around to resolve the incident.   

Delivery Automation & AI Strategy: 

- 
CI/CD & Quality Rigor: Champion deployment automation across Origin CI, Kargo, and WoK, ensuring comprehensive unit, functional, Playwright E2E, and Performance, Scalability, and Reliability (PSR) testing. 

- 
AI Framework Governance: Pioneer spec-driven AI development by championing the BMAD framework to standardize, govern, and scale AI-assisted coding (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot) and reusable skill libraries. 

Required Qualifications: 

- 
Experience: 12+ years of progressive software development experience, with a proven track record operating as a Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, or Lead Architect in enterprise product environments. 

- 
Architectural Mastery: Demonstrated history of making company-level architectural decisions, pitching complex technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders, and anchoring multi-team initiatives. 

- 
Core Tech Stack: Advanced proficiency in C#, . NET (ABP framework), Go, gRPC, TypeScript, and database engineering (PostgreSQL / DocumentDB). 

- 
Security & Infrastructure: Hands-on expertise in Privileged Access Management (PAM), SCIM, AWS/GCP cloud platforms, and Kubernetes. 

- 
Testing & Release: Expertise in continuous delivery pipelines, PSR non-functional testing, and automated E2E testing frameworks (Playwright). 

Where you'll be working/Location: 

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description. 

  

You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.   

  

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed. 

  

Language: 

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.   Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description. 

  

Why JumpCloud?   

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You'll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We're out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You'll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.     

  

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to "Build Connections. " To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed. " - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

  

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.   Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.     

  

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. 

  

Scam Notice: 

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment. 

  

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud. com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud. com with the subject line "Scam Notice"  

  

#BI-Remote

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https: //jumpcloud. com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

data.title: Engineer II, System validation Test - Insight QA
data.description:
About The Role

We are looking for an Engineer II in System Validation Testing with 3 to 5 years of experience to join our cloud network management quality engineering team. The role focuses on hands-on testing of a cloud-hosted platform used to onboard, configure, monitor and manage networking devices such as access points, switches and routers. 

The engineer will work with senior QA engineers, developers and product teams to understand requirements, design and execute tests, automate repeatable workflows, investigate failures and contribute to reliable releases across the device, network, cloud, API and web or mobile application layers. 

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Network Management Testing

- Understand feature requirements and expected customer workflows for cloud-managed access points, switches and routers. 
 - Test device onboarding, discovery, provisioning, configuration and removal workflows. 
 - Validate device-to-cloud communication, cloud-to-device operations and configuration synchronization. 
 - Test device status, statistics, alerts, notifications and basic remote-management workflows. 
 - Validate firmware upgrade, reconnect, recovery and factory-reset scenarios under guidance. 
 - Execute tests across common LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and multi-device network setups. 

Test Planning and Execution

- Review user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications with the QA team. 
 - Create and maintain clear test scenarios and test cases covering positive, negative, boundary and recovery conditions. 
 - Prepare test data and configure required devices, accounts, subscriptions and environments. 
 - Execute functional, integration, system, regression, compatibility and end-to-end tests. 
 - Record results accurately, report coverage gaps and escalate blockers early. 
 - Retest resolved defects and run focused regression for impacted workflows. 

API Cloud and Data Validation

- Test REST APIs using tools such as Postman and automation libraries. 
 - Validate request and response data, status codes, authentication, authorization and error handling. 
 - Verify consistency across APIs, backend services, database records and user interfaces. 
 - Test asynchronous operations, events and notifications with support from senior engineers. 
 - Use AWS logs, dashboards and application telemetry to investigate test failures. 
 - Perform smoke and regression validation in QA and staging environments. 

Networking and Troubleshooting

- Apply networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, IPv4 and IPv6, DHCP, DNS, ARP, ICMP, HTTP and HTTPS, VLANs, routing, switching, NAT, LAN, WAN and Wi-Fi. 
 - Use ping, traceroute, nslookup or dig, iperf, browser developer tools and device or cloud logs during troubleshooting. 
 - Capture and perform basic analysis of network traffic using Wireshark or tcpdump. 
 - Isolate whether a failure is related to the device, network, cloud service, API, backend or application layer, and involve the appropriate team. 

Test Automation

- Develop and maintain Python-based automation for APIs, device workflows and regression scenarios. 
 - Create or update UI automation using Playwright, Selenium or an equivalent framework. 
 - Follow existing framework standards and build reusable, readable and maintainable test components. 
 - Analyze automation failures, distinguish product defects from script or environment issues and fix tests within assigned scope. 
 - Run automated suites through CI/CD pipelines and report failures with supporting evidence. 
 - Identify stable, repetitive manual scenarios suitable for automation. 

Defect Management and Team Collaboration

- Log clear defects with reproducible steps, expected and actual behavior, logs, screenshots, API traces and packet captures when applicable. 
 - Participate in defect triage, daily stand-ups, sprint planning and test-status discussions. 
 - Collaborate with software, cloud, firmware, networking and mobile teams to reproduce and resolve issues. 
 - Track assigned defects through retest and closure and communicate risks or delays promptly. 
 - Maintain test cases, automation and technical notes in the agreed repositories and tools. 

Release and Production Support

- Support release regression, production smoke testing and post-deployment validation as assigned. 
 - Verify critical customer workflows after deployments and provide accurate test status to the QA lead. 
 - Assist with reproducing customer-reported or production issues in controlled environments. 
 - Contribute new regression tests for escaped defects and recurring failure patterns. 

Required Qualifications

- 3 to 5 years of software QA or system validation experience. 
 - Hands-on experience in functional, integration, regression and end-to-end testing. 
 - Working knowledge of TCP/IP and core networking concepts. 
 - Experience testing REST APIs and interpreting JSON request and response data. 
 - Programming or test-automation experience using Python. 
 - Exposure to UI automation using Playwright, Selenium or an equivalent tool. 
 - Ability to analyze logs, reproduce issues and write clear defect reports. 
 - Experience using Git and working with CI/CD test execution. 
 - Good written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work in a cross-functional team. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing cloud-managed networking or network management platforms. 
 - Hands-on exposure to access points, switches, routers or Wi-Fi test environments. 
 - Familiarity with AWS services, microservices, Docker or Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with Wireshark, tcpdump and basic packet analysis. 
 - Exposure to mobile application testing, performance testing or API security testing. 
 - Awareness of Wi-Fi 5, Wi-Fi 6, Wi-Fi 6E or Wi-Fi 7 concepts. 
 - Responsible use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or GitHub Copilot for test design, automation, debugging or log analysis.

You'll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture. 

We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. data.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
About the Role

We're looking for a  QA Engineer  to help ensure Nosh delivers a reliable cooking experience across our hardware, firmware, on-device Android application, and mobile app. 

Nosh is a smart cooking device that runs Android with a dedicated application, while embedded firmware controls various physical cooking operations. Users can also monitor and control Nosh remotely through our mobile application. 

This is a  hands-on product QA role. You'll work with actual Nosh devices, test real cooking scenarios, find corner cases, validate new features, and ensure software and firmware work correctly together. 

What You'll Do

- Test Nosh end-to-end across  hardware, firmware, Android app, and mobile app. 
 - Test new features before release and perform regression testing on existing functionality. 
 - Design and execute test cases for real-world cooking scenarios and unusual corner cases. 
 - Try to break the product by testing unexpected user behavior and failure conditions. 
 - Test scenarios such as power interruptions, Wi-Fi loss, device restarts, incorrect user actions, interrupted cooking, delayed commands, and connectivity recovery. 
 - Test the Android application running directly on the Nosh device. 
 - Test remote monitoring and control of Nosh through our mobile application. 
 - Verify synchronization between the physical Nosh device and mobile app. 
 - Validate the  accuracy, timing, repeatability, and reliability of firmware-controlled operations. 
 - Verify that software commands result in the expected physical device behavior. 
 - Test sensors, motors, heaters, actuators, and other firmware-controlled components. 
 - Reproduce issues and work closely with software, firmware, hardware, and product teams to identify root causes. 
 - Write clear bug reports with reproduction steps, logs, videos/images, and relevant device/software/firmware information. 
 - Verify bug fixes and help determine release readiness. What We're Looking For

- Experience in QA/software testing with strong fundamentals in test-case design and regression testing. 
 - Experience testing  Android & iOS applications. 
 - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to think beyond the happy path and identify unusual real-world scenarios. 
 - Comfortable testing and debugging physical products. 
 - Strong attention to detail and ability to clearly document issues. 
 - Interest in working across  software, firmware, hardware, and IoT systems. Good to Have

- Experience testing IoT, embedded, robotics, appliances, or connected consumer products. 
 - Familiarity with  ADB, Logcat, Postman, REST APIs, MQTT, WebSockets, Bluetooth/BLE, or Wi-Fi debugging. 
 - Experience testing embedded firmware. 
 - Experience validating sensors, motors, heaters, or other electromechanical systems. 
 - Basic Python or scripting knowledge for test automation. 
 - Experience with Android/mobile test automation. 
 - Familiarity with OTA software/firmware updates. Who Will Do Well in This Role

We're looking for someone who is naturally curious about  how a product can fail, not just whether the expected flow works. 

You should enjoy asking questions like: 

What happens if Wi-Fi disconnects in the middle of cooking? What if the user sends a command from the mobile app while something else is happening on the device? What if the device restarts midway through a recipe? Did the firmware actually perform an operation accurately, or did the software simply report that it did?

- If you enjoy finding these kinds of problems before customers do, we'd love to talk.

Position Overview

The Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring the delivery of high‐quality software through a combination of manual and automated testing practices. This role works closely with Development, Product, DevOps, and Delivery teams to validate functionality, improve test coverage, identify defects early, and continuously enhance the quality of products and platforms. Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe-directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries. 

Vanguard India

We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients. 

Role Summary

Lead a team of engineers and technical leads responsible for architecting, developing, and supporting enterprise technology solutions across multiple platforms. This role provides senior-level technical leadership, drives modern engineering practices, oversees secure API integrations, and ensures alignment between technology architecture, business priorities, and user needs. The incumbent champions innovation, software quality, documentation standards, and the adoption of emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions. 

Responsibilities

- Lead, coach, and develop high-performing engineering teams by setting clear expectations, fostering career growth, and driving accountability for results. 
 - Provide strategic technical leadership and architectural direction for complex, enterprise-scale software and platform solutions. 
 - Drive the design, development, implementation, testing, deployment, and support of secure, scalable, and resilient technology solutions. 
 - Review and approve technical designs, architectural recommendations, and engineering deliverables to ensure alignment with enterprise standards and business objectives. 
 - Partner with business, product, UX, infrastructure, and security teams to deliver technology solutions that enhance user experience and operational efficiency. 
 - Lead resolution of complex technical challenges through root-cause analysis, risk mitigation, and proactive problem prevention. 
 - Establish and maintain engineering best practices, technical standards, governance processes, and software documentation frameworks. 
 - Guide the adoption of modern software engineering methodologies, development tools, automation, and cloud-native technologies. 
 - Drive API strategy and integration architecture to support secure and seamless data exchange across enterprise systems and applications. 
 - Ensure solutions comply with information security, privacy, risk, and regulatory requirements. 
 - Mentor engineers and technical leaders, fostering continuous learning and technical excellence across the organization. 
 - Contribute to strategic technology roadmaps, architecture evolution, and long-term investment planning. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity, software quality, development efficiency, and platform scalability. 
 - Stay current on emerging technologies, industry trends, AI innovations, and modern software architecture practices. 
 - Support organizational initiatives and perform additional duties as assigned. 

Qualifications & Skills

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline; Master's degree preferred. 
 - Minimum 10 years of software engineering or technology experience with at least 5 years leading engineering teams and managers. 
 - Demonstrated success delivering enterprise-scale applications and technology platforms from concept through production. 
 - Strong expertise in software architecture, distributed systems, application engineering, and modern development practices. 
 - Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, C#, or JavaScript. 
 - Experience with Agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and test automation. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), containerization, and microservices architecture. 
 - Experience designing and integrating APIs and enterprise-scale software solutions. 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills. 
 - Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing engineering teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading multiple engineering teams, technical leaders, or platform organizations. 
 - Strong understanding of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and modern AI architectures. 
 - Experience building and scaling enterprise AI products, platforms, or developer enablement capabilities. 
 - Knowledge of AI governance, model risk management, Responsible AI, security, privacy, and compliance frameworks. 
 - Experience with agentic AI, multi-model architectures, and enterprise automation solutions. 
 - Ability to define technology vision, roadmaps, and investment priorities aligned to strategic business outcomes. 
 - Experience leading globally distributed engineering organizations. 
 - Financial services or other highly regulated industry experience. 
 - Experience driving enterprise-wide technology transformation and adoption initiatives. 

Location

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered. 

Our mission

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life: 

Financial wellness

We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs. 

Physical wellness

We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness. 

Personal wellness

We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. data.title: Lead AI Product Engineer
data.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. 

The role

Cogentiq I2C is Fractal's agentic AI Product for invoice-to-cash, covering Collections, Cash Application, Deductions, Invoice Management and Credit Risk. It runs on a Next. js front end, a FastAPI service layer, the Cogentiq agentic runtime, and a data tier on Azure Databricks with PostgreSQL. 

You own the AI side: the agents, the models and everything that makes them accurate and dependable in front of a finance team. You design it, you lead the team that builds it, and you write code yourself. 

What you will own

- Technical design of the AI side: agent decomposition, orchestration patterns, tool design, memory and context strategy. 
 - The agents across all five modules, from document extraction and matching through to the reasoning steps behind a recommendation. 
 - Accuracy and reliability. Evaluation sets, regression suites, and a defensible number for how well each agent performs before it ships. 
 - Guardrails and human oversight: confidence thresholds, escalation to a person, audit trails, and traceable reasoning for any decision touching cash. 
 - Predictive and machine learning models where they serve the product better than an agent does. 
 - Model strategy: choice of models, cost and latency per workflow, and the ability to switch providers without a rewrite. 
 - The interfaces between your side and the platform, agreed jointly with the engineering. 

How you will work

- Lead the AI and agent engineering team. Set standards, coach engineers, and keep the team unblocked. 
 - Stay in the code. Take the hardest agents yourself and set the patterns others follow. 
 - Work as a pair with the Engineering Lead. 
 - Work with product management on what an agent can realistically be trusted to do, so external commitments are grounded. 
 - Be able to explain an agent's behaviour to a finance stakeholder who will not accept "the model decided". 

What you must have

- Ten to fourteen years in AI, machine learning or software, with at least three leading a team. 
 - Track record of owning technical design, not only implementing someone else's design. 
 - Production experience with LLM and agentic systems: multi-step workflows, tool use, orchestration frameworks, and the failure modes that only appear at scale. 
 - Real evaluation discipline. Evidence that you have measured agent quality with something more rigorous than manual spot checks. 
 - Strong Python engineering. Your team ships production code, not notebooks. 
 - Document understanding and information extraction experience, ideally on messy real-world inputs such as emails, remittance advices and attachments. 
 - Classical machine learning depth alongside the generative work, and the judgement to know which problem needs which. 
 - Enough understanding of services, data and deployment to build agents that fit the platform and to hold your side of a design argument with the Engineering Lead. 
 - Product track record: AI built for many clients, not one-off delivery for a single engagement. 

Good to have

- Order-to-cash or accounts receivable domain knowledge: collections, cash application, deductions, remittance handling. 
 - Experience with agent observability and tracing tooling. 
 - Experience getting AI through enterprise risk, compliance or model governance review. 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking Introduce Yourself in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are-with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody's is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we're advancing AI to move from insight to action-enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence. 

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity. 

Skills And Competencies

- 7+ years of experience in deploying and managing large-scale machine learning (ML) and generative AI applications
 - Strong expertise in AWS services and proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tools
 - Solid familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and orchestration technologies
 - In-depth knowledge of ML/AI infrastructure and adherence to security best practices
 - Proven track record of managing teams and delivering complex technical projects
 - Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills
 - Deep expertise in artificial intelligence, with a track record of implementing advanced AI solutions to drive strategic transformation and operational efficiency. Strong experience using AI tools to lead innovation initiatives. Demonstrated leadership in managing AI-related risks, ensuring ethical governance, and fostering a culture of responsible AI adoption across the organization

Education

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field
 - AWS certifications (e. g. , AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional, AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty)

Responsibilities

The Team Lead drives secure, scalable, and cost-efficient cloud and ML infrastructure while leading high-performing engineering teams aligned to Moody's strategic AI initiatives. 

- Lead and manage a team of MLOps engineers and cloud system engineers, ensuring alignment with strategic AI initiatives
 - Oversee the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and cost-efficient cloud and ML infrastructure on AWS
 - Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to optimize model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management
 - Develop and enforce best practices for infrastructure provisioning, model deployment, and security compliance
 - Drive continuous improvement in operational processes, leveraging automation and infrastructure-as-code tools
 - Optimize the costs of our cloud resources while ensuring the optimal performance of our AI solutions
 - Foster a culture of teamwork, openness, and innovation within and across teams

About The Team

Moody's Ratings' AI Analytics group develops advanced machine learning (ML) and generative AI solutions for high-profile data science initiatives. The successful candidate will guide teams in building robust, scalable, and secure solutions on AWS. The successful candidate will strive to meet Moody's values: openness, diversity, inclusivity, respect, and a willingness to learn. 

Moody's is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law. 

Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody's Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

data.title: Lead Data Engineer
data.description:
- Joining Arup

Arup's purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. 

We are looking for an experienced Lead Data Engineer to help shape, build and operate scalable data solutions on the Databricks platform. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can set technical direction, mentor engineers and deliver robust, secure and high-performing data pipelines, Lakehouse solutions and analytics-ready data products. 

You will work closely with data engineers, analysts, data scientists, architects, product owners and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into practical, reliable and scalable data services. You will bring strong technical judgement, a passion for engineering excellence and the ability to promote best practice across data engineering, governance and platform operations. 

The Opportunity

At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective - in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning - to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve. 

- Lead, mentor and support a team of data engineers, setting technical direction and encouraging engineering best practice. 
 - Design, build and operate scalable data pipelines and Lakehouse solutions using Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake and cloud-native services. 
 - Define standards for ingestion, transformation, orchestration, testing, deployment, observability and monitoring. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to turn business and technical requirements into high-quality data solutions. 
 - Champion reusable frameworks, automation, medallion architecture patterns and modern data engineering practices. 
 - Embed data quality, security, governance and compliance controls across pipelines and data products. 
 - Review solution designs, code and deployment approaches to maintain consistency, resilience and operational reliability. 
 - Optimise Databricks workloads for performance, scalability and cost efficiency. 
 - Support Agile delivery, sprint planning, estimation, continuous improvement and technical roadmap development. 

Did you know: Our Digital Technology team are proud prior winners of the IT Team of the Year Award at the Chartered Institute of IT's UK IT Industry Awards. 

Is this role right for you?

- Strong production experience in Databricks, Spark, PySpark, SQL and Delta Lake. 
 - Experience designing scalable data pipelines, Lakehouse solutions and cloud-native data services. 
 - Knowledge of Unity Catalog, data governance, security and access control patterns. 
 - Confidence leading, mentoring and developing data engineers. 
 - A passion for engineering excellence, automation, reliability and continuous improvement. 

What We Offer You

At Arup, we care about each member's success, so we can grow together. 

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive - through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do. 

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup's legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts. 

Different people, shared values

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you're pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas - this drives our excellence. 

Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion - we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at Careers - Your Life at Arup . 

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you. 

Our Application Process

To understand what to expect next, please visit our Careers page Our aim is to make this process as streamlined and easy as possible for our applicants. 

Please note that all applicants must apply directly via the job portal and applications sent via email will not be considered. If this role is not quite what you are looking for, but you are interested in other opportunities for a future with purpose, please sign up to our Talent Community where you will be kept up to date with roles suitable for you to shape a better world. 

Stay safe online - Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process. 

An environment that will give you freedom to design with a purpose, focus on your skills to deliver quality work to our clients, opportunity to learn and share knowledge openly. You will have the opportunity to utilise your technical expertise to improve the lives of the most vulnerable in the communities in which we live and work through Arup's community engagement programme. 

You'll have access to lots of learning opportunities and ongoing training through Arup university and other learning programmes.

Job Title: Lead Engineer -RT Streaming Inventory Management ( Assistant Vice President)

Department: GM IT

About Business line/Function: Inventory Management, Prime Technology - Global Markets IT

Position Purpose

The role is embedded in a globally distributed inventory management technology team with presence in London, Hong Kong, Lisbon, Glasgow and Bengaluru. The aim of the team is to deliver a new state-of-the-art inventory management platform called AOS (Asset Optimization Services). The platform will be the basis for both manual and automated inventory management decisions, creating a global business by abstracting away from our entity structure and managing requirements across the group level. The technical stack includes Java, Spring, Apache Flink, Apache Kafka, Apache Ignite, Angular. 

Responsibilities

The candidate will report functionally into the global inventory management development lead, will be the line manager for the Bengaluru AOS development team and will work closely with the global development team. 

The candidate will have demonstrable experience and knowledge of advanced streaming middleware technologies such as Apache Flink, Kafka, and Apache Ignite

The candidate is expected to proactively influence design, providing input on complex assignments developed both inside and outside their immediate project, and promoting good software development standards. 

The candidate will act as a role model, supporting and fostering a culture of good conduct. 

The candidate will demonstrate proactivity, transparency, and accountability in identifying and managing conduct risk. 

The candidate will work closely with the regional managers of the team to ensure consistency of program goals, architecture, resource allocations & assignments, and people topics (career management, objectives, reviews). 

The candidate will manage business demand and expectations for work and delivery of the work in alignment with budget and overall business direction and governance. 

The candidate will be responsible for the full development of a project, from design to deployment in production. 

The candidate will ensure end-deliverables are clearly defined and communicated, and that stakeholders are kept informed of each deliverable's progress, issues, and risks. 

The candidate will proactively manage risk and issues, escalating where appropriate, to ensure delivery progress is maintained. 

The candidate will design solutions that align technology roadmaps to business strategy and conduct high-quality functional design, system, integration testing, and UAT. 

Contributing Responsibilities

The candidate should have experience working in a global team, aiding others through pair programming and knowledge sharing to help the team improve their development practices. 

The candidate should demonstrate excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. They should possess a can-do attitude and be able to partner with others both inside and outside of the development team to investigate issues, drive conversations to find and agree on solutions, and communicate those solutions to a diverse set of stakeholders. 

The candidate should be able to partner with business, developers, architects, and infrastructure teams to help shape the future platform. 

Technical & Behavioral Competencies

The candidate should have extensive experience in complex software development

The candidate will have demonstrable experience and advanced knowledge of modern streaming middleware technologies such as Kafka

The candidate is an expert in server-side java, highly concurrent programming. 

The candidate should have experience working with SDLC automation tools such as Jira, Bitbucket, Artifactory, and Jenkins. 

The candidate should possess very strong technical skills, and be an advocate of test-driven development and delivery automation

Specific Qualifications

Bachelor's /Master's degree in Computer Science / Engineering or equivalent. 

Technical Skills

Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)

- 
 - Advanced experience in Java 17, 25, Spring framework
 - Advanced experience with streaming, Apache Kafka
 - Cache / Data Grid Middleware 
Behavioral Skills

- 
 - Work in an agile environment with frequent production releases. 
Education Level: Masters or equivalent experience. At least 12+ years of relevant experience. 

Location: Bengaluru

About BNP Paribas Group

BNP Paribas is the European Union's leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185, 000 employees, including more than 145, 000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group's commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability. 

About BNP Paribas India Solutions

Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union's leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions. 

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. data.title: Senior Director, Engineering - AI Studio (CX & EX)
data.description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of "solutions" that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done. 

There's another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works. 

At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72, 000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks' customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And, over 4, 500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world. 

Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us. 

Job Description

At Freshworks, we are building the future of customer and employee engagement - and AI agents are at the center of it. The AI Agent Platform is the foundation on which our next generation of autonomous and assistive experiences are built. AI Studio is the product surface that brings that platform to life: the place where builders design, test, deploy, observe, and continuously optimize AI agents that ship inside our CX and EX products. 

We are looking for a visionary engineering leader to own AI Studio end to end. As the Senior Director of Engineering for AI Studio, you will lead a dynamic, multi-disciplinary organization that builds the front-end experience and the Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) layer for the AI Agent Platform, and embeds these capabilities natively within our CX and EX product lines. This is a pivotal, high-visibility role with the opportunity to shape how thousands of businesses build and operate AI agents - setting the bar for craftsmanship, developer experience, reliability, and scale. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead a dynamic, multi-disciplinary organization of engineers and engineering managers spanning front-end, BFF/services, and platform integration. 
 - Own the vision and technical execution for AI Studio - the end-to-end experience to build, test, deploy, observe, and optimize AI agents on the AI Agent Platform. 
 - Deliver a best-in-class front end and a robust Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) layer that expose the AI Agent Platform's capabilities to builders with speed, trust, and clarity. 
 - Embed AI Studio natively within both CX and EX product lines, ensuring a seamless, consistent builder and end-user experience across surfaces. 
 - Establish the agent lifecycle as a first-class product: authoring and configuration, testing and evaluation, safe deployment, live observability, and data-driven optimization. 
 - Partner deeply with the AI Agent Platform, AI/ML, and Data Science teams to surface state-of-the-art models, tools, and orchestration capabilities through intuitive workflows. 
 - Define and track impact: agent build velocity, time-to-deploy, adoption, agent quality and containment/deflection, reliability, and measurable ROI for CX and EX customers. 
 - Establish governance and trust: access controls, guardrails, data classification, privacy/PII handling, auditability, and compliance-ready practices for agent workflows. What You'll Do

- Set the AI Studio vision: Define the strategy, roadmap, and operating model for a unified studio experience that lets builders create, test, deploy, observe, and optimize AI agents across CX and EX. 
 - Own the full builder journey: Ship the front-end and BFF that make agent authoring, configuration, and iteration fast, intuitive, and reliable - from first prototype to production at scale. 
 - Deliver testing & evaluation: Build the tooling for agent testing, simulation, and evaluation (quality, safety, regression) so teams ship agents with confidence and measurable quality bars. 
 - Enable safe, scalable deployment: Provide deployment, versioning, and rollout controls that let teams promote agents across environments with strong guardrails and zero-downtime expectations. 
 - Build observability & optimization: Deliver real-time monitoring, tracing, and analytics for live agents - surfacing quality, latency, cost, and outcome signals - and close the loop so insights drive continuous optimization. 
 - Embed across CX & EX: Ensure AI Studio integrates natively into Freshworks CX and EX products, delivering a consistent experience while respecting the needs of each product line. 
 - Lead & inspire: Cultivate a high-performance, inclusive culture across a multi-tiered organization of engineers and managers. Mentor the next generation of technical leaders and build a team known for technical excellence and execution velocity. 
 - Execute with excellence: Master the full development lifecycle, from strategic planning and roadmap management to deployment and operations. Champion agile, iterative delivery to ship exceptional products under ambitious deadlines and evolving priorities. 
 - Drive technical & architectural strategy: Act as the technical authority for AI Studio. Guide teams in building large-scale, distributed cloud systems, performant front-end architectures, and resilient BFF/API layers, adopting best practices and emerging AI technologies. 
 - Collaborate to win: Build powerful partnerships with AI Agent Platform, AI/ML, Product, Design, and GTM leaders so the AI Studio roadmap is aligned with platform capabilities, business needs, and customer expectations. Foster a "one team" mindset. 
 - Champion innovation & quality: Foster continuous improvement and out-of-the-box thinking. Establish and track KPIs that measure AI Studio health, reliability, builder productivity, and business impact. 

Qualifications

What You'll Bring

- A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, with a proven track record of at least 5 years in a senior leadership role (Director or above) leading product-facing platform, developer-tooling, or application engineering teams. 
 - Demonstrable experience building, scaling, and leading high-performing product and engineering organizations in an enterprise SaaS environment. 
 - Strong technical foundation in building and operating large-scale, distributed systems on public cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS, Azure, GCP), including modern front-end architectures and Backend-for-Frontend (BFF)/API design. 
 - Hands-on understanding of the AI/agent landscape: LLMs, agent orchestration, RAG, evaluation and observability for AI systems, and the practical realities of shipping AI features into production. 
 - Track record of delivering builder- or developer-facing products (studios, low-code/no-code tooling, or platform consoles) with excellent UX and reliability at scale. Skills Inventory: 

Leadership & Talent Management

- Inspirational leadership & mentorship
 - Talent acquisition & retention
 - Organizational design & scaling
 - Performance management & career developmentTechnical & Architectural Acumen

- Front-end architecture & Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) design
 - Cloud computing, microservices & large-scale distributed systems
 - AI agent platforms: LLMs, orchestration, evaluation & AI observability
 - DevOps, CI/CD, and SRE principles
 - Data security, guardrails & compliance frameworksStrategic & Business Acumen

- Long-term strategic planning & vision setting
 - Roadmap development & prioritization
 - Budget & resource management
 - Data-driven decision making & KPI managementExecution & Collaboration

- Agile & iterative development methodologies
 - Cross-functional influence & stakeholder management
 - Exceptional communication & interpersonal skills
 - Problem-solving & crisis management

Additional Information

Please note this is a hybrid role that requires an in-office presence 3 days / week (Tue-Thu). 

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.

This role directs and oversees engineering teams and all work across an entire capability. This role works closely with product leaders and across enterprise teams to ensure the delivery and reliability of technology solutions and capabilities.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
Staff Backend Engineer : Digital Credit Platform (AI-Augmented Engineering)

Domain: Fintech, Lending, or Credit Systems

About The Team / Role

As a Staff SOFTWARE Engineer, you will be the primary architect and execution lead for the transformation of our Digital Credit Application. We are pivoting from a legacy monolith to a high-performance, pluggable API ecosystem. Your mission is to decouple core adjudication logic, enable rapid A/B testing of the customer journey, and lay the technical foundation for future AI-driven chat and automated decisioning experiences. 

This is a high-impact role designed for a true "builder" who thrives on the duality of supporting a live production environment while aggressively migrating mission-critical services to a modern, microservices-based backbone. 

The AI Edge: We are a forward-thinking engineering org. You are expected to be an expert in leveraging AI Software Development Lifecycle (AI DLC) tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Amazon Q, LLM-based code gen and architecture agents) to accelerate migration, write bulletproof tests, and automate documentation. 

How You'll Make An Impact

Architectural Migration & Strategy

- Strangler Fig Migration: Lead the decoupling of core credit application logic out of the legacy monolith and into a scalable, cloud-native Java/Spring Boot microservices environment. 
 - Migration with Zero Downtime: Design and execute high-volume traffic migration strategies from legacy systems to new stacks seamlessly without disrupting live customers. 

Pluggable Adjudication & API Ecosystem

- Modular Architecture: Design and implement a modular adjudication layer allowing the business to swap or update credit rules and third-party data providers without impacting core application flows. 
 - API-First Design: Build and maintain robust, versioned REST/gRPC APIs that support a multi-channel experience (Mobile, Web, and future AI Chat interfaces). 
 - A/B Strategy Enablement: Engineer backend infrastructure for dynamic routing and experimentation, allowing real-time testing of various application flows. 

AI Readiness & Process Acceleration

- AI DLC Mastery: Champion the use of AI tools across the development lifecycle to write code faster, refactor legacy code into modern Java, and generate robust test suites. 
 - Data Science Partnership: Partner with Data Science teams to ensure data pipelines and backend schemas are optimized for LLM integration and real-time credit decisioning models. 

Operational Excellence & Leadership

- Observability & CI/CD: Establish rigorous standards for CI/CD, observability (OpenTelemetry), and automated contract testing. 
 - Technical Mentorship: Provide guidance to mid-level and senior engineers, fostering a culture of high engineering standards, clean code, and AI-assisted productivity. 

Experience You Will Bring

Technical Architecture & Stack

- 10+ Years of Engineering Excellence: Proven track record in backend architecture, specifically within Fintech, Lending, or Credit systems. 
 - Modern Java Stack: Expert-level proficiency in Java 17/21, Spring Boot 3. x, and Spring Cloud. 
 - Monolith-to-Distributed Migration: Significant experience extracting tightly coupled business logic from legacy backends into external, scalable cloud microservices (AWS). 
 - Complex Adjudication & Rules Engines: Experience building or implementing rules engines (e. g. , Drools, Camunda, or custom JSON-logic) for automated decisioning. 
 - Event-Driven Design: Deep experience with Kafka or RabbitMQ for maintaining asynchronous data consistency between the new API layer and legacy systems of record during migration phases. 
 - Contract-First Development: Strict adherence to API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger) to ensure seamless collaboration with frontend teams. 

AI & Modern Delivery Tools

- AI DLC Proficiency: Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants (Cursor, Copilot, etc. ) to optimize workflows, refactor legacy code, and accelerate delivery. 

Leadership & Education

- Strong analytical skills and a proven capability in resolving complex, cross-functional problems. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex technical concepts clearly to stakeholders. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

data.description:
Senior DevOps Engineer - Platform Deployment & Multi-Cloud Infrastructure

Location: [Remote / Hybrid - specify]

Team: Platform Engineering / Innovation

Employment type: Full-time

About The Role

We are hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer to own and evolve the deployment of our AI-powered application modernization platform (NEXUS) into client production environments. This role is a unique hybrid of Platform Engineering and Technical Advisory. You will not only design the underlying multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) but also partner directly with client IT groups to establish SysOps frameworks. You will leverage our AI-driven automation tools to provision infrastructure, integrate AIOps for anomaly detection and remediation, and ensure clients receive seamless product updates via our Helm-based delivery pipeline. 

This is a senior individual contributor role that requires a "product mindset"-you are designing for scale, security, and long-term operational sustainability in client environments. 

What You Will Do

Client Collaboration & SysOps Partnership

- Serve as the primary technical partner to client IT groups, guiding them on best practices for operating bespoke NEXUS implementations. 
 - Work with client-aligned delivery teams to manage the lifecycle of the platform, ensuring timely and reliable product updates via Helm charts. 
 - Collaborate with client stakeholders to tailor infrastructure and operational workflows, ensuring NEXUS integrates seamlessly with their existing enterprise monitoring and ticketing systems. 

AI-Driven Automation & AIOps Integration

- Build & Leverage AI for Provisioning: Architect and implement AI-assisted workflows to automate the provisioning and configuration of infrastructure across multi-cloud environments. 
 - AIOps Implementation: Integrate and adopt 3Pillar's AIOps platform into client ecosystems to enable proactive, automated anomaly detection and incident remediation. 
 - Knowledge Base Evolution: Maintain and refine the AIOps knowledge base, training agents to perform accurate root-cause analysis (RCA) and automate recurring issue resolution. 1

Platform & Multi-Cloud Development

- Evolve our Helm-based platform layer and Terraform module libraries to support standardized, secure deployment patterns across AWS, Azure, and GCP. 1 2 
 - Design for "Delegation": Move our automation from simple execution to self-adapting workflows that handle ambiguity and get smarter over time. 3 
 - Ensure all infrastructure-as-code and automated remediation scripts meet rigorous enterprise security and compliance standards, including PII access logging and least-privilege IAM. 

Our technology stack

You should be comfortable working with most of the following (or able to ramp quickly): 

Area

Technologies

IaC

Terraform (>= 1. 5), remote state (S3 + DynamoDB), module versioning via Git tags

Cloud

AWS (primary for client deployments): EKS, VPC, NLB, EFS, ECR, Route 53, KMS, IAM/IRSA

- Azure: AKS, Key Vault, ACR, VNet
 - GCP: GKE, Artifact Registry

Kubernetes

Production cluster operations, storage classes, ingress, HPA, troubleshooting CrashLoop / init failures

Packaging

Helm (umbrella charts, atomic releases), feature-flag-driven deployments

Platform services

HashiCorp Vault, Keycloak, OAuth2 Proxy, cert-manager, Zalando Postgres Operator, Neo4j, Redis Operator, Strimzi Kafka, Prometheus/Grafana/Loki, Apache Airflow, MinIO

Application platform

Python/FastAPI backend, React frontend, MCP server, background workers, retrieval/RAG services; container images on a private registry (e. g. GHCR)

CI/CD & GitOps

GitHub Actions, Flux (internal environments), image signing (Cosign)

Observability & ops

kubectl, helm, structured logging (Loki), metrics/alerts, operational runbooks

Security

TLS (Let's Encrypt DNS-01), secrets via Vault/VSO, SSO/OIDC, VPN / CIDR-based ingress controls

Required Experience

- Client-Facing Advisory & Enablement: Proven experience in a technical advisory or client-facing engineering role. You are comfortable partnering with client IT teams, guiding them through technical adoption, and translating complex platform requirements into operational success. 
 - DevOps & Infrastructure Expertise: 5+ years in DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering. You possess production-grade Terraform experience-architecting modular, multi-cloud IaC frameworks that enable consistent, repeatable deployments across different environments. 
 - AIOps & Observability: Hands-on experience integrating or managing AIOps platforms or automated observability stacks. You understand the lifecycle of incident response, anomaly detection, and automated remediation. 
 - AI-Driven Automation: Demonstrated experience building automation workflows. You don't just write scripts; you build systems that reduce manual operational toil and empower users through self-service provisioning and automated configuration. 
 - Platform Engineering at Scale: Deep expertise in Kubernetes and Helm. You have a track record of deploying and operating complex, multi-service platforms and managing their lifecycle (chart development, values layering, atomic releases). 
 - Foundational Cloud Operations: Proven AWS expertise (EKS, networking, IAM/IRSA) with a strong aptitude for multi-cloud environments (Azure/GCP). 
 - Identity & Security: Solid experience with secrets management (HashiCorp Vault or similar) and identity/SSO integration (Keycloak/OIDC). 
 - Communication & Mentorship: Excellent written and verbal communication. You are able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and mentor teams on best practices. 

Strongly Preferred / Nice To Have

- Consultative Experience: Prior work as a Solutions Architect, Technical Account Manager, or Implementation Engineer in a SaaS or Managed Services environment. 
 - AI/LLM Infrastructure: Experience managing infrastructure for AI/ML workloads, including GPU node pools, vector databases (e. g. , Neo4j), or RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines. 
 - GitOps & Lifecycle: Hands-on experience with GitOps methodologies (Flux, Argo CD) for managing continuous deployment at scale. 
 - Enterprise Compliance: Experience operating within regulated or enterprise environments (PII logging, audit trails, network isolation, SOC2/compliance-heavy workflows). 
 - Kafka & Distributed Systems: Experience with event streaming platforms (e. g. , Strimzi/Kafka) or specialized operators for stateful services. 

What success looks like in your first 6-12 months

- Successful enablement of client IT teams to independently manage and operate the NEXUS platform. 
 - Quantifiable reduction in manual operational toil for clients through the successful adoption of AIOps-driven anomaly detection and automated remediation. 
 - Seamless, low-friction delivery of platform updates via automated Helm-based pipelines. 
 - Deployment of robust, AI-provisioned infrastructure stacks that adapt to client-specific demands while maintaining security and compliance.

Job Overview

We are looking for a Specialist DevOps Engineer to join a distributed team, working day-to-day alongside fellow engineers to deliver and maintain reliable, scalable infrastructure. In this role, you will be a strong hands-on practitioner - deploying and operating Kubernetes-based platforms, building CI/CD pipelines, and contributing to the team's shared tooling and practices. You will work collaboratively within established patterns and under the guidance of principal-level engineers, helping the team execute consistently and continuously improve. 

A Day In The Life

Kubernetes & Container Platform

- Deploy, operate, and maintain Kubernetes workloads on Redhat Openshift and AKS in production and test environments. 
 - Work within established cluster standards - applying RBAC policies, namespace conventions, and workload placement guidelines set by the team. 
 - Implement GitOps workflows using ArgoCD and work with the Kubernetes tooling ecosystem: Helm, Kustomize, ingress controllers, and service mesh. 
 - Follow and help maintain container image standards: base-image usage, vulnerability scanning, and registry hygiene. 

CI/CD, IaC, & Cloud Platform

- Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines to support consistent and reliable software delivery. 
 - Write and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform, following shared module patterns and team standards. 
 - Support Azure platform operations including networking, IAM, and Azure-native services within defined team practices. 

Observability, Reliability, & Security

- Instrument monitoring services using the team's observability stack (metrics, logging, tracing, alerting); respond to and investigate incidents. 
 - Contribute to post-mortems and help implement follow-up improvements to increase system reliability. 
 - Apply security practices across day-to-day work: secrets management, network policies, and policy enforcement tooling. 

Collaboration & Team Contribution

- Work closely with fellow engineers and principal-level team members, proactively communicating progress, surfacing blockers, and contributing to shared solutions. 
 - Maintain and improve team documentation, runbooks, and operational guides to support consistent practices. 
 - Participate in code and infrastructure reviews, providing constructive feedback and applying guidance received

What will help you thrive in this role?

- BTech/MTech/MCA
 - 5+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering. 
 - Solid Kubernetes experience in production environments; familiarity with Redhat Openshift or AKS. 
 - Working proficiency with Terraform for infrastructure as code and ArgoCD for GitOps-based deployments. 
 - Practical experience with Azure services: networking, identity, and cloud-native tooling. 
 - Experience with CI/CD platforms and the software delivery lifecycle. 
 - Familiarity with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) and security fundamentals. 
 - Clear communicator who works well in a team environment and takes direction effectively. 
 - Experience migrating workloads to Kubernetes or working with on-premises Kubernetes deployments. 
 - Familiarity with containerization strategies and best practices for legacy application modernization. 
 - AWS experience or exposure to multi-cloud environments. 
 - Kubernetes certifications (CKA or CKAD). 

Hubbell Incorporated

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently. 

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses. 

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.
