data.title: Senior DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer (SMTS)
data.description:
We are looking for a Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS) in DevOps to build and run the infrastructure behind our energy and IoT platform. The SMTS will own AWS and Kubernetes in production, keep services reliable, and make sure we get maximum value from every rupee of cloud spend. 

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role. It requires strong DevOps and AWS capability, deep Docker and Kubernetes experience in production, a proven record of cloud cost optimisation, and site reliability practice covering SLOs, observability and incident response. Strong programming skills in at least one language such as Python, Go or Java are essential, because automation here is built as software. This is an AI-native engineering environment: AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Cursor are part of the daily workflow. The role requires 5+ years of relevant experience. 

THE WORK

Key Responsibilities

AWS & Infrastructure

- Design, build and operate AWS infrastructure across compute, networking, storage, managed databases and IAM, with ownership of resilience and security posture. 
 - Write and maintain infrastructure as code with Terraform or equivalent, using review, testing and versioning like any other software. 
 - Manage networking, VPC design, DNS, load balancing and access control across environments. 
 - Partner with security on secrets management, patching, vulnerability scanning and least-privilege access. Docker & Kubernetes

- Own Kubernetes clusters in production, including upgrades, autoscaling, resource management, networking and multi-environment setup. 
 - Define container standards with Docker: lean images, secure base images and consistent build practices. 
 - Package and deploy services with Helm or equivalent, and drive GitOps practices where they help. 
 - Troubleshoot workloads across pods, nodes, networking and storage. Cost Optimisation

- Own AWS and Kubernetes cost visibility, with tagging, dashboards and per-service cost attribution. 
 - Reduce spend through rightsizing, autoscaling, Spot and Graviton usage, Savings Plans, storage lifecycle policies and removal of idle resources. 
 - Review architecture and capacity decisions for cost impact before they reach production. 
 - Report cost trends and savings to engineering leadership with clear recommendations. Site Reliability

- Define and track SLIs and SLOs for critical services, and use them to guide reliability work. 
 - Build monitoring, logging, tracing and alerting that is actionable rather than noisy. 
 - Lead incident response, run blameless post-mortems and drive fixes for recurring causes. 
 - Plan capacity and run load and failure testing before peak demand or major releases. 
 - Write runbooks and automate repetitive operational work so on-call stays sustainable. CI/CD & Automation

- Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines with automated testing, safe rollouts and fast rollback. 
 - Write production-quality automation and internal tooling in Python, Go or Java rather than relying on ad hoc scripts. 
 - Mentor engineers on deployment, observability and production ownership. 
 - Use Claude Code, Cursor and equivalent AI coding agents for infrastructure code, automation and log analysis, and review AI-assisted changes carefully. 

THE ENVIRONMENT

Technology Environment

- Cloud: AWS (EC2, EKS, VPC, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch). 
 - Containers & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes and Helm. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Terraform or equivalent. 
 - CI/CD & GitOps: GitHub Actions, Jenkins and Argo CD. 
 - Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Loki and Sentry. 
 - Cost Management: AWS Cost Explorer, Kubecost or equivalent. 
 - Programming: Python, Go, Java and Bash. 
 - Services Supported: Java, Spring Boot, Python, Django, FastAPI and Node. js. 
 - Data & Messaging: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, MQTT and Apache Flink. 
 - AI Tooling: Claude Code and Cursor. 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Qualifications & Experience

Essential: DevOps & AWS

- 5+ years of experience in DevOps, platform or site reliability engineering for production systems. 
 - Strong hands-on AWS experience across compute, networking, storage, managed databases and IAM. 
 - Infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) and CI/CD pipelines built and maintained first-hand. 
 - Strong Linux and networking fundamentals. Essential: Docker & Kubernetes

- Deep hands-on Kubernetes experience in production, including cluster-level ownership rather than only deploying to it. 
 - Strong Docker and container fundamentals, including image security and build optimisation. Essential: Cost Optimisation & Site Reliability

- Demonstrated cloud cost reduction with measurable savings. 
 - Experience defining SLOs, building monitoring and alerting, and participating in on-call. 
 - Incident response and post-mortem experience on customer-impacting issues. 
 - Strong debugging across application, container, network and infrastructure layers. Essential: Programming

- Strong coding ability in at least one language such as Python, Go or Java, writing maintainable automation and tooling rather than only shell scripts. Essential: Ways of Working

- Ability to work independently and bring clarity to ambiguous operational problems. 
 - Clear written communication across runbooks, post-mortems and design documents. 
 - Bias towards fixing causes rather than symptoms, and automating rather than repeating. 
 - Fluent use of Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent AI development tools in daily engineering work. Desirable

- AWS Certified Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer or CKA certification. 
 - GitOps with Argo CD or Flux. 
 - Operating Kafka, Flink or time-series databases in production. 
 - Chaos engineering or disaster recovery planning. 
 - Security and compliance practices such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2. IoT, energy, industrial or real-time data platforms

data.title: DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Why Techjays

At Techjays, we're helping companies reimagine how they build, operate, and scale with AI at the core. We're part of the small percentage of companies globally building secure, production-grade AI systems that drive measurable business outcomes. Our team brings together engineers and leaders who have built and scaled products at organizations like Google, NetApp, ADP, Cognizant Consulting, and Capgemini. 

We're looking for a DevOps Lead who can own cloud infrastructure, automation, CI/CD, reliability, and engineering practices for modern software and AI-enabled platforms. The ideal candidate will be deeply specialized in either AWS or Azure, with strong hands-on DevOps experience and practical exposure to AI workloads or AI-driven products. 

Key Skills

- Cloud Technologies (Expert): Strong hands-on expertise in either AWS or Azure, with deep practical experience designing, deploying, and operating production cloud environments. 
 - AWS: EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, EKS, Lambda, ECR, CloudWatch, and related infrastructure services. 
 - Azure: Azure VMs, VNets, AKS, Azure DevOps, Azure Container Registry, Azure Monitor, Key Vault, and related infrastructure services. 
 - CI/CD: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including multi-stage pipelines, approvals, artifact management, and deployment automation. 
 - Containers & Kubernetes: Docker, Kubernetes, AKS or EKS, Helm, scaling, networking, secrets, and production workload management. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Strong Terraform experience preferred. Exposure to CloudFormation, Bicep, ARM, or similar IaC tools is valuable. 
 - Automation & Scripting: Strong Python, Bash, and/or PowerShell skills for infrastructure automation, deployment, and operational tooling. 
 - Monitoring & Reliability: CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana, centralized logging, alerting, incident management, and performance optimization. 
 - AI Exposure: Prior experience supporting AI/ML applications, GenAI platforms, AI services, LLM applications, or AI-enabled products. This is an exposure requirement, not an MLOps-specialist role. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Lead the design, implementation, and operation of scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure. 
 - Own DevOps strategy and technical direction across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, automation, and production operations. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application and AI-enabled workloads across development, staging, and production. 
 - Design and manage Kubernetes environments using AKS, EKS, Docker, and Helm. 
 - Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and relevant cloud-native tools. 
 - Establish deployment standards, reusable pipeline templates, and automated release processes. 
 - Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational practices to maintain reliability and performance. 
 - Work closely with engineering and AI teams to provide the infrastructure required to deploy and operate AI-enabled applications. 
 - Support cloud environments used by AI/ML applications, including compute, networking, containers, storage, security, and observability. 
 - Drive cloud security practices covering IAM/RBAC, secrets, networking, access controls, and infrastructure governance. 
 - Troubleshoot complex production issues, lead root cause analysis (RCA), and implement permanent fixes through automation and engineering improvements. 
 - Optimize infrastructure performance and cloud costs while maintaining reliability and scalability. 
 - Evaluate and introduce DevOps tools and practices that improve engineering productivity and deployment quality. 
 - Mentor DevOps engineers and provide technical leadership across projects and teams. 

What We're Looking For Beyond Skills

- Cloud Specialist: Deep hands-on expertise in either AWS or Azure. You do not need to be an expert in both. 
 - Strong DevOps Foundation: Proven experience owning CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, containers, automation, and production operations. 
 - AI Exposure: Experience working with or supporting AI/ML, GenAI, LLM, or AI-enabled applications and an understanding of their infrastructure needs. 
 - Builder Mindset: Ability to design, implement, and improve systems rather than only manage existing environments. 
 - Ownership: Willingness to take responsibility for reliability, delivery, security, and operational excellence. 
 - Leadership: Ability to mentor engineers, drive technical decisions, and work effectively with engineering and product teams. 
 - Location & Availability: Willingness to work onsite from the Coimbatore office and availability to join immediately or at short notice. 

Good to Have

- Experience supporting AI/ML, Generative AI, LLM or AI-agent based applications in production. • Experience with GitOps and Argo CD.   
 - Experience with cloud security, governance, networking and enterprise landing zones. • Experience with blue/green, canary and automated rollback strategies.   
 - Experience with Python-based automation or AI integrations.   
 - Experience with FinOps and optimization of cloud infrastructure costs.   
 - Relevant AWS, Azure or Kubernetes certifications.   

What we offer

- Competitive compensation  
 - Coimbatore office-based role with a strong engineering environment  
 - Opportunity to lead production-grade cloud and AI-enabled platforms for global clients
 - Exposure to modern AWS/Azure, Kubernetes, DevOps and AI engineering practices 
 - Paid holidays & flexible time off  
 - Medical insurance (Self & Family, up to ₹4 Lakhs per person)  
 - A culture that values clarity, integrity and continuous growth

Lumilens is seeking a Senior Director of Manufacturing Software Engineering to lead the strategy, development, and execution of software systems enabling high-volume manufacturing of next-generation optical transceivers (800G, 1. 6T, and beyond). You will build and scale manufacturing software infrastructure that drives yield, test, calibration, and production efficiency for our photonics manufacturing ecosystem. 

This is a critical leadership role at the intersection of software, manufacturing, and hardware systems. You will define and implement frameworks supporting end-to-end production-from wafer-level test and module assembly to system validation-ensuring high yield, reliability, and throughput at scale. 

The ideal candidate has deep experience in manufacturing software, test automation, and production systems in semiconductor, optical transceiver, or high-performance hardware environments, with a strong record supporting hyperscale customer deployments. 

Key Responsibilities

Manufacturing Software Strategy & Execution

- Define and lead the software roadmap for manufacturing systems supporting optical transceivers and photonic devices
 - Architect scalable test, calibration, and data infrastructure for new product introduction (NPI) and high-volume manufacturing (HVM)
 - Drive software solutions for wafer probe, module test, system-level validation, and final test
 - Ensure seamless integration with MES systems and factory automation platforms

Yield, Test & Production Optimization

- Develop software frameworks to improve yield, throughput, and cycle time across manufacturing lines
 - Lead implementation of data-driven yield analysis, failure detection, and root cause methodologies
 - Build and deploy automated test and calibration systems for optical modules, including DSP tuning and optical alignment
 - Partner with manufacturing and quality teams to reduce escapes, improve reliability, and optimize cost

Hyperscaler & Production Readiness

- Ensure manufacturing software meets the scale, quality, and traceability requirements of hyperscale customers
 - Support customer qualifications, audits, and production ramp readiness
 - Implement robust telemetry, logging, and traceability systems
 - Drive alignment between internal manufacturing systems and customer validation environments

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Partner closely with photonics, ASIC, hardware, systems, and operations teams to enable manufacturable product designs
 - Support NPI to HVM transitions with robust, production-ready software systems
 - Interface with foundries, OSATs, and contract manufacturers to standardize test and software infrastructure
 - Collaborate with supply chain and operations to ensure capacity and scalability

Organizational Leadership & Team Building

- Build, lead, and scale a high-performing software manufacturing and test engineering team
 - Establish best practices in software development, release management, and manufacturing deployment
 - Drive a culture of operational excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement
 - Mentor engineers across software, test, and manufacturing domains

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or advanced degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
 - 15+ years of experience in software engineering with significant focus on manufacturing, test, or production systems
 - 5+ years of leadership experience managing engineering teams
 - Strong background in manufacturing software, test automation, and production systems for semiconductor, photonics, or hardware products
 - Proven experience supporting NPI to HVM, including yield ramp and production scaling
 - Experience working with contract manufacturers, OSATs, and/or global manufacturing partners
 - Strong programming experience (Python, C/C++, or similar) for automation, test, and data systems
 - Deep understanding of manufacturing KPIs: yield, throughput, cycle time, cost, and quality
 - Experience with MES systems, data pipelines, and manufacturing analytics

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with optical transceivers (QSFP, QSFP-DD, OSFP) and high-speed modules (400G, 800G, 1. 6T)
 - Background in silicon photonics, advanced packaging, or optical module manufacturing
 - Experience building factory automation systems and test infrastructure at scale
 - Familiarity with DSP-based systems, calibration flows, and optical performance tuning
 - Experience supporting hyperscalers or Tier 1 data center customers
 - Experience in fast-paced startup or high-growth environments

What we offer

- Competitive executive-level compensation, including meaningful equity participation
 - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
 - Opportunity to build and lead a critical engineering function at a rapidly scaling photonics company
 - Direct impact on next-generation AI and hyperscale infrastructure
 - Collaborative environment with world-class photonics and systems engineers

Automate and simplify all aspects of software delivery and development actively evangelizing the need to automate and simplify where needed.

Drive blameless postmortems culture to identify root causes of incidents and implement learnings

Introduce new technologies and architecture by following enterprise guidelines

Advocate for engineering principles outside of current organization/platform

Provide development and architecture guidance to team members

Build relationships and effective partnerships across organizations

Write and evaluate recommendations for job promotions based on an unbiased view of one's accomplishments

Lead by example with hands-on approaches to demonstrate engineering excellence

Encourage staff to share and seek knowledge within their Guild/Program to drive reuse of patterns/libraries/practices and enhance productivity

Has skills in building applications using open frameworks to achieve reuse and reduce development times (e. g. , Spring Boot, Angular, DXP, others)

Understands internals of operating systems (Windows, Linux) to write interoperable and performant code

Able to perform debugging and troubleshooting to analyze core, heap, thread dumps and remove coding errors

Has skills to document and coach team on the development practices and coding guidelines (e. g. , branching, peer reviews, library use, logging, scanning rules, test-driven development, error handling)

Understands use cases for advanced design patterns to implement efficient code

Has skills to undertake a technical review of code across applications and their dependencies to look for anti-patterns and promote continuous refactoring

Understands and elaborates technical debt and operational issues to drive prioritization discussions with stakeholders to improve the run experience

Has skills to simplify deployment and eliminate software and infrastructure snowflakes using standardized platforms, ephemeral instances, and automation

Has skills to orchestrate release workflows and pipelines and apply standardized pipelines via APIs to achieve CI and CD using industry-standard tools

Able to configure rules and build automation for code with vulnerability scanning and software composition analysis using standard tools

Has skills to define, organize, and report on test runs for major, minor, and hotfix releases (including unit, component level, system level, customer journeys, past customer issues, and regulatory controls)

Has skills to conduct various performance tests (e. g. , load, spike, breakpoint, endurance) to Understands application/service limits and behaviors

Actively integrates generative AI tools into day-to-day development workflows - leveraging AI-assisted code generation and code review to accelerate delivery while maintaining quality and security standards.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Senior AI & Full Stack Software Engineer - Cloud & AI Accelerator Team

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

We are looking for an AI & Full Stack Software Engineer to join our newly established Cloud & AI Accelerator team. 

The team focuses on helping accelerate high-impact and strategic initiatives across SimCorp. We work where we believe we can create the most value - helping shape new solutions, explore opportunities enabled by AI and cloud technologies, and support important business initiatives that require speed, innovation, and strong engineering foundations. Our focus is where we can create the biggest impact, and we value engineers who thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy solving new challenges. 

You will work across the full stack using technologies such as Azure, . NET, TypeScript, and Angular, while collaborating closely with engineers, architects, UX designers, and business stakeholders across SimCorp. 

AI will play an important role both in what we build and how we build. We actively explore modern engineering practices and AI-assisted development workflows, including tools such as Claude Code, to support experimentation, learning, and developer productivity. 

We value people who care deeply about creating meaningful solutions - not only from a technical perspective, but also from a user and business perspective. We are looking for curious, creative, and collaborative engineers who want to help shape both products and ways of working. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

You will be using multiple technologies, and your responsibilities will also include: 

- Help explore how AI can improve user experiences, workflows, and engineering productivity. 
 - Build AI agents for and in collaboration with different business domains
 - Design, develop, test, and maintain AI agents & modern cloud-based applications across the full stack. 
 - Collaborate closely with other engineers, product stakeholders, UX designers, and architects to shape solutions that solve real user problems. 
 - Contribute to frontend and backend development using technologies such as . NET, TypeScript, and Angular. 
 - Participate in discovery, experimentation, and iterative product development. 
 - Build scalable and maintainable solutions with a strong focus on quality, testing, and operational excellence. 

What We Value

We imagine your profile looks something like this: 

- You are passionate about AI and have some experience implementing AI agents
 - You have experience as a software engineer working with both frontend and backend technologies. 
 - You have experience with modern frontend development using frameworks such as Angular and TypeScript. Experience with React or similar frontend frameworks is also valuable. 
 - You have experience with C#, . NET, and cloud-based development. 
 - You are interested in modern engineering practices, cloud technologies, and AI-assisted development. 
 - You enjoy collaborating with others, sharing ideas, and contributing to a positive engineering culture. 
 - You thrive in environments where we learn and adapt as we go, and where creativity, initiative, and experimentation are encouraged. 
 - Experience with Angular, Azure, distributed systems, micro frontends, or investment management workflows is a plus, but not required. 
 - We know that great candidates rarely match every single point perfectly. Most importantly, we are looking for people who are motivated by learning, improving, and building meaningful products together with the team. 

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy - Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days. 
 - Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application. 
 - Self-Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work. 
 - Inclusive and diverse company culture 
 - Work-life balance - We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace
 - Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. 

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Nearly 75, 000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations. 

Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us. 

Job Description

At Freshworks, we don't just ship software-we shape it to be fast, reliable, and refreshingly simple. As a Staff Full Stack Engineer (IC4), you will architect the end-to-end systems that drive our global SaaS products, balancing complex distributed backend infrastructure with highly responsive, scalable frontend applications. You will lead cross-functional technical strategies, champion engineering excellence across teams, and mentor engineers to level up our entire platform ecosystem. 

If you obsess over time and space complexity, love breaking down tough, multi-tier architectural problems, and take pride in leading technical execution without losing touch with the code-you'll feel right at home. 

Impact You Can Create

- E2E Platform Evolution: Own and scale foundational full-stack architectures capable of handling millions of transactions while delivering seamless, high-performance web experiences globally. 

- Technical Guidance (IC4): Act as a technical compass across multiple engineering tracks, translating ambiguous product visions into resilient, modular high-level and low-level designs. 

- Engineering Multiplier: Foster a culture of excellence by leading deep-dive code reviews, mentoring junior/mid-level systems engineers, and introducing modern architectural patterns. 

- AI-Powered Efficiency: Pioneer the integration of modern AI tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot) into the daily full-stack development workflow to accelerate delivery without sacrificing technical depth. 

Roles & Responsibilities (R&R)

- Full-Stack Architecture: Architect, build, and maintain scalable backend microservices and extensible REST APIs paired with intuitive, modular frontend application layers. 

- Full Lifecycle Ownership: Own the entire software development lifecycle-from gathering functional/non-functional requirements and data modeling to deployment, automation, and production support. 

- Code & Design Optimization: Write clean, modular, and testable code optimized for browser rendering efficiency, database execution performance, and space/time complexity. 

- Production Governance: Ensure backend and frontend systems are tuned for high availability (99. 99%+), multi-tenant fault tolerance, security compliance, and deep observability. 

- Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with Product Managers, UI/UX designers, and Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) to ship highly localized, value-driven capabilities fast. 

- Root-Cause Analysis: Troubleshoot complex full-stack performance bottlenecks in production, from slow database queries to state-management memory leaks. 

- Mentorship & Best Practices: Lead architectural reviews, establish development roadmaps, mentor 2-4 engineers, and actively drive OOPS and SOLID design principles across the org. 

Qualifications

Skills

- Computer Science Foundations: Expert-level grasp of Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA), time/space complexity trade-offs, and Object-Oriented Design (OOD) anchored in SOLID principles. 

- System Design (HLD & LLD): Proven capability to design scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant end-to-end multi-tenant systems, including APIs, web architectures, schemas, and data models. 

- Distributed Infrastructure Stack: Solid exposure to RDBMS, NoSQL, caching strategies, microservices architecture, and distributed queuing systems. 

- Modern Web Ecosystems: Strong understanding of frontend engineering paradigms, including component lifecycles, state management, and client-side performance optimization. 

- Cloud & DevOps Practice: Hands-on experience working with CI/CD automation pipelines, DevOps tooling, and cloud infrastructure platforms (AWS or GCP). 

- AI Tool Fluency: Practical exposure and experience using generative AI tools to improve day-to-day coding efficiency and technical exploration. 

- Technical Communication: Exceptional logical reasoning with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical thought processes and designs to both engineers and executives. 

Qualifications

- Professional Timeline: 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience building and scaling full-stack applications in high-growth product teams. 

- Iterative Sourcing History: A proven track record of building complex systems from scratch and steering them through multiple scale iterations in production. 

- Pragmatic Delivery: Skilled at balancing rapid feature delivery with long-term code maintainability, clean documentation, and scalability. 

- Collaborative Leadership: Experience managing technical initiatives, coordinating cross-functional engineering loops, and mentoring other engineers. 

- Education Baseline: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative technical field. 

Additional Information

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.

data.title: Senior Quality Engineer
data.description:
We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented Software Engineer in Quality Assurance (Automation) to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of building and scaling our test automation ecosystem - owning quality end-to-end, from test design to continuous delivery pipelines. You'll work closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps to ensure our products are robust, reliable, and release-ready at all times. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build & maintain scalable automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, and TestNG. 
 - Own test strategy for assigned squads - defining scope, coverage, and risk from requirements through production. 
 - Write BDD feature files (Gherkin) to enable collaboration between QA, Dev, and Product stakeholders. 
 - Implement TDD practices - writing tests before or alongside code to drive quality in development cycles. 
 - Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar) for continuous feedback. 
 - Perform API testing and validate end-to-end user journeys across web and services. 
 - Identify, document & triage defects with clear reproduction steps, severity classification, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Mentor junior QA engineers and champion quality best practices across the engineering org. 
 - Continuously evaluate test health, flakiness, and coverage gaps - iterating to keep automation suite trustworthy. 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have Skills

- 3+ years of hands-on experience in QA automation in a product engineering environment. 
 - Strong proficiency with Selenium WebDriver - page object model, explicit waits, cross-browser testing. 
 - Solid experience with Cucumber (BDD) - writing and maintaining feature files, step definitions, and hooks. 
 - Hands-on with TestNG - test configuration, data providers, listeners, parallel execution, and reporting. 
 - Working knowledge of TDD principles and integrating tests into agile development workflows. 
 - Proficiency in at least one programming language - Java or Python preferred. 
 - Experience with CI/CD integration and running tests in automated pipelines. 
 - Strong analytical thinking with an eye for edge cases, boundary conditions, and failure modes. 
 - Excellent communication skills - ability to clearly articulate test findings to technical and non-technical audiences. 

Nice to Have

- Domain knowledge in Payments - understanding of payment flows, gateways, settlement, reconciliation, or fraud systems. 
 - Experience testing APIs with tools like Postman, RestAssured, or similar. 
 - Familiarity with performance / load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, k6). 
 - Exposure to cloud testing environments (Sauce Labs, BrowserStack, AWS Device Farm). 
 - Knowledge of security testing basics relevant to financial or transactional systems. 
 - Experience with mobile automation (Appium or similar). 

The Mindset We Value

Beyond technical skills, we hire for how you think and operate: 

- Ownership mindset - you treat quality as your personal responsibility, not a sign-off gate. You proactively identify risks, flag issues early, and see bugs as a systemic problem to solve. 
 - Shift-left thinking - you involve yourself in requirements and design discussions, not just execution phase. 
 - Bias for automation - if something is tested manually more than twice, you ask how to automate it. 
 - Collaborative - you work with developers as partners, not adversaries, and build shared ownership of quality. 
 - Continuous improvement - you regularly revisit your frameworks and practices, improving coverage, speed, and reliability. 

Location: Mumbai - UI, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

data.description:
Job Description

Role: Senior Software Developer Engineer in Test

Location: Bangalore

About MiQ

MiQ is a global programmatic media partner for brands and agencies, combining data, AI-driven technology, and expert teams to deliver smarter advertising outcomes. Our engineering teams build the platforms, intelligence products, and automation that power programmatic campaigns at scale. 

About The Role

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer in Test (SDET) to embed directly within a product squad and own end-to-end test strategy for a critical vertical. This is not a siloed QA role - you'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with developers from design through release, shaping testability early, building and maintaining automation, and giving the team confidence to ship fast without compromising quality. 

What You'll Do

- Define and own the end-to-end test strategy for new and existing services, starting from requirements and design through to release sign-off. 
 - Identify and prioritize P0/P1 critical test scenarios, ensure comprehensive coverage, and drive manual and automated test execution - with a strong emphasis on deep, domain-aware manual testing of complex business workflows, not just scripted checks. 
 - Design and execute exploratory and manual test cases for data-heavy, multi-step business scenarios (e. g. , campaign/order lifecycle, pricing, reconciliation) where domain nuance materially affects correctness. 
 - Build, maintain, and scale automated test suites (UI, API, and integration) using modern tools such as Cypress, Selenium, Playwright, or REST Assured. 
 - Partner with developers to get test scenarios automated and integrated into CI/CD pipelines, enabling parallel test execution and fast feedback loops. 
 - Champion shift-left testing - flag testability and design concerns early, before code reaches production. 
 - Work as an embedded member of an engineering squad (not a separate QA function), participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and design reviews. 
 - Reduce test flakiness and continuously improve confidence in continuous testing / CI pipelines. 
 - Track and report test coverage, release quality metrics, and defect trends to stakeholders. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis on production issues and feed learnings back into test strategy and automation. 
 - Mentor engineers on testing best practices and help raise the overall quality bar across the team. 

What you'll bring

- 8+ years of experience in software testing, with strong hands-on exposure to both manual and automation testing (UI, API, and database/backend) - manual testing depth and domain understanding are weighted as a must skill for this role. 
 - Proven ability to translate business/domain rules into thorough manual test cases and catch edge cases that automation alone would miss, particularly in data- or workflow-heavy systems. 
 - Proficiency in Java (or another OOP language) and SQL, with solid experience building and maintaining test automation frameworks
 - Hands-on expertise with automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, REST Assured, or Karate, and BDD frameworks like Cucumber. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins or equivalent) and working with version control (Git) and issue tracking (JIRA). 
 - Demonstrated ability to define a test strategy from scratch for a new service or capability, including defining P1 scenario coverage. 
 - Experience working as an embedded tester within a cross-functional engineering squad, rather than a separate/siloed QA team. 
 - Strong analytical and debugging skills, with experience performing root-cause analysis on production defects. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum delivery practices. 
 - Prior experience in a domain-heavy industry (e. g. , payments, banking/finance, telecom, insurance, supply chain, or e-commerce) is strongly preferred. 

We've highlighted some key skills, experience and requirements for this role. But please don't worry if you don't meet every single one. Our talent team strives to find the best people. They might see something in your background that's a fit for this role, or another opportunity at MiQ. 

If you have a passion for the role, please still apply. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with performance/load testing tools (e. g. , JMeter). 
 - Exposure to GenAI-assisted testing - using tools like GitHub Copilot, Claude, or ChatGPT to accelerate test case design, script generation, or test maintenance. 
 - Experience building reusable test automation utilities/libraries adopted across teams. 
 - Familiarity with reducing flakiness and improving reliability of continuous testing pipelines at scale. 

What's in it for you?

Our Center of Excellence is the very heart of MiQ, and it's where the magic happens. It means everything you do and everything you create will have a huge impact across our entire global business. 

MiQ is incredibly proud to foster a welcoming culture. We do everything possible to make sure everyone feels valued for what they bring. With global teams committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, we're always moving towards becoming an even better place to work. 

Values

Our values are so much more than statements. They unite MiQers in every corner of the world. They shape the way we work and the decisions we make. And they inspire us to stay true to ourselves and to aim for better. Our values are there to be embraced by everyone, so that we naturally live and breathe them. Just like inclusivity, our values flow through everything we do - no matter how big or small. 

- We do what we love - Passion
 - We figure it out - Determination
 - We anticipate the unexpected - Agility
 - We always unite - Unite
 - We dare to be unconventional - Courage

Benefits

Every region and office have specific perks and benefits, but every person joining MiQ can expect: 

- A hybrid work environment
 - New hire orientation with job specific onboarding and training
 - Internal and global mobility opportunities
 - Competitive healthcare benefits
 - Bonus and performance incentives
 - Generous annual PTO paid parental leave, with two additional paid days to acknowledge holidays, cultural events, or inclusion initiatives. 
 - Employee resource groups designed to connect people across all MiQ regions, drive action, and support our communities. 

Apply today!

Equal Opportunity Employer

- We are building a highly resilient, scalable, and world-class SaaS-based Warehouse Management System (WMS) using modern technologies. 
 - To achieve this, We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer to strengthen our QA capabilities. 
 - This role is ideal for someone who believes in building quality early and driving automation-first testing practices. 

What You'll Do

- Design, develop, and execute test strategies, test plans, and test cases for complex enterprise applications. 
 - Develop and maintain automation test suites using Robot Framework (mandatory). 
 - Perform API testing (functional and integration level) using appropriate tools and frameworks. 
 - Contribute to regression, integration, and end-to-end automation coverage. 
 - Collaborate closely with developers, product owners, and DevOps teams to identify, track, and resolve defects. 
 - Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and sprint-level quality activities. 
 - Analyze test results, identify risks, and provide clear quality insights to stakeholders. 
 - Continuously improve QA processes, tools, and automation frameworks. 

What We Are Looking For

- B. E / B. Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related engineering discipline. 
 - 4-7 years of experience in Software Quality Assurance with strong hands-on ownership. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Robot Framework for test automation (mandatory). 
 - Experience with FitNesse or Playwright
 - Solid understanding of API testing concepts and validation techniques. 
 - Exposure to at least one programming or scripting language (Python, Java, or similar). 
 - Strong knowledge of test design techniques, defect lifecycle, and QA best practices. 
 - Working experience with SQL for backend data validation. 
 - Experience working in Agile development environments

Good To Have Skills

- Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution. 
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP. 
 - Exposure to Supply Chain / Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) or related domains. 

Our Values

If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success - and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Job Description

If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.title: FH Engineering
data.description:
Job Purpose

To plan, direct, monitor and control all engineering activities and facilitate unit in achieving all business objectives related to safety, quality, cost and productivity. To standardize system, upgrade equipment, improve Process, People technical competency and skills, collaborate with various functions within unit and central team. To conceptualize, design, plan and analyze budget for existing and future capex projects. To do this by following all Statutory and related Compliances. 

Job Context & Major Challenges

Job Context: The global Aluminium market is valued at USD 87. 84 billion in 2021 and is expected to grow 7. 5 % (CAGR) from 2022 to 2030. Increase in demand for lightweight and durable extruded products is driving the growth. Top aluminum extruders are investing and creating tough competition. 

This plant is first of its kind, across the globe to have mill finish, anodized, powder coated, fabricated products manufactured under one roof. The profiles developed and manufactured are highly complex in nature, having critical die design, challenging operations, involve highly skilled technicians, special machinery and processes. This unit has two 8-inch press with a capacity of 16KT per annum, anodizing 2. 5 KT per annum, powder coating 3. 2KT per annum along with various fabrication machinery like manual and robotic welding, CNC cutting & machining centers, Flaring & collaring, assembly lines serving for Building & construction (38%) , industrial (41%), Exports (11%), Automotive (7%), and solar segments (3%). 

This unit is increasing its business in automated warehouse system, premium anodizing finish products (exports). Solar energy and automotive (domestic) segments by increasing utilization of existing facility with additional shifts, setting up new fabrication facility, additional anodizing tanks and a brand-new extrusion press. 

Job Challenges: The job demands extensive planning and detailed work scheduling of contracts, close coordination between all contractors, detailed engineering consultants, on site management at Kuppam, absorption of Technology monitoring & control of project costs, and ensure compliance to budget. Management of Safety will be a top most priority during the construction phase, with large contract workforce. 

This job demands in-depth understanding of all critical operating requirements and to lead a highly technical competent team in Engineering and Projects involving selection of right skills and developing right mindset for managing engineering activities of a world class Aluminium extrusion and value add Centre. This requires formation of core engineering team with internal and external recruitment for upcoming expansions. A cohesive high performing and delivery focused team would be crucial success factor. 

As Engineering head must have desired sensitivity to anticipate the different risk plant could face & to prepare risk mitigation strategy. The job demands an understanding of the Statutory needs. 

Key Result Areas

KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)

KRA1 Standardize Engineering system & practices Develop and continuously update engineering management framework. 

Audit engineering function and identify gaps and develop opportunities. 

Support unit in best practices adoption. 

Facilitate horizontal replication of best practices. 

Monitoring engineering planning functions across unit and mentoring engineering planners. 

Keep track of digital initiatives and enable horizontal deployment based on performance. 

KRA2 Incorporate world class engineering activities

- Drive and institutionalize RCM (Reliability centered Maintenance) as a concept and roll down across unit. 
 - MIS & reporting
 - Major plant shutdown - institute proper planning and scheduling so that time and costs are adhered to as well as completion of scheduled tasks. Embedding reliability culture through training and mentioning of engineering workforce. 

Facilitating and reviewing the reliability improvement projects. 

Driving specific reliability improvement projects for engineering department. 

Facilitating and reviewing reliability improvement project. 

Develop KRA dashboard for monitoring plant engineering

Issue guidelines for KRA calculation and reporting. 

Analyze major shutdown during year on key parameters of time, cost, rework and activity compliance. 

Facilitate process improvement. 

KRA3 Cost Management

- Maintain various operational costs at P&B levels through efforts to control and improve fuel oil, power, consumables and raw materials efficiencies. 
 - Plan, recommend and control the engineering budget. Review the operating parameters & Practices of Departments to ensure efficiencies are as per plan. Coordinate interaction between engineering, production planning and Departments to achieve targeted efficiencies. 

Review of inventory levels of spare parts materials by coordinating with materials function. 

Prepare & finalize budget for operating supplies and contractor manpower. 

Approve, monitor, and control each consumption as per budget. Review actual expenses monthly against planned. 

KRA4 Manpower Development

- Select, Train, Develop and Motivate all employees to provide continuous availability to competent and motivated workforce to meet current and future challenges
 - Maintain harmonious industrial relations for a congenial & productive working environment by formulating & ensuring implementation of proper IR processes along with HR function. Develop training plan in line with the objective of meeting the requirements of the extrusion Business Scenario and create a platform for conductive work culture. 

Finalise a performance objective for employees and review the same. 

Conduct Performance Appraisal & Provide feedback to subordinates. 

Identify Potential Employees and mentor them to develop succession line. 

Recognise good performances and motivate department and operating teams. 

Communicate about the vision of the unit and prepare employees for change through suitable initiatives. 

Identification of training needs, recommendation of training for engineers, supervisors and workmen. 

Interact and actively provide support to HR function in manpower planning and IR issues. 

Handling of grievances and Disciplinary Cases. 

Kra5 Safety

Direct, Monitor and Ensure implementation of all safety procedures to ensure accident-free working environment and compliance of factory and environment related requirements. Guide Departments to identify aspects and impacts and risks and hazard related to all process in the plant. 

Plan & review of environment management programs. 

Monitor safety procedures laid out are strictly followed by the operating teams. 

Analyse accidents if any and direct preventive and corrective actions. 

Ensure that Departments identify near misses and unsafe conditions and practices to make a robust prevention system.

data.title: Tech Team Lead- Adobe Workfront / Fusion
data.description:
Unleash Your Potential at L'Oréal's Beauty Tech!

Who Are We?

For 115 years, L'Oréal, the world's leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world. 

For more than a century, L'Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L'Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty. 

Today, L'Oréal includes more than 2, 000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future. 

Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L'Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure. 

A Day in the Life of Tech Team Lead- Adobe Workfront / Fusion!

L'Oreal is deploying Adobe Workfront globally as the core Operating System for its Content Adaptation Factories. As the Tech Team Lead, you will head the engineering unit responsible for both platform configuration (Workfront Core) and automation/integrations (Workfront Fusion). You will manage, coach, and mentor a team of developers, establish engineering best practices, govern the technical architecture of the global instance, and ensure delivery of high-performing, secure, and scalable solutions connecting Workfront to L'Oreal's Content Tech ecosystem - including OpenText DAM. 

In this role, You will. . 

Be Responsible For The Following

Team Management & Technical Leadership

- Manage, mentor, and grow a hybrid team of Workfront Core Developers and Fusion Integration Developers. 
 - Define sprint planning, allocate resources, conduct code/scenario reviews, and maintain delivery velocity in an Agile environment. 
 - Foster a collaborative, continuous-learning engineering culture focused on clean architecture and operational excellence. 
 - Conduct regular 1-on-1s, performance reviews, and drive individual development plans for each team member. 

Architecture Governance

- Serve as the technical authority for the global Workfront instance - defining master configuration blueprints and metadata models. 
 - Oversee end-to-end integration architecture: Fusion scenarios, custom API webhooks, data synchronisation with DAM/PIM. 
 - Establish and enforce environment management (Sandbox to Production) and release management protocols. 
 - Define and maintain coding/configuration standards, naming conventions, and review checklists for the team. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner with the Global Workfront Product Manager, Business Analysts, and brand/market stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical roadmaps. 
 - Collaborate with L'Oreal's Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, and Identity Management teams for compliance with global IT standards. 
 - Act as the technical point of contact for Programme Orchestra stakeholders

Performance & Incident Management

- Act as L4 escalation point for critical system outages, API failures, or configuration conflicts. 
 - Proactively monitor system health, API limits, and Fusion scenario execution performance. 
 - Drive post-incident reviews and implement preventive measures. 

What are we looking for?

Workfront Core - Deep Technical Skills

- Advanced Text Mode mastery for complex custom reporting, views, groupings, filters, and collection-based queries (including nested EXISTS statements). 
 - Expert-level Calculated Custom Fields using Workfront formula functions (string manipulation, date math, logical conditions, system wildcards). 
 - Dynamic Custom Forms: multi-tier cascading dropdowns, field skip-logic, section visibility rules, cross-object data mapping. 
 - Workfront Proof (ProofHQ): proofing decision routing, automated workflow templates with multi-stage deadlines, proof role permissions. 
 - Resource Management: Resource Planner, Workload Balancer, Job Roles, Billing Rate Cards, Cost/Revenue tracking. 
 - Enterprise Security: hierarchical Access Levels, Layout Templates, System Preferences, data partitioning via Companies, Divisions, Groups, and Teams in a multi-brand global setup. 
 - Direct experience with the Workfront REST API (v15+) for bulk updates, search queries, and schema exploration. 

Workfront Fusion - Integration Skills

- Scenario architecture and optimisation for high-volume, low-latency execution. 
 - Advanced data processing with Aggregators, Iterators, Routers, Filters, and JSON schema-based Data Structures. 
 - Enterprise error handling using Fusion directives (Commit, Rollback, Resume, Ignore, Break). 
 - Custom connector development using Fusion DevTool / Apps SDK and raw HTTP requests for systems without native connectors. 
 - Data Store management for state caching, sync deduplication, and data buffering. 
 - Workfront Event Subscriptions (Webhooks) with filtering parameters for real-time automation. 

Leadership & Domain Knowledge

- 3-5 years managing engineering or platform development teams. 
 - Strong Agile delivery experience: sprint ceremonies (Scrum/Kanban), backlog management, velocity tracking. Jira or Azure DevOps proficiency. 
 - Understanding of creative production lifecycles, content adaptation workflows, localisation processes, or agency ecosystems. 
 - Fluent professional English (written and spoken). French is a strong asset. 

Certifications

- Required: Adobe Certified Professional - Workfront Fusion APIs and Integrations. 
 - Required: Adobe Certified Professional - Workfront System Administrator. 
 - Note: Candidates without both certifications may be considered if they demonstrate equivalent depth during the technical interview. Certification must then be obtained within 6 months of joining. 

Nice to Have

- Full-stack background: JavaScript, Python, or SQL for advanced Fusion scripting or BI reporting. 
 - Identity management: SSO, SAML 2. 0, automated user provisioning (SCIM / Azure AD / Okta) into Workfront. 
 - Experience with DAM platforms (OpenText, AEM Assets) and metadata taxonomy design. 
 - Prior experience in a Global Capability Center or offshore delivery model. 

What's In It for You?

- Working with cutting edge Technology, empowering employees with new age learning, global exposure, and opportunities to build future-ready careers. 
 - A flexible and modern workplace, enabling teams to perform at their best through a smart hybrid model that supports balance and autonomy. A 3 Day in Office, 2 Day Work from Home setup. 
 - Employee support at every life stage, with inclusive and progressive parental policies that help individuals and families thrive. 
 - Holistic wellbeing offerings - personalized health benefits and strong mental wellness support to ensure employees feel their best. 
 - Reward and Recognition opportunities, long-term incentives, and opportunities to share in L'Oréal's collective success. 
 - L'Oreal is an Equal Opportunity Employer and takes pride in a diverse environment

Good to know: The Recruitment Process

- Interview with HR
 - Technical Interview
 - Interview with the hiring manager

We would love to find out more about you as a candidate and we do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices. The beauty we find in our differences gives us the freedom to go beyond. That's the beauty of L'Oréal.

HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2, 500 of the world's most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what's next. 

Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills. 

People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards. 

About The Role

As an Engineering Manager on the Assessment Platform team, you will lead the technical vision and execution for the systems that power the assessments on HackerRank. This includes giving candidates the ability to work on a real world application running on dedicated VMs with an online ADE built by HackerRank. Doing this for concurrencies of up to 100K candidates is a very interesting technical challenge. You will also partner with product teams across HackerRank to embed these solutions into every product, drive the team's roadmap, and build a high-performing, growth-oriented team that delivers scalable, resilient systems. 

What You Will Do

- Own the vision and roadmap for assessment platform, working closely with Product to shape priorities. 
 - Architect systems that reliably handle 100k+ concurrent users. 
 - Own delivery commitments and run the team's day-to-day execution using agile practices. 
 - Ensure operational excellence: reliability, incident response, security and privacy. 
 - Hire, mentor and grow engineers, and set clear career paths for each team member. 
 - Define how the team uses AI tools in development to improve quality and speed. 
 - Partner with Product, infrastructure and Security teams. 

Who You Are

- 8+ years of software development experience, including 3+ years leading engineering teams. 
 - Strong experience designing highly available, scalable, fault-tolerant, secure distributed systems and large-scale web services. 
 - Strong technical leadership, with the ability to drive critical architecture discussions. 
 - Proven record of hiring, leading and mentoring technical teams and managing stakeholder expectations. 
 - Hands-on proficiency in at least one of Go, Python, Ruby or Node. js
 - Strong hands-on proficiency in at least one of AWS or GCP. 
 - Clear communicator who thrives in fast-paced, evolving environments. 

Even better if you have

- Experience building or scaling cloud IDEs, remote dev environments, or online coding platforms, with a developer-first mindset. 
 - Hands-on depth in containers, Kubernetes, and on-demand VM or sandboxed compute at scale. 
 - A track record of load testing, autoscaling, and capacity planning for spiky, event-driven traffic. 
 - Experience driving AI-assisted development practices across an engineering team. 

You will thrive in this role if you

- Enjoy balancing hands-on technical contributions with people leadership. 
 - Think strategically about long-term platform scalability while delivering short-term results. 
 - Comfortable operating in fast-paced, evolving environments. 
 - Take ownership end-to-end from roadmap definition to execution and team growth.
