Job Description

The Opportunity

- Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare. 
 - Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products. 
 - Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats. 

Our Technology centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of the company IT operating model, Tech centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy. 

A focused group of leaders in each tech center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers. 

Role Overview

As a SAP Test Engineer, you will ensure the quality and functionality of software by meticulously designing and executing test cases. You will identify and document software defects, collaborate with developers to resolve issues, and contribute to the continuous improvement of testing processes. This role involves both manual and automated testing, requiring strong technical skills, SAP knowledge and attention to detail. You will play a crucial part in delivering reliable and robust software products to users. 

What Will You Do In This Role

- Develop detailed test plans and cases based on thorough analysis of SAP software requirements, functional specifications, and user stories. 
 - Conduct various types of testing, including functional, regression, integration, system and security role based, to ensure SAP software meets all specified criteria. 
 - Execute automated test scripts and analyze results to identify defects or issues in Enterprise applications. 
 - Perform manual testing for complex scenarios that cannot be automated. 
 - Identify, document, and track software defects. Collaborate closely with developers to reproduce issues, troubleshoot problems, and validate bug fixes, ensuring clear communication of testing requirements and outcomes. 
 - Identify, document, and report software defects using bug tracking tools. Ensure detailed and accurate documentation of testing activities and outcomes. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis for any issues identified during testing and develop corrective action plans. 
 - Develop and maintain automated test scripts to improve testing efficiency and repeatability. Utilize tools such as TOSCA or other automated testing frameworks. 
 - Attend product design and requirements review meetings to provide insights and feedback from a testing perspective. Highlight potential issues and propose improvements. 
 - Perform post-release and post-implementation testing to validate that all requirements and specifications have been met. Ensure software remains stable and functional after deployment. 
 - Contribute to the improvement of testing processes, tools, and methodologies. Stay updated with the latest testing techniques and industry trends. 

What Should You Have

- Primary skills- SAP modules (like SAP FI, CO, Tax, MM, SD, QM, PM, PP, WM, EWM, ARIBA, Concur, Fieldglass, SAP Cloud Commerce, ATTP - Serialization, etc. ), Experience with SAP APIs, SAP BTP / Integration Suite and Integration testing, Experience with SOAP, Rest, IDOC, ODATA Integration Testing. 
 - Secondary skills- S4 hana, JIRA XRAY
 - Bachelors' degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or any Technology stream. 
 - 5+ years of experience in SAP testing, preferably in a pharmaceutical environment, quality assurance, or related fields. 
 - Proven experience with different SAP modules (like SAP FI, CO, Tax, MM, SD, QM, PM, PP, WM, EWM, ARIBA, Concur, Fieldglass, SAP Cloud Commerce, ATTP - Serialization, etc. ) and their functionalities is required. Prior experience with S/4 HANA would be advantageous. 
 - Experience with SAP APIs, SAP BTP / Integration Suite and Integration testing. 
 - Experience with SOAP, Rest, IDOC, ODATA Integration Testing. 
 - Proven experience with SDLC in the pharmaceutical industry required. 
 - Involvement in SAP implementation or upgrade projects, particularly in testing roles is required. 
 - Proven experience in various testing methodologies such as Manual Testing, Automated Testing, Performance Testing, and Load Testing required. 
 - Knowledge of programming languages like ABAP (Advanced Business Application Programming) can be beneficial for understanding the backend processes. 
 - Proven experience with testing tools and frameworks (e. g. JIRA, XRAY, TOSCA, LiveCompare Analytics, HP ALM, Load Runner) required. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Effective communication and interpersonal skills to liaise with cross-functional teams. 
 - Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities. 
 - Certifications in quality assurance, application management, project management and testing are preferred, such as ITSQB (such as Certified Tester or Advanced Test Manager), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Agile Tester Certification (CAT), Certified Software Tester (CSTE) or Quality Assurance and Testing (QAT), PMP, or other relevant certifications. 

Our technology teams operate as business partners, proposing ideas and innovative solutions that enable new organizational capabilities. We collaborate internationally to deliver services and solutions that help everyone be more productive and enable innovation.

Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us-and start making your impact today.

You will work closely with Firmware, Hardware, Systems Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and Hyperscale/Datacenter customers throughout the product lifecycle. The successful candidate must thrive in ambiguous environments, influence cross-functional teams, and drive complex technical initiatives with minimal direction.

- 14+ years of experience in Embedded Firmware development/validation or 10+ years of SSD FW Verification with strong firmware and hardware debugging expertise. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in debugging and driving complex issues to closure
 - Good understanding on NVMe and PCIe protocol including Cloud SSD specification
 - Good understanding on SSD/NAND architecture
 - Proven experience in defining test strategies, qualification methodologies, and validation plans covering: Host Interface layer (HIL), Flash Translation Layer (FTL), NAND Management, Error Handling and Recovery Flows, Power Loss Protection (PLP), Reliability and Endurance Validation
 - Extensive experience architecting Feature Validation Test (FVT) coverage for Garbage collection, Wear levelling, Bad block management and Error injections
 - Good to have experience in developing validation plans for AI-centric storage workloads including: Model Training, Checkpointing, KV Cache, Inference, Agentic AI Workloads
 - Experience in test development and coding in Python
 - Experience translating product requirements and customer use cases into scalable validation architectures, test plans, coverage matrices, and automation frameworks. 
 - Prior experience validating SSD firmware and storage solutions for Datacenter, Enterprise, AI Compute, and Hyperscale environments. 
 - Define, develop, and implement new validation methodologies, automation frameworks, and tools to improve test effectiveness, coverage, and execution efficiency. 
 - Drive feature-level risk assessments and ensure validation completeness through requirements traceability and coverage analysis. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, firmware, and system teams to influence product design for testability and quality. 
 - Lead root-cause investigations by analyzing protocol captures, firmware logs, telemetry data, system traces, and performance metrics. 
 - Drive critical issues to closure by interfacing with Firmware, ASIC, Hardware, Systems, Reliability, and Customer Engineering teams. 
 - Own and scale the test infrastructure, improving test repeatability and coverage to accelerate the qualification cycle for next-generation NAND technologies. 
 - Demonstrated experience of leading big initiatives spanning multiple teams and organizations and leveraging deep domain expertise to influence product roadmap
 - Passionate about exploring and deploying noble methods to improve coverage, debugging, and efficiency of our FW releases. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent. 
 - Good knowledge of NVMe, PCIe and Datacenter SSD specifications
 - Strong understanding of SSD and FW architecture. 
 - Strong understanding of end-to-end storage stack interactions, including: CPU, Memory, PCIe, NVMe, Drivers, Operating Systems, Firmware, Virtualisation Layers, AI Accelerators (GPU/TPU)
 - Deep understanding of Feature Validation methodologies, test architecture design, coverage modelling, qualification metrics, defect escape prevention, and validation sign-off criteria.

data.title: Manager Program Manager, Relay Operations Center Quality and Customer Experience, North America
data.description:
Description

Amazon's Relay Operations Center (ROC) is the execution backbone of North America's middle-mile transportation network-managing tens of millions of loads annually across a vast asset base. As we deploy an ambitious automation program that will fundamentally transform how carriers and drivers interact with our network, we need a results-driven Program Manager to ensure that speed never comes at the cost of experience. 

You will lead quality improvement cycles, drive customer experience (CX) metric adoption, and partner with operations, technology, and training teams to deliver measurable improvements in carrier and driver experience across NA ROC operations. This role requires you to think big, dive deep, and balance strategic planning with hands-on program execution. 

As Program Manager, ROC Quality & Customer Experience, you will serve as a strategic advisor to internal and external stakeholders while driving the adoption and engagement of ROC's quality and CX programs. You will be responsible for developing long-term OP planning inputs, contributing to the three-year vision, and building strategic roadmaps for quality and training. In addition to long-term strategic planning, you will partner closely with operations, workforce planning, learning partners, and technology teams to operationalize and deliver improvement initiatives at mid-term horizons. 

You will lead a diverse team across various levels and capabilities-program managers, quality analysts, and business analysts-to drive results for NA Transportation Operations. You will set and drive a culture of defect reduction through continuous improvement cycles, maintaining accountability across multiple business units to deliver large-scale, high-visibility projects. It is an exciting role where you will interact with Sr. Leaders (Directors and VPs) from different organizations across NA. 

Key job responsibilities

CX Metrics & Quality Improvement

- Own execution and continuous improvement of core CX metrics - TTR, PRR, FCR, and Repeat Rate - across automated and human-handled interactions
 - Drive quality defect reduction through closed-loop cycles: defect detection → root cause analysis → SOP update → training content → effectiveness validation
 - Support deployment of AI-powered quality monitoring (Contact Lens) to expand audit coverage and identify tone, clarity, and soft-skill gaps across voice transactions

Training & Operational Effectiveness

- Partner with L&D and workforce planning teams to operationalize training plans addressing quality gaps and automation readiness
 - Develop strategic roadmaps for quality and training, including OP planning inputs and three-year vision contributions
 - Lead continuous improvement initiatives that reduce defect rates through structured coaching frameworks and SOP standardization

Voice of Customer & Carrier Advocacy

Drive the Anecdotes Program - intake, 5-why investigation, closed-loop resolution, and systemic prevention of recurring carrier issues

- Partner with Relay Product, TTS, and Middle Mile teams to translate carrier feedback into actionable program improvements and roadmap priorities

Automation CX Readiness

- Conduct pre-launch CX impact assessments and 30/60/90-day post-launch audits for automation deployments, ensuring quality parity between automated and manual processes
 - Own case transfer governance and routing optimization, reducing unnecessary handoffs and improving first-contact resolution

Stakeholder Management & Reporting

- Present quality and CX insights in WBRs, MBRs, and QBRs to Director and Sr. leadership audiences, translating data into prioritized action plans
 - Lead a diverse team of program managers, quality analysts, and business analysts; partner cross-functionally with TTS Engineering, Relay Product, WFM, L&D, and PXT

A day in the life

You start your morning reviewing CX metrics dashboards and preparing a narrative update for a leadership review. By mid-morning, you are in a working session with Relay Product and Middle Mile partners, aligning on carrier feedback themes and roadmap priorities. After lunch, you hold a one-on-one with a direct report to discuss their development goals and review a quality audit proposal they have drafted. Later, you facilitate a post-launch CX readiness review for a recent automation deployment, diving into the details to ensure quality parity. You close the day by reviewing defect reduction trends across your portfolio and adjusting training plans with your Learning and Development partners. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
 - 2+ years of team management experience
 - 3+ years of program or project management experience
 - 
 - Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
 - 
 - Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
 - 
 - Experience working cross-functionally with tech and non-tech teams

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
 - 2+ years of cross functional project delivery experience
 - 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
 - 
 - 2+ years of supply chain or transportation operations experience
 - 
 - Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
 - 
 - Experience preparing quality metrics and effectively engaging with stakeholders to set and drive quality goals
 - 
 - Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design, or related field

Job Description - API Test Architect & Test Solution Lead

API Modernization | Microservices | Healthcare | Quality Engineering

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced API Test Architect & Solution Lead to lead the quality engineering strategy, architecture, and implementation for large-scale API modernization and microservices transformation programs within the healthcare domain. 

The role will be responsible for defining the end-to-end API testing architecture and modernization validation strategy for enterprise services being transformed from legacy/monolithic platforms into modern RESTful APIs and microservices. 

This is a customer-facing technical leadership role requiring strong expertise in API testing, test automation architecture, microservices, legacy-to-modern API parity validation, CI/CD integration, healthcare data validation, and AI-assisted Quality Engineering. 

The Solution Lead will work closely with enterprise architects, API developers, product owners, business teams, DevOps teams, and QA engineering teams to ensure modernized services meet functional, integration, data integrity, performance, security, and release-readiness requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

API Test Architecture & Solutioning

- Define the enterprise API Quality Engineering architecture, strategy, standards, and implementation roadmap for API modernization programs. 
 - Design scalable and reusable API automation frameworks supporting hundreds of APIs and thousands of test scenarios. 
 - Establish standardized testing approaches using Cucumber, TestNG, REST Assured, Gradle, Git/Bitbucket, Jenkins/Udeploy, and automated reporting. 
 - Define framework architecture with clear separation of: 
 - Test data
 - Test logic
 - Configuration
 - Validation utilities
 - Reporting
 - Environment management
 - Build reusable automation components, utilities, libraries, and common validation capabilities that can be adopted across multiple projects. 
 - Establish traceability across requirements → feature files → test data → automated execution → defects → results. 

API Modernization & Microservices Validation

- Lead testing strategy for migration of legacy enterprise services to REST APIs and microservices architecture. 
 - Define legacy-versus-modernized service parity testing to ensure business functionality and data behavior remain consistent during modernization. 
 - Establish baseline request/response datasets from legacy services and compare them against modernized API responses. 
 - Design automated comparison capabilities for: 
 - Request/response validation
 - JSON/XML payload comparison
 - Schema validation
 - Field-level comparison
 - Business-rule validation
 - Data transformation validation
 - Database/backend validation
 - Error and exception handling
 - Validate service decomposition and interactions across distributed microservices. 
 - Develop testing approaches for synchronous and asynchronous service integrations. 
 - Define regression strategies that allow modernization teams to continuously verify functional parity during incremental migration. 

API Functional & Integration Testing

- Define comprehensive API testing coverage including: 
 - Functional testing
 - Integration testing
 - Contract testing
 - Schema validation
 - Positive and negative testing
 - Boundary testing
 - Authentication and authorization validation
 - Error handling
 - Data integrity validation
 - Regression testing
 - End-to-end service validation
 - Establish API test scenarios based on OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, GraphQL schemas, interface contracts, business requirements, and legacy system documentation. 
 - Define reusable test-data strategies using Excel, generated datasets, synthetic data, and approved production-like samples. 
 - Drive automation-first testing while identifying scenarios requiring specialized or exploratory validation. 

Healthcare Domain Validation

- Provide Quality Engineering leadership for healthcare enterprise services supporting areas such as: 
 - Member and eligibility
 - Provider
 - Claims
 - Benefits
 - Enrollment
 - Accumulators
 - Authorization
 - Payments
 - Clinical and administrative integrations
 - Ensure modernization testing validates critical healthcare business rules and cross-system data integrity. 
 - Support testing of healthcare interoperability and data exchange services where applicable, including FHIR/HL7-based APIs and healthcare integration patterns. 
 - Ensure appropriate handling of sensitive healthcare test data and alignment with organizational security, privacy, and compliance requirements. 

Automation Framework Engineering

- Architect and enhance BDD-based API automation frameworks using: 
 - Cucumber
 - TestNG
 - REST Assured
 - Java
 - Gradle
 - Define reusable feature files, step definitions, API clients, assertion libraries, data utilities, and comparison utilities. 
 - Develop configurable validation mechanisms capable of supporting different APIs without extensive custom coding. 
 - Establish coding standards, framework governance, peer reviews, and reusable engineering patterns. 
 - Optimize automation suites for parallel execution, maintainability, stability, and faster regression cycles. 

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate API automation into Jenkins/Udeploy CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Define automated quality gates for builds and deployments. 
 - Enable API regression suites to execute across development, QA, integration, staging, and release environments. 
 - Establish mechanisms for: 
 - Pipeline-triggered execution
 - Environment configuration
 - Test-data management
 - Parallel execution
 - Failure diagnostics
 - Automated reporting
 - Partner with DevOps and engineering teams to enable continuous testing and shift-left quality engineering. 

Reporting & Quality Metrics

- Define enterprise-level API Quality Engineering reporting using: 
 - Cucumber Reports
 - JSON Reports
 - HTML Reports
 - Execution Logs
 - CI/CD dashboards
 - Establish metrics for: 
 - API automation coverage
 - Functional coverage
 - Regression coverage
 - Pass/fail trends
 - Defect leakage
 - Modernization parity
 - Execution stability
 - Release readiness
 - Provide technical insights and quality recommendations to engineering leadership and customer stakeholders. 

AI-Assisted Quality Engineering

- Drive adoption of GitHub Copilot and GenAI-assisted engineering across the API testing lifecycle. 
 - Use AI assistance for: 
 - Requirement and API specification analysis
 - Test scenario generation
 - Test case generation
 - Gherkin/feature-file generation
 - REST Assured automation development
 - Code refactoring
 - Test-data generation
 - Coverage-gap identification
 - Failure analysis
 - Leverage OpenAPI specifications, GraphQL schemas, legacy documentation, and existing test assets as inputs for AI-assisted test design. 
 - Define appropriate human review and governance practices for AI-generated test assets. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through intelligent automation and reusable accelerators. 

Technical Leadership & Customer Engagement

- Act as the technical solution lead and architecture point of contact for API Quality Engineering. 
 - Engage with customer stakeholders to understand modernization objectives, current-state architecture, quality risks, and target-state requirements. 
 - Translate business and technical requirements into testing architecture, solution approach, implementation roadmap, effort estimates, and delivery plans. 
 - Conduct architecture reviews and technical solution presentations with customers and engineering leadership. 
 - Lead technical discussions across development, architecture, DevOps, business, and QA teams. 
 - Mentor automation engineers and QA leads and provide technical direction across distributed teams. 
 - Identify testing risks, dependencies, technical constraints, and mitigation strategies early in the modernization lifecycle. 

Required Technical Skills

API & Microservices: REST APIs, RESTful services, Microservices Architecture, JSON, XML, OpenAPI/Swagger, GraphQL, API contracts, service integration patterns

API Automation: REST Assured, Cucumber BDD, TestNG, Java, Gradle

Framework Architecture: Reusable automation framework design, modular architecture, custom assertion utilities, schema validation, response comparison, test-data management

DevOps: Jenkins, Udeploy, Git, Bitbucket, CI/CD integration, continuous testing

Testing: API functional testing, integration testing, contract testing, regression testing, legacy-to-modern API parity testing, data validation, negative testing

Reporting: Cucumber Reports, JSON/HTML reporting, execution logs and CI/CD quality reporting

AI-Assisted Engineering: GitHub Copilot, AI-assisted test analysis, scenario generation, Gherkin generation, automation development and coverage analysis

Healthcare: Strong understanding of healthcare enterprise systems and preferably experience with claims, member, provider, eligibility, benefits, authorization, payments, or healthcare interoperability services. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience leading enterprise API modernization or monolith-to-microservices transformation programs. 
 - Experience architecting API automation frameworks used across multiple applications or programs. 
 - Experience with legacy-to-modern service comparison/parity validation. 
 - Knowledge of cloud-native architectures, containers, Kubernetes, API gateways, and service discovery is desirable. 
 - Exposure to service virtualization, mocking, contract testing, and API performance testing. 
 - Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards such as FHIR and HL7 is advantageous.

Experience

- 13+ years of overall experience in Quality Engineering, testing, software engineering, or related disciplines. 
 - 7+ years of strong API testing and automation experience. 
 - 5+ years in a Test Architect, Solution Architect, QE Architect, Technical Lead, or equivalent technical leadership role. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading complex API modernization, microservices, integration, or digital transformation programs. 
 - Prior experience in healthcare or health insurance programs is strongly preferred. 

Expected Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be able to take an enterprise modernization requirement such as: 

Legacy Enterprise Services → Modern APIs → Microservices

and independently define the corresponding: 

Current-State Assessment → Test Strategy → API Test Architecture → Legacy Baseline → Modern API Validation → Automated Parity Testing → CI/CD Integration → Regression Strategy → Quality Gates → Production Readiness

The candidate should combine hands-on API automation architecture expertise with solutioning and customer-facing leadership, rather than functioning only as a test manager or delivery manager.

data.title: SDE II, EE Experiences, Everyday Essentials Experiences
data.description:
Description

Everyday Essentials (EE) is a $100B+ business and one of the fastest-growing categories at Amazon - the household staples, health and personal care, grocery, and beauty products hundreds of millions of customers reorder. We're reinventing how customers discover, buy, and get more value from them, and we're looking for Software Development Engineers who want to build that future. 

The EE Experiences organization builds the shopping experience for the products customers come back for most. Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization: helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and get more value on every essentials purchase - and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day. 

This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off-the-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product - we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll have the freedom to propose new ideas, prototype them, and ship them worldwide. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership. 

We're an AI-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build - the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in. 

Key job responsibilities

- Design, build, and own software end to end - working backwards from the customer through design, code, testing, deployment, and operations. 
 - Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions to hard problems. 
 - Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer problems into products that ship worldwide. 
 - Use AI tools and modern engineering practices to build faster and at a higher bar of quality, and help the team level up how it uses them. 
 - Own operational excellence for what you build - monitor it, respond when issues arise, and keep improving the customer and partner experience. 
 - Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent. 

A day in the life

Most days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find a better everyday-essentials product, or fill their basket faster. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters. 

About The Team

Our team owns how customers discover and buy the everyday essentials they rely on - and how the brands behind those products reach them. Our mission is to make restocking the things you need effortless, and to help customers find better options along the way. Day to day you'll work with fellow engineers and partner closely with product managers, designers, and scientists, who bring the customer and data insight that shapes what we build. We're a small, fast-moving group solving open-ended problems for hundreds of millions of shoppers - a place where you own problems end to end and your ideas reach customers fast. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
 - Experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems

The systems we build span web-scale indexing, hybrid retrieval (keyword + vector), and advanced ranking systems, delivering low-latency results across massive and heterogeneous datasets. You will play a key role in shaping the technical vision for search, driving innovations in relevance, performance, and scalability. 

This role requires deep technical expertise, strong system design skills, and the ability to influence architecture and execution across teams. You will partner closely with engineering, product, and data science to deliver impactful improvements to search quality and platform capabilities. 

Value You Deliver

- Architect and build highly scalable, low-latency distributed search systems
 - Design and optimize large-scale indexing pipelines and retrieval systems
 - Drive hybrid search architecture (BM25 + vector search + LLM-based reranking)
 - Lead design and development of backend services and REST APIs using Java and Spring
 - Build real-time and batch data pipelines using streaming frameworks
 - Design event-driven architectures leveraging message brokers such as Kafka
 - Improve search relevance and ranking quality using ML/NLP and LTR techniques
 - Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across indexing and query layers
 - Define search quality metrics, evaluation frameworks, and experimentation strategies
 - Ensure system reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance using distributed system best practices
 - Own end-to-end lifecycle of microservices (design, development, deployment, operations)
 - Implement security best practices (authentication, authorization, data protection)
 - Lead technical design discussions and influence architectural decisions
 - Mentor engineers through code reviews, design guidance, and best practices
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Data Science, and AI teams

What You Bring

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field
 - 8+ years of experience in backend or distributed systems development
 - 5+ years of hands-on experience with large-scale data processing or streaming systems

Technical Skills

Core Programming & System Design

- Deep expertise in Java (Java 11/17+) and JVM ecosystem
 - Expert-level knowledge of Spring Framework (Boot, MVC, Security, Retry)
 - Strong understanding of concurrency, multi-threading, and performance optimization
 - Proven experience designing scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems

Search & Information Retrieval

- Strong experience with search technologies (Solr / Elasticsearch / OpenSearch / Lucene)
 - Deep understanding of indexing strategies, query execution, and relevance tuning
 - Experience with hybrid retrieval (keyword + vector + semantic/LLM reranking)
 - Hands-on experience with Learning to Rank (LTR), query understanding, and personalization

Stream Processing & Distributed Systems

- Extensive experience with Apache Beam, Spark, or Storm
 - Strong understanding of event-driven architectures and streaming pipelines
 - Knowledge of processing semantics (exactly-once, at-least-once), windowing, and state management

Data Storage & Persistence

- Strong expertise in NoSQL systems (preferably Cassandra)
 - Experience with multi-tenant architectures and high-throughput systems
 - Understanding of consistency models and distributed data design
 - Familiarity with document stores and schema design

Messaging & Event Systems

- Production experience with Kafka or similar systems
 - Understanding of event sourcing, CQRS, and backpressure handling

Security & Cloud

- Experience with OAuth and service-to-service authentication
 - Knowledge of encryption (in transit and at rest) and KMS
 - Familiarity with Kubernetes and containerized environments
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Maven)

Testing & Quality

- Strong experience with unit, integration, and distributed system testing
 - Familiarity with JUnit, Mockito, and embedded test frameworks
 - Understanding of testing strategies for distributed systems

Value Competencies

- Drives technical vision and architectural decision-making
 - Balances immediate delivery with long-term platform evolution
 - Demonstrates strong ownership and accountability
 - Mentors and uplifts team through technical leadership
 - Collaborates effectively across engineering, product, and data science
 - Operates with a startup mindset-speed with scalability
 - Passion for solving complex search and relevance challenges at scale

Where you belong

We are part of the CTO Organization for Intelligent Spend and Business Network at SAP, building a next-generation Search Platform that powers enterprise discovery at a global scale. 

Our team works on cutting-edge challenges across distributed systems, search relevance, and AI-driven retrieval-combining traditional IR techniques with modern LLM-based approaches. We focus on building systems that are scalable, observable, and impactful, while fostering a culture of engineering excellence and innovation.

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. data.description:
Location: Ahmedabad

Experience: 4-5 years

Key Responsibilities

- Quality System Management: Develop, implement, and maintain robust Quality Management Systems (QMS) across the manufacturing plant. Ensure compliance with ISO standards and industry-specific regulations (Pharma/F&B GMP standards). 
 - Inward Quality Control (IQC): Oversee the inspection of incoming raw materials (e. g. , SS 304/316), fabricated parts, and bought-out components (electrical, pneumatic, and mechanical) to ensure they meet engineering specifications. 
 - In-Process Inspection: Monitor machining, fabrication, and assembly line processes. Implement rigorous quality checkpoints during the machine building phase to prevent defects and rework. 
 - Final Inspection & FAT: Lead the final inspection of fully assembled machinery. Coordinate and execute Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) with internal teams and clients to ensure performance, safety, and output parameters are flawless before dispatch. 
 - Defect Analysis & Resolution: Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for any non-conformities, defects, or client rejections. Implement effective Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA). 
 - Vendor Quality Management: Conduct vendor audits and work closely with the Purchase and Procurement teams to evaluate supplier performance and improve the quality of outsourced components. 
 - Team Leadership & Training: Manage, mentor, and train the QC team (inspectors and engineers). Promote a culture of continuous improvement utilizing methodologies like 5S, Kaizen, and Six Sigma. 
 - Documentation & Reporting: Maintain accurate QA/QC documentation, calibration records for measuring instruments, inspection reports, and quality performance dashboards for management review. 

Qualifications & Skills

- Education: B. E. or B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering. (Additional certifications in Total Quality Management (TQM) or Six Sigma Green/Black Belt are highly advantageous). 
 - Experience: 4 to 5 years of dedicated QA/QC experience in industrial equipment, capital goods, or packaging machinery manufacturing. 

Key Responsibilities

- Quality System Management: Develop, implement, and maintain robust Quality Management Systems (QMS) across the manufacturing plant. Ensure compliance with ISO standards and industry-specific regulations (Pharma/F&B GMP standards). 
 - Inward Quality Control (IQC): Oversee the inspection of incoming raw materials (e. g. , SS 304/316), fabricated parts, and bought-out components (electrical, pneumatic, and mechanical) to ensure they meet engineering specifications. 
 - In-Process Inspection: Monitor machining, fabrication, and assembly line processes. Implement rigorous quality checkpoints during the machine building phase to prevent defects and rework. 
 - Final Inspection & FAT: Lead the final inspection of fully assembled machinery. Coordinate and execute Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) with internal teams and clients to ensure performance, safety, and output parameters are flawless before dispatch. 
 - Defect Analysis & Resolution: Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for any non-conformities, defects, or client rejections. Implement effective Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA). 
 - Vendor Quality Management: Conduct vendor audits and work closely with the Purchase and Procurement teams to evaluate supplier performance and improve the quality of outsourced components. 
 - Team Leadership & Training: Manage, mentor, and train the QC team (inspectors and engineers). Promote a culture of continuous improvement utilizing methodologies like 5S, Kaizen, and Six Sigma. 
 - Documentation & Reporting: Maintain accurate QA/QC documentation, calibration records for measuring instruments, inspection reports, and quality performance dashboards for management review. 

Qualifications & Skills

- Education: B. E. or B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering. (Additional certifications in Total Quality Management (TQM) or Six Sigma Green/Black Belt are highly advantageous). 
 - Experience: 4 to 5 years of dedicated QA/QC experience in industrial equipment, capital goods, or packaging machinery manufacturing.

data.title: Sr Principal Verification Engineer
data.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www. analog. com and on LinkedIn and X. 

Analog Devices is seeking Digital Design Sr Principal Verification Engineer, who will be responsible for design verification of highly integrated solutions and products in a multifunctional team. You will be working on driving real revenue growth on the next generation of Intelligence at the Edge products across multiple products and business units. 

About ADI: 

Analog Devices, Inc. is a leading global high-performance analog technology company dedicated to solving our customers' most complex engineering challenges. We play a critical role at the intersection of the physical and digital world by providing the building blocks to sense, measure, interpret, connect, and power devices and systems. We design, manufacture, test, and market a broad portfolio of solutions, including integrated circuits (ICs), software and subsystems that leverage high-performance analog, mixed-signal and digital signal processing technologies. We embrace a culture of innovation and collaboration to push the state of the art. 

About The Role

Lead design verification team for SOC or subsystem design pre silicon verification. The candidate will be responsible for formulating verification strategies, Define verification architecture, Flow, Methodology and leading, driving and completing verification of large integrated products. As a senior team member, it is expected that he/she will lead and influence verification methodologies within both DBU and ADI. The candidate is also encouraged to participate in cross company technical initiatives as well as patent and publish work where possible. 

Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end SoC verification for complex digital SoCs, driving execution from planning to signoff. 
 - Verify complex microprocessor-based designs, AI/ML accelerators, and high-speed peripherals using advanced verification methodologies. 
 - Define and drive team execution by planning tasks, tracking progress, and providing technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance. 
 - Collaborate closely with architecture and design teams to define requirements and align on verification deliverables and dependencies. 
 - Drive pre-silicon readiness by aligning with emulation, FPGA, and software teams to cover post-silicon validation scenarios early. 
 - Develop and execute end-to-end system-level use cases for comprehensive functional validation. 
 - Architect and implement scalable UVM-based testbenches, DV flows, and methodologies. 
 - Define and review test plans; ensure closure of functional and code coverage across block, subsystem, and SoC levels. 
 - Work cross-functionally with emulation, FPGA, firmware, and system teams to ensure full-system correctness. 
 - Apply formal verification techniques for IP and subsystem-level validation. 
 - Lead NoC/interconnect verification and ensure robust data flow across the SoC. 
 - Perform performance verification and system-level analysis across real-world use cases. 
 - Drive innovation in verification strategies to meet aggressive schedules and quality goals. 
 - Define overall verification strategy based on product requirements and design specifications, leveraging modern techniques such as formal, emulation, portable stimulus, and virtual platforms. 

Requirements

- B. Tech/M. Tech with 20+ years of experience in digital pre-silicon verification, including leadership across IP, subsystem, or SoC-level DV. 
 - Strong understanding of SoC/Subsystem architectures with hands-on expertise in Verilog/SystemVerilog and UVM-based testbench development, debugging, and methodology implementation. 
 - Proven track record in verification closure using functional and code coverage metrics across block, subsystem, and SoC levels. 
 - Expertise in NoC, bus, and interconnect verification, along with coverage analysis and optimization. 
 - Experience in architecting scalable testbench environments and defining robust DV flows and methodologies. 
 - Strong background in power-aware verification (UPF), including power analysis and optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience with formal verification, including flow definition, connectivity, and functional property checking. 
 - Solid protocol knowledge and verification experience across high-speed and low-speed interfaces such as I2C, SPI, Ethernet, UART, AXI/AHB, DMA, and SVI3. 
 - Experience in security and safety verification, ensuring compliance with secure design and functional safety requirements. 
 - Familiarity with gate-level simulations with timing annotation (GLS). 
 - Strong expertise in test planning, constrained-random verification, assertions, and transaction-level modeling. 
 - Good understanding of processor-based systems (ARM, RISC-V, Tensilica), AI/ML accelerators, and proficiency in C/C++, SystemC, and scripting (Python/TCL/Shell). 
 - Exposure to mixed-signal/analog verification (ADC/DAC/PLL/PHY) is a plus. 
 - Excellent communication and leadership skills with the ability to collaborate across global teams and drive verification innovation. 
 - Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to quickly learn and adopt new technologies

data.description:
Meet the Team

Customer Experience (CX) is a team of extraordinary technical experts whose #1 focus is to deliver a premier customer experience and accelerate value realization. Our team, Solution Validation Services (SVS), is an integral part of Cisco Customer Experience, specializing in pre-deployment solution validation, software qualification, and architectural assurance for complex, mission-critical networks prior to Go-Live. We help Tier-1 Service Providers, Web/Cloud hyperscalers, and large Enterprises tackle their toughest business and operational challenges through network-centric testing, digital twin lab simulations, and advanced test automation. Our success is proven through accelerated customer deployments, reduced operational risk, premier customer satisfaction metrics, and employee engagement excellence. 

Your Impact

As An Architect In SVS, You Will Provide Top-tier Technical Leadership And Drive The Validation Strategy For Next-generation Service Provider Networks

- Architectural Influence: Translate complex validation outcomes and testbed findings into actionable business risk mitigation strategies for C-level and senior engineering leadership. 
 - Solution Validation & Assurance: Lead end-to-end testing of next-generation Service Provider routing architectures, major software releases (Cisco IOS-XR 64-bit), and modern transport solutions (SRv6, BGP EVPN, Routed Optical Networking) to guarantee production readiness. 
 - Lab Digital Twin Simulations: Build full-scale, high-fidelity customer simulations in world-class SVS test laboratories to uncover, isolate, and resolve sophisticated protocol, scale, and multi-vendor interoperability bottlenecks before production deployment. 
 - Test Automation Excellence: Architect and implement continuous test automation frameworks using Cisco pyATS/Genie, CXTM, and CI/CD pipelines, driving automated test coverage and accelerating project delivery velocity. 
 - Defect Advocacy & Engineering Liaison: Act as the primary technical escalation authority during validation, partnering directly with Cisco Product Engineering (XR Dev, HW/Silicon teams) to triage defects, validate SMUs/patches, and ensure rapid resolution. 
 - Pre-Sales & Scoping Leadership: Partner with SVS Business Development Managers (BDMs) and Account Teams on pre-sales scoping, developing Statements of Work (SOW), Level of Effort (LOE) models, and Joint Test Plans on Record (JTPOR). 
 - Talent Mentorship: Mentor, coach, and elevate the technical proficiency of consulting engineers across the global SVS organization, fostering a culture of innovation and delivery excellence. 

Decision Making & Scope of Impact

- Strategic Autonomy: High degree of technical autonomy: determines validation methodologies, test strategies, and architectural best practices across global SP engagements. 
 - Business Impact: Decisions directly impact customer Go-Live success, network availability, multi-million dollar project margins, and Cisco's trusted advisor standing with Tier-1 accounts. 
 - Organizational Alignment: Translates global CX and SVS strategic priorities into concrete technical initiatives, testbed innovations, and delivery standards. 

Role-Specific Responsibilities

- Customer Architectural Engagement: Collaborate closely with customer Principal Architects, Cisco Account Teams, and CX Technical Leaders to define validation scopes, acceptance criteria, and migration test strategies. 
 - Deliverable Governance: Author, review, and formally approve key SVS deliverables, including Detailed Test Plans (DTP), Joint Test Plans on Record (JTPOR), Method of Procedures (MOP), and End of Test Reports (EOTR). 
 - Performance & Scale Validation: Synthesize complex traffic profiles and performance benchmarks utilizing industry-standard hardware traffic generators (Spirent TestCenter, Keysight/Ixia IxNetwork) and WAN impairment tools to validate line-rate throughput, QoS behavior, and failover convergence. 
 - Automation & Tooling Leadership: Drive the adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Test Automation as Code across SVS delivery pods, building reusable pyATS test scripts and CI/CD validation pipelines. 
 - Advanced Troubleshooting & RCA: Lead root cause analysis (RCA) on sophisticated customer defects, analyzing packet captures, router debug logs, and telemetry streams to pinpoint software bugs and configuration regressions. 
 - Knowledge Transfer & Assets: Champion knowledge sharing by authoring best-practice whitepapers, test methodology playbooks, and reusable test suites to scale delivery efficiency globally. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Education & Experience: Typically requires a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Telecommunications Engineering, or equivalent plus 10-15+ years of relevant experience in Service Provider network design, testing, validation, or advanced technical delivery. 
 - Core Platform Expertise: Deep, hands-on architectural and validation expertise in Cisco Service Provider routing platforms and network operating systems. 
 - Consulting & Client Engagement: Proven experience in customer-facing consulting, technical leadership, or solution architecture roles engaging with senior-level decision makers. 
 - Certifications: Expert-level Cisco certification (CCIE Service Provider or CCIE Enterprise/Routing & Switching) or equivalent proven industry standing is strongly desired. 
 - Software & Automation: Demonstrable foundation in software programmability and automation scripting (Python, REST APIs, JSON/YAML). 
 - Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication, executive presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to navigate ambiguous, high-pressure environments. 

Preferred Technical Qualifications

Strong architectural understanding and hands-on validation expertise across minimum two of the following SP domain areas: 

- Service Provider Core & Edge Routing Architectures (Converged SDN Transport & RON): 
 - Cisco SP Platforms
 - Operating Systems
 - Core Routing Protocols
 - Segment Routing & Traffic Engineering
 - Multi-Service VPNs & EVPN
 - SP Network Timing & 5G Sync
 - Routed Optical Networking (RON)
 - SP Resiliency & Security
 - SP Automation, Orchestration, Observability & Tooling: 
 - Cisco pyATS & Genie Test Frameworks
 - SP SDN Orchestration & Controllers
 - Data Modeling & Interfaces
 - Streaming Telemetry & Observability
 - Scripting & CI/CD Pipelines
 - Test Lab Simulation, Traffic Generation & Telco Cloud: 
 - Hardware Traffic Generation
 - Virtualization & Digital Twin Platforms
 - SP Cloud & Telco Infrastructure

Leadership & Autonomy

- Self-Direction & Initiative: Operates with high autonomy, determining methods and validation frameworks on strategic, high-visibility customer projects. 
 - Strategic Advisor: Serves as a trusted technical advisor to leadership and customers, translating strategic technology goals into actionable validation programs. 
 - Team Leadership: Champions innovation, leading internal initiatives to advance SVS testing capabilities, tooling, and delivery best practices. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

As a strategic partner to Finance, Accounting, and Technology teams, you will bridge the gap between complex financial business processes and advanced technical execution. You will lead enterprise-scale Oracle Cloud initiatives, architect integrations, optimize end-to-end workflows, and help shape the future of intelligent ERP automation through emerging AI and Agentic technologies. 

This is an opportunity to influence enterprise architecture, mentor engineering teams, and drive digital transformation initiatives that directly impact business performance. 

Impact of the Role

- Drive enterprise-wide Oracle Cloud ERP transformation initiatives that improve operational efficiency and business performance. 
 - Influence enterprise architecture, integration strategy, and financial systems modernization. 
 - Enable intelligent automation through AI-powered workflows and Agentic technologies. 
 - Improve financial process efficiency, data accuracy, compliance, and user experience across ERP ecosystems. 
 - Mentor engineering teams and establish technical excellence across Oracle Cloud platforms. 
 - Partner with business and technology leaders to deliver scalable, secure, and innovative financial solutions. 

Technology Platforms You Will Work On

- Oracle Cloud ERP Financials. 
 - Accounts Payable (AP), General Ledger (GL), Accounts Receivable (AR), and Fixed Assets (FA). 
 - Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC). 
 - REST APIs and SOAP Web Services. 
 - File-Based Data Import (FBDI). 
 - BI Publisher (BIP). 
 - Oracle Database technologies including SQL and PL/SQL. 
 - Oracle EPM (Enterprise Performance Management) modules. 
 - Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). 
 - AI-powered enterprise automation platforms. 
 - Agentic AI architectures and LLM-based autonomous agents. 
 - Enterprise integration frameworks and cloud-native development platforms. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design, development, implementation, and support of Oracle Cloud ERP Financial solutions across multiple business functions. 
 - Serve as the technical lead for Oracle Cloud Financials initiatives, ensuring scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions. 
 - Partner with Finance, Accounting, and business stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into technical designs and actionable solutions. 
 - Provide architectural guidance and establish best practices for Oracle Cloud development, integrations, and data management. 
 - Drive enhancements and continuous improvement initiatives across Oracle Cloud Financial modules including Accounts Payable (AP), General Ledger (GL), Accounts Receivable (AR), and Fixed Assets (FA). 
 - Analyze, optimize, and streamline end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Order-to-Cash (O2C) business processes. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, data accuracy, automation, and user experience across financial workflows. 
 - Architect and develop robust integrations between Oracle Cloud ERP and external enterprise applications. 
 - Design scalable integration frameworks utilizing Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, SOAP Web Services, FBDI, and BI Publisher (BIP). 
 - Integrate Oracle Cloud with third-party systems such as banking platforms, tax engines, payment providers, and legacy applications. 
 - Ensure integration reliability, performance, security, monitoring, and supportability. 
 - Design, develop, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL and PL/SQL solutions. 
 - Create and maintain database objects, stored procedures, packages, views, and performance-tuned queries. 
 - Perform root cause analysis and resolve complex production issues across Oracle Cloud and integrated environments. 
 - Drive technical excellence through code reviews, performance optimization, and adherence to engineering standards. 
 - Evaluate and implement emerging technologies that enhance ERP automation and operational efficiency. 
 - Contribute to the design and deployment of Agentic Workflows and LLM-powered autonomous agents for financial process automation. 
 - Identify opportunities to leverage AI-driven decision support, workflow orchestration, exception handling, and intelligent process optimization within Oracle ERP ecosystems. 
 - Lead cross-functional technical initiatives from concept through production deployment. 
 - Mentor engineers, conduct code reviews, and foster a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement. 

Qualifications

- 8+ years of enterprise application development experience with significant hands-on experience in Oracle Cloud ERP. 
 - Deep functional and technical expertise in Oracle Cloud Financials, including Accounts Payable (AP), General Ledger (GL), Accounts Receivable (AR), and Fixed Assets (FA). 
 - Strong understanding of financial accounting concepts, controls, and compliance requirements. 
 - Proven expertise in end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Order-to-Cash (O2C) business processes. 
 - Ability to translate complex financial business requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in SQL, PL/SQL, database design, performance tuning, package development, debugging, query optimization, and troubleshooting. 
 - Strong experience with Oracle database objects and enterprise data architecture principles. 
 - Demonstrated success designing and implementing Oracle Cloud integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, SOAP Web Services, FBDI, and BI Publisher (BIP). 
 - Experience integrating Oracle Cloud with external applications, financial institutions, tax systems, and enterprise platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise application architecture, integration patterns, security principles, and cloud-based solution design. 
 - Experience leading technical delivery across multiple concurrent projects and initiatives. 
 - Experience with Oracle EPM (Enterprise Performance Management) modules. 
 - Hands-on experience developing AI-powered enterprise automation solutions. 
 - Knowledge of Agentic AI architectures and LLM-based autonomous agents. 
 - Experience implementing intelligent workflow orchestration, process mining, or ERP automation initiatives. 
 - Familiarity with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) services and cloud-native development patterns. 
 - Experience working in large-scale retail, manufacturing, distribution, or financial services environments. 
 - Oracle Cloud certifications in ERP, Integration Cloud, or related technologies. 
 - Exceptional communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with executives, finance leaders, business stakeholders, and technical teams. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities. 
 - Demonstrated success mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence. 
 - Ability to influence architectural decisions and drive consensus across diverse teams. 
 - Strategic thinker with a passion for innovation, continuous improvement, and emerging technologies. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive, ownership-driven mindset. 
 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment while managing multiple priorities and deadlines. 

Scope & Learnings

You'll have the opportunity to lead transformative Oracle Cloud initiatives, shape enterprise architecture strategy, and pioneer the adoption of AI-driven automation within critical financial business processes. If you're passionate about combining deep Oracle expertise with innovative technologies to solve complex business challenges, we'd love to hear from you. 

Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center

- Our people first and performance driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career and invest in the well-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family. 
 - Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership culture that empowers engineers to make real impact. 
 - Build and operate large-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale. 
 - Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges. 
 - Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement. 

About Us

Williams-Sonoma India Pvt. Ltd. 

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Today, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is one of the United States' largest e-commerce retailers with some of the best known and most beloved brands in home furnishings. Our family of brands are Williams-Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teens, West Elm, Williams-Sonoma Home, Rejuvenation, and Mark and Graham. We currently operate retail stores globally. Our products are also available to customers through our catalogs and online worldwide. 

Williams-Sonoma India sourcing office was established in 2013. We are based in Gurugram, India. We are sourcing premium products across all categories of Home Furnishing and recorded double digit year-on-year growth. We have a dynamic team of over 100 members handling versatile vendors across India, Nepal & Bangladesh. We are looking to onboard talented people and create successful professional journey.

data.title: DevOps Engineering Manager
data.description:
Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here: 

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you're trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That's why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry. 

Job Description: 

What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes. 

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development. 

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence. 

Role Summary

The Manager, DevOps Engineering is the lead hands-on engineer responsible for the India-based DevOps capability supporting enterprise applications, integrations, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure. The role combines technical leadership with direct engineering accountability across Azure infrastructure, networking, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, security, environment management, observability, and production readiness. 

This is not a process-focused or administrative management role. The manager is expected to personally design, build, review, and troubleshoot infrastructure, deployment pipelines, network configurations, access controls, monitoring, and automation. The role will also establish engineering standards, mentor DevOps engineers, review technical work, and serve as the escalation point for complex infrastructure and deployment issues. 

The manager will work closely with enterprise architects, application teams, integration engineers, data engineers, networking, security, and delivery leadership to ensure environments and deployment processes are secure, repeatable, scalable, and operationally supportable. The role is accountable for improving delivery discipline, reducing manual processes, resolving environment bottlenecks, and ensuring infrastructure and releases are ready for production. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor DevOps engineers while remaining hands-on in delivery. 
 - Design and support Azure infrastructure, networking, identity, monitoring, and platform services. 
 - Manage virtual networks, subnets, private endpoints, DNS, routing, firewalls, and IP capacity. 
 - Build and maintain reusable Infrastructure as Code using Bicep or Terraform. 
 - Design and support Azure DevOps YAML pipelines and reusable deployment templates. 
 - Automate environment provisioning, configuration, testing, release, rollback, and recovery. 
 - Implement Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, service principals, RBAC, Key Vault, and least-privilege controls. 
 - Establish monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and operational runbooks. 
 - Review infrastructure code, pipeline code, scripts, and security changes. 
 - Lead troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, incident response, and production-readiness reviews. 
 - Enforce DevOps, security, release, and operational engineering standards. 
 - Partner with architecture, application, integration, data, networking, and security teams. 

Required Qualifications

- 8+ years of DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or related experience. 
 - 4+ years of hands-on Microsoft Azure engineering experience. 
 - 2+ years in a lead engineer or technical management role. 
 - Strong Azure networking and IP-address planning experience. 
 - Strong Infrastructure as Code experience using Bicep, Terraform, or both. 
 - Strong Azure DevOps and YAML pipeline experience. 
 - Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, service principals, and Key Vault. 
 - Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights. 
 - Strong scripting skills using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Bash, or Python. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead engineers while remaining technically hands-on. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hubs, and microservices. 
 - Experience with D365 Finance and Operations, Power Platform, or Dataverse. 
 - Experience with Azure Policy, security scanning, disaster recovery, and cost optimization. 
 - Experience with containers, AKS, or site reliability engineering practices. 

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe's values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times. 

Our Benefits: 

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!

How You Can Grow: 

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

More about Crowe: 

Crowe Capability Center - India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U. S. A. ), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world. 

Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge. 

We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role's responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.
