data.description:
Job Summary

Sr Software Engineer B3 will design and build scalable hybrid cloud applications using Java based microservices React Native interfaces and robust data platforms on PostgreSQL and SQL. The role requires deep proficiency in Kafka based event streaming AWS services and Spring Boot to deliver secure resilient and high performing solutions that support global business operations and enrich user experiences. 

Responsibilities

- Design scalable microservices based applications using Core Java and Spring Boot to support resilient and modular business capabilities that can evolve with changing enterprise needs. 
 - Implement high quality backend services with strong focus on clean code practices automated testing and observability to reduce production incidents and improve maintainability over time. 
 - Develop and optimize PostgreSQL and SQL based data models queries and stored procedures to ensure reliable data integrity consistent performance and robust transactional behavior for critical systems. 
 - Create and maintain PL SQL and MySQL routines where needed to integrate legacy components with modern services while preserving data quality and reducing migration risk. 
 - Build responsive React Native user interfaces that deliver consistent and accessible experiences across mobile devices and platforms while adhering to modern usability guidelines. 
 - Write Advanced JavaScript and JavaScript logic that emphasizes modularity reusability and performance to support complex front end workflows and dynamic data visualizations. 
 - Design and implement Kafka based event streaming pipelines that ensure reliable message delivery fault tolerance and near real time data processing for high volume workloads. 
 - Deploy and operate services on AWS using best practices for security cost efficiency and scalability while leveraging managed services to reduce operational overhead. 
 - Collaborate closely with cross functional teams in a hybrid work model to refine requirements clarify technical constraints and align solutions with broader enterprise architecture standards. 
 - Conduct code reviews mentor peers through constructive feedback and champion engineering standards that improve overall code quality and delivery efficiency across the team. 
 - Troubleshoot complex production issues by analyzing logs metrics and traces to quickly identify root causes and implement preventative improvements. 
 - Document system designs APIs operational runbooks and deployment procedures to support smooth handovers and consistent onboarding of new team members. 
 - Partner with product and business stakeholders to translate functional goals into technical solutions that create measurable value for clients and contribute to positive societal outcomes through reliable digital services. 

Qualifications

- Apply strong experience of at least nine years in Core Java Java Spring Boot and microservices to architect and deliver secure high performance backend solutions in enterprise environments. 
 - Use advanced expertise in PostgreSQL SQL and PL SQL or MySQL to design normalized schemas tune queries and manage migrations that ensure scalable and reliable data persistence. 
 - Bring proven experience with Kafka and event driven architectures to design streaming solutions that support decoupled services and real time data flows. 
 - Leverage deep skills in React Native Advanced JavaScript and JavaScript to craft intuitive front end experiences that integrate seamlessly with backend APIs and enhance user productivity. 
 - Utilize hands on AWS experience to configure environments manage deployments and apply cloud native patterns that improve availability and resilience of critical applications. 
 - Demonstrate strong understanding of software engineering practices including version control continuous integration code review and test automation to support predictable and high quality releases. 
 - Draw on previous work in hybrid delivery models to collaborate effectively across locations and time zones while maintaining clear communication and accountability. 

Certifications Required

Good to have

data.title: Sr Software Engineer-SIP, Golang, C++
data.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We're a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that's critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future. 

Department Overview

We are seeking a Software Engineer to join our core engineering team to design and develop a high-throughput, mission-critical active-active microservice framework responsible for dynamically routing and balancing traffic across multi-site deployments based on real-time health, capacity, and geolocation metrics. 

Job Description

Key Responsibilities: 

- Develop the core Load Distribution engine using Finite State Machines (FSM) to manage dynamic homing, execute Weighted Average Score (WAS) algorithms, and implement hysteresis. 
 - Architect high-throughput API and messaging layers using gRPC for metrics ingestion and RabbitMQ (RMQ) for event-driven communication. 
 - Implement distributed leader election and consensus mechanisms utilizing Consul Raft and LockAuthority across active-active deployments. 
 - Ensure system scalability to handle 3, 000+ assignments per second while integrating Apache Ignite/GridGain for stateless caching and data recovery. 

Required Skills & Experience

- Deep hands-on experience in Golang (preferred) and proficiency in C, C++, or Java. 
 - Strong computer science fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms. 
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems, multi-threading, concurrency control, and Finite State Machines (FSM). 
 - Hands-on expertise with networking and messaging protocols including gRPC, Protobuf v3, and RabbitMQ. 
 - Strong background with distributed databases like Apache Ignite and GridGain, and consensus tools like Consul Raft and LockAuthority. 
 - Practical knowledge of persistence and caching solutions such as PostgreSQL, Redis, and ElasticSearch. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and explaining complex ideas. 
 - Industry Experience - 1 to 10 years. 

Basic Requirements

- Proven ability to design active-active multi-site architectures handling network partitions, majority/minority quorums, and site-isolation scenarios. 
 - Experience with large-volume transaction systems, data migration workflows, and end-to-end observability frameworks like OpenTelemetry and Kibana. 
 - Familiarity with enterprise security tooling such as Vault and mTLS. 
 - Background in automated deployments using Docker and CI/CD pipelines. 

Travel Requirements

Under 10%

Relocation Provided

None

Position Type

Experienced

Referral Payment Plan

Yes

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic. 

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you'd like to join our team but feel that you don't quite meet all of the preferred skills, we'd still love to hear why you think you'd be a great addition to our team.

data.title: Staff Engineer, Payments
data.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 

About The Team

Payments is at the core of Stripe's mission to increase the GDP of the internet. As we expand our payments footprint in India, we are looking for a Staff Engineer to set the technical direction for our next generation of payment offerings in the market. 

As a Staff Engineer on the India Payments team, you will build on Stripe's foundational platforms and lead the architectural evolution of critical systems that process money movement every millisecond. Working across the payments stack, you will shape how we integrate with local payment rails, initiate and intelligently route payments, ensure reliable completion and automate reconciliation and settlement. 

Partnering with engineering teams, cross-functional partners and leaders globally, you will solve complex, high-stakes technical challenges involving low-latency execution, transactional correctness and idempotency, safe migrations with zero downtime and resilient distributed-state management. 

What you'll do

Responsibilities

- Design, build and operate secure, reliable and extensible production systems. 
 - Drive complex initiatives from concept to launch by managing dependencies, making decisive architectural trade-offs and ensuring successful delivery. 
 - Set a high technical bar through hands-on coding, design and code reviews, rigorous testing, clear documentation and maintainable system design. 
 - Partner with cross-functional teams and external partners to navigate regulatory and operational complexity, unblock execution and deliver roadmap commitments. 
 - Own operational excellence by leading incident response and continuously improving system health, security and operational workflows. 
 - Improve engineering standards, tooling and processes. 
 - Mentor and develop engineers to cultivate the next generation of leaders at Stripe. 

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 

Minimum Requirements

- 10+ years of hands-on experience building and operating highly available, fault-tolerant distributed systems. 
 - Proven experience driving the architectural vision for complex, multi-team initiatives, backed by deep expertise in system design, databases and API development. 
 - Strong track record of end-to-end technical ownership, steering projects from concept to delivery while proactively influencing both technical and product roadmaps.

data.title: Senior Quality Engineer
data.description:
About StarRez

StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1, 400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user-friendly, all-in-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner. 

Role: 

As a Senior Quality Engineer - you will play a pivotal role in elevating our quality practices across customer-facing event management workflows, booking and registration experiences, operational administration, product integrations, and complex distributed systems. You will be an expert within our engineering organization, deeply understanding product behaviour, customer journeys, business rules, and the systems that support seamless conference and event experiences. This role will balance hands-on individual contributor responsibilities with leading, influencing, and coaching your peers. 

This individual contributor role is for someone who is passionate about seeing systems holistically, has a strong vision for product quality, and is eager to drive the highest standards of customer experience, functional correctness, usability, accessibility, reliability, performance, and release confidence. You will leverage your deep understanding of SaaS product behaviour, end-to-end workflows, integrations, environments, and customer operations to guide and influence our development process. 

You will not manage people. You will set the quality bar for your team, do the work to hold it, and coach the engineers, product managers and designers around you to share ownership of it. You will report to the Director of Quality and work day-to-day with your team's Engineering Manager, Product Manager and engineers, alongside Support and Implementation Services when payment issues reach customers. 

What You Will Own: 

- Own the end-to-end test strategy within your team's area, deciding how things get tested based on the risk each change carries. 
 - Design validation for payment flows including authorisation, capture, settlement, partial and full refunds, failed and retried transactions, chargebacks, idempotency, and reconciliation between our records and the provider's. 
 - Coach and support your team to make of quality everyone's responsibility, and provide hands on support via executing testing activities when required. 
 - Validate integrations with third party payment gateways and providers. 
 - Engage from discovery and refinement onward: challenge assumptions, surface missing scenarios, and make sure acceptance criteria are specific and testable before a story is picked up. 
 - Assess your team's current quality maturity honestly, build a plan to lift it over the next two to three quarters, and share what you learn with Senior QAs on other teams facing the same gaps. 
 - Coach engineers on testing principles, test design, and shared ownership of automated tests, the goal is a team that builds quality in, not a QA who inspects for it. 
 - Mentor mid-level QA engineers on risk assessment, automation, observability and shift left practice. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipeline health and deployment quality gates: test suite selection, environment readiness, pre and post deploy checks, and safe release strategies including feature flags and staged rollout. 
 - Own production defect triage for Payments: assess customer and financial impact, distinguish severity from priority, drive fixes at the right urgency, follow through to root cause & prevention, and provide regular updates on defect remediation. 
 - Represent Payments quality in incident reviews and, where needed, in conversations with Support and customer facing teams. 

Required Qualifications: 

- 5+ years of progressive software engineering or quality engineering with deep focus on quality in complex, distributed system environments 
 - Hands-on experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate customer needs into well-defined user stories, acceptance criteria, and risk-based test scenarios that support high-quality product delivery. 
 - Proven track record advocating for quality and ability to influence technical direction through innovative, pragmatic, and evidence-based approaches. 
 - Hands-on experience working with web-based products, including front-end behaviour, API, service integration and functional end-to-end testing. 
 - Experience contributing to test automation frameworks and using and have a solid understanding of the testing pyramid. 
 - Practical experience working with CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, Build-kite, or similar platforms. 
 - Experience contributing to deployment and release quality gates, including test suite selection and environment readiness checks. 
 - Ability to translate customer needs into well-defined user stories, acceptance criteria, and risk-based test scenarios in collaboration with cross functional teams. 
 - Strong root cause analysis and problem-solving skills across complex, multi system failures. 
 - Excellent technical communication, you influence engineers, product managers and business stakeholders through evidence and expertise rather than authority. 
 - Practical experience using AI in modern software development, with sound judgement about where it helps and where it does not. 
 - Genuine curiosity about product architecture, customer workflows, and the business impact of engineering decisions. 

Reasons to join our team: 

- Opportunity to be a part of a well-established, high-performance company that has been in business for over 30+ years
 - Full benefits including health care, paid time off, and others
 - A supportive team environment with emphasis on learning and development opportunities
 - Our Promise: You will learn, grow, and be appreciated for your impact and contributions. 
 - Z-Factor: Our most celebrated value, you will work with a team of caring, high-performing, and passionate people who have fun supporting our vision, innovation, and continuous improvement. 

Even if you don't have all of the Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!

StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

data.title: Global M&C Portfolio Data Engineering Chapter Lead - MarTech Data Architect
data.description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact. 

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures-and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. 

What You'll Do

The MarTech Data Architect & Data Engineering Chapter Lead for Marketing & Communications is a senior technical leader responsible for the engineering excellence, architectural integrity, and continuous evolution of BCG's marketing data foundation and connected platforms. Sitting within the MarTech Engineering team, this person leads the data engineering chapter that serves BCG's Global Marketing analytics and data functions owning the technical standards, pipeline architecture, and data platform capability that underpins the full marketing analytics and data ecosystem, from CRM data operations and audience segmentation through to Tableau dashboard delivery, channel performance intelligence, and AI-assisted insight generation. 

A core part of this ownership is the identity resolution model the framework that matches and unifies client and contact records across marketing data and CRM systems into a single trusted profile. The Chapter Lead designs, manages, and continually refines this model, and partners closely with BCG's core data architect, client, marketing, CRM and engineering teams and data functions to maintain a shared, consistent definition of identity across systems. 

This role also carries direct responsibility for aligning the marketing data layer with BCG's wider enterprise data approach. The Chapter Lead partners with enterprise data governance and architecture teams to ensure marketing's data standards, access controls, lineage, and quality practices are built to firm-wide policy rather than developed in isolation representing marketing's needs in enterprise governance forums while bringing enterprise requirements back into the marketing data roadmap. 

The role sits at the intersection of technical leadership and marketing analytics product delivery. The Chapter Lead is not only the most senior data engineering voice they are an active partner to the product owners, analysts, and insight leaders whose work depends on the reliability, quality, and sophistication of the data infrastructure this person builds and leads. They lead and develop the data engineering team, set the data engineering direction in line witht the overall MarTech strategy and standards, establish the data standards, and ensure that BCG's marketing data platforms are capable of supporting not just today's analytics needs but the agentic intelligent data environment the marketing organization is building toward. 

Chapter Leadership & Data Engineering Development

- Lead the data engineering chapter serving BCG's Global Marketing & Communications team setting technical direction, establishing engineering standards, and creating an environment where engineers across squads are developing their skills, doing their best work, and growing their careers
 - Provide architectural oversight and hands-on review of engineering work across the chapter code quality, architectural consistency, pipeline reliability, and data modeling standards are upheld across all squads the chapter serves
 - Actively mentor and develop chapter engineers conducting regular technical reviews, providing structured feedback, identifying growth opportunities, and building the collective engineering capability that allows the chapter to take on increasingly sophisticated data and AI challenges over time
 - Partner with squad product owners to ensure engineering capacity, technical priorities, and sprint commitments are aligned with the analytical products and insight capabilities the marketing organization depends on
 - Contribute to hiring decisions, team structure, and data engineering development helping build a chapter that is technically excellent, well-motivated, and capable of sustaining the marketing analytics function's growing ambitions

Data Pipeline Architecture & Engineering

- Design, document, and implement robust, scalable data pipelines that feed the marketing analytics data models powering BCG's dashboard suite, channel insight products, audience intelligence, and CRM data operations built on Snowflake, dbt, and Apache Airflow as the core platform stack
 - Build monitoring and alerting for match-rate quality, pipeline failures, and unexpected shifts in merge/split volume Establish a lineage trail so any resolved identity can be traced back to its contributing source records and the logic that merged them
 - Build processes to handle un-merging (splitting incorrectly merged records) as well as merging
 - Implement data standardization logic (name normalization, address formatting, email canonicalization) as a pre-processing layer ahead of matching
 - Integrate data from across BCG's marketing technology ecosystem into the marketing data environment in a structured, governed, and scalable way that supports both current reporting needs and future analytical capability
 - Apply SCD, CDC, and DQ/DV frameworks rigorously across pipeline development ensuring that data arriving in the marketing master dataset is accurate, complete, historically traceable, and fit for the analytical and insight purposes it is intended to serve
 - Evaluate and implement new technical solutions, data engineering patterns, and platform capabilities that improve the reliability, performance, and sophistication of BCG's marketing data infrastructure contributing MVPs and proofs of concept that demonstrate feasibility before committing to full implementation

Data Quality, Governance & Security

- Own the data quality and governance standards for BCG's marketing data engineering environment implementing the monitoring, validation, and alerting frameworks that catch data quality issues before they surface as errors in stakeholder-facing dashboards or analytical outputs
 - Implement data performance and data security policies that align with BCG's governance objectives, regulatory requirements, and privacy obligations working in close partnership with enterprise data governance, IT security, and legal colleagues to ensure the marketing data environment meets the firm's standards across all dimensions
 - Maintain clear, accessible documentation of data models, pipeline architecture, transformation logic, and engineering decisions building institutional knowledge that reduces key-person dependency and supports the chapter's resilience as it grows

AI & Identity Resolution Architecture

- Design the end-to-end identity resolution architecture spanning CRM, marketing automation, web/behavioral data, campaign platforms, and third-party data sources
 - Define the matching strategy: deterministic rules (exact matches on email, phone, CRM ID) vs. probabilistic matching (fuzzy name/address matching, behavioral signals), and when each applies
 - Design the "golden record" / unified profile structure what fields it contains, how conflicting values are resolved, and which source system wins for each data type
 - Build a confidence-scoring framework so matches are tiered (auto-merge, flag-for-review, reject) rather than treated as all-or-nothing
 - Define the survivorship rules most recent, most complete, most trusted source that determine what data persists into the unified profile when records merge
 - Design for scale and extensibility so new data sources (new martech tools, new regions, new business lines) can be onboarded without re-architecting the core model

Technical Monitoring & Incident Management

- Actively monitor the health, performance, and reliability of BCG's marketing data pipelines and Snowflake environment - establishing the observability frameworks, alerting standards, and incident response protocols that minimize disruption to the analytical products and insight outputs the marketing organization depends on
 - Lead the triage and resolution of critical technical incidents with urgency, clarity, and sound engineering judgment - communicating clearly with product owners and stakeholders throughout, and ensuring that root cause analysis and remediation are completed systematically rather than reactively
 - Identify and address performance bottlenecks across the data engineering environment - conducting regular performance reviews and implementing optimization improvements that keep the platform scalable and responsive as data volumes, analytical complexity, and user demand grow

Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Partnership

- Build strong working relationships with external stakeholders across BCG's global data and technology organization ensuring that marketing's data engineering work is aligned with firm-wide data standards and that dependencies are managed proactively
 - Partner with IT architecture and platform teams on shared infrastructure decisions - including AWS cloud services, Azure Active Directory integration, and CI/CD pipeline tooling - ensuring marketing's engineering choices are compatible with BCG's broader technology environment
 - Engage with product portfolio management and cross-functional data product teams across finance, HR, legal, and other BCG functions - contributing a marketing analytics perspective to firm-wide data platform conversations and maintaining awareness of cross-functional data and security trends that affect the marketing data environment

YOU'RE GOOD AT

- Leading a chapter of data engineers with technical authority and genuine investment in their development - you set a high bar, model it yourself, and bring people along rather than simply holding them to it
 - Designing data pipeline architectures and Snowflake data models that are not just technically correct but genuinely built for the analytical consumption patterns of a sophisticated marketing analytics function - you think about the downstream insight need as much as the upstream engineering requirement
 - Writing advanced SQL and well-structured dbt models that your colleagues can read, understand, maintain, and build on - you treat code quality and documentation as professional obligations, not optional extras
 - Navigating the intersection of data engineering and marketing analytics with enough domain fluency to engage credibly with product owners, analysts, and insight leaders - you understand what they are trying to build and why, and you engineer solutions that serve those needs rather than just satisfying technical requirements
 - Bringing a current and practical perspective on AI and its implications for data engineering - you are not evangelizing AI for its own sake, but you have a well-formed view of where intelligent automation, Snowflake Cortex, and LLM integration create genuine engineering opportunity in a marketing analytics context
 - Staying calm and effective in critical incidents - you triage with sound judgment, communicate clearly under pressure, and resolve issues systematically rather than reactively
 - Collaborating with product owners and Agile teams in a way that adds engineering value to product decisions - you show up to sprint ceremonies prepared, you flag technical risk early, and you help the squad make better product decisions by making the engineering trade-offs visible and understandable

What You'll Bring

- 8-10 years of data engineering experience with a strong focus on data warehouse architecture, pipeline development, and data modeling, including at least 2-3 years in a chapter lead, technical lead, or senior engineering leadership role 
 - Demonstrably advanced SQL proficiency and deep hands-on experience with Snowflake - including data modeling, performance optimization, security configuration, and consumption layer design for analytical workloads 
 - Expert-level proficiency with dbt for data transformation and data model development, and strong hands-on experience with Apache Airflow for pipeline orchestration and job scheduling 
 - Solid experience applying SCD, CDC, and DQ/DV frameworks in production data engineering environments - you have built these patterns, maintained them, and debugged them when they break 
 - Demonstrated ability to write clean, well-documented, version-controlled code - you use GitHub or Bitbucket as a professional standard, not an afterthought 
 - Experience integrating data from complex, multi-platform marketing or enterprise technology ecosystems - familiarity with platforms such as Dynamics CRM, Adobe Analytics, Marketo, Sprinklr, or equivalent marketing technology is a meaningful advantage 
 - Working knowledge of AI and machine learning concepts as they apply to data engineering - including intelligent pipeline orchestration, AI-assisted data quality, and the evolving role of Snowflake Cortex or equivalent capabilities in analytics environments 
 - Strong Python scripting skills for pipeline development, automation, and data engineering tooling; experience with PowerShell or equivalent a plus 
 - Experience with cloud platforms - AWS preferred, Azure and GCP also valued - and familiarity with CI/CD pipeline tooling and version control workflows in a production data engineering environment 
 - Experience working in Agile and scrum-based delivery environments - including active participation in sprint ceremonies, backlog grooming, and cross-functional squad collaboration with product owners, architects, and data SMEs 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills - including the ability to present architecture decisions, engineering trade-offs, and technical recommendations to non-technical product owners and marketing stakeholders clearly and confidently 
 - Experience with JIRA and Confluence for delivery management and technical documentation 
 - Familiarity with other data platforms including Oracle, SQL Server, or MDM systems is a plus 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Science, Data Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Who You'll Work With

This role operates within BCG's Global Marketing analytics and data hub functions as the senior technical leader of the data engineering chapter that serves it. Your most important day-to-day working relationships are with the engineers in your chapter - the people whose technical growth, work quality, and professional development you are directly accountable for - and with the product owners across the marketing analytics and data hub squads whose roadmaps depend on the reliability and capability of the engineering infrastructure your chapter builds and maintains. 

Within the analytics function, you will partner closely with the Director of Marketing Analytics and the Director of Data Hub who run the squads who access, monitor, and deliver insights and data driven insights for the global marketing organization. You will also collaborate with the CRM data operations and CRM engineering leads - ensuring that the data quality and governance standards that apply at the platform level are reflected in the CRM data environment that feeds the broader marketing analytics ecosystem. 

Beyond the marketing analytics and data hub functions, you will be expected to engage regularly with BCG's enterprise data organization to ensure marketing's engineering work is aligned with firm-wide data standards and that shared infrastructure decisions reflect marketing's needs. You will also work with IT architecture, cloud platform, and security colleagues on the infrastructure and governance dimensions of the marketing data environment. 

At the most senior level, you will engage with the Director of Marketing Analytics & Data and Director of Data Hub as a peer and strategic partner - contributing the engineering perspective that shapes how the function's data platform capability evolves, how AI and emerging technology are incorporated into the chapter's roadmap, and how BCG's marketing analytics and data infrastructure is positioned to support the organization's most ambitious data and insight ambitions. 

This is a role for a data engineering leader who finds genuine satisfaction in the combination of deep technical craft and organizational impact - who wants to build something that is not just technically excellent but genuinely indispensable to how a world-class marketing organization understands and acts on its data. 

Additional info

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development. 

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices. 

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork. 

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws. 

BCG is an E - Verify Employer. Click here for more information on E-Verify.

The Engineering Manager will act as the primary technical authority for rail engineering activities delivered from India, providing leadership across Civil, Track, Signalling, Telecom, MEP and multidisciplinary rail projects. The incumbent will work closely with UK stakeholders, project managers, clients, and engineering teams to ensure successful project execution and delivery.

 - Establish engineering governance frameworks and delivery methodologies.

data.description:
The Team

Cundall is an award-winning global, multi-disciplinary consultancy with a strong and growing presence across the Asia-Pacific region. Our leadership in sustainable business was recognized when Cundall received the World Green Building Council's 2020 Business Leadership in Sustainability Award for the APAC region, reflecting our commitment to embedding sustainability into the way we work and the outcomes we deliver for the built environment. 

Sustainability underpins everything we do. We empower our people to drive positive change, decarbonize the built environment and create energy-efficient, resilient and climate-responsive buildings and communities. 

Our Building Services team delivers integrated, resilient and technology-led solutions for complex buildings and infrastructure. Our Building Automation, ELV and ICT specialists work across commercial, mission-critical, healthcare, hospitality and mixed-use developments, combining controls and systems-integration expertise with a practical understanding of construction, commissioning and building operations. 

The Role

This is an excellent opportunity for a Building Automation and ELV/ICT Engineer or Senior Engineer to join our Chennai office and contribute to projects across India, the Middle East and the wider Asia-Pacific region. 

We are seeking an engineer with strong consultancy design experience in Building Management Systems (BMS), building automation and controls, supported by capability in Extra-Low Voltage (ELV), Information and Communications Technology (ICT) and electronic security systems. 

The successful candidate will lead or develop coordinated controls and ELV designs from concept through construction and commissioning for commercial buildings, data centres and other complex facilities. 

The role requires confident engagement with clients, architects, MEP engineers, contractors, controls specialists, system integrators and vendors, together with sound engineering judgement and strong technical documentation, coordination and communication skills. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop Building Management System and building automation designs, including controls philosophies, points schedules, sequences of operation, system architectures, network topologies, plant schematics, control-panel requirements, integration matrices and performance specifications. 
 - Design and coordinate controls for HVAC, central utility plants, electrical monitoring, energy metering, lighting and other building systems, with particular emphasis on mission-critical facilities and data centres. 
 - Define interfaces and data exchange between BMS, SCADA, EPMS, fire alarm, security, lighting control, lifts, packaged plant and other third-party systems using appropriate open protocols. 
 - Design ELV and ICT systems, including fire detection and alarm, voice evacuation/public address, CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, structured cabling, LAN/Wi-Fi infrastructure, intercom, and other specialist systems as applicable. 
 - Prepare design criteria, layouts, schematics, calculations, technical specifications, equipment schedules, bills of quantities, cost inputs and tender documentation.

 - Support tender evaluations, value engineering, technical clarifications and assessments of controls contractors, OEMs and system integrators. 
 - Contribute to BIM-led coordination and work effectively with Revit and CAD technicians to deliver accurate, coordinated drawings and models. 
 - Manage assigned deliverables, budgets and programmes across multiple projects while maintaining Cundall's quality and safety expectations. 

The Skills

Qualifications and Experience: 

- Bachelor's degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Instrumentation, Controls, Mechatronics, Telecommunications or a related engineering discipline. 
 - Typically 4-8 years of relevant consultancy or design experience for Engineer/Senior Engineer level, with demonstrable building automation or BMS experience; candidates with stronger leadership experience may be considered for a more senior position. 
 - Proven experience developing BMS controls philosophies, points schedules, sequences of operation, system architectures, integration requirements and commissioning documentation is essential. 
 - Experience producing coordinated Building Automation and ELV/ICT designs for commercial, data centre, healthcare, hospitality, industrial or large infrastructure projects. 
 - Proficiency in AutoCAD is essential; working knowledge of Revit, Navisworks and BIM coordination workflows is strongly preferred. 
 - Ability to develop technical specifications, BOQs, design reports, calculations, schematics and tender packages with limited supervision. 
 - Experience coordinating with clients, architects, MEP consultants, contractors, OEMs, controls specialists and system integrators. 
 - Familiarity with applicable Indian codes and approvals, including NBC requirements, relevant BIS/IS standards and local fire-authority expectations, together with commonly used international standards. 
 - Relevant certifications or training in BMS platforms, Niagara Framework, networking, RCDD, CCNA/CCNP or security systems are advantageous but not mandatory. 

Technical Knowledge And Personal Attributes

- Strong technical knowledge of BMS, HVAC controls, direct digital control, instrumentation, control panels, field devices, plant optimisation and energy-management strategies. 
 - Ability to write clear and technically robust sequences of operation for air-side, water-side, electrical and mission-critical systems, including normal, failure, standby and recovery modes. 
 - Knowledge of BACnet, Modbus, KNX, LonWorks, MQTT, OPC and common API or gateway-based integration approaches, including network architecture, interoperability and cybersecurity considerations. 
 - Understanding of BMS, SCADA and EPMS boundaries, high-level interfaces, alarm management, trending, graphics, reporting, analytics and data-centre monitoring requirements. 
 - Strong knowledge of IP-based CCTV, video management systems, access control, intrusion detection, fire detection and alarm, VESDA, public address/voice evacuation and structured cabling systems. 
 - Understanding of copper and fibre cabling, equipment-room planning, racks, pathways, containment, power supplies and resilience requirements. 
 - Working knowledge of TCP/IP networking, VLANs, PoE, switches, servers, storage, virtualisation and cybersecurity principles relevant to connected building systems. 
 - Awareness of relevant BIS/IS, NBC, ECBC, ASHRAE, CIBSE, ISO/IEC, TIA/EIA, NFPA and BS/EN requirements commonly referenced on Indian and international projects. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication in English; additional Indian language capability is welcome. 
 - Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a collaborative approach. 
 - Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently when required and travel to project sites within India or internationally. 

If you are motivated by technically challenging projects and want to develop high-performance Building Automation solutions integrated with ELV and ICT systems for the buildings of the future, this could be the role for you.

data.title: Full Stack AI Engineering Lead
data.description:
About Bloom AI

Bloom AI builds AI-native intelligence systems and workflows for enterprise teams across research, marketing, sales and other knowledge-intensive functions. We combine enterprise data, external intelligence, AI and software engineering to help organizations build systems that continuously understand context, generate intelligence and support action. Our model sits between traditional product companies and services firms. We build reusable technology and engineering patterns while deploying them against real enterprise problems and adapting them to different client environments. 

Bloom AI is based in the U. S. and India (Delhi/NCR). This is a hybrid role. 

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on Full Stack AI Engineer with 4-6 years of experience who can design, build and deploy production-grade AI applications, with particular emphasis on multi-agent systems, backend engineering and end-to-end application development. 

This is a core engineering role for someone who combines strong software fundamentals with practical experience building LLM-powered applications, agentic workflows and intelligent data systems. 

You should be comfortable working across the stack-from building agent orchestration and backend services to developing user-facing applications, integrating enterprise data and deploying solutions in cloud environments. 

This is not a prompt-engineering or research-only role. We are looking for someone who can turn AI capabilities into reliable, scalable software that solves real business problems. 

You will work across client engagements, reusable Bloom AI capabilities and internal technology development, taking ownership of solutions from architecture through production deployment. You will be part of core team reporting to the CEO. 

What You'll Do

Build Agentic Systems

- Design and develop multi-agent systems that coordinate specialized agents to execute complex tasks and workflows. 
 - Implement agent orchestration, planning, tool calling, task delegation, context management and state management. 
 - Build LLM-powered applications using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen or similar. 
 - Develop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, agent memory and knowledge retrieval capabilities. 
 - Integrate agents with enterprise APIs, databases, documents and external data sources. 
 - Implement evaluation, tracing, error handling, monitoring and reliability mechanisms for production AI systems. 

Build Backend and Full Stack Applications

- Design and develop scalable backend services, REST APIs and application logic using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI. 
 - Build user-facing applications using modern frontend frameworks such as React, Next. js or similar. 
 - Develop data models, database integrations and processing pipelines for structured and unstructured data. 
 - Implement asynchronous processing, background jobs and integrations between application components. 
 - Design modular, maintainable architectures that support reuse across client environments. 
 - Own features end-to-end, including technical design, development, testing, integration and deployment. 

Work with Graph and Context Systems

- Design data structures and retrieval mechanisms that help AI systems understand entities, relationships and context. 
 - Work with graph-based data models and knowledge graphs to represent relationships across enterprise and external data. 
 - Combine structured data, semantic search and graph-based retrieval to support richer agent reasoning and intelligence workflows. 
 - Contribute to the development of persistent context, memory and state-management capabilities for AI agents. 
 - Evaluate when relational databases, vector databases or graph-based approaches are appropriate for different problems. 

Deploy Production Grade Systems

- Deploy and manage applications on cloud infrastructure, preferably Microsoft Azure, with AWS or GCP experience also relevant. 
 - Work with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, model APIs and enterprise AI services.

Who You'll Work With

data.title: Engineer - Stack Testing
data.description:
Job Description

- Prepare test plans, test protocols and procedures for performance characterization, durability, accelerated stress and dynamic cycling tests. 
 - Support commissioning of the test system, including verification of sensors, interlocks and safety logic through to final tester acceptance. 
 - Manage routine calibration and verification of test instruments to ensure measurement accuracy. 
 - Execute testing and data analysis of PEM electrolyser stacks. 
 - Adapt quickly to different test types, tester designs and functionalities. 
 - Guide test technicians with clear instructions for continuous monitoring of stack and system operation and performance. 
 - Process and analyse large multi-channel datasets from operating stacks, including individual cell voltages, stack voltage/current, temperatures, pressures, flow rates, etc. 
 - Define, calculate and track key performance indicators such as cell voltage spread, energy consumption, efficiency, degradation rate and gas crossover. 
 - Perform cell-to-cell and stack-to-stack statistical analysis and correlate test results with stack build data to identify root causes of variation. 
 - Perform gas chromatography (GC) analysis and data evaluation to support performance characterisation and identify anomalies and key trends. 
 - Apply electrochemical characterisation methods for performance evaluation and diagnostics of electrochemical systems. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to analyse and correlate stack and system performance. 
 - Lead root cause analysis (RCA) of system failure modes and oversee troubleshooting and maintenance of the testers. 
 - Record and manage test deviations, non-conformances and corrective actions and provide feedback to stack design and materials teams. 
 - Prepare test reports, technical summaries and presentations for internal reviews and project updates. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance testing efficiency, quality and reliability. 
 - Ensure compliance with all health, safety and environmental regulations. 

Ohmium Cultural Values

At Ohmium, you are expected to embody and champion our core cultural values: 

Accountability: I own my tasks and execute on time. 

Demonstrate strong accountability by owning deliverables and decisions, ensuring timely and consistent results. 

Teamwork: I will not let other teams fail. 

Takes ownership beyond own team to support cross-team success and prevent failures, thereby fostering a collaborative work environment. 

Learning Mindset: I drive change and learn from mistakes. 

Exhibits a strong growth mindset by proactively leading meaningful change and consistently learning from experience. 

Winning Attitude: I compete to win. 

Showing up every day with a strong perspective, to drive results and be the BEST in Green Energy. 

Education And Experience Required

B Tech in Electrochemical or Chemical or Mechanical Engineering or related field. 

1-3 Years of experience in Testing is desirable. 

Previous experience in the renewable energy sector including Batteries, Fuel cells, Electrolyser is preferred. 

Looking for a highly skilled Testing Engineer with a strong background in electrochemical engineering. Responsible for testing, validation, trouble shooting and data analysis for PEM stacks. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise in testing and understanding on electrochemical systems such as batteries, fuel cells, electrolyzers etc. This role also covers tester commissioning, test execution, validation, and analysis of large multi-channel stack and system datasets. 

Ohmium is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

data.title: Quality Automation - Manager
data.description:
The Opportunity

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You'll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services-solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We'll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference-every day. 

We Are

A Quality Engineering practice that helps clients move from late-stage testing to continuous quality, efficiency, and resilience. We embed with product, engineering, and architecture teams, apply modern automation and AI-enabled testing, and take quality work from experiment into operational delivery at enterprise scale. 

You Are

A hands-on SDET and quality leader with 12+ years in test automation and software quality engineering. You write and review automation, set and execute the quality strategy for your program, and coach a team while remaining technically engaged. You are comfortable in global, collaborative delivery environments and you care about embedding quality across the full software development lifecycle - not only at the end of a sprint. 

The Work

You will lead quality for complex application delivery: partnering with product, development, and architecture teams; defining and executing a modern test strategy; and applying AI-enabled approaches where they deliver measurable value. You will take accountability for your team's delivery outcomes, technical direction, and continuous improvement, acting as both a technical lead and a client-facing quality partner. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Strategy & Leadership

- Define and lead end-to-end quality for your program, including early validation, risk-based testing, and continuous testing. 
 - Own quality strategy, test planning, estimation, execution governance, defect management, and release-readiness assessment across your workstreams. 
 - Establish the appropriate balance of unit, API, UI, integration, regression, and exploratory testing based on product risk and architecture. 

SDET & Custom Application Quality

- Lead the design, development, and enhancement of automation frameworks and validation components - not test cases alone. 
 - Design, implement, and scale maintainable automation frameworks for web applications and services, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and performance. 
 - Build UI, API, and where required mobile automation using Playwright and comparable tools such as Appium and REST Assured. 
 - Partner with developers to improve unit-test coverage, testability, coding standards, and shift-left quality practices. 

AI-Enabled Testing & Innovation

- Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and agentic test automation solutions to accelerate test design, implementation, maintenance, and analysis responsibly. 
 - Apply GenAI tooling (for example GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini) to improve test design, code generation, debugging, and root cause analysis. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI-enabled testing tools through controlled proofs of concept and recommend adoption based on measurable value, security, accuracy, and maintainability. 

DevSecOps & CI/CD Integration

- Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and define quality gates that provide fast, reliable feedback. 
 - Embed automated testing into delivery pipelines such as GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, covering version control and artifact management. 

Cross-Platform Quality Delivery

- Lead testing across web, API, and mobile (iOS/Android) layers as the engagement requires. 
 - Apply contract testing, test-data management, service virtualization or mocking, and observability practices. 

Client Engagement & Advisory

- Partner with client and business stakeholders to shape quality strategy and support transformation initiatives. 
 - Facilitate workshops and deliver pragmatic quality solutions in ambiguous or evolving delivery environments. 

Team Leadership & Delivery Accountability

- Manage, mentor, and develop a high-performing quality engineering team, local or distributed, while remaining technically engaged. 
 - Own your team's delivery outcomes and guide day-to-day technical decisions. 
 - Coach team members, set technical direction, review automation code, and promote continuous learning and engineering discipline. 

Cross-Team Collaboration

- Collaborate across product, development, architecture, DevOps, security, and business teams to resolve dependencies and embed quality throughout the delivery lifecycle. 

Continuous Improvement & Capability Building

- Improve test coverage, automation maturity, and delivery efficiency over time. 
 - Champion quality engineering best practices, reusable standards, automation patterns, and shared assets that build team capability. 

Reporting & Insights

- Produce clear test outcome reports covering execution status, coverage, defect trends, residual risk, release recommendations, and improvement actions. 
 - Track meaningful quality metrics and deliver dashboards that identify systemic issues, improve predictability, and reduce escaped defects. 

Security, Accessibility & Compliance

- Embed secure, accessible, and compliant quality practices into delivery, including in regulated environments such as financial services, public sector, and healthcare. 

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related discipline. 
 - 12+ years of experience in test automation, SDET, or software quality engineering roles, with demonstrated ownership of complex automation programs. 
 - Proven experience leading quality engineering teams, managing priorities, mentoring engineers, and influencing delivery outcomes. 
 - Hands-on coding proficiency in at least one of TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, Python, or Java, with experience building automation frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, clean-code principles, reusable framework design, version control, and code reviews. 
 - Practical experience with Playwright or a comparable modern UI automation framework. 
 - Strong API testing and automation knowledge, including REST services, authentication, data validation, error handling, and service-level test design. 
 - Strong grounding in functional testing techniques, including requirements analysis, test design, boundary and negative testing, risk-based testing, regression testing, and defect lifecycle management. 
 - Experience with unit-testing frameworks and close collaboration with development teams to improve unit and component test coverage. 
 - Proven experience integrating testing into DevSecOps pipelines, including CI/CD, automated quality gates, reporting, source control, and artifact management. 
 - Strong experience in test strategy, test-data management, mocking, and observability. 
 - Ability to create effective test strategies and communicate concise, evidence-based test outcome reports to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, stakeholder-management, written communication, and cross-team collaboration skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in SAFe Agile or other scaled Agile environments. 
 - Strong understanding of GenAI in the SDLC, including prompting techniques and AI-augmented testing approaches. 
 - Experience with contract testing and advanced observability frameworks. 
 - Background in cross-platform application testing across web and mobile. 
 - Experience in compliance-heavy or regulated industries such as financial services, public sector, or healthcare. 
 - Experience contributing to quality engineering transformation or digital testing programs. 
 - Experience leading quality engineering across multiple products, platforms, or distributed teams. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy automation suites or transitioning to Playwright and AI-enabled testing approaches. 
 - Familiarity with non-functional quality areas such as performance, security, accessibility, reliability, and observability. 
 - Relevant testing, cloud, Agile, DevOps, or engineering certifications are an advantage. 

Leadership Competencies

- Lead with accountability, sound judgment, and a strong customer-focused quality mindset. 
 - Communicate quality risks, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to engineering leaders and business stakeholders. 
 - Build alignment across teams without relying solely on authority, and facilitate timely resolution of quality issues. 
 - Create an inclusive, collaborative environment that supports coaching, knowledge sharing, and sustainable delivery. 
 - Continuously improve processes while balancing speed, reliability, maintainability, and business value.

data.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

Position Description
We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join the Advanced Integration Builder team within Okta. This team builds and maintains the backend services, provisioning frameworks, authentication connectors, and next-generation Entitlement Management engines that let Okta customers secure, integrate, and govern access to thousands of third-party enterprise applications - from modern cloud platforms (Microsoft Office 365, Workday, Salesforce, AWS, ServiceNow) and AI agentic systems to legacy on-prem systems. As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design and implementation of integration components end-to-end: REST/SOAP API clients, OAuth2/SAML authentication flows, user and group provisioning/sync jobs, and the retry and rate-limiting logic required to operate reliably against dozens of idiosyncratic third-party vendor APIs at scale. This is a backend-intensive role - the large majority of your time will be spent in Java/Spring Boot services - but you'll also need decent frontend experience in React and JSP to build and extend the screens that surface integration configuration to customers

Job Duties and Responsibilities
- Feature Execution: Drive technical design and implementation of integration features - new app connectors, provisioning/sync capabilities, authentication flows - primarily in backend Java services, extending into React/JSP configuration screens. 
- Build and maintain REST/SOAP API clients, OAuth2/SAML authentication handlers , and vendor-specific exception/error-mapping layers for third-party SaaS and enterprise applications. 
- Implement and extend user/group provisioning adapters built on shared contracts and scheduled sync/import jobs that keep identity data consistent between Okta and external systems. 
- Resilience at Scale: Apply retry/backoff, rate-limiting, and pagination strategies to handle vendor API quirks, throttling, and intermittent failures gracefully across the dozens of concurrently supported integrations. 
- Security & Compliance: Ensure credential/secret handling, token exchange, and audit logging for provisioning operations meet Okta's security and compliance standards. 
- Product & Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with PMs, support, and technical leads to prioritize new app integrations, resolve customer-reported connectivity issues, and participate in technical interviews/recruiting. 
- Operational Excellence: Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues in integration pipelines, drive root-cause analyses, and improve observability/alerting for sync and provisioning jobs. 
- Code Quality & Technical Standards: Participate in code reviews, write thorough unit and functional tests, and maintain clear technical documentation. 
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
- Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience building and operating reliable, production-grade backend services. 
- Backend Expertise: Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot; comfortable owning services end-to-end from design through production support. 
- Distributed Systems: Experience with asynchronous job processing, scheduled/batch sync jobs, and event-driven patterns. 
- Data Management: Proficiency with relational databases (MySQL) and caching layers (Redis or similar). 
- Resilient Systems Design: Practical experience with retry/backoff strategies, rate-limiting, and handling pagination/throttling quirks from third-party APIs. 
- API Design: Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs, including clients for third-party vendor systems with varying levels of API quality and documentation. 
- Problem Solving & Ownership: Ability to break down ambiguous integration requirements and independently drive a feature from design to production. 
- Decent Frontend Experience: While the role is backend-dominant, you should be comfortable building and modifying UI in React and JSP - well enough to independently deliver the frontend without relying on a dedicated frontend engineer. 
Nice to Haves
- Experience with identity/IAM standards (SCIM, SAML, OAuth, OIDC) or directory services (AD, LDAP). 
-Integration & Auth Protocols: Working knowledge of REST/SOAP API integration patterns and authentication standards such as OAuth2, SAML, or WS-Federation. 
- Exposure to legacy protocol support (SOAP-based provisioning services) alongside modern REST/OAuth integrations. 
- Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architectures or specialized compliance environments (e. g. , FedRAMP/GCC-High). 
- Experience with message brokers/queueing systems (Kafka) for asynchronous processing. 
- Exposure to HTTP mocking/test-server frameworks (e. g. , WireMock or equivalent internal mock-server tooling) for API-level testing. 
Education
B. E. /M. S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

data.title: QA Automation Lead
data.description:
We're looking for a QA Automation Lead who enjoys owning product quality end-to-end and building a full testing platform, not just browser automation. 

You'll lead quality engineering across frontend, backend, APIs and integrations: test strategy, automation frameworks, CI gates and release confidence. This role is for someone who wants to do more than write UI scripts or file bugs after the fact. You'll design the quality system across every layer, raise engineering standards, and have real ownership over how we know a release is safe. 

What you'll do 🛠️

- Own quality strategy from risk assessment through automation, CI enforcement and release readiness. 
 - Design a layered test strategy across unit, component, API, contract, integration, smoke, sanity, regression and end-to-end testing, plus accessibility, performance and visual checks where valuable. 
 - Build and scale reliable automation for UI, API and service layers (Playwright, API frameworks, unit/component runners). 
 - Decide which layer owns which risk: keep E2E thin and push most coverage down to unit, API and contract tests. 
 - Set up CI/CD quality gates: PR checks, post-deploy smoke, nightly regression, and a clear process for fixing flaky tests. 
 - Own test data, environments, fixtures and mocks so automation is reproducible from local to staging. 
 - Partner with product and engineering on acceptance criteria, edge cases and risk-based test plans before features ship. 
 - Drive release confidence with smoke, sanity, E2E and regression signals that engineers trust for go/no-go decisions. 
 - Reduce flakiness ruthlessly and keep CI green. 
 - Track meaningful quality metrics (escape rate, flake rate, suite runtime, critical-path coverage), not vanity dashboards. 
 - Join architecture and design reviews to flag testability, failure modes and contract boundaries early. 
 - Mentor QA and engineers on testable code and shared ownership of quality, and help hire and grow the QA/SDET team. 

What we're looking for 🔎

- 5+ years in QA automation or SDET roles, including leading or owning an automation or quality platform. 
 - Hands-on experience across multiple test types, not only browser E2E. 
 - Strong grasp of the test pyramid and when E2E is the wrong tool. 
 - A track record of making flaky suites reliable and keeping CI trustworthy. 
 - Strong debugging skills across UI, network, APIs, services, auth, data and environments. 
 - Good understanding of web and backend architecture: REST APIs, auth/sessions, async jobs and service boundaries. 
 - Ability to risk-rank what to test, at which layer, and what can wait. 
 - Clear written communication: bug reports, test plans and failure analysis engineers can act on. 
 - Experience mentoring others and raising quality standards across engineering. 
 - Comfort with ambiguity, and an ownership mindset that chases failures to root cause. 

Nice to have ✨

- Deep Playwright experience (fixtures, tracing, parallelization, auth setups)
 - Unit/component testing: Vitest, Jest, React Testing Library, pytest, JUnit
 - API testing: Postman/Newman, REST Assured, Supertest, k6
 - Contract testing: Pact, OpenAPI/JSON Schema validation
 - Integration testing against PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka or similar
 - Visual regression, accessibility and performance testing
 - CI/CD with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, Docker and ephemeral test environments
 - Reporting with Allure, Playwright or JUnit reports
 - TypeScript, JavaScript, Python or Go for automation frameworks
 - Familiarity with React/Next. js frontends and REST/event-driven backends
 - Testing complex B2B SaaS workflows (multi-tenant, roles/permissions, long-running jobs)
 - Security-minded testing (authorization gaps, IDOR, secrets in logs)
 - Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup

What we value 🧭

- Quality ownership over QA handoffs: we fix the root cause and prevent the class of failure. 
 - Full-stack quality over browser-only automation: E2E is one tool, not the strategy. 
 - Signal over suite size: fifty reliable tests beat a thousand flaky ones. 
 - Shift-left over late discovery: the cheapest bug is the one that never ships. 
 - Risk-based testing over exhaustive theater: protect critical journeys, push the rest down the pyramid. 
 - Determinism over "just rerun it": flaky tests are defects, and we fix them. 
 - Release confidence over test count: the goal is shipping valuable software safely. This is a high-ownership leadership role with real influence over release quality, automation platforms and engineering culture. 

Probably skip 🚫

- You want a manual-only or browser-only automation role with no interest in API, unit or contract testing. 
 - You measure success by test cases written rather than bugs prevented and CI trust. 
 - You accept flaky tests as normal and tell people to "just rerun. "
 - You only test happy paths and ignore auth, permissions, edge cases and failure modes. 
 - You're uncomfortable reading logs, network traces, API responses or code. 
 - You want to be a gatekeeper who blocks releases without helping fix quality. 
 - You rely on AI-generated selectors and scripts without understanding why they flake. 
 - You're uncomfortable with ambiguity, changing priorities or early-stage startup constraints. 

How to apply? 🧑🏻💻

Send your resume and a short note on why you're a great fit to careers@phinite. ai with the subject line "QA Automation Lead - [Your Name]"

data.title: Lead DevOps Engineer (AI & GPU)
data.description:
Zimperium is a global leader in AI-empowered mobile security, delivering purpose-built protection for mobile applications and devices against advanced threats such as mobile phishing, malware, app vulnerabilities, tampering, device compromise, and zero-day attacks. As cybercriminals increasingly adopt a mobile-first attack strategy, Zimperium enables organizations to detect and stop mobile threats while gaining clear visibility into mobile risk. The company's autonomous security solutions help safeguard critical mobile infrastructures and the sensitive data of organizations and their customers. 

As part of our fast-growing pace, we are seeking an AI Systems Engineer to own the delivery, model-serving, routing, and observability layer of AI-native platform. These are the systems that ship, run, and make fully visible every AI workload. Within the Hybrid AI Multi-Environment Runtime, this role owns how AI services and agents are built and deployed, how models execute, how requests are routed to them, how AI assets are catalogued and governed, how consumption is measured and bounded, and how the entire platform is observed across cloud, on-prem, edge, and air-gapped environments. 

This role owns the delivery and runtime surface, including the CI/CD/CV pipelines that ship AI workloads, secure model execution, semantic routing, and model/prompt selection, together with the governance, discovery, cost, and telemetry systems that keep AI workloads shippable, economical, discoverable, and transparent. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who is equally comfortable building automated delivery pipelines, operating high-performance inference (GPUs, model servers, sandboxed execution), and building deep observability and cost visibility; who understands that in regulated contexts every AI workload must be delivered repeatedly and every AI request must be economically bounded, attributable, and traceable end-to-end. 

Responsibilities: 

- Own DevOps and delivery for AI workloads: build and operate the CI/CD/CV pipelines that ship AI services, agents, and runtime components, including automated build, test, continuous verification, release, and rollback, so AI workloads are delivered repeatedly and safely into every environment. 
 - Own governance and discovery for AI assets, including service catalog/registry (Artifactory/Nexus, Harbor), experiment tracking and model metadata (MLflow), upstream registries/mirrors (HuggingFace/NGC), CVE/SBOM scanning (Trivy), lineage contracts (OpenLineage), and license management. 
 - Own resource and cost management, including quotas and rate limits, cost attribution and utilization (Apptio/OpenCost/Kubecost), so AI execution stays economically bounded and controllable per tenant and engagement. 
 - Own the full observability stack, including metrics (Prometheus/Mimir), logs (Loki), traces (Tempo/Jaeger), dashboards (Grafana), LLM debugging and evaluation (LangSmith/Langfuse), and SLA/alert notifications. 
 - Own the OpenTelemetry collection layer, including multi-tenant receiver, exporters and queues (Kafka sink), DCGM exporter for GPU telemetry, processor batching, and dynamic filtering, so every signal is captured and routed reliably. 
 - Automate GitOps-based delivery and continuous verification; embedding quality, integrity, and cost gates into pipelines so releases are policy-compliant by default rather than by manual review. 
 - Close the loop between delivery and observability by using telemetry, evaluation, and cost signals to drive deployment decisions, progressive rollout, and automated rollback of AI workloads. 
 - Ensure cost and telemetry are identity-stamped and per-tenant, so consumption and behavior are attributable end-to-end, keeping FinOps and observability tied to the workloads that generate the load. 

Requirements: 

- Strong DevOps expertise: CI/CD/CV pipeline design, GitOps, continuous verification, and progressive/automated release and rollback for production workloads. 
 - Deep expertise operating model-serving and inference systems (Ray, vLLM/Triton/NIM) on GPUs at production scale. 
 - Deep observability skills: metrics, logs, traces, and OpenTelemetry. 
 - FinOps mindset: able to attribute, bound, and optimize AI consumption cost per tenant and workload. 
 - Familiarity with model/artifact governance, registries, CVE scanning, and license/lineage tracking. 
 - Comfortable operating across cloud, on-prem, edge, and air-gapped environments with consistent runtime and telemetry semantics. 
 - Strong communicator able to explain runtime, cost, and observability tradeoffs to engineers, architects, and leadership. 

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related technical field. 
 - 8+ years in DevOps, MLOps, platform, or observability engineering, with hands-on production ownership of AI or high-throughput services. 
 - Strong hands-on DevOps experience, including CI/CD/CV pipelines and GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Helm, GitHub Actions/GitLab CI, or equivalents) for automated build, test, release, and rollback. 
 - Hands-on expertise operating inference/model-serving frameworks (Ray Serve, vLLM, Triton, or NIM) on GPU infrastructure. 
 - Strong experience with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo/Jaeger) and OpenTelemetry. 
 - Experience with API gateways and request routing (Envoy or equivalent), including streaming responses. 
 - Experience with cost management / FinOps tooling (OpenCost, Kubecost, or equivalent) and quota/rate-limit enforcement. 
 - Familiarity with model/artifact registries and supply-chain scanning (Harbor, MLflow, Trivy/SBOM). 
 - Proven track record operating AI or service infrastructure under compliance, security, or regulatory constraints. 
 - Ability to define clean ownership boundaries and consumption contracts with platform, trust, and data teams. 

Nice to Have: 

- Experience with LLM evaluation and debugging tooling (LangSmith, Langfuse) and prompt/response quality measurement. 
 - Experience with sandboxed/secure execution (gVisor, Firecracker, or microVM isolation) for untrusted or multi-tenant workloads. 
 - Familiarity with GPU telemetry (DCGM) and GPU utilization optimization. 
 - Experience with lineage and governance contracts (OpenLineage) and AI license management. 
 - Exposure to multi-tenant cost attribution and per-tenant SLA/alerting. 
 - Exposure to regulated delivery environments (financial services, tax, healthcare, risk). 

Zimperium is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Must have skills : AWS CloudFormation

Good to have skills : AWS AI Services

Minimum 12 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary: 

As a Custom Software Engineering Lead, a typical day involves steering the technical vision and architectural framework for bespoke software projects. This role requires guiding teams through the entire lifecycle of design and implementation, ensuring that development practices meet high standards. The position demands continuous oversight to maintain code quality, scalability, and system performance, all while aligning with the strategic goals of the organization. Collaboration with various stakeholders to synchronize efforts and deliver robust software solutions is a key aspect of daily activities. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

- Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.

 - Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions. 
 - Expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams. 
 - Lead the establishment and enforcement of development standards to ensure consistency and quality across projects. 
 - Facilitate effective communication and coordination among cross-functional teams to drive project success.
