data.title: Sourcing IT Team Lead
data.description:
At Chain IQ, your ideas move fast. 

Chain IQ is a global AI-driven Procurement Service Partner, headquartered in Baar, Switzerland, with operations across main centers and 16 offices worldwide. We provide tailored, end-to-end procurement solutions that enable transformation, drive scalability, and deliver substantial reductions in our clients' indirect spend. Our culture is built on innovation, entrepreneurship, ownership, and impact. Here, your voice matters - bold thinking is encouraged, and action follows ambition. 

Purpose

The Team Leader, Tactical IT Sourcing is responsible for leading, developing, and managing a team of Tactical Sourcers supporting global clients across a broad range of IT procurement activities. The team primarily executes lower-complexity, value sourcing projects, quotation exercises, contract renewals, supplier onboarding activities, and operational procurement support. 

The role focuses on ensuring operational excellence, delivery quality, service efficiency, stakeholder satisfaction, and team productivity while developing sourcing capabilities within the India delivery center. The Team Leader acts as the first point of escalation for sourcing challenges, drives process standardization, and ensures adherence to client requirements, procurement policies, and service level agreements (SLAs). 

Operating in a fast-paced shared services environment, the Team Leader is expected to balance people management, workload distribution, process governance, and continuous improvement initiatives while supporting multiple clients and sourcing categories. 

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & People Management

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of Tactical Sourcers. 
 - Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and development planning. 
 - Support recruitment, onboarding, and training of new team members. 
 - Foster a culture of accountability, customer focus, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 - Monitor individual and team performance against KPIs and SLAs. 
 - Ensure appropriate capability development and knowledge sharing across the team. 
 - Drive employee engagement and retention initiatives. 

Operational Delivery Management

- Manage daily sourcing operations and ensure efficient execution of sourcing requests. 
 - Allocate workload effectively across team members to meet client deadlines. 
 - Monitor sourcing pipeline, queues, and project status to ensure timely delivery. 
 - Act as the escalation point for sourcing issues, supplier challenges, and stakeholder concerns. 
 - Ensure sourcing activities are completed according to client processes and policies. 
 - Conduct quality reviews of sourcing events, supplier evaluations, and negotiation outcomes. 
 - Monitor team productivity, utilization, and service quality metrics. 

Tactical Sourcing & Procurement Support

- Oversee execution of RFQs, RFPs, supplier selection exercises, and bid evaluations. 
 - Support commercial negotiations for low- to medium-value sourcing initiatives. 
 - Review supplier quotations and ensure competitive pricing is obtained. 
 - Support contract renewal and extension activities. 
 - Ensure sourcing opportunities are handled according to category strategies and procurement guidelines. 
 - Assist with supplier onboarding and supplier management activities. 
 - Support basic spend analysis and cost optimization opportunities. 

Stakeholder & Client Management

- Build effective working relationships with procurement stakeholders, business users, and suppliers. 
 - Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through responsive service delivery. 
 - Provide sourcing status updates and reporting to internal and external stakeholders. 
 - Support client governance meetings and operational review discussions. 
 - Collaborate closely with Strategic Sourcers, Category Managers, and Client Delivery Teams. 
 - Escalate strategic, high-risk, or complex sourcing matters to senior sourcing leadership. 

Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

- Drive standardization of sourcing processes, templates, and documentation. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and automation. 
 - Support implementation of procurement technologies and e-sourcing tools. 
 - Ensure compliance with procurement policies, audit requirements, and regulatory standards. 
 - Track and report team KPIs, SLA performance, and operational metrics. 
 - Promote best practices across sourcing operations. 

Required Experience & Skills

Professional Experience

- 6-10 years of procurement or sourcing experience. 
 - 2-5 years of people management or team leadership experience. 
 - Experience in shared services, global business services, or procurement operations environments. 
 - Experience managing high-volume sourcing activities and multiple concurrent requests. 
 - Exposure to multinational stakeholder environments. 

Procurement & Sourcing Knowledge

Good Understanding Of

- RFQ and sourcing processes
 - Supplier identification and supplier management
 - Contract renewals and extensions
 - Procurement operations and governance
 - Spend analysis and reporting
 - Basic negotiation principles
 - E-sourcing platforms and procurement technologies

Exposure To IT Procurement Categories Is Preferred, Including

- Software and SaaS
 - Hardware and end-user devices
 - IT services and consulting
 - Cloud services
 - Telecommunications and network services

Leadership Skills

- Strong people leadership and coaching abilities. 
 - Ability to motivate and develop teams in a delivery environment. 
 - Strong organizational and prioritization skills. 
 - Effective stakeholder management skills. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. 
 - Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 

Technical & Language Skills

- Experience using procurement and e-sourcing tools. 
 - Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint. 
 - Familiarity with process automation and AI-enabled procurement tools is advantageous. 
 - Business fluency in English. 
 - Strong reporting and analytics capabilities. 

Join a truly global team. 

We offer a dynamic and international environment where high performance meets real purpose. We're proud to be Great Place to Work-certified and even prouder of the people who make that possible. Let's shape the future of procurement - together. 

Chain IQ - Create. Lead. Make an impact. 

Information for agencies: Applications sent or uploaded by placement agencies or similar are not desired, will therefore not be considered and will be deleted.

Description

Salesforce has immediate opportunities for software developers who want their lines of code to have significant and measurable positive impact for users, the company's bottom line, and the industry. You will be working with a group of world-class engineers to build the breakthrough features our customers will love, adopt, and use while keeping our trusted CRM platform stable and scalable. The software engineer role at Salesforce encompasses architecture, design, implementation, and testing to ensure we build products right and release them with high quality. 

Code review, mentoring junior engineers, and providing technical guidance to the team (depending on the seniority level) We pride ourselves on writing high-quality, maintainable code that strengthens the stability of the product and makes our lives easier. We embrace the hybrid model and celebrate the individual strengths of each team member while encouraging everyone on the team to grow into the best version of themselves. We believe that autonomous teams with the freedom to make decisions will empower the individuals, the product, the company, and the customers they serve to thrive. 

Your Impact

As An Engineering Lead, Your Responsibilities Include

- Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow by pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high-quality code

 - Experience developing SaaS applications on public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
 - Strong understanding of relational and non-relational databases (e. g. , PostgreSQL, Trino, Redshift, MongoDB) and solid SQL skills

data.title: Software Engineering PMTS (Apache, Kafka, Terraform)
data.description:
Description

You will be a Principal Engineer (PMTS) leading the Monitoring Cloud Events team in Hyderabad, India. Our team builds systems that handle huge amounts of data for Salesforce. We make sure everything in our cloud runs the way it should. In this role, your job is to guide the team, build great software, and own the services we create from start to finish. 

What You'll Actually Be Doing

- Day-to-day work: You will build and maintain an Observability stack using in-house, open source and cloud managed services and run data pipelines (ETL) and use big data tools. You will check system health and fix problems quickly so our services stay online. 
 - Leading the way: You will teach and mentor other engineers to help them grow and do their best work. 
 - Working together: You will talk to partners and customers all over the world to make sure they get what they need. 
 - Long-term goals & impact: You will make our cloud faster, safer, and easier to use for millions of people. You will learn how to run big, global systems and become a top leader in the tech world. 

Tech Stack

- Cloud & Compute: AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) for stateless, scalable multi-cloud orchestration. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Terraform for resilient, automated platform provisioning across environments. 
 - Edge Ingestion: OpenTelemetry (OTel) for standardized instrumentation, and Vector/Fluent Bit for high-throughput log routing. 
 - Message Buffering: Apache Kafka to ingest billions of telemetry events, ensuring durable, decoupled data pipelines. 
 - Stream Processing: Apache Flink for real-time log parsing, rolling aggregations, and anomaly detection before storage. 
 - Backend Languages: Java for building heavy stream-processing applications, supplemented by Go and Python for operators and tooling. 
 - Ad-Hoc OLAP Analytics: Apache Druid to power sub-second, interactive dashboard queries over massive historical datasets. 
 - Log & Trace Storage: ClickHouse for fast columnar event storage, natively tiered to AWS S3 / GCP Cloud Storage for cost-effective cold storage. 
 - Time-Series Metrics: VictoriaMetrics, M3DB, or Prometheus to ingest and compress millions of high-cardinality metric rollups. 
 - Visualization & Alerting: Grafana and Apache Superset for single-pane-of-glass UI, paired with Prometheus Alertmanager for incident routing. 

You're Our Person If. . . 

- You have deep experience building software and leading engineering teams. 
 - You know how to move, store, and work with very large amounts of data. 
 - You are highly skilled at building ETL data pipelines. 
 - You have hands-on experience with open-source tools like Kafka, Flink, and Apache Druid. 
 - You are a kind and helpful mentor to other engineers. 
 - You are a great "service owner, " meaning you care deeply about keeping systems online and running smoothly. 

Even Better If. . . 

- You have worked on an Observability stack before (tools that monitor system health and logs). 
 - You have experience working with global teams across different countries and time zones. 
 - You enjoy talking directly to customers to understand and solve their problems. 

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

data.title: Software Development Mgmt 5
data.description:
About The Team / Role

As a Director, Data Platform Engineering, you will be the primary leader and visionary for the core data infrastructure that powers the entire enterprise. This is a "platform-as-a-product" role; your mission is to lead the team building the internal foundation-creating the high-performance engines, abstraction layers, and self-service frameworks that enable hundreds of other engineers to move faster. You will manage a team operating at the intersection of Systems Programming and Data Engineering, solving "hard-tech" problems like automated schema evolution, multi-engine compute optimization, and global data discovery. As a top-level technical leader, you will bridge the gap between long-term business strategy and engineering execution, ensuring WEX's data platform remains a competitive advantage. 

Is this role for you?

- YES, if: You are an Engineering Manager or Lead Backend/Software Engineer who loves leading teams that solve "Big Data" problems, build APIs for data discovery, and optimize distributed systems. 
 - NO, if: Your primary expertise is managing teams that write SQL queries, build Tableau dashboards, or manage ETL workflows without deep experience in Java or Python system architecture. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Strategic Roadmap & Sovereignty: Define and execute the 3-5 year technical roadmap for the Data Lakehouse. You will guide your team in deciding how storage, compute, and metadata layers (e. g. , Apache Polaris, Unity Catalog or Datahub Catalog) interact at an elemental level. 
 - Platform-as-a-Product Delivery: Lead the development of internal SDKs, CLI tools, and automated orchestration frameworks. Your goal is to ensure your team abstracts away cloud complexity via Control Planes and Custom Operators, allowing Data Engineers to focus on business logic rather than infrastructure boilerplate. 
 - Internal R&D Management: Champion and resource prototyping and benchmarking of emerging technologies (e. g. , specialized Spark extensions) to keep the platform at the bleeding edge of performance and cost-efficiency. 
 - Global Governance & Security: Oversee the architecture of "compliance-by-design" systems. Ensure the team automates data lineage, PII masking, and fine-grained access control across petabyte-scale environments without sacrificing developer velocity. 
 - AI Governance Lake: Facilitate real-time data ingestion by implementing streaming support for Open Telemetry data from AI Agents into the Data Lake, drive the development of advanced AI evaluation metrics and reporting. 
 - Engineering Excellence & Delivery: Set the gold standard for code quality and system design across the company. You will oversee Cross-Functional Architecture Reviews and ensure your team effectively resolves the most complex system outages or performance bottlenecks. 
 - Team Leadership & Mentorship: Hire, mentor, and grow a world-class engineering team. Foster an "Engineering Community, " influencing the hiring bar and professional development paths for the entire data engineering organization. 

Experience You Will Bring

- Experience: 15+ years in software engineering and distributed systems, with at least 4 years of experience managing high-performing engineering teams delivering platform-scale initiatives. 
 - Core Technical Competencies (Software Engineering Focus): 
 - Strong Software Foundations: Deep understanding of software engineering, system architecture, and scalable production applications (Algorithms, Data Structures, and System Design). Experience in the Java/J2EE ecosystem (Spring Boot, Microservices) and Python. We are looking for a leader who ensures their team writes clean, testable, and high-performance code, not just scripts. 
 - Data as a Product: Experience managing or building the platforms / framework engines and APIs that power data movement, rather than just building the ETL/ELT pipelines themselves. 
 - Data Lakehouse Mastery: 
 - Deep understanding of Apache Iceberg, Hudi, or Delta Lake (metadata management, manifest files, and compaction strategies). 
 - Experience managing teams contributing to or deeply customizing open-source data projects (e. g. , Spark, dbt). 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure: 
 - Extensive experience with cloud architecture and services, including AWS (S3, EMR, Kubernetes, Lambda) and Azure. 
 - Deep understanding of CI/CD automation, modern development tools, Git Actions, Terraform and frameworks. 
 - AI-Driven Development & Productivity: 
 - AI Native Development: Experience leveraging AI Code Gen platforms into the software development lifecycle (SDLC) to automate code generation, reviews, generate unit tests, and perform root-cause analysis of system failures. 
 - LLM-Ops for Platform: Ability to guide the architecture of infrastructure required to support AI Agent development by enabling vector database integration. 
 - Leadership & Vision: 
 - Proven track record of driving adoption of new technologies across multiple autonomous teams. 
 - Ability to communicate complex architectural trade-offs (e. g. , "Latency vs. Consistency" or "Build vs. Buy") to C-suite executives and engineering teams alike. 
 - Education: 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science (Distributed Systems focus) preferred, or equivalent deep industry experience.

data.title: Software Engineering PMTS - Cloud Infra & Security
data.description:
Description

Come join our growing Hyperforce Enterprise Security organization. We are chartered with architecting, implementing, and operating security solutions that protect Salesforce's complex, multi-cloud technology landscape at scale. 

As a Principal Member of Technical Staff, you will provide technical leadership in building the next generation of infrastructure security and developer security guardrails. You will work across the software development and deployment lifecycle to identify security risks early, build scalable controls, and enable secure-by-default engineering practices without compromising developer velocity. 

Our team operates at the intersection of cloud security, application security, infrastructure security, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and runtime security. We build and operate security guardrails that identify and prevent high-risk security issues from source code and Infrastructure as Code through CI/CD and into runtime environments. 

You will be expected to operate at both strategic and hands-on technical levels, defining architecture and technical direction while also diving deeply into complex engineering problems, writing production-quality code, and driving solutions from concept through deployment and operation. 

This role is an opportunity to shape security capabilities that operate at significant scale across Salesforce infrastructure and to influence how security is embedded throughout the engineering lifecycle. 

Responsibilities

- Act as a technical leader and subject matter expert for infrastructure security and security guardrails, providing architectural direction across teams. 
 - Design and build scalable shift-left security capabilities that identify security risks in source code, Infrastructure as Code, containerized workloads, and deployment configurations before they reach production. 
 - Architect and build shift-left security controls that identify security risks early while providing developers with actionable findings and straightforward remediation paths. 
 - Design scalable policy-as-code and security enforcement frameworks for consistent security controls across multiple gates and environments. 
 - Drive risk-based security engineering by identifying exploitable, high-impact, and meaningful security risks rather than treating all scanner findings equally. 
 - Design mechanisms for security finding correlation, prioritization, deduplication, and enforcement when signals originate from multiple security systems. 
 - Lead architecture and implementation of Kubernetes admission control and workload security capabilities. 
 - Define technical strategies for reliability, scalability, performance, observability, fault tolerance, and operational readiness of security services. 
 - Establish and evolve SLIs, SLOs, telemetry, rollout strategies, and operational practices for critical security services. 
 - Own technical outcomes across the complete lifecycle - requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, production readiness, rollout, and ongoing operations. 
 - Continuously identify opportunities to improve security coverage, automation, detection quality, enforcement, and developer experience. 
 - Establish engineering standards and best practices for reliability, scalability, observability, testing, and operational readiness of security services. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar across the organization. 
 - Influence technical strategy and roadmap decisions across teams and drive initiatives from concept through production. 
 - Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow by pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high-quality code. 
 - Design and orchestrate complex systems where AI agents integrate seamlessly into human workflows, driving efficiency and innovation at scale. 
 - Contribute to building and maintaining the shared system context, an explicit repository of system designs, constraints, and standards that enables AI to operate accurately and reliably. 
 - Critically evaluate code (human or AI-generated) for correctness, quality, security, and performance. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field involving software/systems engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 15+ years of software engineering, systems engineering, security engineering with significant experience designing and delivering large-scale production systems. 
 - Strong programming experience in one or more languages such as Go, Java, or Python, with the ability to design, implement, debug, and review production-quality systems. 
 - Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure and cloud security, including experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native infrastructure. 
 - Strong understanding of CI/CD architecture and DevSecOps, including deployment pipelines, security gates, policy enforcement, and automation. 
 - Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform, Helm, CloudFormation, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Experience designing distributed, highly scalable, reliable, and secure systems. 
 - Strong understanding of security engineering concepts including vulnerability management, configuration security, policy enforcement, workload security, identity/access controls, and risk assessment. 
 - Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous security problems, identify the core technical challenge, and drive an architecture and implementation to completion. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex architectures and trade-offs to senior technical and business audiences. 
 - Preferred Qualifications
 - Deep experience in cloud-native security, DevSecOps, infrastructure security, or application security. 
 - Experience building security platforms/services or guardrails that operate at large enterprise scale. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes Admission Controllers, admission policies, OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, or similar policy enforcement technologies. 
 - Experience with policy-as-code and security-as-code frameworks. 
 - Experience with IaC security and tools such as Checkov, OPA, Terraform security scanning, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of container and workload security, including Seccomp, Linux security mechanisms, container isolation, and runtime security. 
 - Experience building systems that correlate security signals from multiple sources and prioritize findings based on risk, exploitability, exposure, and business impact. 
 - Experience with vulnerability management, cloud security posture management, container security, or automated security remediation. 
 - Experience designing developer-facing security products with a strong focus on actionable findings, low friction remediation, and developer experience. 
 - Experience designing security controls across the complete lifecycle: source → IaC → CI/CD → deployment → admission → runtime. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud networking, identity, workload architecture, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience driving technical strategy across multiple engineering organizations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to identify new security opportunities and turn them into scalable engineering solutions. 
 - Experience mentoring senior engineers and serving as a technical leader for complex, multi-team initiatives. 
 - A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering - using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty. 
 - Experience using AI tools (e. g. , Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc. ) in development workflows. 
 - Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will be expected to: 

- Raise the technical bar for infrastructure and developer security engineering. 
 - Build security controls that are effective, scalable, reliable, and developer-friendly. 
 - Move security closer to the point where risks are introduced through strong shift-left and automated enforcement. 
 - Improve the ability to distinguish noise from meaningful and exploitable risk. 
 - Establish consistent security coverage and enforcement across the software delivery lifecycle. 
 - Drive complex initiatives from architecture and design through implementation, production deployment, and operational maturity. 
 - Identify gaps in the current security landscape and proactively develop innovative solutions to address them.

data.title: Team Lead - Fund Accounting
data.description:
About Us

WHY LINEDATA ?

Join us in shaping the fintech of tomorrow. 

With more than 1, 350 colleagues across 20 locations worldwide, you'll help build cutting-edge platforms and tailored services that power the daily operations of 700 leading financial institutions. As a global, multicultural company with over 45 nationalities represented and just as many languages spoken, we thrive on diverse perspectives and collaboration. Together, we tackle future-focused topics like Al and the digitalization of finance, delivering smart solutions for our customers. 

Whether you're just beginning your career or are an experienced professional, Linedata offers exposure to large-scale client projects, internal mobility and opportunities to develop your skills alongside leading experts. 

Position Responsibilities

The role will involve the following critical activities: 

- Supervise preparation and review of fund financial statements, loan schedules, NAVs, and investor capital account summaries. 
 - Review journal entries, loan-level accruals, amortization schedules, and general ledger maintenance. 
 - Ensure compliance with GAAP/IFRS and Private Credit-specific accounting policies. 
 - Oversee calculation of management fees, performance fees, carried interest, and fund operating expenses. 
 - Review monthly/quarterly valuation of loans, including interest PIK accruals, OID amortization, prepayment calculations, and impairment assessments. 
 - Oversee daily/periodic loan servicing activities such as interest accruals, cash movements, repayments, drawdowns, and roll-forwards. 
 - Review credit facility accounting (revolvers, term loans, subscription lines, and leverage facilities). 
 - Monitor covenant compliance tracking and SOFR/LIBOR updates for floating-rate loans. 
 - Ensure accurate setup and maintenance of loan investment data, pricing, and valuation inputs. 
 - Lead preparation and review of investor statements, capital account allocations, and performance reporting. 
 - Oversee capital calls, distributions, equalizations, and allocation of income, fees, and expenses. 
 - Maintain and review investor capital accounts, waterfall models, and performance calculations. 
 - Liaise with investor relations teams and respond to investor queries. 
 - Manage, guide, and mentor a team of analysts and senior associates. 
 - Delegate tasks effectively, set priorities, and track delivery against KPIs. 
 - Conduct training and development sessions to enhance team capabilities. 
 - Drive process automation, standardization, and efficiency improvements. 
 - Ensure strong internal controls and issue remediation plans. 
 - Coordinate with auditors, fund administrators, and internal control teams during audits. 
 - Ensure all documentation, checklists, and reconciliations meet compliance requirements. 
 - Identify and mitigate operational risks proactively. 

Looking For

Must Have: 

- Qualified Accountant or equivalent. 
 - CA with 4+ years' experience in Fund Accounting OR MBA (Finance) with 6+ years' experience. 
 - Strong understanding of fund accounting principles including NAV calculation, income accruals, loan valuation, amortization (OID/Premium/Discount), and pricing. 
 - Experience in Private Credit / Direct Lending / Loan Accounting (Term Loans, Mezzanine, Senior Secured Loans, Revolvers). 
 - Ability to compute and review interest accruals, PIK interest, commitment fees, prepayment penalties, and amortization schedules. 
 - Experience with accounting tools, general ledger systems, loan servicing platforms. 
 - Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills. 
 - Strong MS Office skills. 
 - Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. 

Good To Have

- Experience with WSO, eFront, Investran, Geneva, or similar systems. 
 - Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, formulas, basic macros). 
 - Strong analytical, leadership, and organizational abilities. 
 - Experience managing multiple deliverables in a deadline-driven environment.

Dedicated system architects will provide the macro architecture and domain designs; your job is to translate those blueprints into concrete Low-Level Designs (LLDs), data schemas, and clean API contracts, while writing production code alongside your team. You will run daily technical unblocking, review pull requests with high standards, and maintain the pod's delivery cadence. 

Key Responsibilities

Hands-on Feature Engineering (60%): Write clean, production-grade asynchronous backend code, build stateful workflow engines, and integrate third-party APIs, data stores, and event brokers. 

Low-Level Design & Task Scaffolding (20%): Take high-level architectural diagrams and break them down into modular interface designs, schema validations and well-scoped technical tickets for 4-5 engineers. 

Technical Mentorship & Unblocking (20%): Run PR reviews, pair-program through complex race conditions and deadlocks, establish testing/mocking standards, and maintain CI/CD pipelines.

data.title: Senior/Lead Robotics Validation Engineer
data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we'll advance your career. 

Robotics Lead Validation Engineer

About The Role

Join AMD's PAVS team as a Robotics Developer experience Usecases Validation Engineer where you will Validate and Execute diverse Robotics platforms, variants and customer usecases for advanced robotics systems across software, hardware, and integrated platforms. Your work will ensure safety, reliability, and performance through rigorous testing in simulation, Gazebo, Isaac sim, SIL/HIL environments, and real-world deployments. 

Key Responsibilities

- Validation Strategy & Usecases : Define Usecases and execute validation plans for robotics software stacks (perception, planning, control) and hardware subsystems. 
 - Automation & Frameworks: Develop automated test suites for ROS2 nodes, navigation stack (Nav2), and fleet APIs using Python/C++, pytest, gtest/gmock. 
 - Simulation & Scenario Testing: Build simulation environments (Gazebo/Ignition, Isaac Sim) for warehouse layouts; author scenarios for obstacle avoidance, dynamic traffic, and multi-robot coordination. 
 - SIL/HIL Validation: Set up Software-in-the-Loop and Hardware-in-the-Loop rigs for AMR controllers, LiDAR emulators, and safety sensors; automate provisioning and logging. 
 - Sensor QA: Validate LiDAR, depth cameras, IMU, wheel encoders, and odometry accuracy under varying conditions. 
 - Navigation & Fleet QA: Test SLAM, localization robustness, path planning, and fleet orchestration (traffic management, task allocation, VDA5050 compliance). 
 - Safety & Compliance: Execute safety protocols for AMRs (emergency stop, zone monitoring, speed limits) aligned with ISO 3691-4, ISO 13849, ANSI/RIA R15. 06. 
 - Performance & Reliability: Measure latency, throughput, and stability under high-load scenarios; validate battery management and docking behaviors. 
 - CI/CD Integration: Embed automated tests into pipelines for continuous validation; monitor KPIs like defect escape rate and scenario coverage. 
 - Leadership: Act as a strong individual contributor and mentor for robotics validation teams; collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure customer experience is prioritized. 

Required Qualifications

- 6-12 years in QA/Validation, with 7+ years in robotics or AMR systems. 
 - Strong Python for automation and C++ for ROS2 integration. 
 - Hands-on experience with ROS2, Nav2 stack, colcon, and simulation tools (Gazebo/Ignition, Isaac Sim). 
 - Expertise in LiDAR, depth cameras, IMU, odometry, and sensor calibration. 
 - Familiarity with fleet management systems, traffic control, and VDA5050 protocol. 
 - CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Jenkins; Docker-based test environments. 
 - Knowledge of functional safety standards for mobile robots (ISO 3691-4, ISO 13849). 

Preferred Skills

- Multi-robot coordination, dynamic obstacle handling, and SLAM algorithms. 
 - Robotics AMR safety PLCs, zone scanners, and emergency stop circuits. 
 - Warehouse automation workflows, WMS integration, and OPC-UA. 
 - Performance benchmarking, reliability testing, and telemetry dashboards. 

Success Metrics

- Automated coverage of navigation and fleet scenarios. 
 - Reduction in field defect escape rate. 
 - Stability and reliability under multi-robot deployments. 
 - Compliance with safety standards and successful audits. 

🎓 Academic Credentials

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Electronics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or a related field.

data.title: Build and Integration (B&I) Staff Engineer - Customer Engineering Team
data.description:
Company

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Applications Engineering

General Summary

JOB OVERVIEW

This position is part of the Qualcomm Customer Engineering Group, which collaborates closely with automotive partners and customers - from concept through commercialization - across Qualcomm's broad Snapdragon Automotive platform portfolio. The team supports all aspects of embedded software including hardware and software architecture, feature bring-up, platform integration, software customization, system validation, and complex debugging efforts that are critical to product launch. 

This is a Staff-level Software Applications Engineering position focused on Build & Integration (B&I) and Release Engineering for Qualcomm Snapdragon Automotive platforms. The primary mission of this role is to own, drive, and continuously improve build systems, integration pipelines, and release processes that enable automotive software delivery across IVI, ADAS, and FLEX segments for global automotive customers. The role spans multiple OS environments including Linux, Android, QNX (HQX), and HGY (Gunyah Hypervisor) with multi-OS virtualized stacks. 

The successful candidate will serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Build & Integration engineering within the BDC CE team, driving cross-functional collaboration between Customer Engineering, Dev/Platform SW teams, and global automotive OEM/Tier-1 partners. As a Staff Engineer, this individual will provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, define build and release methodologies, and contribute to the continuous improvement of automation frameworks and engineering productivity tooling. 

Key Responsibilities

Build, Integration & Release Management

- Own and manage end-to-end build, integration, and release activities for complex Snapdragon Automotive software products spanning multiple OS platforms. 
 - Design, implement, and maintain scalable and reliable build infrastructures and CI/CD pipelines tailored for embedded and HLOS automotive software stacks. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of build systems, toolchains, automation frameworks, and release processes across program milestones. 
 - Establish release governance, versioning, branching, tagging, and artifact management strategies for multi-OS automotive software deliveries. 
 - Monitor build health, integration quality, and release readiness across multiple product streams and chipset generations. 
 - Collaborate with development, quality engineering, and platform teams to ensure successful integration and deployment. 
 - Identify bottlenecks and implement measures to improve build performance, reliability, and delivery efficiency. 
 - Define and maintain build and release KPIs, dashboards, and operational metrics to track program health. 
 - Ensure compliance with software development standards, security policies, and release governance processes. 
 - Lead investigations and root-cause analysis for build failures, integration issues, and release blockers. 

Triage & Engineering Support

- Serve as the primary escalation point for build and integration-related issues across the Customer Engineering (CE) team. 
 - Provide timely triage, troubleshooting, and resolution support for development, integration, and release issues. 
 - Analyze build logs, compiler errors, dependency conflicts, toolchain issues, and deployment failures. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for recurring engineering issues; own Change Requests (CRs) end-to-end from triage through patch validation. 
 - Partner with product, platform, and infrastructure teams to resolve cross-functional technical challenges. 
 - Develop self-service tools, documentation, and best practices to improve engineering productivity across the BDC CE team. 
 - Track and manage technical debt associated with build environments, toolchains, and integration workflows. 

Customer Engagement & Technical Support

- Serve as a key technical interface for build and integration queries from automotive OEM and Tier-1 customers across regions. 
 - Support Automotive RFI (AutoRFI) assessments for B&I-related NRE scoping, communicating technical complexity and resource requirements. 
 - Engage with customers during bring-up, pre-CS, and post-CS phases to proactively identify and mitigate build and integration risks. 
 - Provide on-site customer support as required during critical program milestones. 
 - Collaborate with NA, EU, and India CE teams to ensure global follow-the-sun build and integration support. 

Automation, Tools & Engineering Productivity

- Drive development and validation of build and release automation frameworks for multi-OS automotive software platforms. 
 - Design and maintain automated build health monitors, integration quality dashboards, and triage tooling to reduce mean time to resolution. 
 - Partner with platform and APT (Automated Platform Test) teams to define and integrate build qualification checks across CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Create and maintain build guides, integration runbooks, and reusable diagnostic artifacts for build and release issues across platforms. 
 - Track and analyze build and integration trends across program stages (Bringup → ES → L0-L4 → FC → CS) and communicate risk to program and customer teams. 
 - Contribute to secure software supply chain and DevSecOps practices within the automotive software delivery pipeline. 

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

- Serve as the B&I SME for the BDC CE team, providing architectural guidance on build system design, integration strategy, and release engineering. 
 - Lead cross-functional B&I reviews with Dev, QA, DevOps, and CE teams; drive root-cause analysis delivery to enable process improvements. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on build system concepts, CI/CD best practices, scripting, and customer engagement. 
 - Influence feature design and architecture decisions to proactively prevent build and integration failures in future Snapdragon Automotive SPs. 
 - Scale technical knowledge through reusable documentation, training materials, and knowledge-base contributions. 

Minimum Qualifications

Education & Experience

- One of the following: 
 - B. E. / B. Tech in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, or related field with 8+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Embedded Systems, or related experience. 
 - M. Tech / M. S. in relevant field with 6+ years of experience. 
 - Ph. D. in relevant field with 4+ years of experience. 

Required Technical Skills

- 5+ years of hands-on experience in build, integration, and release engineering for large-scale software products. 
 - Strong expertise in CI/CD pipeline design, implementation, and optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience with build automation systems (Make, CMake, Bazel, Ninja, Gradle, or similar). 
 - Proficiency in scripting languages: Python, Shell/Bash for build and automation workflows. 
 - Strong expertise in source control management and branching strategies (GitFlow, Trunk-Based Development). 
 - Experience with artifact repository management and release artifact governance. 
 - Experience with Linux/Unix build environments and containerized build infrastructure. 
 - 3+ years of customer-facing or cross-functional technical support experience. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to document RCAs and communicate technical findings to cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Staff-level experience owning build and integration engineering for production automotive programs (IVI / ADAS / FLEX) from bringup through SOP. 
 - Experience with multi-OS build environments spanning Linux, Android, QNX (HQX), and HGY (Gunyah Hypervisor). 
 - Familiarity with Qualcomm Snapdragon Automotive chipsets across Gen3 / Gen4 / Gen4. 5 / Gen5 software delivery pipelines. 
 - Experience with DevSecOps practices and secure software supply chain management. 
 - Knowledge of containerization (Docker) and cloud-native build pipelines for embedded software. 
 - Familiarity with ASPICE process compliance, ASIL functional safety considerations, and automotive program delivery cycles. 
 - Experience with AutoRFI processes, NRE scoping, and CDEV (Chipset Development) activities within CE programs. 
 - Knowledge of build and release KPI frameworks, dashboards, and workload-based productivity trend analysis. 
 - Proven experience collaborating with global automotive OEM and Tier-1 customers on build, integration, and release escalations. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience. 

OR

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience. 

OR

To strengthen this motivated team, we are looking for an experienced and dedicated Control design Engineer with high interest in power electronics and control technology. As the system being continuously evolving, becoming more complex and customized, great deal of test & verification are required. Thus, the job description would be as given below: 

How You'll Make An Impact

- You will be responsible for planning of control and protection systems for power electronic converter projects. 
 - You will focus on continuously improving GPQS Overall Control engineering tasks. 
 - You will be responsible for Open loop controls application development and design using Compact control builder. 
 - Programming skills in Structure Text, Functional block diagram, etc. C, C++, Java programming skills are added advantage.

 - Technical co-ordination with sub suppliers and multiple stakeholders in different locations & discussion with other departments / stakeholders to prepare the Division of works.

 - Involved in FAT / SAT activities with along with sub suppliers.

data.title: DevOps Engineer
data.description:
ACI powers the payments ecosystem - globally, and you power ACI. You'll innovate, collaborate, and grow - in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers - in all roles and levels - are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments. 
As a DevOps Engineer in Pune, India, you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world's payments ecosystem!
A typical day at ACI for a DevOps Engineer is: 
• Responsible for designing, developing and delivering high quality Development Operations tools. 
• Analyzes reports of customer or development reported problems and provides long term solutions and improvements. 
• Maintains detailed knowledge of the hardware platform, network and application layers. Manages the dependencies for use in designing proper solutions. 
• Provides guidance and subject matter expertise to the development organization. 
• Actively contributes to CI/CD automation streams and DevOps initiatives supporting business scalability and operational excellence. 
• Perform other duties as assigned. 
• Understand and adhere to all corporate policies to include but not limited to the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics. 
Knowledge, Skills and Experience needed to succeed in this role: 
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent software development experience. 
• 3 to 6 years DevOps / SRE or infrastructure setup experience including development/system administration. 
• Experience with Linux/Unix and scripting languages. 
• Strong understanding of hardware platforms, networking concepts and application layers. 
• Experience supporting automation, continuous integration and continuous delivery practices. 
Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Experience needed for this role: 
• DevOps, Containerization and native Cloud (Azure) experience would be preferred. 
• Linux System Engineer experience would be a plus. 
• Experience with Configuration Management tools such as Ansible, Puppet or Terraform. 
• Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins. 
• Experience with Source Code Management tools such as Git, Bitbucket, Gerrit or Gitea. 
• Experience with scripting languages including Bash, Python or Groovy. 
• Experience with Build tools such as Gradle. 
• Experience with Artifactory solutions such as JFrog or Nexus. 
• Experience with HashiCorp Vault and Consul. 
• Experience with Virtualization and Containerization technologies including VMware, Docker and Kubernetes. 
• Experience with Reporting, Statistics and Analytics tools such as Nagios, Dynatrace, Prometheus and Grafana. 
• Experience with Apache Tomcat and OpenSSL. 
Core Capabilities: 
We seek colleagues who embody our core capabilities - these shape our culture and enable us to make a meaningful impact together: 
• Ensure Accountability: holding self and others accountable to meet commitments. 
• Drives Results: consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances. 
• Customer Focus: building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions. 
• Cultivate Innovation: creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful. 
• Collaborates: building partnerships and working collaboratively with others. 
• Courage: stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said. 
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in India on a full-time basis. This position does not offer sponsorship for employment visa status or work permit now or in the future. 
In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package-all within an innovative and collaborative work environment. 
Our benefits are the "Best in Industry" such as: 
• Health Insurance for Employee and Family with periodic health checkups. 
• Paid time off and sick time off. 
• Maternity and Paternity time off.

ACI Worldwide is an AA/EEO employer in the United States, which includes providing equal opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities, and an EEO employer globally. Important Notice About Recruitment Scams

data.title: Site Reliability Engineering Manager
data.description:
SITE RELIABILITY ENGINEERING (SRE) MANAGER

Job Description | AWS & Azure | Banking & Fintech

Location: Bangalore

Experience: Typically 6+ years in infrastructure, cloud engineering, DevOps, or SRE, including 3+ years leading technical teams

Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on SRE Manager to lead the reliability, availability, performance, and security of platforms serving major banks and fintech companies. 

This role combines technical delivery, people management, and client engagement. You will design and operate production infrastructure across AWS and Microsoft Azure, lead a team of SRE engineers, and work directly with client technology, security, and operations teams. You should be comfortable troubleshooting a production incident, reviewing infrastructure code, developing your team, and explaining technical risks to senior client stakeholders. 

Key Responsibilities

Hands-on technical leadership

Design, build, and operate highly available, scalable, and resilient infrastructure across AWS and Azure. 

Lead architecture reviews covering availability, capacity, security, operability, and disaster recovery. 

Remain actively involved in infrastructure automation, code reviews, troubleshooting, and complex production issues. 

Establish service-level indicators and objectives (SLIs/SLOs), define error budgets, and use them to guide reliability improvements. 

Reduce operational toil through automation, self-service tooling, and repeatable engineering practices. 

Own capacity planning, performance tuning, cloud cost optimization, and production readiness reviews. 

Cloud infrastructure and platform engineering

Manage AWS services such as EC2, EKS, VPC, IAM, RDS/Aurora, S3, CloudWatch, Route 53, and load balancing. 

Manage Azure services such as Virtual Machines, AKS, Virtual Networks, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure SQL, Storage, Azure Monitor, and Application Gateway. 

Build and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform or equivalent tools, with appropriate testing, review, and change controls. 

Operate Kubernetes and container platforms, including deployments, upgrades, scaling, networking, access controls, and troubleshooting. 

Engineer secure connectivity across cloud environments and client networks, including private endpoints, VPNs, AWS Direct Connect, and Azure ExpressRoute. 

Develop reliable CI/CD workflows with deployment safeguards, rollback strategies, configuration management, and secrets management. 

Reliability and production operations

Establish observability across metrics, logs, traces, synthetic checks, and actionable alerting. 

Lead incident response for critical services, including incident coordination, technical troubleshooting, stakeholder updates, and recovery. 

Own on-call practices, escalation paths, operational runbooks, and incident readiness. 

Drive blameless post-incident reviews and ensure corrective actions are completed. 

Define and validate backup, restoration, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures against agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives (RTO/RPO). 

Improve resilience through failure testing, dependency analysis, and controlled recovery exercises. 

Security and financial services requirements

Partner with security and compliance teams to implement least-privilege access, encryption, key management, vulnerability remediation, and audit logging. 

Operate within client requirements for data protection, data residency, segregation of duties, and controlled production access. 

Support security reviews, audits, and evidence collection for applicable standards and regulatory requirements, such as PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and relevant banking regulations. 

Ensure production changes are traceable, reviewed, tested, and aligned with client change-management processes. 

Design and operate infrastructure supporting sensitive financial workloads and critical transaction services. 

Team leadership and management

Hire, mentor, and manage a team of SRE engineers, setting clear expectations and supporting career development. 

Own team priorities, delivery planning, performance reviews, and skills development. 

Balance hands-on engineering with delegation and development of technical ownership within the team. 

Build a sustainable on-call model and manage workload, coverage, and operational health. 

Establish engineering standards and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 

Work closely with application engineering, architecture, security, delivery, and support teams. 

Client engagement

Serve as the primary SRE contact for major banking and fintech clients. 

Translate client requirements and contractual service commitments into technical designs and operational plans. 

Lead service reviews, reliability discussions, incident reviews, and infrastructure planning sessions. 

Communicate incidents, risks, dependencies, and remediation plans clearly to both technical and business stakeholders. 

Manage client escalations and coordinate internal teams to deliver timely resolution. 

Present service performance, reliability trends, capacity forecasts, and improvement roadmaps. 

Required Skills and Experience

Strong production engineering experience across both AWS and Azure, including architecture, networking, security, and operations. 

Demonstrated experience managing an SRE, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, or platform engineering team. 

Recent hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and CI/CD platforms. 

Strong Linux administration, networking, and troubleshooting skills, including DNS, TLS, HTTP, routing, firewalls, and load balancing. 

Proficiency in at least one automation language, such as Python, Go, or PowerShell, along with shell scripting. 

Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Open Telemetry, LGTM Stack, Splunk, or cloud-native monitoring services. 

Practical understanding of SLOs, error budgets, incident management, distributed systems, and resilience engineering. 

Experience operating databases, caches, and messaging systems, with an understanding of replication, failover, backup, and recovery. 

Proven ability to lead major production incidents and deliver lasting improvements. 

Strong client-facing communication skills, including experience handling escalations and explaining technical tradeoffs. 

Experience supporting banking, fintech, payments, or other highly regulated production environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

AWS Solutions Architect Professional, AWS DevOps Engineer Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, or relevant Kubernetes certifications. 

Experience with payment platforms, digital banking, transaction processing, or financial APIs. 

Experience with hybrid cloud, multi-region architectures, and private connectivity to enterprise environments. 

Familiarity with ITIL processes and enterprise service management tools such as ServiceNow or Jira Service Management. 

What Success Looks Like

Services consistently meet agreed reliability and performance objectives. 

Major incidents are managed effectively, with clear client communication and measurable reductions in repeat failures. 

Infrastructure is secure, automated, recoverable, and cost-efficient. 

The team grows in capability and operates with sustainable workloads. 

Banking and fintech clients have confidence in service operations and the reliability improvement roadmap.

 - Strong knowledge of Kubernetes, containerisation concepts, Operators, Ingress, Networking, Storage and cluster lifecycle, including Machine set, cluster autoscaling, safe drain/cordon, RHCOS patch cycles, worker pools, quotas and configuring limits and requests.

 - Experience administering Azure components: RBAC, Entra ID, PIM, Policies, Networking, Firewalls, DNS, Log Analytics, Azure Monitor. 
 - Skilled with CLI tools: oc, kubectl, az. 
 - Experience with CI/CD tooling (Azure DevOps, Git), Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform), YAML pipelines. 
 - Strong knowledge of observability tooling (Cluster Logging/Log Forwarder, Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic, Splunk, Log Analytics, ServiceNow). 
 - Demonstrable experience supporting production platforms and diagnosing complex, multi-layered issues. 
 - Knowledge of Private ARO networking ( VNet peering, UDRs, NAT Gateway/Azure Firewall egress, Private DNS). 

You need to be this kind of person

- Passionate about leading a highly motivated team to drive business outcomes
 - Able to work and learn quickly in a fast paced, fun and dynamic environment
 - Curious to learn and develop your own technical skills
 - Able to both collaborate and move as a team but also be self-motivated and deliver results independently when required. 
 - Able to take ownership of issues, tasks and solutions managing them from inception to conclusion. Whilst working within the audit and governance frameworks. 
 - Ability to challenge and speak up in discussions with colleagues of all levels

Educational Qualification:

We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. data.title: System Architect - Automation Train Protection Systems
data.description:
Hello Visionary!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We're looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you'd make a great addition to our vibrant international team. 

We are looking for a System Architect - Automation Train Protection Systems

You'll Make a Difference By

- We are seeking an experienced System Architect to lead the design and specification of Automatic Train Protection (ATP) systems in the railway domain. This role focuses on embedded safety-critical systems and requires deep expertise in SIL4-compliant architectures, systems thinking, and stakeholder collaboration. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with train protection technologies such as Kavach (TCAS), PTC, ETCS, and TCAS. 
 - Key Responsibilities: 
 - System Architecture & Design
 - Define and maintain System Requirements Specifications (SRS) and System Architecture Specifications (SAS). 
 - Develop and manage Interface Control Documents (ICDs) and ensure seamless integration across subsystems. 
 - Ensure system design complies with SIL4 safety standards (EN 50126, EN 50128, EN 50129). 
 - Apply systems thinking to analyze, design, and optimize complex embedded systems. 
 - Quickly understand base solutions and adapt them to meet evolving customer and regulatory requirements. 
 - Utilize UML modeling for system design and documentation. 
 - Apply simulation tools to validate system behavior and performance under various operational scenarios. 
 - Quickly Understanding base solutions and defining reuse approach. 
 - Stakeholder Management
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams including hardware, software, safety, and validation. 
 - Engage with customers, certification bodies, and railway operators to align system design with expectations. 
 - Lead technical discussions and ensure traceability of requirements through the development lifecycle. 
 - Domain Expertise
 - Apply knowledge of Train Protection Systems such as: 
 - Kavach (TCAS) - Indian Train Collision Avoidance System. 
 - PTC - Positive Train Control (USA). 
 - ETCS - European Train Control System. 
 - Understand operational scenarios, fail-safe mechanisms, and interoperability requirements. 
 - Technical Leadership
 - Guide engineering teams in implementing system-level designs and safety architectures. 
 - Support safety case development, validation, and certification processes. 
 - Evaluate and recommend tools, platforms, and technologies for system development. 
 - Required Skills & Qualifications: 
 - Bachelor's or master's degree in Electronics, Computer Science, or related field. 
 - 15+ years of experience in embedded systems architecture, preferably in railway or other safety-critical domains. 
 - Proven experience with SIL4-compliant system design and safety lifecycle processes. 
 - Strong understanding of real-time systems, microcontrollers, and communication protocols. 
 - Familiarity with tools like DOORS, Enterprise Architect, and model-based systems engineering (MBSE). 
 - Proficiency in UML design and system modeling. 
 - Experience with simulation environments for embedded systems validation.

data.title: ETL Tester
data.description:
Role Summary: 

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented ETL Senior Tester to join our growing data team. The successful candidate will be responsible for validating the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of data as it flows through our enterprise-grade Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) and Extract, Load, Transform (ELT) processes and data pipelines. This role is crucial for ensuring the reliability of our data for analytics, reporting, and critical business operations. 

The ETL Tester will play a key role in designing and executing comprehensive test plans, scenarios, and cases for complex data transformations, data migrations, and data warehousing solutions. They will collaborate closely with data engineers, developers, business analysts, and other stakeholders to ensure that our data solutions meet business requirements

Essential Responsibilities

· Test Strategy & Planning: Analyze business, functional, and technical requirements to identify testable scenarios and clarify ambiguities in user stories and specifications. Design comprehensive test plans, test scenarios, and test cases for ETL workflows, data platforms, and reporting solutions. 

· ETL Testing Execution: Execute manual and automated testing for ETL processes, data transformations, data validation, and data pipelines. 

· Data Validation & Integrity: Perform thorough data validation, data comparison, and backend testing to ensure the accuracy of data transformations and mappings. Validate data mapping, transformations, aggregations, and business rules across source systems, staging layers, data warehouses, and reporting layers. Conduct data integrity checks, reconciliations, and consistency validations using advanced SQL and other data validation techniques. 

· SQL Proficiency: Write and execute complex SQL queries for data validation, reconciliation, integrity checks, and to verify data transformations and business rules. 

· Defect Management: Identify, log, track, and manage defects using tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps, and collaborate with developers and data engineers to resolve issues and verify fixes. 

· Performance Testing: Support ETL performance testing and validate load performance against benchmarks. Analyze pipeline runtime, throughput, latency, and resource utilization. 

· Documentation & Reporting: Document test execution results, defect reports, test evidence, and sign-off artifacts to support quality assurance, audits, and compliance. Communicate test results, risks, quality metrics, and recommendations clearly to cross-functional stakeholders. 

· Agile Collaboration: Actively participate in Agile delivery processes, including Program Increment planning, stand-ups, sprint planning, grooming, and retrospectives, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. 

· Continuous Improvement: Incorporate learnings and best practices to improve the ETL testing process over time and contribute to continuous QA process improvements

Required Experience

· Bachelor's degree or higher from a reputed university

· 6 to 10 years of experience in manual and automated testing, with a strong focus on ETL, data transformation, and data validation. 

· Strong understanding of ETL processes, data warehousing concepts (facts, dimensions, star/snowflake schema), relational databases and PySpark scripting. 

· Advanced SQL skills, including writing complex queries for data validation, reconciliation, and integrity checks (joins, aggregations, subqueries, window functions). 

· Hands-on experience creating test cases, test scenarios, and executing test plans

· Experience with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform or Azure, AWS, Dataproc or Databricks

· Experience with defect tracking tools such as Jira or Agility etc. 

· Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

· Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an Agile environment

· Experience with scripting languages like Python for test automation

Good to have

· Healthcare industry experience

· Familiarity with healthcare data models (claims, clinical, eligibility, provider data, etc. )

· Understanding of data governance and data quality standard

data.title: Software Engineer, Senior B Performance Engineering
data.description:
Senior Software Performance Engineer

6+ Years Experience | PAX India

About The Role

Help scale the performance engineering discipline across Blackbaud - building the tooling, practices, and expertise that let dev and ops teams do their own performance analysis, while staying hands-on enough to solve the hardest problems yourself and mentor others. 

Our core stack is Kubernetes/Azure-based microservices, though you'll occasionally support older, more monolithic systems too - the core skills (profiling, load testing, root-cause analysis) transfer directly. 

This is a hands-on coding role: most of your time goes to building and maintaining our load/synthetic test tooling (including AI-assisted testing) and integrating it into our SDLC. The rest is split between observability tooling and ad hoc performance analysis, with strong ownership of latency, throughput, and resource efficiency. 

What You'll Do

Load & Synthetic Test Tooling

- Build and maintain our synthetic/load-testing framework - test development (Playwright/Gatling), execution, and reporting. 
 - Apply AI capabilities to improve test development - AI-assisted authoring, scenario generation, result analysis. 
 - Integrate performance and synthetic tests into CI/CD pipelines so checks run continuously, not just ad hoc. 

Observability & Ad Hoc Performance Analysis

- Improve observability tooling (Splunk, Grafana, Honeycomb, App Insights, AppDynamics, New Relic): dashboards, alerting, SLIs/SLOs, instrumentation. 
 - Run load, stress, and soak tests to catch bottlenecks before production; profile CPU, memory, GC, I/O, and network in C#/. NET and/or Java services. 
 - Troubleshoot production performance issues (latency regressions, resource exhaustion, throttling) and tune resource usage in Kubernetes/AKS (requests/limits, autoscaling, kubectl diagnostics). 

Ongoing

- Build self-serve performance capabilities (dashboards, guardrails, docs) so teams can diagnose issues without escalating. 
 - Design and maintain C#/. NET and/or Java microservices with a focus on performance and scalability. 
 - Collaborate via Agile/GitHub workflows and mentor junior engineers on profiling and troubleshooting. 

What You'll Bring

- 6+ years of software engineering experience with meaningful exposure to performance, scalability, or reliability engineering. 
 - Strong C#/. NET and/or Java skills, plus strong Azure experience. 
 - Solid grasp of how compute resources (CPU, memory, I/O, network) drive performance/scalability, including tuning in containerized environments. 
 - Hands-on experience with a load-testing tool (k6, JMeter, Locust, Gatling) and a browser-automation tool for synthetic/end-to-end testing (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright). 
 - Experience with profiling tools (dotnet-trace, PerfView, App Insights profiler) and observability/APM tooling (Splunk, Grafana, Honeycomb, AppDynamics, New Relic). 
 - Some experience applying AI/LLM tools to dev workflows (AI-assisted coding, test generation, analysis). 
 - Experience integrating tooling/tests into CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) and troubleshooting production performance issues. 
 - Working knowledge of Linux fundamentals and networking basics (DNS, TLS, routing) as they relate to performance. 
 - Experience with Agile/GitHub, strong documentation and communication skills, and comfort working across time zones. 

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

- Are self-motivated and comfortable driving your own investigations without step-by-step direction. 
 - Have systemic curiosity - you want to understand how a system behaves end-to-end, and think across layers from application code down through infrastructure and database. 
 - Question assumptions and keep digging until you find the actual root cause, not just the first plausible explanation. 

Nice to Have

- Gatling or Playwright experience specifically. 
 - AKS experience (cluster ops, node pools, scaling) with a performance/capacity lens. 
 - Front-end development experience using Angular/TypeScript. 
 - Database-layer performance troubleshooting (query plans, indexing, stored procedure tuning). 
 - Familiarity with distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), capacity planning and cost/performance trade-off analysis. 

Quick Summary

"Backend-heavy engineer who codes daily, hunts down and fixes performance bottlenecks, and operates production systems; strong in C#/. NET and/or Java, Azure, compute/resource performance fundamentals, load testing, and observability. "

Stay up to date on everything Blackbaud, follow us on Linkedin, X, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube

data.description:
Xuman. Ai is live on both app stores. Real people are using it. 

What is Xuman. Ai

Xuman is building a network for on-demand human connection. 

Billions of people have knowledge, skills, and experience that could be valuable to someone else. Making that accessible is a coordination problem. 

What you want to do, who's up for it, and when you're both available. 

Xuman brings those things into one system. You discover the person, book their time, and connect. If they're available now, that can happen immediately. You can also make your own capabilities available through the same network. 

The goal is to make finding and connecting with the right human as easy as finding information. 

Think about how much more people could learn, build, and accomplish if that worked globally. 

The stage

What's the rarest stage to join a startup?

Building from zero? Everywhere. 

Joining after scale? Everywhere too. 

The stage in between is where it gets interesting. 

The product is built. It's live. People are using it. 

Now it's about syncing what they feel with what we build. 

Ship. Watch. Learn. Fix. Improve. Repeat. 

What you'll own

- The app on iOS and Android for your side of the product, end to end. 

- Push, deep links, permissions and location, and the quality of each. 

- The release to both stores: builds, review, rollout, and the fixes in between. 

- Performance and crash rate on the handsets real people actually carry. 

- The mobile experience as a whole, with the standing to argue for it. 

How we work

The founder sets what the product does and how it should feel. When you spot a gap, a bug or a better way, you bring it up before you build it. Once it's agreed, the technical approach is all yours. That is how we stay fast without breaking what people already use. 

What you bring

- iOS and Android experience, shipped to both stores. 

- React Native in production. Ours is Expo. 

- TypeScript. 

- App Store and Play review survived, including a rejection you fixed yourself. 

- Push notifications end-to-end: tokens, delivery, taps, and the deep link after. 

- Permissions and location done properly, foreground and background. 

- Over-the-air updates and build channels. Ours is EAS. 

- Native work when JavaScript is not enough. You can read Swift or Kotlin. 

- Crash reporting and release health as your job, not QA's. 

- Offline, flaky networks and low-end devices treated as normal conditions. 

- You already build with Claude, Copilot, or ChatGPT every day. 

What helps further

- background location or foreground services. 

- over-the-air update pipelines. 

What you get

- Work that is yours end to end, not tickets off someone else's board. 

- Your work in real hands the same week, on a product that is live today. 

- Pay that grows with every milestone we hit. 

- Growth that is claimed, not handed out. More opens as you carry more. 

- You're joining before the growth. What you build now is the foundation, and inside the company it will always be known as yours. 

How to be a Xuman

Experience the product first. It costs you a few minutes, nothing else. 

Then pick your path. 

Apply here, and wait for my message to book a time. 

Or come find me in the app. Create your Xuman. Ai profile through

https: //xuman. ai/vishal. chamaria

Put up one thing you know, do, or have a strong POV on, so people can book you. Then text me your profile link in the app, or book a time with me. 

Before you book a time, two things, so I know who I'm talking to: 

• Get your blue tick. It tells me you're real. 

• Fill in your details under Settings → Personal. It tells me who you are. 

Then book a time with me, whenever works. 

Come as a builder, not a candidate.
