data.title: Engineering Manager - .NET & Azure
data.description:
Engineering Manager - . NET & Azure

Hands-on engineering leadership | Architecture | Client collaboration

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on engineering leader to help a capable team take a mature and growing product forward. The role involves working on interesting product and engineering challenges, combining technical leadership, engineering delivery, mentoring, architecture and close collaboration with product and client stakeholders, with room to influence technical direction and how the team works. 

This is not a traditional project-management role, nor a people-management role disconnected from engineering. You'll remain meaningfully involved in the engineering itself - moving comfortably between code, architecture, debugging, technical decisions and planning, while helping the team make sound decisions and deliver well. 

You'll be working on a product with a rapidly expanding customer base across the global AEC industry. 

Dwaravati is a software development studio with a small team of experienced engineers. We work closely with client stakeholders to shape and build products, and operate as a lean, cohesive and highly effective company with a flat hierarchy and an open, collaborative environment where experienced engineers have significant ownership and autonomy. 

At a glance

- Experience: Engineering Manager / Senior Engineering Manager / Development Manager / Technical Lead
 - Core technology: Microsoft . NET / C# / Azure
 - Engineering: Hands-on leadership across architecture, design, coding, debugging and technical delivery
 - Systems: Significant experience with mature, long-lived production software
 - Leadership: Experience leading and mentoring engineering teams
 - Collaboration: Strong experience working with product, business and client stakeholders

The role and your ownership

You will lead day-to-day engineering and delivery, combining technical leadership, hands-on engineering, mentoring and direct collaboration with product, QA, delivery and business stakeholders. Coding, design reviews and debugging will remain a meaningful part of the role. 

You will work closely with the founder during a gradual leadership transition, learning the product, domain and technical context that has accumulated over time. As you build that context, you will increasingly take ownership of engineering and delivery decisions and become the team's first point of contact for most engineering matters. 

The founder will remain involved in selected architectural, strategic and people matters, while providing historical context where useful. You will have significant autonomy in how the team and system evolve, with the support and context needed to make good decisions. 

This is a role for someone who enjoys ownership without unnecessary hierarchy - someone who still likes getting into technical detail, but also wants the scope to influence engineering direction, help others grow and make the team and product better over time. 

What you will do

Lead technical direction

- Guide architecture and implementation decisions across a mature, long-lived production codebase. 
 - Be a trusted technical sounding board for engineers, helping them work through design choices, difficult bugs, performance and reliability problems, and architectural questions. 
 - Stay hands-on through coding and prototyping, design and code reviews, technical investigation, debugging, system design and technical documentation. 
 - Help the team evolve the system pragmatically, balancing immediate needs with maintainability, performance, reliability and long-term technical health. 

Help the team deliver well

- Work with engineers on estimation, planning, technical task breakdown, sprint execution, bug triage and capacity. 
 - Help turn uncertainty and competing priorities into clear engineering decisions and practical delivery plans. 
 - Identify recurring problems and improve the underlying system or practices rather than repeatedly treating the symptoms. 
 - Improve engineering practices and processes where they make a meaningful difference to quality, delivery or team effectiveness. 

Work closely with product and client stakeholders

- Work directly with product, QA, client and business stakeholders to turn incomplete or evolving requirements into actionable plans. 
 - Explain technical options, constraints and uncertainty clearly, including implications for performance, scalability, reliability and cost. 
 - Disagree constructively when needed, while keeping discussions focused on the problem and the outcome. 

Mentor and support engineers

- Help engineers improve not only their code, but their engineering judgment and ability to make sound technical decisions. 
 - Provide technical guidance and mentoring suited to each engineer's experience and needs. 
 - Contribute to performance discussions, career development and the continued growth of the engineering team. 

Essential experience

This role could suit an Engineering Manager, Senior Engineering Manager, Development Manager, Technical Lead or similar engineering leader with genuine responsibility for both people and engineering outcomes. 

- Strong . NET engineering experience: Substantial experience designing, building and maintaining long-lived production applications using . NET and C#. You have the technical depth and interest to remain hands-on, and are comfortable reasoning about architecture, services and APIs, asynchronous and concurrent systems, persistence and data access, performance, diagnostics and observability. You understand how maintainability, deployment and runtime behaviour shape the evolution of a system over time. 
 - Practical Azure experience: Meaningful production experience with Azure and cloud-hosted applications. You should be comfortable reasoning about compute, messaging, databases and storage, caching, scaling, monitoring, reliability and deployment, including performance and cost. You do not need to know every Azure service. 
 - Engineering leadership: Meaningful experience leading and mentoring engineers, balancing technical and delivery priorities, and taking responsibility for team and engineering outcomes. You are comfortable working with Scrum or similar agile practices and adapting the process when circumstances call for it. You are comfortable giving difficult feedback, handling competing priorities and supporting engineers through their growth. 
 - Strong stakeholder communication: Substantial experience working directly with product, business or client stakeholders. You can explain complex technical situations clearly, navigate ambiguity, discuss trade-offs openly and disagree constructively when needed. 
 - Engineering judgment: You are comfortable working with imperfect information and making pragmatic decisions in complex, evolving systems. You care about long-term technical health without losing sight of the product and business outcomes the team needs to deliver. 

Helpful but not required

Any of the following would be useful, but is not essential: 

- High-volume or performance-sensitive applications
 - Experience with mature B2B products
 - Experience as an application or solution architect
 - Azure or Microsoft certifications
 - AEC domain experience

How we work

We value thoughtful engineering over unnecessary complexity, responsibility over hierarchy, and direct but respectful communication. 

We expect senior people to form opinions, test assumptions and change their minds when better information emerges. We encourage constructive disagreement, intellectual honesty and low-ego collaboration. 

We value sustainable processes that improve outcomes without unnecessary bureaucracy. People are trusted to take ownership, make decisions and raise problems early, while working together to find the best solution for the product, the team and our clients.

data.title: Engineering Manager - Payments
data.description:
Overview

As a part of expanding our Engineering team, we are looking for Engineering manager/s who will be responsible for keeping projects on track, solving technical issues that arise, communicating with other teams and acting as an overall leader for the team. He / She will be working on multiple projects at the same time, building and managing diverse teams of engineers from different disciplines (in-house & outsourced). 

To succeed, you need to possess a blend of strong leadership skills and technical depth in Payments. You will own the systems that move money between diners, restaurants and payment partners across multiple APAC markets, including payment acceptance, orchestration, settlement, reconciliation and merchant payouts. 

This role is for someone who understands why idempotency matters, what happens when a PSP times out mid-capture, and how a one-cent reconciliation break turns into a finance escalation. You will lead a team of in-house and outsourced engineers, partner closely with Product, Finance, Risk and Compliance, and stay close enough to the code to make sound technical calls. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Payments Platform Ownership: Own the end-to-end payments stack including checkout, authorisation, capture, refunds, voids, chargebacks, settlement, and merchant payouts. Lead integrations, onboarding, and ecosystem management with PSPs, acquirers, and gateways such as Stripe, Adyen, and Airwallex, as well as local payment methods across APAC (e. g. , PayNow, GrabPay, QRIS, PromptPay, GCash). 
 - Orchestration & Reconciliation: Drive payment orchestration and smart routing across payment rails (Stripe, Adyen, Airwallex) to improve authorisation rates, reduce costs, and enable failover during outages. Own transaction-level reconciliation, analytics, and reporting across our ledger, gateway/PSP dashboards, reports, and bank statements. 
 - Reliability, Security & Compliance: Set high bars for uptime and correctness with idempotent APIs, clear state machines, and auditable ledgers. Ensure PCI DSS compliance, tokenisation, secure data handling, and partner with Risk/Compliance on 3DS, SCA, and fraud controls. Track payment SLOs and lead incident response. 
 - Delivery and Stakeholder Management: Work closely with Product, Design, QA, Finance, and Operations to sequence work by business value, refine stories, and communicate technical direction clearly to all stakeholders. 
 - Team Leadership: Hire, onboard, coach, and grow in-house and outsourced engineering teams. Provide clear career development, set goals, and drive pragmatic agile execution to deliver value iteratively. 
 - Hands-On Engineering: Stay close to the code, review pull requests, conduct technical design reviews, and debug production issues alongside the team when needed. 

Desired Candidate Specification: 

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years as an Engineering Manager in a start-up or scale-up environment. 
 - At least 4 years building or leading payment systems in production (PSP, fintech, marketplace, e-commerce, or food delivery). 
 - Hands-on experience integrating with PSPs, acquirers, or local payment schemes, and deep understanding of money movement (ledgers, idempotency, reconciliation). 
 - Practical knowledge of PCI DSS, tokenisation, and security/compliance best practices. 
 - Proven track record of building and leading hybrid engineering teams (in-house and outsourced). 
 - Strong tech stack knowledge: Java, Spring Boot, Node. js, JavaScript, HTML, MySQL, MongoDB, AWS/GCP, and event-driven microservices architecture.

Shape the future of work in complex industries. 

At Falkor, we help some of the world's most complex industries operate with greater clarity, confidence, and control. 

Built on more than 200 years of KONGSBERG industrial heritage, our industrial intelligence platform connects people, systems, and workflows across energy, processing, power, renewables, and other heavy-asset industries. 

We turn complexity into clarity and data into decisions, helping organizations improve safety, efficiency, and performance across the asset lifecycle. 

As industries evolve, we're building the technology that helps people see further, decide faster, and operate with confidence. 

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Test Engineer with strong expertise in Manual Testing to join our Product Engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of our software solutions through comprehensive test planning, execution, and validation. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, customers, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality products while supporting multiple Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and product initiatives in parallel. 

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented quality professional with a strong understanding of software testing methodologies, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced product development environment. 

What You'll Do

- Plan, design, and execute comprehensive manual test cases for web and enterprise applications. 
 - Develop test strategies, test plans, and test scenarios based on business and functional requirements. 
 - Perform functional, regression, integration, system, exploratory, and user acceptance testing. 
 - Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects through to resolution. 
 - Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Developers, and Solution Architects to ensure product quality throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). 
 - Work efficiently across multiple projects and Proof of Concepts (PoCs) simultaneously while maintaining high-quality standards. 
 - Participate in requirement reviews and provide early feedback to improve product quality. 
 - Validate product functionality before customer demonstrations and production releases. 
 - Interact directly with customers to understand requirements, clarify issues, and support PoC demonstrations when required. 
 - Ensure adherence to testing best practices, quality standards, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Provide clear status updates, test reports, and risk assessments to internal and external stakeholders. 

What we're looking for. 

- 8-10 years of hands-on experience in Manual Testing of enterprise or web-based applications. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science / Information Technology or a related discipline
 - Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, SDLC, STLC, defect lifecycle, and quality assurance best practices. 
 - Proven experience in Functional, System, Regression, Integration, and User Acceptance Testing. 
 - Experience creating test plans, test cases, test scenarios, and defect reports. 
 - Ability to manage testing activities across multiple projects and PoCs in parallel while meeting project timelines. 
 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail. 
 - Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to interact directly with customers. 
 - Experience supporting customer demonstrations, Proof of Concepts (PoCs), and solution validations is highly desirable. 
 - Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies and defect tracking tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps is preferred. 

Why join Falkor?

You'll be joining a global technology company helping to redefine how complex industries operate. 

At Falkor, You'll Have The Opportunity To

- Work on meaningful challenges with real-world impact
 - Collaborate with talented colleagues across technology and industry domains
 - Learn from experts in software, engineering, operations, and digital transformation
 - Grow your career in a business that is expanding globally
 - Help shape technology that expands human capability in complex industries

We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, included, and able to do their best work. 

About Falkor

Falkor is a KONGSBERG company that enables organizations in heavy-asset industries to expand human capability and redefine how assets are designed, operated, and optimized across their lifecycle. 

By connecting people, systems, and workflows, Falkor's industrial intelligence platform turns complexity into clarity and data into decisions, helping leading organizations improve safety, efficiency, and performance. 

Ready to apply?

If you're excited about solving complex challenges and making an impact through technology, we'd love to hear from you. 

Apply today with your resume.

Firmware Architect (7-8 yrs) || Bangalore

Role Overview

Looking for a Firmware Architect who can own and evolve complex firmware and embedded OS layer architecture for high-assurance hardware products. The person should be comfortable working at the boundary of firmware, embedded software, system architecture, product behavior, and real-world customer use cases. The role requires someone who can understand complex end applications, translate them into clean technical architecture, and guide the implementation toward a stable, auditable, and production-ready product. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own firmware and embedded OS-layer architecture for hardware-based products. 
 - Understand product use cases, deployment environments, customer workflows, and system-level requirements. 
 - Translate high-level product and application requirements into firmware architecture, design modules, interfaces, and execution flows. 
 - Comprehend the existing architecture, identify gaps, and evolve it without unnecessary redesign. 
 - Define clean software boundaries across boot, system initialization, runtime services, application layers, management interfaces, and update flows. 
 - Work closely with hardware, FPGA, product, application engineering, and validation teams. 
 - Build architecture that is maintainable, testable, scalable, and suitable for long product lifecycles. 
 - Create clear design documents, interface specifications, state machines, flow diagrams, and implementation guidance for the engineering team. 
 - Review firmware implementation for correctness, robustness, security posture, error handling, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Support structured external evaluation, technical evidence preparation, and product assurance activities. 
 - Mentor engineers and help them convert ambiguous requirements into practical implementation steps. 
 - Own technical decisions across architecture, trade-offs, debugging, and release readiness. 
 - 
Relevant Experience

- o Around 7+ years of experience in embedded firmware, embedded software, or system software development. 
 - o Strong experience in firmware architecture or embedded OS-layer design. 
 - o Good understanding of boot flows, memory management, task scheduling, inter-process or inter module communication, error handling, fault recovery, and system initialization
 - o Experience working with complex embedded systems where firmware interacts with hardware, application logic, and external interfaces. 
 - o Ability to read and understand existing codebases and architecture without needing everything to be explained from scratch. 
 - o Strong C/C++ programming background. 
 - o Ability to design abstractions, interfaces, and modular firmware components. 
 - o Experience with RTOS, embedded Linux, bare-metal systems, or custom embedded runtime environments. 
 - o Good debugging ability across software-hardware boundaries. 
 - o Strong documentation skills for architecture, design, and engineering handover. 
 - o Ability to work with incomplete information and still bring structure to the problem.

data.description:
Job Title

Senior Manager I/II

Job Description

Senior Manager I/II

You will be part of DXR R&D SW team and will be the Group Lead for Serviceability team. You will lead the transformation of DXR Serviceability software engineering by embedding AI, automation and data-driven practices into everyday engineering and operational processes, improving productivity, quality, speed and customer value. 

Your Role

- Shape the DXR service portfolio in line with customer needs, business strategy and the long-term aspirations of the DXR business. 
 - Lead the development and execution of the DXR service innovation strategy, including digital services, education and learning solutions, and service content development. 
 - Define and drive the software operations and delivery strategy for DXR Serviceability, ensuring alignment with software reference architecture, platform strategy, PIL solutions and enterprise technology standards. 
 - Develop and execute the digital roadmap for DXR Serviceability based on customer needs, installed-base opportunities and business priorities. 
 - Drive the adoption of AI and GenAI across the software engineering lifecycle to improve development productivity, software quality, speed and engineering effectiveness. This includes areas such as requirements analysis, design, coding, code reviews, testing, defect analysis, documentation and knowledge management. 
 - Identify and scale AI-enabled opportunities across engineering and operational processes, including test automation, intelligent troubleshooting, service diagnostics, workflow automation and engineering decision support. 
 - Establish measurable outcomes for AI adoption and ensure that AI solutions deliver tangible improvements in productivity, quality, cycle time and customer value while complying with responsible AI, security and regulatory requirements. 
 - Deploy best-in-class software engineering and quality practices and ensure adherence to development processes, quality management systems, cybersecurity requirements and applicable regulatory standards. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in engineering productivity through automation, DevOps, CI/CD, data-driven engineering practices and AI-assisted development. 
 - Build, develop and retain a high-performing global software engineering organization capable of executing the DXR Serviceability and digital strategy. 
 - Define clear accountability, objectives and success criteria for individuals and teams and establish an environment of ownership and high performance. 
 - Manage the long-term capability roadmap for the department, ensuring that competencies evolve in areas such as software architecture, cloud and connectivity, AI, data engineering, cybersecurity, serviceability and digital technologies. 
 - Ensure effective people management practices covering recruitment, staffing, performance management, capability development, succession planning and leadership development. 
 - Foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, continuous learning and engineering excellence, encouraging teams to challenge existing ways of working and adopt new technologies where they create meaningful value. 
 - Apply agile and modern software development practices and continuously improve the effectiveness of product development teams. 
 - Collaborate closely with software architects, system engineering, product owners, product managers and project and program managers to ensure software solutions meet architecture direction, business requirements, quality expectations, SLAs, SLOs and delivery commitments. 
 - Manage vendor and strategic partner deliverables where applicable, ensuring alignment on architecture, quality, cost and schedule without compromising engineering standards. 
 - Lead programs that translate service and customer needs into deployable solutions, with accountability for project scope, schedule, budget, quality, risks and cross-functional alignment. 
 - Guide project teams in defining realistic milestones and execution plans required to achieve committed launch dates. 
 - Ensure early identification and transparent communication of project risks and drive proactive mitigation and contingency planning. 
 - Anticipate potential conflicts and dependencies across functions and drive timely resolution through constructive stakeholder engagement and fact-based decision-making. 

You Are Fit If

- BE/B. Tech/MCA with an overall experience of 15+ years in Software development. 
 - Experience in Services and Solutions delivery environment, in global and multicultural setting. 
 - Broad understanding of full range of business challenges and opportunities and internal/external trends in services and solution delivery. 
 - Proven track record of leading software teams and delivering complex solutions. 
 - Mandatory hands-on experience in applying AI, GenAI and automation across the software engineering lifecycle, with proven ability to drive measurable improvements in productivity, quality, speed and engineering effectiveness. 
 - Ability to identify, prioritize and scale AI-enabled use cases across engineering and operational processes while ensuring responsible AI, cybersecurity, quality and regulatory compliance. 
 - Managing complex R&D project(s) with stakeholders in different geographies. 
 - Demonstrates enterprise mindset and platform thinking. 
 - Working experience in agile/SAFe development methodologies. 
 - Expertise in estimation and planning for the creation of useful, reliable, and practical plans for software development projects. 
 - Strong people management skills with proven experience in managing medium-size software teams and implementing software engineering best practices. 
 - Strong ability to work cross-culturally in a global environment with geographically dispersed project teams. 
 - Strong interpersonal skills, communication, attention to detail, and initiative. 
 - Strong drive and focus on software quality, process, and customer-oriented. 
 - Ability to manage cross-functional teams simultaneously in a matrix environment. 

Preferred Skills & Certification

- Medical devices or solutions knowledge. 
 - Experience in software project deliveries in healthcare/regulated environment. 
 - PMI or IPMA or equivalent certification. 

How We Work Together

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. 

Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company's facilities. 

Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company's main facilities, generally at the customers' or suppliers' locations. 

This role is an office-based role. 

About Philips

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others. 

- Learn more about our business. 
 - Discover our rich and exciting history. 
 - Learn more about our purpose. 

If you're interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care here.

data.title: R&D Senior Member of Technical Staff, Product Development
data.description:
AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies. 

Job Title: R&D Senior Member of Technical Staff

Location: Bangalore, India

Employment Type: Full time, hybrid work arrangement

The job

The R&D Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS) is a senior, hands-on full-stack engineer responsible for designing, developing, and delivering high-quality, scalable, and secure web and cloud solutions for AVEVA CONNECT. The role requires strong expertise in C#, . NET/ASP. NET Core, Angular with Highcharts, SQL Server, Microsoft Azure, and Azure DevOps CI/CD, along with strong engineering practices around quality, security, and performance. 

The SMTS works closely with Product Owners and cross-functional R&D teams to drive end-to-end delivery and architecture decisions, resolve customer issues, and mentor engineers through design/code reviews and best practices, including effective use of AI-assisted development tools. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and support scalable full-stack web and cloud applications. 
 - Work closely with the Product Owner, stakeholders, and Scrum Team to understand requirements and design, implement, and deliver software solutions that meet business and customer needs. 
 - Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning/estimation, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Collaborate with Customer Support to troubleshoot customer-reported issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive timely resolution through hotfixes and regular releases. 
 - Develop high-quality, maintainable, and scalable code that is peer-reviewed, unit/integration tested (as applicable), documented, and delivered in line with agreed engineering standards. 
 - Ensure solutions meet security and compliance requirements, applying industry-standard secure coding and cybersecurity practices. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD and DevOps practices (Azure DevOps pipelines), improving reliability of builds, deployments, and release readiness. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of engineering practices, performance, observability, and overall product quality; mentor junior engineers and support technical reviews. 

Essential Requirements

- 8+ years of software engineering experience. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in C#, . NET / ASP. NET Core, and enterprise cloud-based application development. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with modern front-end development, particularly Angular (TypeScript) and data-visualization libraries such as Highcharts. 
 - Working knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs, and AI application development. 
 - Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure and cloud-native architecture (microservices, containers, Kubernetes, messaging, observability). 
 - Strong software design fundamentals, including OOP, SOLID principles, design patterns, and reusable framework/component design. 
 - Strong engineering quality and security mindset, including automated testing, secure coding, authentication/authorization, dependency risk management, and vulnerability remediation. 
 - Strong technical leadership skills, including mentoring engineers, conducting design/code reviews, defining engineering standards, and collaborating across Development, DevOps, Security, Product, and R&D teams. 
 - Strong awareness of cybersecurity principles and secure SDLC practices. 
 - Ability to translate business/product requirements into technical designs, executable backlogs, dependencies, estimates, and realistic delivery plans. 

Desired Skills And Competencies

- Good understanding of Azure DevOps, CI/CD practices, Infrastructure-as-Code, and Azure automation using PowerShell / Azure CLI. 
 - Strong operational awareness, including observability, logging, monitoring, troubleshooting, performance diagnostics, and production support. 
 - Experience with technical discovery, prototypes/POCs, architecture documentation, and communicating technical decisions across teams. 
 - Experience using AI to improve developer productivity, automated testing, code quality, and engineering workflows. 
 - Familiarity with emerging AI development frameworks and tools. 
 - Good knowledge of SQL Server, database design, data access patterns, and performance considerations. 

R&D at AVEVA

Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name. 

Our track record of innovation is no fluke - it's the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us. 

You'll also be joining an award-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® CertifiedTM in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our awards and recognition. 

Find out more: aveva. com/en/about/careers/r-and-d-careers/

India Benefits include: 

Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support

It's possible we're hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive. 

Find out more: aveva. com/en/about/careers/benefits/

Hybrid working

We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process. 

Hiring process

Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process. 

Find out more: aveva. com/en/about/careers/hiring-process

About AVEVA

AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6, 500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life - such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals - safely, efficiently, and more sustainably. 

We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report. aveva. com/

Find out more: aveva. com/en/about/careers/

AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria. 

AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. data.title: Staff Engineer
data.description:
About Aspora

People on the move deserve a bank that moves with them. Since 2022, Aspora has been building a borderless financial operating system that makes money as mobile and transparent as its users. 

Backed by influential venture capitalists like Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator & Global Founders Capital. We're a team of 150+ across India, the UK, the UAE, EU and the US, working with extreme ownership, radical candour, and an obsession with customer impact. 

We celebrate builders who question assumptions, ship fast, and turn regulatory complexity into elegant solutions. If you're driven to redefine what global banking can be, we'd love to build the future with you. 

About The Role

As a Staff Engineer at Aspora, you'll be a central technical force shaping the backend architecture that powers our global banking platform. This is a deeply hands-on role where you'll design, build, and scale systems that serve millions of users across markets. 

You'll work on large, ambiguous problems, break them down into clear technical direction, and partner closely with product, design, and operations to bring high-impact features to life. As one of the senior-most Individual Contributors in the team, you'll raise the technical bar, mentor engineers, and influence engineering culture and decision-making across pods. 

If you enjoy building from scratch, solving complex distributed-systems challenges, and operating at a pace where ideas turn into shipped features quickly - you'll feel right at home at Aspora. 

Location: Bangalore, India

What You Will Do

- Drive system architecture and high-level design for scalable, reliable backend platforms. 
 - Stay hands-on with coding, debugging, testing, and deployment to deliver high-quality backend services. 
 - Build and evolve systems end-to-end; prior experience creating services from scratch is a strong plus. 
 - Make informed technical decisions by evaluating architectural trade-offs and long-term impact. 
 - Own performance, reliability, and operational excellence across backend components. 
 - Convert product requirements into robust technical solutions through close cross-functional collaboration. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and technical guidance. 
 - Define and champion engineering standards and best practices across the backend stack. 
 - Bring deep expertise in system design, distributed systems, databases, queues, caching, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Shape technical direction and drive key engineering initiatives that strengthen the overall platform. 

Who You Are

- You bring 7-12 years of strong backend engineering experience. 
 - You're motivated to build products from the ground up and help define technical processes at Aspora. 
 - You understand the pace and mindset of a startup and are excited to contribute to its growth and culture. 
 - You have deep technical expertise, paired with a willingness to learn and adapt to Aspora's internal systems and ways of working. 
 - We are language-agnostic and value strong engineering fundamentals over specific tech stacks. 

Why Aspora?

- Build high-impact, zero-to-one systems that directly influence the product's future. 
 - Drive architecture and technical direction in a culture that values deep engineering thinking. 
 - Work with a lean, high-ownership team where your contributions are visible and meaningful. 
 - Grow with a fast-scaling startup where you help shape both the platform and the engineering culture. 

Perks And Benefits

- Competitive compensation and equity, aligned with experience, impact and market standards. 
 - Learning & development support, including professional development budgets and learning stipends. 
 - Wellness and team engagement programs to support work-life integration and collaboration.

Job Description

Position Title: Engineer / Sr. Engineer / Assistant Manager

Department: Production

Industry: Automotive Component Manufacturing & EV - Wire Harness / Sheet Metal / Welded & Molded Parts

Experience Required: 8-10 years of experience in automotive parts manufacturing, with proven expertise in Wire Harness and Electrical Component production. 

Educational Qualification: Diploma / B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronics Engineering. 

Reporting To: DGM - Production

Location: Udaipur, Rajasthan

OBJECTIVE OF THE ROLE

To lead and manage the production function for wire and cable harness manufacturing operations, ensuring products meet ISO and customer quality standards, driving continuous improvement, line balancing, lean manufacturing, Low cost automation, fixture concept, Poke-yoke, Kaizen, localization initiatives, and effective troubleshooting of process and product quality issues across all manufacturing stages. 

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Production System

- Lead and manage the production function and teams across wire harness manufacturing lines. 
 - Develop, implement, and maintain the production system in compliance with ISO. 
 - Drive internal audits, management reviews, and CAPA (Corrective & Preventive Action) closures for quality non-conformities. 
 - Collaborate with Plant Head or seniors and cross-functional teams to align production target with plant and business goals. 
 - Champion Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, 5S, and Total Quality Management (TQM) initiatives. 

Wire Harness Production

- Ensure production of wire harness sub-assemblies, assemblies, connectors, and terminals as per customer and engineering specifications. 
 - Drive Line Balancing on wire harness assembly lines to optimize manpower and machine utilization, cycle time, and throughput while maintaining quality standards. 
 - Lead troubleshooting of process, machine, and product quality issues on the shop floor, including crimping, splicing, molding, and continuity/functional testing. 
 - Drive localization of wire harness components, connectors, and raw materials, ensuring supplier qualification, PPAP approval, and quality validation of localized parts. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis (5-Why, Fishbone, 8D) for in-house rejections, customer complaints, and field returns, and implement effective countermeasures. 
 - Ensure SPC application critical/special characteristics as required by the customer. 

Supplier & Customer Quality

- Manage supplier quality assessments, QMS audits, and supplier rating for wire harness components and raw materials. 
 - Production ramp-up through scientifically method. 
 - Address customer complaints and quality escalations, ensuring root cause identification, corrective action, and PPM reduction. 
 - Maintain strong customer relationships to ensure sustained quality satisfaction and reduced return PPM. 

Documentation, Reporting & Team Development

- Ensure accurate and updated quality documentation as per ISO requirements (control plans, PFMEA, work instructions, inspection standards). 
 - Prepare and present production performance reports, KPIs, and improvement trends to senior management. 
 - Train, mentor, and develop the production team including engineers and line inspectors on quality procedures, troubleshooting techniques, and best practices. 

Key Skills & Competencies

- Strong technical knowledge of Wire Harness manufacturing processes (crimping, splicing, molding, testing).

Position: Assoc Director/Director - Quality (Medical Coding) Coimbatore

Department: Medical Coding - Quality & Compliance

Profile Description

This role is responsible for defining and driving the quality strategy across one or more medical coding portfolios while ensuring coding accuracy, regulatory compliance, client satisfaction, and continuous process improvement. The Director - Quality will lead enterprise quality initiatives, strengthen audit governance, partner with Operations and Training teams, and leverage analytics to improve coding quality, reduce denials, and enhance client outcomes. The role is also responsible for ensuring compliance with industry standards, payer guidelines, and organizational quality frameworks. 

Key Responsibilities

Process

- Own the Quality Management System (QMS) across assigned coding portfolios and ensure consistent execution of quality processes. 
 - Establish and maintain coding quality standards aligned with ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS, payer policies, CMS guidelines, NCCI edits, and specialty-specific coding requirements. 
 - Drive achievement of internal and client-defined quality SLAs across all accounts. 
 - Develop audit methodologies including concurrent, retrospective, prospective, focused, and validation audits. 
 - Ensure calibration across Quality, Operations, Training, and Client teams through standardized audit guidelines. 
 - Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for quality defects and implement effective corrective and preventive actions (CAPA). 
 - Monitor coding trends, denial trends, payer edits, and regulatory updates to proactively mitigate quality risks. 
 - Drive continuous process improvement initiatives through Lean, Six Sigma, and automation opportunities. 
 - Standardize quality scorecards, audit tools, and governance dashboards across portfolios. 
 - Ensure readiness for client audits, internal audits, compliance reviews, and external accreditation requirements. 
 - Establish governance around coding policy changes and ensure timely implementation across operations. People

- Build and lead a high-performing Quality organization across multiple coding specialties. 
 - Coach and mentor Quality Managers and Leads to improve audit effectiveness and leadership capabilities. 
 - Develop competency frameworks for auditors and quality professionals. 
 - Partner with Operations and Learning teams to identify knowledge gaps and implement targeted training interventions. 
 - Drive certification programs (AAPC/AHIMA), continuing education, and ongoing competency assessments. 
 - Promote a culture of quality ownership across Operations rather than quality inspection. 
 - Drive employee engagement, succession planning, talent retention, and career development within the Quality function. 
 - Conduct regular calibration sessions to ensure inter-auditor reliability and consistency. 
 - Foster innovation by encouraging adoption of AI-assisted quality monitoring and analytics. Client

- Serve as the Quality leader during client governance meetings including Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs), Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs), and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs). 
 - Present quality performance, audit findings, denial trends, and improvement initiatives to clients. 
 - Build trusted client relationships through proactive communication and consultative quality leadership. 
 - Partner with client coding compliance teams to resolve coding interpretation differences. 
 - Support client onboarding, transitions, and implementation activities by establishing quality governance. 
 - Lead provider education initiatives arising from coding audit findings when required. 
 - Ensure client quality KPIs, contractual obligations, and compliance expectations are consistently achieved. Financial

- Improve client ROI by reducing coding defects, rework, denials, and revenue leakage. 
 - Partner with Operations leadership to improve first-pass quality and operational efficiency. 
 - Support account profitability by minimizing quality-related cost of poor quality (COPQ). 
 - Measure and report financial impact of quality improvement initiatives. 
 - Participate in business reviews and support strategic growth opportunities through quality excellence. 
 - Drive automation initiatives that improve audit efficiency and reduce manual effort. 

Governance & Compliance

- Ensure compliance with HIPAA, CMS regulations, payer-specific guidelines, OIG recommendations, and organizational policies. 
 - Monitor coding compliance risks and implement mitigation strategies. 
 - Lead internal compliance audits and support external regulatory audits. 
 - Maintain documentation supporting quality governance and audit readiness. 
 - Ensure timely dissemination and implementation of coding guideline updates. Analytics & Continuous Improvement

- Develop executive dashboards highlighting quality trends, DPU, accuracy, denials, auditor agreement, productivity, and compliance metrics. 
 - Perform advanced trend analysis using audit data to identify systemic process improvements. 
 - Utilize statistical quality control techniques and predictive analytics to improve coding performance. 
 - Lead enterprise quality transformation initiatives leveraging AI and automation. 
 - Benchmark organizational performance against industry standards and best practices. Qualifications

- Graduate in any discipline is mandatory. 
 - BPT, MPT, B. Sc Nursing, M. Sc Nursing, B. Pharm, M. Pharm, BOT, or Life Sciences preferred. 
 - AHIMA or AAPC certification (CPC, CCS, CCS-P, CIC, CRC or equivalent) is mandatory. 
 - Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt preferred. 
 - MBA or Master's degree in Healthcare Administration or Quality Management will be an added advantage. 
 - MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS, or other healthcare professional qualifications would be an added advantage. Role Prerequisites

- 12+ years of experience in Medical Coding with significant leadership experience in Coding Quality and Compliance. 
 - Minimum 5 years of managing enterprise quality programs across multiple specialties and clients. 
 - Extensive experience in coding audits, coding compliance, provider education, and denial prevention. 
 - Strong understanding of US healthcare regulations, payer policies, CMS guidelines, and coding compliance. 
 - Experience in leading quality transformation initiatives across large teams (300+ FTE preferred). 
 - Demonstrated experience working with executive leadership and external clients. 
 - Experience in AI-enabled quality assurance, analytics, or automation initiatives is preferred. Functional Competencies

- Expert knowledge of ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS, CMS Guidelines, and NCCI edits. 
 - Expertise across multiple coding specialties. 
 - Advanced coding audit methodology and compliance knowledge. 
 - Strong understanding of revenue cycle management and denial prevention. 
 - Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective & Preventive Action (CAPA). 
 - Statistical quality analysis and performance analytics. 
 - Governance reporting and executive dashboard preparation. 
 - Lean Six Sigma process improvement methodologies. 
 - Client relationship and stakeholder management. 
 - Advanced Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and Microsoft Office/G-Suite proficiency. 
 - Knowledge of AI-assisted coding validation and quality monitoring tools is preferred. Behavioral Competencies

- Accountability
 - Customer Service Orientation
 - Strategic Thinking
 - Developing Others
 - Coaching and Mentoring
 - Collaboration
 - Analytical Thinking
 - Decision Making
 - Continuous Improvement Mindset
 - Communication and Executive Presence
 - Change Leadership
 - Innovation
 - Influence without AuthorityKey Success Metrics (KPIs)

- Coding Quality Accuracy (%)
 - Defect Per Unit (DPU)
 - First Pass Yield (FPY)
 - Coding-related Denial Rate
 - Audit Completion SLA
 - Auditor Agreement / Calibration Score
 - Corrective Action Closure Rate
 - Client CSAT / Quality Satisfaction Score
 - Regulatory Compliance Score
 - Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ)
 - Revenue Leakage Prevented

The role requires strong technical understanding of mechanical engineering, manufacturing processes, engineering drawings, GD&T, dimensional inspection, and supplier quality management. The engineer will work closely with Design, VCD, Manufacturing, IQC, and suppliers to prevent quality issues and establish robust supplier processes. 

What you'll do: 

Supplier Quality Management

- Own quality performance of assigned mechanical suppliers. 
 - Monitor supplier KPIs including PPM, rejection rate, line rejection, customer complaints, 8D closure, and repeat issues. Conduct regular supplier performance reviews and drive improvement plans for poor- performing suppliers. 
 - Lead supplier containment and corrective action for critical quality issues. 
 - Establish and maintain supplier quality improvement roadmaps. 
 - Support supplier selection, evaluation, development, and qualification. 
 - Develop suppliers to achieve consistent quality, process capability, and delivery performance

Mechanical Product & Process Quality

- Provide technical quality expertise for mechanical components, parts, and assemblies
 - Review engineering drawings, specifications, BOMs, GD&T requirements, material specifications, and engineering changes from a quality perspective. 
 - Ensure critical-to-quality and special characteristics are identified and effectively controlled. 
 - Assess and control manufacturing processes such as fabrication, welding, casting, forging, machining, sheet metal, heat treatment, surface treatment, and assembly. 
 - Evaluate process risks and establish appropriate process controls, inspection methods, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Drive process capability and quality improvement for critical characteristics. 
 - Support dimensional inspection and validation using appropriate measuring equipment and inspection methods

PPAP

- Support and drive supplier PPAP activities from new product development through SOP and mass production. 
 - Review and approve supplier PPAP deliverables. 
 - Review and challenge Process Flow, PFMEA, Control Plan, Work Instructions, MSA/GR&R, SPC, capability studies, inspection standards, and PPAP documentation. 
 - Ensure special characteristics and critical-to-quality characteristics are identified and adequately controlled. 
 - Conduct supplier Run-at-Rate and production readiness assessments. 
 - Review and approve PPAP submissions for new and modified mechanical components

Supplier Process Audit & Development

- Conduct supplier process audits based on IATF 16949, VDA 6. 3, customer-specific requirements, and internal standards
 - Conduct manufacturing process audits covering various mechanical manufacturing processes. 
 - Assess process robustness, process controls, traceability, inspection systems, and operator practices. 
 - Identify process risks and gaps through manufacturing process audits. 
 - Develop suppliers through structured improvement plans, technical training, and process improvement. 
 - Verify implementation and effectiveness of corrective actions through follow-up audits. 
 - Drive process capability improvement for critical characteristics

Problem Solving & Failure Analysis

- Lead technical investigation and root-cause analysis of mechanical quality issues. 
 - Drive effective containment, 8D, 5-Why, Fishbone, RCA, corrective and preventive actions with suppliers. 
 - Analyze issues related to dimensional variation, machining defects, casting defects, welding defects, fabrication defects, material issues, surface treatment, assembly, and functional performance. 
 - Use appropriate problem-solving and analytical techniques to identify root causes. Coordinate with suppliers and cross-functional teams to validate root cause and corrective actions. 
 - Ensure corrective actions are effective and prevent recurrence. Identify systemic improvement opportunities from recurring supplier quality issues

Incoming Quality & Manufacturing Support

- Work closely with IQC and Manufacturing Quality to establish appropriate incoming inspection requirements. 
 - Define critical inspection parameters, sampling requirements, inspection methods, and acceptance criteria based on supplier process capability and risk. 
 - Support production teams in resolving supplier-related quality issues. 
 - Establish defect standards and limit samples where required. 
 - Drive reduction of supplier-related line stoppages, production rejections, and quality escapes

Change & Sustenance Quality

- Review supplier ECR/ECN/PCN changes for potential quality risks. 
 - Ensure changes related to material, process, tooling, equipment, manufacturing location, or sub-suppliers are appropriately evaluated and validated. 
 - Ensure changes are validated and approved before implementation. 
 - Monitor quality performance after supplier/process/material changes. 
 - Drive continuous improvement projects for chronic supplier quality issues. 
 - Maintain lessons learned and standardization across suppliers

What you'll bring: 

- Education qualification
 - B. E. /B. Tech/Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related discipline
 - 5-10 years of experience in Supplier Quality / Quality Engineering, preferably in automotive, EV, or similar manufacturing industries
 - Strong hands-on experience in mechanical component manufacturing and supplier quality
 - Good knowledge of multiple manufacturing processes such as fabrication, welding, casting, forging, machining, sheet metal, heat treatment, surface treatment, and assembly
 - Good understanding of engineering drawings, GD&T, dimensional inspection, and measurement systems
 - Experience in supplier quality management, supplier audits, APQP, PPAP, and supplier development
 - Hands-on experience with PFMEA, Control Plan, MSA, SPC, Process Capability, 8D, RCA, and problem-solving tools

Preferred Experience (Good to Have): 

- Experience with VDA 6. 3 / VDA 6. 5
 - IATF 16949 Internal Auditor / Lead Auditor certification
 - Core Tools certification. Practical knowledge of GD&T and dimensional inspection
 - Experience with CMM, profile projector, height gauge, gauges, and other precision measurement equipment
 - Experience in supplier capability studies and manufacturing process audits
 - Experience with casting, forging, welding, fabrication, and machining suppliers
 - Experience in new product development and industrialization
 - Experience working with global automotive / industrial / construction equipment suppliers
 - Knowledge of material specifications, heat treatment, surface treatment, and metallurgicalrequirements

What matters to us: 

- Quality of work
 - Structured problem-solving
 - Dissatisfaction with mediocre work
 - Ability to multi-task and handle a dynamic working environment
 - Resilient attitude to bounce back after failing

About Us: 

Exponent is building the energy stack powering commercial EVs in India. Our proprietary battery and charging technology enables safe, reliable 15-minute rapid charging while delivering a 3, 000-cycle battery life warranty using standard lithium-ion cells. Today, our platform powers high-utilisation commercial vehicles - from three-wheelers to intercity buses, making electric mobility rapid, more reliable and more affordable than petroleum. 

Founded by Arun Vinayak (Founding Partner & Former Chief Product Officer, Ather Energy), Exponent is a 250+ member team of passionate builders solving some of the toughest engineering challenges in energy. 

If solving hard engineering problems across mechanics, thermal systems, power electronics, manufacturing, and the charging network, while staying obsessed with customer experience excites you, we'd love to build with you.

Screening Checklist

data.title: Software Development Engineer 1
data.description:
About The Team & Role

Team builds the infrastructure that keeps commercial drivers and fleets moving from fuel payments

at the pump to the apps and backend services that power authorizations, loyalty, and real-time

transaction data. As an SDE I, you'll join one of two full-stack engineering teams within WEX's

Mobility organization. 

Both teams own their systems end to end. The 10-4 (OTR) team builds the over-the-road platform

customer-facing APIs, event-driven microservices (Java/Spring Boot, Python), Kafka-based async

processing, payment and identity integrations (Fiserv, Okta), and the Android and iOS apps that

drivers use in the field. The NA Mobility Platform team builds and owns the shared frontend

infrastructure that product teams across the organization depend on Angular micro-frontends with

NestJS BFFs, Module Federation, a shared component library (Theseus UI), brand theming, and app

scaffolding via Theseus Builder. 

In both cases, you'll work across layers of a real production stack, ship to real users, and be

supported by engineers who care about doing the work well. We value clean APIs, strong testing

habits, and engineers who improve the systems they touch. You'll work closely with the product, 

other OTR teams, and your peers on features from design through implementation, testing, 

deployment, and production support. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Build specific components within an established architecture. You'll follow the patterns your team
 - has set, whether that's microservices, event-driven design, or component-based frontend, and
 - implement features correctly within those structures rather than redefining them. 
 - Write clean, compilable code with unit tests that meet the team's quality standards. Before you
 - start building, you'll ask the right questions about acceptance criteria and error states so you're
 - solving the right problem, not just writing code. 
 - Identify and fix bugs in well-defined tasks. You'll reproduce issues, pinpoint where in the code
 - they're happening, and work with senior engineers to land the right fix rather than just patching
 - the symptom. 
 - Handle low-priority support tickets as a first responder and participate in on-call rotations under
 - supervision. During incidents, you'll run specific checks and scripts as directed, building your
 - confidence with live systems gradually and safely. 
 - Contribute to basic observability by adding error and info logging that helps the team debug
 - issues. You won't be expected to triage complex production problems alone, but your logs should
 - make it easier for others to do so. 
 - Keep the team's process running smoothly. That means updating Jira daily, following the
 - Definition of Done, moving tickets through the right stages, and raising a flag immediately if
 - something is at risk. You don't deviate from the team's agreed process without checking first. 
 - Show up fully in team rituals like standups, backlog grooming, and demos. You'll listen to
 - stakeholder feedback during demos to understand how your work actually lands with users, not
 - just whether it passed the acceptance criteria. 
 - Use AI tools like Cursor or similar to reduce boilerplate, get unstuck faster, and understand error
 - messages more quickly. You own the quality of everything you ship though, which means
 - validating AI-generated output rather than passing it through unchecked. 
 - Update documentation when you find something inaccurate or missing. Good documentation is
 - part of the job, and you'll be expected to keep it honest as you learn the system. 

Experience You'll Bring

- You have a solid grounding in data structures, algorithms, and software design from a B. S. or M. S. in Computer Science from a reputed institution, with 0 to 1 year of professional experience. 
 - You're comfortable writing clean, compilable, tested code in at least one of Java, Python, or TypeScript/JavaScript, and you understand what makes code maintainable, not just functional. 
 - You understand the testing pyramid and have written unit tests as part of coursework, an internship, or a personal project. You see tests as part of the feature, not an afterthought. 
 - You know never to hardcode secrets, you have a basic understanding of IAM and role-based access control, and you're willing to learn which compliance requirements like PCI or SOC apply to the systems you work on. 
 - You know your way around Git and pull requests, can deploy to an existing CI/CD pipeline, and can tell when your specific commit caused a build failure. 
 - When you're blocked, you ask focused questions and explain what you've already tried. You flag a deadline risk the moment you see it, not the day before it's due. 
 - You receive code review feedback without getting defensive, you actively learn your team's standards and tools, and you're comfortable switching between tasks within a project when priorities shift. 

Preferred Qualifications

- A degree in computer science software engineering from a reputed institution. 
 - Internship or co-op experience where you shipped real code to a production or staging
 - environment as part of a team. 
 - Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team. 
 - Familiarity with cloud basics even through coursework or personal projects. 
 - Exposure to containerization through Docker. Reading and running existing Dockerfiles counts, 
 - you don't need to have written them from scratch. 
 - Some experience working in an existing codebase, contributing improvements, and navigating
 - code you didn't write yourself. 
 - Awareness of AI tools beyond code completion, such as experimenting with prompt design or
 - modifying a simple AI-powered script or agent. 
 - A genuine interest in the domain. Payments, fleet operations, or developer platform work are
 - exciting problem spaces and it helps to be curious about the industry, not just the technology.

Senior AI Evaluation Analyst

Location: Kochi

Experience: 5-8 Years

Role Overview

Seeking an experienced and detail-oriented professional to join its Machine Learning Science team, supporting the development and improvement of AI-powered travel products. The team works on conversational AI agents that help travelers discover options, compare products, plan trips, and receive assistance throughout their travel journey. 

You will play a key role in evaluating the quality, accuracy, relevance, and reliability of AI-generated responses against established guidelines and quality metrics. You will analyze evaluation results, identify recurring errors and quality gaps, and translate findings into actionable insights that help improve AI agent performance. 

This role requires a strong foundation in data annotation, quality evaluation, analytical problem-solving, and guideline-based decision-making. The position is suited to professionals who enjoy hands-on evaluation and analysis of AI outputs rather than traditional business reporting or dashboard development. 

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is an experienced, hands-on professional who combines strong evaluation and quality assurance skills with analytical thinking. They should be comfortable reviewing large volumes of information, applying structured guidelines, identifying recurring quality issues, and converting observations into meaningful insights. 

Candidates with experience in AI evaluation, data annotation, content quality, search relevance, or similar quality-focused roles are encouraged to apply. Direct experience with LLMs or conversational AI is an advantage but is not mandatory for candidates with strong transferable experience. 

Key Responsibilities

- Evaluate AI-generated responses from conversational agents against predefined guidelines, evaluation criteria, and quality standards. 
 - Perform and review data annotation, labelling, and classification to assess the accuracy, relevance, completeness, and appropriateness of AI-generated content. 
 - Identify and document incorrect, misleading, incomplete, inconsistent, or irrelevant responses, including potential AI hallucinations. 
 - Conduct quality assurance reviews to ensure consistency, accuracy, and adherence to evaluation guidelines. 
 - Analyze large and complex datasets to identify recurring errors, quality trends, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement. 
 - Interpret quality metrics such as error rates, evaluation consistency, reviewer disagreement, and other relevant indicators. 
 - Investigate ambiguous or borderline cases and apply sound judgment while adhering to established evaluation criteria. 
 - Prepare clear documentation of evaluation findings, root causes, observations, and recommended improvements. 
 - Use Excel or Google Sheets and, where applicable, basic SQL to filter, analyze, and summarize evaluation data. 
 - Collaborate with Machine Learning Scientists, AI product teams, and other stakeholders to communicate quality insights and support improvements in AI agent performance. 
 - Contribute to the refinement of evaluation guidelines, quality frameworks, and review processes based on observed issues and emerging patterns. 
 - Maintain accurate documentation and track identified issues through appropriate ticketing and workflow management systems. 

Required Skills and Qualifications

- 5-8 years of relevant experience in data annotation, data labeling, AI evaluation, content quality, quality assurance, search relevance evaluation, or similar guideline-based assessment roles. 
 - Strong experience evaluating data, content, or system outputs against predefined guidelines, quality standards, and measurable criteria. 
 - Demonstrated ability to analyze large datasets, identify patterns, investigate quality issues, and derive actionable insights. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, particularly when dealing with ambiguous or inconsistent information. 
 - Excellent attention to detail and the ability to apply evaluation criteria consistently. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for data filtering, analysis, quality tracking, and reporting. 
 - Strong written communication skills and the ability to document findings, explain issues, and communicate insights clearly. 
 - Ability to work independently on evaluation tasks while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. 
 - Genuine interest in artificial intelligence, conversational AI, and data-driven product improvement. 
 - Experience with Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows, AI training data validation, model output assessment, or LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. 

Good to Have

- Exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, conversational agents, or AI-generated content evaluation. 
 - Familiarity with evaluating AI responses for factual accuracy, relevance, completeness, helpfulness, and hallucinations. 
 - Basic SQL knowledge for extracting, filtering, and analyzing datasets. 
 - Experience with quality metrics such as error rates, inter-annotator agreement, reviewer disagreement, and evaluation consistency. 
 - Experience maintaining evaluation guidelines, quality documentation, review workflows, or issue-tracking systems. 
 - Exposure to travel, hospitality, customer experience, search relevance, policy evaluation, or content quality operations.

data.description:
Role Purpose

The team is responsible for performing quality analysis of the vouchers processed by the Accounts Payable team day before as well as check for the possible duplicate payments to stop the same from being paid to vendors again. Perform QA of the vouchers processed by the AP team day before, QA is done on sample bases in order to confirm that team covers entire population as well as major portion of value of invoices processed day before the QA is done. Quality analyst is also responsible for checking the possible duplicate vouchers processed by the AP team & ensure those are deleted or closed from / in the system so that payment is not done again for the same invoice to the same vendor. 

Key Accountabilities

- Extracting the population data on daily basis to form samples. 
 - To select the samples of vouchers for each user so that entire population is covered in QA.

data.title: DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Job Title: DevOps Engineer (AI & Automation)

Location: Noida

Experience: Min 3 Years

Department: Engineering / Infrastructure & Platform

Role Overview

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to own our core DevOps administration while leading the

implementation of AI-driven development workflows. In this role, you will manage

repositories, establish automated CI/CD pipelines, and design autonomous coding, testing, 

and code-review agents using technologies like Claude Code, Anthropic Agent SDK, and

GitHub Copilot Workspace/Agents. You will bridge classical platform engineering with AI

native software development lifecycles. 

Key Responsibilities

1. DevOps Administration & Repository Management

• Repository Architecture: Design, enforce, and maintain repository branching strategies

(e. g. , Trunk-Based, GitFlow, Feature-Branching) and access governance across

organizations. 

• CI/CD Pipeline Engineering: Build, optimize, and secure multi-environment

deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps with caching

and automated quality gates. 

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Provision and manage cloud resources using Terraform, 

Pulumi, or Bicep, ensuring zero-drift environments. 

• DevSecOps Integration: Implement automated secret scanning (e. g. , Gitleaks), 

dependency vulnerability checks (Trivy/Snyk), and SAST/DAST within CI steps. 

2. AI Coding Agent Setup & Branch Workflows

• Coding Agent Deployment: Configure and orchestrate developer AI agents (e. g. , 

Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Cloud Agents, or custom agent frameworks) to perform

autonomous task execution across different Git branches. 

• Repository Context & Prompts: Author and maintain repository-level context files

(AGENTS. md, CLAUDE. md, custom system prompts, and MCP server integrations) to

steer agents toward project conventions and architecture patterns. 

• Multi-Branch Automation: Configure workflow triggers that allow AI agents to pick up

issue tickets, work within dedicated feature/bugfix branches, and automatically draft

PRs. 

3. Automated Code Review & Testing Agents

• Code Review Agents: Integrate automated AI code-review agents within pull request

workflows to perform compliance checks, security audits, and style adherence reviews

before human sign-off. 

• Automated Testing & QA Agents: Build autonomous testing pipelines where agents

analyze diffs, generate missing unit/integration tests, triage test failures, and suggest

fixes directly in CI. 

• Governance & Safeguards: Establish strict safety guardrails, execution sandboxes, and

human-in-the-loop approvals for agent-generated code. 

Technical Qualifications

Must-Have Experience

• Core DevOps (2+ Years): Hands-on expertise in CI/CD pipeline building, Docker, 

Kubernetes, and IaC (Terraform/Bicep/CloudFormation). 

• Git Administration: Mastery of Git internals, branch protection rules, merge strategies, 

and repository permissions. 

• AI Coding Tools & SDKs: Proven experience configuring or extending GitHub Copilot

(Copilot Workspace, Agent Mode, Custom Instructions/Skills) or Claude (Claude Code

CLI, Anthropic API/SDK, Model Context Protocol). 

• Automation Languages: High proficiency in Python, Bash, or TypeScript/Node. js for

building custom hooks, bots, and API integrations. 

Nice-to-Have Experience

• Experience building multi-agent orchestrations (e. g. , CrewAI, LangChain, or custom

sub-agents). 

• Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) server setups to connect AI agents with

internal tooling, databases, and monitoring systems. 

• Deep understanding of DevSecOps standards and cloud infrastructure cost

optimization. 

Expected 90-Day Deliverables

Month 1: Audit existing repos and establish standardized CI/CD templates and branch

protection rules across all development projects. 

Month 2: Deploy initial Claude / GitHub Copilot agent workflows for automated PR code

reviews and unit test generation. 

Month 3: Fully operationalize an end-to-end agentic workflow where feature tickets can be

assigned to branch-specific coding agents to generate, test, and submit initial pull requests.

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Lead Software Engineer

Overview--The Lead Software Engineer provides technical leadership for the Transaction Lookup Services (TLS) platform, driving the design, development, and support of scalable, resilient, and secure transaction lookup APIs and data services. This role partners with Product, TPMs, Architects, Data Engineering, and Operations teams to deliver enterprise solutions supporting transaction processing, disputes, chargebacks, refunds, and historical transaction retrieval capabilities. The position is responsible for defining technical direction, mentoring engineers, and ensuring operational excellence across the platform. 

Role-

- Lead the architecture, design, and development of microservices and APIs using Java, Spring Boot, REST, and gRPC to support mission-critical transaction lookup services. 
 - Design and implement highly scalable, low-latency solutions leveraging Oracle, SQL, PL/SQL, Hadoop, Hive, Impala, and Spark for transactional and historical data retrieval. 
 - Define API contracts, integration patterns, and service standards while ensuring security through TLS/mTLS, OAuth, JWT, and secure coding practices. 
 - Drive performance optimization efforts across application and database layers, including query tuning, indexing strategies, caching, and capacity planning.

 - Lead incident resolution, root cause analysis, and reliability improvements to meet platform availability and performance SLAs. 
 - Mentor software engineers and senior engineers, providing technical guidance, coaching, and leadership across multiple initiatives. 

Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements that enhance platform scalability, resiliency, maintainability, and developer productivity. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively across engineering and business organizations. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
