data.description:
At AGCO, our purpose is to provide farmer-focused solutions that sustainably feed our world. Every day, our teams work alongside farmers to deliver innovative machinery, smart technologies, and precision agriculture solutions that help increase productivity while reducing environmental impact. 

Job Summary

The Director of Supplier Quality is responsible for leading AGCO's global supplier quality strategy, performance, and continuous improvement initiatives across the supply base. This role drives world-class supplier quality performance through robust APQP, PPAP, supplier development, supplier performance management, and supplier warranty recovery processes. The position is accountable for reducing supplier-related quality defects, warranty exposure, production disruptions, and cost of poor quality while enabling successful new product introductions and strategic sourcing initiatives. 

A critical focus of this role is developing supplier capability in low-cost countries, improving supplier readiness for new product launches, and driving consistency of supplier quality systems and execution across all global regions. The Director will partner closely with Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing, Product Integrity, and Regional Quality teams to improve supplier performance and ensure suppliers consistently meet AGCO's quality, delivery, and reliability expectations. 

What You'll Make Possible

- Improved quality and reliability across AGCO products
 - Successful execution of global product launch programs
 - Stronger supplier capability and manufacturing readiness
 - Reduced quality risks and warranty costs
 - More resilient and sustainable supply chains

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute AGCO's global supplier quality strategy, aligning quality performance with business, sourcing, and operational objectives. 
 - Lead and develop a high-performing global Supplier Quality organization, driving a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence. 
 - Drive supplier quality performance through effective supplier development, performance management, corrective actions, and risk mitigation programs. 
 - Enhance supplier capability across global sourcing regions, including India, China, Southeast Asia, and Eastern Europe, with a focus on manufacturing readiness, APQP, PPAP, and quality system maturity. 
 - Lead supplier quality activities supporting New Product Introduction (NPI), ensuring robust APQP and PPAP execution, launch readiness, and defect prevention. 
 - Partner with Global Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing, Product Integrity, and Regional Quality teams to improve supplier performance and support strategic sourcing initiatives. 
 - Establish data-driven supplier performance management processes to reduce supplier defects, disruptions, warranty exposure, and cost of poor quality. 
 - Drive supplier warranty recovery programs and ensure supplier accountability for quality-related field issues. 
 - Lead strategic supplier improvement initiatives focused on quality, reliability, process capability, and operational performance. 
 - Support category and sourcing strategies through supplier capability assessments, quality risk analysis, and supply base improvement roadmaps. 
 - Build strong relationships with executive supplier leadership and key internal stakeholders to deliver sustainable quality improvements across the global supply chain. 

Success Measures

- Reduction in supplier quality defects (PPM) and manufacturing disruptions. 
 - Improved APQP and PPAP effectiveness and launch quality performance. 
 - Increased supplier capability and quality system maturity. 
 - Improved supplier scorecard performance and corrective action effectiveness. 
 - Enhanced supplier warranty recovery and reduced cost of poor quality. 
 - Strong execution of supplier development and supply base improvement initiatives. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, or related field required. 

Experience

- 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality, Product Integrity, or Supply Chain Quality. 
 - Demonstrated success leading global supplier quality organizations. 
 - Experience with APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, MSA, Control Plans, and Root Cause Problem Solving. 
 - Experience driving supplier development programs in low-cost countries. 
 - Strong background in supplier performance management, warranty reduction, and supplier recovery. 
 - Experience supporting complex global manufacturing and new product introduction environments. 

Preferred Certifications

- ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE)
 - ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE)
 - Six Sigma Black Belt
 - IATF 16949 Auditor Certification

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured by the organization's ability to reduce supplier-related quality issues, improve launch readiness, strengthen supplier capability globally, accelerate PPAP and APQP effectiveness, maximize supplier warranty recovery, and deliver sustained improvements in supplier quality performance across AGCO's global supply base.

data.title: RC-REGULATORY COMPLIANCE-CSV - MES -Manager
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

EY - GDS Consulting - Enterprise Risk (ER) - Regulatory Compliance - CSV - MES - Manager

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence. 

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. 

As part of our EY-ER- Regulatory Compliance team, you will help the clients by understanding their business needs and delivering solutions in accordance with the EY guidelines & methodologies. As a Regulatory Compliance Manager actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. In line with our commitment to quality, you will consistently drive projects to completion with high quality deliverables, achieve operational efficiency, proactively identify and raise risks with the client as well as EY senior management team and lead internal initiatives. 

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Validation Manager - Computerized System Validation (CSV) to lead validation and compliance for defining and executing the validation strategy for Manufacturing Execution System (MES) deployments using PAS‐X across regulated and business critical computerized systems for global pharmaceutical clients. The ideal candidate will ensure compliance with global regulatory standards (FDA, EMA, MHRA) and drive strategic initiatives for business process transformation and operational excellence. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Validation Strategy & Planning: Develop the end‐to‐end validation approach for PAS‐X implementations, including CSV/CSA strategy, risk assessments, and the validation master plan or equivalent documents aligned to corporate QMS and current GxP expectations. Define scope, deliverables, and acceptance criteria for releases and site deployments. 
 - Regulatory Compliance: Ensure alignment with 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, Annex 15, ICH Q9/Q10, data integrity principles (ALCOA+), and applicable regional guidance. Monitor regulatory changes and translate them into pragmatic updates to validation practices. 
 - Lifecycle Documentation: Own and author or oversee key lifecycle documents: User Requirements (URS), Functional/Design Specifications (FS/DS), Configuration Specifications, Risk Assessments (FMEA/HAZOP where applicable), IQ/OQ/PQ protocols and reports, Traceability Matrices, Data Migration and Interface Validation, and periodic review plans. 
 - Test Governance & Execution: Define test strategy and environments for PAS‐X core, master batch record (MBR) configurations, interfaces (e. g. , ERP, LIMS, historians, shop‐floor devices), and reports. Coordinate and witness test execution, deviations management, defect triage, and formal release decisions. 
 - Supplier & System Management: Lead quality oversight of the PAS‐X vendor and implementation partners per supplier qualification processes. Review vendor documentation, leverage vendor testing where appropriate under a risk‐based model and ensure adequate evidence for audits and inspections. 
 - Data Integrity & Security Controls: Validate user management, electronic records/signatures, audit trails, backup/restore, time synchronization, and segregation of duties. Confirm controls for recipe/MBR versioning, electronic batch record (eBR) review, exception handling, and e‐signature workflows. 
 - MBR/Content Validation: Establish standards and procedures for validating MBRs, libraries, and parameter sets. Ensure design reviews, simulation runs, and test data reflect representative production scenarios and critical process parameters. 
 - Infrastructure & Platform Qualification: Coordinate qualification of underlying infrastructure (on‐prem or cloud), databases, and PAS‐X application tiers following ITIL/DevOps and GAMP 5 guidance. Oversee change control for configuration items, patches, and upgrades. 
 - Interfaces & Automation: Drive validation of integrations with ERP (SAP/Oracle), LIMS, warehouse/dispensing, labeling, serialisation, SCADA/PLC, and historians using standardized patterns, message catalogs, and error‐handling tests. 
 - Change & Release Management: Implement compliant change control, versioning, and release procedures for PAS‐X and content. Chair or contribute to CABs, assess impact, and ensure regression testing and re‐validation are commensurate with risk. 
 - Audit/Inspection Readiness: Prepare teams and documentation for internal audits and health authority inspections. Lead responses to observations and CAPAs, and drive continuous improvement in validation processes. 
 - Cross‐Functional Leadership: Collaborate closely with Manufacturing, QA, QC, IT/OT, Engineering, Digital, and Site/Global Program teams. Provide coaching on CSV/CSA principles and mentor validation engineers and testers. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Biotechnology, , Engineering, or related field. 
 - 8+ years in Computerized System Validation (CSV/CSA) within GMP environments, with focused on MES; direct experience with Werum PAS‐X is strongly preferred. 
 - Hands‐on experience validating integrations with ERP, LIMS, SCADA/PLC, historians, and shop‐floor equipment; familiarity with ISA‐95/ISA‐88. 
 - Strong understanding of regulatory requirements including, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11
 - Consulting or client‐facing experience preferred. 
 - Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills. 

Must-Have Skills & Attributes

- Deep understanding of GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, Annex 15, data integrity, ICH Q9/Q10, and relevant regional guidance. 
 - Strong Expertise in CSV/CSA documentation: Gap Analysis, URS, FRS, IQ/OQ/PQ, Risk Assessments, Traceability Matrix, Validation Plans. Familiarity with CSA principles and risk‐based testing. 
 - Experience working in Agile delivery models
 - Understanding of PAS X architecture, modules (eBR, MBR design, Weigh & Dispense, Track & Trace, KPI/Reporting), and configuration lifecycle. 
 - Competence in test management tools, e. g. , ALM/Jira/Xray, and document management in eQMS. 
 - Knowledge of databases, networking, virtualization/cloud (e. g. , AWS/Azure), and cybersecurity controls as relevant to MES. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and client facing skills, with ability to collaborate across business, IT and quality teams
 - Strong project management, problem solving and communication skills

Good-to-Have Skills & Attributes

- Exposure to business development activities and client engagement strategies. 
 - Awareness of AI/ML use in regulated environments and associated quality/governance considerations. 
 - Ability to align technology with business transformation goals. 
 - High attention to detail and analytical thinking. 
 - Familiarity with emerging regulatory trends, such as CSA or digital validation approaches. 
 - Adaptability to changing regulatory and business environments. 

Preferred Certifications

- Certified Software Quality Engineer (CSQE), Certified Software Quality Assurance (CSQA)
 - ISO 9001: 2015 Lead Auditor, Quality Auditor Certification (CQA). 
 - PAS‐X vendor training/certification or equivalent MES credentials
 - Information Security or Risk Management certifications. 

What We Look For

- A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills. 
 - An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide. 
 - Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

What Working At EY Offers

At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. 

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer: 

- Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
 - Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
 - The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

▪ Automate provisioning, configuration, and scaling of platform components (AKS, Key Vault, Monitor, Storage). 

▪ Automate and manage Databricks workspace configuration, access control, and cluster policies. 

▪ Define and enforce platform standards for cluster usage, performance, and cost optimization. 

CI/CD & Automation

▪ Design and implement CI/CD pipelines for Scala-based data applications. 

▪ Automate build, packaging, and deployment processes (e. g. , SBT, github enterprise). 

▪ Enforce DevSecOps practices, including secure pipeline design and infrastructure governance. 

Reliability Engineering & Observability

▪ Implement observability for data pipelines and platform components (logging, metrics, alerting), using grafana. 

▪ Diagnose failures and implement long-term reliability improvements, including root cause analysis and post-incident remediation. 

▪ Define and implement reliability engineering practices, including SLIs/SLOs, incident response, and automated recovery mechanisms. 

▪ Monitor Spark workloads using logs, metrics, and performance diagnostics. 

Data Platform Enablement

▪ Enable reliable runtime execution of production data pipelines and ensure SLA adherence. 

▪ Collaborate with engineers to resolve performance bottlenecks and deployment issues. 

▪ Support environment transitions, and platform lifecycle processes. 

Power BI Platform Integration

▪ Engineer and automate Power BI service configuration, workspace management, and monitoring. 

▪ Design and operate enterprise gateway infrastructure for hybrid data integration scenarios. 

▪ Troubleshoot and continuously improve reliability of dataset refresh and hybrid integration pipelines. 

Governance & Security

▪ Implement and enforce platform governance standards (RBAC, tagging, audit logging). 

▪ Design secure secrets and credential management using Azure Key Vault, managed identities, and federated identity credentials. 

▪ Automate compliance checks and support platform audits across Azure, Databricks, and Power BI environments. 

Platform Optimization

▪ Optimize resource utilization, scalability, and cost-efficiency across platform components. 

▪ Provide transparency into platform usage, cost drivers, and optimization opportunities.

Qualifications

▪ Minimum 5 years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, with a strong focus on automation and infrastructure engineering. 

▪ Strong hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred), Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/Bicep), and CI/CD pipelines. 

▪ Experience designing and operating production-grade data platforms and pipeline ecosystems (Scala / Spark environments).

data.title: Back End Developer
data.description:
We're looking for a strong Backend Developer who can independently own, maintain, and scale our production backend systems. Our applications handle real-time communication, digital transactions, wallet systems, and subscription-based payments. 

We need someone with strong backend fundamentals and hands-on experience in payment gateway integrations, recurring subscriptions, UPI AutoPay, webhooks, and transaction management. 

This is an ownership-driven role where you'll work directly on live production systems and solve critical backend challenges. 

What You'll Do

Backend Development & Architecture

- Build, maintain, and optimize Node. js and Express. js backend services. 
 - Develop scalable REST APIs and manage MongoDB/Mongoose databases. 
 - Maintain WebSocket/Socket. io real-time communication. 
 - Work with Redis for caching, queues, and background processing. 
 - Optimize database queries, API performance, and backend scalability. 

Payments & Subscription Management (Critical)

- Integrate and manage payment gateways including Juspay, Cashfree, Razorpay, PhonePe, or similar providers. 
 - Build and maintain UPI AutoPay and recurring subscription flows. 
 - Handle mandate registration, activation, recurring debits, renewals, cancellations, and failures. 
 - Implement secure payment webhooks and server-to-server payment verification. 
 - Manage payment status synchronization, transaction reconciliation, and settlement-related workflows. 
 - Handle failed payments, retries, duplicate transactions, and subscription lifecycle events. 
 - Build reliable wallet, ledger, and transaction management systems. 
 - Debug payment gateway issues and coordinate with payment provider technical teams. 

Production & Infrastructure

- Independently manage backend deployments and production issues. 
 - Monitor server performance, logs, APIs, and application health. 
 - Debug and resolve critical production issues. 
 - Improve application reliability, security, and error handling. 
 - Work with AWS/GCP or similar infrastructure. 
 - Take ownership of existing production codebases and improve system stability. 
Must Have

- 2+ years of hands-on Node. js and Express. js development experience. 
 - Strong understanding of MongoDB, Mongoose, REST APIs, and backend architecture. 
 - Practical experience integrating payment gateways and handling production transactions. 
 - Experience with recurring subscriptions, UPI AutoPay, mandates, or similar automated billing systems. 
 - Strong knowledge of webhooks, payment verification, asynchronous processing, and idempotency. 
 - Experience with Redis and WebSockets/Socket. io. 
 - Understanding of authentication, authorization, and API security. 
 - Ability to independently debug production issues. 
 - Comfortable working with existing production codebases. 
Good to Have

- Direct experience with Juspay, Cashfree, or Razorpay subscriptions. 
 - Experience with UPI mandates and recurring billing. 
 - Knowledge of payment reconciliation, refunds, settlements, and ledger systems. 
 - Experience with Docker, CI/CD, AWS, or GCP. 
 - Experience with high-concurrency or real-time applications. 
 - Familiarity with background jobs, message queues, and load testing.

data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Job Title: EY GDS - AI Automation Engineer, Technology Consulting

At EY, we're all in shape to your future with confidence. 

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 

Join EY and help to build a better working world. 

About Global Delivery Services

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda. 

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80, 000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom. 

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service. 

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY's global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services. 

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation. 

About the Role: 

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a high-performing AI Automation Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI-driven automation solutions for enterprise and client environments. This role focuses on hands-on engineering, building scalable AI-powered workflows, and accelerating delivery through intelligent automation and generative AI capabilities. 

You will work closely with cross-functional teams to implement production-grade AI use cases across application security, offensive security, and enterprise workflows using modern AI tooling, LLM frameworks, and automation platforms. 

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with working knowledge of generative AI, automation frameworks, and secure development practices, and demonstrates the ability to translate business needs into scalable AI-enabled solutions. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Develop, test, and deploy AI-driven automation workflows using LLMs, agent frameworks, and orchestration tools. 
 - Build and integrate AI-powered solutions into enterprise pipelines, including CI/CD workflows and cloud environments. 
 - Implement automation for use cases such as code generation, testing, vulnerability analysis, documentation, and knowledge retrieval. 
 - Work with generative AI tools including OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, and similar platforms to accelerate engineering productivity. 
 - Develop and support Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, prompt engineering strategies, and evaluation datasets. 
 - Contribute to AI harness frameworks, evaluation pipelines, benchmarking models, and fine-tuning datasets. 
 - Implement agentic workflows using modern frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or equivalent. 
 - Collaborate with architects and senior engineers to translate solution designs into working implementations. 
 - Ensure adherence to secure coding standards and integrate DevSecOps practices in AI solution delivery. 
 - Work closely with client stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver measurable automation outcomes. 

Cyber Experience (Any One Preferred): 

Application Security: 

- Secure coding practices, static and dynamic application security testing (SAST/DAST), DevSecOps, CI/CD integration
 - API security, OWASP Top 10, software supply chain security, secrets management

Offensive Security: 

- Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT), red teaming, adversarial testing
 - Exposure to AI/LLM security risks including prompt injection, jailbreaks, and model misuse

Technical Skills and Expertise: 

- Programming: Python (mandatory), with exposure to JavaScript or other scripting languages
 - AI/LLM Tools: OpenAI Codex, Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Gemini, or similar tools
 - AI Frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or equivalents
 - Cloud Platforms: Azure (preferred), AWS, or GCP
 - AI Platforms: Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face, Vertex AI, or similar
 - Prototyping Tools: Replit, notebooks, rapid experimentation tools
 - Data & Pipelines: Basic understanding of data ingestion, preprocessing, vector databases, embeddings
 - Concepts: RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, fine-tuning basics, evaluation methods, agentic workflows

Soft Skills and Attributes: 

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
 - Effective communication and collaboration with global teams
 - Ability to work in fast-paced consulting environments
 - Continuous learning mindset with interest in emerging AI trends

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI/ML, Cybersecurity, or related field
 - 2-4 years of experience in software engineering, automation, or AI-driven solution delivery
 - Hands-on experience with generative AI tools and automation frameworks
 - Relevant certifications are a plus: 
 - Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate
 - AWS Machine Learning Specialty
 - Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional (CSSLP)

What We Offer You

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more. 

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today. 

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need. 

- Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost. 
 - Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship. 
 - People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing. 
 - Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development. 
 - How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. 
 - Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits. 
 - "We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion". 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Principal Engineer, Test Automation
data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

We are seeking a Principal Automation Engineer with 10+ years of experience defining automation architecture, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards for API, UI, integration, and end-to-end testing. The ideal candidate is a systems-oriented Quality Engineer who understands how products and services interconnect, sees the broader product architecture, and can decompose requirements to capture use cases holistically. This hands-on role will lead the development of scalable C#/. NET frameworks, establish CI/CD quality gates, guide cross-team adoption, and resolve complex automation and testability challenges across distributed products. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the enterprise-grade automation architecture and roadmap for C#-based REST API, UI, integration, and workflow testing. 
 - Design modular frameworks with reusable libraries for configuration, service clients, page or component objects, test data, parallel execution, retries, logging, reporting, and environment management. 
 - Define coding standards, branching and review practices, framework governance, versioning, documentation, and contribution models. 
 - Establish pipeline strategy for pull-request validation, daily smoke tests, staged regression, release qualification, and automated quality gates. 
 - Guide teams on automation suitability, testability, coverage modelling, risk-based selection, and reduction of flaky or low-value tests. 
 - Lead technical reviews, proofs of concept, framework migrations, tool evaluations, and resolution of complex cross-service failures. 
 - Define dashboards and metrics for coverage, reliability, execution time, defect containment, failure causes, and productivity gains. 
 - Partner with architecture, software, DevOps, cybersecurity, systems, and verification leaders to embed quality throughout delivery. 
 - Mentor automation engineers and build engineering capability through reusable assets, coaching, and technical communities of practice. 

Required Skills And Qualifications

- Mandatory: Systems-oriented Quality Engineer with a strong understanding of how products, services, and components interconnect; able to see the broader product architecture and decompose requirements to capture use cases holistically. 
 - Mandatory: Hands-on Automation Architect with advanced C# and . NET skills and a strong understanding of software design principles, dependency injection, concurrency, asynchronous execution, and extensible architecture. 
 - Mandatory: Hands-on experience architecting and developing REST API automation frameworks using RestSharp. 
 - Mandatory: Strong hands-on experience with NUnit or Selenium or playwright for test automation. 
 - Mandatory: Working knowledge of GraphQL (GQL) and experience validating GraphQL APIs. 
 - Mandatory: Solid understanding of test data management principles, strategies, and reusable data provisioning approaches. 
 - Mandatory: Strong awareness of Kubernetes and containerized test environments. 
 - Good understanding of communication protocols, particularly SIP, and hands-on exposure to SIPp for protocol-level testing. 
 - Expertise in API contracts, distributed systems, microservices, event-driven integrations, databases, authentication, authorization, and service virtualization. 
 - Deep experience with Git, CI/CD architecture, parallel execution, automated reporting, and quality gates. 
 - Proven ability to improve framework reliability, diagnose flaky tests, optimize execution, and drive adoption across multiple teams. 
 - Strong technical leadership, stakeholder communication, mentoring, and architecture decision-making skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with Allure reporting is preferred. 
 - Experience with Postman is good to have. 
 - Experience with Azure, Docker, infrastructure-as-code, message brokers, observability platforms, and cloud-native test environments. 
 - Experience validating healthcare platforms, HL7/FHIR integrations, connected devices, or regulated software products.

data.title: Executive Vice President, Technology, Data & Delivery
data.description:
About Citco

JOB DESCRIPTION

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 50 office locations worldwide. With more than $1. 8 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end-to-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients' needs. 

For more information about Citco, please visit www. citco. com

About The Team & Business Line

Fund Administration is Citco's core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry's most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience. 

Strategic Operations is a dedicated function within Private Assets. It brings transformation delivery, project execution, business analysis, operational initiatives and implementation support into one team, reducing the delivery burden on BAU Operations and maintaining ownership from design through adoption. 

The group will be split across three distinct focus areas, aligned under two individual leaders: 

Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions: led by the Operating Model & Product leader, this area will define how services should run end to end, shape scalable products and solutions, support complex client implementations, and ensure client commitments are operationally deliverable. 

Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement: led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will define Operations requirements for data, reporting and platforms, strengthen data quality and lineage, and carry solutions through testing, deployment and adoption. 

Digital Workflow, Automation & AI: also led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will identify and deliver workflow, automation and AI opportunities, establish appropriate controls, and measure whether the expected benefits are realised. 

The group works in close partnership with Operations, the Transformation Office, IT, Tactical Operations and Marquee Client teams. Roles may be permanent or approximately 12-month rotational assignments anchored in strategic locations. Rotational colleagues will join from the business, help shape and deliver change, and return to the line with broader project experience. 

Responsibilities

Your Role

You will own how we build it, prove it, and land it in the business - with accountability for delivery standards across the whole of Strategic Operations. 

- Lead the Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement and Digital Workflow, Automation & AI focus areas, setting priorities across the technology-enabled change agenda for Private Assets. 
 - Own the business analysis and implementation discipline across all three focus areas, including requirements, testing standards, cutover and benefits tracking, so delivery quality is consistent across the group. 
 - Set out Operations' requirements with IT and the Transformation Office, and hold the relationship through build, test and deployment rather than handing over. 
 - Sponsor automation and AI opportunities, from identification through to deployment and measured benefit. 
 - Own the data, reporting and platform roadmap from an Operations perspective, including data quality, lineage and reporting capability. 
 - Govern delivery: release planning, UAT, defect management, deployment readiness and post-implementation review. 
 - Partner with Operations to ensure change is understood, trained out and genuinely adopted. 
 - Build and develop the team, including the rotational model, and actively participate in recruitment. 
 - Maintain alignment with Tactical Operations and Marquee Operations, picking up solutions originating in either for wider reuse. 
 - Represent Strategic Operations at Private Assets and CFS technology and delivery forums. 

Qualifications

About You

You have 12-15 years' experience in fund administration, alternative asset management or a related financial services environment, with substantial exposure to technology-enabled change. 

- A demonstrable record of delivering large-scale technology, data or platform initiatives in a financial services setting, with change that was genuinely adopted. 
 - Strong understanding of private assets processes and the platform estate that supports them. 
 - Credibility with technology partners - able to translate operational need into technical requirement and to challenge a solution design. 
 - Practical knowledge of automation, digital workflow and AI, and sound judgement on what is worth automating. 
 - Delivery governance experience including testing strategy, cutover planning and benefits realisation. 
 - Strong leadership skills and supervisory experience of other professionals, including rotational colleagues joining from the business. 
 - Skilled in business planning, budgeting and stakeholder negotiation. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Advanced computer skills (Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and SharePoint). 
 - Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related field; professional accounting designation a plus. 

What We Expect Of The Strategic Operations Team

Regardless of role or focus area, everyone in Strategic Operations is expected to demonstrate the following: 

- Deep technical and operational knowledge - genuine depth in how our processes, data and platforms actually work - the detail that only comes from having run the work. 
 - Curiosity - the instinct to ask why a process looks the way it does, to challenge the answer, and to keep asking whether there is a better way. 
 - A transformational mindset - comfortable redesigning end to end rather than patching, and prepared to see change through past go-live to the point where it is genuinely adopted. 
 - Ownership through to adoption - accountability does not end at delivery; success is measured by whether the change sticks in the business. 
 - Commercial and client awareness - an understanding of what we can genuinely run, so that what we commit to a client is deliverable. 
 - Global mindset - working across regions, jurisdictions and time zones, and designing solutions that scale beyond a single desk, client or location. 
 - Ambition to shape Citco's future - an appetite to help build the operating model we will run for years, and to be measured on whether it works. 

Our Benefits

Your well-being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location. 

We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect. 

Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe-directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries. 

Vanguard India

Vanguard's office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients. 

Role Summary

The Manager, IT Delivery role manages and leads a team of technical support staff who design, develop, test, implement, and monitor software and tools; works with business leaders to define scope and requirements, and plans and executes the development of various systems; and acts as liaison with business sponsors and principals, while leading cross-functional teams, managing project risks and resources, and integrating cybersecurity best practices to ensure secure and successful project delivery. 

Responsibilites

- Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures. 
 - Responsible for delivering software releases relating to the product for the business units. Works with business clients to determine scope, and develops environmental requirements for each project. 
 - Works closely with management to develop and implement staffing and operational plans. Participates in the development of short and long term department goals. Monitors and reports on service delivery metrics and overall performance. 
 - Develops and implements changes to department policies and procedures to meet changing business needs and to achieve department objectives. Identifies opportunities for continuous improvement. 
 - Leads quality initiatives to improve the delivery of service levels. Works with senior management in the planning, development, and execution of short and long range goals. 
 - Presents status, metrics, and department initiatives at meetings with management and project peers. Maintains relationships with technical teams, IT, and business partners. 
 - Participates in the development of the department budget. Reviews expenses and ensures department operates within budgetary guidelines. 
 - Ensures staff complies with information technology and information security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements. 
 - Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned. 
 - Lead cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration and effectively communicating project progress and updates to stakeholders. 
 - Identify potential risks throughout the project lifecycle and implement strategies to mitigate them, ensuring smooth project delivery. 
 - Develop comprehensive project plans, set timelines, allocate resources efficiently, and manage budgets to ensure successful project delivery. 
 - Enhance cybersecurity frameworks by integrating advanced security measures and best practices into IT projects to safeguard company data and assets. 

Qualifications And Skills

- Minimum 8 years of experience in IT project management, software development, or IT service delivery. Previous leadership experience required. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. PMP, ITIL, or Agile certifications preferred. 
 - Strong expertise in IT project management, Agile methodologies, and SDLC best practices with experience in IT infrastructure, software development, and enterprise IT solutions. 
 - Must have skills: Node. js, TypeScript, ECS, Kubernetes, Kore. AI, Android, iOS development
 - Proficiency in risk management, budgeting, and IT governance. Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and IT compliance standards. 
 - Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 

Location

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered. 

Our mission

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success. 

Our commitment to you

Benefits

Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success-at work and in life-with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life: 

Financial wellness

We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs. 

Physical wellness

We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness. 

Personal wellness

We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life. 

How We Work

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

data.title: Software Engineer II (JVM)
data.description:
EngRadar / Nexla

Software Engineer II (JVM)

Nexla

Nexla is the leading Integration platform, built with AI, for AI, accelerating development for GenAI, Analytics, and Inter-company data. 

Nexla is the employer - EngRadar is a job radar, not a recruiter. We track this posting from their own careers page and send you straight there; we never handle applications or CVs. 

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India Posted today data integrationai

Apply directly →

Nexla, briefly

Nexla is the data layer for enterprise AI. We give AI apps and agents the connectivity, context, and governance to work across more than 1, 000 enterprise systems in real time, and we process over a trillion records a month doing it. DoorDash, LinkedIn, Johnson & Johnson, Instacart, and LiveRamp run mission-critical data on us. Honorable Mention in the Gartner Magic QuadrantTM for Data Integration Tools, and top-rated by customers on Gartner Peer Insights four years running. Founded 2016, remote-first, headquartered in San Mateo. 

Our values are short and we actually use them: Have Empathy. Be Curious. Be Intellectually Honest. Achieve Excellence. Remember to Relax. 

Role

You would work on the backend systems that move data through Nexla: JVM services, the streaming runtime on Kafka, and the distributed processing underneath it. Production Java every day. You take a problem, shape the design, build it, and own it through deploy and on-call. You debug it when it breaks. Small, focused team, which is why the ownership is real rather than nominal. This role sits closest to the integration layer, where the platform meets everything outside it, so the problem below is the one you would live in. 

What You'll Own

- Core framework features, designed and shipped by you. Schema evolution, pagination, rate limiting, circuit breaking, and the automated retries and self-recovery that keep pipelines running without a human watching. The SDKs and interfaces other teams build on sit here too: you write them, document them, and use them yourself. 
 - The streaming and processing path in production. Kafka, Spark, and Flink workloads, checkpointing, backpressure, and failure recovery. You operate what you build. 
 - Design decisions inside your scope, and a real voice in the ones above it. Multi-tenancy, concurrency, and latency show up in almost everything here, and you would be expected to have views on the tradeoffs rather than only implementing someone else's. 
 - The hard debugging. Trace failures across Kafka clusters, distributed runtimes, and flaky third-party APIs, fix them, then build the guardrails so they do not come back. 

Roughly 70% building and shipping, 15% design and technical discussion, 15% code review and the RFCs, runbooks, and docs that come with it. 

The hard problem

Our platform integrates with more than a thousand external systems, each with its own schema quirks, auth scheme, rate limits, and retry semantics. The framework problem is the N+1 one: making the thousandth integration as cheap to add as the tenth. That means absorbing the differences into the abstraction rather than special-casing them, while the data underneath keeps moving at production volume. 

Must-Haves

- 5 to 8 years of software engineering, with some of it on backend platforms, services, or SDKs rather than only end-user applications. 
 - Strong Java. You understand JVM memory management, concurrency models, and non-blocking I/O, and you can work your way to the cause of a thread starvation issue from a heap dump. 
 - Hands-on experience with distributed systems in production: Kafka, Spark, Flink, or similar. You have run them, not only built against them. 
 - Comfort with the modern data stack and the protocols around it: Snowflake, Databricks, gRPC, GraphQL, webhooks, and CDC. 
 - You have owned production systems and know what good operational discipline looks like. 
 - You use AI tools in your actual work and can say specifically where they help and where they mislead you. 

Bonus points

- Contributions to open-source data projects such as Airbyte, Flink, Debezium, or Arrow. 
 - Time at an iPaaS or ELT company: MuleSoft, Fivetran, Informatica, Airbyte, or similar. 
 - Deep Kubernetes and cloud-native experience, including Strimzi for Kafka. 
 - Security architecture: OAuth 2. 0, mTLS, and encrypted credential management at scale. 

You'll thrive here if

- You want ownership and will take it. You write code every day and you carry what you ship, through deploy and on-call. 
 - You are comfortable defining scope on the fly and shipping before the full picture is clear. 
 - You would rather build the guardrail than fix the same failure twice. 
 - You raise the quality of what is around you through review and pairing, not just the quality of what you write yourself. 

One thing to be clear about: our product definition is still moving as AI reshapes data integration, and the platform has to move with it. If you want a stable, well-defined surface to work on, this is not it. 

How We Hire

Four conversations, about two weeks end to end. 

- Coding. Working through real code rather than a puzzle. 
 - Low-level design. How you structure a system at the class and interface level, and the tradeoffs you would defend. 
 - High-level design. Distributed systems design on a problem close to what we run in production. 
 - Hiring Manager. Ownership, clarity of thinking, and how you actually use AI in your work. 

On AI in the coding round. Use it the way you would on the job, ours or anyone else's. We build AI tooling and we expect you to use AI tooling, so watching you work without it would tell us nothing useful. What we dig into is your judgment: what you delegated, what you verified, and what you threw away. 

You will hear from us either way. 

The practical stuff

Bengaluru, hybrid, 2 days a week in office. Compensation includes base salary and equity, set by depth and experience rather than by title. You will need to overlap with morning Pacific hours for syncs, design reviews, and collaboration with our US-based leadership and engineering teams. 

Worth a look before you apply

- What we are building now. MCP Studio and Express, our two newest bets. 
 - Who uses us, and why. nexla. com/customers
 - The product in engineer terms. docs. nexla. com
 - Our CEO on why we take "Remember to Relax" seriously. Read the founder story
 - Everything else. nexla. com
 - Blog
 - All open roles

Why Nexla? Why now?

A few large companies - DoorDash, SentinelOne, Johnson & Johnson, LinkedIn, Amex, Integrity Marketing, among them use Nexla for data integration. Connectors, runtime, transformations, scheduling, the parts of the stack where data has to move between systems reliably. 

The reason this is an interesting moment to join is what the agent shift is doing to the category. Data integration used to mean "land this data in that warehouse so a human can look at it. " That product is mature. What it's becoming is closer to "an agent asks a business question, and the platform figures out which data and what code and which APIs add up to a real answer. " That's a much bigger problem, and most of the architecture for it hasn't been built yet by anyone. 

A concrete example. A revenue team wants to ask "which enterprise customers are showing renewal risk" and get a real answer through whatever agent or app they work in. Today there is no clean way to answer that question, it requires CRM, usage, support, and billing data joined in org-specific ways, and the calling agent can't just invoke a tool that returns the right answer unless someone first establishes whether the underlying data is even capable of producing one. 

That is the system we are building. A probe agent investigates the data plane whether the right fields are populated, whether freshness is adequate, whether the joins exist, whether credentials cover the required scope and returns a grounded feasibility answer. Where there are gaps, Express. dev composes the pipelines to close them. The capability is then exposed as an MCP server: "renewal risk" as a curated product, with the business logic correct and the query semantics described well enough that the calling agent uses it as intended. The MCP Gateway governs which agents can call which capabilities, with the policies, audit, and observability an enterprise control plane requires. 

The bet is that ten years of connector work, an enterprise customer base, and a runtime that already moves real volume are the right foundation to define this layer from.

data.title: QA - SDET
data.description:
QA - SDET - SaaS Product Engineering - Please read these requirements carefully before applying. 

Location: Pune, India (Remote)

Experience: 5+ years total in software development or test automation role

Employment Type: Full-Time

Schedule: Rotating 24/7 on-call coverage

About This Opportunity

Not every QA engineer is an SDET. We're looking for someone who knows the difference. At KIBO, we operate a sophisticated, enterprise-grade SaaS commerce platform supporting global brands and mission-critical business operations. 

When code goes to production, we need someone exceptional ensuring its quality, resilience, and scale. We are looking for a technically strong, hands-on Senior QA SDET who understands modern cloud-native architectures, earns the respect of backend and frontend developers, and can design, build, and maintain robust automated test frameworks from scratch. 

This is a high-ownership role where your technical depth, automation skills, API mastery, and commitment to quality directly affect our platform's reliability and our customers' success. You won't just be manually clicking through test cases; you will be writing clean code, engineering test contexts using AI tools, validating microservices, and driving continuous quality across our deployment pipelines. 

We have high expectations for this position. We're looking for proven automation experience and architectural testing depth, not just familiarity with testing terminology. 

About KIBO

KIBO is a global SaaS technology company delivering modern, composable digital commerce solutions for B2B, B2C, and D2C organizations. Our platform brings together enterprise eCommerce, Order Management, and Subscriptions, helping businesses simplify complex operations and deliver exceptional customer experiences. Trusted by brands including Ace Hardware, Zwilling, Jelly Belly, Nivel, and Honey Birdette, KIBO powers sophisticated commerce environments where reliability, performance, and scalability matter. 

Our technology is built around modern MACH architecture: 

- Microservices-based: Independently deployable services supporting scalability and flexibility. 
 - API-first: Modern integration capabilities connecting complex enterprise ecosystems. 
 - Cloud-native SaaS: Modern cloud infrastructure designed for enterprise-scale operations. 
 - Headless: Flexible architecture separating customer experiences from back-end commerce capabilities. 

KIBO is MACH Alliance Certified and was recognized as a Leader in The Forrester WaveTM: Order Management Systems, Q1 2025. We're also at the forefront of embracing AI and intelligent automation, continually exploring how emerging technologies can improve engineering productivity, operational efficiency, and the experiences we deliver to our customers. Our global team of Kibonauts works in a remote-friendly environment that values technical excellence, accountability, innovation, continuous learning, and customer obsession. 

If you enjoy working with talented people, sophisticated technology, and meaningful technical challenges, KIBO offers an opportunity to make a real impact. 

What You'll Do

Architect & Own Automation Frameworks: 

- Design, build, and maintain scalable automated testing frameworks for backend REST/GraphQL APIs and frontend UI components using modern tools (Playwright, Cypress, Jest, RestAssured, or TypeScript/Java/Python). 
 - Integrate test automation seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps) to enable automated quality gates for every pull request and release. 

Drive API & Microservice Quality: 

- Perform deep API-level testing, validating contract adherence, payload structures, status codes, error handling, and data consistency across decoupled microservices. 
 - Validate asynchronous, event-driven workflows (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS/SNS) to ensure message ordering, idempotency, retry mechanisms, and schema validation under distributed failures. 

Leverage AI-Native Testing Workflows: 

- Systematically direct AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to generate test cases, stub mock data, optimize assertion logic, and accelerate test coverage. 
 - Maintain human review gates over AI-generated test scripts to ensure compliance with Kibo's architectural standards, security requirements, and edge-case validation. 

Perform Performance & Scale Validation: 

- Design and execute performance, load, and stress test scenarios (using JMeter, k6, or Gatling) to simulate peak-season transaction volumes, order surges, and concurrent API traffic. 
 - Identify system bottlenecks across API, database (MySQL/MongoDB), caching (Redis), and network layers in collaboration with backend and SRE teams. 

Defect Root Cause Analysis & Quality Leadership: 

- Proactively identify, isolate, document, and track complex defects to root cause using log analysis (Splunk, Grafana) and database queries. 
 - Participate actively in Agile sprint ceremonies, providing early input on feature specifications, acceptance criteria, testability, and risk analysis. 

What You'll Need - Mandatory Qualifications

SaaS Product Company Experience

- Minimum 4 years of recent, direct employment with a SaaS software product company. 
 - Experience supporting and operating a company's own software product in a live production environment. 
 - Understanding of the operational complexity associated with cloud-based, multi-service SaaS platforms. 

2. Professional Experience

- Minimum 5+ years of total experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles. 
 - Proven track record of writing clean, maintainable automation code (TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, or Python) following standard design patterns (Page Object Model, SOLID principles). 
 - Strong experience building or expanding automation frameworks for both APIs and web UIs. 

3. Technical Capabilities

- API Testing Mastery: Strong, practical command of RESTful/GraphQL APIs, OAuth 2. 0/JWT authentication, payload validation, and webhooks. 
 - UI Automation: Proficiency with modern web automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium Webdriver. 
 - AI Tooling Fluency: Daily usage of AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude, Copilot) to accelerate test creation, data generation, and refactoring. 
 - Database & Data Modeling: Comfortable writing SQL queries and interacting with document stores (MongoDB) for test data setup and database verification. 
 - Observability & Logs: Ability to inspect system logs and metrics using tools like Splunk, Grafana, or Datadog to isolate failure root causes. 
 - Cloud & DevOps: Familiarity with AWS/GCP, Docker containerization, and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines. 

4. Communication & Mindset

- Exceptional written and spoken English skills to articulate quality risks, bug details, and test strategies clearly to global engineering teams. 
 - Strong problem-solving mindset-takes pride in breaking complex edge cases, validating distributed transactions, and advocating for user experience. 

Additional Experience That Will Set You Apart

- Experience testing enterprise commerce, retail technology, Order Management Systems (OMS), or payment gateway integrations. 
 - Familiarity with commerce-specific workflows: checkout state machines, inventory allocation, promotions, fulfillment, and return flows. 
 - Exposure to contract testing (e. g. , Pact) or visual regression tools (e. g. , Applitools, Percy). 
 - Hands-on experience with performance/load testing frameworks (k6, JMeter) in a cloud environment. 

Our Hiring Process - What to Expect

We take technical hiring seriously. Our interview process is designed to evaluate your individual engineering capabilities, coding standards, automation depth, and problem-solving mindset. 

- Step 1: Live Video Recruiter Screen
 - A conversation focused on your background, SaaS product-company experience, QA methodology, and career goals. 
 - Step 2: Interview with the QA / Engineering Leader
 - A discussion around your testing architecture decisions, automation framework design, API validation strategy, and cross-functional collaboration. 
 - Step 3: Live Technical Coding & Automation Interview
 - An interactive hands-on evaluation where you will write automation code, debug API/UI test scenarios, inspect logs, and showcase your test design capabilities. 

Behavioral and Cognitive Assessments

Candidates will also complete behavioral and cognitive assessments as part of our selection process. 

Our Policy on AI During Interviews

At KIBO, we embrace AI and put it to work daily. However, during live technical interviews, the use of unauthorized AI tools to generate code responses or real-time answers is strictly prohibited unless authorized by the interviewer. We want to evaluate your core technical intuition and personal problem-solving abilities. 

Why Join KIBO?

- Work with modern, MACH-certified enterprise SaaS technology. 
 - Join an AI-first culture that encourages the daily use of cutting-edge AI tools (Cursor, Claude, Copilot) to maximize speed and efficiency. 
 - Collaborate with talented backend, frontend, and cloud engineers in a global remote-friendly setting. 
 - Take true ownership over quality deliverables with clear paths for technical growth. 
 - Receive competitive compensation alongside comprehensive health, wellness, and time-off benefits. 

Bring your experience. Bring your judgment. Bring your best. 

At KIBO, we celebrate and support differences. KIBO is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunities without discrimination based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

data.title: Senior Director AI/ML Engineering
data.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together. 

As the Senior Director of Software & AI/ML Engineering for GTS, you will drive the strategic vision, architectural direction, and production delivery of scalable, resilient, and secure software and AI/ML solutions that support healthcare applications and workflows. Combining deep software engineering expertise with applied AI/ML leadership, you will build and lead teams delivering cloud-native services, reusable components, and robust APIs alongside machine learning models, generative AI solutions, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and AI agents that enable workflow automation and decision-making. You will advance the adoption of AI-powered development tools and cloud AI services, establish engineering standards for automated evaluation, deployment, and monitoring, and ensure solutions align with security, reliability, and responsible AI practices. , You will own people management, talent development, team performance, and delivery across both areas, partnering with product, data, security, and business leaders to shape the roadmap and deliver measurable business value. In this senior leadership role, you will develop engineering leaders, guide critical architecture decisions, and accelerate software modernization and AI adoption through your teams, maintaining technical depth through reviews and targeted prototypes rather than serving primarily as a hands-on individual contributor. 

Primary Responsibilities

- Set engineering strategy, roadmaps and delivery standards. Prioritize the software and AI/ML portfolio with business and product partners, balancing value, risk, technical debt and capacity
 - Manage people and lead software and AI/ML teams. Set clear goals, provide regular coaching and feedback, conduct performance reviews, support career development and address performance concerns
 - Own hiring, workforce planning, skills development and succession planning. Develop engineering managers and senior engineers, where appropriate, and build a culture of accountability, inclusion and continuous learning
 - Own multi-team delivery commitments, resource allocation and engineering budgets. Manage cloud and AI service costs, resolve dependencies and communicate progress, risks and trade-offs to senior stakeholders
 - Guide architecture for scalable, resilient and secure cloud-native services, application programming interfaces (APIs), data integrations and reusable platforms. Strengthen quality through design and code reviews
 - Lead applied ML, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents and cloud AI services for workflow automation and decision support. Select approaches based on business needs, data readiness and measurable benefits
 - Set evaluation standards for large language models (LLMs) and other models. Require baselines and tests for accuracy, unsupported claims, robustness, bias, latency and cost before release and throughout production use
 - Establish ML operations (MLOps) and LLM operations (LLMOps) practices for versioning, automated evaluation, deployment, monitoring and rollback. Oversee model serving, data quality and changes in model performance over time
 - Make responsible AI, security and privacy part of design and delivery. Partner with data and security teams on access controls, sensitive-data protection, human review and safeguards against prompt injection and unsafe agent actions
 - Strengthen coding, testing and continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) practices. Own production readiness, service reliability and incident improvements, with clear accountability across software and AI/ML teams
 - Drive adoption of reusable components, shared AI capabilities and AI-powered development tools. Measure business impact, user adoption, quality and productivity, and use evidence to scale, improve or stop initiatives
 - Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
 - 18+ years of relevant engineering experience, including substantial experience delivering production software and cloud-based systems
 - 7+ years of people leadership experience, including direct people management, hiring, performance management and career development; experience leading multi-team delivery and developing technical leaders
 - 5+ years leading production AI/ML initiatives, with accountability for model evaluation, deployment, monitoring and business outcomes. Experience requirements may overlap and are not additive
 - Experience setting engineering roadmaps, managing capacity and costs, and making portfolio trade-offs across competing business and technical priorities
 - Proven solid technical grounding in backend engineering, distributed systems, APIs, cloud architecture and secure delivery; experience with a production backend language and Python sufficient to guide technical decisions and reviews
 - Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and partner across product, data, security and operations. Ability to communicate technical risks clearly and lead teams through delivery and organizational change

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading engineering in healthcare or other regulated environments, including responsible use of sensitive data
 - Experience developing engineering managers or leading through managers, and building shared software or AI platforms used by multiple teams
 - Experience with generative AI, RAG evaluation, vector search, AI agents and ML frameworks; ability to assess when AI is appropriate and when a simpler software solution is better
 - Experience with containers, infrastructure as code, model registries and automated model delivery; success scaling AI adoption with demonstrated improvements in quality, productivity or cost

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.
