data.title: Engineering Manager (Mobile)
data.description:
Who We Are: 

Fareportal is a travel technology company powering a next-generation travel concierge service. Utilizing its innovative technology and company owned and operated global contact centres, Fareportal has built strong industry partnerships providing customers access to over 500 airlines, a million lodgings, and hundreds of car rental companies around the globe. With a portfolio of consumer travel brands including CheapOair and OneTravel, Fareportal enables consumers to book-online, on mobile apps for iOS and Android, by phone, or live chat. Fareportal provides its airline partners with access to a broad customer base that books high-yielding international travel and add-on ancillaries. 

HIGHLIGHTS: 

- Fareportal is the number 1 privately held online travel company in flight volume. 
 - Fareportal partners with over 500 airlines, 1 million lodgings, and hundreds of car rental companies worldwide. 
 - 2019 annual sales exceeded $5 billion. 
 - Fareportal sees over 150 million unique visitors annually to our desktop and mobile sites. 
 - Fareportal, with its global workforce of over 2, 600 employees, is strategically positioned with 9 offices in 6 countries and headquartered in New York City. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a high-performing Engineering Manager (Mobile) with comprehensive, end-to-end requirement-to-delivery experience. In this role, you will transition from individual contribution to managing a high-caliber team of mobile engineers, including Team Leads and Staff Engineers. 

You will own the technical architecture, cross-platform development, native modules, UI styling frameworks, and API integrations for our iOS and Android applications. As a delivery and people leader, you will be entirely responsible for the "Concept-to-Store" lifecycle, ensuring our mobile booking engines scale to handle peak OTA traffic with maximum uptime. 

Core Responsibilities: 

Delivery, Architecture & Technical Strategy

End-to-End Requirement to Delivery Ownership: Take total accountability for the mobile roadmap from initial product requirement scoping to final store deployment. Ensure predictable sprint velocities and on-time delivery across multiple parallel tracks. 

Architectural Governance: Oversee and approve client-side mobile architectures. Guide the team on when to leverage cross-platform modules (React Native) versus writing native performance bridges (Swift/Kotlin). 

API & Data Orchestration Strategy: Enforce robust security and performance standards for data layers interacting with RESTful APIs, GraphQL (Apollo Client), and real-time WebSockets. Ensure seamless optimization for low-bandwidth environments. 

MarTech Ecosystem & Routing: Oversee the integration and performance impact of Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs like AppsFlyer/Branch), customer engagement platforms (e. g. , CleverTap, Braze), and ensure flawless execution of complex deep linking/universal links across the booking funnel. 

Release Train, CI/CD & OTA Updates: Orchestrate continuous delivery and automated release tracks using Fastlane and GitHub Actions. Manage Over-The-Air (OTA) update strategies (e. g. , CodePush or EAS Update) to rapidly deploy JavaScript bundles and hotfix critical production bugs without waiting for Apple/Google store review cycles. 

App Store Ecosystem & Policy Governance: Act as the final gatekeeper for App Store Connect and Google Play Console. Navigate complex store review guidelines, manage rejection appeals, and ensure the app stays compliant with evolving platform policies. 

Scalability & Traffic Spikes: Design robust, high-concurrency client architectures capable of handling sudden, massive traffic surges typical of B2C flash sales, holiday booking rushes, and flash marketing events without degradation. 

Leading Elite Mobile Teams & Culture

Managing High-Performer Dynamics: Successfully lead, inspire, and retain an elite team of highly skilled developers. Turn divergent technical opinions among senior engineers into unified architectural decisions. 

Product & Stakeholder Partnership: Act as the strategic counterpart to Product Managers and UX/UI Leads. Translate business requirements into technical roadmaps, negotiate sprint scopes, and ensure engineering deliverables align tightly with OTA business KPIs (conversion rates, booking funnel optimization). 

Engineering Craftsmanship: Promote a high-standard engineering culture focused on code quality, thorough documentation, reusable UI component libraries, and automated testing (Jest, Detox, Appium). 

Technical Debt & ROI Management: Strategically balance feature delivery with technical debt. Advocate for engineering refactors by translating technical gains (e. g. , modularization) into clear business value for non-technical stakeholders. 

Talent Cultivation & Growth: Run quarterly performance reviews, establish clear individual career ladders, and mentor team leads. Design rigorous interview loops to attract top-tier mobile talent in a competitive market. 

Advanced Competency Standards

Security, Compliance & Data Protection

PII & Payment Data Security: Demonstrate a strong understanding of best practices for securing Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and Payment Card Industry (PCI) data within mobile clients, guiding the team on safe payment processing and data tokenization without acting as the primary compliance officer. 

Data Localization & Privacy: Architect storage and transmission strategies that respect regional data localization laws and data-at-rest encryption requirements. 

WebView & Boundary Hardening: Mitigate advanced WebView vulnerabilities-including Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and script injection-ensuring strict security controls over hybrid features. 

Network & Authentication Security: Mandate certificate pinning across native and cross-platform network layers. Manage complex token lifecycles and secure token exchanges (OAuth, JWT) seamlessly across native/web boundaries. 

Reliability, Observability & Performance

React Native Performance Tuning: Optimize React Native-specific bottlenecks, including JS thread blocking, memory leaks, bridge traffic reduction, and Hermes engine tuning to ensure native-like 60fps scrolling and fast TTI (Time to Interactive). 

Telemetry Infrastructure: Establish expert-level implementation of Application Performance Monitoring (APM) and logging tools (e. g. , Sentry, Datadog, New Relic). 

Actionable Insights: Transform raw error metrics, crash logs, and latency telemetry into clear, prioritized technical backlogs that actively improve app stability and user retention. 

Production Guardrails: Define, monitor, and defend strict operational SLAs, targeting a >99. 9% crashfree user rate and optimized app launch velocities. 

Global Accessibility (a11y): Ensure the application meets WCAG guidelines and supports native screen readers (VoiceOver/TalkBack), maintaining an inclusive booking experience for all users. Required

Technical Skills & Stack

UI & Core Frameworks: React Native, Redux/React Query/MobX, JavaScript/TypeScript, CSS-in-JS, Tailwind CSS, and React Native StyleSheet. 

Native Development Platforms: iOS (Xcode, Swift, Objective-C, UIKit/SwiftUI, Core Data) and Android (Android Studio, Kotlin, Java, Android SDK, SQLite/Room). 

API Integration & Networking: RESTful APIs, GraphQL (Apollo Client), WebSockets, Axios, and RTK Query. 

Infrastructure, OTA & MarTech: CodePush / Expo Application Services (EAS), AppsFlyer, Branch, Firebase, or similar MMP/Engagement SDKs. 

Testing & Automation: Jest, Detox, Appium, XCTest, Espresso, Fastlane, and mobile CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , GitHub Actions). 

Qualifications

Experience: 10+ years of professional software development experience, with a minimum of 3 years specifically in Engineering Management directly leading mobile teams. 

Proven Scale: Proven experience managing large scale D2C app development in a B2C organization. Domain Expertise: Experience in the travel domain would be helpful but is not mandatory. 

Education: Engineering degree from a Tier 1 college. 

Disclaimer

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Fareportal reserves the right to change the job duties, responsibilities, expectations or requirements posted here at any time at the Company's sole discretion, with or without notice.

data.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone-freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow- helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. 

Join us to put AI to work for people. 

Job Description

This role is for a software engineering director who leads a high-performing team of software engineers building AI-native and cloud-native applications on the ServiceNow platform. The Director combines deep technical credibility with strong people management capabilities, fostering a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. They are responsible for team performance, career development, hiring, and execution of key business initiatives. This role requires the ability to balance people development with business results, think strategically about AI integration and platform architecture, and influence across the organization to enable team success. The ideal candidate brings experience scaling AI-native teams and a passion for building leaders. 

What we do - Finance and Procurement teams are at the forefront of AI-native engineering at ServiceNow-building autonomous solutions for the world's largest enterprises that handle mission-critical financial and procurement operations at unprecedented scale. They continuously learn and integrate the latest AI and cloud-native technologies to deliver performant, resilient systems that transform how businesses manage supplier lifecycles, procurement workflows, payments, and receivables. 

Responsibility Area: People Leadership & Development

- Build, grow, and maintain a high-performing, diverse team of IC2-IC5 engineers; hire and develop talent at all levels
 - Set clear expectations for individual and team performance; establish metrics and goals aligned with business objectives
 - Conduct regular 1: 1s with direct reports; provide coaching, feedback, and career guidance tailored to each engineer's growth stage
 - Create a culture of psychological safety, learning, and ownership; encourage experimentation and learning from failures
 - Support engineers through career transitions-from IC2 to IC3, IC3 to IC4, and technical-to-management pathways
 - Identify high-potential engineers and invest in their development; prepare emerging leaders for increased responsibility
 - Address performance issues promptly and professionally; provide clear paths for improvement or transition
 - Sponsor team members for growth opportunities, stretch assignments, and leadership development programs
 - Celebrate wins and recognize contributions; foster a positive, collaborative team environment
 - Model vulnerability, continuous learning, and AI-native thinking; lead by example in your own growth

Responsibility Area: Hiring & Team Building

- Define hiring strategy and conduct recruitment for open positions; build a pipeline of qualified candidates
 - Lead technical interviews and assessments for engineering candidates at all IC levels; make hiring decisions
 - Partner with HR and recruiting teams on job descriptions, sourcing strategies, and candidate pipeline management
 - Evaluate cultural fit and potential; hire for values and growth potential, not just current skills
 - Onboard new engineers effectively; assign mentors and ensure smooth integration into the team
 - Build a team with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives; actively work to improve representation
 - Identify gaps in team capabilities (technical depth, domain expertise, AI/ML fluency) and address through hiring or development
 - Build relationships with external technical communities to attract and recruit top talent
 - Participate in employer branding and represent the organization at recruiting events and universities

Responsibility Area: Technical Strategy & Product Leadership

- Work with product, design, and cross-functional partners to define product roadmap and technical strategy aligned with business goals
 - Establish technical direction for the team; make architecture and technology decisions that balance innovation, quality, and delivery
 - Ensure the team's technical approach stays current with AI/ML advancements and ServiceNow platform evolution
 - Champion AI-native thinking across the team and organization; help teammates understand how to build with AI at the core
 - Lead architectural reviews and technical decision-making; provide guidance on complex technical trade-offs
 - Advocate for technical investments (refactoring, infrastructure, tooling) that improve team productivity and code quality
 - Set quality standards for code, testing, and security; establish practices that enable sustainable delivery
 - Partner with IC4/IC5 engineers to set multi-year technical roadmaps and long-term strategic initiatives
 - Represent the engineering team in product and executive discussions; influence organizational priorities

Responsibility Area: Team Execution & Accountability

- Drive team delivery of committed business objectives and product initiatives; maintain accountability for results
 - Establish clear sprint goals, work-item prioritization, and delivery timelines; remove blockers for team success
 - Track team metrics: velocity, quality, customer satisfaction, incident response, deployment frequency
 - Conduct regular retrospectives; identify process improvements and drive adoption of better practices
 - Manage team capacity; balance new feature development, technical debt reduction, and customer support
 - Ensure team participation in on-call rotation; monitor incident response and post-incident learning
 - Report on team progress, risks, and performance to senior leadership; provide transparent communication
 - Escalate critical issues or resource constraints; collaborate with peer managers to solve cross-team dependencies
 - Foster a culture of ownership where engineers take responsibility for quality, testing, and production outcomes
 - Lead team through organizational changes and initiatives; maintain morale and focus during transitions

Responsibility Area: Customer & Cross-Functional Engagement

- Build and maintain relationships with key customers and stakeholders; understand their needs and priorities
 - Participate in customer meetings, technical escalations, and business reviews; represent engineering capabilities and constraints
 - Work closely with product management, customer success, and other teams; ensure alignment on priorities and capabilities
 - Lead customer-critical incident response; ensure timely and professional resolution of critical issues
 - Gather customer feedback and translate into product improvements; communicate back to customers how feedback is addressed
 - Advocate for customers' needs within the engineering organization; ensure customer voice is heard in decision-making
 - Build trust and credibility with customers through transparency, responsiveness, and technical leadership
 - Participate in strategic customer discussions and technology roadmap reviews

Responsibility Area: Organizational Leadership & Culture

- Model the organization's values and desired behaviors; set tone for engineering culture within your team and across teams
 - Contribute to hiring and interview training of other managers; build bench strength in people leadership
 - Mentor junior managers or peers; contribute to manager development and leadership pipeline
 - Participate in engineering leadership meetings; contribute to organizational strategy and policy
 - Promote psychological safety, inclusion, and belonging; actively work to reduce barriers for underrepresented groups
 - Foster knowledge sharing across the organization; encourage your team to contribute to brown bags, documentation, and communities
 - Lead by example in work-life balance, continuous learning, and sustainable pace; prevent burnout
 - Encourage your team to engage with the broader tech community (conferences, open source, speaking, writing)

Responsibility Area: AI-Native Thinking & Innovation Leadership

- Develop deep understanding of AI/ML capabilities, limitations, and integration patterns; become a thought leader on AI-native development
 - Coach your team on AI-native thinking-how to build systems with AI at the core, not as an afterthought
 - Help engineers understand prompt engineering, retrieval systems, agentic workflows, and responsible AI principles
 - Establish practices for evaluation-driven development, hallucination detection, and model performance monitoring
 - Lead discussions on AI safety, data privacy, and responsible AI; ensure team builds with appropriate guardrails
 - Create learning opportunities for the team to stay current with AI/ML advancements and frameworks
 - Identify opportunities to apply AI to improve internal processes and team efficiency
 - Contribute to organizational conversations about AI strategy and responsible AI practices
 - Stay informed about LLM advancements, new models, and emerging techniques; share insights with your team

Qualifications

- 12+ years of professional software development experience, with 5+ years in AI-native systems, cloud-native architecture, or equivalent
 - 5+ years of people management experience leading software engineers; track record of developing talent and building high-performing teams
 - 3+ years managing application development on SaaS platforms (ServiceNow, Salesforce, or similar); deep understanding of platform architecture and constraints
 - 3+ years hands-on experience with AI/ML systems, LLM integration, prompt engineering, and responsible AI practices
 - Demonstrated expertise in hiring, team building, and organizational development; ability to attract and develop top talent
 - Expert-level understanding of modern software engineering practices: CI/CD, testing, security, deployment
 - Strong technical credibility; ability to engage in technical discussions with IC4/IC5 engineers; hands-on coding experience still valued
 - Proficiency in Python, Java, and JavaScript; understanding of ServiceNow scripting and platform APIs
 - Track record of delivering significant business results through engineering teams; ability to drive accountability and execution
 - Experience scaling teams and organizations; demonstrated ability to work at multiple levels of complexity
 - Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills; ability to influence across technical and non-technical stakeholders
 - Strong coaching and mentoring skills; ability to develop engineers across all career stages
 - Experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies; ability to adapt to team and organizational needs
 - Demonstrated understanding of data security, compliance, and responsible AI practices
 - Strong emotional intelligence; ability to navigate difficult conversations and build trust
 - Experience with performance management, feedback delivery, and difficult personnel decisions
 - Passion for building inclusive, psychologically safe teams where all engineers can thrive
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, business, or related field
 - Experience leading teams through organizational change, technical migrations, or strategic initiatives
 - MBA or management certification is a plus; however, demonstrated people leadership capability is more important
 - Track record of developing talent into senior engineering leadership roles or managers
 - Active engagement with engineering and AI/ML communities; thought leadership through speaking, writing, or open source is a plus
 - Experience working with diverse teams and commitment to building inclusive organizations

Preferred Attributes

- Experience managing managers or leading multiple teams
 - Background in both individual contributor and manager roles (not just promoted from individual contribution)
 - Experience working in fast-paced startup or scale-up environments
 - Familiarity with data-driven decision making and analytics
 - Experience with customer-facing or go-to-market organizations
 - Understanding of product management and business metrics
 - Track record of improving team efficiency, reducing cycle time, or improving quality metrics
 - Experience mentoring individuals into management roles

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to help build and evolve PWI's intelligence, inferencing, platform, and AI-powered systems. 

This role is ideal for a solid, hands-on engineer who enjoys solving complex engineering problems, building reliable distributed systems, and applying modern AI technologies to real-world product scenarios. You will work on systems that process signals from Microsoft 365, generate meaningful intelligence, and power experiences across Copilot and People & Work Intelligence. 

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own significant components and technical areas from design through production. You will collaborate closely with engineering, product management, data science, research, and partner teams to translate ambiguous requirements into scalable, secure, and reliable solutions.

About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success. 

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide. 

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe. 

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. 

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. 

Why Kaseya?

Join a fast-growing company transforming the IT management and cybersecurity industry. At Kaseya, we are modernizing how software is designed, built, tested, and operated-combining strong engineering fundamentals with AI-native development practices. 

As a Senior Staff Engineer, you will have the opportunity to shape not only our technology architecture, but also how engineering teams leverage AI to build high-quality software faster and more effectively. 

Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives!

Job Summary

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to provide hands-on technical leadership across our SaaS platforms and shared backend services. 

This role is for an engineer who combines deep expertise in Java, distributed systems, cloud architecture, and software design with a modern, AI-native approach to software engineering. 

You will lead complex initiatives across multiple teams, influence architecture and engineering standards, and remain deeply involved in implementation. You will also help define how engineering teams effectively use AI coding tools, including Claude Code, throughout the software development lifecycle-from understanding existing systems and designing solutions to implementation, testing, debugging, code review, documentation, and modernization. 

This is not a purely architectural role. We are looking for a technical leader who designs, codes, prototypes, reviews, mentors, and leads by example. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Define and drive architecture for Java-based platform services, distributed systems, APIs, and event-driven applications across multiple product areas 
 - Lead complex technical initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams, services, and business domains 
 - Remain highly hands-on through architecture, prototyping, implementation of critical components, code reviews, debugging, and production troubleshooting 
 - Champion AI-native software engineering practices, using AI coding tools such as Claude Code to improve developer productivity, code quality, testing, debugging, documentation, and system understanding 
 - Establish effective patterns and guardrails for using AI-generated code in production engineering environments 
 - Help engineering teams evolve from traditional development workflows toward AI-assisted and agentic software development 
 - Identify opportunities where AI can accelerate modernization of legacy systems, test creation, refactoring, migration, and technical debt reduction 
 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, and Architecture leaders to translate business priorities into scalable technical solutions 
 - Guide the evolution of cloud-native architectures, microservices, data flows, integrations, and shared platform capabilities 
 - Drive improvements in system performance, availability, observability, security, and operational readiness 
 - Establish engineering standards and reusable patterns for Java development, API design, testing, CI/CD, AI-assisted development, and production operations 
 - Mentor Senior and Staff Engineers through architecture reviews, technical guidance, hands-on collaboration, and modern AI-enabled engineering practices 
 - Evaluate emerging engineering and AI technologies and determine where they can meaningfully improve our products and engineering organization

Required Qualifications

- 7+ years of software engineering experience building production SaaS applications, distributed systems, or enterprise software platforms 
 - 4+ years of experience developing production backend services using Java 
 - Strong hands-on coding skills and the ability to design, implement, review, debug, and operate complex production software 
 - Proven experience providing technical leadership across multiple engineering teams or product areas 
 - Experience designing and operating distributed systems on AWS, Azure, or GCP 
 - Experience leading architecture reviews and establishing engineering standards or practices adopted across multiple teams 
 - Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted coding tools as part of real software engineering workflows 
 - Ability to use AI effectively for code generation, codebase exploration, refactoring, testing, debugging, documentation, and technical problem-solving 
 - Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals and the ability to critically review, validate, test, and improve AI-generated code 
 - Ability to mentor engineers and influence technical direction without relying solely on organizational authority

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience with Claude Code or similar agentic AI coding tools 
 - Experience with Java technologies such as Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate, Kafka, or similar frameworks 
 - Experience designing cloud-native, microservices-based, or event-driven architectures 
 - Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or Oracle 
 - Experience leading platform modernization, cloud migration, or large-scale re-architecture initiatives 
 - Experience using AI to accelerate modernization of large or legacy codebases 
 - Experience improving reliability, observability, performance, testing, or operational practices across production systems 
 - Experience integrating AI-enabled capabilities, LLMs, agents, or AI services into production software 
 - Experience developing engineering standards, workflows, or guardrails for AI-assisted software development 
 - Familiarity with modern AI engineering concepts such as LLM APIs, tool use, agents, RAG, evaluation, and prompt/context engineering 
 - Experience measuring and improving engineering productivity using AI-enabled development workflows

What Success Looks Like

A successful Senior Staff Engineer at Kaseya does more than design systems. You will: 

- Build: Stay close to the code and deliver critical technical solutions. 
 - Lead: Set technical direction and drive complex initiatives across teams. 
 - Modernize: Improve architecture, engineering practices, and legacy systems. 
 - Amplify: Use AI to increase the effectiveness and velocity of engineering teams. 
 - Mentor: Raise the technical capabilities of engineers around you. 
 - Own: Take responsibility for solutions from architecture and implementation through production operation. 

We are looking for engineers who see AI not as a replacement for engineering fundamentals, but as a powerful multiplier for exceptional engineers. 

Additional Information

Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

data.description:
Founded in 2014, Circles is a global technology company reimagining the telco industry with its innovative SaaS platform, empowering telco operators worldwide to effortlessly launch innovative digital brands or refresh existing ones, accelerating their transformation into techcos. 

Today, Circles partners with leading telco operators across multiple countries and continents, including KDDI Corporation, Etisalat Group (e&), AT&T, and Telkomsel, creating blueprints for future telco and digital experiences enjoyed by millions of consumers globally. 

Besides its SaaS business, Circles operates three other distinct businesses: 

- Circles. Life: A wholly-owned digital lifestyle telco brand based in Singapore, Circles. Life is powered by Circles' SaaS platform and pioneering go-to-market strategies. It is the digital market leader in Singapore and has won numerous awards for marketing, customer service, and innovative product offerings beyond connectivity. 
 - Circles Aspire: A global provider of Communications Platform-as-a-Service (CPaaS) solutions. Its cloud-based Experience Cloud platform enables enterprises, service providers and developers to deliver and scale mobile, messaging, IoT, and connectivity services worldwide. 
 - Jetpac: Specializing in travel tech solutions, Jetpac provides seamless eSIM roaming for over 200 destinations and innovative travel lifestyle products, redefining connectivity for digital travelers. Jetpac was awarded Travel eSIM of the Year. 

Circles is backed by renowned global investors, including Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia), Warburg Pincus, Founders Fund, and EDBI (the investment arm of the Singapore Economic Development Board), with a track record of backing industry challengers. 

Job Role - Software Engineer II (DevSecOps)

Location - Bangalore , India

Role Description

DevSecOps is a core, cross-functional discipline that spans the entire organization, offering the unique opportunity to collaborate with multiple teams across diverse products and platforms. Your role is central to ensuring software features are reliable, scalable, and ready for both build-and-launch and operational handoffs. 

As a DevSecOps Engineer, you will operate as a hands-on individual contributor, responsible for proposing, designing, implementing, and troubleshooting robust CI/CD pipelines for multi-tier applications deployed on virtual machines and containerized platforms in public cloud environments. You'll collaborate closely with principal engineers across various teams. 

This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a highly skilled team where your impact will be felt organization-wide. It also offers a platform to deepen your expertise in DevSecOps while enhancing both your technical and strategic business skill sets. 

You will be immersed in a cutting-edge DevSecOps ecosystem featuring CI/CD automation, ephemeral (dynamic) environments, automated QA pipelines, fan-out deployment strategies, blue/green releases, and scalable deployment to partner environments-ranging from on-premises to multi-cloud platforms. 

Your Responsibilities

- Design, implement, test, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines for containerized applications, covering the full lifecycle from build to deployment. 
 - Establish continuous delivery and deployment pipelines integrated with release workflows to support streamlined release orchestration. 
 - Diagnose and resolve issues in multi-layered, containerized applications deployed in cloud environments. 
 - Own infrastructure architecture and define non-functional requirements, ensuring alignment with the overall technology roadmap and platform launch objectives. 
 - Champion a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) culture across the organization by promoting industry best practices, standards, tools, documentation, and reusable code across engineering teams. 
 - Design, develop, and drive adoption of solutions that enhance observability, reliability, and operational efficiency across the platform. 
 - Integrate AI-driven solutions into the software development lifecycle to enhance development and operational efficiency. 
 - Automate manual, repetitive, or mechanical processes by applying software and scripting solutions wherever beneficial. 
 - Troubleshoot complex, cross-platform issues spanning OS, networking, and databases in a cloud-based SaaS environment; handle live production incidents and ensure implementation of SRE best practices. 
 - Conduct system discovery and analysis to identify and implement performance, availability, and reliability improvements. 
 - Collaborate with software engineers and QA teams to ensure the system meets non-functional requirements such as performance, availability, and security. 
 - Maintain comprehensive system documentation, develop runbooks, and ensure key system knowledge is accessible to relevant stakeholders. 
 - Manage and monitor infrastructure deployment and orchestration, including servers, Docker containers, Kubernetes clusters, and other backend components. 
 - Stay up-to-date with security trends, proactively identify vulnerabilities, and troubleshoot complex security issues. 
 - Participate in an on-call rotation, including weekend support, to ensure high availability and quick incident response. 

Required Educational Qualifications

- Bachelors or masters degree in Information Technology/Computer Science or equivalent combination of education and experience. 

Certification Requirements (nice To Have)

- Kubernetes CKA or CKAD certification is nice to have
 - AWS or GCP DevOps related certifications is nice to have
 - GCP or AWS certification on cloud architecture - associate/professional is nice to have

Required Technical Competencies

- Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience with CI/CD platforms, Kubernetes, and a strong background in DevOps, SRE, and Agile methodologies. 
 - Proven experience in designing, setting up, and maintaining Kubernetes clusters and managing containerised pipelines. 
 - Expertise in developing, testing, and implementing CI/CD pipelines for automating build, deployment, and code promotion processes. 
 - Proficient in writing automation scripts and pipelines using Groovy or Python to streamline routine tasks and eliminate manual intervention. 
 - Strong background in troubleshooting CI/CD pipeline issues, especially for containerised and multi-layer applications deployed in GCP or AWS. 
 - Experience in infusing AI into the software development lifecycle to enhance automation and decision-making. 
 - Extensive experience working with cloud-native CI/CD environments, and container technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, Docker Swarm, and Helm. 
 - Solid experience as a Linux system administrator (e. g. , Ubuntu, RedHat), with proficiency in command-line tools such as Bash, VIM, and SSH. 
 - Familiarity with infrastructure monitoring and performance analysis tools like Grafana, Prometheus, DataDog, Nagios, and New Relic. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to perform deep root-cause analysis and implement effective solutions. 
 - Advanced knowledge of core infrastructure components including storage, systems, and networking. 

Required Business Skills

- Self-motivated, adaptable, and able to manage multiple priorities independently with a collaborative, team-first attitude. 
 - Strong communication and presentation skills, capable of clearly conveying ideas to diverse stakeholders using visual aids like PowerPoint and architecture diagrams. 
 - Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities with a data-driven mindset to identify root causes, validate outcomes, and provide effective solutions. 
 - Quick to learn new technologies and apply them to deliver impactful, timely results with minimal supervision. 
 - Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to provide relevant project updates and insights to stakeholders efficiently. 

Desirable Technical Competencies

- Experience integrating AI into the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), particularly within CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Configuration Management as Code (CMaC), and Policy as Code (PoaC) is highly desirable
 - In-depth knowledge of common internet protocols and applications such as SMTP, DNS, HTTP, SSH, SNMP, etc. 
 - Familiarity with platforms like GitLab or GitHub and technologies like ELK stack, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, and Etcd. 

Circles is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, disability or age.

data.title: Full Stack Developer (Golang + React js)
data.description:
Aeon

Full Stack Developer (Golang + React JS)

Bangalore or Kolkata • Full-Time• 7+ Years Experience

Build the infrastructure that powers how the world hires. 

Aeon is a cloud-native talent intelligence platform that uses AI, machine learning, and predictive models to eliminate the friction between sourcing and hiring. We work with 150+ Fortune 500 companies across the US, Canada, LATAM, and India. Our Bangalore and Kolkata teams are not satellite offices. They are core engineering. 

We are not looking for someone to maintain what already exists. We want engineers who build things that have not been built before, who ship fast, and who use AI as a force multiplier on everything they touch. 

This is an AI-First Role

Aeon provides every engineer a monthly AI token budget (Claude, Copilot, or equivalent). Using it is not optional. We expect you to demonstrate measurable gains from AI, whether that is faster delivery, higher code quality, fewer bugs, or better architectural decisions. You will be asked to show your work. 

What You Will Build

- Core backend services and APIs in Golang that handle real-world scale, not demo load
 - React JS frontends that hiring teams and HR leaders use every day
 - Microservices that integrate with AI/ML pipelines powering candidate matching and ranking
 - CI/CD workflows and infrastructure tooling that keeps deployments reliable and fast
 - New features from spec to production, with full ownership of quality and performance

The Stack

Backend

Golang, REST APIs, Microservices

Frontend

React JS, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML, CSS

Data

PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB

Infra & Cloud

AWS / GCP / Azure

DevOps

Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD Pipelines

Architecture

System Design, Microservices, Scalability

What We Look For

- 7+ years of full stack development experience
 - 3+ years of hands-on Golang for production backend systems
 - Strong React JS fundamentals, not just framework familiarity
 - Clear thinking on system design, scalability, and API architecture
 - Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB in real production workloads
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
 - Comfort with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD, ideally something you have shipped through, not just configured
 - A track record of using AI tools to move faster and produce better work

Why Aeon

AI budget, day one

You get a monthly token budget for AI tools. Use them to ship better work faster. We measure the gains. 

Global product, India core

You are not supporting a US team. You are building the product. Your code runs in production for Fortune 500 clients. 

Ownership, not tickets

Engineers here participate in architecture decisions. If you see a better way to build something, say it. 

A real growth path

Aeon is growing fast. Senior and lead roles are earned here, not imported. The people who join now are the ones who will run the team later. 

How the AI Expectation Works

When you join, you will get access to our AI tooling and a monthly usage budget. We do not have a rigid script for how you use it. What we do expect: 

- You use AI actively in your workflow, not as an afterthought
 - You can speak to specific ways AI improved your output, delivery speed, or code quality
 - You share what worked and what did not with the team
 - Over time, your usage and results will be part of how we evaluate your contributionThis is not surveillance. It is a commitment we make to you: we will invest in your tools, and we ask that you invest in using them well. 

Ready to build something that matters?

Apply at www. aeonhire. com or reach out directly.

Job Description

- Execute CSV activities for SAP implementation, enhancement, upgrade, integration, and support projects. 
 - Participate in validation planning and determine validation requirements based on system criticality, intended use, GxP impact, and risk. 
 - Support preparation, review, and approval of validation deliverables such as: 
 - Validation Plan / Master Validation Plan inputs. 
 - GxP and system impact assessments. 
 - Computerized System Risk Assessments. 
 - User Requirements Specifications (URS). 
 - Functional and Design Specifications, where applicable. 
 - Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM). 
 - Test plans, test scripts, test protocols, and test evidence. 
 - Installation, Operational, and Performance Qualification documentation, where applicable. 
 - Validation Summary Reports. 
 - Standard Operating Procedures and Work Instructions. 
 - Review SAP business and functional requirements to ensure applicable GxP, quality, regulatory, and data integrity requirements are adequately addressed. 
 - Ensure requirements are clear, testable, traceable, and appropriately linked to business and regulatory risks. 
 - Support risk-based validation and testing strategies to avoid unnecessary testing while ensuring adequate control of GxP-critical functionality. 
 - Review SAP configuration, custom developments, workflows, reports, forms, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, and integrations from a CSV/GxP perspective. 
 - Participate in SAP testing activities including: 
 - Functional testing. 
 - System Integration Testing (SIT). 
 - User Acceptance Testing (UAT). 
 - Regression testing. 
 - GxP/validation testing. 
 - Review executed test evidence for completeness, accuracy, traceability, objective evidence, and compliance with validation procedures. 
 - Ensure test deviations, incidents, and defects are documented, investigated, resolved, and appropriately assessed for GxP impact. 
 - Support validation of SAP interfaces with external or third-party applications and ensure appropriate controls for data transfer, reconciliation, error handling, and audit trail. 
 - Assess and document data integrity controls including ALCOA+ principles, audit trails, electronic records, electronic signatures, access controls, and record retention. 
 - Support evaluation of SAP roles, authorization controls, segregation of duties, and privileged access where relevant to GxP processes. 
 - Participate in SAP data migration validation including source-to-target mapping, data verification, reconciliation, completeness, and accuracy checks. 
 - Support assessment and validation of SAP master data and transactional data impacting regulated business processes. 
 - Participate in validation of applicable SAP modules/processes such as: 
 - Materials Management (MM). 
 - Production Planning (PP). 
 - Quality Management (QM). 
 - Plant Maintenance / Asset Management (PM/EAM). 
 - Extended Warehouse Management (EWM). 
 - Finance and Controlling where GxP relevance exists. 
 - SAP Fiori applications and workflows. 
 - SAP integrations and interfaces. 
 - Work with SAP functional and technical teams to ensure validation requirements are embedded throughout the system development lifecycle. 
 - Support change controls and perform GxP/validation impact assessments for SAP enhancements, configuration changes, patches, upgrades, and releases. 
 - Support periodic reviews of validated SAP systems to confirm continued validated state. 
 - Support incident, problem, deviation, CAPA, and change-management processes affecting validated systems. 
 - Assist in maintaining validation documentation throughout the system lifecycle and ensure controlled documentation is current and audit ready. 
 - Support system decommissioning and archival activities where required. 
 - Participate in internal audits, regulatory inspections, customer audits, and supplier audits involving computerized systems. 
 - Provide validation documentation and evidence during inspections and respond to auditor/inspector queries as required. 
 - Ensure validation activities comply with organizational SOPs, Quality Management System requirements, and approved project methodology. 
 - Coordinate with Quality Assurance for review and approval of validation documents and resolution of compliance observations. 
 - Support qualification and assessment of SAP vendors, System Integrators, cloud/service providers, and third-party technology suppliers where applicable. 
 - Promote standardized CSV practices and consistent validation methodology across SAP projects and geographical locations. 
 - Identify validation risks early and escalate gaps that may impact regulatory compliance, data integrity, testing, or project go-live readiness. 
Required Experience & Skills

 - Practical understanding of SAP implementation and application lifecycle activities. 
 - Experience supporting at least one full SAP implementation, upgrade, rollout, or major transformation program preferred. 
 - Good understanding of pharmaceutical GxP business processes and associated computerized-system controls. 
 - Working knowledge of applicable regulations and guidance, including: 
 - US FDA 21 CFR Part 11. 
 - EU GMP Annex 11. 
 - GAMP 5 principles and risk-based validation. 
 - Data Integrity / ALCOA+ principles. 
 - Applicable GxP and Good Documentation Practices. 
 - Experience preparing and reviewing validation lifecycle documentation. 
 - Hands-on experience with risk assessment, requirements management, traceability, testing, deviation management, and validation reporting. 
 - Good understanding of SAP configuration versus custom development and associated validation risks.

 - Ability to interpret technical and functional SAP documentation from a regulatory and quality perspective. 
 - Strong analytical and documentation skills with attention to accuracy, traceability, and compliance. 
 - Ability to work effectively with business, Quality Assurance, IT, SAP functional/technical teams, System Integrators, and external vendors. 
 - Good communication, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills.

data.title: Lead Engineer - Controls Engineering
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design-Trade-off-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft. 

Beeinflusst den Abteilungsbetrieb und ist verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung. Die Rolle hat eine gewisse Autonomie, konzentriert sich jedoch auf die Ausführung von Aktivitäten innerhalb einer operativen Disziplin, die durch funktionale Standardpraktiken und -verfahren abgedeckt wird. Möglicherweise ist ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen erforderlich, dies erfolgt jedoch in der Regel unter Anleitung. 

Job Description

Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten

- Identifizieren, entwickeln, bewerten, führen ein und verwalten Engineering-Lösungen für die Anforderungen der Produkt- und Steuerungssystemtechnologie. Wenden die Steuerungstheorie und mathematische Modellierung auf Entwurfs- und Steuerungssysteme mit dem gewünschten Verhalten an. Beinhaltet Bedienbarkeit, Festlegen von Grenzen, Zyklusoptimierung, Steuerlogik, steuerungsbezogene Software, Sensoren, Hardware- und Softwarealgorithmen sowie Feedback zur Steuerung der Leistung von Geräten, Subsystemen und Systemen. 
 - Vertiefung der Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin. Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und erworbenes technisches Fachwissen, um Richtlinien/Strategien umzusetzen. 
 - Fundiertes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten. Vertiefte Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt. 
 - Verwendet ein gewisses Maß an Urteilsvermögen und hat die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Lösungen außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter vorzuschlagen, aber mit Anleitung. Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und die Ausbildung am Arbeitsplatz, um einfache Aufgaben zu lösen. Hat Zugriff auf die technischen Fähigkeiten und das analytische Denken, die zur Lösung von Problemen erforderlich sind. Kann mehrere interne Quellen außerhalb des eigenen Teams verwenden, um Entscheidungen zu treffen. 
 - Eine Stelle auf dieser Ebene ist wahrscheinlich ein einzelner Mitarbeiter mit nachgewiesenen zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten oder Führungsnachwuchs, der Talente einstellen und entwickeln kann. Bietet informelle Anleitung für neue Teammitglieder

Grundqualifikationen

- Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung). 

Gewünschte Eigenschaften

- Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, andere zu beeinflussen und kleine Teams zu führen. Initiativen von mittlerem Umfang und mittlerer Wirkung leiten. Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. Nachweisliche analytische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten. Hinweis: Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind. Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden. Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern. Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern. 

Additional Information

data.title: Manager - Salesforce Services Delivery
data.description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

We are seeking a seasoned Software Delivery Lead to lead a cross-functional Salesforce delivery team at the Delta Technology Hub in Bangalore. Your mandate is quality. Work that leaves this team is right, tested in the environment it will run in, and complete. You have led software delivery teams before and you have made them better. 

You will lead a small, growing team, starting with a Salesforce Release Engineer, a Salesforce Platform Administrator, and two Developers. You partner with the Salesforce Product Manager, who owns scope, priorities, technical direction, and all commitments to the business. You are accountable for the work delivery and quality. The team's roadmap includes integrating Salesforce with AI agents hosted on AWS, and you will lead delivery across both platforms. 

This is a hands-on leadership role. You build a team that produces work that is right the first time, and you delegate to it as it gets there. Where the team is not there yet, you step in yourself: reviewing, fixing, coaching, and guiding the team on what "done-right" looks like. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality of Delivery

Build the practices that make quality the team's habit rather than your inspection: a definition of done the team owns, peer review before anything is called complete, validation in the target environment as a standard step, fault paths proven rather than assumed. Review directly where the team is still developing that discipline, and step back as it takes hold. Track quality outcomes and make them visible. 

Team Leadership and Development

Lead, coach, and develop the team. Set clear expectations, give direct and timely feedback, and hold regular one-on-ones. Teach end-to-end ownership: owning the outcome, not the task. Own onboarding for new team members and their ramp to independent, reliable delivery. Manage performance, development plans, and the local HR relationship. Develop people to the point where they own outcomes without oversight and give them the room to. 

Delivery Execution

Run the team's delivery cadence: capacity, sprint execution, blockers, and the handoffs between development, testing and release. Keep the Product Manager informed of risks early, with options. Coordinate with Architects, Business Analysts, Developers, the Release Engineer, and QA Engineers so that stories move through the pipeline without waiting on each other. Protect the team's focus. 

Standards and Process

Own the team's working standards and the documents that encode them: definition of done, testing expectations, coding and configuration conventions, and runbooks. Keep them current and true. When a standard is causing problems, fix the standard. When a document has drifted from reality, correct it before it causes damage. 

Cross-Team Collaboration

Work across time zones with the U. S. -based Product Manager, business stakeholders, delivery partners, and the platform vendor. Represent the team's status, risks, and needs clearly and without spin. Be the local point of contact for Hub leadership on matters concerning the Salesforce team. 

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field
 - 14+ years in software delivery, with at least 3 years leading technical delivery teams and a demonstrable record of improving a team's quality of output
 - Experience leading delivery teams across Salesforce and at least one major cloud platform, AWS preferred
 - Professional knowledge of the Salesforce platform and delivery on top of it: how it is configured, how it is built, how it is deployed, and where it commonly breaks
 - Ability to review technical Salesforce work and give specific, actionable feedback
 - People management experience: performance, development, feedback, and onboarding
 - Exceptional spoken and written English communication skills

Behavioral Competencies

- Ability to champion a collaborative environment by empowering team members, demonstrating resilience, being inclusive, and building a culture of trust. 
 - Ability to build and sustain robust networks across internal and external stakeholders. 
 - Being a coach/mentor/advisor to drive continuous team development and growth. 
 - Use systemic thinking to drive business results and strategic decisions that enhance organizational outcomes. 
 - Ability to advocate for customer-focused innovations, model empathy in decision-making, inspiring others to approach problems from the customer's perspective and decisions that reflect an uncompromising commitment to customer safety, fostering trust and loyalty. 

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

- Experience leading projects that integrate Salesforce with AI agents hosted on AWS, such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
 - Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator (formerly Salesforce Certified Administrator)
 - Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator II (formerly Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator)
 - Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder
 - Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I / II
 - AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate or Professional
 - AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional
 - AWS Certified Generative AI Developer Professional
 - AWS Certified AI Practitioner
 - AWS Agentic AI Demonstrated Microcredential

Protect the future of freight logistics by building the technology that keeps Amazon's middle-mile network trusted, and reliable. You'll lead an engineering team that safeguards thousands of carrier relationships across Amazon's transportation network - turning complex operational signals into high-confidence insights that protect Amazon, legitimate carriers, and drivers at scale. Leveraging advanced machine learning, computer vision, and Gen AI, your team builds intelligent systems that strengthen the integrity and safety of the carrier network. 

Your day will be a dynamic blend of strategic planning, cross-functional collaboration, and technological innovation. You'll work closely with engineering teams to design and implement intelligent detection and decisioning systems, real-time alerting, and Gen AI-powered tooling that accelerates how our teams work. Expect to dive into data-driven decision-making, prototype AI-powered tools to boost both operational and developer productivity, and ship products that directly improve the accuracy, speed, and reliability of our systems. You'll balance operational excellence - maintaining high availability for mission-critical services, with forward-thinking innovation that shapes how Amazon secures and strengthens its carrier network across the globe. 

We are a passionate group of technologists and problem-solvers dedicated to reinventing trust and safety technology for freight. Our team sits at the intersection of technology, security, and operational excellence, working to build intelligent systems that protect carriers, drivers, and Amazon's logistics network. We embrace collaborative innovation, leverage Gen-AI capabilities to accelerate development, and are committed to solutions that make a tangible difference in protecting the integrity of the carrier marketplace. From real-time machine learning models to intelligent decisioning systems, we're building the technology backbone that keeps Amazon's middle-mile trustworthy. 

Key job responsibilities

Work closely with software developers and managers to architect and develop the best technical designs, architectures and implementations. 

Develop monthly, quarterly and yearly strategy and roadmaps for the team based on project priorities and project benefit. 

Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to a variety of audiences. 

Work with Product and Program Managers to develop and evolve the vision and strategy for the team. 

Use Agile principles to run the development lifecycle for team's applications and services. 

Manage, execute and communicate project plans and delivery commitments. 

Staff, mentor, enhance and maintain a best-of-class software development teams. 

Basic Qualifications

- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 7+ years of engineering experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.description:
We're looking for a Director, AI Engineering This role is Office Based, Hyderabad Office

Director, AI Engineering - India

Cornerstone OnDemand is looking for a Director of AI Engineering who will lead and scale multiple teams of software and AI engineers to deliver high-quality, scalable, and reliable software solutions. You will be responsible for setting technical vision, driving engineering excellence, and ensuring successful delivery of strategic initiatives aligned with business objectives. This role combines organizational leadership, technical strategy, and people leadership to build and sustain a high-performing engineering organization. 

In this role, you will. . . 

Engineering Leadership & Delivery

- Lead and oversee multiple engineering teams across the full software development lifecycle - from requirements and architecture through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations. 
 - Define and drive technical vision and architecture strategy, ensuring systems are scalable, resilient, and aligned with long-term organizational goals. 
 - Own end-to-end delivery across portfolios/programs, ensuring alignment with business priorities, timelines, and quality expectations. 
 - Establish and standardize engineering best practices across teams, including design reviews, code quality standards, testing strategies, and CI/CD adoption. 
 - Drive consistency and excellence in software development processes, system reliability, and engineering productivity. 
 - Partner closely with Product, UX, QA, and other stakeholders to ensure effective planning, prioritization, and execution of roadmaps. 
 - Oversee proactive management of technical debt, system performance, and operational reliability at scale. 
 - Ensure effective incident management frameworks, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement for system uptime and performance. 

People Leadership & Organizational Development

- Lead, mentor, and grow engineering managers and senior technical leaders, building a scalable organizational structure. 
 - Drive hiring strategy to attract and retain top engineering talent across levels. 
 - Establish clear career frameworks, succession planning, and leadership development initiatives. 
 - Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, inclusion, and continuous learning across the organization. 
 - Provide ongoing coaching, performance management, and feedback to leaders and their teams. 
 - Oversee resource planning, organizational design, and capacity management to align with strategic priorities. 

Strategy & Cross-Functional Leadership

- Partner with executive leadership to define and execute long-term technology and engineering strategy. 
 - Drive engineering roadmaps aligned with product vision and business objectives. 
 - Provide regular executive-level updates, including progress, risks, and investment trade-offs. 
 - Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies, tools, and platforms to enhance innovation and efficiency. 
 - Lead organizational improvements across Agile practices, delivery frameworks, and operational processes. 
 - Collaborate with DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Data teams to ensure operational excellence, scalability, and compliance. 
 - Represent engineering in executive forums, cross-functional planning, and architectural governance discussions. 

Requirements

You've Got What It Takes If You Have. . . 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 15+ years of software engineering experience, with 5+ years in engineering leadership roles managing managers or multiple teams. 
 - Proven track record of leading large-scale, complex software programs and distributed engineering organizations. 

Technical Expertise

- Strong background in software engineering, system design, and distributed systems architecture. 
 - Hands-on experience in technologies such as Java, C#, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Go (prior coding experience expected, even if not day-to-day). 
 - Deep expertise in cloud platforms, microservices architecture, and API design patterns. 
 - Strong knowledge of data systems (SQL/NoSQL), caching, and large-scale data architecture. 
 - Experience with CI/CD, DevOps practices, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code. 
 - Solid understanding of security, scalability, performance engineering, and reliability best practices. 

Leadership & Soft Skills

- Exceptional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence at all levels, including executive stakeholders. 
 - Strong strategic thinking and decision-making capabilities with a focus on business impact and outcomes. 
 - Demonstrated success in building and leading high-performing, geographically distributed teams. 
 - Ability to manage complex priorities, ambiguity, and large-scale organizational challenges. 
 - Strong collaboration skills with the ability to align cross-functional teams toward common goals. 
 - High sense of ownership, accountability, and commitment to delivery excellence. 

Nice to Have

- Experience in SaaS or enterprise product organizations at scale. 
 - Exposure to AI/ML platforms and integrating AI capabilities into products. 
 - Experience leading platform modernization, cloud transformation, or large-scale migrations. 
 - Familiarity with talent management, HR tech, or learning management systems. 

Our Culture

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now - is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone - anywhere - to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today. 

Who We Are

Cornerstone powers the potential of organizations and their people to thrive in a changing world. Cornerstone Galaxy, the complete AI-powered workforce agility platform, meets organizations where they are. With Galaxy, organizations can identify skills gaps and development opportunities, retain and engage top talent, and provide multimodal learning experiences to meet the diverse needs of the modern workforce. More than 7, 000 organizations and 100 million+ users in 180+ countries and in nearly 50 languages use Cornerstone Galaxy to build high-performing, future-ready organizations and people today.

data.title: Senior Python Engineer - Data ( Remote, Full-Time) [AS340]
data.description:
About Smart Working

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn't just another remote opportunity - it's about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you're welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being. 

Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you're empowered to grow personally and professionally. 

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world. 

About the Role

As a Senior Python Engineer (Backend / Data), you will join an existing engineering team to strengthen backend development and data engineering capabilities. This is a long-term, ongoing opportunity (subject to confirmation), focused on building and maintaining reliable production systems. 

You will work closely with the engineering team and an existing DevOps/SRE engineer on infrastructure, deployments and releases. The role requires independent ownership of assigned work, collaboration across engineering functions and an understanding of how data pipelines support the wider product. 

You will contribute to engineering decisions, maintain high standards of data quality, correctness and testing, and propose solutions rather than simply execute assigned tasks. Reliability and thoroughness in production are key priorities. 

Responsibilities

- 
Design, build and maintain reliable data pipelines in Python on AWS. 

- 
Build and maintain backend services and APIs using Django and FastAPI. 

- 
Model, query and optimise data across PostgreSQL and search/NoSQL databases, including OpenSearch, Elasticsearch and DynamoDB. 

- 
Deploy and run services on Kubernetes, working alongside the DevOps engineer. 

- 
Take end-to-end ownership of assigned work, including design, testing, code reviews, releases and production support. 

- 
Work independently on assigned tasks while collaborating closely with the engineering team and DevOps/SRE engineer on infrastructure and releases. 

- 
Maintain high standards of data quality, correctness and testing while understanding how data pipelines contribute to the wider product. 

- 
Follow established engineering practices, including code reviews and CI/CD, while adapting to changing priorities. 

- 
Proactively identify problems, propose solutions and challenge technical decisions when necessary rather than simply executing tickets. 

- 
Prioritise thoroughness, reliability and production stability when developing and maintaining data pipelines and data stores. 

Requirements

- 
6+ years of experience in software engineering, including 5+ years of commercial Python development. 

- 
5+ years of Python backend development experience, with strong hands-on engineering capabilities. 

- 
3+ years of experience in data pipelines and data engineering, including ETL/ELT processes and batch processing. Relevant technologies include Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, AWS Glue and Step Functions. 

- 
3+ years of AWS experience, with practical experience developing and maintaining cloud-based backend services and data pipelines. Strong GCP or Azure experience may be considered on a case-by-case basis. 

- 
3+ years of experience with Python web frameworks, particularly Django or FastAPI. Flask is an acceptable alternative. 

- 
3+ years of PostgreSQL experience, including data modelling, querying and optimisation. MySQL or SQL Server experience may be considered where strong SQL expertise is demonstrated elsewhere. 

- 
2+ years of experience with non-relational or search databases, such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch or DynamoDB. Relevant alternatives include MongoDB, Redis and Cassandra. 

- 
2+ years of Kubernetes experience, including deploying and running services. Docker combined with ECS or EKS exposure may be considered as an alternative. 

- 
Ability to independently own technical tasks from design through implementation, testing, release and production support. 

- 
Strong attention to data quality, correctness, testing and production reliability. 

- 
Ability to collaborate with engineering and infrastructure teams while independently proposing solutions and challenging decisions where appropriate. 

- 
Ability to follow engineering practices and adapt to changing priorities. 

Nice to Have

- 
1+ year of experience with workflow orchestration, using Airflow or similar technologies. Alternatives include Celery and cron-based schedulers. 

- 
1+ year of experience with streaming or event-processing technologies, such as Kafka, Kinesis or SQS. RabbitMQ is an acceptable alternative. 

- 
1+ year of experience with Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD, including Terraform and GitHub Actions. Alternatives include Pulumi and GitLab CI. 

- 
Previous experience leading a technical project or taking complete end-to-end ownership of a data pipeline or backend service

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
 - 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

data.title: AI Technical Expert
data.description:
Job Title

AI Technical Expert

Job Description

Role Summary: 

We are looking for a senior technology professional with 15+ years of experience in software engineering, architecture, and enterprise technology, with strong experience across data engineering, machine learning, and AI/Generative AI. 

The candidate will be responsible for applying AI to solve meaningful enterprise problems and realize measurable business and engineering value, while architecting and delivering scalable AI-enabled solutions and reusable AI capabilities. 

The role requires strong software and data engineering foundations, AI/ML expertise, system architecture, hands-on development, and technical leadership. 

Key Responsibilities

- Identify and realize high-value enterprise opportunities through AI, with measurable business and engineering impact. 
 - Architect and develop AI/ML and Generative AI solutions for enterprise use cases. 
 - Build reliable data pipelines, data platforms and data processing capabilities that support AI/ML solutions. 
 - Apply ML techniques to develop, train, evaluate and deploy machine learning solutions. 
 - Design and develop LLM-based applications, including RAG, agents, tool use, and AI-assisted workflows. 
 - Integrate AI solutions with existing enterprise platforms, APIs, data sources, and engineering tools. 
 - Establish practices for AI architecture, evaluation, security, observability, and governance. 
 - Lead POCs from hypothesis through productionisation, with measurable outcomes. 
 - Mentor engineers and establish engineering best practices. 

Experience & Skills

- 15+ years of software engineering / architecture / technology experience. 
 - Strong programming skills, particularly Python, and solid software architecture fundamentals. 
 - Experience designing data pipelines, data processing workflows, data platforms, and data quality practices. 
 - Practical experience with ML model development lifecycle including data processing, ML model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. 
 - Strong understanding of AI/ML techniques and modern GenAI approaches, including but not limited to LLMs, prompting, context engineering and inference. 
 - Practical experience with LLMs, RAG, AI agents, embeddings, and vector databases. 
 - Experience with modern AI application frameworks and orchestration technologies such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel or equivalent. 
 - Experience taking AI/ML solutions from PoC to production in enterprise environments. 
 - Understanding of AI security, evaluation, observability, and governance. 

Experience applying AI across the software development lifecycle (SDLC), DevOps and developer productivity is highly desirable.
