data.title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
data.location: Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar, Punjab, India
data.description:
Everything we do is for our customers!

Featured on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 list and G2's leaderboard, Maropost offers a unified commerce experience that our customers need, transforming ecommerce, retail, marketing automation, merchandising, helpdesk and AI operations with one platform designed to scale for fast-growing businesses. With a relentless focus on our customers' success, we are motivated by customer obsession, extreme urgency, excellence and resourcefulness to to power 5, 000+ global brands while we head to 100, 000+. 

Driven by the same customer-centric mentality as above, we empower businesses to achieve their goals and grow alongside us. If you're a driver and not passenger and are ready to make a significant impact and be part of our transformative journey, Maropost is the place for you. 

The Opportunity

Thrive on change and grow beyond limits! We are looking for a bold thinker who sees a chance to learn and define what's possible with every challenge! Ready to make an impact? Welcome to Maropost and you can turn ideas into action!

We are seeking an experienced Sr. DevOps Engineer to join our growing team responsible for building, scaling, and maintaining the core infrastructure of our SaaS product on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will architect and implement robust, secure, and scalable systems using Kubernetes for orchestration and terraform for infrastructure-as-code. 

What You'll Be Responsible For

- Design, implement, and optimize cloud-native infrastructure on GCP to support our SaaS product. 
 - Lead the deployment and management of Kubernetes clusters, ensuring high availability and security. 
 - Develop and maintain Terraform scripts for automated provisioning of cloud resources and environments. 
 - Collaborate with development and product teams to deliver scalable and reliable solutions. 
 - Establish CI/CD pipelines and automate infrastructure deployment and application delivery workflows. 
 - Set up and monitor observability solutions (logging, monitoring, alerting) to ensure operational excellence. 
 - Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, contributing to continuous platform optimization. 
 - Drive adoption of DevOps practices and mentor junior engineers in Kubernetes, GCP, and Terraform best practices. 
 - Participate in on-call rotations and support incident response as a senior technical resource in 24/7 rotational environment. 

What You'll Bring To Maropost

- 6+ years of experience in DevOps, with a focus on cloud-native SaaS environments. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise with GCP services (Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud SQL, IAM, etc. ). 
 - Advanced skills in Kubernetes cluster management, workload orchestration, and troubleshooting. 
 - Deep proficiency in Terraform and infrastructure-as-code concepts for cloud automation. 
 - Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Bitbucket, Build kite, Argo CD , or similar). 
 - Proficient in scripting/programming (Python, Go, or Bash). 
 - Solid understanding of networking, security, and compliance in cloud environments. 
 - Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Stack driver, etc. ). 
 - Excellent problem-solving, communication, and team collaboration skills. 
 - Exposure to service mesh (Istio, Linkerd), cloud cost optimization, or FinOps. 
 - Experience with other public clouds (AWS, Azure). 
 - Certifications in GCP, Kubernetes, or Terraform. 
 - You exemplify Maropost's Values: 
 - Customer Obsessed 
 - Extreme Urgency 
 - Excellence 
 - Resourceful
Message from the Founders: Maropost is looking for builders - people who want to drive our business forward at all costs in order to achieve the goals we have both short and long term for the results and outcomes that that will bring to us all. 

If that isn't for you that's ok, for those of you that it is please get in touch with us!

data.title: Senior Engineer Software [T500-30055]
data.description:
About Albertsons Companies Inc. (ACI): 

As a leading food and drug retailer in the United States, Albertsons Companies, Inc. operates over 2, 200 stores across 35 states and the District of Columbia. Our well-known banners across the United States, including Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, Jewel-Osco and others, serve more than 36 million U. S customers each week. 

We build and shape technology solutions that solve customers' problems every day, making things easier for them when they shop with us online or in a store. We have made bold, strategic moves to migrate and modernize our core foundational capabilities, positioning ourselves as the first fully cloud-based grocery tech company in the industry. 

Our success is built on a one-team approach, driven by the desire to understand and enhance the customer experience. By constantly pushing the boundaries of retail, we are transforming shopping into an experience that is easy, efficient, fun and engaging. 

About Albertsons India Capability Center: 

At Albertsons India Capability Center, we're not just pushing the boundaries of technology and retail innovation, we're cultivating a space where ideas flourish and careers thrive. Our workplace in India is a vital extension of the Albertsons Companies Inc. workforce and important to the next phase in the company's technology journey to support millions of customers' lives every day. 

At the Albertsons India Capability Center, we are raising the bar to grow across Technology & Engineering, AI, Digital and other company functions, and transform a 165-year-old American retailer. At Albertsons India Capability Center, associates collaborate directly with international teams, enhancing decision-making processes and organizational agility through exciting and pivotal projects. Your work will make history and help millions of lives each day come together around the joys of food and inspire their well-being. 

We are excited to announce an opening for Senior Engineer Software at ACI. 

Please find below the details of the role and its responsibilities. 

Position Title : Sr Engineer Software

Function: 

Roles & responsibilities: 

- Hands on code writing and doing code reviews
 - Evaluates complex user requests, projects, and clarifies objectives and functional requirements for new or modified computer programs
 - Designs/develops software solutions and business process solutions based on business needs and requirements using specialized domain knowledge and developed business expertise
 - Improves/sustains embedded system software using specialized domain knowledge and developed business expertise
 - Conducts and prepares feasibility studies for new applications and/or existing ones and makes decisions within general parameters under little supervisions
 - Demonstrates standards to deliver high-quality products and services; models adherence to quality standards for more junior employees
 - Focus on quality in all aspects of work; Follows established standards of excellence and also continues to strive on improving them. 
 - Participates in the hiring process (by submitting referrals, meeting candidates, attending recruiting events, presenting externally, writing blogs)
 - Contributes to team activities and collaborates within all teams within/across domains to solve problems. 
 - Has deeper understanding of quality standards and guides others. 

Experience Required: 

- 5-7 years of experience as a Full Stack Developer in Java, Web, and Mobile development technologies
 - 6+ years of programming experience in OOAD, Java EE, Web Technologies, and REST APIs
 - Specialized knowledge of application servers such as Tomcat, Apache Jetty, Reactor Netty
 - Specialized knowledge of database technologies including relational databases (Oracle, Azure SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra), with experience in mobile data synchronization and offline storage
 - Specialized knowledge in UI/Web 2. 0 Development (JavaScript, CSS, SCSS, HTML5, AJAX, jQuery, NodeJS, ReactJS, AngularJS), including responsive and mobile-first design principles
 - Hands-on experience with mobile application development using frameworks such as React Native, Flutter, or native Android/iOS SDKs
 - Strong expertise in design patterns, with a solid foundation in building scalable and maintainable applications across web and mobile platforms
 - Minimum 2+ years of experience with cloud platform services and application development using Microsoft Azure, GCP, or AWS
 - Familiarity with GitHub Copilot or similar AI-assisted development tools
 - Specialized knowledge of the full software development lifecycle
 - Specialized knowledge of automated unit testing with tools like JUnit/TestNG and test automation frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cucumber, Rest-Assured, Karate; plus mobile testing tools like Appium or Espresso
 - Specialized knowledge of software development methodologies (Agile)
 - Ability to understand client/stakeholder expectations and recognize and escalate issues that may affect delivery
 - Specialized knowledge in CI/CD processes using Jenkins or GitHub Actions
 - Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and/or Kubernetes is a strong plus. 

Competencies: 

- Compassionate and kind, showing courtesy, dignity, and respect. They show sincere interest and empathy for all others. 
 - Show integrity in what is done and how it is done - without sacrificing personal/business ethics. 
 - Embrace an inclusion-focused mindset, seeking input from others on their work and encouraging the open expression of diverse ideas and opinions
 - Team-oriented, positively contributing to team morale and willing to help. 
 - Learning-Focused, finding ways to improvise in their field and use positive constructive feedback to grow personally and professionally
 - Think strategically and proactively anticipate future problems, needs or changes in the work
 - Retail Domain Experience is required

data.description:
Location: India

Reports To: Director of Engineering - Enterprise Software & Analytics Services (Agile Value Stream Leader)

Position Summary

Qualitrol is building an AI-Native Product Engineering team focused on enterprise analytics services for critical electrical infrastructure. The Product Architect provides technical leadership across multiple product squads, defining architecture while remaining hands-on in specification, software design, implementation, code review, mentoring, and production support. The role guides the evolution of a common enterprise analytics platform deployed from a single code base across cloud-native and customer-managed on-premises environments. 

AI-Native Product Engineering

Our engineers begin with precise specifications rather than source code. Using a Specification-Driven Agentic Software Development Lifecycle, Product Engineers collaborate with AI agents to accelerate architecture, implementation, testing, documentation, and validation while retaining full accountability for engineering judgment, software quality, cybersecurity, and customer outcomes. 

Mission

Lead the architecture, design, development, and lifecycle evolution of Enterprise Analytics Services while establishing technical direction for reusable platform capabilities that serve multiple analytics domains. 

Areas of Stewardship

- Architecture and technical standards
 - Product architecture across multiple Agile squads
 - Specification-driven engineering practices
 - AI-assisted engineering workflows
 - Secure, observable, cloud-agnostic enterprise software
 - API-first and event-driven architecture
 - Technical mentoring and architectural governance
 - Production excellence, reliability, and continuous improvement

Key Responsibilities

- Define and evolve the Enterprise Analytics platform architecture. 
 - Partner with Product Owners to transform end user outcomes into executable engineering specifications. 
 - Lead architectural reviews, technical design sessions, and implementation strategy. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate production-quality software delivery while maintaining human accountability. 
 - Establish reusable architectural patterns, APIs, and shared services. 
 - Drive engineering quality through automated testing, code reviews, and engineering standards. 
 - Champion secure-by-design, observable, resilient software. 
 - Mentor Product Engineers and foster technical excellence. 
 - Collaborate closely with Quality Assurance throughout the SDLC. 
 - Support SAFe 6. 0 Agile planning, architecture runway, and continuous delivery. 

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related discipline. 
 - 12+ years building enterprise software with significant architecture leadership. 
 - Expertise in C#, . NET, C++, ASP. NET Core, Python, cloud-native development, Kubernetes, distributed systems, plugin-based architectures and API-first design. 
 - Demonstrated success designing software deployable from a common code base across public cloud and customer-managed on-premises environments. 
 - Strong knowledge of cybersecurity, observability, multi-tenancy, event-driven architecture, and enterprise software engineering. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction across multiple teams. 
 - Experience with Agile Scrum; SAFe 6. 0 preferred. 
 - Experience with specification-driven development, AI-assisted engineering workflows, or agentic SDLC practices. 

Engineering Principles

- Own products, not features. 
 - Begin with specifications, not code. 
 - AI accelerates engineering; accountability remains human. 
 - Architecture is a shared discipline, guided by clear technical leadership. 
 - Design once. Deploy anywhere. 
 - Security is a design requirement. 
 - Observability is a product capability. 
 - Optimize for customer outcomes. 

Success Measures

- Platform architecture adopted across product squads. 
 - Increased engineering productivity through AI-native engineering practices. 
 - Improved software quality, resilience, and deployment consistency. 
 - Reduced technical debt and accelerated release cadence. 
 - High-performing engineering culture built on ownership and continuous learning. 

Ralliant Corporation Overview

Ralliant, originally part of Fortive, now stands as a bold, independent public company driving innovation at the forefront of precision technology. With a global footprint and a legacy of excellence, we empower engineers to bring next-generation breakthroughs to life - faster, smarter, and more reliably. Our high-performance instruments, sensors, and subsystems fuel mission-critical advancements across industries, enabling real-world impact where it matters most. Description

Amazon Devices is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineer high-profile devices like the Kindle family of products, Fire Tablets, Fire TV, Health Wellness, Amazon Echo & Astro products. This is an exciting opportunity to join Amazon in developing its next generation SOC's for the machine learning enabled consumer products. We are looking for exceptional engineers to join the SOC development team and help develop the next generation of chips based on a revolutionary architecture. 

Work hard. Have Fun. Make History. 

The Role

At Amazon, as a Manager - Test engineer you will be instrumental in bringing New Product from first silicon testing, ramp up to be ready for Production Volume Test and improving the Product Yield at all stages of manufacturing the product working with the OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly & Test) vendors. Design, collect and Analyze Test Data during Verification and Correlation Process to meet Product Specification and Manufacturability Criteria, while working closely with Test Engineer from the OSAT. Support Test Operations to test and ship Engineering Samples and Production quantities. 

Key job responsibilities

- First silicon debug with Design and OSAT Test Engineering. 
 - Defines test program flows and methods for solid test coverage. 
 - Drive final test yield analysis and corrective actions
 - First silicon debug with Design and OSAT Test Engineering. 
 - Finalize wafer-sort and final test programs in support of production
 - Drive product to meet yield and test time/cost goals. 
 - Analyze yield at Engineering Sample phase and Characterize NPI product performances and manufacturing yield window including bench correlation to meet product requirements. 
 - Identify and implement root cause solutions to yield loss mechanisms through statistical data analysis and failure analysis techniques. 
 - Transfer product knowledge to OSAT sustaining engineer
 - Manage Test Contractor (OSAT) in early production stage

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
 - Knowledge of the semiconductor industry, processes, technologies and key suppliers
 - 10+ years or more experience in semiconductor digital design, test and/or product engineering for complex SoC's
 - Must have hands on experience & solid understanding of SOC development cycle in multiple ASIC projects
 - Hands on experience in successful new product introductions for multiple complex, high-volume SoCs in advanced process nodes
 - Strong knowledge of new product introduction from first silicon through product qualification and characterization
 - Good analytical, communication, team work, and troubleshooting and problem solving skills required
 - Managing a team of Test Engineers

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree or Ph. D. degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
 - Good knowledge and debugging skill on ATE (J750 & Advantest 93K is preferred)
 - Chip design background in circuit/physical design (timing closure, power, etc. ) or DV (correlating SW signatures to block level tests) is desirable
 - Post silicon physical debug background in speed-path/Vmin, memory arrays, clocking, or yield improvements
 - Post silicon logic debug background in exercising various DFX features, analyzing scan-dump/mem-dump, suggesting tests in both system level and in DV
 - Product engineering background and familiarity with ATE coverage, margin, binning, scan pattern generation, etc
 - Knowledge of CPU, DDR4/LPDDR4/LPDDR5, USB, eMMC, CSI/DSI & MIPI characterization is a highly desired

As a Global Quality Front-End Central Quality Assurance Remote Operation Control (GQ FECTQA ROC) Engineer at Micron Technology, Inc. , you will be part of a global organization responsible for centralized quality operations supporting Micron wafer fabrication sites across Asia and the United States. You will play a critical role in safeguarding product quality through automated quality screening, lot disposition, statistical risk assessment, and operational excellence initiatives. 

In this role, you will leverage advanced statistical analysis, semiconductor process knowledge, automation, and data-driven decision-making to identify quality and reliability risks, recommend appropriate product dispositions, and drive network-wide quality improvements. You will collaborate closely with Site QA, Product Engineering, Reliability, Manufacturing, and Global Quality teams to ensure consistent execution of quality control strategies and defect containment actions across the Micron network.

Design and Develop Quality Screening and Disposition Systems

Execute Wafer Lot Disposition and Quality Risk Assessment

 - Create dashboards, metrics, and reporting solutions to improve operational visibility and decision-making.

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

Prior experience with APL isn't required, we provide comprehensive training and a supportive environment to help you succeed. WHY SIMCORP, WHY NOW

Simcorp is growing rapidly in the market and we see increasing demand from existing and potential clients. You would be working on topics that touch different areas of Simcorp Dimension which places you in a unique position to view

 - Mentor and guide engineers through code reviews, technical planning and agile ways of working.

 - Use Git-based workflows and work effectively in a continuous integration environment. 
 - Collaborate with cross-located teams and contribute to shared ways of working across sites.

Your Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field. 
 - 5+ years of software development experience. 
 - Strong engineering fundamentals: object-oriented design, architecture patterns, clean code, and pragmatic problem solving. 
 - Solid experience in C#/. NET (Core/Framework) and building backend systems (APIs, services, integrations). 
 - Familiarity with APIs (REST/streaming patterns) and messaging concepts (e. g. , service bus patterns). 
 - Proficient understanding of code versioning tools such as Git. 
 - Experience with automated testing and CI/CD, plus strong code review habits. 
 - Acquaintance with AI tools and ML is a plus 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team. 
 - Comfortable collaborating with multiple stakeholders and communicating clearly in an international environment. 

APL READINESS

- You don't need prior APL experience. What matters is curiosity and willingness to learn. We provide training and a supportive environment to help you succeed, and SimCorp partly owns Dyalog APL, helping ensure the language remains actively maintained and relevant. 

NICE-TO-HAVE

- FinTech / regulated-industry experience. 
 - Exposure to vector-based or functional languages (helpful for ramping up in APL). 
 - Experience in a technical leadership role. 

Benefits

Benefits Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, at SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide an excellent work & life balance: flexible work hours, and a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have IP sprints where you have time you can spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company's development. There is never just only one route, we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. 

NEXT STEPS

Please click below to apply or get in touch with Aditya Gurijala, Recruitment Consultant or you may send an email to aditya. gurijala@simcorp. com to learn more about the vacancy and what SimCorp has to offer regarding salary, benefits, and perks. Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your CV in English as soon as possible. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office. 

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today's complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what's next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. 

Job Description

Job Description: 

We help some of the world's largest and most exciting companies modernize their networks that are self-driving. Through HPE networking, we're providing next-generation network access solutions for enterprise in the campus and branch domain by creating new customer experiences. Join us redefine what's next for you. 

Platform Software Engineer (Networking Systems)

Architect and build the system software behind high-performance ethernet switching networking platforms by owning design decisions end-to-end, optimizing for reliability and performance, and delivering capabilities that run at scale in real-world mission critical deployments. 

Responsibilities

What you'll do: 

- Drive system design and implementation for platform software across core networking subsystems, including: 
 - Chassis/line-card platform services, Ethernet interfaces, optics, and the underlying system infrastructure that ties hardware and software together
 - Own architecture and end-to-end delivery within JunOS or Junos Evolved - define interfaces between hardware and software and between various software components, evaluate design trade-offs, implement, and integrate across the networking software stack. 
 - Partner with system and solution test teams to set quality bars and build performance and reliability requirements, feedback to strong test strategy, and shorten debug/triage cycles. 
 - Work with support teams as the engineering owner - to perform root-cause analysis on production issues, drive fixes to closure, and continually harden the switching platform for best customer experience. 

What You Need To Bring

Education and Experience Required: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or related discipline. Master's desirable. 
 - Typically, 4-10 years' experience. 

Knowledge And Skills

- Deep experience with low-level systems domain: device drivers, board/system bring-up, and FreeBSD/Linux internals. 
 - Strong systems debugging skills - able to isolate cross-layer failures (hardware/firmware/OS), and reason about performance, concurrency, and resource bottlenecks. 
 - AI-first engineering mindset: comfortable using AI-assisted tools (e. g. , coding copilots, LLM-based assistants) to accelerate design, implementation, and debugging - while validating outputs, writing tests, and protecting sensitive data. 
 - Requirement: consistently apply AI-assisted workflows across the system design lifecycle (problem framing → tradeoffs/interfaces → implementation → test/verification → production triage) to improve speed, quality, and reliability. 
 - Habit of documenting decisions and using lightweight design artifacts (problem statements, tradeoffs, interfaces) to align quickly and iterate with the team. 
 - Solid networking fundamentals (Ethernet; familiarity with switching concepts is a plus). 
 - Strong C/C++ engineering: clean API/interface design, OO design, data structures, and comfort with low-level/system debugging tooling. 
 - Working knowledge of hardware/firmware interfaces and integration points (PCIe, SPI, I2C, FPGA/CPLD) - able to translate datasheets into robust software abstractions and implementation. 
 - Bonus: prior experience shipping system software for networking products (platforms, routers/switches, or similar).

data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Lead Software Engineer

Position Overview

The Business Experimentation and Optimization (BE&O) teams within Mastercard's Services organization are building industry-leading software that empowers business users around the world to make data-driven decisions through advanced analytics and experimentation. As we expand our product offerings and modernize our technology stack, we are reimagining how we deliver scalable, cloud-native solutions to our clients. 

We are seeking a hands-on, technically strong Lead Software Engineer to drive the architecture, design, and development of our next-generation experimentation platform. In this role, you will help define and evolve system architecture and non-functional requirements-such as scalability, performance, security, and reliability-ensuring our solutions meet the highest engineering standards. As a technical leader, you will guide cross-functional teams in building scalable services, APIs, and analytical capabilities that power our platform, leveraging technologies like Databricks and cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure. You will collaborate closely with your immediate team and partner with other development teams across programs to align on shared goals, define cross-cutting initiatives, and deliver cohesive, enterprise-grade solutions. You will also mentor engineers, work across global time zones, and champion engineering excellence through best practices in software development, observability, and continuous delivery. 

Our teams are small, agile, and empowered to choose the processes that work best for their goals. Every engineer contributes to the full development lifecycle-from ideation and design to implementation and testing-fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement. 

We are seeking passionate and talented technologists who share our vision of empowering customers to make smarter, data-driven decisions. Join us and help shape the future growth of our team. 

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is the global technology company behind the world's fastest payments processing network. We are a vehicle for commerce, a connection to financial systems for the previously excluded, and a technology innovation lab. We ensure every employee has the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and to change lives. We believe as our company grows, so should you. 

Position Responsibilities

At Mastercard Services, you will serve as a senior technical leader and hands-on engineer for BE&O's next-generation experimentation and analytics platform. As a Lead Software Engineer, you will lead through technical influence, architectural judgment, and execution excellence to help modernize our platform and deliver scalable, secure, cloud-native capabilities for global business users. 

Lead the technical design and delivery of complex, data-intensive software solutions that enable advanced analytics, experimentation, and data-driven decisioning for Mastercard clients. 

Define and drive technical strategy for modernization initiatives, including evolution of legacy systems toward scalable, cloud-native, API-driven, and service-oriented architectures. 

Lead system design across multiple levels of detail, including platform architecture, high-level design, detailed technical design, integration patterns, non-functional requirements, and implementation approach. 

Serve as a hands-on technical contributor, designing, coding, testing, debugging, and delivering production-quality software across the full engineering lifecycle. 

Build and evolve scalable services, APIs, data pipelines, and analytical capabilities using modern engineering practices, cloud platforms, and data technologies such as AWS, Azure, Databricks, Spark/PySpark, and related frameworks. 

Partner closely with product managers, engineering teams, architects, data scientists, QA, security, and operations teams to translate business and functional requirements into robust technical solutions. 

Coordinate and lead technical execution across globally distributed engineering teams, ensuring alignment across regions, time zones, dependencies, design decisions, and delivery milestones. 

Drive architecture and design reviews, code reviews, technical decision-making, and engineering tradeoff discussions to ensure solutions are secure, resilient, observable, performant, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards. 

Identify opportunities to improve platform scalability, reliability, developer productivity, operational readiness, and speed of delivery through modernization, automation, reusable patterns, and engineering best practices. 

Provide technical mentorship to junior and mid-level engineers through design guidance, code review, pairing, knowledge sharing, and modeling strong engineering judgment. 

Navigate ambiguity in complex initiatives by clarifying technical direction, decomposing large problems, identifying risks, and driving alignment across stakeholders. 

Champion a culture of engineering excellence, continuous improvement, ownership, collaboration, and high-quality delivery across the team and partner organizations. 

Ideal Candidate Qualifications

8+ years of software engineering experience delivering scalable, high-performance, and reliable software in an agile environment.

As we scale our complex, highly transactional enterprise product suites across the Healthcare (EMR/EHR) and Hospitality ERP domains, we are looking for a technical custodian to own our system architecture, champion Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and guide our Agile Release Trains (ARTs).

·  Bridge Strategy & Code: Own the technical runway at the ART level, collaborating closely with Product Management during PI Planning to balance business features with technical excellence. 

·  Automate Quality: Design and implement automated architecture testing gates and static code analysis (like ArchUnit) within our Java CI/CD pipelines to catch structural regressions early. 

·  Mentor & Review (MOST IMPORTANT): Establish standard-setting code review practices, write core reference implementations, and mentor senior developers across teams to cultivate a culture of "Built-in Quality. "

  

  What We Are Looking For: 

·  Our Core Tech Stack: Strong architectural command over Spring Boot for scalable backends and Flutter for cross-platform frontends. 

·  Microservices Mastery: Proven hands-on experience designing, deploying, and managing complex, highly resilient microservices architectures handling high data concurrency. 

·  DDD Practicality: Real-world experience defining Bounded Contexts, Aggregates, Repositories, and Domain Events within a distributed Spring Boot environment. 

·  Deep Domain Expertise: Proven track record architecting heavy, data-intensive enterprise systems (ERP, EMR, or complex financial/transactional platforms). 

·  Hands-on Leadership: You don't just draw architectural diagrams-you are comfortable diving into code reviews, setting up linting rules, and building framework foundations. 

·SAFe Framework: Strong understanding of the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), managing dependencies, and collaborating effectively across multiple agile teams on the train.

Location : Bengaluru, Hosur

NP: Immediate

Experience: 5-6 years of experience in testing laboratories / quality /

environmental testing, with exposure to lab operations and team management

Educational Qualification: Bachelor's degree in engineering is a must

quality systems (ISO/IEC 17025 preferred)

Woke Mode : 6 Days Working | 3rd Saturday Off

Language : Kannada Mandate

1. Test Activity Management: Plan, schedule, and monitor all testing activities to ensure

timely execution and optimal utilization of resources. 

2. Customer Coordination Communication: Manage test slot bookings, provide status

updates, and handle customer queries, clarifications, and escalations. 

3. Program C SRF Management: Review and approve SRFs, ensure proper sample tracking, 

and monitor execution of test programs as per requirements. 

4. Internal Coordination: Coordinate with operations, delivery, finance, and sales teams to

ensure smooth execution and alignment of test programs. 

5. Maintenance Management: Plan and oversee preventive and breakdown maintenance; 

coordinate with AMC/service teams to ensure minimal downtime. 

6. Quality Management: Implement and monitor quality objectives, ensure compliance

with standards (ISO/IEC), and maintain overall lab quality systems. 

7. Non-Conformance Handling: Identify, document, and manage non-conforming work; 

perform root cause analysis and implement CAPA. 

8. Calibration Management: Plan and ensure timely calibration of all equipment and

instruments; maintain records and traceability. 

9. Resource C Shift Management: Allocate manpower, manage shifts, and ensure

availability of skilled resources for uninterrupted operations. 

10. Test Report Management: Review, verify, and approve test reports ensuring accuracy, 

completeness, and compliance with requirements. 11. Technical Oversight: Provide guidance on test setup, execution, troubleshooting, and

ensure correct data recording and interpretation. 

12. Performance C Training: Identify training needs, evaluate team performance, and ensure

competency development. 

13. Data C Documentation Management: Ensure proper maintenance of records, logbooks, 

utilization data, and audit readiness. 

14. Safety C Compliance: Ensure adherence to safety protocols, proper handling of

equipment, and safe working conditions in the lab. 

15. Customer Satisfaction C Issue Resolution: Address customer complaints, minimize

delays, and ensure timely delivery of services. 

16. Continuous Improvement: Drive initiatives to improve efficiency, reduce downtime, and

enhance quality and productivity.

data.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner-and every person here makes that happen. You'll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. 

This Position reports to: 

Senior Engineering Manager

This role will be working as Lead Engineer and will be part of Automation Energy Business Area for Energy Industries division based in Bangalore, India. In this role you will be reporting to Engineering Manager and will be responsible for designing and executing DCS engineering activities in Service or Greenfield projects with medium to large complexity, according to standard work instructions, quality standards and safety guidelines. Delivering quality customer service to satisfy customers. 

The work model for the role is # LI - Hybrid. 

This role is contributing to the to the Energy Industries for INOPC based in Bangalore, India. 

You will be mainly accountable for: 

- Lead end-to-end execution of automation and control system projects, including design, engineering, configuration, testing, commissioning, and customer acceptance activities. 
 - Develop and review control logic, HMI applications, engineering documents, test plans, FAT/SAT procedures, and technical deliverables. 
 - Provide technical leadership to project teams, ensuring quality, adherence to standards, and timely delivery of project milestones. 
 - Coordinate with project managers, engineers, vendors, and stakeholders to manage project scope, technical requirements, risks, and issue resolution. 
 - Monitor project progress, allocate work packages, track KPIs, and drive project health through effective planning and execution. 
 - Lead technical reviews, design freeze meetings, customer discussions, and project status reviews to ensure successful project outcomes. 
 - Support installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and field service activities while ensuring compliance with safety and quality requirements. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives, mentor junior engineers, capture lessons learned, and contribute to engineering best practices and innovation. 

You will join a talented team, where you will be able to thrive. 

Qualifications for the role: 

- 8-10 years of experience in industrial automation projects covering the complete project lifecycle, from bid phase through engineering, testing, commissioning, and handover. 
 - Proven experience in process industries such as Oil & Gas, Refineries, Petrochemicals, Power & Water, or New Energy sectors (Hydrogen, Carbon Capture & Storage). 
 - Strong knowledge of control system architecture, DCS engineering, field instrumentation, industrial communication protocols, and automation standards including IEC 61508, IEC 61511, IEC 61131-3, IEC 61850, IEC 104, and IEC 101. 
 - Hands-on experience in DCS application engineering, graphics engineering, system configuration, testing, and commissioning. Experience with ABB control systems (800xA, Symphony Plus, Symphony Harmony, Advant, Infi90, Conductor NT, PPB) is highly desirable. 
 - Ability to interpret and work with engineering documents such as P&IDs, Control Narratives, SAMA diagrams, I/O Lists, Functional Design Specifications (FDS), Cause & Effect diagrams, Interlocks, and Protection philosophies. 
 - Experience working with global customers and managing technical interfaces across multicultural project teams. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with willingness to travel internationally (>30%) to support FAT, commissioning, and site activities. 
 - Bachelor's Degree (B. E. /B. Tech) in Instrumentation Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. 

More About Us
ABB a provides a comprehensive range of integrated automation, electrical and digital systems and services for customers in the process, hybrid and maritime industries. These offerings, coupled with deep domain knowledge in each end market, help to optimize productivity, energy efficiency, sustainability and safety of industrial processes and operations. 

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division's goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle. 

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. 

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www. abb. com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

 - 5+ years of experience with Virtual Network Edge (VNE), VNF/VNFaaS, SDN/NFV or virtualized network services. 

About You

Key Responsibilities

- Take end-to-end technical ownership of the Evolution Platform VNE Service, including architecture, deployment, lifecycle management, availability, performance, and continuous improvement. 
 - Define and implement platform standards, engineering practices, and operational processes. 
 - Ensure scalability, reliability, security, and resilience of the VNE environment. 
 - Troubleshoot complex platform and production issues and lead root-cause analysis and permanent remediation. 
 - Develop reusable automation frameworks, scripts, APIs, and tooling. 
 - Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for VNE services and platform components. 
 - Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, Python or equivalent. 
 - Design and implement end-to-end automation for infrastructure provisioning, application deployment, configuration, testing, monitoring, and lifecycle management. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, development, operations, security, and infrastructure teams. 
 - Evaluate new technologies and identify opportunities to improve the VNE service. 
 - Ensure high availability and reliability of the VNE service through proactive monitoring, capacity management, performance optimization, and resilience engineering. 
 - Lead incident, problem, and change management from a technical perspective. 
 - Establish automated health checks, alerting, remediation, and recovery mechanisms. 
 - Drive reduction of MTTR and operational toil through automation. 
 - Act as the technical SME and escalation point for VNE-related platform and automation challenges. 
 - Lead technical initiatives from concept through implementation and operational handover.

- Knowledge of SDN/NFV, Kubernetes networking, service mesh, or network orchestration. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Virtual Network Edge (VNE), VNF/VNFaaS, SDN and NFV concepts and technologies. 
 - Experience in deploying, configuring, operating and troubleshooting virtual network functions such as Firewall, Router, SD-WAN, Cloud Networking and SSE/SASE. 
 - Understanding of VNE lifecycle management - provisioning, configuration, modification, upgrade, patching, scaling, monitoring and decommissioning. 
 - Strong understanding of VNF service chaining and interconnection with Internet, WAN/MPLS and public/private cloud. 
 - Experience working with multi-vendor network/security functions and integrating vendor releases into a common platform. 
 - Managed multi-vendor SD-WAN/SASE/firewall environments. 
 - Experience working with multi-vendor network and security technologies, preferably including Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Versa, VeloCloud, HPE Aruba, Zscaler, Netskope, Aviatrix or equivalent. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot issues across VNE ¿ VNF ¿ virtual infrastructure ¿ network connectivity ¿ cloud/service layer. 
 - Strong knowledge of IP networking, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, NAT, routing and switching. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of BGP, OSPF, VRF, MPLS/IP-VPN, VLAN/VXLAN and IPsec. 
 - Strong understanding of VPN connectivity and network segmentation. 
 - Excellent Python scripting/programming skills. 
 - Experience with REST APIs, JSON/YAML and API-driven automation. 
 - Experience automating network configuration using Ansible/Terraform or equivalent. 
 - Strong experience implementing CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure, network services and platform components. 
 - Experience designing monitoring and observability for network and virtualized services. 
 - Strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis capabilities. 
 - Experience reducing MTTR, operational toil and manual intervention. 
 - Proven experience operating business-critical production services in a 24×7 environment. 
 - Strong knowledge of observability and service assurance using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch and equivalent platforms. 
 - Good understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, Helm and cloud-native architectures, with practical experience in containerized environments preferred.

data.title: Software engineer - Infotainment tester with Python
data.description:
Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive

We're a global, multi-disciplinary team that's putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career. 

- Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
 - Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
 - Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Infotainment Test Engineer with strong Python programming skills to join our Automotive Software Engineering team. The candidate will be responsible for validating next-generation automotive infotainment systems, designing automated test frameworks, executing functional and integration testing, and ensuring high-quality software delivery for automotive products. 

What You Will Do

- Design, develop, and execute test cases for automotive infotainment systems. 
 - Develop and maintain test automation frameworks using Python. 
 - Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Validate multimedia, connectivity, navigation, HMI, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, Android Auto, and Apple CarPlay features. 
 - Analyze software requirements and create comprehensive test plans and test strategies. 
 - Debug issues, perform root cause analysis, and work closely with development teams for resolution. 
 - Execute test campaigns on actual hardware platforms and simulators. 
 - Track, report, and manage defects using defect management tools. 
 - Participate in Agile development processes, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Generate test reports, quality metrics, and release sign-off documentation. 

What You Need To Be Successful

- 3 to 6 years of experience in Automotive Infotainment Testing. 
 - Strong programming and scripting experience in Python. 
 - Good understanding of test automation frameworks and test methodologies. 
 - Hands-on experience in validating infotainment features such as Media, Connectivity, Navigation, Bluetooth, Android Auto, Apple CarPlay, Voice, and HMI. 
 - Experience with automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, or Ethernet. 
 - Knowledge of Linux and Android-based infotainment platforms. 
 - Experience using test management and defect tracking tools such as JIRA, ALM, or Azure DevOps. 
 - Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 

Bonus Points If You Have

- Experience with Robot Framework, PyTest, or other Python-based automation frameworks. 
 - Exposure to Automotive SPICE (ASPICE) processes. 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automation integration. 
 - Experience with CANoe, CANalyzer, or Vector tools. 
 - Understanding of embedded systems and automotive software architecture. 
 - Exposure to cloud-connected vehicle services and OTA testing. 
 - Knowledge of ISO 26262 and automotive cybersecurity concepts. 

What Makes You Eligible

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, or related field. 
 - 3 to 6 years of relevant experience in Automotive Infotainment Testing. 
 - Proven experience in Python-based test automation. 
 - Strong understanding of automotive software quality processes and testing lifecycle. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional and global engineering environment. 

What We Offer

- Competitive salary and benefits package
 - Opportunities for professional growth and development
 - Collaborative and dynamic work environment
 - Access to cutting-edge technologies and tools
 - Recognition and rewards for outstanding performance through BeBrilliant
 - Work from Office environment with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite Five days a week. 

, 

You Belong Here

HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you - all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want. 

About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology

Ever since the 1920s, we've been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected. 

Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today's most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world's ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Senior Software Engineer

Job title: Senior Software Engineer

Overview: 

Join our mission-driven team building the future of digital commerce on our rapidly scaling Priceless Platform. As an engineering leader, you will leverage your expertise in leading high-visibility projects and hands-on technical knowledge to help us achieve flawless execution. We are experiencing tremendous growth as a premium B2B2C (Business to Business to Consumer) platform delivering world-class experiences to Mastercard's banking partners globally. 

Acquired after being a successful startup, we maintain our drive for innovation and velocity even as part of Mastercard. This is an opportunity to join a collaborative, cloud native engineering culture focused on reliability and scale. You will collaborate with talented engineers, guide adoption of technologies like AWS (Amazon Web Services) and ensure operational excellence as our portfolio expands exponentially. If you are an engineering leader passionate about developing people, being hands-on, and enabling business growth through technology, we want to hear from you. Together we will build on our momentum and create the future of digital commerce. 

The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead projects to enable reliability, security, and velocity on our Priceless Platform. You will help recruit top talents, grow the team and mentor them to establish SRE practices like chaos engineering, observability, and progressive rollouts. Partnering with Quality Engineers, you will write automated tests and shape them. Collaborating with platform engineers, you will guide automation of infrastructure provisioning, scaling, and more. As part of the team, you will help build frameworks to integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines across multiple languages and frameworks. With your technical expertise and leadership, you will promote a culture of site reliability, test automation, shared ownership, and transparency. An effective communicator, you will work cross-functionally to translate business needs into appropriate engineering reliability and testing solutions. As we rapidly expand our portfolio, your principles and disciplined approach will help us scale without sacrificing quality. 

This is an opportunity to join a collaborative, innovative engineering culture and make an impact by leading some of our most mission-critical initiatives. We want engineering leaders who can raise our bar for technical and cultural excellence. You will focus on the areas of test automation, CI/CD pipeline creation, and infrastructure automation. This role is based out of our Mastercard location in Pune, India. 

- Hands on implementor - in test automation, performance testing, functional automation, test data management. As well as infrastructure automation
 - Collaborate with test automation engineers, exemplifying technical expertise and fostering a culture of excellence through knowledge sharing and mentorship. 
 - Instill a culture of site reliability, shared ownership, and automation across the organization. Lead technical design reviews and code quality processes focused on reliability, security, and testability. 
 - Drive SRE practices like chaos engineering, progressive rollout, and DevOps collaboration to bolster resilience. 
 - Architect monitoring, logging, and alerting to provide end-to-end observability. 
 - Tune performance and scalability via load testing, capacity planning, and architectural improvements. 
 - Develop playbooks for incident response, disaster recovery, and post-mortem analyses. 
 - Spearhead test automation frameworks, harnesses, and CI/CD integration for comprehensive test coverage. 
 - Be a part of on-call support for critical production systems on a rotating basis. 
 - Continuously improve SRE and test automation through emerging technologies and methodologies. 
 - Manage test environments, data, and infrastructure to enable comprehensive testing. 
 - Enable velocity through agile processes, CI/CD adoption, and fast release cycles. 
 - Foster regular skill development and provide coaching to help teams reach their potential. Motivate and inspire the teams through servant leadership and collaborative culture. 

Your background and experience

- You have been working as a technical lead for 7+ years, in Test Automation, SRE or DevOps
 - Hands on experience on Playwright with typescript/Python Test Automation along with Git Actions and AWS. 
 - A track record of delivering complex technical solutions in fast-paced environments. 
 - Proven and enthusiastic Cloud/AWS Engineering technical leadership experience
 - You have a direct, hands-on background in leading high-visibility projects and collaborating closely with and contributing technical skills in high-performing engineering teams across multiple regions
 - Experience taking part in & leading code reviews, refactoring, gathering code quality metrics. 
 - Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, with strong relationship, collaborative, and organization skills. 
 - Deep, hands-in, understanding of AWS with hands-on ability in developing, deploying, and securing services, ideally in regulated environments. 
 - Experience with software development productivity metrics (e. g. , code churn, commit size, test coverage, ) and help to continuously improve code velocity, quality, and release frequency. 
 - Experience in using code and scripts to provision, configure and manage the underlying infrastructure resources including servers, networks, databases and other components. 
 - Practitioner of automation/configuration management, deployment strategies (blue/green, canary, A/B testing, feature flags), and logging and monitoring practices for high availability. 

Education: 

Bachelor or Master's Degree in Computer Science or equivalent

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that helps everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Lead/Senior SQA Analyst
data.description:
Job Description

Our Mission: 

We aim to be the leading provider of content management software and expertise, helping clients create, manage, publish, and deliver high-value content. 

About Us

Contiem, Inc. is a global provider of software and services to assist clients in creating, managing, and delivering high-value content - technical documentation, eLearning, online help, visualizations, training materials, etc. We continuously challenge the status quo and empower organizations by delivering effective content solutions and services that help clients achieve their business objectives. 

Contiem headquarters is located in Annapolis, MD, with additional locations in the US and internationally in Sutton, UK, Chennai, India, and Sydney, Australia. Our elite team of subject matter experts works closely with clients to assess, optimize, and transform their content objectives and operations. Our global team allows us to support clients in 40 countries, including many of the world's largest companies and iconic brands, from various industries such as Government, Aerospace, Publishing, Consumer Products, Healthcare, Industrial, Technology, and Financial Services. 

Position Summary

Contiem is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead/Senior SQA Analyst to join our team and support testing for our Web, Desktop, and mobile applications. As a Senior SQA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our documentation tools. Your primary responsibility will be to design, execute, and maintain testing strategies and test cases to validate the functionality and performance of our software applications. 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Quality Ownership & Technical Leadership

- Own end-to-end quality of releases through comprehensive test planning, execution, and risk assessment. 
 - Define and drive test strategies, quality standards, risk-based testing approaches, and release readiness criteria across multiple product areas. 
 - Act as a technical escalation point; mentor colleagues on test case design, automation frameworks, and QA best practices. 
 - Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to influence product quality decisions. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis, track defect metrics, and drive continuous process improvements. 
 - Participate in release retrospectives, providing actionable testing insights to improve product quality. 
 - Champion quality advocacy across teams, ensuring adherence to standards and compliance requirements. 

Test Strategy & Coverage

- Analyze requirements and user stories to identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks; design targeted test plans accordingly. 
 - Execute manual and automated tests across web, Windows desktop, mobile (iOS/Android), APIs, databases, and XML content. 
 - Validate XML against schemas/DTDs (e. g. , S1000D, DITA, custom) to ensure product compliance. 
 - Perform accessibility testing (WCAG & EAA), performance testing (JMeter), functional, regression, and exploratory testing. 
 - Ensure test coverage across integration, system, and user acceptance testing phases. 

Automation & CI/CD Excellence

- Architect and optimize scalable automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium. 
 - Implement Power Automate flows to streamline testing workflows. 
 - Integrate and maintain automation within Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation. 
 - Maintain test data management strategies to support automation and regression testing. 
 - Assist in expanding automated coverage across UI, API, workflow, and data validation layers. 
 - Develop automation approaches for XML validation, publishing verification, and content quality checks. 
 - Analyze automation effectiveness and continuously improve test coverage. 

Functional & Workflow Testing

- Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies for enterprise content management solutions. 
 - Validate complex XML based structured authoring, review, approval, and publishing workflows. 
 - Test automated workflows, including content creation, reuse, versioning, branching, localization, metadata management, and publication processes. 
 - Validate workflow orchestration across multiple integrated systems and services. 
 - Ensure content integrity throughout the content lifecycle. 

XML and Publishing Validation

- Perform validation of XML-based content processing pipelines. 
 - Verify XML structures (e. g. , DITA maps, topics, etc. ), metadata, key references, conrefs, and content reuse mechanisms. 
 - Validate XML transformations and publishing workflows. 
 - Conduct output fidelity testing by validating that rendered outputs accurately reflect source XML structure, metadata, conditional processing rules, content reuse mechanisms, and publishing business rules. 
 - Verify content accuracy across PDF, HTML, WebHelp, and other publishing formats. 
 - Troubleshoot content rendering issues and identify root causes across transformation pipelines. 

Data Layer Testing

- Test both relational and NoSQL data architectures. 
 - Validate data persistence, retrieval, indexing, and content storage processes. 
 - Perform scale and performance testing against our content databases . 
 - Develop and execute XQuery-based validation scripts to verify content integrity and business rules. 
 - Validate database indexing, search relevance, faceted search behavior, metadata retrieval, taxonomy relationships, and content discoverability across large repositories. 
 - Ensure data consistency across systems and environments. 

API and Integration Testing

- Design and execute API testing for REST, GraphML, MCP and SOAP services. 
 - Validate API and Application integrations with authoring tools, publishing engines, translation management systems, identity providers, content delivery platforms, and downstream applications. 
 - Test webhook-based integrations and event-driven workflows. 
 - Verify message processing, asynchronous workflows, and system-to-system communication. 
 - Perform end-to-end validation across integrated platforms. 
 - Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance of integration points. 

Performance and Reliability Testing

- Validate system performance under realistic content processing workloads. 
 - Test scalability of publishing pipelines and content repositories. 
 - Identify bottlenecks across application, database, and integration layers. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability and performance. 

Collaboration & Execution

- Partner closely with global developers, technical writers, product managers, and QA teams. 
 - Document results and issues in Jira with detailed repro steps, severity levels, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Support multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining sprint velocity and meeting deadlines. 
 - Contribute to cross-functional initiatives such as DevOps, release management, and quality governance. 

Experience And Skills

Mandatory Requirements & Qualifications: 

- Excellent English language (written and spoken) skills. 
 - Strong experience with enterprise XML based Component Content Management Systems (CCMS), including structured content authoring, workflow management, content reuse, localization, and publishing processes. 
 - Solid understanding of XML content architectures and structured content management. 
 - Strong understanding of XML technologies and XML-based publishing pipelines. 
 - Experience validating publishing outputs against source XML content. 
 - Hands-on experience testing XML/NoSQL database platforms, with the ability to develop and execute XQuery-based validation scripts. 
 - Experience testing modern APIs. 
 - Experience testing asynchronous, event-driven, and webhook-based workflows. 
 - Strong SQL skills and experience validating relational database systems. 
 - Expertise in Playwright (JS/TS), JMeter, Azure DevOps, and Jira. 
 - Minimum of 10 years' experience in SQA, specifically testing XML based systems. . 
 - Proven experience defining enterprise QA strategy, establishing testing standards, and driving quality initiatives across multiple teams. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence product, engineering, and architectural decisions through quality leadership. 
 - Experience mentoring QA engineers and leading quality efforts without direct supervision. 
 - Track record of improving release quality, automation maturity, and testing efficiency at an organizational level. 
 - Deep understanding of SDLC/STLC with proven Agile/Scrum experience. 
 - Strong skills in test data creation, maintenance, and management. 
 - Ability to manage multiple projects independently in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Education: MCA / Bachelor's in Engineering (Computer Science or equivalent). 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 

Preferred Skills & Qualifications

- Experience with Power Automate for workflow automation. 
 - Strong API and database testing expertise (REST, SOAP, SQL, MarkLogic, NoSQL). 
 - Accessibility testing knowledge (WCAG & EAA compliance). 
 - Proficiency with Git and version control systems. 
 - Experience working with structured content publishing ecosystems, including localization, translation management, or content delivery platforms. 
 - Exposure to cloud-based testing environments (AWS/Azure). 
 - Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes) for test execution. 
 - Knowledge of security testing fundamentals (OWASP).

data.description:
What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

DMS Change Management provides reference data management and valuation solutions for many of the world's leading and most innovative financial institutions, including regional and global banks and asset management firms. 

The Senior SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test) in the DMS Change Management Team is a strategic asset for our organization operating in this complex and demanding sector. Deep expertise in BDD-driven test automation using Gherkin and Cucumber on the C#. NET stack, combined with strong engineering discipline and leadership, is essential for ensuring the quality, reliability, and security of software applications that underpin the financial system. 

By designing robust, maintainable automation frameworks and embedding quality early in the development cycle, the Senior SDET plays a crucial role in mitigating risks associated with software releases - translating into significant cost savings by avoiding rework and potential financial losses due to production errors. 

Senior SDETs take on leadership roles within engineering and testing teams, guiding junior members, driving automation strategy and framework design, conducting code/test reviews, and mentoring others on BDD and automation best practices. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

Technical Expertise: 

- Expert-level design and implementation of BDD frameworks using Gherkin and Cucumber (SpecFlow) on the C#. NET platform. 
 - Strong hands-on programming skills in C#. NET for building and maintaining scalable, reusable test automation frameworks (Hybrid and Data-driven). 
 - Proficiency in agile methodology and workflow, Azure DevOps (pipelines, work item tracking), and Salesforce know-how. 
 - Knowledge of databases and SQL queries: ability to write queries to extract test data or verify results. 
 - Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated BDD test suites into build/release pipelines. 
 - Working knowledge of Capital Markets - financial instruments, trading platforms, regulations, and industry best practices - is a strong plus. 

Testing Activities: 

- Design and execute test plans and strategies: align testing activities with business requirements and project objectives. 
 - Author clear, business-readable Gherkin feature files and scenarios covering functionalities, user journeys, and edge cases. 
 - Build and maintain automated regression, smoke, and sanity suites; execute manual testing where needed; identify, report, and track defects. 
 - Perform performance and security testing to ensure the system meets required standards. 
 - Analyze automation results and test metrics, identify trends, and recommend improvements to optimize testing processes and framework reliability. 

Communication and Collaboration: 

- Effectively communicate with stakeholders: developers, product owners, business analysts, etc. 
 - Collaborate with the development team to resolve defects and improve code quality. 
 - Participate in code reviews and provide testing/automation feedback. 
 - Present testing results, automation coverage, and findings in clear and concise reports. 
 - Proactive, eager to learn, and driven by efficiency and accuracy. 

Additional Responsibilities: 

- Stay updated on industry trends: continuously learn and adapt to new technologies, tools, and BDD/automation best practices, including within the Capital Markets domain. 
 - Contribute to the testing community: share knowledge and expertise through presentations, internal training, or participation in industry forums. 
 - Take ownership of specific automation areas: become a subject matter expert for the BDD/Cucumber automation framework and drive its evolution. 

What We Value

Must have

- 7-8 years of experience as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) / Test Automation Engineer in Quality Assurance. 
 - Expert-level, hands-on experience with Gherkin and Cucumber (SpecFlow) for BDD test automation, including framework design and implementation. 
 - Strong programming proficiency in C#. NET; target platform for automation development is C#. NET. 
 - Solid experience with test automation frameworks (Hybrid and Data-driven) and UI/API automation tooling. 
 - Up-to-date knowledge of the latest test automation developments and BDD best practices. 
 - Strong analytical skills. 
 - Strong interpersonal skills and a self-assured approach. 
 - Excellent communication and presentation skills, including listening skills. 
 - Proactive nature and a natural drive for problem-solving. 
 - Enthusiastic, committed, and result-oriented. 

Good to have

- Capital Markets domain knowledge is a plus, preferably with buy-side firms and experience. 
 - ISTQB certification. 
 - Experience working with Reference Data Management setup and understanding of various asset classes (Equity, Derivatives, Fixed Income, etc. ) and market data feeds (Reuters, Bloomberg, MarkIT, etc. ). 
 - Experience with performance/security testing tools and practices. 

The expectations of a Senior SDET's behavioural skills are centered around an agile mindset of working in teams. Business knowledge requirements vary across product domains but are overall within the financial sector. In SimCorp, we use several coding languages and technical domains, so the concrete skills here also vary across the organization. 

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference. 
 - Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application. 
 - Self-Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work. 
 - Inclusive and diverse company culture 
 - Work-life balance - We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace
 - Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. 

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

WHO WE ARE?

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

In this role, you'll work across manual testing, system-level validation, and Hardware-Software Integration Testing (H-SIT), collaborating closely with engineering teams to investigate issues and improve product quality. You'll also have opportunities to contribute to test planning, requirements traceability, defect management, and customer-facing test reviews.

 - Manage testing activities: Track test progress, coordinate execution schedules, maintain requirements traceability, and report testing status, risks, and outcomes.
