data.title: QC In charge and Plant In charge
data.description:
WE ARE HIRING - RS READYMIX CONCRETE

Position: QC & Plant In-Charge - Ready Mix Concrete (RMC)

📍 Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu

🏢 Industry: Ready Mix Concrete (RMC)

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly experienced RMC professional with strong technical expertise in Quality Control (QC), in-depth knowledge of the Chennai RMC market, and the ability to independently manage overall batching plant operations. The candidate must ensure consistent concrete quality, efficient plant performance, timely deliveries, cost control, and customer satisfaction. 

QC expertise is the primary requirement, followed by plant management and operational leadership. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities1. Quality Control (Primary Responsibility)

- Manage and monitor all quality control activities at the RMC plant. 
 - Ensure concrete quality meets approved mix designs, project specifications, IS standards, and customer requirements. 
 - Develop, review, and implement concrete mix designs for various grades of concrete. 
 - Conduct and supervise raw material testing for cement, M-sand, P-sand, aggregates, water, and admixtures. 
 - Monitor aggregate grading, moisture content, specific gravity, water absorption, and other relevant material properties. 
 - Conduct regular slump tests, workability checks, and concrete temperature checks as required. 
 - Ensure proper sampling, casting, curing, and testing of concrete cubes. 
 - Monitor 7-day and 28-day compressive strength results and maintain test records. 
 - Analyse cube test results and take corrective action for deviations. 
 - Maintain quality consistency across different concrete grades and production batches. 
 - Control water-cement ratio and ensure accurate batching as per the approved mix design. 
 - Monitor aggregate moisture corrections and their impact on concrete quality. 
 - Identify the root cause of quality failures, rejected loads, low-strength concrete, and customer complaints. 
 - Implement corrective and preventive actions to avoid repeated quality issues. 
 - Maintain QC registers, test reports, calibration records, and material inspection reports. 
 - Coordinate with external laboratories, consultants, project engineers, and customer QC teams. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable IS standards, including IS 4926 and relevant concrete testing standards. 
 - Establish quality inspection procedures for incoming materials, production, transit, and concrete delivery. 
 - Monitor admixture dosage, setting time, segregation, bleeding, and other concrete performance issues. 
 - Ensure proper handling, storage, and preservation of cement, admixtures, and other raw materials. 
 - Conduct regular quality audits and implement continuous improvement measures. 
 - Train laboratory technicians, QC engineers, and plant personnel on quality procedures. 
 - Ensure the availability and proper maintenance of laboratory equipment and testing instruments. 2. Chennai RMC Market Knowledge

- Possess strong working knowledge of the Chennai RMC market and local construction industry. 
 - Understand the availability, quality, pricing, and supply conditions of cement, aggregates, M-sand, P-sand, and admixtures in Chennai. 
 - Maintain good coordination with local raw material suppliers, transporters, and testing laboratories. 
 - Understand customer expectations and concrete quality requirements across residential, commercial, infrastructure, and high-rise projects. 
 - Coordinate with project-site engineers and customer QC teams to resolve technical issues. 
 - Support the management team in evaluating material sources and identifying cost-effective alternatives without compromising quality. 
 - Understand local market competition, customer requirements, and operational challenges. 
 - Assist in technical discussions with clients, contractors, consultants, and project teams. 
 - Ensure timely resolution of site complaints and maintain strong customer relationships. 
 - Support management in improving product quality, service reliability, and market reputation. 3. RMC Plant Operations & Management

- Manage daily batching plant operations and ensure smooth production activities. 
 - Plan daily production based on customer orders, dispatch schedules, and plant capacity. 
 - Supervise batching operators, plant technicians, loaders, laboratory staff, and other plant personnel. 
 - Ensure accurate batching of cement, aggregates, water, and admixtures as per approved mix designs. 
 - Monitor batching plant performance, production efficiency, and equipment utilisation. 
 - Coordinate with sales, dispatch, transport, and project-site teams to ensure timely concrete supply. 
 - Monitor transit mixer availability, vehicle deployment, and delivery schedules. 
 - Minimise production delays, equipment downtime, material wastage, and rejected concrete. 
 - Ensure preventive maintenance of batching plants, conveyors, silos, mixers, compressors, and related equipment. 
 - Coordinate breakdown maintenance and ensure timely repairs. 
 - Maintain plant housekeeping, equipment cleanliness, and proper material storage. 
 - Monitor stock levels of raw materials and coordinate timely procurement. 
 - Ensure proper functioning and periodic calibration of weigh batching systems and water/admixture dosing systems. 
 - Maintain daily production reports, dispatch records, plant downtime reports, and material consumption records. 
 - Ensure optimum utilisation of manpower, machinery, materials, and plant capacity. 
 - Monitor production costs and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency. 
 - Ensure proper coordination between QC and production teams before and during concrete production. 
 - Implement standard operating procedures for plant operations and production quality. 
 - Ensure uninterrupted plant operations while maintaining quality and safety standards. 4. Manpower & Team Management

- Lead and supervise the QC and plant operations teams. 
 - Allocate daily responsibilities to QC engineers, lab technicians, batching operators, and plant staff. 
 - Monitor attendance, discipline, productivity, and work performance. 
 - Train employees on testing procedures, batching operations, quality standards, and safety practices. 
 - Coordinate with management for manpower planning and recruitment requirements. 
 - Conduct regular team reviews and ensure accountability for assigned responsibilities. 
 - Resolve day-to-day operational issues and escalate critical matters to management. 
 - Develop a team-oriented work culture focused on quality, productivity, and customer service. 5. Customer & Site Coordination

- Coordinate with customer representatives, site engineers, contractors, and consultants. 
 - Ensure concrete supplied to sites meets the approved specifications and order requirements. 
 - Attend site visits for quality inspections, concrete testing, and technical troubleshooting. 
 - Investigate customer complaints related to slump, workability, setting time, and compressive strength. 
 - Provide technical support during concrete pouring and resolve quality-related concerns. 
 - Monitor concrete rejection cases and implement preventive measures. 
 - Maintain proper communication with customers regarding technical issues and corrective actions. 
 - Support customer retention through consistent quality and reliable delivery. 6. Inventory, Cost Control & Reporting

- Monitor consumption of cement, aggregates, sand, admixtures, diesel, and other consumables. 
 - Reconcile theoretical and actual raw material consumption. 
 - Identify material wastage, abnormal consumption, stock discrepancies, and production losses. 
 - Coordinate with purchase and stores teams for timely material availability. 
 - Maintain daily production, QC, stock, rejection, and plant performance reports. 
 - Prepare periodic MIS reports for management review. 
 - Track key performance indicators such as concrete rejection percentage, cube strength performance, plant downtime, material wastage, and delivery efficiency. 
 - Support budgeting and cost-reduction initiatives without compromising concrete quality. 
 - Maintain proper documentation for audits, customer inspections, and statutory requirements. 7. Safety, Compliance & Housekeeping

- Ensure compliance with applicable RMC plant safety procedures and environmental requirements. 
 - Enforce PPE usage and safe working practices across the plant. 
 - Ensure safe operation of batching equipment, loaders, transit mixers, and material-handling systems. 
 - Monitor housekeeping, dust control, wastewater management, and proper disposal or reuse of concrete waste. 
 - Ensure safe storage and handling of cement, admixtures, diesel, and other materials. 
 - Conduct safety briefings and report incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions. 
 - Coordinate equipment inspections and maintain safety-related records. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable statutory, environmental, and operational requirements. Candidate Requirements

- Degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering. 
 - Significant hands-on experience in RMC quality control and batching plant operations. 
 - Strong knowledge of concrete mix design, material testing, cube strength analysis, and relevant IS standards. 
 - Good understanding of the Chennai RMC market, local suppliers, raw materials, and customer expectations. 
 - Proven ability to manage QC activities and independently handle plant operations. 
 - Strong leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to coordinate with customers, suppliers, production teams, and senior management. Preferred Candidate Profile: An experienced RMC professional who can independently take ownership of quality control, lead plant operations, resolve technical issues, manage teams, and deliver consistent concrete quality in the Chennai market. 

- 📩 Interested candidates may share their updated CV through direct message.

About Unified Infotech

Unified Infotech is a technology consulting and software development company delivering digital transformation, custom software, web and mobile applications, SaaS solutions, cloud services, and data-driven solutions for clients across diverse industries. With a strong focus on engineering excellence, innovation, and client success, Unified Infotech works with global businesses to build scalable, secure, and high-quality digital products. 

Role Description

Unified Infotech is looking for an experienced QA Manager / Principal Engineer - QA to lead quality engineering initiatives for mid-scale and complex applications. The role requires a strong passion for software quality, team leadership, software system design, requirements understanding, and client satisfaction. 

The ideal candidate will lead a team of Quality Analysts and QA Engineers while working closely with Product, Engineering, Business, and Client teams to ensure high-quality, reliable, and business-aligned product releases. 

The role requires a strong understanding of business requirements, SDLC and STLC, software testing methodologies, web and mobile technologies, test automation, and quality engineering practices. The candidate will also be responsible for mentoring the QA team, improving testing processes, identifying risks, and driving continuous quality improvements across projects. 

Desired Experience

- 10+ years of overall experience in software testing and quality assurance. 
 - Proven experience working closely with development teams to understand requirements, identify risks, and communicate business and technical impacts of defects. 
 - Minimum 2 years of experience managing and mentoring a QA team of at least 4-5 members. 
 - Strong creative thinking, problem-solving, planning, time-management, and organizational skills. 
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with customers, support teams, engineering teams, and management. 
 - Strong experience in identifying, assessing, and managing risks during product discovery, development, testing, and production launches. 

Job Requirements

- Collaborate with Engineering Managers, Developers, Product Managers, and other stakeholders to design and execute integration, system, regression, and release testing. 
 - Define efficient processes for test planning, test design, test preparation, execution, reporting, and release validation. 
 - Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) and STLC (Software Testing Life Cycle). 
 - Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and direction to the Quality Assurance team. 
 - Analyze business and functional requirements and translate them into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases. 
 - Ensure effective execution of both manual and automated testing across appropriate testing phases. 
 - Hands-on experience with test automation and scripting using widely adopted automation tools such as Selenium or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Define, track, and analyze QA and product quality metrics such as defect density, defect leakage, test coverage, automation coverage, and release quality, with a focus on continuous improvement. 
 - Collaborate with business development and pre-sales teams when required to provide QA expertise, support solution discussions, and ensure quality considerations are aligned with proposed solutions and delivery plans. 
 - Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases such as MySQL, Oracle, MongoDB, Cassandra, Neo4j, Redis, or equivalent technologies is an added advantage. 
 - Hands-on experience with Git and version-control practices is required. 
 - Stay updated with emerging QA methodologies, testing tools, automation frameworks, digital technologies, and industry best practices, while promoting continuous learning within the team. 
 - Strong experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, including sprint planning, refinement, daily stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, and release activities. 
 - Demonstrate a continuous-learning mindset along with a strong Can-Do / Get-It-Done attitude. 
 - Excellent time-management, multitasking, prioritization, and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities effectively. 
 - Be results-oriented, dependable, accountable, and comfortable working under pressure while managing multiple projects, stakeholders, and delivery complexities.

data.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50, 000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work-but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. 

Principal Digital Solutions Engineer

About Lilly

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50, 000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work-but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. 

Manufacturing & Quality Technical Hub, Hyderabad

Lilly's Hyderabad hub is a first-of-its-kind technical center built to lead the manufacturing and quality science agenda for Lilly's global supply network, and the work done here reaches patients in more than 110 countries. 

This hub oversees contract manufacturing of starting materials and intermediates for API manufacturing in India, managing the full scientific agenda for manufacturing and quality. We're building a cutting-edge scientific organization and looking for top talent in process engineering, chemistry, analytical and data sciences to be part of it. 

The science you develop here doesn't stay here. It moves through Lilly's global supply network and reaches patients across more than 110 countries who are counting on it. 

Digital Manufacturing Engineering (DME) is part of the Corporate Engineering Tech Center (ETC). The ETC is a technical resource for training, standards, project implementation, and the center of engineering excellence for the corporation, providing deeply technical resources to solve the most intractable technical problems in manufacturing. DME provides Digital Engineering Platform ownership, OT data integration solutions, engineering data standardization/ownership, and digital manufacturing solutions for Lilly Manufacturing. Our team focuses on connecting our facilities (securely) and leveraging the data from those facilities to deliver digital manufacturing solutions to improve manufacturing productivity, data integrity / compliance, quality, and operational excellence. Digital Manufacturing Technologies include digital twins, computational modeling, edge/IoT, and analytics solutions. Digital Engineering Platforms include CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System), GECMS (Global Engineering Content Management System) and many other digital platforms leveraged by engineers across Lilly Manufacturing. 

Position Description And Responsibilities

The Principal Digital Solutions Engineer will design, develop, support, and continuously enhance digital solutions across Lilly's global manufacturing network, while serving as the owner for one or more digital products developed by the DME team. Representative solutions in scope span the four pillars of the Engineering Digital Strategy and include - but are not limited to - the Intralogistics Monitor (ILM), Audit Trail solutions, Condition-Based Maintenance solutions, RCA and troubleshooting solutions, equipment health and predictive maintenance dashboards, capital project and qualification workflow tools, engineering knowledge search, and inspection-readiness data products. These solutions are developed on standard Digital Engineering Platforms supported by the DME team, and the engineer will partner with data leads to ensure the necessary IT, OT, and ET data is available to support each solution. The engineer is also expected to leverage AI tools and platforms - such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, and Anthropic's Claude - to accelerate development and to embed AI capability into solutions, including building agent skills, prompt-based workflows, and retrieval/automation patterns on top of existing Lilly-approved AI platforms. This role is not focused on training or developing foundation models; it is focused on applying AI tools effectively and responsibly to manufacturing problems. This is a global role, supporting functional initiatives and all Lilly Manufacturing sites globally. 

This role operates within an evolved Digital Solutions Engineering operating model. The team includes a Rapid Innovation branch that works at speed to prototype concepts and proof-of-value solutions against key business problems surfaced from the manufacturing network. The Principal Digital Solutions Engineer takes ownership of those solutions once they have been validated as worth scaling - maturing them from prototype to production-grade, hardening them for validated-system and data-integrity requirements, deploying and supporting them across sites, and providing long-term ownership over their roadmap, enhancement, and lifecycle. This split lets the Rapid Innovation branch stay focused on speed and discovery while the Principal Digital Solutions Engineer ensures that the most valuable concepts become durable, well-supported solutions that scale across the global manufacturing network. 

The primary focus of the role is twofold. First, to develop and continuously enhance high-quality digital solutions that deliver measurable value to manufacturing operations - improving productivity, data integrity and compliance, quality, and operational excellence. Second, to assume the role of owner for those solutions: defining the product roadmap, managing the backlog, owning the technical architecture and lifecycle, ensuring compliance with validated-system requirements, and providing direct technical support to global users across Lilly Manufacturing. The engineer will work under guidance of the Digital Program Lead and partner closely with site engineers, network engineering organizations, and IT/OT platform owners to ensure each solution remains fit-for-purpose as the network and the underlying technology landscape evolve. 

Key Objectives/Deliverables

- Develop and continuously enhance digital solutions in support of the Engineering Digital Strategy for Manufacturing and Quality across its four pillars: Asset Delivery & Qualification, Asset Performance/Maintenance & Reliability, Engineering Fundamentals, and Training & Knowledge Management. 
 - Build and own solutions across a broad portfolio that may include: the Intralogistics Monitor (ILM), Audit Trail solutions, Condition-Based Maintenance solutions, equipment health and predictive maintenance dashboards, RCA and troubleshooting tools, capital project and equipment qualification workflow tools, engineering knowledge search, change-management assistants, and inspection-readiness data products. 
 - Serve as owner for one or more DME-developed digital products, including ownership of the product roadmap, backlog, technical architecture, and full lifecycle from build through sustained operation. 
 - Partner with the Rapid Innovation branch of the Digital Solutions Engineering team to take in validated prototypes and proof-of-value solutions, then mature them into production-grade, validated, scalable solutions ready for global deployment. 
 - Lead the deployment of solutions across Lilly Manufacturing sites - including site onboarding, configuration, change management, training, and stand-up of ongoing support. 
 - Provide direct technical support for owned solutions across the global manufacturing network - triaging issues, performing root cause analysis, delivering fixes, and managing the change and release process to keep solutions reliable and validated. 
 - Drive continuous enhancement of solutions in production, prioritizing improvements based on user feedback, operational data, evolving site needs, and emerging technology capabilities. 
 - Leverage AI tools and platforms - such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, and Anthropic's Claude - to accelerate solution development, automate routine engineering tasks, and embed AI capability into DME solutions. This includes building agent skills, prompts, retrieval-augmented patterns, and automated workflows on top of existing Lilly-approved AI platforms; it does not include training or developing foundation models. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI tools and patterns and integrate them responsibly into DME solutions, in alignment with Lilly's AI governance, data integrity, and validated-system requirements. 
 - Write, review, and maintain production-quality Python code that powers DME digital solutions; establish and uphold development standards, code review practices, and version control discipline. 
 - Build analytics, monitoring, and visualization capabilities using Seeq and Power BI to surface manufacturing insights to engineers, operators, and leadership. 
 - Partner with data leads within DME to define and provide the IT, OT, and ET data requirements needed to support each solution, and ensure data flows are reliable, governed, and fit-for-purpose. 
 - Ensure all solutions are designed, operated, and enhanced in accordance with validated-system, data-integrity, and GMP requirements, and develop and implement the associated technical requirements and documentation. 
 - Develop proof-of-concept solutions to explore new concepts within the Engineering Digital Strategy and progress them toward production-grade deployments. 
 - Ensure solutions focus on value generation and demonstrate measurable impact on manufacturing capacity, resilience, compliance, and operational excellence. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Computer/Software Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering/science field. 
 - Minimum 3 years manufacturing experience. 
 - Demonstrated software development experience, with a strong working knowledge of Python. 
 - Knowledge of manufacturing datasets and experience accessing and using IT, OT, and ET data sources. 
 - Experience leveraging data to solve problems within a manufacturing environment. 
 - Experience working with validated systems. 
 - Experience in pharma or GMP industry. 

Additional Skills/Preferences

- Hands-on experience building solutions in Seeq (advanced analytics, asset framework, monitoring) and Power BI (data modeling, DAX, dashboards). 
 - Experience acting as an owner or product owner for a production digital solution, including roadmap, backlog, technical support, and lifecycle ownership. 
 - Demonstrated experience providing ongoing technical support and continuous enhancement of digital solutions in a production environment. 
 - Experience leveraging AI tools and platforms (e. g. , Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar) to accelerate development and to build agent skills, prompts, and automated workflows. Experience training or developing foundation models is not required. 
 - Familiarity with industrial data sources and protocols (e. g. , Aveva PI, OPC UA, MQTT, historian/SCADA systems) and with enterprise data platforms (e. g. , Databricks, SQL/relational data stores). 
 - Experience with one or more of the example solution domains: intralogistics monitoring, audit trail/data-integrity tooling, condition-based maintenance, equipment health monitoring, RCA/troubleshooting, equipment qualification, capital project workflows, or engineering knowledge management. 
 - Familiarity with modern software engineering practices: source control (Git/Azure DevOps), CI/CD, automated testing, and code review. 
 - Strong technical writing and communication skills; ability to translate between manufacturing engineers, IT/OT teams, and software developers. 
 - Ability to work well across different cultures and global manufacturing sites. 

At Lilly, caring is not only what we do for patients. It is how we work. We believe the people who dedicate themselves to making medicines better deserve an environment that makes their lives better too, one where they are supported, respected, and given the space to do their best work. Senior Observability Engineer

Location: 

Eli Lilly, Hyderabad

Position Type

Full-Time

Level

At Lilly, we believe in the talent of our workforce. One of the best ways to utilize and develop that talent is to use our existing workforce to fill new and/or open positions. If you are looking for a new position within Lilly, you can view and apply to open roles posted in the internal job posting system. You must meet the minimum qualifications outlined in the job description and have/obtain work authorization in the country the position is located in order to be considered. When applying internally for a position, your current supervisor will receive notification that you have applied to the position. We encourage employees to discuss the opportunity with their supervisor prior to applying. 

Note: Roles are posted at the lowest level of a band; however, employees should search across all levels of the band to identify all opportunities. Employees hired on banded positions (e. g. , P1-P3, R1-R2, B1-B3, etc. ) transfer at their current level, despite the level indicated on the job posting. 

Lilly is seeking a passionate and curious Senior Observability Engineer to help build and maintain monitoring solutions that improve system reliability and operational visibility. This role supports the implementation of observability tools such as Splunk Cloud, Splunk IT Service Intelligence (ITSI), and OpenTelemetry, working closely with senior engineers and cross-functional teams to deliver actionable insights. 

Key Responsibilities

Focus: Observability + ARE

This role is accountable for designing, implementing, and scaling Lilly's enterprise observability capabilities across applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and digital products. The role leverages Splunk, OpenTelemetry, automation, AI-powered operations, and Agentic Reliability Engineering (ARE) practices to improve visibility, reliability, operational efficiency, and autonomous support capabilities across the enterprise. 

The primary focus is to ensure enterprise services are observable, actionable, resilient, and increasingly autonomous through modern monitoring, telemetry, automation, and AI-enabled operational workflows. 

What You'll Do

Observability Engineering

- Engineer, administer, and enhance enterprise observability platforms including Splunk Cloud, Splunk Enterprise, Splunk ITSI, Infrastructure Monitoring, and OpenTelemetry. 
 - Design scalable collection of logs, metrics, traces, and events across cloud, infrastructure, and application domains. 
 - Develop Service Trees, KPIs, Entity Models, Glass Tables, Correlation Searches, and Service Health Dashboards. 
 - Expand observability coverage by onboarding enterprise applications, cloud services, and technology platforms. 

Agentic Reliability Engineering (ARE)

- Design AI-enabled workflows for autonomous detection, diagnosis, triage, and remediation of operational issues. 
 - Partner with operations, platform engineering, and automation teams to reduce toil and improve service reliability. 
 - Contribute to Lilly's shift from reactive operations toward autonomous and intelligent operations. 

Automation, Integration & AI Operations

- Develop REST APIs, integrations, and automation frameworks that improve observability operations. 
 - Integrate observability with ServiceNow, Event Management, Incident Management, and automation platforms. 
 - Use AI-powered tools to accelerate scripting, troubleshooting, incident analysis, diagnostics, and runbook development. 
 - Implement AIOps capabilities including alert correlation, noise reduction, anomaly detection, and intelligent incident triage. 

Operational Excellence

- Perform root-cause investigations and reliability analysis for complex operational issues. 
 - Improve monitoring standards, telemetry quality, observability adoption, and operational maturity. 
 - Partner with cloud, application, infrastructure, and support teams to improve reliability and availability. 
 - Create and maintain technical documentation, standards, and operating procedures. 

How You'll Succeed

Observability & Engineering Expertise

- Strong experience with Splunk Cloud, Splunk Enterprise, Splunk ITSI, and enterprise observability solutions. 
 - Deep understanding of logs, metrics, traces, OpenTelemetry, and telemetry architecture. 
 - Strong Python and/or Golang development skills with API integration experience. 
 - Ability to design scalable monitoring and service intelligence solutions aligned to business outcomes. 

Automation & ARE

- Experience building automation that reduces manual effort and improves operational efficiency. 
 - Understanding of ARE principles, autonomous operations, and self-healing architectures. 
 - Ability to leverage AI-assisted engineering tools with proper governance, testing, and validation. 

Collaboration & Delivery

- Ability to work across Operations, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Service Management, and Application Support. 
 - Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Ability to independently drive solution design, implementation, testing, and adoption. 

What You Should Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline. 
 - 12+ years of overall technology experience in observability and infrastructure, production support roles. 
 - 3-5 years of hands-on Splunk ITSI engineering experience. 
 - Experience with Splunk Cloud and/or Splunk Enterprise. 
 - 2-4 years of experience with observability, monitoring, or operational intelligence platforms. 
 - Strong knowledge of SPL, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, logs, metrics, traces, and distributed tracing. 
 - Experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud services. 
 - Hands-on experience using AI coding and automation assistants (such as, but not limited to, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and OpenAI Codex) to accelerate scripting, troubleshooting, and infrastructure work

ROLE SUMMARY

We are looking for a QA Engineer with 3 years of overall experience, of which at least 2 years are in software testing, to join our client engagement team. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in manual testing and has begun building automation skills. You will help ensure the quality, stability and usability of web applications by designing and executing test cases, logging clear defects, and gradually contributing to the automation suite. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

•          Analyse business requirements, user stories and functional specifications to prepare test scenarios and test cases. 

•          Execute manual test cases across functional, regression, smoke, sanity, integration and system testing cycles. 

•          Identify, log, track and retest defects using a defect management tool, with clear steps to reproduce and supporting evidence. 

•          Perform basic API testing and database validation to verify end-to-end behaviour. 

•          Develop, maintain and execute automated test scripts for stable, repeatable scenarios under guidance from senior team members. 

•          Participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, defect triage and retrospectives in an Agile environment. 

•          Prepare and share test execution reports, defect summaries and status updates with the project team and stakeholders. 

•          Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and verify fixes before release. 

•          Collaborate with developers, business analysts and product owners to clarify requirements and resolve issues quickly. 

TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES

Must-Have Skills

•          Manual Testing: Strong hands-on experience in manual testing, with a clear understanding of the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). 

•          Test Design: Ability to write detailed test scenarios, test cases and test data, and to maintain a requirements traceability matrix. 

•          Defect Management: Experience with a defect or project tracking tool such as JIRA, Azure DevOps or Bugzilla. 

•          Database Basics: Working knowledge of SQL for data validation (basic queries, joins, filters).

SOFT SKILLS

data.title: General Manager
data.description:
Job Description

Position

Deputy General Manager / General Manager - R&D

Function

Research & Development - Ion Exchange Resins, Speciality Chemicals & Advanced Polymer Products

Reporting To

Chief Technology Officer / Business Head

Location: Patancheru

1. Job Purpose

To lead and drive the organization's Research & Development function for Ion Exchange Resins, Speciality Chemicals and Advanced Polymer Products, with overall responsibility for product innovation, application development, process improvement, technology development, scale-up and successful commercialization. 

The incumbent will provide strategic and technical leadership to R&D laboratories and scientists, develop new chemical and polymer technologies, strengthen the organization's product portfolio, and accelerate innovation in alignment with business strategy and market requirements. 

The role will also be responsible for building strong technical interfaces with Production, Quality, Marketing, Sales, Application Engineering and Customers to ensure successful technology transfer, product commercialization, field validation and resolution of complex technical issues. 

2. Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

A. R&D Strategy & Innovation

- Develop and implement the R&D strategy for Ion Exchange Resins, Specialty Chemicals, Polymers and related advanced materials in line with the organization's business objectives. 
 - Identify emerging technologies, market trends, customer needs and competitive developments to build a strong pipeline of new products and applications. 
 - Lead and promote innovation initiatives involving new chemistries, polymer architectures, formulations, processes and applications. 
 - Identify and evaluate new chemical pathways, raw materials, technologies and scientific approaches for development of differentiated products. 
 - Establish a structured product development pipeline covering concept, laboratory development, validation, pilot scale-up, commercialization and post-launch improvement. 
 - Drive intellectual property generation, technical know-how and technology differentiation wherever applicable. B. Product & Process Development

- Lead the development of new and improved: 
 - Strong and weak acid ion exchange resins, Strong and weak base ion exchange resins
 - Polymeric adsorbents and porous polymers, Catalyst resins
 - Pharma-grade and specialty-grade resins, Polymer dispersants
 - Flocculants and polyelectrolytes, Antiscalants and green polymer inhibitors
 - Emulsion polymers and specialty polymers, Paper chemicals, including sizing and wet/dry strength resins
 - Defoamers and other specialty chemical products
 - Lead product formulation, customization and optimization based on customer and application requirements. 
 - Drive process improvement initiatives to improve product quality, yield, productivity, cost competitiveness and consistency. 
 - Establish appropriate laboratory and pilot-scale procedures for synthesis, modification, formulation and evaluation of new products. 
 - Lead scale-up activities from laboratory to pilot and commercial production in close coordination with Production and Process Engineering teams. 
 - Ensure that R&D projects are delivered within agreed scope, timelines, quality and cost parameters. C. Ion Exchange Resin & Application Development

- Provide technical leadership in the development and application of ion exchange and adsorbent technologies. 
 - Develop new applications for IEX resins in areas including: 
 - Water and wastewater treatment, Demineralization and deionization
 - Process separations and purification, Chromatographic applications
 - Advanced catalysis, Pharmaceutical and specialty applications
 - Recovery and purification of valuable chemicals/materials
 - Develop application solutions for specialty polymers and chemicals in: 
 - Water treatment
 - Cooling and boiler water treatment
 - Petrochemical/refinery applications, Textile, Ceramic, 
 - ETP/wastewater treatment
 - Other allied process industries, Paper and pulp

- Provide technical support for complex customer application problems and develop appropriate resin/chemical solutions. 
 - Lead field trials, customer evaluations and application validation for newly developed products. D. Competitive Benchmarking & Technology Intelligence

- Conduct systematic competitive benchmarking of products, technologies, performance characteristics and application capabilities. 
 - Evaluate competitor products through analytical, physical, chemical and application-performance testing. 
 - Identify gaps in the existing product portfolio and recommend new product development opportunities. 
 - Track advances in polymer chemistry, ion exchange technology, specialty chemicals, water treatment and related fields. 
 - Translate technology and market intelligence into actionable R&D programs. E. Raw Material & Product Evaluation

- Direct the evaluation and qualification of new raw materials and alternate raw material sources. 
 - Establish specifications and acceptance criteria for critical raw materials and finished products. 
 - Direct comprehensive product performance evaluation, stability studies and application testing. 
 - Develop appropriate analytical and performance test protocols for new products. 
 - Work closely with Quality Control/Quality Assurance to establish product specifications and analytical methods. 
 - Ensure consistency between laboratory-developed products and commercial-scale products. F. Characterization & Technical Evaluation

- Provide technical leadership in polymer synthesis and characterization. 
 - Ensure appropriate use of advanced characterization techniques for understanding structure-property-performance relationships. 
 - Guide evaluation of: 
 - Molecular characteristics, Functional groups
 - Porosity and surface properties, Particle characteristics
 - Thermal and chemical stability, Mechanical properties
 - Ion exchange capacity, Adsorption characteristics
 - Chemical resistance, Application performance
 - Establish scientific correlation between polymer structure, processing conditions and final product performance. G. Project Management & Commercialization

- Act as project leader for strategic and high-value R&D programs. 
 - Define project objectives, milestones, resources, timelines, risks and deliverables. 
 - Establish stage-gate/project review mechanisms for major development programs. 
 - Monitor project progress and proactively address technical and resource constraints. 
 - Coordinate laboratory development, pilot trials, plant trials, customer trials and commercialization. 
 - Ensure effective technology transfer from R&D to Manufacturing. 
 - Provide technical inputs for cost estimation, product positioning and commercialization decisions. 
 - Ensure proper documentation of development history, technical data, process parameters and scale-up learnings. H. Customer, Marketing & Cross-Functional Interface

- Work closely with Sales and Marketing teams to understand customer requirements and identify new product opportunities. 
 - Participate in customer meetings, technical discussions, product presentations and troubleshooting activities where required. 
 - Provide technical support for strategic customers and critical applications. 
 - Coordinate customer trials and evaluate field performance of new and existing products. 
 - Collaborate with Production, Quality, Procurement, Engineering and Commercial teams to ensure successful product commercialization. 
 - Provide technical recommendations to management for product development, product modification and technology investment decisions. I. R&D Team Leadership & Capability Development

- Lead, mentor and develop a multidisciplinary team of R&D scientists, chemists, technical specialists and junior researchers. 
 - Build a high-performance, innovation-oriented R&D culture. 
 - Define individual and team objectives, KPIs and development plans. 
 - Monitor team productivity, project delivery and technical performance. 
 - Coach scientists and chemists in experimental design, scientific problem-solving, data interpretation and technical documentation. 
 - Identify competency gaps and implement appropriate training and capability-building programs. 
 - Encourage scientific collaboration, knowledge sharing and cross-functional problem solving. 
 - Develop the next generation of technical leaders within the R&D organization. J. Technical Documentation & Knowledge Management

Ensure preparation, review and maintenance of technical documentation including: 

- Know-How Dossiers (KHDs), Product Data Sheets (PDS)
 - Product Bulletins, Safety Data Sheets (SDS/MSDS)
 - Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
 - Technical specifications, Test methods, technical reports
 - Application notes, Internal technical notes
 - Scale-up and technology-transfer documents, Customer technical reportsEnsure that R&D knowledge, experimental data, development history and process know-how are systematically documented and protected. 

K. Quality, Safety, ISO & Sustainability

- Ensure effective implementation of applicable ISO systems, quality procedures and laboratory management systems within R&D. 
 - Maintain high standards of laboratory safety, chemical handling, waste management and environmental compliance. 
 - Ensure appropriate risk assessment and safe operating practices for chemical synthesis and laboratory activities. 
 - Support organizational sustainability objectives through development of safer, greener and more resource-efficient products and processes. 
 - Promote reduction of hazardous raw materials, waste generation, energy consumption and environmental impact wherever technically feasible. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory and customer requirements. L. Intellectual Property & Technology Protection

- Identify potentially patentable innovations and support IP evaluation and protection. 
 - Develop and maintain proprietary technical know-how related to products, processes, formulations and applications. 
 - Ensure appropriate confidentiality and control of sensitive technical information. 
 - Support patent searches, technical documentation and intellectual property initiatives in coordination with the relevant functions. 

3. Key Product & Technology Domains

The incumbent should ideally possess broad expertise across one or more of the following areas: 

Ion Exchange & Adsorbent Technologies

- Strong/weak acid cation resins, Strong/weak base anion resins
 - Chelating and specialty ion exchange resins, Polymeric adsorbents
 - Porous polymers, Catalyst resins, Pharma-grade resins, Chromatographic resins
 - Specialty separation and purification mediaSpecialty Polymer & Chemical Technologies

- Polyelectrolytes, Flocculants, Polymer dispersants, Antiscalants
 - Scale/corrosion inhibitors, Emulsion polymers, Paper chemicals
 - Sizing chemicals, Wet and dry strength resins, Defoamers
 - Green polymeric additives/inhibitors, other specialty and functional polymers

4. Application Areas

Strong understanding of applications in some or preferably several of the following sectors: 

- Water and wastewater treatment, Industrial water treatment
 - Cooling and boiler water treatment, Process separation and purification
 - Petrochemical and refinery, ETP applications, Pharmaceutical and biotechnology applications
 - Paper and pulp, Textile, Ceramic, Chemical processing, Food and beverage
 - Mining and metal recovery, Chromatography and advanced purification
 - Catalysis and specialty chemical processing

5. Education & Experience

Preferred Qualification

- Ph. D. in Polymer Science, Polymer Chemistry, Materials Science, Organic Chemistry or a closely related discipline from a reputed university/institution, with a minimum of 10 years of relevant industrial R&D experience after Ph. D. OR

- M. Sc. /M. Tech. in Polymer Science, Chemistry, Materials Science or a related discipline, with a minimum of 15 years of relevant industrial R&D experience in ion exchange resins, specialty polymers, polymeric chemicals or allied specialty chemical products. Experience

- Significant experience in industrial R&D, product development and technology commercialization. 
 - Proven experience in development of ion exchange resins and/or specialty polymeric chemicals. 
 - Strong hands-on understanding of polymer synthesis, formulation, modification, characterization and performance evaluation. 
 - Demonstrated experience in leading multidisciplinary R&D teams. 
 - Experience managing a team of approximately 5-15+ R&D scientists/chemists, depending on organizational structure. 
 - Proven experience in leading multiple R&D projects from concept through commercialization. 
 - Experience in pilot-scale development, scale-up and technology transfer to manufacturing is highly desirable. 
 - Customer-facing technical/application development experience will be an advantage. 

6. Core Technical Competencies

The incumbent should demonstrate strong practical knowledge of: 

- Polymer chemistry and polymer synthesis, Functional polymer development
 - Ion exchange chemistry and resin synthesis, Surface chemistry and adsorption
 - Polymer characterization and structure-property relationships
 - Product formulation and optimization, Application development
 - Analytical and performance testing, Process optimization and scale-up
 - Technology transfer, Product benchmarking, Design of experiments and scientific data interpretation, Failure analysis and root-cause investigation
 - Technical troubleshooting, Product and process cost optimization

7. Leadership & Behavioral Competencies

The position requires a strong combination of technical depth, business orientation and people leadership. 

The incumbent should possess: 

- Strategic thinking and innovation mindset, Strong scientific and analytical thinking
 - Excellent problem-solving and decision-making capability
 - Strong project leadership and execution skills, Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities
 - Ability to convert customer/market needs into commercially viable R&D programs, Strong communication and presentation skills
 - Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills
 - Ability to influence cross-functional teams, Strong mentoring and coaching capability, High level of initiative and ownership
 - Independent and self-managing approach, 
 - Result-oriented and commercially conscious mindset
 - Ability to work under challenging timelines
 - Strong commitment to quality, safety and ethical scientific practices

8. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance may be evaluated against the following parameters: 

- Number and quality of new products successfully developed and commercialized
 - R&D project delivery against agreed timelines
 - Successful scale-up and technology transfers
 - Revenue contribution from new products/applications
 - Product cost reduction and process improvement achievements
 - Improvement in product performance and quality
 - Number and success rate of customer/field trials
 - Competitive benchmarking and product improvement initiatives
 - R&D productivity and laboratory utilization
 - Intellectual property/know-how generation
 - Successful resolution of critical technical/customer issues
 - Team capability development and retention
 - Compliance with quality, ISO, safety and sustainability requirements

9. Overall Role Expectation

The DGM / GM - R&D will be expected to function as a technical and innovation leader, rather than only as a laboratory manager. The incumbent should combine deep expertise in polymer chemistry, ion exchange technology and specialty chemicals with strong commercial understanding, customer orientation and people leadership. 

The successful candidate will be responsible for creating a robust R&D pipeline, accelerating development and commercialization of differentiated products, strengthening application capabilities, developing technical talent and establishing the organization as a technology-driven and innovation-focused player in Ion Exchange Resins, Specialty Polymers and Advanced Chemical Products. 

This version is structured to work as a senior-management JD for recruitment, internal grading, or organization approval, while keeping the technical depth expected for a DGM/GM-level R&D leader. 

Note

The above responsibilities represent the minimum requirements of the position. Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned by the Department Head or Management based on operational requirements. This document serves as a guideline and is subject to revision and modification as required by the organization

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager, MineStar
data.description:
Career Area

Engineering

Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. 

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do - but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here - we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. 

Senior Engineering Manager, MineStar

Your Work Shapes the World

Whether it is groundbreaking products, best-in-class solutions or creating a lifelong career, you can do work that matters at Caterpillar. When you join Caterpillar, you join a global team of makers, innovators and doers who turn progress and innovation into outcomes for customers and communities. 

Job Summary

Caterpillar is seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to provide product and technical leadership for MineStar development. This role leads engineering teams responsible for developing, integrating, enhancing, maintaining and supporting mining technology solutions that deliver measurable value for customers. 

The Senior Engineering Manager operates across a broader product and organisational scope than an Engineering Manager while providing direct leadership to engineering managers and supervisors in the organization. The role translates MineStar product strategy into executable engineering priorities, develops leaders and technical talent, and ensures teams deliver safe, reliable, supportable and competitive solutions. 

This leader will partner closely with product management, commercial and product support organisations, process owners, suppliers, dealers and mining customers. Success requires strong engineering judgement, disciplined program execution, customer focus, global collaboration and the ability to influence complex decisions through technical and business expertise. 

What You Will Do

- Lead a portfolio of MineStar product development, integration, enhancement, maintenance work, aligning engineering outcomes with product strategy and business priorities. 
 - Translate strategic direction into department objectives, roadmaps, resource plans, budgets and measurable delivery commitments across multiple teams or technical workstreams. 
 - Provide leadership and performance management for engineering managers, technical leaders and product development staff. Build succession strength and a high-performing leadership pipeline. 
 - Coordinate technical feasibility assessment, architecture and design optimisation, validation planning, cost and schedule management, risk assessment, mitigation and ongoing production support. 
 - Own or influence engineering investment decisions and manage the research and development budget for the assigned MineStar portfolio, balancing new capability, modernisation, quality, reliability and customer support. 
 - Establish governance and operating rhythms that provide stakeholders with clear visibility into scope, decisions, dependencies, risks, financial performance and delivery status. 
 - Guide the resolution of complex, cross-component and field issues by bringing together internal experts, suppliers, dealers and customer teams. Ensure that lessons learned improve future product and process decisions. 
 - Champion systems and software engineering discipline, technical excellence, cybersecurity, safety, quality, reliability, scalability and lifecycle support across MineStar solutions. 
 - Monitor customer needs, market dynamics, competitor movement and technology developments. Recommend product, capability and engineering responses that strengthen MineStar customer value and competitive position. 
 - Build strong partnerships across Caterpillar business units and functions and with external suppliers. Reconcile competing priorities and create shared accountability for outcomes. 
 - Represent MineStar with customers, dealers, suppliers and senior leaders, communicating complex technical and business issues clearly and serving as a trusted engineering adviser. 
 - Foster innovation, operational excellence, inclusion and continuous improvement while maintaining urgency and accountability for commitments. 

Education Requirement

- Bachelor's degree in an accredited Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering or closely related technical curriculum. 
 - An advanced technical or business degree is preferred. 

What Skills You Will Have

Planning: Tactical and Strategic

Develops integrated plans across multiple teams; converts product strategy into sequenced engineering priorities; allocates people and funding against the highest-value outcomes; and adjusts plans using data, risks and changing business conditions. 

Technical Excellence

Creates an environment that rewards technical excellence; provides recognised leadership on complex systems and software challenges; engages the appropriate subject-matter experts; and ensures decisions reflect sound architecture, engineering evidence and lifecycle considerations. 

Decision Making and Critical Thinking

Frames ambiguous problems, evaluates alternatives with multiple stakeholders, distinguishes facts from assumptions, anticipates second-order effects and makes timely decisions during high-impact or customer-critical situations. 

Product Design and Development

Leads cross-functional development from concept through production and support; strengthens development methods and governance; and balances customer value, speed, quality, cost, reliability and technical debt. 

Customer and Market Focus

Maintains a direct understanding of mining customer needs and success criteria; responds proactively to market and competitive shifts; resolves difficult customer issues; and converts field insight into prioritised product and engineering action. 

Influencing Through Expertise

Explains complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences; challenges decisions constructively with evidence; builds trust across organisational boundaries; and develops others as credible technical advisers. 

Collaborating Globally

Builds networks across functions, regions, dealers, suppliers and customers; reconciles conflicting interests; uses collective expertise to solve complex problems; and creates shared ownership for business results. 

People Leadership and Career Development

Develops managers and technical leaders, establishes business-driven development plans, identifies mission-critical capability gaps, supports targeted rotations and learning, and links talent decisions to long-term MineStar needs. 

Program, Financial and Risk Management

Manages a portfolio of commitments, budgets, dependencies and risks; establishes transparent operating mechanisms; and intervenes early when delivery, quality, cost or customer outcomes are at risk. 

Troubleshooting and Production Support

Directs the structured resolution of complex and non-recurring failures, coordinates internal and external experts, establishes mechanisms for problem tracking and organisational learning, and ensures corrective actions address root causes. 

Basic Qualifications

- Typically fifteen or more years of progressively responsible experience in engineering, software, systems or product development, including significant leadership responsibility. Equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading managers, technical leaders or multiple engineering teams delivering complex products or integrated systems. 
 - Experience managing product development scope, schedules, budgets, risks and production-support priorities. 
 - Experience working across organisational boundaries and communicating with senior leaders, customers and external partners. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, make evidence-based decisions and deliver outcomes through others. 

Top Candidates Will Also Have

- Experience with MineStar, mining technology, autonomy, fleet management, site systems or related digital products. 
 - Experience with software-intensive and systems-of-systems product development, including cloud and on-premises deployments and integration with machine or site technology. 
 - Experience implementing Gen AI development tools and practices. 
 - Knowledge of Caterpillar product development and new product introduction processes, or comparable lifecycle governance in a complex industrial environment. 
 - Experience modernising established products while maintaining compatibility, quality and customer continuity. 
 - Demonstrated success developing engineering managers and senior technical talent across global teams. 
 - Direct experience engaging mining customers, dealers, suppliers and product support organisations. 

Additional Information

- Location, relocation support and travel requirements will be confirmed for the final posting. 
 - The role is expected to include regular interaction with global teams, suppliers, dealers and mining customers.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we're looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others. 

Kong's API Management suite includes the Kong Enterprise Gateway, the Konnect SaaS platform and a variety of Managed Gateways in public clouds like AWS, Azure and GCP. This suite of products helps customers in different industries (like finance, banking, eCommerce, airlines, etc. ) manage their API platforms and operations at scale. Our customers expect secure, reliable, high scale, low latency offerings from Kong whether running on-premise or in the public cloud. 

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will develop high-performance Go runtime, CLI engines and declarative state managers. You will architect the software that thousands of engineering teams use every day to interact with Kong's runtime - including deck (Kong's state management & drift detection engine), the Kong Terraform Provider, official Go SDKs and automated spec-driven API tooling. 

What You Will Build & Own

You will balance Software Development with APIOps Architecture: 

What You'll Bring: 

- Declarative Engine
 - State & Drift Management Engines: Design and optimize algorithms in Go for state diffing, validation, and real-time drift detection across large-scale multi-tenant API topologies. 
 - Go SDK & Core Libraries: Architect and maintain enterprise-grade, high-performance Go SDKs used by Kong's internal microservices and external clients to interface with the Konnect SaaS platform. 
 - API Design & Standardization: Define clean, extensible REST API contracts across Kong's platform runtimes. 
 - Code Generation & Tooling Pipelines: Architect spec-driven tooling (OpenAPI/AsyncAPI) to dynamically generate SDKs, client libraries, and IaC definitions without manual developer toil. 
 - APIOps & IaC Ecosystem
 - Core CLI Engineering: Build modern, fast, and intuitive CLI-first developer experiences designed for both human developer workflows and high-concurrency CI/CD automation pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). 
 - Terraform & Provider Ecosystem: Build and extend high-reliability Terraform Providers to enable seamless IaC operations. 
 - Support for Next-Gen Runtimes: Bring new runtime capabilities into the declarative management ecosystem as native API primitives. 
 - 5+ years of software engineering experience designing and delivering production-grade backend systems and developer tools using Golang. 
 - API Design Mastery: Proven experience crafting intuitive, developer-friendly API schemas (REST, gRPC, OpenAPI), with a strong focus on backwards compatibility, versioning and developer experience (DX). 
 - Hands-on IaC / Platform Understanding: Production exposure to Terraform provider development, Kubernetes operators or stateful CI/CD automation pipelines. 
 - Engineering Rigor: Strong commitment to clean code, comprehensive automated testing (unit, integration, end-to-end), benchmarking and robust software architecture. 
 - Communication & Technical Leadership: Ability to articulate complex technical decisions, mentor junior engineers and collaborate across global backend and platform teams. 

Why Join Kong?

- Build for Engineers: Your work is open-source adjacent and directly impacts millions of developers and Fortune 500 enterprises around the globe. 
 - Solving Deep Technical Problems: Move beyond standard CRUD services to solve high-impact problems in declarative state sync, API governance and distributed connectivity. 
 - High-Growth Pre-IPO Startup: Scale your career alongside a market-leading company driving the future of API management and AI connectivity. 

About Kong

Kong Inc. , the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong's unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic - on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www. konghq. com.

About Us: 

Marriott International Inc. , headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland, USA, was founded in May 1927 by J. Willard Marriott and Alice S. Marriott with a modest nine-seat A&W root beer stand. Guided by the family's leadership and core principles, Marriott International today has grown into a global hospitality giant, operating approximately 10, 000 properties and over 30 leading brands in more than 140 countries and territories. 

From such humble beginnings to becoming the world's largest hotel company, Marriott International has never stopped searching for inventive ways to serve its customers, provide opportunities for its associates, and grow their business. At Marriott Tech Accelerator center (MTA), Hyderabad, India, Marriott is exploring the world we live in and all its possibilities. At Marriott Tech Accelerator, we are a team of passionate engineering minds dedicated to creating and building cutting-edge solutions that streamline operations and elevate guest experiences. 

Marriott Tech Accelerator is an ANSR entity incorporated exclusively for providing services to Marriott International. 

Role Title: Technical Process Engineering Lead, SRE

Position Summary: 

The Process Engineer is responsible to lead cross-functional initiatives within our Service Reliability Engineering (SRE) organization that support millions of Marriot customers globally. This role is responsible for driving the planning, coordination, and execution of reliability-focused programs that support the availability, performance, and scalability of critical systems and services. Process Engineer will work closely with engineering, operations, product, and security teams to ensure that SRE goals align with business priorities and are delivered effectively. 

Partners closely with Product Teams, Applications teams, Infrastructure, and the broader Applications and Infrastructure Delivery teams to develop key metrics and KPIs to improve applications stability, availability and performance. The ideal candidate will bring strong communication skills, collaborating with key stakeholders across the company to optimize cloud infrastructure and uphold the highest standards of operational excellence in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. 

Job Responsibilities: 

- Program Ownership: Drive end-to-end execution of complex SRE programs, including incident reduction initiatives, service maturity efforts, observability adoption, and disaster recovery planning. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the primary liaison between SRE, Platform, application teams, and business stakeholders to align program objectives and timelines. 
 - Operational Readiness: Support go-live planning, SRE onboarding, hyper care, incident response readiness, and process documentation for new services or platforms. 
 - Metrics & Reporting: Track KPIs and SLO compliance, prepare regular updates on program status, risks, and outcomes, and present to SRE leadership. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Identify gaps in current operational practices, drive process improvements, and implement best practices from SRE frameworks (e. g. , postmortem culture, toil reduction). 
 - Risk Management: Proactively assess technical and operational risks and ensure mitigation plans are in place. 
 - Tooling and Automation: Partner with SREs and other stakeholders to promote adoption of automation, self-healing systems, and resilience testing tools. 

Drive Applications Performance Management and Monitoring: 

- Identify Key Performance Indicators, apply monitoring, and report out on compliance. 
 - Gather information to develop reporting metrics and KPIs
 - Ensure that all applications adhere to appropriate monitoring standards based on their technology/business process
 - Determine forums and cadence to provide regular monitoring updates

Building Successful Relationships: 

- Collaborates with Enterprise Application and Architecture and Infrastructure teams to continuously improve processes and procedures. 
 - Liaises with vendors and Service Providers to select services and tools that best meet company goals

Managing Projects and Priorities: 

- Functions as a strategic senior technical expert within the department. 
 - Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish work. 
 - Champions leaders' vision for product and service delivery. 
 - Makes and executes the necessary decisions to keep moving forward toward achievement of goals. 
 - Determines priorities, schedules, plans and necessary resources to promote completion of any projects on schedule. 
 - Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc. 
 - Plans, develops, implements, and evaluates the quality of operations. 

Delivering on the Needs of Key Stakeholders: 

- Understands and meets the needs of key stakeholders. 
 - Communicates concepts in a clear and persuasive manner that is easy to understand. 
 - Demonstrates an understanding of business priorities. 
 - Supports achievement of performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc. 

Skill and Experience: 

- 6-8 years' experience in information technology process and/or technical project management including: 
 - Experience in program or project management in a technical environment, preferably with SRE, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering teams
 - Strong understanding of SRE principles, incident management, service-level objectives (SLOs/SLIs), and CI/CD
 - Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects across globally distributed teams
 - Proficiency in using Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools like Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills
 - Excellent presentation skills (require to make presentation deck for executive leadership team)
 - Deep understanding of SRE practices such as Service Level Objectives, Error Budgets, Toil Management, Observability & Monitoring, Blameless Postmortems, Incident Response Process, Capacity Planning
 - Experience working with SaaS, IaaS, and PaaS offerings
 - Ability to work with global teams located in US and India
 - 6+ years experience in a technical discipline role with experience in planning, implementing and evaluating processes, systems and/or initiatives
 - Broad technical acumen across multiple disciplines applications with a solid understanding of current technologies
 - Experience applying measurement processes/methods for assessing program outputs and outcomes or progress toward goals and objectives. 
 - Extremely high level of analytical ability with complex problems
 - Ability to work across organizational boundaries, to help lead and influence change
 - Ability to command the process across all levels to ensure customer focus; including being assertive and self-starting
 - Demonstrated leadership experience in influence and garnering alignment from external organizations
 - Ability to align change management strategies with projects
 - Skilled in conceptualizing creative solutions, documenting them, and presenting/selling them to senior management
 - Very high level of interpersonal skills to work effectively with others, motivate employees, and elicit work output in a team environment. 

Education and Certifications:
