data.title: Quality Assurance Technical Manager
data.description:
Aeliya Marine Tech sources and supplies marine, industrial automation, and electrical/electronic spares (ABB, DEIF, Ghisalba, Elfin, Gestra, and other major brands) to ship owners, marine equipment resellers, and industrial traders worldwide. This is a senior, cross-functional role with authority to audit, correct, and drive accountability across Sales, Procurement, Logistics, E-commerce, Accounts, and Warehouse - ensuring every quotation, order, and shipment is technically accurate, on time, and error-free. 

  

Key Responsibilities : 

  

- Technical: Match customer RFQs and part numbers (incl. revision/model checks) against stock; identify exact-fit or compatible alternates; resolve technical queries from clients and internal teams via email/WhatsApp. 
 - Quality: Audit product listings and quotations/PIs across portals for part number, spec, price, and condition accuracy; review Sales & Purchase email/WhatsApp threads for professionalism and TAT compliance. 
 - Logistics: Run pre-dispatch checks; track DHL/FedEx shipments; resolve delayed or customs-held shipments; manage returns, refunds, and credit-term cases (incl. PayPal Pay Later requests). 
 - Reporting & Governance: Maintain sales/performance data, vendor documentation, and shipment records; deliver regular reports to leadership. 
 - Leadership: Step in for Sales/Purchase Heads when needed; lead training sessions to close technical and process skill gaps.   

Who We're Looking For : 

  

- Experience in technical, quality, or operations roles spanning multiple functions  marine spares, industrial automation, e-commerce, or parts distribution background is a strong plus. 
 - Comfortable cross-referencing part numbers, brands, and revisions (ABB, DEIF, Ghisalba, Elfin, etc. ) to judge fit and compatibility. 
 - Sharp eye for detail doesn't let inconsistent listings or stuck shipments slide. 
 - Comfortable driving accountability across teams without formal authority over them. 

Engineering/technical background preferred but a proven track record matters more than the paper.

data.title: DGM - APS & Lean Management
data.description:
Purpose of the Role

Managing and leading a cross-functional team of engineers and production specialists to design, deploy, and sustain a world-class Production System (PS) grounded in Lean Manufacturing principles. The role is pivotal in driving cultural and operational transformation across the cell manufacturing plant by embedding lean tools, methodologies, and a continuous improvement mindset at every level of the organisation. The DGM will be responsible for developing and implementing the Agratas Production System (APS) framework, standardising work processes, eliminating waste, and enabling measurable improvements in people, safety, quality, delivery, cost, maintenance, energy and environment (PPSQDCMEE). The role requires close collaboration with production, maintenance, quality, supply chain, and HR functions, as well as engagement with external partners and benchmarking organisations. 

Key Responsibility Areas

Technical / Functional

- Agratas Production System (APS) Development & Deployment: Design, develop, and implement a comprehensive Production System framework aligned with Lean principles (LEAN MANUFACTURING -PS-derived), covering all manufacturing areas of the cell plant. 
 - Lean Transformation Leadership: Lead end-to-end lean transformation initiatives across all shop floors, including Electrode, Assembly, Formation, and End-of-Line, ensuring sustained change management and cultural adoption. 
 - Value Stream Mapping (VSM): Conduct detailed current-state and future-state VSM exercises to identify waste, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities across the manufacturing value chain. 
 - Standardised Work & Work Instruction Management: Establish, maintain, and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), standardised work documents, and operator work instructions. 
 - Kaizen & Continuous Improvement Programme: Plan, facilitate, and drive structured Kaizen events, improvement workshops, and CI projects targeting PSQDCME metrics. Track and report savings and impact. 
 - 5S & Visual Management: Design and sustain 5S systems, visual factory standards, shadow boards, andon systems, and production control boards across all production areas. 
 - Line Balancing & Flow Optimisation: Lead cycle time studies, takt time analysis, line balancing exercises, and layout optimisation to enhance throughput and reduce WIP

Knowledge Generic

IT SkillsExperience with layout design, ergonomics, and material flow optimisation in greenfield or brownfield plants is desirable

- Proficiency in MS Excel (advanced), PowerPoint, and data analysis tools such as Minitab and project management. 
 - Familiarity with digital lean tools, plant simulation software, or Industry 4. 0 platforms is an advantage. 
 - Good presentation and facilitation skills for senior stakeholder engagement and shop-floor coaching. 
 - 
 - Strong understanding of the Lean manufacturing - Production System philosophy and its application in high-volume high-speed discrete or process manufacturing. 
 - Proven experience in leading large-scale lean transformations with measurable business impact. 
 - Knowledge of statistical process control (SPC), Six Sigma methodologies (Black Belt preferred), and problem-solving tools (A3, 8D, PDCA). 
 - Understanding of battery cell manufacturing processes (Mixing, Coating, Calendaring, Slitting, Assembly, Formation) is desirable. 
 - OEE Improvement: Drive Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) improvement programmes in collaboration with maintenance and production teams; identify and eliminate losses across availability, performance, and quality. 
 - Pull System & Kanban Implementation: Design and implement pull-based material flow systems, supermarkets, and Kanban replenishment loops across internal logistics and production areas. 
 - People Development & Lean Capability Building: Develop and deliver lean training programmes for all levels of the organisation, from operator to senior management. Coach and mentor internal lean champions. 
 - Production System Governance & Lean Maturity Model Adherence: Establish LMM frameworks to assess PS maturity, compliance, and sustainability. Drive corrective action plans based on findings. 
 - Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, Launch Integration, Supply Chain, and HR to align lean initiatives with overall plant and business objectives. 
 - Benchmarking & Best Practice: Lead external benchmarking activities across automotive and adjacent industries. Adapt and integrate best practices into the Agratas Production System. 
 - Project Management: Manage multiple lean and PS projects simultaneously, ensuring on-time delivery, resource allocation, budget adherence, and stakeholder communication. 
 - KPI Monitoring & Reporting: Define, track, and report on lean KPIs including lead time, cycle time, defect rates, first-pass yield, scrap, OEE, and cost savings to senior leadership. 
 - Establish metrics: Ability to identify and drive the drill down of organisational metrics to the front-line leadership level
 - Ability to integrate concepts such as TPM with the broader Production System and lean transformation

Job Context Specific

Mandatory / Desired

- Engineering degree in Mechanical / Industrial Engineering / Manufacturing Engineering or equivalent. 
 - Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (minimum); Black Belt preferred. 
 - Formal Lean / Production System training from an automotive OEM, Tier-1 supplier, or recognised lean institute. 

Mandatory Desired

- 15 to 20 years of experience in manufacturing operations with at least 8 to 10 years in a dedicated Lean / Production System role. 
 - Demonstrated track record of implementing Production Systems in high-volume manufacturing industries such as Automotive, Battery / EV, Pharma, Electronics, FMCG, Tyre, or Aerospace. 
 - Proven experience in building and leading lean teams, coaching frontline supervisors and managers, and driving cultural change. 
 - Experience working in greenfield manufacturing set-ups or transformative lean journeys from inception is strongly preferred. 

Knowledge Specific

data.title: JUNIOR ENGINEER - QUALITY
data.description:
Sansera Engineering Limited

PRIME FUNCTION

To ensure product and process quality in line with automotive industry standards by implementing robust quality systems, driving continuous improvement, managing customer requirements, and ensuring compliance with regulatory and organizational quality benchmarks. 

Job Description / Responsibilities

- Develop, implement, and maintain Quality Management Systems (QMS) in line with IATF 16949 / ISO standards
 - Lead quality planning activities including APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plans, and MSA
 - Monitor manufacturing processes to ensure adherence to quality standards and specifications
 - Handle customer complaints, conduct root cause analysis (RCA), and implement corrective & preventive actions (CAPA)
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen methodologies
 - Conduct internal audits, process audits, and supplier audits
 - Ensure supplier quality through evaluation, development, and performance monitoring
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Production, Design, Supply Chain) for quality improvements
 - Maintain documentation and records related to quality processes and compliance
 - Train and mentor junior engineers and shop-floor personnel on quality standards and practices
 - Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and statutory requirements

AUTHORITY

- Authority to stop production in case of major quality deviations
 - Approve/reject incoming materials, in-process products, and finished goods based on quality standards
 - Recommend process changes for quality improvement
 - Initiate corrective and preventive actions across departments
 - Interface with customers and suppliers on quality-related matters

JOB SPECIFICATION / COMPETENCY

Education: 

- Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical / Automobile / Production Engineering
 - Master's degree or certification in Quality Management is an added advantage

Experience: 

- 1-3 years of experience in quality roles within the automotive manufacturing industry

Technical Skills: 

- Strong knowledge of IATF 16949, ISO 9001 standards
 - Hands-on experience with APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, MSA
 - Familiarity with core quality tools (8D, Fishbone, 5 Why, Pareto Analysis)
 - Knowledge of GD&T and engineering drawings
 - Experience with quality inspection tools and measurement systems

Behavioral Competencies: 

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Effective communication and stakeholder management
 - Leadership and team collaboration
 - Attention to detail and process orientation

PERFORMANCE MEASURES

- Reduction in customer complaints and warranty claims
 - First Pass Yield (FPY) / Right First Time (RFT) metrics
 - Internal and external audit scores
 - Supplier quality performance (PPM, rejection rates)
 - Closure rate of CAPA within defined timelines
 - Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) reduction
 - Process capability indices (Cp, Cpk) improvement
 - On-time completion of quality deliverables (PPAP, audits, etc. )

Skills

Competencies

Attention to details

Attentive Listening

Communicating Effectively

Customer Centricity

data.title: ENGINEER - QUALITY (SPECIAL PROCESS)
data.description:
Sansera Engineering Limited

PRIME FUNCTION

To support Quality Control and Assurance activities for Special Processes in accordance with Nadcap, AS9100, customer, and regulatory requirements by performing inspections, maintaining records, monitoring process controls, and assisting with audits and corrective actions under the guidance of senior quality personnel. 

Job Description / Responsibilities

- Perform incoming, in-process, and final inspections for Special Process components as per approved procedures, drawings, specifications, and control plans. 
 - Verify process parameters, inspection results, and traceability records, and promptly report deviations to the responsible senior engineer or manager. 
 - Maintain inspection reports, process logs, check sheets, calibration status records, and other quality documentation. 
 - Support preparation for Nadcap, AS9100, customer, and internal audits by compiling records and ensuring workplace readiness. 
 - Assist in recording non-conformities, segregating nonconforming product, and supporting root cause analysis and corrective action implementation. 
 - Monitor basic quality indicators such as rejection, rework, first-pass yield, and process compliance, and escalate adverse trends. 
 - Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, and other functions to resolve routine quality issues. 
 - Follow approved QMS procedures, safety requirements, work instructions, and good documentation practices. 
 - Participate in training, improvement activities, and assigned quality projects to build technical competence. 

AUTHORITY

- Authority to hold or identify nonconforming material and immediately escalate the issue to authorized quality personnel. 
 - Authority to request correction of incomplete or inaccurate inspection and process records. 
 - Authority to raise non-conformance reports and recommend corrective actions for review and approval. 
 - Authority to seek clarification when process, drawing, specification, or quality requirements are unclear. 

JOB SPECIFICATION / COMPETENCY

Qualification: 

- Diploma/B. E. /B. Tech in Mechanical, Production, Metallurgy, Industrial Engineering, or a relevant discipline

Experience: 

- 1-5 years of experience in Quality Control, Quality Assurance, manufacturing, or Special Processes; 

Technical Competencies

- Basic understanding of engineering drawings, specifications, inspection methods, and aerospace quality requirements. 
 - Awareness of SPC, RCA, FMEA, non-conformance control, and QMS practices. 
 - Basic awareness of Nadcap Special Process requirements and audit expectations. 
 - Awareness of AS9100 requirements, document control, and traceability. 

Behavioral Competencies

- Attention to detail, discipline, and willingness to learn. 
 - Basic analytical, problem-solving, and decision-support skills. 
 - Clear communication, teamwork, and timely escalation of quality concerns. 

Tools Required

- Quality Management System and document control applications
 - Basic measuring and inspection instruments relevant to the assigned process
 - SPC and basic data-analysis tools
 - FMEA, control plan, and non-conformance reporting formats
 - MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
 - Applicable Nadcap checklists and Special Process documentation

PERFORMANCE MEASURES

- Accuracy and completeness of inspection and quality records. 
 - Timely identification, containment, and escalation of non-conformities. 
 - Adherence to approved procedures, control plans, specifications, and safety requirements. 
 - Support provided for audit readiness and closure of assigned actions. 
 - Contribution to reduction of defects, rework, and documentation errors. 
 - Completion of assigned training and demonstrated improvement in technical competency. 
 - Timely completion of assigned inspections, reports, and improvement activities. 

Skills

Competencies

Adapting to Change

Attentive Listening

Collaboration and Team building

Communicating Effectively

Delivering High Quality Work

data.title: General Manager - Real Estate
data.description:
About the job

General Manager (GM) - Engineering

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Real Estate Development

Company Overview: 

Welcome to Venus Group of Companies-where passion meets excellence in the dynamic world of Real Estate. With a legacy of over three decades, we have been instrumental in shaping the skylines of Gujarat through landmark residential and commercial developments. Our projects are defined by quality, innovation, and sustainability, anchored in a strong foundation of integrity and customer trust. At Venus, we don't just build structures-we create enduring spaces that reflect aspirations and deliver lasting value. 

Role Overview: 

We are seeking a seasoned engineering leader to join us as General Manager (GM) - Engineering for our flagship high-rise developments. This role is pivotal in driving end-to-end project execution, ensuring excellence in construction, adherence to timelines, and alignment with quality and safety standards. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of managing large-scale high-rise developments, including at least two successfully completed projects with a minimum height of 150 metres each. The incumbent will bring strong technical acumen, leadership capability, and cross-functional coordination to deliver complex developments with precision and efficiency. 

Key Responsibilities: 

1. Project Planning & Execution -

- Lead the development and execution of comprehensive project plans, ensuring alignment with business objectives and project milestones. 
 - Drive project scheduling, resource planning, and milestone tracking across all phases of construction. 
 - Ensure timely delivery within approved budgets and defined quality benchmarks. 
 - Oversee construction methodologies, technical planning, and execution strategies for high-rise developments. 

2. Site Management & Supervision-

- Oversee all on-site engineering and construction activities, ensuring seamless coordination across project teams. 
 - Ensure strict adherence to approved drawings, design specifications, construction methodologies, safety protocols, and quality standards. 
 - Collaborate effectively with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders. 
 - Monitor critical construction activities, including structural works, vertical transportation, façade installation, and finishing. 

3. Budgeting & Cost Control-

- Manage project budgets and monitor cost performance against approved estimates. 
 - Drive cost optimisation initiatives while maintaining the required quality and technical standards. 
 - Review and approve contractor bills, BOQs, and variation claims in accordance with delegated authority. 
 - Identify opportunities for improving productivity, resource utilisation, and overall project cost efficiency. 

4. Quality & Safety Compliance-

- Establish and enforce robust quality assurance and quality control frameworks. 
 - Implement and monitor safety standards, site inspections, and audit mechanisms. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable statutory, environmental, and construction regulations. 
 - Drive corrective and preventive actions to address construction quality issues and site risks. 

5. Vendor & Stakeholder Management-

- Lead vendor selection, technical evaluation, and contractor performance management. 
 - Build and sustain relationships with key stakeholders, consultants, contractors, and relevant authorities. 
 - Proactively resolve site-level challenges, technical bottlenecks, and project escalations. 
 - Ensure effective coordination between engineering, procurement, planning, and project management teams. 

6. Reporting & Governance-

- Present periodic MIS reports on project progress, cost performance, quality, and operational efficiency. 
 - Identify project risks and implement appropriate mitigation strategies. 
 - Lead project review meetings with internal teams and senior leadership. 
 - Establish effective project monitoring systems and ensure accountability across execution teams. 

Candidate Profile-

- Experience: 20+ years of experience in engineering and construction, preferably within the real estate development sector. 
 - High-Rise Project Experience: Must have successfully completed at least 2 high-rise projects, each with a minimum height of 150 metres. 
 - Leadership Experience: Minimum 8 years in a senior leadership role managing large-scale residential and/or commercial developments. 
 - Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of high-rise construction, structural engineering, project planning, execution methodologies, and construction management. 
 - Qualification: B. E. / B. Tech / M. E. / M. Tech in Civil Engineering. 
 - Project Delivery: Proven track record of delivering complex, large-scale developments with strong execution, cost control, quality, and safety outcomes. 
 - Leadership & Coordination: Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage consultants, contractors, and senior stakeholders. 

Mandatory Selection Criterion-

- Candidates must have direct experience in the successful completion and delivery of a minimum of two high-rise projects, each at least 150 metres in height.

data.title: AI Product Manager
data.description:
Company Description CareerPassport is building evidence-led professional identity infrastructure designed for the AI era. The company focuses on helping knowledge workers showcase their real, lived experience and capabilities, beyond traditional resumes and profiles. By enabling talent evaluation based on concrete evidence rather than claims, CareerPassport supports more accurate and fair hiring decisions. The platform empowers professionals to present "the real you" and helps organizations hire for what is demonstrably real. Applicants joining CareerPassport will contribute to redefining how professional identity and talent assessment work in an AI-driven world. 

Roles and Responsibilities

• Build and operate services - Design, ship, and run Node. js/TypeScript services that sit behind the GraphQL federation. Own a slice of the ~40-service estate end-to-end: API design, schema, persistence, tests, deployment, on-call. 

• GraphQL federation subgraphs - Add types, resolvers, and capabilities to the federated Platform API. Keep subgraph boundaries clean; respect RBAC at the federation enforcement layer. 

• Commerce backbone - Build the subscription, invoicing, overage, dispute, and payout flows that integrate with Stripe and PayPal webhooks and the billing state machine. Make sure metering, billing, and payouts stay accurate, auditable, and replayable. 

• Proxy control plane - Build the management APIs and background workers that configure the runtime proxy: API keys, plans, rate-limit policies, quota caches, abuse signals. 

• Event-driven systems - Produce and consume Kafka and Kinesis events safely: schema evolution, idempotency, retries, dead-letter handling. Operate Lambda consumers where they're the right tool. 

• Data services - Help own the Node. js Analytics Service and Quota Service that front ClickHouse and Snowflake. Keep latency low, queries cheap, and authorisation correct. 

• Performance and reliability - Diagnose hot paths, tune queries, add caches where they matter, and remove caches that have become liabilities. Write the SLOs and the alerts that defend them. 

• Security isolation - Implement OAuth2 / JWT / mTLS where they belong; respect least-privilege; design APIs that fail closed. 

• On-call and incident response - Take part in the rotation. Lead investigations across services when something rooted in your area breaks. 

• LLM-assisted engineering - Use LLM-based coding and agentic tooling to evolve how features are designed, reviewed, and tested. 

What Success Looks Like

• Services you own meet their SLOs, deploy multiple times a day, and rarely wake anyone up. 

• Billing, subscription, overage, and payout flows you ship are accurate to the cent, replayable, and trusted by both providers and consumers. 

• GraphQL subgraphs you maintain stay fast, well-typed, and pleasant to extend. 

• Event pipelines you produce and consume are idempotent, observable, and survive replay and back-pressure. 

• The first generation of agent-native primitives you help build land in production and start carrying real agent traffic. 

What You Bring

• 5-8 years of backend engineering experience, with non-trivial work on production services that real customers depended on. 

• Strong TypeScript / Node. js in a production service environment; comfort with async patterns, streams, and back-pressure. 

• Solid API design - REST and GraphQL (ideally federation: Apollo Federation, Mercurius, or similar). Schema design, persisted queries, performance tuning. 

• Production fluency with SQL - MySQL and/or Postgres. Bonus for Redis or ClickHouse. 

• Experience with event-driven systems - Kafka or similar. You understand idempotency, exactly-once myths, and consumer lag. 

• Hands-on AWS (EKS, MSK, Kinesis, DynamoDB, Lambda, DMS) and Kubernetes. Comfortable reading and writing Terraform. 

• Modern engineering practice: observability, feature flags, CI/CD, and safe rollouts. 

• Care for correctness on the money path - you have shipped billing, metering, or payment code before and have the scars to show for it. 

• Bonus: experience with API gateways, rate limiting, quota enforcement, usage metering, agent protocols (MCP, A2A, x402), or LLM-based developer tooling. 

• You write small, reviewable PRs. You add the test before you fix the bug. You would rather ship a smaller thing well than a bigger thing badly.

data.description:
Job Description: Platform Engineer Relius / Oracle

Experience: Senior-level experience in Oracle DBA, PL/SQL, and production support

Platform: FIS Relius Administration

Cloud: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)

Database: Oracle 12c / 19c

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Platform Engineer Relius / Oracle to take end-to-end ownership of the FIS Relius Administration platform and its underlying Oracle database environment hosted on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). 

This role combines Oracle database administration, PL/SQL development, release management, application support, and production troubleshooting. The ideal candidate will act as a bridge between development and production, ensuring that database changes, releases, and corrective scripts are reviewed, tested, and deployed safely. 

The candidate should have strong hands-on Oracle DBA experience, the ability to debug complex legacy systems, and experience supporting production applications in regulated financial environments. 

Key Responsibilities 1. Relius Platform Administration

- Manage and maintain Relius environments across Development, UAT, and Production. 
 - Handle Relius upgrades, service packs, environment refreshes, configuration changes, and capacity management. 
 - Monitor database storage, tablespaces, audit logs, and platform health. 
 - Manage FIS support tickets and coordinate with external vendors and internal infrastructure teams. 
 - Perform application and web-tier health checks, service restarts, and deployment-related validations. 

2. Oracle Database Administration

- Administer and maintain Oracle 12c/19c databases in production environments. 
 - Perform Oracle database patching, upgrades, backup, recovery, and environment refresh activities. 
 - Manage database performance tuning, query optimization, long-running SQL, and stored procedure performance. 
 - Monitor database capacity, storage utilization, availability, and operational health. 
 - Manage database access, user provisioning, privileges, access reviews, and revocation. 
 - Support Oracle database operations on OCI; AWS or Azure database operations experience is also acceptable. 

3. PL/SQL Development and Code Review

- Develop, review, troubleshoot, and maintain PL/SQL scripts, stored procedures, functions, packages, and triggers. 
 - Review SQL/PL/SQL scripts developed by application teams before deployment to UAT and Production. 
 - Develop safe corrective scripts for production data issues and application integrations. 
 - Analyze legacy database schemas and troubleshoot data inconsistencies. 
 - Ensure database changes follow established coding standards, testing procedures, audit requirements, and change-control policies. 

4. Release and Deployment Management

- Execute scheduled releases, application updates, database deployments, and emergency hotfixes. 
 - Validate deployment readiness, database scripts, dependencies, and rollback procedures. 
 - Coordinate with development, QA, infrastructure, and database service providers. 
 - Maintain deployment records, change documentation, and release updates in Jira. 
 - Improve deployment processes to ensure repeatability, reliability, and auditability. 

5. Production Support and Troubleshooting

- Act as the primary escalation point for Relius/Oracle production incidents. 
 - Investigate transaction-processing failures, report and statement generation issues, data anomalies, and inbound/outbound file-feed failures. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis across application and database layers. 
 - Diagnose complex production issues using SQL queries, logs, database monitoring, and application-level troubleshooting. 
 - Implement corrective actions while protecting data integrity and minimizing production risk. 
 - Provide timely incident updates and coordinate resolution with vendors and technical teams. 

6. Data Integration and Monitoring

- Support Oracle data extraction, replication, and integration with downstream systems and data lakes. 
 - Work with Change Data Capture (CDC) and replication technologies where applicable. 
 - Monitor database and application health, server/event logs, alerts, and operational metrics. 
 - Support integrations with custodians, financial advisors, and other external systems. 
 - Use AI-assisted development and troubleshooting tools as part of daily engineering activities. 

Mandatory Skills And Experience

- Strong, hands-on Oracle DBA experience with Oracle 12c/19c in production environments. 
 - Expertise in Oracle database patching, backup and recovery, database refreshes, performance tuning, and capacity management. 
 - Strong PL/SQL development and debugging skills, including stored procedures, packages, functions, and corrective scripts. 
 - Experience troubleshooting legacy applications and complex database schemas. 
 - Experience handling production incidents, root-cause analysis, release deployments, and change management. 
 - Experience working with cloud-hosted databases; OCI is strongly preferred, with AWS or Azure database operations also considered. 
 - Ability to review database scripts and execute controlled changes against critical production data. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including incident reporting, vendor coordination, and cross-team collaboration. 
 - Practical, regular use of AI-assisted development tools. 

Good to Have

- Hands-on experience with FIS Relius Administration, including its database schema, service packs, and environment management. 
 - Experience in retirement administration, recordkeeping, banking, financial services, or other regulated environments. 
 - Knowledge of retirement plan and participant data, contributions, distributions, loans, and financial transactions. 
 - Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server. 
 - Experience with CDC, database replication, and data lake integration using Databricks or similar platforms. 
 - Experience with database migration, modernization, and re-platforming initiatives.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components

 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with:

 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective.

 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines

data.title: Head Technology & Innovation
data.description:
Huntsman Corporation is now looking for a dynamic individual as a Head Technology & Innovation. The main objective is to develop new products and new technology platforms for the Indian market. This is done by managing technical resources (people, equipment, facilities, FC and intellectual property) within the Technology & Innovation team. 

The EAIME business requires a dedicated team to develop, validate and support commercialization of new products and applications to drive differentiated growth through a world class innovation pipeline into existing as well as new market spaces to enhance the business portfolio. These resources are managed centrally for maximizing impact through a disciplined approach to project work, risk management as well as leverage and build new technical capabilities within the regional business. Close collaboration with the rest of the organisation is key for success. 

The Platform Manager must be able to effectively deal with the Marketing and Commercial team decision makers as well as work with a number of external partners. Furthermore, the incumbent must work across a wide range of internal personnel in a manner which builds trust, buy-in and understanding. The incumbent must be able to positively influence all the relationships mentioned above and be able to help define, articulate and communicate the value of the project portfolio. 

The level of interactions include higher level strategic, tactical and short- and long-term projects (3+ years). 

Major challenge for this position includes the ability to manage a complex portfolio of Product Innovation projects with a potential of high impact to the business, some results of the decisions taken will only be visible 3 years later or more. 

Project portfolio management includes allocating appropriate resource levels based on potential value creation for the business and providing strong technical expertise to deliver the project efficiently. 

The incumbent will have to be open minded to manage a complex portfolio of high impact projects and develop the skills and competences in the team to deliver those projects. 

Another challenge is to implement a strong project management culture in his/her organisation to ensure most efficient resource utilisation and decision taking. 

The expectation is that an interdependent, collaborative and team-oriented approach will be undertaken. 

This position will be based in Mumbai, India. 

As a Head Technology & Innovation, You Will

Ensure that all activities are conducted to the highest standards of Safety, Health and Corporate Compliance and that the team behavior demonstrates a commitment to safety culture. 

To efficiently manage and drive a portfolio of product development projects for maximum impact and to ensure full alignment to the regional business strategy. Projects can be related to exploring applications and markets. 

To manage and develop the team to improve the delivery of product innovation projects and maximizes value creation for the business. 

To ensure a good connection with platform managers in Tienen and other regions to allow efficient localization of established technologies, taking into account local raw materials and market needs. 

To support the innovation director in defining and delivering the EAIME vision and strategic trusts. 

To manage a seamless integration/collaboration with the other groups of the EAIME organisation as well as Global Research to ensure most efficient project delivery. 

Foster an open and collaborative culture to ensure most efficient use of resources, knowhow and expertise available in the organisation. 

To be an active member of the IMT (India Management Team)

What skills and experiences are we looking for?

The ideal candidate should have a Master in a technical discipline preferably in a chemical related field and have extensive managerial and applications experience. 

He/she should have 15-20 yrs experience in the company or 10yrs in the Polyurethane industry

The candidate should have an in-depth knowledge of how polyurethane works and the processing/applications benefits that can be achieved in existing as well as in potential new application and markets. 

The candidate must have proven managerial skills and ability to take far reaching decisions and influence situations at senior level. 

The candidate must have the ability to manage a diverse project portfolio as well as be able to set priorities in a complex environment. 

Ideally the candidate, in addition to the education above should have 15+ years technical development experience with a track record of project delivery, people management and organisational development. 

In lieu of the education noted above the candidate could qualify if (s)he possessed 15+ years experience in advanced polyurethane product and application environment. 

The incumbent, due to his/her experience, must be able to focus on strategic issues without compromising potential tactical choices. 

What can we offer?

Huntsman offers unsurpassed opportunities to build a successful future. We are a global specialty chemical company with locations in 25 countries around the world, employing over 6, 000 associates. Our diverse portfolio creates a range of career fields including manufacturing, research and development, technical services, sales and marketing, customer service - and the list goes on. 

Here, you can make an impact and make a difference. Come join us. 

Huntsman is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all qualified applicants for employment, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, gender identification, sexual orientation and/or expression or any other characteristic protected by law in every location in which we have facilities national or local. 

Please refer to https: //www. huntsman. com/privacy/online-privacy-notice for Company's Data Privacy and Protection information. 

All unsolicited resumes presented by recruitment agencies are treated as pro bono information or service. 

Huntsman is aware of a scam involving fraudulent job offers. Huntsman does not make job offers until after a candidate has submitted a job application and has participated in a face-to-face interview. Please be advised that emails from Huntsman always end in "@huntsman. com" and that any job offer that requires payment or requires you to deposit a check is likely a scam. If you have questions about any open positions at Huntsman, please visit our Careers website at

http: //www. huntsman. com/corporate/a/Careers.

data.title: Senior Engineering, Automation & Productization Consultant
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Engineering, Automation & Productization Consultant based in India. 

We are seeking an experienced engineering consultant to support enterprise networking and digital transformation initiatives within a large, global organization. In this remote consulting role, you will transform architectural concepts into scalable, standardized, and production-ready solutions. You will combine enterprise networking expertise with Python-based automation, technical design, validation, and implementation support. Working across architecture, engineering, security, cloud, and operations teams, you will help improve deployment efficiency and establish repeatable engineering practices. You will also contribute to technical governance, documentation, and knowledge transfer, ensuring solutions are reliable, secure, and operationally sustainable. This opportunity is ideal for a proactive technical specialist who can bridge strategy and execution while delivering practical results in a fast-paced enterprise environment. 

Accountabilities

- Architecture and engineering: Support the development and review of High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), ensuring solutions meet requirements for scalability, security, supportability, and operational readiness. Establish and maintain engineering standards, design guidelines, and reference architectures, and participate in technical governance forums and design reviews. 
 - Enterprise networking: Apply expertise in routing, switching, TCP/IP, LAN/WAN technologies, VLAN design, network segmentation, and enterprise connectivity. Review connectivity architectures and implementation approaches, support network security integration, and contribute to enterprise and cloud connectivity planning. 
 - Automation and development: Identify opportunities to automate deployment and operational workflows. Develop and maintain Python-based scripts, integrate REST APIs, and create reusable automation templates, frameworks, and engineering accelerators that improve consistency and operational efficiency. 
 - Productization and standardization: Convert individual solutions and pilot implementations into repeatable production models. Develop deployment methodologies, implementation playbooks, reusable design templates, and engineering best practices. Capture lessons learned and translate implementation experience into standardized frameworks and practical guidance. 
 - Validation and implementation support: Support solution testing, validation, pilot deployments, and first implementations. Investigate implementation challenges, recommend remediation actions, and refine designs based on field feedback to ensure solutions meet technical and operational requirements. 
 - Cloud and platform integration: Support integration across enterprise networks, applications, security platforms, and cloud environments. Contribute to hybrid architecture design and help ensure reliable connectivity and effective interoperability between systems. 
 - Documentation and knowledge transfer: Create and maintain architecture documentation, engineering specifications, deployment guides, operational procedures, and implementation instructions. Conduct technical walkthroughs and knowledge-transfer workshops to support smooth handovers to engineering and operations teams. 
 - Consulting and stakeholder collaboration: Work independently across architecture, engineering, implementation, and operational teams. Gather requirements, facilitate technical discussions, engage stakeholders, and help align engineering solutions with enterprise objectives and delivery standards. 

Requirements

- Professional experience: At least 10 years of experience in enterprise networking, engineering, automation, or solution architecture, ideally within large, global enterprise environments. Candidates should have a proven record of delivering technical solutions across architecture, implementation, validation, and operational handover. 
 - Enterprise networking expertise: Strong knowledge of routing and switching, TCP/IP, LAN/WAN technologies, VLAN design, network segmentation, enterprise network security fundamentals, connectivity design, and network integration. 
 - Automation and programming skills: Hands-on experience with Python, SQL, REST APIs, JSON, YAML, Git or other version-control systems, scripting, and automation frameworks. The ability to identify automation opportunities and develop reusable engineering solutions is essential. 
 - Architecture and technical design: Experience developing and reviewing HLDs and LLDs, defining solution architectures, establishing engineering standards, and producing clear technical documentation. Familiarity with validation and testing practices and technical governance processes is required. 
 - Cloud and integration knowledge: Understanding of enterprise cloud connectivity, hybrid architectures, platform integration, and security integration across network, application, and cloud environments. 
 - Productization and engineering practices: Experience developing reusable templates, standardized deployment methodologies, implementation playbooks, and repeatable production processes. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD concepts, DevOps practices, workflow automation, and product engineering is an advantage. 
 - Additional enterprise technology knowledge: Familiarity with SD-WAN, Network Access Control (NAC), Identity and Access Management (IAM) integration, monitoring and observability platforms, and enterprise security technologies is desirable. 
 - Consulting and stakeholder management: Strong customer-facing consulting experience, requirements-gathering skills, and the ability to facilitate technical workshops and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders. Experience supporting global enterprise delivery initiatives is preferred. 
 - Analytical and communication skills: Excellent problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and strong written and verbal communication skills. Candidates should be comfortable explaining complex technical concepts, resolving implementation challenges, and bridging architecture, engineering, automation, and operations. 
 - Personal effectiveness: A proactive, curious, and solution-oriented approach, with the ability to work independently under minimal supervision and adapt to evolving priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Education and certifications: A bachelor's or master's degree is indicated for the role. Preferred certifications include Cisco CCNP or CCIE, Cisco DevNet, AWS, Azure or Google Cloud certifications, automation or DevOps certifications, and TOGAF. 

Benefits

- Remote work: Fully remote consulting opportunity based in India. 
 - Contract engagement: Contract-based position with a shared specialist resource model. 
 - Senior-level technical scope: Opportunity to contribute to enterprise networking, architecture, automation, and digital transformation initiatives. 
 - Engineering impact: Help establish reusable engineering standards, productized solutions, and scalable deployment practices across enterprise environments. 
 - Cross-functional collaboration: Work with architecture, engineering, security, cloud, implementation, and operational teams. 
 - Professional development: Gain exposure to enterprise technologies, automation frameworks, cloud integration, and engineering process improvement. 
 - Compensation and additional benefits: Salary or consulting rate, healthcare coverage, paid leave, contract duration, and other benefits have not been specified in the available job description.

The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

data.title: Quality Control Engineer
data.description:
Company Description Renuka Plastic Crafts Private Limited is an electrical and electronic manufacturing company located in Subhash Nagar, Jeedimetla, Nampally, Telangana, India. The organization focuses on producing plastic components and related products for the electrical and electronics industry. As a growing manufacturer, the company emphasizes consistent product quality and reliable delivery for its clients. Team members have the opportunity to work with industrial production processes and quality systems in a dynamic, factory-based environment. 
Role Description The Quality Control Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad. This role is responsible for inspecting incoming materials and finished products, monitoring production processes, and performing routine quality checks to ensure compliance with internal standards and customer specifications. The Quality Control Engineer will document inspection results, prepare quality reports, and support root-cause analysis and corrective actions for nonconformities. Day-to-day tasks include collaborating with production and maintenance teams, assisting in the implementation and improvement of quality procedures, and supporting internal audits and continuous improvement initiatives. The role also involves maintaining testing equipment, ensuring safety and regulatory adherence, and providing feedback to stakeholders to improve overall product quality. 
Qualifications

- Strong foundation in Quality Control and Quality Assurance, with hands-on experience in inspection, testing, and defect analysis. 
 - Proficiency in Quality Management concepts, including documentation, process control, and continuous improvement practices. 
 - Well-developed Analytical Skills to interpret data, identify trends, and support root-cause analysis and problem-solving. 
 - Effective Communication skills for clear reporting, cross-functional coordination, and collaboration with production and management teams. 
 - Degree or diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - Familiarity with manufacturing environments, preferably in electrical/electronic or plastic component production. 
 - Knowledge of relevant quality standards (e. g. , ISO 9001 or equivalent) and basic understanding of safety and regulatory requirements. 
 - Ability to work on-site in a factory setting, manage multiple inspections, and maintain attention to detail under production timelines.

data.description:
Job description: 

Job Description Role: 

The purpose of the role is to provide assurance on the quality of deployment for the assigned accounts and support in establishing mechanisms that enhance and sustain customer satisfaction levels. The role is expected to support in enhancing customer advocacy by predicting and preventing customer escalations & dissatisfactions and drive a culture of continuous improvement in the assigned accounts.   

͏ Do: 

- Implement deployment quality strategy for the assigned Accounts
 - Provide inputs in the development of strategy for the assigned accounts while considering the quality standards, client expectations, quality, and monitoring mechanisms
 - Review and reallocate the priorities to align with the overall strategy of the line of business / business unit
 - Quality control and Customer satisfaction
 - Support the completion of Annual Customer Satisfaction survey by ensuring completion of survey by the account customers, representatives for various projects within the account.   
 - Ensure completion of survey and address any queries in a timely manner.   
 - Support in conceptualizing the action planning by communicating with clients and interacting with Delivery Managers, vertical delivery heads and service delivery heads
 - Drive the account wise tracking of action planning identified for sustained CSAT in various projects.   
 - Drive the Quarterly pulse survey for selected accounts or projects for periodic check-ins.     
 - Support the Account Leadership teams for tracking and managing client escalation for closure. 
 - Early Warnings and Business partnership
 - Drive the implementation of mechanisms for preventing client escalations / dis-satisfactions by creating an early warning system in DigiQ covering aspects like delivery quality, delivery schedule, resources constraints, financial issues (overloading of effort / over-run potential), productivity, and slippages on milestones. 
 - Participate in Monthly and Quarterly Business review along with Business and Account leadership to ensure adherence of defined quality processes, define new life cycle models and ensure gating processes are followed the projects within the accounts.   
 - Drive the upskilling of delivery teams on quality management tools, knowledge management and create mechanisms for sharing of best practices. 
 - Support the collection of metrics on the performance / health of process and regular publishing of compliance and metrics dashboards. 
 - Continuous Improvement  
 - Drive a culture of continuous improvement in the assigned accounts to ensure enhance efficiency and productivity of resources
 - Create mechanisms between the projects in the account for sharing knowledge, quality issues, risk mitigation methods within the accounts to drive the continuous improvement
 - Plan and drive year on year improvement goals in various projects by way of process streamlining & improvements and automation, leading to cost savings and / or efficiency
 - Support the collection of metrics to show the improvements- efficiency / productivity improvement. ͏ 
 - Team Management

data.title: Specialist - Tech Development
data.description:
Position Summary

The Tech Development Lead is a Grade 8 individual contributor who supports design, build, deployment, and operates reliable data pipelines and AI-enabled solutions. The role applies to technical judgment across data engineering, GenAI, and agent engineering, with accountability for production reliability, observability, trusted data access, prompt effectiveness, and responsible operation in a regulated environment. 

The role owns complex components of the data and AI landscape end-to-end, makes day-to-day technical decisions with limited oversight, and helps shape practical engineering direction. It partners with business, product, platform, architecture, security, governance, and engineering teams to translate ambiguous needs and user feedback into scalable, maintainable solutions while mentoring colleagues and strengthening team capability. 

Why This Role Exists

- Own data pipelines, datasets, and supporting interfaces end-to-end for analytics, machine learning, and GenAI use cases. 
 - Build and maintain AI agents and LLM-powered capabilities that support trusted, efficient business workflows. 
 - Establish agent reliability, observability, guardrails, and escalation controls for stable and compliant production operation. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering as a core working practice while applying strong judgment to generated code, tests, documentation, recommendations, and downstream risk implications. 

Key Responsibilities

- Data Pipeline & Platform Engineering
 - Independently design, build, deploy, and operate batch and streaming data pipelines that meet defined expectations for freshness, correctness, reliability, performance, and cost. 
 - Own data models and datasets across ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving, using modern warehouse or Lakehouse technologies. 
 - Monitor source and platform changes, including ServiceNow data exposed through Databricks views, and address inconsistencies that could affect downstream solutions or agent reliability. 
 - Make informed technical decisions on pipeline, interface, data-model, and automation changes, escalating only where architectural, compliance, or business-risk thresholds require broader approval. 
 - Control and monitor approved data access points across structured and unstructured sources, cloud platforms, documentation, and authoritative business repositories. 
 - AI Agent & GenAI Engineering
 - Build, deploy, and enhance machine learning and GenAI solutions aligned with validated user requirements. 
 - Develop and maintain AI agents using Python, Azure services, APIs, LLM frameworks, retrieval patterns, and appropriate interface technologies. 
 - Use AI coding assistants and LLM tooling to plan, scaffold, refactor, test, document, and debug code, while validating outputs before adoption. 
 - Create agent-based automations for data-quality investigation, failure triage, documentation, schema and lineage analysis, dataset discovery, and routine remediation. 
 - Test, refine, and govern prompts; identify new prompts aligned with evolving business needs and approved solution scope. 
 - Incorporate user feedback, agent metrics, and production outcomes into a closed-loop improvement process for prompts, models, and agent behavior. 
 - Reliability, Observability & Trust Controls
 - Monitor system health, trace logs, response quality, hallucination indicators, data drift, failures, and operational trends. 
 - Define and maintain practical detection thresholds, alerts, dashboards, and escalation paths for production issues. 
 - Instrument pipelines and agents, respond to incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and drive corrective actions for reliability, quality, security, performance, and cost. 
 - Validate that agent responses rely on approved authoritative data sources and map to defined domain controls, identifiers, measures, or calculation logic where applicable. 
 - Implement refusal or human-escalation behavior when a request is outside approved scope, lacks authoritative evidence, or requires human judgment. 
 - Partner with AI platform and technology teams to improve guardrails, usability, response clarity, and front-end experience without changing approved business logic. 
 - Quality, Governance & Documentation
 - Implement data-quality and testing controls such as freshness checks, contract tests, anomaly detection, test automation, and clear alerting paths. 
 - Ensure changes align with applicable architecture, security, privacy, platform, model-governance, and responsible-AI standards. 
 - Maintain technical documentation, operating procedures, training materials, data lineage, governance records, and service-landscape knowledge. 
 - Act as an effective first-line tester for changes and enhancements, with clear evidence of validation and traceability. 
 - Influence architecture and tooling decisions, balancing delivery speed with maintainability, supportability, scalability, and compliance. 
 - Business Partnership & Capability Building
 - Translate business needs, ambiguous requirements, production findings, and user feedback into prioritized, deliverable increments. 
 - Consult business and technology stakeholders on proposed changes and communicate technical implications clearly to non-technical audiences. 
 - Partner with product owners, risk or control specialists, data and analytics teams, and platform teams to deliver solutions that preserve approved business logic. 
 - Train end users on effective prompt usage, solution boundaries, escalation paths, and good practices. 
 - Mentor engineers and colleagues through pairing, code review, onboarding, troubleshooting support, and practical knowledge sharing; act as a go-to technical advisor within the team. 
 - Development Capability (ability to fulfil at least 1 of the following specialisms)
 - Front-end development - ability to design, build, test and maintain accessible, responsive user interfaces using React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS, or comparable GSK-supported frameworks. Ability to translate user interviews, observation and usability feedback into intuitive, secure user experiences through prototyping, iterative development and validation. 
 - Data engineering - ability to design and operate secure, reliable ingestion from ADLS, Snowflake or other GSK-supported components into Databricks and the appropriate Code Orange foundation, trusted or unified layer. Ability to validate, transform, clean, document and model data through maintainable queries and jobs, producing governed tables or payloads for analytics, data science, AI/ML and LLM solutions, including structured outputs consumable by APIs and front-end applications. 
 - Data science - ability to design, build, evaluate, deploy and support AI/ML models for text, image or numerical analysis. Select reproducible statistical or machine-learning approaches appropriate to the business need and data, define meaningful performance measures, and validate model quality, limitations, robustness and ongoing performance. 
 - AI engineering - ability to design, version, test and optimise prompts, retrieval and agent workflows; integrate approved LLMs through APIs; and select models and reasoning settings against defined quality, latency, security and cost criteria. Ability to use AIGA components for evaluation, registration, deployment and telemetry, including Weights & Biases Weave and OpenTelemetry, to trace lineage, usage, cost, performance and explainability. 
 - Full-stack development - ability to design, implement, secure and test end-to-end applications and API-based data interchange across user interface, service and data layers. Demonstrated capability in at least two other listed specialisms, including integration, deployment, observability and operational support within the GSK technology stack. 

Required Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, data engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Typically 4- years of relevant hands-on experience building, operating, and improving production data, software, AI, or cloud solutions. 
 - Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience developing maintainable production code, APIs, tests, and automation. 
 - Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services and concepts such as Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Web Apps or App Services, Key Vault, storage, and deployment practices. 
 - Experience with modern data engineering technologies, including data modeling, Spark, orchestration or transformation tooling, and warehouse or lakehouse patterns. 
 - Experience with AI or application frameworks such as LangChain or related LLM frameworks, FastAPI, Pydantic, and API gateway patterns such as Kong. 
 - Working knowledge of containerization and deployment technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, plus source control and engineering artefacts including GitHub, JSON, JavaScript, Jupyter, YAML, and shell scripting. 
 - Practical experience using AI coding assistants as part of daily engineering work, with disciplined review of generated output. 
 - Strong communication, stakeholder-management, and mentoring skills for guiding colleagues and influencing business, product, governance, architecture, security, data, and engineering teams. 
 - Preferred Qualifications & Experience
 - Master's degree or higher in software engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field. 
 - Experience creating or significantly extending AI agents in an Azure environment using Python, web applications, and enterprise data sources. 
 - Knowledge of large language models, generative AI, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector stores, and fine-tuning techniques. 
 - Experience with unstructured data, data contracts, data-quality frameworks, catalogs, lineage tools, and observability platforms. 
 - Familiarity with model governance, privacy-preserving techniques, responsible AI, bias mitigation, and controls for high-stakes or regulated solutions. 
 - Experience in financial risk management, finance controlling, controls testing, or another regulated business domain. 
 - Experience working effectively in international, distributed, and cross-functional environments. 

Skills

Data Integrity, Data Quality, Digital Fluency, GxP Regulations, Influencing Without Authority, Lean Management, Problem Solving, Project Management, Quality Assurance (QA), Quality Metrics, Risk Awareness, Technical Writing, Technology Management

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

It partners with business, product, platform, architecture, security, governance, and engineering teams to translate ambiguous needs and user feedback into scalable, maintainable solutions while mentoring colleagues and strengthening team capability. 

Why This Role Exists

- Own data pipelines, datasets, and supporting interfaces end-to-end for analytics, machine learning, and GenAI use cases. 
 - Build and maintain AI agents and LLM-powered capabilities that support trusted, efficient business workflows. 
 - Establish agent reliability, observability, guardrails, and escalation controls for stable and compliant production operation. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering as a core working practice while applying strong judgment to generated code, tests, documentation, recommendations, and downstream risk implications. 

Key Responsibilities

- Data Pipeline & Platform Engineering
 - Independently design, build, deploy, and operate batch and streaming data pipelines that meet defined expectations for freshness, correctness, reliability, performance, and cost. 
 - Own data models and datasets across ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving, using modern warehouse or Lakehouse technologies. 
 - Monitor source and platform changes, including ServiceNow data exposed through Databricks views, and address inconsistencies that could affect downstream solutions or agent reliability. 
 - Make informed technical decisions on pipeline, interface, data-model, and automation changes, escalating only where architectural, compliance, or business-risk thresholds require broader approval. 
 - Control and monitor approved data access points across structured and unstructured sources, cloud platforms, documentation, and authoritative business repositories. 
 - AI Agent & GenAI Engineering
 - Build, deploy, and enhance machine learning and GenAI solutions aligned with validated user requirements. 
 - Develop and maintain AI agents using Python, Azure services, APIs, LLM frameworks, retrieval patterns, and appropriate interface technologies. 
 - Use AI coding assistants and LLM tooling to plan, scaffold, refactor, test, document, and debug code, while validating outputs before adoption. 
 - Create agent-based automations for data-quality investigation, failure triage, documentation, schema and lineage analysis, dataset discovery, and routine remediation. 
 - Test, refine, and govern prompts; identify new prompts aligned with evolving business needs and approved solution scope. 
 - Incorporate user feedback, agent metrics, and production outcomes into a closed-loop improvement process for prompts, models, and agent behavior. 
 - Reliability, Observability & Trust Controls
 - Monitor system health, trace logs, response quality, hallucination indicators, data drift, failures, and operational trends. 
 - Define and maintain practical detection thresholds, alerts, dashboards, and escalation paths for production issues. 
 - Instrument pipelines and agents, respond to incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and drive corrective actions for reliability, quality, security, performance, and cost. 
 - Validate that agent responses rely on approved authoritative data sources and map to defined domain controls, identifiers, measures, or calculation logic where applicable. 
 - Implement refusal or human-escalation behavior when a request is outside approved scope, lacks authoritative evidence, or requires human judgment. 
 - Partner with AI platform and technology teams to improve guardrails, usability, response clarity, and front-end experience without changing approved business logic. 
 - Quality, Governance & Documentation
 - Implement data-quality and testing controls such as freshness checks, contract tests, anomaly detection, test automation, and clear alerting paths. 
 - Ensure changes align with applicable architecture, security, privacy, platform, model-governance, and responsible-AI standards. 
 - Maintain technical documentation, operating procedures, training materials, data lineage, governance records, and service-landscape knowledge. 
 - Act as an effective first-line tester for changes and enhancements, with clear evidence of validation and traceability. 
 - Influence architecture and tooling decisions, balancing delivery speed with maintainability, supportability, scalability, and compliance. 
 - Business Partnership & Capability Building
 - Translate business needs, ambiguous requirements, production findings, and user feedback into prioritized, deliverable increments. 
 - Consult business and technology stakeholders on proposed changes and communicate technical implications clearly to non-technical audiences. 
 - Partner with product owners, risk or control specialists, data and analytics teams, and platform teams to deliver solutions that preserve approved business logic. 
 - Train end users on effective prompt usage, solution boundaries, escalation paths, and good practices. 
 - Mentor engineers and colleagues through pairing, code review, onboarding, troubleshooting support, and practical knowledge sharing; act as a go-to technical advisor within the team. 
 - Development Capability (ability to fulfil at least 1 of the following specialisms)
 - Front-end development - ability to design, build, test and maintain accessible, responsive user interfaces using React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS, or comparable GSK-supported frameworks. Ability to translate user interviews, observation and usability feedback into intuitive, secure user experiences through prototyping, iterative development and validation. 
 - Data engineering - ability to design and operate secure, reliable ingestion from ADLS, Snowflake or other GSK-supported components into Databricks and the appropriate Code Orange foundation, trusted or unified layer. Ability to validate, transform, clean, document and model data through maintainable queries and jobs, producing governed tables or payloads for analytics, data science, AI/ML and LLM solutions, including structured outputs consumable by APIs and front-end applications. 
 - Data science - ability to design, build, evaluate, deploy and support AI/ML models for text, image or numerical analysis. Select reproducible statistical or machine-learning approaches appropriate to the business need and data, define meaningful performance measures, and validate model quality, limitations, robustness and ongoing performance. 
 - AI engineering - ability to design, version, test and optimise prompts, retrieval and agent workflows; integrate approved LLMs through APIs; and select models and reasoning settings against defined quality, latency, security and cost criteria. Ability to use AIGA components for evaluation, registration, deployment and telemetry, including Weights & Biases Weave and OpenTelemetry, to trace lineage, usage, cost, performance and explainability. 
 - Full-stack development - ability to design, implement, secure and test end-to-end applications and API-based data interchange across user interface, service and data layers. Demonstrated capability in at least two other listed specialisms, including integration, deployment, observability and operational support within the GSK technology stack. 

Required Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, data engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Typically, 7- years of relevant hands-on experience building, operating, and improving production data, software, AI, or cloud solutions. The overall capability, judgment, autonomy, and technical influence should be consistent with a Grade 7 individual contributor role. 
 - Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience developing maintainable production code, APIs, tests, and automation. 
 - Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services and concepts such as Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Web Apps or App Services, Key Vault, storage, and deployment practices. 
 - Experience with modern data engineering technologies, including data modeling, Spark, orchestration or transformation tooling, and warehouse or Lakehouse patterns. 
 - Experience with AI or application frameworks such as LangChain or related LLM frameworks, FastAPI, Pydantic, and API gateway patterns such as Kong. 
 - Working knowledge of containerization and deployment technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, plus source control and engineering artefacts including GitHub, JSON, JavaScript, Jupyter, YAML, and shell scripting. 
 - Practical experience using AI coding assistants as part of daily engineering work, with disciplined review of generated output. 
 - Strong communication, stakeholder-management, and mentoring skills for guiding colleagues and influencing business, product, governance, architecture, security, data, and engineering teams. 
 - Preferred Qualifications & Experience
 - Master's degree or higher in software engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field. 
 - Experience creating or significantly extending AI agents in an Azure environment using Python, web applications, and enterprise data sources. 
 - Knowledge of large language models, generative AI, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector stores, and fine-tuning techniques. 
 - Experience with unstructured data, data contracts, data-quality frameworks, catalogs, lineage tools, and observability platforms. 
 - Familiarity with model governance, privacy-preserving techniques, responsible AI, bias mitigation, and controls for high-stakes or regulated solutions. 
 - Experience in financial risk management, finance controlling, controls testing, or another regulated business domain. 
 - Experience working effectively in international, distributed, and cross-functional environments. 

Skills

Business Data Mining, Data Analysis, Data Analysis Tools, Data Mining, Data Modeling, Data Storytelling, SQL Databases, Statistical Analysis, Structured Query Language (SQL)

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK.
