data.description:
IMEA (India, Middle East, Africa) India LIXIL INDIA PVT LTD Employee Assignment Not remote Full Time 13 April 2026

JOB DESCRIPTION - Engineer/ Sr. Engineer - Mechanical & Utility Maintenance

Location-Bhimadole

Purpose: Maintain all zones such as Ball mills, KILN, conveyors, vacuum systems, Stirrers, Agitators, 

Dust collection system, Bowers, spraying system, RO plant, ETP, STP, FIRE HYDRANT & fighting installations, material, handling & lifting equipment like - Fork lifter, HOPT, EOT crane, JIB crane, Electric hoist, chain blocks, Automobiles, ZLD, Chiller, Cooling Tower, Heat Exchangers, dryers, refrigeration system, Industrial gas storage & pumping system (LPG & PNG), compressed air & AIR COMPRESSOR's Position may also serve as back up for plant equipment. 

Qualification: BE/B. Tech - Mechanical with AutoCAD proficiency (AutoCAD, SolidWorks)

Experience: Required Minimum 5-8 years specific on hand work experience- advantage if the experience is in the same business line/continuous process industry like - Sanitaryware/ceramic field/FMCG/Automobile/Cement/Oil & Gas/Steel/Paper. 

General Requirements

- Shall be responsible for two primary functions: Utility Maintenance and co-ordination of TPM system. 
 - Perform maintenance management by supervising maintenance personnel and establishing priorities in maintenance schedules. Taking decision for Predictive & corrective maintenance of plant equipment based on performance. Control of shift maintenance losses as per plan and deputing manpower for optimum utilization. 
 - Maintain manufacturing assets, utilities, facility, parts inventory, monitoring purchase orders, invoice approvals, and manage the department budget. 
 - Manage maintenance personnel by setting direction & priorities and provide training & continuous development on all maintenance personnel. 
 - Ensure the facilities, utilities, layout, and machinery run to their maximum efficiency & output. Manage to upkeep of all the manufacturing assets, resources and assisting in the design & installation of new systems and implementation of energy saving projects. 
 - Timely Perform Performance Evaluations on direct reports and Verify Performance Evaluations are being performed on technical work force. 
 - Drive the Maintenance & Reliability initiative focused on Preventive & Predictive Maintenance, not reactive and maintain work order & inventory management. 
 - Managing, maintaining, and establishing maintenance procedures to ensure production meets & performs better than budget. 
 - Developing and maintaining quality & safety standards. Develop associate and supervisor skills by conducting training meetings, one on one development sessions, outside technical skills training, establishing, and monitoring performance reviews for supervisors. 
 - Setting and maintaining departmental budget by reviewing financial statements, monitoring efficiencies & cost and other expenses. 
 - Participate in designing & developing future production capacities & improvements by coordinating with user departments and updating maintenance operating procedures & schedules to incorporate the changes. 
 - Design & maintain mechanical maintenance plans, strategies, Schedules, procedures & methods for the plant & critical utility equipment's. 
 - Ability to maintain water records such as RO water, RAW water, ETP, ZLD, Fire Hydrant & STP Waters as per the statutory & legal requirements. All fire prevention equipment was maintained and tested to insure 100% operation. 14) Need to have knowledge on statutory & legal requirements for utility services and Maintain Daily logbooks & records accordingly. 
 - Adherence of preventive maintenance schedule. Carry out routine maintenance work and respond to equipment faults and diagnose breakdown problems. 
 - Monitor and control maintenance costs. Need to work on specific consumption & utilization. 
 - Ability to operate & update data in SAP, MS word, MS excel, MS power point, & Auto cad etc and understand & develop drawings in Auto cad. 
 - Design and specify new equipment installations undertaken by the business unit. Prepare project cost estimates and capital appropriation requests justifying proposed spending with economic returns meeting company standards. 
 - Coordinate with production, maintenance, purchasing departments while preforming engineering activities. 
 - Must be able to work a flexible schedule & calculate the MTTR & MTBF. Complete engineering projects on time and at or under budget. 
 - Provide process engineering and troubleshooting support to production, utilities as necessary to meet all the production commitments. Contributes to production flow by minimizing downtime due to equipment/parts failures. 
 - Willingness to work in a team-based environment and a commitment to continuous learning and improvement. Need to have knowledge on TBT, KAIZEN, HAICHIBAN, 5S, Critical Six, OHSAS, ISO, QMS, EMS and Behaviour Based Safety. 

Typical Responsibilities

- O& M of RO plant, ETP, STP, ZLD, FIRE HYDRANT SYSTEM & AIR COMPRESSOR simultaneously. 
 - Maintain required inventory such as consumables, machinery spares, etc. , safe work

environment by following company safety procedures, water parameters as per APPCB

Standards, AMC for all the required utility machinery, zero leakages in Compressed Air Line & Water Lines and monthly PPT'S Such as graphical representations & improvements. 

- Manage the utility maintenance staff and external contractors for the projects & required

modifications. 

- Worked individually and in teams, demanding & maintaining 0% damage & injury rates. 
 - Assisting the HOD in mechanical maintenance services of the process machinery, equipment's & supporting utilities. 
 - Handling contract management for the plant maintenance and other related activities. PM/CBM Compliance to 100% RCA to be carried out for major & repetitive failures with appropriate corrective action and preventive actions and smooth execution/supervision of ongoing projects and plant modification activities within stipulated time frame with focus on safety and quality. 
 - Record and analyze non-conformities, initiate corrective action/guide on implementation of corrective/preventive action & MIS. Maintain the QMS & OHSAS system and the subsequent records regarding the plant. Guide and develop the department team members.

Full Stack Development are involved in full stack development and implement end-to-end components of custom applications. Their job involves designing and developing the UI, business logic, data & integration layer along with testing and maintenance of these layers.

- Physical Requirements: Sedentary Work

Associate Director - AWS, Python & Snowflake Developer

10+ years of relevant technology experience, with substantial hands-on engineering work in cloud data platforms

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Associate Director to join our team who continues to write code and build solutions. This role requires deep, practical expertise in AWS, Python, and Snowflake, with a strong emphasis on Snowpark development, serverless architectures, and orchestrated data pipelines. The ideal candidate combines senior-level technical depth with the ability to guide architecture decisions and mentor engineering teams. 

Must-Have Skills (Core Requirements)

- Python Development

Strong hands-on programming experience in Python, including building production-grade data processing applications, writing efficient and maintainable code, and working with common libraries used in data engineering workflows. 

- Snowflake & Snowpark

Demonstrated experience building and deploying Snowpark stored procedures, working with Snowflake's data engineering capabilities, writing efficient SQL, and optimizing Snowflake warehouses and query performance for large-scale datasets. 

- AWS Cloud Services

Practical, Hands-on Experience With: 

- AWS Lambda for serverless compute and event-driven processing
 - Amazon S3 for data storage, lifecycle management, and integration with downstream pipelines
 - General familiarity with the AWS ecosystem to support cross-service integrations
 - Workflow Orchestration

Experience designing, building, and maintaining DAGs (using tools such as Apache Airflow or equivalent orchestration frameworks) to manage complex, multi-step data pipelines with dependencies, scheduling, and failure handling. 

- Secondary Skills (Good to Have)
 - Version control proficiency with Git, including branching strategies, pull request workflows, and CI/CD integration
 - Familiarity with additional AWS services such as Glue, Step Functions, CloudWatch, IAM, ECS/EKS, or SNS/SQS
 - Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation)
 - Exposure to containerization (Docker) and deployment pipelines
 - Understanding of data governance, security, and compliance practices in cloud environments
 - Domain Knowledge

Prior exposure to or working knowledge of the asset management/Investment banking or broader financial services industry is a strong plus. Familiarity with investment data concepts, portfolio management systems, or regulatory reporting requirements in this space would be beneficial. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable data engineering solutions using Python, Snowflake, and AWS services
 - Build and optimize Snowpark stored procedures for complex data transformations
 - Develop serverless applications leveraging AWS Lambda integrated with S3 and other AWS services
 - Design and manage DAG-based orchestration for end-to-end data pipeline execution
 - Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance while remaining actively engaged in hands-on development
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams including data analysts, business stakeholders, and platform engineering
 - Establish and enforce coding standards, best practices, and code review processes
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, fostering technical growth within the team
 - Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, ensuring high availability and performance of data pipelines
 - Contribute to technical roadmap planning and platform modernization initiatives

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
 - 10+ years of overall technology experience, with significant time spent in hands-on data engineering roles
 - Proven track record of delivering production-grade solutions in Python and Snowflake environments
 - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in ambiguous or evolving requirements
 - Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting technical solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Related Skills

Agile Methodology, Continuous Integration and Deployment, Data Analysis, Debugging, DevOps, Enterprise Application Integration, Operating Systems Management, Problem Solving, Programming, Software Development, Software Development Life Cycle, Web Application Development

data.description:
Position Description

Job Title: AI Engineer

Position: Senior Software Engineer

Experience: 7-12 Years

Category: Software Development/ Engineering

Shift: Hybrid - (1PM to 10 PM Shift)

Main location: Hyderabad, Bangalore

Position ID: J0926-0014

Employment Type: Full Time

Position Description: We are looking for a Lead AI Developer to join our team. This position involves design, develop, and lead enterprise-grade Generative AI solutions. This role requires deep hands-on expertise in Python, Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and agent-based architectures. 

Your future duties and responsibilities

- Lead the design and development of scalable Generative AI solutions using LLMs
 - Define and implement architectures for RAG, agentic, multi-agent, and multimodal systems
 - Review and guide solution designs to ensure alignment with AI CoE standards and enterprise architecture
 - Mentor and guide developers on GenAI patterns, tools, and best practices
 - Develop end-to-end AI solutions using Python
 - Design, test, and optimize prompt engineering strategies
 - Build and manage embeddings, vector search, and semantic retrieval pipelines
 - Develop applications using LangChain and monitor, evaluate, and debug workflows using LangSmith
 - Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, and structured/unstructured data sources
 - Implement agent-based and multi-agent workflows for task orchestration and automation

data.title: Senior Tunnel Engineer - Design
data.description: Job Title: Senior Tunnel ManagerOverview: We are seeking an accomplished Senior Tunnel Manager with a minimum of 15 years of professional experience, including at least 10 years in Hydel and/or Metro tunnelling projects. The successful candidate will provide technical leadership and strategic oversight for complex underground infrastructure projects, ensuring safe, economical, and constructible tunnel solutions. This role involves managing multidisciplinary teams, interfacing with clients and authorities, and guiding projects from concept through construction and commissioning. ResponsibilitiesProvide overall technical leadership and management for tunnelling projects, including hydropower tunnels, metro tunnels, shafts, caverns, cross passages, and associated underground structures. Lead and review geotechnical and tunnel design activities, including ground characterization, rock mass classification, support philosophy, lining systems, and construction methodology selection. Oversee and approve design basis reports, calculations, drawings, and technical specifications, ensuring compliance with project requirements, international standards, and best industry practices. Guide the application and interpretation of advanced numerical modelling and analytical studies (FEA / FEM / FDM) for ground-structure interaction, construction staging, and risk-critical scenarios. Manage and coordinate multidisciplinary teams comprising geotechnical, structural, construction, and BIM engineers to achieve integrated and optimized tunnel designs. Lead geotechnical risk assessments, constructability reviews, and value engineering exercises, and develop mitigation measures for adverse ground conditions and geological uncertainties. Provide strategic input on tunnelling methods (TBM, NATM / SEM, drill and blast, cut-and-cover) and temporary works in consultation with construction teams and contractors. Act as the primary technical interface with clients, independent engineers, regulatory authorities, and stakeholders, supporting approvals, technical negotiations, and statutory clearances. Support construction-phase engineering, including design change management, review of method statements, site observations, and resolution of technical issues arising during execution. Mentor and develop junior and mid-level engineers, contributing to capability building, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement of tunnel engineering practices within the organization. QualificationsBachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or Geotechnical Engineering; Master's degree in Rock Mechanics, Tunnel Engineering, or Geotechnical Engineering is strongly preferred. Minimum 15 years of total professional experience, with at least 10 years of direct experience in Hydel and/or Metro tunnelling projects, preferably in urban and complex geological settings. Strong expertise in rock mechanics, tunnel support design, ground behaviour, and geotechnical risk management, particularly for long tunnels and deep underground works. Sound understanding of structural design principles for tunnel linings, caverns, shafts, portals, and underground stations. Proven experience in guiding and reviewing analyses using PLAXIS, FLAC, MIDAS GTS, RS2/RS3, SAP2000, or similar engineering software. Demonstrated ability to manage large design teams and multiple work fronts, while maintaining technical quality, programme, and budget objectives. Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder-management skills, with experience in client interactions, design reviews, and high-level technical presentations.

Accountable for the end-to-end architecture, engineering blueprint, deployment model, operational readiness, security, governance, and integration strategy of the client's enterprise AI systems, ensuring that AI solutions operate as secure, scalable, compliant, and business-aligned systems across models, applications, infrastructure, data, networks, and external dependencies. The core responsibilities for the job include the following: End-to-end AI system architecture: - Define the overall architecture of AI systems across models, agents, applications, data, APIs, infrastructure, and external services. - Establish architecture principles, reference architectures, and technology standards. - Define the technology selection principles and coding standards. - Define the architecture standards to be followed by individual AI products. - Ensure architecture supports scalability, resilience, performance, and maintainability. Infrastructure and deployment: - Define/approve the deployment architecture across cloud/on-premise/hybrid environments for both Maveric and client environments. - Define/approve requirements for Kubernetes, GPU infrastructure, storage, networking, and compute. - Establish/approve deployment, release, and rollback patterns for AI systems. - Define checklists and guidelines to ensure production-readiness of AI products. data.title: Senior HPC Cluster Engineer - AI, ML
data.description:
NVIDIA is a pioneer in accelerated computing, known for inventing the GPU and driving breakthroughs in gaming, computer graphics, high-performance computing, and artificial intelligence. Our technology powers everything from generative AI to autonomous systems, and we continue to shape the future of computing through innovation and collaboration. Within this mission, our team, Managed AI Superclusters (MARS) builds and scales the infrastructure, platforms, and tools that enable researchers and engineers to develop the next generation of AI/ML systems. By joining us, you'll help design solutions that power some of the world's most advanced computing workloads. 

NVIDIA is looking for a Senior AI/ML HPC Cluster Engineer to join our MARS team. You will provide leadership and strategic guidance on the management of large-scale HPC systems including the deployment of compute, networking, and storage. You will be working with a team of passionate and skilled engineers across NVIDIA that are continuously working to provide better tools to build and manage this infrastructure. Ideal candidate is strong in building and maintaining distributed clusters, driving improvements, and has the ability to understand researcher computing needs. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Provide leadership in systems administration and service delivery on our AI/HPC fleet by coordinating system upgrades, responding to incidents, and delivering reliability improvements. 
 - Collaborate closely with global teams to deliver a world class user experience in AI and HPC research. 
 - Own day-to-day operations of production AI/HPC clusters, ensuring system health, user satisfaction, and efficient resource utilization. 
 - Develop and improve our ecosystem around GPU-accelerated computing including developing scalable automation solutions. 
 - Build and maintain heterogeneous AI/ML clusters on-premises and in the cloud. 
 - Create and cultivate customer and cross-team relationships to meet user evolving user needs. 
 - Support our researchers to run their workloads including performance analysis and optimizations
 - Analyze and optimize cluster efficiency, job fragmentation, and GPU waste to meet internal SLA targets. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis and suggest corrective action Proactively find and fix issues before they occur. 
 - Lead SEV triage and postmortems for reliability incidents affecting users or infrastructure. 
 - Participate in on-call rotation and incident response for critical production GPU clusters. 

What We Need To See

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related field or equivalent experience

data.title: Systems Engineer, Infrastructure Solutions Architecture
data.description:
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Systems Engineer to join our Infrastructure Solutions Architecture team. This role is responsible for building and validating test environments across our enterprise operating systems, server platforms, and containerized workloads, ensuring the integrity, performance, and efficiency of the infrastructure that supports end-to-end production deployments. The ideal candidate is a hands-on builder with a proven ability to design and implement automation while provisioning and managing test environments. 

Responsibilities

- Build, configure, and maintain test environments across Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL 8/9/10), Windows Server (2019/2022/2025), and virtualized and containerized platforms. 
 - Author and maintain test automation and infrastructure provisioning using Python, Ansible, and Terraform, including reusable roles, modules, and CI-style test workflows. 
 - Stand up and operate containerized and orchestrated test workloads using Docker or Podman and Kubernetes or OpenShift. 
 - Perform firmware, BIOS/BMC, and OS patching and lifecycle activities on enterprise server hardware, including out-of-band management via iDRAC and iLO. 
 - Develop and maintain test plans, test cases, and documented methodologies; track and report results meticulously. 
 - Execute functional, integration, performance, and stress testing for backend infrastructure, analyzing results to identify variances and improvement areas. 
 - Troubleshoot issues encountered during testing using logs, telemetry, and systematic root-cause analysis. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to refine testing processes and support development and proof-of-concept cycles. 
 - Manage work through ServiceNow (incident and change) and Jira; stay current with platform roadmaps and testing practices. 

Knowledge And Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred. 
 - Relevant certifications (RHCSA/RHCE, Microsoft, or equivalent) are advantageous. 
 - 5+ years administering Linux (RHEL preferred) and Windows Server, including patching and upgrades at scale. 
 - 5+ years supporting standard enterprise server hardware (Dell, HPE, etc. ), including firmware and hardware lifecycle, with iDRAC/iLO out-of-band management experience. 
 - 2+ years of scripting and automation using Python and Ansible, with infrastructure-as-code experience in Terraform (Bash and PowerShell also valued). 
 - Hands-on experience with container runtimes (Docker or Podman) and orchestration (Kubernetes or OpenShift). 
 - Experience with VMware vSphere/ESXi virtualization. 
 - Proven experience authoring test automation, integration testing, and performance/stress testing for backend infrastructure. 
 - Experience with benchmarking and performance tools such as Phoronix Test Suite, SysBench, SPECint, and fio (storage I/O). 
 - Ability to manage multiple small-scale projects and test cycles simultaneously. 
 - Experience with Jira and ServiceNow for work and change tracking. 
 - Strong analytical skills with a focus on detail and accuracy; excellent written and verbal communication. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience working within a compliance-gated, hardened fleet (patch baselines, controlled change). 
 - Observability and telemetry exposure (for example Splunk). 
 - Experience building CI/CD-style workflows for infrastructure or test automation. 
 - Familiarity with GPU-optimized or AI/ML infrastructure testing (and associated benchmarking) where applicable. 
 - Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills; ability to work independently and as part of a team. 
 - Ability to adapt to changing technologies and learn new tools quickly; good organizational and prioritization skills.

data.title: Sr. Manager, Data Engineering
data.description:
Role Summary

We're looking for a Senior Manager to lead a blended AI engineering team building the agentic AI platform and the marketing solutions that run on top of it. This is a delivery-leadership role: you own the roadmap, execution, and quality bar for a team of platform engineers, applied-AI solutions builders, and data engineering - turning cutting-edge agentic AI into reliable, production systems that marketing and analytics teams depend on every day. 

You will operate at the intersection of platform and product: hardening the agentic infrastructure (LLM orchestration, retrieval, tool/MCP integration, deploys, reliability) while making sure the AI solutions built on it deliver real marketing outcomes. You'll grow the people on your team, set a high engineering bar, and partner across a global AI organization. 

What You'll Do

Platform & infrastructure

- Own delivery and reliability of the agentic AI platform: LLM orchestration, retrieval/RAG pipelines, tool and MCP integration, model routing, and evaluation. 
 - Drive engineering quality - test discipline, deployment safety, observability, cost and latency management - across everything the team ships. 
 - Set technical direction with your senior engineers; make the hard architecture calls and unblock the team (design-level involvement; not expected to write production code day-to-day). 

Applied AI solutions

- Lead the team that builds AI agents and workflows for marketing use cases (analytics, paid media, content-to-intent, executive reporting) on top of the platform. 
 - Ensure solutions are grounded in real business outcomes and adopted by stakeholders - not demos that stall. 
 - Balance platform investment against solution delivery so both advance. 

People leadership & delivery

- Manage, coach, and grow a blended team; run hiring to build out the function. 
 - Own the roadmap and quarterly planning; convert ambiguous priorities into committed, sequenced delivery. 
 - Represent the team's work to leadership and cross-functional partners; drive alignment across a globally distributed AI organization. 

The Team You'll Lead

A blended engineering team of: 

- Agentic AI / platform engineers - Python, LLM orchestration, RAG, MCP/tooling, cloud-native deploys. 
 - Applied-AI solutions builders - wiring AI to marketing and analytics use cases. 
 - Data engineering - the pipelines and semantic layer the AI grounds on. 

Must-Have Qualifications

- ~12+ years in software / AI/ML engineering, with 4+ years managing engineering teams (including hiring and growing engineers). 
 - Demonstrated depth in agentic AI / LLM systems - orchestration, retrieval/RAG, tool use, agent frameworks, and evaluation of AI quality. 
 - Track record of shipping production AI/ML systems at scale - reliability, deployment safety, cost/latency awareness - not just prototypes. 
 - Strong Python and modern cloud-native / containerized delivery. 
 - Ability to set a high engineering bar and make sound architecture decisions while leading primarily through the team. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management across a globally distributed organization. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Marketing technology or analytics domain experience - AEP / AJO / CJA, adtech, or digital marketing analytics. 
 - Experience with Databricks, vector databases (pgvector), graph stores (Neo4j), or similar data/AI infrastructure. 
 - Hands-on with agent/LLM frameworks and MCP, prompt/eval tooling, and LLM cost governance. 
 - Experience standing up or scaling a new AI engineering function. 

What Success Looks Like (First 6-12 Months)

- A team operating with a clear roadmap, predictable delivery, and a visibly higher quality/reliability bar. 
 - At least one AI solution moved from concept to in-production use, adopted by marketing/analytics stakeholders. 
 - Platform reliability, evaluation, and cost/observability practices established as the default, not the exception. 
 - Key hires made; team members growing and taking on larger scope. 

Leadership Behaviors

- Candor and clarity - lead with the bottom line, disagree openly, separate fact from guess, flag risks early. 
 - Ownership - own outcomes end-to-end, not just handoffs; the team ships things that work and says so honestly when they don't. 
 - Bar-raiser - hire people better than the current team and hold a high engineering standard. 

Builder's bias - move fast on real problems, cut scope ruthlessly, prefer working systems over polished plans. 

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe's industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity. 

Our 30, 000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We're on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours. 

Let's Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create. 

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more. 

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe. com. 

AI Use Guidelines for Interviews: 

Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process. 

At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI - and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it's restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

data.title: RCM Associate Manager - Quality
data.description:
Job Description Summary

The Associate Manager - Quality, RCM is responsible for leading, monitoring, and continuously improving the quality assurance function within Revenue Cycle Management operations. This is a people-plus-process leadership role that combines hands-on audit governance with team management, client engagement, and strategic quality improvement. 

You will serve as the primary quality ambassador between operations, clients, and senior leadership - ensuring compliance with payer guidelines, HIPAA regulations, and internal SOPs while driving performance excellence across all QA analysts. You will own the quality scorecard, shape audit strategy, and build a culture of accountability and continuous learning within your team. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Oversight & Governance

- Own and enforce quality benchmarks across all RCM functions - coding, billing, AR follow-up, denial management, and payment posting
 - Establish and maintain quality control checkpoints at each stage of the revenue cycle workflow
 - Ensure 100% alignment with CMS guidelines, payer-specific rules, client contractual obligations, and HIPAA/PHI regulations
 - Define and manage the monthly/quarterly audit plan, sampling strategies, and QA frameworks

Audit Management & Root Cause Analysis

- Oversee daily, weekly, and monthly transaction audits and calibration sessions across all RCM verticals
 - Drive root cause analysis (RCA) for all identified errors and ensure actionable corrective plans are documented and tracked
 - Maintain comprehensive audit trails and error logs for regulatory and client review
 - Identify recurring defect patterns and escalate critical findings to operations leadership with data-backed reports

Team Leadership & People Management

- Lead, mentor, coach, and manage a team of 20+ QA analysts, ensuring equitable workload distribution and professional growth
 - Facilitate regular team huddles, one-on-one feedback sessions, and calibration meetings to promote a quality-first culture
 - Identify skill gaps through error trend analysis and develop targeted coaching and upskilling plans
 - Act as the first point of escalation for QA analysts and provide real-time guidance and support
 - Participate in monthly/quarterly performance reviews for all QA team members in coordination with HR

Performance Management & Analytics

- Track, analyze, and report quality metrics including accuracy rates, defect rates, rework rates, and SLA adherence
 - Manage and implement corrective action plans (CAPs) for underperforming analysts and processes
 - Align team KPIs with organizational quality goals and report progress to senior leadership
 - Monitor Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) and drive year-on-year reduction targets

Process Improvement & Innovation

- Drive continuous improvement (CI) initiatives to reduce defects, rework, and COPQ using Lean/Six Sigma methodologies
 - Design and optimize QA workflows, sampling strategies, and feedback loop mechanisms
 - Collaborate with operations, IT, and training teams to implement process changes that improve first-pass accuracy rates
 - Evaluate and pilot quality improvement technologies (e. g. , AI-powered auditing tools, automation)

Client Engagement & Stakeholder Management

- Lead and participate in client quality calls, review meetings, and audits - presenting quality metrics, trends, and action plans
 - Manage and resolve client escalations related to quality issues within defined SLAs
 - Support client-specific onboarding by documenting payer rules, quality requirements, and SOPs
 - Build and maintain strong client relationships by ensuring consistent delivery of quality benchmarks

Reporting, Documentation & Compliance

- Prepare and share daily/weekly/monthly quality MIS reports, scorecards, and dashboards with leadership
 - Maintain up-to-date QA SOPs, error category definitions, calibration logs, and feedback templates
 - Design and deliver quality-related training modules for new joiners and refresher programs for existing staff
 - Stay current with payer policy changes and disseminate relevant updates to the quality and operations teams

What We're Looking For

Education & Experience

- Graduate in any discipline; additional certification in Medical Billing / Coding (CPC, CRC, CPMA) preferable
 - 9 - 11 years of experience in RCM operations with a minimum of 7 years in a Quality Analyst / Senior QA / Team Lead role
 - Proven track record of managing quality teams of 10+ members in a healthcare BPO/KPO environment

Domain Expertise

- In-depth knowledge of Billing , payment posting AR follow-up, denial management, and payer rules
 - Strong understanding of HIPAA, PHI, CMS guidelines, and payer-specific compliance requirements
 - Experience with EMR/PMS systems) and QA dashboards
 - Proficiency in MS Excel (advanced), data analysis, and MIS/dashboard reporting
 - Familiarity with Lean/Six Sigma methodologies or process improvement frameworks is a strong plus

Leadership & Soft Skills

- Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and drive performance improvements across teams
 - Excellent written and verbal communication for client interactions, presentations, and internal reporting
 - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving ability, and attention to detail
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet tight deadlines, and thrive in a fast-paced environment
 - Effective stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence without authority

Compensation for this job is subject to market conditions, geographic considerations, the candidate's unique skills and experience, state and local laws, and budget. Our commitment to pay transparency is a testament to our dedication to creating a fair, equitable, and inclusive workplace. By continuously analyzing market trends, staying abreast of changes in state laws, and making budgetary adjustments accordingly, we strive to ensure that our compensation practices reflect the value we place on our associates' unique contributions and support their professional growth. 

Enhancing Lives and Building Careers

Veradigm believes in empowering our associates with the tools and flexibility to bring the best version of themselves to work and to further their professional development. Together, we are In the Network. Interested in learning more?

The Veradigm Network is a dynamic, open community of solutions, external partners, and cutting-edge artificial intelligence technologies that provide advanced insights, technology, and data-driven solutions. Job Description Summary

The Engineering Manager is accountable for end-to-end delivery execution and people leadership for a cross-functional POD consisting of software engineers, quality engineers, and related technical contributors.  - Own sprint execution, delivery predictability, release readiness, and dependency management across the POD. 
 - Partner with Product Management to translate roadmap priorities into executable delivery plans.

 - Ensure operational excellence through monitoring of delivery KPIs including throughput, defect escape rate, cycle time, reliability, and team health metrics.

data.title: Lead Engineer - Process Engineering
data.description:
Within Nuclear New Build (NNB) engineering organization, the Lead Process Engineer holds full responsibility for the assigned Process Engineering scope, ensuring technical excellence, the quality of deliverables, and adherence to schedule and cost targets throughout the entire project lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities - Lead Process Engineer

As a Lead Process Engineer, you will play a central role in driving the technical execution of complex power generation projects. Your main responsibilities will include: 

Project & Contract Execution

- Represent the Process Engineering scope within the project team. 
 - Take over the project from the Tendering team, including review of the Division of Work, contract documentation, and risk log. 
 - Perform contract review, identify risks and opportunities, and propose technical deviations and clarifications to the Project Engineering Manager. 

Planning & Coordination

- Contribute to the development of the overall engineering schedule and manage the planning of Process Engineering activities. 
 - Support resource planning at both project and functional levels. 
 - Coordinate daily with other Lead Engineers (calculations, arrangement, mechanical equipment, piping & valves, electrical, etc. ). 
 - Ensure efficient communication across teams, functions, as well as with the partners and the client. 

Process Engineering Activities

- Lead and perform the following engineering tasks, supported by the team of Process engineers and internal experts: 
 - Process system design including P&IDs, System Design Manuals, control logic diagrams, management of mechanical/electrical/I&C interfaces. 
 - Nuclear safety, functional safety, and RAM (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability) studies. 
 - Manage mechanical and functional interfaces with customers and partners. 
 - Participate in technical meetings with clients and partners related to your scope. 
Quality & Compliance

- Ensure that all engineering deliverables meet contractual requirements, project standards, and internal Arabelle Solutions procedures. 
 - Guarantee timely, accurate and high‐quality information delivery to internal and external customers. 
 - Lead design reviews (mechanical process, process control, system layout), ensure timely closure of actions, manage design freeze, and apply design change processes. 

Testing, Construction Support & As-Built Documentation

- Coordinate and participate in Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) for the control system. 
 - Ensure quick processing of Non‐Conformity Reports and provide support to construction and commissioning teams on site. 
 - Coordinate and deliver the Process "as‐built" documentation, and collect and share lessons learned for continuous improvement. 

Reporting

- Report operationally to the Project Engineering Manager for all project-related matters (what, when). 
 - Report functionally to your Line Manager for all other topics (how, who). 

Candidate Profile

- Engineering degree in Energy Engineering, or Fluid Mechanics, Thermodynamics. 
 - 5 years of experience in Process & Control Engineering within the energy or better power generation sector. 
 - On‐site experience, ideally a minimum of 3 months. 
 - Knowledge of the nuclear or broader energy industry. 
 - Strong understanding of multidisciplinary aspects of power plant engineering, including equipment specifications, installation, and electrical design. 
 - Knowledge of water‐steam cycles and steam turbine and generator auxiliary systems used in power plants. 
 - Proficiency with standard office software tools (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc. ). 
 - Excellent communication skills in both French and English, written and spoken. 
 - Ability to plan, organize and co-ordinate well, delegate and supervise. 
 - Ability to lead, motivate and persuade their team members, enjoys personal contact. 
 - Is "Customer Focus" minded. 
 - Ability to solve conflicts. 
 - Ready and willing to take responsibility. 
 - Ready and willing to provide good service (effort, steadiness of performance, good resilience, self-motivation). 
 - Ready and willing to accept changes (learning capability, openness to innovations, flexibility, self- criticism). 
 - Intellectually alert (Reasoning power, comprehension, creativity). 
 - Willing to travel. 

Join us and work with global teams to support global customers ! At Arabelle Solutions, we have team members of more than 49 nationalities spread across 16 countries. 

At Arabelle Solutions, we know diversity makes teams and business stronger.

We are building the future of responsible AI at Amazon. We deliver privacy-first, accessible, and trustworthy AI experiences that millions of customers use daily. Lead multiple engineering teams building foundational systems and consumer-facing features that enable trustworthy AI experiences at scale, owning architectural decisions across privacy-preserving AI, responsible AI frameworks, and accessibility. 

Define and drive the technical strategy for privacy-preserving architectures including federated learning, differential privacy, and on-device processing that protect customer data while delivering high-quality experiences.

We are focused on scaling responsible AI infrastructure as agentic and multimodal capabilities grow. If you are excited about leading engineers who solve novel problems in AI safety and privacy while shaping industry standards, we would love to hear from you.

data.title: GLS Verification Engineer
data.description:
Company Description Core ASIC Inc is a customer-focused VLSI design and verification services company with operations in Bengaluru, India and Austin, Texas. The company delivers complete spec-to-silicon turnkey solutions, including firmware co-development, for custom semiconductor and IoT applications. Its silicon-proven platform solutions support IP design and verification, VIP development, SoC verification, and emulation services. Core ASIC emphasizes on-time delivery, strong client collaboration, and alignment with customer vision to improve time-to-market and return on investment. A dedicated team of engineering, technology, and domain experts works as a growth partner to clients across the product development lifecycle. 

Experience: 5-10 years

Key Skills

Gate Level Simulation, SDF Annotation, Timing Verification, Low Power Verification, Debugging, Verdi, VCS, Xcelium

Detailed Job Description

Execute gate-level simulations with and without SDF, perform timing validation, low-power checks, reset verification and debug GLS failures. Analyze setup/hold violations and work closely with STA, RTL and Physical Design teams to achieve sign-off. 

Role Description The GLS Verification Engineer is responsible for gate-level simulation and verification of complex digital designs, ensuring functional correctness, timing closure, and manufacturability. Day-to-day tasks include creating and executing GLS test plans, developing verification environments and testbenches, running regressions, analyzing waveforms, and debugging failures across RTL and gate-level netlists. The role involves close collaboration with RTL design, physical design, DFT, and validation teams to resolve issues, support sign-off, and improve verification methodologies. The engineer will also contribute to documentation, process improvements, and best practices for GLS and functional verification. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru and Hyderabad

Qualifications

- Strong experience in RTL Design and Functional Verification for complex digital ASIC/SoC projects. 
 - Proficiency in Debugging simulation failures, timing issues, and gate-level mismatches. 
 - Knowledge of Validation processes and methodologies for pre-silicon and post-silicon environments. 
 - Understanding of Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) or equivalent quality and reliability standards in semiconductor development. 
 - Hands-on experience with GLS flows, STA concepts, and EDA tools (e. g. , simulation, lint, formal verification). 
 - Familiarity with Verilog/SystemVerilog, scripting languages (such as Python, Perl, or TCL), and regression automation. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to collaborate in cross-functional engineering teams. 
 - Experience in VLSI design services or semiconductor product companies is an advantage.

data.title: Associate AI Python Engineer
data.description:
We are looking for an energetic and driven Associate Python AI Engineer to join our engineering team and contribute to the development of scalable, AI-powered applications and backend systems. In this role, you will work closely with senior engineers, AI/ML engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders to build production-ready Python applications, AI/LLM solutions, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud-native services. 

Title: Associate Python AI Engineer

Location: Remote

Shift Timing: 2-11PM

Job Type: Full-Time

Key Responsibilities: 

- Python Application Development: Design, develop, test, and maintain robust and scalable backend applications using Python and industry-standard development practices. 
 - AI & LLM Application Development: Contribute to the development of LLM-powered applications, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, document processing, and AI-driven workflows. 
 - Backend & API Development: Build and integrate secure, scalable APIs and backend services using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django. 
 - Database Development: Work with relational and NoSQL databases to design schemas, write efficient queries, manage data, and build reliable data-access layers. 
 - Data & ETL Engineering: Develop and maintain ETL/data-processing workflows, ensuring reliable ingestion, transformation, validation, and movement of data across systems. 
 - Asynchronous Processing: Implement background jobs and distributed task processing using technologies such as Celery and Redis. 
 - DSA & Problem Solving: Apply strong data structures and algorithmic thinking to develop efficient, optimized, and maintainable solutions. 
 - Cloud & Deployment: Develop and deploy applications on AWS/GCP, leveraging cloud services and following cloud-native engineering practices. 
 - Containerization: Containerize applications using Docker and contribute to reliable and repeatable deployment processes. 
 - CI/CD & Engineering Practices: Work with CI/CD pipelines to automate application testing, builds, deployments, and release processes. 
 - Code Quality & Collaboration: Write clean, modular, testable code; participate in code reviews; troubleshoot production issues; and collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams. 
 - Continuous Learning: Stay current with emerging developments in Generative AI, LLMs, AI agent frameworks, backend engineering, cloud technologies, and distributed systems

Non-Negotiable Skills: 

- Python: Strong understanding of Python fundamentals, OOP, exception handling, modules, packages, and writing clean, maintainable production-quality code. 
 - Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA): Strong problem-solving ability with a good understanding of arrays, strings, hash maps, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, sorting, searching, and algorithmic complexity. 
 - SQL: Strong understanding of SQL, including joins, subqueries, aggregations, indexing, transactions, and query optimization. 
 - AlloyDB & Firestore: Understanding of relational and NoSQL database concepts with hands-on experience in AlloyDB and/or Firestore preferred. 
 - FastAPI / Flask / Django: Experience building REST APIs and backend services using at least one modern Python web framework. 
 - LLM & RAG: Understanding of Large Language Models, RAG architecture, embeddings, document processing, and vector search. 
 - Celery & Redis: Understanding of asynchronous/background task processing, caching, queues, and distributed application patterns using Celery and Redis. 
 - ETL Design: Understanding of data ingestion, transformation, validation, processing, and pipeline design. 
 - Docker: Ability to containerize Python applications and understand fundamental Docker concepts such as images, containers, networking, and volumes. 
 - CI/CD: Understanding of continuous integration and continuous deployment concepts, automated testing, build pipelines, and deployment workflows. 
 - Cloud - AWS/GCP: Familiarity with cloud computing concepts and hands-on exposure to deploying or operating applications on AWS or GCP. 
 - Git: Strong understanding of Git, including branching, merging, pull requests, conflict resolution, and collaborative development workflows. 
 - AI Agents: Exposure to AI agents, tool calling, agent orchestration, memory, and multi-agent workflows. 
 - Vector Databases: Hands-on experience with vector databases or vector search technologies such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Milvus, or equivalent. 
 - Cloud AI Services: Exposure to AI/ML services offered by AWS or GCP is an added advantage. 

Negotiable Skills: 

- LangChain: Experience building LLM-powered applications and workflows using LangChain. 
 - LangGraph: Understanding of graph-based AI workflows, stateful agent orchestration, and multi-step LLM applications using LangGraph. 
 - Kubernetes: Basic understanding of Kubernetes concepts including pods, deployments, services, configuration, and container orchestration. 

About Techolution: 

Techolution is the world's #1 AI Acceleration Partner and the inventor of BPA 4. 0, the groundbreaking AI platform that delivers guaranteed ROI from enterprise AI in 30 days or less. 

With over 10+ years of experience, we specialize in turning AI into measurable business value-helping global enterprises achieve dramatic efficiency gains (like 42x improvements in key processes), modernize legacy systems, migrate to the cloud (as a Google Premier Partner), and deploy custom AI solutions across industries such as healthcare, manufacturing, media, banking, government, and life sciences. 

Our mission is simple yet powerful: "TURN AI INTO ROI" - where it matters most. We go beyond generic AI by offering risk-free innovation, including our 100k Challenge (2x quantifiable savings in 100 days or your money back), rapid diagnostics via BPA Value Finder, and AI-powered managed services that deliver twice the quality at half the cost. 

Backed by 12 patents, 5 notable awards (including Inc. 5000 recognition), 2 published books, and a track record of solving real-world challenges-from patient prioritization during COVID-19 to quality control in supply chains and air quality monitoring-we empower teams to thrive in an AI-driven future. 

At Techolution, we're building "innovation done right" with a passionate, collaborative team focused on delivering next-level impact, workforce enablement, and trustworthy, enterprise-scale automation. Join us to be part of redefining how businesses operate with AI. . 

Let's explore further!

Uncover our unique AI accelerators with us: 

1. Enterprise LLM Studio: Our no-code DIY AI studio for enterprises. Choose an LLM, connect it to your data, and create an expert-level agent in 20 minutes. 

2. AppMod. AI: Modernizes ancient tech stacks quickly, achieving over 80% autonomy for major brands!

3. ComputerVision. AI: Our ComputerVision. AI Offers customizable Computer Vision and Audio AI models, plus DIY tools and a Real-Time Co-Pilot for human-AI collaboration!

data.title: Quality Assurance Manager (Python and selenium)
data.description:
We are looking for a QA Manager to own the QA function across Arcitech's product portfolio. This is the senior-most QA seat in the organization. You will set QA strategy across products, manage a team of 8-12 QA engineers (including the QA Lead who owns hands-on senior QA beneath you), run QA across 7-8 concurrent projects, and be the QA counterpart to product and engineering leadership. Reporting directly to the CEO, you are accountable for the release-readiness of everything Arcitech ships. 

This is a management role, not primarily a hands-on IC role. You are the strategist, the reviewer, and the leader of the function. Hands-on senior QA - designing frameworks, running performance tests, writing critical automation - sits with the QA Lead beneath you; your job is to set direction, hold the bar, grow the team, and represent QA at the leadership table. That said, on the hardest technical problems and the highest-risk releases, you will still be hands-on - particularly on new-product launches and cross-product testing initiatives. Prior experience running QA at a SaaS / IT product company is non-negotiable. Prior experience genuinely managing a QA team of 8+ is non-negotiable. This is a role for someone who has already done this work before, not someone stepping up into it for the first time. 

You will report directly to the CEO. 

Key Responsibilities

QA Strategy & Direction

• Own the QA vision and strategy across the SaaS portfolio. 

• Define what gets tested manually, what gets automated, and what needs performance testing - per product, per release. 

• Own release-readiness decisions in partnership with product and engineering leadership. 

• Set priorities across 7-8 concurrent projects; make trade-offs on coverage vs speed explicit. 

Team Management

• Manage a team of 8-12 QA engineers, including the QA Lead as your direct report. 

• Set clear expectations, run 1: 1s and reviews, and own performance conversations end-to-end. 

• Grow the team's technical depth in manual, Python + Selenium automation, and performance testing. 

• Own hiring for the QA team - who joins, at what level, and how they ramp up. 

• Develop the QA Lead specifically as a senior report with their own career growth needs. 

Quality Bar & Review

• Define and hold the QA quality bar across the whole function. 

• Review the QA Lead's work and the wider team's work on strategic / high-stakes releases; catch issues before ship. 

• Own QA process, documentation, and best practices across the SaaS portfolio. 

• Set the standard through your own review - not by out-executing the Lead. 

Cross-Team Leadership & Business Communication

• Partner with engineering and product leadership on release scope, quality trade-offs, and CI/CD integration. 

• Represent QA to the CEO and leadership clearly - what's shipping, what's at risk, what needs decisions. 

• Communicate quality risks in business terms, not QA jargon - impact, likelihood, mitigation, cost. 

• Coordinate with DevOps on CI/CD integration of automated tests across products. 

Hands-On QA (Selective)

• Personally own the hardest technical problems on high-risk releases when it matters. 

• Design or review critical automation frameworks and performance test strategies for new-product launches. 

• Delegate day-to-day execution to the Lead and the team - stay in strategy and review mode by default. 

Required Skills & Experience

• Experience: 6+ years in QA, with at least 3 years in a QA management role

• Team management (must-have, non-negotiable): proven experience managing a QA team of

8+, including at least 2+ years directly leading a team - real people-management with 1: 1s, 

reviews, hiring, and performance calls; not just informal mentoring

• SaaS / IT product background (must-have, non-negotiable): prior QA leadership at a

technology / SaaS / IT product company

• Manual QA depth (must-have): 6+ years of hands-on manual QA experience - deep, thorough

process across test planning, execution, defect management, no shortcuts

• Automation (must-have): 3+ years minimum, hands-on Python + Selenium (not Java). Real

frameworks you have built and led teams to build. 

• Performance testing (must-have): hands-on with performance / load testing tools (JMeter, 

Locust, K6, or similar); can design, run, analyze

• QA strategy (must-have): genuine experience setting QA direction across multiple products or

product lines

• Multi-project (must-have): proven ability to run QA across 7-8 concurrent projects without

dropping quality

• CI/CD integration: hands-on with CI/CD integration of QA (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI); 

driven CI adoption at team level

• Communication: clear, senior communicator; can represent QA to the CEO and cross-functional

leadership

Nice to Have

• API testing depth (Postman, REST Assured with Python). 

• SQL / database validation experience. 

• Experience testing AI-driven products or non-deterministic outputs. 

• Exposure to security-testing basics. 

• Prior experience defining or scaling a QA function from small to mid-size. 

• Experience with observability / monitoring integration for post-release quality signal. 

The Ideal Candidate

• Has genuinely managed a QA team of 8+, and can point to what specifically improved under their

leadership. 

• Has worked inside a technology / SaaS / IT product company for a meaningful part of their career. 

• Is strong across all three testing disciplines - manual, automation, and performance - not just

one. 

• Can balance strategy, review, team management, and selective hands-on work. 

• Communicates well with the CEO and leadership; represents QA as a business function, not a

purely technical one. 

• Runs a QA function with process and craft, not chaos and heroics.

Job Details

Description

About Archer

A new regulatory change lands somewhere in the world every six minutes, and agentic AI is outpacing most teams' ability to govern it. At Archer, we help the enterprises powering the global economy turn that pressure into an advantage. 

Mandates like the EU AI Act and the SEC cybersecurity disclosure rules are driving the most significant GRC buying cycle we have seen in years. That demand is why we are growing this team. 

This is hard work that matters. Our customers span energy, utilities, financial services, pharmaceuticals, and the public institutions communities depend on. People choose Archer because they get to partner with the most trusted brands in the world, on work that protects the customers and communities those brands serve. 

If that sounds like your kind of work, let's chat. 

The Role

Quality is not something we inspect at the end of a release; it's something we build into every stage of engineering. As a Senior Quality Engineer, you will be responsible for elevating product quality through intelligent test strategies, automation, continuous validation, performance engineering, and close partnership with engineering and product teams. You'll help teams identify risks early, find defects quickly, and ensure every release meets high standards for functionality, performance, security, and reliability. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of quality engineering by leveraging modern CI/CD practices, AI-powered engineering tools, and data-driven decision making while collaborating with globally distributed teams

- Name the team, key stakeholders this person will work with, who they report to and the one or two main areas of ownership. 

What You'll Do

Quality Strategy & Risk-Based Testing

data.description:
About Refold AI

Refold AI has raised $6. 5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital. 

About this role

The SAP Architect is Refold's resident SAP expert who owns the architecture for our hardest enterprise SAP problems. You've spent years working with SAP ecosystems, understand SAP architecture and enterprise processes inside out, and have a deep, hands-on command of SAP systems, data models, APIs, and how SAP connects with the broader enterprise technology landscape. You set the technical approach where there's no playbook and serve as the primary technical point of contact for enterprise accounts on SAP architecture and implementations. 

- Team: Senior technical IC role within the delivery org, owning SAP architecture and enterprise implementations. 
 - Building: Mission-critical agentic AI integrations involving complex SAP environments at enterprise scale - the problems for which no playbook exists yet. 
 - You'll work with: CTOs, CIOs, VPs of Engineering, SAP leaders, and enterprise architecture teams at Fortune 500 enterprises and $50M+ ARR software companies. 

What you'll do: 

- Own the architecture for the hardest SAP problems. Design complex, mission-critical solutions involving SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP BTP, and other enterprise systems, addressing complex business processes, data flows, and cross-system dependencies, especially where no playbook exists yet. 
 - Be the technical POC for enterprise accounts. Serve as the senior SAP technical voice enterprise customers trust and the technical owner of their most important SAP architecture and implementation initiatives. 
 - Make the decisive technical calls. Own the hard decisions on SAP system architecture, data modelling, integration patterns, extensibility, agentic orchestration, authentication, error handling, and performance under real enterprise load. 
 - Speak credibly to enterprise security. Be the trusted technical voice with customers' security and compliance teams on SAP security models, role-based access controls, SSO, VPC, mTLS, and our SOC 2 Type II / ISO 27001 / ISO 42001 / HIPAA posture. 
 - Shape product direction. Be the most credible field voice in the room. Translate patterns observed across SAP implementations, customer accounts, and deals into identified gaps, reference architectures, and durable product bets, partnering directly with Product and Engineering on the roadmap. 
 - Codify what works. Turn hard-won learnings into SAP reference architectures, implementation patterns, solution blueprints, and runbooks that scale across the delivery team and feed the support knowledge base. 
 - Bring architecture expertise to high-stakes deals. Partner with pre-sales on the prospects where getting the SAP technical approach right is what wins, leading architecture reviews, solution design discussions, and technical deep dives. 

What we're looking for: 

- 6-10 years of experience in SAP architecture, SAP technical consulting, or enterprise solutions architecture, with a substantial, demonstrable background in designing and delivering complex SAP solutions. 
 - Mandatory hands-on SAP experience with enterprise SAP environments, including SAP S/4HANA and/or SAP ECC, and a strong understanding of SAP architecture, implementation approaches, and enterprise business processes. 
 - Excellent, deep understanding of SAP integration capabilities and technologies, including SAP BTP Integration Suite, SAP APIs, OData, IDocs, RFCs, BAPIs, and relevant integration patterns. 
 - A deep technical problem-solver who designs solutions from first principles for problems that have no established answer. 
 - Deep expertise in SAP solution architecture, SAP data models, enterprise application landscapes, and modern cloud infrastructure. 
 - Strong technical communication; credible as the senior technical voice with CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, SAP leaders, and enterprise architects. 
 - Startup-grade agency, high ownership, low ego, comfortable building the playbook as you go. 

Nice to have: 

- Hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic frameworks (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, agent orchestration). 
 - Prior principal/staff SAP architect, lead SAP technical consultant, enterprise solutions architect, or founding solutions engineer role at a high-growth enterprise startup.

data.title: Principal Engineer (Warehouse Engineering)
data.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. 

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come - and return - to Quince because they trust us to deliver. 

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way - at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before. 

- We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose - soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price - we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. 
 - Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
 - Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you. 

THE ROLE

Principal Engineer : Warehouse Engineering

We're looking for a Principal Engineer : Warehouse Engineering to define the technical vision and architecture for Quince's warehouse technology ecosystem. You will build the platforms that power inventory movement, fulfillment execution, warehouse operations, and returns across a rapidly scaling supply chain network. 

In this role, you will lead the architecture of Quince's warehouse integration platform, proprietary Warehouse Management System (WMS), and returns platform. You will solve complex problems across warehouse operations, logistics, inventory, and fulfillment while establishing scalable technical foundations for the future. 

This role requires a strong combination of distributed systems expertise, operational platform experience, and technical leadership. You will influence architecture across multiple engineering teams, mentor senior engineers, partner with business and operations leaders, and help shape how Quince builds technology for a highly complex and rapidly evolving supply chain. 

Responsibilities

Warehouse Integration Platform

- Architect and build a standardized integration platform connecting Quince with third-party warehouse operators and WMS platforms. 
 - Define integration contracts, APIs, data models, and engineering standards that minimize bespoke development for new warehouse partners. 
 - Build scalable mechanisms for monitoring, reconciliation, error handling, and operational visibility across warehouse integrations. 
 - Establish platform capabilities that simplify warehouse onboarding and improve reliability across the warehouse network. 

Warehouse Management System

- Define the architecture and technical strategy for Quince's proprietary Warehouse Management System. 
 - Build systems supporting inbound, outbound, inventory, fulfillment, and warehouse execution workflows. 
 - Design the platform to support both Quince-operated facilities and third-party warehouse operators. 
 - Establish scalable multi-tenant architecture, including data isolation, configuration management, access controls, and extensibility. 
 - Define architectural patterns that allow the WMS to evolve into a scalable platform for external warehouse operators. 

Returns & Reverse Logistics

- Drive the architecture and evolution of Quince's end-to-end returns platform. 
 - Design systems supporting return intake, inventory reconciliation, restocking, refurbishment, replenishment, and disposition. 
 - Build operational capabilities that provide visibility into reverse logistics workflows and enable efficient throughput. 
 - Ensure returns systems meet high standards for reliability, scalability, observability, and data integrity. 

AI-Native Engineering

- Drive the adoption of AI-native engineering practices across warehouse technology. 
 - Identify opportunities to apply AI to exception management, warehouse operations, workflow automation, and operational decision-making. 
 - Partner with Data Science and Operations Research teams to productionize AI and optimization models within warehouse systems. 
 - Establish reliable architecture patterns for integrating AI capabilities into operational workflows while maintaining correctness and reliability. 

Technical Leadership

- Define the long-term technical vision, architecture principles, and roadmap for warehouse engineering. 
 - Lead architecture reviews and provide technical direction across warehouse, logistics, supply chain, and platform teams. 
 - Establish engineering standards around scalability, reliability, observability, data integrity, and operational excellence. 
 - Identify architectural risks, technical debt, and systemic opportunities across warehouse technology. 
 - Make high-impact technical decisions while balancing immediate business needs with long-term platform scalability. 

Organizational Impact

- Mentor senior and staff engineers and raise the technical bar across the engineering organization. 
 - Partner closely with warehouse operations, logistics, product, and business stakeholders to translate operational challenges into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Influence technical strategy across multiple teams and domains without relying solely on organizational authority. 
 - Contribute to hiring, talent development, and building a high-performing engineering organization. 
 - Represent warehouse engineering in broader technical and organizational initiatives. 

Qualifications

Required: 

- 12+ years of software engineering experience building large-scale operational, supply chain, logistics, warehouse, or similar systems. 
 - Proven experience architecting and scaling distributed systems and event-driven architectures in production. 
 - Deep expertise in designing highly reliable systems where data integrity, consistency, and operational correctness are critical. 
 - Experience designing integration platforms and replacing bespoke integrations with standardized, scalable frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of multi-tenant architecture, data isolation, API design, configuration management, and platform extensibility. 
 - Experience setting technical direction across multiple engineering teams or business domains. 
 - Strong understanding of inventory management, fulfillment workflows, and operational system design. 
 - Experience balancing scalability, performance, reliability, observability, and operational complexity. 
 - Strong technical communication skills with the ability to influence senior engineering and business stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers and drive engineering excellence across teams. 
 - Experience working with AI-enabled development workflows and/or integrating AI capabilities into production systems. 
 - Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with significant ambiguity and ownership. 

Preferred: 

- Direct experience designing or building Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) at scale. 
 - Experience working with commercial WMS platforms and understanding the trade-offs between vendor solutions and custom-built systems. 
 - Experience with reverse logistics, inventory condition management, refurbishment, and disposition workflows. 
 - Experience in e-commerce fulfillment, 3PL operations, retail, logistics, or large-scale warehouse networks. 
 - Strong understanding of warehouse automation, inventory accuracy, fulfillment optimization, or operational planning systems. 
 - Experience building multi-tenant SaaS platforms serving external customers, operators, or partners. 
 - Experience partnering with Data Science or Operations Research teams to productionize optimization and decision-making models. 
 - Experience in high-growth, technology-first organizations with highly autonomous engineering teams. 

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike. 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis. 

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. 

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom-never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.
