data.title: Senior Lead, AI Data Engineer
data.description:
About Amplify Health

Who We Are

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain. 

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam. 

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies-with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems. 

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health's health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company's technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards. 

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security. 

Our Vision and Ambition

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery. 

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals' lifestyle/ behavioural choices. 

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia's strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools. 

The Position

Role Overview

As Senior Lead, AI Data Engineering, you will lead multiple teams and projects that deliver data and AI solutions on Azure and Databricks, and act as a trusted technical advisor to clients and senior stakeholders. You stay hands-on, shaping architectures, building reference implementations and reviewing critical code, while setting the technical direction, delivery standards and talent strategy for AI data engineering. Your job is to turn AI ambition into governed, measurable outcomes: help clients choose the right use cases, design the data foundations to support them, and make sure they run reliably and responsibly at scale. 

Role at a Glance

- Experience: 12+ years in data engineering or data architecture, including 4+ years leading multiple teams and 3+ years delivering AI/ML or GenAI solutions
 - Team leadership: Leads multiple teams or pods (typically 8 to 20 engineers, including lead engineers); line-manages leads and senior engineers
 - Project scope: Accountable for multiple concurrent projects or programmes (typically 3 or more)
 - Stakeholder / client exposure: Client-facing trusted advisor; leads technical solutioning, pre-sales and executive engagement
 - Hands-on expectation: About 30 to 50% hands-on (architecture, reference implementations, critical code and reviews, proofs of concept)

Responsibilities

Strategy and architecture

- Define the AI data engineering vision, reference architectures and reusable accelerators (for example, RAG ingestion frameworks, evaluation harnesses, MCP / agent data-access patterns and governance templates) used across projects. 
 - Act as design authority across projects: review and approve solution architectures, key trade-offs and non-functional requirements (security, scalability, cost, resilience, disaster recovery). 
 - Maintain a technology radar for data and AI (lakehouse, agentic AI, evaluation, AI gateways, open table formats) and lead structured evaluations of new platforms and vendors. 
 - Stay hands-on: build reference implementations and proofs of concept, lead reviews of critical production incidents, and review high-risk code and designs. 

Client and business engagement

- Serve as the senior technical counterpart for clients and business executives: shape AI and data roadmaps and prioritise use cases by value, feasibility and risk. 
 - Lead technical solutioning for pre-sales, proposals and statements of work: scope, architecture, estimates, assumptions, client dependencies and risks. 
 - Present to executive and board-level audiences, translating technical choices into business impact, risk and cost. 
 - Build long-term client relationships and identify opportunities to expand and improve engagements. 

Delivery leadership

- Oversee delivery of multiple concurrent projects, ensuring quality, timelines, budget and margin, and resolving escalations. 
 - Establish delivery governance: architecture reviews, AI release gates (evaluation thresholds, red-teaming, guardrails), production-readiness reviews and post-incident reviews. 
 - Drive FinOps for data and AI: forecast, optimise and report platform, GPU and token costs. 

Governance, risk and responsible AI

- Own responsible-AI and AI-risk practices across the portfolio, aligned with frameworks such as the NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, Singapore's Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI and the EU AI Act where applicable. 
 - Work with legal, compliance, data protection and security teams on AI risk assessments, data residency, consent, auditability and the limits of agent autonomy. 
 - Ensure sensitive data, including health and personal data, is protected by design across every solution. 

People and capability leadership

- Lead, manage and develop multiple teams, including lead engineers: set goals, run performance reviews and plan succession. 
 - Own the skills framework and learning roadmap for AI data engineering: identify skill gaps, sponsor certifications and run communities of practice. 
 - Lead hiring strategy and team design (pod structure, skill mix, location mix). 
 - Set the standard and policy for AI-assisted and agentic engineering across teams, balancing productivity with quality, security and IP protection. 
 - Build a culture of engineering excellence, psychological safety, learning and innovation. 

Candidate Profile

Required Qualifications

- 12+ years in data engineering or data architecture, with 4+ years leading multiple teams or a practice of 8+ engineers, including leads. 
 - Expert, current hands-on skills in Python, PySpark and SQL, Azure and Databricks lakehouse engineering, and distributed system design. 
 - A track record of delivering multiple GenAI / ML solutions to production at enterprise scale, including RAG or agentic systems, evaluation frameworks and LLMOps. 
 - Deep data and AI architecture expertise: lakehouse, streaming, unstructured data, vector retrieval, semantic layers, model serving, AI gateways and MCP-based agent integration. 
 - Strong grounding in data governance, privacy, security and responsible AI in regulated environments. 
 - Proven client-facing experience: pre-sales solutioning, estimation, statement-of-work inputs, executive presentations and managing client expectations. 
 - Experience managing multi-project delivery, budgets and risks. 
 - Proven people leadership: hiring, performance management, coaching leads and building learning programmes. 
 - Exceptional communication and influencing skills with technical, business and executive audiences. 

Technology stack: Primary stack (Azure + Databricks)

- Cloud & storage: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Event Hubs, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Microsoft Fabric / OneLake
 - Lakehouse & processing: Azure Databricks: Delta Lake, Lakeflow (Connect, Spark Declarative Pipelines, Jobs), Structured Streaming, Photon, serverless compute
 - Governance & catalog: Unity Catalog (lineage, tags, ABAC, row/column security), Microsoft Purview
 - AI, retrieval & agents: Databricks Vector Search, Model Serving, Agent Bricks, Lakebase; Azure AI Search; Microsoft Foundry (Azure OpenAI and other models, Agent Service); Azure AI Document Intelligence
 - MLOps / LLMOps: MLflow 3 (tracking, tracing, evaluation, prompt registry), Feature Store, Unity AI Gateway, inference tables
 - Engineering & DevOps: Python, PySpark, SQL, Git, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, Terraform / Bicep, Databricks Asset Bundles, Docker
 - AI-assisted engineering: GitHub Copilot, Databricks Genie Code / Assistant

Nice to have

- Industry depth in healthcare, insurance or financial services; familiarity with data standards such as HL7 FHIR and regional privacy regulations (for example, PDPA, PDPO, HIPAA, GDPR). 
 - Experience setting up AI governance (AI system inventory, risk tiering, model and agent registers) or an AI centre of excellence. 
 - Multi-cloud (AWS, GCP) experience and Snowflake or Microsoft Fabric interoperability. 
 - Thought leadership: talks, publications, open-source contributions or partner advisory boards. 
 - Consulting, product management or business qualifications (for example, an MBA). 

Preferred certifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305). 
 - Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional and Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate. 
 - IAPP Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional (AIGP) or ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer (desirable). 
 - TOGAF or an equivalent architecture certification (optional). 

How you lead

- Trusted advisor: clients and executives seek your view because you are candid about value, risk and trade-offs. 
 - Multiplier: you raise the capability of every team through standards, reusable assets and coaching of leads. 
 - Hands-on credibility: you can still go deep on architecture and code when it matters. 
 - Accountability: you own outcomes across the portfolio, including responsible and secure use of AI. 

How success is measured

- Portfolio delivery: projects delivered on scope, quality, timeline and budget, with no unmanaged critical risks. 
 - Client outcomes: client satisfaction, renewals and expansions, and AI use cases moved from pilot to production with measured business value. 
 - Reusable assets: accelerators and reference architectures adopted across projects, reducing delivery time and cost. 
 - Responsible AI: all AI solutions pass release gates and governance reviews, with no material data or AI incidents. 
 - People: engaged teams, leads developed and promoted, and strong growth in skills and certifications. 
 - Thought leadership: active communities of practice and external talks or publications. 

Join Us

If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply. 

Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Director Of Engineering, Financials & Grantmaking

We are seeking a Director of Engineering to lead the global Financials & Grantmaking engineering organization at Blackbaud. This leader develops strong engineering managers, balances modernization with dependable support of the systems of record our customers rely on, uses AI to accelerate delivery and raise quality, and holds the organization to a high bar for technical excellence and operational reliability. 

About The Team

Financials & Grantmaking builds Financial Edge NXT, Blackbaud's cloud fund accounting solution for nonprofits, and Blackbaud Grantmaking, used by foundations and corporate grantmakers to manage the grant lifecycle. This organization comprises approximately 70 engineers across globally distributed teams in the United States and India, including both employees and contractors. Teams plan and deliver on a SAFe cadence. This role collaborates with leaders across Product Management, PMO, and other cross-functional teams to drive successful outcomes. This team plays a critical role in shaping the future of our solutions, balancing innovation through AI-enabled capabilities with the ongoing modernization and evolution of existing products, all while delivering value to our customers. 

What You'll Do

- Build, mentor, and inspire diverse, high-performing engineering teams and leaders across application development, fostering an inclusive environment where individuals thrive and grow. 
 - Cultivate a culture of continuous learning and innovation - leveraging AI to accelerate delivery and improve quality, and encouraging the team to actively experiment with emerging capabilities as they evolve to enhance product capabilities and operational efficiency. 
 - Shape and execute technical strategy in close partnership with Product Management, Enterprise Architecture, and other key stakeholders, aligning technology roadmaps with business priorities and adapting to evolving industry practices. 
 - Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery by guiding teams to plan with clarity, mitigate risks early, and experiment responsibly, while fostering clear accountability for commitments. 
 - Own end-to-end delivery from development through operations, embedding security, reliability, and automation, and serve as the engineering escalation point for production-impacting incidents and key customer events.

What You'll Bring

- 15+ years of relevant professional experience, including 10+ years in engineering leadership roles and direct experience managing managers. 
 - 7+ years delivering SaaS solutions at scale, with proven expertise in end-to-end delivery from development through operations meeting customer expectations and operational SLAs.

Предлагаме цялостен пакет от възнаграждения и придобивки, създаден да остане конкурентен на пазара, да подкрепя вашето благосъстояние и да признава приноса ви към нашия успех. data.title: Manager-Mechanical
data.description:
Responsibilities

- Lead preventive, predictive, breakdown, and shutdown maintenance activities of Coal Handling Plant (CHP) equipment. 
 - Ensure uninterrupted coal unloading, conveying, crushing, stacking, reclaiming, and bunker feeding operations to support generation requirements. 
 - Maintain and improve reliability of conveyors, crushers, screens, stacker reclaimers, paddle feeders, plough feeders, trippers, vibrating feeders, and associated equipment. 
 - Monitor CHP equipment health and implement reliability improvement initiatives to reduce forced outages and recurring failures. 
 - Plan and execute annual shutdowns, overhauls, major maintenance activities, and capital repair jobs. 
 - Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for equipment failures and implement corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Drive condition monitoring programs including vibration analysis, thermography, lubrication management, and predictive maintenance practices. 
 - Coordinate with Operations, Electrical, C&I, Boiler, and Fuel Management teams to ensure seamless coal handling operations. 
 - Monitor coal feeding systems, bunkering operations, and conveyor availability to meet generation targets. 
 - Optimize maintenance costs, spare consumption, inventory levels, and contractor productivity. 
 - Ensure effective management of critical spares, conveyor belts, gearboxes, pulleys, idlers, motors, couplings, and crusher components. 
 - Supervise contractors, service providers, and maintenance teams to ensure safe and quality execution of maintenance activities. 
 - Ensure strict compliance with safety standards, fire protection requirements, dust suppression systems, PTW procedures, and statutory regulations. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on equipment availability, MTBF improvement, and reduction in coal handling losses. 
 - Develop and mentor maintenance teams through technical training, performance management, and succession planning. 

Qualifications

Educational Qualification

Mandatory

- B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering

Preferred

- M. Tech in Mechanical Engineering
 - MBA (Operations) will be an added advantage

Mandatory Experience

Experience Requirements (Must Have)

- 12-18 years of experience in Mechanical Maintenance. 
 - Minimum 7 years of hands-on experience in Coal Handling Plant (CHP) Maintenance. 
 - Experience in Thermal Power Plants or Large Captive Power Plants. 
 - Experience in maintenance of coal conveying and material handling systems. 
 - Exposure to utility-scale power plants of 300 MW and above. 
 - Experience handling shutdowns, overhauls, and reliability improvement programs. 
 - Experience managing maintenance teams, contractors, and OEMs. 
 - Working knowledge of SAP PM or equivalent CMMS systems. 

Non-Negotiable Requirements

- B. E. /B. Tech Mechanical Engineering. 
 - 12-18 years of relevant experience.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we are building the future of cloud for enterprises with the agility of a startup and the scale of a global enterprise leader. Compute is one of OCI's foundational organizations, responsible for delivering the core infrastructure powering Virtual Machines (VMs) and Bare Metal (BM) services. 

As an OCI Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you will work closely with development and product teams in a shared full-stack ownership model across multiple services and technology domains. You will develop deep expertise in service architecture, dependencies, configurations, and operational behavior across large-scale production environments. 

You will be responsible for improving the reliability, scalability, performance, and operational efficiency of OCI Compute services. The role includes handling critical customer incidents, supporting deployments, performing validation and operational testing, troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, conducting root cause analysis (RCA), and driving service reliability improvements. 

You will act as a key escalation point for complex production issues, leveraging strong knowledge of distributed systems, service topology, and infrastructure dependencies to identify mitigations and restore service health while partnering with development teams to meet SLA commitments. 

The role also involves leveraging AIOps and intelligent automation to enhance monitoring, anomaly detection, event correlation, predictive alerting, RCA, and remediation workflows. Using observability platforms, telemetry analytics, and automation frameworks, you will help reduce operational toil, improve incident response, and enhance overall service reliability. 

This is an opportunity to combine deep technical expertise with operational excellence to solve complex cloud infrastructure challenges at massive scale within Oracle's next-generation cloud platform. 

Responsibilities

Job Responsibilities

- Improve the reliability, scalability, performance, and operational efficiency of assigned OCI Compute services and components. 
 - Investigate and resolve complex production incidents; contribute to mitigation, recovery, RCA, and follow-up actions. 
 - Own and improve service-level KPIs, SLOs, dashboards, alerting, deployment validation, and operational procedures for assigned systems. 
 - Build automation and tooling to reduce operational toil and improve production safety. 
 - Partner with development and infrastructure teams on service architecture, deployment, configuration, and reliability improvements. 
 - Use observability, telemetry, event correlation, and AIOps capabilities to improve detection, diagnosis, and incident response. 
 - Support upgrades, migrations, patching, capacity planning, performance tuning, and production rollouts. 
 - Troubleshoot distributed-system issues by analyzing service topology, dependencies, configuration, and failure modes. 
 - Contribute to incident-management practices, operational readiness, and service ownership improvements. 
 - Share technical knowledge and support team members through documentation, reviews, and collaboration. 
 - Participate in a 12x7 on-call rotation and support response to customer-impacting incidents. 

Mandatory Skills

- 4-8 years of experience in SRE, Production Engineering, Cloud Operations, Systems Engineering, or a similar role. 
 - Experience operating and improving highly available production systems. 
 - Strong programming or scripting skills in Python, Go or similar languages. 
 - Hands-on experience with Linux, cloud infrastructure, networking, compute, and storage. 
 - Experience with production monitoring, alerting, dashboards, logs, metrics, and tracing. 
 - Experience owning or improving service SLIs, SLOs, KPIs, and operational procedures. 
 - Strong incident troubleshooting, RCA, debugging, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Experience with deployment pipelines, release validation, automation, and change-management practices. 
 - Understanding of distributed systems, service dependencies, capacity planning, and performance tuning. 
 - Ability to work independently on technical problems and collaborate effectively with engineering teams. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with OCI and cloud infrastructure services. 
 - Experience with AIOps, anomaly detection, event correlation, predictive alerting, or automated remediation. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, containers, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD. 
 - Experience with service migrations, fleet maintenance, upgrades, patching, security vulnerability management or production rollouts. 
 - Experience with architecture reviews, operational-readiness reviews, and post-incident improvements. 
 - Experience contributing to technical initiatives, knowledge sharing, code reviews, or operational improvements within the team. 
 - Familiarity with security, compliance, and access-control practices in production environments. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

Job Description

About the Company

Kaleris is a global leader in supply chain execution, focused on accelerating the transformation of digital supply chain for industrial and finished goods shippers and carriers by combining best-in-class solutions for industry-specific challenges tied to yard management, shipment visibility, and asset management, across rail, truck, and multi-mode transportation. 

Our cloud-based solutions connect shippers, carriers, and drivers to the Kaleris platform where visibility across multiple modes and nodes are connected and deliver powerful analytics and second to none, enterprise-level execution. 

Many of the world's largest shippers rely on Kaleris solutions for mission-critical workflows to achieve the confidence and clarity necessary to make moves ahead of the curve. Kaleris is backed by Accel-KKR, a leading technology-focused private equity firm with deep domain expertise in supply chain management software and solutions. 

Role Summary

We're seeking a skilled and motivated Senior DevOps Engineer to join our Marine DevOps team. DevOps is a development-oriented approach, and you will implement and maintain a DevOps platform that supports development teams for our products. We are passionate about automating routines, infrastructure, and the whole software development lifecycle. Day-to-day, you will engage directly with internal customers, like Software Engineers, QA Engineers, and numerous other teams, to better optimize their workflows through automation and well-designed systems. You will be involved in migrating applications to containers, deploying them in public clouds (AWS, Azure), deploying and promoting new services for internal clients, and automating every single part of those applications. Observability and security are also priorities.

- Design and manage cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure) using infrastructure as code (Terraform, OpenTofu). 
 - Build and maintain CI pipelines for automated builds and tests. 
 - Develop and improve deployment pipelines, which include QA/Dev environments and support the same for different product units across Kaleris. 
 - Drive platform modernization, self-service capabilities, and automate processes using GitOps approaches and scripting. 
 - Lead containerization and orchestration initiatives using Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Collaborate with Infrastructure, Development, and Quality Engineering teams to improve products and the delivery process. 
 - Mentor Junior DevOps Engineers and promote DevOps best practices across teams. 
 - Maintain operational runbooks, documentation and disaster recovery plans. 
 - Drive observability initiatives using logging, metrics and tracing tools (e. g. , Sumo Logic). 
 - Leverage Kaleris managed security tools (e. g. , Wiz & Vanta to enforce security best practices across internal and production environments. 

Requirements

- 6+ years of professional experience, 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Software Engineering, or similar roles. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with at least one cloud provider (AWS, Azure). 
 - Demonstrated experience in architecting, managing, and operating complex applications deployed in AWS or Azure. 
 - Experience in IaC Tools (Terraform, OpenTofu, Packer, Ansible). 
 - Extensive knowledge in creating and managing CI/CD/GitOps Pipelines (GitHub Actions, TeamCity, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Spacelift, etc. ). 
 - Skilled in Linux and Windows server maintenance and proficient in scripting & automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash). 
 - Strong experience with container tooling and orchestration (Docker and Kubernetes). 
 - Proven experience managing production Kubernetes environments. 
 - Familiarity with cloud security guidelines and best practices on public clouds. 
 - Knowledge of monitoring/observability tools (Sumo Logic, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, ELK). 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze and support distributed systems on a global scale

Soft Skills

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Adaptable and curious about AI-assisted tooling - actively uses tools like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude to work more effectively and stays current as the ecosystem evolves. 
 - Ownership mindset. 
 - Ability to remain calm and effective during incidents and high-pressure situations. 

Kaleris is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

data.title: Lead Quality Engineer
data.description:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology. 

Job Role: You will work at the intersection of nonlinear mechanics (FEA simulation), industrial validation, solver quality. The role is ideal for candidates who enjoy converting complex engineering physics into robust benchmark problems, improving simulation credibility, and influencing the quality of advanced CAE products used by demanding engineering teams. 

Role Snapshot

Role focus

Advanced nonlinear (simulation) validation for CAE solvers and workflows

Ideal background

Ph. D. in Mechanical, Civil, Aerospace, Applied Mechanics, or closely related field

Experience

3+ years in CAE/FEA with strong nonlinear statics and dynamics exposure

Preferred Tools

Nastran/Marc/ Abaqus/Ansys pre/post tools such as HyperMesh/ANSA/Patran

What You Will Work On

- Design high-value validation strategies for advanced nonlinear simulation capabilities, including contact, large deformation, material nonlinearity, nonlinear dynamics, and coupled thermal-mechanical workflows. 
 - Translate demanding industrial applications such as elastomer sealing, composite damage/failure, and complex contact simulation into practical, high-fidelity benchmark models. 
 - Validate solver behavior using a mix of analytical checks, simplified hand calculations, comparison with trusted references. 
 - Build and automate test cases for Nastran and Marc so that complex physics can be validated repeatedly, efficiently, and with clear quality metrics. 
 - Work closely with developers, product teams, and QA engineers to identify gaps, isolate issues, improve testability, and support reliable software releases. 
 - Prepare clear validation reports, technical notes, and evidence-based recommendations that help improve product quality and customer confidence. 

Core Technical Strengths We Are Looking For

- Deep understanding of nonlinear finite element analysis, including geometric, material, and contact nonlinearities. 
 - Strong foundation in continuum mechanics, numerical methods, finite element formulation, and interpretation of nonlinear solver behavior. 
 - Hands-on exposure to advanced constitutive modeling such as hyper-elasticity, viscoelasticity, rate-dependent plasticity, shape memory alloys, or progressive damage/failure in composites, buckling. 
 - Practical experience with meshing, model idealization, boundary conditions, convergence behavior, and post-processing of nonlinear simulation results. 
 - Ability to connect theory with engineering judgment: simplify a complex problem, validate the essentials, and explain results clearly. 

What Makes a Candidate Stand Out

- A record of technical publications, conference presentations, benchmark studies, or research-to-application work in CAE/FEA. 
 - Evidence of solving difficult nonlinear simulation convergence, modeling, or validation problems. 
 - Experience with Python Scripting and AI skills. 
 - Clear communication style: able to explain assumptions, limitations, results, and risks to both technical and product teams. 

We're doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can't.

Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.

data.title: Engineering Manager, AI Builder Experience
data.description:
AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI - and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience org at MongoDB, we're forming a brand new engineering team to make that happen, and we're looking for the founding Engineering Manager to hire the team, set the technical direction, and ship integrations into some of the fastest-moving open-source ecosystems in tech. 

In this role, you'll be close enough to the code to jump into exploratory work yourself while also building the team, process, and operational rigor to keep a growing integration portfolio healthy long-term. The new team will work mostly in Python and TypeScript while collaborating closely with client library teams and other engineering groups across MongoDB that deliver the underlying driver, platform, and product capabilities needed to support these integrations well. 

You'll collaborate closely and move quickly with product, partners, field teams, the developer community, and open source project maintainers to ship where demand is real, deepen investment where adoption proves out, and evolve the portfolio over time as it becomes a critical part of MongoDB's future in AI. 

MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our values every day. We value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. 

Position expectations

- Work closely with recruiting to hire a team of Python and TypeScript engineers who will build and own MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like Langchain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra
 - Execute effectively in a fast-moving environment where priorities may shift week to week based on framework changes, customer demand, partner needs, and strategic opportunity. Deliver quickly while keeping a high standard of technical quality
 - Flag issues, concerns, and resource needs early, working with management to triage, staff, borrow expertise, and cross-functionally hand off completed projects as needed
 - Work closely with product managers, program managers, sales, GTM, and peer engineering teams to define, prioritize, and deliver capabilities that improve the builder experience and strengthen MongoDB's position in the AI framework ecosystem; help decide where to invest effort and where to pull back
 - Manage dependencies on drivers, platform capabilities, and other MongoDB product surfaces required to deliver excellent framework integrations
 - Collaborate with external teams who own open source projects MongoDB integrates with, maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy to work effectively through external maintainer review cycles to land high-quality upstream contributions
 - Jump in to do initial, exploratory work. Guide key decisions, unblock the team, and contribute when needed as projects grow
 - Own the monitoring, operations, maintenance, and ongoing quality of a broad, evolving integration portfolio; develop testing strategy, release readiness, and operational follow-through after launch
 - Help the team build and maintain sustainable engineering practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, version compatibility awareness, and strong integration health over time
 - Develop a team that stays current with the Python, TypeScript, and broader AI builder ecosystems, including important frameworks, community discussions, and emerging patterns; maintain awareness of trends and discourse in contemporary AI
 - Bring a research and discovery mindset to the role, using customer, community, partner, and field signals to help guide roadmap and investment decisions; identify emerging opportunities in the ecosystem and help decide where early investment could create strategic advantage

Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience building developer platforms, libraries, or other high-scale technical systems, with strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript and an ability to lead teams working across both the Python and TypeScript ecosystems. Experience working with programming language polyglot teams is a plus
 - 3+ years of experience managing a team of software engineers and providing technical leadership for complex projects or products
 - Experience with query optimization (especially MongoDB) and AI coding tools; distributed systems experience would be an asset
 - Demonstrated success hiring, mentoring, and growing high-performing engineering teams, including experience supporting career development, feedback, and performance management
 - Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving technical landscape with frequent context switching, incomplete information, and competing opportunities, while maintaining sound prioritization and strong judgment
 - Strong technical depth in developer-facing software, with the judgment to make and guide architectural trade-offs
 - Experience leading the launch of new features or systems and operating them successfully in production after release
 - Excellent written and verbal technical communication, with a strong instinct to collaborate across engineering, product, and other stakeholder groups
 - A track record of escalating issues early and fostering a team culture that values intellectual honesty and collaboration
 - Comfort operating in ambiguous, evolving spaces and helping teams make progress when customer behavior, technical requirements, or ecosystem priorities are still taking shape
 - Strong and demonstrated interest in modern AI builder workflows and the developer tooling landscape, ideally with familiarity across frameworks, retrieval patterns, agent workflows, embedding, vector search, or adjacent areas; experience in this area would be an asset
 - Experience working with open source software, external ecosystems, or integrations with third-party frameworks and communities, especially in the Python ecosystem; familiarity with open source contribution models, external maintainers, and engineering work that spans company-owned and upstream repositories would be a plus

Success measures

- In the first month, you will understand the team's scope, the high-level architecture of the platform and integrations, the current portfolio of work, and the key technical and organizational dependencies around the role. You will start building relationships with cross-functional partners, especially recruiting, and develop a hiring plan
 - In three months, in collaboration with our recruiting team, you will have a healthy candidate pipeline and the first members of your new team onboarding. You'll have a hand-off plan with the teams currently owning AI Framework Integrations
 - In six months, you will have staffed the core of your team, demonstrated effective partnership with recruiting, taken responsibility for major initiatives in the upcoming quarter, and improved the team's ability to execute through technical and organizational ambiguity
 - In twelve months, you'll be having active growth conversations with your team members about performance and longer-term career development. You'll have led the development and operation of multiple meaningful features or integrations and helped shape the forward-looking technical and execution strategy for this area

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. 

With offices worldwide and over 67, 000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software. 

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

data.title: Cloud Expert- Oracle
data.description:
CLOUD EXPERT- ORACLE

We are looking for a Cloud Expert- Oracle to be part of our Nestlé Nespresso Digital and Tech Team. 

Position Snapshot: 

- Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
 - Type of Contract: Permanent
 - Grade: Band 2
 - Type of work: Hybrid
 - Work Language: Fluent Business English

The Role: 

Under the supervision and guidance of the Product Owner, the Cloud Expert brings deep technical expertise to the platform team, with a primary focus on the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of enterprise cloud landing zones. S/He ensures that landing zones provide secure, scalable, resilient, and standardized foundations for cloud workloads, aligned with Nespresso's architecture, security, networking, compliance, automation, and financial governance requirements. 

Working at the leading edge of cloud technology, the Cloud Expert performs technical assessments and preliminary studies, helping the Product Owner and Platform Manager define the technological direction, roadmap, and standards for the platform. 

S/He supports the delivery and sustainment of complex cloud capabilities, including account and subscription provisioning, identity and access integration, network connectivity, security controls, policy enforcement, logging and monitoring, tagging, cost-management controls, and Infrastructure as Code automation. S/He may be accountable for specific platform deliverables or lead technical activities within their area of expertise. 

S/He ensures that landing zones remain operational, compliant, maintainable, and aligned with evolving business and technology requirements. 

In This Role, You Will: 

- Collaborate with multiple teams to implement the Cloud solutions to empower Nespresso Applications. 
 - Develop and maintain the necessary IaC to deploy Nespresso Infrastructure. 
 - Ensure optimal end-to-end delivery of IaC to Cloud providers by understanding and overseeing the delivery pipeline. 
 - Mentor Platform teams in the optimal usage of IaC and GitOps within the scope of the landing zones. 
 - Work closely with DevOps, development teams and suppliers to secure that the value planned will be delivered in the most optimal way. 

What We're Looking For: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, system analysis or a related study, or equivalent experience. 
 - Demonstrable 8 + years of experience working with multiple Cloud Providers. Extensive experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is mandatory. 
 - Proficiency in hands-on IaC development. Extensive experience with Terraform and Terraform module libraries is a must. 
 - Demonstrable experience working in enterprise-scale Cloud deployments including fundamentals of cloud-native identity, Networking and Security. 
 - Experience designing and operating cloud landing zones at scale, including subscription/account architecture, network segmentation, identity integration, and operational controls. 
 - Demonstrable experience working with DevOps, GitOps, and modern software engineering practices. 
 - Experience troubleshooting complex cloud environments and driving technical investigations across infrastructure, networking, identity, and automation domains. 
 - Strong problem-solving and solution design skills, with the ability to balance security, scalability, operational excellence, and developer experience. 
 - Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership of complex technical challenges, and drive initiatives from concept to delivery with minimal supervision. 
 - Experience in effective communication at different level in the organization and in English. 

Extra Skills That Set You Apart: 

- CI/CD Pipeline Integration: Proficiency in integrating solutions into Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, ensuring seamless updates and deployments. 
 - Experience having worked in a global environment and with virtual and diverse teams. 
 - Linux OS hands on proficiency
 - Experience with Azure Cloud. 
 - Experience leveraging AI-assisted engineering tools to improve productivity, code quality, documentation, and automation workflow
 - Experience mentoring engineers and driving technical standards, best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Strong communication skills

We Offer You: 

We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself. 

- Flexible work policies including core hours and options for working from home. Discuss with us during the recruitment process to understand what flexibility could look like for you!
 - Genuine opportunities for career and personal development through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset. 
 - Modern "smart office" locations providing agile workspaces. Our state-of-the-art campus is equipped with areas to co-create, network, and chill!
 - International, dynamic & inclusive working environment with attractive additional benefits. 
 - The pride to work for a B Corp certified company and one of the world's most trusted brands. 

The Hiring Process: 

- Your Application: Submit your application, and we'll review it carefully (make sure your CV is in English as the hiring team is international). 
 - Initial Screening: Relevant candidates will be contacted by our Talent Acquisition team for an initial interview. 
 - Practical Exercises: Practical exercises to be completed and send before the interviews. 
 - Hiring Manager Interview: Selected candidates will then meet with the hiring manager to discuss the role and their experience in more detail. 
 - Stakeholder Interview: Candidates will engage with potential team members to assess fit and collaboration. 
 - Leadership & HRBP Interaction: Candidates will have a discussion with our leadership team & HRBP. 
 - Feedback: After interviews, we provide feedback to all candidates. 
 - Job Offer: Successful candidates will receive a formal offer. 
 - First Working Day: Once the offer is accepted, we'll welcome you on your first day!

About Nespresso: 

The Nespresso story began with a simple but revolutionary idea: enable anyone to create the perfect cup of espresso coffee. 

Since 1986, Nespresso has redefined and revolutionized the way millions of people enjoy their coffee. 

We are a Company committed with the Climate change and we aim to achieve carbon neutrality as soon as possible and net-zero GHG emissions by 2050 at the latest. 

In 2019 we created the digital hub in Barcelona to offer the best customer experience and innovation to B2C and B2B channels. 

We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability. 

People are at the heart of our success - all 14, 000 of them. We actively cultivate diversity, inclusion and belonging in the workplace. We celebrate individuality, believing that your authenticity and uniqueness can help us to grow and thrive together

Join Nestlé #beaforceforgood

Responsible for the proactive support of products so that there is high product performance that is continuously improved. data.title: Programmer/Analyst II, Ship With
data.description:
Description

Amazon's global fulfillment network enables any merchant to ship items that are ordered on Amazon to any place on earth. There is a complex network of ways in which items move between vendor locations, Amazon warehouses, and customer locations as well as several intermediate locations through which packages travel before reaching the customer. With a scale of millions of packages, each with different attributes and delivery requirements, what results is a highly dense graph of nodes. 

We have built a highly respected software engineering team which is focused on solving complex problems in worldwide transportation using workflows, optimization algorithms, and machine learning systems. data.title: Principal Network Developer
data.description:
Job Description

We are the AI Infrastructure - Network Operations team at OCI (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure). We support and operate the RDMA/RoCE/InfiniBand network fabrics for OCI's largest AI and HPC customers. These fabrics are the foundation underneath OCI's AI, GPU and HPC services, and support major tier-0 vendors in the generative AI industry. If you're running an AI workload at OCI, we're running the RDMA network underneath your workload. 

A Network Operations Engineer on our team supports the design, deployment, and operations of a large-scale global Oracle cloud computing environment (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure - OCI). Primarily focused on operation and support of RDMA/RoCE/InfiniBand network fabrics and systems, through a combination of a deep network understanding and automation skills to operate a production environment. As OCI is a cloud-based network with a global footprint, this support will include hundreds of thousands of network devices supporting millions of servers, connected over a mix of dedicated backbone infrastructure and the Internet. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Lead network lifecycle management initiatives by defining technical objectives, delivery plans, and implementation procedures for large-scale network infrastructure projects. 
 - Translate high-level network architectures into detailed designs and deployment plans while ensuring scalability, reliability, and operational readiness. 
 - Serve as the technical lead for moderately complex network projects, coordinating the efforts of multiple engineers across design, deployment, automation, and operational support. 
 - Design, implement, and support network solutions across data center, backbone, cloud, and service provider environments. 
 - Partner with service owners and infrastructure teams to ensure network solutions are fully integrated with monitoring, observability, automation, and operational support systems. 
 - Act as a Tier 2 and specialized escalation point for network incidents, driving root cause analysis, corrective actions, and long-term reliability improvements. 
 - Lead the investigation and resolution of complex network issues and large-scale service-impacting events. 
 - Develop automation solutions, tools, and scripts to improve operational efficiency, network reliability, deployment consistency, and incident response. 
 - Contribute to the design and delivery of network automation frameworks and operational tooling. 
 - Collaborate closely with product teams, program managers, network leadership, and PMO organizations to align infrastructure capabilities with product and service requirements. 
 - Partner with vendor engineering teams and account managers to troubleshoot issues, evaluate new technologies, and drive operational improvements. 
 - Participate in hardware evaluations, RFQ/RFP processes, and adoption of new networking technologies and platforms. 
 - Drive technology decisions that support business, product, and service objectives. 
 - Mentor junior engineers through technical guidance, troubleshooting support, design reviews, and knowledge sharing.

Position Overview: 

The Regional Etail Quality Improvement Manager is responsible for driving service quality, process adherence and continuous improvement across the regional Etail First Mile and Last Mile network. 

The role monitors end-to-end shipment lifecycle performance across Service Centres and delivery locations, identifies service-quality gaps and drives corrective actions with branch, area and regional operations teams. 

Owns regional Etail quality analytics and governance across key service metrics including pickup and delivery performance, First Attempt Delivery Success, undelivered shipments, NDR, ageing, customer complaints, shipment exceptions and operational process adherence. 

The role leads the regional Etail Quality Improvement team and works closely with Operations, Customer Service, Security, IT/Digital and other stakeholders to improve shipment flow, eliminate recurring defects and strengthen customer experience. 

This is primarily a quality governance, analytics and continuous improvement role, working in partnership with line Operations teams who continue to own day-to-day operational execution. 

Job Purpose: 

To continuously improve Etail service quality across the regional First and Last Mile network by identifying operational defects, analysing shipment lifecycle performance, driving root-cause resolution and ensuring sustained adherence to service standards, thereby improving delivery reliability, customer experience and operational quality. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities: 

Leadership

- Lead and manage the regional Etail Quality Improvement team and ensure clear ownership of quality-monitoring priorities. 
 - Build strong quality and problem-solving capability across the team. 
 - Establish regular quality-review mechanisms with regional, branch and operational teams. 
 - Drive accountability for closure of recurring service-quality gaps. 
 - Build a culture of proactive quality management rather than reactive exception resolution. 
 - Coach teams on root-cause analysis, corrective actions and sustained process improvement. 

Etail Service Quality Management

- Monitor end-to-end Etail shipment lifecycle across pickup, processing, movement and delivery stages. 
 - Track regional Etail service-quality performance against defined organisational standards and customer commitments. 
 - Identify service failures, ageing shipments, delivery exceptions and recurring operational defects. 
 - Drive improvement in First Attempt Delivery Success and reduction in avoidable delivery failures. 
 - Monitor NDR reasons and ensure corrective action on operationally controllable causes. 
 - Review undelivered, misrouted, delayed, damaged or exception shipments and drive closure with respective teams. 
 - Identify high-defect locations, routes and operational pockets and initiate targeted improvement plans. 
 - Ensure consistency of Etail service-quality standards across locations within the Region. 

Quality Analytics & Exception Management

- Analyse shipment-level and location-level quality data to identify trends, recurring defects and systemic issues. 
 - Develop regional quality dashboards and exception reports for management review. 
 - Establish proactive alerts for shipments or locations at risk of service failure. 
 - Conduct root-cause analysis on major service deviations and recurring customer-impacting issues. 
 - Track corrective and preventive actions through closure. 
 - Use data to differentiate isolated operational exceptions from structural process issues. 
 - Maintain visibility of quality performance by branch, service centre, route and relevant operational parameters. 

First & Last Mile Quality Improvement

- Partner with First Mile and Last Mile Operations teams to improve pickup and delivery quality. 
 - Review adherence to pickup and delivery processes, operational cut-offs and shipment handling standards. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve delivery attempt quality, shipment visibility and customer communication. 
 - Support improvement of address quality, delivery instructions and exception coding. 
 - Drive reduction in repeat attempts arising from avoidable operational reasons. 
 - Work with operational teams to improve route-level quality and delivery consistency. 
 - Support peak-period quality readiness and identify potential service risks before volume surges. 

Process Compliance & Standardisation

- Conduct periodic process-quality reviews across regional operating locations. 
 - Ensure adherence to defined Etail SOPs, shipment handling processes and service standards. 
 - Identify deviations from standard processes and drive corrective action. 
 - Support implementation of national quality initiatives across the Region. 
 - Standardise proven quality-improvement practices across branches and Service Centres. 
 - Ensure sustained implementation through follow-up audits and control mechanisms. 
 - Support quality readiness for new facilities, routes or operating models where required. 

Customer Experience & Complaint Reduction

- Analyse Etail-related customer complaints and identify underlying operational causes. 
 - Partner with Customer Service and Operations teams to reduce repeat complaints. 
 - Identify systemic customer experience issues and recommend operational solutions. 
 - Monitor complaint trends by location, failure type and root cause. 
 - Ensure major recurring service failures are addressed through structured corrective-action plans. 
 - Support improvements in delivery experience and shipment visibility. 

Continuous Improvement

- Build and maintain a regional quality-improvement pipeline focused on recurring service defects. 
 - Apply structured problem-solving methodologies such as RCA, PDCA, Pareto analysis and process mapping. 
 - Conduct field visits / Gemba reviews at locations with persistent quality gaps. 
 - Identify opportunities for process simplification, automation and preventive controls. 
 - Track measurable benefits from improvement initiatives. 
 - Institutionalise successful interventions across relevant locations to prevent recurrence. 

Technology, Data & Automation

- Use operational dashboards and shipment-level analytics to identify quality gaps and intervention priorities. 
 - Drive accurate exception coding and data discipline across operating locations. 
 - Support implementation and adoption of digital tools that improve shipment visibility and quality control. 
 - Partner with IT/Digital teams to automate recurring quality reports and exception identification. 
 - Identify opportunities for predictive / proactive quality monitoring. 
 - Ensure quality data used for decision-making is accurate, timely and actionable. 

Stakeholder & Governance

- Collaborate closely with Regional Operations, Branch Operations, First & Last Mile teams and Service Centres. 
 - Partner with Customer Service on complaint trends and customer-impacting quality issues. 
 - Coordinate with Security on shipment loss, damage and other quality exceptions wherever relevant. 
 - Work with IT/Digital teams on system or data issues impacting shipment visibility and quality. 
 - Conduct periodic Etail quality reviews with regional stakeholders. 
 - Escalate structural or recurring quality risks requiring regional or national intervention. 
 - Act as the regional SME for Etail service quality and continuous improvement. 

Qualifications & Experience: 

- Education: Bachelor's degree in operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Business Administration or related discipline preferred; MBA / PG qualification desirable. 
 - Experience: 5-8 years of relevant experience in express logistics, eCommerce logistics, last-mile operations, service quality, operational excellence or supply chain operations. 
 - Strong exposure to First Mile / Last Mile operations and shipment lifecycle management. 
 - Experience in analysing service-quality metrics and driving corrective actions across multiple operating locations. 
 - Understanding of delivery performance, NDR, ageing, service failures, customer complaints and operational exception management. 
 - Experience in data analysis, operational dashboards, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement. 
 - Exposure to multi-location operational governance and stakeholder management. 
 - Experience managing or coordinating quality / operational improvement teams preferred. 
 - Preferred Industries: Express Logistics, Courier, eCommerce Logistics, 3PL, Last Mile Delivery, Distribution and Supply Chain Operations. 

Skills & Capabilities:

 - Shipment Lifecycle Analysis 
 - Root Cause Analysis & Corrective Action 
 - Quality Audits & Process Compliance 
 - Operational Dashboards & MIS

Strong performance optimization skills (rendering, virtualization, lazy loading, re-render control).

Experience handling real-time / near real-time data in frontend applications. 

Strong code quality practices (clean code, code reviews, testing).

Good to have

Working knowledge of Kubernetes (pods, deployments, logs, metrics)

data.title: Senior Manager - Quant Developer
data.description:
The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance

At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance. 

As India's first crypto unicorn valued at $2. 45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale. 

We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what's next. 

If you're driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you'll feel right at home here. 

SM Quant Developer - Crypto Market Making

About The Role

This isn't a typical quant developer role. 

You will own the systems that quote prices and manage risk across crypto markets in real time - the engine that lets CoinDCX provide deep, reliable liquidity to every trader on our platform. This is work that directly shapes how price discovery and market quality happen for millions of Indian users. 

We're looking for a builder who can architect low-latency market making infrastructure in C++, connect resiliently to multiple exchanges over WebSocket and REST, and lead a small team of quant developers. You'll be hands-on with the hardest engineering on the desk: keeping order books accurate under messy, high-rate, sometimes-failing exchange feeds, and turning microsecond-level decisions into consistent PnL. You will set the technical bar for how we build, measure, and scale our trading systems. 

What You'll Do

- Design and build low-latency market making systems in modern C++ (C++17/20), optimising the hot path for memory, cache, and lock-free performance. 
 - Own resilient connectivity to multiple crypto venues (Binance, Bybit, Deribit, CoinDCX and more) over WebSocket and REST - handling reconnects, heartbeats, sequence-gap recovery, and snapshot+delta order book reconstruction. 
 - Build a normalisation layer that tames inconsistent exchange APIs, rate limits, and weight systems into one clean, reliable interface for strategies. 
 - Lead a team of quant developers - reviewing code, setting engineering standards, breaking down work, and mentoring them into strong systems engineers. 
 - Deliver the quoting, order management, and risk-check components end-to-end, partnering closely with traders and quants to translate strategy needs into robust production systems. 
 - Measure and improve performance and reliability relentlessly - instrumenting, benchmarking, and tuning the system against real latency budgets dominated by network round-trips and exchange behaviour. 

You'll Excel in This Role If You

- Have 7-8 years building low-latency, high-throughput systems in C++, with deep performance-engineering instincts (lock-free structures, no allocations on the hot path, CPU pinning, profiling). 
 - Have shipped production systems with` persistent WebSocket and REST connectivity at scale - trading background preferred, but strong low-latency engineers from any domain are welcome. 
 - Think in first principles about where latency actually lives - network RTT, exchange matching, and rate-limit budgeting - rather than mechanically applying nanosecond-hardware playbooks. 
 - Have led as a tech lead - owning components, reviewing code, and guiding junior engineers 
 - Are obsessed with correctness and resilience under messy, inconsistent, sometimes-failing exchange APIs. 
 - Communicate latency and risk tradeoffs clearly to traders and non-engineers, and bring a measurement-driven, owner mindset. 
 - (Bonus) Understand crypto market microstructure - order books, funding rates, perpetuals, liquidations, maker/taker fee tiers - or have worked with kernel bypass, or colocation/proximity hosting. 

You'll Know You're Winning When

(Key success metrics for the first 6 months)

- You've taken ownership of the core market making stack and shipped measurable latency and reliability improvements on the hot path. 
 - Your exchange connectivity layer maintains accurate order books with robust gap recovery and minimal downtime across venues. 
 - Junior developers in the team are independently shipping reviewed, high-quality components against a clear engineering standard you've set. 
 - Traders and quants trust your systems - quoting and risk checks run consistently in production with fewer incidents and faster iteration. 

Why This Role Matters & What's In It For You

Market making is the heartbeat of an exchange - the systems you build directly determine the liquidity, spreads, and trading experience for millions of users. You'll sit at the intersection of engineering, trading, and risk, with real ownership over a business-critical edge. 

You'll work closely with senior leadership and our researchers and traders, influence high-stakes technical and strategic decisions, and grow into a leader of one of the most demanding engineering functions in one of the world's fastest-evolving industries. 

How To Apply

This role is for you if you thrive on hard systems problems, love working close to the action with sharp traders and engineers, and want to own infrastructure that matters. 

Apply via: 

- Careers page link 
 - LinkedIn link

Hiring Process

Here's what your journey with us looks like: 

- Application Review - We assess for skills, alignment, and intent 
 - Recruiter Connect - A short conversation to understand you better 
 - Functional Round(s) - Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving 
 - Assignment / Simulation Round - A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios 
 - Culture & Values Discussion - A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best 
 - Founder Conversation (Optional) - For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit

Where We Work

We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space. 

With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our Bengaluru HQ, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time. 

Perks That Empower You

- Design Your Own Benefits: A flexible benefits program tailored to your lifestyle. 
 - Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Take time to rest and recharge as you need. 
 - Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources. 
 - Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly sessions to learn, unlearn and grow continuously. 

Ready to Build What's Next?

If you're looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it. 

Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

data.title: Cloud Architect
data.description:
We're improving the way we live and work by intelligently connecting energy systems, buildings, and industries!!

Smart infrastructure from Siemens makes the world a more connected and caring place - where resources are valued, where impact on the world is considered, where sustainable energy is delivered optimally and efficiently. It provides the flexible infrastructure to allow society to evolve and respond to changing conditions. Technology and the ingenuity of people come together to be at one with our environments and to care for our world. We do this from the macro to the micro level, from physical products, components, and systems to connected, cloud-based digital offerings and services. Siemens offers a broad portfolio of grid control and automation; low- and medium-voltage power distribution, switching and control; and building automation, fire safety and security, HVAC control and energy solutions. 

JOIN US! WE MAKE REAL WHAT MATTERS. THIS IS YOUR ROLE

We are looking for an experienced Cloud Architect - IoT & Digitalization to define and drive the cloud architecture for our next generation of digital products and IoT solutions. 

In this role, you will take technical ownership of scalable, secure and highly available cloud architectures. You will work closely with Product Owners, Software Architects, developers, cybersecurity experts and globally distributed engineering teams to translate product requirements into robust cloud-native solutions. 

The role provides an opportunity to influence architecture from edge to cloud, establish reusable technology patterns and enable engineering teams to build secure, scalable and maintainable digital solutions. 

Your key responsibilities

As a Cloud Architect, You Will

Define and drive end-to-end cloud architecture for IoT and digital applications. 

Design scalable, resilient, secure and highly available cloud-native solutions. 

Establish cloud architecture principles, reusable design patterns, standards and technology guidelines. 

Translate business and product requirements into technical architecture and solution concepts. 

Architect solutions based on microservices, containers, Kubernetes, serverless technologies and managed cloud services. 

Define integration concepts using REST APIs, API gateways, event-driven architecture and messaging technologies. 

Design cloud infrastructure covering networking, compute, storage, databases and platform services. 

Drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated cloud provisioning approaches. 

Embed security-by-design principles covering identity, authentication, authorization, encryption and secure communication. 

Define architectural approaches for high availability, scalability, disaster recovery and performance. 

Enable DevOps/DevSecOps practices, automated CI/CD and cloud-native deployments. 

Define observability concepts covering system monitoring, logging, metrics and alerting. 

Evaluate and recommend appropriate cloud technologies, platforms, frameworks and tools. 

Lead architecture and design reviews and support teams in resolving complex technical issues. 

Mentor engineering teams and promote cloud-native architecture and engineering practices. 

Collaborate with globally distributed R&D teams and other stakeholders on technology and product roadmaps. 

These capabilities build on Siemens' existing internal architecture profiles, which cover microservices, APIs, messaging, container orchestration, serverless development, DevOps, observability, cloud networking, IaC, high availability and disaster recovery. 

We Are Looking For Someone With

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline. 

Strong professional experience in software engineering, cloud technologies and solution architecture. 

Proven experience designing scalable, secure and highly available cloud applications. 

Strong knowledge of cloud-native architecture and distributed systems. 

Hands-on architectural experience with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS. 

Strong understanding of microservices, Docker and Kubernetes. 

Experience with serverless architecture and managed cloud services. 

Experience designing REST APIs, API management and event-driven architectures. 

Good understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases. 

Strong knowledge of cloud networking, security and identity/access management. 

Experience with CI/CD, DevOps and DevSecOps practices. 

Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform or comparable technologies. 

Understanding of observability, monitoring and logging concepts. 

Strong knowledge of software architecture principles, system design and design patterns. 

Strong analytical, debugging and problem-solving capabilities. 

Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. 

Ability to technically lead, influence and mentor engineering teams. 

Siemens internal architecture material specifically references AWS/Azure/Google cloud experience, Terraform/AWS CloudFormation/Azure ARM Templates, DevOps, containerization, microservices and cloud security as relevant architectural capabilities. 

WE DON'T NEED SUPERHEROES, JUST SUPER MINDS!

WE'VE GOT QUITE A LOT TO OFFER. HOW ABOUT YOU?

We're Siemens. A collection of over 379, 000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in across Gender, LGBTQ+, Abilities & Ethnicity. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination, and help us shape tomorrow. 

Find out more about Smart Infrastructure at: https: //new. siemens. com/global/en/company/topic-areas/smart-infrastructure. html and about Siemens careers at: www. siemens. com/careers #SL

data.title: Head of Quality Management
data.description:
Company Description Sant Aluminium Pvt Ltd is a leading aluminum extrusion company known for delivering customized, high-quality solutions across diverse industries and applications. The organization combines innovation, engineering, and craftsmanship to transform aluminum into versatile, precision-engineered profiles. Each product is developed with a strong focus on reliability, performance, and adherence to exact customer specifications. Sant Aluminium Pvt Ltd fosters a culture of excellence and continuous improvement, appealing to professionals who value quality-driven manufacturing. The company offers opportunities to contribute to advanced extrusion projects in a dynamic industrial environment. 
Role Description The Head of Quality Management is responsible for overseeing all quality-related activities within Sant Aluminium Pvt Ltd's extrusion operations. This full-time, on-site role based in Chandigarh involves developing, implementing, and monitoring quality management systems and standards to ensure products meet internal specifications and customer requirements. Day-to-day responsibilities include leading quality inspections, supervising quality control teams, reviewing process data, and driving root cause analysis and corrective actions for non-conformities. The role also includes planning and conducting internal and external quality audits, coordinating with production and engineering teams to optimize processes, and maintaining compliance with relevant industry and regulatory standards. The Head of Quality Management will champion continuous improvement initiatives, provide training on quality procedures, and prepare regular reports for senior leadership on quality performance and metrics. 
Qualifications

- Strong Quality Management and Quality Assurance skills, with experience setting and maintaining quality standards in a manufacturing environment. 
 - Proficiency in Quality Control practices, including inspection methods, testing procedures, and process monitoring. 
 - Experience in Quality Auditing, including planning, conducting, and documenting internal and supplier audits. 
 - Well-developed Analytical Skills for interpreting data, identifying trends, and implementing effective corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Proven leadership experience managing quality teams and collaborating with cross-functional departments (production, engineering, supply chain). 
 - Knowledge of relevant quality frameworks and tools (e. g. , ISO standards, SPC, root cause analysis, CAPA, Six Sigma or similar methodologies). 
 - Bachelor's degree in engineering, industrial management, or a related technical field; advanced qualifications or certifications in quality management are an advantage. 
 - Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to present findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders at all levels. 
 - Experience in metal or aluminum extrusion manufacturing is highly beneficial.

This role requires you to have significant technical breadth and deep understanding of low-level system software specifically in server class systems. 

You will be part of a new team responsible for integration of different system software deliverables and development of system tests spanning all the components. You will

Design and Development

- Act as a technical authority for designing test infrastructure and features.

 - Develop re-usable and scalable pipeline solutions to support component teams

 - Take ownership of technically challenging areas and ensure near 100% feature coverage. 
 - Perform initial triage and debugging of both internal and external issues. 
 - Review and improve design, coding and implementation processes across the team.

 - Consult stakeholders of the package to understand their use-cases to develop robust system tests. 
 - Develop acceptance pipelines covering tests across teams using the system software package. 
 - Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both expert and non-expert audiences. 

Quality, Reliability and System thinking

- Ensure correctness, robustness, security, scalability and maintainability of the tools and pipeline solutions. 
 - Contribute to improvement in validation framework, CI/CD systems, testing methodologies and packaging pipelines. 
 - Drive root-cause investigations and long-term corrective actions along with the component teams for all incoming issues. 

Mentorship

- Mentor junior engineers within the team. 
 - Raise quality and coding standards through guidance, best practices and setting an example. 
 - Contribute to long term improvements in culture and team ceremonies. 

Candidate Profile

Essentials

- 10+ years of experience in low level system testing and integration. 
 - Experience working with RTOS and complex boot logic. 
 - Experience working with Linux and device drivers
 - Experience in test development using Python and C/C++. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines using GitHub/GitLab/Jenkins or similar. 
 - Experience with build and integration tools and modern testing practices. 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills and a track record of working with complex cross-layer issues. 
 - Strong communication skills and proven ability to document. 

Desired

- Experience working with server class systems

Do you want to revolutionize how millions of Amazonians worldwide receive HR support? Are you passionate about building intelligent, AI-powered solutions that transform employee experiences?
