data.title: Product & Technology Lead - AI B2B SaaS
data.description:
Job Title: Product & Technology Lead

Location: Hybrid - India (regular overlap with UK business hours required)

Exp: 15+ Years

Stack: Azure, React, Python, pandas and PySpark and SQL Server

Client is building an AI-driven financial and operational platform that transforms how multi-site businesses manage finance, operations and business intelligence. The first market is UK dental groups: practice owners and group operators who run multiple sites and need a single, reliable view of financial and operational performance. 

The platform combines Financial Management, Power BI Embedded analytics, AI Insights, Dental Pay, Bookkeeping Automation, Forecasting, Reporting, Workflow Automation, and integrations with dental PMS systems, Xero, banking and payroll. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Leadership

- Lead the engineering, QA and DevOps team: set direction, allocate work, run the delivery rhythm and hold the team to a standard demonstrated personally. 
 - Own the technical roadmap and translate the CEO's commercial priorities into a sequenced plan with honest dates. 
 - Act as the CEO's technical partner: give straight answers on what is possible, what it costs and what the risk is, early enough to change the decision. 
 - Assess and grow the team: form an independent view of strengths and gaps, close gaps through coaching, restructuring or hiring, and report findings honestly and early. 
 - Set and enforce engineering standards: coding standards, code review discipline, documentation and definition of done. 
 - Solve problems in the open, with options: what is actually going on, the realistic options, the cost of each in time and risk, a recommendation with reasons, and a fallback plan. 
 - Turn ambiguity into a plan: run discovery, frame the problem, size it honestly and return with a sequenced plan and named risks. 
 - Show the working: prefer a one-page options paper with a clear recommendation over a polished conclusion with no reasoning. 
 - Own technical decisions and their consequences (architecture, tooling, build-versus-buy, technical debt) with reasoning that can be explained to a non-technical board. 
 - Represent the technology in commercial conversations: prospect security questionnaires, customer technical due diligence, and partner and vendor discussions. 
 - Manage external technology partners, contractors and vendors where used. 2. Delivery, Quality & Release (Including Hands-On Development)

- Write production code across the stack (Python, React, SQL Server on Azure), particularly on the critical path to go-live. This should be a meaningful part of most weeks. 
 - Own the remaining development backlog: triage, prioritise and drive to completion the features, defects and technical debt needed for a stable, commercially releasable product. 
 - Fix the hard defects personally: those nobody else can reproduce, those in financial calculations, and those found the day before a go-live. 
 - Run defect management end to end with a single, well-maintained register covering severity, reproduction steps, root cause, owner and target release. No "unknown" or ageing untriaged bugs. 
 - Own test strategy and execution: functional, regression, integration, data-accuracy and user acceptance testing. Personally test critical financial flows. Reconciliation, pay calculations and reported figures must be right every time. 
 - Define and enforce the release process: release notes, environments, deployment checklists, rollback plans and a go/no-go decision for each release. 
 - Translate business requirements into clear technical specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria that leave no room for interpretation. 
 - Run agile ceremonies (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives) across India-based development workstreams. 
 - Review solutions and implementation quality: challenge architecture and technical decisions, and ensure coding standards, documentation and security practices are followed. 
 - Remove blockers and manage delivery risk, escalating early and with a proposed option. 
 - Maintain platform documentation (technical, configuration, integration and support) that the wider team can use. 
 - Drive AI and automation initiatives, including AI-generated insights and automation of internal delivery and support tasks. 3. Security, Penetration Testing & Compliance

The company handles financial data for healthcare businesses. Security is a condition of selling to dental groups at all and will be tested by every prospect's procurement process. 

- Own Client's security posture: authentication, authorisation, tenant isolation, encryption in transit and at rest, secrets management, access control and audit logging. 
 - Commission and manage external penetration tests: scope them, brief the testers, triage findings, own remediation to a committed timeline and get the re-test passed. 
 - Own the remediation backlog with severity-based SLAs. Critical findings do not wait for the next sprint. 
 - Embed security into the development process: secure coding standards, dependency and vulnerability scanning, security review within code review, and secrets hygiene. 
 - Own UK GDPR compliance in the platform: data residency, retention, subject access, deletion, and the technical controls behind DPAs. Data sits close to special category health data and must be treated accordingly. 
 - Complete customer security questionnaires and technical due diligence, and build a reusable evidence pack. 
 - Monitor and respond: alerting on suspicious activity, a rehearsed incident response plan, and a clear understanding of breach notification obligations. 
 - Prepare for certification: build toward Cyber Essentials Plus or ISO 27001 as customer demand requires. 4. Customer Onboarding, Data & Integration Delivery

- Own the technical implementation of every customer: tenant and environment setup, configuration, data integration, migration, technical testing and technical go-live readiness for each dental group and each of its practices. 
 - Lead data integration delivery: connect and validate dental PMS, Xero, banking and payroll sources; map charts of accounts, practice, practitioner and cost-centre structures; build and monitor the pipelines that keep them running. 
 - Own data quality and reconciliation: profile source data before onboarding, resolve gaps, duplicates and structural problems, and reconcile platform output back to source so every figure can be defended. 
 - Configure and validate dashboards per customer: ensure Power BI Embedded dashboards reflect the customer's group and practice structure, perform at scale, and are accurate before the CSM presents them. 
 - Implement and prove Dental Pay: configure pay rules, splits, lab fees, deductions and pay runs per group, and run parallel testing against the customer's existing process until output matches. 
 - Build and sign off Reports: standard and customer-specific reporting, scheduling and distribution, verified figure by figure before handover. 
 - Build a repeatable technical onboarding playbook: data collection pack, integration checklist, configuration templates, migration scripts, technical UAT pack and go-live checklist, so each customer is faster than the last. 
 - Run the technical implementation plan: milestones, dependencies, environment readiness, cut-over planning and risk management across multiple concurrent onboardings. 
 - Support UAT and go-live: prepare test data and scripts, support the CSM through customer UAT, resolve issues found, and make the technical go/no-go call. 
 - Own technical escalations after go-live: triage issues from the CSM team, diagnose root cause, route into the backlog and drive resolution to a committed timeline. 
 - Monitor live customer environments (integration failures, data refresh issues, performance, errors) and fix issues before the customer reports them. 
 - Feed the roadmap: turn recurring integration friction, data problems and CSM-reported requests into prioritised product improvements. 

Essential Experience

- Proven experience as a Technical Lead, Engineering Manager, Head of Engineering or Principal Engineer in a SaaS business, both leading the team and writing production code. 
 - Currently hands-on: production code shipped within the last twelve months, with the wish to keep doing so. This is the single most important requirement and will be tested. 
 - Structured problem solving: take an ambiguous or broken situation, work out what is happening, lay out realistic options with costs and risks, and make a clear recommendation. 
 - Demonstrable track record of taking a SaaS product through final-stage development, testing and release into live production. 
 - Experience owning security in a product sold to enterprise or regulated customers: pen test cycles, remediation, and sales-process security questions. 
 - Hands-on delivery of the technical side of B2B SaaS customer onboarding (integrations, data migration, configuration, technical UAT), ideally for multi-site or multi-entity organisations. 
 - Experience integrating with on-premise or legacy line-of-business systems, not only cloud-to-cloud APIs. Some customer source systems sit on a server in the practice. 
 - Strong project management discipline: plans, milestones, RAID logs, status reporting and structured communication. 
 - Strong agile delivery experience: sprint planning, backlog management, stand-ups and release management. 
 - Experience leading or coordinating India-based, offshore or distributed engineering teams. 
 - Practical QA and UAT experience: able to write and execute test cases personally. 
 - Proven experience working alongside customer-facing colleagues (Customer Success, Account Management or Support) as their technical counterpart. 
 - Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical issues plainly to non-technical UK colleagues. 
 - Comfort working with financial data, where accuracy is non-negotiable. 

Technical Skills & Required Level

What You Must Be Able to Do

- Python - Hands-on daily - Primary language for data work: pandas and PySpark pipelines, cleaning and reconciliation. Write and review it, not commission it. 
 - React - Hands-on daily - Platform front end. Commit, review and release alongside the team. 
 - SQL (SQL Server) - Hands-on daily - Write complex joins, aggregations and window functions unaided. Profile source data, build mappings and write reconciliation queries that prove a figure is right. 
 - REST API integration - Hands-on daily - OAuth2 flows and token refresh, multi-tenant connections, pagination, rate limits, webhooks, retries and idempotency. Diagnose a failing integration from logs and raw responses. 
 - Data integration & ETL - Hands-on daily - Incremental loads, change detection, error and dead-letter handling, reprocessing and backfills. Own pipelines that run unattended. 
 - Data reconciliation - Hands-on daily - Prove platform output matches source, figure by figure. This is what makes Dental Pay safe to switch on. 
 - File-based data handling - Hands-on daily- CSV, Excel and SFTP feeds with inconsistent headers, encodings, date formats and duplicates, cleaned and loaded reliably. 
 - API & data testing- Hands-on daily - Postman or equivalent, SQL-based data validation, test case design and regression packs. 
 - Azure - Working level - Data Factory or Logic Apps and Functions, App Service, Key Vault, Blob storage, Application Insights. Own environments, alerting and monitoring. 
 - Power BI Embedded - Working level - Semantic models, DAX (read and debug at minimum), row-level security, incremental refresh, capacity and performance tuning, embed tokens. 
 - Multi-tenant data security - Working level - Tenant isolation and row-level security so no customer can ever see another group's practices. Non-negotiable. 
 - CI/CD & environments - Working level -Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, branching, release pipelines, environment promotion and rollback. 
 - Application security -Hands-on -OWASP Top 10, secure coding, dependency scanning, secrets management. Read a pen test report, judge what is real, and fix it personally. 
 - Penetration test management - Working level - Scope and commission external tests, triage findings by severity, own remediation to a deadline and pass the re-test. 
 - UK GDPR & data protection - Working level - Data adjacent to special category health data: DPAs, data residency, retention and deletion, encryption, access control and audit logging. 
 - Finance & accounting basics - Working level - Chart of accounts, double-entry principles, accruals, VAT treatment and payroll concepts, enough to know when a number is wrong, not just different. 
 - AI / LLM integration - Working level -Prompt design, retrieval basics and, above all, guardrails so an AI insight never states a financial figure it cannot support. 
 - Verifying AI output - Hands-on daily - Use AI tooling, explain every line that reaches a customer, and catch it when the tool is confidently wrong.

data.description:
Acceldata is reimagining the way companies observe their Data!

Acceldata is the pioneer and leader in data observability, revolutionizing how enterprises manage and observe data by offering comprehensive insights into various key aspects of data, data pipelines and data infrastructure across various environments. Our platform empowers data teams to manage products effectively by ensuring data quality, preventing failures, and controlling costs. 

As a Staff Platform Engineer

You'll develop internal tools, create and enhance Linux CLI applications and extend Go-based tools with plugins. You'll also build web applications to integrate these tools with customer APIs and services. 

A day in the life of Staff Platform Engineer

Primarily developing/extending Linux command-line (CLI applications for the various product offerings at Acceldata. Example: tools similar to kubectl, docker-cli and aws-cli). 

Extending our existing internal tools developed in Go programming language by developing various plugins. (Example: plugins that can extend the functionalities of Telegraf, Filebeat etc. , )

Develop web applications that will chain the internal tools with the various APIs/services at the customer's end. 

You are a great fit for this role if you have

- 9-12 years of total experience. 
 - Hands-on experience in Go programming language paradigms, constructs and idioms
 - Experience with Golang frameworks such as Cobra, Gin or HashiCorp's Go-Plugin. 
 - Understanding of Go-specific data structures & algorithms, RESTful web services. 
 - Experience in relational & non-relational databases. 
 - Knowledge of DevOps tools such as Docker/Kubernetes and practices is an advantage. 
 - Experience in Linux and system application development. 

Bonus Points for

- Proficiency in Big Data Systems or Hadoop components. 

We care for our team

- Mentorship & Growth
 - ESOPs
 - Medical and Life Insurance
 - Paid Maternity & Parental Leave
 - Corporate Uber Program
 - Learning & Development Support

Acceldata for All

We are a fast-growing company, solving complex data problems at scale. We are driven by strong work ethics, high standards of excellence, and a spirit of collaboration. We promote innovation, commitment, and accountability. Our goal is to cultivate a healthy work environment that fosters a sense of belonging, encourages teamwork, and brings out the best in every individual. 

Why Acceldata?

Acceldata is redefining data observability for enterprise data systems. Founded by experts who recognized the need for innovative monitoring and management solutions in a cloud-first, AI-driven environment, our platform empowers data teams to effectively manage data products. We address common challenges such as scaling and performance issues, cost overruns, and data quality problems by providing operational visibility, proactive alerts, and monitoring reliability across the various environments. 

Delivered as a SaaS product, Acceldata's solutions have been embraced by global customers, such as HPE, HSBC, Visa, Freddie Mac, Manulife, Workday, Zoominfo, GSK, Oracle, PubMatic, PhonePe (Walmart), Hersheys, Dun & Bradstreet, and many more. Acceldata is a Series-C funded company and its investors include Insight Partners, March Capital, Lightspeed, Sorenson Ventures, Industry Ventures, and Emergent Ventures.

data.title: Global IT Platform Engineer Director
data.description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact. 

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures-and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. 

What You'll Do

The Senior Site Reliability Engineer is responsible for running the engineering capability behind a defined area of reliability across the organisation. The role works across multiple SRE disciplines including infrastructure, cloud, observability, automation, identity, security, and network operations, applying engineering thinking to reduce operational toil, improve resilience, and embed reliability and governance into delivery and operational workflows. 

The role drives engineering quality and consistency within its scope of responsibility, contributes to wider engineering standards, and helps shape how reliability is delivered across the organisation. It builds reusable patterns, mentors engineers, and provides senior engineering input across a wider set of stakeholders. 

The ideal candidate is a senior practitioner who is comfortable operating across multiple domains, balances delivery with mentorship, and can articulate engineering trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. 

Core Responsibilities

- Run and continuously improve the reliability engineering systems within scope, including automation, pipelines, observability, and operational tooling. 
 - Design and implement engineering solutions that eliminate operational toil at scale and embed reliability into delivery workflows. 
 - Help shape engineering standards, patterns, and reusable frameworks across the SRE practice. 
 - Lead the engineering response to complex incidents within scope, drive systemic remediation, and contribute to post-incident learning. 
 - Mentor and coach less senior engineers across reliability engineering, automation, observability, and SRE principles. 
 - Drive cross-team collaboration with engineering, platform, and operations functions to embed reliability and governance through engineering controls. 
 - Communicate engineering status, risks, and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders and leadership forums. 
 - Contribute to monthly operational reviews with structured metrics on service health, ingestion or pipeline performance, automation coverage, and improvement progress. 

What You'll Bring

- 5-8 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, or related operational engineering disciplines. 
 - Strong hands-on experience across multiple SRE domains, including cloud, automation, observability, and CI/CD. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and implementing automation and reliability solutions at scale. 
 - Deep knowledge of at least one cloud platform (AWS or Azure), including networking, identity, and observability primitives. 
 - Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (e. g. Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Strong scripting experience (e. g. Python). 
 - Experience leading incident response and driving systemic improvement. 
 - Strong stakeholder engagement and technical communication skills. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with one or more enterprise observability platforms (e. g. Splunk, Datadog). 
 - Proven experience designing and operating telemetry pipelines, ingestion controls, and observability cost management. 
 - Proven experience designing signals (SLIs, SLOs, synthetic checks, alerts) and ops automation triggered from those signals. 
 - Experience driving SLO/SLI practices across multiple teams. 
 - Deep hands-on experience operating cloud infrastructure across at least two of AWS, Azure, GCP, or Alibaba Cloud. 
 - Proven experience designing reusable IaC patterns and landing zone components across cloud providers. 
 - Strong working knowledge of cloud networking, account management, identity primitives, and policy enforcement across providers. 
 - Experience driving cloud platform engineering standards and governance across multiple teams. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with identity platforms (e. g. Entra ID) and secrets management (e. g. HashiCorp Vault). 
 - Proven experience designing OIDC, workload identity, and dynamic credential patterns. 
 - Experience driving Zero Trust and least-privilege adoption across multiple teams. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with security tooling embedded in CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Proven experience designing policy-as-code controls and secure-by-default patterns. 
 - Experience driving secure engineering adoption across multiple teams. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with hybrid and cloud network architectures. 
 - Proven experience designing automated network controls through IaC. 
 - Experience driving Zero Trust segmentation and network observability adoption. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working within a federated, multi-cloud, or large enterprise environment. 
 - Familiarity with containerisation (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes). 
 - Experience with secrets management tooling (e. g. HashiCorp Vault). 
 - Cloud certification at professional level. 
 - Experience with policy-as-code tooling (e. g. OPA, Sentinel). 
 - Experience contributing to engineering communities of practice. 
 - Experience with AIOps, noise reduction, and event correlation. 
 - Experience with event-driven ops automation platforms (e. g. ServiceNow, PagerDuty, custom workflows). 
 - Ability to lead complex observability platform incidents and capacity reviews. 
 - Experience with cloud FinOps, cost engineering, and chargeback tooling. 
 - Hands-on experience with Alibaba Cloud platform architecture. 
 - Experience with cloud policy-as-code tools (e. g. AWS Service Control Policies, Azure Policy, OPA). 
 - Strong understanding of identity-related security risks and mitigations. 
 - Strong understanding of common security risks and mitigations across the SDLC. 
 - Strong understanding of network reliability, observability, and security patterns. 

Who You'll Work With

- Hybrid or on-site work model. 
 - Operates as a senior individual contributor with mentorship and cross-team influence. 
 - Expected to participate in on-call rotation and lead incident response. 
 - Occasional travel may be required for team or stakeholder engagement. 

Additional info

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development. 

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices. 

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

About The Job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. 

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions. 

Google Cloud accelerates every organization's ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google's cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

data.description:
Job Description: 

About Us

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. 

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates' physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. 

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. 

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs. 

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Global Business Services

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. 

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. 

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services

Process Overview

The GBS GMO QA team sits within the Global Markets Operations Risk function. The team delivers robust and consistent oversight and support for all forms of GMO Risk performed QA and EIT (Enterprise Independent Testing) performed QA of GMO processes and controls. QA includes in-house QA which is supported by the GMO Risk team and EIT (Enterprise Independent Testing) QA. 

Job Description

The role drives centralized execution and oversight of GMO QA activities, including test design, execution, validation, and reporting. It involves coordinating with FLU and EIT to ensure effective governance, accurate issue resolution, and continuous improvement through data-driven insights and automation. 

undefined

Responsibilities

Support BAU, including the execution of in-house QA testing Manage new tests, modification of tests. Critical partner for EIT and FLU in test design, development and migration to EIT. 

Manage the end-to-end process of test results, critical liaison with FLU including: 

Monitor and accept testing results. 

Investigate and rebut unacceptable results. 

Validate failed tests and ensure satisfactory resolution of valid fails. 

Self-serve and interpret results data, create reporting and manage escalations as necessary. 

Carry out testing of new QA tests (where applicable), 

Manage the implementation of new tests and

Oversee the transition of tests to EIT

Report testing results to FLU

Analyze testing results to identify trends, themes, and systemic issues to drive

remediation and continuous improvement

undefined

Provide overarching governance and oversight of all GMO EIT QA: 

Monitor and oversee EIT as service provider. 

Define the organizational approach for QA, including the rationale for which QA is transitioned to EIT, and which remains. 

Define the organizational approach for test design/test script standards, calculation methodologies and thresholds, change controls and test script reviews. 

Design tests, create test scripts, capture all testing documentation. 

Carry out testing of new QA tests, manage the implementation of new tests and oversee the transition of tests to EIT. 

Define the process and rationale for the proactive review and refresh of QA tests and manage all identified changes. 

QA data analysis - trending, themes etc

To explore and implement automated solutions to create efficiency within the QA process

Requirements

Education: Graduate / Post Graduate. 

Certifications If any: NA

Experience Range: 4-6 Years

Foundational skills: 

- Strong organizational, prioritization, and communication (oral / written) skills with attention to detail· 
 - Strong coordination skills as will need to navigate across several GMO teams and enterprise stakeholders· 
 - High level of attention to detail, ability to self-start and adapt to a fast-paced environment with multiple deliverables. 
 - Able to build/maintain relationships with key stakeholders· 
 - Preferred skills include experience with SharePoint, BI and Tableau reporting, risk data analysis, Alteryx/ETL workflows, and advanced Excel and PowerPoint. 
 - Knowledge of GMO processes and controls is desirable, to be able to understand and define testing requirements for key processes. 
 - Experience in a testing environment is preferred. 
 - Within a risk, regulatory compliance or audit function would be an advantage but not essential

Desired skills: 

- 
 - 2 years of overall experience in banking industry· 
 - Strives to bring new thoughts and ideas to teams in order to drive innovation and unique solutions· 
 - Excels in working among diverse viewpoints to determine the best path forward· 
 - Experience in connecting with a diverse set of clients to understand future business needs - is a continuous learner· 
 - Commitment to challenging the status quo and promoting positive change. 
 - Participate in and drive collaborative efforts to advance tools, technology, and ways of working to better serve an evolving client base· 
 - Believes in value of diversity so we can reflect, connect and meet the diverse needs of our clients and employees around the world 
 - Work Timings: 11: 30 AM to 8: 30 PM IST
 - Job Location: GIFT/ Hyderabad

Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours. 

You are part of a team responsible for experimenting with cutting-edge technologies, delivering solutions by testing and learning and developing strong partnerships to enable growth through innovation and agile methodologies.

You will conduct innovative pilot projects to drive disruptive ideas across the organization, using the learnings from these projects to inform decisions on whether to incorporate them as a portfolio project or to introduce them as a new proof of concept. Working with other Mondelēz teams, you will get to experiment with cutting-edge technologies to build a strong pipeline of ideas to pursue. In addition, you will get to bring the outside in by building relationships with start-ups and building your knowledge of actual proof-of-concept cases and lead end-to-end product management activities after the proof of concept has been successfully adopted. 

What You Will Bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in: 

- Project management including knowledge of Agile

 - Technical and business acumen to evaluate opportunities with internal and external partners
 - Understanding a variety of disruptive technology products and services
 - Machine learning/artificial intelligence programming languages
 - The start-up landscape

 - Driving for results and Analytical skills

More About This Role

The individual in this role will be the process and system expert in Customer Care and Order to Cash, with a focus on AI-powered solutions. Responsible for leading end-to-end project delivery - from scope definition through build, delivery, and deployment - of intelligent Customer Care capabilities including Agentic AI, intelligent insights, automated case management, and human-in-the-loop workflows that improve service quality and reduce manual effort across OTC.

 - Lead the design and delivery of Agentic AI capabilities plus product specific products (SAP; analytics BI/ Databricks)- including intelligent query intake, intent-based routing, case coordination, and automated resolution
 - Partners with MDS community and business stakeholders to understand Customer Care requirements and translate those into technical requirements, AI solution designs, and implementation plans
 - An Application Functional role in a project team to execute and support full project lifecycle including blueprint, build, testing, implementation, user training and post go-live support - with particular focus on AI model validation and confidence tuning
 - Define and implement Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) frameworks for AI-assisted response generation and case resolution oversight
 - Accountable for adherence to Toll Gate Methodology and all appropriate Global release processes
 - Responsible to implement new AI-powered solutions as per the architecture designed by the GSO, enterprise architects and solution architects, ensuring that new solutions are cost optimized and easy to maintain
 - Support non-discretionary projects leveraging an external partner strategy (including AI/cloud vendors)
 - Provides project planning and estimates to develop, implement and roll out pilot and commercialized AI and Customer Care solutions in OTC
 - Ensure adoption of globally harmonized processes, ways of working, and strategic AI solutions within the Customer Care and OTC space

Job specific requirements: 

'- Sales & Distribution, Order to Cash process experience with a focus on Customer Care and case management

- Experience designing or delivering AI/ML or Generative AI solutions (e. g. , intelligent automation, NLP, agentic workflows)
 - DevOps deployment methodologies; TGM methodology understanding, Project/Program Management (internal process can be taught)
 - Good knowledge of sales and distributions of fast-moving retail business processes and related technology solutions
 - Vendor Management, particularly with cloud and AI technology partners (e. g. , AWS)
 - Good understanding of OTC tools, architecture, functions and features - including AI orchestration frameworks (e. g. , AWS Agent Core)
 - Good functional knowledge of SAP SD modules, standard Customer EDI processes (5-7 years' experience minimum)
 - Familiarity with customer query management, case routing, SLA monitoring, and resolution workflows
 - Advanced English level oral and written

Work schedule: Hybrid

No Relocation support available

Business Unit Summary

At Mondelēz International, our purpose is to empower people to snack right by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way. That means delivering a broad range of delicious, high-quality snacks that nourish life's moments, made with sustainable ingredients and packaging that consumers can feel good about. 

We have a rich portfolio of strong brands globally and locally including many household names such as Oreo, belVita and LU biscuits; Cadbury Dairy Milk, Milka and Toblerone chocolate; Sour Patch Kids candy and Trident gum. We are proud to hold the top position globally in biscuits, chocolate and candy and the second top position in gum. 

Our 80, 000 makers and bakers are located in more than 80 countries and we sell our products in over 150 countries around the world. Our people are energized for growth and critical to us living our purpose and values. We are a diverse community that can make things happen-and happen fast.

Job Family

Coding Quality OP (India)

Travel Required

Up to 25%

Clearance Required

None

What You Will Do

- Plans, monitors, direct and evaluate QA production on a daily basis. Ensures that daily schedules are met and communicates with Director, and Coding Operations if situations occur that hinder meeting deadlines. If system issues or other emergencies delay QA, an implement measures/schedules to return to established schedules at the earliest possible time. This should be done closely with each quality specialist to ensure the needs are met and that satisfy our client requirements. 
 - Responsible for ensuring that the QA communicates a valid, workable schedule for his or her client each week. Accurate, sensible & on-time. **If this doesn't happen properly, it's the responsibility of the Lead QA Specialist to make it happen promptly. 
 - Review medical record documentation for accuracy in code assignment of the primary/secondary diagnosis and procedures using ICD-9-CM and CPT-4 coding conventions. Sequence the diagnosis and procedures using coding guidelines. When applicable, ensure MS-DRG/APC assignment is accurate. Abstract and compile data from medical records for appropriate optimal/complaint reimbursement for hospital and/or professional charges. This involves reviewing code assignments that are not straightforward or the documentation in the record is inadequate, ambiguous, or unclear for coding purposes. 
 - Answers queries from the quality staff on a day to day basis and escalating to the Director of Coding as necessary. 
 - Meets agreed sampling targets and accuracy. 
 - Keeps abreast of coding guidelines and reimbursement reporting requirements. 
 - Documents QA data on teams of QA/coders and records findings in the QA system (Guide Audit), which will be for reporting to the client, identifying risk areas, development of training and education programs and development/implementation of standardization within the organization. This also involves guidance and mentorship of coders. 
 - Helps to ensure that continuing education is planned, scheduled and completed for all coding/QA teams through the coordination of the US. 
 - Coordinates scheduled quality meetings with the QA and production staff. 
 - Brings identified concerns to Guidehouse's coding compliance management for discussion. 
 - Project Launch - Active involvement in project launch sessions along with team leaders to understand the coding process. 
 - Have a rotational arrangement and is flexible to work with any given team as assigned. 
 - Abides by the Standards of Ethical Coding as set forth by the American Health Information Management Association and adheres to official coding guidelines. -
 - Maintain a thorough understanding of anatomy and physiology, medical terminology, disease processes and surgical techniques to effectively apply ICD-9-CM and CPT-4 coding guidelines to inpatient and outpatient diagnoses and procedures. 
 - Assist with research and development and presentation of continuing education programs on areas of specialization. 
 - Assist with special projects as required. Example: Focused audits; client launches, etc.

 - Shall report incidents related to security of information to concerned authorities. 

What You Will Need

- Key Skills: Medical Coding

 - ICD-10-PCS coding systems, ensuring accuracy and compliance with all regulatory and reimbursement requirements

- Superior problem-solving abilities
 - Experience mentoring and training Team Leader and Associates. 
 - A flexible mindset to learn.

Title And Summary

Lead Platform Engineer

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. 

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. 

Overview

The Lead Platform Engineer is a hands-on technical leader responsible for designing, building, and maintaining automation frameworks and platform services that support largescale hybrid infrastructure environments. This role focuses on engineering reusable automation patterns using Chef, Infrastructure as Code, and DevOps tooling to deliver consistent, secure, and self-service infrastructure capabilities. The ideal candidate brings strong DevOps engineering experience, deep knowledge of Chef (Infra, Habitat, or Automate), and a passion for building scalable automation systems, not performing manual operations. 

- Design, develop, and maintain Chef cookbooks, recipes, roles, and policy files to automate configuration management across cloud and prem environments. 
 - Build and maintain Chef Automate or equivalent orchestration pipelines for compliance, reporting, and fleet management. 
 - Engineer reusable automation frameworks, including shared libraries, templates, and patterns for consistent infrastructure provisioning. 
 - Integrate Chef automation with CI/CD pipelines, secrets management, artifact repositories, and enterprise governance controls. 
 - Implement automated testing and validation for Chef code using tools such as Test Kitchen, InSpec, and ChefSpec. 
 - Collaborate with cloud, platform, and security teams to define and enforce configuration baselines, compliance policies, and hardened system standards. 
 - Support the design and implementation of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep) for provisioning compute, network, and platform services. 
 - Troubleshoot complex automation, configuration, and infrastructure issues across hybrid environments. 
 - Contribute to platform engineering initiatives such as self-service catalogs, GitOps workflows, and automated remediation. 
 - Document automation patterns, architectural decisions, and operational runbooks. 

All bout you

- 5-8+ years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, or configuration management roles. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Chef Infra, including cookbook development, policy files, Test Kitchen, and InSpec. 
 - Experience managing largescale configuration management environments (Chef Server, Chef Automate, or similar). 
 - Solid understanding of Linux systems administration, OS hardening, and configuration of lifecycle management. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and on Prem virtualization (VMware, HyperV). 
 - Strong scripting or programming skills (Ruby preferred for Chef, plus Python, Bash, or PowerShell). 
 - Experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps. 
 - Strong understanding of Git workflows, branching strategies, and code review practices. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot complex automation and infrastructure issues across hybrid environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Chef Habitat or application-level automation. 
 - Experience with Chef Automate for compliance, reporting, and fleet orchestration. 
 - Familiarity with Terraform or other IaC tools for provisioning infrastructure. 
 - Experience with policyascode tools (OPA, Conftest, Sentinel). 
 - Background in security hardening, compliance frameworks, or CIS benchmarks. 
 - Exposure to Kubernetes, Helm, or container orchestration. 
 - Experience with monitoring and observability platforms (Prometheus, Datadog, Splunk, ELK). 
 - Knowledge of network automation or infrastructure APIs. 
 - Core Technical Skills (Competency Areas)
 - Configuration Management
 - Chef Infra (cookbooks, recipes, policy files)
 - Chef Automate, InSpec, Test Kitchen
 - Ruby development for automation
 - Infrastructure as Code & Provisioning
 - Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep (preferred but not required)

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

Test Strategy & Implementation

 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

Here's what you'll need

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm. , M. Pharm. , B. Tech or BE or MSc.

Technical Skills

- Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis.

 - Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities across national and international locations.

data.title: Senior Design Engineer
data.description:
About Aion

aion is the enterprise AI platform, a full-stack solution for building, fine-tuning, and deploying AI at scale. Whether an organization is modernizing internal operations, launching AI-powered products, or transforming customer experiences, aion takes them from concept to production on a single, unified platform. 

We're a fast-growing, VC-backed startup led by founders with a track record of successful exits. With teams across the US, UK, and India, we're building the next generation of enterprise AI and we're looking for exceptional people to help us scale. 

We're hiring a design engineer who builds like a founder. You see what's missing and make it exist: you design it, build it, ship it and own it. Code is your design material, and you write a shader when CSS runs out. The bar is an interface that feels physical: it tracks the finger, carries momentum and never drops a frame. 

What You'll Do

- Take ideas from a blank file to production: decide what's worth building, prototype it in code, and own it once it ships
 - Build production UI in React and TypeScript, from primitives to complete surfaces
 - Build the custom tools that make the team faster: design-system tooling, motion tuners, debug overlays and internal apps
 - Tune motion and gestures until they feel physical: momentum, weight and interruption
 - Create 3D, shader and generative work where it lifts the experience
 - Review every build on real devices at 1× and 2×, and keep it fast, accessible and robust under abuse

Requirements

Interaction

- You treat interaction design as thinning the layer between intent and software, and your work has moments where the interface inferred what someone wanted instead of asking
 - Physics is a toolkit to you, not a style: springs tuned by stiffness, damping and mass; velocity projected on release so a flick finishes the job; rubber banding where a hard stop would feel broken; secondary elements interpolated from the gesture driving them
 - You give movement conceptual weight: light things settle quickly, heavy and destructive things resist, and bounce appears only where something was thrown
 - Your gestures have three beats, constrain on start, track 1: 1 on move, resolve on end, and stay contained: no stray text selection, no triggered neighbours, no pointer lost at the edge
 - Choreography is second nature: the primary element answers instantly, secondary elements follow late, exits clear faster than entrances arrive, and a touch of blur hides the seams
 - Your restraint scales with frequency and input: touch gets the most feedback, the pointer some, the keyboard almost none, and anything used a hundred times a day loses its animation

Craft

- You build without waiting: when a tool, component or prototype doesn't exist, you make it, and you've shipped things of your own that people use
 - Code is your design material. You judge an idea by building and using it, prototype in the browser rather than in static frames, and polish only once the idea has earned it
 - You iterate until nothing is left to explore, then have the discipline to choose the simple version from many iterations back
 - Robustness is binary to you: you spam every state, scroll too fast, drag past every edge, and cut any detail that can't work every time
 - You see at the pixel: optical alignment at high zoom, animations scrubbed frame by frame, and before-and-after captures on every change
 - Native first: real scroll over hijacked wheel events, clip-path over animating width, CSS keyframes before reaching for a library
 - You study the work you admire by rebuilding it, then make something unmistakably your own

Engineering

- 5+ years shipping production front ends, with live work you can link to
 - React and TypeScript at expert level, with component APIs that don't lie: contextual props, derived state, variants over boolean flags and compound components
 - Motion values and direct DOM updates for anything high-frequency, so gestures and scroll never wait on a render
 - CSS in depth: clip-path, masks, backdrop filters, blend modes, scroll-driven animations, container queries and the View Transitions API
 - Type and pixels in code: variable fonts, optical sizing, OpenType features, and layouts free of shift and subpixel blur at 1×, 2× and 3×
 - Performance as a feature: an 8 ms frame budget at 120 Hz, compositor-only animation, and pages that load instantly because every byte was questioned
 - Accessibility as craft: focus rings styled rather than removed, focus moved into overlays and back, full keyboard paths and reduced-motion settings honoured

3D and creative

- Real-time 3D with Three. js or React Three Fiber on WebGL or WebGPU
 - Shaders in GLSL or WGSL: noise, signed distance fields, glass, refraction, lighting and post-processing, all inside the frame budget
 - Motion studies in After Effects and 3D in Cinema 4D or Blender, so ideas move before a line of production code exists
 - Generative and data-driven work in Canvas and SVG, and interactive animation in Rive

Building for AI

- Interfaces for streamed, non-deterministic output: progressive rendering, interruption and retry
 - You build daily with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, use them to ship whole tools and products on your own, and review every line they write

Good to have

- Custom tools you built that others rely on: plugins, design and motion tooling, debug overlays, generators or internal apps
 - Something you started and shipped yourself: a product, a studio, a library or a side project with real users/customers
 - Writing and articles about your craft: essays, breakdowns or notes that show how you think
 - Creative coding or generative art
 - Open-source work in motion, graphics or UI components

Benefits

- Work directly with high-pedigree founders shaping technical and product strategy
 - Build infrastructure powering the future of AI compute globally
 - Significant ownership and impact with equity reflective of your contributions
 - Competitive compensation, flexible work options, and wellness benefits

Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1, 500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. 

The Role

Did you know? Alternative investing has the potential to generate higher returns compared to traditional investments over the long term. AI and Machine Learning are revolutionizing the way alternative investments are managed and analyzed. Investors are using these technologies to gain insights, see opportunities, and optimize their investment strategies. 

Addepar is building solutions to support our clients' alternatives investment strategies. The alternatives data management product is a serverless, modular and terraformed stack. We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to design, implement and deliver modern software solutions that ingest and process ML-extracted data. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including data scientists and product managers to build intuitive solutions that revolutionize how clients experience alternatives operations. 

You will work closely with operations engineering on document-based workflow automation and peer engineering teams to define the tech stack. You will iterate quickly through cycles of testing a new product offering on Addepar. If you've crafted scalable systems, or worked with phenomenal teams on hard problems in financial data, or are just interested in solving really hard technical, critically important problems, come join us!

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. 

What You'll Do

- Architect, implement, and maintain engineering solutions to solve complex problems; write well-designed, testable code.

 - Collaborate with machine learning engineers to bring ML-extracted data into the backend stack of the application in Python or other languages.

Who You Are

 - Familiarity with writing, debugging, and optimizing SQL queries

 - Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
 - Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success. 
 - Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
 - Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews, " and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar. com.

data.title: HEAD QUALITY - CLUSTER
data.description:
JOB PURPOSE

Lead and manage the quality assurance function across the assigned cluster, ensuring that the right quality of products is consistently manufactured to meet customer requirements. Drive customer satisfaction by resolving quality issues and fostering continuous improvement at all manufacturing plants within the cluster. Provide guidance to Plant Quality Heads to achieve uniformity and excellence in quality processes and outcomes. 

This role ensures product quality consistency, impacting customer satisfaction, warranty claims, and overall cluster efficiency. Metrics for success include improved customer quality ratings and reduced defect rates. 

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

1. Customer Quality Assurance

- Lead efforts to resolve customer complaints by ensuring the root cause is identified and corrective actions are implemented across all plants in the cluster. 
 - Monitor and improve customer satisfaction metrics, including rejection PPM (internal and external), and warranty claim reduction. 
 - Act as the primary liaison between customers and cluster quality teams to align on quality standards, manage expectations, and address escalations promptly. 
 - Ensure consistent communication and reporting of quality metrics and improvement initiatives to customers and corporate quality teams. 2. Product Quality Assurance

- Ensure all manufacturing plants within the cluster adhere to defined product quality standards and processes. 
 - Oversee quality audits conducted by plant teams to ensure compliance with customer and regulatory requirements. 
 - Regularly review quality performance metrics with Plant Quality Heads, identify gaps, and define improvement actions. 
 - Drive standardization of quality processes and best practices across the cluster to maintain uniformity in quality outputs3. Quality Management System

- Implement Varroc Quality Management System in all Plants in the Cluster
 - Monitor review activities to sustain certification requirements of the customers, including self-audits and audits by customers. Facilitate certification by external third-party agencies such as IATF through yearly plant surveillance audits
 - Coordinate observations from all plant audits through Plant Quality Head and Plant Head for reporting and submission to the customer
 - Ensure that Product / process change follow established process4. Guidance to Plant Quality Heads

- Provide strategic direction and operational support to Plant Quality Heads, ensuring alignment with cluster-level quality goals. 
 - Establish clear quality-related expectations and review the performance of Plant Quality Heads through regular assessments and feedback sessions. 
 - Act as a bridge between Plant Quality Heads and the Regional Quality to address escalations and implement cluster-wide quality improvement initiatives. 
 - Facilitate collaboration among Plant Quality Heads to share best practices and address common challenges. 5. Continuous Improvement in Quality

- Lead initiatives to drive continuous improvement in product quality, focusing on reducing internal and external defects. 
 - Oversee the implementation of corrective and preventive actions for recurring quality issues. 
 - Promote a culture of quality and accountability by fostering ownership of quality metrics at all levels within the cluster. 6. Team Development and Management

- Recruit, mentor, and manage a high-performing MP&L team across the cluster. 
 - Conduct regular performance reviews and identify skill development opportunities for team members. 
 - Foster a culture of continuous improvement and accountability

QUALIFICATION

- Minimum Qualification required: BE / B. Tech (Electrical / Electronic Preferred)
 - Preferred Qualification: ME / M. Tech / MBA

WORK EXPERIENCE

- Minimum 15-20 years of experience in Quality Management, with a strong focus on Customer Quality Assurance. 
 - Strong Exposure to Manufacturing Quality in terms of understanding the Components (Automotive Electrical / Electronics) & its Manufacturing Processes - MANDATORY
 - Experience in handling Automotive OEM customers (2W OEM Customers preferred) - MANDATORY. 
 - Proven track record in managing quality teams and quality processes in an automotive industry
 - Expertise in core quality tools (APQP, FMEA, SPC, QMS) and customer engagement. 

REPORTING -

- The position reports administratively to the Manufacturing Cluster Head & Functionally to the Head - Quality & EHS (Manufacturing India)
 - The position has Plant level teams reporting to it

WORKING WEEK (6 days/Week): The position is based at our Manufacturing Cluster & requires the incumbent to work for 6 days / week from the Manufacturing Cluster. 

RELOCATION

Outstation Candidates will have to RE-LOCATE to Chh. Sambhajinagar and will be eligible to avail benefits under the Relocation Policy.

data.title: Senior CQV Engineer
data.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

The Sr. CQV Engineer will be responsible for leading the efforts for commissioning, qualification, and validation of equipment/ systems, and processes in the production of Drug substances/ Drug Product/ Sterile Facilities/ API/ OSDs, as well as the Utility system, HVAC system and Area. 

The role will require the leadership of an experienced, energetic, and committed Senior CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals. 

The person should have experience of leading a team of CQV engineers for a project and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle from SLIA generation through to OQ completion. The lead will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and coordinate CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations. 
 - To prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan. 
 - Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level. 
 - Track progress of C&Q activities as required and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders. 
 - Ensure effective resource planning, including coordinating materials, spares and consumables for commissioning and qualification activities. 
 - Identify and mitigate project risks while ensuring project deliverables meet required quality and compliance standards. 
 - Provide leadership in team meetings and facilitate problem-solving discussions to ensure project milestones are met. 
 - Act as the primary point of contact between clients, internal teams, and external vendors to drive project success. 
 - Management of Contractors and Vendors, document control, punch list management. 
 - Participate in design, constructability, and commissioning reviews to ensure technical aspects are covered in the Commissioning Plan and schedule. 
 - Well versed with risk-based approaches to C&Q (e. g. , ASTM E2500, ISPE)
 - Conduct risk assessments and gap analysis for process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities, to identify critical process parameters and control strategies. 
 - Developing system boundaries for the system at an early stage of C&Q. 
 - Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports. 
 - Experienced in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems. 
 - Participate in design document reviews and ensure that quality aspects are included in design. 
 - Review vendor documents (CTOPs/ VTOPs) to support commissioning and qualification requirements. 
 - Ensures C&Q non-conformances or deviations are minimized during execution of CQV activities. For issues that do arise ensure they are closed out in a timely manner. 
 - Track and confirm closure of actions items identified through FAT, HAZOP, Design Qualification and other reviews. 
 - Perform shakedown during commissioning and qualification of systems on site. 
 - Field Walkdowns of systems as part of transfer of ownership of the system from Construction. 
 - System Startup activities

Working Conditions

- The position requires travel and/ or deputation to other sites or manufacturing facilities. 
 - Ability to work in a cleanroom environment and adhere to gowning requirements. 
 - Flexibility to work outside of regular business hours as needed to support project timelines

Here's what you'll need

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm. , M. Pharm. , B. Tech or BE or MSc. 
 - 10-15 year's experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing. 
 - Candidates must have proven experience of carrying out commissioning and qualification activities on multiple projects. 
 - Have functioned as CQV Lead level for at least one Project. 

Technical Skills

- Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis. 
 - In-depth knowledge of cGMP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory requirements. 
 - Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities across national and international locations. 
 - Experience with process validation and computer system validation. 
 - Experience on DCS/ PCS system such as Delta-V, 800xA, etc. 
 - Familiarity with Construction management software such as EIDA, PIMS, Aconex, is an advantage. 
 - Familiarity with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and Valgenesis is an advantage. 

Soft Skills

- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a results-oriented mindset. 
 - Strong project management and organizational skills. 
 - Effective communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients' expectations. 

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you. 

At Jacobs it's all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. 

Your application experience is important to us, and we're keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

data.title: Senior Automation Engineer
data.description:
We're looking for an experienced QA Automation Engineer to lead API quality for a Spring Boot microservices platform hosted on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You'll design, build, and maintain scalable API automation frameworks using Java, RestAssured or Karate, and BDD practices, while integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. 

In this role, you'll collaborate with developers, product teams, architects, and integration partners to shape testable designs, identify quality risks, and ensure services meet functional, performance, and security standards. You'll help define QA strategy and team practices, manage test cases and execution using Jira and Xray, and use AI-enabled tools to support test design, automation, and analysis. 

The ideal candidate brings strong Java and API testing expertise, experience with Spring Boot, cloud-native technologies, Docker, Kubernetes, and GCP, plus familiarity with Agile delivery, databases, Git, and CI/CD tools. Knowledge of API security, contract or performance testing, monitoring tools, and eCommerce is an advantage. A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field is preferred. 

- Leadership and Strategy
 - Develop and execute a comprehensive API automation strategy aligned with the organization's quality goals. 
 - Identify and introduce innovative testing approaches, tools, and technologies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of QA processes. 
 - Stay current with trends in API automation, AI-assisted testing, and cloud-native testing, and apply them where they add value. 
 - Promote a culture of quality ownership and accountability within the team. 
 - API Automation Development
 - Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable API automation frameworks using Java, RestAssured (or Karate), and BDD principles (Cucumber/Gherkin). 
 - Write clean, well-documented, maintainable automation scripts to validate API functionality, performance, and security. 
 - Implement data-driven testing strategies to ensure comprehensive test coverage. 
 - Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI) for continuous testing. 
 - Build reusable frameworks and integrate SaaS frameworks to improve scalability and efficiency.

 - Apply API security testing principles (for example, OWASP) and validate data quality, including with large datasets. 
 - AI-Enabled Testing

 - Set up and configure AI agents to automate testing tasks and speed up test design, execution, and analysis. 
 - Evaluate new AI models and tools, and recommend how the team should adopt them. 
 - Test Management with Jira and Xray
 - Create, organize, and maintain test cases in Xray. 
 - Integrate Xray with Jira to provide traceability between requirements, tests, executions, and defects. 
 - Build and manage test catalogs and test sets in Xray. 
 - Plan and track test execution and report results in Jira and Xray. 
 - Keep test plans, procedures, scripts, results, and configuration documented in Git, Confluence/SharePoint, and Jira. 
 - Collaboration and Communication
 - Work with developers, product managers, architects, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and ensure testability. 
 - Participate in design and architecture reviews to give feedback on testability and flag quality risks early. 
 - Work with extended integration partner teams to define and execute exploratory and automated API tests. 
 - Communicate test results and quality metrics to stakeholders clearly and concisely. 
 - Take part in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives) and contribute to product design and architecture discussions. 
 - Quality Assurance and Best Practices
 - Establish and enforce QA guidelines, best practices, and standards across the team. 
 - Review code actively to ensure software quality and functional accuracy. 
 - Ensure all code follows secure coding practices and maintains code coverage of at least 70%. 
 - Write and maintain unit tests with JUnit or TestNG where applicable. 
 - Coding and Development
 - Complete coding tasks to design specifications, with high quality and on schedule. 
 - Work under the guidance of a Technical Architect and contribute to the overall system design. 
 - Use Git and collaboration platforms such as GitHub, Bitbucket, or GitLab for version control and code reviews. 
 - Cloud and Platform Testing
 - Validate microservices built with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud, including RESTful APIs and dependency-injection-based components. 
 - Test services deployed on GCP (for example, Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions), using Docker and Kubernetes environments. 
 - Validate data in relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL datastores (MongoDB, Cassandra). 
 - Operational Support
 - Handle operational issues with minimal oversight, and troubleshoot and resolve problems quickly. 
 - Use monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) to diagnose issues where available. 
 - Nice-to-Have Contributions
 - Implement contract testing with Pact or similar frameworks. 
 - Run performance tests with JMeter or Gatling. 
 - Apply eCommerce domain knowledge to improve test scenarios and coverage. 

Education

Experience

- 8-12 years of experience in software development and quality assurance, with a strong focus on API automation. 
 - Experience working in Agile teams and taking part in sprint ceremonies. 

API Automation

- Extensive hands-on experience with RestAssured for API testing. 
 - Proficiency in BDD frameworks such as Cucumber/Gherkin. 
 - Experience with API testing tools such as Postman, Swagger, Hoppscotch, or ReadyAPI. 
 - Knowledge of API security testing principles and tools (for example, OWASP). 
 - Experience designing data-driven tests and building reusable automation frameworks. 

AI Tools and Automation

- Familiarity with a range of AI models and their strengths. 
 - Comfortable using AI models in day-to-day testing, including creating test cases and identifying test scenarios. 
 - Experience setting up AI agents for test automation. 

Java and Spring Boot

- Strong proficiency in Java and related open-source technologies. 
 - Hands-on experience with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud for building microservices. 
 - Working knowledge of dependency injection, RESTful APIs, and other core Spring concepts. 

Cloud Technologies

- Solid understanding of cloud-native technologies and architectures.

 - Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, and Cloud Functions. 

Testing Frameworks and Tools

Test Management (Jira and Xray)

Quality and Secure Coding

data.description:
Role Purpose

The Team Lead will supervise a sub-team of analysts responsible for cash and position reconciliation activities. They act as the first line of operational oversight, ensuring accurate and timely reconciliation output, break resolution, and adherence to process controls. The Team Lead plays a key role in coaching analysts, managing day-to-day workflow, and escalating exceptions appropriately to the Team Manager. 

Key Responsibilities

- Daily Reconciliation Oversight
 - Oversee end-of-day and intraday cash & Position reconciliation across all accounts and asset classes providing both L1 and L2 services. 
 - Review and validate reconciliation outputs completed by analysts before submission. 
 - Monitor break queues and ensure timely investigation and resolution of exceptions. 
 - Coordinate with custodians, counterparties, and internal teams to clear outstanding items. 
 - Team Supervision & Development
 - Allocate daily work to analysts, monitor progress, and ensure SLA timelines are met. 
 - Provide on-the-job training, guidance, and feedback to analysts.

 - Maintain accurate records of breaks, resolutions, and exception logs. 
 - Support the Team Manager in audit preparation and compliance reviews. 
 - Reporting & Communication
 - Prepare and submit daily/weekly break reports and exception summaries to the Team Manager. 
 - Participate in internal team meetings and represent the team in operational calls. 
 - Proactively communicate operational risks or issues to the Team Manager. 
 - Process Improvement
 - Identify repetitive manual tasks and suggest improvements or automation opportunities. 
 - Support implementation of process changes and new reconciliation workflows. 
 - Share knowledge and best practices within the team to improve overall quality. 

Key Requirements

Experience & Skills

- 6-8 years of experience in cash and/or position reconciliation within financial services or banking operations. 
 - Prior experience in a supervisory or lead capacity managing junior team members.

 - Good understanding of trade lifecycle, settlements, corporate actions, and fund accounting. 
 - Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and ability to manage multiple priorities.

Hello Visionary!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We're looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. Siemens Mobility is an independent run company of Siemens AG.
